text: Some of the fare on offer at That BBQ Place is wildly overpriced, especially given the fact that real cutlery, proper table service, and glassware are all missing.  While this place is as neat as a pin and while it offers very friendly service, I'm unlikely to return.  It won't matter, though, for it's busy enough that my custom is unlikely to be missed.  Their ribs still lack bark and they remain too moist for my liking.  In the end, Sherwood Parkers seem to like the place and that's all that matters for the owners.

Care more about your customers.
I went to fresh healthy cafe for a mid morning smoothly with my wife. There was no one in the restaurant when we got there. I ordered a smoothy and my wife ordered a latte and a parfait. The parfaits are premade and quite good. The latte came out just as she was finishing her parfait (5 minutes ish), I continued to wait at least a couple of more minutes for my smoothy. I could have made it faster at home. When I did get it, it was not worth the wait. There was far too much ice... They give you a wide slurpy straw to make up for the increased ice volume, it's just not the consistency I like and had very little flavour because if the high ice volume.

It's nice to see a healthy option place in my new neighbourhood, but I hope that they vastly improve their service and quality.

Haircuts? Usually pretty great. Stylists have always been very friendly. But I will never understand why the management is so incompetent. There are far more chairs than stylists, 100% consistently. What this leads to is a lot of my time being wasted stopping by only to find the wait is an hour and a half. Every. Single. Weekday. So many stations, not enough staff. I want to give them my money, but it's almost like they enjoy shooing off potential customers with ludicrous wait times. 

Stylists: keep it up!
Management: take some courses and learn how to properly staff your salon.

--
Yikes! management seem to have found a way to delete my Google review...
Anyhow, I called in on Aug 26-27-28 (forget which) at about 5:49pm, and mid-sentence I was rudely hung up upon by the girl on the phone just because I said that I didn't want to put my name on the list. Guess I wasn't important because I wouldn't offer immediate patronage?

Tried to come in yesterday too and, once again, at 2pm they already had a sign saying they weren't taking in any more names for the day. I noted that most seats had no working stylists. STAFF THE PLACE ALREADY!

Just tried this place for the first time today and I'm so sad because I've been living here for four years and now I'm just discovering it! Super fresh breads, ingredients, home made soups, similar to fife and dekel but without the pies. Reasonably priced, and it's got a Grandma's sandwich shop feel to it (in the best way possible). I got a Montreal meat sandwich and the pastrami barley soup, both were SO good and I can't wait to come back here again!!

This review incident dates back to 2009 but I still truly feel "hot under the collar" about my used car experience with Sherwood Kia.

I bought a 2002 Sunfire, cash, off the lot. The salesman was pushy, rude, and very ignorant. Upon the test drive the car was was hesitating as I was shifting gears and he said that they would look at the problem before I left the lot if I bought the car. I paid $3000 for it and needless to say....what a piece of *%#@! Everything that was checked off their "maintenance report" saying was in good condition had to be replaced within the first week I had the car as I took it to a reputable mechanic.

SO....7 days, I asked for my money back!!! I got the run around so bad that I eventually wrote a letter to the owner (AFTER NO ONE WAS RETURNING MY CALLS) and the Used Car dept. manager (whoever) called me after another 2 weeks and asked me to come in. I went in there asked for the manager and then I stood in the dealership for 30-minutes before he came up to me. Well....we got into a yelling match in the parking lot after I was in tears and yelling inside and threatened to call the BBB, tell everyone of FB, and whoever else would listen that...get this...(his exact words)..."We DO NOT guarantee quality used vehicles"!!!! I'm not kidding! I never got my money back and I REFUSE to ever do business there again!!!!

The donair meat was very cheap tasting....like it came out of a can or something gross.   The place looks run down.  We won't be back.  People who think this is the best donair have lived a very sheltered life in the land of donairs!  This is probably one of my worst ones!

The best prices and best quality donair I have had in ages. Quality ingredients, your choice of meat and sauce and ingredients. Awesome selection on top of awesome prices and you cannot go wrong. 10/10 would recommend. Only downside was the lineup at prime time for lunch (1230) however did get in and out within 15 minutes.

This is the best BBQ place in these parts! The sandwiches, the brisket and the ribs are amazing! Side are so good, beans and corn bread you can not go wrong. The special sandwich of brisket, smoked pork and smoked turkey with smoked cheese on top might be the best sando in Alberta!

Wow. I was really impressed with the taste of the burgers and fries at Five Guys. They stand head and shoulders above other fast food joints in Edmonton (and area). 

I went to In 'N' Out when I was in Vegas, loved it, and was talking to a friend about wishing we had them here. She said the closest thing was Five Guys, and she was right!

I went on a Sunday afternoon around 1pm, and it was busier than I expected it to be. There seemed to be a little bit of organized chaos going on behind the counter, but they must have their system down. Our food came pretty quickly.

Now, all the burgers come with two patties as the standard, so if you only want one, order the 'little (burger name)'. I had a little bacon burger, my husband had a regular sized bacon burger, we and shared large cajun fries - everything came to $18. Holy moly, yum. Just delicious. Kind of indescribable, actually, which is a little funny for a fast food burger. It was just so fresh and juicy and actually tasted like something, rather than a slab of cardboard with ketchup on it. The cajun fries were nice, too, although I still want to try the regular fries sometime. Even though I got a little burger, I still couldn't finish it!

I wish there was a Five Guys in Edmonton, but for now I'll have to settle for hitting this one up when I'm in ShPk. Sure it's more expensive than "regular" fast food, but it's also way tastier.
Great food. Great atmosphere. The decor is really nice. Modern and cozy. I had lasagna and it was one of the best lasagna I've ever had. Hubby had risotto loved it as well. Service was good.

This is my fourth visit.   It's much improved from our first visit but still not yummy.  The brisket, while not petrified, was still dry and chewy.  I'm not sure whether the bun was stale or just not to my liking.  It was kinda dry too but that might be the way its supposed to be.  I liked the mashed potato side.  Fairly garlicky.   Coleslaw too saucy for me but not bad. In general, I love brisket on a bun....but here it's .....passable.  Not something to make a point of coming out for.

I was in this store yesterday to purchase a new wireless home phone which were on sale for about 55.00.  First i waited for approximately 10 minutes to have the case opened which the large box for the phone was in.   Then I was told by a very young employee that they needed to walk me up.  As if I was under arrest and needed an escort to purchase a 55.00 phone.   I took a look around me and could have many products in smaller boxes with higher values in my cart with no escort.   I told the cashier that i found this practise very insulting to which she very RUDELY replied.  the "POLICY CARD".  The policy on this is made by the owner of the store.   I have had many rude shopping experiences in this store and this is the last straw.   I am looking into defamation of character charges and also my civil rights. This is the same store that was investigated in 2004 for illegally collecting drivers licence information for returns.    Which was another one of my rude experiences in this store.    My point is if you don't want to leave a shopping experience feeling like a criminal please stay out of this store.   This store has been know to push policy to invade your privacy and now treats its customers as criminals.    

I feel very sad that it is allowed to use the word CANADIAN in its name which I attribute to politeness.   

The owner of this store needs to be taken to task.

I am from Saskatchewan and when I came to Alberta I hated shopping around for insurance as customer service in this province seems like a myth.  Millennium is amazing...I reside in Leduc and use millennium even though they are in Sherwood park because they are that good.  Amazing prices, great service and prompt.  Good job peeps.

Food was ...okay. Seating was super slow for a Friday night with tables open and 4 girls at the front desk looking confused. Service was good and the food came surprisingly fast. Ordered a beef dip and it was the ends of the roast by the looks. All the meat was shredded and falling out of the bun. But the au jus was good. Kids had chicken strips and husband had a blackened chicken sandwich. We were super hungry by the time we were seated so the food went down fast. Waitress was pleasant but rushed and took a long time to come back after dropping off a dessert menu. We probably won't be back for a while (if ever) there are better options within the same distance.

This earls has done a really good job changing the atmosphere from what it used to be, to what it is today. 
I went to earls for a chamber if commerce mixer where the food is free and the drinks are a la carte. They served pulled pork coleslaw spoons which were amazing. I had a sous chef that kept coming my way with the served trays because he could see it in my eyes how much I liked them.  The other item was some sort of sushi roll, which always blows my mind that a place that's not a sushi restaurant can execute a sushi roll so well when a lot of real sushi restaurants are not good at all. Thank you earls for having legit red seal chefs.
The only reason this isn't 5 stars is that they crammed 60+ people into an area designed for no more than 30. At least I got to know people a little better, which was the whole point of the mixer!

It is with great disappointment that I have recently discovered Earls has removed their "iceberg" beers and they are no longer available for purchase. My friends and I often spend multiple nights per week at this establishment eating dynamite rolls (which are top notch) and drinking Keith's icebergs. The iceberg is a staple in the pre-whyte ave drinking scene, and no doubt accounted for a large part of this particular business' profit. I am not a restaurant manager, but to me it seems like a poor decision to remove such an item from the menu. My vists here will be a lot less frequent indeed. A 5 star rating would have been well deserved if icebergs were still on the drink menu.

I love this place, both their hamburgers and hot dogs are amazing. The cheese, not so much, too thick and plastic like. I'm also not crazy about the fries, but that is personal taste, not anything to do with the restaurant, I like a crispier fry. I do love the Cajun seasoning though. Very tasty.  Staff are all your typical teenager type workers, and the service has always been very good. I ABSOLUTELY love the complimentary peanuts. I think it's a fun and tasty way to pass the time (not that the wait is long either) til you get your yummy food.

Great BBQ!  Just moved up from the States and heard about this place from my husband's co- workers. 
Definitely worth the drive from Edmonton. Everything was fresh, the meat was tender and moist.  Our big family had everything from ribs to brisket to pork sandwiches, and everything was great.  Super kid friendly and the owner and his daughter were wonderful. Glad we're moving to the area- this will be our go- to BBQ joint!

Be careful of your credit cards, people. I have never set foot in this location. Somebody working at this Red Robin location in September MANUALLY ENTERED - not one, but TWO - cash advances for $500 each using our company credit card number that was stolen from a retail location in Red Deer.
VISA and RCMP are working on the file, but, it's one thing to innocently take a fraudulent card, but when you process a "cash advance" at a place of business that doesn't deal in cash advances - either a staff member or a manager is crooked. Taking $500 cash from the float on two different occasions and then balancing the cash after doing so is no accident. That is something that should have been noticed at audit - and the fact that it wasn't, shows that the criminality is higher up the ladder than one would think...Shame on you Red Robin Sherwood Park!

Brianna provides the best service to me every night I see her. Kaela is one of the greatest, always look forward to seeing her. I keep coming back just because of them. NOBODY ELSE. Except for Jenna Boyd. I love jenna.

On dec 4th went for dinner at earls in Sherwood Park. I have not been there for awhile as it is usually too busy to get  in Anyways they  have done renovations since,so went too see and I was not impressed.They use high end materials from cultural stone to beautiful light fixtures but when u look around it is all booths just like Humphrey s. No privacy, and no class......and still noisy

Went in tonight for supper . Right off we weren't greeted with any hello or friendly greeting . Waitress was miserable and seemed like she hates her job . Wrong choice of profession . We got water and left within minutes . I hope the business owner realizes the staff he has working for him/her . It's unfortunate.

Why do I always forget to take pictures here??  argh!  

Actually... there's a simple explanation for that.  I forget to take pictures of the establishment because I'm so excited and distracted by the smells and decisions that need to be made.  I signed up for their emails YEARS ago and now every single week I get an email that tells me what their soups and salads are for the week, as well as what their hot special is each day.

More often than not I go for the turkey sandwhich.  You won't find processed deli meats here... it's real, fresh tasting turkey and they ALWAYS have cranberry sauce on hand for it.  yum.  It's a build your own sandwich type place, similar to Fife n dekel in Edmonton, if you're familiar.  The veggie toppings are pretty standard, and they also have various mustards and spreads available for you.

One of the hot specials this week pulled me in.. it was the perogies.  I'm a sucker for a great homemade perogies, and I just knew they wouldn't be serving me cheemos!  I can't say I was disappointed, but I'll admit that they were not as good as I hoped they would be.  Just a tad bland.  But the sausage that was served with it really made up for that.  SO GOOD.

Once in a while they have a meatball sub special that seems to be really popular.  I'll have to try it out.  And maybe I'll remember to take some damn pictures!!

I was here with 4 adults and 2 kids not satisfied with the food at all.very disappointed.
I will not. Be going back their 
Not 1 of us was impressed

This hidden gem in Sherwood Park has the potential to be one of the greats but the atmosphere is terrible. 

I debated given this place a 4 star rating but I can't because of the atmosphere. It doesn't suit the food. I'm not sure what they were trying to go for but the name of the restaurant doesn't match the decor. A fish tank in the middle? Huh? Silver furniture? Ok? 

Half of a restaurant experience relies on the atmosphere. At least for me. 

Now I want to talk about the food. Amazing! I had their chicken club sandwich for lunch and it delivered on taste and presentation. Serving a sandwich on a cutting board fits the restaurant name and the menu item. The bread was toasted well. The chicken was juicy and the condiments well balanced. 

If atmosphere isn't important to you, go here.  I really wished they would have done a complete remodel from the past 3 restaurants that occupied this space before they took over. Disappointing. I hope things turn around for them and they invest in a reno. It would be a shame to lose this restaurant.

I attended with a party of four on a Friday evening. The atmosphere is beautiful with elegant woodwork.  It was not even half full and the service was horrible.  it took forever for any request.  so lets break this out:
Design: 5, love the wood work, feels slightly elegant

Atmosphere: 3, would have liked to hear Italian music not 80-90s music over satelite

Service: 2, our waitress was hard to understand and obviously did not know enough about Italian food as some of our food requests they didn't list was basic, like pasta with garlic and oil.
Number one rule as a server, NEVER LET A DRINK GO DRY !!!!!. The server.....she made several major mistakes with drinks and general service.  Ladies should always be served first, wine should be first poured by the server and not plopped on the table with glasses. bringing condiments for your meal 10 minutes after we start eating is useless (pepper and cheese).   i watched a male server working away and he had his "A" game on. i watched a table come in well after us and leave before we got our meal.  The female we had was sleeping or was following snails to our table...WAKE UP !!!!

Food:  2, poorly timed dishes,  two plates came out so they sat as we waited for the other two. 4:30 minutes go by....wow finally the other two come...if the food inspector ever came by they would certainly fail the food temperature test, several dishes were luke warm at best.  the flavor of the dishes were blah, except the pasta with garlic.  one dish had veal and it was tough meat.  The other two dishes had chicken and they were dry and tough.

Price:3, the prices are way to high for what you get, i had a dish that was $25.95 that was worth maybe $19.95 at best, my friend had meatballs, that was priced at $14.95, that's reasonable and the portion was good sized. 

As a server you are the first and last person to represent the brand and a restaurant, if you fail as a server in your duties you are failing the business and the doors will close fast.

I hope the owners read this

I cannot say enough amazing things about this place!!! I had my wedding ceremony and they were incredible. They were communicative, efficient and caring. They made sure to check in even during the process of our event. The decorating they did for us was top notch. You could tell that they really cared and wanted it to be special for us. They made signs for us and allowed us to take photos wherever. The staff were out of this world and made sure to assist in keeping our event private. I would highly recommend them. We appreciate everything they did for us.

I am actually angry that I have not heard of this place sooner!! Creme de la Creme needs to do a better job of advertising their eye shadows because they are INCREDIBLE!!! So amazingly pigmented, soft and buttery - and the price is super reasonable. Especially considering I have paid more money for higher end cosmetics at Sephora which don't even come close to comparing to these. They are seriously a dream - I am mad I have so many other eye shadows at home because as soon as they are done I am re-vamping my whole palette with Creme de la Creme shadows!!! Their lipsticks were amazing too, I can't wait to go back when I have more time and create some customized eye shadows, lipsticks and perfumes!!!

So, I work next door to this place and have thought plenty of times I would like to try it. Normally I'm a Subway consumer but finally I made the decision to go in and Check this place out. My final push to give it a shot was a Facebook post I saw on my feed reaching out to Sherwood Park patrons to support this local business (search for the post if you want the details).
It's not a fancy place. Very "cafeteria" like. The hours are pretty short as well (another reason I never seems to time it right to go in). They are Monday to Friday 8:30am only until 2:30pm.

I initially planned on trying out their tuna sandwich but the patron in front of me had ordered the roast beef and after seeing how much fresh roast beef they piled on his bread, I quickly changed my mind. I ordered a roast beef on white and a small baked potato soup. Everything was incredibly fresh. No processed deli meat crap here! Bread all baked fresh, soup homemade. It was delicious. Large portions and incredibly fresh veggies. They had lots of salad and dessert choices as well, I just didn't partake in those. It was about $11 for sandwich, soup and a bottle of water. First thought was that it seemed a bit pricey until I reminded myself I easily pay that at subway and don't get a soup with that!
You can stay in or take out. Not sure if you can call in an order to pick up but not really necessary because the steady stream of lunch time patrons were served quickly and accurately. Would definitely consider making a permanent switch from subway with the hours of operation being the only thing that would stop me.
Worth checking out. Go support local!

Amazing service from the lady in the roses section. She gave me so many helpful hints and tips on how to keep my roses lasting over winter and what to do if.. 
Beautiful and inspiring displays made me just want to buy more land and expand my tiny yard. 
The check out was great and speedy and I even became a gardener member. I will be back to save even more with my membership. Thank you for a great experience!

Boston Pizza Millennium location. This is pathetic. We just ordered a large pizza and a double order of wings and it cost $70.00!!!! The shrimp were soggy and water logged. There was a huge piece of onion skin in one slice of pizza. The wings were mediocre and very small On what planet is it reasonable to charge $40.00 for a large pizza and $23.00 for 16 wings. That's a $1.45 EACH!!! I will never order pizza from Boston Pizza again. 

For all those interested I highly recommend Nitza's pizza in Sherwood Park!
Overrated and very expensive for what you get. I am all for supporting local but this was by far one of the worst breakfasts I have ever had.

I really like to support local businesses as much as possible. My Wife and I had been wanting to try this place for 2 years despite some of the reviews we had heard. It's true that the "atmosphere", decor etc are quite uninspiring. It doesn't really give you the impression of a place where you are buying a $55-65 Steak meal. I love the idea and the concept of supporting local farmers. I think that the ambiance and overall presentation is very lacking and uninspired, unlike their phenomenal concept. I think they should highlight and mention their local partnerships with where they source their goods. Although I did enjoy the twice baked potatoes, The fries were ok and the charcuterie board was ok (it was quite large), the best part was the truffle chips that came with the Charcuterie board. The helping was great and the bacon jam good I found the lack of more cheese styles disappointing. One of the cheeses my wife and I didn't even touch. Had we know more of the description of what it came with we may have changed our order.  I imagine there are many other items on the menu that are exceptional. It seems the Duck is one of the hits, perhaps had we chosen differently from the menu we would have been more pleased. However, a 14 oz Rib eye was overcooked and at $60 or as the menu states "market price" I was curious to find out more about what market they were talking about. 

Overall, I wish the business well. I think a few updates to the decor, shifting from paper menus and some more engaging music may boost its ambiance and people will feel more appropriate about the pricing to reflect the overall feel of the establishment. The food was good, it just wasn't incredible, amazing or exceptional. I think we would have enjoyed our time at the Keg or sawmill more. 

Service was good. Our server was a very nice and informed young lady. Thanks for that!

The only positive about this franchise location is how new it is. The food, while still pretty good, was not up to the standard we have become accustom to at other Red Robin restaurants. While we were seated relatively quickly that was where the service ended. We were ready for drink refills while waiting for our waitress to return to take our food order... For some strange reason the wait staff at this location does not clear the table as food and drink is finished. Instead they leave everything on the table until after you leave when a busboy clears everything. It was a little challenging to keep young children entertained with a massive pile of dishes and glasses in the middle of the table.

Ate here for the first time this weekend and i can honestly say it was pretty bad and tasteless. I know this place has been here for a very long time and the owner works hard to keep the place running but what i had from the dinner buffet was not very good. There was sweet and sour sauce on the buffet but no chicken balls were offered in the buffet on this day. I guess it was there to maybe put on the bland white rice they called fried rice. I have had chicken and beef fried rice many times in my life and there was no way that was fried rice. More like warmed up/steamed plain old white rice that was clumpy and hardly had anything in it. There was no vegetable in the rice. I honestly don't know what that was. I tried the ginger beef and it was way overly spicey and soggy. The egg roll was soggy as well and seriously had nothing inside it besides bean sprouts that tasted really bad. Not what i would call an egg roll. I tried the fried chicked that was on the buffet and that was pretty good. Overall i was disappointed though and will not go back.

You have got. To he kidding since this new owner has taken over alot of people will not go in here its now dirty 

What a shame it was an awesome place before 
Not now

Nice to see a stand alone specialty toy store in Sherwood park. They have a great selection of educational toys as well as all the standards like Lego, playmobile etc.
Their prices aren't bad and they offer free gift wrapping on everything in the store! Too bad they don't sell gifts for my wife!
I went in to do some Christmas shopping and bought a couple of kids books and some playmobile for my son. I am sure I will go back next time I need a present for a birthday party or event to take care of the free gift wrap offering for sure.

Decided to give Dimaggio's a shot tonight for dinner. Been driving by since they opened.
Not too shabby.
As they label themselves a steak and pizza place, I settled on the House Steak calzone. A nice mix of both. Indulged in a poutine on the side.
For ~$20...I was pleasantly surprised.
Nice decor.
Friendly server. Never did get a refill on my Iced tea...
Good food. Large, filling serving size.
Not going to rush back...but not going to rule out a return visit either.

I have never in my life been soon impressed with an establishment.  There is so much love put into this family run, non-chain restaurant.  The food was awesome and the portions large enough I brought some home to enjoy tomorrow.  I had the mashed potatoes and cornbread for my sides and devoured them.  The owner was manning the front tonight which was so nice.  He really knew his product and took pride in his recipes and his sauces.  I appreciated the unlimited refills....even though I didn't make it through the first lemonade.  I recommend everyone pop in here at least once and let their magic work on you!
I am so pleased with this place, for a get down and dirty messy delicious burger...can't be beat!  Love the Roasted Peanuts in the shell!

I must admit.
I've been sceptical.
If indeed they don't keep regular hours...phone ahead.
Just induged in a Super Donair after reading all the positive reviews.
I've eaten here a few times in the last few years.
I think because on my first visit I watched the chef pull the meat from a tray...and not off the spigot...I was turned off. Shaving it "fresh" just seems right.
So I've always approached since with trepidation.
Tonight however...
Damn.
It really hit the spot!
Juicy and delicious.
Friendly service.
It's not fancy...at all!
But I think I finally appreciate why they are famous!

Update on my last review 
So on my last review it was winter and they were in winter mode.
I bought a membership card for the season so i'd get a percentage off and have been buying plants for my backyard and a few tools.
They have a great selection of trees,perennials ,annuals,cactus,whatever you need.
I also tried out the restaurant .
It is very nice and classy with a lot of outside tables as well as inside ones.
Staff was friendly and prompt.
I had a proscuito and pineapple pizza with a coffee.
The pizza was one of those ultra thin types with a very thin layer of cheese and a few pineapple chunks,a mall amount of thin meat slices and a few pepper rings on it.
It was a 12 inch i think and cooked perfectly and it was tasty but  wasn't very filling and 1 person can eat it easily .
A little disappointing for $15+tip .
The coffee was really good. 
Anyways still a great place to buy garden stuff.

Tucked away in Sherwood Park this is a hidden gem.  A small place with an interesting collection of beer and some surprises that are still in stock when they sell out at the larger bottle shops.  Owners will take very good care of you and it is definitely worth a stop if you are in the area.
Good food, pretty greasy, but surprisingly expensive. $16 for a standard cheeseburger fries and drink

Wow this place is great if you have any kind of problem stains master cleaner sure can help out not only will they do press only they do bulk laundry service I never have to touch a washing machine again and the cost is cheaper than you think if you have no time or just don't like doing laundry come to master cleaner you'll be happy you did the customer service is also outstanding thank you master cleaner and with free pick up and delivery service it can't get easyer than that for clean wrinkle free garments

I never thought I would find myself driving out to sherwoord park for a salon but now that I've been, I can't imagine not! Headquarters (a Bumble and Bumble exclusive salon) has been up and running for what seems like forever, but you would never be able to tell from their space.  Recently renovated, the interior is modern and bright.  It's everything you'd want to relax and get pampered! 

The stylists are amazing and so friendly!  It's definitely not one of those high end salons where their staff comes with a superiority complex!! They really know what the ire doing and I would trust any one of them with my hair!

In addition to a great space in the salon,  they also have a really gorgeous spa space. The spa side is almost as big as the salon!  They have heated massage chairs while you enjoy your mani/pedis and huge bright rooms for your massage and any spa needs.  

Plus they're pretty much right off of baseline road which takes you in and out of edmonton!  It's so fast and easy and you completely bypass all the construction on the yellow head! Take some time and make your way out here to spoil yourself! 

Ps! They're one of the only salons that are open on Mondays!!

I ordered the Half Rack Ribs with Corn Bread and Mashed Potatoes. Ribs are very chewy and dry. The Corn Bread and Mashed Potatoes are both very good. Fired Up BBQ is better. Will only come back here for the Corn Bread and Mashed Potatoes.

I normally wouldn't review a chain restaurant but since this place has barely caught on in Canada I'm willing to give it a pass. Let's start with the burgers... they are good. Very good. The beef is clearly freshly ground, they give you more choice of toppings than anywhere I have been so far, and the whole package comes together in a delicious way. The only complaint I have about the burgers are the buns; seriously the buns are too small to fit everything they put in them. I understand there's a certain charm to eating something so messy that it spills everywhere, but I usually reserve those times for things smothered in chilly or gravy, not just a regular burger. Although these aren't the best burgers I've ever had, they are definitely better than your run of the mill fast food joint. What really makes Five Guys a staple are their fries. The cajun fries are without a doubt the best fries I have had in my 22 years of fry eating experience. Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, a perfect thick cut french fry covered in spicy Cajun seasoning... I think I'm in love. Oh, and I can only assume that the fry cup they give you is some source of great humour for the employees, since it is completely inadequate to house the massive portion of french fries that you must dig your burger out from under (not a complaint). I'd suggest sharing a fry portion with a like-minded chum. Definitely worth further investigation for those who have grown tired of traditional fast food fare.

It's been a while since I've eaten at Fulton Burger... Market... uh Burger Company... whatever. Anyways, it's been a while but I really like the place. The burgers here are extremely customizable. You have many pre-made options as well as the ability to make a brand new burger (take that McDonalds). Oh, and filling out the card with those little pencils remind me of playing mini-golf... so I guess that's a bonus? I have had a few of the different options here and they are always good. The buns stand out as compared to many a burger I have tried. For one, they are actually an adequate size to contain the vast array of toppings one might decide to grace the burger with. Secondly, they are not just any old bun, you actually have a choice of many different "gourmet" buns. Semantics aside, this place provides quality burgers at a good price (worth the extra to not eat at a chain). Once again, not the best burgers I've had, but this place is worth checking out.

Service was quick and courteous.
However, burger was undercooked and I could not taste any of the beef really. The burger tasted really... Buttery, unlike other red robin establishments I have been to where they tasted up to par if not a bit better than my expectations. 
The retro style inside really adds to the atmosphere making it an enjoyable place to hang out with friends and family on an evening out.

I have been to this barbershop three times now, two haircuts and today a shave. Well I'll tell you in the words of Don, this is something every man should experience at least once, no scratch that, every time. I'm sure not every stylist is as focused as others. But I had Rachelle (prob spelled wrong) and she made me feel like I was the most important client that she had all month. I'll definitely be back. Oh and the wait thing, maybe I just hit it right, but wait time was maybe 20 min max today, but usually has only been like 5-8 min.

I have eaten at this location several times, and I really enjoy a Good Donair which is exactly what I got every time I ate there at Famous Donair in Sherwood Park.
The owner which was who was working every time I ate there treated me very well and on a person to person level, meaning treated me like he knew me by name and was extremely friendly, I guess which is why he has been in business for so long. He had a deal with me at the time every time I would bring in 4 people for Donair's he would give me 1 free, so basically mine would be free. Ha-ha at the time I owned a Landscape Construction company so I had lots of employees and would quite often eat there for free.
I started eating there; well it is 2013 now so 7 or 8 years ago maybe even longer.
I have to agree with most of the other reviews above This Joint is the Best Donair in Sherwood Park, which is quite a compliment and I would be quite happy knowing that if this was my establishment. Unfortunately not the best Donairs when comparing to Columbus Donair in Edmonton which by far is the best Donair to date that I have ever eaten.
The one thing that I truly remember and will never forget about Famous Donair is that his Donair are very large and very filling.
4 out of 5 thumbs up and keep them coming.
Randy R.

That BBQ Place cannot be beat for true southern BBQ in Canada. The brisket, ribs, pork and turkey are all to die for. Pitmaster Bruce's baked beans are deadly, made with love and a little brisket for good measure. 

The sides are all as good as the smoked meat. I almost always go for beans and slaw but the cornbread and garlic mashed potatoes make great alternates.

When I book my appointments with Sylvia & Company Salon Services, I know that I'm in for a treat!  The staff is wonderful; they are extremely professional - yet oh so personable.  The AVEDA products, are certainly second to none!  But there's just nothing quite so soothing as coming in for my hair appointment, being met by one of the Client Services gals, who immediately get me settled in with a fabulous glass of herbal tea (their own special blend!), and then taken to my stylist's station...as I wait in anticipation for (something everyone receives) my head/scalp massage.  Oh, how relaxing!  The rest of my appointment never skips a beat; my hair is colored and styled, and while I'm waiting...a hand massage!

The product is fabulous, the service is outstanding, and the price is VERY reasonable.  After all, I'm not just going to an ordinary salon, I'm going to Sylvia's, where it's always an experience to remember!

Well done ladies!!!  Thank you for always looking after me!!

Do Not Buy A NISSAN .... They knew there was a problem with their 2005 - 2010 PATHFINDERS radiators but chose not to reveal that to consumers.  We did every recommended service but they never said a word. Had they made us aware of this we would of replaced the radiator.  Now we are looking at a 8500 bill.

Amazing selection. Friendly knowledge staff. And free gift wrapping !! This lady has her new go to Toy store !
Ps Sydney was exceptional.

5 Guys is my go to burger place.  I eat low carb and really like that you can get bunless and appreciate the free peanuts since I do not eat fries.  The burgers are always great as well.

The bottom line is 5 Guys is one of the best burger joints.  I go here when I can.

Don't believe the 5-star fake reviews!! Terrible service.

My dismal experience with Sherwood Park Chevrolet started a few years ago, when I brought my 2005 Chevrolet Malibu in to get serviced due to a steering wheel recall. In short, they had to replace my steering column. The work was done free of charge (due to it being a safety recall) but of course, they happened to "notice" a few other issues. One of them being "a bad leak at transmission cooler hoses."
Being a red seal journeyman heavy duty mechanic, I decided I would change them myself. In short, it turns out the hoses were just weeping (a tiny amount of moisture on the outside of the hose), and I saved myself hundreds of dollars by not having to do a pointless part change.

Fast forward to Monday, February 9th/2015. I dropped my Malibu off at the Sherwood Park Chevrolet dealership to now have a "brake control module" and "transmission shift cable" recall repair done. I was told it will only take a day. On Wednesday, I called the service department wondering if my car was finished yet. It was sometime after 4:00pm, I was talking to Mike and he tells me that my work was finished yesterday (Tuesday) and that Shawna left me a message telling me it was ready (which she did not). So they send the shuttle driver to come pick me up and bring me to the dealer to get my car (yay, right?) 
Well, little did I know that I was their last shuttle pick up of the evening, and because of their poor communication I arrived at the service department around 6:00pm, conveniently as the service department leaves to go home. So let's just say that the shuttle driver and nightshift Detailer had a heck of a time getting my car keys.
About 20 minutes later, I got my keys and went to my car. Guess what? No power. The battery was completely dead. I couldn't open my trunk to get my booster cables because the electric trunk release wouldn't work (battery is dead remember) and the key lock is seized.
So thankfully, Mike the AWESOME shuttle driver rounded up a booster pack and helped me boost my car! (Thanks again Mike!)
I arrived home that night, charged my battery on 2 amps with my battery charger until it was full. I thought all is good. 
A day later, my battery was completely dead AGAIN! So I called the service department and politely explained my situation. They got me in the next morning to check my battery. They then said that the battery needed to be replaced (which I figured since they just completely drained it). I explained to them how this had never happened before and it only started doing this after THEY worked on it. Something is draining my battery. 
The assistant service manager makes some excuses, saying that the battery in my car (which I purchased from and had installed by Rocky's Battery in Edmonton) was a poor quality battery and that they need to be changed every 2-3 years.
Anyway, I went and bought a new battery and installed it myself. $90 compared to the GM $200 batteries PLUS  labour charge.
I was in a crunch this whole time, because I needed my car to drive North for work on Saturday the 14th.

Now here's a nice story. It's Wednesday, February 18th and I just get off a 12 hour shift in Fort McMurray. I didn't have time to eat dinner at work, so I order a pizza and plan to pick it up. At 9:00pm I go outside to start my car. Know what happened? Sweet nothing, because my car won't start since
my BRAND NEW BATTERY IS DEAD! 
Did it die on the 5 hour drive to Fort McMurray? NO! It died while it sat on my landlords driveway for 3 days. 
So, my pizza got cold, and I had no option but to get it delivered and forego my plans of picking up some beer to relax for the evening.

Oh and you know what else? My work order for the brake and transmission cable recall work also had a note in the inspection saying they noticed "a bad leak at the transmission cooler hoses".

Ya, ok. Just like last time right?

I called this place asking for their hours and was met quite rudely by a woman  who answered the phone.  Giving the benefit of the doubt I decided to try their bbq anyway.  Once I arrived, my order was taken by a woman who seemed friendly and by the sounds of it was the same woman I spoke with on the phone.  I thought, "ahh one off thing".  I ordered ribs and brisket (the same I compare to all bbq places).  The ribs were dry but had some flavour to it, but I did not want dry ribs.  When I tried the brisket, I had never tried brisket that was this dry in my life.  Their bbq sauce is what "saved" everything and made it palpable to eat. The highlight of this was their corn bread and beans, not the best I've had but it was definitely good. 

After much debate, I decided to try this place again a few weeks later.  Sadly, nothing about the food has  changed.  I've been to many bbq houses that I've never once had a "hit n miss" let alone two misses.  Sad to say, I do not foresee this business surviving once another comparable business arrives.

Here enjoying a great burger, the Mad Love, until a random customer start complaining about things that didn't happen. The manager didn't listen to her bar staff or me while defending them. She ended up giving away a gift card to this guy. He lies and makes up things about the staff and he rewards HIM, WOW. The bartender and hostess were amazing and helped me out every moment of my time spent here...except while the manager was distracting them to cater to the loud mouths lies. I will definitely come back and spend time here. Michelle was off duty and still helped me out.

What a great place.  The food is fantastic and has a unique presentation.  The service is fast and friendly.  They serve good sized portions at a reasonable price.  The atmosphere could be called quirky southwestern.  Even though it is in Sherwood Park it is worth the drive from Edmonton.
I love this location, friendly staff and the food is always great! I love to order the hot wings!

Today I went to this place for lunch with friends. I'm impressed with my burger and endless fries! It is the best burger experience I've had since I moved to Alberta.

The place looks pretty family friendly as well. I will definitely come back again either with friends or family.
The food was very salty food and cold when ir came out. The waitor could care less and provided poor service.

Service was awful, food was almost inedible.  I had the roast beef sandwich and the gravy had no flavor,, The poutine was awful for the same reason.  The garlic shrimp was dry and gross.  Our server disappeared for about 20 minutes with out anyone picking up the slack.  I will never go back.

I have to give a big Thank You to Rob & Randi the general manger and his assistant. I went 2 weeks ago on a Sunday evening to pick up my order. I was trying to pay for my order, and I did not have my reading glass I was trying to enter a tip not to sure which button to select and accidentally tipped an outrageous amount($3700.00) . Randi caught my error but not before it went through. She did all she could but the matter had to wait until the next business day for Rob. Needless to say I was upset and embarrassed but their professionalism and kindness calmed me down. The matter was resolved and my food was excellent.  Because we took so long to try to rectify Randi had my order remade so I could have a fresh pizza.

I absolutely love going to Vadara for everything. Snow is amazing at hair, I always leave with the perfect blonde! I love all the girls in the spa side and the relaxation massage by Lily was THE BEST!

Only slightly more expensive than your typical fast food joint, the delicious burgers and exceptional fries are worth the drive to Sherwood Park. They are NOT stingy with the fries, oh boy do they give you a lot. I'm not a big fan of the cajun style fries but if you love spicy go for it. Unlimited toppings on the burgers and there are plenty to choose from.

When I travel up to the Great White North, I usually end up wandering around a Canadian Tire.  And I keep some Canadian Tire Money in my wallet for good luck, as some have told me that it's sometimes more valuable than the Loonie.

I have been in better Canadian Tire Stores than this one.  However, when you're on business and you're bored at the end of the day, there's plenty browsing here to keep you busy and happy.  It's also an inexpensive place to buy an ice scraper, gloves, or anything else you might have forgotten to pack or considered regarding climate differences.

Service was fantastic! The girls went out of their way to hold the door open for us! (I'm currently on crutches) 

Tried the clover club no. 4 drink. It was great and had a little bit of a sour taste. It came with a beautiful stencil design on top. Caesars are always good. 

Love the dynamite rolls. Tried the tuna tostadas for the first time. Not something I would order again. May be just my tastes but it was not good. 

Other than that lunch was great.

This place is awesome!! Got my pedi and gel nails done, the pedi was amazing I've ever had! Lots of massage and clean up all the dry skin. The fill that I had was impressed too, done it quickly and nicely!! Will highly recommended this place!!

For two Americans, this was our home away from home.  Food quality was excellent along with the portion size.  Never ate in the restaurant side of the house but the bar was the spot for us.  

So what makes this place amazing?  It is the incredibly staff.  Torrie was exceptional, the burgundy goddess - treated us as part of her family and not just a paying customer.  Her wit was spot on.  An outstanding conversationalist to say the least.  Jade was additionally just as nice and welcoming.  their backgrounds are so much more diverse than one would think.  Leanne and Zac round out the cast of fun wielding staff members.  each has worked at BP for years and it is clear they enjoy their job.  

Make a point to visit when you are in the area - you will not be disappointed.

What an amazing experience! Brought my friend in to have a custom lip stick made for her birthday. The shop is absolutely lovely, bright, open and full of class. The owner is extremely knowledgeable wand was a big help as she guided us to blend the colors to make of gorgeous lipstick. I definitely suggest this to anyone, soooooo great!!
There is always a wait and you usually end up with a different hairstylist. Went twice, wasn't overly impressed with the haircut for the money.
It is a sad, sad day for Burger lovers in Sherwood Park. Burgerworks has closed. RIP blue cheese and portebello mushroom burger!

My wife had decided to do something new with her hair. Normally she would would just do a Singletons special but she knew that she wanted something new and fresh. We decided to give Vadara a try as it had a good reputation. My wife was looking for a modern style with something intense for colour.  Not having experienced a nicer salon before she was unsure of the value. The team at Vadara treated her very well from wash to colour to cut she felt pampered. She went in as a skeptic but came out really seeing the value in something higher end. She was extremely pleased with the results and the experience.  Beth was her stylist and my wife said she is amazing. She really listen and shared her enthusiasm with my wife. She communicated continually with my wife and made her feel comfortable.  Vadara is not cheap but you get amazing service and care. You walk out feeling special and pampered. My wife was so happy that she would say it is totally worth the experience.  Give them a try!

Hip hip hooray!  Parents and Moms-to-be rejoice!  A 3rd location for Once Upon a Child opened up last year - this time in Sherwood Park.

I had a chance to run in here last month while my daughter was at ski lessons and what a treat!  Books were on clearance for $1 that day!  YES - $1 books!  Came home with a giant bag filled with books to overfill our already filled bookshelves!  But hey, since when could one have too many books?

Once Upon a Child is HANDS DOWN the best consignment store chain for used children's clothing and accessories.  I've frequented them in Edmonton for several years now and even visited one in Saskatoon!

You can drop off your gently used clothing and toys to trade in for store credit if you'd like as well.

They offer a frequent purchaser stamp card to earn discounts and usually have coupons in the SUTP coupon book.

They are on facebook and have an e-mail list if you would like advance notice for upcoming sales and specials!

They also carry new items like Melissa & Doug at prices below what you would find at Toys R Us.

Once Upon A Child is most definitely a dream come true for frugal shoppers who know that a baby outfit may get worn once or not at all!

So good you want a quality meal with a family type atmosphere with the comforts of home cooking to hook you in please try out the soup and sandwich place!! Locally owned business they do a daily special they post on Facebook what it's going to be for the day and a weekly menu up in the shop. Healthy bread choices with the added benefit of a choice of two rye breads!! Quality of meat exceeds your mouth watering dreams of sandwiches past.  They have told me they cook the (not sure if some or all) meat in house and slice it up for your sandwich. A lot of variety in fresh ingredients as well as freshly made salads with dressings you drool over as days go by. A lovely stop for lunch if your working in or around sherwood park but best to try and be early or try Mondays cause they attract lots of regulars! Desserts were baked in house as well with a selection of banana bread and puffed wheat squares as well as fresh triple chocolate  cookies. Honestly it tastes like mom's and my mom is a baker and caterer. I've searched so long for food to be made with love and I'm beyond happy every visit!! Don't forget to tip everyone they deserve every bill you got!!
Brandie was very thorough and gave an awesome massage! Can't wait to go back for my next appt!

Very disappointed. Girlfriend had made a reservation a month prior for my birthday and we showed up to find that the restaurant was shut down by the health inspectors for a flood. We understand accidents happen but we received no phone calls no emails to inform us that they were closed. We even checked the website prior and they said they were closed dec 16-19 but would be open the 20th our reservation date. A little customer service goes a long way and a simple phone call would have saved us the trip.

This location is hit or miss.  Usually more hits though.  Way better than the Claireview location, worth the drive East for sure!  Recently though I ordered a burger on a Gluten Free bun and the bun cam out FROZEN.  They offered to make me a new burger, I asked if I could have a new bun instead as everything else seemed ok.  Took over 15 min for my bun to come out and it was SLOW and the rest of my table was done eating before I could even start.  Didn't even get a discount for the delay.  I didn't expect my meal for free, but maybe 50% would have been nice.  Especially when I didn't yell and scream and freak out over a that.  I have seen people melt down for worse.  And the manager was well aware of the situation as he said he was the one who prepared my burger AND heated a new bun.  Other than this is had been great service and food.
Love love this salon ! Lindsay & Tara are the bomb ! Always happy with results. Been going there 10yrs .

Went to this Kal Tire when the other location in Sherwood Park was too busy to deal with me and wow was I impressed with the service.  The people there got me right in fixed what needed to be fixed and did a bunch of other inspections that I didn't ask for.  They never tried to sell me anything I didn't need and were extremely accomodating.  I will be buying my next set of tires from them here and if they give the same service to everone would highly recommend them.

Nice quite, quaint place. The sandwiches are great with fresh bread, meat and veggies, and the soup was fantastic.  I think most of all it was the service  that stood out. Very attentive staff -especially the guy behind the counter. You couldn't ask for a friendly fella...I was in from North Carolina and this guy made me feel like I was at a deli around the corner from my house. Will return every time I'm back in edmonton

First time here as a customer. Got a man-pedicure and it was great. The place is well laid out and organized. The foot spa area is huge with 10 chairs. It's quiet, serene and quite relaxing. Didn't know that massage chairs would be that nice. 

As for service. Quite good. Te ladies who work here are all very welcoming and friendly. They did a great job on my manly feet. I do think I will be coming here at least two times a year for foot maintenance.

I've been to both Red Robin restaurants in the Edmonton area many times; this is the first time at the Sherwood park location. Was about 9 pm place was empty but 2 other tables, we were sat at a table with a direct view of the kitchen entrance. Food was good as usual, service was decent. Only issue was our view of the kitchen, we watched kitchen and wait staff and the on duty manager walk over garbage the whole time we were there. I worked at a restaurant when I was younger, customers had zero view of the kitchen but it was kept clean, my thoughts were if that's what I can see what does the rest of it look like? A member of our group approached the manager as we were leaving and was basically told to mind his own business.

I had a chicken mucho burrito sans sour cream with guacamole instead. Lots of great veg and rice options to add on. I added pinto beans and they were full of flavour and added mucho fun later on in the day. Stack the burrito with goodness! You can spice it up with different levels of heat! Try the lime jarrito soda drink. There are other options than burritos such as tacos, quesadillas, and taco salad. This is a family friendly restaurant with lots of open seating. I will go back again next time I'm in the area.

So I don't actually drive so I don't normally review gas stations based on pricing, but I was here recently as a passenger as folks in my vehicle wanted the inexpensive gas and our experience was pretty good in general. All the cars wait in orderly lines and all drive in the same direction which is pretty good in general. Sure it helps to drive on the correct side of the pump to match where your gas tank is, but there is also a great gizmo that helps you put gas in your car if you are on the other side of the gas pump too so that's quite helpful. 

On the whole it was a good experience even if we did have to wait in line for quite a while.

Never been treated so poorly! I Was there for a lunch meeting. Had been there twice before and had no issues and the food was acceptable but yesterday was one of the worst experiences I have ever had at a restaurant. I ordered the special, Chicken Parmesan with soup. I waited an hour only to receive way undercooked chicken. When I finally got the waitresses attention my companion had been completely done his meal for 5mins. I told her the chicken was raw and she took the plate with no apologies, only to return to tell me I would only be charged 1/2 price. Never would I ever return to such a place. They are more concerned with making money than putting out a quality product. Mistakes happen in commercial kitchens but you don't charge the customer for your mistakes. Appalled by this behaviour.

I am so disappointed!  After reading reviews for this place, I was expecting so much!  I ordered the beef brisket,...  you know how white turkey meat can look and smell delicious but you almost choke to death trying to get it down because it is so dry?  That was the brisket they served me.  The portion was laughable!  What is the one thing all southern BBQ places have in common?  Ridiculously generous portions.  The portion I received would have been perfect on a kids menu.  The lowlight of the experience was the 8 stale potato chips they put on the platter.  The coleslaw earned them one extra star as it was very good.

I had bought a 2011 Kia Sorento from a private deal loved my kia so much that I thought I would upgrade to a 2015. That was the biggest mistake of my life. I will never by a new vehicle from kia again. I am again back at the dealer for warranty work. I live 2 hours away so it's a major issue to get in during their sad hours that they can actually work on the vehicle. I have come in 2 times because the vehicle would randomly turn off when driving (a little scary while going 100 in winter and you loose power) now 2 times because the awd is locked on (huge gas problem.... If I wanted a 4x4 I would have bought one). 

The shuttle service is only a recommendation- don't book thinking you can get it on time.  If you ask for a 9:30 shuttle you may expect to wait until 10:30-11.

Today my pedicure was with Paige and i had so much fun at our appointment. If your looking for an estethician that really understands her trade request paige!! She's super friendly and has amazingly strong hands to help relieve tired sore feet. I find a lot of times my favorite part is the massage and paige has a knack for it. I decided to trust paige to know what to do for color design asking her to use three shades i brought myself so i could touch up later. She made an even better color design set up that never would have occurred to me so i was pleasantly surprised and happy with the outcome of my paint job  which has never looked better! The best work always comes from letting the artist decide for you :) The new massage chairs controls are confusing at first but once you figure out what works for your body its always a benefit during your pedicure. The chairs don't heat up like the old ones but im totally cool with that cause im never cold in the pedicure room. The new design is so beautiful!!! You feel like your royalty when your in there and both my friend and i getting the pedicures were remarking how we would add some of headquarters designs to our own hypothetical dream houses. Must say im loving what you've done to the place headquarters! ! And ill definitely be requesting paige from now on!

I really like the location - I was meeting some family who were driving from Vegreville to Athabasca, so I suggested here because it was easily accessible from the Yellowhead, and didn't require me to drive from Millwoods to St. Albert.

My aunt is in a wheelchair, so I went in before she got there and asked the hostess (possibly a manager?) for an accessible table. It was about 1:30 on a Saturday, so it was still pretty busy, but she showed us to a table very close to the door and quickly whisked away a chair so the wheel chair could be accommodated.  I appreciated it.

As far as food goes - it was standard for a Red Robin.  Everything was tasty.  I had a soup and salad.  Both of which were just kind of "okay" - but nothing specifically wrong with anything.

I can't give more than 3 stars because the service was incredibly slow.  Like... painfully.  But... the location is good, so when meeting people from out of town, this is a good compromise to keep everyone happy.

The customer "service" rep was rude and extremely unhelpful. As an added insult, the advice provided was erroneous. 

I will not be back.

Of all the Earls restaurants I would visit this location on convenience more so then atmosphere. The food is average, the  restaturant size is rather small...thats what she said..lol...and well the people are ???? I just got this weird feeling in there, I noticed that the staff seemed to friendly to one another in public.  The servive was average overall, if your in the park sure check it out.

Good stuff. I was expecting more after reading Brittany K's review. In all it was a decent place. The burgers taste no different from what can be made in your own kitchen. The Yam fries were good and the real milkshake are good. I had the banana and it was the best part of the meal. It was really good!

I went to That Bar-B-Q Place when it first opened and thought it was decent, so decided to go there for lunch with a friend today to try it again. We met at 11:30 so it was very quiet when I first got there, but it did pick up later.

I ordered and by the time I had paid, my food was ready on the counter. Very fast... maybe too fast? I ordered the brisket sandwich with beans and my friend got the pulled pork sandwich with mashed potatoes. 

The first bite was pretty disappointing. Then bun was stale and tasted a few days old. The brisket was very dry and pretty flavourless. I was able to douse the meat in barbecue sauce, so that kind of salvaged it, but I prefer to have the meat stand alone, not just be masqueraded in a sauce. There was no saving the stale bun though.

I had tried the pit beans the first time I was there and enjoyed the smoky taste and brisket mixed in. This time, I could hardly distinguish them from beans straight out of a can. 

My friend wasn't very fond of his pulled pork sandwich, saying that it was very bland.

Honestly, the only saving grace of this place is the barbecue sauce. Everything else was a big meh. I've had much better barbecue at chain restaurants than this specialty barbecue place.

When did Red Robin get so crappy? We went for my son's birthday on a Wed night, the only thing good were the burgers, hot & fresh, the fries on the other hand were terrible. Cold, dry, tasted like they were left over from the day before. Also, the apple slices that came with one of the kids meals were brutal, dried out and brown. Not sure who approves the food leaving the kitchen but clearly not doing their job. The waitress we had was great, and was clearly embarrassed by food quality and immediately tried to rectify it and apologetically. We also found the kids chicken fingers and fish, extremely salty as they had been over salted after cooking. Clearly, the food quality at Red Robin has seriously gone down, doubtful that we'll ever return to any location. Too bad, because Red Robin used to be the place to go for a decent family meal.
The worst A&W experience I have ever had. My order was taken incorrectly after I said it 3 times, then when I got the order it was missing 2 things and the sandwiches were wrong. Really poor.
Pretty good place. Pizza was good but the crust was a bit dry for my liking. The wonton soup is great!

I'm most disappointed by my last visit to this place.  The service was average but the food was not the same as my first visit a year ago.  They charged too much for something that McDonald can do much better.  Looks like a gourmet burger joint but the experience was much worse.

Absolutely amazing! Greeted by owner Justin and Chef Jason, very pleasant atmosphere and superb inspired menu. Local suppliers, so fresh! We enjoyed the eggs Benedict served on yorkshire pudding, fresh baked bread, eggs cooked to perfection. Also had the burger steak and eggs, fresh ground chuck was so perfectly seasoned, it was mouthwatering delicious!!  We will most definitely be back!  Treat yourself, this is our new favorite restaurant!

Pretty good.
Standard fare as the "new world" burger joints go. Doesn't really stand out anymore as this market has exploded.

No nonsense menu.
Can get pricey fast.
Burgers get messy fast!
Decor less than amazing.
I enjoy taking the kids here from time to time.

It's a newer bistro lounge with tv screens.  High ceilings and very deep booths that seat 10.  Modern decor.  Servers in black skirts.  The seafood linguini was good but the chicken fettuccini was bland.  I saw a guy using his napkin to pour ketchup...maybe the bottle was greasy.  Servers were pleasant.  They have happy hour.  Overall nothing special to get me to return.

My brother-in-law and his soon to be wife took us out for dinner here mid-week. We met at 7pm on a Tuesday and had to wait a few minutes to be seated, even though the restaurant wasn't full. Not a big deal. The table we got was strange, though. It was a big round table in the middle of all the booths, and really close to the kitchen, so I could hear all the kitchen noise and see some of the action.

Our sever, Curt (I think), was really great. He was friendly, attentive, checked on us enough but not too much, joked around with my father-in-law. He was a fairly young guy, working in a Boston Pizza in the middle of the week, so I have to admit I was really surprised at how good he was. It was actually some of the best service I've had at a restaurant in a long time.

All of our food was as ordered and come out in a timely manner. No problems there. It was Tuesday night and all wine was half off!

The only gross thing was that there was garbage and dirt all over the floor, under our table and everywhere. Napkins, crumbs, food remnants. Ew.

I recently purchased my first vehicle from Sherwood Dodge and being that it was my first venture into car buying for myself, it was a great experience. I had made sure to bring my own backup considering I know very little about vehicles. I dealt with Byron and never once did I feel pushed into anything or like I was being taken advantage of. I had shopped around a little bit before buying and almost all of the other salesmen I dealt with were pushy or condescending. I got a great deal and wouldn't hesitate to shop there in the future.

We were excited to try somewhere new in Sherwood Park- unfortunately... it was not nearly as good as we thought it would be.

Friday night and it was fairly busy- we got our drinks that were pretty good- the bartender was awesome but for some reason they had her serving tables as well -there were more than enough waitresses working. 

The calamari was delicious but the portion size was literally smaller than what you would expect for even a kids menu.  Our meals took just under an hour to get.   The butter chicken looked like it sat under a heat lamp for a long ...long time - had a "lovely" film on the top.  It was more like a butter chicken sauce .. with some chicken in it   The rice was cool and clumpy.   The seared salmon ? I'm not even sure it was "seared" it was covered in copious amounts of sauce.  The rice was clumpy and cold. The grilled vegetables looked great- but sadly they were cold as well. They really like the sauces- maybe it hides the blandness of the actual meal?

The manager seemed to be afraid to leave the comfort of the kitchen doors at the back of the bar-chatting with the waitresses as the bartender was serving tables (odd).  He should probably start talking to customers and checking the food quality instead.    

Sorry just our honest opinions

Great food & great service!! The place was packed but we were seated in about 10 minutes. Special mention to the wait and cook staff. They made sure our orders were correct which sometimes is lost when a restaurant is really busy. Well done!!

So I hadn't been to Dimaggio's in a couple years (shame since I love their pasta) when a family member was in town, trying to think outside the box I suggested we headed to Dimaggio's. Walking in we realized we were the only two customers in the restaurant (about 7:30 on a Thursday). Immediately I started second guessing my selection wondering if maybe the food had gone downhill. 
I was so relieved when my food came out just as delicious as I remembered it being! My only comment may be that it was a tad overpriced by a few dollars. However still great quality food.

I visit Red Robin a few times per year with my family.  The most recent time was this location a couple of months ago.  I ordered a spicy burger, which had hidden in it a piece of metal from the grill scraper.  I discovered it by biting into it.  Fortunately I didn't crack a tooth.  The staff comped my dish only and offered a free dessert, which I declined.  I expected better.  Likely will not be back to this or any other Red Robin.

I stopped in at French Healthy Cafe for some drinks to go, so I can't comment on their food. When I arrived the cafe had no customers, but three workers who did not look up until I greeted one of them ready to order. 
I ordered two London Fogs, one half sweet. The lady who was taking my order asked what I meant by half-sweet and I explained half the usual vanilla syrup. She said they don't usually come sweetened so I had to add (and pay for) a shot of syrup in the drinks. When I took my drinks to their destination both my friend and I noticed that the cups were about 2/3 full. I admit grudgingly that they were delicious - clearly a very high quality tea.
But you still get two stars from me, F.H Cafe. My expensive drink was very yummy, but I hate snottiness and a not-full cup.

A fellow Yelper (Adam B. from Halifax) recently opined that there are better local places, better local chains, and better local pies than at Boston Pizza.  And that may be especially true for out-of-towners who don't have the local knowledge.  In my case, I look at the mass of places along Wye and Baseline Roads and quickly either seek a port in the storm or flee into Edmonton.

Awhile ago, I had a 2 week business trip within greater Sherwood Park and met my work colleagues for a beer, pizza, and some televised sports.  This Boston Pizza is more suburban and family-oriented than the one that I like better in downtown Edmonton.  That sort of energy doesn't really make a sports bar atmosphere, but as friends who were spending weeks away from their families, we had a nice time anyway.

I was visiting Sherwood Park mall on this rainy day and decided to warm up with a buffalo chicken poutine from Joey's Urban. One would not think that gravy and Frank's red hot would mesh well together but it seemed to work with neither flavor overwhelming the other. The full portion of poutine and ingredients seemed like good value for the money although it could have used a few more chicken pieces. Including a drink it managed to get me full for under $10.00. The staff were also pretty nice. The lady at the till asked my name right away and continued to use it for the duration of the transaction. It was a nice little personal touch that im not used to getting from a fast food restaurant. If I was in the mall again I would have no issues returning. The food is a higher quality then I am used to getting from a fast food establishment and the staff made a great first impression with me.

Decided to give Dimaggio's a shot tonight for dinner. Been driving by since they opened.
Not too shabby.
As they label themselves a steak and pizza place, I settled on the House Steak calzone. A nice mix of both. Indulged in a poutine on the side.
For ~$20...I was pleasantly surprised.
Nice decor.
Friendly server. Never did get a refill on my Iced tea...
Good food. Large, filling serving size.
Not going to rush back...but not going to rule out a return visit either.

I have read many reviews online (On other sites) about Five Guys Burgers and Fries, and after eating there several times I am surprised by so many people saying it wasn't as good as they hoped, or that it was too expensive. I can't imagine the majority of people that like burgers not liking these. I guess the 27 person line up at 11:40 am on a weekday (In spite of it being 2 or more times the price of other places) speaks for itself about the taste. 

I had the little bacon cheeseburger with only mustard and ketchup, and a small fries. I loved it!! The fries are like a real fish and chip shop fry.
I can see the size of the bun being a problem for those who like loaded burgers-eating while driving is not an option here. The burgers don't fare very well after being wrapped in real tin foil. They are very messy as they put ketchup on both sides of the bun, but I didn't find them greasy at all.

As far as the price goes, I would expect to pay a premium for fries and patties that are made in store, by hand, by staff earning between 10-14.00 an hour (According to their hiring posts). Imagine how much cheaper machine cut fries and machine formed patties would be. 
There were 12 people on staff this morning, so It does seem a little slow considering the simple menu.
This place is already a hit, it isn't going away any time soon. It just doesn't really fit in with all the other burger joints where you can have a combo for lunch for 6 dollars or so.

First time in the new joeys and there's no doubt it is a great improvement from the old location. It's fresh, clean and roomier. The food has always been good in the past but quality is lacking a bit here. I had a steak and asked for rare. It came blue rare as the middle was cold to cool. We also had the California chicken sandwich but the chicken was cool. They did replace it and did not charge us which was good of them as the sandwich came after we were all done eating. The steak I just ate anyways. Service was just ok (and that's a compliment).

I went here for lunch on a Groupon and ordered a 1/3lb burger (as opposed to the 1/2lb burger which seemed excessive - additional patties are also available) and cajun fries.  The onion bun was dry and stale and devoid of any onion flavour.  The vegetable toppings were fresh and crisp.  The patty itself was quite tasty, but the perfect shape gave me the impression that it came out of a box.  The fries were average.

Ultimately, the Groupon (which cut my price in half) made it a good meal.  At full price, I would eat elsewhere in the future.  There are better burgers out there.

Wanna lose faith in Car Dealers? Then don't come here... 

When I first saw my Camaro ZL1 on their lawn I knew I had to have it. Saw it on a Sunday and had signed papers by Monday morning. My sales person Daniel G. was a pleasure to deal with and, being a Camaro owner himself, was able to make sure that all of my needs and questions were taken care of with the car. Heidi B. in financing was unlike any other financing person I have ever dealt with... She was personable, amusing and we shared quite a few laughs through-out the course of my purchase experience.

If I have any friends looking for a new car I will gladly let them know about the team that helped me get this car.

Had great service and the food was great too! Travelled to Italy this past summer and this place actually compares! The pasta we are used to here in North America is not what it is in Italy so I could see why some wouldn't give it good reviews. The best part was the food was super hot when it got to the table. The decor is a little disjointed and it is way more of a restaurant inside than expected based on how it looks from the outside. All in all we left satisfied. I recommend the lasagna and caprese salad.

The food is great and the staff friendly. This location is new, has more seating and typically less of a lineup than the baseline location. I recommend the caesar wrap, spicy tomato soup and the chopped water. Good healthy alternative to the usual grease burger joint. Take your girlfriend here for lunch instead of McDonalds you cheapskate.
Terrible service. Waited for 10minutes to be seated when they weren't busy. Had our server changed 3 times. Food was okay.

I'm not a skinny person and I don't eat like a skinny person, but the chopped leaf leaves me feeling satisfied. I always get the same thing. Bowl #1 with chicken. It's like a southwest mexi style rice salad bowl with pita chips and avocado. It's delicious, spicy and filling.
You order at the counter and they bring it out to you when it's ready. The service is fine and the lunch is quick enough to eat a business lunch in half an hour. It's definitely near the top of the list of my go to lunch spots.

Came here tonight with my bf before his shift. Have not had this much to eat in a while! I had the one meat special choosing beef brisket and it was more than enough with two sides included my sides were the coleslaw and the mashed potatoes.  The cole slaw was so so but i expected that since its hard to get fresh ingredients to keep in winter. Now the mashed potatoes were mind blowing!! Im talking if i could have had a huge helping of just mashed that would of been fine cause holy carp i could totally eat those day in and out! My bfs meal was the two meat with him deciding on pulled pork and beef brisket and a baked potatoe and a baked bean side. He loved the beans and said next time he'd definitely pair the mashed potatoes with the beans and one meat cause two was excessive even for his appetite. The signature sauces on the tables come in three choices sweet spicy and original, both of us played it safe and got the original which was just spicy enough and tangy. Im pretty picky with bbq sauce but i did live the original! Service was prompt and professional with some really wacky decor happen I happen I in the walls. Definitely somewhere to treat your man for a relaxing semi fast food experience. We arrived an hour before close on a Sunday and there were only two other customers in there making for it to be a calm peaceful meal.
