If you dine in your food is served directly on a paper placemat on a tray so pretty neat way of serving there hearty tasty cuisine. Will be back to show my dad.

I recently purchased a preowned SUV from sales person Ronaye. It was my first time purchasing from a dealership and I was fairly nervous, Ronaye made it an absolute breeze! Everything was finalized in a few short days from the initial search at KIA. They had my SUV transferred in from another dealership and had it cleaned extremely well and ready to go for pick up. They supply you with all the documentation, a full tank of gas and your on your way! She was very honest that the vehicle wasn't in the condition she had promised from the previous dealership but did all she could to have a few minor blemishes buffed out before pick up! I would highly recommend this dealership, but would recommend Ronaye over anyone!

In Sherwood Park.  Pros:  inexpensive and lots of meat.  Also the owner is a personable guy. Popular with students.   Cons:  I wish they would skip the lettuce and add more onions and tomatoes instead, and I don't particularly like their donair sauce as it doesn't have that nice sour creamy taste.  No whole wheat pita bread but that is the norm unfortunately at these places.

We were stoked to try Fulton Market after hearing so many great things, but there was more wrong than there was right. I liked the menus. The whole "build your own" thing is great. The selection of burger sauces was awesome. I like a good sauce. Well, the fiance and I both do, so we got to work picking out toppings and making the best possible burgers. 

The girls on the till seemed a little spaces out and not quite into their work. Sure, you work at a burger place, but do the best at what you do. Carrying on. The fires were meh, and I should have gotten a ciabatta bun, because my burger was drowning in sauce! I couldn't take a bite without having sauce run down my arms. It didn't take long before my bun was almost disintegrated. That still didn't cover up the fact that they were using frozen patties. The burger was dry. 

Shawn's stood up better of the heartier bread, but neither of us was really thrilled enough to go back. If we do, and things are better. I'll definitely update.

Great Burgers!
That's about it. Otherwise, there is little to really set this appart from any other franchised eatery.
It is to burgers what Olive Garden is to Italian.
And frankly...that's just fine!
Always came away with exactly what I've gone in expecting.
Really tasty dishes, quick service and nice atmosphere. Not super loud either, which is nice!

Looking for someplace different to try, and thought we'd give this local business a try. Nice atmosphere, maybe not particularly Italian-looking, and about 40% full on a Saturday evening.

Friendly staff, but it took a while to get our glasses of wine (I was pleased to see a barbera on the menu).  We started with a grilled vegetable salad and some calamari. The veggies were flavourful, with a nice balsamic drizzle, but they were a little shy with the peppers and smoked Gouda, and maybe a little potato-heavy. The calamari was tasty, the breading was light and crisp, but maybe applied a bit thickly. The accompanying tomato sauce had a nice kick.

I had the spaghetti carbonara, and it was very nice, rich and creamy, the sauce maybe a hair thick. My wife had the veal marsala, with fettuccine and a Rose sauce, and the veal was a little tough although the mushroom sauce was tasty. Her pasta sauce was also a little thick, but enjoyable.

All in all, it was a nice meal, we'd go again, probably a 4 minus out of 5, like 3.75 if we could do that.

Amazing fast,friendly service. They read order wrong when we asked for brisket and ribs and got brisket and pulled pork. They then just brought us the ribs on the side. All were amazing. Especially the pulled potatoe.  I recommend substituting the coleslaw for beans. So much food.
Even the owner Bruce came over to bring us rake out containers..we couldn't eat it all. Amazing guy,amazing place. 
Bbq sauces were all homemade and so good..even the spicy! 
Price is right too.
We will be back for sure!!

I'm not sure if I'm jinxed at this place but the last couple times Ive been there the service was terrible. Took forever to get a waitress and even longer to submit food orders. No one knew who our waitress was. Other than that it's a good place to eat. 

Food is what it is. A typical Red Robin Franchise. It's great food for a decent price.

This place makes great burgers and the cajun fries are amazing. Overall everything is great quality and is well priced for what you get. Don't expect fast food prices here cause you're gonna be spending about $13/person at least for a standard meal... but its sooo worth it.

We'll I thought I would come in here to see if good ole Earls could redeem themselves.  I used to come to Earls all the time quite a few years ago, but got sick of them. And to be quite honest, I find them boring.. Anyway this was my first visit to Earls in about five years.  Thought I would come to this one in Sherwood Park because all the great reviews it got. Yes the Stella on tap is nice and cold, food was presented nicely we ordered an appy and shared an Italian pizza, the service was good. The atmosphere was nice too. The staff here are trained well in making sure the customer is happy. That's a good thing.  I couldn't find to many things to complain about. But its still didn't wow me off my feet for me to give them a five star. I'll give the four star and say yes they did redeem themselves.
Worst mucho burrito there is by far. Bad in different ways everytime i go back (not sure why i kept going back) wont ever go back to this one again

The addition of Fresh Healthy Cafe to the Sherwood Park quick bite scene is nothing but a fabulous addition!

One of the best things about this Cafe is that in addition to nice wraps, good soup and nutritious smoothies and juices, they also serve gluten free, dairy free and vegan selections. The prices aren't the cheapest in town, but you pay for the quality.

The hubs was thrilled to discover a huge date/granola/square type bar that is soft, chewy and incredibly filling while still being gluten free AND dairy free. They have also told him they can prepare him a gluten free wrap.

The ambiance is light and casual with lots of great art. Check out the huge piece on the middle wall, on the right hand side, facing away from the kitchen. Some say it is interesting, some say creepy but I prefer whimsical. If it was just a bit smaller, I would pack those cute pair of jeans up and take them home with me!

The Cafe has expanded twice since they opened - once to add a patio and the second time to more than double their interior seating.

Best pulled pork available in a restaurant! Amazing home made bbq sauces, very tasty sides (slaw and cornbread very good) and a personable and friendly staff. I come here every time I'm in the area and hope they expand to other locations. Highly recommended the triple slider, three different mini burgers to give a good sample of how excellent the food is.

Why is it that restaurants can't cook steak properly? I went to earls to get a steak and had a good laugh with the waitress about how the last time I was there with the same person, we both sent our steaks back.
We both ordered steaks again and both ordered them blue rare. Blue rare for those of you don't know is an uncooked cool red centre.  My steak came out medium and his steak came out rare.
Where I come from, rare is passable because the meat is still not cooked.... But honestly, how do you screw up blue rare? I sent it back and they fixed it. The fixed steak was quite delicious, but I feel like I should either not order steak here anymore or find a different restaurant.

As per every Biston Pizza...hit and miss.
But what does anyone really expect.
Family and large group friendly.
A menu that I must admit I consistantly feel like "ordering one of everything".
BP's is like an old friend.
It's there when you need them.
I am also a sucker for their delivery service as it's really the only readily available service one can order such a range of Western food. Of course the pizza is good...but one can also order such a plethora of different dishes that aren't the go-to pizza...or chinese.
Keep it up BP's.
It's always a reliable stop when out with the kids and fast food isn't on the menu!

I didn't know what to expect from this toy store. I'd never heard of it before but when I did some web research I found out this place is a franchise. First thoughts were "ok, be prepared for over priced goods" Boy I was wrong. 

Entering this store is like entering a classical toy store. They got it right when they designed the interior - Packed walls full of delights. While it may seem a bit cramped when it gets busy, the quality and selection of toys are amazing. I found many cool items that I've never seen before. Plus a large number of brand names you can get everywhere. BUT the big surprise was that their pricing is on-par with the box stores. 

I managed to get a hot Xmas item for my boys there that was on back order. While the service was a bit slow in getting this item reordered I was very impressed that they honoured their grand opening promo when I paid for it a month later. 

I'm a fan of this place. It has a great selection of toys ranging from pure fun all the way to educational.

This is a gluten free heaven delicious proteins, gluten free bread options, High quality condiments such as homemade bbq sauces and Hellmann's mayonnaise.   
Trina and Bruce are also just great to deal with! So if you like great service and amazing BBQ check this place out

Went last minute for a lunch. 3 tables 1 server you don't think anything terribly wrong can happen. 

Meal 1: My spouse orders a lunch meal - Santa Fe  Quesadillas with fries and gravy. 

Quesadillas was good he said but the fries were stale and only warm. 

Explained to server and she took the fries back but left the gravy. The waitress  brought new fries but i had the gravy went cold. So I had to request again new gravy. 

Meal 2 : I ordered the Boston Brute no onion with a side of meat 

Waitress brings the Boston brute with no meat sauce. She comes to ask how our first bite after about 10 minutes and I had explained there are onions on my sandwich and I ordered meat sauce for the side. 

She took away the sand which and got it remade. After waiting about 20 minutes I got my sandwich and meat sauce.  

The waitress was good but she seemed kind of irritated with the kitchen and was reflecting on her serving abilities to us. 

Manager gave us free desert but i personally wasn't very hungry after waiting for new food and having to watch my spouse eat his entire meal.

I love this location! The staff are friendly and so helpful. They really take their time to make sure everything is awesome! Even though they passed on some of my items I didn't feel annoyed or upset. They explained the process easily with me and I even made $ after I bought stuff. The store is organized so that you can find things easily, and it is kept very clean. I will definitely make the drive to come here.

Food is superb. Would give 5/5 stars for food alone.
However, I bet your wondering why I'm giving only 3. 
Well unlike the common pig I like to eat off a plate and not a slop tray, for the love of god, please get some dinnerware and proper utensils.

I bought a 2008 Pathfinder in 2010. I took it for running boards to dress the look and got a quote. I went to pick up the truck and paid the bill. My memory isn't that good so I checked the quote against what I paid. I ended up paying more so I called Sherwood Nissan. The parts manager  apologized but said he made a mistake and clearly didn't want to refund me. He offered me a free oil change which I accepted. 

Last year the truck completely dies. I thought it was a gas gauge problem so i completely filled it with a gerry can. Still wouldnt start so I had it towed to Sherwood Nissan. They said it was a sensor issue and an injector pump. The pump was warranty so I approved both fixed. They called and said it was ready. I went to pick it it up and the gas gauge read empty and the check engine light was on. When I went back in they said they installed the wrong sensor? I asked them if they noticed the check engine and the lack of gas when they drove it to the holding yard? So, I had to bring the vehicle back to have them fix it again. They fixed it and a few days later, a girl calls to ask about my service experience. I said it was a little rough she asked me share. I spent a while explaining the issues, afterwards she says, "You know what you should do? Write a letter to Caesar, the service manager." Why would I spend the time telling you're too lazy to write it up to pass it to this Caesar??  
Anyway, maybe just bad luck...

I gotta say that I am actually kind of surprised by the previous reviews - I did not get the same impression of the food or the service here.  In fact I was slightly disappointed.

Went here for a work lunch one afternoon at about 12:30pm.  It was no problem at all finding a table of 4 to sit at as it was not the typical busy you find at this time of day in the 'industrial area' of Sherwood Park.  I found the decor to be outdated and dirty and the service to be slow.

Now the food - I hate to say it but the Caesar salad that I had ordered had a taste and texture to it that led me to believe that this was prepared the previous day- or before that.  It's a Caesar salad people?!?!?!?!?! - how exactly do you screw that one up??  The chicken on my salad was good though.  My colleagues were not impressed by their experience either.

Looks like this might have been just an out of the ordinary experience here given the extremely positive reviews preceding mine.  Perhaps I will give it another try - maybe try the pizza that everyone is raving about?!

Staff are wonderful, friendly 
They do an amazing job on wedding dresses and stain removal

What is not to love about getting the cheapest gas in the city and attendants that ensure people all drive in the same direction?!?

Also, Costco gas stations have that American gas pump component that lets you pull down the trigger to pump while you get back in your warm car until it's done - Oh yes, baby!  That is a NECESSITY on a -40c kind of day!

Be aware that they only accept debit and gift cards.  They used to accept American Express but Costco is transitioning to MC so not sure how that will affect what they allow as I always pay with debit but NO CASH!  

68 cents yesterday really made me smile :-)

This is a 5 star destination. We went to this out of the way joint a few times within a week. A rarity for us as we like to try new places, but it was so good we had to go back. And it was even better the second time!

It is in Sherwood Park but well worth the drive. That BBQ Place is a dine in/take out restaurant with ample seating for solo diners, or small familes and groups.

The facility is spotless, and the staff are exceedinly friendly and patient. The first time we went there we were deer in the headlights and the cashier was patient, helpful, and did not rush us or get impatient. The second time we had a different cashier and she was also extremely friendly. The staff are excellent and add to the great experience. They were awesome.

The first time we went there the food was aoh so good. When we got our HUGE portions, we were awestruck. And once we dived in, we were not disappointed. The pulled pork was delicious, the ribs were meaty and had a great smoky flavor, and the brisket was tasty and perfectly portioned. Between the two of us we had homemade potato salad, coleslaw, beans, and cornbread. Each platter we ordered came with a pickle slice, and a handful of potato chips.

The second time we went, we ordered the same thing and it was even BETTER! The brisket you could cut with a fork. A plastic one, at that. I could not believe how good it was. Best I have had. Ever. The ribs were similar. They fell right off the bone and were so tasty. And it was all perfectly cooked. Were the naysayers eating at the same place? Hello?

The staff actually came up and asked how everything was. Wow! Usually in a place like this they stay behind the counter, but all patrons were asked how things were and tables were cleaned promptly when customers were finished. 

We also had the lemonade and the unsweetened iced tea which were both delicious as well.

This place was not packed, but very steady. Both times we were there there was a steady flow of customers coming through from construction type workers to families.

All the meats we ordered were definitely smoked. You could tell from the color of the ribs that they were smoked. And you could taste it. Both times we were there.

We are going to try a few other BBQ places in Edmonton, but for now That BBQ Place is our "go to" barbeque restaurant, and we will see how the others compare.

Prices were more than reasonable for the quality of the food (it is homemade) and service was exemplary and quick. 5 stars well earned! Thanks for this wonderful place and we will be back soon!

We ordered takeout.  A separate container for buns, potato chips, sauce, coleslaw, cornbread and beef.  Beef was in plastic bags.  Coleslaw and cornbread were good.  Beef left a smoky natural gas aftertaste that felt weird.  Smelled like a campfire.  We bought some potato salad from a grocery store instead of using the bun and potato chips.  They gave us a lot of sauce.  I would like to know how they prepare the beef....that much smoke can't be healthy.  We would try elsewhere next time.

This is one of those dealerships that make me want to need to buy a car lol! 
I went in because I had some business to do and I was greeted by a very friendly and helpful receptionist. 

The reception area was sharing a cake with customers that was a birthday cake for someone who works there - it was in the shape of a car :) You could tell by the joking and smiles around the reception area that the people enjoy working there.

The showroom is very nice and modern. The cars are gorgeous and they have an incredible selection of cars, including some beautiful Corvettes!

We bring our Camaro in for maintenance here and have nothing but pleasant and professional service. You might also want to check into their tire storage program as it is a great help!

This Canadian Tire is massive!!

We went here yesterday in search of some bike accessories and we found everything we were looking for, and for some pretty good prices.

Canadian Tire has everything you could ever want for your home, for outdoor sports, for camping, etc. They had a great selection of helmets for any price range, bike locks, mirrors and many other things you would need for your new bike. They only had 2 options for a bell for your bike, but I wasn't picky so it didn't really matter to me.

My only complaint is that the helmet I got was priced $10 less than what they charged me. I didn't realize it until later, and I wasn't about to go back over $10.

Overall, this massive Canadian tire has a ton of stuff, but the quality is sort of lacking, as with all Canadian Tires!

While I like the Burgers, I think waiting 20 minutes for a single burger before the lunch rush is a bit much. Looking at the line up right now some people will be here for at least 45 minutes before getting to eat.

We went here because it was close to the car dealership we were dealing with in Sherwood park and took a chance - glad we did. It was adorable inside, lots of Italian decor and music playing. It is very small but cozy. The menu was pretty limited- few salads and a few pastas but they were good. The bean and quinoa salad was great and so was the home made minestrone soup. My husbands lasagna was watery but he said the taste was good. Worth checking out for somewhere Local to eat.

Great quality of meat and good for a decently steep price. But overall a very good place to eat for supper or lunch and very clean and decorative! Owner is very friendly and asks how your meal was and brings the food out to you which is awesome. Check it out!

We ordered from this restaurant because we both love Chinese food. After a long days work we were looking forward to our meal. However we were very disappointed. The food was tasteless. It's almost like they forgot to season the food. Then the sauces were bitter instead of sweet. I wish I could find something positive to say. Considering how expensive our food was, we won't be ordering from there again.

I'm noticing lots of one off bad experiences weighing down on this location's rep which doesn't seem fair to me :/ I've gone plenty of times and they've never let me down! The food is great and fresh, pretty good drinks/selection for everyone and the service has always been awesome. It can be a little on the loud side and wait times can be a bit long, but I'm being picky at best. Go check it out for yourself and enjoy!

First time to the store this past Saturday, the owner was so very helpful. He suggested the Black Lager from Yellowhead Brewery, based on what I had told him of my likes. All I can say what a wonderful beer, it is exactly what I have been looking for.  I will be back to try other beers.  Thank you.

Great for fast burgers. 
Probably the best tasting and best cooked gluten free fries.
It can get busy at times.

Amazing food,  the service can be slow when busy,  but the server is very knowledgeable about the menu and the food is always great. Totally recommend the salt and pepper wings. The only benefit to the sometimes slower service is that the appetizers and entrees have space between them for enjoying them and chatting.  One of my favorite restaurants. Would definitely recommend.

I come here several times a year depending on when my job posts me in Sherwood Park. I've been to several Mucho Burritos in the city, and this location is clean and usually not busy. 

It's been a few months since I visited a Mucho Burrito and it seems their prices have increased by about a $1? Or perhaps I never noticed it before. 

I ordered the small veggie burrito which came out delicious, albeit a bit overheated during the final press stage. I also opted to try the chicken tortilla soup - it was suuuuuuuper salty! Ugh... I've had it before and it was the opposite last time, not enough salt. I guess they've now tried to overcompensate. The soup, if it was't salty, would've been yummy since they place a scoop of guacamole, plus crushed tortilla chips and pieces of chicken into the bowl, prior to scooping the broth into it. 

Overall, hit & miss but I'd still return since I'd like me a mucho burrito anytime =)

I am so happy that Nicholson Chevrolet decided to move out to Sherwood Park and not make me have to drive down that Brutal Argyl Road with my Camaro. I needed a kidney belt when they were there! So they moved here and changed the name to Sherwood Park Chevrolet, it was a big win for everybody. 

After talking to one of the managers I found out that the move alone helped propel them to the number 1 Chevrolet sales position in the Edmonton area. Customers found it much easier to deal with them also in this new location. I will admit having a massive showroom and great people that work here was a definite help also!

I book my car in for service and they handle me like I am their best customer, but that is not always the truth. At one point we struggled with a roof problem and I was a bit soggy about it, after all my car is my baby. They never changed their attitude I was promised it would be fixed and a short time later they did remedy it, and put me into a rental until it was completed. When it was done and I was happy they released dancing girls into the drive through area and the wine flowed like water! ( I may have just imagined that last part) What I am saying is they won't give up on you.

They have also shared the facility to promote local events and are an outstanding member of the Sherwood Park community. I recently attended Gluten Free Sherwood Park event and the staff was pitching in to help every way they could...talk about classy. 

My weakness is for the fun and fast play toys, well they have them here in spades. As Alberta's Exclusive Callaway Dealer they can turn your mild mannered Camaro into a monstrous beast! But they have Callaway kits for trucks and cars and even SUV`s. It's always fun to see what they have and it never hurts to dream a little dream.

Stop in and say hi, I am sure you will enjoy it, I always do!

I brought my car in this morning at 8:30am as I had a bolt/nail lodged in my tire and I cuold hear it clicking the whole way to work.
The gentleman at the front desk was very nice and told me I could leave my vehicle there and they would give me a call when the tire was fixed.
I just called to see if my vehicle was ready and the gentleman told me it was just finished. I asked him how much it was going to cost, and he told me it was free!
That is excellent customer service!! I will definitely be going to Kal Tire in the future and recommending them as well.

Although on the pricier side of fast food with a bacon cheeseburger costing $8.49, regular fries at $3.49 and a regular drink at $1.99, the food itself is quite good. Regular burgers are actually 2 beef  patties so they are larger then a normal burger and you can customize it with anything you want at no extra cost (i added grilled onions and mushrooms to mine)

Although I waited to receive the food, it was quite fast for how busy it was. The restaurant itself has a pretty cool vibe to it, with text snippets from reviewers plastered across the walls, big bags of french fries separating the seating from the order line and free peanuts to snack on while you wait. 

I will for sure be going back for more.

Definitely one of the best burgers I've had in the Edmonton area. It's pricier than the regular chain fast food burger joints, but the burgers aren't even in the same league. 

The burgers are incredibly customizable and often the hardest part of eating there is narrowing down the toppings you want on the burger. Seriously they have everything you could ever want on a burger-- a few types of cheeses, guacamole, different types of mushrooms, and so much more I can't even remember. The meat is prime rib and it's really tasty too. 

It's usually pretty busy and it takes a few minutes to get your food but it's worth the wait. There's also a TV that shows the status of every order, so you know when yours is coming up next. 

I usually get the sweet potato fries with garlic mayo (I think) and I've always been pretty happy with them. 

Been there a few times now and looking forward to going back!

Here's a new hot spot in Sherwood park with tons of potential. This is a relaxing place to go for a drink or get some great food either lunch or dinner. I went for lunch and had a steak sandwich it was very satisfying and they served it up on some cool dishes which was different! I see on social media that they recently did a makeover on their menu so there's new items to taste! The decore is very nice for a lounge which made for a good atmosphere. I would definitely go back as I want to try their happy hour specials.

Came here for the Caesars cuz of the buzz around their bacon wrapped Caesars! And they didn't disappoint! Best Caesars for sure. They come with 2 bacon wrapped scallops and all the other normal stuff. Worth it just to check it out

Also had a pizza. It was ok. Don't recommend it. Wasn't anything special.

My husband and I were looking around to buy a new truck, though we weren't set on a make just yet. We walked into Sherwood Dodge and were immediately greeted, went on a test drive and were shown all the bells and whistles of the truck. 

The salesman was good to deal with, prompt and friendly. We got a breakdown in price and went on a test drive all within an hour. We didn't end up buying a dodge due to personal preference, but did enjoy the friendly service. 

That being said, I can't comment on the entire car buying process through Sherwood Dodge, thats why I have only rated 3 stars.

Surprised by all the negative reviews. What do people realistiy expect from a franchise such as this these days. It's not Tres Carnalles...it's Mucho Burrito! 
My personal favorite is the Chorizo sausage.
I look at thus change as a nice change from Subway, and the pita places. Hot. Spicy. Filling....and not an overpriced franchised hamburger. 
One of my favorie places to "grab-a-bite" when time is of the essence, and I am after something hot and fresh.

Could have used a sixth guy, to clean the tables which were covered in condiments and peanut shells.  Eating a cold burger on a dirty table isn't worth the price.

Also, the 'reviews' plastered all over the walls, some from the early nineties, wasn't necessary.
Stopped in after Costco & again was so impressed with this place! Just ALWAYS great food, value, and great people & service! Love this place!

Some girl friends and I went here together to celebrate a birthday and it was so much FUN! The very friendly husband and wife couple who started this business made us all feel like queens! It was so much fun making our very own custom lipsticks, eye shadow or perfume. And there was also a candy bar while we waited for our products to process. Great for parties or just treating yourself! They also had a wide selection of makeup for purchase. Not a lot of people know about this hidden gem, I will definitely be yelping more about this place to all my friends!!

It has taken me a long time to finally find a hair salon /  hairdresser that didn't completley overcharge me for a so-so hairstyle. The girls here are all so friendly, serve you coffee, and are easy to chat with! They know their Aveda products very well and are so helpful in picking out the right type of product for you (IF you are looking...they don't push it on you) Also... this is the first salon that offers FREE bang trims once you have been there once!! Most salons charge up to $15....ridiculous!! Love the salon!!!
Not sure what is up, but I have notified Yelp twice that this business has closed. I also left a message under the review. Yes Yelp, I too am sad they have closed but denial won't bring them back!

Stopped in on Sunday. Beautiful smokey smell greets you as you enter. Decorated simply; meal served on a tray lined with poly coated butcher paper, so not a formal place, but very clean & neat!
I ordered the 2 meat meal & picked pulled pork, brisket, baked beans, garlic mashed. EVERTHING was outstanding! I am so glad there is a smoke bbq  place of this caliber in the Edmonton area. The prices were reasonable, the service was very good & very fast, and the food was literally SMOKIN! Sorry! But I really liked it! So did everyone I was with! 
Eat in or take out, you gotta try this place!

The hair dressers here are great at their work. But the front desk service needs a bit of help. My daughter had an appointment. When we got there there was no hi or welcome. So I said my daughters name.  And she said ok. As everyone else walked in they were offered drinks, but we never were. 15 min past our appointment time so i asked to confirm we had an appointment.  The lady at the front desk said let me check with the hair dresser. Then she said there's a 10 min wait because they had a power outage. So we waited, another 15 min. Very disappointed that we were not informed ahead of time that the hair dresser was running 30 min behind. Hopefully we have better luck next time.

Service and food was less than spectacular... I expected a little more seeing as it's always so busy! Wondering what's so great? so I went a couple times maybe there was an off day whih is expects but the couple times it was just ok... Food wasn't great all times...

Came here for dinner last night. Ordered the "West Pizza" and a glass of red wine. The pizza I'm sure was a Delissio frozen pizza - the taste was exactly the same. They keep their red wine at the bar, not in a controlled temperature environment. The wine was way too warm. This place has a nice atmosphere but the food and wine disappoint. Also disappointed with portion sizes for appetizers. Had the calamari. About 8 pieces for $15. That's ridiculous

I was very excited when my friend told me they had opened a Five Guys in Sherwood Park. I developed my love for this place in recent trips to Washington, DC and Phoenix, AZ. Visited this location for the first time in late Feb and was pleased it is just like the US ones I've visited complete with the bags of potatoes and bottles of peanut oil on display as well as the peanuts that you can grab and snack on while you wait. I ordered a cheeseburger (not the "mini" I typically get) and found out that the regular cheeseburger actually has 2 health beef patties. I like how you can pick toppings like caramelized onions, fried mushrooms, etc. In addition, I love that you don't need to order more than regular fries since they dump a whole bunch of fries into your bag after they have filled your container of fries. So I supposed I've established the portions are generous but the food tastes great too! Burgers juicy and you pick your toppings/sauce. Fries are fresh cut, crispy on the outside and potato-y on the inside. Love Five Guys and will be back soon!

Nothing bad to say!

I parked the company vehicle after a 3 day trip out of town, and found that my personal vehicle had a flat tire.  I knew it had a slow leak before I left and I really should have taken it in, but I forgot about it.

I noticed that there was a Kal Tire truck in our yard (I work for a trucking company down the road from this location) changing out some tires, so I limped my car over to where he was and asked him if he would mind filling it up so I could at least get home that night and get it back to Kal in the morning.  Not only did he fill my tire, but he showed genuine concern - asked me how far I had to go, and if I knew how fast it was leaking.  He wanted to make sure I was going to be able to make it home and back without causing a bigger problem.  Once he filled it up, he checked to see if he could see/hear a major leak.  luckily he didn't.

That was my first encounter with staff from this location.  The next morning, I took my car straight to Kal Tire.  I'm so used to the super busy location on 99th street, where you have to get there half an hour before they open and line up, so I got there about 15 minutes before they were open, and got ready to wait.  Much to my surprise, there was only one other person waiting.

Once the doors were open, they took care of us really quickly.  Asked good questions, and made sure they had the best number to contact me at.  

It took no time at all, and within a couple hours, they called to say that my car was ready, and explained the work they did.  When I arrived to pick it up, I was told that there was no charge for it!  I'm told that that is likely because my tires were purchased from Kal Tire, so they provide quite a bit of complimentary service and maintenance.

This will be my go-to place from now on.

Was disappointed with the food, had the 3 meat combo with turkey, brisket and pulled pork, the turkey was the best and the other two were quite bland , and wasn't a fan of
The BBQ sauces either. I got the beans and cornbread has my sides, didn't like either.

Place was busy though and staff were friendly.

Earl's was never a place I usually go to but we had a stagette this weekend and some of the other Bridesmaids chose Earls. I probably have not visted Earl's in about 4 years and I think it has changed. It is still Pricey for what you get. I had Fish Tacos to start they were probably one of the better Fish Taco's I have ordered in a chain restaurant in awhile. 
For my main course I had a Steak mmmmmm was it great!
Earl's to me is a great place for special occasions I am not sure if it is a place I would go weekly.

great place if you want to customize your burger. they have quite the selection of toppings and the quality is very good. it is a little bit hidden and you wouldn`t expect a burger place like that in an industrial area. it`s definitely worth the trip!

Located just off the Sherwood Park Freeway is Earls. Earl's is a restaurant with a bar. It's a good stop for lunch or for dinner and drinks after work. 

My group went for lunch and we were not disappointed. We were seated almost immediately by a friendly hostess. The waitress was prompt at taking our drink orders and answered any questions my group had with good advice. I had the Royale Mushroom burger with cheese and I am definitely a fan. The burger was tender and the flavors were great! The fries were "pub" style fries but they were still quite good. 

The waitress was attentive to our table and was quick to refill drinks. My only complaint was how noisy it was in the actual restaurant. The noise pollution was quite bad but that could simply be from the amount of people in the building at lunch time. The table space also felt a little cramped.  Earls has television's in the bar area with either the News or Sports which can be a nice way to relax. 

The parking lot right beside the building is quite small and mainly for Handicapped customers and delivery trucks. Earl's has an adjacent lot across the street for additional customer parking. 

The prices can be pricey depending on what you order but they have quite a few deals under $10.

Came here before a wedding based on a local's recommendation and absolutely loved my experience here! Received highlights, a cut, and updo from Tracy who was fantastic. She was really good at interpreting what I wanted, and the end result was superb. Tracy was also just very friendly and easy to talk during the appointment. Hope I'm in this area so I can come and have Tracy do my hair again - thanks HQ!

Gotta say - not too sure what all the hype is about with this place?  To me, my experience was extremely average.  Burgers are very fresh and there are lots of free toppings to choose from.  Sides are huge and there are free peanuts!  The price compliments the quality/quantity of the food well.  Decor is neat, place is clean- but the walls plastered with raving reviews of the place is a little cornball to me.  If your looking to sit down with some friends and have a decent burger at a fair price this is a good choice.

This place has great BBQ. As many other reviewers have noted, the turkey is delicious. I have also tried the ribs and brisket and really like them all. They also have great cole slaw and good baked beans. The service is always friendly. The sweetened iced tea is a must for lovers of the fresh brewed stuff. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is that I wish they had alcohol and I'm not a fan of cafeteria -style dining.

We have been coming here for a while and have never been disappointed until tonight.  We sat down and waited...and waited...and then a table that was seated after us got served.  We waited a few more minutes after that and then decided to leave for another place and no one seemed to notice.  It was a shame.
Five Guys offers the best fast food burger in the Edmonton area, hands down.
The food is always fantastic and the service is always great. This is our favourite Earls by far :)

I have long been a fan of Red Robin, but since it was always a fair bit of a drive it was always a special treat. I was so excited when they opened this location. I have been there several times already at different times of the day (lunch and dinner) and have always experienced fantastic service even during the crazy Friday lunch rush. And the food has always been fantastic. This location is a bit smaller than the Edmonton locations but the food is worth it being a bit crowded.

This store is full of fond memories. I've been coming here since I was a little girl with my Dad. Of course now I'm less invested in the toy section and more invested in everything else. It never ceases to amaze me what you can find at Canadian Tire. I've had great service from their service department with my vehicle. I find that the staff in store are slightly less helpful. But I usually like wandering anyways. Occasionally they have amazing deals, sometimes things can be a bit pricier. But it's always worth a look.
The staff here are amazing!   They are always so friendly.   Oh yeah....let's not forget the Aveda Tea.  Love it!

I use this shop all the time for my car, and will continue to do so. I have confidence in them.  I'd like to encourage the two reviewers who had disappointing experiences to immediately let the service supervisor of a shop know asap whenever  they have a bad experience,  and give the shop a chance to rectify . Don't  just go home, log in and complain about it here.. The service supervisor at this shop is serious about customer satisfaction and very very approachable. How can CT Sherwood Park improve service to you without being given the chance? I will continue to let this shop take care of my vehicles.

I'm never been treated so poorly.  The owner(the women that sits in corner on the laptop) was incredibly rude when I asked for no rice (for dietary reasons) and all vegetables instead looked at the size of the wrap and charged me for a large instead of the regular because it was the size of a mucho. If there was another Mexican restaurant in sherwood park I'd never go there again.

This was my first time eating in Sherwood Park and it was a real treat! The burgers are everything that you would expect from a home cooked burger and more. I had bacon on my cheeseburger and it was probably the best bacon I have ever had...not greasy or fatty whatsoever! Toppings are free and there are a ton of options to choose from....the only thing I was not such a fan of was the cheese...it tasted like an unusually thick Kraft singles slice.

Fries were good as well and very filling. A regular order split between two people is more then enough. If you want to try something different you can have your fries done Cajun style. The only cautionary tip I have to offer about this business would be if you get jalapeno on your burger to be aware they are not the ones from a jar they are the fresh cut ones which are MUCH hotter then the jarred ones. My eyes and nose were definitely running a bit halfway through the meal.

If your looking for a good burger and fries out in Sherwood Park be kind to your tummy and check out Five Guys!

DO NOT USE THIS LOCATION!!! I came to this location today and got completely ripped off!! Similar experience to other users - I generally always go in with the same amount of bottles (3 bag fulls and 1 large box of glass bottles). At other depots I would get about $50-$55 and at this location today I got $33!!! Impossible.. The people here don't look like they would give a crap either and how do you prove what you had when they already chucked everything into a giant bin with hundreds of other bottles? Lesson learned, never using this location again!

For someone who is not a huge burger fanatic I have to say that this is my favourite burger joint to date. I love the customize your burger style and the wide range of selections for everything (bun, patty, toppings, sauce, cheese, etc...). This place is a little more pricey so it's the kind of place I go to when I want to treat myself but it is for sure worth it once in a while! When I am craving a burger (which is rare) this is my first choice! 

Portion sizes are huge - I would say definite value for your buck (however, I eat like a bird so a burger there is a little much for me and they don't leftover well, unfortunately). Food is great - always fresh and it's made to your personal tastes so how can it not be good??? BONUS -a good chicken burger is difficult to find sometimes and Fulton's is excellent!  ...AND just looking at all the previous reviews - looks like I have to try a milkshake from there sometime soon!!

I have always gone at off times of the day so I have never had to wait for too long. But given the location I would imagine that it could get a little crazy there during peak hours! Definitely worth a try though for sure!!! I would choose Fulton over Delux Burger Bar any day!!!

First Impressions:  The entry looks quite upscale, prompting my partner to feel underdressed (he wasn't).  Inside, the tall ceilings and wood panelling continued the impression with comfortable, inviting booths.  There were a few ubiquitous pop culture posters on the walls; not enough to detract from the setting, but enough that I found them amusing.  Can't find a casual restaurant nowadays that doesn't sport Marilyn's image.  

Atmosphere:  While the decor was pleasant enough, the TV screens everywhere ruined the general effect.  I don't mind them in a casual bar, but I don't understand their purpose in a dining room.  The background music was decidedly Muzak, but it was quiet, so I didn't mind.  Even as the place filled up, the sound level remained reasonable and we couldn't hear the conversations of other patrons.

Menu:  Reasonable selection for omnis and vegs alike with gluten-free pasta available for a surcharge (of course...).  Veg items are not marked, but the server assured me that they could work with most of the dishes.  Prices were comparable to other casual restaurants.

Wine list:  Not particularly varied, but enough for the average person to find accompaniment for their meal.  

Food:  We started with the Arancini, deep-fried risotto balls.  The menu didn't mention that they contained mushrooms; I wouldn't have ordered them had it said so.  They came on a bed of wilted lettuce with a dollop of a delicious sauce on each.  They weren't bad at all, if a little boring.  And I hate mushrooms.

My partner had this to say about his Penne Polo Alfredo ($17.95): "It was thin - milky rather than creamy.  The pasta was cooked appropriately, but there wasn't much flavour and I had to work to coat each piece with sauce.  I coulda got better at Boston Pizza."

For my part, the Cannelloni ($15.95) was certainly palatable, if a little bland.  I appreciated the sparing use of cheese in the filling, but the shells were over-cooked and the sauce lacked interest.  For the price, I'd've been much happier at Sicilian Kitchen.

Service:  Our server was quite gracious, but she was also very busy.  Perhaps they hadn't expected the rush?  I'm not sure, but, well... We were prepared to order dessert, but it took so long for her to return to our table that we gave up and paid our bill instead.  She also ignored my request for the 5oz glass of wine, neglected to clarify the size required by my partner, and brought us 8oz each.  I didn't quibble with the bill, as we did drink the wine, but I do prefer a smaller glass with my meal.

All in all, my partner and I agreed that, while we left full, we certainly weren't satisfied.  I do appreciate the coupon with which we paid for my meal.  I wouldn't've cared to pay full price for what we got.  We likely won't return.

I always found Earls restraunts to be top quality for a decent price. The Sherwood Park Location is no exception and with excellent service as well! Love going here for drinks because of the wonderful atmosphere.

There are two Boston Pizza's in Sherwood Park. One on Broadmoor Blvd off of Baseline (just before the Costco) and the other off of Wye Road.

This restaurant was the second to open after the Wye Road branch being open for many years. I would like to say it is second to none, but that wouldn't be accurate - I would say it is second to the Wye Road location.

This branch has been riddled with service issues ever since it opened a few years ago. I'm not sure why, but I have heard a lot of complaints about inconsistent service. My experience has confirmed that as well.

Sometimes the service is just fine and other times you are left hungry and annoyed. In contrast, the one off Wye almost always has great service.

That is not to say the service is atrocious, not by a long shot. We keep going back for the pizza - especially the gluten free pizza. It is not on the menu but just specify that you want and which toppings. There have been occasions when it has arrived a bit overdone (black around the edges) so I might consider asking a head of time to make sure it isn't too overdone or crispy.

While the hubs is gnawing on his GF pizza, I was enjoying a regular Mediterranean pizza. This is a great pizza choice and one I wish I had ordered earlier. Artichokes, spinach, pesto sauce and sun-dried tomatoes make for a very nummy combination. The crust was perfect for this type of pizza, nice and thin and crispy, without being crumbly or flakey.

Overall, I would go back because it is Boston Pizza.

Absolutely the worst experience ever at a dealership, I had a gas tank problem, can you believe these guys made me drive to a gas station to see how I filled up my vehicle. I had been driving for over thirty years. I could go on and on but I just get too upset.
Magoo approved burgers and Awesome Cajun fries. They give you a take out bag on every order, because your lucky to finish the heaping helpings of fries. It is THE BEST BURGERS in E-Town. Bar none !

Wow! Some of the best barbeque experienced in the west. 
It is a small cozy place - the service is fast and congenial. The staff really care that you have a great experience and a good meal. The menu is straight forward and uncomplicated.
The food; Beans are like home-made cowboy style, the coleslaw is excellent, the potato salad is divine...but the real meat of the story is the BBQ meats. Ribs are excellent, the turkey succulent, the brisket is killer! 
The sauces are not overdone.

This is the real place for BBQ - not to be missed if you are in the Park!

Hard to describe...and the Edmonton area finally has a decent BBQ spot worth time and money!

If you're in the market for pulled pork check this place out. They have a small menu but what they do they do well. Huge portions that you still devour. They also do catering! I love this quaint family owned place.

Although their sandwiches are OK, they always take forever, and despite being a juice bar, it seems like their juicer is always broken. I've actually ordered juice and never received it because 45 minutes went by and I had to leave. Slowest place on earth but when they can actually get you the juice (2/5 times I've been there) it is pretty good.

Sliders where awesome and restaurant was very clean. Tho the price for two triple sliders combo's and two pops was over 34 dollars a bit pricey for the amount you get in meats. The potatoes chips came like someone sat on them or bottom of bag ( more crumbs then anything with a few chips on top) . And what they advertise as whipped and creamy garlic potatoes  were nothing short of lumpy and had more lumps in the potatoes then Edmonton has potholes ! They where disgusting as hell. My friend agrees his sliders where great and the beans here also good but his baked potato was barely warm . Yes he told them and nothing was offered so I see how customer service is here. I will say again the sliders are good but for that price more meat should be added .

Stay away!

Shysters. Tell you everything you want to hear, of course personable and friendly, cause it's their job. they really don't care about the person. They make the buying part a decent experience, until after the fact of course. Once they have your money they do not give a shit about you. They had supposedly done an inspection on the vehicle we bought before selling it to us, but of course we found issues almost right away. Trying to get them to fix these items was the worst experience. And they were items that should've been caught in the inspection, like a broken seatbelt. Had to make numerous trips back to the dealer for these repairs and they weren't apologetic at all for the hassles. Didn't offer to reimburse gas for all the trips. Now we're finding out certain crucial info about the cars history that was not disclosed fully to us in the beginning. That info would've caused us not to buy the vehicle, but they knew that and weren't upfront. They made the info vague and now we're finding out the vehicle isn't worth nearly as much as we thought and doubt we'll be able to resell if we wanted to.

Worst car  buying experience ever. They have caused us so much stress. Don't let their personable charm fool you. These are car sales men. They're pros at being fake.

Do not buy from them.

These guys don't even deserve one star.

So, in all fairness, I usually like this restaurant but it have to say - I just ordered delivery from them through Skip the Dishes for the first time and am not very pleased. I ordered my usual go-to pick, the Chopped Signature Salad with the fruit vinaigrette instead of balsamic and ordered the full size instead of the small. When I opened my box I saw that they had packed a very small container of dressing (enough for the small).  Had I known I would only get enough to cover about half of my salad I would have asked for extra.

Great little store with lots of variety. First place in Sherwood Park that we found Phillips Beer (from Victoria, BC). Its my husbands favourite brewery from Vancouver Island. They sometimes get the Advent Calendar (24 different beer for the days before Christmas) but you have to sign up early.

This salon is exceptionally run in so many ways. 

First off, every client receives a 5 minute scalp massage and treatment every time they come in for a service. This service is to die for and something that keeps me coming back time and time again. On some occasions I have even received a hand massage while I wait for my colour to set. Wow. 

Second, this salon actively and passionately cares about our environment. Sylvia's product line, Aveda, is derived from 100% natural ingredients. Not only that but they are one of the only salons I know of who recycles & repurposes hair, foils, colour-tubes, papers and plastics AND diverts excess hair chemicals from being rinsed down the drain through a program called green circles. 

Third, the staff members are always so pleasant and speak so highly of one another. The support among the women is real and it is so refreshing to hear and feel it. Not only that but each one of them has a portfolio available on Pinterest and Instagram where you can go browse each stylists look book. This gives you a great glimpse into which stylist would most suit your style. I for one love this. 

Fourth, the owner of the salon actively invests in her employees education. Each stylist receives continuous support and training from day one so that they are always working on and building upon their craft. 

Fifth, the atmosphere is warm, welcoming and smells divine. The music is soft and enjoyable, the tea is soothing and I always feel so beautiful when I walk out that door. 

You couldn't' persuade me to go anywhere else.

I went to buy a used xterra from these guys these past week and in the end I didn't go through with the sale and it left a really bad taste in my mouth. I found an xterra there that was used, 2 years old with a little less than 70,000km on it . The price was 29,000 which seemed somewhat reasonable when a new xterra is going for 37-38k. I went in the day it arrived and took it for a quick test drive,  after I was out with it they took it in to have its inspection and they ended up replacing the tires and brakes so the following day when I went back the price went up $2000 due to the work they performed on it. I was trading in my vehicle which they offered me a really low value on (as expected) but I was able to sell privately before I signed the paperwork for a lot more than the offered........ in the end I checked around at a few other dealerships in the city before I went through with the sale and I found that there was a huge sale on at all dealerships in the city trying to get rid of all 2014 stock.  I found a brand new 2014 same model however this one had heated leather seats, navigation, much better tires and a back up camera for only 2000 more than this used one they were trying to sell me.  I find it hard to believe that they were unaware of this huge sale taking place and don't think it was fair that they would try to sell me a used vehicle with no options, no bumper to bumper left, scratches on the bumpers, paint chips etc. for a price so close to a new one with the extra options. There is no way anyone would ever opt to buy the used vehicle if they knew of this sale happening and it was unethical of them to not say something in my opinion. I will personally never give them my business in the future and will tell this story to anyone I know who wants to buy a vehicle from them. In the end they tried to make a sale with the most profits possible and it cost them a customer and earned them this review, I hope it was worth it.

First time last time
This is my first time ever writing a review but felt it necessary after the service my wife received at Sherwood Nissan 
We have a 2014 pathfinder that can not say enough good thing about and we took it in for its annual 32,000 km service
We chose one of their service packages that was 329 knowing that there would be most likely additional charges for air filters etc. which we were fine with
I received a phone call from there service department stating that there were some recommended things to be done outside of the service plan
There was two type of air filters that were going to be an additional charge that was no problem also they want to charge $45 to clean the battery posts which baffled me a little as you would think that would be included in their so-called service
My wife stated that her door fab was not working properly and if they could look at it for her while it was in 
Apparently one of the settings inside the vehicle was turned off there for the fab would not work they turned it on and charge us an additional hundred dollars for diagnostic 
I then questioned what our service included as I thought it was excessive if it just needed to be turned on the lady stated to me that she would ask the mechanics of food like to work for free but she didn't believe they would
I found it very unprofessional and very rude that somebody would say that when we were just trying to figure out what the service included for $329
I have a business as well it would never expect anyone to work for free but I would not nickel and dime them to death and then be ignorant about it first and last time I will ever go there it is too bad seeing how we buy a new vehicle every second year and really have nothing bad to say about the Nissan product itself

Good western style Chinese food place. Fresh ingredients and lots of veggies in everything. Would go back. I say western style because the menu is in English only and the appetizer section includes buffalo wings...

I must get my car steering checked, driving west on Wye Road this afternoon and car took over and swerved into the parking lot of Five Guys Burgers & Fries, in shock I stumble into the restaurant. Forgetting my diet (wait what diet?), I order a burger & regular fries. 
This was 1230 during the lunch rush, four in front of me, great a long wait, but no my order was in took about 2-3 minutes from arrival until I was at my seat with my complement peanuts.  In a very short time, had not even finished my peanuts, was that Oder 77 that was called out, can't be, I still have nuts to eat.  But my order was ready, a hamburger to die for, the fresh made fries yummmmm, only complaint about fries, no order size smaller then regular, but I did manage to fight through the  order. If you are a burger guy/gal let your vehicle swerve in like mine did, you will not regrets.

The most honest garage I have ever worked with and I have examples (+ examples of great customer service).

1) I was told by Sherwood Honda I needed new breaks (front/back).  I took my car to Kal-Tire to get it done and they DECLINED doing because the breaks had too much life left.  Was 1.5 years before I needed the front and another year before the back (naturally Kal-Tire got my business)

2) Had a squeal when I was driving over 20-30 km/h and had it at Sherwood Honda for oil change and to take a look at the squeal.  Was told it was ~$700 to get the squeal fixed.  After the 'repair' it still squealed and Sherwood Honda tried to tell me the tires wore uneven so it would take new tires to fix the problem for another $800-1000.  I said 'no', took it to Kal-Tire, had a JOURNEYMAN mechanic look at it and ~$270 later it's fixed (just a new bearing)

3) I have purchased new winter and summer tires and their service is tremendous.  Furthermore, they do free repairs on the tire for life.  Definitely worth considering when price comparing.  1 or 2 free repairs the tires cost of the tires are way cheaper!

Thank you Kal-Tire! I go out of my way to refer business your way as often as possible!!

The service was simply "EXCELLENT"!! However I do think the waitresses are a tad phony and really need to open their vocabulary up and learn some synonyms for Excellent. Other than the overly " excellent " waitress the food was "excellent."

Without re-hashing what Gerry D. said in a previous post on 11/11/2012 basically the same thing happened to us.  After not hearing back from Sherwood Park Kia for several days I called several times asking for my deposit back.  I was told it would be ready on Friday, then Saturday, then Monday, then Wednesday.  On Monday I had enough and asked to speak with the owner/manager.  Mark called me back and was extremely belligerent and rude.  I said I simply wanted my money back and would move on.  I did file complaints with the regulatory agencies involved and was told by Mark that I "couldn't get him in trouble" so what was I doing.  Simply have the right to post my displeasure with his dealership.  I was also told that he "talked to staff" and that I should "be ashamed" of myself for the way I treated them.  I was always polite and direct.  I would recommend anyone looking at Sherwood Park Kia look at their "F" rating at the Better Business Bureau as well as other online rating systems.  They are rude, unprofessional, and will abuse you if you complain.

You need to stop what you're doing and go eat here. Highly recommend. Four of us dined, we had a mixture of appies and one person had the lamb shank special. Everything was fantastic. Lamb sliders, wow. Chef came out to greet us. Service was good. Only improvement would be an explanation of what we had from the server.

Am finding the burgers going downhill compared to when they first opened.  My last burger was under cooked, rare in the center. The bacon was rancid. I really find it difficult to understand why they cannot sauté the mushrooms, onions, peppers etc. on the flat top grill while cooking the burgers.  Something not difficult to do and would boost the quality and flavor of the burger.  I am disappointed that these burgers have become just another fast food burger. I expected more when they first opened and very disappointed that the burgers have gone done hill, so to speak, so quickly. I can't believe that this is the same type of burger New Yorker's would rave about. I will not be returning to Five Guys.

Are you kidding me! That was such a great meal. My husband and I just discovered this gem and I can't wait to go back. Very fast and friendly service from the owner. He told us that he makes it all from scratch. Even the baked beans, which are started from dried beans and made into this amazing saucy dish. The coleslaw was great. My husband had the beef brisket plate and we were very happy to see it doesn't come with sauce on it; since he's cutting down on the carbs. He enjoyed it without any sauce. They have three kinds of sauce at every table and you can put the amount you want on yours. I had pulled potato with beef brisket. It comes topped with the fresh coleslaw and two slices of pickles and a side of chips. Then it had bbq sauce and this special mayo sauce on the edge that was so amazing. There was so much food that both of us left with a takeout box for our lunch tomorrow, which I'm pretty stoked about. Happy dreams for me tonight.

I don't have high expectations for chain restaurants (I take them for what they are - somewhere to eat a moderately priced meal that provides consistently mediocre fare), but my last experience with this Boston Pizza was utterly disappointing.

I tried to place a delivery order online, but their system appeared to be down, so I called in my order and was informed that it would be delivered within an hour. Well, an hour passed. Then another hour passed. Two and a half hours after placing my order (an hour and a half after it was supposed to have been delivered), I received a phone call from someone at the restaurant. He casually informed me that their online ordering system was down and that my order hadn't gone through. When I told him that I hadn't ordered online, he had no explanation as to what happened, nor did he seem to care. His only response? "Do you still want your food? It'll be another hour." I told him no, and hung up.

After this upsetting phone call, I'm left with a couple of questions. If my order didn't go through, then how did the restaurant get my phone number? And if they had my phone number (which they clearly did), then why didn't they get in touch with me as soon as they recognized the issue? To me, this displays a complete disregard for customer service and lack of respect for my time and needs. I work in the customer service industry, and I would never treat my customers like this.
Nice place with lots of options for everyone.  I went with the seasonal over baked salmon and it was excellent.  The others at my table also all enjoyed their dinners as well.

Went to Earls for a celebration with girlfriends last Saturday night.  We went after 7 for dinner.  We started off with appetizers and ordered our meals.  I ordered my steak medium-rare it came well done when I mentioned this to the waitress she looked at me and said sorry.  Nothing was done!  The waitress was not very attentive at all and seemed like she had better things to do.  It was not busy the dining room was 1/2 full. I had not been to Earls in years as my last experience was not the greatest either.  It looks like I won't be going back.

We recently purchased our first new vehicle from Sherwood Nissan.  They gave us a great deal on the vehicle we wanted, took the time to listen to us, and went out of their way to put a smile on our faces.  From start to finish, a very enjoyable experience.  We would recommend them to anyone looking for a laid back purchasing experience.

Very good BBQ.  Meats are smoked in house daily. Sauces are also house made. You have the choice of regular house sauce and hot and sweet versions. You can even buy a bottle of your fav sauce to take home. I had ribs and brisket with slaw and cornbread. Very satisfying meal. With a drink, it all came to 25 bucks including tip. Decent price. This will be another on my list of places to come back to.

I figured since it's Wednesday I may as well get some buddies together and head down to a local watering hole and get some wings! We made our way to this BP's right in the middle of the evening rush and were helped right away! The wings took a while to come out, hence the four stars, but we always had a cold beer ready and conversations to bed had with the staff. The wings were great! I had the thia chili and twice baked hot, my buddy had hot and teriyaki! All in all it was a good night!

This Earl's is along Wye Road in Sherwood Park and is a convenient stop for casual dining when I'm in town on business.  I specifically remember being here on a few different trips that occurred in the middle of my long divorce and very much felt at home and at peace here.  I particularly like their wine selection and Asian themed dishes.  When the weather permits, I enjoy their patio and the service has always been very good.

Mmm yummers this is the best fast food place in the mall like a New York Times best seller that's how good it is 8/8 -IGN

Ps: Doug is talking about a different place

ribs are ok butneed to be cooked longer. i saw some bloody red parts.  
bbq sauce was great.  i hope they sell them in bottle one day.
corn bread was great. tasty and moist.

Hard working family has made this a popular dining spot in the Park for almost 20 years. Simple decor but great food and excellent value.  Chinese dishes are great and the staff will go out of their way to accommodate your needs.

The best hands down burger joint in the Edmonton area!!!! My boyfriend and I tried it out yesterday- all I can say it blew both of us away! It was fantastic...the portions are very BIG! We shared regular fries which was more then enough for the both of us. He had a regular bacon cheeseburger, which is 2 patties and a ton of toppings that are FREE! I had a little cheeseburger that was a single patty and again a ton of toppings if you so wish! 
They also have a nice touch of peanuts available to customers that are complimentary. 
I would say it was reasonably prices for what you get. 
This place is better then Fulton Burger and Fat Burger! Although they don't have milkshakes. :(

To be honest, it's hard to only give three stars here. This guy is a Sherwood Park Staple. He knows his customers and works hard. He's in every day and the place, although not in the best shape, is clean. Is it the best donair? Probably not. Is it the kind of place that you walk into and feel like you are being pampered or are made of money? Not at all. This is one of those places though that you find and tell your friends about. The kind of place that makes you feel comfortable walking into on a lonely day. If this place were a song it would be "I've got friends in low places" because this guy and this place are one of a kind, they always welcome you and you always know what to expect. 

I would honestly give a 4* rating if not for the fact that he is always out of fries. I like fries to go with my donair and he always seems to be out. Please bro, get some fries! 

In the winter the temp. can be on the cold side as well making it hard to enjoy a warm meal. 

As for the decor? I'm sure if he gets busier, he would be able to renovate that much easier. But enjoy it for what it is, the ever whispered about, always loved nugget in the rough. 

PS Love his truck that states "Way, Way less then 4 billion served" HA! Love it!

Very disappointed. We ordered a 10 pieces of chubby chicken and it's included  coleslaw and fries. But, unfortunately they're run out of coleslaw so I asked if it's possible to order onion rings instead and I will pay the difference. The staff I talked to automatic says "NO" 
In a very rude way. So what we did, we canceled the order and went to Wye road A&W and ordered Chubby chicken, upgraded the coleslaw to Onion rings and I left happy and satisfied. I will never coming back to A&W BASELINE!
We checked this place out last night the food was amazing. Had the stuffed potato and it was awesome I was truly stuffed.

Foods not that great but the service was even worse. Sat in the lounge & it was like pulling teeth to have the bartender/waitress fill up my drink, bring me the check, take my credit card. Not to mention, she's stuffing her face with food. Gross...

Apparently I'm on a burger kick lately, and so far, Fulton Market Burger definitely takes the cake. (Takes the beef? I don't know. Insert some kind of meat-appropriate idiom here.)

With a meeting planned in Sherwood Park, I just knew I would have to visit Fulton while I was here. The hype on Yelp was killing me! It was a must-see. I drove to the Park early so I would have time for a tasty lunch, and after a bit of confusion with Google Maps (SP, why you have named streets instead of numbered streets?), I finally found it.

It's in a brand-new looking complex - the building is very nice and modern. I like the high ceilings in here, too. Gives it an open feel.

FMB is set up like this: pick your patty (one of about a dozen), pick your bun (maybe 10 or so to choose from), then add as many free (tons!), special (I think they were 50 cents?), and super special premium (I think they were $1) toppings as you want. I picked a bison burger on a ciabatta bun with lettuce, tomato, mayo, BBQ sauce, jalapeno jack cheese, guacamole, and bacon. I'm sure you're wondering, and the answer is yes: it tasted just as delicious as it sounds.

I'm sure my order was far from the most complicated they've seen, but I was still impressed that everything came out correctly. The gal working the till added every item as I said it and I could see each item show up on the computer screen to make sure that my order was entered correctly.

While my burger was very tasty and I was impressed with the meal and experience overall, I'm docking one little star. Tasty yes, but hot, no. The burger was somewhere between warm and hot, but it definitely wasn't piping.

Horrible service. Waited an hour for my bacon and eggs and waited over 15 mins to get my coffee after I was seated. The worst part is that the restaurant wasn't even close to being busy. So many empty tables. I asked for my eggs to be not slimy but they came out slimy. So gross. I'm not impressed, will never come back. Very disappointed. :|

We went for Sunday football, the service was absolutely wonderful. The new drinks are really good, my personal favourite is the new west coast sour. During football the tankards are on sale, which is a bonus. The food is quick and hot. The only downside was that we always get calamari, so my husband and I both got an appetizer of calamari to ourselves but they switched the recipe from the one that has tzatiki and banana peppers. To calamari with jalapeños, red onions, and garlic aioli on top and some weird sauce the looks like shrimp sauce on top of sour cream. We were very disappointed when calamari was gone for a little while but this new recipe is a no go for us.

The parking here is... odd.  You can pretty much forget about parking in the lot out front - in fact, avoid this tiny, awkward space - but there is ample parking across the street.  The foyer is ample enough to handle waiting patrons, which is good because if you arrive here after six you will be wait, though rarely longer than fifteen minutes.

You won't wait long to be offered drinks once you're seated.  If you are gluten intolerant or vegetarian, be sure to ask your host/ess for a specific menu.  They have both available and happily answer questions about either.  We are huge fans of the salads and soup/salad combo.  I know that's an odd choice with such a varied menu, but we have tried other selections as well and thoroughly enjoyed everything.  The Hunan Kung Pao is particularly good, but if you like spicy food, order at least four chilis.  

Earl's offers seasonal desserts that are delicious and prepared on site instead of ordered in frozen as well as a hot buttered toffee drink that makes a fantastic dessert alternative.  They also have a delicious assortment of coffee cocktails for after dinner.

I appreciate the lack of false chipper in the servers.  They do their jobs well, balancing friendliness with efficiency.

Great place to eat as a family or with friends, though I don't advise bringing small children here.  The place does get quite loud during busy evenings.

This location is hit or miss.  Usually more hits though.  Way better than the Claireview location, worth the drive East for sure!  Recently though I ordered a burger on a Gluten Free bun and the bun cam out FROZEN.  They offered to make me a new burger, I asked if I could have a new bun instead as everything else seemed ok.  Took over 15 min for my bun to come out and it was SLOW and the rest of my table was done eating before I could even start.  Didn't even get a discount for the delay.  I didn't expect my meal for free, but maybe 50% would have been nice.  Especially when I didn't yell and scream and freak out over a that.  I have seen people melt down for less.  And the manager was well aware of the situation as he said he was the one who prepared my burger AND heated a new bun.  Other than this is had been great service and food.

Meh... Mediocre Food for Premiere price. 

My husband and I went last night. We had spinach dip, wings, a caprese sandwich and a prime rib burger. 

The food wasn't terrible, it just wasn't anything to rave about.  Very forgettable.

 Service was sub-par. There were 2 servers and only 2-3 tables filled in the restaurant - no one at the bar.  Both waitresses seemed to be pissy.  Not social or bubbly.  The whole experience was a bit dreary.  We most likely won't be back.

They have 3 draught taps for Growler refills of local craft fav, Alley Kat. FRESH BEER IN THE PARK!! Pale Moon is our favourite by a long shot and can hold up to any BC hop head's craving. We were able to find some beers we liked from BC after moving from Vancouver, and were surprised by a few we hadn't seen before, including Wild Rose seasonal 41. They are outdone by BC craft beer stores, sure, but this is an awesome store with a cooler and I'm guaranteed to find something I like here, so I don't shop elsewhere.

Best burger place in Edmonton area, beats Fat Burger Any day, It's fast, good service, extremely customizable menu, like you pick every single bit of your order. Makes the best milkshakes in town, cause they use the good expensive ice cream, not like other restaurants that use cheap ice cream that taste plain. Burgers here look exactly like they are displayed on the pictures, which surprised me. Only thing bad is the location of the place, its located in the middle of no where hiding behind car dealerships and factory's, they need to get more advertisement out there. I'm definitely  putting a good word out to people i know. If i was hungry and craving a burger, i would drive 45 minutes just to go to this place.

5Guys is fast food, done slower... and better. 

The regular burger is actually a double, and the "little" burger is a single. 
There is nothing fancy about these burgers, so if you think you're going for some gourmet burger you should just turn around and maybe go see the folks at The Next Act, or talk to Chef Cowan at Hundred Bar and Kitchen. 

This thing is juicy and cheesy. Just the way I like it. 
And it isn't pretty. It actually looks a mess by the time i've finished loading stuff onto it. But it tastes good. 

Really good. 

It's greasy in a way that you know is wrong, but oh so right. Just don't eat 3 a week and you'll be fine. 

You can top these bad boys with any amount of toppings from the huge selections, and I dare you to leave still hungry. At $7.50, it comes in right in between fast food burgers and sit down restaurant burgers. 

The fries are a bit hit and miss here. Everywhere I've had them in the states, they are awesome. Here? They're about 50-50. 

It's worth checking them out, and just FYI.... it's BYOD. 

That's Bring Your Own Defribrillator.

A long-standing Sherwood Park small business master cleaner has proven time and time again the quality of their service outstanding customer service 
free delivery you really can't beat master cleaner

We went there on a Friday night to celebrate a birthday. There were ten of us for a birthday celebration and we arrived at 6 pm   When they finally took our order it was 6:30 and the food didn't arrive until 7:45!!!
