Very poor service and no offers were made to see us through their inconvenience. Very disappointed. The food was ok but nothing spectacular

Best in Sherwood Park. And I have tried them all!

It's high time I update my review.
This is no longer the Famous Donair of old.
I went once years ago. Much like the older reviews state...I wasn't impressed at that time.
That however...was years ago, and I have recently learned that was under the original owner. He was an "old school", "my place...my way...my hours" kinda guy. Hence, the reviews which state odd hours and inconsisstent service.
So I've always approached since with trepidation.

That being said...
Today's incarnation...
New owner.
Consistant hours and quality.
Even delivery option during peak hours.

Upon dining here on several occasions recently...
Damn.
It really hits the spot!
Juicy and delicious.
Friendly service.
It's not fancy. Could use an update on the decor to go with the updated owner...but I'm not here for the ambiance. I'm here for a donair.

I do believe I finally appreciate why they are Famous.

In Edmonton area for work and we spotted this small strip mall BBQ place in Sherwood Park while driving by in the late evening. Stopped to check it out but it was closed fairly early which makes sense for a good BBQ place. Through the windows it looked pretty quaint, kind of  old diner style. The menu posted in the window was so compelling, we just had to try it. The next day we headed went back for a late lunch. The cashier, cook (BBQ pit master) dishwasher and owner greeted us and took our order. The decor has some interesting theatre to spark discussion, service was quick and the portions were hearty. Most of all, this is authentic BBQ and Paul is very passionate about his craft. The BBQ was awesome and all the sides were excellent. I loved the beans and the cornbread was delicious. The brisket was wonderful.  I had the half rack of ribs and couldn't finish my meal in the restaurant. That led to some very jealous coworkers on my next work shift lunch break. I noted they offer a catering service and if I was hosting an event, I would definitely consider this option. I will definitely dine at "That Bar-B-Q Place" every visit to Edmonton going forward.

I got my haircut at tommy guns recently and I was very happy with the results. A little tip for this place is after you check in, don't leave and let them text you because it's always faster to wait in the store. The machine for checkin said it would be 1.5 hour wait, but I grabbed a chair within 10 minutes by waiting.
The reason this is 3 stars instead of 4 or 5 is that while I was getting my hair cut I had to slouch really really low. You see, my hairdresser was about 5' even and didn't have a stool, so she could see the top of my head (I'm not even that tall at 5'10"). 
I have never experienced anything like this before and know it won't happen to everyone, but it really threw me off.
Overall a good experience, but doubt I would be back.

Enjoy this place when I stop in for sure! Would love to see a renovation take place!! I enjoy at other locations where I can see my food being prepared for me rather then behind a secret wall 

  Absolutely no complaints other then that (not that it is s complaint, more so an idea). The food is always enjoyable, staff have never been a problem. So rock on Wendy's location!

I've been coming to BPs for years now and I'm happy to say I've had plenty of good experiences when I do! The food is always fresh and quick getting to me, the service is kind, plus I always walk away satisfied and happy that I went  

It's a must visiting this place every Wing Wednesday to grab a pound of their award winning wings for half off. These guys can't spell wings without win for good reason  Check it out for yourself when you get the chance!

Quick update: you should check out the newly upgraded bar the next time you come here, it looks great!

What is not to like about a gas station that offers a great discount to members?

We had been a Costco member for a year or two before we clued in to the fact that they had gas at a decent price and then offered a discount to members on top of that. 

The discount usually amounts to about five cents per litre, which is nice because it isn't like some places that offer a discount by giving you a coupon to spend in their store (SuperStore). This discount is right off the top.

They have both self-serve and full service available.

The staff was extremely helpful. Great healthy alternative to fast food, we loved that we got to mix different kinds of meat choices. My husband and I love our food spicy and we weren't disappointed. They use fresh ingredients and the portion sizes are awesome. Had a great lunch for 25 dollars we will definitely go back! The only down fall is that because it is considered fast food they don't serve alcohol but the restaurant set up is very modern and extremely clean

So another Boston Pizza. 
Does it stand up? Yup you bet. 

The greatest thing about this is that the specials are always exactly as advertised, and I love the pasta Tuesday.

Pros
Lots of parking
Great specials
Great food staff

Cons
Why didn't it get a 5 star review? It could be a bit better for their prices regularly, but how can you complain about a delicious and mountainous pasta for $10?
Staff are very helpful and knowledgable. Some prices are s bit higher but quality is good. We love coming at Christmas time as well and the cafe is fabulous for a date.

First visit, very good, very friendly service. Lots of food! Smoked turkey is very good, not dry. Coleslaw and mashed potatoes are delish and iced tea tastes like what my mom made when I was a kid. Sliders are a great option to try the different smoked meats. Didn't have room for dessert this time.

Worst manicure I have ever received.
They have poor customer service and rushed the entire manicure as they had double booked.

Seriously as good as it gets for a non-fast food burger. A strange niche in the world of fast/ and tasty! Get into five guys for tasty burgers and tastier fries. Warning. Don't get the cajun fries without a sample. I've found it not as good as the normal fries.
I"m not going to talk about the burgers, because the burgers are exactly what you would want.

Went to pick up my dry cleaning after the expected pickup time and was told that my item could not be found after a halfhearted search. Was asked if it was too much trouble to come back some time later. When asked when I should come back and where my item might be I got a fairly noncommittal answer. This is not acceptable. Although this location is walking distance from my home I don't intend on coming back.

came in right before close on a Saturday night and the owner Bruce was super friendly and helpful!! the portions were generous and the house Bbq sauce is amazing!! will be back for sure especially because of 10/10 customer service

Service was pretty good. The waiting room/area was amazing they have a little deli where you can get various munchables. If your vehicle is going to be a while you can even get a shuttle that'll take you home and even pic you up when it's ready.

4 stars for consistency, good food, good prices, great service and a high degree of cleanliness (a very important factor).  Also, it's a franchise that has seemed to recognize the big hits for customers and has maintained them on the menu for while.  Overall a great place for lunch or supper.
Kaela was fantastic. Food was great. Thanks!

Not bad not bad.  All in all service was good and food was quick and well prepared.  I was surprised for a new restaurant and it being so busy.  Anything that I saw as an issue I would chalk up to opening wrinkles that need to be ironed out.  We will definitely try again  sure.

Why would I drive 25 minutes to a burger joint on a Saturday night? Why did the chicken cross the road? To order the best burger from a fast food outlet. Fresh, fast, and tasty. Great value considering what the other fast food burger joints offer.  It's more expensive than a In and Out burger but you get more burger. The concept is the same, a limited menu and cooked right in front of you as you wait.

After the second attempt to get my haircut here I think it is time to start going somewhere else. Whenever I go there they have a dozen chairs but only two or three girls cutting hair. It's a minimum hour wait. And today it was 3pm and they said they weren't taking any new clients even though they are open till six. WTF! Don't waste your time with this place. For the price you pay you get a substandard haircut.

To be fair, as a current Texan and former resident of Kansas City, I probably have super high standards.  I love brisket and like to try different types.  It wasn't awful, but I found it to be a little tough and dry.  If it was sliced at the more common 1/4 Inch thickness for Central Texas style, it may have helped but it was still drier than it should have been.  I also didn't find the brisket very flavorful.  It's amazing what salt, pepper and good post oak smoke can do to a brisket when done right.  I usually don't eat brisket with any sauce but needed the sauce here for flavor (sauce was very good by the way).  Lastly, I didn't like the cornbread and the pit beans I found to be average.  Overall I may try again and get something different, especially different sides.  The folks working there were very nice and I wish I had a different take.
I've never had bad food here ever! I've only ever sat in the lounge, but the service is always great.  :)

Very unprofessional!  Went to test a drive 2016 Sorento, it was filthy dirt the salesman never even acknowledged the dirty when we asked about it. Every question we had about the vehicle he could not answer. No price is indicated anywhere. He insisted we on a 500. deposit, we said you haven't even told us anything about the vehicle!!!!! We never even saw one feature! We continued to ask "What is the price?" Another employee realized the current sales person was incapable so he asked the manager to help us! We had every intention to drive home with a new vehicle that day but as a result of the unprofessional nature it was not going to happen. The dress and grooming of the sales people are a poor example of a $47,000.00 purchase. Kia Canada should be addressing the embarrassing representation from this dealership. We will be taking our business elsewhere.

Earl's in the Park not to die for, I would prefer death. Wait was long (not busy) 
food overdone. We had a late dinner Brides Chicken Caesar server told us they had to redo as chicken was overdone, when it came it was still overdone. My hot wings I think came from the KFC dumpster and the Celery ! I did not know they grew Brown Celery. The dip (who knows what flavor) I had to break through the crust so passed on it. Next time I have the urge to go to Earls I think maybe stop short at Wendy's. Oh by the way don't try the coupons from hockey game, this one does not accept them.

These people are absolutely horrible. I know car sales people are a little different and very manipulating. These guys are the worst of the worst. When I did not decide to buy a car at the first visit, assistant manager guy was so mad and he kept yelling at  me and my wife. I regret I did not call the police at that time. I started going to tommy guns on a more regular basis in the last year or so. In that time I have seen the same hairdresser 10 or more times and have started to request her specifically because she is amazing.
I would tell you her name but then you would likely request her too and then the wait would be too long. So I'll tell you.. . It rhyme with "hemma" or "jemma" or "schmemma"... morale of the story is don't book emma. She's mine. I love getting my hair cut by her and will continue to go back and wait for her when I have the chance. This is my new place. Back off... it's mine!

Hidden off some of the main roads in Sherwood Park is Fulton Market Burger Co, a wonderful burger restaurant that allows you to create your own edible masterpiece. They make it easy by offering cards and pencils when you walk in the door, allowing you to construct your burger at your own pace, before you get to the till, or select one of the seven offerings from the menu.

I grabbed one of the cards so I could list all the options available (current as of this review):

Choose your meat:
1/3 LB prime rib burger
1/2 LB prime rib burger
Grilled chicken breast
Cheese stuffed Italian sausage
Veggie burger
All beef hot dog
Kid's burger combo
Kid's chicken nuggets
--You can also make the burgers (top 2 choices) a double

Pick your bun:
All dressed; classic bun; hot dog bun; whole wheat bun; ciabatta bun

Classic toppings (all free):
Tomato; Fulton signature sauce; Honey mustard; Jerk sauce; Red pepper mayo; Garlic herb mayo; Lettuce; Red onions; Chipotle mayo; Salsa; Ketchup; Cajun spice; Cucumbers; BBQ sauce; Pickles; Blue cheese sauce; Steak sauce; Mustard; Horseradish; Peppercorn mushroom sauce; Teriyaki; Relish; Frank's hot sauce; Ranch; Dijon mustard; Corn relish

Deluxe toppings (50 cents each):
Shitake mushrooms; Caramelized onions; Guacamole; Grilled Portabella; Sauerkraut; Dusted onions; Roasted red peppers; Grilled pineapple; Button mushrooms; Banana peppers; Jalapeno peppers; Avocado

Supreme toppings (99 cents each):
Strip bacon; Mozzarella; Jalapeno jack; Peameal bacon; Goats cheese; Cheddar; Provalone; Swiss; Smoked cheddar; Chili; Havarti; Havarti dill

You can also pick from sides, which include onion rings, fries, Coney Island fries, sweet potato fries, ranch potato wedges, poutine, New York poutine, garden salad, caesar salad, and coleslaw.

What's on MY perfect burger (the GordoBurger), you ask? Well, let me tell you...
I start off with the 1/3 LB Prime Rib patty (these burgers are VERY filling, and I doubt I could do the 1/2 LB), on the classic bun. I'll add some burger staples such as ketchup, mustard, pickles and lettuce, but then spice it up with some Cajun spice, and jalapenos. The dusted onions, which are like mini onion rings, are extremely tasty as well, and not something commonly found at burger places (Red Robin's has these as well - called "onion straws"). Then I'll top it off with some strip bacon, and either jalapeno jack, or cheddar cheese. Depending on my mood I'll have either onion rings, sweet potato fries, or regular fries, with a nice Sprite to drink. Wow, I'm getting hungry again just thinking about it!

You'll have to wait a few minutes for your burger, but it'll come out nice and fresh. Burger toppings can be a very personal thing, and Fulton Market has everyone covered with their selection of toppings.

This Liquor, Beer & Wine store is a fantastic independent store. Locally owned, with an amazing selection of Beer, Spriits , Wine & Specialty items. Personal service....they will "Special Order"  for you if it's available.
Great for Beer Aficionados  &  Connoisseurs! One of the BEST SELECTIONS around. Wow. Check them out...Order a Keg for your next party!
You won't be disappointed shopping there.
Friendly personal service too.
They CARE about you at  LITTLE GUY.
Once you shop here....you will not go back to the Big Box stores!

Well we came down to five guys because of all of the reviews, well what a letdown!! The  place is filthy and the burgers are paper thin with out flavor. The only good thing was the fries. We will not be returning. We were very disappointed!

They carry a lot of plants, some varieties are rare in Canada. Just be sure to inspect the leaves and soil for bugs. Bought several plants with spider mites and fungus gnats, it will ruin your life. Oh and be sure to isolate it for a month so you don't jeopardize your other healthy plants.

Have been seeing Tessa for past year. Love her! She is just building her clients, lovely young stylist. Always takes her time to make sure your happy & her kind way to advise what will / won't work. Never rushed enjoyable to visit with. I've always got many compliments with cut & highlights! Up & coming star!!

Brutal! 
We went to buy a lawnmower. They had them in the flyers, also on display. But if you want one, they keep them in trailers behind the store. You need to drive around back, and  They start rummaging through. We waited about 40 min, then asked for the receipt back so we could just get our money. When I went inside to customer service, there were three people working at the desk, all off of one till. Not sure why, but they were. The line was 5 deep. I waited for another 20 min until it was my turn. They had to call the department, which said there was three in stock. So they told me to go back, they couldn't do a refund. The one older lady at customer service was rude, no one ever apologized for the error they created. At one point she even accused me of stealing to another girl at customer service. I have used Master Cleaner for a long time -whether it is the typical "I need my suits and shirts done" or the unusual (like the time I spilled an epoxy resin coating on my leather jacket,) whatever I drop off ends up looking great when I get it back. Highly recommend these guys -great work, great pricing, great results. And they're always done on time.

Fast sorting and accurate counting!  They have carts available to push your bottles from your car.

It's also right next to the used oil depot (operated by the bottle depot).

By far the best Mucho Burrito I've ever been to. Staff is very friendly and always stuff the burrito super full. They never scrimp on ingredients and if you want a little more of something they are happy to appease you. Highly recommend this location.

I usually go to Fountain Tire for my car servicing and needed my power steering fluid flushed and replaced.  Fountain Tire's price was way higher than Kal Tire's so I chose to go to Kal Tire instead.  Fountain Tire had told me the seals were bad and might leak but when Kal Tire serviced my car they said it was all fine.  Three weeks after Kal Tire replaced my power steering fluid, I lost all power steering.  Clearly the seals were bad and they didn't catch it.  I wasted my money there and don't recommend using them at all.

Not the best experience. Clearly our waiter was new and I'm going to guess poorly trained. He was very frazzled. To begin with he was doing the job of 3 people. He was waiting, bussing tables and mopping floors behind a booth that had a pint of beer spilled on them. He came back with a hand full of napkins and began to mop the spill on the table a bench seat leaving the poor guys to sit with beer under their feet throughout their meal. This is one of my fave spots if you're craving a burger and fries but also need it to be fast! There's even peanuts to munch on while you wait! All the fries are made in the restaurant fresh and they always throw extra into the paper bag so you have all the potatoe goodness you can handle, because lets face it the fries at the bottom of the bag are the best. Most of the burgers come standard with two patties so if you've never gone before don't forget to ask for just one if you don't think you can handle it! It's a great burger joint with all the right fixings, love going here and would recommend to anyone.
Amazing food, quick service, very friendly.  Loved it, and my 5 kids wolfed down 2 lbs of meat
If you are going to get a haircut, do check this place out.  Never been disappointed. Their stylists really know what they are doing.  Highly recommend this place!

I don't live in Sherwood Park but I visit this Earl's very often in the summer. The patio is great. It is surrounded by brick fencing so you feel like you can enjoy the outdoors and some privacy as well. 

The inside lounge is really nice too. The bar is a lit up semi-circle style that many people sit at. It just has an inviting atmosphere. If you are looking for privacy they have booths inside as well. 

The service is good and the wings are among the best in the city.

Their burritos/bowls are generally good. I'm disappointed that they recently changed their tortilla chips from freshly made to store bought. Also, the most recent time we've been here, I had the pork burrito and bit into a chunk of charcoal or something black in which tells me they're not cleaning the grill well enough.

This Earl's has always been a personal favorite of mine. The only possible complaint I can think of is the parking lot- unfortunately tiny and awkwardly situated, however the rest of this reastaurant's features more than make up for that tiny blip. 

The atmosphere here is wonderful, very comfortable, and excellent service. I have been here multiple times for both family dinners and business lunches, and Earls is perfectly suitable for both.

When this location first opened we came here a lot. At some point we stopped coming as much but recently I decided to revisit it to see if it was as good as I remembered. I think it could have even been better than I remembered. The burgers are great. I love the limited selection but your ability to pick your own toppings. And the fries! Two words - bag fries. Seriously so good. The only downside is the wait of them having to cook your burger fresh - but is that really even a downside?

I've read a few of the other reviews on this place and they sum up the restaurant pretty well.  However, I'd like to add a few things to their assessments.

First off, the last few times we've gone to Fulton Market, our experience has been less that stellar.  The first time I went there, August of 2009, I think, I had nothing but good things to say about the place.  But the last few times, things seem to have gone downhill.  They still make some of the best burgers in the Edmonton area, but the quality has taken a hit.  Case in point: totally hard avocado on my girlfriends burger during our last visit.  Somebody in the kitchen didn't know how to pick a ripe avocado apparently.  We've also learned to ask for "light" sauce on anything that has sauce, otherwise the burger is swimming in the sauce.  Their sweet potatoes fries are a miss if you ask me.  They are really lacking in seasoning.

They still make some of the best milkshakes in town, using good ice cream.

With all of this said, the burgers are still quite enjoyable and fairly reasonably priced.  Expect to wait a while on a busy Friday or Saturday night.  Fulton Market still beats most burger joints, hands-down, but quality seems to be slipping.

What could you possibly complain about here?  The gas discounts alone make the Costco membership worth it these days.

I usually stop in the morning on my way to work, and it is never busy at that time of the day.  Even when there's reports that the price is about to spike.  

The attendants always make their presence known, but don't bother you unless it looks like you need help.  Then they'll jump in and do what they can for you.

**NOTE - pay attention to road markings and signs - you can only enter from one direction.  And they do not take cash or credit cards, other than the Costco credit card.

I visited here for the first time yesterday after so many rave reviews. I was not disappointed. I had a cheese donair that was beyond large and absolutely loaded with meat. I have a big appetite and it takes a lot to fill me. I could barely finish this donair. The staff were so friendly and happy. They were literally running to bring people their food. There were many things on the menu I wanted to try and I will definitely be back to do that. So happy I heard about this place!
Decent restaurant with fairly good service and the wraps are fantastic. Bottomless fries and they're awesome too.

Horrible dealership. Bought a 2010 Nissan Titan. Supposedly passed Sherwood Park Nissan's inspection. Not even a week later had to have the front and rear pinion seals on my differentials replaced. Rear differential pinions have be replace 2 more times since. Whole rear differential is finally being replaced. Since I bought the vehicle at 40000km the front and rear struts have been replaced, the back brakes have been replaced, the passenger side CV joint boot has been replaced, all of the door seals, rear bumper and sensors. I have only put on 30000 km since I bought the truck. I do not take the truck off road or pull any heavy loads. I recently found out that Sherwood Park Nissan passes all of their used vehicle inspection reports. All of the repairs have been done at Mills Nissan because Sherwood Park Nissan will not replace them under warranty. I was also promised an owner's manual which took over a year to get. DO NOT BUY A VEHICLE FROM SHERWOOD PARK NISSAN. WORST DEALERSHIP EVER!

I have always been a huge fan of Red Robin!!  Since this location opened a few months ago, I have already been about a half a dozen times.  The food is always good, there is a pretty good selection, and prices are fair.

This location has been pretty busy since it's opening (weekends especially) but if I can get there before the standard rush times, I have never had to wait too long.

Unfortunately, I wont not recommend this location for large groups on weekends.  We recently showed up for a friend's birthday on a Friday evening.  We had called about a week ahead to attempt to make a reservation, and this is when we found out that they wont take reservations on a weekend; however, if we were to show up before 4:30pm, they should be able to accommodate us.

Well, they did find us somewhere to all sit together which was nice.  But for the rest of the evening, the service was horrible.  Don't get me wrong; it was NOT for lack of trying, but these poor girls were so confused/lost by everything that some people were eating before others had ordered, and it literally took over 1.5 hours AFTER we FINISHED eating to settle the bills.  You would think the manager might step in eventually to help out; but no, he just pretended like nothing was happening and carried on with what he was doing. 

After a few people had complained from our party, they offered to comp the bday girl's meal; unfortunately, that left 19 other unhappy customers and probably a pretty upset young waitress.  The lack of support from management was very disappointing and there was barely an apology offered.

Nonetheless, this is a great place for a party of about 5 or less, and I will be back because I just can't resist the food sometimes.

Went there last November ... My husband Ordered seafood fettuccine ...
Gross .. No seasoning ... Pollock and tiny pieces of shrimps.. I had the daily special wich was the beef ribs. Un... Eatable . Couldn't even chew the one bite I took. Had a Caesar ....  Ordinary. Caesar salad .. All
Coming out of a box / bag.  I also had the won ton soup to start ... Hell no don't even try it !!!!!! 

100$ for supper ... What a waste of money
This is one of the first time ever in a restaurant I couldn't even take one more bite off my beef ribs.  Maybe for pizza one day ... The other couple in the restaurant ( there was only my husband and I and some other couple in the restaurant at prime time hours) ordered pizza and it didn't look too shabby ...

My friend and I ventured down to Sherwood Park recently to try That Bar-B-Q Place. The family-owned restaurant serves different types of Southern BBQ (beef brisket, pulled pork, turkey breast, and ribs). The BBQ can be ordered in a sandwich or in dinner platters. For sides, you can choose from coleslaw, corn bread, baked beans, and potatoes (mashed or baked). The food gets heavy so I would suggest coming here for dinner instead of lunch. It's a fast-casual style restaurant where you order, pay, then wait for your food to be brought out to you.

I knew I had to order their famous creation when I heard about it. The Pulled Potato is a baked potato piled high with your choice of brisket or pulled pork, smoked cheddar, coleslaw, Louisana mayo, BBQ sauce, and pickles on top. It also came with a few potato chips - as if you need more potatoes right?! I decided to get mine with pulled pork and no pickles. The pulled pork was tender and there was a good amount of it. The coleslaw added a refreshing touch to the otherwise heavy item. I found the whole thing to be very filling even though it wasn't accompanied with a side like the rest of the menu items. It was a bit too saucy towards the end though. The Pulled Potato was good but wasn't anything spectacular. I do recommend trying their housemade hot BBQ sauce with the pulled pork for a hint of spice.

My friend had the regular-sized beef brisket sandwich, which comes with one homemade side. At first bite, he found the brisket to be very dry. I tried a bit and I would have to agree that it was way too dry to eat. He informed the owner who told us that the meats were made without sauce. He brought him a new beef brisket sandwich which tasted more moist but the dryness still lingered. For his side, he decided to go with garlic, creamy whipped potatoes. It certainly tasted homemade!

I wouldn't go out of my way to stop by this BBQ place but if you're around the area, stop by and try the Pulled Potato for something different! They also offer family platters which seems like a good deal if you're with a group of people. It's located between Costco and Millennium Place, or in the same area as Sumo Sumo.

Unfortunately, this is how
My wife's burger came tonight. We both have grown up with BP and have always experienced great service in the restaurant or delivery. This time was a disappointment. Bun burnt on the burger, and the food barely warm. Prolly a slip up, but investment in training in supervisors is always a good idea.

This place is so lovely just to visit on a nice day, it has a lovely little cafe built in and now has a gorgeous indoor pond with waterfalls! 

The quality of their plants is second to none and they offer a replacement and warranty option on many of their plants, which is a really nice piece of mind when buying expensive large plants. 

My only complaint is that they don't have as many indoor plants now that they have put in the big water feature, but hopefully they are adding more again in the future.
Just awful! Found the food to be cold and tasted like cardboard. I use to really love Wendy's but after this visit I don't think I'll ever be back.
Om nom nom nom! That about sums it up!  Best burger I've had in a while. Go eat, you'll see :)
Really enjoy this place when on the go! Always my go to for a wrap and a smoothie. There soups are great as well, however still high in calories. Very affordable and great prices for kids meals!

For a barbeque joint, the food is extremely affordable at this Sherwood Park restaurant. This place is always busy at lunch but they do a great job at getting everyone's food at quickly! 

My favourite is definitely the pulled pork sandwich with a side of garlic mashed potatoes. The pork has zero to very little fat and they have a selection of BBQ sauces for you to try. Another good choice is the pulled potatoe which is a baked potatoes with your choice of meat and beans or slaw.  Even though it doesn't sounds like much, it is extremely filling!

When looking at vehicles at Sherwood Kia I was initially impressed with the salesman. He was very helpful and led me to the used vehicle price range I was interested in. Upon pick up I was given the inspection report (the one completed after and not the original showing the actual problems found. This report of course states everything was fixed and now ok. Partly my fault for not going through the vehicle with a fine tooth comb. After 6 weeks I'm finding more and more wrong. The passenger door won't lock with power locks, the flip seat to get into the 3rd row doesn't work. Only the driver heat works. The passenger works barely and the rear not at all. Could not really tell until the weather got cold. Of course there is no guarantee on used vehicles but these are basic things that should be working. I am disappointed and will not return to this dealership in the future. I guess when buying a used vehicle you can take the "inspection" and just ignore it. I have learned and won't let this happen again.
Absolutely amazed with my hair! Very very good results and very very professional! Jessica is amazing hair stylist I would definitely recommend her.

Went to SP Dodge to look at a Fiat. I had been in touch with the sales team in advance and had a contact name. Went to the dealership at the time we were told, but when we arrived we were told the sales person was not in that day - why on earth would you schedule an appointment on a day you don't work? Then, we spent no less than 45 minutes waiting for a sales person to speak to us about the Fiats. We saw the one we wanted to test drive, but were told that there were no keys (um, k?). We head home disappointed, only to be emailed the next day by that salesperson asking why we didn't take it for a test drive. We bought a Volkswagen instead.

More than this, the Owner is a self-righteous, arrogant man. He is impossible to reach, he thinks the world revolves around him, and I'm sure he'd step on his own grandmother to get ahead. All in all, not impressed with this "just what you expect from used car salesmen"-style dealership.

If you want gas discounts all time then look no further than a Costco Gas Station. I don't come here very often but similar to other Costco gas stations, they have multiple lanes with two gas pumps lined up on each side. If the pumps are busy - which they can be at most times during the day, then be prepared to wait. It sucks when you end up choosing the wrong lane to wait behind while other lanes go way faster. 

A good tip is that you don't necessarily have to wait in line for a pump that matches the same side as your vehicle. Each gas pump has a long enough cord extension that it can reach over and around most, if not all vehicles to the opposite tank.

Note that you have to pay through the pump through debit, MasterCard or Gift Cards (no cash allowed)

I have yet to see a gas attendant there but i'm sure they're around.

Fulton Market Burger can be compared to Fat Burger... but Fulton is way better. It has the same type of set up as fat  burger too. You order your food, grab a seat and then they bring it out to you. The place itself is really nice for a burger joint. It has brick walls, windows all around and spread out seating. It feels more like a restaurant than a fast food place.

The burgers themselves are delicious. Some of the best I have had because they actually taste like proper burgers. They aren't to greasy and are easy to eat. They are also very filling. It is a bit more expensive then I expected but it was well worth it.

The Hubs and I have been to 5 Guys a couple of times while vacationing in the States, and were thrilled when one finally opened up that we didn't need a plane ticket to visit.
The menu is simple...there are burgers (with or without cheese) and there are fries (normal or cajun).  There is also a grilled cheese and a veggie sandwich (I think) to appease non-meat eaters.  
The burgers are fresh and juicy (the standard burger is a double, a single patty is called a "little"), and so yummy.  They have a ton of fresh toppings that you can add to your burger free of charge - but remember the more you add, the harder it is to eat.  I get grilled onions and mushrooms, and its certainly appreciated to have an option above raw white onions.
The fries are also really really good.  And again, a big size - a regular will easily feed 2 people - and fried golden brown.
Everything is cooked fresh upon ordering, so its not an immediate turnover like most fast food chains - but the wait is definitely worth it (and there are bins of peanuts in the shell that you can help yourself to while you wait.).
5 Guys is a great addition to the burger landscape, and has become our go-to place when the alwasy-inevitable burger craving creeps up.

Horrible service! The one near Southgate Centre inEdmonton is way better than the one in Sherwood Park. I do not recommend to go to a red robins in Sherwood Park. I recommend to go to one in Edmonton. Very horrible service and very horrible food.

I have always enjoyed going to Boston Pizza as the food was always good. But today I received the simple pizza bread with Bolognese sauce . The sauce came out with a Hugh meat ball in it. When I took it out there wasn't much sauce left so asked for another sauce it didn't taste like bolognese sauce it was bland missing something and my pizza bread was doughy and not cooked on the bottom. It made me unhappy as when I pay for something I have been ordering for years I have expectations on what it's going to taste like. Quality control maybe needs to be looked at. First time ever leaving not satisfied in 40 years.

used to be great place to go. i went there friday after work and has some of the worse service i have ever had. seems there has been some staff chai arrived at 4pm we sat down it was busy but it took us almost 40 minutes to get are first drink served. the service continued to be horrible waiting another half hour at least for refills. after a couple hours the place started to die right down. we sat at the table for over and hour close to an hour and a half and never had are server come by the table once the place it dead by now. we then had to ask to other servers where are bill was and they had to go and find our server who had been missing for almost 2 hours at this point. she did come out about 15 minutes later and we got are bills and left. i think this server is the new manager i know she said she was from cuba. this is probably the worst service i ever had and the waitress dint even apologize for leaving are table for close to 2 hours. is sad because a month ago this place had immaculate service.

Went in knowing I had alot owing on my truck. Made them fully aware I was okay with walking out with nothing. They said everything was fine. I talk to the sales person and was told I need 15,000.00 down. I'm not kidding. Just a waste of time. Go somewhere else.

I enjoy joeys urban when I'm looking for a good shrimp taco! My favourite one is the tropical shrimp! A couple of months back you were able to get two tacos with one order but now they weirdly reduced it down to one taco (about the same size) I'm disappointed about this because I really enjoyed being able to have two. Their selection of poutines are outstanding and possibly the best poutines I've tried in town yet! The location of the restaurant in the food court is good on their outcome as well because their restaurant is really the only one that bases themselves purely on fried seafood. If you enjoy unique poutines and good shrimp tacos I recommended this place!

This place is unreal. I had heard about Greenland for a long time without actually visiting it. Well I was kicking myself for not going sooner when I finally did go. The selection is fabulous, the staff are helpful and their Christmas displays and items are out of this world. I will be back for sure and also to try Branches out!

I love love Wendy's but this one is the worst one that I have ever been to. I just cannot spend my money here. The service was meh. The burger poorly made. 

Wendy's as a brand puts so much emphasis on great service and great product, this place does not live up to the brand.

I was really looking forward to trying Fulton Market Burger, but unfortunately it just really disappointed in every way. 

When we entered, we were clearly confused by the menu, and even though there were a couple staff staring at us, nobody offered to explain things to us. 

There were 4 people in our group and we tried 4 different burgers. 1 beef, 1 chicken, and 2 bison. 

All the burgers suffered from similar deficiencies. Especially my bison burger. If it was any more dry it would have been powder and blown away. The patty looked to me like the kind of thing you get from the frozen section at superstore... the yellow box garbage too, not the presidents choice. The bun was similarly arid. And the portion, though other reviews say is big, I found pretty small. I was hungry, so I did eat 90% of it before I could stomach no more, but I was still pretty hungry. 

I had onion rings for a side and well, they were more like onion mush. Way undercooked, oily, and the batter slid right off half of them. Awful. 

I look at all the glowing reviews, and I can't help but wonder what went wrong on our visit?? 

I couldn't justify another visit, especially when I can go 5 minutes south to 5 guys and get a much more satisfying, fresh made burger and fries for less money.

This is a good Boston Pizza in my books!  

Our server was really great.  She was super friendly and even joked around with us a bit - which I love!

She was very attentive and made sure my pop and my boyfriend's coffee were always full.  She was great.

The food was great too.  I had an individual Hawaiian pizza and it was fantastic.  I love the pizza at Boston Pizza - they know what they are doing when it comes to pizza!

Great location.
Ive been going to Headquarters for a few years now.  Emma is just a great stylist!  I love my hair every time!  I have tried some of the spa services too.  Wish I could do that more often !

Wendy did my foils and cut the other day and did an amazing job. She took time to listen and asked lots of questions during the consultation. I got exactly the color I wanted and the haircut was beautiful to boot! Very happy! :)

The food here is standard for most Earls. Good. The only difference I have found at this location is that they won't let you order half fries half salad as a side for burgers ect. I find that it's a bit odd they say they can't do it given that all other Earls locations will do it. 

The restaurant is a weird lay out and atmosphere. I've mainly been here on weekends. I'd expect the lounge and restaurant to be at least a bit busy which adds to a fun atmosphere. This location is surprisingly dead most of the time. When you walk in you walk thru the restaurant to the back where to lounge is. The lounge itself is quite closed off and the tables are laid out in an odd way. It definitely is quite different from all others Earls I have visited. The only nice thing about the physical restaurant is the patio in the summer. The patio is contained by a wall lined with flowers and they have nice potted flowers through out. It also is a quiet patio which I prefer to those that are adjacent to busy roads.

Best place ever! The servers were so kind most of them and came out of their way to talk to me all the time and was checking on me and my drinks and made sure I was in good service! I just wanna thank the little Taylor she was amazing from the start and me me feel really comfortable I had an amazing time I will be back for sure! Thank you everyone and Taylor for making my week something to remember plus the Ceasers I had was one of the best!  I will be coming back to this place anytime, Adi was amazing as well!

Better than how I remember the chain as it was 10 years ago, but still generic. Happy Hour Special is the time to go, 3-6pm, for $4 pints in the park - a special "rhino" lager is delish, brewed by Granville Island for Earls. This is not a wimpy lager.

There is a happy hour appie menu, but you have to ask for it. The food is still overpriced and the service is professional but unremarkable.

OK - the pizza IS pretty good!  Too bad the service was still pretty terrible.  I watched a guy at the table next to ours find his own chair (it was a table set for 4 but there were 5 in the party) AND bring the menus to the table for the group...oh my!

This establishment is tucked away and right away the building felt forced into the space. It was small and awkward. There was extra space across street for parking but I didn't notice it until I left. 

We entered through two large doors and we're greeted by the hostess. She was polite and quick to get us a table. The restaurant was small with about 13 booths and tables. The lounge was overcrowded with high tables and chairs. The washrooms are located through the lounge and even with no one in the lounge it was difficult to move through the space. I would not recommend this place to anyone that needs accessibility. 

The atmosphere was warm and dark. The seating was all dark brown leather and tables were a beautiful dark brown wood. 

The server was excellent, he was easy to work with and had no problem making substitutions for me. The menu looked amazing, so many creative and decadent dishes. It was extremely difficult for me to find a decent filling vegan option. But they do cater to vegetarian and gluten free. Prior to visiting I looked up nutrition information and all items as they are on the menu are extremely calorie and fat dense. Even the salads. 

I had the Forager Burger with no cheese or mayo and subbed the brioche buns for the sour dough bread and a side of fries. It was delicious. The other dishes were chicken tacos, clam chowder and dynamite roll. Everyone ate without comment so I assume it was good. It did look amazing. They had a decent selection of wine. 

The washrooms were elegant with complete closed stalls with granite tile and wooden doors. The sink was automatic and had a nice trough granite sink. 

Overall the staff were the best part. They were pleasant and helpful. The food from a vegan and health perspective was very disappointing. But from my company's point of view was adequate. The space is awkward and tight. I would not go again unless it was a group choice.
Worst dealership I have ever dealt with. Long story short, Put a deposit on a vehicle booked aircraft tickets to go and pick it up and they sold it.

A fantastic way to spend a birthday gathering or a girls day!
Going in, I wasn't sure what to expect. I hardly wear make up! But everyone was so helpful and happy! It was a delight to spend time there and have a bespoke lipstick (or two!) created just for me! 
While you wait, enjoy the beautiful mini lounge, Evian water and candy bar!
Worth the drive to Sherwood Park!
Terrible food, terrible service. Even when they are open, they seldom have donairs available. Not that you'd be missing out.

Very gourmet food, in a casual dining space. I was impressed with the quality of the food, and the prices although high were quite reasonable for the quality. Quite reasonable, because the quality was FANTASTIC! The head chef, Jason, told me he has source from over 30 different farms that he has to drive to constantly depending on who has how much of what, to ensure it's all fresh.

This is such a great garden center. They do tend to be expensive. But they have a great selection of tools, fertilizer, and plants. House plants being all the rage right now, they have a huge selection of healthy plants here. The grounds are also so nice. Before or after we've made a purchase. And if you're in the mood for dinner or dessert, they have Branches a very elegant restaurant  So this is my go-to place for all things garden related. The staff is also very knowledgeable and attentive.

We used to like Red Robin but pretty much every meal we've had at this location has been terrible.

Tonight we felt like burgers so we tried one more time. I ordered the quacamole and bacon burger. When it arrived the patty was burnt and like a hockey puck and there was almost no guacamole and no bacon. I showed the waiter and he took it back and they made a new one. The replacement burger was quite pink and didn't seem cooked. It did have bacon but again very little quacamole.

The other burgers weren't too bad (not great) but the fries were terrible. Not cooked very well.

At the end of the meal, all the burgers were on the bill. 

We've definitely dined here for the last time!

Buddy that works in there treated my food with some serious anger and hate. I honestly just wanted to apologize to my bowl before I ate it because of the cruelty that went into making it. PS. Do not forget that there are green peppers on the bottom cause if you ask him for some he will dig through your bowl to find them and say "they're RIGHT HERE"

They actually had the nerve to call me right after i bought the car to come on here and right a review. Ok. Sure. The initial purchase went really well. Well after writing the review, their service went to shit. They wouldn't return calls. Made promises they couldn't keep. This literally went on for like 3-4 months. I finally said fuck this and am using a different dodge location for all my service. These guys have contests every month for the sales reps and once they've got your sale, they mentally check out.
Paid parking. Overpriced. Poor customer service. Too many other salons in Sherwood Park that are better to deal with.

It's an inexpensive chain comfort food restaurant. Judging by the amount of obese patrons.  But the place is closing down in 6 months.  Busy.  Cheap eats.  Pre packaged fries.  Processed cheese on the burgers.  They have beer on tap.  But staff were friendly.  And the washrooms were large and clean. A few TV screens. Free refills of fries and pop. I won't be back.

Well what can I say....I love this place. I have been going there since they pretty much opened a few years back. They have some of the best pizza around. They have a cajun cesar salad....YUMMY! for whatever reason it far beats any other cajun cesar salad I have had. Service is always adequate and even though it is alittle above average for prices....it is well worth it. Remember what they say...You get what you pay for. Oh and steak....yep it is delicious!

The pizza at Dimaggio's is fantastic!

We ordered a couple pizzas from here one day and were blown away.  They were incredible.  We got one that was kind of like a Mexican style pizza and we got a classic Hawaiian pizza too.  They were both phenomenal. 

If you like pizza, you have to try Dimaggio's.

The only thing that kept them from 5 stars was that I found them expensive compared to other pizza places.  However, they worth it.  

GREAT PIZZA!!!!!!!!

I've been seeing my hairdresser, Kerry, for over a year and I couldn't be happier.  She's cut and permed my hair several times and I love the way I look every time I walk out of there.  Kerry has never pushed me to buy the Bumble and Bumble products they sell but the few she recommended have completely changed the way my hair looks (for the better)!  The front desk staff is always super friendly and helpful.  I couldn't be happier with Headquarters!

Whenever I hear this dealership's radio commercial, I automatically come back to this site to know if anybody else has the same horrible experience as mine. This dealer will give you a legitimate one single horrible car buying experience. I was bullied by then assistant manager because I decided not to buy a car so he wasted his time. Can you believe ?

Cool decor.  Menu is bland. Food is mid quality. It has the makings to be a good spot but the menu has to go. Zero personality in the food. Save your $$$. Think Rics grill - it just doesn't have anything special.

We were here on Father's Day and had a great experience. The service was friendly and prompt, and the food was fantastic. In the past I haven't always been the biggest earls fan since most of their menu items aren't something that I would normally go for, however their hot chicken sandwich is fantastic!  I will probably be more eager to return here.

The food and service here are fine... not fantastic, not awful.  Just fine.

But I was really irritated today.  I never go to BPs for lunch.. but I just started a new job and that's where my co-workers wanted to go.  

I ordered an individual sized pizza and a started ceasar salad.  Which came to over $17 with a pop.  After I ordered... I noticed a sign for their lunch combos.  Which said I could have gotten a pizza and the salad for something like $9... that's a HUGE difference.  Yes, the pizza would have been slightly smaller than what I orderd, but I would have absolutely been okay with that, had I realized it was an option.

What happened to your server telling you the specials of the day?  I actually felt a little taken advantage of.  When I ordered my lunch, she should have said something along the lines of "Would you be interested in switching that to our lunch combo?".  

ah well.

I've been using this dry cleaner exclusively since I moved to the Park. The service is always great and the staff are friendly. The turn around time on dry cleaning is great and when they give you your receipt it has the pick up date on it, so no need for a business card with a time written on it. The pricing of service is on par with other dry cleaners as well.

Great location. Very clean and superior service for a fast food place. 

The friendly staff kept giving table service for refills and the food was fresh and hot

EXTREMELY DISSATISFIED WITH THIS BUSINESS!

My husband took our daughter to get gel nails for her grad.  He paid $80 for them...NOT IMPRESSED!!  They turned out to be crooked, messy and just not worth the money.  I went back to have them fixed and they would not fix them until I paid again.  I mentioned that they were crooked and they said it depends on how you are looking at them.  I told them how unhappy I was with the nails and they said then why weren't you here when your daughter got her nails done.!  Next time they won't do anything unless I am there.  I still wanted the nails fixed and she said that I still had to pay.  The staff at this facility were extremely rude!!!  I would not recommend this establishment to my worst enemy. 

The other time that we were here it cost us $94.00 for a pedicure and toe nail polish for my daughter.  The gentlemen who helped me did not even give me a proper pedicure.  Get in - Get out and pay the cashier!!  I would suggest that you also CLEAN UP your act.

I have tried to give this business a chance to redeem themselves but that didn't work.  You are dead to me now!  Never will I go there and never will I recommend them to anyone else.  

I have already advised some friends that do go there to find another place to go.!  We pay good money to have a service done and the service is absolutely terrible.

Shame on you Studio Nails!!

If I were allowed but two words to describe my experience at this Red Robin location, then those two words would be extremely underwhelming.  From the slow table service, to the horribly overcooked and overpriced burger, to the cold and only half-crispy steak fries, and finally to the cutlery and the napkin that arrived at the end of my meal, the dining experience at this location was decidedly subpar.  I won't be in a huge rush to make a return visit.

Best gas price in town! With the high cost of gassing up these days, it is worth it to make a stop at their gas bar. There are several pumps so lines are not too long, when not before a long weekend of course.

And this is being nice about it. I come here lots and  always eat the chicken & wontons with rice & they hit it normally on  the spot . Today was the worst experience I had they forgot to clean the deep fryer and there was stuff from pervious orders in it then they cooked my chicken in it. I found exactly 11 burn pieces in my dish. The manager was  friendly and explained it was due to dirty oil and apologized for the mistake ! You would think they would do a bit more for a regular customers?  Very disappointed this time round will rate it on my next visit.so I got home after they serve me the chicken and wonton for the second time had more burnt pieces and I took them out and I just ate it because I was tired of waiting for my food I woke up the next morning around 730am vomiting and diarrhea with a touch of food poisoning as I called 311 and talk to an Alberta health nurse she told me it looks like it's a sign of food poisoning because that's the only thing I ate that day she suggested drinking plenty of water to try to flush it out there's nothing much more they can do. We called Earls talk to a manager who said that there is another complaint last night besides mine so they've closed down the deep fryer are there cleaning and scrubbing it also inform me that they're going to call the health board and have them come in and check to make sure the kitchen passes the Canadian health and food standards because I'm not the only person that got sick. I hope they find a way to make this better or I will make sure I tell everyone in Sherwood Park and anywhere not to eat at that Earls location ever ! nobody should be served food that was burnt bad the first time and then given it again when it was burnt again this time it only had four pieces in it I put the pieces aside again to show the manager. I guess the point is the first time when I was that badly burnt and I had 11 pieces that were burnt chicken and made the food taste funny they should Of just closed down to deep-fried  right away. For my experience at this Earl's location it is always been good this is the first time I've had something this serious happened to me where I'm sick and I was quite shocked they only took off one chicken and wonton  after putting us through waiting for our food again which they told me would be 10 minutes which was almost 20 wake up earls Sherwood Park time for a reality check. Anyone has any questions or wants to talk to me about the food poisoning and my experience call me at 780-938-0812

What a nice place!
It was my first time going there and it was a perfect place for shopping for Christmas decorations.
It's a very friendly place with a nice atmosphere full of Christmas spirit! (Or at least that's how I felt)
I've heard it's a pretty cool place in summertime too so it's already on my list for then.
Although it was pretty busy, parking wasn't a big issue.
I'm pretty sure I will go back there again! :)

Its a car dealership...They are in the business to make as much money as they can off the car, your trade-in and extras

I haven't completed my sale but feel compelled to review my experience.

We are dealing with the used car section (Kevin).
They are there to make money but are also there to keep your business and understand that in this digital age buyers are more knowledgeable then ever before.
With that said I have found them to be very upfront and give you the feeling that they are really working for you.

They do not have what I want in stock in their used section but are determined to find.  We do not feel that we are "being taken for a ride", we know what we want and they are trying to deliver.

I give 5 stars as I believe it is unfair to rate at 1 for such a large organization.  People may have unrealistic expectations when it comes to sales.

When it comes to dealerships you should already have an general idea of what your needs are.

In 2011 the amount of cars in the world surpassed 1 billion...That leaves ALOT of choices out there.

And most important thing to note for my experience is that my sales person was not pushy in the least.  If you feel pressured then its time to take a step back and reassess

i would give these guys negative. I would even go as far as suing them if I had the kind of money they do. We are a young family with two young children and at the time we bought a truck from them our youngest was still a baby, yet they still felt ok with scamming us.

We went in about a Used Toyota Tundra. Was what we thought an amazing deal. Our dealer was Marty Dobrowski. we are fairly new to buying cars as we're just getting started in life as a family. We were humming and hawing and he asked what was holding us back. We told him we don;t even own a home yet and wasn't sure this was smart. but seemed like too good a deal to pass on. We asked if we had a time period to try the vehicle to see i we liked it. He told confidently told us we could bring it back. we were naive enough to believe that because we are new at this. We kept finding issues with it and wanted to return it after a few weeks. brought it back and he told us we can't return it. And denied he said that to us. Than the next person up the line, Mike, stepped in and made a seen with us in front of the whole dealership. It was embarrassing. We had to bring the truck in about five times within the first month to get work done, including finding out it was missing a back seatbelt. 

A few months later we tried to trade the vehicle with another dealership and found out the carproof reported it had $11k of fire damage. This was not shown in the original carproof they showed us. This was an updated version from a few months prior to us buying it. They lied to our faces and tried to cover it up. After showing them and the manager this they basically said we were screwed. They got out money and we could;t do anything about it. eventually we got to the top and the VP offered a trade in because he obviously knew they were in the wrong and wanted to avoid getting sued. It has also resulted in much stress in our lives.

Moral of this story. Car sales men are scum bags that would happily scam a young family trying to get started for their own personal gain. Marty Dobrowski is a loser and a shiester. Avoid this dealership PERIOD.

Two people in line up and we waited for over 10 minutes to be served ? We decided after waiting that long to take our money and business else where . Use to be a great location but has gone down hill with poor customer service. I would rather go to the city and eat at another Wendy's after this experience .

Is there a score lower than ZERO. This place is totally unorganized. My visit started with me having to wait for Chelsea to finish her conversation with a co-worker over some social media posting. The other 4 (yes 4) service techs ignored me. One actually told me to deal with Chelsea. Finally go to pay. I ask if I could pick up some parts and put them on the same bill. This leads to another disappointment. First the parts tech, brings 1/2 the parts. Tells me there both there. He handed me 1 piece. Finally get both parts. Then they only  put half the parts on the bill. And we have to do another billing. The whole point of this was to do it on one bill. Next we have to go to the front desk, because the parts counter can't process payments. ‍. Whatever.

Hubby and I popped in here on a Saturday afternoon to check it out. We were looking for burgers but this is not a burger joint per se. As in no beef patties, more sandwiches on a bun. Anyhoo, we decided to stick it out. 
We both ordered beef brisket on a pretzel bun with mashed potatoes. The food comes out on a sheet of parchment paper on a tray. The bun doesn't have sauce on it, just meat. You add one of 3 choices of bbq sauce yourself. A scoop of luke warm mash and some plain chips and a pickle are also on the tray. I wish the potatoes were hot, would have enjoyed them more. There is a TON of brisket on the bun. The bun is dry. Even adding bbq sauce to it didn't help. I ended up just eating the brisket off the bun - on its own, it was quite good. 
Overall I wasn't blown away and I didn't leave raving , however this place is unique in what it's offering anyway. Bring an appetite, it's hearty and filling. Not a place to go for a light lunch. Next time i might try the turkey sandwich, in hopes that it's saucier. 

Clean store front, friendly guy behind the counter.

This location is substantially nicer than the Christy's Corner location. Washrooms are very clean. The staff is friendly and helpful. The floors are hard (they look like wood, but are probably laminate) and the store doesn't smell musty - which is a feat for a storefront packed with used bargain merchandise. And it's right by the Pasta Pantry!

I'm really impressed with this place. I was wanting a decent burger and was settling for A&W when I spotted this place and decided to give it a try. The food was really good. I love their fries and the cheese burger was enormous! It was way too much food for just me.

 As for service, the people were pleasant,  it was busy (to be expected as I was there at 12:15 on a Friday lunch hour) but I was out of there by 12:45 and there were 22 orders in front of me... 
I recommend this joint  for sure.

NEVER COME TO THIS DEPOT, they rip you off big time. I usually bring 2 bags (loose ones even, not tight) and would get about $9 to $12 (from Fir Street Bottle Depot). But when I dropped by in this depot with the same count of bags, I only got $4 for 2 bags (and they are tighter this time). I asked him "that was it? and he said yes" ... then I asked him again "are you serious? you are kidding right?" He firmly answered "yes" again. So much to my disappointment, I would like to complain but no one there looks decent enough to talk to.

Not to be racist or anything, but this depot is not the best to go to. I'd spare you guys from your misery and disappointment. If you can drive a little further, go to the one at Fir Street (Wye Road). They are more honest and friendly there (I hope)

Nice staff but food not quite. Had pizza, I kinda picked late so it was cold but it was most tasteless food I ever ate. The cake we ordered for desert was perfect. I tried calling in to tell but no body answered so leaving comment here.

I give this 2 stars.
I don't really care about how I get greated or where I get seated, I usually care about how the food is. I'll start with the washrooms. They have those automatic water taps. Me and my father could not get the water to stay on for longer then a second, it was ridicules, we got 2 seconds of water total. The paper towel holder was the same thing, we couldn't get ANY paper towel from the dispenser.
The restaurant was really cold, it was -10 outside at the time, but we where far enough from the door that we shouldn't have to wear our winter coats while eating.
I ordered a Blue cheese burger ($14), it was good. But hardly had any blue cheese, and I had a total of 16 fries. I enjoyed the burger but it wasn't worth $14, it should of cost half that. The fries where gross and under cooked.

I used to come here religiously years ago until my stylist left. After trying a few other stylists and not being happy I began going somewhere else. However I returned a couple weeks ago as part of a bridal party. The interior has been completely updated and looks fantastic. My hair was done by Amy and was gorgeous and lasted all day and night! And Delina did my makeup and she was super awesome. If I was in the market for a new stylist I might try here again.

Hadn't been to Earl's in a while so my husband and I went for dinner. We started with their chilli lime chicken and wontons. It was quite good. I am a wimp when it comes to spicy so some of the more saucier pieces I left to my husband! I ended up getting a small Caesar salad and spinach dip. I completely didn't think of the romaine recall until my salad came and there were different types of lettuce. Props to them for making it work, I just am not a fan of kale (but I easily left those pieces out). My husband got the Kung pao chicken bowl. Kind of nice that you can choose your level of spice. Our server was great. She checked in, made conversation, and refilled drinks regularly. We sat in the lounge which was nice. In the end, it was a decent night. I would recommend stopping in!

I was thoroughly unimpressed with this location. I regularly shop at the once upon a child just south of the Whitemud and it is far superior. I was so excited walking in because they had such a big location to house lots of used children's goodies! Turns out it just means they can be non-discriminatory in taking consignment items. There was a lot of really over worn and over washed items. I was looking at a little girls 0 to 3 month bunting suit from The Gap. They had it marked at $35! You could get a brand new one for close to that price, particularly if you shop the sales. There was also an incredibly dirty Graco stroller that had leaves and mud on the seat that they were selling. The other locations in the city have great 10 item for $10 bins which you can find some awesome stuff in. I left this location without purchasing anything and the feeling of needing to wash my hands. Made a special trip from Edmonton to check it out and was really disappointed. Don't waste your time.

I'm all for a good burger, in fact, I love a good burger.  So, being that a new burger joint opened in the Park recently, I was excited to try it.

I have to say, I was a little disappointed after the hype I'd heard about this chain.  They're opening businesses all over the place, including Calgary, but I'm not totally satisfied with what we experienced here.

I do have to give the business kudos for moving customers through efficiently.  We arrived at around 6:00 PM on a Saturday evening and there was a substantial line-up.  Even though the lineup was large, we still moved through ordering and getting our meal (take-out) in under 15 minutes.

The restaurant was clean and bright, with tons of staff working on at least 12 different stations - all in plain view of the patrons.  Everything looked nice and clean.

On to the food.  Both my girlfriend and I ordered double patty burgers with all the fixin's (lettuce, tomato, pickles, mayo, etc.).  I had mushrooms, cheese and bacon on mine, my girlfriend had just cheese.  The burgers tasted good, but I was frustrated from the start.  The bun was WAY too small to contain all the burger inside.  I ended up eating the last part of the burger with a fork as it had slopped all over my plate.  The bun needs a serious re-design.  The rest of the ingredients, including modest patties made from what looked like freshly ground beef were quite good.

Now, this chain claims to have some of the "best fries in America."  Sadly, I wouldn't know.  They fry their potatoes in peanut oil and I'm allergic. I know I shouldn't find this frustrating, but I do.  With all the people out there who enjoy fries and a good number of them who are allergic to peanuts, this seems like a problem to me.  But I guess I shouldn't feel slighted... I am in the minority on this one.

In summary, our experience was just OK.  Service was friendly, burger was tasty, but really needed a better bun and not being able to have fries was a let-down.  Time will tell if we give them another try.

Dirty as hell no one here except my self and three other people . Staff seems to think standing around talking is more important then a clean restaurant . I would suggest if you like the food try a cleaner location . Lazy staff dirty store health board should take walk through ! Wait I understand they where waiting for a young lady to show up because as soon as sh got here she was sent to clean lobby area ! How is that fare when those three boys where standing around doing fuck all talk about lazy

Excellent donairs at this location! Bright and clean restaurant with fantastic service. 
The meat is nice and spicy with a balanced amount of sauce. The serving sizes for the platters are also quite large. I will be back for sure.

If i could give this place zero, or even negative stars, i absolutely would. I will make it my life's mission to NEVER buy a vehicle from here. I was in the market for a vehicle, but was on a very limited and tight budget (About $6000 give or take a little) I had also looked into what i could afford for insurance, so i knew the type of vehicle and year i could afford. Basically i had my criteria down pact and there was no room to stray. I was looking on Kijiji and Sherwood Park Dodge had an ad up for a vehicle in my price range. I initially emailed and got a pretty fast response. We talked back and forth about what i wanted and he told me to come down after work and we could test drive the vehicle i initially emailed about and that he actually had a few vehicles that fit my criteria so he said i had some options. Great! I was pretty excited. I work just on the outskirts of the city on the west side so i literally drove across town to Sherwood Park. First things first, when i arrived, the guy i was emailing with wasn't even there. He had gone home for the day. Let me just reiterate that we had already talked about when i would be coming, so needless to say i was already irritated. Another guy came out from the back and told me he was told to look after me instead. He took me into his office and i had to explain everything i had already gone over with, with the other guy. Told him all my criteria and there was no room to bargain. I told him about the vehicle i had initially emailed about and that i wanted to test drive it. He went to get the keys but when he came back he said another couple had just test driven it not even an hour earlier and had paid to put a hold on it. I was pretty disappointed, but thats neither his or my fault, so i told him how the other guy had said there were a few other vehicles in my range and asked to see them. He left to go look and about 10 minutes later he came back saying they did not have any other vehicles under $10k and that they generally don't to begin with. I was extremely upset at this point. Why had the other guy told me they did then??? Just to get me out there and "hopefully" make a sale on another vehicle??? Are Salesmen REALLY that shady?? So he noticed i was visibly bothered and said he had a "great vehicle" for $10k but he would sell it to me at a discount for my trouble (insert MASSIVE eye roll) so i humored him and followed him out onto the lot. The "great vehicle" he was talking about was like a 1998 Dodge Durango that had 350,000km's on it. Gave me this whole shpeel about how he would sell this vehicle to his daughter, its so safe, blah blah blah. So i immediately left.
