Since my review is not on the front page, I rewrite it.

Just do not even think about this dealership while you are in the market. My experience was back in 2013, but still I have hard time forgiving the third world treatment I received from this dealership. Lies and yelling.... Man, I could not believe it happened in Canada.

Prepare to be overwhelmed by the delicious smells the minute you walk in!

If you try nothing else, make sure you have some pulled potato! Very filling (my daughter and I will share one) gluten-free and delicious!

This is not fine-dining, so don't bother getting dressed up if you decide to eat in. They offer take-out so you can go home if you want to create some romance. Fairly basic, utilitarian tables and chairs with paper napkins and to-go glasses. 

You order up at the counter and wait for your food. It won't take long and it will be soooo worth it!

I wanted to take the family out to a garden centre today and was told by my neighbor that this was a good one-so half an hour drive,ready to buy a whole bunch of garden stuff...and we are told" can't come in because you have children "

I definitely will not be shopping here

It says something about how many really great burger joints now grace the area, that this place  is not creating more buzz.  They make great burgers, have a huge choice of great toppings including upgrades like grilled portobello  mushrooms   

You can do a custom order with choice of patty size, bun, sauce and toppings, or order from a short list flavour combinations  My go-to is the rustic combo with grilled onions, portobellos and red pepper on an onion roll with Dijon mustard which comes very close to burger perfection.

Made to order milkshakes are thick and good. Fries very good, rings fine  

So take a trek out to the Park and try a really good burger place. Be warned it is on a side street of a light industrial area, but very near to Costco and Millennium Place.  Also do not trust Google maps on this one, you will get lost.

This is one of the better Earls' I've been too.

With that said, I don't really like any Earls.   I think they try to hard.  

The food is only every good, it's never great.  And the service is average.

Something that Earls does right though, is atmosphere.  They manage to create a great atmosphere for patrons.

And now that the weather is getting better, Earls has a great patio.

Oh gosh, I was pretty happy with this location as it is so large and well laid out! The non-clothing items are nearly hidden up high but there is such a great selection of everything else easily found at hand. I was really pleased with the quality and variety of baby moccasins/shoes when I stopped by recently as my infant needed new shoes for daycare but is not walking yet so doesn't need the more structured shoes that older kids require. Fortunately there were so many available in this infant's size and most had no signs of wear at all: in fact they looked brand new!I was really quite pleased. This location is quite convenient and I'm happy that they have plenty of what I was looking for at the time. Given the pandemic, I was surprised that so many employees were working behind the counter. We quickly signed up for their loyalty program and were able to inquire about what they're currently accepting (apparently they accept a limited amount of clothing for the wee infants and that's understandable as those clothes tend not to get as worn), but I look forward to eventually bringing in some of our outgrown baby clothing/items and definitely look forward to purchasing other things as our child gets older.

This place is exactly what you expect. It's a chain fast food restaurant. That being said a&w really seems to be consistent with the quality of their food it's not a cheap fast food restaurant but you definitely seem to pay for quality. Plus what can beat a teen burger, onion rings and a root beer?

I really enjoy mucho burrito when I'm really craving for one. I mostly get the featured ones because they are the most flavourful and I don't have to be burdened with so many burrito choices. My first burrito experience with the specialty burritos was that one flavour was always overpowering the rest of the burrito and it was very tense to eat. My second experience with the specialty was that it was too spicy! I would love if you would be able to adjust the burrito and be able to take some parts out so one ingredient is not ruining the whole burrito. I haven't ordered from this place since the second time! Although the burritos are very good they can kind of be unenjoyable to eat when there's just one flavour going on.

Getting very fed up with the lack of professionalism out of the reception desk and the people answer the phones in the service department. I've brought my car in for ABS issues - originally I was told that they cleared the error and to bring it back if it happens again. Clear the error? Should've fixed the error as it happened again immediately. Also beware they refer some services to 3rd parties and they won't necessarily write down the information in your file, and then you have to fight with them to find out where to take it when whatever was installed stops working. On top of that they give you attitude, even though you're the one spending 10's of thousands of dollars initially and then more upon repairs. A little kindness, courtesy, and customer service would go a long way.

PS - I don't take my car to Sherwood Nissan to be serviced anymore after they told me I needed to a tire alignment and a wheel rotation (even though my alignment was fine and my tires had been on for 5 days). They told me it was due regardless and I'd have to pay even if I chose not to get the service done. Cause that seems right.

I'm a beek geek and I love to find interesting and out of the way places to drink and get bottles. I've been told by many people that I had to go to Little Guy because they often had some hard to get bottles languishing on their shelves, well it seems like the secret is out because all I saw were easy to find beers. However, Little Guy is still a cut above Liquor Depot and similar stores.

Little Guy has another great advantage too...the owners and staff are extremely friendly and helpful and will bend over backwards to help you. I feel so welcomed every time I walk in here. If the selection was deeper, I'd come more often, but usually there are only one or two beers on the shelves I haven't had before.

We decided to try something new- and found ourselves in a nice Italian restaurant. The menu looked wonderful as did the decor.  Unfortunately there was only one person working. She was the hostess, the bartender, the waitress and we are sure she was helping the cook too..... She was super polite and apologized- but we decided to leave after 30 minutes as our drinks were no where to be seen.

We live in Edmonton but only 10 minutes from Sherwood Park, so we do a lot of errands out there and we stop into this Earl's a lot. 
Their appetizer selection is pretty good and their happy hour menu is excellent, they have healthy options, gluten free options, and a nice drink menu.  I count my macros using macroscience to stay in shape and I use an app where everything I eat and drink is calculated, then it tracks my exercise as well. Every menu item at Earls is in my app so I don't have to enter everything. 
One day my daughter and I went to this specific Earls and as we walked in around lunch time we were told it was ladies day and were given champagne on the house. 
In the summer, their patio is beautiful and I miss their frozen pink lemonade. 
I've attached a picture of my frozen pink lemonade on the patio in July.
Customer was talking about me in another language. Although the food was good I do not recommend them for their insufficient customer service.
Been coming here since I was a child...and is still my favorite.  Portions are large.  Veggies plentiful.  Delicious options and choices galore! I love their combination dinners too!!

I was surprised with the gift of visiting Creme de la Creme. As soon as I walked in to the store I was greeted by the friendly and knowledgeable staff. The perfect place to pamper yourself to custom lipstick, eyeshadow, and fragrance. 

There is a candy bar while you wait and the decor is fit for a twentieth century Marie Antoinette.

I was able to sit with a staff member who interpreted my colour suggestions to help me make the perfect color. No more searching and swatching! I am so excited to wear my new lippie!

This place is terrible. They never have the meat I want (shrimp) and always tell me it will take "at least three minutes" for the fish. The staff clearly don't give a crap about their jobs, they don't seem to want to be here at all. I gave it one chance too many. I won't be back.

Prime rib burger and lobster bisque soup was delicious
Highly recommend this joint 
Only feed back was meals came out 10 min apart and didn't return to refill waters or sodas

It's hard to find a good Shawarma in Edmonton. It is NOT the same thing as a "chicken Donair" and so few places put the effort into properly spicing their chicken. I was so happy I decided to try this place out. Their Shawarma pita did not disappoint - their garlic sauce is amazing and the chicken very tasty. The staff were also great. Really fun and engaging. It seemed like they were really thrilled  to see every customer (there were lots!) and when I told them it was my first time there, they gave me a few items to try. I can't wait to go back and try the rest of the menu!

I WILL CHANGE MY REVIEW and GIVE THEM Thumbs UP, If they are able to sort out and help me with the rest of the claim, I hope they read this and contact me to sort out their mistakes.
This was a good place but it's gone down hill, service usually is slow and really bad, half of the items I went for are gone now & well, it's just not the best it could be.

I was originally very happy with the service here. I was test driving different vehicles and getting a feel for what I wanted. I found one I loved and made a deposit to hold it as I was looking into pricing, insurance etc as this was my first stop they even stayed after close to write everything up. I was still unsure and didn't want to rush into such a large purchase so I took my time and shopped around a bit. I ended up finding another vehicle elsewhere that I was in love with. Here is where the story gets not so good. I was getting calls etc everyday from Sherwood Kia even tho I told them I'd contact them with my decision. Communication between staff if terrible. How ever I do believe they have good intentions and do want to see you in a vehicle you like but I wouldn't recommend this place to family or friends just with my experience.

This is a nice casual spot if you're in the mood for a good burger. They have a large menu of different burger options including lettus wrapped ones, bring on the veggies! They have a few sides options including bottemless fries. I had the Whiskey River BBQ Burger, it's the sauce this Burgers cooked in that really gives it a great taste! This place is relaxed and casual there is also a bar area if you are just out for a drink. I hear they also have great catering, I've never tried it personally but apparently they send you all of the burgers buns and fixings along with instructions how to make any of their signature burgers. You can also get a free Burger on your birthday as well as other rewards with their rewards program!

Great place for burgers and beware, their fries are delish..but I suggest sharing them, the portion is huge!
I found the staff to be friendly and truly love their job! it was refreshing to see that a fast food place didnt have people behind the counter who looked like they did not want to be there.
Great addition to the busy South Common area:)
Will be visiting again soon!

Had a reservation with 25 people at 6:30. Didnt get our food until around 8-830. one poor server taking all of our orders. I wouldnt say it was really packed in the restaurant, didnt know who ordered what. Food came out not even that warm & found old food under the curve of the plates.

Night
Dealershi
I love this place and there food. There smoothies are really good but food is very pricey. Would be better if they lowered the prices.

We went to this location and ordered the teen burgers (2 for $8) and onion rings and fries. All food was on our tray in under a minute. 

There was only a child at one table and another client just finishing their meal, so I'm pretty sure the onion rings weren't for them. The child was likely one of the staff's children, since they were too young to be there without a responsible caregiver.  She was swinging from table to table, obviously board. 
When we arrived, I noticed onion rings sitting under the heat lamp. I didn't notice if these were the ones we were given, but taking into account that our food came so quickly and was lukewarm, I suspect as much. 
I like that the company is using hormone, steroid and antibiotic free meat. 
Unfortunately, I would be hesitant to give this restaurant my business in the future. The Capilano location is just as bad with serving cold food. 
I also didn't like that there were several flies buzzing around.

Food was good. Nothing really stood out at me on the menu. Service was good. Had the risotto. Very small portion, quite good though. Atmosphere was meh, not sure what there are going for between the style of paintings to the hydroponic vegetation growing in the middle of the restaurant. A unique restaurant. I will return to try breakfast sometime.

I have been buying bikes from Canadian Tire to bolt on small 50cc engine's.
I am disabled so I use the engine to help me get around.
The last bike I purchased had severe rim wobble on the back tire and the front had a bearing out of alignment.  I called and confirmed it would be alright if my bike had additional parts on it.  The manager named "Nick" said it would be fine and to bring it in 3 days later.  3 day's later I call to verify they can still replace the rims, they agree once again.
I'm told if I bring the bike within 3 hours of the prior phone call the bike would be fixed that day.
I take my bike there and am told I have to leave it there and it won't be fixed for 3 day's...  I then reluctantly agree.
I later phone to see why I was lied to about them fixing it the same day and was told they are no longer fixing it.
So now I'm stuck with a bike I'm unable to ride and out 180$.
I'll never shop here again.  I recommend avoiding Canadian Tire at all costs.

Honestly this is my favourite Mucho Burrito location. Not only is the food delicious (which has been my MB experience across the board) but I find the staff at this location particularly kind. There's one gentleman in particular (I wish I knew his name) who always seems to go above and beyond - whether it's bringing me a glass of water to my table since I didn't bother buying a drink. Or just always bringing my meal out to me even though I would have no problem walking up to the counter to grab it. I've  always experienced wonderful customer service here and would recommend this location for that reason alone.

Sandwich was ok, hardly any sauce. Had only a few bites that had enough sauce. The sides were not good at all, the beans were completely undercooked and crunchy. The slaw was bland and the garlic creamy potatoes were neither garlicky or creamy, undercooked potatoes and lumpy.
