I've been with Millennium ever since I moved to Calgary 6 years ago. There's no office in C-town, but that's no matter. Millennium folk are expedient and professional over the phone. Besides that, they were the cheapest rates I found at the time! Even cheaper than the employee discount offered at a competitor when I worked with ATCO.

Thankfully, I haven't had need to file a claim with them in all of these years... and I hope never to have the need to do so. So I have no comment on how they deal with claims. But, my car insurance and home insurance are both through Millennium and I don't see myself changing that any time soon.

They're but a quick phone call away and always helpful!

This place is off the beaten path, but still very busy. 
The process is a little bit long- but the result is pretty good. 
I tried the chicken and my boyfriend had a burger- they are big, and filling. I would recommend that you get a side to share as it can be pricey and you get lots- too much really. We each had fries and neither of us ate them all, and together probably would not have finished a shared order. 
I will say their milkshakes are FANTASTIC!!! I am and always will be a REAL milkshake fan and they have em! 

Would I go again? Ya I think so. It is alittle more then your average fast food burger joint, but worth it.

This was a new place for me. It's a modest order at the counter venue with a whole lot to look at. If you're going the vegan or vegetarian route they have baked potatoes plain and lots of BBQ sauces to try with it. We ordered the platter of three meats and two sides. The ribs were the best I've ever had. Juicy meaty and fall off the bone. The pulled pork and brisket were good too. But what made them exceptional was three BBQ sauces at the table you put on. There was a house sauce, sweet, and hot. All three were delicious.

Try their MEDITERRANEAN VEGETABLE Pasta one of the best dishes. I do take out every now and then. They have never disappointed, I just came from long shift right now had this pasta. I feeling like I'm in haven. Thank you thank you guys you are awesome!!!

I loved the entire retro look of the place. The service was absolutely fantastic. I was offered a free drink upon arrival.  The chairs are so comfortable; I really loved how the sinks are set up with the chairs so there's no moving around, dripping water anywhere. The wash was fantastic. Their peppermint oil shampoo is to die for. I would and will definitely go back. The lady who cut my hair did an amazing job! She was so nice and talkative in the best way. Made the entire thing comfortable and quite an ease. Finally, I got all that. for such an incredibly low price. I'm satisfied. Loved the experience.

I tried Five Guys with some friends for the first time a few days ago, and it ended up not being what I expected. I went in thinking it would be another Fatburger, but it's actually quite a bit different. They don't actually have a lot of burger choices, but you can have your burger made with many toppings for no extra cost. A burger, fries, and drink comes out to about $13-$15 a person, but wow do you get a lot of food! The burger was huge, and the bag is just completely filled with fries. There are also unlimited refills on drinks (which is nice because it took us a long time to get through eating it all). I ended up taking most of the fries home and getting another meal out of them! I've always been critical of Fatburger's prices. But simply for the amount of food you get a Five Guys, their prices are right in line.

The burger itself was quite good. They went a little overboard with the condiments, making it messy to eat, but otherwise it was good. Everything tasted fresh. The fries weren't the best I've had, but still decent. Overall Five Guy's isn't a place I'd go to regularly (no should you unless you want to be buying a lot of new pants...), but it's definitely somewhere I'd go back to.

My wife decided I should do something with my hair, that in itself is hard to believe as I am pretty much bald. She actually wanted me to try the straight razor shave they do here, friends of hers had mentioned it was great so she picked me up a gift card for Christmas. 

I was looking forward to it, but was I hyping it up too much and would I be let down once I arrived? I phoned to book an appointment one day and that was a serious let down to me. I was told they don't take appointments and that made me fear this was just another chain barber shop that would give you an overpriced cut and send you packing.

I still wanted to use the gift card so I walked in one day when I knew I had a few free hours to spare. The place was done up very nicely and the waiting lounge was very comfortable. You sign into what I could only assume is an iPad on steroids and they call you when they are ready. 

Five minutes after I set foot in the door I was called upon to join a lovely young lady the back....don't read too much into it, the back is just behind the counter and there was no funny business about to take place. 

What I saw was a great layout of multiple old school barber chairs, I aboslutely love theses things, they are more comfortable than most current recliners. I made myself comfortable and then she went about trimmiming my lack of hair...I wish I could figure out why it grows so well in some areas and not in others...but I digress.
 
Then came the shave, this is what I was excited for. She explained everything to me as we worked our way through the process, and it was a process. They don't just slap some foam on and scrape it off with a swiss army knife, they instead prepare your skin and take it through several diferent processes, all the while making you feel like you may have died and fallen into the hands of an angel. This was probly the best I have ever felt with my pants still on. Needless to say I was not dissapointed at all in the end. My face felt as smooth as a babies bottom, not that I compared.

If you want to treat a man to a special experience I highly recomend this, or if you're a man that wants to feel like you are the center of the universe, even if only for an hour I recomend you find Tommy Gun's and see for yourself!

Awful experience!!! My beautiful long hair, ended up so damaged, rusty colour and very uneven shade! I have to go to a different salon to get it fix because they could not do nothing to improve the look... Not to mention that I payed 300 for my hair to be ruined like that. This salon is the worst I ever tried.

The walk in beer cooler is packed full of icy Cold Coolers& Beer !
Check it out....you'll grab a few cold ones for sure! This locally owned liquor store is a hidden gem! The selection of craft beers, scotch, rum , vodka & specialty items will not disappoint you. If an item is available...Kelly & Mike will do their best to order it for you. Stop in and check it out, it WILL become your new favorite to buy your favorite drinks! You'll wonder why you ever shopped at a chain store!

When I first moved to Alberta, it took me a little while to get my gardening mojo back. I mean, you don't just move from one of the hottest climates in the world to one of the coldest with no growing pains. I watched my mother-in-law working on hers, asked questions of just about everyone I knew, and puttered a bit. The main thing they taught me? Wait until Victoria Day long weekend to plant anything. Coming from a place where I can start breaking ground in January, you can see I had a lot to learn. 

One day, someone told me about Greenland, and I finally made the voyage out to Sherwood Park last summer to visit. Oh squeeeeeeeeee! 

After the limited options available at the big box hardware stores and Apache Seeds, this place was a breath of fresh air. Annuals, perennials and bulbs, oh my! In addition to oodles of varieties of any possible plant you can imagine, they also carry tools; bagged goods like compost, mulch, and fertilizer; pond supplies; garden decor like statues, sundials and plaques (perfect for prettying up the place!); topiaries; lotions, potpourri, candles and other fragrant inside doo-dads; books on gardening; and they have a garden cafe, where you can take a break for a latte and a sandwich while you're shopping.  

The selection is amazing and well marked, so you can see what zone your new baby likes best and cater to that location (zone 3, shade lover, that sort of thing). It's hard to screw up with such good markings. If you're still having problems, sign up for one of their classes so you can become an even better gardener. And best yet, sign up for their club, so you get great deals on Greenland merchandise. 

I haven't been at Christmas yet, but I've heard the place is all fixed up in its Yuletide finery, and quite a gorgeous sight. Yes, it's out of town, but the selection and deals definitely make it worth the trip. If you're coming from Edmonton, get off the Yellowhead at Clover Bar, and head north of the highway. You'll see it off to the left.
I've been eagerly waiting to try you since we first moved 'in the park'. It was amazing!! Pork ribs and brisket are my favs, but it's all amazing. You'd be crazy not to try this wonderful smokehouse.

My alternator went on a Saturday morning. Had it towed to Park Muffler. I was quoted in between $1000.00-$1100.00. The alternator itself cost $229.00 from Canadian tire and took two hours of shop labor to install. Grand total of $700.00 (including extra fee of $150.00 to take apart air compressor to access alternator- understandable).
at Canadian Tire NOT TO MENTION FINISHED SAME DAY! Park Muffler told me three days. Moral of the story is this shop is looking to take advantage of anybody down on their luck. They will overcharge you beyond belief if they think you are in a desperate situation. BAD BUSINESS WOULD NOT RECOMMEND TO ANYBODY.

I pass this location all the time but never noticed this restaurant. We ended up finding it on Google and we put in a order for a combo #3. It had ribs, brisket, turkey, and three sides. Everything was wonderful. We will be ordering from them again soon.

Been here a couple of times and every time the service was horrid.  The staff will either get your order wrong or will forget to put something in your bag if you are taking your food to go.  If you have to eat here always double check your order as you may need to turn right around.

Also lady in the drive-thru was insistent that she had to hit the OK button on the debit machine before she handed it to me so I couldn't see the price.  I just pulled my card out and made the transaction again but she grumbled something about the debit machine being broken.  Worked fine the second time and I could actually see what I was paying for.  Needless to say I will never darken their doors/drive-thru again.

The best variety of donair and shawarma!
Staff are overzealous and awesome!
We will be here OFTEN!!
Love the food!

I do not have children myself but with that being said I do occasionally find myself in stores like these when a close friend or family member is expecting to see if I can pick up anything to help them with their new bundles of joy. This one located in Sherwood Park is quite possibly one of the nicest I have been in so far.

All the racks are pretty full and you can see the staff makes a real effort to not only size but color block the clothes as well. While I did not see a ton of brand names I did however find alot of stuff on the racks that looked to have only been worn a few times. I feel quite confident in saying if you dressed your child in only clothes from this store nobody would be able to tell you had been shopping second hand.

They also carry toys and books here as well. I was pretty impressed with how cheap the books were and was able to pick up a couple of Skylanders books for $1.50 a piece. There also seems to be a high standard for what they will accept for toys so you wont have to worry that your child is going to be begging to take home any worn or half broken pieces of junk you will just end up throwing out in a week.

While on the subject of the toys however that brings me to the first of my two issues with the place. Located in the toy area are several signs asking children not to play with the toys and to instead play with the toys in the play area. Upon checking out the play area however I noticed there was only a few toys in it and they all appeared to be quite worn. With all those new toys they get coming in I would think it would be no problem to put some new stuff in there that would actually make the children want to stay playing there.

My second issue with this place is the size. If there is a mother with a stroller standing in the middle of an isle you want to walk down be prepared to wait as it is incredibly difficult to move past people due to the size of the store. It is just way too small in here for all the racks and shelving units they have.

With all that being said however this is still in my opinion one of the nicest and most reasonably priced children's stores in Edmonton and area and you should definitely check it out if you happen to be in Sherwood Park.

This place didn't look like much on the outside in this strip mall

But once inside an awesome up town place

Food was top notch 

I would recommend this place
Yum yum YUM!!  Friendly.  Clean.  Excellent bang for buck.  What more can you ask for!

It's alright.  Food is good of course.  And service is always pleasant.  Wide range in prices.  The restaurant is kind of plain inside, not upscale in my view.  The lounge is small and the booths are tight.  The lounge is a little more upscale.  There is an outdoor patio.  Very little salmon in the salmon zen bowl so I was disappointed for $20.  They have happy hour in the lounge which is nice. They have private parking onsite and across the street.

We ordered sandwiches for lunch at work today. They were available on time for pick up. Which was awesome. The sandwich trays were nicely put together and lots of variety. The varieties were not only type but there were four types of bread as well. We received white, whole wheat, rye and marble. The types were roast beef, egg salad, chicken salad, chicken, tuna, cold cuts and ham. We also received tomatoes and coffee with all the fixings. The platters were a great and healthy choice for our office lunch. I am definitely going to try them out on my own!
Best donair in Sherwood Park.  Great flavor, quality and portions.

I highly recommend this place, if you're looking for some very specific things in a restaurant. Do you want your hostesses to be snotty and bored-looking? Do you want your waitress to treat you and your family like you're a cardboard box she has to fill with pencil shavings? Do you want your coffee to be lukewarm and never to be refilled? Do you want average food cooked to a shocking hardness for a high price? You do? Then come on down to Red Robin in the north! 

You can have my spot, because I'm never coming back.

What a great find!  I got off of work early and am a visitor to this area of Canada.  Life Italian is located in a strip mall and doesn't look like much from the outside.  Don't be fooled by the outward appearance.  What awaits inside is SO MUCH BETTER.  I love the ambiance and the food is amazing.  I had the Veal Marsala and it was cooked to perfection.  I will definitely visit them again when in the area.  I will also recommend this restaurant to my business colleagues who live in this area.  I am so glad I stopped in and the staff is very friendly.

Wow!

Came to Greenland Garden Centre this summer after winning a gift certificate from CISN radio.  How had I not come here before?!?  This place is AH-MAZING!

If you want the quality of Hole's/Enjoy Centre but at a slightly lower price with WAY more variety - this place is for you!

The layout was perfect and easy to navigate.  There was loads of staff anywhere you turned.  

From trees, to perennials, to annuals, to shrubs, to herbs (lemon mint for my mojito and spicy basil for my curries, yes please) to trinkets for your fairy garden - this place is off the hook!

I will most definitely be returning here every year to get my green thumb on even if it is an hour drive for me!  Hopefully, the Henday completion to the Park will help speed this up once finished.

They have moved to Wye Road.  Our food was great, with large portions and a lot of meat and veggies.  The only thing we did not like was the green onion cakes.  It was like a heart attack in a box. Like eating deep fried lard.  Not at all like what you find at festivals. They need to find a new recipe that is less fatty, more doughy and with a few more onions.  The sweet and sour ribs were much better than last time; last time they were dry and hard, likely due to the shutdown. There is free parking.  The interior pretty bland and open and there are no curtains so you can see everything inside.  They could frame the edges with curtains. Staff were friendly.

I love this place. They have a restaurant I haven't made it to yet but I will! This is an excellent place to pick up Cedars, fruit trees, shrubs as well as an arrangement of perennial and annual flowers. There's also a good selection of merchandise for the garden that includes kelp based fertilizers. The staff were very knowledgeable. There is also a beautiful botanical garden that you can walk around in for inspiration and relaxation. All of the plants that I have purchased there so far have been healthy and the selection is the best around.

This place was mediocre and they gave my son food poisoning. I would not recommend this mucho burrito. No love at all.Don't waste your money here. The one in capilano on the other hand is really good.

We only ordered delivery so can't comment on the business or the servers but it arrived very quickly and so hot we had to let it cool down. We have been craving some good Italian food and this is as good as we have had in a while! We will order from them again.

I don't get out for manicures very often and it was a treat. My mom took my sister and I for manicures and wax treatments. The manicures were done at a large table so we could all sit by each other and talk. The three estethicians were well-groomed and very pleasant to talk with. The warm wax was soo nice and the hand massages were great.

Pedicures are done in a massaging chair, too bad manicures couldn't be done in them. My mom and sister had gone for pedicures the week before and loved them.

They had a large selection of nail polishes. I actually surprised myself and went with black. I love it and went back to get the polish. 

We were given bottles of water the had HQ Salonspa labels. Other beverages were available.

I noticed that they have a large selection of Bumble & Bumble. It is a selective brand that isn't in many salons.

The only improvement I could suggest would be more comfortable chairs. They had little pillows which did help but still weren't that comfy. They looked pretty though.

The smoked turkey is, as previously noted, quite good.  The brisket was disappointing, as were the ribs -- there was no discernible taste of smoke in either.  There was also no nice bark on the ribs.  This isn't the southern barbecue with which I am familiar.

The amount of moisture in all three of the meats that I tried makes me wonder if the cooks are using more water in preparing them than might be advisable.  Try the potato salad; it's very good.

The space is tidy and the owner is very friendly.  It's nice to see another barbecue option in the Edmonton area.

Tech savvy and bottle depot are not words that often get put in the same sentence. That has changed. This bottle depot has taken collections to a new level of service that is not only transparent but very convenient. 

When you arrive here you have the typical scenario man/woman counts your bottles at a station but where the tech comes in is with their screens showing you how much you made and how many bottles were counted. Then when all is said and done they hand you a receipt to which you scan at their cash dispenser! 

Quick and painless. But if you wanted to speed up the transaction pre count your bottles and have them separated in clear bags. 

I've been going to this place since I moved to Sherwood Park. I've never had a bad experience. The staff are friendly and quick and get you in and out fast.

Went for lunch with my Sister and Dad had the Buffalo chicken sandwich my sister had the crab cake salad and dad had the rid-eye steak absolutely delicious also great service wonderful waitress Natasha

Great customer service first of all!  To the point were the Grill master comes around and visits with the customers, and is always willing to tell a story, and was very nice to our children!  the BBQ sauces are excellent and you have to try the potatoe!  It is a great place to eat if you are hungry and want great food fast!

Nissan's been bugging me for a review for years, so here goes my honest review. Not 5 stars, as repeatedly suggested, quelle surprise.

Ridiculous about sums up my experience with Sherwood Nissan and especially their service department. I've had some dumb experiences with the Nissan service department, like screwed-up oil changes TWICE, but this takes the cake. 

Bought tires online from Nissan and scheduled an appointment via their online scheduler. Got a text back saying they got my order but could I please call for an appointment to install the tires.

I call back, and somehow it's like I never placed an order. They don't know what I'm talking about, they have no record of my order. I have a screenshot with the order, confirmation number. OK then, why do you have a online ordering system if you don't know how to use it?  So I reorder the tires on the phone, based on my original order.

I have one car and live out of town, the shuttle is no longer running, and these days any appointment, no matter how minor, they'll always tell you your vehicle will be ready by 3:30pm. So I need to arrange for a ride, in this case an elderly family member. I drop off my vehicle at 0945h.

At 1230h, I get a call from Nissan. They've ordered the wrong tires, completely. Of course, they don't admit this. They say, "the wrong size tires were ordered". I ask them how, the same thing is parroted. Not, "we messed up", more like they try to suggest that somehow you gave them the wrong order. Nope, I still have the original order, and I am not stupid enough to order tires with a rim size 2" too big. Pretty sure they have my records too showing my tire size, a two second double-check could have prevented this. FFS. And it took them 3 hours to notice this? Yeah, that's my day shot, thanks.

So I call up my elderly family member and 1/2h later we're at Nissan. Guess what? They still haven't put my tires back on my vehicle. 45 minutes later, it's done. All in, I wasted 5 hours of my day (and over an hour of someone else's day) to not get my tires changed and to have it suggested to me that it was my fault for ordering the wrong tires.

They never once admitted they screwed up. Yet when they beg for customer service reviews, they say, "be sure to give us 5 stars!" Yeah right, how about you give 5 star service and tell Cesar, the service manager, to manage his staff and his department better. 

SUMMARY: Nissan thinks nothing of inconveniencing it's loyal customers and wasting their time.  Their service department keeps hiring people who can't do basic things like properly tighten oil filters, locate online orders, or punch numbers in on a keyboard correctly.

2 stars because I've had normal experiences at Nissan, and they will comp you minimally (a free oil change). They're not a total 1 star clown-show, but man they come close at times.  This speaks about the management, in my opinion.

I know I can get a bit star crazy with my reviews, but during the pre opening practice run they flat out impressed me.
When we arrived to our reservation we were greatest by the manager outside and he proceeded to share some information and explained how our free meal would work. We were escorted to our seats by one of at least 30 staffers that were all there for training purposes, it's not very often the staff outnumbers the amount of guests! But this was understandable as they were all learning the routine and presentation process. Don't get me wrong, this was not a situation where they tossed them in with the sharks and said learn to swim. I had watched the previous days leading up to this where they were all huddled up inside for some 1 on 1 training.
They pulled it all off beautifully. The food was even better than I remembered RedRobins being and I know I used to like them before I found out about my gluten intolerance. I still try and avoid places where I am tempted, burger joints are my weakness. I love me a good burger! 
I was absolutely ecstatic to find out that not only could I get the burger I wanted, but they have their own special gluten free buns. When it came I couldn't hardly wait, I don't get to eat many burgers with buns anymore, I think bread is one of the things I miss most. The bun was not like any other gluten free I had ever had before, this one was actually soft, and had flavour, talk about a reason to return. 
We asked to talk to the manager to inquire on the gluten free process we were told about. When you order something off the GF menu it is handled by a manager on duty to assure the chances of contamination are kept to a bare minimum. That on its own was impressive. You won't find that at many other restaurants. 
All I can say is if you are like me and want a good gluten free burger at a very reasonable price, I would highly recommend you give Red Robins a try, they won't let you down.

This is exactly what a toy store should be like - chocked full of intriguing toys, both the familiar and the kinds you won't find at the big box store, with something to explore at every turn.  Go when you have time to explore, because you don't want to miss the opportunity to really see all the wonderful things you can find there.  And as someone else mentioned, the prices are not what we've come to expect from "specialty" toy stores - they were pretty darn reasonable!

Nice touch - when checking out, I was asked if anything was a present, offered the usual gift receipt, but also free gift wrapping in a choice of patterns, and encourage to sign up for emails that would send me discount offers but not bother me with excessive notices.  Staff was friendly and seemed to like their jobs, which nowadays can be a surprise in itself.  I definitely would be happy to shop here again.

Wow. I am surprised at the bad reviews. I purchased a new Kia Forte 5 last year. They stayed late to meet us on our schedule. We got exactly the car we wanted at the price we wanted. I would go back in an instant. 
But
The reason I was there is because of the terrible sales experience of buying my other Kia at west Edmonton. It was the worst experience ever. Absolute liars and thieves. 
Love both cars and like the service at west but have never tried the service at Sherwood. Over 200,000 km between the two cars.

Came on a date here with my boyfriend from fort sask, and it was awesome, we went on a Sunday night and it was quiet and a super nice atmosphere, drinks came quick and an overall good experience, we will be back for sure!

Used this service center for what was supposed to be quick job on a Saturday.  Quoted 15-30 minutes to get it in the shop.  90 minutes later nobody had touched it.  Hours later receive a phone call for $800 of work I didn't even request and told parts were 5-10 days away.  
Found parts required within 20 minutes locally, went somewhere else and had repaired in under an hour. Informed that some parts that were quoted weren't required.


Never again

A long haul from the west end on yellowhead to sherwood park for me to get there but it was worth it.
I needed some cacti and succulents for a terrarium i'm building and they had a good selection.
The place is huge with a restaurant,tons of great backyard things like fountains,gargoyles ,wind chimes.Pretty much anything you need .
Gardening tools, chemicals,seeds,dirt  etc etc etc.
Even a small jewellery section.
It's too early for outdoor stuff yet so i'll have to come back and check it out then.
In the winter they carry a big selection of old fashioned christmas decorations.

STAY AWAY GIVE YOUR MONEY TO SOMEONE ELSE. SCOTT FIX YOUR SERVICE BUSINESS. 

You know the business doesn't care about you when they don't even respond to the awful review on Yelp. Look at all the awful reviews on yelp its amazing. Does Scott even read these?

This is the worst dealership I have been too in many years. Total incompetence and disorganization. STAY AWAY. So today I had my truck booked in for 9 am so I showed up at 8:30 am. I took the day off work to deal with my truck in Sherwood Park as I work downtown. I needed my truck back before 5 PM to pick up my kids from St Albert so I booked this days in advance. I dropped off my truck and explained that I was hearing noises in the front end when i am driving on the highway and there is also a recall that needs to be done. As normal I asked them to call me when they find out what is wrong so I can approve the repairs. I left and took the shuttle back home only to receive a call at about 10:30 am telling me that they took my truck for a drive and they couldn't hear any noise. I told them I would come back to the dealership to take a test drive with the mechanic. When I got there the mechanic went to pull my truck around only to find out they were test driving the wrong truck. They put the work order to the wrong truck. Ok fair enough so I went for a test drive with the mechanic and he identified the problem so I left again. At 4pm I had not heard from them so I called Cyrus only to remind him that my truck was there and he explained they got busy and didn't even look at my truck. I told them I was coming to get my truck as I have to get my kids and to please get it ready. When I got there they had it on a hoist and spent 10 minutes and showed me a couple problems (which I didn't have time for) and then went on to say that they have to charge me something so I was getting a deal at $85 for the inspection. 

Well so the moral of the story is that my truck was booked in days in advance and now I still don't have the recall done, the noises in the front end is not fixed, the tires I asked to be rotated are not done  and out of pocket $85 and lost a day of work. 

Well I will never bring my truck there again and I would suggest that everyone stays far away from this place.They are in their own best interests not yours so give someone who cares your money.

We always order take out here.  I Like their special bean sprout chop suey, non battered ribs, mixed vegetable dishes, meat dishes.  You can ask for items that are not deep fried or battered.  Staff are friendly.  They just moved to Wye Road.

If you're looking for a great healthy place for lunch, this is it. It's still "fast food", but is in no way like your regular fast food joint.

You're able to get wraps, paninis, soups, salads and awesome, DELICIOUS smoothies. Everything is made fresh and to order.
 
I am celiac and am happy to report that I can eat here as well. They've got GF wraps and baking available at all times. They
also have lots of options for people with other allergies. (Soy milk, soy cheese, vegan options, etc).

They've recently expanded their space, so there's lots of tables where you can sit and enjoy your meal.

If you're in Sherwood Park, or passing through, I definitely recommend that you stop by for a delicious meal.

Best OUAC!
I've been to all the Edmonton stores (sold and shopped with) and have had unpleasant experiences more than 50% of the times I would go. Rude, inappropriate, unhelpful employees, clothing for sale at price's 5x higher than the original cost in one incident.
Mishandling of sellers items and even talking horribly, for the whole store to hear about a customer who had just left.All around unprofessional! 
When OUAC opened in Sherwood Park I didn't expect it to be any better but they surprised me! It's been nothing but the exact opposite of the other OUAC's.
Shopping is easy and affordable and they have done a great job at staying as organized as possible with the given amount of space they have to work with. Every time here has been pleasant and relaxed!
One negative is the selling sometimes. I've never felt ripped off selling my stuff except the last time I went it...approx 10 pairs shoes, still good condition of course, not outdated, etc... They offered $20.
It was my decision in the end to sell them but I couldn't help feeling ripped off. One of the 10 pairs alone were boys Adidas high tops purchased the previous year and only worn a few times, indoors only. I paid $60...they offered $1.60 ! So I don't think I will waste my time selling their anymore though unfortunately.

Parking is only a few spaces in an awkward parking lot with high traffic so go slow and be extra cautious. I've never had a problem parking even with the only couple spots as people are usually in and out fast enough.

We were looking for new cars at Sherwood Kia and had the pleasure of working with Aaron.   He is knowledgeable, responsive and really fun to work with.   He is super customer service oriented and has a really great no-pressure approach and really wants to make sure he meets his customer's needs.    You won't be disappointing working with him!

I have been with this insurance company since I have had insurance and they were great up until I got into my first collision. Unfortunately, I side swiped a parked car and was 100% liable. We tried to do a cash settlement however from my understanding, the owner of the hit vehicle did not proceed with a claim. 

Come time to renew my policy, my rates sky rocketed. When I called to ask why it was "Oh. You were liable for the accident you were in. Did you not receive a letter in the mail?" 

Unfortunately for them, I work at an independent insurance adjusters company and know that it is required to provide the insured with a liability letter. Still working on it!

I thought I was fine with Millennium insurance until I had to make a claim when I was struck by another vehicle. You expect your insurance company to be on your side when you're not at fault but my insurance adjuster Dan T. was the absolute worst.

First with the multiple emails to get a simple question about how to make a claim gets answered (first response was just a cut and paste form letter ). Then when I make a claim by scanning and sending them my receipts via email as suggested.  It's rejected because "he can not fully print them off"

So I go to the trouble of rescanning and resending in the receipts in a printable pdf format so he could easily print them. Once Dan T. received these he said I would only be paid if I mailed in the originals. When I frustratingly dared to ask why I had to jump through all these hoops with emails and scanned documents in the first place only to have send in the originals anyways he responded 

"My asking for scanned is so we are aware or can expect the originals to come in."

If you want to be treated like a criminal ( Dan actually insinuated anyone not willing to do all this was likely trying to commit insurance fraud!) As though someone who is attempting to defraud their company by making a claim, then use Millenium. 

I'll be looking for a new provider as soon as this is resolved. I never want to deal with their "customer service" again. 

-Previously content customer for 5 years making first claim for $200.

This was quite the experience! The portions are generous and has that mouth watering home cooked backyard BBQ taste. The meat was falling off the bones and filling my gullet. The Pit Beans is an absolute must. I will be back. If you haven't tried this place yet, change that immediately.

Actually a 4.5 stars. Delicious food. I did not try a donair (next time maybe) instead I went with the falafel platter. I love a good falafel, and Edmonton is lacking them. When I inquired if the falafels were made fresh, he showed be the bowl and proceeded to make them as I placed my order. With my platter it came with garlic sauce and hummus, both fresh tasting...and you can pick two sides. I decided on the Tabbouleh and the chickpea. so delicious. Fresh vegetables and a fresh dressing...pita was good too. My friend had the chicken shawarma plate and she was equally impressed. She has gone back to eat there.  From the other reviewers it looks like they may be on the slow side. We were the only ones in the restaurant so I can't comment on that. However, it wasn't particularly comfortable to sit in and it was way too cold...for December you need to have some heat on. That is why they loose half a star.  Definitely will go there again and try something else.

Terrible. Waitress got mad because I didn't leave a tip, I didn't leave a tip because she was slow, ignorant, fake, snotty, and overall just the worst service I have EVER received. The food itself was shit. Cold, tasted terrible, took very long to come out. We were only getting dessert, and took over an hour. It's hard to screw up dessert but these found a way. The restaurant itself was hot, small, smelly, utensils were filthy, water was contaminated with specs of dirt. One star

I've only ever been to this for truck parts, and stopped going because their entire parts department is staffed by people who have no knowledge of vehicles, and can barely look up information in their database. If I have to shop at Canadian Tire, I make the trip to Leduc.

when you read better business burrow know if you are not the board you can not make a review or a complaint.  know as a condo owner bbb does feel your thoughts are important!! good way to give false representation!!  celtic management is a good way to ensure your condo is a slum and your condo fees are so expensive.

I went to Canadian tire to get tires. Another shop put passenger tires on a heavy duty truck. I knew this is one of the better shops so I had my tires put on there. I found the staff to be very helpful and friendly. I would definitely go there again. 
   Thank you very much for helping me out excellent service. It was very busy shop and I see why.

I have heard a lot of people talking about the Crispy Cheese Chicken Burger from Famous that I finally had to try it. 

The sandwich is absolutely huge, my wife and I split it and it was more than enough food for the two of us. The chicken burger has a very nice super crispy coating. They then add some more deep-fried deliciousness with some deep fried mozzarella all on a bun with mayo and a few veggies. 

I would definitely agree with people that this is the best chicken sandwich in Sherwood Park so far, but for me is the second best in the Edmonton area (Northern Chicken owns number 1 spot in Edmonton). 

Famous is a must try if you're in Sherwood Park.

We came to Polo's one Friday on a whim after shopping in Emerald Hills, immediately we were impressed with how busy it was on a a fairly miserably cold evening. We were sat prompty. I ordered the french onion soup and the bruschetta (lying to myself I wasn't starving) while my partner ordered the Lamb shank. Our food was really good, the lamb shank was just falling off of the bone. We were very impressed. Literally the only reason it didn't get five stars was the fact that the booth we sat in (maybe theyre all like this?) I felt like the bench cushion was going to hit the floor, it was so weird like the bench cushion had no support.

Love this place! Modern design, with a huge staff to choose from. Very friendly and Sara did an Amazing job revamping my blonde, she was very educated and knew exactly what to do to get the results I wanted! Great products too:)

Closest thing to Southern style BBQ I have found in Canada. BBQ Baked Potatoes are easily the best item in the menu. Ribs are good but not great and lack consistency (some days they are perfect, other days overcooked and dry).

This is a very poorly managed store.This store is generally a mess with items left in the aisles and not stocked.  I took my 6 year old daughter here to get her first pair of skates and we had to move a few pallets around to get into the aisle we needed to get to.  I was looking for an employee to help us but no one was around.  This was at 7 pm on a Thursday.  When we found the skates that we were buying the employee told me they charge $5 for the first sharpening.  Having bought skates myself on many occasions at places like SportChek, United Cycle and Sin Bin sports it's customary to include the first sharpening.  I asked to have the fee waved but was refused.
I called the manager the next day just to let him know that generally it's industry standard in the sporting good world to include the first sharpening.  He politely told me that I was wrong.  I explained my experiences at other stores.  He said I must not have bought skates in the last year because this was the new industry standard.  When I called United Cycle to check up on this they knew nothing about this "new" standard and will include the first skate sharpening.

I have been coming to Greenland for years now, to buy flowers for my containers, and also every Christmas to pick up some new ornaments.

This is definitely one of my favourite greenhouses, and my all time favourite place to buy tree decoartions. Lots of unique finds. It's pricey so I just buy a little bit each year.
Bruce is a true pit  boss it shows in his meats as for who am I I am son of a joe Smokey joes  so yes it's like walking into work without the 19 hr work days

I just celebrated my favourite birthday EVER at Creme de la Creme! I wanted to go and make a custom lipstick. Boy was I floored when I arrived because I could make not only custom lipstick, but gloss, liquid lipstick and eyeshadow as well! 

I ended up making a lipstick, a gloss and purchased 4 eyeshadows in a palette. Those eyeshadows are crazy pigmented (and I am picky!)

The lipstick I made was a hit on the first try. I felt my technician listened to what I wanted and was very open to let me try to make my own shade even if I messed it up. I ended up making a gorgeous berry shade that smells like strawberries! The gloss was harder for me to nail down, but only because there were so many gorgeous shimmers to add! 

Because we were celebrating my birthday, I was given a cute little metal and crystal tiara to wear and keep. I was giddy! I have to add, the place is just GORGEOUS as well. It was like being a princess. 

I would highly recommend Creme de la Creme and every lovely person who works there. Thank you so much for making my birthday extra awesome!

Service is terrible and they got our order wrong. They said the correct burger would be out momentarily and it's been over 15 minutes. 

Been sitting next to a dirty table with dishes on it for 45 minutes. I'm sure 15 staff have gone by it and nobody cares.  Hope the kitchen is clean!

Will be a while before I come to Sherwood Park Red Robins again.

Love this place! As soon as you walk in the door you are greeted by the friendly owners. I usually order the donair plate,  while my wife orders the chicken donair.  Food is fresh with great flavor, and the portion sizes are large,  I always have enough left over for lunch the next day! 

This is one of our family favorites for sure!

This is a terrible insurance company. I was t- boned by a driver. After dutifully paying my premiums for 11 years, they refused to contact me or do anything with my claim for over 1 and half years. Then finally when I switched insurance companies they said they could only give me 50/50. Then they said after the deductible the amount would be paid towards my loan. I received nothing!! These people are criminals who should not be in business. Worst insurance company ever. Do not use.

I work close to Joeys Urban and I am so thankful for that. 

Not to be confused with the full service Restaurant of almost the same name- Joey. They serve tasty poutines of a wide variety and fresh battered fish and chips. 

They are located in the Sherwood Park Mall, so seating is ample and well-lit. 

I really enjoy their crafted poutines. I usually go for the Greek poutine that comes with fresh cucumbers, tomatoes, tzatziki, and chicken. 

Recently I tried the Perogy poutine and will be adding that to my list of favorites! It comes with bacon, mini perogies, green onions, and sour cream. 

A medium poutine is around $10 and is quite filling.

Don't take your vehicle here for service. They are more expensive than anyone in the city, as the young woman explained at the quick lube counter, people in Sherwood Park are OK with paying more as long as it's convenient. I think people are still looking for value and there is not any here. T,hey are close to my work, so I have used them and each time the bill came in about 20 percent higher than the already quoted on service. The services have all been regular maintenance such as transfer case and differential flush or brake rotters turned. Each time the bill comes in higher than quote by quite a lot.

But my worst beef with Sherwood Park Dodge is that every time I get an oil change there they don't tighten the oil filter well and it leaks on my new driveway or garage! I told them about the problem last year, as I took it there twice and leaked both times and both times I told service that I had to go under truck myself and tighten the oil filter and clean up the oil around it. The third time It happened  I took it back to them and let them see for themselves. They tightened it and apologized. The next oil change I took it in to Sherwood Park Dodge and reminded them to tighten up the oil filter as it leaked the last three times and when it was complete and I returned home, I crawled under my truck to check the filter and it was not tight. I finger tightened it myself. 

I obviously chose to go elsewhere for oil changes. Then almost a  year goes by and I'm too busy to run around to other places to get oil changes so I did get my last one at Sherwood  Park Dodge. Guess what I found under my truck this morning. Oil. I went under it to check and sure enough, the oil filter had oil all around it and was dripping down into my garage floor of my two year old garage concrete, leaving a nice stain. Again, I finger tightened it. 

So everywhere else I've gone can do an oil change and tighten the filter and I get zero leaking. But Sherwood Park Dodge can not complete an oil change. I would be very leery with  paying all that extra money Sherwood Park Dodge charges for any of their services since they failed to complete four out of four oil changes for me successfully. I will be joining the long list of people who will not be back.

Visited The Soup and Sandwich Co. for the first time today. The ladies working were quite delightful and their food was delicious and very reasonably priced. 

The beef noodle soup was awesome, chunks of beef that were super tender, shell noodles in an amazing broth. 

The egg salad sandwich on rye was delicious. Very fresh bread, you get to choose the veggies that go on your sandwich, make it the way you want it. 

We will definitely be going back to try their other sandwiches and other soups. Make sure you check out their website as they change their soups daily, a vegetarian soup and a meat soup.

I do love shopping here, although I do often come across clothes that are priced too high for the condition that the item is in (I just choose to not purchase those items). I have tried to sell here once, but the amount that they offer for almost new clothes, is far too little, in fact almost insulting. Not to mention they seem to be extremely picky for some people, but will take just about anything from others. Some of my items were slightly wrinkled, and were refused, but yet shopping I have found items on the racks with holes, stains and broken zippers. Their consistency needs to be worked on.

Love this place. I've been doing my own Southern BBQ for 20 years. And tried BBQ all over the place, including the southern states. This is now my go to place when I don't want to spend a whole day Making my own BBQ. There are other options in the city, but this is the best. 

The meat is moist and tender and really good. The available sauces are excellent as well as the beans and slaw.  

Served simply cafeteria style on a butcher paper, it's very non pretentious. I wouldn't come here on a first date trying to impress anyone with atmosphere or anything. But I'd bring my family. It's a small space that's usually pretty quiet. 

They also have unsweetened brewed iced tea which makes it a true southern experience! Which is a detail most local places miss.

Called Canadian tire in sherwood park looking for a simple part. After waiting 10 minutes on the phone someone answered. He asked me to hold for a minute. After another 5 minutes the phone disconnected. I've never seen anything like the service there. -30 out of 5 stars. Good thing they have the box store behind them or they would have folded a long time ago

Horrible service at the store in customer service I couldn't even take back my Airsoft gun without them lying by saying you get a 90 day warranty and we only had it about 60 days! Great job Canadian Tire! Great service! If I could post 0 stars I would!

dishonest and unprofessional salespersons and sales " manager "  that only backs the lie ! 

made a deal on a vehicle here ,  from the beginning I requested that whatever price the sales person quoted me " included and extra dealer fees like a  doc fee"    " no problem"  was the sales persons responce .  so after a few days of phonecalls back and forth and a test drice a price was agreed to a deposit was paid and i was told the truck would be ready in 2 days .  when i went to pickup and had to to to the " finance office "  even though i was not financing i was told be the finance person that ther was a documentation fee that needed to be paid over and above the agreed price with the sales person and i i didnt pay it i would not get the truck .   she refused to even ask my salesperson about our agreement and when i went to his office to ask him he laughed at me and made an offensive comment regarding my appearance !  

needles to say i did not buy from them and as it turns out got the same vehicle with some extra accessories for 2000.00 less from another dealer !   

I did leave a voicemail for the owner who preaches his dealership is different and honest .  he did not bother to return my call which shows me his claims are only about getting you in the door !
Delicious pulled pork, perfectly smoked ribs, amazing bbq sauces and friendly staff! Definitely worth the trek from Edmonton and will definitely will be back!!

Last time I went the service was really good.... the food was delivered fast at sherwood park mall..... I love a and w it's a good fast food restaurant so that's cool right everyone?! And the people are so friendly too......the other time I went was at southgate mall and it was just as friendly and good too........ and the prices are excellent too!!!!! Cannot wait to eat there more often!!!!! Thanks a and w....for making my lunch a better place to eat at whenever I need fast food

Nice looking dealership. They have everything. What they don't have is good follow up. Was looking at a new vehicle. It was between two. The other guy actually followed up. Perhaps a little pushy but at least he really cared about communication. Maybe it was the salesperson that we got. I see most of their reviews here are poor.

Lucky they're getting at three. Normally when I come here at the door greeters are very friendly . Today doesn't seem like this one girl is very friendly . I am sure it is a bad day maybe ? Ordered a double chicken and wonton and it came on two plates ? Wtf is wrong with earls today  last BD come here next time the keg . This is ridiculous

Keri's listed as owner online; she seems to believe that everything is about race and that minority hockey players shouldn't be allowed to stand up to guys who are racist to them (Evander Kane clapping back at Logan Paul, who is notable for using ethnic slurs). Not to mention apparently standing up against racism is racist in this Karen's eyes. Save your money guys, go somewhere else.

I went to this new restaurant for dinner around 5:30 PM on May 29, their opening day. The restaurant is small, with about 10 tables. By the time we left, over half the tables were occupied.

The restaurant is owned by a family and it appeared as though all staff were members of the family. Everyone was very friendly and two people (the owners?) came by while we were eating to ask how the food was. 

We tried (what I think) was all the meat options: beef brisket, turkey, pork and ribs. Al the meats were tender and smoky. We were surprised to find, however, that the turkey was our favourite of the group.

The restaurant offers a selection of sides including coleslaw, corn bread, beans and potato salad. I tried the coleslaw and corn bread. The coleslaw was good, but nothing special. The cornbread I found a bit dry.

For drinks, I was happy to see both sweet tea and unsweetened iced tea available, both made in house.

For my future visits, I look forward to trying some of the sandwich options. 

I recommend this new restaurant for others. It's nice to have another non-chain option in the Park.

You know what's worse than a shady used car dealership? A shady new car dealership and that's this place in spades.

For some reason, even after  numerous attempts to get my name off their mailing list, I still get e-mail spam from these people. I must have spoken to a dozen people, each gave me their assurance that I would never again get an e-mail but like clockwork I do. Every single time I'm a "guaranteed winner" and all I need to do is drive 3378Km to get there to claim my prize.

I've never been to Alberta. I've never given my name to these people. I've never signed up for anything they offered and yet for some reason they still want some guy in Toronto to buy a Chrysler from them. Bitch please. Even if I wanted a Chrysler, it's a lot easier not to mention cheaper for me to get one here.

So please. stop with the SPAM e-mails. It's annoying.

Christmas wonderland! Wonderful spot to wander around ANY time of year. Perfect spot to meet a friend, wander and look at the wonderful displays, then go for a lunch or latte at the always fabulous Branches. While they do a great job all year round (very cute post-Christmas displays in past years have included a pond and a Tiki hut), this place is in its glory over the Christmas season. They also have a wonderful selection of ladies clothing and home decor. However, it IS a greenhouse, so you'll want to come check out there plants in spring/ summer. I especially love their little outside garden/ park area that circles a pond, perfect to wander around and chat with a friend. Grab a latte first.  Make sure to call ahead or check their website for hours of operation, as they sometimes shut down for changing displays between seasons. A Sherwood Park gem!

Awesome little liquor store with the best Craft Beer selection in the Edmonton area. Every week they have something new to offer their customers. My favourite thing they do is they sell single beer, so I will usually go in and grab an assortment of different craft beer to try, that way I am not "stuck" with 3 beer I find mediocre. 

They also have a couple beer on tap if growlers is your thing.

Little Guy Liquor in my opinion is the best place in the Edmonton to get local craft beer. They have an absolutely massive selection and are always bringing in new beer for people to try. 

One of the cool things I like about this place is you can buy all the beer as singles. I will usually buy a 4 pack of something I know I like then buy 4 random singles to try something new (I can never leave with just 4 beer :P). 

They also have a few beer on tap if growlers are your thing.
i had a great experience here when i got a pedicure. the lady took her time and made a welcoming atmosphere. massaged with lotion. very relaxing. reasonable prices. i will definitely come back

Unique presentation and generous portions.  

This is a cafeteria style experience.  You go up to the front counter to order your meal.  The staff is phenomenal about taking care of their guests, so don't be afraid to tip up front!  

The restaurant is very "eco-friendly" which is always nice to see.  Your meal is served on a piece of butcher's paper on top of a small serving tray.  The cups and utensils are also disposable/biodegradable.  

This is one of the only restaurants I have seen where you can make your own meal.  You have a choice of ribs, pulled pork, brisket or smoked turkey.  There is also a selection of sides.  

The "Two Meat Plate" was a huge portion size with two meats and two sides.  My husband couldn't finish it all.  He highly recommends the Pit Beans - they were very good.  

I had the "Pulled Potato" which is unique to this restaurant.  It is a baked potato lined with apple-wood smoked cheddar, mayo, your choice of meat, BBQ sauce, coleslaw and pickles.  It was a meal in itself.  Very tasty!  A great gluten-free option.   

You have a choice of three different types of house-made BBQ sauces here: House, hot and sweet.  All of the smoked meat is made with BC Apple Wood. 

There are gluten free buns and dessert options. 

They have a great special for a "Family Platter for Four".  This is three meats, two large sides, four cornbread, chips, pickles and BBQ sauce for $49.95.  There were a few people that came and picked one of these up while we were eating.  

The staff checked in on us several times to make sure we were enjoying our meal.  They were very attentive and knowledgeable.  

We will be back!

I visited this place with my husband for a casual dinner out.  We were both so disappointed with the menu that we never even ordered a meal.  We just ordered a couple of appetizers and one drink.  The appetizers were pretty basic... my husband did like the flavour of the wings.  Were were pleasantly surprised when the bill came and the appetizers were half price for happy hour.  It turned out to be a very inexpensive outing... but nothing special.

Got an e-mail about appreciation day and free dessert with purchase. By 7:30pm when we wanted to share a dessert, no mud pie and no cheesecake- all sold out. Feel a little tricked since I was looking forward to a treat and left sad. If you "appreciate" your customers, might want to order in enough dessert so that you don't run out.

Eaten here twice in the last two days with different friends.

Thursday February 21, 2019 at 7:00 pm
We both ordered the Mix Shawarma with house salad, huge portion size, delicious flavourful food, very friends staff.

Friday February 22, 2019 Alford lunch at 12:40 PM
Friend had the Chicken Shawerma House with friend and I had the Mix Shawarma with house salad, great portion sized, delicious flavourful food, very friendly staff. 

Clean restaurant, lots of families with kids and staff was friendly to all.

We will definitely be eating here again and getting catering for our office.
Fantastic food, quick delivery, and super friendly staff. This is the only place we can and do order Chinese food from.

First off, they blow it with their commercial when the owner says, "we have the best sales in Canada and I don't so much say that to sound boastful...."
Well, Mr, CEO that is terriby boastful and arrogant!
Your service is so typical:  go straight to the guy in the couple as you believe that he is the decision maker and ignore the 'little lady'.

Absolutely terrible. We have been here twice and our ordered was messed up both times. Today our appetizer came out wrong and my main dish came out wrong twice. The manager was extremely rude about it. I would NEVER recommend this place. Terrible service.

So disappointed  
Prices have gone up substantially 
They changed the clam chowder soup and it didn't even taste like clam chowder 
They took away the soup, salad & pan bread from the menu 
Caesar salad was very poor quality yellow lettuce with barely any Cajun chicken on it. 
Will not return

Automotives dept.      Told by AMA that Canadian Tire was the only,place that could perform an out of Province inspection.  Paid the fee $240 and returned to find a very long list of items that required attention.  Couple of thousand dollars.  Decided to take it to a third party for another opinion.... had it repaired by the third party and only $1100.  Took it back to Canadian Tire to get the certificate and was told that I had to pay another $70 because I had not had the work done there and they needed to inspect again.  Call for the Manager and he pointed at a sign behind the counter indicating the extra fees....I told him that I would be presenting this info to the Provincial Inspection Department.  All of a sudden, got my certificate and no further charges.   My vehicles will never be back to Canadian Tire.

We financed, with a trade-in, a KIA Sportage that was 2 yrs old.  Right from the start there were warning bells.. the Bill of Sale was not accurate, the trade in allowance was out by $500 under, this had to be corrected, then the admin fee was to be waved, but was billed as Security on the final Bill of Sale, also a Service Fee of 850.50.. for what we are not sure as there was no service done at any time then.. and only one "free" oil change since 2011.  

The bill of sale was made out to our co-signer and mailed to her!  It took numerous phone calls and 3 months to get a bill of sale in our name!  We were told, "oh that doesn't matter, you make the payments.. "  what?!!  WE were new to car lot sales.. but not totally stupid.

We also had issues getting warranty work done, at one point we were denied, when we had seatbelt issues, so I had to phone head office in Ontario.  We received a call the next day from KIA West that they would honour the warranty work - as directed by head office.  We had a rubber seal on the sunroof come loose, we took it in for warranty replacement, were told we would have to leave the truck for the weekend - THIS WAS FRIDAY!  We went to West End KIA, they said a couple hours and they would do it.  BUT then KIA Sherwoood Park would not give the part to us or to KIA West, nor did they have the one that was damaged... so we had no part to reorder.. consequently this never got done.   

We also paid $3000 (yah first time buyers we got totally scammed!) for a protection package, and this was a hassle to arrange to get done, a paint spray coat protector and under carriage protection application.  The shuttle guarantees nothing, and we had to pick it up after hours so there was no shuttle service!  Good thing we have 2 vehicles... or we would have had to way to get to work the next morning!  We will NEVER go back there for anything.  

Yesterday, AUG 17 2015, a salesman called to ask me about the service.. ( we have asked them to stop calling numerous times, blocked the number and rejected mailouts to no avail).  I told him all this, he says, sorry to hear that, but I am just calling to offer a great deal on a new vehicle! (yah right!)  I said not ever again and we have already paid this one off in full and do not want a payment at this time.  He promised to call me back today to get the warranty work done and address my concerns about the $3000 protection package we still have!  Still no call ... 5:17PM August 18.  Big surprise? no

Do not ever buy from here if you think you might like straight forward, honest, customer oriented service.

If you want to get screwed around this is the place to do it. This isn't the place you want to buy a vehicle from. I've bought and sold a number of vehicles over the years so this wasn't my first rodeo. It took 15 days to get my truck I picked right off the showroom floor and yet my loan start date started 15 days prior to being in receipt of the vehicle. Sketchy right?

 I was told by Sherwood Park Chevrolet finance it was not an issue to switch financing after a year by just calling the bank finance setup and to just ask the bank for a lower rate based on sound history with the loan. 1.5 years later with a great history with no missed payments and great credit I decided to call the bank and they tell me that I was mislead by Sherwood Park Chevrolet finance because they don't do that. In fact, the bank representative candidly told me it is sort of the dealership's business to try to get you into a higher rate as the returns to the dealership are higher and I should have easily seen a much better rate originally. Don't be fooled!

 I went through private financing after this with my bank and naturally got my rates reduced to a great amount. However before doing this when I called in to Sherwood Park Chevrolet to first confront their finance department about the financing that they promised and assured me they kept trying to put me into another vehicle despite my just having bought my truck from them the previous year (2014 Silverado loaded). I outright told them to have salesmen stop calling about selling me another vehicle. The finance department that I called and asked for was messing me around and instead trying to get me into another car instead of returning my calls. That took two weeks just to get some answers out of the Sherwood Park Chevrolet Finance. The rates they came up were for a new vehicle which they had apparently applied for me to get another vehicle when I had blatantly told them absolutely not numerous times. Seriously, I feel like I should have sued them.

If they try to sell you on not getting winter tires put into the package don't go for it. The stock all season tires are inadequate from my 1.5 years of driving my truck for Alberta's interesting winters. Definitely opt for some winters into the deal as you'll slide pretty good without.

So basically if you want to get conned, someone filing applications for something you didn't ask for and random sales people harassing to buy you after you asked them to stop then go to these guys. No not one or two but three guys calling despite saying no thanks. They don't listen and they certainly don't demonstrate any integrity. I'm a pretty fair person but I honestly wouldn't advise buying anything from them. If for some reason you do decide to buy a vehicle from them I'd use unhaggleme online before going in to get bottom rates and using private financing so you get exactly what you're looking for rather than being mislead.

 If it comes to the service department I have nothing but good things to say about them. The service department is an absolute pleasure to deal with but I'd definitely avoid buying a vehicle from them.

Always a great spot for a quick burger.
 
Not a huge fan of the cajun fries, but simple classic american burger with all the peanuts you can eat. 

I usually go for the Little Cheeseburger, don't be fooled, this is still quite the burger.
Tons of topping choices, i usually go for the full top row on the menu. 

Simple quick grilltop burger!

Just keep on driving past this new location of the Red Robin's chain. Appears that the staff are still deciding how they should serve their clients. Our server was friendly but very forgetful of simple requests for pop or deserts? The burgers came out bland and overdone.  Our little girl's kids meal of spaghetti arrived at the table - cold & dry. You would think for the price these places charge for a pop, burger and fries - that it would be better than any lower priced chain. Give it a pass - there are better options for a burger without the higher prices & mediocre service.

Went this this place on Saturday for dinner. We were  seated right away and asked where we would prefer to sit. The service was excellent and the waitress gave us the specials. The three meals at the tablle  were prime rib burger with yam fries, fish and chips and chicken stir fry. Everyone enjoyed their meal. Each was around $19. 

The ambiance, service, taste of food and cleanlinesss of this place was super. Parking was free and the plaCe was easy to find. I would definitely go back. 

Sorry, no pictures this time.

We had the pleasure of enjoying better than average wine and wine this evening. We ordered the Rascal red wine the Syrah and Grenache blend and found it great enough to order a second bottle to take home. 

The food was fresh. Even the Calamari I ordered smelled like like squid instead of oil like it usually does. I also had the tuna poke which was really good, little too much avocado in the blend, but good nevertheless. My wife ordered the ribs with slaw and warm potato salad. Delicious. Breana was busy but always checked in with us. It was a pleasurable visit 

I will rate this experience 5 stars. Great fresh tasting food, excellent service and quick turn around on everything during a peak period. We've been here before. I recommend earls Sherwood Park!

The place was all decorated for Christmas.  It was beautiful. So many ornaments! Worth checking out just to see all the trees. Each one different. Then go for lunch at Branches. Can't wait to come back in the spring when they get all the bedding plants.

Great place if you like BBQ, menu is variety of pork, brisket or turkey. Sandwiches or platter of meat with deep friedbeans, baked potato or cornbread or mashed potato.  This was my first time here, it will not be my last.

Like all the rest of the reviews here and many other places. Celtic Management Services  is a company that bullies, uses your condo money to ensure the condo board and Celtic Management makes condo fees unbearable by stuffing there own and the condo boards pockets!!     Like myself, money has gone missing and they do not respond to lawyer requests for basic information.  The have hired most of the lawyers out there as they are skilled at using the system to abuse you the condo owner.   In our case the condo board is paying themselves too!!

Two words,  so good. This was the first time we have ordered here, and judging by the restaurant, I was not sure what to expect. Damn... wow... crazy good. We did not see them prepare our donairs, but, when we got home,we noticed their massive side. I ordered a super donair with cheese and my son ordered the jumbo. The meat is deliciously spicy,and the donair is prepared fresh with your choice of toppings. If your on the fence, get off and go here now. I'll be back to try your poutine!! Thank you.

People always tell me that this guy makes the best donairs around. Not the case, Usually those are the people that havent ventured out from the park for a donair. 

Its better than richards, and the other donair stores in town, but thats not saying much. 

This guy takes forever to make you a donair and he wont stop talking to you.

This is going to be a weird review for me. I quite enjoyed the donair I had from Donair & Shawarma House but I can't give it 5 stars because the donair is to big. Normally I am all for low price with large portions but here it doesn't work for me. When I eat something like a donair when I take a bite I want a bite with the meat, onions, tomatoes, etc. This is just not possible with this monster of a thing, you are either just eating donair meat or the toppings. 

The people working here are great, super friendly and really understand the meaning of great customer service.

The flavour of their food is great, and maybe massive portions is your thing then this place is for you, I personally just think less would be more.

This place was amazing! First time going and the service was super fast and fresh hot food. Worth the drive out. They even have daily specials and we got 15% off all of this. Perfect amount of food for 4 of us. Ordered family combo #2

Honestly I don't care what anybody says about y'all me and my wife stayed at the Hampton and order Boston pizza 4 nights in a row and spent a total of 240$ it was worth it the pizza was hot and fresh every time the wings are delicious the spinach artichoke dip is amazing they give you a specific time they will show up but was always early which is great for two hangry people anyways thank y'all for the hospitality and for being very nice and generous over the phone keep up the good work and bless you all

I used to go to this place and was fairly happy with it even though it's really expensive. However it has gone downhill. Sylvia the owner is extremely rude and does not care about the clients. I have an undercut but typically they are complimentary to trim. However the day before I'm to have my next undercut trim Sylvia calls and tells me I have to pay 25$ for it because I haven't gotten my hair coloured there in awhile. Unfortunately money is tight and I can't be paying their extreme amounts every month. I don't mind paying for an undercut trim however 25$ is extremely expensive and to call me the day before when this has been booked for a week shows me how much she doesn't value customers. I was looking to book a makeup application in January however I definitely will never be going back and will make sure to let my friends know. Very disappointed.
Nope. Don't bother. $17.72 for burger, fries and soft drink. Burger had a store-bought patty which tasted like cardboard. Very small portion of fries. Service was OK but not great. Won't be back.
Great food and an incredibly friendly staff. Definitely worth checking out. If you're in Sherwood Park it is a MUST!

Wow!  What an amazing buying experience. Our salesperson Lanique was amazing. No pressure, very knowledgeable. If he didn't know the answer to a question he immediately found out for us.  The manager, Kim, is friendly and works hard for the customer.  When we went to pick up our vehicle it was later in the evening and we were worried we wouldn't have time for a walk through.  When we asked the other manager, Leland, how late they were open he told us they would stay open until the business was done. We weren't rushed at all.
I would highly recommend sherwood kia to anyone looking for a vehicle.
Bruce is a true pit  boss it shows in his meats as for who am I I am son of a joe Smokey joes  so yes it's like walking into work without the 19 hr work days
The Best BBQ rest in Edmonton !!! The ribs, brisket, pulled pork nicely done  !!! The owner is very friendly n very welcoming !

I think sometimes Earl's is discounted as a good restaurant to eat at because it's a chain.  I happen to like Earl's, and the menu is varied enough that I can always find something I want to eat when I visit any location.  

I had visited this Earl's many years ago, and when I went last week I was pleasantly suprised by the recent renovations.  The interior and entry are much more spacious and updated than previously, and it looked like the inside had nearly doubled the seating capacity.  This was another Sherwood Park restaurant we were checking out for our rehearsal dinner, and after our horrible meal at Joey Sherwood, this Earl's exceeded my expectations.  We called ahead and met with a supervisor prior to our meal and she was able to answer all my questions and show me where the tables could be set up for our dinner.  She was very professional, and gave me a business card when we were done talking.  When we are looking at spending ~$700 on a dinner, this is exactly how I would hope to be treated.  

My meal was above average compared to the food I usually get at Earl's.  I ordered a chicken caesar salad, and the chicken was moist and flavorful, and the lettuce was fresh and crisp.  My mom's pesto pizza was delicious, and my fiancee enjoyed his steak as well.  Our server was knowledgable about the menu and was very quick to keep our water glasses full and check in with us regularly.  Earl's food (at any location) is never spectacular, but it is consistent and tasty.  The service at this location puts it a step above some of the other Earl's I have visited, and I am looking forward to eating here in the future.

Store is a mess, employees don't even know where their own product is, and their system is a mess. System said they had 2 of what I was looking for in stock, but no one could find them anywhere. I really dislike this store

Pulled up at midnight & realized they had a drink bar?? A DRINK BAR!! Never seen that before. High key got so excited! I ordered a iced caramel cold brew latte thing and it was so good it even has the foam stuff like Starbucks does! SO GOOD!  Also I didn't even have to ask for light ice because it only came with a small amount of crushed ice. Bf got a berry açai thing & it was really good too! Also the man working was very nice and very patient 10\10 experience

Never a bad meal when I visit here. Not the most authentic tasting Mexican food but for American style Tex mex it's very good. 

Not a big deal for me but my wife usually orders shrimp and they rarely if ever have shrimp, this may be because of the pandemic or it could be like the McDonalds milkshake machines always "down" and they just don't want to make shrimp because it does take a bit longer.

Would give zero stars if possible. Went to make a simple return for roughly $10. Had reciept, original method of payment(debit)and unopened/undamaged product. Also purchased less than 2 weeks prior. NEVER SHOPPING AT CANADIAN TIRE AGAIN! EVER!!!
