Just Love The Food Here. Lots Of Choices And Awesome Ambience. Would Definitely Go Visit Again. Specially The Barbequed Food And Variety Of Meats. Perfect Marination . Visited With Friends And Family. We Had An Awesome Experience And Enjoyed The Cosy Evening.

NEVER COME HERE!!!! EVER!!!! 
It's my job to bring in the bottles, a job of which I do probably 3 maybe 4 times a year. Needless to say I am familiar with bottle depots/ how they work/ how to organize said bottles etc. I always pre-count, and sort- for convenience with everyone involved and to ensure I don't get ripped off that bad. However I do understand when going to the bottle depot they'll always find a way- again hence pre counting. Anyhow, I generally go to the bottle depot on Wye road, but today I tried this one. 
As mentioned I had everything perfectly sorted having done it many times before, I went in and they tore everything apart and insisted on counting everything themselves. Sure, fine- it's their job requirement. They told me 6 of the bottles I had were not acceptable, so they threw them out. Throughout the process there was 5 more that were unacceptable, for reasons I don't understand but nonetheless, the point being is that they only subtracted 11 bottles (1L + and -) from the huge lot I had. I had looked up their prices and predetermined the price to be $61.05 exactly. I imagined since they subtracted a few it would maybe be $59 now, if not more. Somehow their total rang to $54.95!!!! A significant loss from the original total despite only 11 bottles not meeting their qualifications. They gave me my change and I was FURIOUS so I left because it's not worth an argument with these guys. I got home and took out the change and these imbeciles gave me $52.60 in change. (???!!!) given I didn't count the change on hand so I guess my bad for getting conned but how does someone mess that up that horrendously. 
Terrible experience from start to finish and they stole $10 from me. 

I will never return here.

I brought my 2012 Fusion in to get the winter tires put on, an oil change and have an issue with the windshield wiper fluid not spraying out.

First the timing and communication for the entire visit was good.

There however two issues. They did not bag my summer tires, just put them in the car.

And second they repaired the issue with the windshield washer fluid, however when I got home and tested it nothing came out.  I popped the hood to have a look and discovered they forgot to connect the hose to the fluid was just spraying allover the engine.

It was easy enough for me to correct,  but that is not the and something many people would be willing to do.

This is the first time in many years I have gone to Kal Tire for anything, based on the experience I am indifferent to going  back.

We ordered food for our family as well as a steak meal for our 12 year old beloved dog, that we had to put down the following day. They we so amazing. Plus she got an free dessert and loving remarks from staff on the card they had provided with it. They went well above and beyond for all involved these folks are amazing!!

Me and my Husband have been here twice, first time we had the beef stroganoff and the stir fry, both were fantastic, Before i complain, i hate that being that person who complains, i feel bad but it was just that bad. We just went again today, super excited to go back as we had great service and food about 4 months ago, today we got the beef stroganoff and spaghetti and meatballs, beef stroganoff came out tasting bad and undercooked, and the waitress did not follow direction on our orders ( we get it that happens sometimes!) my spaghetti and meatballs (i don't think i would even feed to my dog) it was like eating gravy and cut up noodles, so so so dissatisfied, our waitress took 10 minutes before she even noticed our food at the end of the table, after the manager came over we ordered something else and a drink, our drink never did up coming as we watched it sit at the bar for 15 minutes, In conclusion our date night was ruined and we just wanted to go home, we paid full price for everything and they gave us a 20% off gift card for next time.... we left that behind... as we will never be back. Nobody was remorseful and the service and food was all around just really bad. Must be under new management since the last time we were there, it's too bad because it had great potential! Do not recommend anyone going here to waste their time and/or money.

This is a great greenhouse. We've been coming here for several years. The prices are a bit higher than for plants at the Home Depot or Walmart but you sure get what you pay for. We bought their alfalfa fertilizer for our lawn after a gardening expert recommended it on a gardening radio show. The lawn was dying and after trying every fertilizer known to man I figured I would have to dig it up and re-sod. The alfalfa was a miracle, in one season it
rejuvenated the lawn to where it was one of the best in the neighborhood.

Greenland also has a very nice restaurant with a beautiful patio. A varied menu and the chef prepared delicious crab cakes with sangria and we enjoyed them in the soft tropical hydrangea scented air, the sound of water cascading over rocks nearby.

Intrigued by the all you can eat so I took my daughter after dance on a Tuesday. Amazing kids food options and large adult selection. Service was quick- got in and out fast. Bathroom is very outdated but clean.

Will be back to try out more of the menu!

I had a radiator leak that they said was from the coolant tank, which they replaced.  They also did a general checkover of the vehicle and said they found no other problems.  As soon as I got it home I noticed a coolant smell that turned out to be another leak.  They told me this time I needed the water valve and radiator replaced,  When I had the repairs done I talked to the mechanic, who was honest and he said there was nothing wrong with the radiator. Also, their customer service left much to be desired.  I had to call them to find out things they should have informed me about, and the bills both times were considerably more than they quoted.  I would not go back to them.

Celtic management refuses to answer basic question regarding budgets, the spread sheets are concerning and even two accountants found them confusing.  Celtic management are bullies, strive to make running your condo very complicated so you feel you need to stick with them, are unprofessional in emails and meetings and try to get condo owners to go against each other.  If you want exceptional unreasonable condo fees, and running a simple condo very complicated choose Celtic Management. Lots of reviews to support not using Celtic.  Sadly there are no actual regulation for management companies.

My experience with this company has been a nightmare. They are taking over 5 months to repair drywalls and change the floor. They never answer the phone. 

They have little regard for customers, probably because they operate behind the clout of condo corporations.

I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THEIR SERVICES

This is a welcome addition to Sherwood Park's food scene.
Fresh. Trendy. And doing their part to source locally.
The chef came out and spoke at length to a couple beside me about their practices.
To some extent...this is interesting.
Good on them for going about things in a concious way.
All in all however...for me..it boils down to the food, the value, and the service. Pretty much in that order!
To that extent...
Service was excellent.
Atmoshere was really nice and I look forward to dining in their lounge someday.
Value...decent. I think things are a little pricey. Obviously...cost cutting isn't in the cards given their approach.
Food...
The two offering ilI tried were satisfying...but not amazing. The risotto was quite tastey, but by the end...I was gettingsimewhat tired of it. It was indeed very rich and flavourfull.
My lamb sliders were...unique..but hust didn't "wow" me the way I had hoped they would. Pretty dry (as lamb is), and I didn't want to dunk them in the ketchup provided for the accompanying fries.
Am I glad "Farm to Fork" is here...yes.
Will I be back...yes.
Will I rush back...doubtfull.
But they are very deserving of everyones opportunity. These kind of places are worth investing in.

So my Mrs and I w ere excited to go out to the park buy a few things for the garden and check out the restaurant. There was no lineup was about 7 pm on Friday. There were a bunch of empty tables and plenty of staff. We were told it was a 25 minute wait. What a joke. Never going back to this place again. Just goes to show Greenland. You never get a second chance to make a first impression. The greenhouse folks were very helpful having said that. So it wasn't all bad just disappointing on the restaurant side.

Earl's has been around a long, long time.  You would think the restaurant would get boring but oddly I continue to find myself an Earl's fan over the last 20 years. And this is the best of the lot, I will even drive from my home in the north end just to go to this location. I find the staff friendly, helpful, and the food is always consistent and fresh. 

I believe the difference in this location is the management, they seem to know how to treat a guest, a rarity these days it seems.

 I am never disappointed here. If you feel like an old friend like Earl's, this is the one to go to.

I recently approached the used car department at Sherwood Kia in hopes to come away with a used pickup on the lot.  From the start I felt like I was on the defensive.  
Sales tactics fit the common "greasy used car salesman"  Was introduced to one of the many 'managers' that were standing around, and he continued to pressure me to put a signature on paper before I had agreed to anything. That he couldn't move forward without a signature because he didn't want to waste time on someone who wasn't serious.
I have been to many used vehicle lots over the last while, many better experiences than here.  I would even go as far to say that i would pay more somewhere else for an equivalent vehicle to avoid doing any business with these people.

Well...damn!
Just discovered there was yet another new Donair shop in "the Park" a few days ago...and here we are!!
This is clearly a sign that it's time to put that epic "50" mark in my proverbial rear view mirror. 
51, pleasure to make your aquaintance!
Great lookin' shop!
Shiney.
Clean.
Classy lookin' place .
Friendly staff.

And this is where things...for me...began to seem more than a little disorganized.
I hope they work out a better system...cuz' the good is really good. But this review may wind up a little more disjointed than usual, as I want to give'em a fair shake, despite seeing a few concerns with the way they are presenting themselves. A lunch rush, based on my experience, could be quite the affair.

Only minor confusion with my order...
Super Donair
Side garlic sauce.
Water.
$11.81.
Not too shabby!
But wait...
Confusion began when man taking my order was surprised that I wanted to "pay now".
Well.
...
Yeah.
I placed my order at a cash register...at the end of a counter...in a donair shop. As per my volume of experience, I should be "in-and-out" inside 20 minutes...

When i entered, there was a family of 4 and two singles earing, eating.  One gentleman was waiting patiently.
1:12.
I place my order at counter.
Explain what i would like a few times.
Convince one of the two employees that I would indeed like to pay now.

Off torear of restaurant to wait.
And wait.
...
And wait.
At about the 15 minute mark...
The patient gentleman recieved his platter.
Lol
And promptly took a picture of it....
The family began fo leave...
And pay.
Another couple arrived, and began to order after family payed.
Now 1:29.
16 minutes in.
As the new couple sat down, another couple clenter.
Then a pair of ladies.
At this point, I walked up to coynter and asked where my food was.
He pointed toward grill.
I told him I was changing seats and sat closer to counter.
At this time...
I saw them begin to prepare my food.
The original couple...waiting for order.
New couple and ladies...waiting to order.
Only my oder... placed almost 20 minutes earlier, the only one in the works.
In cones yet another couple.
Now 4 pairs of people awaiting food.
Two employees.
Every customer being set up for 3 encounters with the employees (place order,  be delivered order, return to pay for order).
Not too efficient.

By the time I finished eating, they were appearing to be just beging to makeall the meals before them.
With this kibd of system, it would make more sense to put a "please wait to be seated" sign up, have a host and a wait staff.
Not at all what I expect from what appears as any other donair shop.
I really hope they straighten this out.
As now.
Finally...
THE FOOD!
After hastilly piling my wrap togetger, and me reminding them of the side of garlic sauce, I received my donair.
Phew.
Sorry.
I hope I never have to go on like that again.
...
Wow!
Good stuff!
Great value.
Soft pita.
Excellent, suculent meat.
Plenty of fresh veggies.
Sweet sauce seemed really good, ghough a little tough to locate by the halfway mark.
Garlic sauce was decent, but so this that I couldn't pour it on. Had to be "painted" on wirh tiny container.
By the end my bag and my hands told the tail of a battle well fought.
Happy they have a washroom as it's quite possible one would need to washup afterwards .
All in all.
A solid 3.5
I wish YELP would allow it.
So 3 it is.
Not 4 material from my experience.
That being said.
Check'em out.
Give'em a chance.
Here's hoping your experience is better.
The food is good.
I actuallyheard a few of the customers praising the salads. Proof, they have done well before.
As a caviet, the head guy dod stop me on my way out and appologize for the delay.
Good stuff.
But from my perspective, he had 4 more appologies brewing as I left.
...
Yowza.

After getting some service/repair work done on my Grand Cherokee Jeep Diesel, the engine malfunction light came on as soon as I drove off. I did a quick u turn, and the technician had a quick look, reset the indicator light and said all was okay. I was on holiday for 2 weeks and when I returned the vehicle struggled to start and the engine malfunction light came on again. By the time I got an appointment to get it back into them the damage was already done. During the initial work done the glow plug module grounding strap had been removed and accidentally left off, resulting in over $2K of damage. When I questioned why I should have to pay as it was their fault, it was a case of no pay, no return of vehicle. I spoke to the service manager in person a few times, sent emails, spoke to Jeep Canada etc, but the bottom line is I have had to foot the bill. To rub salt into the wound, I later found out that the tire pressure monitor that they changed, was double the Costco price, and was not even an original manaufacturers part. I have vowed that Dodge Jeep will never get another cent off me, and take great pleasure in advising my friends and colleagues of my issues.

Brought our xtrail there for diagnosis for non functional all wheel drive system twice. First time they said there was nothing wrong. I have owned all wheel drive cars for many years and know for fact it was not working in our car. The girl said there is no code, they had it on lift, they road tested and system was functioning normally. Ok so I'm dumb. After I disagreed she told me to bring it in again when I had a chance. Two months later bring it in again for this problem and also problem with heater not blowing. Told again all wheel drive system was functioning normally? WTF?So I'm driving around town starting from icy intersection and front wheels are spinning and car hardly moves but the all wheel drive system is functioning normally ? Complete fail ! I remember now why I don't associate with dealerships. these guys just reminded me !  almost $400 bill and all they accomplished was an oil change and wired a new plug on the block heater. I won't even get into the heater issue ! Misdiagnosed that too ! Never again! The manager was informed (so I was told) about their mistakes. I guess he doesn't care. Never heard a thing from them since.

Wonderful Brunch! Tasty and fresh! Highly recommend their Eggs Benedict on Yorkshire pudding. The Farmers Breakfast is huge and delicious!

I have eaten there for lunch and supper before. Was quite impressed with the menu. As locally sourced as possible in Northern Alberta! Thought I would try it for brunch. Was certainly not disappointed. 

Staff is friendly and courteous. Loved that both, the chef AND the owner, came out to check on us.

There's also a bar for more pub style food.

Definitely try it for supper or lunch. All meat dishes there melt in your mouth.  The fish? Moist and flaky. I had the Coho. To. Die. For.

My fave? The lamb sliders on homemade potato chips.

But don't take my word for it. Go there. Just GO!

This place employs chauvinists and mansplainers. They tried to force me to purchase a car I did not agree to buying, and it got to the point that I had to involve lawyers. 

I signed paperwork for a vehicle subject to the installation of cruise control. When they discovered that installation of cruise was not possible for safety reasons they refused to install it and told me they would pay me cash to get it installed my self...what? It's a safety concern and you expect me to do it myself because you won't take on the liability? They then said because I signed for the car I had to take it. And some chauvinist pig decided to lecture me on whether I even needed cruise. Not your business mansplainer. When I threatened a law suit since they were absolutely not providing me with the product I agreed to purchase they finally realized that their chauvinism had lost. 

I will never buy Nissan or deal with a Nissan dealer ever again. I know too many who've had poor customer service experiences with Nissan and their poorly built vehicles.

Horrible place. Horrible and difficult people.

Their services, client care, and accountability are horrible!!!!! If you are lucky to buy a car without any problem, great! I bought a brand new car and the emergency brake doesn't work as it should be. I ask them to check it out and they did but they said they couldn't do anything, that they are sorry but I have to handle it and then they said they put tape on the camera to help. They put tape to fix my brand new car..........I emailed the sales, service, and branch manager, no one had the courtesy to even reply to me. I went there to complain that my emergency brake doesn't work and they said it's a weather problem. I would like to add that I made this complaint at the beginning of Fall!! there was no snow, just cold weather. Most of my mornings or afternoons my emergency brake doesn't work and no one there cares, they treat me as nonsense and with irony/ sarcasm. Their managers are disrespectful and they don't have an idea what client care means. Do NOT buy your Nissan there! drive a few minutes and buy your car somewhere else. It's worth the drive because they only care about the sale. Horrible client care if you have a problem.

My Daughter has had her vehicle serviced  at Kal  Tire in Sherwood Park a couple of times. On both occasions Will has been outstanding to deal with. His demeanour is so friendly and professional and their service quotes are always fair when compared with other service centres,  including Costco. The service has also been very prompt and flexible working around the customer's needs and schedule.  I would highly recommend visiting Kal Tire in Sherwood Park for your tire service.

I've been to this salon several times and each time was a great experience. Their salon is clean, the staff are nice and happy, they're fast and will do what you ask, even make suggestions. I've had shellac nails done in the past at other salons that never last more than 3 days, these nails last 2 weeks before my nails grow out and I need a change! I've never had to wait even when I was a walk in, and there is always a steady stream of clientele. My mother in law and I go together, and she is a tough woman to please, but she leaves with a big smile on her face every time we go. A great nail place!

Tuna melt! That's the only thing I have tried here/ate today. It has to be one of the best melts I have ever had to be honest. Never did I think that so many healthy options put into a dish could be so good but I was totally wrong. 


    For my first time trying it I would absolutely go back for the same dish. If not try other things on the menu. I am a guy trying to live healthier with food choices and this dish still satisfied me wants! 

   Great staff, great environment as well. The lighting is a little dark but I really don't mind that, no different then the keg! Cheers!!!

Took my car in to have an oil leak diagnosed. After $600 of parts and labour I found that the vehicle was still leaking oil. Took it back expecting the shop to do the job they said they would. Dropped it off on a Friday and apparently the car was ready Saturday, not that I would know considering I wasn't notified until 6pm on Monday. After rushing over to the shop to pick up the vehicle they had the audacity to charge me another $88 for a leak near the oil filter that they failed to notice the first time. This shop used to have a high standard but this is unacceptable and I do not recommend them any longer. Abysmal customer service and I now question if they changed a part that did not need changing the first time.

I don't want my $600 back, I just want my $88 back
Food is amazing! It took anout 25 minutes for my take out order to be made though so it is not the quickest.

Celtic management refuses to provide documents to support accusations of money owing. Refusal to respond to lawyer letters or the owners letters for basic account requests. Celtic Management charges an extreme amount of money, however they do not maintain the property such as main fire doors coming off of hinges, electric box fixed with a piece of tape, damed flooring and the list goes on. Celtic Management is apart of the better business group however if you are not a board member they will not look at or post your complaint !!! Be very very wary of this terrible group!! REMEMBER AT THIS TIME IF THEY CHOOSE TO IGNORE EVEN A LAWYERS REQUEST FOR INFORMATION YOU NEED TO GO TO THE COURT OF QUEENS BENCH TO HAVE RESOLUTION. THIS PATHETIC BUISNESS RELYS ON THIS!!

This has had to be one of the worst experiences I've ever had with a shop. Not only did I have to wait 1.5 hrs before the alignment technician even showed up to work! But the guy barely understood english...I wanted my alignment set at specific numbers. When I told him he just had this glazed over look on his face. The manager was quick to reassure that everything would be taken care of. Well my alignment is still off, but according to them its the best that they can do. I installed specialty parts that would allow the alignment to be dialed in. Also they left my steering wheel crooked instead of making sure it was corrected. This place is a joke! Arrogant staff that think they know more than they actually do. Id give this place a negative score if I could.

I have been to,unit a few Earls restaurants over the years.  They offer good reliability in food consistency and service.  I thought I would check out this relatively new Earls with my friends to see if they might break out of the Earls box, so to speak.

We had a nice evening out. The decode was pretty standard for Earls.  Moderately engaging without being distracting.  It wasn't a very busy night, which certainly lowered the atmosphere, but it did allow the servers to spend more time with each table group.  Earls continues to ale staff to dress in a manner that is more about drawing the eye of male customers than is about ensuring the safety and wellbeing of their employees - and I suspect that dress requirements many change with the recent court decisions on this mater - and that would be a good thing.

The food came in a good time.  Everything was appropriately hot or cold.  The hamburgers were quite tasty.  We shared an ice cream dessert dish, and the waiter remembered to bring extra spoons all around.  Kudos for attentive service
Best donairs around. A must try.   It's always fresh and very good.

Fresh Healthy Cafe serves smoothies, salads, wraps, sandwiches and soups on the edge of the Summerwood neighbourhood in Sherwood Park.

The smoothies are delicious. Although scary looking with its bright green colour, I recommend the kale smoothie for a fresh drink.

Some of the sandwiches are a bit bland and some, such as the spicy chicken, don't transcribe well to salad. 

As far as the soups go, I recommend the Spicy Thai Chicken. Although it comes with an extra charge over the regular soups, it is filling and flavourful with a generous portion.

Not much of a car enthusiast but this place is reliable. Bought my used car from Toyota Mayfield which is a Nissan Altima fully loaded previously owned by an elderly person. However, when I bought it there at mayfield they told me they didn't know the problems to my vehicle. Long story short, I took it to this Nissan dealership who told me it was my wheel bearings worn out and they were able to diagnose/repair my car for free due to an outdated call back on the vehicle. Been coming here ever since with minor fixes and oil changes. Express service is averagely good, very pricey for parts. My advice for used cars is to take it to its original car dealership to have it inspected. Better knowing the correct problems instead of money grabbers taking advantage of you. Again i'm not a car savvy but stay wise.
Recommended for people who own Nissan vehicles to get their car fixed. As for parts you can look elsewhere for great deals.
Well it's 11:49pm on a Saturday. I went to Wendy's at 11:15 and they close at 1pm. The people ignored us and wouldn't tell us why they were closed .... got A&W instead... better choice.

Not bad at all. I'm a picky eater and they made my sandwich to perfection. Their spicy chi ken was not dry which is a plus. 
What was nice was the fries were not over salted but it seemed like there was no salt at all on them. Other than that no issues

I have been taking my 2015 Murano to Sherwood Park Nissan ("Nissan") since I purchased it in Calgary.  At the time, I choose Nissan because it was closer to home and I was told that it was No. 1 in Canada for sales/service, but now I think the No. 1 dealership is in Calgary (DON'T quote me on that though)!  I have taken the Murano a few times to Nissan and their service/personnel have been great; e.g. no problem getting warranty work done, status updates while you wait, express service (no appointment necessary; oil changes), wash your car (it is not a touch less wash, but it is free!), etc.  As well, their customer waiting area is nice; e.g. reading material, television, beverages (water/coffee), etc.

Also, we brought a previously owned vehicle from Nissan.  Just a word of advice; ensure you know what you are getting!  We purchased the vehicle in March/April and was told it had new tires to which I was positive I asked if they were "all seasons" tires; the salesman replied, yes.  Well, they turned out to be new "WINTER" tires!  Lessons learned, check before taking the vehicle!

I've ordered from Life in the past before and loved my food but recently I've been able to dine in and I must say I love it. The staff is so friendly and helpful. The food is all prepared wonderfully. I love that they were able to accommodate one of my party's garlic allergies without any problems (which for an Italian restaurant seems amazing) 

This place will definitely be making it into our rotation of locations to eat regularly.

It was pouring rain the day we came here for a late lunch.  I ordered the pesto chicken sandwich which was cold. My mushroom soup was good.  This restaurant is always so cold though.  We sat in two separate booths and froze in each one.  The place is nice and clean but so cold.  I'm sure I could have brought my sandwich back to be heated up more but we were in a rush to get food down and back off to work.  Service though is great the workers are friendly and the place is clean.  Washrooms are clean. I liked how a worker came by our table and refilled our water.

This is the absolute worst management company.

They do not ensure that their workers are actually certified in task they are doing.
The company they hired caused an emergency asbestos abatement to happen in my building that they have still not given anyone a cost for and were caught trying to short cut repairs without letting the owners or the board know.  This has happened in several units in this complex and they have no idea about the condo act and the actual information it encompasses.
When called out on their mistakes they take zero accountability for it.

This company is garbage, they do not respond to
Emails or calls, do not ensure tasks are completed and are very secretive regarding financials of your building and costs.

They use contractors they are romantically involved with that are not even competent or certified to complete the work and do not disclose this information.

They will try to shortcut everything and act like they own the building and not that they are working for the condo.

It's Wendy's...
Really. What does one expect.
I have eaten at this location since it was built over 20 years ago.
As a kid, it was a place to go for shakes after a ball game with my team. As a teen...it was somewhere to see who could eat the most JBC's when we were cruising around.
I certainly don't frequent it like I used to...but when I do stop in...I get exactly what I expect.
No complaints here.
Their food is definitely not pretty but damn is it good. Definitely one of if not the best burger in Sherwood Park.

Ran in with my 6 year old to find a birthday gift for his friend. An amazing selection of toys, crafts, puzzles, books and sweet treats. Comparable prices to  big box stores but better selection. My favourite part? Free gift wrapping! 

Very friendly staff and great service. 

We got a selection of a science themed toy, a silly toy and pop rocks. 

We were both pretty pleased. My son liked the toys and I liked the price.

I really wish Sherwood Park would build a second location...

That being said...This has been my go-to Canadian Tire for pretty much my whole life. I shudder to think how much money I have contributed to their coffers in that time! 
At the same time...It IS CANADIAN...and these days, as American chains buy out and push out local stores...I wouls rather I contribute to good old "Ukranian-Tire" (Crappy Rubber...call it what you will). 
They hire young people...for better or for worrse. Those who used to make burgers still work here. Some days the service is great...others..its OK.
Never the less...I will be back...time, and time again!

Back in early May I sent a message to this dealership, stating my interest in a 2020 Chevrolet Colorado Z71. The next day I was contacted by Internet Sales Manager, Derek.  Just an introduction, and an offer to answer any questions I had. I made clear my intent to not purchase until end of summer, as I was just entering my research phase, and still had to look at the Tacoma and Frontier. He never made a pressure sales pitch. Just answered my questions. Over the next couple of months, as I went over all 3 trucks, and narrowed my choices, General Ssles Manager Jordan, and General Manager Scott both reached out to see if they could help me in any way, and asked what they had to do to get my business when I'm ready. I told them at that point, that they really didn't need to sell me on a vehicle. I'd researched the hell out of the midsize truck market, and landed on a 2020 Chevy Colorado ZR2. They only need to sell me on them as a dealership. Near the end of July, I shifted from researching vehicles, to searching for one. I reached out to every Chevy dealership I could feasibly drive to if need be. This included Ft Sask, Leduc, Wetaskiwin, Stony Plain, St Albert and even Edson, along with every E-town spot. One of those dealerships lost my business because they only focused on the trade-in of my Mazda, and nothing else, and wouldn't tell me their appraisal numbers until after I told them my remaining balance of the car loan (I never did, and stopped responding to them). SPC didn't even ask about my trade-in until after we agreed on the truck price. This dealership was fantastic in all aspects of this process. From the 3 gentleman who helped find the vehicle for me, to Zach, Rana, and (especially) Gavin in the finance department. Zach, and Rana got the ball rolling, but it was Gavin who got me to the finish line. Thanks to salesman Scott for all the help at the dealership, for the walk-around, and getting set-up with onstar and getting me on the road. It truly was a pleasure dealing with all of them. It was nice to see everyone wearing masks, and taking social distancing serious. I'm not sure when I will be buying again, but I will send anyone I know that is looking, to Sherwood Park Chevrolet. Again, big thanks to everyone there who helped me in this process.

This is my go-to place for Middle eastern in the park, the portion is large, food is delicious, and the owner is so so nice.

Quality is very similar to Al Salam in southside, but it saves me 1 hour of drive both ways. Nothing near by is that close to this place.

I've only been here for breakfast but the food is AMAZING! Literally the best shredded hash browns I've ever had (I have a serious love for shredded hash browns). Omelettes are amazing and their cream cheese french toast is a delicious spin on one of my favourites. The only downside is the service. Most of the time I go our server is a young asian woman that seems she couldn't care less about anything. One time we went and had a young man who did give us great service. The food usually takes quite a while (good server or not), but it's worth the wait. If you go in with the mindset that you'll get a great meal with just diner style service, I guarantee you'll enjoy it. It's my go to spot for breakfast in the park now.

HUGE selection of happy, happy plants! Ranging from outdoor, houseplants, bushes, succulents, you name it. Staff is ultra knowledgeable and helpful. If you don't know what you're looking for or how to care for something, they are a great resource.

One thing that I particularly love is the garden beside the centre. It's absolutely beautiful, well maintained, and filled with plants (all with a label in case you'd like to take your own home). Take a walk through it, or if you have time, sit and relax.

Never really had a problem here. And as I've live here my whole life..I've eaten here since it was built.
Amazing...nope.
Consistant...more or less.
This particular visit I must admit my onion rings werd pretty bad. Just too much salt. Pretty much all I could taste.
I still prefer A&W to McD's.
Our burgers were. True to form as this chain goes.
I come in expecting to be fed quickly...often in my car.
I get what I expect...

Yummy smoked bbq. Tried the pulled pork it was smoked just right with tasty flavour. They have their own home made bbq sauces to top off your sandwich with. You get to choose a delicious side and they give you some pickles and potato chips as a little garnish ! Will be back

This may look like a dirty grungy shop, but its what's inside that counts. A great staff and service that is second to none are just some of the things I noticed here while I waited on my car. No need for an appointment, just drive up and you are likely to get rushed right in. I came in for a muffler bracket and they informed me that I would have to wait a week for a replacement if they could get it. I opted for a new muffler they could make work with one of their own brackets and have me on my way in a half hour! The staff is top notch here but the facility does have that old dreary kind of feel to it...don't let that stop you from coming in...it is a great place to have most vehicle maintenance done.

Awesome local liquor store.
Friendly, knowledgeable staff.
The kind of place you want to shop at. 
Specializes in small, craft brews.
Good selection of these to indulge in.
I look forward to returning and exploring their offerings.

Our contact at Celtic is amazing, after screening one potential renter she reported that they did not meet their very high standards and then continued the search for the perfect renter. The family that she found is wonderful with never an issue. Nancy is a great representative for the company. Should you be a renter I believe that Celtic is there to take care of you just as much as they take care of the owners.

Worse auto service ever!!! Do not get your car fix here there objective is to steal your money!! My engine was overheating and an independent mechanic figure out that it was the head gasket causing the overheating so I went and bought a head gasket from part-source unfortunately he didn't have the necessary tools to fix and replace it, so we brought it on a Saturday to this exact Canadian tire, with my head gasket to get it fixed so they did their own inspection which was 77$ and supposedly through their own inspection it was not the head gasket but the water pump we were confused but expecting them to be experts and me thinking they obviously know more than I do we decided to go and change the water pump instead. Next day I receive a call saying they did another inspections which I had to pay 77$ again twice!!!!  And found that it was the head gasket but I still had to pay for the water pump they replaced at 270$ at this point I was furious because we came there the first time to get my head gasket replaced and they're charging me a ridiculous amount of 3400$ to replace my head gasket including 270$ for the water pump and the 154$ dollars more I had paid for inspections. It furious they do this to people especially when I was laid off from work and currently have no jobs so I'm relying on my car to go from different places looking for jobs. Highly recommend not to get your vehicle fixed here.

Conveniently located.  Ample parking.  They have a new fancy pop can circular sorter. Staff were friendly.  Computer screen shows your tally.  Busy during peak hours so come early!.  They sort fast.  Quick in and out.

Went in for lunch with Wife. Asked staff not to place cooked shrimp next to my wife's food as it was being prepared as she is VERY allergic. The staff member claimed it was always placed on the line, but proceeded to toss the pan onto an adjacent counter. He walked away and assisted another customer and proceeded to state very loudly "I've never heard of that, it's not a thing". I attempted to explain to him how allergic my wife is to shrimp and he brushed me off. My wife's food was prepared by another staff member. When I got to the til to pay, I tried to explain to him again my wife's allergy and he said I lying. I then asked to speak with the manager and he stated he was the manager. He was the most unprofessional person I've ever dealt with. I went to pay and he stated he didn't want my money. I will never return to this establishment. I hope people with allergies take precautions when ordering there.

First time here and it was very good.  Kind of got that Fife and Dekel feel, but all the soups are home made 

Went with egg salad on rye and a salmon and dill soup. The sandwich was good, nice dark rye bread, and good flavour. 

The soup was interesting and hearty.  Had a little kick and was what I was looking for.  Something good and different.  

Will be back if I'm nearby again.
Vadara has a Modern, Energetic Environment! Anytime I am in there, the Staff is Cheerful and Pleasant. This is definitely a hidden Gem in Sherwood Park

As this chain goes...I like this outlet.
Allready better in my mind than the other in Sherwood Park.
Pleasent, friendly staff.
A huge plus...for the first time, I was finallyable to try the prawn salad rolls. Several times at the other location I have tried to order these but they have been out.
They were very fresh and delicious.
I also ordered a Bangkok wrap with prawns. It was darn good.
All in all...I am very please with my experience and will no doubt be back.
Not really worth the price in my opinion. Average food, with higher than average cost.

We went here just a week ago after a long hard day of work...it has been a long while since we visited, but this was exactly what we needed. 
We ordered the typical pizzas, which were very good, not remarkable but very good.
We also ordered a fishbowl or 2. They are literally drinks supersized, in an actual fish bowl! Pretty original, and memorable, we shared images all over SM.
Marketing done right!

Me: "Hi could you fix a leaky tire?" 
Useless Cdn Tire Employee: "Not today." 
Me: click
#useless
Bad selection of plants and accessories (vases, pots, soil, etc.), overpriced, and poor service.

I recently bought a 2 year old truck at Strathmore Ford, that was MISTAKE number 1. They talked me into buying an extended warranty with Millennium Insurance for approximately $5,000.00 ,that was MISTAKE number 2.
   Within the first 8 weeks I had numerous break downs including ball joints, wheel alignment, replacement of front tires and 2 new batteries. All claims were denied because  of Millenniums parameters. I would have thought that if your alignment and ball joints were bad enough to completely chew through a set of tires in one month, they should be fixed. 
   Fast forward to Dec 22 2018 and I was on my way to TORONTO when the rear end blew in Thunder Bay. I had the truck towed to a Dodge dealership. The repair bill was $7,000.00 and they didn't deal with Millennium so I paid out of my own pocket. When I arrived at home, I forwarded the bill and many pictures to Millennium. Imagine my SURPRISE when finding out that they would only pay $2,000.00 out of my bill because they new of someone in Thunder Bay that would do the sam e job for that price. 
   If I could offer anyone some advice if ever you are looking for a vehicle and extended warranty. STAY AWAY FROM STRATHMORE FORD AND MILLENNIUM INSURANCE!!
Gary Geick 
Bearberry Alberta

The pizza toppings are wafer or razor thin now.  This is not acceptable on a $30 pizza.  I will order from Nitza pizza or Caffreys from now on.  I will no longer order a pizza from Boston Pizza.  Other food items seem to be OK.  Happy hour is nice.  Decor is updated.  Staff are friendly.  But seriously $30 for a pile of crust is unacceptable.

I had run over a concrete separator in a parking lot in May 2018. I didn't think too much of it for a couple of weeks, but I was off to Jasper and sometimes my car would rattle, so I thought I should get it checked out. I brought it to Park Muffle for an inspection and tire change. Turns out, I had completely snapped in half my trailing arm and that it was not fit for my upcoming road trip. The Park Muffler technician showed me the part that needed to be fixed and what condition it should've been in. They lent me one of the their courtesy vehicles for the weekend and didn't mind if it went to Jasper (though we didn't end up using it). My car was fixed within a few days and sooner than they originally thought. They were friendly and courteous. Thank you!

The food is really good here.  Almost feels healthy.  Portions are large.  Fresh vegetable plates.  Little to no filler batter on meats.  Wonton soup not very salty.  My favourite place for years.  I like the no batter sweet and sour ribs, the chop suey full of bean sprouts, the beef/veg dishes...it's all good.  We usually get takeout and todays order was perfect.  Interior is somewhat plain.   Have found the food very consistent.  Keep up the good work!  Great value in my book.

We had a warranty issue (Torque Converter Clutch Circuit) come up after a little less than 10000 km over our warranty, The warranty manager said he would look into getting it repaired under warranty, we didn't hear anything for days (meanwhile we were driving this vehicle with our four children in it), after numerous unanswered phone calls (about a week later, despite being told we would receive an answer in a couple days) we finally got a call back and were told they wouldn't cover it under warranty, in the reasons stated to my husband one that stuck out was "loyalty", in other words my family could not afford to buy multiple vehicles from Sherwood Dodge, nor could we afford their overpriced oil changes, apparently buying a vehicle from them and being positive about your experience with the sales staff is not loyal enough. Beware because once you drive off the lot the customer service ends.

Tuesday waited for a table for over an hour only to be told NO Crab cakes left.Could have told us not available while we were waiting. Ordered ice tea was like water. They replaced it but took it to the wrong table . Finally the meAls came not hungry by then. Not recommended. Earls used to be a nice restaurant No More.

This review is for the automotive shop alone.  The rest of the store is your usual hodge podge of useful stuff.  

This Canadian Tire is close to where I am living right now, so I really wanted to like it.  I used to work in a Canadian Tire, in Calgary, so I have a pretty decent understanding of what goes on there, and the expectations the franchise has of its employees.  And yes, I did work in the shop, so I am not just speaking from observation.

I have taken both my vehicles to this shop about four times for oil changes.  There are a few basic things the apprentice is expected to do when an oil change comes in.  Change the oil, obviously.  Lube the ball joints and driveshaft if it is a domestic or an older vehicle still equipped with grease nipples.  Inflate the tires to 32 PSI for cars, 35 PSI for trucks, visually inspect the underside, test the battery, and put in a new "Next Service Due" sticker.  Now, the sticker is important, because it is the only visual tell that the service was done, to the average customer.

The last four times I have taken a car or truck there, I can only assume the oil change was done, because I have never seen a new sticker, and have usually had to go back in and ask for one.  Three of those times, I have had to inflate my own tires at a gas station, as they clearly didn't even check them.  Two of those times, the two where I took my older truck in, they had not greased any of the grease nipples.  They did check the battery every time, as I received a printed proof from the little battery tester machine.  However, the last time I took my truck in was five days after I had installed a new battery myself.  I had driven the truck about, so plenty of time for the alternator to charge it up, if it had a low charge from sitting on a store shelf.  Yeah, that brand new battery?  They recommended replacing it.

Sure, they change the oil... I think.

Take your car somewhere else.  This shop clearly doesn't give a damn.

First impressions when walking into a business count, NOT AT THIS BUSINESS. 
I'm met with "you come for pedicure pick a colour". Staff whisper among themselves pretend they don't speak English. 
And then whats supposed to be a relaxing procedure my pedicure began. Abruptly grabbing my feet by each of my small toes putting my feet where she wanted, no asking. This hurt!
One word requests from her after that or rough handling after that, she even tried to hammer my feet down in order to straighten my toes.
She then expected me to pay for her service, if that's what you call it before my toes went under the dryer.

Being as I already had a swelled ankle I left in worse pain than when I arrived.
Nails weren't dry therefore smudged when I left. I returned for a fix even though the obliged it was done reluctantly.

Nails were scratchy and rough, a bad pedicure all round. 
Impolite rude staff who need training in more ways than none.
I will NOT be returning!

I had an amazing new car buying experience with Sherwood Kia. From sales to finance to reception everyone was very personable and a pleasure. I never felt pressured to commit to buying and they wanted to insure I was completely satisfied before signing anything. They went above and beyond to find me my vehicle. I went into the dealership on Monday evening and drove off the lot Wednesday. While signing my paperwork l noticed one of the salesmen was entertaining another customers two toddlers while mom and dad bought their new ride :) Sorry to the other reviewers who had a bad experience with the used sales. If you want to buy new I would recommend Sherwood Kia any day!

I am staying at the Edmonton Hampton Inn for business and this restaurant is attached.  The servers here are very friendly and attentive.  I had a rare ribeye.  I ordered it rare and it was cooked that way.  It was a little thin where I prefer a thicker cut.  I had the wedge salad, and was a little disappointed that it came with the steak and was on the side instead of on a separate plate.  

The bottom line is that this is a convenient place to eat while staying at the attached hotel.  I probably would not seek this place out, but it is fine to eat here while staying at the attached hotel.

We dropped in to Golden Capital for lunch on a Friday. The waitress was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and prompt. My companions had the all day breakfast special, and they commented that it was delicious and a fantastic value. I had the Chinese buffet, and thoroughly enjoyed a classic Canadian Chinese buffet with all the staples including a wonderful wonton soup. Overall, this quaint little spot was relaxing, friendly, and delicious. I will most certainly be back.

Earls is one of my absolute favourite place to order out or dine in but this location on the last four visits has been nothing but subpar. 

We ate in and the service was so slow then at the end of the meal we had a gift card. The server told us she needed the manager to punch it in but her manager was having her lunch so we would need to wait until she was done eating. The other three times all of our takes out have been wrong. We checked our bag on the last time we ordered and everything was labelled correctly. Open the boxes when we get home and there is pasta inside a box labelled salad. We will phone and let them know it's wrong and they will ask us to come pick up new items which is great but having a newborn makes this not easy to return.
Just had my eyebrows shaped by Claudia.  The whole experience was amazing.  I would highly recommend!  Front desk staff were very helpful!

Absolutely fantastic service, and customer care! Just purchased a 2016 Nissan Maxima, and they let me tell them what I wanted. Never once felt pressured or pushed!  Everybody there was pleasant and friendly, even if they emerge not helping me. The parts guy gave me another source for after market parts that they don't carry!  
My sales guy Nathan was super informative, and helpful. And the sales manager Craig was very helpful, and friendly. Had lots of knowledge of the car add on's and made the whole experience painless. Sherwood Nissan has taken the bad taste out of purchasing a new car, and turned it into a happy, enjoyable experience!  And lastly the finance guy was quick, and knew what he was doing!

Thanks Mario, Nathan and Craig!

So. Good. So. Filling.

I'm a fan of the food at Red Robins, mainly because they have an awesome selection of salads and they know how to handle a gluten-free request. In fact, they have what my husband calls the best gluten-free bun he has ever tasted. That is saying a lot as he has only been gluten free for a year and remembers what bread is supposed to taste like.

My biggest issue with the one in Sherwood Park is how busy it is and how crowded. The tables are set up in such a way that you know when the restaurant is full. You can feel it. I feel the service also suffers quite a bit when they are that busy. Not sure if they don't have enough staff on to deal with it or if they just aren't trained to deal with that many people. All I know is when I go there and it is busy (almost always) I end up almost feeling claustrophobic because it is so squishy and noisy.

It is a shame because, as I said, the food is good
For a fast-food restaurant, Joey's satisfies with top-quality ingredients, an amazing variety of poutine, and prompt service from friendly staff.

I became a fan of Kal Tire when they fixed a punctured tire for me at no cost. I didn't buy the tire from Kal Tire, they just did it.
I loved it. 
I thought if it wasn't fixable they'd try to upsell me for a tire.
They didn't. 
They just fixed it and off I went.

I was going to buy my next set of tires from Costco, but Costco f'd up my order. 
So in I went to Kal Tire. They'll price match!

So if you love Costco prices but want to avoid the brutal Tire Center service (as you might have heard from other people it's brutal) go to Kal Tire.

There are a lot of locations and you they all interconnect for service!

Cheap gas with a great organizational system that has everyone driving the same direction - that basically says it all. If there's something to complain about it would simply be that sometimes it can get crazy busy but honestly that's no different than being inside of Costco so really you should know what you're in for. I almost solely buy my gas here.

Tried to give them another chance but no more. Worst service ever again. Burgers burnt fries not cooked. Paid the extra for garlic Parmesan fries ... what a joke. Nothing was on them. Complained to manager and wow took a whole 9 dollars off bill. Terrible

Just went through the drive thru and my nuggets were RAW! Glad I caught it before I left. Double check your nuggs folks!! The bacon cheeseburger was great though, but with the timers and guidelines in today's fast food... sending raw food out is unacceptable.

Tried this place out several times . Their pizza is incredible . Pad Thai is very flavorful . You get a lot of food for what you pay for . The service was great and staff are all happy and knowledgeable with the menu. There was a wide variety of options to choose from in the menu . Something for everyone . I recommend this place and will be back again .

Fast, no BS!  Tried other places and they were telling me 5 -7 days.

These guys are just getting work done and even brought me out back to talk about a few extras I wanted.

These are Great People!

Parts and service pushers. Beware. If you have deep pockets and don't mind losing use of your vehicle for at least two days these guys are for you. I would not recommend them. Crooks wearing Canadian Tire shirts.

I lived in an apartment complex that switched management shortly after I moved in.  Celtic management was called & asked to do an in-report with me.  I never received a response.  The apartment was quite dirty & the walls should have been painted & rugs replaced before I moved in.  I asked them for paint codes so that I could do touch ups myself.  No response from Celtic.  I remember Mary-Jo Downs telling me that "Rome wasn't built in a day!"  Rome was never even thought of by Celtic Management Services let alone built.  I had agoraphobia & had not gone anywhere for about 2 months.  Even ordered take-out so I could stay home.  One day I found bed-bugs in my closet.  I was mortified!  I had accidentally leaned on a chair that someone had left beside the dumpster while throwing in something heavy.  The two recliners had been there for over two months without being picked up.  When my father & I threw my couch over the balcony to take to the dump, I also decided to take the chairs because I am a kind person.  When we went to pick them up we realized that both chairs had the fabric on the seats cut out.  It was then that I saw lots of bed bug carcasses.  Our property manager actually called me a dumpster diver!  Nothing could be farther from the truth....  So thankful for the experience though, as I now know one property management company to never use myself!  They also charge 3% on credit card payments....

We bought a 2010 Nissan Titan from Sherwood Nissan on Dec 18, 2013.  Paid cash for it.  Within one month the truck failed to start so called them, they said put it on a charger.  We did & it started.  Less than another month passes, again fails to start. So now twice within 2 months of purchase it won't start.  Had a mechanic look at it & he found a loose battery cable with some plastic thing that couldn't be tightened any further.  We bought a new terminal and replaced it, truck still won't start.  Emailed the dealership to complain & received and email back stating "sorry we lost your business, could you fill out this form so it doesn't happen to others?"  WHAT????? Emailed back and said first of all you didn't lose our business and second you can't eveN respond to an email properly. Not impressed.  Immediately started getting calls and emails from manager Rick to see how they could help us.  Rick finally agreed to replace the battery free of charge, just come on down.  Go there and Greg (service manager of some sort) sends my husband away saying sorry, it's been two months.  Not gonna help you out.  again WHAT?  So I call Rick back and he is shocked, cause Greg never said a word to him.  Said come on down and he would take care of it.  After much deliberation, we decided to purchase a battery elsewhere and replace it ourselves.  We did not want to take a chance of them getting their hands on the truck again.  
As well, they installed a car starter in my car, and claimed that my battery was not good so they replaced it with a "new" one.  We are thinking WoW.  Less than a week later, I have to buy a new battery elsewhere, as the new one they put in failed to work.

Would NOT recommend this dealership nor would we go back.  POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE.  STAY AWAY.

I am a big fan of Texas bbq and this is a tasty place to go when I'm missing those southern flavours. If you've never had southern bbq (or even if you have) than Memphis Blues Barbeque is a must try! The meats have that great smoked taste and the baked beans are delish!

Yes way Jose!!

Excellent food and friendly staff. Three of us ate a plate with a beer  each. Cost about $60, but it was worth it! The Carne Asada was delicious and worked very well on the torta with its peppers and onions. I would recommend this place to everyone.

Booster Juice is my go-to breakfast spot. They have a lot of great flavours and varieties but my favourite is the Bananas a whey. Chock a block full of banana flavour and high in protein, it is the ideal way to start the day.

If you aren't interested in a smoothie for breakfast, they have other delicious options such as the scrambled egg wrap. Whichever you decide on, both are satisfying and healthy.

Excited to see a new taco shop in Sherwood Park, took the family to see what it was all about.  Hesitant as location has been through multiple names and staff as burger restaurant prior too.  
Was pleasantly surprised, food was quick, decent portion size, friendly staff and had kids portions and menu.

will visit again.

Not the biggest mall out there but it has it's charm.  This mall has started to become more and more modern in recent years adding stores like West 49, Below the Belt, Le Chateau, etc...I used to attend high school just across the street so I spent a few hours here as a teen to say the least.  I can usually find what I am looking for here and it's not typically crazy busy.  It's central to Sherwood Park as well so it is easy to get to and parking is not usually an issue.  You will find a good number of teens loitering in the food court at times though - as I did back in the day!

This is not a review about the store in general, this is a review about its employees. Earlier this evening a friend and I were attacked outside of the sherwood park mall right by chapters. Was looking for a specific book and found it very difficult to get any help! Maybe they are short staffed at this location, not sure. When I finally did find someone she was less than enthused to help me.

All I can say is awesome. Order the platter so you can try all the meats but be warned it is huge... We are a family of four and could not finish the whole platter. The service is friendly, atmosphere is casual. The home made BBQ sauce is awesome.

I order catering for 60 people, to be delivered to the Valley Zoo.  I had used the website contact email, and was surprised to be contacted by the Sherwood Park location, but the owner James assured me he'd have no problem delivering to the Zoo and keeling it hot.

The food arrived well on time, and hot. Everyone loved it. I ordered the Elvis platters which has an assortment of bbq... Brisket, smoked pork ribs, chicken, ribs and rib ends, pulled pork, corn bread, beans, coleslaw, and potato salad. I ordered according to James recommendations and the food did not disappoint. Honestly, the brisket was the best I've had in Edmonton.

Sherwood Park-ians... You are lucky! Hit this place up and even get takeout when you want to be really lazy :) The Elvis platter can definitely feed a family of 6-8. I know website says less, but it's a lot of food! And definitely use them for catering!!! This could be the best wedding food ever! Unless you want to be all fancy.

As far as Superstores go, this one is as good as it gets! Clean, bright, and a HUGE selection of Joe Fresh clothing and a decent toy section, too. 

Their markdowns on clearance tends to be higher than other locations - that coupled with their large selection equates to one if the best superstore options for savings.

Annoying is the fact you need a loonie for a shopping cart and that their plastic 5 cent bags are crap.

Produce section is pretty big and the deli has a nice olive bar.

I uploaded pics from a few sections.

By far, my favorite part is the self checkout option - huge time saver!

And remember that their PC brand products are all guaranteed!  I recently purchased a set of their sippy cups for my kiddos and they were HORRID and leaked no matter what.  So I took them back with the receipt the very next day and they returned them for me.  Had they been another brand they said they wouldn't have accepted them back used but because they were PC brand they had to take 'em back :-) 

My number one PC brand item is their PC brand of green cat litter made from pine trees!  Lighter and cheaper than traditional cat litter and not full of harmful chemicals!  And it's cheaper than the major competitor we used to purchase at Petsmart!

We are visiting from Toronto and needed a place for dinner on the way to Elk Island. Craving beef (we are in Alberta after all), we found this small diner on yelp and reviewers did not exaggerate! Food was delicious (one beef brisket sandwich and one beef brisket meal), the beef was tender and flavourful. Fries were well seasoned and crispy. Corn bread was the let down, pretty tasteless and dry. Service was fast and friendly, worth the diversion off the highway!

Excellent southern barbecue, great atmosphere. 

Tried the calamari.... superb!

Also had the brisket on a bun.... just as good.

Highly recommend this restaurant. The location in Millwoods is just as good.

Went for lunch here with a couple ladies from work. I was pleasantly surprised. I had the combo meal. Smoked sausage,  brisket, fries, coleslaw, beans. Plus Memphis BBQ sauce. $25.00.  It was a HUGE portion of food. I'm a big eater And I had enough left for lunch the next day.
I loved that the fries were seasoned. The brisket was moist and fall apart. It had the baked on outer layer. I think this is referred to as the bark. I'm not a connoisseur...yet. The sausage was great dipped in the BBQ sauce. Even the beans were yummy, so flavourful. Lil bits of meat in em. Mmmm.  There was Franks, a Carolina? Mustard and a spicy BBQ sauce available on the tables to use as well. I tried the mustard but liked the side BBQ sauce best.  
There is no waiter to take your order (you stand and order at the cashier) but the food is brought to the table. I have no complaints. Keep it up! I'll be back!

We go early Sunday afternoon and they are out of everything and don't restock.  No mini wheats, no PC coffee pods, no hazelnut creamers, no romaine lettuce ...etc etc.  so frustrating that we spend more time at Walmart.  What is the point of guaranteeing open tills if the shelves are bare? Take some of the till staff and use them to restock!  Saturday and Sunday are peak shopping days and as such management should act accordingly.

I was there September 21. 2015 around lunch time. Outer door was broken. Place was empty. Carpet was filthy from winter foot traffic. Table service OK. 

Ordered $ 10.95 red chili dish which was a big glob of white jasmine rice and a small bowl of -- I think -- bamboo shoots and large pieces of red and green peppers in a spicy thai sauce. Sauce was nice. It seemed overpriced to me for the small amount of food. Might go back if they have a buffet instead. 

Everything on the menu was $ 10.95 which I found odd. 

Seemed to me that the owners were new small business owners trying their best but they need to work on some improvements.

Tried out this location of Memphis Blues tonight. The food was good. The portion was more than enough for two meals. I had the brisket which was excellent and the ribs which were mediocre. Salad was mediocre. Beans were excellent. Cornbread was excellent. Fries were mediocre. What stood out tonight was the service. James and Liam took VERY good care of us. We felt very welcome and like we were having dinner with family. The restaurant was clean and busy. The selection of drinks was great.

This mall is starting to die. Target is leaving (for reasons we all know about), but so are many other store because of the extremely high rent. I don't go here often, but there are a few food court restaurants and stores that I do like, and if the mall continues to die, they won't be there much longer. It's very sad

Had the salad with smoked chicken with the tastiest dressing. Ample comfy booths. Great selection of interesting drink choices in the cooler. Baked beans were excellent. Bbq sauce could use some tweaking.  I recommend giving it a at try. They also do smoked turkeys during the holidays which sounds like my next must try.

Ordered the full slab or ribs. After reading the thee reviews looks like I should have went with something else. 

Ribs did not fall off the bone. Not what I was expecting. The guys there were really great and near the end of the meal did offer to get us something else. Should have taken them up on that offer. 

May return to try the brisket as they said it is really tender and fall apart.

We recently visited this restaurant in Sherwood Park. It's cozy and was quite busy for a Saturday at 6pm. But, we were seated promptly. The service was attentive. Even as the restaurant continued to fill with guests. The food is reasonably priced
and very tasty. We really enjoyed the pad Thai fried Rice. Would come here, again.

This Chapters location is the best of all of them! Sadly, I live in Edmonton so it's quite a drive to Sherwood Park, but I do make it to this Chapters 3 or 4 times a year. The customer service is always spectacular, and they all want to see satisfied customers. Just yesterday, I interacted with three different lady employees, and every one of them helped me out, with one of them conversing with me about my philosophy about society for a few minutes. :)
The one cashier, Kendall, was so helpful and friendly, that I went to the Chapters website to complete a survey and mentioned her name.
Excellent food. Lovely service and just a delightful place for Mexican food. I love it.

Great restaurant. I enjoyed the locally grown aspect and the portion sizes were quite good. Restaurant was quite empty as it had just opened but I would definitely go back. Higher end pricing but I felt like it was worth it. Lots of micro brew beers as well. Check it out !

This is a great spot. Decor is nice and relaxed. Environment is cool and down to earth. The owner is pretty cool and loves talking with his customers. 

The food was fantastic. Had the Patty-Melt sandwich with fries. Great spin on a burger. Has a bit of a kick to it with some ethnic flavour. It's a bit messy but worth the constant finger wiping. 

What really impressed me is the menu changes they do every year and the buy local mentality. 

I will be back to try the wings!

I buy almost every gift here! They have a beautiful selection in all ages kids toys and science kits and craft kits! Ive even gotten a beer making kit and wedding gifts galore! Recently was stumped for gift ideas for a baby shower and found some really cut towels with animal themes like a duck towel and an elephant super cute. They staff are always quite friendly and not pushy which i appreciate since i frequent here often on my breaks. Definitely one of my top five fave stores!

We dropped in here for "Opening Night" midway thru January. I like the place, with very few TVs, and a classy 60's-esque atmosphere. The owner or manager (I think) stopped by our table, and when we told him how nice it was to not be in a sports bar, like Cafferys has become, he assured us the four screens clustered about the bar like a chandelier would play old silent movies, and maybe the big hockey games. Sounds good to me!

The kitchen was closed when we visited, so I can only say the hors d'oeuvres coming around were tasty enough. Nothing mind blowing, we sampled the tuna sushi on a cracker, which was nicely done with a late blooming spiciness, but could've done with a hint of soy sauce. We also got a deep fried cheese ball each, in a spicy tomato sauce. Good, but perhaps a bit overcooked. A very small sample to choose from, I know, so I can only say this was a hint of what they might be able to offer.

The only quibble I have is the price. A big (660ml) tasty beer cost 12.50, fair enough. But a shot of tequila mixed in a glass of plain fruit juice cost $13! $8 for the shot, and $5 for the juice. Ouch.

I am not sure we will come here very often, as the price is simply higher than I wish to pay. But perhaps other, wealthier Sherwood-ites will not shrink from the prices. The decor is certainly very nice!

Love the self check out. I've had a couple negative experiences with staff but the vast majority of my interactions have been pleasant. The self check out line moves really quick if everyone using it knows what they're doing. 

I shop here every single week and keep coming back for the low prices. 

I typically shop midweek during the morning but I really appreciate that they have all their tills open on the weekends now, so if I find myself needing a few items on the weekend I don't have to stand in line for ages. In fact, weekends typically have empty tills with cashiers waiting to check out. 

Their clothing section is quite good, the natural foods aisle has a great selection of items, and they usually have a decent book/magazine selection too.

Bonus is their PC plus points rewards program that is tailored to the items you buy and allows you to accumulate points fairly quickly. Even better is that I can just have the app for it on my phone and not worry about a physical card.

Most of the time when I am looking for a new release book I usually find myself at the large Indigo by Northgate mall however I have recently been spending more time in Sherwood Park and have had the pleasure of visiting this Chapters now on several different occasions.

The selection is pretty similar to what you would find at other Chapter's stores as well as Indigo. If your a mystery lover however you may want to visit here as they have a much better variety then I have gotten at WEM Chapters as well as my beloved North side Indigo. Also I noticed they don't offer as much of the home decor gifts like the fancy throw pillows and candle holders which I am quite pleased with as I am not a fan. 
Quite frankly if I wanted that stuff I would go to Homesense but I don't and it takes up valuable room that could be used for books.

It takes a little bit of effort to find staff members and it feels like they just don't have enough people out on the floor here to handle the size of this store. However when you do find someone the customer service is superb. I had a great conversation today with a lady working there who is a mystery lover like myself. She was able to give a very helpful description of a few books I may find interesting because they didn't have what I was looking for today. She was also kind enough to print off the listing from their website for the book I was looking for to make it easier for any staff member I approached the next time I was in store to see if more copies had arrived. I always enjoy my time in this store and whether your a visitor like myself or a Sherwood Park resident I strongly believe you would enjoy this store too.

Had brunch there today. The breakfast looked as if it were just slapped together but was very delicious. Our waitress however was horrible, Its good to know that they hire the homeless. She looked as if she slept in her dress all week and she only appeared at our table to take our order, bring our food(1 plate at a time, it was only myself and my girlfriend) and to give us our bill. Thankfully the bartender was attentive and obviously noticed the lack of enthusiasm and sleep our waitress had last night

The food was spectacular tonight as well as the excellent service we received.  There were 9 of us so we ordered 6 dishes plus jasmine and coconut rice for our group. The pad thai was the tastiest I've ever had.  The green curry chicken was also bursting with flavour although the portion was slightly small for the price. Everyone mentioned that the food was very fresh and delicious; we would definitely recommend this restaurant!

So my wife and I and a couple of friends decided to try this place out. Got to say I truly enjoyed the meal and the service by the owner was top notch and super friendly. The food was very good and the beef brisket was melting your mouth good. I will definitely be going back to this restaurant when in the area again.

Stopped by today to see what the buzz is all about. Got BBQ Chicken with pork n' beans, coleslaw, cornbread and fries. WOW. I do agree with the other positive reviews that were given recently. Chicken is tender, lots of flavour. Pork n' beans and coleslaw are both good. Corn bread and fries are probably THE best I've had in a BBQ joint. If I have to nitpick on something, it would be that the price is a bit higher compared to one of the best ones in the city like Fired Up BBQ or MEAT. But I have to say, I think I just found my new fav BBQ joint!

I have gone to this location twice so far; parking is quite open, the location is brightly lit & appearing very welcoming due to the windows all around.

I find the employees have been consistently  friendly & the wait time for receiving my smoothie has always been timely (less than 5 minutes). 

I'd definitely be back if I'm in the area.

First time I are here. We ordered take out and indulged at home. I was really happy with the flavours and spiciness of the dishes we ordered. Not uncomfortable hot. Just enough to make your nose run and boost the tastiness of the dishes. 

One downfall was the lack of protein in the dishes. There didn't seem to be enough considering the main reason we ordered some of the dishes was for pork, shrimp etc. 

As for pricing. It was a bit on the pricey side. Don't know if I would come back. This place didn't wow me. It's kinda forgettable.

I have stopped in here four or five times when I happen to be in Sherwood Park as they have a much better small animal toy selection then any store in Edmonton and each time they deliver a consistently pleasant shopping experience.

The store is about medium sized in my opinion and laid out really nicely. It always looks super clean as well which is something you definitely want to see in a place that offers grooming. The staff are always really nice,knowledgeable,and take a genuine interest in their customers. I have been asked in the past how my rabbit is doing and if she has enjoyed the purchases I have made for her.

My only gripe here is that they mainly carry the care fresh brand of small pet litter which produces an AWFUL smell and they also price it too high in my opinion for such a poor quality litter. I would love to see them bring in some different brands or at the very least lower the price of the low quality litter. Otherwise though I am happy to give them four stars and can still comfortably reccomend them if your out shopping for your fur babies in Sherwood Park.

The food is good no question, on par with others in the area...brisket was melt in your mouth, ribs fell off the bone...... but I can't go past 3 stars because of the prices.  Prices are high, $50 for dinner for two without alcohol is pretty steep for a food counter/diner style stop.  If the prices were a bit lower this would be a home run.

This rating was originally about the Sherwood Park Mall, but somehow it was moved to Sport Chek. Sport Check has now moved, and although often too pricey for me, I sometimes cannot  avoid shopping here. For the most part, I have had extremely helpful and friendly staff. The one time though, when I truly needed helping, looking for a skating helmet for my daughter, it took me 20 min to find someone willing to help.

Service is fine, they don't hover or ignore. The soup with coconut and shrimp was good, but a very small portion for what you got. The Matsuman is tasty, but I've had it much better at other places.  The beef was very tough and dry, despite being in a tasty sauce. The coconut rice is very good. This place would do in a pinch if your craving Thai food.

Great SUNSETS! They have afternoon and an evening HAPPY Hour now.  They have an interesting indoor outdoor patio!  Big booths with some with panoramic window views!  Cool to see the refineries at dusk.A few tv screens for sports. They have daily drink specials.  It's akin to a modern wood laminated warehouse style lounge.  They say they focus more on the food but have a good beer selection.  Different from Beer Hunter.  They have burgers and steaks.and salads.  It's new so they are still sorting out the food.  Friendly staff.

I've had bbq all over America, and I have to say that this is in my top 2 out of about 20-something restaurants for rib tips ( they're called "rib ends" here). Great, fresh cuts of meat with a delicious rub. The collard greens and baked beans were also  excellent. This is not an "imitation" Memphis bbq spot, it's the real deal. Clean dining room with great customer service too!

Have shopped here since the store opened. Most of the cashiers have been very friendly and the shoe and clothing associates were very helpful too. However, I witnessed one of the managers being very rude to a customer over a simple question. It was not professional. Although prices are very very high (thats capitalism for ya), the products USUALLY have good quality.
Excellent bbq and a really good value. James is a wonderful host! Little hard to find. It is across from Jysk and neighboring Fat Burger.
Awesome place for quick Chinese food! First time to eat here but I'm impressed! The place is clean, the staff's friendly, and the food was great too! Will definitely be coming back soon.
