Stick to your ribs tasty goodness is found here in many dishes, personal favorite is the brisket. Beautiful brisket. Vegetarians are weird, you won't find any of them at this place, meat lovers only.

A short drive, and I wish it was downtown Edmonton - walking distance from home so I could visit more frequently.

We came on a Saturday night just around suppertime. And it filled up before we left. The patio had a few clients for the time of the year - cool fall weather kept us from sitting outside.

Food is entertaining and fantastic! All but 3 menu items can be made Gluten Free, a boon for the community.   The majority of our party are celiac and require safe food. We did bring a couple of spouses who don't require gluten free to provide an opinion.

Chef Caraganis brought us treats from the new menu before it had been released... a bowl of spiced seeds and nuts to share.  Unfortunately, no serving utensil for hygenic sharing. We requested spoons. ;-) They were definitely tasty, and went extremely well with other dishes we elected to taste later on.

We also tasted a delicious bubbling Cheese fondue in a screaming hot stone bowl - a molcajete I believe. Served with corn tortillas and several condiments, a green salsa, a pico de gaillo, and I've forgotten the last one. Sides were a little small, and again, no additional serving utensils for the condiments.  The one challenge was the corn tortillas.  Unfortunately, they were served cold, which with corn tortillas makes them fragile, less able to deliver the delicious cheese and condiments. Tortillas need to be warmed, and kept warm to maintain their flexibility.  Perhaps a tortilla warmer would keep them on the table in a workable style throughout the duration of the cheese... which wasn't too terribly long... ;-) The crispy cheese in the bottom of the bowl was particularly delicious, although scraping it off was a challenge worth undertaking. 

We carried on with the onion rings.  GIANT onion rings... "Tractor Tire Style" said the description. it did not lie, they are gi-normous. The occasional one had too much batter that didn't crisp up in the fryer, but tasty bites.

We also had a bit of the tuna tartare. I was pretty full and didn't have room to devour it all, but someone did.

Hoarse from shouting when we left.  We found the music was a bit loud, which made the conversations around the restaurant louder as well.

Blinds would be helpful during sunset.  As the evening progressed, we found the lights a little too dim to read the menu.

I love this place. Pulled pork is my weakness and this place does it right. Service has always been quick and friendly whenever I have gone and the food has always been top notch. If I was going to point out any cons is this place is tucked away and can be hard to see from the road.

Wandered here by accident while trolling through Alberta. Cute little place with an excellent authentic food. Kind of north east Thai style of cooking but amount of spice can be adjusted by request. Also emphasis on healthy and fresh ingredients. Real treasure in this sleepy town.

We have visited Ruamit several times over the past few years.  It is consistent, delicious, and overall wonderful. 

On this particular visit I had the green curry, which is spicy with a hint of coconut.  It has become my favorite dish over the dozen or so times we have been here. Also at the table was their garlic shrimp, which is a great entry level dish for someone who hasn't had Thai before. 

We opened with the salad rolls, which were fresh and amazing with the peanut sauce.  

Service is always good.  Never had any problems.

I had such a great experience while I was shopping.  The staff was great at helping me find what I needed and when it was something that they did not carry they gave suggestions as to where I could look.

I can't wait to come back. 
The service was friendly and helpful. There is a ton of selection and the finished product exceeded expectations.
We had the nachos, the poutine, and a chicken sandwich.  Now we're back at work planning on what to order next time.
Got take out from here, service was quick and everything was so delicious! Best BBQ place in Sherwood Park and one of the better ones in the city! Everything is well seasoned and tender.

Square One is amazing! The cocktails are unique without being weird and are properly made the old-fashioned way. They don't use bottled mixers, ever and you can taste the difference. The food is unique but approachable and always perfectly executed. I do wish the menu had more to choose from but that's only because I like the food so much I want to be able to try more from this very talented culinary team!

Before the new company bought this mall it was destined for doom. The stores were terrible and the decor brutal. I'm happy that the new owners see potential in this place. It's been renovated and there are new stores coming that are of higher quality. Stuff us younger people like to shop at. 

The layout of the building is good. One lap and you can get to every store. No hidden walkways or weird transitions that make you double back. The fact that the theatre is connected makes it even better because you can kill sometime before your movie starts. Just keep in mind if you come to a movie after store hours the entrance to the mall will be closed. 

I'm sure over the next year or two you will see the old person shops disappear and new trendy stores taking their place. It was only a matter of time. This city needs better shopping and I'm happy that the new owners are making it happen.

I'm grateful for this smoothie chain, I truly am. This location is always on their A-game too. The other day, I had literally just put my wallet away after paying to hear my name called since my smoothie was already ready! The service is extremely efficient and the staff here are kind too. Not to mention they make a great, nutritious product every time you go there. Oh and fun fact: did you know this entire chain started up right here in Sherwood Park? All the more reason to support a terrific franchise that's good for you too!

The food was incredible. We shared the platter and got a little bit of everything. The serving was huge. We also had the peach crumble for dessert. It was warm and delicious, and the ice cream on top was awesome. Best part of all though was the service. Anything we needed/wanted was brought to us before we even asked. My new Fav spot to eat!

The goods


Chain restaurants don't have what this place has. Layers of flavor. Malt, bourbon and smoke. Corn bread a little dry but the ribs were amazing. You will not get dense flavor like this elsewhere. One of the few times in my life where adding BBQ sauce would have been a shame. Had to try the BBQ sauce but moist ribs were the cats pajamas......

My wife and I decided to visit this place since she has never been. We went for a drink and appetizer. The experience was terrible. 

I heard a lot of great things about their cocktails so we ordered a Bellini and their cherry pop. My cherry pop was way too strong for a single shot. I sent it back and got a beer. The Bellini was very dry. 

We ordered their colossus onion rings and they were mediocre. The batter was uneven. The taste was sub par and they looked like they were overcooked. 

Our waiter was great and he explained the bartender didn't know how to mix the drinks. Lol. The price for the drinks was way too steep for what you got. And to boot the place was dead. I'm slightly concerned about this since it was a beautiful day out. 

Maybe the staff today was inept? Or maybe they were working today because Sunday is a slow day? I'm not happy regardless and this experience doesn't make me want to return and waste 9 bucks on a cocktail with one ounce of alcohol. 

I hope they can turn it around otherwise I expect this place to be closed by next year.

The ice cream was good enough for both times we've gone. The service wasn't too great. Both times the employees were rude and depressing. The blonde male was very short with us and clearly wanted us to hurry up. Neither employee hid the fact that they hated their jobs. Not a welcoming place. I overheard the lady in front having a very similar experience. Uncomfortable.

We've been going to this place for a few months now and previously always ate on the patio. The appetizers are good and there's not a lot of gluten free options but for meat dishes normally it's really good. However, the last time we went we didn't sit on the patio and were served inside. The server never checked in about the food, the other servers had to help out and we ordered the special and the food was cold served on a hot plate. Needless to say, we won't be going back. But if you do go I highly recommend sitting on the patio as the service seems to be better out there.

Tried this place after reading a newspaper review stating how much they had improved, and they were worth a second chance.  Wish I hadn't read that article...wish I had gone someplace else on date night.  The service was good, waitress was friendly and attentive.  The food was a huge let down in my opinion (and my wife's).

Was greeted and seated immediately!

The piña colada was amazing, however the Guinness was not poured properly. Ordered items and upon receiving them sent the old, stale and crunchy dynamite rolls back immediately.  Ordered the mushroom burger instead which took 25 minutes to receive . . . which was not worth the wait. 

Food items:

Dynamite Rolls: DO NOT ORDER - they were very stale, crunchy and old. Mushroom Swiss Burger: flavourless and you were able to count the mushrooms (3.5) placed on top of the patty. Fettuccine Alfredo was good along with the Canadian Hunter burger (only thanks to the chipotle sauce). The fries that went with the burgers were OVERLY SALTED and contained a mixture of 3 different types (is this on purpose?) that due to different cooking times left some soggy or tough. Our server Katie was great - we know the food issues are not her fault. Waiting 25 minutes though to get a burger and then receiving it when everyone else is done their meal was disappointing.

TVs are placed awkwardly around the bar which makes for a difficult viewing experience (and the lighting fixtures do not help by adding glare), however the acoustics in the bathroom from the hockey game were excellent.

Looking at the Sherwood Park Mall you wouldn't expect too much out of it. But actually it's full of good shopping! There's clothing stores, shoe stores, card stores, a Chapters... Even a David's Tea, which is super exciting because I'm a tea addict and this location is closest to me. 

You can do groceries here, shop, and even go see a movie! Or I suppose you could work out, since there is a gym here. I'd rather pig out on popcorn though. Speaking of food, the food court is a little small but it's got a good selection - from Thai to tacos, it's got quite the range of food. There's even two Starbucks in the mall for all you coffee addicts.

We have ordered take out from Memphis Blues about 3 times now and have enjoyed their food each time. We had the pulled pork nachos, the Elvis Platter which is a sample of all the meats they cook. We also had their pulled pork poutine which my kids really enjoyed. Their barbecue sauce is really tasty. This a treat we can only afford once in a while if we are feeding all 6 of us. We've tried other barbecue places but their side dishes have been boring and tasteless at best. Memphis Blues fries are seasoned with their own special blend and they are delicious. I would recommend this place to others. It's a quaint place so we prefer to order pick up so we aren't in the way. It's worth checking out.

Yes it is one of the cleanest Superstores.  It is huge with a clothing, seasonal, housewares, eye ware and pharmacy.  What I don't like is that they don't restock sale items and popular regular items... They shouldn't be out of stock at 3 in the afternoon.  Always out of Brown sugar mini wheats and light International hazelnut coffee creamer.  This store competes with the Walmart superstore to the north which has better restocking than Superstore.  I find myself going to Walmart more often. Superstore finally smartened up and has a short line policy with more tills open to compete better with Walmart.   Parking stalls are very tight and turning at the end of rows is very narrow.  They have a frequent user points system so you should get a card.  The problem with the savings card is that you have to load the offers every week or you don't get them when you check out.  Poor system.

Chapters is the Canadian bookstore chain most similar to Barnes and Noble or Borders.  They and Indigo are owned by the same Corporation and have a certain flair that you don't usually see in most US chain bookstores. 

This Chapters is tucked away within Sherwood Park and seems to be popular with locals and those of us here on business looking for a place to hang out during our free time.  The book selection is decent and the magazine section is generous.  There's also a coffee shop attached and a good selection of stationary, journals, and gifts.

Have not gone back in a year due to the food quality. The service was fine, but there is no excuse for the chewy chicken, which appeared to be right out of the microwave. I'm honestly not sure how this place stays in business. I've heard other people say their lunches are great, but I'll never go back based on my horrible experience.

I came in with very long hair, left with the best haircut I've ever received. Mickey was very meticulous, and took his time to make the cut perfect. I will be a repeat customer.

Everyone was very friendly and there was a good vibe in the shop. Great experience.

Thank you!

Ordered the calamari, which where ok, and a feast plate. It was more than enough for 4 people. The beef briskets was the best on the plate, cooked to perfection and very tasty. The sausage was also very good. If it's your first time order a platter so you can taste all of the meats and then decide what you like best for your next visit.
good but not worth the money. You can get just as good at dairy queen for half the price..PLUS... the girl sneezed in her hand and then grabbed my cone with her bare hand...not hygienic!!

$4 tapas on Thursdays is the way to go. (Also bottles of wine are 1/2 price, about $20 that same night).

Appetizers are good quality, sometimes slight on the portions (true tapas style). We like sitting at the bar rather than the seats or patio, most comfortable and the servers chat with you which is a nice change to sanitized service. Many are sommoliers, travelled or just interesting people.

The craft beer is delicious, just wish they would expand their offerings. I would take friends, parents, and colleagues here on a Thursday for sure. It gets filled, a nice comfortable urban social vibe going on.

Went here with my wife last Saturday. Food was passable, service was abysmal!
It didn't start that way. We were greeted at the door and seated at table promptly and with a smile from the waitress, who came back quickly to take drink orders. 
I gather that they usually do ordering at the counter, but on weekends they do table service...
Soft drinks appeared quickly. It was apparent that the server was working hard to keep food flowing to the tables.

There was another waiter, a young fellow with a tight T-shirt, muscles bulging, leaning against the counter, watching the TV up in the corner. When the line cook finished our plates, placed them up on the counter and called for service, the waiter grabbed the two platters and carried them the 6 feet to our table. After he put them down, I held up my empty soft-drink bottle and asked if he could please  bring another when he had time...


He nodded and went back to the counter and served several other tables their food, then came back to the counter and stood there, leaning backwards against the glass, fixated on the hockey game on TV. All this as I said, 6 feet from our table.

I finished my entire meal but no more Coke arrived although I was right in the waiter's gaze. Eventually, the original waitress happened by, saw the empty bottle and inquired. "Yes," I said loudly, "I would like another Coke!"   No reaction from the waiter who was still leaning against the counter.
My wife loved her brisket platter and I liked my sausage platter, which was moist and delicious. Would that the rest of my meal had been as moist!

I thoroughly enjoy coming to this Chapters. It's clean and well organized, albeit a little smaller than some of the other chains of the store. It has the usual wide array of selection packed into its shelves. This location is never really busy- although the Starbucks can get quite packed. There's always a few staff members roaming around the store, who are very attentive and friendly. 

The only reason I took off a star is because there aren't really any chairs around this store. So if you were hoping to sit around and browse before buying, you aren't really in luck. (Unless you don't mind the floor. But the aisles are pretty small and you'd probably end up blocking things off.). Other than that, it's a great location!

Pros:  The BBQ food I s solid....sample platters are a good idea to try everything.....service was fine. Platter included, ribs, bbq chicken, rib tips, smoked sausage....a bit of everything.

Cons:  a little expensive.....sides (beans, coleslaw) that come with the platter were really small compared to the meat.

I love Square One! 

The people who own it are almost always there and are very friendly and engaged, checking regularly to see if you are happy with your meal or your drink.

The food is hard to describe as no one food type is quite right. The restaurant has meals like pot road soup, butter chicken wings and beet salad.

The atmosphere is casual elegance - you will feel comfortable enough in jeans or even dressed up.

Don't forget to check out "MonaVader" - the only picture on their walls!

ps: patio is opening this year!!
Lunch for two, $23.00, and it was quite tasty. Can't go wrong. Pleasantly surprised with the speedy friendly service. Will come again

Can Yelp allow a negative star rating for Telus? Please? After they almost tricked me into signing a contract after I distinctly told them I pay month-to-month, and after waiting hours, literally hours, on hold, I realized that they just can't keep up with the market.

Expensive, small portions and squid was NOT good. We ordered traditional dishes. Green curry, pad Thai , beef and squid. Curry and beef were VG. Squid was very fishy, not good. Rice was also good. 
5 dishes with rice was $100, and barely fed 4. Really No left overs. We had takeout, so no comments on service. Unfortunately our 2 favorite Thai places in the Park are closed Mondays, so gave these guys a try. Love to support local but, Cannot recommend.

Great atmosphere and food. They seem to really care about your experience and the food and drinks don't disappoint. I've been missing the local and unique dining options I once had in Victoria, this is exactly what I'd been waiting for. 
The patio is wonderful as well, the only thing it's missing is a dance floor for late night. ;)

I love the ice cream here it is hands down the best ice cream around. It's pricey but you pay for quality. At least now you don't have to pay per mixin'. It's definitely a special treat though. 

The staff usually seem to hate their life and the quality of staff as declined over the years but the quality of the ice cream has not.

After experiencing a hair disaster recently at a salon that will remain anonymous I decided to give Chatters a try. I was a little leery at first because this salon is a franchise and I've always been hesitant about trying salons like this, but today I was absolutely thrilled. 

I had an appointment scheduled with Kim, whom I might add was amazing. She did a fabulous job fixing my hair disaster and I can honestly say that after 2 years of living in Alberta that this is the first time I've left a salon feeling as great as I did today. 

Kim was very professional and courteous. She made me feel comfortable and did an awesome job with both my cut and color. I would definitely recommend her to anyone who is looking for a competent stylist. 

I drove in from Fort Saskatchewan and I can honestly say that Kim is well worth the drive. I've tried a few different salons in town with no success so I decided to venture out.  This turned out to a wise decision.  If you live in Fort Sask, Sherwood Park or even the city and have experienced one hair tragedy after another like myself I say give Chatters a try.

The price was reasonable and I even left with free product and coupons for my next visit. If you're looking for a new place to get your hair done check this place out. I promise, you will not be disappointed!!!

Spotted the awesome patio from baseline road last week and that's how we knew there was a new establishment in town.   Tried it out for a special occasion last night. Walked through a mostly empty restaurant to the spacious well done patio.  There is one very loud speaker up against the building so we chose a table away from that so we could visit.  The menu was better than the usual "Alberta Menu" (Why we are subjected to virtually the same menu in SP is another topic!). 

Ordered a mix of appetizers and mains to share.  Visually the food was impressive.  Steak bits were fatty and tough.  Wings were average.  Ribs were good.  

The good:  great outdoor space, friendly servers.
The bad:  food quality is lacking. Beer isn't cold enough on a hot day. 

I'd go again just for the patio. Maybe give the food one more chance to impress.
I've been coming here every two weeks for the past 10 years, Mickey always does a fantastic job on my hair, always up to date with the latest hair styles.

I went here on a whim for lunch. Having recently really embraced my love for Mexican food. The food was decent. I didn't like that sour cream wasn't offered on the side. I would definitely come back and eat here again - but it's not my first choice. Nice staff and clean dining room though.

Well, I'll give a one since I can't give a zero.

Telus is the epitome of poor service.  They offer "great deals" on PVR's, and discounted bundles.  This is a total joke since the PVR's don't work well at all (audio / video syncing problems, blacked out shows / no digital sound, it takes about 5 seconds for it to change a channel -- that's not an exaggeration).  And the discounted bundles are only discounted in the ads -- they'll throw all kinds of extra charges in that they promise are included free (like modem rental fees, being an idiot and signing with Telus fees, etc.). Then they say, Oh we'll just adjust your next bill.  And then, guess what?  The bill is wrong again.  Every time. For months. If you add up the $5 here and $10 there on every customer that they're ripping off, they're making a lot of money.  And most people just don't look at their bills anyways.

The thing that really bugged me was missing shows due to network problems or whatever -- nothing but a black screen for 30 minutes or more sometimes.  There were a number of times I pvr'd a football game or a movie, only to watch a black screen when I got home.  And then to charge me extra for so-called included fees was enough to make me cut the contract after less than a year of hoping things would get resolved.

Save yourself the trouble and just go with Shaw or Bell instead.  Telus is only a better deal in their ads.

Went for the first time during the lunch hour.  Buffet was set up and it must have been assumed by the server that would be the only reason we'd be there.  Though there were only two other tables occupied we sat, and sat, and sat and sat and were not acknowledged until I spoke up.  No menu, prices, drinks were offered for over 5 minutes.  

I understand that most folks likely come in for the buffet at lunch but I would have appreciated being greeted and been asked if that's what I wanted.

Food was decent.  I've had some great Thai food and some no-so-great Thai food, this place is in the middle.  Not bad, but the Edmonton area must have better to offer.

Great staff, always great food on hand. Small and cozy! Location is great for moving around town and getting stuff done but wanting to catch a healthier alternative on the way. 

    Zero complaints on staff, always friendly and happy to help!! Worth a stop in when on the go as well!

So I completely agree with all of the grievances towards Telus mentioned below. I am usually severely disappointed with Telus customer service and have had countless service issues throughout our relationship. However, my most recent Telus experience was more than fantastic so I thought I would share. 

I bought a car charger for my blackberry curve in Jan 2011. Last week I noticed the wires were loose and it wouldn't charge unless you pushed the wires into the little USB thingy that goes into your phone. I was ready to try and red-green it back together but I thought I would stop by the place I got it at and see if there was any chance they would do anything for me. Well I walk in with my guard up ready for a war. No sooner did I pull out the cord to show the guy when he simply grabbed another box, took out the charger and handed it to me no questions asked. I wish I knew the guys name so I could give him some credit but I was in and out of there faster than I could read his name badge. I honestly was so taken aback by this gesture (and my unusually pleasant experience at a TELUS store) that I started to wonder if something weird was going on in the world that I was unaware of - it was actually kind of scary for a second. 

Anyway, Telus - this small gesture has temporarily restored my faith in you - for the time being...

We go early Sunday afternoon and they are out of everything and don't restock.  No mini wheats, no PC coffee pods, no hazelnut creamers, no romaine lettuce ...etc etc.  so frustrating that we spend more time at Walmart.  What is the point of guaranteeing open tills if the shelves are bare? Take some of the till staff and use them to restock!  Saturday and Sunday are peak shopping days and as such management should act accordingly.  And there is no internet service, internet is blocked. The store is huge and has clothing and pharmacy as well as seasonal goods.  Never overly busy now that there are 2 Walmarts that compete for groceries.  Prices are cheaper than other stores except Walmart is prices similarly.

Are you kidding?  Who could be impressed with this place?  I can't believe the positive reviews that led me to try this place.  It is a very cheap and weak attempt to be like an Earl's or Joey's.  Looks cheap and barren in the dining room.  Didn't care for the inside ambiance whatsoever.  Bunch of kids working.  Sat outside which was fine/standard.  Shocked at the cost of the items on the menu.  Figured the food better be stellar.  My pot roast soup came with a hair wrapped around the spoon and not nearly a big enough spoon for the soup.  The soup came with a nice film already on the top which indicates the soup had been sitting.  Little yorkshire pudding roll tucked to the side.  Soup simply was not worth anything close to $14 in taste nor presentation nor size.  Really disappointed.  Virtually slopped down by the server.  Just completely and 100% not impressed.  Wouldn't go back if my meal was paid for.  Wouldn't cross the street to go there for free.  Not going back.  Not worth my time at all.  Sorry, but for better everything when I want this type of experience - I'll go to Earl's or Joeys or Ric's.   This was a major bust.  As we walked out - 2 guys who were just seated next to us got up and left before ordering.  Talked to them on the way out.  They found it way too expensive.  We told them it was not worth it.  They were glad they left.

This is the cleanest superstore in the city which is surprising since its one of the oldest. I like doing my big grocery shops here because their pricing is consistently good.
The cashiers are fast and they seem to always have lots of lanes open for checking out as well.
They need to work on their 'deal of the week' though. I don't mind that they offer it, but the cashiers don't seem to really care about it and because of that I get it for free about 60% of the time. It's funny though because the only way to get it for free is to 'catch' the cashier... It's a flawed system.
I will keep shopping here and keep trying for the deal of the week, but I wish their system was a bit more polished.
Very friendly and helpful. Offered to make a special smoothie for my kids (a little more "plain" then what's on their menu).
Went a while back. Impressed with everything but the flavour. What bar-b-que? The sauce was a horrible concoction. Too bad, nice folks, good decor.

We absolutely love this place. My boyfriend and I constantly order the Memphis platter and then enjoy left overs for the next day as well. The staff are friendly and very helpful in explaining everything that comes to the table. Great selection of drinks as well.

They have an interesting indoor outdoor patio!  Big booths with some with panoramic window views!  Cool to see the refineries at dusk. A few tv screens for sports. They have daily drink specials.  It's akin to a modern wood laminated warehouse style lounge.  They say they focus more on the food but have a good beer selection.  Different from Beer Hunter.  They have burgers and steaks.and salads.  It's new so they are still sorting out the food.  Friendly staff.

i have been to this salon twice, both times I have had issues. The first time my ends were uneven and it was an easy fix. The second time I arrived with pictures of what I wanted done. The end result was no where near what I had shown Emma. She had left a puffy area on the side which I pointed out to her and she said it was the way she had dried my hair. That was also her reasoning with my bangs that are way too short and not at all like the pictures I had shown her. Nothing that she did resembled any of the pictures that I had shown her. I also had an allover color for the tune of $100.00 that is quite a bit darker than I wanted. She said she wouldn't charge me for the cut due to my original problems but they give you a free haircut with color so that was no big deal. I  would not recommend Emma and she is the service  mngr..
Excellent food, and great drinks, not your usual fare. Try the party melt or club house sandwich. Highly recommended!

Excellent authentic Thai food. Small restaurant, simple decor, owner is Thai and chef and personally supervises the meals so expect things to take some time to prepare. Worth the wait! Great buffet at lunch as well.

YUM!  So glad a co-worker talked me into going here for lunch!  Definitely a new favourite of mine, and I'll probably drive all the way from Summerside the next time I've got a Chinese food craving.

It's set up similar to a food court Chinese food place, in the sense that the entrees are in dishes under heat lamps so that you can see them and pick what you want.  However, you can clearly see into the kitchen and the large woks that are cooking them before they make it up front.  

The prices are incredibly reasonable for the value that you get.  

And the food.... oh my gosh the food.  SO YUMMY!  No weird textures.  Nothing dried up from sitting under the lamp (they keep refilling them often, so nothing sits under there for too long).  

I had the orange chicken.  The chicken actually tasted fresh and the sauce was a perfect mixture of sweet and tart.

I honestly can't wait to go back.


AND... they have a drive through!

You can't get any better to the real deal! I absolutely love their BBQ sauce & pour it on everything! Their chicken is so tender & the ribs are amazing. I love the flavour of the wings. They also serve this cider in various flavours, which I have tried, along with their beer & juice it makes for a complete dinner package & wonderful dining experience!

Telus in Sherwood Park Mall has the worst service. Some of the staff have absolutely no idea how to answer questions. We were in there 2x to pick up our phone and renew the contract on business accounts. We provided ID but the staffs working evening on May 3rd,2019 had absolutely no idea what they were doing,  very rude and unprofessional. Worst customer service experience ever. We had to go to Telus store in bonnydoon mall where the staff knew exactly what to do, polite, efficient and we had no problem picking up our phone

I called the store the other day to see if they had a doll for my kids Xmas present as I'm 2 hrs away 
The lady that helped me on the phone was great 
I think her name was Katie 
Really great customer service skills 
She went above and beyond looking for this item
They are holding it as a favour 
Kudos

It is a tiny little restaurant that can be hard to find. Worth looking for. Good value for the money. Especially the sandwiches which are only about $12. I had the fries as a side and they were nicely spiced. Food is delivered quickly.

The buns are a little blah and I don't think they have an ice machine. I got room temperature water in my glass with no ice. The bottled drinks are a little expensive and no fountain pop.

I will go back as the meat is cooked very well.

Try the banana bread with some Skor!

Whenever I get a craving for ice-cream, I usually head here. Mainly because of the selection. I can always find something to satisfy whatever craving I happen to be having that day. However, I always pay a bit reluctantly as I find their prices pretty out of line compared to others.

The service is ok, although I certainly wouldn't say it is above average. I get the impression the people who work there are not thrilled to be working a shift and they don't go out of their way to help. If you have never been there before, it can be a bit overwhelming and you may have questions.

So bottom line? does the trick, with no frills.
The storefront is so unassuming, but GATDAYUM the barbeque is good!  Top-notch service as well!
I went in an hour before they were supposed to close and they turned me away and said that they were out of food and not making more. The food is usually good bur don't go too close to closing
I came here once more than 2 years ago I think. What I had was awesome. I will come back. Staff very friendly. I wanna try other menu items and go from there.

If I could give the Telus customer service a rating for all Sherwood Park locations it would be 0/5 stars.

Do Not ever go to these places unless you enjoy waiting in line for hours, dealing with extremely rude customer service techs (who I notice half the time do not even have Telus phones themselves), or being spoken down to by someone younger than you, because these are the people that work in these places.

I don't care that you work at a phone kiosk, so don't talk over me like your better than me. I understand your job can be stressful sometimes but wow...just wow...

I'm sorry that you helping me is taking away time from your busy texting schedule so maybe you should go shave those pre-pubescent mustaches off ( I'm talking men and women here) and get a job you actually enjoy.

Beware of best before dates on frozen dinner items! We bought some last week (Sept 2014) and they weren't on clearance or on sale.  When my daughter ate one, she said it tasted funny.  We checked the box and the date was July 11!!
I shouldnt have to check all dates when I buy them should I? I assume they don't keep them that long????  
We no longer have the receipt so can't return the rest! :(

Best pizza in Sherwood park.
I have been going to Nitzas since high school when they offered all you can eat pizza for like $7. I don't know if they offer that anymore, but either way I get delivery now as that was eat in only.
My favorite 2 pizzas from Nitzas are the donair with just meat and sauce and one with pepperoni mushroom and crumbled bacon.  However I recently went off book and tried the donair but also added hot pepperoni and black olives. It blew my mind! I loved how the salty olives and sweet donair sauce complimented the spicy pepperoni. I can't wait to try it again!
The delivery hits my house in well under an hour every time and the pizza is always hot and fresh.
I am impressed with their selection and price variety. Good staff that know their wines. Friendly inviting store with a great selection wall of 90point wines.

I got my hair cut today, girl did a great job. But rushed cleaned and didn't seems to be interested in her job. Great place though, took me in right at time of appointment. Again love love my hair cut.

Service was fast and friendly, but thats about all i enjoyed.. food was dry and hard. Rice was bland and dry. Cream cheese bites had hardly any cream cheese. I've heard good things about the food here but I was sadly disappointed and will not be revisiting...

called and called, no one answers the phone, 3pm on a Wednesday, after ringing and ringing it ends up saying goodbye and disconnecting the call.  wow, waste of time and I was going to spend a few hundred on a new printer
Awesome burgers! My son and I both had a burger. His girlfriend got the Ginger Beef bowl and said it was amazing. Hubby devoured his Hot-iyaki wings. Great ambiance. Will be back

I took my family here last night because I'd heard really great things about it. All I can say is that it was pretty average Mexican food. My husband and I ordered the tacos while my son ordered the burrito--because they were sold out of the fish tacos. (I was a little surprised at 6 pm) I liked the steak tacos better than the chicken. But both were just ok. The service was good and they were helpful in explaining how to order things. The pico de guillo had too many onions for me. The guacamole was tasty. Just an average Mexican meal but an above average price. Won't likely go back.

I would say their best dish is the pad Thai. It has a really good flavour and they make their own sauce. It's not ketchupy like the other Thai restaurants. You can also ask for additional spice on the side.... the other dishes were average. 

If it weren't for Groupon not sure if we would be coming back. Prices are on the higher side and being a bit tucked away isn't worth the drive.

Seriously I am in the place right now. I bought a ticket to an event three months ago. The service would not talk to us for Half an hour. Now they are telling me that they are over capacity and I have to leave.. They sold 160 tickets and they said that they have 165 people here and they say that they are over capacity???

1 star = 0 star

Love their self-serve dog cleaning station! The staff were welcoming and friendly and told my husband and I if we needed help we can always ask. They have shampoo, towels, a smock/apron, brushes all to groom your dog if you don't have much of the supplies yourself. We weren't rushed, and the staff had a good chuckle at my dog who was talking through most of her grooming lol. Will be returning every time my trio needs a clean :)

We had a family date in Sherwood park and my kiddo wanted Thai food. We decided to try the Ruamit Thai. It actually has been around for years, which is interesting that I have never heard of it. Really cute inside. Nice colors and love all the travel photos of Thailand on the walls. Our server was friendly enough and attentive, filling up our water glasses promptly and checking on how we enjoyed everything. We wanted to try a variety of things...we started with the Ruamit Platter where we could try 3 appetizers. We decided on the spring rolls, the salad rolls, and the Thai fish cakes. It was generally average. Nothing was unpleasant, but nothing was standoutish. Luckily, all the other dishes were better that followed the appetizers. For main dishes we tried the Green Curry Chicken (green curry with chicken, coconut milk, snap peas, mushrooms, bell peppers, broccoli, and basil leaves), The Masamun Nua (beef cubes with coconut milk, peanuts, potatoes and onions), Coconut Rice, and Pad Thai Krung Tep (rice noodles with egg, chicken, green onion, bean sprouts and peanuts) . Everything came out fresh, hot, and fragrent.  I really, really enjoyed the flavours of the green curry chicken...it seemed like the coconut milk really enhanced the other flavours in the dish. My husband was pleased with the amount of beef in the Masamun Nua, although I didn't find the flavours as complex as the curry. The best dish though, was the Pad Thai. Excellent flavour balance...sweet and sour, tangy and savoury, and the noodles were cooked perfectly. I would love to try the other pad Thai offered here. Generally, perhaps a little more in price than other establishments in Edmonton, but not so much more that it too noticeable. I definitely would be back to explore the menu, but perhaps skip the appetizers and try instead another curry.

What a huge liquor store. Big, bright & spacious. I came here quickly on my lunch hour to grab a couple bottles of white wine. Was greeted shortly after entering and asked if there was anything they could help me find. The gentleman walked me to the wine I was looking for. Very nice of him. The checkout process was quick and efficient. All in all a nice location for your vino needs.

Went here yesterday after reading good reviews to have a good 6 inches cut off of my hair and received one of the worst hair cuts i've ever gotten! My hair is now choppy, uneven and worse than before! Even after asking her to fix a section at the salon that was visibly uneven, I STILL had to go home and try and fix it myself. Overall very unsatisfied and will not be going back here again.

Got my hair highlighted and cut a few weeks ago. Just had to go get it cut again to chop of 3 inches because of major over-processing and have had to do a number of treatments to try to restore moisture from the damage caused by this salon. I came to my appointment and the stylist, Ronada, mentioned her last client was an hour late and would I mind if she just did her roots because the client was going on vacation , it would take 10 minutes. Well close to 3 hours later my appt was highjacked and that client had her roots done, cut and styled. Meanwhile my hair was way over processed and will take months to recover even with the 3 additional inches I cut off at another salon today. $200 to get my hair wrecked. I will not be back to this location and don't recommend it.

Great lunch. First time I tried it and was impressed. It was a customer pick and he had ate there a few times. We all had sandwiches but they were excellent with a started of BQ Shrimp. The shrimp were great and come with corn bread . Would highly recommend and I am sure you will not be disappointed.
Always amazing food quick and super friendly service. Plus they have always been fantastic when dealing with a a volunteer group. I would highly recommend

Selection is pretty much like other Chapters, but staff is even better. Went on Christmas Eve for  a few last minute gifts and four different staff asked if I needed help.  One guy spent 10 minutes trying to find a book for me.  Really great customer service.
It's a hit or miss. Sometimes food is good and sometimes everything is empty. If you don't mind waiting, ask them to cook fresh.
I shit my pants before I got out the door, but I enjoyed it so would recommend er Wut

FYI- if your dog got sprayed by a skunk 10 months ago expect to be treated like they have plague.  I tried to explain that and he was washed many many times in that time, but the woman continued to berate me in front of other customers like he was just sprayed yesterday.  I was going to purchase other items and spend over $100 which  but did not after that.  Won't ever be back!
Like I said he was sprayed 10 months ago but the woman who was working did not listen & needs to learn the dignity part ... won't ever spend my money there again and neither will any of my friends!

Feeling like Frank Underwood from House of Cards, eating dem ribs. Such tender juicy southern ribs that I wouldn't mind eating all day all day. I like the option of sauce on the side cause overly sauced meat like some BBQ places really make for a shitty rib that doesn't give you the option to taste it's smoky flavor. All the sides were surprisingly good, but shout out to the potato salad that is made fresh daily. You da real MVP. 

Place got TV's with all the sports on, and this location is probably better than the millwoods location because the service was alot faster. Best BBQ in Sherwood Park for sure and better than Meat because it's less pretentious and has places to park your car. Also you don't have to sit next to strangers....maybe the owner, John, will, like Freddy in HOC.

Sal says: Just eat it

I LOVE this place. I'm a donair pizza fanatic, and they make the best donair pizza in the Edmonton area IMO (the extra onions and mushrooms you can get and oodles of sauce takes it to the next level!). I live in Edmonton and drive out to Sherwood Park just to get their donair pizza on occasion. My husband loves their tropical pig pizza. The service is always quick, the prices reasonable, and did I mention that I love their donair pizza?! We've browsed their menu while waiting, and they definitely have some unique pizza toppings that I'm sure are also great. I'll stick to my donair pizza forever, though.

This is the best pizza in Sherwood park, way better than the new nitzas. The crusts here are fresh and delicious, the sauce is great, and the toppings are all fresh and delicious. As well, the staff is very friendly. On multiple occasions while we were waiting for our pizzas they offered us a can of pop (usually 1$) for our wait. If you are buying, order from the 3 for 1 menu, the pizzas are considerably cheaper (2$ or so more for 3 mediums vs 2 large).  They recently moved from their old location to the old happy mart if you are looking for them. Defiantly recommended!

Service was good, very attentive
Food was delicious, great portions. A bit pricey.
IT WAS DEAD! I was on the patio on a sunny Saturday, and no one was there...made be wonder why.
Tried going to Hunter's for the first time. Really disappointed with the service. Waited 10 mins and no one greeted us. So we left, and probably not coming back again.

Terrible service from the supervisor Sandra Hrytsak, they talked to me like i was annoying and treated me with no respect. the customer service was terrible i would not recommend  this location to anyone. terrible terrible terrible terrible
This is probably going to be my last visit to everything wine and more in Sherwood Park, Rudeness from staff was unnecessary, especially ones uneducated in their product.

The ice cream good, the service was not amazing felt rushed and didn't really care. I mean who's super happy I know I'm not always happy. But it's just ice cream? Ease up and smile. Anyways great ice cream.

About 6 years ago I walked into Vidal Salons on a whim and I've never done that before.  Fortunately, I was able to have Cathy take care of me and she has ever since.  I love coming to the salon, great comradre and Mickey, the owner, is always pleasant and welcoming.  Can't imagine going anywhere else.  In all these years I can say I've only had to wait, at the most ,10 mins for my appointment on only one or two occasions. Vidal Salons has a very welcoming, comfortable, environment with smiles awaiting you when you walk thru the door.  Well worth the prices they charge, remember, you get what you pay for but they deliver!
This is the biggest Indigo/Chapters I have ever been in. It is practically overwhelming. There is a huge kids' section, lots of gift ideas, and plenty of books. I could easily spend hours here.
Great appetizers, burgers, soup. Definitely hit up if youre in the area. Clean atmosphere. Service was inconsistent on a slow night but the food made up for it

We arrived before the noon opening but they let us sit inside in the warmth to wait. I had the pulled pork on greens and my friends had the jambalaya and barbecued chicken sandwich. Everything was good! The greens are arugula and were incredibly fresh and I'm super picky about wilted greens. The jambalaya is just slightly spicy and the fries were excellent. The iced tea was real tea that had been sweetened and the pop came in bottles. Highly recommend this place!
Service was good and the decor is simple. 50s tunes were playing when we were here.

I don't usually do fast food, and I never thought of going to Panda Express, however, there was a free trial this last week (in the middle of the -40C week) if you just registered your email. So we went..and it was okay. What I didn't like is that they have things ready to go (like in a Chinese food court in a mall) and I wanted the kung pao chicken, and she scooped out the last bit and really I think I got stiffed. And the fried rice that came with it was bland. (I should of taken a picture of my food but I was so disgruntled that I didn't). My husband thought his sweet spicy chicken was okay but it lacked spice. My kiddo loved the chow mien side noodles, and honey sesame battered chicken. And it was a decent portion. Tip - look at the hot area and pick the stuff that looks the freshest. I wouldn't run here but in a pinch if you are pressing for time and want to please your family, I think most people would find something here to eat. (Only one veggie dish and no tofu though).

Really stand up BBQ place.  I am not a huge fan of going up to order at places (if I didn't want to be served, then why don't I just cook at home). However, everything else here was great. Really cute décor, although maybe a little too fast food-ish.. I think BBQ places should be give out a relax, roll up your sleeves and dig in ...not get in get out. However, it was clean and I enjoyed the Memphis themed memorabilia.  Our server (if you want to call him that) was friendly. We decided on the Memphis Feast  - Every meat plus the fixing's. Wow! What a platter that was! BBQ Chicken, Ribs, Beef Brisket, Pulled Pork, Rib ends & Double Smoked Farmer Sausage.sides: coleslaw, potato salad, fries, BBQ beans, BBQ sauce & cornbread.  The portion was massive! It says feeds 3-4 people, but there was 3 of us and there was enough for lunch the next day. Everything was tasty, but our favourites were the smoked Farmer's Sausage, The pulled pork, BBQ chicken, potato salad, and corn bread. The only thing that I felt was a little dry was the beef brisket. Fries were also nicely seasoned and the BBQ sauce had a great kick. Food was quick to be served. If you like meat give this one a go!

If I could give this restaurant 0 stars, I would. Food is terrible, no one greets you or even looks your way to talk to you. All of the servers stand in one area and chit chat. Total waste of time. Not to mention they closed their doors one weekend and didn't bother to tell their staff. Poor unprofessionally run. Can't wait to see what happens to their Spruce Grove and West End location the beer hunter !! Brutal guys. Keep it classy.

Very encouraging start for a new restaurant in town. It wasn't very busy on a Saturday night, but it only just opened so I guess that was to be expected. We picked a booth from the ample number of available tables, and a friendly waitress came over right away to explain their menus. They have a good selection of draught beer, including Phillip's Electric Unicorn IPA, although I would love to have seen some Alberta microbrews. They also have a variety of mules, and blended drinks, my daughter enjoyed their bellini. We were there for a quick bite, so focused on the appetizers, and selected some mango chipotle wings, onion ring tower, and poutine. They were all good, plump wings were a nice bonus, but could have used a few more onion rings for $8.50. We wanted a little more, so we tried the pepperoni bacon flatbread, which was fine, could have been crisper, and the soup of the day, a take on jambalaya, which was okay but not stellar.

Overall, great service, reasonable prices, extensive menu, good beer and drinks, decent to above average appetizers, but we'll have to explore their menu more to be sure.

FYI- if your dog got sprayed by a skunk 10 months ago expect to be treated like they have plague.  I tried to explain that and he was washed many many times in that time, but the woman continued to berate me in front of other customers like he was just sprayed yesterday.  I was going to purchase other items and spend over $100, but did not after that.  Won't ever be back!

Wouldn't eat here again, food and drinks were over priced. Food was mediocre, ribs were dry and I wasn't impressed with the rub or the sauce. I don't like how it's set up with ordering, and if I'm spending that much on food someone should come check and see how everything is not just hang out behind the counter and visit with coworkers. The atmosphere isn't anything special either.

Since it's a well known fast food chain in US, I decided to give a try last week. I love Americanized Chinese food as well as Traditional food so this not about authenticity whatever. When i entered the restaurant, buffet was so empty like as if the restaurant was done making food. I went there around 1 and it's kinda sad that i got the last bit of the food. I ordered a small combo with rice, honey pepper chicken and one item which i don't recall. All I can say is it taste good as an airline food or hospital food court food but it wasn't worth going out of your way to try this place. The food was pretty bland and not special.  I had better Chinese combos here in Sherwood Park. I probably wont try again.

I came here recently for a pedicure. I really liked the ease of booking online, the prices are decent for about $65 I got an hour long shellac spa pedicure. 
I was greeted the second I walked in, my technician was great. And I'm really happy with the results. 

Everything was clean and you can see that they have high standards for cleanliness. 

My legs and feet felt great afterwards. I definitely plan on coming back.

Dropped in here for lunch on Friday afternoon with a friend. Hear about this place a few times and we decided to check it out during our lunch break. 
Staff was friendly, restaurant was clean. Place was empty for a Friday. 
Food was good and flavourful even thought the messed up one of the orders, but the food was still excellent quality. 
Would eat here again

My husband and I both had the calamari po" boy sandwich.  He had fries and I had the beans and slaw
We've been to the other BBQ place in Sherwood Park and weren't wowed enough to go back.  What we ordered at Memphis Blues did not disappoint.  I agree with one of the other reviewers. BEST fries I've had.  The Calamari and the beans were also more flavourful than I expected. Although we will most definitely return, it's too bad they don't have a patio.  They are licensed so have a selection of various beverages. We could see ourselves heading there Friday after work for beverages and starters.  We still plan on it but a patio in the summer would be so much more inviting.  I'll be recommding this place to everyone I know!

Ordered the Memphis Feast and it was absolutely incredible! All the meat was tender, juicy and not overly smoked. All the sides were also really good - just the right amount of flavour and not over done or seasoned! Corn bread was perfect. Very happy and will be ordering again

I went into this liquor store for a couple different items, they were doing a wine tasting and asked everyone if they wanted to sample wines, except for me; there was a woman in her 50's literally overdrinking and causing a scene. 
One of the staff was filling her cart with bottles, her boss asked what it was for, she said 'I'm buying this after work' and her boss (I'm assuming her boss) yelled at her in front of all the customers. She shouldn't be doing that but reprimand her in public. 
I walked into the temperature vintage wine room to take a look around and a lady followed me around without speaking, she stood beside me the whole time as I moved around. I'm a grown adult and I don't look like a risk at all, it was so awkward. 
I left empty handed and went to wine and beyond, I love it there so why switch. Just thought why not try this place, it looks nice online, but the people aren't nice. 
I posted a picture for your entertainment. 
Anyone who actually knows anything about wine knows why the picture is funny.

This is one of my favourite places to get pizza, and always will be. 

I used to work here as well a few years ago which some may think causes a bias but I think it makes for an even more honest review because I know how things are prepared from start to finish. 

First things first. The dough is freshly prepared everyday by a wonderful gentleman we all call Sunny, because he has a shinning personality and a smile on his face ready to help all customers that come in the door, but back to the dough. Wow. It smells and tastes phenomenal and like I said it's freshly prepared EVERY DAY! 

There's so many different options for toppings and it's truly wonderful because you can endlessly create pizzas and get a great deal.

I also had the opportunity to experience how Omar the owner treated his customers. He knew peoples names, asked about their kids, how their specific job or business was going because he genuinely cared about how his customers were doing. He also goes above and beyond for everyone who walks in, even if it's something small like offering them some pop or giving them another pizza on the house. The man is a good guy and also was an excellent boss and continues still to be kind to me even thought I haven't worked for him for 4 years. 

If you're looking for a pizza that's delicious and reasonably priced, look no further and visit some of my favourite people at Nitzas!

For the flashy building, and nice dining area and big bar, this place is mediocre at best. The vibe of the place is nice very nostalgic, very country. The food was subpar, to terrible. The overwhelming menu throws many options towards you but even where you end up, it will still be very mediocre. The food is an attempt to be like a top notch restaurant but it fails. Tastes like a high school cafeteria food at best.The prices are high for how bad the food is, and the service seems very hesitant, borderline attitude towards you if you have leftovers. My expectations when seeing the place were sky high, which is fair for the appearance. But I was disappointed. One star.

What a rip-off and the rip-off ruined our night out.
Ordered the Green Curry Chicken $16.95 and the Garlic Pork $17.95.
When the two dishes came to our table we were dumbfounded by how tiny they were. We looked at each other with disbelief.
There wasn't enough there for one person let alone two.
To make make matters worse, the curry was a thin watery soup with a minuscule amount of chicken and the same with the small plate of Garlic Pork. Maybe five small pieces of pork. 
No wonder the waitress asked us if we wanted rice.
I now regret eating it and should have just paid what we owed and walked out.
Should have taken pictures.

My best friend took me here because she was craving a soup from there, well I was craving perogies but she didn't know so I decided to get the combo plate that has a little of everything, is the first time I ate everything that I tried for the first time! Everything is good, but my favorite ones where the perogies and the cabbage rolls!!! I didn't wanna eat all my cabbage roll because it was so good!!!!! They have some deals on Facebook!! If you are close stop by won't regret it!!!

Yes the reviews are correct.  They have good pizza and full of toppings.  Lots of green peppers, lots of mushrooms.  Good amount of cheese.  It was so much better than the Panago we ordered a week earlier.  This will be our new regular goto for pizza. Two thumbs up.  They also have a TV to watch sports while you wait for your order.

I dropped in today after taking my pup to the dog park to get him a fairly overdue bath. The bath set up is amazing and the staff were so helpful considering that neither myself or Roscoe had been before (poor guy got more than he bargained for) the prices were all really competitive and the guy at the till helped me sign up for their reward program (after 7 baths you get one free!) my pup was a little wild post bath. But I plan on coming back here soon either without him or with a little calmer version of him so I can really check the place out.

I really love Panda Express! The fine in experience is just like any regular Chinese buffet, myself personally I like ordering off of skip the dish. This is one of the best Chinese fast food restaurants I have ever tasted. I enjoy ordering the chow menu and the orange chicken but for any seafood lovers the walnut shrimp is a great pick. Although the Chinese food is good my least favourite item is the cream cheese ragoons the outter shell has an awful stale taste and flour residue, I'd prefer the outside be similar to the wrapping of the chicken spring roll.

We went here for ribs. They were  just okay. A bit bland and no options for different sauces other than the strong tasting acidic one they served on the side.  

I was most disturbed by the plastic serving dishes they used for all their side dishes. Seriously, you can't get stainless ramekins and wash them?  And then you use Styrofoam takeout containers?  You know you could buy compostable cardboard ones, right?  Do you have to  destroy my planet while you serve me barely mediocre food?  I will never be back!

Could you find a friendlier bunch of staff?! These people rock at customer service! I love the recently upgraded store. There is so much to choose from. Clean and organized. The staff knows their stuff!

I love Panda Express. It's reasonably priced and reliably good quality. 

The staff here are friendly and helpful. I always have to get the orange chicken! It's a great drive through alternative to the usual burgers.

Poorly stocked shelves and rude, condescending staff; after a few experiences like that, we won't be back to this location.   We asked a staff about having an item in the back (as not on the shelf), got told twice (the second time in a manner used for toddlers), "you go DOWN this AISLE...". We once again made our request clear and finally got the answer that no, they were out of stock. Is it so hard to listen to what your customers are asking instead of assuming they are stupid and hearing impaired? Geez...
Love this place!  I almost never have to wait with or without an appointment.  I'm usually in and out within 30 minutes or so.  My nails are always done well!

Nice and modern, music not too loud . Interesting Menu. A little of everything. The Patti melt was tasty but very greasy with grilled bread. House dressing Meyer Lemon, very oily not much lemon flavour. Staff were friendly and helpful. I will go back and try something else. Expensive $17 for a Burger.

Had a very nice lunch there yesterday. Great burger, just the right amount of condiments  and fries were thick cut and well prepared, not too much salt. Just right. Ribs were good and a generous portion for a half rack. Friendly staff, all in all a great lunch experience.

A year back, I switched to Telus for my home phone, internet and security.  

Since that time, I have regularly contacted Telus about the home phone.  Being unable to access the voice mail feature.  Can't set it up and the phone rings and goes directly to voice mail on the first ring.  And I can't access the voicemail to check messages or to change the number of rings prior to voice mail pickup.

Seems like an easy fix, right?  Not so.  Apparently.

Today, July 03. 2021, I got it fixed, after nearly a year of trying.  More than 14 hours, aggregate,  of being on the phone, constantly transferred and told what number I was in a que, throughout the year.

I have had the virtual assistant transfer me to the technicians, and after 45 minutes with a technician, have that same tech get pissed off at me, because he works with 'copper' and I am 'fiber.'  How do they not know this?

Today, it was finally fixed.  It took 3 different people to do it.

I went with Telus initially to save money.  The TV and Internet are good, the service is incompetent.  The jury is still out on how the home phone functions, as it's just been fixed.

I am not saving money.  When I 'add' the features I previously had, I'm now paying more and am stuck in a contract.

There will be no recommendations for Telus from me.
Love the chow mien always and the orange chicken is so great! Your staff are always so nice and we love that they always offer samples! Really nice to see such great customer service!

I always come here when I am looking for over salted BBQ food, slow service and a dismal atmosphere.

When you have experienced real BBQ food in places like Kansas City and Austin Tx then this is barely recognizable as food.  A step up from Tony Romas though so that must be something......

i have to be  honest here , this is not mexican food at all , i don't understand why they say they have 40 years of experience if the way the prepare the food is not good at all, i was there and tried 3 different kind of tacos, al pastor, carne asada, and barbacoa, carnes asada meat very cold , barbacoa meat cold, tortillas not warm enough !!! more salad than meat , only salsa was good.
i really don't understand why in their web page they say is authentic mexican food, !!! believe me don't waste your time and money..!!!!!

Very large wine selection. 
Place was very clean and fully stocked. 
Staff was very friendly and helpful.

Following all of the COVID rules, everyone was wearing masks, they had stickers at the registers 6 feet apart and a glass shield separating the cashier from the customer.

This is a family owned business that have been running for quite a while now. I've been here before and after their recent renovation and it is beautiful! The staff here are always so kind and welcoming as well so it makes the place that much more vibrant. Their services are very fairly priced for the amount of effort they put into each service. From nails to eyebrows, I highly recommend this salon for your beauty needs!

What can I say, this is a destination for many local shoppers in Sherwood Park. As far as that goes most people don't mind it. For me it doesn't quite cut the mustard, I need something a bit busier and with more shiny things to keep my attention. I think when they did the makeover they never went far enough, they put some great big skylights in and a bit of trendy lights in the roof of the food court, but nothing to make it pop. It looks more like it was designed in the 90's, or by someone in their 90's. 
Overall it does have a good selection of stores and can keep you entertained for a few hours. The selection is limited if you are looking to shop for anything other than phones...they have every phone store on the planet here!
When they do a new Phone release you are better off coming here than waiting in a day long line at another place.
The food court does have a great selection, but I may be biased because I let my belly do most of my thinking. I can always find something to eat!

This place is just amazing! Got a lot of blonde foils done and she gave me amazing results. Plus a quick trim to shape mr hair. 
Would most definitely recommend this place.

I just couldn't put off getting a hair cut any longer! I read the reviews on Yelp for Sherwood Park salons and chose this one based on the reviews. I was so happy that they could fit me in on the same day I called. I met with Brittany who was very sweet and listened carefully to what it was that I wanted. I have long hair and really needed a cut and style. Brittany didn't over cut my hair or do anything that would require high maintenence care as I explained my daily hair routine. I am so happy with the result and will definitely be going back.

Terrible Value!

When I learned that Wally's Plavce was gone. I was disappointed.
Discovering it had been replaced by a Taco place...I had high hopes and promptly stopped in for dinner.
I am surprised by how disenchanted I am after eating here.
The food isn't bad. Not amazing...but decent. But the portions vs. prices just don't add up for me. 
$5 for a soft taco no bigger than one from Taco Bell with a couple of tortilla chips. Just too much...for too little! And to be honest...until I added the Salsa verde..it was pretty bland.
Likewise was my opinion of my $10 Burrito. Flavor was unimpressive until the salsa was added, and the portion was just too small. I put the plastic fork ontop in my pic for scale.
I asked the employee why there is nothing served to dip to accompanying tortilla chip in and was told they are there to clean up the droppings from the burrito/tacos. Alas...my tiny portions did not leave a mess requiring cleaning up. 
Long story short...for this prices...there are simply better options.
The burrito may have been worth $7...and the tiny taco was at best worthy of $3.
For the $15 I spent...it should have either tasted much better and or been much more filling
Long story short...
Will I be back?
...
No Way Jose.

Photo Update...it would appear that the photos that have been posted since my original review are all posted by the establishment. They are a little too perfect and the descriptions a little more involved than a patron would write.

We read some reviews and decided to drive to Sherwood Park and give it a try. We arrived Just after 7:00 pm saw 2 signs on the door stating they were open till 8:00pm but there were no customers inside, lots of staff running around looking at me through the door.

One person came right up to the door looked at me then looked away, and went behind the counter again, not really sure what was going on. 

I would not go back, if they totally ignore a person at the door I can only imagine what the service must be like.

They appeared to have copied Smokey joes I will go and see as for now I'm curious ok get this Thur your tiny brains Smokey joes hickory smokehouse  was first and best for 28 yrs joe passed away 2011 from bone cancer as his son / head chef  y'all have just copied our old menu

Finally got into Memphis Blues today and "boy-howdy" am I glad I did!
So very good! And a decent value for such a good meal!
I settled (as really..I wanted one of everything) on a sausage sandwich.
Delicious! And at ~$12, a solid value. 
The BBQ bean side was also great. The coleslaw...well it was ok. Somewhat bland, but ok.
I think this is going to be one of my favorite new places. At the very least...I still have to give...well...everything a go!

Update- Oct 14/15  - Went again for dinner. Got an order of calimari and a catfish poboy. Woman behind counter recomended I dine in as they don't advise taking the catfish to go. "Ok"...I guess I need a drink.
I'll just grab this small bottle of house branded water...$3.20. "Nope". Pack it up to go please. Not impressed water is so expensive. Sell me no-name for $2.00...
Anyway. Poboy was quite good. Slaw had a little more flavor this time. 
Calamari. Interesting. Spicy. Too salty for my liking...but perhaps that was a one time thing. I may have to give it another go...
I like coming here it's clean and the staff is always friendly.  Dian does a great job on my nails.

I left very hungry!! I ordered the jambalaya that come in a tiny bowl, the smallest jambalaya portion I've ever had for $18. It had a bit too much vinegar for my taste. It was served with salad and corn bread.  The quantity of salad was more than double the main dish.  The corn bread was served dry and cold.  If you like Montanas corn bread, you will dislike this one.  My salad was served on paper!! Really???  Portion size is not representative of the price.
Atmosphere sucks! Not worth it! Never going back!

Iam extremely disgusted with this store. During this outbreak is hard enough for people to take a chance on going out to get basic needs. I stood outside in the line and went when allowed. Had to wait a hour for my prescription. I picked out items that were marked reduced and since I had time to spare I scanned them to find they were not marked down. I then double checked regularly advertised items as well. Not the price advertised. To insure I wasnt wrong I went back to grab other items to find the same results with most. I then went to the till to ask cashier to please price check my seeds she ignored me 3 times. I asked her what the deal was since my order was over 300 she was rude stating we dont know. She said it's not this Turkey,  I said I dont care I wanted the turkey. Till infront of service desk she didnt find out what the free gift was after I was upset and started to ask my self. She then made another rude comment she had no room as I was packing my groceries as quick as I could while trying to get some response. I wanted to watch the prices of my items as they were put through but they have the plexiglass now infront and the screens pointed inwards. How convenient.  Get home to find I was over charged on several items.  I have tried to call for 3 days now to not even getting a ringing. Iam disgusted a company would take advantage 0f people at a time like this! Pay attention to your receipts folks!

I visited on March 19 for dinner with some friends (party of 3), first approach to table was fast. Took 12 min to get our drinks, where we watched our server stir our beers to get the foam down. We order a appetizer, took 30 min from the time we sat down. All the people who came in after us got their food before we did. From the time we sat down to the time our meals came was 1 hour and 15 min. The food was cold, fries weren't cooked through and cold. The sauce that came with out meals was sweet, lime sauce. Incorrect for my meal. Absolutely horrible service. There were 4 tables in the restaurant total including us... to top it off, our menu's remained at your table the whole time. Our server could be heard yelling at the staff about how slow they were. While we were paying our bill after 1 hour and 45 min, one of the kitchen staff walked past us starting at us. Very unprofessional. I do not recommend this restaurant at all, I will not be back! Wish I could give no stars but have to give one!

Terrible customer service!  Came in with the laptop that I purchased here as I have been experiencing problems. Although Monica in tech services greeted me, when I started to explain my problem she interrupted me and asked if she could assist a man who had approached us with a question. She went on to assist him, then took on another customer at the tech desk and left me waiting for a full half hour!  I asked another employee for assistance who said he didn't know enough and I could leave it for the tech who was not in that day. I finally went up to Monica at the service desk who was now dealing with the third customer since she left me hanging.  So without being able to fully explain my problem, she said I'd have to leave my laptop for a diagnostic which could take 3 to 5 days. I left and will go somewhere else where they understand customer service.

Food tasted amazing, I usually don't eat fries, but their seasoning was also great. Overall great meal, at a great price , all whilst listening to the blues . Staff were super kind and nice. I am definitely coming back!

Calamari!!! It's one of my favorites to have. They even have a sandwich for it  the thing I love about there calamari is the spice  not under and it over, a solid in between that even on spice lovers who want to get into it can really enjoy! Serious pack a punch of taste with it as well. Well done  Memphis B!
Wow what a great  find.  I got the combo plate and it was excellent.  So was the beet soup.   I wanted to try more but I was too full from the combo place.  Next time I'm in the area I'm coming back.
Mmm!  Perogies with a variety of sauces, all delicious!  The coleslaw was made fresh and very tasty. Service was friendly. The place is clean. I will be back!

I don't know what you people are complaining about!
This store is fabulous - clean, brightly lit, well organized, ALWAYS stocked (even during the initial COVID shortages!), friendly staff - I could go on and on. I've done both in store shopping and regular PC express pick up and never had an issue. And let me tell you, their produce section? A work of art - fully stocked, lots of variety, always fresh. I purposely drive 15 minutes each way to go to this store when I have a Superstore literally 5 minutes walking distance from me because the quality of service, management, and organization are just that different.
And in regards to the COVID nonsense, they did just fine. Yes, lines were longer but that's not their fault and they were far better than a lot of other places I shopped. 
Ignore the haters - you guys are doing a fantastic job!

I'm very untrusting when it comes to my hair as I have had some really awful hairdressers since moving to Alberta. The crappy ones will keep taking your money and when you finally find a good one - they move away or quit or have babies lol :(
So I decided to give Chatters in Emerald Hills a try...well..needless to say they kept taking my money too....there's a reason they have the 14 day policy in place. If there is a problem with your colour they will fix it for free up to 14 days after you have it coloured. I have been there in the last 2 years probably 6 times for some sort of colour service and EVERY TIME I have had to go back to get something fixed or the colours re-done. I get low lights and highlights typically - not rocket science and not hard - and each time there has been something wrong. I have gone back because the lowlights have bled into the highlights and it looks like leopard spots and blotchy -  it was on the back of my head and strategically hidden when blow dried because I would've noticed it right away had it not been "hidden", I have gone back because I wanted brown put in my hair and she put a red/mahogany colour in and told me it was brown and as soon as I got outside it was glaringly reddish, I have gone back because my blonde is always orange. The salon even sold me purple shampoo the last time to combat the orange - I thought it was kinda odd that 5 minutes after finishing my hair I was asked/instructed to purchase purple shampoo to "tone the blonde" by another employee there. That should've been a HUGE red flag...but it didn't make sense until I got home and the husband says "why is your hair orange again"....I was upset and refuse to go back. Ya its nice you get free product but for the $150+ dollars you're going to pay for a possible crappy colour and the extra trips back to the salon to fix the mistakes...go somewhere else that knows how to work with colours and will get it right the first time - especially if you are entertaining blonde or are already blonde.
Another issue is that you hear the employees complaining about other customers coming back to have colours fixed. They complain to each other and to their current customers about how much of a pain in the a** it is to have to do a "re-do" - because they don't make any $$ off that re-do....that really turned me off of Chatters Emerald Hills. Not good business! Try the Chatters in the mall instead.

Horrible service from the print center. Charged me $5 to scan a legal sized document double sided after making me wait for 15 minutes.
