The supervisor said it was a "service fee" but I have never once paid that. The document was all flipped around and black and white when I got home (not what I asked for). I have never written a bad review before but this ticked me off beyond belief. Will not come here again. Strongly suggest you don't either.

I went into this location twice this week to get supplies for my small dog that was attacked by a Pitbull. Rachel was beyond helpful. She helped me find what I needed and then the second time I went, I had called ahead and she brought me what I needed to my van. When I told her I needed a different food, she went back in and quickly switched it out. She was so helpful and the store had everything I needed. Thank you, Rachel! I appreciate you!

Meat. Meat and more meat! Love this place they are great and the food is very good !

Original BBQ and great beans.

I always like to be greeted when I walk into a place, it's not that it's mandatory but I like to feel welcomed. I was recommended to try going to Beauty Hour for a pedicure, and they offered a package that included a massage, a wax and some sort of treatment. Now, I'm not the world's most versed cosmetic treatment customer by any means, but all I know is I felt like my tired feet went back in time and became baby feet. It felt like I was literally walking on sunshine. Do recommend.

Tried The Purple Perogy for the first time and had the Buffalo Chicken Perogies, $13.99 or $15.49 if you order on SKIP for 9.

The actual perogies were delicious and the flavour of the shredded buffalo chicken was good, but the texture of the shredded chicken was off putting.

Glad I have tried it but unfortunately at that price for 9 I will probably make my own perogies at home and very easily can make the buffalo chicken for on top.

Really impressed!
Decided to try a new franchise tonight...and boy am I pleasantly surprised!
Clean. Modern. Plenty of options. Reasonable prices and friendly, helpfull staff. 
I had to go with a "Big plate" to get the best sampling of their wares. 
I pointed out to my server that it was my first time here and she quickly offered free samples of anything that caught my eye. Such a great policy!
I had noodles as my main, and chose black pepper chicken, spring rolls and honey walnut shrimp (really good!).
Total was ~$13 (they charge an extra $1.5 for the shrimp). Portion was just right to fill me up!
All in all, I am very pleased with my 1st experience here, and I look forward to returning and exploring more of their options!

Food was  good, though I would recommend the drive to Whyte Ave to Meat, before recommending Memphis. Service was not good, waited a long time for drinks, food(over an hour) and bill but they were swamped, so we gave them the benefit of the doubt. Second visit, place was not busy, yet after 5 minutes of sitting in plain view of all staff behind counter and server tending to other tables, we weren't even acknowledged?? We decided to leave, I think they could really have something, but won't last with poor service and apathetic staff. 
Too bad:( We won't go back.

My husband and I got a bunch of food for our anniversary a while back. Let me tell you... I have dreams about their borscht... like I think about it, a lot. Maybe it's because of covid and not having much excitement but it was so wonderful. Even just writing this makes me want to place an order and get my husband to bring some to me! 

The perogies were good. I really liked the dill sauce. My baby also enjoyed them as well. The meat was good, it didn't blow me a way but garlic sausage is always a hit. 

When my husband picked up food, they followed covid protocol and were very friendly and efficient. We will definitely be back to eat again! I wish I had photos of the food (next time) but we just ate it so fast haha. Highly recommend!!

Decent pizza take out place. I've only ordered from here a couple of times but I'm glad I decided to get a delivery from them last week. Easy enough to place an order online. The delivery driver was lovely and rang the bell and stepped back far enough to make sure someone picked up the pizza. Awesome technique and well appreciated. 

With this social distancing, one really craves carbs after all! Decent crust thickness and good amount of toppings. I ordered a caesar salad not knowing it would be so big that it would be three meal potions. Sauce on that side and toast cane with it. Bit disappointed that the bacon on yet salad was the fake bacon bits but it was still good to have some greens! Got my milk intake too. Definitely a nice local pizza place to grab take out or get delivery.

So being the only Sport Chek in town it tends to be the go to. That being said I find the service here is so hit or miss. I've gone and received 5 Star help in the sporting equipment section to absolutely terrible service at the checkout. Which is even more frustrating when the other staff member working the other till seems to be great. They typically have a decent selection and if you can hit a sale it's worth it but when it comes to service it's inconsistent as heck.

Finally got into Memphis Blues today and "boy-howdy" am I glad I did!
So very good! And a decent value for such a good meal!
I settled (as really..I wanted one of everything) on a sausage sandwich.
Delicious! And at ~$12, a dolid value. 
The BBQ bean side was also great. The coleslaw...well it was ok. Somewhat bland, but ok.
I think this is going to be one of my favorite new places. At the very least...I still have to give...well...everything a go!

Brutal. So disappointed.

Arrived around 10:15 on a Sunday to exchange a tog that had come s as apart after oonly 2 days. Not their fault. No big deal.
Take toy to...kids department as well...that's where it came from.
There is only one woman ahead of me at the till.
Behind the counter is the woman working the register. Beside her, is what I assume...is her coworker.
After the employee and customer finish all their chatting and planning of gift wrap (about 5 minutes) if is now my turn to be served.
Or so I thought.
The afor mentioned coworker now pipes up and tells me to go to the main store register.
"Why? I just waited in this line"
"Because this clerk has three other customers to wrap gifts for."
"But they  aren't here...and I  have been waiting?"
"Sorry. She is too busy" he says.
"Hows about you wrap the gifts and the clerk serves me" I suggest.
I guess that bothered him.
"Don't talk to me like that" he says
Lol
Like what.
Like a customer expecting  service?
Two staff infront of me.
One working.
The other telling me to  go wait in another line.
So in the intrrest of not completely coming unglued on this....person...I went to other line.
After waiting in main line, I desxribe the troublesome staffer to this clerk. "That's your manager...isn't it" I assume...
"Yup" she says
‍
Guess I have no one to complain to about my treatment.
So here I am.

Next.

This is one of the best Asian take outs I have tried 

Only feedback is that when you are dishing out the beef and broccoli ensure there is beef on the plate mine had none which was the only disappointing this.   All in all top notch

Yes please!  oh man, I love perogies so much.  And when I am too lazy to make them myself, it's good to have some authentic choices.  It was Ukrainian Christmas, and I needed to pick up something delicious on my way home.  I didn't want to drive to my usual place on the north end and remembered hearing about Purple Perogy!  Actually... I had tried something from their food truck in the summer and was impressed, but hadn't had a full meal from the restaurant yet.

I called in an order because I assumed that they would be crazy busy.  I *LOVE* their combo plate and love that I don't have to make any decisions.  It comes with a little bit of everything... perogies, nalysnyky, pedishke, cabbage roll, garlic sausage, and meatballs.  I would say that the garlic sausage wasn't anything extraordinary but everything else was fantastic.  The meatballs really stood out to me... very tender and flavourful.  Pedishke is always my favourite and I absolutely loved these ones.  

Prices are great and service is fantastic.  If I'm not mistaken, I believe it is run by a single family.

Everything was really good AND it survived the 25 minute drive home without getting terribly soggy.  I'll definitely be back.

Food was poor at best. It was quick but ribs weren't juicy. Wait staff isn't eager to help you. The kicker was the $6.50/glass for the lemonade for the kids aged 2 and 5. Had a full rack meal, $10 side of calamari, $10 side of shrimp and the total was $70!! Will not recommend. Definitely will not eat again. If you want cajun food go to Dadeo's on whyte.

Very disappointed by the manager's service. I came in looking for gifts for my grandchildren, and the girl in the kids' department was very kind and helpful. While I was shopping in other areas of the store I asked for assistance from an associate, who unfortunately was not helpful and I found to be quite rude. I had multiple questions about pricing and stock, and he was very impatient and did not seem interested in assisting me. I later found out this staff member was a manager, which is even more disappointing. While I do enjoy shopping at Sherwood Park Indigo, as the selection is great and the customer service from the girls in the kids' section is amazing, the fact that a manager provided such poor customer service and was rude does not encourage me to return.

Had lunch here for the first time today. Chose the Southwest salad with chicken,  in a wrap. AMAZING flavor. My friends chose Pegasus (Greek) salad which I'll try next time. It won't be long. Fresh ingredients, wonderful flavors, creative presentation, friendly staff and pleasant ambiance.

This was my first experience of purchasing a new vehicle and I really wasn't sure what to expect. I was a little nervous, I've heard so many stories about dishonest and pushy sales people who will tell you anything just to make a sale. But my experience at Sherwood Park Toyota was really great, actually so much better than I could have expected. I initially went with the intention just to look at a particular car, not sure if I would end up purchasing anything that day. The staff were really friendly and welcoming right from the beginning and I felt comfortable the entire time. I never felt like I was being pressured into anything I wasn't sure of. Once I decided to go ahead with the purchase, the entire transaction went really smoothly. There weren't any surprise hidden fees revealed at the end, options were presented but I didn't feel pressured to accept anything I didn't want. I drove the car home that day and really couldn't be happier with the entire experience.
I love being able to run in and pick up really tasty food at the spur of the moment. I've never been unhappy with an experience there.

I wish I could give this store 3.5 stars.  I went to Bridal Debut with high expectations after a rave review from a close friend and also after seeing their dresses in a fashion show at Bridal Fantasy.  The store didn't meet my expectations, and I think I would be inclined to give it a more positive review if I hadn't gone into it with any preconceptions.  

First off, the store is quite large, but I wasn't wowed by their selection of dresses.  I was disappointed when I walked through the store with my mom and bridesmaid and only found two dresses that I was interested in.  Again, this is reflective of my personal tastes, and there were many beautiful dresses available to try on.  

My biggest complaint with the store is the dressing rooms and changing area.  I've been to three other salons as a bride, and all had private change rooms with large mirrors and a platform, as well as a couch for guests to sit on.  The changing room I was assigned to was so small I could barely fit in it with a ballgown, and I was given only one chair for my two guests.  My poor bridesmaid had to stand for the entire appointment.  I also had to share the pedestal and mirrors with another bride, and I could see all the other brides trying on dresses as well in other sections of the store.  It's hard to enjoy the experience when there are people waiting for their turn at your mirror and other people in the store watching you try on dresses.    The decor also felt dated, with older carpet and purple and green flowered chairs.  

I asked to try on a dress that had been on display at Bridal Fantasy and my consultant did not know what I was talking about.  She finally found it and I was able to try it on, but only had one beaded belt for me to try on with the dress.  I enjoyed talking with my consultant, but when my appointment was approaching one hour, she started telling me my time was up, despite being told on the phone that I had booked a 90 minute appointment slot.  I was also not asked what my budget was for a dress, which didn't turn out to be a problem, as the dresses here are very reasonably priced, but I was surprised that this wasn't considered when my consultant was pulling dresses for me.

My experience at Bridal Debut wasn't bad, but it wasn't great either.  I think this store is a good stop in the Edmonton area for brides-to-be, but I the layout of the changing areas didn't feel on-par with spending $1000+ on a wedding dress.

Well overall the facilities are great, I've used the pool, workout area and soccer arenas but customer service is really important to me. The major issue is All the people. I don't know when this place is not packed. I've bought tickets for the pool and after I purchased them I was told there was a 25 min wait? Huh? what? Why didn't you tell me that before I bought the entrance fee? So finally allowed in the pool. As I am swimming my laps, great cardio folks, I am dodging the kids jumping in and out of the pool. Splash...Kablaam... its like a blitzkreg of teens and I am the allie sub meant to be sunk. I look at the lifeguard like call off the troops and well they had nothing to say, so I do. Next thing I know a group of lifeguards are talking to me about harassing the teens...excuse me? what? Well I guess he sided with them because they are all the same age. After my harassment now a buzzer goes off " Everyone out of the pool"...theres a floater, a floater is not a good thing by the way its a human made snickers bar pushed out the back end incase anyone was unsure, and they need to clean the pool. Ughhhhhh Im done with this pool. This how ever is an ideal place to bring your family cause the kids are everywhere. The kids pool is full of interactive activities. Where's the pool for 18 + crowd. I respect the notion of family but what about the rest of us.  Will I be back to swim...NOPE...but when my  2 yr old nephew needs a jungle to be in, Ill make sure we stop at Millennium.
This is an amazing place for a quick lunch with great Indian food. The people are friendly and food is so good!

Absolutely terrible customer service. Individuals in the grooming salon have poor communication skills and people skills in general. The overall environment was unfriendly and it made us feel as if we were an inconvenience at 9am in the morning. Will be returning to the Manning location where the employees seem to enjoy their work with animals.

Get Everything in Writing

While my experience buying a car from Sherwood Park Toyota Scion was great, I thought it would be important to share a not-so-great experience that occurred when the vehicle was brought in for servicing. 

Part of the deal that I negotiated for the vehicle involved three free oil changes being "thrown in". Not a big deal, but big enough to keep me from going to a competitor that had a better price on a similar car. When I was signing the paper work, there was no mention of the oil changes on the forms. When I enquired as to whether I needed a coupon (or other written record) that I was due these oil changes, I was ensured that this was not necessary. I was told that the oil changes had been recorded and that the service department would be aware of this when I brought the car in for its first oil change. 

Fast-forward five months. I brought the car in for new rims and winter tires as well as an oil change. When I went to pick-up the vehicle I found out that I had been charged for the oil change. There was apparently no record that I was to be given three free oil changes.

I followed-up with the product advisor in the sales department that I purchased the vehicle from, but this did not result in me getting the three free oil changes back. No written record of the free oil changes in the deal to purchase the vehicle = no free oil changes.

While I am a bit disappointed with the dealership in not holding up their end of the deal, I am much more disappointed in myself. I should have known better than to walk away without EVERYTHING IN WRITING. If you are shopping for a vehicle, please make sure you do get everything written down. I was lucky in that my error only cost me about $160. It certainly could have been a lot worse.

I dont know the name of the lady I spoke to but I can tell you I would never buy from this place simply because of the way she handled my call!  I called ahead to make sure they had underskirts/hoop skirts in my size (26-28) all she told me was that they have one size and I need to come in and try it on....I said to her that a one size for all doesn't really cut it for plus size girls and that I needed to know your sizing better before I made the trip in as my time right know is extremely tight as I'm 6 weeks before my wedding...she kept getting frustrated(as was i) and telling me that I need to come in! 
Well lady, you got your place of work a bad review! I simply can't just come in..that's why I called ahead in the first place.
I bought 2 dozen large roses and they charged me $50 for a really crappy vase. Pink roses died in 2 days not good value for the $240 I spent.

Bought a new car from this dealership. Had an excellent experience all the way through, including negotiations for my trade in. Dealt with Thomas and Raza. Easily the most pleasant car dealership I've ever dealt with. I traveled to this Toyota because I was dissatisfied with the dealership closer to my home in Edmonton and I didn't regret it!
This place is awesome! Donair pizza is delicious. Super friendly staff. Kids can sometimes go back and make their own pizzas!

4 Thumbs Down! Old. Dirty. Outdated. Small. Since millennium place pool is closed I decided to try aqua size at the kinsmen...big mistake. I tried deep water one day and felt very out of place and unwelcome. None the less, it was something to do. Later in the week I tried shallow water...begrudgingly. They limit how many can go in deep water, told me it was sold out but gave a bracket to the lady behind me. So I had no choice but to do shallow water...after 10 minutes I was bored silly and tired of being yelled at by the instructor...I can't wait for Millennium up reopen

I brought in a old Gift Reward from Airmiles and the cashier told me she'd have to get a manager.  The manager came and had to take the certificate to his manager.  When he came back he told me he couldn't accept it.  I asked to speak to the upper manager as monetary certificates don't expire in Alberta.  The cashier (who had been rude to 2 customers after I had been asked to wait) jumped in and said too bad.  I snapped at her and the floor manager refused to send me to the assistant manager.  He said that's the final word so I couldn't find out how I could resolve the issue.  Turn out (according to Head Office) they have to accept my old gift certificate.  It's just too bad I had to call Head Office to get this resolved for the assistant sales manager.
The line ups are usually long with only 1 cashier and the one I usually see after work (Christine) is very poorly trained.

I called Petsmart on Sunday to ask about getting my cats nails trimmed. I made an appointment for Monday morning. At no time did the girl I spoke to ask me if my cats shots were up to date. When we got there we were asked if the shots were up to date. We weren't sure so they called the vet and told us our cat had to have her rabies shot before they could trim her nails. My husband works crazy hours and made a special trip there with our cat. This could have all been avoided if the girl I talked to Sunday had asked me about the shots or told me what their policies are. The employees should be asking specific questions when people make appointments so we don't waste their time or ours.

I love the free kids tours!!! What a fantastic way to get kids involved and knowing where there food comes from!! The fact that all donations from the kids pizzas go to the Stollery is amazing. 
Little more sauce & onions on the donair and it would've been 5 stars

Had lunch here for the first time today. Chose the Southwest salad with chicken,  in a wrap. AMAZING flavor. My friends chose Pegasus (Greek) salad which I'll try next time. It won't be long. Fresh ingredients, wonderful flavors, creative presentation, friendly staff and pleasant ambiance.

I took a Zumba class here a couple of weeks ago on a Saturday afternoon and loved it! The instructor, Shumi, was energetic, always smiling, and easy to follow. You could tell she really loves teaching Zumba. Great music and atmosphere as well! The gym itself is impressive, from the equipment to the change rooms to the bathrooms. They even have a kids room! As well as a Booster Juice on site, which would be convenient for people needing their energy or protein drink before or after working out.

Seriously guys, this place is good! I have gone so many times that I know the owners on a first serve basis. They are good people, the food is great and they have good staff. Paul and Vijay are a really nice couple too. 

My favourite dish is the Butter Chicken and my wife always has the combo platter. The portions are huge and every second visit, they send me off with a little something extra(Samosa's or a free dish to take home to enjoy)
We love the food here and chopped fruit infused water.   But pricey but I hate fast food and this is a very clean eating, healthy option.  You don't feel like a clogged artery when walking out :)

This little gym is hidden. Although Snap Fitness is a franchise, I personally have not heard of this gym until I saw the deal on kijiji. I was on the hunt for a new gym and wanted to try this out because it is close to my workplace. 

Pros
Nice and clean little gym.
no line up for cardio machine (not even during peak times)
newer equipment
tanning room (extra cost)
staff always friendly
very reasonable membership fee and you don`t have to sign any contracts
there is a juice bar but I don`t care for that 

Cons
hard to get parking at times
some false advertisement - no fitness classes as advertised
not exactly living up to the services offered in the deal such as personal training sessions (lacking a little bit of integrity)

Overall I would recommend this gym to people who, like to get in, get done and get out.

Very disappointed in the service provided. 
On my initial appointment, I had a lovely consultant and found THE dress, I went in a second time and also had a lovely consultant..
She measured me and told me I was in-between 2 sizes and I could choose which size to order, of course I said the smaller one.... Maybe it's my fault, I didn't ask which sizes I was between. Though talking to other brides, the consultants at their stores discussed the size chart, showed the brides where their measurements fell... Seeing as I've never ordered a wedding dress before I didn't question her. 
When my dress came in, it was much too big, needing to be taken in 5+ inches in bust, 2-4 inches in the waist and 1-2 inches in the hips. I was quoted 1235 for alterations. Which seemed outrageous! So I took my dress home after paying for it (not without getting sass from the consultant-"I'll have to re-bag it, then you'll have to bring it back for alterations")
I saw 3 seamstresses for a quote and got the same comment... Why did you buy a dress so big? 
I contacted the manager (can't remember her name) and brought my dress in.
She remeasured and yes I lost inches (1.5" to be exact 1" in bust, .5" in waist) manager confirmed that I was in between sizes... 2 for bust, 4for waist and 6for hips, she showed me the chart as requested... Seeing this I would definitely have ordered a 4. She brought in the seamstress and have me a new quote for $735. Though all the while maintaining that she would have recommended the 6, but also confirming I'd need 2" taken in off the hips. She also stated alterations 1"+ would be a size. This tells me I should order a 4 to have a better fitting dress with out needing so many alterations. They estimate 4-600 fit alterations, but perhaps they recommend a dress size to ensure you'd have to pay at least that much for alterations!! Shop around ladies... I was quoted 300, 455, 375 from independent seamstresses.

So so pleased with the service we had here this weekend for my friends wedding when we tried on dresses. The store was packed but they were so organized that everyone had there own consultant. We were in and out from choosing our dresses within 45 minutes measurements and all!
Nicole has very high standards for cleanliness and immediately put me at ease. She takes pride in her service and continues to put customer service and health/safety first.

I'm struggling to find what all the hype is about for Chopped Leaf.

While it's an awesome, healthy alternative to fast food - it really wasn't all that fast for take out.  My whole experience from standing in line ordering, and grabbing my food over lunch was approx. 20 minutes.

The prices are relatively high if you'd like to add any protein or add ons, which kind sucks.  My salad was alright - I found that they were pretty skimpy with everything except lettuce.
I ordered a side butternut squash soup and it tasted like a thin, tomato soup - not all that appealing.

I'm not sure I'd give this place another go.

I normally order from Nitza's when it's pizza night. We enjoy the freshness and the taste of pretty much all of their pizzas. Yes we have tried most of them. Our favorite is the 6 cheese. We don't care for the tomatoes so we order without (normally the tomatoes get soggy by the time they are delivered). The donair pizza is awesome too. 
Tried the lasagna based on suggestions from friends-not for us. But hey it's okay.

Went and was disappointed,  the girl at the desk knew it was my first visit to that location and didn't even help me find the change rooms. I had asked her & she just pointed hardly looking up. Had to ask where the cardiovascular machines were (upstairs I know this aging because  she just pointed) but I found them so all was well.  The actual  machines there are good, but the place is dark and warehouse -y feeling, uninspiring  and I skipped the showers as they seemed cramped. Will not go back. Sad because  I was excited to go initially.

A friend of mine asked me to try this place if I wanted to start eating healthy. Boy was I not disappointed, although it did take me awhile to understand their sizes or portions. Everything seems to be made fresh and the taste is great. The only thing that kinda twisted me off was the Thai soup, wasn't as spicy or tasty enough to remember my previous encounters of that good soup. Salad dishes are phenomenal as in they have a very diverse good taste, unforgettable for sure. Lots of greens to select from with made combos or you can substitute if you don't like some combos. I found it awesome to switch around some stuff but it may cost extra. Their iced water fruit drinks are fresh but bland probably because there is no sugar. Again eating healthy is probably the reason it tasted bland for me. Staff is friendly and parking is cramped in front due to other stores nearby, make sure to park behind the area much more space and you can enter through the back as well.
Recommended for anyone looking to make better or healthier decisions for a quick fix.

My husband, myself and my son were all in your restaurant a little over two hours ago (probably around 4pm) it was our first time eating in and I just wanted to say how nice it was to first enter and see a group of young adults (I won't say teenagers due to the awesome behavior) behind the counter who were all attentive and did not have cell phones in their hands and truly provided great ..... awesome customer service.  There was this one young lady who was working (longer dark hair and dark framed glasses) and my goodness she went above and beyond her job.  Our son who is almost 3 --- she offered him a slushy as soon as he entered and then he began to have a melt down due to just waking up from a nap.  She tried to joke with him and got the table all set up for us while we waited for our food.  The meltdown was continuing as my husband tried to carry him around to calm him down as we waited for our food.  Once our pizza arrived and it was too warm for my son she just walked over to our table and took his pizza and said that she would place it in the freezer so it could cool down enough for him to eat.  The amount of common sense in this young lady's head is amazing.  I thanked her as at this point the meltdown was going on for about 20 minutes and I just wanted to pull my own hair out and crawl into a hole.  Then once my son continued to have his meltdown I decided that we would leave.  I went to the counter and asked for boxes to put our pizza in and this young girl ran over and helped me pack up all of our food then ran to answer the phone.  I told her on my way out that she is an amazing young person and really amazing at her job.  Had my son not been flipping out we were going to wait and ask to speak to the manager to tell him about the amazing customer service this young lady provided us with!  She truly is a great young lady and an asset  to your business.

I went in to Bridal Debut last week and found my veil! Although I did not purchase my dress from Bridal Debut so cannot comment on that aspect, Pam was very helpful and knowledgeable and helped me find a gorgeous white fingertip length veil. Luckily for me they were having a sale on their accessories and she also patiently helped me pick out some ear rings for my big day.

This is the only drive through Timmy's on Wye road (Why...?!)!  Thus, during the busy times the drive-through line is insanely long and often far too intimidating to even attempt.  Other than that, the service is usually quick and friendly.  Good for the late night cravings (...when too lazy to change out of my Tweety pyjamas, but too ashamed to be seen in public!).

Great looking and spacious building. The consultant, Dori was great. She gave us a tour and helped point us in the right direction. She paired my favourite dress with the perfect bridal belt. She was helpful in showing possible alterations and even cracked a few jokes during the appointment. 

The manager gave us a better deal than what was on the tag. I went back the same day after attending another dress appointment elsewhere (which had horrific service) and i purchased the dress. 

The store the dress until alterations 8-10 weeks before the wedding date. 

Great overall impression!

Customer service is terrible. I have been to this Tim Horton's several times- only because it is convenient and close to home. Every single time I go to this location they either mess up my order, or are out of something.  Seriously, they even got the order of " a large black coffee" wrong.  Today they messed up the order and asked if it was ok the way they made it( after telling me they didn't get it right). When I said " No, I would like it re-made." I received attitude from the girls at the window.  Then I was told they were out of the product. When I asked for a refund, I was given even more attitude.  
Completely done with this place- definitely not going back.

I have to say the staff when I went in to get my pizzas were great and friendly. I guess that was to help cover up for the bad pizzas. We had 6 people sitting home waiting to enjoy this so called great pizza and everyone was extremely disappointed. We paid just short of $40 for two large pizzas that were about the size of a couple of 12" and figured that this was not going to be enough to feed us all. To our surprise we pretty much had one whole pizza left because no one liked either one. Our Donair pizza tasted like it had mayonnaise on it instead of donair sauce and who puts red sauce on the Donair pizza. The other meat pizza was just plain bad tasting as well. Pretty bad when our pizza eating dog would not eat either one as well. Needless to say I will not be throwing another $40 dollars to the composte bin again from this place.
My favorite lunch spot. Wait can be heavy somtimes, but we're not dealing McDonald's here. I'm happy to have healthier options around!

I'm disappointed to see all the bad reviews! Out of the three bridal shops I went to in Edmonton, this one was my favourite. The staff was so lovely and helpful,  they greeted us with smiles and helped us right away! I walked in without an appointment, it was the very first time trying on wedding dresses ever and it was a wonderful experience. The selection was pretty good and the place was clean. They were having a 10% discount on all dresses as well. Thanks for a great experience !
Great staff,  food, service,  but can be very busy.  Offers wide selection of food and coffees.  I recommend the iced cappuccino made w/white milk

My favorite spot for a quick, nutritious meal! I'm not usually in Sherwood Park but I was driving through and stopped in for a Whole Bowl. I always get #2 with grilled chicken.

I liked the layout in their location- there was lots of seating and it looked very crisp, clean, and new. The service was quick and it was fairly quiet- only one other group was in there and it was a weekend lunch time.

My whole bowl was, of course, super tasty. I am obsessed with that goddess dressing. My only complaint is that I've consistently been unhappy with the grilled chicken- it has been really dry and I honestly usually save it for my puppy. I keep trying though because I want the protein. Step up your chicken game, Chopped Leaf!

This location is WAY better than Gateway. 

My salad was HUGE it was worth $13 this time!  3/4 of the way through I was getting full. 

The only downside is that they don't offer warming your protein in a separate pan on the grill to avoid cross contamination with Gluten. You are offered it cold or microwaved. I decided cold was a better choice. I pefer eating any meat cold than microwaving it even at home.
Pharmacy team always goes above and beyond and the ladies at checkout are always pleasant. They can also have great sales on grocery items.

Good services, good price and happy customer! 
We went there on Saturday Just to take a look and left With a brand new truck at 7h pm.

I wasn't expecting such a facility when I moved to Sherwood Park.  I am not sure what I was expecting, but Millennium Place was not it!

This facility has quite a lot of stuff!  For about $8, you have the run of the gym, the wave pool, the saunas, the hot tub, the ice rink, and some sort of kids play place.  Best of all to me, are the drop in classes happening every day.  There are several geared toward those who are older and active, and several geared for those wanting to prime their bodies.  I take the adult swim in the lane pool which happens three mornings out of five, and the bootcamp which happens two mornings out of five, with another two or so in the evenings.  I can't say much about the weekends, as it is usually swamped with kids, and I don't go.

The Millennium Pass is handy.  For $40 a month, you get unlimited access not only to Millennium with its long hours, but also two other pools and fitness centers in the area.  So you can work out or swim pretty much all the time.

There is no contract nor start up fee.  Just a void cheque and a picture taken.  Then you can go and scan your handy card as many times as you like.  And best of all, there is no cancellation fee.  So when I am in town for a few months, I can swim, and when I leave, it is simple!

I got noticed after waiting an hour and a half for a prescription. Yup - they completely forgot about me. There goes my night. Warning: AVOID this place for prescriptions. 

On the other hand, the employees in the beauty & fragrance section are fantastic and very helpful.

I dislike making phone calls to secure meals. I find more mistakes are made this way then through web-based order systems. Unfortunately, Nitza's on Wye doesn't offer online ordering. Fortunately, they've never mistaken our order. The (usually) women who answer the phone do so promptly and repeat my order back to me along with the delivery info. They could stand to speak a little clearer and slower, but I understand they are pretty busy handling both phone and counter orders. 

Delivery estimates can seem a little long, between 30 and 45 minutes, but the pizzas arrive within that time frame and they are always hot. 

I've had several of their veggie selections including the "Veghead" (with and without cheese) and the "Greek Popeye". On the latter, I've swapped out the fresh tomatoes (I find them abhorrent on pizza) for banana peppers and sundried tomatoes with no issues, though there seems to be some confusion about whether substitutions are allowed. So far, no one has vetoed my choices. If they ever do, I'll stop ordering here. As a vegetarian, I'm usually have so few options for recipe pizzas (mushrooms on every &@$/ one), I feel I'm being taxed when I create my own variations. 

Their sauce is excellent, not too sweet, not too stingy. The ingredients are generous and fresh (a little too generous when it comes to the artichokes; I like the 'chokes strained a bit more thoroughly or they make my pizza soggy). I can't speak to the meat recipes, but my partner loves the chicken ranch. He ordered the vegetarian nightmare once and said it was kinda boring.

Today, our pizzas arrived in 35 minutes.

My favorite place to go for food!!!  Whenever my mum and I go there we reminisce about how they use such simple fresh, healthy ingredients to make such delicious combinations!  I highly recommend the Whole Bowl!

I recently in the last few weeks got out of my membership at millenium. The building is really nice but unfortunetly if you do not want to have 200 people around you working out you would have to go at 6 am.... I just do not want to do that. They have overloaded there gym and I really noticed that in the last few months. I work a day job and can not get to to the gym until evening. The price is right and the classes are great. It may be a gym I wouild try again If I could go anytime besides evenings.

I'm a fan of this place, but I really struggle to give a rating. I'd rather give a 3.5 - with 4 stars for the food, 2.5-3 stars for speed and service. 

Downside -really slow service and sometimes the amount of dressing seems inconsistent. Every time I'm forced to wonder why it's taking so long to order and receive a salad? It is a bit pricey and loud inside so when I place my order the server often has trouble hearing me and doesn't always get my order right which I find out when I get back to the office (I've taken to checking before I leave). I've given up going to The Chopped Leaf during the lunch hour since I just don't have the time to wait 25-35 mins in line for a salad.

For a healthy "fast food" place they do well with a great menu and good quality ingredients and it's great that their salads so colourful and not skimpy on the toppings. It's just too bad that it's not faster and there aren't more quick options near by for fresh and healthy lunches.

This place always delivers on taste !! 
They also have good portions and a good variety. The butter chicken and samosas are phenomenal!
Definitely the best in Sherwood!
LOVE! This place. Costumer service at its finest plus they cater to kids! On top of all that the food is Awesome!

Use to love there food. Most resent couple of times, the donair meat was not cocked right. My family and I got sick. Onion rings came soggy as soup. Not to mention. When ordering for delivery, just hope you don't have to repeat what you want 5 times or more. Highly, not impressed

Ive been going to Wye rd Timmy's for awhile now , always great service  by all employees , but one stands out KAT ! She rocks ! I work @ 4am she always has my order ready & rems  my name always . She's always friendly  and cheerful; even at 4o'clock in the morning !
Why do people go to these places when they know there getting ripped off? Business like this should be shut down immediately!!!!!!

Honestly when this pizza joint first opened about 4 years ago, I hated it. But then I ordered from there yesterday and OMG! I don't know what they have done but it was fabulous! Everything was so fresh...hot...mouth watering! They must have tweaked the recipe because the pizza was so flavorful! The donair sauce was on point too. Hands down the best pizza in Sherwood Park. A bit pricey but you get what you pay for...quality! I am definitely now a returning customer :)

I went here to get a bridesmaids dress for a friends wedding recently; absolutely will not be purchasing my dress from here. Firstly 95% of the sample sizes were under a size 12 (which is like a 10 in actual sizes); so they only actually had one bridesmaid dress in my size. On top of that the sales women literally went out of her way to make the shopping experience bad for me; she kept going on and on about how this dress wouldn't work for me or this one would because it hides a "tummy"..excuse me who are you to tell me what part of my body I should be hiding? She was down right rude and insulting; particularly because she kept making these comments throughout the whole appointment. On top of all that the dresses were very, very over priced.

I have the details of the bridesmaid dress and I will be taking that info to another store.

The best!!!! Thanks for feeding my friends family and coworkers for the past year and now at my new location NWR. I know it's a distance but we loved our Christmas pizza lunch at work. Not a slice left!!
Thanks again Peter Rene and the rest of your staff. Until the new year!!! I can't wait!!

This massive top notch Toyota store is also a Scion Dealership! This is where I bought my Scion tC! The level of knowledge that my sales associate had was impeccable. This was my first POSITIVE Car buying experience that I have ever had. I have never felt so comfortable and confident buying a vehicle before! Everyone, including the owner Art (who by the way has the best radio commercials ever), went out of their way to make sure my new car was the best fit for me! They even let my puppy Misiu run around the dealership because they felt bad she was in the car! I now have been driving my tC for 6 months. It is such a unique and good looking car. I get stopped all the time and am asked about it. I can't tell you how many times I had employees from 7-11, Starbucks and gas stations come outside asking me to show them my tC (I think I should ask Art for a sales job). I highly recommend this dealership. Everyone is truly amazing there! Plus it is huge, I have never seen such a nice Toyota and Scion dealership!! These guys rock!
First time there, Great meal! Service was incredible! Hope people get out, would really like to see this place succeed.

I had a unique situation as I can't walk all the time. I called about 5 minutes to close and asked if they were able to bring me out an icy/hot apply on patch at first the supervisor seemed thrown off (do you blame him) then I told him I struggle to walk and had cash, he was 100% fine with that and brought it out for me. Receipt and cash. How many places are this amazing these days?! Little did he know I just got done chemo tharpy and being 22 over work my poor body! He truly made my night I don't think I can praise this place and or that human being enough!! Went here before but I will never go anywhere else again for anything other than grocery!!!!!

We enjoy this pool over Millennium, as it is usually less crowded (except during swim lessons). But they are a few things needed. They added more handicap spots and now have way to many, these spots are almost never used and many are forced to park way down on the other end of the lot due to this and splash park users. The front half of the parking lot should be reserved for facility users. There is a parking lot behind the building for splash park users, but many choose to use the front lot, Pushing patrons who are there to use the building to the back of the lot (it's a rather large lot and quite far to walk with small children). The "family" chnagerooms are ridiculous (only 2 change rooms and only one with a toilet), the space if way too small and has a glass door that looks straight into the lobby. The staff is mostly friendly, but they do have a few bad apples. There is one very grouchy lifeguard, but if you stay away from her, you're safe. The lazy lifeguard doesn't usually bother you, but if you need help, don't ask him. The worst is one receptionist. She is miserable and mean and glares at everyone that walks through the door. And you get it even worse if you choose to look for a lost item in the lost and found or if you choose to use the family change room. I don't think she even knows how to smile. She does not belong in the position, working with the public.

The upstairs has a great playground and party room which we used for my daughter's birthday. We were largely undisturbed by staff and had a blast. They earned an extra star for this area.

Stopped here one day after grabbing a booster juice from next door and wow I'm glad I did!

As we walked in the man behind the counter turned up the Indian music playing on the tv (to get the party started I guess) and the smells coming from the walk up counter that greeted us were fresh and aromatic and not at all greasy or stale like food court smell.

The first time I just ordered 3 samosas as I was not feeling quiet brave and my bf ordered a butter chicken wrap. Right before our eyes fresh naan was made and slapped up side the inside of the handy dandy naan baking oven thingy.  My samosas were dropped in to the deep fryer as the butter chicken wrap was being assembles.  The man kept up some chatter with us as he worked and the smells from the other dishes were quickly making me regret I had not ordered more. 

Long story short. Butter chicken naan wrap was apparently good and my samosa was nice and crisp not soggy.  I found the bits of potato in my snack was a bit on the large side but the flavour was good and not too over powering with one spice or another. 

All in all it was yummy and not expensive at all :)

I've been back 3 times and am heading over again right now and I have yet to be disappointed in any of their dishes.  

Cheers
 

Ps
Okay so some ppl don't like their food swimming in sauce but when the sauce is that yummy how can you mind?

Well, if i could rate this Snap Fitness with a ZERO rating I would, sadly I can't.  I was a member here for about two weeks before it was seized and closed overnight.  Imagine my joy and happiness (ultimate sarcasm) when I arrived at the gym with seizure notifications pasted against the locked doors.  Seems the owner is such a good business person he forgot to pay rent for a while.....to the tune of 156,000 and some change.  Nice hub?  It seems he also owns the DOWNTOWN EDMONTON location, wonder how long before that one suddenly closes??  Shady business practices means a lot of unhappy gym members.  Pathetic, this location was awesome.  The gym sits silent, full of equipment still and frozen in time.  SOMEONE rescue it please.

Excellent pizza; exceptional service. Cannot say enough good things about Nitza's - they do truly understand customer service and excellent food. Service is above and beyond and the food is all quality delicious and prepared with care.
great pizza...amazing taste....great choices on menu...both vege and non vege items...had their pizza at a party....will definately try the resturant....recommended....

I have been a downtown, central Edmonton girl for almost 10 years now.  I was pretty hesitant to move away from all my convenient places, let alone to Sherwood Park.  One of the things that was giving me the most anxiety was having to find another gym as good as the one I was leaving.  I didn't know where to start looking when I moved, until my personal trainer fiance told me to go to Millennium Place.  I was still skeptical of a public gym being the place to send my muscles, but I was convinced as soon as I walked in.

This facility is awesome!  The gym is large, even larger now that they just expanded.  It is often very busy but I have rarely had a problem getting a machine or weights.  There is a track connected to the gym that overlooks soccer fields.  The track has a small "hill" which I really appreciate for those days that I am doing sprints.  It really beats being on a treadmill.  There is a large pool here as well with hot tub/sauna/steam room.  There are also a couple places in a food court, one of which serves pretty good sushi.  I am always a bit sad though to smell french fries at a place that is focusing on personal fitness.  There is also a Running Room attached that carries a full line of work out clothes and shoes.  

Like I said, this place is often busy.  That business extends well beyond the gym as there is hockey here as well.  Parking can be a bit of a pain, but if you are willing to walk from the very very back then you should have no problems at peak times of day (extra cardio??).  I really enjoy working out here by myself and with my personal fiance trainer as well!

Terrific menu! Perfectly seasoned for North American taste buds. Chicken Korma and Butter Chicken are incredible.  What far surpasses anything is their  naan bread! Fresh, hot and oh so scrumptious! Try some samosa's while you're there. Vegetarian choices too! Try it, you'll love it!

Excellent food and service. We were at this location on February 24 with a group. They were excellent to deal with. We let them know what time we would be arriving and everything was ready to go when we got there. We were served a good variety of pizza, salad, fries, wings and fountain soft drinks. They set the food up buffet style for us. We were really impressed with the quality, quantity and variety of food. The service was exceptional as well. This will be our new go to, individually or as a group. It was one of the best food and service experiences we have ever had. Great value as well. Thank you Nitza's!

First time I have eaten at any of the OPA franchises and it won't be my last. I'm really fussy when it comes to food served on a bread product. I was waiting to have my gyro served on a dry pita but I was in for a surprise. The pita was moist and soft. The food itself was great. I got their Hero Meal and it was delicious. The meat to veggie ratio was spot on and the serving of fries was also the right amount. 

This location is fairly new in the area, so as expected their dining room is well laid out, clean and has ample room for groups.
Pizza not the same anymore, ordered pepperoni but meat seems not want we want... Not so great Valentines meal... On the other hand, fast service and clean eating area.
I love their food here. Especially their butter chicken and saffron rice. We usually get it to go. And eat it at home. It's very delicious.
Healthy fast and sooooo good. I always feel full and fresh when I leave. Try bowl #3 with chicken...

Just bought a 2018 4Runner and couldn't be more thrilled! I originally went in a month ago and looked at one, however I really didn't like the salesman we were dealing with. We all know what sales people can be like but when I went back I ended up with a different man named Les. He was very level headed to talk to and was happy to put in the extra work to make me happy!

They were more than willing to make me comfortable in my purchase. Especially being a young woman it can be intimidating but I never once felt pressured with my purchase. They took their time to crunch the numbers and gave me what I wanted, never trying to sell me more than I needed. Les made sure I was in that new SUV with all the upgrades I wanted the very next morning, I was very impressed!!!

Would I recommend Sherwood Toyota again? Definitely. When you get the right salesman it makes all the difference and I'm so happy I made that change and went back. 
Thank you Sherwood Toyota and thank you Les!! It was a great experience and I'm so happy with the 4Runner!

I went here for the first time with my sister for lunch on a Monday afternoon. She is a regular to Chopped Leaf and insisted that I tried it!

We both ordered the Sunshine wrap with chicken and their fruit infused water. Considering how busy it was and the amount of time that is probably required to make the monstrous wraps, we had them delivered to our table in a timely fashion.

I was so pleased with how it tasted and the portion size. I was absolutely stuffed, but didn't feel gross afterwards like I would have from a large fast food meal. I thought the wrap's ingredients worked well together and loved that they weren't skimpy on the avocado or chicken. 

Awesome! I will return. I recommend this place for anyone that is wanting a large portion of food that is both quick and healthy.
Worst place ever! Completely messed up my car and long story short had to get my newer 2012 car towed after they carelessly messed it up.

This is one of my favorite Indian places in Edmonton, let alone in Sherwood Park! Perfect place to grab lunch or take-out to go home with. The food is consistently good, great value and the service is quick and friendly. Some of my favorites are the Shahi Paneer and the Saag Paneer. The samosas are fresh, hot and homemade. And the naan bread is hands-down, the best in the city. Always fresh, hot and crispy, yet chewy.

You can dine-in if you would like - all though the environment isn't super attractive, it's comfortable and easy if you and a co-worker want to sit down and enjoy. There isn't a LOT of seating so you might be hard pressed to find seating at lunch time if you're with a larger group. You are paying for great food and great service, and it's still set at an affordable price (some lunch options are under $10). Taste of India Express is a great dining option in Sherwood Park run by very nice people.

I had a really amazing experience here, and while I haven't bought my dress here yet, I am expecting to go back to do it. 

My consultant wasn't quite finished when we arrived but that was okay, because they set us loose in the store to look at dresses. They gave us little hooks to mark dresses we liked, which was great. At first we thought that's all we got, but once the dresses were pulled they gave the hooks right back so we got to keep picking. Between my mom, my future MIL and I, we got to pick a decent selection (though honestly it was all what I wanted, but hey- I'm the bride). 

My consultant Sabrine was really really great. She was funny and friendly and genuinely seemed to care about all 3 of us. She took cues from me really well and had my back when the moms wanted me to try a dress that I was NOT interested in at all.  

In the end, I didn't find a dress I loved completely, but I found 2 dresses I loved parts of. After my appointment was over she made some calls and found out about making my dress customized with the details I wanted (and it's possible!). Overall the effort she put in to try and get me what I wanted made me feel really great. The sales people here aren't on commission so I didn't feel over-pressured to buy a dress that day. They were happy to book me another appointment and I am really excited to go back!
The owner was very Helpful & Kind. Fixed my dress for free considering it was too small.
So delicious, every time. We usually get the donair pizza, you can't go wrong

I was looking to get a Brazilian wax and didn't want to pay an arm and a leg but still wanted somewhere that was clean and professional. In my search, I came across Bare Affair. The prices were reasonable, which caught my attention, and once I saw Nicole's bio and where she had previously worked, I was sold. I used to go to the high end spa where she had worked previously so I know the quality of staff they hired. Even though I had never been to Nicole before I felt fairly comfortable booking with her and I was not disappointed. Her place is small and only has a common waiting area, but it was still nicely decorated, comfortable and most of all, clean. No Brazilian wax is a fun experience, you're exposed to a stranger who is inflicting torturous pain on your most personal bits, but Nicole was very easy to talk to and made me feel at ease. I will be going back, she did a great job, and would recommend Bare Affair to anyone.

Not impressed with there service department. I've been twice and ripped off both times. Most recently quoted 65$ for an insulation of a part I already purchased and brought with me (a friend was going to install it for me). As soon as my vehicle is in the shop they called requoting me 150$ saying they thought I wanted a cord installed not the whole part. I ended up leaving paying 200$... Yes I agreed to the cost on the phone and I should have refused if I would be upset by it. When you've organized dropping it off having an alternative mends of transportation and have personally purchased the part to be installed already, you just want it done at that point. The ladies at the desk were kind to me and had no issues with the customer service side of the interaction. I am just disappointed with the huge difference in cost. I confirmed twice over the phone when originally booking that $65 would be the cost to install my part. They need to address the issues with the people booking and quoting services.

We currently hold a Millennium Pass and it comes out of our bank by automatic withdrawal each month. You can also pay for a year at a time if you choose. One of the bonuses of this pass is you can put it on hold (for example over the summer months when you'll be spending way more time outdoors) without penalty. 

The pool is great but could definitely use a larger slide to appeal to an older crowd. The play structure and attached slides in the pool are geared towards the younger kids. You can play in the waves, on the structure, or in the lazy river. There is a hot tub, sauna, and steam room, as well as another pool for lane swimming. If you show up here to swim on a weekday at 9 am, you will find you almost have the pool to yourself (provided there are no field trips scheduled for the day). 

The skating "pond" is quaint and when it gets busy enough the open up the adjoining rink. You can also rent skates here if you don't have any or have forgotten yours. 

The indoor playground is great for those around 8 and under and I like that they have a smaller baby/toddler area that is slightly separate from the rest of the area.

The teen lounge has a selection of video games, a fooseball table, and air hockey. It is located right next to the gym where you can play basketball, badminton, and floor hockey, among other things, or climb on the jungle gym structure.

Hubby and teen daughter have enjoyed yoga class here (included in the Millennium pass) and there are often decent outside events hosted here (ie. model train show, outdoorsmen show).
Fixing problem

I was visited  couple of time perfect place  to  eat Indian food. some of my favorite food are the  butter chicken,chicken korma, lamb vindlo,shahi paneer,saag paneer,mutter paneer,veg.korma and home made samosas also fresh and hot naan bread. Affordable price if you  are in sherwood park don't miss to test  food in Test of India  restaurant.
Place is closed for good, complete garbage! Don't waste your time or energy trying to get in because this place is a ghost town.

Great Experience!

My wife and I needed to replace her vehicle after it was "totalled" in a car accident. As we were down to one car for family use, it was difficult for us to travel to the different Toyota dealerships in Edmonton and surrounding area to find the right vehicle for the right price.  Sherwood Park Toyota was one of the few dealerships that we contacted that was more than willing to communicate via e-mail, including initial negotiations on the price. This made things much easier for us and was greatly appreciated. Nick Bhalla was terrific: greeting us when we initially arrived and helping us compare the new vehicles that we were interested in. He also showed us a few used ones that may have been of interest. This was not something that we had come to the dealership for, but we were grateful that Nick had done this. My wife and I did not feel pressured at all with Nick's sales approach and he was great at getting back to us via e-mail with any questions we had. 

After agreeing to purchase the vehicle, I dealt with Juliana Parkin in the finance department. Juliana was fabulous and went above and beyond her duties by faxing additional paperwork to help us register our newly purchased vehicle. It was a smooth process all-around.

The day we picked-up the new vehicle Nick was, once again, great. Making sure that the vehicle was spotless and "ready-to-roll". Nick also spent time with me, showing me how to use various features of the car, including the navigation system. Nick's patience and professionalism were greatly appreciated. 

Thanks Nick! Thanks Juliana! Thanks Sherwood Park Toyota!

Paul and Vijay have some of the best Indian around. I have been loyal to them since they had the full size restaurant on the other side of town. The shahi paneer is my favorite and the daal there is amazing.

This is my favourite lunch option during the work week.  Fast, healthy and convenient - what more could I ask for?  I especially love grabbing a bowl of soup on a cold day.  I'm not the biggest fan of the seating layout, but at least there is always some form of available seating even during rush hour.  Staff are friendly and service is fast.  They are always at the top of their game every time I've come in for lunch.
Best naan bread you can find. Samosas are amazing especially for price. Food is always good and very moderately priced for how much you get
This place is great! Good service and the food was amazing. Huge portions for a small price plus a little desert! Will definitely be coming back.

My two friends and I went along with a bride-to-be and had a fabulous experience!! The bride was very anxious walking in as she had some previous negative experiences at other shops due to dresses not fitting and pushy sale ladies. This was NOT the case here!! We had a fabulous sales associate by the name of Kristin (I think) and she was great! So welcoming, patient, and really listened to the wants, concerns, and needs of the bride! Our friend was thrilled! She finally came out of her shell and started loosening up and having fun :) Kristen allowed us to pull up chairs around the fitting room so we could watch in comfort, offered us water, and allowed us to take photos (which a lot of businesses do not).  In the end she found her dream dress, and we all walked out so impressed!! Go here and skip the prissy little shops! Oh ya and go in the morning during a weekday....usually pretty empty place and no need for waiting etc. :D

I absolutely love everything about this Gym. They have great hours, the change rooms are super clean and always maintained, and the group classes they offer are fun and the instructors are excellent. I recommend this gym to everyone I know.
Fab place! very modern, excellent facilities. The only thing this place this is missing is a squash court. Otherwise the best gym ever!

I did go back to buy my dress and though I dealt with a different person the experience was just as great. We had a really fun experience, and even though we knew we were going to purchase, they were happy to let us try more dresses for fun, just to be sure. They were professional but good humoured, and I got a cute little cup declaring me a "bridal debut" bride! I am excited to see how their standards hold up through the alterations and the rest of the process!

Awesome dealer to work with. Purchased a roof rack for my 80series through Travis and he was in contact the whole process, making sure the pricing was right and keeping in touch with the delivery status. Will be using them again!

I have been to many gyms and this gym has been the best-hands down. Why? you ask? They have great equipment, great hours, great staff, sauna for detox, steam room, tanning and when you are all finished your work out.....massage chairs! I work out in the area just for girls and it's never too busy- unless you go later in the evening.(also hard to find parking in the evening-) The classes are excellent with very qualified instructors-they love us and want us to feel good and look good. My husband and I have a pass and we also bought our oldest daughter a pass as well. My only negative wb is they are very slow with gym maintenance...if a piece of equipment is down the broken sign is usually on it way too long. If a massage chair is down it should be priority to fix asap. Last time I tried to get into the sauna- that was down:(
Try the hot yoga- really helps if you are feeling you need a warm get away.

1st time at Chopped Leaf in the Park pleased with food.Concept well explained by staff. Could have given 5* if wider choice for sandwiches and a few more Olives in my salad. I had the Pegasus (could be called Greek) but no mater as it was delic.  Would I go back....you betcha. It is a new business and should advertise more as the strip mall location is not that visible. Staff very friendly, lots of seating this was Saturday night and I had none of the dreaded Satnite waiting.

Just Ok. I made an order on their e commerce site. Went pretty smoothly. A few days went by and I didn't receive confirmation. So the night before delivery I called in to confirm. One shop can't really help the other so I was directed to call the other location. No answer. Going back to the first point of contact they took my info and we're going to get someone to contact me. Great!  I tell them to email or text as I was dining with the recipient. They called.  I excused myself and it was apparent they were unaware of the order!  Gah.  I had another order in Camrose, also placed on a website,  I got a confirmation. Then a notice that the order had been completed. And then a delivery notice.   And then a thank you.   Room to "grow" FP. I want to be a customer again but with a more successful experience.

Staff work very hard here to keep up with orders. Generally the restaurant is usually clean but tables and side counters can get dirty with pile ups during peak hours. 

Healthy food choices are very limited. 

The wifi does not work very well. I have had to call their Tech Support twice. On both occasions, Tech Support claims that "too many people are on the wifi." 

The last time it happened, I told the tech support guy over the phone that there were only six people in the restaurant besides me, and five of them were not on their phones or lap tops. Then Tech Support says "oh, someone must be watching a movie.."

If I go to McDonalds, I can click on "settings" on my phone and select "McDonald's wifi," then the sign in, and -- boom -- I am connected within 15 seconds. 

But at Tim's I have waited up to 5 to 10 minutes to get connected. Very annoying... otherwise a friendly place to have a coffee.

Amazing place. Always nice and clean. My favourite is coconut chicken and of course naan bread. I think I've tried everything over the years and it never disappoints. The men that work there are very nice as well. Highly recommended. I love how the naan bread is made right in front of you. I prefer this place over other East Indian Places in the Park.

Always a very pleasant experience getting take out here. Staff is very friendly and helpful, willing to explain anything you may want to explore.  Fresh, tasty food lives here. Don't forget the pakoras, they're an every time thing.

Our family loves going to Milennium place! It's an inexpensive venue with a slew of activities for the whole family. Kids under 12 are $3 (I think) and adults are about $8: that's for the whole day! You can choose from the following activities: swimming, ice skating, indoor play space and an indoor gym. i have a 5 yr old and 12 yr old and they both love it. The play space is great for my 5 yr old, while my 12 yr old really likes the pool and skating, so we can do it all.
The place is always clean and they have a good selection of healthy food in their "food court" area. A short trip from east Edmonton for a fun day of activity!
Cannot say enough about Spinunity; such a welcoming, caring group of people. Beyond friendly. Super helpful. & most importantly, non-judgmental for those of us who are not athletic at all.

The gym at Millenium Place is amazing, clean and gigantic.  You never have to wait for a machine while working out in the morning.  your millennium pass also gets you access to all of the other facilities there including soccer fields, gymnasiums and ice rinks, not to mention a huge water park for kids and lap pool for adults with hot tub and sauna/steam room.  What more could you ask for out of a gym membership!
unfortunately getting an actual millennium pass is like pulling teeth and the customer service people at the front don't seem to know anything about customer service.  When you go to get a millennium pass make sure you have a letter from your bank saying it is ok to sign up as well as a piece of photo ID.  The only way to actually pay them to sign up is to pay a year up front, if you want to go month to month they need direct withdrawals... so while It may be worth the hoops you have to jump through in order to get a millennium pass, it's typical government bureaucracy in order to get it done.

This is really as good as it gets when it comes to working out. Millennium Place has everything you could ask for. They have an indoor skating rink & indoor soccer fields, a gymnasium, a large workout area with tons of fitness equipment, an indoor swimming pool, a track, food court, and outdoor soccer fields. 

The wellness center and track are open from 5:30am - 11pm and swimming and skating are open 9am-9pm, which allows for any busy person to get a workout. I honestly cannot think of anything to complain about and at about $30 for monthly membership or approximately $7 for any given day it is much cheaper than most other fitness centers that offer a fraction of the facilities. 

I usually go with a couple of my friends and we do everything from playing basket ball to soccer to lifting weights and we never have to wait for machines or benches to open up. I have never found myself waiting around for something to free up.  We occasionally go for a swim and they have lanes set up as well as a general pool. 

If you need motivation to start working out I suggest you take a tour of this place and you will be convinced.

It's weird to me how different franchises of the same chain can be so different.  

The southside and downtown locations both seem to work like a well-oiled machine.  Even during a lunch rush.

This location however... nobody seems to have any drive.  The staff are all nice enough, they just don't appear to care about hurrying up at all.  If that meant the quality was higher, I might be more forgiving.  But it's not.  I don't typically order any protein with my salads here, because I find it almost rubber-y.  I've started to enjoy their sandwiches more than salads, but they fall apart quite often and are difficult to eat.

With Freshii finally opened up nearby, my visits have definitely become less frequent.  There's just nothing to pull me in.

Nichole is very professional and really good at her job! My eyebrows have never looked better. When you first walk in the bare affair there is a little waiting area. Her studio is decorated tastefully and very comfortable. Great place!
Our consultant was not interested in helping us at all, her sole job was to lace me into dresses, thats all. Was super dissappointed.

Great facility and great staff! Locker room is always clean and they offer toiletries with your membership. Towel service is 10$ a month. If you need a little kick in the butt every once in a while get the personal training. If you get personal training when you sign up the basically put it in your monthly payment which is pretty cool so you don't have to dish out a big amount right away.

It's Timmies folks, what can I say? Great Canadian "to go" place. 

This location has been recently renovated and even has cool awnings! The donuts, coffee and tea are still the good old reliable fare. 

This location has a drive thru but is in an awful spot and gets mightily congested. Better and faster to get out of your car and order inside. It is the last Timmies on the way to Hwy21 and Whytemud/Henday (14) out of the Southeast part of Sherwood Park.

The staff is super friendly and ALWAYS smiling! Lots of tables available. All in all a nice Timmies.

One of a few healthy options to eat out. If you go at lunch though expect to wait a little as at times, the line up is to the door. I have come once for dinner and service was super fast. I enjoy the menu as its not peppered with everything, the options are a few but delicious. Like Ramsay always says keep it simple and short. The prices are what you expect for healthy food a lil more pricey. I wish there were more locations of this place because going to the Park or downtown is a little out of the way. Ive tried everything and have nothing but good things to say.

Love love LOVE this place!  

Greek salad - the BEST.  I order it every time.  Pizza is delicious:  crust isn't thick, pizza itself is not greasy.  Our kids love the chicken tenders and fries, two kids (even two adults!) could easily split the portion, it is huge!

They always offer free fountain drinks whenever we pick up, another plus!

The other night my husband went in to pick up with our son, who was in his soccer attire.  The owner was there and he said that if our son only let in two goals next game, he would get a free pizza.  It does not get any better than that - made our son's day.  

This will continue to be our "go-to" take out place.  We have eaten in before (very casual set up for those who are wondering) and it was great, too!

The prices might be slightly high but the quality is there - so who am I to complain?

It started with Mario in the used car portion of the lot. Very low key, super friendly, asked questions and listened to my needs. The one I had come for was already pending- but there on the side- a classy white Jeep Patriot, low km's and just in price range... I took it for a ride and yeh- she moves! New tires and all that. It's perfect. We talk, we talk, I get a little off because another lot had one for cheaper across town. Then the scary financing side of things... Owen B took amazing care of me, and got me far better financing than I expected and got the team to do a rustproofing on the undercarriage to make up for the setup fee of the loan. They worked with me and now I have a car that won't blow up. Thanks guys! I wanted to post this so folks know this place is absolutely customer focused.

UPSTAIRS PARTY ROOM:
We had our boys' 1st & 3rd birthdays in their upstairs play area. It's a rentable space booked in 2 hour slots.  Because our kids were born in the dead of winter, this place worked out perfectly.  It's a huge space with lots of things for kids to climb, throw and run around.  They can be as loud as they want to be without any complaints from down stairs.

Bonus goodies- there is an attached room with a door that doubles as an eating venue/gift opening area/bathroom. It was the perfect setting for a bunch of rug rats to eat candy and blowoff some energy.  Definitely will be renting this space again.

SWIMMING POOL:
My children have been taking swimming lessons here for awhile now and I can't say enough for the swimming programs they have. They are perfect in building confidence in little ones. The instructors are great. 

Yes the pool is out dated, it's one of the older pools in Sherwood Park. I like it because it's a salt water pool and the kids area is perfect.  The water is shallow and it's separated from the main pool. I suspect that once the new pool is built in Emerald Hills, this pool may get a major facelift. But I could be wrong.

Family-friendly, inexpensive to use, and with a variety of activities from which to choose (swimming, ice skating, weights, and more), the only major downside to Millennium Place is the long drive. It is open year round and has a decent concession facility, is connected to a hotel, and also hosts numerous special events like craft shows.

What isn't there to like?

The flavours in the food are amazing and the ingredients fresh.The samosas' have such a nice crunch, and the inside texture is soft and easy to chew.
My favourites are the butter chicken wrap (the naan and the butter chicken paired together are SO delicious); the garlic naan, the fish and chips, and the chili chicken wrap. The fish has such great flavours, and has the bit of breaded crunch  with the warm and tender fish inside.

The staff are so friendly and welcoming. This is definitely my favourite place in the Park to grab a bite to eat.
Love this place!  Peter and the gang are awesome.  Love the new additions to the menu.

Excellent gym in Sherwood Park. Great hours and great staff.

You can get a three day free trial to check it out too.

Huge choice of equipment and weights. Lots of machines such as threadmills and bikes so you never have to wait for one. 

The change rooms are spotless. They have saunas, steamrooms and showers in the women's one. Haven't looked in the men's, might get into trouble if I did!

They also offer various exercise classes, spin ones as well as hot yoga.

And after all the hard working out, you can even relax in a massage chair. Well earned I must say!!

Great location in the Sherwood Park Mall, which offers lots of parking!

Sooo if your New Year's resolution is to get healthy, this should be your starting point. Free session with a trainer too. What are you waiting for? I've got my membership!

Fantastic Greek food. It is a quick serve restaurant but the food sure is delicious.

My personal favorites:

OPA Fries (Fresh fries spiced up with lemon juice and other spices)
Pita bread
Greek Salad
Chicken Souvlaki Wrap

The food here is never bad, if feeling unsure what to eat but want something filling, this is the place to go! If you're wanting it for lunch  and working around the area.. avoid it during high school rush hour or you'll be late for work!
I enjoy working out here. Helpful staff, clean gym and equipment is all in working order.

I go here at least once a week because it's soooo good! Favourites are coconut chicken on saffron rice ( only $5 for rice bowl!) and the veggie samosas. 
Food is always fresh and tasty. Same chef is always there and he's great!

I like this pool... It has a few quirks. Being the second-tier pool in The Park next to Millenium it's pretty decent and IMHO better for families with small kids then Millenium.
