They have a small kid wading pool that is about 20 degrees warmer then Millenium. It's always less busy. The slide is 100X better as you do not have to go through serious water blasters.  Dislikes include: no family change room, stairs up to the slide are a little dangerous to send my 3 year old solo so I have to go up with him 40X during one visit, hot tub can be too hot for my liking. Also has a rope swing and a couple high diving boards. It's an older pool and the change rooms could also use an update (tile's getting grudgey... Bring flip flops).

This was the first bridal shop I went to, and I had no clue what I wanted.  I was all over the place debating between satin and lace, ballgown for something more fitted.  Yean, my consultant, was extremely patient with me and very helpful in pulling styles I wouldn't even have thought of.

I ended up spending 3 hours there and didn't feel rushed at all.  Didn't get my dress here but they had one that was a close runner-up.  Definitely would recommend for the service and quality of dresses!

This is definitely one of the better bridal stores I've been to. They have a very large selection of dresses in a variety of styles, and the service there was fantastic- I think the lady who helped me there was easily one of the most friendly and helpful people I've ever been helped by in any store! She really went out of her way to make suggestions to help me get what I want in my wedding dress. 

I'd say going here was definitely worth the drive out of town :)

I love doing aquasize here especially since growing up this was the pool we always went to as millennium was still new. 

It's an older pool but they keep it nice and clean plus I like the salt water.

My only criticism is that I much prefer when they have several different aquasize teachers to choose from because their main one through the summer is awful. She's really cranky and unfriendly. We've mostly stopped going because of her. It's a shame.

This is the slowest chopped leaf I've ever been to. Sometimes I go in on my lunch break and it takes them 30 minutes to make my bowl. Every other location I've been to is always super quick and delicious. Staff also seems miserable so maybe replace them with happier quicker ones.

Out of all the wedding dress places I went to to find a dress this one was the cleanest and most comfortable. The salesperson who helped us gave great advice and did not select only expensive dresses for me to try. And we were not rushed at all.

This store has great selection and was having a great sale to clear out older stock. I got my dress for a really good price. As well, their dresses were all spotless, even all the sale dresses. The lady there said they clean and repair them on a regular basis. This was quite a change from some other places I visited with gray or yellow areas or stains and beading that was coming off. Every dress there was perfect. This is significant if one wants to buy off the rack like I did.

As well, with the purchase comes a cleaning and pressing. They'll store the dress for you too.

I inquired about prices for alterations and it's on par with other places that specialize in wedding dresses. However, they charge a set quoted price for the service itself and not per fitting like some other places. For example, some places charge for every fitting so after the dress comes back if it doesn't fit you pay again and it is several hundred usually for fittings. Bridal Debut gives the price in advance and it is what they say it will be.
Very helpful staff, not pushy at all. Excellent service and beautiful gowns. I would come back. I had a wonderful experience.

I was a little disappointed with this place. It has great potential but I felt that that food was a little bland. Also the staff was a bit lacking. The person taking orders did not seem like she wanted to be there.

The classes are well run here and the instructors are very friendly! The staff is good and helpful for the most part. It's a smaller gym compared to the goodlifes in the city but not bad. The women's side doesn't have a squat rack but does have a smith machine. There's a sauna and steam room for both change rooms. Overall, it has good equipment for cardio and weight lifting.

WOW! I have lived down the street for 6 years and have never tried this place. Food is really good and portions very generous. I had the butter chicken combo. So good. The naan bread was a little bit too charred for my liking and the dessert that came with my combo wasn't the best, but the main meal was DELICIOUS! Can't wait to go back and try something else.

If you go here (and you should) you MUST see Janice. She is amazing. There are no other words to describe her. She has worked there for 13 years i believe she said and is just fantastic. This was the second place we went for my friends wedding dress and the experience was perfect. Our first store was David's Bridal and as per my review, was AWFUL. But to be honest, it worked out fantastically going there first and then coming to Bridal Debut because the experiences were night and day. First off, the quality of dresses at this place compared to David's isn't even a conversation worth having. If you're looking for a cheap discount dress then David's is your store. If money isn't necessarily a problem, then Bridal Debut is your place. And that's not to say they are expensive because they are very decently priced actually. Just MUCH better quality both in the dresses and help. All said and done we found her dress here and it was an incredible experience. Tears all around! Not only did we find her dress, we found her veil, and a few other accessories as well. The thing i liked about Bridal Debut as well, is our consultant (Janice) stayed with us the entire time, answering any and all questions, providing opinions and just generally helping us. At David's Bridal, our "consultant" couldn't have been more useless. Disappearing constantly and providing 0 help ( Can you tell how awful that experience was now? ) This place was just a breeze for us, we had an appointment booked right after here at the Bridal House but cancelled after we came here. Just an awesome experience, highly highly recommended!

I checked out Bridal Debut on my "gown tour" with my mom and grandmother.  We were able to make an appointment easily and were excited to walk in and see a LOT of dresses.  I enjoyed my experience at the store, but I didn't find anything I liked.  A lot of the dresses were fuller than I was looking for with lots of bling!  I know this is what a lot of girls are looking for, so this is a great place to check out.  They are also the only store I came across in Edmonton that had the Royal Wedding replica dress.  I tried it on and it was gorgeous, but just not for me.  The customer service was attentive and friendly.  They had a large selection of off the rack dresses as well as made to order.  Shoes, bridemaid dresses and LOTS of accessories live here as well.  Check it out if you are in the area!

I went to Shig's because it was recommended by a friend. I ordered an arrangement for $150, being promised a certain flower composition. When picking it up, the lilies I ordered were not included. I complained and they did then place them in. Four days later, the gladiolas never opened and drooped, plus the orange vase I picked out was not orange, but spray painted and the coating started flaking. Not impressed.

I have eaten here twice in the past couple of months and loved it both times.  The location is reasonably spacious and quite comfortable if you want to eat-in, and take-out on a Saturday night was ready in under 20 minutes.  I'm not a huge pizza fan, but their pizzas are delicious.  The crusts are doughy but not too thick, and I didn't find the pizza greasy at all.  They have a wide variety of pizzas on their menu, and offer free fountain pop or slushies with your purchase.  The staff were friendly and I can't wait to go back.  Highly recommended.

Excellent food, I'm always craving a wrap or whole bowl from chopped. Staff are friendly and the restaurant is modern and clean. I highly recommend you check out this healthy alternative if you haven't had a chance yet.

This pizza place used to be the best pizza place in Sherwood park, but recently the prices have been going up and the quality has been going down.  I would now recommend the old Nitza's Pizza over the new one. I would no longer recommend this pizza restaurant to people (unfortunately)
Wow, this is the best pizza in Sherwood Park.  The atmosphere is nice and modern, they have free pop with your pizza, and the pizza comes fast, and tastes delicious.
Awesome pizza, great staff, delivery is fast and they delivery to acreages in Ardrossan.

Not too shabby.
Not as good as a few other Indian establishments I have tried recently...but still...I'd give them another shot.

Stopped in for a late, take out dinner. Had a three item deal which came with rice and Naan bread. I also ordered a couple of chicken samosas, and an order of stuffed naan bread (i went for cheese and onion). 
Dishes were decent. Butter chicken had a distinct tomato taste. Chili chicken was good. Stuffed naan was a a bit greasy...but the cheese inside no doubt contributed to that. It to was tastey. Samosa was unlike any other I have had. Shell was very hard. You can see in my picture. It tasted decent.

Overall...I'm content.
If I lived close, I would probably be apt to go back soon.
I don't live that close...so I will be back...one day.
For now.
So many new places to give a chance.

I had a great experience here while introducing my mom to chopped leaf. While the CL at home takes out the things I can't have due to dietary restrictions and then charges me extra for any changes, these guys were happy to give me extra of what I CAN eat, which was amazing. 

Service was friendly, quick, and our meals were both excellent. I'm also in love with the amount of seating at this location- wishing the one at home had booths and tables like this!! Will definitely try and come back next time I'm in town.

I love this facility. It's true it can be busy, usually on weekends And during the summer months, but what do you expect? I try to take the kids on weekdays while school is in, and it's really not busy at all. During the summer mornings and evenings tend to be a little less busy. 

I lane swim here minimum three times a week. The lane pool can also get busy, but Millenium offers a weekly schedule which allows a swimmer to know how many public lanes are open at specific times of day. Plan your swim around those times and it's highly likely you will get your own lane.  

The indoor playground is a great place for kids to play on cold miserable days. 

They also have babysitting for parents who want to exercise but need a place for their kids. They have a gym, an indoor track, indoor skating rink, soccer facilities, tons of things so get out and enjoy! 

The cost is very reasonable especially compared to the prices in the city.

An update from my previous Yelp post on Sherwood Park Toyota: the free oil changes I had negotiated have now been credited to me. Not sure if it was a computer "clitch" or if there was another reason for the mix-up.

I went for take out lunch... I thought it would be made fresh to order- yes it was semi-fresh made that morning/last night, but it was served cold (out of the fridge) and 2min after I ordered... literally.  

I found the meal tastelless and much room for improvement. I eat vegetarian so I ordered the Bangkok with "smoked tofu ($3)" in total with 1$ tip was 13$ in total... not cool.

The tofu was in little tiny cubes which I could not taste any of the smoke...

I would rather go get a wrap with some taste for 6$ then some out of the fridge with watered down sauce that came out of the jar.

I'm sorry but I will not be going back.

Contrary to what others say, IT IS EASY TO EAT OUT HEALTHY... without paying big prices.

This was an absolute disappointment. I had an appointment booked for my 5 bridesmaids to pick out dresses. When I spoke to the store I told them that I needed a different style for each of my girls. They said "no problem"! They confirmed a day before for the appointment which I thought was nice... UNTIL we showed up to the store and were shown a rack of 8 dresses. This was all they had, they had stopped carrying in a specific designer and they only had the 8 bridesmaid dresses in store.. oh and those dresses were size 0-4. So even if we wanted to, we couldn't have tried on the dresses. I was baffled that the store didn't warn me of their pint sized selection. I was also baffled that when the consultant told me that they changed their website to reflect what they carry in store. LIES. I will NEVER use this store and I sure as hell WONT BE RECOMMENDING THEM TO ANYONE. How disappointing.

Spinunity is AMAZING. 
My husband and I started off with the Groupon one month deal almost a year ago, and have been hooked ever since. We have been doing group fitness on and off for about 7 years now, in several cities in different countries, and this has been our favourite so far. 
Spinunity is like a big family and they will literally know your name within a few classes. They work so hard to build a community of riders and wonderful staff, that you want to come back day after day just to see everyone and feed off their energy.
The parking here is directly outside. It's literally a 2 second walk from the door. So nice when it's -30. 
The bikes and equipment here are really good. You don't have to have cycling shoes and they don't make you wear theirs. It's much better to use them but I like that it's optional at Spinunity. 
They run three different types of classes, Fusion: which includes two weight tracks and lots of choreography and combinations on the bike. Spin and Strength which is approx half on the bike, half weights or body weight conditioning exercises. Spin and Yoga which is half on the bike half on the mat stretching. I've done all three many times but find even if I just do Fusion it's enough of a full body workout that I progress physically. Adding a weekly Strength or Yoga class is even better. 
I was scared to walk through the doors the first time and would not have considered myself physically fit ever in my entire life. Spinunity keeps me interested and coming back for more. When I am able to do spin here 3-4 times a week I feel strong, healthy and for the first time ever, fit!

I signed up at World Health for its convenience. The Sherwood park location itself is a nice and quiet gym which I like as I could focus more on my own training. When I was signing up I told the staff member that I had a condition and there could be a possibility  that I could become ill at any time and would have to cancel my membership. He did not offer me any helpful suggestions but only a 6 month or 12 month term.( at which point I should have left -  I also signed up for the 12 month-yes complete stupidity on my part) He did say that If I need to cancel at any time before my term ended, that all I would need is a medical note and the cancellation fee would be waved. 6 months have passed and now going into surgery tomorrow I am unable to cancel my membership  Because I am in a contract that does not allow me to cancel unless I pay the remainder of my term plus a cancellation fee. There is no option for me to take a Medical Leave of Absence with this type of contract as well.  I am not impressed with how poor their customer service is and lack of knowledge for consumers like me. They are not for the client and only about numbers. Just shows the lack of integrity and disrespect they have for newcomers. I will never go to this gym again and I am better off being a Good life reject. Back to good life it is for me in 6 months.

Who doesn't appreciate a well placed, irritatingly overused, cliche phrase like "you get what you pay for"...

At the Chopped Leaf, you get what you pay for.  In other words, the food is AWESOME; so fresh, and colourful, and delicious, but also pretty expensive.  A salmon wrap, a bottle of water, and a $2 tip (which brings me to another point which I will make shortly) cost me about $15.  To me, that's a little much for lunch - not to mention that I am smaller than the average person - nicknamed things like Shorty, Littleton, Smurfette, and my personal fav, Oompa Loompa throughout my life may give you an idea of what I mean - so I typically fill up faster than most: adding a salad or soup would likely bring you closer to the $20 mark.

We have all experienced this type of fast food dinning; pick your wrap, pick your protein, pick your veggies, pick your cheese, pick your sauce.  Everything extra costs you a little extra and they limit you to 3 veggie topping choices.  Again I add, the food is delicious and fresh tasting!  

Now about tipping at these types of places (and other similarly set up places like Press'd or Mongolie Grill)...I have worked in customer service my whole life (Dairy Queen, Mr. Sub, Best Western - Front Desk, and now in Sales) and never EXPECTED a tip from any of these places.  Now it seems like there is a tip jar or debit tip option EVERYWHERE you go...I don't always feel that a tip is warranted for these types of places but I don't know if maybe things have changed, and I don't want to be rude - what's the deal, yo?!?!

Anyway, back to the point - when it comes to the Chopped Leaf, if YOU are paying, I am IN!! Parking at this location is ATROCIOUS during peak hours, be forewarned!  Definitely worth checking this place out!

So I can't believe I have never heard of this place before. I asked on Facebook where would be a good place to take my daughter for lunch who is developmentally delayed. Someone mentioned that Nitza pizza on Sundays allow kids to make their own pizzas if you just donate to the Stollery. We were warmly greeted by the staff and they treated my daughter well. She made her own little pizza while my husband ordered a large un-vegetarian, and I ordered a larger Conner's Delight. The pizza came out promptly and it was delicious. Nice thin crust, good sauce and lots of toppings. And such a great restaurant to support. They do so much for the Stollery in memory of their niece Nitza who used it. They also give you a good bang for your buck with their two for ones and a free pop or slushie with your order.

This review is based on the kids play area and the wave pool since I haven't been to any of the other parts of this seemingly amazing facility. 

Our nearest pool was closed for renovations so we devices to check this place or since we had seen it when we were in the kids playground last month and it looked amazing. Well folks with children, this place beats the pants off any of the other children's pools in Edmonton by a long shot and that includes the kids space at West Ed Waterpark. 

The family change room has these enormous change rooms with a bench, hooks, baby change table and garbage can. My only complaint and the reason for the 4 star review is that there are not enough rooms for busy periods. I think there are a total of 6 rooms. So if you're not lucky, you'll end up waiting for a room, with shivering kids until one opens up after your post swim shower. 

The wave pool is nice and warm. No cold shock getting into it after your cleansing shower. By the way, the showers are excellent. Nice pressure, hot water and I think the water temperature can be adjusted but we liked it the way it was. There is a big climbing structure with a double slide and a covered and lots of other water features. I don't know how to best describe the wave pool but it was super fun and there are loads of water toys to play with including canoes, tubes, rafts, a motorcycle, etc. The pool was busy today but there was an abundance of pool toys to go around. 

The lazy river combined with the waves was really fun to go around in too. Definitely grab a tube or something to hang onto to enhance the experience. 

We really enjoyed our morning here and I can say with certainty that we would be back here more often than any other facility in town for our swim times. 

Last month, we took the kids to burn off some energy at the indoor playground. Excellent space with a couple of climbers, a big climbing wall, a baby space, a nature themed area and a cabin themed area. My kids had a lot of fun here. I appreciated the bathroom in the playground to reduce time spent wandering around for a bathroom, thereby reducing play time. I also appreciated that the space had a staff member present the whole time we were there. He was paying attention and smiled at the kids but otherwise let the kids play. 

We watched skaters on the skating pond next door and found out that there are public skate times and they have plastic skating aids for the little kids so I think we will be back soon to check that out. 

Overall we are pretty impressed with millennium place and will be back in the future for our recreational needs. Too bad it wasn't a little closer!

While we do enjoy this pool more than the other local pool, I have never in my life seen a place so filthy in the change rooms! I really wish they would take better care of the floors...since we've been coming to this place regularly our whole family has been battling WARTS. My youngest is in swimming lessons, her grandma had to take her once cuz i was called to work...now her grandma has warts! From one visit there!!! 
Out of the many times I've been to this pool I've only ever seen someone come in with the floor cleaner twice!  But it never even touches the change stalls or further up in the bathroom stalls! It's gotten to the point where we will be looking for other pools for swimming lessons and family swims. Disgusting! All the staff they have on a regular basis, theirs no excuse for those floors to be in that condition
Great place to get your Greek fix taken care of.  The chicken and salad was delicious and I love how they grill up the pita.

Healthy and very filling! Not "fast" food, but I'm fine with that since the quality is great. Just come with some time to spare. 

The food and place:
I'm a mushroom soup lover, and get it whenever I have the chance since it's not frequently available at most places. But today was my lucky day because it was one of the daily soups at Chopped Leaf! The "wild mushroom chowder" was hot and fresh, with rice, celery, and a good amount of sliced mushroom. Really good! 
The Spicy chicken sandwich also had onions, mushrooms, cheddar, romaine, and came with an aioli dipping sauce. It was fabulous!
Beautiful interior, with a rustic feel and lots of tables. Even has a small patio outside. I found the staff very friendly. 

How it works:
-pick what you want off the menu boards
-order and pay at the cashier
-if it's "to go" you wait for your food to be passed over the counter near the door
-if it's "to stay" you get a number that you display on your table, and your food will be brought over to you. 
-when you're done, you leave and they clear your table for you. 

Large menu,  I'll have to come back to try more!

Recently tried Nitzas...gluten free of course...the pizza was delish!!! Light crust plenty of toppings and the sauce was just right! Be prepared for a wait,  they make it all fresh. 

WILL be back and recommend!

I can start by saying I prefer this establishment's pizza over boston pizza because it doesn't have that sweet taste in the sauce that BP has. I rate them a 1 because of their total disregard for customer care. 
Me and my wife both work leaving us with a limited window in our day to do what we need to(groceries, household maintenance etc.). They usually have a 10-15 minute wait time so we called 20 minutes ahead of time right after work. 
My wife spoke with one of the girls, and asked her for the total. She stated "around $60" my wife asked for an exact amount so we could be sure that we would be taking everything we ordered, who wants a surprise $100 pizza bill after all! So she said yeah, it's going to be $60 - even. 
So, as we're pulling up we get a call. 
The guy says that he was just confirming the phone number was real - need I remind you that the time for the order was 10-15 minutes, same amount of time it takes us to get there. 
We told the guy we were pulling up and it should have been done already. 
When we're inside, the guy from the phone said that it's an out of town number and they wanted to make sure that it wasn't someone from elsewhere trying to contact someone else.
We then had to wait about 15 minutes there and when it came out, the cashier told us the total was $71. I told her that we were told $60. 
She said "well I didn't take your order" and I asked for a manager. As she was doing that, the girl that took the call said to the guy "I messed up" and ran in the back. 
Guy approaches us, immediately is defensive. Says to let him try and figure out a way to lower the price and says there's no way. (They don't have a regular system that you normally see. They have little girls using pen and paper to add it all up.)
I told him that we were told something else and he says "I'll go ahead and give it to you for $60. Just give me $60, it's not worth making a girl cry over." It wasn't as easy as I just made it out to be either because i had to put up with his bs negotiation tactics for 5 mins, right as I was about to walk out without the pizza, before he agreed to accept what one of his employees quoted us. Had she done her job and added up our total upon request, this could have been avoided. And to try and make us feel guilty for a girl crying (BECAUSE SHE DIDNT PERFORM HER BAASSSIC DUTIES) that I didn't even say a word to, is completely out of hand in my opinion. 
- your employee that messed up is more important to you than a customer...who is paying you??? How is this customer service? 
Why is some little girl in skimpy clothes more important to you than someone who wants your product!? 
Very, very, VERY poor customer service. 
We won't ever be here again, sadly. 
There is absolutely no customer loyalty or appreciation.

Huge, HUGE rave to Bridal Debut in Sherwood Park. After finding a dress I loved there last weekend, I decided to still shop around and go to my other appointments. Beverley, one of the consultants at Bridal Debut agreed to squeeze me in at 9am, an hour before opening, just to try the dress on one last time before the big purchase. I'm so thankful for the accommodation, the helpful advice and expertise of the women there. So a huge thank you! I said YES to the dress.

I'm really baffled by all these 5-star reviews. There were a couple of good aspects to my experience at Bridal Debut but I was completely put off by a number of things that happened there.

Pros (would have been a 1-star rating without these):
 - pretty decent selection
 - large fitting rooms, lots of mirrors and good lighting
 - very nice jewelry & veil selection
 - I told the consultant I had fallen in love with another dress that was discontinued and she did show me a sample that was similar (unfortunately it was also discontinued, so I would have had to buy it off-the-rack and it was about 3 inches too short)

Cons:
 - the dresses are DIRTY. Often they are torn as well. I get that a sample may be tried on by dozens and dozens of brides but when I am standing in a torn, dirty, wrinkled dress I don't feel pretty no matter what it looks like
 - aside from the off-the-rack dress she found for me, the consultant did NOT listen to what I told her I wanted. The two things I was adamant about not having on the dress were appliques and flowers, so what dress does she suggest I try on? One that is covered in flower appliques. She pretty much lost any chance of making a sale right then and there, it's not hard to remember when a customer tells you there are only TWO things she doesn't like!
 - when you walk in at first, they give you a few tags to put on dresses you want to try on. I think she only gave me three tags, and considering I was in a party of four including myself that meant that not even every person there got to choose a dress for me to try!
 - they are UNORGANIZED. When I walked in they seemed surprised to see me despite having an appointment booked for weeks. I had booked a bridesmaid consultation immediately after my bridal appointment. When the bridal appointment was done, the consultant started trying to rush me out the door and again, seemed totally surprised when I told her that we had an hour-long bridesmaid appointment booked right then.
 - there was another bridesmaid consultation going on while my bridesmaids were trying on dresses, and not only did they not have enough fitting rooms available, but the other consultant had put an accessory for the other appointment into my bridesmaids' fitting room, and actually asked them to pass it to her WHILE one of them was changing. Like the other customer couldn't wait 2 minutes so my bridesmaid didn't have to open the curtain half-dressed to fix the consultant's mistake. That seemed very unprofessional to me.
 - the PRICES. THey are so expensive! I tried on one dress that I later priced at another store for $500 less. Another one I priced for $700 less. For a salon that does not carry high-end brands and is not a particularly fancy or well-run place I don't understand how they can jack up the prices that much. Also I told the consultant at the beginning what my budget was and that it was FIRM. She brought me 3 dresses that were over my budget even after I told her each time that I would not go a penny over my budget. 
 - the sizing. They have a pretty good range of sizes for the wedding dresses, but every dress my bridesmaids tried on was multiple sizes too large. My bridesmaids are both between size 6 and 8 and I think the smallest dress they tried on was a 14. THey did provide us with clips, but it's impossible to fully "get" the look of a dress when there's more of it cinched back than actually on the person wearing it.  
 - I ended up liking a couple of the samples my bridesmaids tried on, but the store didn't have any swatches of the other colours the dresses came in! That doesn't make any sense to me at all, I'm not going to pick a dress based on what it looks like on a computer screen. Plus every dress designers' website says not to order a dress until you have seen a swatch of the colour you want in person. Do they honestly expect people to order a dress without seeing a colour swatch beforehand? 

SUMMARY:
Don't go here. Based on all of the bad customer service/business practices I experienced I have no idea how they are still in business. Even if you live in the country and Sherwood Park is the closest to you, drive the extra 20-30 minutes into Edmonton where you will have more choice, better prices and better service at a lot of the salons. I ended up getting my dress at Pure Bridal and couldn't be happier with my experience there.
 -

Shig's is a fairly small flower shop in Sherwood Park that I stopped into one day for a dose of something bright and cheery on an otherwise dreary day. 

I slipped in out of the rain and wind, and was immediately greeted by a florist, who welcomed me to the shop and asked if she could help. 

"Yes, I want to step into your flower refrigerator for a moment to get a boost of seretonin," I thought, then just smiled and told her I'd puttter.
 
The shop is rather tiny, with a narrow space up front featuring vases, fresh, curly bamboo stalks and some gifty items. You can't see any flowers from the entrance, as the refrigerator is slightly out of view. I was wondering for a minute if they were out of flowers! But the lovely smells in the shop told me otherwise. 

The kind clerk went back to her work in the back of the shop and I slipped into the cooler to look at the beautiful buds. The colours were vibrant and the selection, while moderate in size, was fresh and healthy looking. They had plenty of stalks of Birds of Paradise, some still-fresh Christmas berrie branches, perky Gerber daisys, gorgeous roses, carnations, mixed bundles and more. They sell those swaths of roses that performers are often given after concerts, for about $50 each. The carnations were about $30, slightly overpriced, but the quality was very good
.
I left feeling much, much better. Flower stores should start charging for the Zen, restorative experience of literally stopping to smell the flowers.

When I was getting married I went to two other Bridal Boutiques before coming to Bridal Debut. What the other places lacked from Bridal Debut was customer service. I felt very rushed at the other places I had gone to. At Bridal Debut my consultant did not once make me feel rushed or pressured into buying a certain dress. She allowed me to try on multiple dresses in multiple styles and also gave me her honest opinions on what looked good and what did not. In the end with her help I was able to find the most Ah-Maz-ZIng dress for me and at a great price too. I would recommend this bridal salon to anyone who is looking for their wedding dress!

I should preface this by saying my experience wasn't bad per se, just meh. After having appointments at Delica, Novelle, and Pure Bridal, I wanted to round out my search and ensure I wasn't missing anything. Walking into Bridal Debut, it immediately felt less upscale than the other boutiques with outdated decor, extremely tiny change rooms and shared pedestal/mirror area with no seating. This was the first appointment I went to alone and I'm glad I did because no one would have been able to sit down! 

I was however, able to walk in to a quiet shop and have a full hour long appointment. I was greeted almost immediately and the consultant was very friendly. I tried on a couple of gowns that somewhat matched what I was looking for. I wasn't really given the chance to look around myself and felt like I was part of a Maggie Sottero sales pitch. This, along with the lack of privacy, kind of cheapened the whole experience for me. 

The gowns here are great for a bride sticking to a tighter budget, but I felt that the dresses they carried lacked the same quality of fabrics and intricate detail that I tried within my budget at other salons.

I'm so so excited! My husband and I attended the 2.5 hour free orientation class and learned so much already!

The owner, Leanne, gave pre-training tips. She gave suggestions on sleeping and eating for our dog that would enhance the training we would be doing. Some of the ideas I had never heard of but it made so much sense.

Leanne has an incredible amount of experience in training animals of all types. She has worked with puppies on movies and with sea lions at West Edmonton Mall. She has quite a few certifications as well.

We had our first one on one training session and we came away not only with some good tips but also, and more importantly, with a better understanding of our dog.

As I said, I am so excited about this journey we are embarking on with our pet!

I recently purchased a 2014 Scion FRS from Sherwood Park Toyota after my Acura started having engine problems around the 400,000km mark. I was greeted in the parking lot in under 1 minute by Kathleen Cook. She was extremely polite, courteous, and knowledgeable about both the specific vehicle and the whole brand in general. She got me a coffee (a few of them actually lol) and took the time to go over all the features with me, get me in the seat and get a feel for it, and out for a test drive. From start to finish it took about 4-5 hours from me arriving at the dealership, to me driving it home. The sales managers and all other staff were very polite, and they got me down to a payment I could afford at a good interest rate. Kathleen went above and beyond her duty, helping me find a much better insurance company, and even driving me personally to get my FRS registered, and has continued to help me out to this day. Overall I've been very pleased with my experience with Sherwood Park Toyota from start to finish, and I would gladly recommend them to anyone looking for a new vehicle!

Ahhh the sweet sweet smell and feeling of a soccer centre. Its been too long since i have ventured into one, and on my recent trip back home to Edmonton, I got to stop in Sherwood Park's premier sports facility to see a cousin's game.

A clean, and tidy facility (even with the car who drove in through the front door days before) and a great spot to attend a game, or play in one.

I just had yet another good experience with Bridal Debut this weekend. I went with a friend and two other girls to help her find a wedding dress. I had previously been to Bridal Debut way back in 2006/07 to find and purchase my own wedding dress, and again last summer as part of a wedding party. My friend (the bride) tried on dresses, and us girls ended up buying our bridesmaid dresses here. 

All of my experiences with Bridal Debut have been positive. The store is big, well organized and clean. Good selection of wedding dresses, with brands like Maggie Sottero (my dress :) ), Alfred Sung, Sottero and Midgley, Allure and more. The selection of bridesmaids dresses is alright. I have seen more variety at another store, but Bridal Debut's selection is probably pretty average. There is an off the rack section, which is gowns that you can buy and take home that day, that are not available to be ordered. Some big discounts can be found there. There is also a selection of shoes, veils, jewellery and other accessories. 

The staff are what really set this place apart for me, specifically the consultants. I've been to several other bridal shops, and the ladies at Bridal Debut have been the best in all of my experiences as far as personality and positive attitudes. We dealt with Rebecca this past weekend, and she was very upbeat, joking around with us and chatting, and also very enthusiastic about pulling different styles of dress for my friend. I've been to other bridal stores where the consultants seem like they are in a rush, or annoyed that we may want to try more dresses or re-try ones to get a second look. I have never encountered anyone like that here. 

Appointments are essential on Saturdays, and probably also on the weeknights they are open late. You might have better luck with walk-ins on weekdays, but I have no experience with that. The appointments here are an hour and a half, so you have lots of time to try on different things without feeling rushed. 

Highly recommended.
I love this place so much! The staff is awesome if anything is ever a problem you can ask anyone. I've been a member here for two years and wouldn't change !!

I've been to this Tim Hortons located at 664-Wye Road in Sherwood Park and I'm finally going to say that the service in the evenings has always been consistent. One employee in particular that stands out is a polite and professional Tim Horton's employee named Camryn Schvetz. I came into this establishment last night and ordered a small white milk from Camryn, who always greets me with her friendly welcoming smile when ever I need to place an order. I was then handed my small milk by this wonderful lady. When I sat down to drink the milk I noticed a sour taste and quickly brought it back to Camryn explaining that the milk tasted sour. Well Camryn like the consumate professional that she is, immediately apologized on behalf of Tim Horton's and then acknowledged to me that she'd bring me another small milk at no extra charge. I in return told her it would be more of a convenience if we just switched this order to a chocolate milk by increasing the odds of not running into another sour white milk, so she just smiled and brought me a chocolate milk. I opened up the carton downed some of it and it tasted just right. Camryn is truly the consomet professional and was pleased to see that smile on my face. I'd suggest that Tim Horton's management consider this professional to a higher promotion in the very near future, cause people like Camryn deserve to move up the ladder for being so courteous and polite in looking after their customers needs like she always has with mine! She rates 5 out of 5 Tim Bits in my taste bud books! John Zapantis

I've been coming here for years, and don't understand all the negative reviews myself. I've personally never experienced anything but stellar and attentive service. Even more so lately. On more than one occasion I've had technicians make me aware of potential issues but also let me know it's something I can do myself. 
My last trip in the manager even let me know that based on my vehicle and the oil I use I could go a lot longer between visits. This has been my go to oil change location for the past 6 years and will continue to be.

I used to work out here, good little gym if you know what you need todo and you want to get in and get out.  One issue i did have was that a few times there were kids in there, one little girl kept taking things out of my circuit, followed me around the whole time and then tried to keep up with me on the treadmill. I was so worried she was going to get hurt.  I don't believe kids should be in the gym.

So dissapointed by this place. I just came here right now at 9 and I was with my friend who is a member here and they wouldn't let me workout. I said I would pay the fee for a drop in and they still said no because he was lazy and didnt want to do it. Last time ill be EVER coming here. Damn juice monkey

Decent pizza but not worthy of a special trip.   Both pizzas we ordered were wrong or incomplete. We ordered #16. It was supposed to have pepperoni and smokey bacon on it.   It had only one sweet sausage like meat.  We also had #31 which I really liked but it was missing the tomatoes.  We advised the store and they were disinterested.   The sizes are smaller than expected, think individual when you see medium.  However, I thought the amount of toppings was generous. The sauce is quite good. Free pop or slush provided with order.   If I lived in the immediate vicinity I would order from here, but I wouldn't make a special trip again. If I was hungry and passing by, I would.

So I've been coming here for a couple years now to buy my dog food/cat food. The staff have always been friendly and as helpful as can be when needed. Having worked in a pet food store myself I tend to be fairly self sufficient in the store so maybe that helps. I find their prices to always be competitive and if I can find dog or cat food on sale - I tend to be that person who will buy two. 
I used their grooming services here for the first time this Saturday for a puppy bath. They were super accommodating when I called to let them know I was running about 10 minutes late. 
They were finished before their quoted time. And were extremely friendly and complimentary about my puppy. I would bring him back here in a heartbeat for more baths.

Fabulous place for a sweat date (husband and I go together). Instructors are very motivational and put on a good workout. The facility is spa-like and the extras (free towels, shampoo, blow driers, etc) make it my fave workout spot.

Staff didn't mention the option of trial passes or monthly passes until I had paid several day passes at $15 each, and only then did they say there was a monthly pass option. Showers were not very clean and you have to ask for towels which are ratty and thin. Hard to get assistance for anything. Compared to other GoodLife locations I thought this was disappointing.
Amazing food and portions! The pasta is fresh and the chicken was delicious. Well worth it!!

This is the best kennel we've ever taken our dogs to. Leeann and her staff are very attentive. This is now the only kennel we take our dogs and we live three hours away. We've also done the training here and Leeann is fantastic. Highly recommend. Word of warning, be on time for your drop off or you will be scolded!

Ate here for first time today. Ordered regular donair. Wow.. it was fresh and delicious. Had to order another one. 

Place was clean and tidy, friendly counter service, order came promptly. Free parking. I could not believe that FREE fountain pop is offered -- even if you are not ordering food!!

Will be back again...

I was on my lunch break which is only half an hour, and I saw that the chopped leaf was open. I went in. 5-10 minute wait in line. 15-20 minute wait for food. I was a few minutes shy of being late to work getting back from getting what is supposed to be fast food. Fail on service's part.

And I am sorry, they charge $4 for the smallest cup of soup I have ever seen and the soup was nothing to write home about (Thai coconut). It was ultimately flavorless except for the coconut. I couldn't even taste the cilantro in it.

I also had the Baja Quesadilla. I have never had such an awful time eating a Quesadilla in my life! It fell apart the moment I went to pick it up and the fillings did not have a lot of flavor at all. There wasn't even a decent browning on the quesadilla and I watched it sit on the grill for 10 minutes. Maybe the speed problem with service is the barely functioning grill?

For a sub par quesadilla, a urine sample size cup of soup, and a half size bottle of Coke zero, I paid almost $17. 

The food was not fantastic, the service speed was appalling. I cannot say that I will ever be coming back or that I will be referring them any business. 

Disappointed

Best Pizza place EVER!! I'm not a pizza fan, and my kids won't eat the crust on most pizza's but this place is DIFFERENT! I LOVE their pizza's and my kids do to, and always clean their plates. Not to mention that their donair loaf is AMAZINGLY DELICIOUS! The staff is always friendly and extremely welcoming and accommodating to everyone, especially kids. I wouldn't order pizza from anywhere else!

I had taken my Ford Escape into Mr. Lube in Sherwood Park on baseline road. Have been going there for years. I have never had a problem until now, when they did an oil change to my vehicle back in late 2014. I drive home after the oil change and woke up the next morning to find a fairly large oil puddle under my front end. I call Mr. Lube and the manager Dustin said to bring it in right away. I went down right away and was taken inside within 15 minutes. the problem they found  was that the fellow who was working under my vehicle did not tighten the bolt that the oil drains from. I told the manager at the time it was all over my concrete driveway and was told there is nothing they can do to clean it up, but was willing to give me 5 free complete oil changes to make up for this mistake as it is on Mr. Lube for not tightening the bolt up properly. I agreed to this as I was told nothing could be done for the oil spillage  on my driveway. I received my last oil change in Feb 2015 at no cost as pre agreed on with the manager of Mr. Lube , and was told the fellow who did this was let go as this is not the first occurrence with him not tightening bolts on the vehicles he had serviced. I called into Mr. Lube today as I park my vehicle  during winter months  and now that my vehicle is being driven again I wanted an oil change. A very nice manager on the phone named Bruce answered my call and I asked for Dustin not knowing he was let go do to these type of problems given customers free oil changes  when he was to follow a different procedure  so they let him go. I told the new manager what the deal was and I live out of town so I wanted to make sure Mr. Lube would still honor there agreement that was given to me by Dustin. He looked it up but could not see free oil changes but seen I had a free one in Feb 2015 at there location as that is where I always went. he could see notes about oil spillage on my driveway, but again no mention of the oil changes that Dustin promised even know it shows one from Feb 2015. which would leave me 4  full changes left, but know they have to ask there area supervisor. I will let everyone know what the out come will be as soon as I hear back tomorrow as they said they will have an answer for this. If they try and back out of it I will also post on all social media including calling there head office, and Google review it as well.  I am not blaming the new manager for what he is doing as he had no idea what happened but as Mr. Lube's manager Promised to take care of it I would expect them to follow through especially when it is a long time customer . Have a great day peeps

The seafood pasta dish was amazing!!  We had 3 appetizers as well.  Calamari was the best I have had, the bruschetta was good and the clams were awesome!  For desert we shared the tiramisu, it was amazing too

Loud bumpn' music, dark flashy disco vibe, great quality bikes, and a fantastic instructor. 

Yes my friends it's spin... But not only are you biking you're doing weights or hilt if you've been to a spin fusion or spin and strength class.

What a great combo, cardio and body weight hilt all in an hour. Not only are you sweating and melting the pounds away but sculpting your muscles too. Plus its fun!

Spinunity is an awesome workout studio, they have a smoothie bar if you need an after class boost and if you have kids they offer child minding (I'm not 100% sure how it works but I think you have to pre-register your youngins first?). 

Indoor biking is where it's at! Especially when the weather hits the Chills. 

If you feel like a change from Running, Zumba or whatever cardio you do come check out Spinunity! The instructor are amazing!
Best Italian restaurant in Sherwood Park. Healthy portions that come delivered piping hot.

I only write reviews when I am either extremely impressed or utterly disappointed with a business.  Shig's Flowers falls in the first category.  The quality is second to none.  Their flowers are fresher and last longer than any other flower shop in Sherwood Park or Edmonton!  The arrangements are gorgeous and their staff is friendly and efficient.  My visits to the store remind me of shopping on Main Street in a small town.  In and out with a custom wrapped bouquet in under 10 minutes.  Or better yet, call in and have your flowers delivered.  I use Shig's Flowers to thank clients for using my services and almost always receive a thank you for the best flowers they have ever received.  Anyone who has purchased flowers from a discount flower store knows that they only last a week at the most.  I've had bouquets from Shig's Flowers last as long as 3 weeks.  I am happy to write this review and encourage you to use Shig's for your next occasion.

If you want to get chastised and threatened for showing up 2 minutes before your drop off time, then this is the place for you. We wont be going back here. There are happier places to go. The owner is not a nice person and threatened to cancel our boarding booking because I was 2 minutes early according to her WALL clock. What a nice person to put our vacation in jeopardy because we were too punctual. This is a terrible business practice, maybe you should look at better segregation if you're legitimately concerned about your problem animals or neighbours complaining.

I've had a horrible experience at this facility. You spend a decent amount of money on a membership only to feel that you are being followed around by their rude staff. Why would anyone use the personal trainers available when they seem so cold and treat you as if you are in their way most of the time. Music is terrible and even though it's a newer place the bathroom always has a horrible smell.

Chicken Taco Pizza
Grilled chicken, salsa sauce, mushrooms, hot peppers, cheddar, diced fresh tomatoes
Nitza's Pizza

If you try the chicken by itself, it's duller than an episode of Little House on the Prairie. But lost in that sea of banana peppers and salsa, you won't notice the chicken's plainness; the other ingredients, especially the infernal salsa, help carry it to a culinary victory. I'm certain ground beef would've tasted better, but I thoroughly enjoyed this chicken taco/pizza amalgam. A masochistic pleasure that catered to my insatiable desire for hot foods.

My Rating: 3.75/5

The other half of the pizza (your left side) is some artichoke concoction for my wife. I didn't care to try it. 

Facebook.com/RamneeksFoodReviews

This is my favourite place to go for waxing. Valerie is professional and such an excellent job. She is a perfectionist and will make sure that everything is up to her high standards. They have a variety of waxing, tinting and microblading. I have only ever gotten the waxing done. It is in an area that you wouldn't expect a spa (but it's right beside an exquisite chocolate shop) but there's tons of parking. This is not a place that you can just walk in to. Every time I have gone, I have booked an appointment and it's always packed with people. If you need any waxing, I would absolutely recommend coming here!

Great pizza!! But what is even better is the customer service. The owner takes time to visit with the customers, especially my children, they do countless sponsors for the community and gave our hockey team a great party for only ten bucks a person (all you can eat pizza and wings!)
They even go as far to allow kids to make there own pizza, which they cannot get enough of!
Great food, great prices, and great customer service!!

Went as part of a bridal party to select bridesmaid dresses. Appointment was booked by the bride months in advance so we could all line up our very busy schedules. We arrive early and the main room is so packed you can't move. Hardly any space for the number of appointments they had booked. Not intimate or enjoyable at all, right off the bat. Then we are brought to a DISMAL selection of bridesmaid dresses (only one size in each dress style, most on the xs to small size). You could see the brides face fall, and the bridesmaids all look at each other like how the hell are we supposed to pick a dress from this. The consultant was very brusque saying that we could just order online. The whole point of setting up an appointment and coordinating the dress try on was to actually try on dresses and see how they fit us. It was a complete disappointment!! We ended up leaving and going elsewhere. There was no apology or explanation offered... I would NEVER recommend this place. It was packed, rushed feeling and the consultant was rude. Don't do it ladies.

Great restaurant. Good prices. Donairs are delicious. Salads are always fresh and tasty although twice my Greek salad was a little over saturated with dressing. Pizza is fantastic. Staff always very friendly although we had a coupon for 1 free pizza but when we tried to order two pizzas one with the coupon and one without we were told the free pizza had to be picked up but they would deliver the 2nd pizza. We ended up having to pay for 2 pizzas in order to have them both delivered. It was strange.

I was really REALLY excited to finally check out Chopped Leaf as I had heard so much about it.  I went for lunch one day on my own and decided on the starter size Bangkok salad with chicken.  The food was fresh when it arrived.  I was impressed with the size of the salad as I think a regular size would have been way too much for me.  The only thing that made me sad was the chicken.  It was clearly not "real" chicken....the kind you get off a bird, unaltered.   Instead it was the kind with grill marks drawn on it that is usually full of sodium and "meat protein".  This surprised me considering the health conscious nature of the franchise.  However, it was warm, and the dressing was good, so down it went.  

The restaurant itself was clean, modern and comfortable.  I would go back to try a different salad, perhaps with prawns or tofu and also because of the friendly staff.

This review is for the service department!

Just like I buy water damage warranties for my electronics, I also buy tire warranties for my vehicles! Nails and screws are two peas in a pod for me and my tires.

I thought I was on a 6 month streak as I haven't had any leaks in my tires. Then I woke up yesterday morning to find that one of my tires was Down to 10 PSI.

I drove across the city to SP Toyota and pulled into the service department. I was greeted by my first name by Jay (the service manager) asking what I did this time, Apparently I have a reputation there.

I proceeded to tell Jay about my tire leaking and that I needed it fixed. Well, because I was unorganized at the time, I didn't have an appointment. The service department fit me in right away to get my tire fixed. They also noticed I was a little late on my oil change and they said they would do it for me as well!

An Hour and a half later and two vanilla coffees in my tummy from their brand new coffee machine, I had my Scion tC back! Tire fixed (yes it was a nail) and my  Oil change completed. They even washed my car for me (for free)! Now that is service!

Thanks again SP Toyota! I'm sure I'll see you soon again. Hopefully with no more Nails in my tires!

Michael C. who helps Sherwood Park Toyota in resolving possible issues/complaints that customers have, contacted me a couple weeks ago in regards to an experience I had with Sherwood Park Toyota over two months ago.

He got Peter from Sherwood Park Toyota to contact me, and we discussed for them to provide a different service at a discounted cost, to which Peter Gladly agreed :)

I will be going there today to purchase two new car starter remotes and have them programmed 

Thank You Michael C. and Peter of Sherwood Park Toyota for regaining my Trust in Your business again :)

Pros: Very good sauces. Quality ingredients. Decent portions. Nice atmosphere. Waiter was personable and efficient.

Cons: The place was busy and a second server would have moved things along better. Price, like everything in Sherwood Park, was high for the category, especially wine which was 6 or 9 ounce glasses and bottles only, nothing in between. 

Verdict: I'll go back but, for the money, there are a lot of other options if you drive into the city.

Nitza's pizza will definitely go down as one of Alberta's finest. I can see it growing into a larger franchise. Ever since I was a kid (I'm not that old), even when there was just the one location, this was my family's 'go to' pizza. A truly unique recipe; the perfect amount of sauce, meats, cheeses, and vegetables (for the strange ones who eat vegetables). I have grown up eating Nitza's pizza and I can see myself eating it in a senior's home at one point of my life. I highly recommend the food here for anyone looking for a new place to try that will satisfy their taste buds! 
I recently moved 1 minute from the wye road location which has had negative effects on my weight,
however, the staff there are very pleasant. Enjoy!

I've always enjoyed Millennium (had a membership years ago when I worked in the park) but forgot about everything that you can do there until a friend invited me to come for coffee while her son was playing (so many things to do!!!)

I figured I couldn't go without actually utilizing the facilities... So I opted for a drop in aqua fit class in the morning. 

I liked the online schedule so I could have a look at all my options ahead of time. And I loved the large change room, the multiple showers (no waiting!) and the pool facilities. There's lots of mirror and counter space to do your hair/makeup (but you will be in the way of everyone coming and going as you're right in front of the shoe racks). 

Although I was the youngest (by far), class was still fun and there was probably around 20 people (but we were so spread out that it only felt like a handful of people were in the pool). And Sasha was a great instructor. 

Heads up - if you have a larger wallet (or longer, in my case), it won't fit in the wallet lockers. And if you are getting a locker in the pool change room (and didn't bring a lock), it takes 2 quarters.

The staff are completely incompetent and the sales people are just looking to get you to sign papers. I agree with the man below who stated to get EVERYTHiNG in writing. because of the issues they caused me in buying the vehicle, they threw in some extras and when I called to get the work done on my car, they had no record of any of it. Once I have finished paying off my vehicle I will never visit this dealership again. It is nothing but headaches dealing with them.

I just bought my wedding dress from here and I can honestly say it was the most flawless experience! I worked with a few of the employees here (Trish, Pauline and Pam) all of them were just amazing. They were all very helpful with finding the style I like and were very honest with what looked good and what wasn't the best option for me. All of my appointments ran so smoothly. Planning and getting ready for a wedding can be stressful so it was so nice to have the stress of dress shopping alleviated. Lots of brides come through this shop but the staff there make every contact so personable. I would highly recommend this shop to any bride to be. Great job ladies and thanks for all your help along the way.
This place is overpriced for what you get. I tried a salad and it was very bland and not very big. Save your money and go somewhere else.

Don't get me wrong, the food here is delicious. Our server was amazing. But it's really expensive. Over $50 for two basic pastas. There is no bread with your meal either. Also it's quite a small place, no really cozy or intimate seating, unless you get that one booth. To pay that much money and leave hungry is not acceptable. My companion and I both finished our meals, and had to go elsewhere for reasonably priced dessert. But hey, if you are rich and enjoy elbow to elbow dining, go for it. Food is awesome.

Review for the car sales department. 

After several visits over the last two years, one thing always seemed to be true. The sales staff wants your business, the management doesn't seem to care to earn it. Easy for me to say right? Well, in the last two years my extended family has purchased three new cars and one used. They all went to Sherwood Park Toyota as one option. Every time we left dissatisfied with the management and have since bought two Hondas, a Chevy and a GMC all in Sherwood Park. Price was def. an issue in most cases as Toyota seem very unmoving on price, but more then that, there is an attitude of Arrogance.
very bad dealing .if you go to finance centre very careful ,so much charge they will take.The product advisor giving a details totally different in finance centre.Also service is not free for new car

I was driving around the area waiting for my mom to finish with her appointment and looked around to find something to eat. I knew i wanted something healthy and yummy that would really hit the spot. Ive heard alot of good things about chopped leaf and thought what the heck might as well give it a go. The food is sooo yummy! The staff is super patient and kind. Im very indecisive and never ate here until today. The employee was super kind and made honest recommendations and was super bubbly, energetic and outgoing. I got the southwest salad! She was super informative and let me know theres also an option of a half order. Which was awesome! But its so yummy i wish i got a full order to eat later too! The half size itself is pretty big! And super filling. I cant believe how yummy it is! Healthy never tasted this good! Last but not least you could tell the employees actually enjoyed working there and had a great team.

Just had the best customer service.  I went in for two items their PC brand popcorn and Redoxon vitamins.  The line up at the one register that was open was really long.  One of the ladies from cosmetics offered to take people in line. She took the next lady who was in line and then I left to join them.  I have never heard of redemption days and this lovely cosmetics lady told me all about it and wrote it on my receipt.  She even offered to put whatever item I wanted on hold for me if I needed.  Now that's some great customer service.  

This is by far one of the best customer service experiences I have ever had.

Great place for an Italian dinner.  Jazz music, attentive staff, wine list and surprisingly large portions.  Prices are reasonable.  High ceilings.  Salads were good.  Cold initially inside but warmed up.  They are usually open for dinner.  Caesar salad was good.  Chicken pastas were good.  Smoked salmon and baby shrimp pasta was a little too salty for my liking: I suggest you use prawns as they are less salty.  Huge portions, so if you are on a budget you could share.  Ample free parking.

Canadians don't let winter get in the way of a good workout.  And whether I've been in Churchill, Whitehorse, Medicine Hat, or Sherwood Park, I have always found a big full service indoor community recreation centre available.  

My first visit to Millennium Place was during December when the sun came up at 9 AM, went down at 4 PM and it was -40 C outside.  It was after work and after plugging the car in at the hotel, I decided to stay in.  The room was comfy, the hotel restaurant and bar served my needs, and a quick indoor walk led me to the Millennium Center for a workout and some great people watching.  This place has almost anything you want - indoor ice rinks/soccer fields, gym, pool, track, fitness equipment, etc.  The hours are also convenient for almost any schedule and the one-off price is very reasonable.

Very nice and clean gym. Nice Staff and overall good environment. The hot yoga studio here is one of the best in the city compared to other goodlifes. My only complaint is how hard it is to get cellphone service especially since the "wifi" is only for audio.

As one of the newer gyms in Sherwood park I believe this world health location is definitely one of the better ones for people who are recently trying to obtain personal fitness such as myself or for people who are experienced already. From my personal experience I have never had a problem or negative moment with the staff. I feel like many of the staff at the front desk have tried to build a cheerful acquaintanceship with me with some even getting in on playing pranks/jokes on my friends that go to the gym as well as some of the trainers. However, being a human myself, I can understand how others have had not so great experiences. Everyone has good and bad days; even when I notice the staff such as the trainers discussing how they've had a long day and are tired, they put on a smile and enthusiastically encourage the people they are around to keep pushing themselves. In addition to this, the whole "feel" of the gym is one of a family atmosphere. What I mean by this is, everyone is respectful of each other and willing to help one another out. One example of how I've witnessed this is, a woman who appeared to be a professional body builder was asked by another normal woman for tips on how to properly do various back exercises to which the body builder graciously instructed her on proper form, etc. without a single ounce of annoyance in her person. It gave me this sense that the gym was welcoming to all and that everyone there was supportive of each and everyone's fitness goals. 

The overall facility is impeccably clean when compared to other popular gyms such as millennium place. ESPECIALLY IN THE WASHROOMS/CHANGE ROOMS! 
Even though the gym may be smaller than other gyms, the trainers definitely make use of the space, finding unique exercises to do within the limited space they have. These can range from challenging and exhausting to challenging but entertaining. 

Although I don't have children, I see the kids area of the gym as an important and defining aspect of the gym for parents who cannot find babysitters for their children. 

The group fitness classes I witness seem to have lots of people taking them, leading me to believe that it's a good idea for people who feel more comfortable working out in a group environment. 

The booster juice located in the gym has been very satisfactory for myself as sometimes I show up just after their closing time but they are still willing to make my drink even after they have cleaned all the equipment there. 

FINAL THOUGHTS:
Although this may not be the gym experience that everyone wants, it's the gym experience where I feel best inclined to keep up with my fitness. 
It's the gym where I will choose to go to from now on, it's the gym for me. 

Thanks to anyone who read this long review haha 
Hopefully it'll provide you with an accurate depiction of the gym!

Slower then hell. Been here 1 hour for 80 boards and 50 fence posts nobody else was here when I arrived so why is it I have to help load my wood on the trailer ? I paided over 1100.00 for this and now I got to help load my stuff when there are several other employees not helping anyone as I was in here first. And am the only one in here still?where the fuck is the people who should be loading me up and why was I doing it? I knew we should of went to Home Depot instead of Rona !

I went in for a wax after seeing good reviews online. I got there a few minutes early to fill out a sheet, but didn't get seen until almost 20 minutes after my scheduled appointment. Also, they apply oil immediately after waxing an area, which makes it extremely difficult to wax off any hair that was left. I haven't seen any other place that does that. I'm giving them two stars because at least the girls who work there are friendly and good at conversation.
Food is really good. Lamb curry is my favourite. They have affordable price and a good service staff is friendly

This review would have been a 5 star review until this week.

Been eating here for about the last two year, 3 to 6 times a month for lunch as the food taste great and the service is excellent and they have catered a few of our corporate events. it's a buffet do you see the food handling techniques and hand washing practices used, and it's always been excellent until this week. 


1. Instead of washing hands with soap and water like I have observed them doing for the last two years, they used Aloe Vera Hand Sanitizer, this does not dry instantly and leaves a film on anything you touch.

2. They ten proceeded to grad a take out container and touched the inside with hand containing un-dried hand Sanitizer and fill my order.

3. They them proceed to flatten the Naan bread and place it in the oven to cook.

4. Proceeded to take my payment while the Naan Bread is cooking.

5. Once again used Aloe Vera Hand Sanitizer instead of washing with soap and water.

Was probably one of the best Indian food locations I have eaten at until this change. Hopefully they re-implement proper hand washing techniques as I'm going to miss this place.

Great food and enthusiastic owners.  But, for me the prices make it a splurge location.  When I'm
Splurging I want all the frills and ambience too and this is a cafe. So, we may go once every few years but at this price it won't be a regular spot for us.  If you haven't been it is worth a try.

i went in there looking for makeup and there was an open package, the worker came over to me and my friend and she then continued to lecture us and get mad at us about this product that we didn't open, we just found it like that. we decided to go to a different shoppers because the customer service was terrible, but on our way way out we wanted to leave a comment about the employee. so i got the attention of another lady working and before i even got to speak she got mad at me for touching my drink to a cardboard stand. i told her i didn't mean to and she still got mad. absolutely awful experience. if you're going to go to shoppers you may as well go to the sherwood park mall one because that one is amazing.

Great fresh food for lunch! The three of us all had something different; the Popeye salad w grilled chicken, prawn salad rolls, and spicy chicken sandwich. All were very good. Friendly staff, clean restaurant. Visiting from USA but we come to Sherwood Park often to visit family. Happy there are non-burger options for a quick lunch in this neighborhood. Will def be back.

Awesome facility! There are tons of amenities to chose from, including: a pool, gym, youth zone, skating rink, and indoor fields. The facility is kept very clean and the equipment is well maintained. There's tons of parking available. Prices are also low in comparison to some of the City of Edmonton facilities. 

In the pool area, there are lanes for swimming, a diving area, hot tub, sauna, you name it. The wave pool is a lot of fun, especially when you're floating around on a  toy (of which there are plenty). In addition, there's an awesome little water park for kiddies to play on! 

You can use your own skates on the skating rink, but if you don't have any, you can rent some for a small fee. Be warned, it does take time for an attendant to come grab the skates for you, so be prepared for a bit of a wait. 

My one qualm is that they don't always stick to the schedule they post for drop in rec activities. Call in to make sure that the program is going to run when scheduled!

Amazing service. We drive past two other Volkswagen dealers on the way to this one and will continue to go visit this team. Everyone there has always been helpful. Josh, Moe, Anderson and Sharon all deserve props!

I have edited my negative review that I had posted after a series of unfortunate events in my dealings with Sherwood Park Toyota. Sometimes things go wrong, and sometimes they ALL go wrong with one customer amd that was me. 
Art Angielski met with two of us over a recent billing dispute and it has been resolved to my satisaction.
Had an excellent experience at Sherwood Park Toyota. Tyler was super great helping me to get my 4Runner with a great deal. Highly recommend Tyler to be your sales representative!

I loved everything about this place. I purchased my first membership via groupon. I must say the community vibe and service felt next level. That was until, I received a ten dollar charge as a "Late" cancellation fee. I had no idea that there was such a fee, and although I assumed it was a small fine print technicality that I signed for, there was no information about a cancellation fee when I found the original groupon. Furthermore, when I cancelled on the mind body app, there was no alert saying that if I did so that I would be charged. 

Every other service I use, whether it's for lashes, yoga, or even a medical appointment, I am at least alerted-obviously making me think about the decision more carefully. If I would have known about the charge, I would have went. 

I am not saying there shouldn't be a fee, I agree there should be. However to be fair, I wish I received some sort of warning.

I bought a car from them , a few weeks later the car stated to stall while driving, I took it back for repairs on 3 separate occasions, they said it was fixed but the same issue kept happening. We agreed it's better we do the exchange they advertise . They forced us to choose a car in 2 days, which we did . it was supposed to be a day or 2 process , 2 weeks later calling every other day to find out when I can go pick up the car , every time I called to speak with the GM(Moe) who authored the exchange I was told he's in a meeting and he's calling me back right away. . 1 month later I am still paying the old car , I am told the exchange is off after they pulled my credit again without my consent . No exchange car . Stay away from this place even if they are the only place to purchase from in town .

I have left this vet frustrated and confused twice now due to the lack of communication and poor bedside manner of Dr. Anwar.

My visits started with my small puppy's broken leg, upon the news that she needed surgery Dr. Anwar simply stated "needs surgery and a pin". I was upset and confused. He didn't explain the process, healing time, cost, or that she was in good hands once. I don't feel that pet owners should pull questions out of the vet about the procedure when you should educate on your field of expertise. Comforting owners that the procedures will go smoothly in your care is important as well. However, when I got home and had my male partner call in and ask about the results, Dr. Anwar was more than attentive.

Today my girl needed a bandage/splint change. Upon walking into the room Dr. Anwar did not address me, did not ask how she was doing, or how her healing journey was. I find this extremely disrespectful and dismissive. I constantly have to be the one to ask questions, and I am given one word replies. Again, I do not appreciate being treated lesser than my male partner - especially when I am the one showing up each time.

You need to provide the knowledge and updates to your patients owners, who are PRESENT in the vet clinic. I am responsible for her care, I need to know how things are looking, and how I could do better all when I am in front of your face. A male should not have to be there, or call in to get the respect you refuse to provide to the female owner present in the appointment.

Work on your bedside manner, it is pitiful. The vet techs could benefit from a course in customer service as well, the majority of the techs are miserable and it is not a pleasant experience.

I was quite surprised to see how high people rate a millennium place. I use the pool 5 to 7 times a week and every time I'm shocked by something new. I find the lifeguards to be very inconsistent, some follow and enforce the rules, others stand in groups chit chatting. I've seen teens making out in the lane pool more than once and noone says anything about it. I've been swimming laps when young "Tweens" hop in and take over-again noone says anything. The change rooms often smell like urine despite the fact I often see people cleaning. My 20 month old niece loves the tree fort play area so I guess it depends on what your looking for when you use the facility. I haven't been skating or to the actual gym for years so I don't feel confident commenting on those as things have undoubtedly changed

HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!!!

Also we both purchased remote starters, however only my husband's car got his remote starter done at that time as they told me my vehicle was a new style and they didn't have the remote starter ready yet. We were advised that it should arrive within  three months which it was fine to us. They told us that someone would contact us when it is ready and we can bring our vehicle in to get it installed.

We didn't hear anything from them until the end of July, we decided to contact themourselves. Then we asked whether he knew if we would get it before the winter time. He laughed and said for sure we would get that before winter.

This time, we patiently waited until the beginning of November which was more 6 months from the day we purchased both of our vehicles, called again  and got advised that the manager from service department would call us. The girl who helped us  - Ashley said that the remote starter had arrived but they were not allowed to book any appointments until they got an okay from their service manager. So basically, they got the remote starters but no one bothered to call their customers. We asked why they had to wait for her to be okay with it, the girl advised that the manager had to get a third party to install the remote and she would be mad if there was any appointment booked without her approval. No one called us again, when we called back, they told us to wait and the manager would call us. We said no, we would not wait for a call anymore, we needed to talk to someone about it.
