I recommend you not to try to come here. When we purchased the vehicles, they treated us so nice. Once you get the vehicle out of the lot, they are more than careless to you, to their customers. Horrible Customer service. My husband and I work in customer service industry as well and we have to tell you, SHERWOOD PARK TOYOTA customer service is the worst (from the management team to the staff).

My dog was improperly groomed at this location as a puppy. She is of a breed in which fur is not supposed to be shaved or trimmed. Despite my request NOT to trim or shave my dogs fur (she was there ONLY for a bath and brush), her entire bottom side and behind all legs were shaved which now results in fur that grows back much longer, more dense, clumped together and matted almost like dreads. As a result of this, I now have to take my dog for regular grooming appointments. Against my better judgement, I continued to take my dog to be groomed here. I pay an outrageous amount, over $100 for a bath/brush & nail trim, in addition to a shave only of the matted fur caused by the initial improper groom. I am by no means satisfied with the groom she receives here as my dog still comes home with matted fur. Despite this, I gave the groomers the benefit of the doubt because I found them to be friendly and they appeared to be good with my dog. That is until today, when I drove 45 minutes out of my way (I live out of town) to drop my dog off at 7 a.m for a groom, only to be called 10 minutes later asking me to come pick her up. According to the groomer, my dog was "too stressed out" and "panting" excessively. The groomer continued to explain that due to a new policy in place, "stressed out dogs" need to be sent home. While I am aware that my dog does not thoroughly enjoy being brushed (as I have done so, myself, numerous times), I have heard from several different groomers, following the dozens of grooming appointments my dog has had, that my dog was great, behaved perfectly and that there were no concerns. This particular groomer, who later identified herself as the manager, could clearly use some better training as I have never been made aware of any other groomer having the issue that she allegedly experienced. This manager was incredibly unprofessional when I arrived to pick up my dog and when I told her that I would not be returning, she said "good, your dog isn't welcome back." The issue is not my dog, the issue is poorly trained and uneducated staff and management. My dog coat has been ruined as a result of this. The service I received today was horrendous and I certainly will never return to this PetSmart, or any other PetSmart for that matter.

Love this local small business. They make some awesome pizzas and take care in crafting unique options. Always tasty, decently fast in making it for takeout. 

They even offer free pop or slushie while you wait for your order. This is gold while it's a small thing, the small things in life are sometimes the best. 

Bonus: they made the wrong pizza when prepping my order so they included as a free pizza with my correct order. It's awesome cause it makes one super happy customer (can't say no to free pizza) and it helps save on food waste!! 

Cheers! Will be a life time customer

Poor customer service and no pride in having a used vehicle properly prepared for sale. 

   I recently purchased a used vehicle from this dealership with 61k on it, when I agreed to the purchase I mentioned I wanted the scuffs scrapes and break dust (white car) taken care of which the salesman agreed. I went to pick up the vehicle and none of these things had been taken care of aside from minor damage to the rim was repaired. The salesman's job is to make sure these things are taken care of prior to delivery! A follow up date was to be arranged to have these issues rectified. After a week and many calls later i finally managed to reach the salesman and I agreed to have him come to my work, take the vehicle to have the required work done. I return to still see break dust on the paint , scrapes have not been taken care of. Not anywhere near acceptable, touch up paint still wrong colour, NEW DAMAGE was done to my front bumper by the person from the dealership driving my vehicle to be repaired. 

   I contacted the salesman regarding my disappointment as this is getting frustrating, to then be referred to the manager which is fine. The manager asked for pictures of the problem areas on my vehicle, which i promptly sent to him by email. It has been over a week and have not heard anything from them. I worked at a car dealership as a detailer for honda, I am 100% aware of what the expected condition of a used vehicle is supposed to be and this was not it. The way i've been treated in unacceptable, I was very understanding and cooperative but was not treated in the same professional manner once money changed hands. Ample time and opportunity were given to have these issues solved to no avail. 

As of writing this I am still without any response to my email with pictures of the issues with my vehicle and no one has attempted to contact me since. Feel free to make your own decision regarding this dealership, but I hope it provides a look into how they opperate. I don't wish this treatment on anyone.

I went to True Balance for bladder concerns. DR. Brown and his staff were very professional and helpful with my concerns. I opted to try the BLT Emsella chair.  I had 6 sessions at a cost of approximately 1100$.  Worth every penny of it. I noticed a improvement right away.   I now can laugh, cough , sneeze and workout with no concerns!!!  I wish I had this treatment years ago!!!

Had service done on my 2006 Toyota Tacoma 26 June 2012 at 08:15 hrs.

They originally stated from our phone conversation that I needed a certain service done, however I had the requested service done with them, and the issue was still apparent when I was about to leave.

To be honest, the issue was audibly noticeable!

I am rather frustrated how this got missed, and I ended up paying for something that did not need to be done :(

Also, I contacted the Service Manager, however they stated He was not in, and will have Him contact Me, have not heard back from Him as of yet.

This is getting rather ridiculous!

Went in this place to looking for wedding dress. No one never even bothered to help us!! We had to look for are selves!!! This place better start help people looking for what they need like a wedding dress because this Service sucks!!
This is worst service. They will charge doc fees of 630$ without actually knowing you about this. Josh(manager) is a good person but other staff are really rude.

I went here to pick up pizza last night and witnessed the owner yelling at his employees and berating them. I asked him if he was always so unhappy, and he said he was fine but his employees weren't able to follow his instructions so he had to get angry with them. I suggested he speak to them privately instead of yelling in front of so many customers and he told me to mind my own business. The young ladies working on the counter said he is always like that and they have figured out techniques to stay out of the line of fire and diffuse him. I told her there are other jobs out there and they did not have to put up with that crap. I will never go back.
We ordered take out and the food was great. The man on the phone lacked in customer service skills (gruffly asked "what do you want"), but otherwise great food and not to pricey

lesson learn - when you put a deposit and you ended up not buying their car, they will not refund the $1000.00 deposit.  The only thing that was communicated with me was that the deposit is used to hold the car.  Nothing about not being refundable if the dealer meets all the requirements. I guess it is in the fine print that was not clearly visible...I called and see if they can understand my situation but they are not willing to refund any kind of amount.  They said because they had to pay a new set of key and winter tires, they will be using the $1000.00 towards it.  So really in turn I paid for the keys and winter tire.  Sherwood Park Toyota also gave me financing which was way higher than what I could get approved for - almost 10%.  I went over to Sherwood Honda, and they were able to offer a much better car and much better financing rate.  My recommendation, please go to Sherwood Park Honda - ask for Jessie and Kenil.  I am no way related or in friends with Jessie and Kenil.

I usually do my aquasize in Edmonton but Sherwood Park is a brief commute for me and my friend and I wanted to try something different so we decided to come here.

First off I will say the staff were great. The instructor teaching the class was super high energy and really seemed to be enjoying himself. The lady at the front counter was also a real peach as we were running late due to getting lost so she allowed us to go and take the class and then come back out and pay when we were done so we wouldn't miss too much.

I will say much like other yelpers I did find the facility to be a bit old. Everything appears to be reasonably maintained though and it wasn't dirty at all in my opinion. My biggest gripe would be the fact there was so much water on the floor and the tiles are so smooth that I came very close to slipping and probably would have hurt myself had there not been a bar close at hand that I used to steady myself.

All in all it was a decent experience however. I think for locals who enjoy lane swimming or classes this is a good alternative to the far busier Millennium Place. Honestly it just didn't excite me enough to want to make that commute again though.

Shady AF. Patched a runflat tire... Told me they didn't. Cleared a bunch of codes before I went for a test drive... Said they didn't record them like that's some kind of a legitimate excuse. Said they went over it... Took it to another dealer (same brand as the one I purchased used from them) and they told me that it wouldn't have passed mechanical for several reasons. There's a long list of issues with this vehicle that they refused to cop to.... 
 
I don't know what they're like with new vehicles... But I wouldn't suggest buying used from them. Judging by the reviews on here... This has been going on for a long time and likely won't change anytime soon.

Had a great experience here. They were super accommodating to our group and even offered to pick up a cake for us from the Italian bakery because we went to celebrate a birthday. Great food everyone loved it. So glad we chose cafe Celeste!

Just spent the day shopping for cars on Sunday. I am a serious buyer and wanting to make decision in short order, which we have now done on Tuesday. Anyway, arrived at dealership 25 min before closing. Looked at cars for 15 min in show room with no one coming to assist us, but noticed 3 sales people talking and joking in one office. Finally asked reception for help and she replied "We are closing soon, I don't think anyone can help you". Well that is fine.... I can't help you with giving you my business either!

For a Tim Horton's, who in my opinion are not known for quick service, this location is outstanding. Early morning line-ups for the drive-thru are usually 10 cars strong, but they hammer through the customers in record time!

I usually go in to pick up my Friday morning breakfast. Line-ups are usually 6-8 people long, but you don't spend more than 3 minutes in line. Staff are courteous and efficient. Quality of sandwiches, BELTs and donuts is like any other Timmy's.

If you're looking for a quick, tasty morning experience as you head out on the road for work, this is a good choice!

You want a perfect definition of a buzzing community rec centre, go here! Every day, from open to close it is always buzzing.

When this place first opened I was amazed. I lived on the north side of Edmonton and would come here bright early 3 times a week to work out or play morning shinny hockey. Now that I've been a Sherwood Park resident for the past 10 years, I continue to come to this place because of it's selection of activities under one roof.

Swimming, jogging, exercising, hockey, indoor soccer, group classes, courts...it's the perfect community centre for Sherwood Park. It accommodates any age group perfectly. Children will love the indoor play area, swimming pool and skating rink. While adults ranging from 18-85 will enjoy the expanded exercise spaces, huge line of cardio equipment and the indoor track. The swimming pool has lane swimming, sauna, steam room and hot tub. Plus a large wave pool to play in.

Since they did the renovation/expansion a couple years ago, this place has gotten better. They included a drop-in kids area and large gymnasium and more group exercise class rooms. Plus expanded free weight areas. So it won't matter what time of the day you come, you should be able to get in a decent workout.

The best part of this place is that it opens at 5am and closes at 11pm. I really enjoy coming here first thing in the morning, the crowd is small and its nice and quiet. 

If you want to take in some great morning shinny hockey, go here! They start at 610-630am and it goes until 830am. I suggest you get here early, like when they open at 5am, it can get filled up quickly.
Our favourite restaurant in Sherwood Park. We love Italian and this place does not disappoint. The owner is great as is the menu and pasta!
My son and I stopped here  for a quick supper ,great place great food good service  , very nice place would be a great place to take a date or friends and family nice quiet and peaceful atmosphere
The food is great, staff was amazing but it is expensive and no bread, Italian restaurant need in my opinion a good bread. Will come back but not my go to Italian.

I don't normally write reviews, but after phoning in with a complaint & being accused of being dishonest & my daughter being accused of being dishonest I felt I need to caution others. After being a long time customer since they opened in Sherwood Park & before in St Albert, I could not accept the treatment my daughter received. When I phoned in to complain the treatment I received was just as rude & angry. I can guarantee if I had walked in he would not have spoken to me in that manner.
So here's the deal. a couple of months ago we bought some coupons through a hockey fundraiser for Nitza Pizza . Good cause, support a local business, (one we love), & glad that this business was supporting the community.
This is not the first time we have bought these coupons & we also know many in the community who buy them as well.  We know how it works,  we know you can't use them Fridays,( which is why last friday when all my kids were home we ordered three & paid for them,) and we know one coupon at a time, so we usually order an extra, however tonight my daughter & I were home alone & I was stuck at work, so I phoned her to put some supper on, she asked if we could get a pizza from Nitza's,  I said fine but how you going to pick it up ( she doesn't drive yet). She said her friend was over & that is what her family was doing for supper, (because they were both going to their perspective homes they didn't think both of them having a coupon would be an issue) perfect I also told my daughter if she wanted milk she would have to pick up a jug at Macs as we were out( I mean really pizza without milk, you gotta have milk.  The girls phoned in their orders would go pick up their perspective pizzas ,then her friend would drop her back off on her way home|(they live just north of us so this made sense.
The problem arises when they went to pick up. they found parking at the end of the lot as there was no spots open when they parked, my daughter ran to Mac's and her friend went and grab her pizza. My daughter went to get our pizza and the girl asked how she was going to pay and she gave her the coupon. The owner started yelling at her saying "Are you with the other girl?" &  you can't use that. He continued to yell & tell her she was dishonest, everyone was staring at her she said she felt like she had been caught stealing or something.She said he continued to swear and tell her she was f-ing lying and that she was going to pay for that pizza.  She tried to explain, and all she got out was umm. By this time she was embarrassed and just wanted to leave so she said fine I can pay and he yelled at her that he didn't want her money, and then walked away telling the girl at the cash to make sure she paid. He accused them of parking down the way so they could hide, and when I phoned in  he was saying there were three spots right in front, which my daughter said  vacated after they had parked. When I got home after work, I found my daughter crying and very upset, when I inquired why, she explained what took place, so When I phoned in to complain about his assumption, rudeness & foul behaviour towards my daughter he continued to talk over me, when I asked him to let me explain why the girls were together,he started telling me how I was dishonest & that my daughter was a liar. I asked him to please listen to what I had to tell him I had not had a chance to explain, He just kept asking if I was done yet & would not listen. So Sir yes I am so done. I have been in the customer services business for 39  & I have seen it all. So I understand your distrust, however had you actually calmly asked if they were together, she would have explained for lack of better term, they were ride sharing, and no they were not eating supper together. I even offered him the other families phone number to follow up. He didn't want no number.
He saw two young girls and jumped to an assumption and a conclusion, which were totally wrong. He also told me I didn't pay for that pizza so he is losing money. Well... first we did pay for our pizza and my daughter brought home a coupon which we also paid $15 for ($4.00 of which goes to the fundraiser)  So I think $11.00 for a cheese pizza he did not lose money.
He has lost a long time customer who actually promoted his business, which now all stops. We teach our children to not bully in school, I will be damned if I let a business be a bully.
Shame on you sir for how you behaved, you may be helping the community, but you are setting a poor example of how to be a human being.
If It had been me in your shoes, I would have calmly asked the questions Are you together & did you know the rules of the coupon, they would have been given an opportunity answer, (which I know didn't happen because of how you spoke to me on the phone) Once they explained their position, I probably would have given them the benefit of the doubt  & told them that they couldn't do that next time because of untrustworthy customers.
Such a wonderful buffet. Best lunch service in Sherwood Park. Highly recommend their lunch buffet.

Feb.21,2018 we visited Sherwood Park Toyota,looking at Rave 4's. Found one we liked but decided to wait to make final decision. Charles Ho suggested we put a deposit down to hold it for 3 days. I was against it but he convinced us they would refund with no problem if we changed our mind so we did. Feb. 22 we called Mr. Ho and told him we couldn't go through with it and would he credit our card with the deposit. He said he would. Today March 15 I received my statement and they had not returned our deposit. We called several times,finally talked to Charles . Again he said he would ASAP. We called later and nothing.Finally emailed him and the Finance dept.called wanting our card information so she could refund. This was a lot of unnecessary frustration for us,and we were very unhappy with the way it was handled. Not even an apology was offered. We are long time Toyota customers (28 years)  sure didn't leave a good taste the way they handled this.

Came to Kinsmen Leisure Centre yesterday for a toddler birthday party.

My review is for the amenities used for the toddler play & party room.

The play room is for children 6 & under.  It had optional black lights throughout the room which the kiddos loved!

There were plenty of slides, climbing structures, giant foam building pieces, gymnastic mats, and a rock climbing wall!

It was clean, it was bright, it was spacious!

Adjoining the playroom was a large party room with tables, chairs, washroom, sink, counter area.

My only complaint is that my kiddos could see & smell the pool which led to incessant requests to go swimming... So we will likely go swimming today!

I think the mom said it was $170 for 2 hours.  Balloons & piñatas are not allowed due to the air intake system.

Overall, I'd give it a 9 out of 10!  2 hours is a pretty tight window to set up, play, eat, open presents, and clean up.  The next group was waiting for us to leave at the 2 hour mark.
never buy a car from here.useless no service covered.nothing say properly

Normally I am not one to go out of my why to address these kinda of issues. However the Finance Director Leanne was above and beyond the rudest person I have ever spoken to....she continued to take my complaint as personal instead of business....saying that my complaint is harmful to her which it is not. She continued to say before I even had a chance to speak that I was being rude to her which I was not....considering she dominated the entire conversation. It was so apparent I would not go anywhere by trying to settle this issue with her that I chose to just let it go.

I went over the car and found so many issues. I was disappointed in the cleaning....its less quality than what I can perform on my own in my garage. I paid 200 for this package.


When we purchased the car.......there were leaks from the start. It had taken three oil changes to find out that our engine gasket was not properly on and it had to be repaired. Over all.....poor service, lack of class, lack of detail, no above and beyond bullshit like the other posters said.....this dealership is no longer getting my service or money.

It was finally time to find a new place... I was still driving to St. Albert, even though I've moved to Fort Saskatchewan and work on the southside.  After a quick yelp and google search, Bare Affair seemed to be exactly what I was looking for.

It's a pretty small space, but they make good use of it.  They have many kinds of wax and they ask a lot of questions to determine the best choice for your skin.

The process is virtually pain free, and fairly quick.  It's definitely a thorough job and I like that they offer a slightly reduced price for those who come back within 4 weeks.

Valerie does a great job.

I've been to Lakeside twice now with the kitten I'm fostering and I have to say I'm really impressed. 

They have day, evening, and weekend appointments.  And they have office cats!  Yes, you read that right!  Adorable balls of purr walking around the office.  

My appointments have been on time thus far and the staff and vets alike have been great!  Everyone I k is who comes here raves about Lakeside.  

And access us a breeze - less than 5 minutes off the Anthony Henday west on Wye Road.

Lakeside is the purrfect Animal Clinic for all your furry friends!

All of the extra packages bought as insurance such as interior exterior tires etc....all of it was useless and a waste of money.

We're not covered for anything. Nothing. No only did we pay thousands and thousands above the asking price for the 4runner new and off the lot but we find out that most of our packages had extremely small warranty time frames regardless of purchasing extended 5 year warranty. 

Rust protection is void...ran out within a short time of it being bought. Rust around the emblem on the hatchback. Received a quote for 1000 to fix it. 

We paid top dollar for a fully loaded limited 4runner with all the packages and whistles.....we were duped into the packages. NONE of them were used or had the ability to be used. Basically meaningless pieces of paper worth thousands in our real dollars.  


I've never hated one dealership more. It's so hard to enjoy a vehicle you love when you have to deal with being conned throughout the whole process of owning it.
Terrible customer service simply cancelled my order rather than trying to make it up to me or offer a solution

Absolutely rude employees. The manager there is not so nice whatsoever. They have a very very rude pharmacist that works in the pharmacy that  ask very unappropriate questions. It seems like all of these employees that work in this shoppers are Rude and snobby. Not a very good climate to be shopping in.

I can't believe  that I haven't heard more about this little gem tucked away in an obscure area of Sherwood park. It was recommended to me and a friend after our massages close by. Really glad she did. Super cute but small inside. I could see how this place would be full on a weekend. However, on a Tuesday at lunch it wasn't too full. We had an incredibly charming server who was super knowledgeable on the wine and food menu. Helped us choose a bottle of wine which was amazing and help us on the menu choices. Menu is pretty much standard Italian fair with the usual amount of selections and diversity between appetizers, salads, entrees and pastas. I decided on the seafood pasta and my friend who was more peckish feeling choice the cheese plate. Both were outstanding in taste and presentation. So much high quality seafood packed in the bowl and a huge portion. I only ate half and the other half did me nicely the day after. And the cheese plate looked fantastic. To me, this is well worth the price they charge for their food. Definitely will be back.

I love the food here. It is a bit pricey for the atmosphere (you go up to order), but the quality is high. I've been a few times and have always found the staff to be effective but kind of rude. I can't describe it, but it's just little things like when I ask what soup they have she pointed to the sign silently instead of just saying it, or they seem kind of impatient if you are deciding. Just not really friendly. But they are fast and work well. I'll be back.

I called this business looking for information on continuing training for my puppy who has been to basic obedience. When the trainer answered the phone and I told her I was calling to get info about her dog training courses she  told me to go ahead. I began explaining a little about my dog and his previous training which included Puppy 1 at a major pet store. She interrupted me and told me that was useless information and means nothing to her.  When I said I was just trying to give her some background she became very sarcastic. She started telling me about the program and began with "we don't offer group classes..." I said " I'm sorry, I saw it listed on your website and thought you did." She said, "if you would let me finish, we don't offer it until you've gone to orientation and a private session." I apologized for interrupting her and for having gotten off on the wrong foot. She responded to this conciliatory effort by telling me it was my fault we got off on the wrong foot because I was defensive about her telling me she didn't want to hear about Puppy 1. She then proceeded to rant about people who waste her time with useless information about things like Puppy 1 that aren't in anyway standardized. I told her I was trying to explain what we learned in that class so she could just suggest a starting point for me. She told me that she can't do a 2 hour phone consultation, that's what orientation is for and if that's my dog barking in the background then I need specialized help because he's beyond basic help and isn't fit for group classes. She didn't ask what he was barking at or anything (he was barking at a rabbit in the back yard). She was so rude it was quite shocking. I didn't call with any specific type of training in mind. I wasn't necessarily looking for group classes or private classes specifically. All I wanted was some information about her services. At the beginning of the call when I stated that I was interested in training for my dog, all she had to do was tell me that she requires potential clients to attend an orientation and there was one that night that I could attend. Dog training isn't just about knowing how to teach dogs, it's also about working with people. This woman failed miserably at that part of her business and that was just in answering a phone inquiry. I can't imagine what she'd be like to work with and after how horribly she treated me, I will never take the time to find out. The only reason I even gave one star is because Yelp won't let me post with zero stars.

This is one of the few restaurants in town that serve a clam linguine & I was not disappointed. I'd have added a photo but it smelled too delicious not to dig in & there was nothing left when I was done. Highly recommend this quaint little place. We were there on a Tuesday night & while there were a number of ppl there it never did get full. I blame the cold weather.  I have no  doubt with food like this they are hard to get into without reservations most nights, and probably impossible most weekends. Prices are comparable for a higher end place and certainly not unreasonable as portion sizes are generous. Our waitress was an absolute darling & let us spend the entire evening chatting, regularly topping up our water. The bathroom room is adorable and super clean. The decor beautiful. The room size is small. So either make a reservation or go early...but definitely go if you want some really good pasta. I don't often give a full 5 but this place deserved it.

This is just not my favourite pizza. Which considering it is the REST of my family's favourite pizza makes me feel like there is something wrong with me. 

I love that the staff are always so friendly and that you get a free slushie with your order. I am just never thrilled with my pizza. Is it fine? Absolutely. Would I rather eat pizza from nearly anywhere else? Also yes. 

That being said the Donair pizza was always something my family raved about.
It was great experience. The food was delicious. The paneer mutar and papadi chat were super testy. The naan was so soft and delicious. Looking forward to going again. Ok

I've previously been to Cafe Celeste but they have recently moved into a beautiful location. Which is right around the corner from our home! I booked reservations for tonight and when you walk in it's warm and extremely inviting. The last location they were at I found was very cold and uninviting so this is a huge plus for them. 

Tonight we ended up going with a bottle of Cabernet Sauvignon which was a great pairing with our appetizer and dinner. The appetizer we went with was the sausage crostini which was wonderful - I did find it odd that it was 5 pieces of bread which we had to decide who would get the last piece and we both wanted it. I had the chipotle rose with penne and chicken and it was great. Nice and spicy when I think of chipotle. My husband had the $44 lamb and pesto cream penne. He said the pasta was phenomenal but the lamb he said was not good in anyway. He said it was extremely bland. Not even pepper or salt to season it. Which sucks as it is one of the most expensive dishes on the menu. We will stick to just pasta if we came again.

Greetings,

I had the most pleasant and enjoyable experience today at True Balance.  "Amy" is certainly a welcoming representative of True Balance, as she ensures positive comfortability. 

"Cassie" completed my Botox treatment and I can honestly say that she is exceptional!  I tend to fear needles, Cassie was compassionate/kind/intelligent and clearly has great experience with the injections.  My overall experience was outstanding.  The injections were a breeze! 

Kind Regards,

Carrie
Great food and great staff.  Wish they had a bigger location as it can get busy but worth the wait if you have to

Went in there 3 years ago to buy my grad dress. Selection is absolutely amazing to choose from. Such an amazing store to have Sherwood park. The lady that was in there was very amazing and helped us a lot. Very good customer service. I'll definitely be back in the near future maybe to look for my wedding dress.

The poor rating is for treatment of the staff.  With first hand experience I can tell you we had to fight with Peter for our daughter to be compensated for the shifts she worked. Our persistence paid off eventually. His use of profanity directed at these kids is unacceptable.   Being a customer previously I had only seen a wonderful side of Peter. Kind, happy and engaging. Be warned as we know our experience is not isolated.

I traded in my 2 door, 2013 Toyota Tacoma with this dealership over the Christmas break and have had nothing but troubles ever since. It appears they sold me a truck with a faulty front tire. I contacted them twice (once in person, once via phone) to get it resolved, but simply got the run around.

Three months later my new truck broke down (flat tire) at 2am and in -35c weather as we were returning from a hockey tournament. I called them up again to have the situation taken care of and was told there is nothing they can do about it. SERIOUSLY! 

This is completely UNACCEPTABLE! Toyota is a great product, but this dealership is not doing them justice. There are other Toyota dealerships in the Edmonton area, take it from me and DO NOT buy form Sherwood Park Toyota. You and your family deserve better!

I've been going here for about 5 years now for Botox treatments for my tension headaches. First and foremost... Holly is wonderful. She remembers conversations from 3-4 months before, is personable, and always does as an amazing job. She makes you feel comfortable during the entire process, and it's always painless and quick. The ladies at the front desk are always a pleasure as well. I can't say enough good things about this place!

Greetings,

I've been shopping at the Cloverbar location for over 10 years, I have to ask if it's under new management.  Note:  this review is no reflection of the pharmacy, as the owner and staff there are amazing!

18OCT31 (7:30 pm) I took a return to the cosmetic counter;  the young lady working at this counter was very kind and professional. Thanks!

After encountering a very stressful and terrible experience with this dealership, I feel obligated to warn others about this place and its staff and give my honest opinion. I drove up to Edmonton from Calgary in search of a new car. I ended up landing a deal for a Certified Pre-Owned car at this dealership and ended up getting the vehicle for a good price. However, the headache begins with dealing with the finance manager Mike Brar and the general manager Moe Fayad. Mr. Brar will do everything in his power to take advantage of you when going over options, warranty and financing. He did a terrible job of explaining anything and ended up tricking me into extended warranty that cost MUCH more than any other dealership (about $900 to $1500 more depending on the vehicle you purchase). I went in 18 hours later to have it cancelled and was told it can never be refunded. Apparently there are 2 kinds of extended warranty: one that cannot be cancelled called "CPO Assurance Premium" and another one called VW extended warranty which can be cancelled within 60 days. I was never described the difference between the two, what they cover, or whether they can be cancelled or not. Sure, I was naïve and should have asked more questions and read more carefully, but the way they treated me as a new customer after purchasing a vehicle from them was atrocious. I have never felt more like a piece of garbage that doesn't matter than I did when dealing with Mr. Brar and Mr. Fayad. They truly did not care and only wanted to make a dime off of me. Mr. Brar also snuck in an extra finance payment without telling me, and he also didn't take a second to apply VW's special financing rate. His excuse: they run a business. So not only did he screw me on the extended warranty, he didn't even care to do his job properly and apply the correct financing to the vehicle. Long story short: don't deal with these scam artists. Take your business elsewhere, to a place that cares about their customers and helps them when they are upset or confused. This dealership is slimy and only out there to make a dime off you and take advantage of you. I just want to warn everyone out there that if you choose to make a deal at this dealership, you better be on your game because they will scam you.

I had a great appointment at bridal debut! My consultant was Shelley, and she guided me through my very first wedding dress shopping experience. I told her what I was leaning towards, in terms of dresses, but I also told her that I wanted to try on all the silhouettes, just to see. She didn't limit the amount of dresses I tried on, and  encouraged me as I learned what I liked. She did a great job explaining all of our options, like holding another color underneath so we could see what it would look like with a blush undertone. This is a fantastic store with some fantastic dresses!!

I only was there to pick up my boyfriends dog and the assistants aren't very nice. I take my dog somewhere else and these guys don't even compare to customer service and friendly staff. They act like they don't want to be there and really didn't make me feel wanted or comfortable. Definitely not recommended

Started going to True Balance in Sherwood Park for Laser Hair Removal, and was so pleased with the result that I go there now for everything and anything they offer.  Some of the Services that I have had personal experience with are:

Laser Hair Removal - Perfect technicians who look after you and despite finding yourself in some compromising positions, they remain poised and professional.  I have had Legs, Bikini, underarm all lasered with terrific results.  I don't even have a razor at home anymore!

Facials - I have done the eye supreme and found that my dark circles under my eyes were much better, even got compliments!

Peels - I have had several peels done through the last years at True Balance.  I was very happy with the results.  Staff listened to all my questions and fears about Peels and were able to put me to ease.  I was so happy with the first peel, I have gone back for more!

Botox - As I suffer from Migraines, I have used the medical staff at True Balance to completely remove Migraines from my life.  It is so effective, the staff so knowledgeable, that I often forget the skill involved with this procedure.  I have steered others to try out this solution for Migraines as it has completely transformed my life.  I would not trust anyone else to do this procedure for me.

I feel like a new person when this procedure is done and I book as often as I can.  Truly feel pampered!

Makeup - I was happy to open up my Christmas present to find the True Balance line of Makeup.  It is some of the best I have every had.  Long lasting and beautiful.  Compliments me perfectly.  And as I have very sensitive skin, it is great to have the mineral makeup to use.

I can't say enough about the Staff, the Medical Staff, and the other practitioners.  From massages to medical appointments, I have nothing but good things to say about True Balance.

I booked an appointment for 2 STUBBORN blemishes. I was told upon inspection that they were in no shape to be extracted. I appreciated the honesty and I booked an appointment for 4 weeks out for the extractions and laser hair removal. The office it a cross between a spa/clinic it was VERY clean and felt very safe being there in our Covid world blocking forward to actually being able to use their services.

I feel I'm in a good position to review Lakeside as I have been going since 1996. I stayed with them because of first impressions. It was an emergency for my cat & Dr. Scheinbein was the only vet then. It was after hours, but he answered from home & rushed back to the clinic & opened for me. 
I just read a recent negative review of Dr. Anwar, who's been there well over a decade,  and I must defend him. He is very caring and an excellent surgeon. He fixed my 9 year old retrievers cruciate ligament (difficult surgery) & he's never had an issue since. He IS very quiet & somewhat serious (I get a chuckle out of making him smile), and often one must enter into the conversation, BUT he does give that information. There has not been one time that he hasn't called me back when I've had concerns, never rushing me & sometimes calling back just to follow-up. He has agreed to come to my home on 2 occasions to euthanize our beloved old men, so they could feel more comfortable at home, which is a wonderful service. 
I have experienced many front end staff, and will admit there have been a few stoic ones (I prefer super friendly), but I give the new ones this- it's been Covid, tough, and they have gone through some staff shortages so have been transitioning- they're getting better. 
I'd love to see them in a new location, as think it's time for a bit more space. The waiting room is very small. I wouldn't have stuck with them if I didn't feel confident my pets well cared for.. and they have been.

Terrible Service when I called to file a complained about my flowers dying within  12 hours. No refunds. They lie over the phone and refuse to answer the phone when they know that it is you calling to speak to the manager. I spent 80$ on flowers that died less then 12 hours later.

Omg finally some good pizza. 
This reminds me of order in pizza when I was a child in the 70-80s. ()

Excellent toppings, great prices and I got a free 8 inch with my two for one pizza deal. 

We got a Greek, ham and pineapple, it had a funny name like tropical pig. Plus the free cheese 8inch. 

Super nice staff and they delivered to our acreage which was amazing. 

My 9 year old wrote a note saying. We can only order from Nitza. So all generations were sold on it. 

AND If you pick up it says you can get all the slurpees  you can carry!

AND they have a kitchen tour tor kids (not on now due to covid.
Shoutout to Vanessa who groomed my golden today he looks gorgeous!This location always has great customer service.Thanks again.

My usual waxing place was unavailable so I turned to Yelp to find a place that specializes in brows. I don't mind the cheap places when it comes to body waxing but for brows... I've spent a lot of time growing these bad boys back since the over plucking days at high school. I need a guarantee that I can trust the person not to leave me with half an eyebrow or undo all the good work I've done getting them back to a natural look. 

I text to make an appointment. Text! - so easy! I got an appointment with Nichole who happens to be the owner too. I don't know what I was expecting but was blown away when I walked in and the waiting area had gorgeous big sofa's with stylish mirrors above, the check in desk has a few items for sale including brow pencils and the shelves at the back are full of brow make up, fake tan products and different waxes.

I went through to the service room and it is very comfortable and well decorated. There was a cool print of James Dean on the wall. I was diggin' the vibes. I filled in a form as a new customer which asked about redness or breakouts etc. Because of the answers I gave she chose a tea tree wax which prevents breakouts after waxing. She mentioned she stocks like 20 types of waxes as she is a waxing specialist. Not just for her recommendations but also some people have a favourite brand so she likes to stock all the best products.

After a pain free wax and brow tint we had a good old chat before I left. She recommended products (in conversation not in a pushy way) on how to achieve certain looks, perfect the arch and be able to keep the look up at home. I was so impressed and the price was completely reasonable too. I don't even mind driving to Sherwood Park for the service. For a brow wax it totally exceeded my expectations!

Would advise anyone that's look for a car to NOT go here. Bought my used bmw from them and the front tires are completely bold. But they're saying the tires are fine. (I bought the car in winter and I had my own set of winter wheels and tires to drive on) and wouldn't do anything about it because "I signed the inspection" I trust them on the inspection but they're saying after I signed it it's non if their business. And the car was tuned with aftermarket tuning that was not declared to me. And at first they won't remove it for me. All the way until I contracted Amvic and they took action. Shady business  with snake management. Either bring your own tech. Or just steer away from this dealership.

Bridal debut was a great store and highly recommended. 

We accidentally showed up early for my appointment but they accommodated us very well by letting us use the time to browse and select dresses. My consultant was Dori and she was fantastic. I loved the selection of dresses and they were all very reasonably priced. They carry a lot of Maggie Sottero which is my favourite brand - so it was great to finally try on some of her dresses. This was my 4th out of 4 appointments (I am from out of town so I had all 4 appointments in one weekend)
I fell in love with two dresses at this store and it was a hard choice between the two. Dori helped me as much as she could and put me back in both dresses to help me decide. Myself, my mom and my bridesmaid left to get lunch and debate between the to, and I came back and made my purchase. It was an overall great experience (the best dress selection of all salons I've been to)

The ONLY downfall to this salon is that you have a smaller change room than all other salons I've been to and you are in a common area instead of a private room. Therefore you are sharing the pedestals and mirrors with other brides. I was unfortunately sharing the area with a much pickier bride who spent her time on the pedestal - even when my bridesmaid made comments outloud about me waiting to see my dress on the pedestal before I switched out of my dress she continued to stay up there. I am a short bride and was trying on mermaid style dresses on a pedestal was necessary. My consultant ended up getting me a footstool to standup on and use a changing room mirror.  Also there are only a few chairs for people to sit on so if you bring a large crowd they should expect to stand and it kind of over crowds the area. 

Overall though fantastic experience and I am extremely happy with my dress choice!!

My grandson & I got the meal for 3 and it was outstanding.  The chili chicken was sweet & not hot...loved it.  The paneer was tasty and the samosas were spicy goodness. The naan was perfect for scooping up the amazing veg korma.  Being so close to where I live this could be dangerous..lol.

I purchased flowers online from Funky Petals. I chose them for little more than their funky name but I can tell you now that their service is AWESOME. The recipient wasn't available at work to collect the flowers as arranged and instead of simply leaving them at reception, Funky Petals connected with her directly to find a time/place that was more suitable for her (all the while keeping me informed of what was going on). It meant re-making the arrangement to do it. Flowers aren't always for happy occasions and I'm so pleased they went the extra mile in this case. THANK YOU.

A friend of mine took me here and for been a small and cheap place to eat Indian food is pretty good, I love chicken butter but if is to heavy I can't eat to much but this one I could eat all of it! The prices are excellent and they give you a lot of food for the price!! I got a special that they have is 5.99 and is chicken butter with rice and nan bread and the ration is pretty good for the price is not big but is not really small I think is just perfect!!! I will go again to try the rest of the menu!!

Been here 4 times now...4 times they have been out of their prawn salad rolls...or all salad rolls. Unbelievable way to run a buisness.
What food I have been "lucky" enough to sample has been pretty good...but I can't see very far past their inventory issues.

If you want their salad rolls..maybe call ahead...or try othef location in Sherwood Park!

They cancelled and changed my appointments for BHRT consults TWICE, they neglected to even call the first time. I book these things months in advance so that I can do it on my days off because I am not able to take extra time off for this- zero respect for their patients time. 
How am I supposed to trust these people to correct hormonal imbalances if they cant even manage to keep a damn appointment straight?!

We went to take our small kids to the pool.  After reading and hearing such great things, I suppose I had high expectations.
The swimming pool was packed to the extreme, I would think to the point of being dangerous.  There are so many toys allowed, that on top of the number of people it made navigating the pool very difficult.  The tree house was very interesting, but there are slides which go off each side of it .... which means the kids can down any which way and as a parent of toddlers I couldn't be at the bottom of each slide.  Also, there is almost no natural light in this facility.
The absolute worst part of our visit was the family change room.  One narrow walkway which has lockers on one side and individual change rooms on the other.  People coming, going, and waiting all crammed into a very narrow space.  If I ever go back (which I won't) I would never choose the family change room.
The only positive thing I have to say is that the cost was a little cheaper than at the Edmonton facilities.

Great value for money!
We got their family meal deal which included 3 main courses or curries along with rice, naan and a dessert. I think the quantity was just right for what we paid. They added in a couple of samosas along with our order. Samosas were good but not the best that I have had in Edmonton. The curries were spiced just right and the naan was soft and not too chewy. 
I would definitely try some more combinations of curries and main courses to get to my desired combination.

Well, I don't understand any of the negative reviews!  My daughters and I (yes, daughters) had wonderful experiences and both of my girls purchased their dresses there with Pam as an awesome sales associate.  My girls were being married 3 months apart and I have nothing but great service, patience, beautiful (stunning) gowns, and wonderful follow up. My daughter ordered special lace and had a few other special requirements.  Also, we received a discount on the gowns although the discount time was technically over. We had to juggle COVID-19 also as my daughter was supposed to be married in April.  Yes, we booked ahead and made a special trip to Edmonton each time during the week to avoid the busy weekends.  I highly recommend Bridal Debut!

Funky Petals is a big supporter of local businesses from where they are getting product to what they do in the community. 
They use a lot of local growers for their products and the way they last, and they also will add products such as cookies and chocolate ect. from so many local small businesses. It almost makes this a one stop shop for any gifts you are looking for. 
Also they do a lot of work in the community donating flowers to senior centres as flowers are known to help in dementia cases. 
For me Laurie and the staff have been very helpful every time I enter, you will not find a better place to buy flowers or any gifts for that matter. 
The quality of care, the way the flowers last so long, attention to detail all add up to a five star place to do business in my mind.

Once again I am thoroughly impressed with the food and the atmosphere.
My wife had Penne Pesto Cream and I had the Habanero Marsala. The food is so good that I could eat it every day.
My wife is pretty much vegetarian and the server helps to select and work with kitchen to make the perfect meal.
I will return again.

Highly not recommended because I brought the my girlfriends van in for a oil change a month ago and just found out the drain plug to drain the oil wasn't tightened it was hand tight I am not impressed as you they could wreck the engine if it would have lost more oil out we only lost about a litter of oil and I won't be taking the van to any mr lube again

Fast.

I visit Millenium Place regularly, even though I'm a proud Edmonton resident. MP in Sherwood Park just does the rec. centre a little better. 

They have the basics covered. It's clean, afforadable, bright and spacious. The employees are mostly friendly and helpful. There is always someone stationed at designated spots to assist. I frequent the children friendly areas of MP, as I often travel with a small herd of children. 

I'm as comfortable in their pool section as I can get in any public swimming space. At peak times (weekends, holidays) it's loud and crowded and not very enjoyable at all. I would suggest avoiding these times altogether as to not tarnish your opinion of this super fun space and instead plan a trip on a random weekday (if you have the luxury of doing so). Neat pool toys and many options keep everyone in our clan entertained for a few hours.

The play place is relatively new, is supervised and seems really fun.  

The skating rink(s) are delightful. A pond and a larger rink are both well maintained.

The food court is sub-par. The food offered is greasy and just not very good quality. I've seen this at other rec centres as well. I'm so confused as to why fitness facilities offer trashy food. We pack our own lunch always. I do appreciate that they have a Second Cup. 

I would recommend Millenium Place to friends and do intend to visit again and again.

I was getting flowers for my mom because she lost her job of 18 years today and the fact that they were going to wait for me past closing without even knowing that was amazing! And they helped me choose an amazing arrangement, highly highly recommend!!!

I don't think I've ever been so frustrated. Sherwood Park Toyota really sucks. They just don't care post sale. It's obvious they make too much easy money. I don't think I'll buy another at this point.

I was really happy with the staff who were checking ID and immunization QR codes when I came here to take my kid to Sportball. The facility seems to be in good repair and the mini gym where sportball was held was well maintained and the venue had ample parking.

I am definitely interested in taking the kid here again someday to check out the toddler play structure when it is available. The pool looks nice. I haven't swum here in over 20+ years so I really can't adequately review it nowadays but I have fond memories of swimming here in any case.

Beautiful quality flowers delivered to my acreage home from friends. Very impressed by the freshness, selection and design. Good customer service in that they called ahead to see if someone would be home to receive. Can't believe how fresh and beautiful they are!

Hi,

Back in February of 2019 I bought a dark silver/Charcoal VW TDI Highline wagon from Sherwood, I live in Calgary, and they are from the Edmonton Area. The pictures of the vehicle looked great online, carfax looked clean and the sales associate was also pretty good and easy to work with. We did a little bartering and ended up on a price that we could all agree on. I will admit that they made the deal easy as they actually would deliver the car to my door, which I though was a really slick service for a long distance buyer.

I bought the car sight unseen, trusting that any damage would be disclosed as I am dealing with a reputable VW dealer and not a middle of the mall dealership. Upon delivery, it was cold and snowy the car obviously arrived covered in snow, which really did not let up for the month of February, along with frigid temperatures,. Within 3 days the battery in the car car stopped working, I could tell the battery was weak on the second day or third day oownership when the car struggeld to start in temps around -10. On top of that the car was obviously jumped recently as the battery cover was left open. I contacted my Sales associate and they took care of the cost of the battery and I installed it myself. This I thought was a very amicable deal for both parties. I did tell my sales associate at that time that I had noticed some hail damage on the hatch of the wagon which was not disclosed during the sales cycle. I told him that I wouldnt be worried about it, if I found no other evidence of hail. 

Well Spring finally came and the car got its first wash, and I noticed that the car is covered in hail damage, not massive dents but there are quite a few on the hood, on the roof infront of the sunroof, as well as behind the sunroof, and on the hatch where i first noticed them to begin with. This being a month and half into ownership, I felt strange contacting the dealership, but at the same time felt wronged as I was not informed about any of this, and the dealership even up-sold me on 3M wrap on the front of the car, which I gladly did, as I like to keep my cars looking good, its at this point that the detail guys installing the wrap would have had to have noticed the hail (If it hadnt been noticed by anyone before, which I find hard to believe). Needless to say that all may now might need to be removed to allow for a new hood (if paintless dent repair costs out weight it).  I contacted my sales agent, he got back to me quickly, he informed me that the he had forwarded the inquiry to the manager. I followed up with a call, and an additional email to the manager, and that was now two weeks ago. I have had no follow up conversation, or even a slightest inclination of concern about the damage or even an the slightest of attempts to rectify the situation.

I write this to provide caution to all long distance buyers, to either get videos, or additional pictures, write something in about refusal to accept the car if it has hail damage, or better yet go look at the car yourself, as I am disappointed with the lack of disclosure, or even attempt to rectify by this dealership

Simply great pizza! Donair pizza is among my favorites! Tried it on the recomendation of a great friend a few years back, and now rarely order from anywhere else. Prices consistant with the industry, and quality has yet to disapoint!

Really... find all the locations in Sherwoid Park to be pretty solid.
Stopped in via drive through this morning for a quick breakfast after a late night of drinking. Hit the spot!

Absolutely amazing!  I came in on the evening of December 16th to pick up some flowers for my mom for her birthday. The financial always said that everything will be cover for the first 4 years but they even ask me to pay 100$ in the third service just to check the fucking break. I would not recommend any body want to purchase the car here.

I've purchased 2 vehicles from this dealership, and although the sales experience was good, and they have some innovative stuff on their website - you can chat with them 24/7 and allow for online quotes that are a discount from what you'd get otherwise.  

My sour impression of these folks is what happened after that.  

I recently had to take my car in for servicing.  I had to make 2 trips into the dealership and my car was with them for a total of 8 hours and it cost me $500.  

They didn't fix the issue.  

I called their service manager to request a refund on the $160 I paid for the part that didn't fix my issue, and he has yet to get back to me.  

Also, despite the fact I'd paid extra for a warranty, the repairs weren't covered under warranty, so like other reviewers I'd fallen for that as well.  

I took my car into Wilson's Auto Tech - the #1 Yelp rated Honda and Toyota shop in the city - and not only did this shop have the issue diagnosed and fixed within a mere 2 hours, but they did it for only $120 - less than I'd paid at SP Toyota NOT to fix the problem.  

The kicker is these guys supposedly brought in a special mechanic on a Saturday just for my car.  Well, Wilson's Auto Tech didn't need a special mechanic and they had the issue fixed for less money and less time, so what the hell is SP Toyota's problem? 

Guess which place is getting my servicing business from now on and which one isn't?  I'll give you a hint, SP Toyota is the latter.  

What really pushed me over the edge is my experience with the online sales manager.  He sent me an email saying he could lower my payments by saving me money on interest, but I had to go into the dealership.  

So, I went to the dealership and we went through a process, apparently he talked to their bank and they wouldn't refinance because what remained on my loan was more than the car was worth.  

Uh yeah, genius, depreciation on a car starts the moment you drive it off the lot, so this is naturally the case with all vehicles.  Why did you think you could get me a better deal if there was a pretty good chance this is what they were going to say?  Pathetic.  

Then, as if to add insult to injury, the guy has the gall to try to convince me to trade in my current vehicle (used 2012 Honda Civic) for a brand new Toyota Corolla, claiming he could approve me for 0.9% interest on my loan, which he claimed would save me about $5000 on the life of my vehicle as opposed to the 7.44% I was paying now.  

I told him I'd think about it.  

I went home and did a little research, as I make it a point never to make large purchases on a whim.  

Turned out that whole scheme was a total bait and switch scam by the online sales manager.  

A new Corolla with the sport package that he was trying to sell me has a sticker price of $25,000.  

That's $8000 more than what's remaining on the loan of my current vehicle - which essentially cancels out the $5000 in savings I would have in interest - not to mention I would be making payments on the car for longer, plus I also talked to my insurance company and the cost of my insurance would go up by $200 a year.  

So, if I were to take that douchebag's deal, what would end up happening is I would've traded in a perfectly good car for a new car I didn't need and wasn't looking for, while at the same time I would be making payments for longer and the cost of my insurance would go up.  

Unless they give me $10,000 in trade for my current car - which is unlikely - then I lose on that deal.  Of course, he makes a sale, so it's good for him, but not so much for me....  

The guy assured me my payments would remain the same, but that doesn't help when I'm making payments for longer than I would've on my current car because the loan is bigger - not to mention the higher cost of insurance and the cost of gas is probably a wash to negligible at best as my current car is already good on gas.  

For my next car purchase I will be shopping around a bit more, and I can tell you, fellow yelpers, if you deal with this dealership follow my guidelines:  

DO NOT get servicing done at the dealership.  They don't stand behind their work.  

If the sales manager sends you an email saying they can save you money on interest and reduce your payment amount, DO NOT followup with them and believe the offer like I did.  It's a scam to get you into the dealership so they can try to talk you into buying a new car.  I didn't even want to ask them what they would give me in trade because it probably sucks.    

DO NOT buy their extended warranty if you buy the car used.  It conveniently doesn't apply when you need it.

Do not take your vehicle to the location on Baseline in Sherwood Park. I had been getting my oil changed here for the last 3 years and never had an issue. I went in for an oil change and all seemed normal.
A few days after going into the shop I noticed a large oil leak under my vehicle. I chose to take it into a friend who is a mechanic that noticed the oil pan had been damaged during the last oil change. In addition to that it looked like the oil had never been changed, it was a black sludge. The damaged oil pan and new oil change ended up costing me an additional $700 in addition to the work I had paid for at Mr. Lube. I contacted the manager at Mr. Lube who referred me to his supervisor that in turn asked me to bring the part in to have it inspected by a mechanic of their choosing. At that point the mechanic no longer had the replaced part. I asked the supervisor for a minimal refund of the money I paid them for the oil change that had clearly not been done and he has refused to respond.
I have been getting my oil changes done without an issue at this located for years, but the unprofessionalism and poor customer service is unacceptable. Their staff is not trained properly and there is zero accountability on their end for poor service. A simple oil change ended up costing me an additional $700. I would strongly advise against ever going to the location on Baseline.

I went into Rona to order a countertop. It all seemed pretty simple, and the employee told me that it would take about 2 weeks, since I was ordering very simple, in-stock counters and they just needed to be cut. But after 3 weeks, I hadn't heard a word from them. I was driving by, so I went in to inquire about the status of my order. As it was a long weekend, and the employee who'd originally served me wasn't there, they took my name and phone number and assured me that I'd receive a call on Tuesday.

I did receive a call on Tuesday, but missed it. I spent the next two days calling back only to be put on hold for 15+ minutes each time before I hung up. Finally I managed to leave a message with the person who answered the phone, and my call was eventually returned.

When the employee returned my call, he said that he'd called me and I'd never bothered calling him back . He said the countertop company needed more information from me - they needed to know where the stove would be. I told him where it would be (pretty sure we'd already been over this) and he told me it would be re-ordered and to expect it in about two weeks later. 

Looking through my phone records, I found that he had called me in the interim. He had not, however, left a message so I had no way of knowing I was supposed to call him back, or that it was even him calling, since the number that came up on the call display was unlisted.

Two weeks later, I called to enquire about the status of my order (sigh). On my first call, the woman who answered the phone told me that the counter guy would be working that afternoon. So, I called at around 3pm I believe. The conversation went like this:

Me: Hi, can I speak with XXXXXX in Kitchens?
Rona employee: No.
Me: Um...no? 
Rona employee: He's not with us any more.
Me: Not with you...like he doesn't work there?
Rona: that's right.
Me: At all?
Rona employee: at all.

I was a bit put-off, so I said good bye and hung up. Then a few minutes later I thought that if he wasn't working there any more, there must be someone at least covering his department, so I called back. Another person answered the phone, and I told her "I understand XXXXXX isn't working there any more, but I really my countertop and is there someone covering his department. She told me "I don't know who told you he doesn't work here any more, because he does. He's outside of the store right now but I can take a message."

She took a message, and he never returned it. 

A week after that, I had completely lost my patiences. I called and instead of asking to speak to kitchens, I told the person who answered the phone that I'd ordered a countertop 7 weeks earlier and still did not have it, and had no information on when it would arrive. She seemed very concerned and took my information, promising to call me back once she'd investigate.

Two hours later, I received a call from the original kitchens employee. He said "didn't you get my message a few weeks ago that it came in and it was the wrong colour?" This seems totally at odds with the conversation I'd had with him in which he told me that the countertop company needed to know where the stove was, and I definitely hadn't received any message of the kind. 

After following up twice in the past week, I finally received my countertop. I've gotten THREE bills for it, and it took 8 weeks. We haven't installed it yet and I'm just praying that there are no problems with it because I don't have another 8 weeks to wait on a reorder.

Can you believe it - I actually had a pleasant experience purchasing my new car from this place?!?!  Now it could be exaggerated by the fact that I had just walked out of Kentwood Ford after telling them where they could respectfully place their pressure 'sales' techniques (and by respectfully place I may or may not mean shove it!!).

I walked in knowing exactly what I wanted and exactly what I wanted to pay for it.  And I walked out with just that - exactly what I wanted for exactly what I wanted to pay - is this real life???  They were straight forward and did everything they could to track down my dream car (which turns out was in BC).  Made sure that I got every deal available (winter tires and rims, a way more than wicked deal on my crappy trade in, and they even gave my dad a referral bonus even though he had only talked to this sales guy once before but had not purchased anything which is typically how the program works).  

By the way the referral program is actually not bad - not like 'go-auto' who gives you $500 bucks towards services they offer at their locations - $750.00 (minimum) cash to do whatever you see fit with - like an actual incentive, not "here's $500 bucks that you can give right back to me when I perform overpriced services on your car in my shops only...blah blah blah."

In general, I found Rob (the sales guy) and Ashley (the finance lady) to be respectful, straight forward, and fair.  I didn't get the vultures swarming feeling when I walked in which is a plus.  I do have to mention - Rob pulled the best sales technique on me I thought - after we settled on the price I said I needed a few hours to think about everything.  Rob says no problem - here take this other ford focus to drive around while you are thinking - Brilliant Rob!  Since I have huge buyers anxiety this may have been the best way to get me to come back and not just chicken out!

Really impressed by this place - which is saying a lot as I have walked out of countless dealerships where the level of scumbaginess was too over the top!!!  Keep up the great work Sherwood Ford - I know I will be spreading the word!

My coworkers are frequent visitors for lunch at Gregg's and today I decided to try it out as well. They have a full one page menu with photos showing all the lunch specials that are $10. I tried the chicken shawarma.  It came with a side of fattoush salad, a big helping of rice/noodle combo and small pieces of chicken on top. I was very surprised at the amount of food I got for such a cheap price!  I was also worried that the rice wasn't going to taste like much but it was super flavourful without being I've powering.  The only thing was that the fattoush was pretty heavy on the sumac. Great lunch spot if you work in the Sherwood park area.

Yummy cookies! Simple ingredients.  So happy they opened up a little shop inside Prairie Mill Bakery in Edmonton!

All of their cookies are excellent!  Reminds us of mom's cookies!  Soooo good!

Newer pub in Sherwood Park Alberta.  On the  bad side beer is really expensive.  But they do have specials.  It has pretty girls in kilts.  It also has quite a number of TV screens. 24 to be exact.    Servers were surprisingly attentive! Or rather chatty. Nachos not very exciting, but quite enjoyed the chicken tacos .  The chicken dinner was OK but the veggies were frozen and overlooked soggy.  The spinach chicken wrap was OK but used pre packaged chicken.  They nailed the home made coleslaw though and it is quite spicy, definitely the highlight!  I wouldn't eat a fancy meal here again, and would just stick to the burgers and wings.  Happy hour 3 to 7. And it can get very noisy during happy hour.  We also found the volume too high on Thursday nights, can barely talk.

I have come here so many times n everytime its the same - Good service. 
The best stop for late night eaters , craving for pancakes or for sweet tooth  i have come here late at night as this place is open till late maybe till 1 am or for all night i m  (not sure)
The bottom line is no matter what time u go , ur food will be quickly n freshly served. 
On my recent visit i found out that they have introduced flavourful breakfast options n choice of skillets. Guess what I ordered a crazy chicken skillet which was outstanding n quite filling. All time favourite is strawberry shake n its a must try guys. U will love me more for suggesting the shake 
This restaurant is spacious n clean including the washrooms. Enough parking outside n reserved handicapped parking right outside the door.

The  new owners are great and the store has been completely renovated. Steve and Christine who are the new owners are both knowledgable and have the patience to both listen and help find the answers...Abby the golden retriever who comes with them to the store every day is most enjoyable and love able . Makes the visit to the store a pleasant one
Terrible service. Disorganized. Save your money and go to the one on Baseline. At least they have it together. 20 minutes to get service rude server slow kitchen.

I have visited this location lots in the past . But I have never had to wait for service like today? I was in the door before two other groups of people and was the last one served ? Interesting how that works that is why a two star rating I will have the food today and inform everyone on the food quality levels for the food I order and also get my friends input on what he orders as well . The quality and speed of the food coming out and the freshness of the food and temperature of the food .  Just so we are clear when I arrived there 9 customers two servers and a manager and bartender.nit overly busy. Ok  I just ate and the food was as awesome as ever just seems like slow service today maybe management should do their jobs instead of staying in the back room getting paid to do nothing interact with the customers or make sure service is up to snuff .

I've had takeout a few times from this place, but have never actually eaten in the restaurant. I popped in for a bit tonight, the place was packed, service was great, food was super. The owner (Kevin) was coming by to chat with each table, and it seemed like he really knows a lot of their customers personally. He was a delight when he came to our table to chat, super friendly.
We'll come into the restaurant more now instead of sticking to takeout!

I purchased a deal through a group-buying promo for this company. I have been going to the store every 2 weeks (for the past 5 months) to try to find something to buy.They have apparently been having issues with their supplier & their shipments have been constantly behind. There was nothing in my size range (M or L) and only select items in S, most were XS. I finally found something the other day but then was told I couldn't use my coupon. After asking to speak to the manager/owner the owner came up to me & was on the verge of shouting at me, saying there was no way I had been coming in constantly as they "always have stock" & calling me a liar (all this while holding her little girl). Ten minutes before I had checked out the sales associate I was working with had verified that there was hardly any items in the store for the past 5 months... The owner did offer to refund my coupon, but at this point I wanted the tops, so she finally put my coupon through. 
I will NEVER again go to this store. It is one of the worst customer service experiences I have ever had. I am notifying everyone I can in regards to how terribly I was treated.

I drive from NE Edmonton when I want SC.  The one that is closest to me SUCKS and I would rather driver the extra 10 minutes for prompt service.  This place always seems fast even when packed.  We even had a party of over 20 once and it went smoothly.

Holy Crap...Why do I keep going back here, giving them yet another chance!  Walked out today after 12minutes, waiting, & waiting or our Draft Beers. The dingbat waitress totally forgot to pull them! Only  1. Other table in the place at 3PM.  Real busy....after taking a customers payment....She forgot all about us and started to clear off one of the several dirty tables. We actually had to yell at her to get her attention for our drinks.  She was surprised to SEE us there. Told her to forget the beers...as we walked out. The tables and decor are getting tattered & worn.  Only desperate hotel guests should go here!

A girlfriend and I decided to do a "ladies who lunch" afternoon and chose this new restaurant in Sherwood Park. We did so with some trepidation as my friend is Egyptian/Lebanese and knows what good mediterranean food should taste like.

So, did it pass her taste test? Well, first let me tell you what I thought. The menu was interesting but I didn't understand what most of the dishes were. It would have been nice to have a bit of a description of what the dishes contained for us, the uninitiated. I was able to get the advice and input from my friend and I chose a half order of the Fattoush, my friend chose the tabouli salad and we shared a half mezza. 

For the half mezza we chose grilled halloume cheese, fried kibbie, spinach fatayer and cheese sambusik.

If you like Greek saganaki, you will love the grilled halloume cheese. It is soooo salty and nummy! I stuffed my warm pita bread with the cheese and some of my fattoush for a tasty treat! The fried kibbie was moist, flavourful and was amazing with some of the complimentary hummus they brought out for us or the yogurt dip that came with the mezza. I enjoyed the fattier and the sambusik as well, the pastry was flavourful and was obviously not a prepackaged type.

My friend wanted to try their rice pudding but there was none ready, but after chatting for a while at our table, the waitress came back and said if we were willing to wait about 10 minutes, the chef was just finishing up a batch. About 15 minutes later the waitress appeared with two to-go containers. They were well worth the wait, as it was absolutely delicious. 

Our lunch was very reasonable and came to $54 for the two of us, including two drinks.

Now back to my friend. Apparently, this is food just like her Gramma used to make. I think that qualifies as a high compliment!

This review is specifically for Kurstin's nail services as that's all I've experienced here but she is amazing, professional and a perfectionist. I always get tons of compliments on my nails since I started going to see her. I highly recommend anyone looking for gel nails to her!

i found the food excellent and the pianos highly entertaining, however some of the patrons that seem to be there regularily seem to be out of control acting as if they own the place.it can get quite out of hand howevere this is not the bars fault. the one thing i found was that the door men/security seemed to be on a power trip of sorts but other then that it was a great expierience!

This restaurant is a hidden treasure in Sherwood Park! Why? quite simply, it has amazing pizza!! I would highly recommend the donair pizza. Or the perogy pizza. Well, actually, pretty much any of their pizza.

They also have oven baked BBQ chicken and steak which we have enjoyed.
