Don't go to this restaurant for the ambience - it is pretty bare bones, but the pizza is the kind that has thick, fresh crust with crispy edges that is sizzling on the plate. The BBQ chicken was moist and slathered in a scrumptious BBQ sauce.

And they deliver in Sherwood Park!

Boring place. Staff were good. Basic food, basic decor, odd mix for music. Reminds me of a dinner that you find I between two cities on a sparsely populated highway. I've been to other Mr. Mikes and they have been better, though it's been awhile. It seems like they have central distribution for the food; and it's not a good one.

Went there for lunch on a weekend and wasn't thrilled with the decor or layout. Very plain but the wings were awesome, many strange flavors. Slow service, seems the waitress was too busy concentrating on the guys at the bar. If your craving wings it's great but I can think of better places to eat
Went their for lunch Saturday. Nice place, clean, average prices and great food. I had the bacon cheese burger. Very good for under $20.00. I'll be going back

You had me at focaccia! I have never heart of any sub place offering focaccia bread, like duh, why don't other places do? That's coz pressd is gourmet, so fresh, so yummy, love it when health meets taste!
Try the veggie sub, Thai soup and really you can't go wrong with anything. 
I recommend the hot pressd sandwiches with focaccia bread. Very neat location, fast and good service. Can't wait to go back!

You won't find a better place in Edmonton or Strathcona county to buy seafood. Being a land-locked province fresh seafood is hard to come by but Fin's is as close as it can get. The selection is the best and their staff the most knowledgeable and helpful I have come across. The Arctic Char and Haddock that they have flown in once a week from Iceland is to die for. I never buy seafood from anywhere else if I can help it. First rate!!!

The hot ready meals at this save on foods are very passable. The main problem they have is consistency. I'm a dry ribs guy, but often the dry ribs are dry and under seasoned. The main reason I keep going back is because the portion size is great for the cost.

I alwasy enjoy stepping into Keylime to do a lil browsing I feel really comfortable, and although I have only purchased a few Keylime Pieces, I love them so much.  I find it great that if they don't have your size in a particular style, the sales staff never say "no we don't have any left" instead they always offer to place you on a call list for when the new items arrive in the size you're looking for.
Really been noticing a great deal of community involvement recently too...Its so nice to see good businesses grow, and expand...so pumped about the new location at city centre. can't wait to check it out when I make my way to that area.

I've always had friendly wonderful service. The food is nothing special, I prefer my own breakfast to it honestly, but my daughter loves it and since there's never a wait it's well worth it for a relaxing breakfast out.

I used to live by the Papa Murphies in The Meadows and LOVED IT! I was so excited to go to the one by my new house in Sherwood Park. Today I walked over with my family to grab a pizza from Papa Murphies and a coffee from Tim Hortons. I was disgusted that 2 staff members were smoking outside with their friends right by the door. I had to walk through their cloud of smoke to get to Tim Hortons. When we were done at Tim Hortons they were still smoking so I decided to get my lunch from somewhere else. I don't think I will be returning to this location.

We went to The Overtime for a Stagette as we wanted a dry Stagette that was fun as the bride is 8 months pregnant.  So we decided to go see the Dueling Pianos.  Fun, right?

The pianos were fantastic and the only reason that I am okay with a 1* rating.  My only complaint would be that we didn't know (as it was our first time) that tips get your songs played.  That was a fail on our part.

There were four of us and we each ordered a baseball sirloin.  All four of the steaks came out and I looked at everyone else's which looked very different (and better) than mine.  I had ordered a baked potato on the side and the waitress said that my potato was lagging behind....kinda weird but okay.

I took one bite of my steak and it was rotten and rancid.  No exaggeration.  I promptly ran to the bathroom and vomited for the next twenty minutes.  When I returned, the waitress asked if I wanted to continue with my meal.  I said no and asked them to take it away....like seriously, I was just violently ill from it, would anyone eat something that made them wretch? So she took the meal away.

The manager came over and asked what the problem was.  I told him that I was served a rancid steak.  He said that they'd take it off the bill.  I said okay and asked for a ginger ale to calm my stomach (as the girls wanted to stay for the pianos).  He said okay.  That was it.  Now, I don't believe in getting freebies...but they served me a rotten steak.  I had one caesar prior to that steak, which I had to pay for and the only thing that I was given to compensate me for my troubles was a free ginger ale.  That was a fail on The Overtime's part.

so, the moral of the story is, unless you're just going for the pianos and some drinks, I'd skip Overtime...unless getting super sick is your deal.

Went to the tilted kilt for a late lunch around 12:30 and there was a 20 minute wait for a table. The hostess was attentive and filled tables as soon as they opened, but they just weren't opening... I guess people liked the scenery enough to take extended lunches.
We got a table about 20 minutes later after a quick drink at the bar. They have a good beer selection with lots on tap.
Once seated our waitress was phenomenal. She gave us a fake name (chase) but in a community like Sherwood park I don't blame her. I ordered the Scottish cheese steak and garlic fries. The Scottish cheese steak is a rib eye minced and fried like a Philly cheese steak. The steak was a little over done, but the nicely grilled vegetables and cheese made up for it. The garlic fries were out of this world, better than safeco field in Seattle, I was impressed. We also got some onion rings that came with a unique spicy sauce, worth trying but nothing to write home or a yelp review about.
Overall a good experience, I can't wait to go back!
These guys were great, got a new screen and tempered glass protector for my iPhone 6, $135 and only took 20 minutes!  Thanks guys!

I can happily say I've been coming here for years with my family and for good reason! I've always enjoyed how hot and fresh the chicken is here every time I get it, along with the wait times being very small to boot. The fries have certainly improved with time which I do appreciate as well. The staff here have always been super nice and take the time getting to know you which is great.

 There isn't much of a drink menu and the menu itself could be seen as limited, but if they have what you want, you won't be disappointed by what they bring you  Definitely worth a visit to see for yourself!
I love this place. I have ordered pizza there many times for my family and even for parties. All my guests and family comments how good it is. It's very affordable and they are very friendly!!!!

Went there and bought 4 knives. The lady was super nice and helpful. We got to compare and look at everything that we wanted to side by side. Great place to get high end knives like wusthof and henckels. Super neat place, which has so many cool nick nacks that its hard not to pick random stuff up. Definitely worth checking out.

Came back on a Saturday morning...was busy but service was awesome & my gluten free menu choice was melt in your mouth - just delish!!! I've changed my mind...I will for sure be back....ask for Douglas as your server - he's amazing!!

A great "neighbourhood" take-out pizza joint.(definately not a sit down restaurant, which is a shame)

It is kind of an odd little sort of a place that can't quite decide what it wants to be. I think that the high school across the street has a lot to do with it. It's sort of a convenience store with a lot of junk food and candy bars, slushie machines, and ice cream cones. My guess is that they have all of that so that they can sell lottery tickets and cigarettes  (which they seem to sell a lot of!). It's a crafty idea!

More to the point, they also do freshly made Donairs, Subs, Pizza and Pasta. I haven't tried any of the Subs, but the Donairs are pretty damn good, and quite generous to boot!  A jumbo Donair was big enough to handle 2 sittings for me. And with fillings that couldn't be any fresher. (I saw the guy slice the tomatoes and lettuce for my order).

But the Pizza is GREAT! Fresh made dough, quality toppings made out real food  (when they say chopped bacon strips, they mean it!) generous with the cheese, and better than average sauce. Price is better than the standard Pizza chains, and the pizza is waaayyy better.

A little place like this deserves more recognition.

Pretty ridiculous overall. Almost speechless. The food was absolutely bland, only way I could consume it was by adding adverse amounts of hoisen and chilli sauce. It is true the vegetables were sitting in baths of water. Compared to The Mongolie Grill, you can tell what an authentically cheap and poor interpretation should taste like; Mongolian indulgence.

Oh, the Mongolian chicken bites oddly remind me of those shitty frozen chicken fingers from Walmart. 98% inedible.

All in all, wasn't worth the exuberant cost.
Cheers!

Staff here are always friendly I ordered one of my drinks incorrectly and they gladly made me a new with a smile love to see a company that trains there staff in the customers always mentality( I paid for both drinks even when they said I didn't have to but I didn't mind because it was my mistake)

Took my daughter here for an eyebrow wax.  What a hidden gem!  It's absolutely beautiful in there and the staff were very friendly.
Unfortunately, I don't remember the name of the girl that waxed my daughters eyebrows, which is a shame, because she was awesome.  
I'll come back for sure - possibly this time for hair.

This is my first visit to Wild Wing.  I ordered wings from the 100 plus choices.  They are as delicious as any wings I have ever had.  I had boneless medium hot, a very messy BBQ, but that's the way I like them and a salt and pepper.  All excellent.  Service was fast and very friendly.  The owners work there and came and chatted with us.  Overall an amazing experience and we will be back.  Lots of big tvs so this is a great place to bring the gang to watch sports.

My sister-in-law and I enjoyed brunch here one weekday morning about two months ago and this place has been on my mind since. I just had to write a review! We had such a wonderful brunch here. It's so nice to find a place that has a bit of a spin on the typical breakfast menu. It was so cool to see an Irish take on breakfast. The place itself was clean and comfortable. The serve was incredible. So nice to hear her Irish accent! She was so attentive and made sure our cups were always full of steaming hot coffee. You will also see novels and books on display in the restaurant. Just gives it a really homey relaxed sort of feel. Skip the usual breakfast places and try out Toast. I'm sure you'll have a great leisurely, delicious breakfast/brunch there. (Love the restaurant name too!)
I've been here twice. Both times it was gross. Not sure why I went back. It's not cheap either.
Best of the best pizza in sh park......easy takeout.  A little small inside.  Pub is an option to stay away from kids. 4 star for war in....5 star for takeout.

Arrived and ordered an Irish Dip and a Hamburger. The restaurant was fairly empty. Waited over 35 minutes for our food. At the point the server came back by and apologized for the long wait due to a new cook. She said our food would be out in 5 minutes and that the manager would take 10% off our bill for the long wait. 

Another additional 15 minutes passed from that time and no food arrived. At that point we flagged down our server and let her know we were taking off. 50 + minutes is way too long to wait for lunch.

The best pizza and pasta! Everything form them is delish! You never have to ask for extra cheese it's always so cheesy. The pasta is very good too! The only thing is that garlic toast is always very dry and I have to remake it before we eat. Otherwise, this is a great place. You have to try carrot cake. Even the delivery boys are nice. I only get delivery I've ever been inside.

I'm so happy that Papa Murphy's came to Canada a few years back and even more excited that there are so many locations now in the Greater Edmonton area.

Mediterranean chicken will always be my family's favourite whether on regular, gluten free, or thin delite!

I also love that they do fun pizzas like the pumpkin shaped ones at Halloween and the Heart shaped ones at Valentine's Day.

Sign up for their e-mails for discounts/deals and looks for coupons in places like the SUTP coupon books sold my schools.

I'll be seeing you soon, Papa Murphy's!

Was a Customer a couple of years ago. The Chinese furniture is constructed SO badly, that even China doesn't want it. Ship it to Steve @create home envy. Then, he'd pawn it off on unsuspecting customers through New Years sales, Christmas sales, etc. I do mean that this junk is something nightmares are made of. The number of pieces that had been returned, end up still being sold as NEW, has been astronomical. Not a great place to shop for long-lasting....or even New furniture. BUYER BEWARE!

Just walked out of this restaurant after waiting 70 minutes for our meal.  As people were leaving we asked how long they waited and everyone said an hour.  There was a large party in the upper lounge and this was the excuse for the wait.  When we came in it would have been nice to be told - there will be a lengthy wait seeing as we just have one cook in the kitchen.  The woman serving us pretty well disappeared. We asked another server where our meal was and he was totally disinterested in helping us - more interested in getting jugs of beer to the large group.  So, lengthy wait, poor service - never again.

Baskets in the park has to be one of my all time favourite spots in Edmonton and area. They have a huge selection of kitchenware, Pandora, and miscellaneous snack foods and trinkets- all of which that make great gifts for any woman or man in your life. I know if I'm ever stuck on a gift idea for my mother, I make my way on over to Baskets in the Park; only to be greeted by the most friendly and knowledgable staff! There is no question they're super experienced in all areas, and my mother loved her customized pandora bracelet and selection of teas and snack foods. As well, from a secret Santa, I was gifted one of their baskets, and I'd have to say, one of the best gifts! Super tasteful and well put together, and I'm still enjoying it even after the holidays have past. I would definitely gift one of those to someone else upon any occasion! 

On top of all of that, I'd have to say the best part is, is that it's completely and 100% family owned and run. you can tell they really put their heart and soul into this quirky little joint, it translates through the customer service and product quality. They had an amazing dream to call their own, and made that dream into reality, I really hope their business flourishes, it's small businesses like this that deserve it most! 
All in all, I've never had a bad experience, and would highly recommend this amazing little one stop shop! :)

This place is great! It's very clean inside and all the booths have televisions in them so you can watch whatever sporting event they have on. We came here for lunch so it wasn't very busy but their food is fantastic. I had a sangria to drink and their Thai shrimp quesadillas to eat and it was delicious. I highly recommend you come here to eat whether you're a sports fan or not.
Very rude, extremely unprofessional manager. Doesnt deserve my business.

My first time at a spa. I was early, so I had to wait, which was fine, but I waited for 20 min before I was offered even a glass of water. My esthetician was very nice and chatty and I really liked her. However, it's a day later and my nail polish is already starting to chip (started to that night).

My massage therapist was polite, but I found her very short and not very friendly.

I will make the drive from Edmonton into Sherwood Park, when I need a good interior car wash; mainly because it's the only reasonably priced car wash. Plus James is always so friendly and professional!

All five of us hungry prawn eaters, came in last night for the Thursday nite special of 35 cent prawns or $3.50 for a basket, you get your choice of dipping sauce, which is the same kind of sauce they use for their wings. (Which is quite a variety of flavors)
I prefer the breaded prawns as opposed to the  regular. They also had their Tankards on special at $7.50 for a 20 oz. glass, but I don't feel they give you the 20 oz, as every Tankard we ordered it looked like a couple of good gulps were taken out, and for that I'm only given a three star. If your the kind of person who likes their beer at the rim, these guys cheap out.  Otherwise the first NFL game and prawns and beer were pretty good. I'll most likely come back on a Monday on another game night to enjoy Meatballs at 35 cents each or $ 3.50 a basket. I'll post another update on that later.

After reading the great reviews for this restaurant, my son and I were excited to  try it!  We started with an order of calamari to share.  Obviously from frozen (it looked and tasted dry), it came with a small plastic take-out container (complete with the lid) that contained the dipping sauce.

I ordered the shawarma combo and my choice of sides were fries and Greek Salad.  The Greek salad looked good even with the powdery feta on top.  I was eager to dive in to it and extremely disappointed with the flavour.  I couldn't even taste the feta beyond the over powering vinegar dressing.  Definitely not a Greek dressing.  The meal itself was mediocre even though the meat was somewhat dry.

My son ordered the chicken shawarma with the Greek salad and rice as his sides.  He said that the rice tasted like Uncle Ben's.

The service however, was really good.
Wonderful people and an awesome selection of dog treats and supplies. Support local animal charities too!

IT was A-OK. Nothing really stood out that impressed me but nothing happened that disappointed me either, so I guess it evens out. The food I enjoyed but our party was kinda crammed into a booth? the restaurant was empty but we were crammed. It did take a while to get a drink but once the service started like a snowball rolling down a hill, it picked up momentum and speed up. The location to me is kind of weird? In a hotel/gym? That kind of takes it out of finer dining and brings it down a notch.  If you a pimple popper, teenager, maybe you can impress your date but if you are a career person might make you look a little cheap...just saying

Oh man, this place is going to put a serious dent in my wallet.  I love the entire concept of this store and the tea actually tastes as good as it smells!  In addition to the ridiculously huge loose leaf tea selection, they have an awesome selection of sampler packages and tea accessories.  If you're new to tea this is the place to be (seriously it's rhyme worthy)!  I very much love that you can buy your favorite tea blends here and try a cup of a new flavor, made the way you like it, at a great price (~$3 for a steeped tea).  The staff always has a couple blends brewed for samples as well, which is awesome for the tea adventurist!

In the past few times I have been here, the service quality varies from decent to amazing (everyone has off or flustered days, it happens).  I am pretty sure I am hooked for life on this business since they will likely never run out of amazing teas to try!

Absolutely love the food at Cora's! Huge selection with many health conscious alternatives. Sometimes its nice to have a breakfast that is not caked in bacon grease (...sometimes). The fruit is always fresh and is a nice change from the standard greasy hashbrowns you would get as a side at most other breakfast places. 

Prices are high for a breakfast/brunch/lunch place so it's kind of a treat when I go there. And as long as you get there before 9am on the weekends you might only have to wait a few mins to get in. But as a huge fan of sleeping in, this is not always the case for me. I usually end up waiting anywhere from 15 to 30 mins to get in and sometimes it gets really chaotic there. Parking at this location is atrocious!! Ummmm poor planning for sure - in a lot with limited parking right next to a Tim Horton's, Joey's Tomato, A & W, etc...good luck finding a spot at lunch time during the week!! 

I think this place is worth trying at least once for sure! A good choice if you are looking to take your gramma out for breakfast one day - it's got that kind of a grandma-y feel to it I guess.

Ive shopped at this store a few times and I really like it. The clothes are perfect for wearing bright flashy workout outfits (Like me) Or just nice basics that are well made. The ladies are really sweet and help you grab whatever you need and offer advice once you try stuff on in the dressing room, they arent pushy or oversell anything. I did want to purchase a pair on leggings that they didnt have in stock and Keylime took my info and called me as soon as they were in again and put them on hold for me. Great service!

I havent experienced service like this, since i was in Paris France. Real unique and real sophisticated take on mediterranean food. Recommend it for a guy to take the girl out too you'll be surprised!!!

Amazing food and great service.   First time here and I tried the shish combo with tabouli.   No complaints at all, everything was fresh and homemade!  The baklava was a treat and must be tried!  I'm giving this restaurant 5/5 stars but if I could find one complaint it would be that it is just a tad overpriced for what you get, that being said not too many restaurants can compete with Greggs level of freshness.    I will definitely be back.

Excellent presentation.    Restaurant sparkled.   Service classy.  We had the grilled halloume cheese.   Extremely salty, and I normally like salty.   Wouldn't have it again.  I liked the fried kibbie.   It's a spiced meatball that was reminiscent of tourtière for me.  Would have again.   We had sujuk on hummus.   By far our favourite.  We would make a special trip for this dish. So delish and very savoury.   The fourth appetizer we had was Mohamra.  We didn't like it because it was far too sweet.   I thought it was supposed to be a spicy and sweet dish.  It looked and had the texture and taste of sweetened refried beans.  Bland and sweet.  We shared the Fatoush salad.  My hubby really liked the deep fried pita bits in it.  I wasn't so sure.  A bit greasy for me.   The salad was otherwise a winner for me. All in all we were really pleased and thought those things we didn't like came down to personal preferences.

PERMANENTLY CLOSED.    Not as friendly any more with staff changes.  Sunday afternoon bartender girl spent 15 minutes texting and waitresses don't come around and chat anymore.  Tuesday $2 tacos are good and Thursday $5 nachos hit the spot!  A lot of TV screens though.  Food is hit and miss.

The staff are really friendly and seem to enjoy working there which creates a great atmosphere for customers.
However, the pizza is a bit expensive considering the size of it you get. In addition to this my last visit there I noticed that the establishment did not have air conditioning which due to the air flow in the building made it uncomfortable to wait inside. 
But! The pizza is really great, it's the first pizza place I've been to in Sherwood park that actually puts the pepperoni underneath the cheese creating an even more interesting texture when eating it and I am excited to try the various other foods on their menu (:

This is a great place to come if you are looking for friendly service and fresh food! The atmosphere is laid back and just a little quirky with great local crafts to be browsed and purchased. The drink of the week is usually really tasty and the pear and goat cheese panini is to die for! Oh, and as an added bonus
Y

Went there last month with my husband ... Obviously ...lots of skin showing! Lol anyway I ordered the burger with deep fried pickles in it and my husband had the burger with blue cheese on it ! Both were ... Freaking awesome !!!!! Will come back for the burgers !!! I had a side of onion rings to start ( I love onion rings lol ) there was plenty and very tasty! Also I had the sweet potatoe fries instead of regular fries which a chipotle and also the dill sauce ( I love sauces LOL) anyway everything was great !!!! Will be back for sure !

I went in for the groupon deal for mani/pedi and was very pleasantly surprised! The salon is easy to miss from the outside, but as soon as you step in it is beautiful! Everyone I dealt with was extremely friendly.
The manicure and pedicure were great! I got regular polish on the toes, and shellac on the nails and both lasted longer than average. The girl (sorry I forget her name now!) was very nice and easy to talk to. The materials used were all very clean and the chair comfortable!
Definitely recommend, would be great for a few girls going in a group as the mani pedi room is separate from the salon side.

Very quiet on the night my husband and I decided to dine. I think we were the only table at the time. Service was a little slow for us being the only table but the waitress was very friendly. We had the hummus to start it was delicious so I was excited for our mains. My husband had the full chicken dinner and I the tabouli salad, as I was planning on sharing some of his chicken. The salad was delicious but his chicken was way over cooked dry and chewy. We don't like to complain but couldn't choke it down. The waitress was very nice about it but they couldn't cook us another one because they didn't have any more chicken?? They took it off the bill but my husband still went home hungry. Not sure if we will give this place another try. We do like to support local and stay away from the chains but not sure if this place is worth another try.

I agree with what everyone else is saying. The staff are awesome, it's for a great cause and their food is always fresh and delicious from my experience. Probably one of the best smoothies I've ever had too by the way: make sure you grab the mango one. A small gem right here in Sherwood Park! Go check it out if you're ever in the area!
Ordered a platter from here tonight and it wasn't good. Everything was over cooked or soaked in grease and the cheese sticks were more battery than cheese. We will not be ordering from here again

Oh god. Another sports bar.....and another Joe.....I didn't have high hopes walking into this place. But as somebody who has literally eaten at every bar/restaurant in Sherwood Park, it's always nice to have a change. 

I'm really glad I did! I had a chance to check out their nacho's and they scored 13/15 on my Nacho Scale

4/5 for value $15.99 for a huge plate $2.99 for Chili beef
5/5 for toppings .....I loved the fact that each chip was fully dressed 
4/5 for cheese. So much cheese...but could they have more?

.....I also got to eat a burger. I love burgers.I"ve been in Asia for a while , so I've missed North American awesome burgers. Seriously you don't know what you are missing if you leave North America.

....A big burger and a cold beer is kind of my thing! Speaking of cold beers they had Sub Zero beers, I don't know if they were any colder than the other beers I drank. But maybe because the Richards Reds I got was pretty cold too.

I got the truffle mushroom burger, and the fries I got updgraded to the lattice fries. I loved the burger, but I regret not getting the sidewinder fries. My friend got the sidewinder fries, and I swear at a certain point , I had to get her to "look over there!" ....so I could steal her fries.

Why did I give this place a 5/5 review?

1. Massive parking lot
2. All the games on, but still classy
3. Good prices for what you got
4. Great service. My server Cassie was super great. 
5. Huge selection of beer and girlie drinks. Seriously I've never seen a sports bar with so many girlie drinks. For fun I had to count. 23 girly drinks! That doesnt count highballs or wine. That's just fancy girly drinks.

What could it have done better?
It can get packed on the weekends. I'd recommend a reservation if you're going to be coming to see the free UFC (They don't charge a cover )!

Worst pho place in sherwood park/edmonton. I ordered chicken vermicelli and seafood pho for the gf.
The chicken vermicelli had probably half a breast of chicken, if that, the pho had cold noodles which kept a bowl shape as if just taken out from the fridge. We had to ask for sprouts and sauces which you usually get as standard at every other pho restaurant.

Will not go again.

Decor is nice though, service was okay.

I was really REALLY excited to check out Cora as I had heard so many positive things from fairly health conscious people.  I decided to go on a Saturday for brunch.  I went solo as I do enjoy dining by myself sometimes and people watching and enjoying some quiet with my thoughts.  I was seated promptly and was excited to check out the menu.

A server came by shortly and took my drink order.  I ordered green tea which arrived quickly.  I was never given water and I am not sure if this is something I was supposed to ask for or if it was missed.  

As I browsed their menu, I decided to throw the "healthy brunch" goal out the door.  Ham and Cheddar crepe Panini with Hollandaise and a mound of fruit looked extremely appealing.  I ordered the dish and expected to wait a while as the restaurant was very busy.

My food arrive fast.  Maybe a bit too fast.  The crepe itself was barely heated up (I am assuming they are not fresh made) and the egg inside the crepe was cold, yet somehow the ham in the middle was warm, however none of it was by any means hot.  This concerned me a bit as food needs to be at a certain temperature in restaurants to be considered "safe", and I didn't see how this could meet those requirements.  Remembering though that I have eaten far worse while traveling , and being a firm believer in not wasting food, I dug in.  

I had taken about two bites before I realized something was missing.  The dish had a good amount of salt to it with the ham and cheese, but it was missing something to balance it out.  and then I realized what it was........the Hollandaise sauce!  I was REALLY looking forward to the Hollandaise sauce and it was completely forgotten!  Not there, not even a drop, definitely missing.  

My server never came by again to see how my meal was.  The fruit was very good and fresh, but the crepe made me seriously sad.  I may check out another location to see if this was specific to this location, however I have crossed Cora off my "places to have a nice brunch" list as I think cooking food in a restaurant is a bare minimum expectation.

The wings were excellent, better than any place I have had before. Our server, Brittany, was pleasant, quick refilling my pop and the menu was easy to understand. Restaurant decor is entirely appropriate and what I would expect. We will be back.

I've been going to Baskets in the Park for years and find their customer service, product knowledge and overall atmosphere to be awesome! Since moving locations, I think that they have only gotten better with a beautiful Pandora display (and great selection) and awesome new store. Location is a little difficult simply because of the upcoming area, but the trip is well worth it. I would much rather support a local business when buying my Pandora, and Baskets in the Park is my go to for great gifts!

Golden 88 used to be the Chinese food in the mall. I remember getting takeout from there for dinner because it is delicious and reasonably priced. Since they moved to their less obvious location near happy mart their food and prices stayed the same, but if you go be prepared to stand in line. I guess they have staff issues because there is usually only 1 person serving and ringing in the food. Serving 5-6 people take minimum 15-20 minutes. It's worth the wait, but they should get more staff.

Busy little breakfast joint but the staff are wonderful and the food is always good. 
If you plan on going on the weekend, give yourself extra time as there is usually a lineup to get a table. We come here often and are never disappointed. I love the eggs benny!

I have held off on writing this update for a long time - I absolutely love the idea behind Cora`s!!  Piles of fresh fruit decorating interestingly colourful breakfast concoctions.  Sadly, fresh is not always the case; and waiting in a tiny crowded entranceway for 20+ minutes every single time is pretty standard here.

It took me FOREVER to convince the BF to stand in line with me to try this place out (I had been once or twice before, but he had not).  It took even longer for both our blood pressures to drop enough for us to try and enjoy our meal after the ridiculous wait (personal space advocate or not; jamming that many people into that small of a space is just NOT COOL!).  

Breakfast is one of those meals you like to sit, relax, and enjoy.  Not here!!  Everything is rush, Rush, RUSH...our server seemed so overly busy that she could barely stop to take a breath, let alone show us the attentiveness we deserved (AKA what you would expect for the prices you are paying).  

Although the food was decent, the fruit was way over ripe!!  So to top of the not so great experience, I was also made to feel like the worst GF ever for dragging him out to try (against his better judgement), and then having to watch him doubled over with excruciating stomach pain for the rest of his Saturday. 

Sorry Cora`s but I think it will be some time (at least) before we meet again!

Came here for my girlfriends birthday dinner and we had an exceptional girls night! The waitress was quick and friendly and every single beer was served cold and promptly. I would definitely recommend the kickin' cherry lime bowl... Yum.

This place is a little too much for me to handle.  Given that the choice for bars is limited in 'The Park' (although it has been getting better over the years), this place gets mental on the weekends - suffocating!!!  It's just way packed and you can barely move and everything is sticky - UCK - HAHA ok maybe I AM kind of a princess sometimes - MEH, I can accept that!  I think the piano idea is really neat - something a little different and I would really enjoy it if I could see or hear it.  Gotta say that the bathrooms are pretty fancy - like way more so than the bar itself which makes it kind of awkward....That all being said, I have many friends who are there every weekend cuz apparently it is the place to go on weekends in Sherwood Park?!
The staff here is always really friendly, the portions are big, and most importantly the food is excellent. I always bring family here when they visit for breakfast and brunch.

The food was great, the place was clean, and overall it was a decent business. But although the servers where kind and checking up on you, they did still forget 1 order of wings. I would give this restaurant 3 out of 5 stars I enjoyed my visit overall but just a little room for improvement.

Interesting name for a restaurant who's owner is not named Greg. After enquiring with the owners about the name, I was told that this newly opened restaurant in the former Café de Ville Sherwood Park location, is named after one of the top restaurants in Beirut Lebanon. Big shoes to fill and big reputation to try to duplicate.

First let me start with letting you know that I am of Lebanese decent and regularly eat an prepare mid-eastern foods. 

As can be expected, I looked at Gregg Mediterranean's menu with a bit of apprehension, having been too often disappointed by similar restaurants.

I went there for lunch with my friend who was not very familiar with mid-east cuisine. The menu dishes' ingredients are partially listed but the dishes themselves are not well described.

When I asked the waitress about how some of the dishes are prepared, she was not sure and I believe may have guessed. I say this because whe I asked if the cheese sambusik was in phylo pastry and fried, she said it was phylo but baked. It was not phyli and was fried. 

That said, it was delicious and I highly recommend it. The pastry was buttery and flaky. The cheese perfectly melted and mixed with parsley and spices.

We ordered a salad each and were more than grateful that the waitress recommended we have half orders as we also ordered a half mezze platter. The half orders were only $4.00 each and could have been a meal by themselves! I had the tabouli, which surprised me by being made with regular white onions instead of green onions. It was still quite good and I would definitely order it again. My friend had the fattoush, I stole a bite and it was perfect with just the right amount of summac used.

Our mezze platter came with the above mentionef sambusik, kibbe, spinach fatayers, and haloumi cheese.

There were 4 of each mezze and various Lebanese pickles, cucumber slices and tomatoes. The fresh veggies were perfect and ripe! Nice surprise for January in Alberta.

The kibbe was a tasty mix of ground beef, cracked wheat, onions and allspice, offered in nice size balls and unbelievably well stuffed, not half empty like others that I have tasted. 

The spinach fatayer were not as well stuffed. They could use a bit more spinach in them but they were very tasty and not too lemony. 

The halloumi cheese was nice and chewy, well spiced but a bit too salty for my taste. It could have used a bit of soaking or rinse to remove some of the saltiness.

Accompanying our meal were a basket of pita and dipping yogurt/sour cream (no extra charge). We were also given a complimentary hummous. 

After the meal we were given a small plate of sliced apples and bananas, lightly sprinkled with caramel and chocolate sauce. The waitress told us that everyone gets a complimentary fruit nappy. What a lovely touch. The fruit eas quite tasty and the sauce was just the right amount to make plain fruit more exciting.

There is a nice dessert menu with cakes, baklava, and rice pudding. I had my heart set on the rice pudding but they had run out and I was told that they were making more later on in the day.

I was disappointed but figured I would survive. My friend ordered a Monte Cristo coffee (it was delicious according to her).

We stayed to chat and enjoy the warm fireplace as she sipped on her coffee. Ten minutes later, the eaitres came to let us know that if we stayed a bit longer, the chef would have some fresh pudding for us, on the house! Of course we waited!!

They brought us to "to-go" containers filled with hot rice pudding, which I devoured as soon as I got home! It was rose-water scented and lightly dusted with cinnamon. Mmm, a perfect ending to a delicious meal.

Just like my Teta (grandma) used to make!

This is definitely a "must go to" restaurant with generous and tasty dishes. They know what good customer service is and go beyond it!

Love this place! The staff are always extremely knowledgable and friendly. Ready and willing to explain all new products and make recommendations when needed. We always take our fur baby with us and she is greeted with a wagging tail from Abby and a gourmet treat from staff. A great local spot for all your doggie needs.

Would give 0 stars if it was an option. Ordered the lemongrass beef bowl. Cant say enough about how disappointed I was in the half bowl being vermicelli noodles, the other half bowl is bean sprouts and the ten overly thin pieces of flavorless burned beef jerky on top. What a joke, I can only hope this place goes out of business soon!!!!

Absolutely delicious, this tiny restaurant offers authentically delicious Mongolian food at a great price. You choose what you want cooked and they charge you by the pound. It's cooked to perfection and includes rice, wraps and a soup to start. We also had great service! This great restaurant has just climbed to our top 5 restaurants in the Edmonton area and our number 1 in Sherwood park.

I booked with Concrete Blonde on a whim as my stylist booked up for the entire holiday season. I called on a Friday for a Saturday appt. knowing that they would likely think I'm crazy for attempting to get in (even I thought so with all the great reviews here). The receptionist was very polite and kindly fit me in. 

When I arrived the receptionist proved to be even sweeter, I felt very comfortable and was greeted right away. It is a gorgeous salon with trendy interior and a curated style throughout. Lots of my favourite products and brands on the shelves. My stylist was on time, although I completely forget her name and will update as soon as I remember. 

She gave me exactly what I wanted. It was a fraction of the cost of what I normally pay at salons, just under $70 for a few inches off my chest length thick blonde hair and a tone. She even added curls in at the end. Normally I pay a lot more for this service, I was pleasantly surprised! Not a single complaint. If I wasn't loyal to my stylist already I would be going back. 
Although it is a trendy bustling place and every stylist is stylish (hah!) you are treated with respect unlike other trendy salons where you often read reviews about guests feeling out of place. I did not get any uncomfortable vibes or feel pressured/unvalued. Highly recommend!

So I had promised Samson to hang out before he takes off back to Asia. But I was super hung over and it took all my energy to get out of the house. Being in my mid 30s, i definately dont bounce back like I used too. All I could think about was water... tons and tons of water. And the idea of having the wattress come back every 5 minutes to refill my drink seemed awful. So the first thing I asked for when we got there was a pitcher of water. No questions asked they got me one. This may seem like a small thing but lots of places wont do that and to me at that moment was a life saver. 
Hungry we went for the whole experience, appetizer, meal and desert. It was hard to decide because they had so many different choices and they all sounded so good and the pictures make you want it all. But in the end we figured it out. The deep fried pickles are delicious and you get more then you would think in an order. The buffalo chicken is a good ratio of veggies to meat and I absolutely loved the sidewinders. Super tasty. They do come in a smaller amount but they are super filling and I had to stop to make sure i had room for desert! Which btw also delicious! Even something as simple as a basket of donuts come with dipping sauces that bring it to a whole different level.
Once my food and water needs were met I got a chance to really look around. Im a sucker for classy modern decor. It may be a sports bar but it was beautifully done. My favourite part is the super comfy seats, they were obviously thinking about peoples comfort more then shoving as many people into a space as they can. 
After a bit I decided to try one of their mixed drinks. Went for the blue freeze because a friend ordered one and it looked pretty. It was the perfect level of sweet but not too sweet. I was amazed by the selection of drinks and I admit part of me felt bad for the bartender who had to remember how to make all of them lol.
Service was seriously the best, our wattress was professional but with a sense of humor. We even met the owner at one point and he seemed like a kind down to earth guy. 
At which point we were wrapping up and Samson told me to check out the bathroom. Samson is seriously obsessed with Bathrooms lol. Especially since he had read that there was a bad review on the size of the stalls he just had to know. I admit the toilet paper dispenser could have been a bit further forward to make more room in the toilet area but on whole i thought it was a standard to large size. IMO there was definately enough room to lie down and take a breather if you've had one to many lol. 
Would i come back here? Definately. This hung over girl, with the headache that wouldnt go away was so happy that i got myself out of the house to have a great time with wonderful friends at a great establishment.

We found ourselves in Sherwood Park today around 6 p.m., and so checked YELP for a possible supper locations. The reviews convinced us to give Gregg a try, and we were not disappointed. We ordered the Mezza 8 pc., picking hummus, calamari, labneh, baba ganoush, lebanese chicken wings, stuffed grape leaves, haloumi, falafel plus a greek salad. The stars of the plate were the labneh and falafel, followed closely by the chicken wings and grape leaves. The hummus and calamari were good, but a little blander than the rest. We also ordered the rice pudding, based on the reviews, and it was very nice and aromatic. 
This is one of those small, local places that are a delight to find. We'll go back and I'll definitely have both the falafel and labneh again as well as try some of their skewers.

Consistent snobby and apathetic service.  Staff doesn't care if you walk in, or out.  Even with different staff and on multiple visits - same outcome.  Really disappointing!!!!!!!!!  Pretends to be high end or high class, but doesn't have the staff or customer service to back it up.  Other friends have noticed it as well.   Staff does not care about whether client is serviced quickly or attentively and couldn't be bothered basically.  I did contact a manager at one time to complain and manager didn't care either.  Wasn't surprised as the apple doesn't fall far from the tree as a rule.  They sell Pandora, but do not give a Pandora experience.  Best to spend your money for Pandora at a Pandora shop where you will get the service you are paying for.  Just not impressed. Overpriced items and poor service - just don't know how they stay in business.  People of Sherwood Park expect better.  Far better.

In response to your comment, Kristi:
It's great to know that you are trying to improve your customer service efforts and that new initiatives are in place to improve them.

However, I am further appalled by your comment in a couple of ways:
1) Your lack of acknowledgement of the situation I experienced is appalling from a business standpoint. Where are your business ethics and integrity? Do you understand the power of a simple apology? Most businesses will do anything to try to reverse a wrong. The reason I was told I couldn't use my coupon was because the $60 tank top was listed at 10% off ($6). I also purchased another tank top that you sold for $40. I was spending well over my groupon limit (ie: spending more of my personal money) and yet you couldn't allow me $6 off...!! Shocking from a business standpoint- you have heard of repeat customers if the customer is happy. Appalled that there is no acknowledgement or apology.

2) Your comment was in regards to how YOU are feeling. ie: "we are human, (women)" & "we dry our tears & move on". Wow! That is completely unbelievable. You're a BUSINESS woman, not an emotional wreck, right? Businesses receive feedback all the time, some good some bad. If you're going to treat customers badly the comments you're going to receive will all be negative. You can't justify your behaviour because you're an emotional woman. Obviously you fall into the category of people that  allow others to not take women seriously in the corporate world. 

I also find it amusing that you finally did acknowledge your lack of inventory in the store. Yet when I was in the store and you were verbally attacking me you said you found it hard to believe that there was little to no stock in your store for the past 5 months. Hmmm.... 

I think you need to do a little more repair work than put new customer service initiatives in place.

Wow, this is a kitchen gadget lovers paradise!! 

I don't often head out to Sherwood Park, ha, actually I think it has been three years since the last time I ventured out east. But I am so glad I went. This store blew me away! One thing you get in the burbs is a whole-lotta-space! And this store is no exception. Big expansive, open concept rooms that have a plethora of kitchen goods spaced evenly apart so that you can clearly see everything. Each item is on display on its own; not cluttered and stacked on top of one another. They have a vast selection from very expensive pots and pans, to high end Kitchen Aid and other small appliances. Gadgets, utensils, cloths and cleaning supplies, as well as many cute and quirky items that would work well as gifts. 

They also have all the speciality food stuffs for gourmet cooking that will impress your dinner guests as well. Such as salted caramels, meat and poultry brine's, fancy jams and rubs, organic juices and glazes, exotic teas, Tahitian Vanillas and Dead Sea salts, well, you get the picture! In the middle of the store is a large cooking demonstration area that would make anyone rub a dirty 'ol lamp to wish it in their house. And when I was in, they had just made delightful cookies with caramels baked into them. Low and behold, the recipe for the cookies is right beside the package of caramels needed... very sneaky, preying on my sweet tooth! 

I bought two items that I have been searching for for a while now, a tea cozy to keep my giant morning pot warm for hours (used it today, totally worth the $10!). And a really cool herb keeper (no, not that kinda herbs!) by a company called Cuisipro. It looks chic and was only $18.95 so all in all, I am very happy about the expedition!

Always friendly people volunteering here. A community cafe - staffed by volunteers. 

A great spot for coffee and home made treats as well as lunches.

This was my third time to a Cora restaurant. Same atmosphere inside, but it just seemed lacking compared to the one's in Edmonton. First there wasn't an animal fruit display like we saw in the South Edmonton location when you walk in. The North Edmonton location at least had a fruit display even if they weren't shaped like animals. This location had nothing. 

Seating took awhile because the hostess really took her time, so table sat empty for the longest time. It also seemed as though (and I may be wrong here) some people were getting seated ahead of others because they knew the hostess. In particular one group of four (looked like grandparents with their grandkids) were seated almost immediately upon arriving and were on a first name basis with the hostess.

Our waitress was friendly. However we had to ask repeatedly for water before she finally complied. We were also ready to order when she took our drink order but she rushed off before we could order our food. 

The food was delicious as always. I had a mochaccino which I've had a different location. There was no whip, and it wasn't all that great (in fact it was almost a chore to drink it).  We all ordered bacon as a side, and I was a little disappointed to notice that 2 out of 3 of us had 4 strips of bacon while the third only received 3 pieces.

Overall, I wouldn't come back to this location. I love Cora, but this location could do better I think.

Happened into this salon through a Groupon....lucky me! Not only was the stylist Lauren very good at her job, she didn't make me do the normal salon small talk! From frizzy, dry, split ended hair - to sleek smooth, beautiful, well conditioned locks! She advised me of a spa next door, so I wandered in and got my brows waxed....the best ever! 

They were having a valentine's special so I took full advantage...purchasing a prepaid card in advance as I WILL DEFINITELY BE RETURNING!

Usually salon/spas can be kind of snooty...but not here...they're awesome!!

Highly recommended!

I stumbled across this place last night. Originally I had planned to go to Cafe Haven with my date for dinner (my bad, they are closed for dinner). Gregg's is located pretty much next door so we decided to give it a try. 

This restaurant is on the smaller side and was empty when we arrived but within half an hour it filled up. It might be best to call ahead and make reservations especially on weekends. 

The waitress mentioned they make almost everything there and in small batches every few days. We started by trying their dip trio. It was delicious, especially their labneh (best I've had)! My boyfriend ordered the falafel wrap, and I the tabouli. 

They nailed the falafel wrap. The tabouli was meh. It was a lot of parsley and not much of anything else. I would have enjoyed it as a side salad but not as a main meal. That's ok though because I filled up on the dip trio and pita bread and added a little tabouli with every bite. 

Overall we were super happy to have discovered this place and would recommend it to others. The service was pleasant and friendly.
Loved it. Drink, good, service, awesome. Fair price. Why more is there to say.  Go there.

I was craving boneless wings and saw Wild Wings not far from where I was spending the afternoon in Sherwood Park.  I was overwhelmed by the selection of flavours and eventually settled on a honey garlic/maple cross. The wings were plump, juicy, well-sauces, and delicious. Definitely the best boneless wings I have ever had. At around $11 for one flavour, the price seemed reasonable. I noticed other things on the menu like hot dogs and wraps at very reasonable prices, as well as a selection of fries. My friend had the fries with gravy, cheese, and bacon, and the portion was huge. Totally filled him up. Service was good (although there really weren't that many other people there as it was an off hour). The place was a little too sporty for my taste, but the food and value is very appealing.

I've eaten here 3 times now.  I started at 3 stars and it's just gotten worse every time I've gone.   The decor is 5 star, the food is pretty dismal.   I always finish my broth and the last bowl I had the broth was so salty it was inedible.  I'm also a fan of vermicelli bowls, but they use almost zero marinade and are big fans of char.   Char without marinade is not a good combo.  It just tastes burnt.   No caramelized goodness.  Finally, I tried the beef stew twice....a shocking lack of beef cubes.  Besides the shockingly small amount of meat, the cubes themselves were tiny - barely a centimetre cubed rather than the standard inch.   Truly disappointing.  Too bad the food doesn't live up to the decor.   Unfortunately, this restaurant doesn't make it pays the three strikes your out rule for me.  Even a two for one coupon might not get me back through the door.

Had breakfast here with friends. One asked for no onions. Had onions in the whole dish. Another ordered an item with cheese in it, but no cheese showed up. Even when they remade an omelette with no onions, the eggs were barely cooked.
Our server was friendly and sort of apologetic though. I wouldn't go back for breakfast.

Absolutely terrible?.this
 was the worst place I've been to in a long long time.  I ordered the philly steak sandwich...the beef was tough and dried out, and the mushrooms were old.  Hubby had spaghetti and meatballs...he's not a fussy eater but the meatballs were taken out and left out. He did manage to get the spaghetti eaten.

First visit here the staff was very attentive and friendly. Food was good and we were seated in a separate room considering we had 3 kids in tow and 4 adults. Come early to avoid lineup. Service is quick and food came out at a reasonable amount of time.

Canadian Brewhouse is my first choice for Atmosphere in Pubs. The prices of it's brews are roughly $2 more than MKT or Original Joes.

And while their menu is gigantic, the food is usually so-so.

Why does this so so place get 4 stars?
GREAT service
Free parking
Fun specials
They give little Canadian toothpick flags that all my out of country guests LOVE!
AMAZING PIZZA: Dough made from scratch daily in house, I can definitely say it's now in my top 3 pizza places.

Why not 5 stars?
Food cost vs value only so so

Brought a friend to the tilted kilt for dinner. It was the suit fitting for his wedding and I am the best man, so I figured this place would be perfect.... I was wrong.
Our waitress had about 6 big tables, so throughout the 1.5 hours we were there we saw her maybe 5-6 times. A different waitress came by to clear plates at one point and I asked why our waitress was so slow and she said it was because she had the most tables in the restaurant compared to other waitresses who only had 1.... Need more balance I think.
The manager came to check on us at one point with the old 'how is everything'... He didn't even wait for a response before he was 3 steps away, so when my response was 'this food sucks' he came back to the table. He asked me to specifically tell him what sucked, so I did. The whisky beef tasted like over cooked unseasoned rump roast and the buffalo dip was totally flavourless, not spicy and far too runny. His response was that he had never heard that before and 'is everything else ok?' Sure it was. Everything else was fine, and with that he walked away to never be heard from again.
I have to give credit to the servers because they seem to work hard, but the management and food needs work at this location.

I love kitchen gadgets - anything to make my life in the kitchen easier or more fun, and I am all for it.  I discovered the Pan Tree when visiting a fitness studio in the same shopping complex, and it's definitely a high end kitchen shop.  The store is large, easy to navigate, and full of anything you would need to stock your kitchen.  They have probably every item ever made by Le Cresuet, two walls of specialty knives, and a wide variety of kitchen appliances.  I especially like that they carry accessories that fit my model of KitchenAid mixer - it is a larger bowl lift model, and most stores like Bed Bath & Beyond and The Bay don't carry the right ones.  

In the middle of the store there is a demo area, and if you happen to go on a night when they are demonstrating food or drink, you can sample everything from exotic trail mix to hot chocolate. I do find that the service is really hit or miss though.  I have been in the store at least ten times, and on some occasions I am greeted by a friendly staff member, and on an equal number of occasions I will spend 10 minutes in the store browsing and leave without being acknowledged or greeted if I don't purchase anything.  The Pan Tree is a great local business to support, but I don't know if I would make the trip into Sherwood Park especially to visit the store.

Been here a few times and I'm digging it. For a franchised business the concept of artisan sammiches seems kinda blahzay from the outside. I mean really, meat and veggies on bread? Never heard of that before! Lol. 

I am pleasantly surprised at the menu of selections at Press'd. When you are no longer in the mood for a sub or hamburger, this place is a nice change of pace. 

This location is clean, the staff are pleasant, and service is quick. 

I had their southwest club sammich on focaccia. I thought it was going to be good but I was not a fan of the raspberry chipotle and honey mustard sauce. It made the sammich too sweet. I would have given this place a 4 star rating if my sammich was tastier. Otherwise they can expect my return the next time I'm in the mood for a good sammich.

In all honesty... it's probably only a 2 star really... but I would go back for lunch again, so 2 stars seems a little harsh.

The service was really slow.  Which is odd in a Pho restaurant.  There was only 3 or 4 other tables there during lunch hour... which I thought was pretty strange.

The decor is very modern and nice.

I got a regular steak pho.  Overall... good enough to order again but incredibly lack lustre.  The beef was already overcooked by the time it made it to the table... and of course it continued to cook in the broth.  So it was pretty chewy.

And something happened to me here that has NEVER happened to me before with pho.  Not only did I finish the ENTIRE bowl... but I did not feel full when it was gone.  I think the broth/meat/noodle ratio is off a bit because it just was not satisfying.

Our piercer was friendly and professional. However she was very negative about my daughters chosen piercing. My daughter had researched and knew what she wanted. She also has a high pain tolerance and didn't even flinch during her piercing. Overall the experience was positive.

Gregg Mediterranean Restaurant offers huge portions and friendly service, but the food there is average at best.  They use frozen vegetables for their sauteed veg, for goodness sake!  I was very concerned when I heard the microwave beep in the kitchen for nothing that I ordered should have required microwaving.  They tasted like crap.  Enough said.  

I'm glad to have tried this place out, but I won't likely return until they fix the frozen vegetable issue.  Also, the Western desserts might be prepared offsite by one of those awful food service companies.  A few simple fixes will help improve things a great deal at Gregg Mediterranean Restaurant.

If you are looking for a place to help stimulate your kitchen creativity, this is the place to go! They have every kind of pot, pan, peeler, scooper or dipper you could possibly want or need for the kitchen.

The owners are very knowledgeable about their products and passionate about sharing it with others. If they don't have an answer to your kitchen question, they will find out who does!

The store also has a full kitchen in the middle where they conduct classes and demonstrations throughout the week. This is a great touch and somehow makes the ambiance that much more welcoming.

Went there tonight for the best vegan cooking class hosted by the Mercury Room chefs Jade And Rylan! Absolutely loved the amazing veggie burgers, beet relish, smokey bbq sauce, cornbread and strawberry shortcake we made! So so good. They were awesome hosts and even better chefs :)

Average to below-average Swiss Chalet.  Food was OK, my chicken burrito was plainer than other locations, there was a good amount of chicken in it, but it was served lukewarm. My mashed potatoes were good, but my friend's fries were nearly cold. He also said his beef on a kaiser bun was underwhelming, boring pot roast flavour when ordered sans horseradish. Our tablemates liked their chicken wings and chicken pot pie, although $11 for chicken wings seems a bit much to me given other full meals are $13. Our server was friendly but didn't refill the water glasses once. Oddly she did get more tea and coffee. Dining area was clean, bathroom could use a paint job. I'm not a big Swiss Chalet fan, but if I have to go to one, I might choose a different location.
2nd visit...     Went with the Brewhouse wrap and its everything I'd want in a wrap, lots of flavor and filling.    Sleeman schooners were 10 bucks again, almost too big if you need to drive home.

Their tea is amazing. The second mortgage I took out to support my habit and collection is not!

Service is friendly and helpfull. It's hard not to buy...more...every time!

Soooo many flavors. So little time! 

Winter nightly ritual..."which flavor tonight".

Very good!

If you are looking for a comfortable, sports-bar type experience with scrumptious wings, this is the place for you!

My all time favourite and go-to is the Honey Blues wings. Honey flavoured wings with blue cheese sauce. The wings are always meaty and moist and very flavourful.

The menu is quite varied - nachos, burgers, deep fried pickles etc. but I always default to the wings. If you order fries with your wings - especially the sweet potato fries - you will be very stuffed!

When I first started going to Wild Wing, I thought the prices were a bit high, but I have discovered that it is an excellent value - you get what you pay for!

This is a newer sports bar in Sherwood Park.  They have no less than 22 TV screens and have regular beer specials.  And they have a good selection of beers, including English and German beers.  I like the layout with good bar counter space and nice tables throughout.  Kilt girls are very chatty so service can be slow.  Girls in kilts!  The appetizers, wraps and burgers are good, but we have had bad luck with the entrees.  I like the $2 Tuesday tacos. Great place to hang out but not for dinner.  Not a big place but has a nice cosy feel with a decent patio.  Stick to the basic food and you will be fine.

Huge variety of all your pub grub favorites, only kicked up a notch with no short cuts taken.   I had the shaved beef sandwich and it excellent and loaded with real roast beef, not cheap deli meat.  You have a good selection of sides, including kettle chips which is a great change from your typical fries.

If your looking to eat healthy, look somewhere else.  If you want lots of food and lots of drink, then this is your place.

The room is filled with HD TV's all over making it a great place to watch the game. 

Great place for large to small groups for numerous events.

Friendly staff and helpful.  Wife and I go each weekend for a breakfast date.

95/100 times we haven't had a problem, 4/100 times there was a problem it was taken care of to our satisfaction.

This was the nicest chicken shwarma I've ever had!

We stopped in based on reviews here and were not disappointed! We left very full and very happy.

I was in the area so decided to stop in. Was greeted by a gentleman who was very nice. There was a woman in the kitchen part who did not even acknowledge me. I was disappointed as I had a question about a kitchen item. I asked the man and he was unsure so he went and got someone who knew

I found a unique item that I didn't know that I needed.

They sell Pandora, unique kitchen items, pots and pans, scarves, and other niknaks. I did not know that they made baskets even with the name. They should maybe do a little display if they still do baskets.

It is a place to go for that person who is hard to buy for
This is my go to place for old school pizza. Good service, great pizza and friendly staff.

I went to the Ford Sherwood Park dealership. I had a bad experience with another Ford dealership, and the Sherwood Park Ford dealership turned everything around. My sales guy Nick (Nasser) was awesome. My finance girl Healee was amazing. Got the car and approval within a day. I'm sooooooooooo happy, and I'll only ever shop at this location. I'm officially a happy Ford owner.

I have tried really hard to fall in love with Key-Lime. I have. I am a lover of yoga pants. I am a perpetual racerback tank kind of gal. I was looking for that perfect space between One Tooth and Lululemon to be filled. Unfortunately I will have to keep looking.

A year or so ago I reviewed the downtown/city centre location and was disappointed with the lack of selection and terrible customer service. The manager of that location was kind enough to apologize to me (even though he didn't have to) and that was enough to have me visit the other location in Sherwood Park.

I had some decent luck in Sherwood Park in that I fell in love with Yoga Jeans. They were flattering, they fit nicely and they were comfortable - all qualities I have never seen in jeans before! I bought a pair and decided a few weeks later that I wanted another. After visiting the location several times over a period of a few months and playing telephone tag back and forth to have a pair put on hold, I wasn't able to get a pair in my size. I get it, I used to work in retail too - it was after the Christmas rush, the stock was low. In March, after being told that another shipment wouldn't come in for up to six weeks, I decided to order them online. The store's website does online orders, but rather than it being a separate online store, it is just the retail location shipping goods out of the store (which I didn't know). Needless to say, I was excited to get my second pair of jeans and was looking forward to it.

A month passed and my jeans had not yet come in, so I emailed the store and was told that there had been some sort of issue and the jeans were now coming in from Ontario. Okay, cool enough. I waited ANOTHER month and heard nothing from the store, so I emailed again and were told that they had been shipped to me. Another two weeks passed and I contacted Key Lime again, and they said they were definitely on their way. I was pleased, but the shipment never came. I waited a few more weeks and now it has been THREE MONTHS since my initial order.

I was told that my order had been shipped out and had been waiting at my local post office for me, but unfortunately I was not given shipping information at the time of the jeans being shipped out to me, and the doortag from Canada Post never made it to my door. I live in a condo, but this is surprisingly the first time this has ever happened. I feel that I am being blamed a little bit for this problem, despite the fact that I never received shipping/tracking information in the first place, but perhaps that feeling is all in my mind.

I have now asked for my order to be refunded, as apparently the jeans are being shipped back to Key Lime.

This whole ordeal has been frustrating and disappointing to say the least, and what's the most disappointing is the lack of customer service that I've received. The communication between myself and Key Lime has been polite, but not once have I received a sincere apology or any indication that they care about this problem, other than a "sorry for the delay." Had I been given a GREAT customer service experience, I could have easily waited it out (and hey, I almost did).

I realize that I am simply one pair of jeans to Key Lime, but unfortunately, now they are just another "one star" business to me. I have no doubt that they may be great with some other customers and that most people have had some excellent experiences. But I can't say that I am one one of those people.

Food is great! Love it! Says the deliver , but they don't. What food place that could make a killing doing that, does not do that. So lame.. Again, good is good

 But!!! The pricing is amazing, the food is fair! It's exactly what you want when the want for Chinese food hits!

Never seen someone so disgruntled to have to make a sandwich one hour before close. First time eating there. Wont be back. Terrible service, never thought about it until other reading other reviews used tap to pag so it didnt prompt to tip, no excuse for terrible service basic food. Had reuben. Soggy and bland

Went there on a Tuesday for their  1/2 price wings ( 1/2 price single order of wings with the purchase of a beverage).  

You have a choice of Traditional (breaded and seasoned), Non-breaded, and Boneless (more of a chicken nugget).

With a very wide selection of flavours to choose from (a full page of flavour options, the widest selection that I've ever seen), my wife had the Spicy Gar-Par and I the Honey Garlic Jerk of which we shared a bit of each, both boneless on this occasion.

Each basket of about a pound of meat was tasty and satisfying, served with seasoned fries and a couple sticks of celery and carrot.
Went very well with the bottle of Sol on special for $5!

The young lady that served us was very attentive and helpful, so the very good service also helped make this casual dining experience worth repeating.

I love the quality and price point of key lime!  I just picked up a very cute green jacket for $68... very reasonably priced!  Store includes many items which fit tall and fuller figures.  Love your store.  Kind, friendly owner.
Broke the screen on my iPhone 6plus. Got it repaired here in about 30 minutes for $149.00 which is what they quoted over the phone. Great service to have in Sherwood Park thanks guys.

A pretty typical sports bar, nothing special really but the service is prompt and there are always plenty of tables.

I like that they offer the availability to swap any burger out for a vegetarian burger, but if you are a vegetarian with a dairy allergy or a vegan, that's pretty much the only thing on the menu so it gets pretty old pretty quickly. 

The drinks are pretty well priced, but don't bother ordering the margaritas, they use pre mixed syrup and table salt so they are average at best.

My friend and I had to make a quick trip out to Sherwood Park this morning and we were feeling quite hungry come like lunch time.

Upon arrival we were greeted by quite possibly the most chipper and cheerful hostess I've ever encountered. Almost over the top but actually genuine... Made me think of a SNL Parody for some reason! Never the less, it was a great way to start our experience.

We were told our servers name (which I now forget... I think it was Shawn?). He greeted us with a smile and offered us some beverages. He told us what the fruit juice cocktail of the day was and went off to fetch our drinks. 

By the time he came back we still hadn't decided what we wanted so he gave us a little more time. Once we were ready he came right over and took our order. 

Wasn't long before our food arrived. It was delivered by two lovely ladies, describing our dishes and not auctioning them off! Beautiful and fresh as always. I don't really have much to say as its so consistent here. Always perfect, always hot and always fresh!  Not one complaint regarding the food... Absolutely delicious! 

When it came time for our bill we waited, and waited and waited some more... Stacked our plates and put them at the edge of our table and well... Waited some more! We could see our server and he walked by our table NUMEROUS times. Clearly busy but it takes a second to drop off a bill. We eventually asked another server if she could grab it for us. Our server came over within moments and handed us our bills. :-) 

Service here isn't bad, just slow when it comes time for the bill. Maybe he should have asked for some help if he was falling behind! 

I will likely be back as I do really enjoy Cora's!

I have been to this location a few times and I've always had amazing service in fact one of the best service experiences in a restaurant was here and I wish I remember the name of our waitress because she deserves a raise! It is a bit pricier and as long as you know that going in you pay by the weight of your bowl so be careful of the amount of meat or water down vegetables you serve up as that will make your meal more expensive. It's a lot of fun to create your own stir fry experience and they cook it for you immediately so it's fresh. Then you get to guess the price of your meal and if you're within five cents I think you used to get it for free but now you get a discount. And this restaurant is a great if you're trying to eat on the healthier side as you can pack it with tons of fresh vegetables!

Good pizza? My butt!!!! Way over priced for nothing special/good.. The burgers we had gotten delivered has been burnt, the mozzarella sticks had something wrong with them! How do you mess those up?! Seriously!!! Got the whole group sick. Not to mention, delivery took an hour and a half, and didn't even get our full order!! :( very un-impressed with what they call "food"
Second time after 4years of coming back here and still disappointed.. I gave three for the fair service..

Slow service since it first opened we thought that it would be packed, the restaurant was 2/3 full and we were seated right away.  Waited forever for drink service and bill. When we ordered the food it did come out in a timely manner I will give them that.  Had a hard time figuring out who are server was as we had 3 different people helping us. We orderd the boneless wing platter with 4 different flavours.  The wings were small (more like a nugget) and the flavours weren't that great.

Ugh! I'm really trying to be more positive about this place. The waitresses are very friendly but basically half dressed. Bikini tops and short skirts, it's a bit much and very distracting. They look great, of course but if you're going out for a meal, you don't need giant boobs in your face. 
I think my groups first mistake was going here to eat. This is a place to go for drinks and no food!
The food was awful!!! And I mean awful!! My one friend and I both got the chicken tacos. There were 3 on a plate with corn chips. The chicken was cut up into tiny pieces and super DRY! There isn't any cheese on the tacos which for me is a nightmare, I love cheese! As soon as you pick up the taco, the tortilla rips and falls apart. They don't provide sour cream, just some flavourless salsa. I used my fork and just ate the very bland insides of the taco, just to get some food in my belly. 
My other friend got the turkey club sandwich. She said it was gross. So I tried a few bites and yep, it was gross! Bland and dry, much like the tacos. 
Hmm what else....oh we all shared nachos to start. They weren't the worst but they certainly weren't memorable. There seemed to be tons of topping left over and no chips to eat it with. 

Anyway, it was a Saturday night and it was very dead. They had some decent live music, a guy and a guitar. He was the best thing about the place. 

I would definitely not go here again to eat. I'd possibly go in for a quick pint, if in the area.

I had supper tonight at The Canadian Brewhouse in Sherwood Park ... it was a short walk from my hotel.

Given its name (a "brewhouse"), I was expecting them to have their own in-house beer.  Alas, they don't ... they carry the usual big brands like Bud, Molson Canadian, Coors Light, Keiths (my go-to beer), Rickards, Stella, etc.

I ordered Chicken Parmesean.  Shelby, my server, warned me that it was a lot of food and she was right ... and it was delicious.  The fettuccine alfredo surprisingly had a bit of heat to it.  And it was real chicken with lots of cheese!

Shelby was friendly and took good care of me.

We really enjoy coming here for a drink- especially with a larger group- they are very accommodating! We've always had great service here. I love the new button system for asking for your bill and etc. 

We did try out the "minors before 8" thing with our 15 year old. When we got there they confirmed that we knew the rules for minors, and we assured them that we did, and we'd be long gone before that time. Then they asked for our daughter's ID? For starters she doesn't have one, and secondly, did we not just go through the rules for minors? 

Anyway, I think they have a few kinks to work out with that, but otherwise, we really enjoy it here.

My new goto place for wings out in Sherwood Park.  Service is always decent, never a complaint about the wings.  Deep Fried Pickles are fantastic.  Price is a little high but the wing quality compared to other places in Sherwood Park is higher so I don't mind paying.  Draft beer always seems a little flat so I stick to bottles or fountain pop.
I have used takeout service as well, never disappointed.

Not sure if they have the Renovation Blues or not - but today's experience was terrible! First they made my wife throw out her Tim Hortons steeped tea before she was seated (I guess so she could buy the crappier, more expensive "Chez Cora" version...
