Lots of water - but only one measly tea bag!). Ordered an omelette and her options for sides: potatoes. Or tomatoes. Because, you know, that makes sense. So she added on a "ramekin of fruit". For $3.50. More like "a meager offering of fruit". 2 strawberries, a slice of kiwi and a few grapes. Needless to say for a little bit more she could have had the buffet at the Fairmont. That's about it for us - the ridiculous wait times used to be worth the great food and above-par service. Now not so much. Hope this is just an off day for them!
Ive ate at willys a few times and havent been able to find a better pub. Great service, friendley surroundings. Food is very good and affordable, definatly a good way to spend a friday night.

I was in a bind and with short notice Confetti Sweets was able to make me a custom order. They were so perfect for a special event.  The logo on them was beautiful and they tasted as good as they looked!  I would definitely recommend Confetti to anyone!

Went in for coffee with a friend. We were both impressed. I want to go back and try the food soon.

I had a chance to stop in again and had a pannini and more coffee. The pannini was an incredible ham, cheese and apple. Totally delicious. Their coffee I found out is roasted by Intelligentsia from Chicago. I have had this somewhere before. On a par with the dear departed Java Jive roasting. Great staff. I shall return.

Very disappointing. We decided to try this place out instead of the much-better Noodle Box. The vegetable chow mein had extremely scarce amounts of vegetables, as did the beef chow mein with black bean sauce. Both tasted the same so I doubt there was any sauce added at all. And the "beef" was either very low quality, or not beef at all. The only thing saving this place from a 1 Star is the portion size, but that can't save the restaurant. Will never be going back.

Brutal beer selection. We went here thinking they specialized in CANADIAN local and craft beer, or heck, even an import or two. Instead they have big names of all the generic , cheapest, flavourless brands - Coors, Budweiser, Canadian. Bleh. Hops? Hef? Stout? Forget it! Choose your favourite pilsner. The only thing even close to a craft beer is Steamwhistle, which was too expensive to draw me back to the generic patio, lackadaisical service, and nachos whose toppings include two different kids of onion, practically raw white and green. Indigestion, lack of beer choices and an expensive bill = no reason to return.

This was my third time here an enjoyed it so much .love the mushroom burger an poutine 
The best. I will be bad soon

This is an absolute wonderful dealership to deal with!  I just leased a Ford Escape and was helped by Michael. He was an absolute pleasure to deal with and helped us find everything we wanted!  The process was made incredibly easy and we are absolutely in love with our new Ford!

I was pretty disappointed as soon as I stepped foot in this restaurant.  It was a game night, so I understand it was going to be busy.  But when you step in at 6 pm and the game isn't till 830 there should be some organisation.  3 people were ahead of us and were told the would be seated in 15 min. Then it came to my husband and I and we were told there are no more tables available, even though 3/4 of the restaurant was empty. So we sat at the bar. We were served right away for our first batch. Over 30 min into our evening the people ahead of us still weren't seated, and we noticed them walking out. There was one server for the seated people in the bar, which us honestly plenty in my opinion. Only problem she walked by us and our empty glasses several times. I had to flag her for service every time. Didn't ask how the food was. Didn't fill our drinks. Nothing until flagged.  EXTREAMLY DISAPPOINTED in the service. Luckily the drinks were good and food was delicious.

Yummy yummy yummy I got fruits in my tummy!

One of my favourite breakfast/brunch places around town! 

Love the cute foodie/ingredient artistic pictures along the walls, very bright interior matches the colours of sunrises and delicious fruits. 
The staff are pretty nice, and sometimes you get that super enthusiastic early morning person which is great! 

I've never had bad food here - it's always been deliciously roasted/toasted/baked/broiled/sliced/diced to perfection 
French toast and crepes are my favourite brekkie dishes, and they know how to pile on the fresh fruit    yum!
It's also decently priced for the quality and quantity that you receive 

Ps - tasty fruit smoothies are in!  Get the summer flavours while you can!!

The line ups are long for dinner order at the counter. Must be worth it because there are 15 of us here right now. Call ahead for pick up orders if you want to be more efficient. Then don't stand in line for your pick up order. Trust me - good Chinese food.
Love this place! The new location looks awesome! I love how it's organized like a little boutique. The owners are amazing! The staff is wonderful.

Wicked Thai is awesome but I find their bacon rubbery/chewy and undercooked...But the main reason for only 2 stars is Why the hell are they asking for a tip BEFORE I even get my lunch??? That's absurd! Just because I don't tip at the time I pay, I get stink eye! Then it makes me feel like they're gonna sabotage my lunch in some way....if I'm staying to eat and they have to clean a table I'll definitely tip..but seriously? Automatically expected?? No thanks
What a great establishment! Best pizza in the Edmonton/Sherwood Park area. Couple that with friendly staff and great service and you got a sure winner!!

Huge menu with high prices. Two $16 burgers and 3 beers later cost $70. Crappy beer selection, but there were middling european imports on draught, nothing local or hopped to speak off. Was expecting a focus on local beer. They do have an extensive hard ice-tea menu. The stripper outfits are cute in a weird pervy Catholic schoolgirl way. It was the first place we tried after arriving in Edmonton, so maybe this is just the Albertan way? I guess you need to work in the oil patch to feel like throwing around a lot of money here is worth it.

So, the cool thing about this restaurant is that after you pick a bunch of uncooked items from a cold table and they cook it all out for you, they have you guess how much money your meal costs as they charge by weight. Other than the first time that I played this game, I have been really bad and really off at guessing.

I would say that a normal person would pay between $12 to $22 for their meal which includes your choice of bad soup or an even worse soup and includes rices/wraps. My recommendation when picking items from the cold table is to skip out on the noodles unless you're really religious when it comes to noodles.

It's hard to blame the cooks or anybody except yourself for a bad meal here as the sauces/meats/ratios are all left to yourself. The groceries and condiments seem quality enough and usually end up pretty tasty.

Looks wise, I think this place is red and has some tables. I can't really picture it besides a few pieces of Mongolian-style art and pictures. Inoffensive and clean, I can see how the East Edmonton and Sherwood Park crowd can make this a regular lunch spot.

Visited here a couple of times before buying our truck. Had a great experience and got exactly what we wanted. The sales staff (Ace) was great to deal with and everyone was very friendly. 

Spent a lot of time in the finance department with Sharbel, another employee that is great to deal with. He has taken care of everything from our finance to our registration and insurance. Friendly and seems to really care about his clients. 

Only downside is the length of time it takes from beginning to end...about 5 hours but I think thats somewhat normal from my past experiences at dealerships. 

We have already recommended Sherwood Ford to our family and we will be returning soon to buy another new vehicle. 

All in all, while visiting here I feel like my integrity is intact and I came out feeling like I was treated like a human being.

I was way too early arriving to Sherwood Park for work today and needed somewhere to kill some time which brought me into Common Ground. You kind of have to keep your eyes peeled for it as it's in a small business complex with a few medical offices and a daycare but it's well worth taking the time to find it.

The atmosphere is so warm and friendly that it feels more like walking into someone's house than a cafe. They offer an impressive compliment of beverages,baked goods,and light lunch items. The chai latte I ordered was one of the best I have ever had and honestly puts Starbucks to shame. You would never know this place was ran by volunteers if they didn't advertise it so freely because the quality of the experience is so good it's hard to believe they are not getting paid.

If your out and about in Sherwood point I highly recommend making a point to stop here and make sure you don't leave without checking out the cases of pretty handmade items created solely by local artists. I will surely be back when I get paid next and my wallet is absolutely going to hate me for it.

Really decent spot. Strange location but the food was unreal and the price was super cheap for the quality. I had the falafel pita and my friend had the chicken shwarma - both were super tastey with a really great flavour. Would definitely go back.

Been twice and have enjoyed the food and staff.  The ambiance is a little bland and bare.  Caution if your order heat level 6 prepare to experience serious spice.

There are so many combinations and we'll keep going back to try more.

Nice addition to SP

This was my first time here and I'll be back. I asked the server what he recommended and he suggested the house special pho noodle soup - it was delicious. The service was great and the establishment was clean and inviting.

My first time to this restaurant. Modern/cold furnishings - okay.
Ordered #18 pho with everything. Had to request sprouts and spoons. I enjoy pho all the time but this one lacked in flavour and quality. Tasted like what dishwater might taste or perhaps a canned pho broth...watered down.  The meat was so dry I could barely swallow it. The meatballs were full of what appeared as grizzle and had absolutely no flavour. The first time I have even left a full bowl.  This has got to be the worst pho I have ever encountered. When asked how our meal was we stated it was not great, the meat dry and tough and the waiter just smiled and walked away. No comment even when picking up the full bowl back to the kitchen. I would not return attempt another dish. I would not recommend this restaurant. Terrible pho.

WOW !!!! Believe it or nor.... the food and service is awesome here :)

Its a Must Do Place!!

Our favourite "Mashawee"- The meat platter and deserts!!

My first time and was skeptical to even go after hearing two polarized views. I get in the door and meet total awkwardness...being stared at next to the "Please wait to be seated" sign. Ordered the 4th of July: crepes, french toast and fresh fruit. The crepes were obviously pre made and frozen, with very chewy texture and dry ends. Yuck. Only saving grace was fresh fruit on top. 

Put your money to better use at another joint or make breakfast yourself. Not worth the visit.

Brought my iPhone 6 in this morning without an appointment. It was shattered glass with entire pieces missing out of the top lines and blotches all over it and I couldn't push any buttons. 40 minutes later it was perfect. We were worried their might be moisture damage and he said there wasn't so I was impressed with the honestly. It was 99$ apple quoted me 400$ I will refer everyone.

Great food and friendly staff. 

Yes, another sports bar, but this one is nice. Love the numerous TV's. especially the little, personal TV at your table. So if you want to watch a game that is not on the larger TV's you can. Food is yummy and plentiful. Cost is comparable to all the other restaurants in the area. 

Big bonus is that not only do they allow kids until a certain time (I was told 8pm, but unsure) but they actually have a kids menu. Many of the similar sports bars in the area allow kids to a certain time, but do not actually have a kids menu. The kids loved their food as did the adults. We will definitely go back.

I have been to this particular location (as well as other locations around the city) and I have to say that I am becoming very "meh" to Canadian Brewhouse as a chain. The biggest thing I enjoy about them is the food; a large and diverse menu with generous portions and everything generally is pretty delicious. However, that is where it stops for me. 

The crowd varies depending on the night, but it is generally on the rowdy side. Many young guys in big groups, as there is generally some sort of sporting event going on. Not really ideal for having a chill dinner with a friend...unless you like yelling over loudspeakers. 

I have also had issues with the service. On a few occasions I have had snarky and rude treatment by the servers here. On one occasion I went to bite down on what I thought was a piece of ice on my pint glass, only to discover that it was actually a piece of glass. Thankfully, it did not cut me, but I ended up getting a piece stuck in my teeth. Instead of helping me and maybe finding me a toothpick, my server panicked and ran away stating "Why do these things always happen on my shift???". It took me and two of my friends to track down a manager to report the incident and to get me a toothpick and a glass of water to try and rinse out the glass. Again, no damage done, but immediately they started aggressively arguing that this was not their fault. The manager "generously" gave us 50% off one item on our tab, but kept pushing us to buy more drinks. The last thing I wanted to do was to make a second attempt at a pint glass in that establishment. 

Recently, my friends and I were there for a paint night event, and the service was not much better. We came with plenty of lead time, but on a night where it was mostly empty in there, our food took almost an hour to come out...so after the event had already started. I even ordered soup...and it still took forever! In addition to that, I had been given a glass with lipstick all around the edges. No biggie, I know that stuff it tough to get off and a dishwasher doesn't really cut it. But instead of taking my glass, the waitress questioned me and said she didn't see it! It's not like I would make that up. Then, when our food finally did come out, they put it on the table we had been sitting at before the event started and never told any of us it was ready! So by the time we got to it, it was already cold. 

So again, overall, the food is good but the customer service is not. Go there to watch a sporting event, but I wouldn't suggest going for much else.

Numerous TV screens for sports.  I counted 23!  There are servers in skimpy attire so if that is not your cup of tea I suggest you go elsewhere.  Cosy indoor pub feel.  They have a patio.  Tuesday $2 tacos are good and Thursday $5 nachos hit the spot!  Food is hit or miss if you stray from the basic burgers and wings. Extensive number of beers on tap including Murphys Stout, Erdinger, Newcastle, Stiegl, Samuel Adams, etc.   Service can be slow so don't be shy to flag down someone or approach the bar.  Drink specials daily.  No happy hour though.

This is my first time buying experience at Sherwood Park Ford. As a local business owner I also want to support local businesses and it was clear from the start that this was the best place to put my money. Everyone treated me with respect and Warren Harding helped me get the deal I needed without delay. We had a couple of hiccups, but nothing that wasn't fixed right away. All of the staff I dealt with were genuine and hard working for the customers. I am proud to be driving my F150.

I came here with a mani/pedi groupon and was very happy with the beautiful atmosphere of the salon, the impeccable service and the end results of pretty fingers & toes! 

It was easy to book an appointment using their online system, and I felt welcomed and comfortable during my entire stay. They seem to do a full service of hair and esthetics, including massage - check them out!

So worth coming here with ESSC! Just join a social sport get your card and come here all the time! Free Nachos with 2 members... I have had the nachos about half a dozen times this season and they are consistently good and numerous locations! YUMMMM!!!! Their $5 special for a 2 topping pizza is a great deal too. I like this place for good standard food and drinks. I am a FAN!

This is Sherwood Park's newest Starbucks and only the second one in town with a drive-thru - that alone should give it a couple extra stars!

The decor of this Starbucks is laid back and comfortable feeling, with lots of diverse seating options. There is one large, long table that would be perfect for a study group or business get together, as well as single, low chairs. With the distressed tin walls covering part of the coffee shop, you get a definite "kick back and relax feel".

The service is great and of course the coffee is... well, Starbucks - so how can you go wrong? A nice selection of bakery items and clean, comfortable washrooms make this spot high on my coffee spots list.

My least favourite place to go in terms of bars in Sherwood park. The overpriced food is decent but the atmosphere is so bad that I can't even get through a meal without rushing out of that dump. I don't know how they claim to be a sports bar? I could go on but why bother. This place won't be around long.
They have a knowledgable staff and have a ton of sizes to offer! All clothes are Canadian made which I love and are of very good quality!
Best pizza in Sherwood Park.  Love the Fred Specail

I am not going to bother to comment about the wallpaper but I will say the food was not great.  Spring rolls came out cold.  Soup was not hot and the wontons were cold in the centre.   Main dishes were cold as well. Very disappointing for a new place.   Sat by the window.  Very dirty.  Will not return.

It's just cookies - but they are great cookies! The chocolate coconut gluten friendly cookies are my "go-to" for work events. Everyone loves them! The service is helpful and accommodating ; even on short notice they will do their best to bake what you need. You can also have kids' birthday parties here - much fun to be had mixing the dough by hand! After they're baked and decorated, each kid takes whom at least a dozen, so the party favours are taken care of too.

Ordered 2 pints of beer and the Montreal smoke meat sandwich. Beer is good and cold as usual, very fairly priced at 7.99 on special for coors banquet. Montreal smoked meat sandwich however didn't come close to what the menu described. Stale bread toasted on one side with lightly cooked fatty meat shoved inside. Plus fries for 16 dollars? Could've done better there.

Like many Mongolian places it's pay by the bowl. They have a special that if you guess within 5 cents of your price you get 10% off but that should have been a warning. At $13 a pound this gets expensive quick. Many vegetables are soaking in water to "keep them fresh" but this just adds extra weight. 

I would have been able to get past all of that of the sauces that they advertise so heavily had any flavor. 

I used 2 full scoops of their lemon dill flavoring and my husband did 2 scoops of their teriyaki flavoring and when our dishes came back to us they were so bland I had to add additional soy sauce so I could even eat it. Maybe it was the soba noodles we both got and the fact they were soaking in water that they couldn't absorb any flavor but I was seriously disappointed with the end result.

Kitchen gadget store that will blow your mind! I love the variety of housewares and knick knacks the have.

Nathalie, the owner, takes great pride in the lines and brands she chooses to sell here, such as Henkel and Le Creuset.  

There are also delicious treats you can pick up to spoil yourself or a loved one. My favourites are the salted caramels (only available during Christmas time) and the Jacek chocolate bars!

I must admit when I walked in the door I had no idea how they came up with the name Baskets In The Park. It was not until I came home and checked out their website that I found out they specialize in custom gift baskets for special occasions. The lady at the front was friendly enough when I came in the door but I would have appreciated if she came out from behind the counter to speak to me and see if there was anything I needed help with because if I had known they had gifts to celebrate new babies I would have bought alot more than what I walked out with today.

They carry a really wide range of interesting products including kitchen stuff and jewelry. I am pretty much a one pan keep it simple kind of gal but I think if your a from scratch cooking whiz you would have a great time checking out all the different pots,pans,and gadgets they sell here. Alot of the stuff looks pricey but I think what they charge is fair for the quality of item your getting. 

I left with a really gorgeous scarf for myself and when I brought it up to the till saw they have a rewards program for their customers. Thankfully there is no annoying card to carry around and they just keep track of everything on their computer. I applaud the intelligence of that decision as I think rewarding your customers for their loyalty is a great way to keep people shopping local businesses.

I am really quite pleased with the scarf and could see myself making return visits when I am in Sherwood Park. It is a new area they are just developing near Millennium Place so the location seems a bit awkward right now but I think when all the new businesses go in and more people get drawn out that way they will see an increase in foot traffic. I just hope when that happens they come out from behind the counter and get more engaged with people. You can't always assume everybody who walks in has been in before and you might be costing yourself potential sales by not educating people about your products and services.

I recently took a baking class here and it was a fun experience. The staff associate (maybe the owner?) wasn't involved in the class but was very friendly and offered us tea and chocolates throughout the evening. The store is very nice and organized. I don't generally purchase many kitchen gadgets or tools but I enjoyed looking around at their interesting products as they have a great variety of items and I will definitely keep this place in mind next time I do need something.

Newer local Mediterranean Greek style restaurant.  Saw the good reviews and checked it out.  We have been to Greece twice.  Small inside but nice.  In a strip mall.  Quiet and good for couples.  Was busy on a Friday.  Mediterranean music playing was nice.  Service was excellent.  Food was average however.  Our Shawarma was very spicy for some reason and I'm no slouch.  Had the burps for hours.  The rice was good.  The Labneh salad had too much vinegary  dressing and there was very little feta cheese.  Their Greek salad is not true Greek as it comes with lettuce and they skimp on the feta.  Good place to try once.
Was a new client and used a Groupon for full highlights with a cut and style, and got a great style. Awesome service, lots of fresh baked goodies, and Kristen gave me a great colour and cut.
We came here while on our trip to Canada, i would say the pizza came out to be the best one i had so far. The people are very nice and friendly. I would highly recommend this place

Just love going there. Abbey(the golden retriever) greets everyone that's comes in the door. I bring my dog every time. They have many varieties of raw dog food. I think my dog eats better than me......Kelly

I don't live in Sherwood Park, nor do I frequent this Save On Foods location very often, but when I do, it's usually during my meal breaks, so i've always found this location to be quiet, with ample parking and I can find whatever I need without feeling frazzled by crowds or carts. Today, I was happily surprised to see free slices of fresh watermelon upon entering the store to promote that they were on sale - oh it was so good! And perfect for the hot day it was! (I actually went back for two slices.... shhhhh!) I would recommend this location as i'm sure it'll serve all your grocery needs!

These cookies are so amazing! Very moist, super fresh and super decadent. Bought these for a potluck and *whooosh* they disappeared! These were obviously a huge hit. 

I had the coconut one... mmmm so good. I normally don't like coconut stuff at all but this was delicious. 

Too bad the feature cookie wasn't included in a dozen. I wanted to try the sandwich!

Will def be back for more!

I've been back to the tilted kilt a few times recently, mostly because of their amazing patio and the nice weather.
The service the last 2 times has been 5 stars as the waitresses have been both attentive and hardworking. The manager (Laura) was very liberal with a couple of free drinks for me and a buddy last time I was there and then this time I heard her send drinks to the table next to us... So good for her for finding ways to increase the customer experience.
So while the food has been decent albeit a little inconsistent, I am confident in saying that this place has a great local following and with their lunch club (10th lunch is free) I will be a part of that moving forwards.
Check it out if you are in the neighbourhood.

I love the quality of my KEYLIME clothing.  I purchased two tank tops and a pair of capri pants and they have held up wonderfully after many wears/washes.

I need to visit the store again - and soon!

Wow. What a nice change for a sports bar. This is what I would classify as an upscale sports bar. The seating is like a lounge feel with full comfy chairs. Almost every seat in the place has a good view of the TV when there is an event going on like UFC. 

Good music playing in the background but not so loud that you can't have a good conversation. The servers were super friendly and fast. We always had a full pitcher of water at out table and drinks were full.

We had the calamari and fried pickles for our appetizers and they were fantastic. The calamari was lightly battered so it's not that heavy and very nicely seasoned. 

I also had the jalapeño burger. This was very good but a little mild for my taste. The jalapeño sauce is a mixture of mayo as well so it's a little bit creamy. Oh! And make sure you get the curly fries. They are a mixture of potato wedges and curly fries.

Lastly we had the doughnuts and pretzels for dessert. These are great to share with a group and taste amazing. 

I will definitely be coming back. Good atmosphere good, good friends. Two thumbs way up.

My experience with Matt and Steve was not a positive one.  Actually I never got to meet Matt or Steve of Donewell Property Services.  The reason being, they never showed up to do the spring cleanup on my property that I had engaged their services for.  Four times they never showed up...  
To start with, it is impossible to reach someone.  The only way to have someone contact you is to leave a message.  It took over 48 hours for Matt to get back to me.  He then said that they were busy, but thought they could fit me in the following Thursday (the next week).  Thursday rolled around without contact.  I thought, no worries, someone will show up...  I called in the morning, wondering what time I could expect them.  Matt answered and didn't recall speaking to me.  Said I must have spoken to Steve, and Steve should be along shortly.  Noon and no Steve.  Afternoon and no Steve.  I finally got a hold of Steve.  He said I must have spoken to Matt, and he didn't have anything about me in their schedule.  Awesome.  Whole day wasted waiting for them.  Steve said sorry, bagger broke down but don't worry, he'll come by on the weekend and do the yard.  Saturday rolled around.  No Matt, no Steve.  No word.  Granted, this was the May long weekend, but if you say you're going to come, then get your butt out here, or at least let me know!  Finally heard from Steve through text message.  Sorry about that, he'll be out later in the week.  Super! (Meanwhile, not being that big of an idiot, I'm now shopping around for a new lawn care company.  He who is out first, gets the job.  So, what do you think happens later in the week???  NO STEVE!!!  Shocking, I know!  
So, I sent another text message wondering what happened and he says Monday for sure.  And I say, for sure this time, and he promises. Seriously, his text message said "I promise".  Ok, ok.  I know I'm getting predictable, but what do you think happens on Monday??  NO SHOW!!!!  I know, I'm not surprised that this point either.  I should say that I don't know if Steve texted me because my horse stepped on my cell that morning, and it did no survive the insult.  I did however call twice to let him know that he couldn't reach me by text, but that he could call me on my home phone.   I called that evening, leaving a pointed message asking what happened and requesting a phone call, as that would be the professional thing to do.  At least have an excuse.  And make it a good one.  At this point however, to ask Steve and Matt at Donewell Property Services to be professional is rather pointless and redundant. 
In summary, if you engage Donewell Property Services, do so at your own risk, and make sure you have a back-up plan.

I was a bit skeptical of this community cafe when I first heard about it. But now I'm a believer.  This place not only serves great coffee they also serve some fantastic homemade baked goods. The volunteer staff are all fantastic and very friendly. Service is great and the atmosphere is top notch.

The only thing I don't like is the lack of plugins for computers. There are only plugins along the north wall. So I can't sun bathe as I work and stuff my face.

I really wish that Sherwood Park had a downtown district because this place would be better served at a location with tons of foot traffic. Nonetheless, there is ample parking and plenty of seats available in the cafe.

You need to stop by this place when you can.

The positive:  The Wednesday night wings were large, delicious and well priced.

The negative:  I couldn't agree more with Paul G. regarding their so called "Pints" of beer.  Give your head a shake Brewhouse for trying to pass these off as a pint.

I have to wear yoga type wear for work and am always looking for new places besides the usual lululemon. I went to the Sherwood park location to check things out after looking online before driving there. I was greeted warmly and the women working was very helpful. when I was trying items on and asking about certain products she was knowledgeable and right there to help. 
the products themselves are very comfortable. as a curvy, well-endowed women it can be a little jab to the self esteem when trying to find sizes and fits. these seem to be tailored more for the average women. in fact trying on the pants made me feel even smaller! the prices are also more reasonable than lululemon and they offer most of the same styles in pants and tank tops. can't wait to go back!

This place was a huge disappointment. I had such high expectations once we were seated - place has nice decor, big menu, tv screens....but then it was all downhill from there. 

We were with a group of 20 for a birthday but were only provided one waitress, even though a reservation was made. There was a 45 minute wait for drinks AFTER they were ordered. Once the food arrived, the waitress asked if everyone had everything they needed but neither myself nor my boyfriend had our meals. When we asked where they were, we were told she didn't ring them up. By the time our meals were served, everyone had finished eating. When I spoke to the manager about the poor service, he couldn't care less. 

Crappy service, subpar food: save your money for the other restaurants close by - Japanese Village, LOCAL or Royal Pizza.

A great place for a quick lunch!  I always manage to find seating around lunch time, which can be a feat in Sherwood Park.  Additionally, I can always seem to find something on the menu that really appeals to me; however, I find that I am never really wowed by the food.  They have a really good selection of pub-type food at reasonable prices.  Not the place to go for a fancy lunch, but definitely a good spot for an informal lunch.  Also a good spot to get together after work for a bevy or 2 with the girlfriends!!

This is my regular grocery store.  It is always clean and with the exception of the bakery staff, the staff is very friendly.  The bakery is awful.  "Fresh" cookies will be on the shelf for way to long and hey are dry and awful.  Check the packaged on dates.  The customer service, and check out staff are amazing and always very helpful.

I went to verge expecting to leave feeling refreshed and w some tension relieved. I left with more pain in my back than what I came with. And the lady doing my fingers and toes left me alone for a totally of 45 minutes and seemed not to care. My 6 year old niece could have done a better job! And at the end when I went to pay no one even bothered to ask how my day was. I won't be back. Ever.

I had heard from a friend that when she went to get her eyebrow pierced here, it got infected right away. I went in to get my lip piercing changed and figured it would be fine since it was already pierced. When I got it pierced, it was clean and I had no problems. Just from getting it changed here, it started to get crusty and eventually tore the skin inside of my lip and had left a flap of skin. Disgusting, I know. I had to end up taking it out.

In my mind this is the best car wash in Sherwood Park. The pricing is reasonable, the bay's are clean and they have horse hair soap brushes. Unlike the other places that use synthetic brushes. What does that mean? Less scratching to your clear coat. 

I've tried every other car wash in the Park and they are either dirty, expensive or just laid out wrong. Mississippi Jacks is the best laid out and best priced punch ticket wash around. 

The only flaw is the driveway to the bays. You have to cut into the gas station stalls when lining up. I recommend not coming here after a rain storm or snow storm or on the weekends. It gets really busy. If you have to come here on the weekend go early in the morning or late at night.

I was a little shocked at the other comments b/c I was in the store today and the people were nothing but helpful! They were practically bending over backwards to help other people and find the right fit. 
The problem with the groupon culture is that people expect to get everything they want at a discount. If you're getting half off a product - smile, be happy. Don't berate the store?!?!

This was my second trip to this location of David's Tea and this trip truly cemented my love for the people who work at this location. This time around I was buying some tea then got some lattes to go. The employees were very friendly and engaging. Making the short wait for my lattes truly a great experience. You can tell  they really love their jobs which makes being a customer so easy and enjoyable.
Great wings and great prices, great staff. Half price wings  on Tuesday and lots of TVs for watching he fights!

I wish they could get my vehicle back to me when promised. I drop my vehicle off the night before my appointment and I NEVER seem to get it back until closing. I book my appointments weeks in advance  not sure why I get calls late morning telling me the are just working on my SUV now. I drop it off early so I can get it back early.
I had a chicken kebob with almazza beer and enjoyed them. The staff were charming and respectful. I would highly recommend this Mediterranean restaurant.

I've long been a fan of royal pizza. It's got such a nice atmosphere and their food is fantastic. The employees treat you like family (but not in a weird way) 
And it sounds weird but I highly recommend the spaghetti pizza. It's so good! 
The parking lot is kind of tight but there's additional parking around the rear. 
I highly recommend this place
Great cafe and great concept of bringing the community together! Love that they have some gluten free baking and very good coffee. Great place to stop in for a visit.

I've been going to Concrete Blonde Hair / Body & Tattoo for a few years. It's a one stop, constantly educated shop with a Stylist, Barbers & Techs most beauty needs can be covered from basic waxing to micro blading, lash extensions and permanent make up application. Have a wedding ? They cater to that with style too. I feel comfortable recommending you try Concrete Blonde. Always a good mix of men & women, both guests & stylists. 

Concrete Blonde is active in fundraising for the community through partnering with local businesses that provide service for those in need. Currently CCB will be Spinning to raise funds and awareness for CASA HOUSE. 

TIP: As always have reasonable expectations! When we, the guest are outlandish beauty shop relationships can sour unnecessarily. Your in good hands here! The salon / spa decor will not disappoint.

We love the service and DEATH SAUCE CHICKEN WINGS!!!

Amazing variety of poutine. This is must go to place in sherwood park!!!

Always good food and happy staff, was welcomed by the bartender with a "how are you guys? Welcome". 
The steak sandwich is great, and I always get a side order of the buffalo chicken poutine. 
Great for lunch and dinner. This pub is clean, and has great appies, and huge tv screens everywhere!  
Great place to start off the night!

Starbucks is Starbucks here or in Seatle. Lots of seating, coffee wharehouse feel. The coffee is too strong for my taste, I always ask for half a shot to any latte. I do like their green tea lattes though. They are tealicious. ;-)

The food was good but the staff were all realllll useless...when I asked to buy a gift card not one of them knew how to do it. We stood around while they phoned probably every other employee, and when they all concluded that nobody could do it, they walked away without letting us know we were SOL. 
We've been back since, and the service was better. I recommend it for a quiet dinner since it's not very busy..
Love, love love this restaurant!!! Went for lunch today and had the kafta wrap. It was amazing. I will most definitely be returning soon!

With the recent change of the menu I am very disappointed. Previously they had the sort of menu and food where no matter what you ordered you couldn't really go wrong. 
Now they have changed their menu from classic pub fare to a fancier gastropub type deal. They used to offer a good steak sandwich special. Well the special remains but the quality of the food has gone down. There was a half hour discrepancy between some of our party members meals coming out. 
Considering how good their food used to be and how often we frequented Overtime as a group. It's really disappointing to say we likely won't be back.

We decided to try take-out but we'll be coming back to dine-in!  They have a belly dancer on Friday evenings.  Very friendly staff and the food we ordered (fattoush salad w/chicken, lamb kebabs, order of hummus) was delicious.
Our favourite neighbourhood pub, great staff, great food, a perfect Friday night place to relax after a long week of work.

Came here recently to get Take and Bake Pizza after ordering online. Staff were very friendly and my order was ready and complete upon my arrival. As always the pizza was in good condition and the additional toppings I requested for my order was added in quantity which was really quite great! I am sure we will be repeat customers at this location as their rewards program really encourages it and we used to visit another location with frequency in the past.

Absolutely terrible Stealership. Bought a "Demo" model F-150 that their Sales manager Nick and one for their sales men, Adel, assured me the Vehicle was like new. They told me it was driven to and from the dealership by one of their managers for a little under a year but it was in perfect condition. What a load of crap! First they were supposed to have the Vehicle detailed (rock chips filled in) when I picked it up they didn't. There was a gap in the rear passenger door handle that they were supposed to get looked at before delivery - they didn't. I had to bring it back 2 times for both these things. The door handle couldn't be repaired as the whole inside door panel is apparently warped and they said they had to warranty the whole inside door panel to fix it and would call me when it arrived. That was 2 months ago still no call to bring it in to get it fixed. At Thanksgiving my wife and my 18 month old were driving 2 hours out of town and almost went off the road THREE TIMES because of how bad the tires were on the vehicle - the Tuesday after Thanksgiving I took it to a Tire shop to look for winter tires and the Tire Centre tells me my vehicle should have 20 inch tires on it but Sherwood Ford had replaced the 20" wheels with 18" wheels and crap tires - why would they do something like this... Hmmm.. Possibly to sell them and recoup more money on selling me a "Demo" model.  These guys are absolutely crooks! There are more issues than that with this vehicle and this Stealership so many, in fact,  that I have a full investigation going with AMVIC as Sherwood Ford refused to address these issues directly with me. Once AMVIC is done I'm going to a lawyer if I do not get this resolved. "The Giant" actually agreed to take the Vehicle back then the next day told me they couldn't give me what they said they would for this Truck as their purchaser takes trucks and resells them to the USA and wouldn't be able to do so with my truck for 6 months as I had registered it. Once I put in my complaint with AMVIC 3 WEEKS AGO I told AMVIC I would give them the 7 business days to correct this issue or I would be starting to let everyone know how bad these guys are. DO NOT BUY FROM THESE GUYS!!! All they care about is taking your money and smooth talking you till they're blue in the face but that's all it is - Talk. Sales department is crap, service department is just as bad. Seriously though - Buyer BEWARE!

Great local business, but the lady I had helping me was full of tattoos and attitude.  Negative about everything, had all kinds of crap to say about other businesses in the area, the entire experience was miserable thanks to her seething negativity.

I had my hair done by Nicole Z. at Concrete Blonde and had to get it fixed a few days later.
I asked for caramel balayage and basically got random orange streaks that started bluntly in the middle of my hair. As soon as I got home to investigate I was shocked to see the terrible job. I immediately e-mailed the owner, along with pictures, who graciously re-booked me with another stylist to fix the mess. My hair was fixed and looked much better at the time, but it quickly faded into a nasty burnt orange color after a few weeks. I ended up going to a whole other salon to get my hair dyed back to brown and will not be trying the "balayage" look ever again. The salon is super nice inside and the muffins were a nice touch. 
5/5 for the customer service on the owners part - but sadly have to give a 2/5 for my initial visit with Nicole = /
Just had a good breakfast! Eggs Benny with a ton of fruit! Gets very busy very quickly. The price was a little expensive but I would definitely go back as a treat!

I love Press'd I order quite often for lunches and work functions, and their staff is always friendly & helpful. 
They always go out of their way to make sure our needs are met even if it's something as simple as throwing together some child friendly platters.

The food is always fresh and delicious. There is a great selection of items that are both classic and new and exciting.
I highly recommend Press'd to anyone who asks.

once again sherwood ford has blown my mind not only am i not a customer or own a ford I am on their mailing list to bring in My ? ford for service you get better every year 
cannot wait for next year I think your organization does need reviewing maybe with the extra postage and printing cost may shorten your life span we can only hope
There all closed around e-town including Sherwood Park.I used to like that one.Girls reminded me of strippers by night.

So sad to have to change my review. We've been visiting Shoeless Joe's since January, on a fairly regular basis. It has been a while since we had gone, so my family decided to return tonight. They were sorely disappointed. The decent beers on tap were gone, and so was the cheese quesadilla on the kids menu (my little girl didn't want to eat after being told this). On top of this the quality of the food has gone drastically down. No longer are the burgers pressed on site, but premade patties and the fish and chips, although large, no longer was a great batter to fish ratio, as it once was, but now mostly batter. It breaks my heart to say this will probably have been our last visit

I am really impressed by their pizza and the whole take and bake model. The staff are pleasant and very accommodating. I recommend that you call ahead your order. It will save you time waiting. 

If you want a good feast buy the stuffed crust pizza. So good! Cooking instructions are dummy proof and the pizza always turns out yummy.

Looking for a to go order on a Sunday I decided to try this place since it's close to home and I had never been before. I can't comment on service or atmosphere - I was so disappointed by the food. Out of the three items in my order only one was tasty (still underwhelming though) the buffalo chicken wrap was very bland and the side salad was wilted. I'm not one to send food back normally but if I had dined in I probably would have. I likely won't be returning here not with all the other choices in the area.

You can say what you want about the evils of chain stores but this girl right here loves the fact that no matter which location I am at I can always count on quality goods and great service from Davids Tea. I stopped in here to get a latte with one of the new recently released winter flavors and had some questions about their tea infused body care line the girl at the counter was more than happy to answer. This was also quite possibly the fastest I have ever been able to get a latte at any Davids Tea. I was also greatly appreciative of the fact she clued me in about the rewards I had accumulated on my frequent steeper card. Those free bags of loose leaf tea do eventually expire and I had accumulated three before anyone warned me they were about to be no more at my regular Edmonton location. The ladies here in the park truly bring their A game!! I will definitely be back the next time I am out and about here in Sherwood Park.

This really a poor experience. We recieved a 5 min tutorial on how to order wings. Its ordering wings how hard can it be?? then looking at the menu, you need a tutorial. In our group all of us had  been to several wing places that offer more than 80l flavours. None of us needed a tutorial before, yet Wild Wing makes ordering stressfull somehow.  

We each ordered our wings (1 pound each all with a differnt flavour) We ordered the "barenaked wings" as none of us like breaded wings. When the wings came they were breaded!! when questioned the waitress said we ordered wrong!!! we clearly confuesed the "Traditional and the Barenaked wings". Of course, that's it!! Three of us all ordered wrong aftere the 5 min tutorial on how to order,  Obviously nothing was done since we made the mistake. 

The Wings.  When you put a flame or 5 beside your flavour there should be some heat in the wings. These were bland, and certainly not hot. 

For a place that serves wings I was expecting better than the average local pub. This was way below the mark. 

I am a big fan of trying new places, but if you have a great or even a good wing place on your list of regular haunts, don't bother coming here to try and expand your list. 

Sorry Wild Wing, Between teh service and how the Franchise has set up the menu, i won't be back or be recomending this place.

No baskets at door customers have to go to till and grab them selves . Lots of people standing around get to work and have baskets ready for your customers your store ain't that busy! Take some initiative and do your fucking jobs. Another problem I have with Walmart especially this location is every time I'm in there they are full of east Indians and their speaking Punjab when they should be speaking English this is rude to do in front of customers and again this is Canada not India . So please respect my rights as a Canadian I don't speak my second language at work especially in front of customers. Smarten up Walmart management or hire someone who will snap down on this crap!!

I was so excited to check-out this store that I had heard so much about that I left work a wee bit early. I needed a Peugeot pepper mill and a few more things and was pumped to spend money on more kitchen accessories that I no longer have space to put them but always seem to find a need to buy more of.

Although the store had a wonderful layout and great quality kitchen stuff, the service was horrible. It did not start well when I walked into this store and was not greeted by the staff. I begin to walk straight to the pepper mill section where I stayed for quite some time looking at the various selection while wondering if they had the one that I liked in a box maybe out back as there seemed to only be displays left on the shelves. As no one was acknowledging me or coming over to ask if I needed help despite the fact that there was only one other customer in the store, I decided to approach the cash register area to ask about kitchen scales.  The customer service representative could not tell me if she had any or where they were, and it took her forever to look them up on the computer... the shop is as big as the palm of my hand...

I was so frustrated by that point that when she did end up showing them to me I briefly looked at them and left the store deciding that I would not be spending my money here and would take my business elsewhere. 

It's too bad, I love encouraging locally owed shops and especially anything that has to do with kitchenware, but I work hard for my money and I expect the level of service that should come with locally owned shops; if I didn't want service I would just shop online which as we all know is much cheaper, convenient and offers a wider variety of products. 

So to conclude my critic, I would recommend this store if you absolutely need that gadget that you are looking for and need right then and there, but if that is not the case, I say go elsewhere where they will provide you with service or at least a smile.
Great breakfast. Always pleasant servers, quick service and tasty food. We have never gone wrong at Toast, a welcome addition to the Sherwood Park morning chow scene. Will return many more times.

I so wanted to absolutely love this Irish Breakfast House, and I almost did. Good location, lots of windows, bright, attractive interior, pleasant cheerful staff. There was even a soccer match on the tv! Good menu with lots of choice, great to see somebody doing breakfast the way that I grew up with. 
   Eggs, bacon, sausage, toast, homefries, baked beans, grilled mushrooms, tomatoes. The problem was in the execution. Maybe I was expecting too much. The eggs where cooked perfectly, the problem was that they tasted like they were cooked on top of a hamburger (I know that taste from past years, working as a breakfast chef). Kinda gross actually (please just scrape the grill!). Bacon is impossible to screw up, but the sausages were kind of nasty. Just cheap, and reheated in the deep fryer. They really didn't need the extra grease. The mushrooms were great. So many places are so cheap with them, but this was a healthy portion. I was secretly hoping that the tomatoes would be grilled, like back home, but they were fresh, as most people seem to expect over here. I'll never understand that one! 
   The single biggest disappointment that I had was with the potatoes. These were NOT homefries, as described on the menu. Homefries are cooked potatoes that are cooked on the grill, sometimes with onions, so that they form that nice crispy brown caramelized crust. Granted, they can be a pain in the butt to make, but you just have to plan ahead and make sure that you are prepped up. These were a pre-made potato product (probably McCains) that comes in frozen and is then just deep-fried. Everyone has probably had them before, as they are used just about everywhere (especially if it's a chain joint).
   Overall, not too bad, but I didn't go there and pay $13 for a breakfast plate that was just ok. I would have gone to McDonald's and paid a whole lot less.

Get your wallets ready folks because this amazingly delicious seafood is going to cost you.  For 2 crabs legs (as long as my arms), 2 king crabs halves (I guess that's what they would be), and a package of 7 giant scallops, we paid about $110 - actually a little less than we expected but still!  Since the bf footed the bill on this one, it was TOTALLY worth it to me!!  The food was delicious and there was more than we could even handle!!  You will not be disappointed with the quality here!  

Cooking supper for your SO for the first time and you really want to impress???  Pick up some seafood at Fin's and (assuming you have the skills to prepare it properly; thank goodness for me my bf is such a great cook!!) I am positive you won't be disappointed!!
I met a friend here today and enjoyed a wonderful London Fog.  The volunteers were very nice and the atmosphere was great.  I plan on making this a "go to" place for my lunch hour.

Went here for the second time in two weeks and this place is going downhill fast. When it first opened the menu was original and the place was busy. Not only have they had a change of menu to meet the basic dining expectations but it's empty.  The food is not good and it takes longer than one would expect. They keep comping the bad food or giving discounts.  We will try one more time in the spring. It's too bad because it was off to a promising start.

I don't really think of Sherwood Park as being a hub for great restaurants, so I was bit skeptical coming in here...especially since it's a sports bar. I though oh great a fancy BP's (insert eye roll here). 
However, it's very nice inside with lots of different seating options available. You can sit in big high booths at the back that overlook the whole place. Or you can sit at low tables, or high tables, or the bar or regular booths. It's definitely more classy than BP's but still with the big tv's and all the sports on. 
My friend and I came for a late lunch and it wasn't super busy but a decent amount of ppl. Our waitress was super duper friendly. She was prompt with our drink order and then back for our food order without delay. 
The menu is HUGE. Everything from sliders, salads, burgers, pasta, quesadillas, rice bowels. Something for everyone. Anyway, we both ordered the turkey burger. My friend got green beans as her side and I got a loaded baked potato with mine. The burgers were delicious. It was my first turkey burger, I decided to be brave. Loved it! Juicy, flavourful, has an aioli on it and pickles. I'd get it again. Even the baked potato was great. It wasn't dry and over cooked. It was moist and the toppings were ample. 

We didn't have alcoholic drinks but the bar looks stacked. Lots of choice. 

It was my first time here, I'd def come back and try other menu items!

My family and I have been coming here for the past year and we've yet to have a bad experience for breakfast. The staff on the weekends are great and very good with kids. They always bring our children's food out early and are quick to fill up our cups with fresh coffee. I've never had a bad meal here. The food is always served piping hot and is quite good.

Ok, so I'm starting to become a regular. 

I just have to say that their garlic fingers with donair sauce as a dip is a must try. 

They have a great selection of flavors to go with their wings and dry ribs, the Chilli yaki sauce on the dry ribs was very very good.

Once again, good beer selection and good pricing.

Oh and of course, let's not forget that it's a great place to watch the game.
Love this seafood shop. Staff are always friendly. seafood is always fresh. Way better than the supermarket.

A little neighbourhood place with great pub style food. Our bike club stops by after rides. Everyone remarked how tasty the pizza was. Portion size for my quesadilla was HUGE, and only $10. Sampled friends dry rib appetizer and it was also good portion, and very tasty. Small but clean pub with attached clean and bright family dining room. Good family dining spot.

Ok it's Starbucks. So don't expect some cafe in Florence. Nonetheless, this Starbucks location does "Starbucks" as well as it can be done. Drinks are always made an attention to detail, and the staff is super friendly.

It's hard for one location in a chain to distinguish itself, but they do an excellent job. Even when they're busy, customer service is never sacrificed.

It's enough of an effort that whenever I'm in Sherwood Park (or that side of the city) and craving some coffee, I always make the trip there. Even if it's not the closest place to go. I only wish all Starbucks locations were this good.

We had a poutine and caesar salad wrap in a rainy day at Wild Wing! Delish! Boosted up my immune system and didn't get a cold. However, service wasn't that great, but all I cared about was the tasty food. Compliments to the chef!

Newly renovated location.    A relatively rookie staff who are working hard to get everything right.   Food was great.   Beer was cold.  The whyte ave location is a dive but this location is very nice.  Pretty girls,  good food,   Cold beer,   Nice TV's showing lots of sports.  What's not to love?

After reading the reviews on here, myself and 3 others were hesitant to check out the tilted kilt...well I am glad we went anyways!
We went on a Wednesday night wing night. Between all four of us, we had poutine, burgers, wings, chicken fingers, and a brownie dessert. All the food was hot, and absolutely delicious when it came to the table. Our waitress was friendly and efficient. We even had a manager stop by and ask how the meal was! The only complaint we would really have is that the ice cream on the brownie seemed to be freezer burnt- not a big deal at all though...
The atmosphere, while loud, was still fun. All in all we will certainly go back :-)

The staff are super friendly and knowledgeable. I love the variety of kitchen gadgets - they don't just have cute stuff, they have products for real cooks!

I also have taken a few baking classes here, and I love the size of the kitchen and the hands on nature of the classes!

Kickass food (the drum wings will change your life) and ultra cold beer in giant mugs.  Friendly staff, good crowd.  Oh yeah their steak sandwich is kickass too.  My friend ordered a burger which looked great but I didn't try it.  Have the drum wings - that's their "thing".  You'll love 'em.
I see that this place has finally gone out of business. Surprised it lasted as long as it did.

I was at this location 2 weeks ago for after work drinks and appetizers. While I understand the location had only been open for a week, we experienced horrible service. Our waitress seemed completely overwhelmed and couldn't even tell us which beers were on tap. She was difficult to flag over, several of the women in our party went over an hour without receiving their drinks (yet the men had no trouble)
The food was pretty good but nothing spectacular. Then when we received the bill drinks that had been previously paid for hadn't been removed. 
The atmosphere was nice enough, had the service been better it would have been a much better experience.

I had lash extensions done and it was a bad experience all around. A month or two later I had lashes done at another place and realized how bad my experience truly was at Verve so I contacted them just to let them know. The manager or owner that I spoke with became angry with me though my attitude and tone never changed from pleasant and constructive, I wasn't' asking for my money back, I just wanted to let them know about my experience. 

I give two stars because I had my hair done here once and it was a good experience, the stylist was pleasant and did a good job. Though I won't be visiting the salon anytime soon again.

I got my nose pierced here recently. What a nightmare.
As soon as it was pierced it gushed blood. 45 mins to stop it. The piercer was nervous and claimed that bleeding like that had only happened once before. It bled for 2 days after that. She also used a plastic stud which after my research shows is a huge no no. I went back after a few days to get a metal stud put in and she wouldn't do it. She prefers the plastic. Bad bad bad. I left with no refund, no metal stud and a nose covered in polysporin. I had to have another company remove the piercing it was hurting so bad :(
I spoke to several piercing companies after this experience and never should plastic studs be used due to high possibility of infection and complications. As well as every one of them advised against piercing in a salon/spa business. 
Do your homework and avoid this business for piercings!!!!!!
The pizza is great and the service is better. I always enjoy supporting this local business because they are always showing how they care about the community and their customers.
Food is good little pricy but has amazing waitresses omg!! Twisted kilt was better but this is good they had better food

After a disappointing experience at another Ford dealership, a friend recommended we go to Sherwood Ford. We stopped by early on a Saturday morning and talked to General Sales Manager Chris Suvanto and explained our previous experience at the other dealership and what vehicle we were looking for. He quickly introduced us to Luke Suvanto and within minutes the Ford Explorer Sport was pulled up and ready for us to take it for a test drive. Luke made sure to walk us around the car from front to back and showed us all the safety features and inner workings. You can tell he really knows these vehicles from top to bottom and it was good to finally deal with someone who took the time to really explain everything. Luke and Chris were able to offer us a very fair number on a 2017 Ford Explorer Sport and a good trade in value on my Ford Focus. Sharbel in Finance was also great to work with and was able to help us get everything we wanted with payments we were comfortable with.Make sure to stop by Sherwood Ford if you are looking for a new vehicle. You won't be disappointed! Thanks for the upgrade Luke!

Food was excellent, expensive. $3.95 for a can of coke is insane.

Crepes were good, but should come with a side for $15.95. 

Three-egg omelettes were good. They come with toast, potatoes and a bit of fruit. Definitely more bang for your buck.

I am a big fan of Cora's I know people seem to be fairly divided on it, but at the end of the day there is one thing for certain and there is always a crazy line up on the weekends. I never have a problem waiting 15-20 minutes because they do a good job moving people through. The staff are always friendly, which I know I wouldn't be having to deal with that many people in the morning. 
I love the food, I always get the Panini -Crepe and have always devoured it. I love all the fruit as well.  Plus the daily fruit cocktail is a must have.

I recently chartered GO Coach for our corporate outing to Edmonton. I must say they have Cool staff but more importantly great prices which made me happy to book using them. Our Driver Claude was an amazing driver! He was very positive in communicating with passengers and was available to answer any questions we had. I will recommend this service to anyone.

Very good quality line of clothing. They will last you a very long time. I shopped here for almost about 4 years now and never had issues whatsoever until now.  They need better deals on Boxing Day and Black Friday. Because paying 119 for the really good quality hoodies is way too much. They need better deals on certain items because I have a customer would not want to pay $119 just for one hoodie. Also a couple months ago when I ordered a pair of leggings to the store the girl who spoke to me on the phone was extremely rude. All I was asking was how long my leggings would take to come in to the store. Also was in there the other day and I did not appreciate The skinny girls look. They need a proper training on customer service because being rude to me on the phone is not how you treat a customer. I only shop here once in a while now because of the way I am being treated.

I adore my hair stylist over there! Nick did my hair yesterday and Ive never had anyone so specific about what we were capable of getting (I have turquoise ombré hair) he explains everything throughly and spends lots of time making sure I was happy. I really appreciate a stylist with opinions on my hair, I always figure they are the experts who know what they are doing and Nick definitely is. The fresh muffins every day are a nice touch, the desk is very friendly too bringing anything from water to coffee. Concrete offers a full range of services, I've only had my hair and nails done so far!!
I would follow Emma anywhere. Her cuts are pristine and perfectly executed.  Helps that Concrete Blonde is a great place to visit.

I had a similar experience to Heidi's. I called for an estimate for maintenance on our property. I was quoted a price that included mowing, weed eating, edging, and 15 minutes of weeding the rock beds each service. After having to inquire several times of when the first service would be, the gentlemen finally showed up. The service took 10 minutes. They mowed the lawn and weed whacked the front edge of the lawn by the road- that was it.  None of the landscaping in the back was trimmed, there had been no edging done, and no weeding of the rock beds.  
After calling and emailing to let Steve know of the situation and giving notice of canceling the service, he emailed back telling me that,"weeding was done by a separate crew."  Hmmmm.  
Either way I cancelled service and asked for a refund for the edging, trimming, and weeding. Steve was kind enough to give a full refund, but it did take several days for the refund to be received.

I've had supper at the Canadian Brewhouse a couple times, each time was pretty good. The most recent time I dined there we had quite a large, obnoxiously loud table right next to us so we did ask to move which the waitress understood completely. The food is pretty good, nothing too extraordinary although the deep fried pickles are my fave! I will go back for a meal but it probably wouldn't be my first pick if I was in the mood for something unique.

On time ,polite driver. At venue on time with bus waiting for return trip. The driver-Claude-was very friendly,flexible, accommodating and a very skilled driver. This is the fourth year we have used Go Coach Bus company and they are a pleasure to work with. Had to change times around multiple times and they were very accommodating. We highly recommend them.

Not the greatest decor. Tables are pretty cheap & not a lot of ambience, however it is kept clean & tidy. The food is definitely worth every penny. Delicious. Had the Chicken & Beef Shwarma plate. Well seasoned, large portions, and flavorful. Friend had the Chicken Shwarma wrap & was very very pleased. Staff was very friendly & attentive. Definitely worth the money. Will for sure be repeat customer. Highly recommended for Greek/Mediterranean food. Don't let the decor fool you. This place is a gem. Apparently they even have belly dancers some nights!!

I love this place. The atmosphere is perfect, especially on game nights. The employees are great and the food is superb! If you're looking for good eats, a nice place to relax with friends while sipping a beer and cheering on your favorite team, this is the place to be.

I visited this place twice for a work meeting lunch with co-workers and both times it ended with staff apologizing for the huge wait from the slow kitchen staff. The staff are nice enough I guess... promptly took our drink and food orders. The drinks came quick, the food did not. The first time it was around a 40 minute wait to see any food come out of the kitchen. We aren't talking about elaborate dishes either, just burgers and fries. The second time (also our last ever visit) we waited around an hour and a half for our food to come to the table. We got excuses of the place being so busy they couldnt keep up in the kitchen and a couple of their staff did not show for their shift. If they knew they were short staffed in the kitchen and there was going to be a delay, they should tell people that before taking orders. We watched several tables just get up and leave fed up with the wait. 

The food is just alright. Nothing special. Typical pub type food. I really wish I could say somrthing special about the food which would make the delay worth it. 

We ended up having the manager take a few drinks off our bill as an apology with him basically begging us to give them another chance in the future. We never did go back again and never will.

I bought a groupon main/pedi. What a waste of money, I honestly would have had a better experience at those typical Asian nail spas. 

My manicure is all chunky and has so many dents in the polish. The nails were not cleaned underneath and I can feel dead skin/nail from the filing. It's gross. 

The pedicure... the aesthetician barely spoke to me and I felt awkward the whole time. 
I just don't get good vibes from this place and recommend you go elsewhere.

Seems this place is having many many major issues with infections. This place is obviously dirty. But don't dare say anything to the manager or owners because they will threaten to sue! From chemical burns, to ripping off skin on a wax job to full blown nasty eye infections, this place NEEDS to step up to the plate and fix their bull$hit customer service and lack of proper sanitization or close up shop. 
If you are the owner or manager of this shop and are reading my review. GROW UP! Face the music, you are running a chop shop and the ladies of sherwood park will not tolerate such poor service!! BTW you can only sue people if it's a "false accusation" get yourself educated..train your staff..and learn how to properly sanitize !

Another new bistro sports bar with TV screens and the usual food fare.  This visit was better than the last.  Music was not too loud.  They appear to have happy hour.  The Wrap was good and the salad.  TV screens in odd places.  Tv screen I. The urinals.  Staff were pleasant.  Lots of free parking.  Open late.
This location is still open,confirmed by voice call.Since West Ed has been closed about a month now,been worried about a "Kilt" shortage!

Food was good, our waitress Brandy was horrid. No checking on how we were, no refills on coffee or water, forget trying to ask for something as she was the queen of 1 word answers. Would I go there again, NO. Go to the Coras in Edmonton instead

This Walmart didn't really impress me that much.

It is set up fairly similar to the super centres in Edmonton but there are a few differences. 

I found this Walmart to be a bit dirty.  I was surprised at this because Sherwood Park is usually the opposite.  

Also, people were not friendly.  We had people bang into our cart to get by and people were pretty rude.  I was shocked.

The lineups were short though, I'll give them that.  We id go during the day on a Tuesday so that could have been why.  But any time you get a short lineup at a Walmart, you should be thankful.

It's a decent Walmart, but not the best by any means.

it's nice to see Sherwood Parks night life slowly growing. This Overtime location offers much of the same stuff the other ones offer which is decent food and good beer. I personally think the one on the south side is slowly losing its appeal and not many people go there anymore but this location is quite popular.

At night it gets pretty packed with locals looking to enjoy themselves. They play good music and the service is good. Whether you come for food or stay for a drink the servers take good care of you and are really sociable.

It makes for a good night.

I was so looking forward to seeing the nice couple at Bone & Biscuit when I finally got my new puppy. I saw that they moved to their new location on Baseline. Instead there was a snotty, curt young woman who snapped that there is no such thing as "puppy food" in raw. Then I tried to buy a training treat that had sounded appealing but I could only remember part of the name. I asked to be directed to their treats section. "The whole store is a treats department". Then she criticized my raw food selection, saying that I would need to add tripe or vegetables at the same time she scowled and handed me a brochure that stated that 'carnivores do not need carbohydrates'. Needless to say, I will never set foot in this store again. I can see why the store was deserted the whole time I was there.

Has been here over a year. In the Flying J truckstop. If you want bad food,and worse service . This place is for you.The omelet was served cold,as was the coffee.Was showed the table by a manager.Who left and brought the water,and coffee. He returned 10 minutes later,took my order. Another 10 minutes passes,out he comes with the food. Did not refill the empty coffee, left.. Did not see him till I walked up to pay.Where he gave me a ticket for $13.52 for my cold dinner. So if you like cold food late at night this is the place for you. Otherwise ,want hot coffee,go to the Tim Hortons in the corner of the parking lot!

I booked a Shellac Manicure and Signature Pedicure for my sister's birthday. I was very excited because the place looks so fancy and professional and they also provide these fun, tropical looking drinks! 

However, the shellac nails did not even last 24 hours! They started peeling off (which I believe is very unusual for gel) after she woke up the next day and are half gone. We called Concrete Blonde and they said the could get us in after 4 days for a fix. The person we spoke to did not apologize even after I expressed that we are in Edmonton and this meant an unnecessary, long commute. We asked if we could come in sooner because the peeling nails get caught in things and look very shabby. We were told they couldn't do anything and only after pushing for it received what felt like a reluctant, half hearted 'yeah, sorry'. When we went all the way back to get it fixed they remained very apathetic and did not express any apology for this ridiculous situation.

Overall, the customer service after the peeling was very poor. Do NOT get shellac from here - just go to a typical Asian nail salon. Not worth the price.

I would not recommend any one to go to this dealer for anything, buying or service. i bought my F150 in 2013 of last year. right off the bat i was given wrong info about the truck after asking if it was the same height as the 2010 model. when i got the truck home i found out it was to big to fit in my parking area. after returning to ford i was told to bad so sad you already signed the dotted line bla bla.  so i sucked it up and had them lower it a few inches for around $1000. got the tuck back and noticed that the passenger window was not working properly. has some safety feature that makes it kick back down if something is in its way. took it back and they cant figure out whats wrong with it so again i have to suck it up.

i had driven the truck for 3 months with no more issues to speak of, i had been taking it to mr. lube for oil changes and what not. after going for four oil changes i find out that my front tires are not aligned right and that they are both tilted in a little bit or should i say bad enough that the tires are no good. after taking it back to ford they tell me that its not there problem because i was not bringing it back to them for service. i pulled the paper work up from when they lowered it and was able to show them that they did not do an alignment on it when it was lowered.  i am then forced to spend another $1300 on new tires and an alignment. 

poor service go to KOCH Ford they are way nicer. i found out form them that it would have been there responsibility to fix and there would have been no problem. However i would have still been screwed on the height. guess i should have done my own research.

Greggs' is simply amazing! In fact, the entire reason that sparked me to download Yelp in the first place! 
In my lifetime I have had the pleasure of traveling numerous places worldwide, and have lived in Europe for a short while- all of which gave me the opportunity to sample many different cultural foods & dishes and dine in many different atmospheres and locations. I have to say, though, Gregg's has got to be one of my favourite restaurants if not my favourite indefinitely. From the atmosphere, to the friendly service, & the large portions of food for a very fair price, I'd recommend it to anyone! 

I generally get the fattoush salad when I'm there, being that it is no word of a lie the best salad I've ever had (I'm quite the salad connoisseur if I do say so myself) though, have tried other things like most of the appetizer plates & the vegetarian wrap & donair- all of which have been equally as tasty, consistently. And seeing as the portion sizes are so large, I always have at least another meals worth of leftovers the next day! bonus! the staff there is all so kind and genuine, it really is just the icing on the cake (or rather the syrup on top of the Baklava) To add, it's always clean and cozy, never too painstakingly busy, and service is right on par! 
The best part id have to say though is the homeliness atmosphere. The hospitality of the staff accompanied by complementary fruit plate after the odd meal, such a great touch! It's so nice to see small business doing such honest things- I find nowadays we are all so used to thinking it reasonable to pay $25.00 for a bowl of noodles, that when come by a place like so are startled by the prices & such. But nonetheless I felt it necessary to write a review because I passionately want their business to flourish because it is sooo well deserved to say the least; I'm unsure as to why it's not packed to the rafters every night! Though, Ive noticed any business that finds its way into that strip mall never really lasts, and if it does is just striving to do so, & for whatever odd reason that may be, regardless I genuinely hope that there isn't reason enough to keep them in business and rolling steady! 

though, I will add- I just wish there was more stars to give, because if so this would be a shining 8/5

I have been to Shoeless Joe's three times now and have no need to ever return.Everything is at best ok.  Beer selection is all Molson so pretty underwhelming, Food is average pub food.  Where it really falls is the service.  I have been there when it was busy and quiet and each time the service was awful.
