It appears that everyone from the manager on down don't care about customer service. Inattentive and unfriendly is the only way to describe it.

There are many other way better options in Sherwood Park for a sports bar, AJs or even Brewhouse are a better bet.  The only thing that makes this place an option is the TV on the patio which is nice in the summer.
Recently got food to go. It was close to closing and they accommodated kindly. Food was good. Place was clean. Good parking. Can't complain.

My service experience has been excellent with the quality of work performed and the value received.  Parts also must be thanked for finding exactly what I wanted and bringing it in quickly with competitive pricing other retail outlets couldn't even come close to.  The new service staff are friendly and helpful and try to make things as smooth as possible including the shuttle service.  Absolutely the best rapid service bays and even a drive through wash! The atmosphere of the sales floor was positive and friendly with zero pressure to buy right now!  i would recommend Sherwood Ford for support, for service  and for sales!  First Class treatment!  By the way, their referral program is amazing!  Who else is better for word of mouth advertising than the customer, and they pay $750 bucks for referrals whether its new or used!  Congrats Sherwood Ford on another completely satisfied customer!

Recently opened in Sherwood Park, another option in the local suddenly crowded sports bar scene. It's in the newly redeveloped area off Broadmoor, and the building looks good from the outside, with a promising patio for the summer.
Inside, the layout is spacious with lots of TV's, a big central bar, and lots of friendly staff. The draught beer list is disappointing, with Creemore Springs the most "exotic" offering. They have no blended drinks, in case you're looking for a Bellini. The calamari was tasty, but rings right out of the box, and not very plentiful for the cost. The burgers were juicy and tasty, but the side of fries was ridiculously small, especially when you factor in the $2 upcharge for lattice or sidewinder fries, the amount was barely worth the original price. Ultimately, decent but not a lot of bang for your buck. I still prefer Average Joe's on all fronts.

VERONICA! She was our TERRIBLE server of the evening. 

Just wanted to get that out there. I have been to this location a few times but tonight's service was pretty bad. She was polite to an extent but she just did not care about our experience there. Did not care at all. 

When we got our food - two orders of wings, one medium and one Hot - my friend noticed that his had no heat to his. When Veronica came back, he mentioned it to her and she flat out said, "That's the hottest we got." We were stunned and taken aback because she offered no solution or anything. My friend said that he couldn't taste any heat on it and she pointed at the Tabasco. 

I suggested maybe a side of the hot sauce or something and she agreed. 

It took a while for a sauce to come and then in and time we thought "what if they switched out orders?" We tried a wing from each other and they were about the equal heat. I wanted to ask if our orders were mixed up but when she finally came with the hot sauce it was the same orange color as his wings. And she left. 

We did not feel like she cared about our patronage and if she was having a bad night it did not seem like it because she seemed quite friendly with the staff. 

The table next to us also witnessed her service but they took off after the beer. 

If Veronica reads this, we were the two guys who each tipped her one dollar. When she saw that she said, "wow."  

Yeah, exactly. Wow.

I had a mani and pedi done. The people were nice, massage chairs were nice, atmosphere great but the quality of work was so poor. I could have done a much better job. I tried to make hints but they were ignored or brushed off. I paid a discounted Groupon price and I still feel like I wasted my money. Didn't buff my nails, thinnest shellac that has peeled up already, horrible cuticles, didn't even fully clean underneath my nails, tried to cover the job with lots of oil. My heels still have major calluses and are ruff. I wasn't given a base coat on my toes so my nails will be a lovely yellow colour when it's off and there was paint all over the skin of the toes. Absolutely horrible - go for the massage chairs if you must but not the quality.
Best budget chinese place around by far! Bang for your buck you will not be disappointed.

Went for their $10 lunch specials with my wife, they gave us pita bread and two dips before meal. The servings where large as my wife couldn't finish. But still had room for desert which Gregg's wife recommended and we were not disappointed. You must try this place out.

Love this car wash. Have tried them all in Sherwood Park and Mississippi's give me the best bang for the buck!
Always clean and bright with lots of pressure and soap at the wands..

Oh love Denny's very fancy establishments although one time I went to the bathroom and I saw blood on the wall and I thought it's kind of disturbed the peace of the restaurant. Period. Hot food hot food yummyThat's yeah come here yeah I guess so you come here it's good yeah I got to go

Best Pizza in Town 20 year customer

Great staff,excellent food-been ordering takeout for 20 yr

Today I met a few friends for brunch at Toast in Sherwood Park. I have tried their other location in St. Albert and was very impressed, so I was very much looking forward to a visit to this location. The restaurant was packed (always a good sign) so our group of five people had to wait to be seated during this busy time. Surprisingly we were only waiting about 10 min or so before they had a table ready. This was made even more impressive considering there was three wait staff for the entire restaurant who were hostessing, busing tables, and serving! Our orders were collected in a timely fashion and the food that arrived promptly was delicious! Our server made certain that our drinks were topped up and that we weren't waiting on anything. All in all it was well worth driving from Stony Plain to try it out and I would certainly visit again. The only odd part of our experience was that the bathroom sink is located inside the wheelchair accessible stall! So if you are in the other cubicle and someone is using that stall (there are only two in total) you are out of luck for washing your hands. Not very hygienic in a restaurant environment. I think a little expansion where the sink could be separated from the toilet stalls would definitely be beneficial! No one is going to wait for a sink while the stall is in use, or even know the sink is there if the door is closed. Something to seriously consider! Other than that it was a great experience and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a tasty breakfast or lunch option!

We used Go coach for an organization event and they transported approximately 97 people in 2 luxury coach buses. Really good company. Reliable , modern buses, really nice staff, They were so professional and took care of all of our event details perfectly.

So the final saga of my car buying experience is finally over - I think!  Good time for an update I figure!

Let's start with a short time-line of events;  
Nov 26, 2011 Amanda buys a car from Sherwood Ford (since the car I wanted was in BC - I was told it could take up to a week and a half before it arrives - acceptable - left happy!
Dec  29, 2011 Amanda finally gets to drive the new car for the first time (after waiting for an hour in the lobby after I my scheduled time to pick up my car)  - YEAH - over a month later - not impressed.  AND to my surprise there are no winter tires on my car (I had qualified for the winter safety program which includes winter tires and rims)?!  Salesman made an OOPS - they forgot.  But no worries - we will get your tires on your car ASAP!  Sure, sure - never heard that one before.
Jan 16, 2012 Amanda finally gets winter tires on the new car.

After getting a run around for a month I was told that Ford would be making my first payment - GREAT!  Thanks Ford - that's awesome!  I was also told that I would be compensated for being so "patient and understanding."  Apparently that compensation meant not having the car ready as promised when I came to pick it up and having to wait another 2 weeks + to get everything I was supposed to get.

Don't get me wrong; I was extremely appreciative of the payment that Ford made for me.  However, after everything I was put through (this being my first ever new car buying experience) I feel that this compensation falls short (especially since they alluded to the fact that they planned on making sure they made up for the run around - over and above making the payment - and nothing more was ever said about this).  I was also told to bring in the customer satisfaction survey so that I could fill it out with my salesman - that never happened so I guess I will be filling it out on my own - honestly!

All in all this place talks the talks but they don't seem to walk the walk - would I refer someone here??  Ummmm - yes I would (for a $750 referral fee) right after I told them the story of my buying experience so they could decide for themselves if this is the dealership for them!
Great Ginger Snaps! Cupcakes were good as well. Pricey and will save for special occasions.

Yes on time again looks like its the only thing that is on time I have a reminder that my ford F 150 which I have never owed is due for service Maybe one day they may become a bit tec savy and look at the yelp comments until then I guess i can only look forward to next years reminder that my never owned F150 will be due for another service

The service was great, but the food was average.
Hopefully, it'll get better.

Great food, horrendous service. They seems more interested in calls to their cell phones and serving other staff who had a table(after a baseball game) then they did taking care of their customers. 30 minutes after we ordered we had to ask where our food was and she told us it was really backed up.... With only 5 other occupied tables in the restaurant... Ooookay.... We got our food 10 minutes later and started eating. Good wings! Too bad she spent her time out on the patio schmoozing other staff or owners... We didn't see her again until we were almost done.

Hopefully they clean up their staff and make room for good people because the food is pretty good.

Had delivery from here. NOT IMPRESSED. Food was cold and chicken was DRY. My chicken loving kids would not eat it, and my husband and brother could barely choke their down. The only reason for a second star was that the wrap I got was not bad, although I had to drown it in Chalet sauce because the chicken was so dry.
People are nice but the prices for wings are insane, 8-9 wings 16 bucks.... a shame :(

I had a slip about 5 weeks ago and broke my iPad screen.  Took it in to MobilFix and they attempted to fix it but had a delay and was going to have to get another part from west Edmonton.  When I mentioned that I was flying out the next morning the amazing manager there, Havti, took my tablet to the west end, fixed it and dropped it at my home in NE Edmonton that evening!  That in itself is amazing service however last week the screen starting randomly shutting off and the home button stopped working completely.  I took it back to them and 24 hours later it was returned with a brand new screen and everything works like new.  No charge, no questions asked.  I can't recommend enough this locations services.  Both times I was helped by young, very professional staff who clearly know the meaning of customer service.

We had the Kibbie starter and the Chicken Shawarma main, and they were both great. The Kibbie was nicely made and the chicken was wonderfully flavourful. Someone came in just to pick up Calamari, which we thought was interesting. We'll definitely be back to try that out.

Came across this place online after seeing Mongolie Grill was shut down. This place was great. Food worked the same as Mongolie Grill and the people working there were extremely nice and helpful. The one thing that I would suggest is to add extra sauce. Perfect place to take your picky eating kids too as they can pick out what they will be eating. Will definately be returning!

Stopped for lunch with some folks from work while visiting from out of town.  Burger was great, fries were crispy, decor on the inside of the place was very good.  Only giving three stars because the service was so slow, and there were only a couple other people in the restaurant at the same time.  It was the opposite of busy. In addition, there wasn't a single smile from a person who worked there while we were there for 45 minutes.   Not particularly nice when ordering or getting food.  I'm not expecting cartwheels or anything, but it was hard not to get bummed out watching the staff inside.

I booked an appointment with Nick after getting some recommendations on Facebook. I looked him up and saw that he does great color jobs. So I treated myself to a cut and color. I have been coloring my own hair for 10 years.

The fresh muffins were a little odd (everything was in them) but very good. I got the exact cut I wanted and Nick was great and funny. My hair color is similar to what I normally wear but it was the first time he did my hair and didn't want to fry it or turn it green. Next time maybe we will try something a little bolder.

I will definitely go back to Nick.

The only thing I didn't like was when I first walked in I didn't see the front desk. No one was there to say hi and I was a little lost on where to go.

Food and service was great. The specials on wings was amazing. Mt waitress was super friendly and there are tones of tv's so I can keep mt eyes and not miss a play while walking around or going to the washroom. Its like all brewhouses, this one seems to have their stuff together. There is one complaint I have with this location is that during certain hours they allow minors accompany with their guardians to be let in....like whats with that?

I love dogs, but having to step over a dog in the front door and almost trip over his tail as he swings it is just not safe. 

The older lady was nice, but not very knowledgeable. She was also very awkward when she came to ask me if she could help me. She acted like I was offended by her asking before I even had a chance to be offended. Weird.

The middle aged woman, on the other hand, was knowledgeable, but condescending. I was waiting for her to yawn in boredom while dealing with me. And, she had a fake smile on the whole time which almost made me walk out and buy the food somewhere else. (By the way, freeze dried is raw food. So, no need to try to make your customers feel stupid.)

Bottom line: We won't be back to this bone and biscuit.

Really happy with my experience with this place. I ordered from them for the first time and had a little mishap with my order, which was quickly fixed, thanks to the fast response from their staff. I received my order fast, well packaged, great frozen and fresh meat. The gentleman who I was emailing with about my order was quick to respond and help when needed, great and personable customer service. Really happy with my order and will definitely order again. They have good prices and good quality food.

Do not bring your vehicle here for service. 

I am not sure if I am more offended by the straight in your face rude service with no apology, or the complete lack of organization which has effectively turned a straightforward one day warranty visit into four separate days of bringing my vehicle in for the exact same issue. Highly inconvenient.    

I should have known better by now, returning to this same place to have the same repeatedly bad service over and over again. Maybe I wanted to believe that the service & experience would improve - had to improve - even if only by the law of averages. No such luck, this place has consistency of service figured out, unfortunately it's bad service.

LOVE IT HERE. Possibly the best fast food restaurant in Sherwood park. Best chicken tenders I've ever tasted but the price is actually quite expensive but it's worth it for the quality and quantity of the food. My only exception is that the portions are bigger at the restaurant that on the food delivery app "skip the dishes". I'd prefer if I got the same quality of the restaurant on that app. Overall an amazing dine in restaurant and take out restaurant.

Would not recommend! After 3 weeks of trying to get them to come out to do spring clean up and 5 different dates they were supposed to come, the last straw is when I got an invoice saying they came to do spring clean up. Later that same day, I got a message through text saying they did the wrong house in a completely different city (after giving them my address twice). I understand it's their busy season but it's a joke how they treat their clients and make promises they don't keep. We hired another company and they came the next day. After trying to confirm they would cancel my invoice through email, I never heard from anyone. Save yourself the time and hire professionals!

Would not recommend Paul McLaughlin from this law office.  He would give conflicting legal advice and was very arrogant and condescending.  He also had questionable billing practices.  Ended up costing a lot of money to settle a small estate.

last time we went here the manager was extremely rude. we politely asked for a bigger table towards the back of the store and she had a hiss fit over us sitting 'way in the back' as 'we took a table that's meant for a group of people'. we know this place doesn't have much people showing up at the first place... my brother has autism and is very picky where he sits, so he started crying. we also ended up waiting almost half an hour for our food, but i didn't mind. the food is pretty good though.

Nice new place, comfortable, good food!
Server was friendly and efficient. 
Unfortunately food quantity does not reflect prices. Luckily we ordered an appetizer as entrees only would have left us hungry. I don't mind spending more at a new place but portions were very small! With all the restaurant options in the area, likely we'll go elsewhere. Disappointed!

This is a simple concept and this restaurant has been here for almost a decade being a local favourite in Sherwood Park.  While you make your drink order and decide what kind of starter soup cup you would like (today, I picked the yummy hot and sour but the house made wonton is equally good), they give you a bowl and you head right over to the cold holding unit to make your plate.  The decor is functional and nothing fancy; service is friendly "you order, we serve".

You can't complain about the taste of the food: you pick your own raw vegetables, raw beef, chicken, lamb, shrimp, salmon, mussels, crab, scallops,  and then head over to the sauce station for an endless possibility of over 15 to choose from.  There are chef recommendations of
Combinations that you can follow but otherwise, the food will taste as you make it by filling the bowl and having it cooked for you; no whining, the idea is to be adventurous and try new flavours each time.  I picked a large amount of meats and added garlic, lemon and ginger black pepper and hot sauces for a tangy combination that was delicious.  The bowl is then cooked on a huge hot wok while you sit down and enjoy the soup.  They bring you rice and thin Asian tortillas when your cooked creation arrives at your table, making your Mongolian Indulgence experience complete.  

You pay by the weight and if you guess the exact amount, which is like winning the lottery, what are the odds lol, your meal Is free.  This is healthy, fast, low-carb, high protein, tasty and darn good; a hands down winning lunch destination in Sherwood Park.
Great customer service and good value for what you pay! Would definitely recommend going here over a Denny's or Tutti Frutti as the food seems more authentic and flavourful.

I went to tilted kilt for the first time a little while back and wasn't impressed. The place was deafeningly loud, which is weird because it was dead, the combination of stripper-rock and 3 tables full of loud old men somehow made it sound packed. At some point in the night I had to relieve myself and I swear there wasn't a square inch of this bathroom that wasn't covered in piss. Food was pretty meh as well. The beer was beer and the service was OK, which is why I'm not going as low as one star.

This place doesn't really catch your eye when you past by, but when you enter the restaurant you get a really cool feel like you're on a different place. Very homey and cozy atmosphere. 

The food is delicious, I tried the beef donair and it was so juicy and full with deliocus sweet sauce and cheese. You get two wraps with it and can either have a side of salad or fries. I had the salad and it tastes very fresh, the sauce was very tangy and has a bit of a spicy kick. My Friend tried the beef Sharma with the same sides as salads and we shared the other half of our wraps. The Sharma was a bit different, it has pickles beets which gave the beef a good contrast with the salad. Overall the Sharma tasted lighter and not as heavy and juicy as the donair.  

We also had desert, tried the gelato coconut and mango with whip cream. I've never tried this desert anywhere, the mango was in the center but yummy it was an awesome pair!

To end the evening we ordered Turkish coffee with cardamom. The coffee was a bit string for my taste. I needed cream and lots of sugar to help with the bitter taste but overall very unique taste; however I didn't taste the cardamom.

Overall the place was great, got busier towards the evening. Service was fast and friendly, the atmosphere was welcoming and the washroom was clean, but only one stall for the women.

Life is awesome when you find a hairdresser you trust! Imagine getting excited for an appointment instead of nervous and anxious. I know, you know what I mean! You're probably reading this review because your inbetween hair dressers or curious about making a change. Kristen is the right choice for a variety of reasons, let me count the ways.... Listens to what your looking for, gives you the truth as to if/ how she can make it possible, goes over and above to ensure you walk out the door feeling pampered and cared for. Even for weeks to come. I say this because it's how she makes me feel everytime. It's been about a year and a half now with countless hours in the chair while she's behind it. I look for a change almost everytime I go see her but what doesn't change and will not is my hair dresser Kristen. With her knowledge, expertise and passion for hair, I know I'm in the best of hands. Only takes one visit and you'll see what I mean!

Example. Many people ask me, 'how often do you get your hair done?' and 'do you touch it up yourself?'. This particular dye job was just before my hair dresser gave birth. We knew I wouldn't be seeing her for a few months therefore went with one colour so I could touch it up easily (if I needed to). What you see is a 3.5month progression using salon shampoo and conditioner whilst rinsing in cold water. Last few weeks using purple conditioner to avoid going brassy on my ends. I did NOT 'touch it up' in any fashion. When Kristen did my hair the root was more saturated than the ends, hence the fade. With every cold water shower my hair would fade, as the story goes. For those of you who want fun vibrant colors my suggestion go for a more rich look initially, invest in salon products and rise in cold water. Obviously results are different for everyone but over the years and many colors later, the fade out is enviable so you might as well embrace it. It's easy to embrace is when you've discovered the  most important piece in the equation, a hairdresser like Kristen . Who possesses the skill and knowledge to lay an amazing foundation. Giving you the vibrant and colorful look you want, weeks (sometimes months) after you've walked out of the salon doors! ‍

Wild wing is without a doubt my go-to restaurant in Sherwood park. Prices are great - (13.99 for a pound of wings and a pint of beer!) and the food is even better 

They have an absurd amount of flavours for wings (over a hundred I believe ) but if you chat to the familiar faces of the waitresses they will reccomend something based on your preferences (do you like dry or saucy, sweet or spicy, ect) 

If your not a wing fan they have tons of other options - burgers , tacos, hot dogs , and amaziiiing poutine. 

Always playing whatever big sport game is on, as well as I've gone for UFC - free entry and not crammed like other places . 

I would highly reccomend wild wings - bring your family ! Very family friends pub/sport bar feel.

Terrible service. I ordered wings and they didn't put any sauce on them, and so I asked them to take it back. They made it seem like such a chore and when I got my wings back they barely put any sauce on. They weren't even covered. I then asked for them to do it again and she refused saying "just eat them, it's not that big of a deal". I want my wings to be covered in sauce not a small dolup 1 mm wide. Won't be coming back here until I see an improvement in service

Try the goat cheese and spinach Benedict! it comes with pan fried potatoes and a mountain of fruit. An awesome breakfast for a big day. Wash it all down with a bowl of coffee. Coras is still a happy hub for a great meal and friendly service.

This is a cute place in a strip mall on baseline road. It serves breakfast and lunch. The menu is quite extensive. A bit overwhelming at first glance. I was torn between a savoury crepe and the salmon sandwich. I opted for the salmon sandwich on a bagel. When I asked for my bagel choices, I was told there's one kind. Which was underwhelming, but I went with it. My dining companion went for a turkey club. The entrees come with soup, salad or fries. We both selected fries.

The restaurant was fairly busy. We were there at about noon on an a Saturday. Or entrees arrived quickly. And looked tasty! The fries were hot and crisp. My bagel was toasted perfectly, filled with cream cheese, smoked salmon and red onions. The turkey club looked great, the turkey slices thickly. It got rave reviews. 

It's a cute place. Comfortable. There is a sign on the wall that says eat local. I was curious if the ingredients are locally sourced. Or if that referred to supporting a local business. Our waitress was efficient, but I thought that question was beyond her. I'm still curious. I'd like to try other items on the menu. Maybe I'll get the answer to my question on a future visit.

The chicken was raw and bloody. When I brought it back a man with a beard without a hairnet, got me a new piece. He put his mouth on his gloves drooled all over them, put his hand all over his beard then touched the chicken meat. It was brought back to me in a dirty container I had dropped in a puddle of muck returning the uncooked meat they served me the first time all the way back from my home. The manager touched the meat with her bare hands and and some of her nail polish chipped in it, She put a dirty thermometer touched all over with her bare hands in the meat. The chalet sauce I returned to them was microwaved and brought back. I just threw it in the garbage, after seeing they deliberately messed with my food. Don't go and save yourself the drool in you're food. Also the man at the cash register kept calling me sir. He told me he calls all women old men.

Where do I begin!? This bake shop it a wonderful place to stop and shop. They have tons of locally made products that you might recognize from the farmers market. Everything from dips to jewelry. There is even a holiday market up the steps inside the bake shop, everything is locally made so you can get all your gifts in one stop! As far as the bakery they make the most delicious cookies!! I had a sugar cookie with colorful sprinkles, a chocolate chunk peanut butter and a shredded coconut cookie. They were all amazing, chewy and soft with a little crunch on the edges just how the perfect cookie should be. I see they also make cupcakes, and a few other treats. They sell cookie decorating kits so you can take them home for some family fun. Supporting local has never been so delicious!
They made a small mistake on my Togo order and went above and beyond to make sure it was remedied and I was satisfied.

We showed up here after not getting served at the Denny's down the road on Broadmoor. We asked the hostess seating us how the night had been going as we'd left the other restaurant and were very hungry. We ended up getting served right away, we had the food come out within 10-15minutes with all of our drinks ahead of the time and the manager personally came out afterwards just to check in about the food and service for the night. I still can not get over what a wonderful experience we had and the food, honestly, is always good. My husband always orders an omelettes with extra eggs and I get the gluten free eggs Benedict. Our experience was absolutely wonderful from start to finish :)

Sorry Ford - guess I jumped the gun - I left the dealership feeling 100% satisfied with my purchase.  Since they were bringing my car in from BC I was told it could take up to a week and a half for my car to come in.  I could accept that for sure - even after 2 weeks I was still calm and understanding.  Well it's been 3 weeks now.  I call my sales guy every day and get the same song and dance "maybe it will be on the next truck but I PROMISE I will call you in a few hours and let you know, I PROMISE." I don't think this guy has ever phone me back when he "PROMISED" he would.  Now I am just frustrated and getting no where and I don't even know if my car is even on its way here yet.

Seems like this place talks the talk but doesn't walk the walk.  It's going to take a lot of sweet talking and some serious compensation for me to regain my faith in this place.  Although I do understand that things don't always go as planned I expect that when the sales guy promises to phone me back he will!  I can even understand that he might get busy/side tracked - so after the first, second, third time I didn't raise much of a stink.  Now, by the 4th and 5th time this has happened to me - the smoke is starting to come out of my ears.

FIX IT FORD!!!!!!!  This is the first new car of many to follow in my life!

I have been going to Verve for about a year now. I see Harpal for eyebrow threadings and I am always happy with the service and results. The salon is clean and the staff is very friendly. I would definitely recommend Verve for eyebrow threading!

I've gotten their cookies from farmers markets before, but it was the first time seeing the shop! I love that there was small market full of other local goodies at the front of the store and on the second floor. I picked up some dehydrated morel mushrooms from untamed feast and can't wait to try it in risotto!

Always great cookies! Perfectly chewy! If you are to try I definitely recommend the coconut and ginger snap cookie!

I try so hard to like this place. The servers are so polite and friendly, the place has a nice pub feel with all sorts of nooks, the food is pretty good, they have live entertainment and specials.  A patio and TVs for sports.  VLTs.  But the background music is too effing loud in the evening.  I have to yell and spit Covid at my buddy to talk.  My voice is hoarse the next day.  This a a Pub, not an effing night club.  I try so hard to like this place.

The last time I've went to Cora's I got a breakfast sandwich. I didn't even take a bite without the whole sandwich falling apart at my hands. I'm a personal lover of big portions for the amount of money that you are paying but sometimes it gets kind of crazy there! If you are going to Cora's it would be the best out of your interest to get something that isn't wrapped around something because it's mostly likely gonna fall out when you try to hold it. I did however try my family's crepes and there quite good, Cora's known for making delicious sweet breakfast dishes and is worth going there for. The staff are friendly and you are filled to the brine with drink refills which is always nice when you have a lot of food infront of you.

This place is fantastic. I've been coming here for about 12 years now. From doggy birthday cakes, to fancy treats, to a nicely curated variety of food, this place is great. Oh and the owners and staff are probably some of the friendliest most welcoming people out there it's obvious how much they love their jobs. If you're looking for bargain pet food this isn't your place. If you're looking for raw or holistic foods, or a nice treat for your pet check them out.

Delicious buttery cookies. Wide assortment of sweet indulgences. Locally made. Fresh. Tasty.

I've been a fan of confetti sweets since they started at farmers markets. The cookies are tantalizing and are so buttery they melt in your mouth but don't make that crumbly mess. Thats how you know they make them right! The cookies do not disappoint and are always tasty. The staff are exceptional and so friendly. I really appreciated it, leaving the store happy with a bagful of sweets.

What surprised me was the evidence assortment of other items like cupcakes, fudge, brittle, Pinocchio ice cream, frozen cookies, soups, shelf stable snacks and so much more. Walking out was so distracting bc so many items caught my eye. Definetly worth another visit. I love supporting local and this cookie place is the best in edmonton area!

Ps. They have the best covid safe facility for a small business. Hand sanitizer is plentiful, mask use and physical distancing made my visit so much less stressful than usual. I didnt pre-order but the staff helped me quickly and efficiently and I was in and out within 1 min.. Epic!!!

The best furniture store in Edmonton by far.  The staff are very professional and knowledgeable.  They had no problem picking out the exact furniture I would need based on the dimensions I provided.  I didn't realize they carry custom designed furniture as well.  Top notch service and pricing.  Will shop here again.

My first impression of Shoeless Joe's was OK, not great. I'd try it again, maybe for lunch, because as so many other Yelpers have noted recently, the service isn't up to par, even on the bar side which was recommended. What happened to the staff that so many Yelpers have downgraded this place based on service in the last year? With a $15 minimum wage, poor service/under staffing speaks to management in my opinion.

A small group of my friends got together here on a chilly Friday evening, and we were surprised that the place was over half empty.  Even with that, service was a bit slow. We found ourselves served by the bartender, which is fine except for some reason he cleared empty plates but not empty glasses. He also kept touching me as the person at the end of the table, which as a non-touchy person made me feel uncomfortable.

We didn't have to wait too long for our meals, but we did wait a while to order. Empty glasses went unretrieved and refills were not offered through the whole meal, which is definitely a costly lack of attention. Once our meals came, they were tasty but sadly all lukewarm. I ate less than half of my gnocchi entrée because it was stone cold by that time. It was tasty, good flavour combo with tender short rib and veal gravy, but I couldn't appreciate because it was cold. Same deal with the burgers and fries. A real shame! Considering the price point, this is really unacceptable. 

Work on your service guys! You offer way more than the average sports pub in terms of beer and food selection. Get it together stat, before you become another statistic. People will pay good money for average food if the service is good. If you're offering good quality food but bad service and you're not offering poncey hipster fair, you might as file for bankruptcy now.

This is the closest Walmart to me. I am used to it so I may not notice the things that's others have. I do know that Walmart credit card was a big push. Every time I went the cashiers were giving the same lines. Over and over again. I eventually signed, just to stop the pestering. I've never used it nor will I. They finally stopped, just recently. 
It is fairly small, but fine for the what I need. Someone mentioned staff...what staff? There are only cashiers to take your money, and one to return it to you. Never, ever, in the 16 years I've been going there, have I ever run into some employee that was there to help. 
Walmart's are mostly the same, minimal staff, discount stuff, same price as Safeway stuff, and you may pick up a new language.

Was searching for a place nearby to get a Rueben Sandwich...I discovered Press'd in Emerald Hills.  Ordered the Rueben and it was delicious and hot when I got home.  Definitely would recommend this place for a good grilled sandwich.

I purchased from them when they where HEALEY FORD in Edmonton and surprise surprise they sold me what they called a new car 2008 Ford Focus at full price . And guess what they sold me a car that had fallen off the car carrier fixed it and sold it as new to me at full price. They realized what they did to me and said they would upgrade me and give me a new 2009 focus loaded at no extra cost! Guess what they charged me more money and there service was like we sold you the car go away now! Poor ran business who are shifty as hell! You almost have to do a carfax on anything you buy from them. The owner is a shifty low life who sees nothing but money signs and he acts like he cares but doesn't don't be fooled! Anyways they will never get my business or anyone of my friends or family after trying to screw me over selling damaged vehicles to people! If I could not rate them minus 5 stars I would of but Yelp makes us rate at least 1 star ! Even know they don't deserve a rating even 1 star is being to nice for these criminals !

Had two bad experiences at Brewhouse back to back two different Locations. This location we were greeted as soon as we walked in, and the server took our order right away, and didn't check on how to the drink were or come back to offer more drinks. We ordered a Bellini and a strawberry Margarita. Neither tasted even good, they were downright terrible. There wasn't enough mix of the peach or the strawberry, so it tasted like blended ice, and they didn't blend it nearly long enough, so it had lots chunks of ice making it impossible to drink through a straw. I ordered the tri-stack nachos, and they were not in fact, tri stacked. 
There was barely any cheese or toppings, and instead of doing multiple layers of the toppings and cheese, it was one pile of chips. Which wouldn't be bad if you had enough salsa, but the salsa comes in the smallest to go cup which isn't nearly enough for how many chips they give you, and then charge you for more salsa. If the dish comes with a sauce, getting more of that shouldn't cost more. If you want a different sauce it doesn't come with, then you should be charged.
The food is poor quality and not made with any love but slapped together.
Delicious cookies and very helpful staff. I have enjoyed watching this local business grow.

Think Hooters and then think Hooters on the clearance rack.  Really lame and very boring predictable food.  Gag.  Horrible junk food.  Poor women dressed in ridiculous outfits.  Quite pathetic for 2015.  Might be a place a 14 yr old would like but a grown man or woman with any class would not choose to eat here.

Came into the store today to ask if they sold larger amounts (30-40) cookies at storefront as i was buying them for my workplace. I was unaware I would have to place an order for this amount as I have never been here before. The lady at the till was quite unpleasant and made me feel embarrassed for not knowing. Will not be returning which is unfortunate as i know their baking is very good.

Came here with a group of girlfriends one night...I felt like every time our waitress was serving us we had to deal with tits in our faces!! These girls are dressing for 50% of their customer base..just a bit inappropriate me thinks. Sorry but neither of us out of 8 people enjoyed our "service"tonight

Came across this place by accident and what a pleasant accident it was.  Great seating arrangement and it's cozy.  

We were greater right away and handed a menu.  Took no time for us to order our usual wonton soup and salad rolls. Both were delicious.  I love that you can get an individual size bowl of almost all their soups.  The peanut sauce is a bit on the runny side I prefer it thicker but plenty of flavour.  

Service was fast and they had no problem with us staying behind to work on some reports.

Wandered in looking for coffee and found so much more!  Not only was the coffee fabulous, but the community aspect was amazing. We had no idea what we had stumbled on until we started looking around and realized it was a volunteer-run, community cafe. There were children's art pieces on the walls, small artist goods for sale, board games, a community room...we loved it! Highly recommend and would love to see it incorporated in more communities, especially back home in the US.

This was my first time visiting the newly opened Pho in Sherwood Park. 

As indicated by the name, this is a Vietnamese restaurant serving mainly Pho and other soups, with a few combo plates on the menu as well.

The restaurant was quite modern in the decor and this was reflected in other details as well, such as the fact that servers took orders on iPads.

My group ordered the salad rolls with peanut sauce to start. The rolls were a little bland, but the sauce was flavourful. The peanut flavour was strong but savoury.

For entrees, we ordered the beef satay soup and the seafood soup. At first, the server brought over a chicken pho instead of the seafood soup, but the mistake was corrected within minutes. The beef satay soup was spicy with generous portions of beef and noodles. The portion was quite large; I wasn't able to finish the entire dish.

With the good food, good service and reasonable prices, I will visit this restaurant again and I recommend it to others.

Great wings, owner is very friendly 
Held a network meeting here 
We filled the house 
Can't wait to come back for an evening event

If you're staying at the Coast hotel and don't have a car, this is a decent option. 

If you do have a car and don't go elsewhere, I will be disappointed in you.

I had the chicken nachos as my main. The chicken on the nachos tasted like teriyaki chicken. It also came with approximately 2 cups of sour cream in two little tortilla cups plus salsa that was clearly from a jar or can.

It was all edible and I didn't get sick. Yay.

My wife has been raving about Gregg's for months, but other than donairs, I'm not usually a big fan of Mediterranean food as a sit down meal.  One day though, she brought home some left over hummus and I was hooked. The amazing roasted garlic flavour with fresh pita was out of this world.
We went in for dinner and were blown away.  It was a monday night, so the only waitress was the owner and there were only 2 tables, so the service was great.  We got the hummus to start and then a sharing platter for 2 as our meal.  It was with 3 skewers each (2 beef, 2 chicken, and 2 meatball (kafta?) then rice and fatuous salad. 
The skewers were all amazing, the marinade on the meats really shone through.  My favourite was the meatball skewers, they were amazingly seasoned. I would definitely order them again.
The fatuous salad was fresh and delicious with fried pita in it, a nice little crunchy surprise.
I hear they are busier on other nights of the week, and on the weekends they even serve Hukka. 
Overall a really great experience, I love seeing new different places like this pop up in sherwood park.

I walked up to the counter upon arrival and the receptionist was on the phone talking to a friend. She did not acknowledge me for about five minutes until other associate walked in and she quickly hung up the phone and then acknowledged me. The stylist that I saw was the most experienced in the salon (or so I was told). She cut my hair into a shoulder length bob. The layers did not blend well, my left side was longer then the right and my hair would never lie flat (I had little fly away pieces everywhere). I had to wear my hair in a pony tail for three months until my hair started to grow out. My highlights were a big blob in the front and hardly any in the back (I asked to have them blended so it would look natural). The scalp massage that I received did feel great though but not so great when I had to pay for it and I never asked for one!!! My bill was over $200 and my hair for lack of a better word sucked!! Even my husband asked "what in the world did you do to your hair?"  When I man comments on how bad your hair is, it is never good. I would defiantly take a pass on this one. The salon is very bright and professionally decorated and looks high class but really nothing special that I could see.

I don't typically review if I have had a bad experience, but I've had enough bad ones at this location to finally say something.  We were greeted promptly but after that, the only thing our server did was take a drink order, and a food order eventually , until we were finally able to ask for our bill 45 minutes later.  We also used a birthday coupon but as we've seen from prior experience , when you use a coupon for a free item, be prepared for sub par service.  We wanted to get more food and drinks but never even had the chance, the server would either walk by without a word.  

  We paid card with no tip and were about to tip cash when we witnessed our server show the receipt to her colleague who then looked right at me with a very dirty look. As a bar manager, to say I'm unimpressed is an understatement.  

  The bar service is always great but when you sit at a table, prepare to be neglected.  

We became quick regulars after moving here a few months ago because they play the sound for the hockey games but after this last visit we won't be back.

Newly renovated and expanded. More TV screens for sports.  More room.  Daily drink specials but otherwise beer can be expensive.  Younger crowd.  Pizza was quite good.  Open late most nights.  Servers were quite pleasant.  Amy is a wonderful server with a great sense of humour!  It is loud though.  Menu is very complicated and hard to read as it took us 5 minutes to find the beer.....and they ironically call it a Brewhouse

In a strip mall.  Phoned in an order for pickup.  Wings are very good.  Lots of meat on them. But just token tiny bits of celery and one half carrot stick .  Staff seemed East Indian and were friendly.  My only complaint was the boxes the wings come in for take out leaks so eating them in the car requires a plastic bag underneath.  I have no idea why they gave us ketchup as we didn't have any fries.  I would get the wings again.  Have not tried the burgers.  Beware the redneck trash drivers that pull up in their jacked up trucks as you are backing out. I suggest you park a lane back and walk, so that you don't have to back out.

The wait here was atrocious. Like really bad to sit then for food. I LOVE Cora but this location maybe needs to get it together. They gave my friend someone elses food then took it back a couple minutes later. I do love the quality of food. The fruit is always on point. The new menu is a bit overwhelming. If you go all the time its probably a nice change. The water and coffee were never more then half empty so whoever was in charge of that they get a gold star!

The waitress was rude and snobby (maybe cause we were a group of girls?) so the service was terrible. The food was also crap, and I even e-mailed their head office to tell them about my terrible experience and heard nothing back. Talk about great customer service!! I have been to other Canadian Brewhouse locations before and had a great experience, but I will not be returning to this one in Sherwood Park.
Shop mechanics were nice and knowledgeable.  All other staff came off as very obnoxious lacking basic social skills.
Great selection. Prices add up very quickly here for not the largest amounts. Service is pretty good.

If you want pressure sales tactics, go here. If you want cocky salesmen, go here. If you are inquiring on a specialty SVT vehicle (perhaps a GT350, or next year's new Raptor when it comes out)... DO NOT COME HERE! There is one other dealership in Edmonton that is also licensed to sell Ford Performance/SVT. 

I inquired here on Saturday, and they charge a $5,000 MARK-UP above MSRP. We even asked if they'd throw in a car cover and the guy snickered and say "Ya, I don't think so". We ended going straight from there to Freedom Ford, talked to the manager Ken, and he said they do not charge any mark-up. Saved $5,000 just by walking out of Sherwood Ford's doors. You should probably do the same.

And my review is based on two experiences, not just my most recent. 3 years ago I was here inquiring on a vehicle, and when I say "pressure sales tactics", I mean them asking me to sign a blank piece of paper (not a form, literally a blank piece of paper) before they would even give me a price. They said they wanted to make sure we were serious about buying. For that purchase, Freedom Ford also got our business.

This breakfast nook Definitely lived up to the hype for my husband and I! It was totally not expensive as people have complained about or claimed.  Unless you are going to A&W (which we do like as well from time to time), the prices match...but what you get is above and beyond.  The fruit alone makes it worthy...but the food was excellent too!  Our server Jacks was soooo friendly and kind.  Go go go! ;)

Maybe my mistake was getting chicken here instead of one of their signature burgers but this definitely wasn't one of my better dining experiences. I went with spicy boneless wings and a drink and found myself quite surprised that it came to almost twenty dollars. My surprise changed to disappointment when the wings came after quite the wait and it was fairly apparent to me that several of them were extremely overdone. The whole order was also lacking in sauce and I left feeling disappointed and like I had not gotten my moneys worth.  Nothing against the front counter staff as they were lovely and do a good job keeping the dining area clean but the food was not good at all and I won't be back.

On Wednesday, June 12, 2013 I had an appointment for a service oil change 11.00 am I arrived on time and was told that the vehicle would be ready in just over one hour At 12.15 I enquired on how they were doing I was informed that it had not yet been brought in That it was next up and would bought been in  10-15 minutes and would take around 1 hour to complete the service I informed them that I also had an appointment at 2.30 and would need the truck I was told not a problem   At 1.15           I checked to see how it was coming along only to be informed that it was not yet started It was bad enough being lied to once  But twice in a short period is unacceptable How can I make other arrangements when Im being lied to No apology nothing just  have a nice day  This explains why I was able to get a next day appointment When I called All the other dealerships were booked and only taking appointments for the next week Everyone was going elsewhere because of the supplied service Lesson learned wait for an appointment that will mean something Ford all the advertising you do regarding service etc May be so at most places but I would take a close look at this dealership 
I would put this place in the all I want is your monies category Thanks for waisting my day and maybe It is a good thing who knows what the service might be if you actually got round to do it would be interested to see if others have had similar experiences

Coming from out of town, we were very pleased to have our bus and driver waiting for us at the Airport. The driver was flexible and accommodating, as our schedule often changed. This is the fourth year we have used GO Coach and they have been a pleasure to work with.

Kristi and the team are incredible supporters of local businesses other than their own. They have incredible pride in the community and have an incredible facility that includes a workout studio upstairs. I highly recommend them, and yes they do have a few items for men too!

Ok I came here on a whim since I was in the area for an in-store pickup. It's actually not too far from Sherwood park Costco, so pretty easy to find. TBH, I was expecting a basic bakery, but I was so unprepared...there was sooo much stuff to buy... I got overwhelmed quite easily (in a good way cuz now it means I have to come back to browse more). The decorator cookie kits and the cookie mixes packets seemed very enticing to do with my kids, but I am trying to watch my waistline since pandemic, so trying not to overdo it. When I was at farmers markets and catch them there, I'd buy at least a half a dozen cookies pre-pandemic ...they are that good... soft, chewy and fresh and all the flavours are delicious! 
I didn't realise they sold cupcakes too! I ended up buying a couple cupcakes and I'm glad they are individually packaged since one was meant as a door drop off for my dad. The mini cookie or chocolate that they add on the cupcake icing actually helps hold the cupcake in place and it looked perfect when it came time to eat it despite being jostled around in my car all morning. My kids gobbled up the cookie despite one kid being a cookie hater. The red velvet cupcake was amazing. I couldn't stop myself from eating the whole thing in one sitting: decadent, moist, tender, and not too sweet... and now I want more just writing about it. Maybe I'll go with a dozen mini cupcakes for smaller doses of goodness to share with the family for next round. 
Side note: I super appreciate that there was feature products from local farmer market vendors that I recognised and have been missing this past year. Glad I could get my fix here too!

This place is pretty cool seeing as it's all volunteer run. The decor is pretty kitschy definitely more homey and laid back. The coffee and drinks are good. It's definitely worth checking out if you want to catch up with some friends. If you're looking for a classy first date location maybe keep looking - but then also drop in with some friends later.

We had an awesome breakfast here on a Sunday morning. Large group and they were very accommodating even though it was quite busy. I had the daily special which was a cinnamon bun French toast. Awesome. It would have been cool to have it with a side of meat but alas it didn't come with it. But I ordered a side of sausage so all ended well. Servers were awesome. Very friendly and the coffee never went dry. This is not a fancy place but great "home cooking" and excellent service. We will definitely be back. We have tried both St. Albert and Sherwood Park locations and both are worth a trip.

Cutest little bakery but has SO much more. There is a store where u can buy locally made items upstairs. Came here for their cookies and were NOT disappointed. If u love cookies (and who doesn't) then you must try these guys out!

The restaurant name is misleading. This place is very, very good. My wife and I went for lunch and had the dinner for two. We had Kafka, chicken, and beef skewers, as well as Greek salad, and grape leaves (better known as dolmades). Meat was cooked perfectly, rice and meat seasoned in balance without one spice overpowering the dish. Also the garlic dip is very good. We finished off with baklava. It is quite obvious everything is made in house. Highly recommend.

It's a restaurant bar with upscale decor. They emphasize the food.  There are TV screens and one TV in each booth.  Airy inside.  Staff were very pleasant.  I do not recommend the Korean beef bowl as the meat and rice tasted like natural gas and there were few vegetables and meat for the price.  I do not recommend the crispy shrimp bowl as there was also few vegetables and just a few battered shrimp for the price.  Burgers were good.  The salmon with vegetables and rice had more vegetables.  Nice atmosphere though with dark wood and higher ceilings.  They have a happy hour.

What a lovely concept: A community café run by volunteers. Profits go back to the community in form of charitable donations to non-profits!

The coffee is great and served by trained barristas, yes, they can make pretty designs on that latte of yours.

Delicious homemade baking. Throughout the day you can smell fresh muffins coming out of the oven! Creative and tasty sandwiches (pear and brie, etc.), to die for soups (dill pickle anyone?), and even Gluten Free goodies!

They even have locally made crafts for sale!!!

Check out their evening events too such as open-mike and music nights.

I highly recommend this place.

We're not from Sherwood Park but this is where we bought our SUV so we thought we would have it serviced here and catch the shuttle to a breakfast place.  I consulted the Yelp app and Toast came up first.  I chose it because I thought it was connected to the wonderful café in central Edmonton with the same name.  It's not connected, or at least if it is, this Toast is nothing like the Edmonton Toast.   However it's still a four star breakfast place so we're in. The staff were super friendly, not just in timing and getting the job done but by appearing like they are actually glad we came in.   I like that.  I ordered the Bruschetta Benedict for $14.50.   My wife ordered the Fit N Heathy breakfast for $12.95.  We were both satisfied with the size and, while I don't normally order Benedicts, this one sounded unique enough to tempt me.   It was good and I found it interesting to try a different type of breakfast that you can't get everywhere else. There were a lot of hash browns but I suppose if they cut back someone would say that there's not enough hashbrowns.  This is not a coffee  place but they did still have a choice of medium or dark roast and my cup never reached half empty before the friendly server was there to top it off. I gave this Toast 4 out of five stars for very good food reasonable prices, decent coffee  and being open in this new pandemic world.  I didn't give them five because the food was very good but not outstanding either.  Also the decor seemed a little dark with an 80s look to it.  When I next return to Sherwood Park I'll probably be back.

The class I attended here was fantastic! (you can immediately feel the effects after the workout) 

I will have to come back to browse the store itself, but this review is specifically referring to the workout studio located upstairs in the store.  The studio is fairly spacious given the size, and kept neat and tidy. 

The class I recently tried here was called Poundfit (by Tracey K).  You use these cool lime-green drumsticks called Pound RipStix - specially designed for beating objects (floor, the other stick, mats)!
It's a great whole-body workout that focuses mainly on core, thighs, and arms/shoulders.  Also, if you like to make noise, relieve stress, smack things together, or feel like a 10 year old while getting your sweat on, this class is for you :)
There's some coordination-involved movements, but as long as you move with the beat in some form and smiling because you're having a good time then it's great!

I highly recommend trying this class at least once!  It's also offered by Tracey K at her main studio - Sculpt Barre South :)

Have fun!

I haven't heard the greatest things about this place but I have to say that I was impressed!  We went here at lunch time on the Friday before Xmas (thinking that we would be lucky to get in anywhere else) and there was barely another soul there.  The staff were friendly, cheerful, and pleasant.  The food was good and it came quickly.  I thought the prices were reasonable and the atmosphere was appealing.  I would for sure try this place again - our entire party seemed pleased with their meals as well.  Given the location you would think that this place would be BOMPIN around lunch time but no - not even a little bit - that in itself is a little disconcerting but it turned out good for me!?!?
Went with my family for breakfast. Really good quality of food. Very clean and  tidy place.

When I am in Canada on business I tend to eat at chains for breakfast especially.  The reason is simple.  It is hard to find someone who take AMEX in the Edmonton area.  That being said, this Denny's was a very good choice.  I had an "ultimate omelette."  It had plenty of stuffing which is the way I like it.  There was plenty of cheese and mushrooms.  The sausage was also quite plentiful. The eggs were fluffy.  The staff was attentive and as friendly as you expect at a chain breakfast place.  Additionally, the service was very fast which is something you appreciate while on business.

The bottom line is the sometimes chain restaurants are just more convenient.  This Denny's is a fine example of how such an establishment should operate.  I will eat here again for breakfast. I would not recommend Denny's for any other meal though. It really is a breakfast restaurant.

I love these cookies! I tried the cupcakes for the first time recently and enjoyed them just as much. 

My favourite cookie flavours are ginger snap and oatmeal chocolate chunk. I've tried all the other ones and many of the feature cookies but I always find my way back to these two. The peanut butter choco-chunk is a close third in my hierarchy.

My wife loves the oatmeal raisin so I've tried these as well but I'm always disappointed that the chocolate was replaced with raisins.

The store in Sherwood Park is amazing but I usually get my cookies from farmers markets. The cupcakes and so much more are available at the store. Kathy has brought in products from so many different vendors that it's become a mini farmers market. 

I love the story of this business, how it started from a basement and grown into an international success. Support this local Albertan sweet shop!

Was super hopeful when I saw that the Sherlock Holmes Pub opened in Sherwood Park. Unfortunately, I was completely let down. The Jack the Ripper burger was tasteless, overcooked, and very dry. The steak was over salted. The ambience was very loud, could barely hear my partner over the music.
The only reason I've given this 2 stars is because the seafood chowder was okay, and the service was really good. Our waitress was excellent and attentive.
Very slow service. French Fries were cold. Went a second time to see if it had improved. No same thing. Can't get lunch in an hour, fries cold again.

A northern Alberta staple! Royal Pizza has a great selection and always great service. I've been to several locations throughout Edmonton and the people are always great. Had the Hawaiian and Meat Lovers at a group birthday lunch. Both pizzas were great! Staff very attentive. Service very quick.

I don't know why there's so much Cora's hate here. I quite liked this restaurant. I've been to Cora's on the southside before and I know there's usually a line. If there's a line go in, and put your name in for a table. With just my friend and I we only had to wait about ten minutes to get seated, which isn't that long. If you're visiting with a larger party it may take more time. 

Whenever I go here I always have a hard time debating what to get. Although I love the fruit smoothies I started with a mochacinno because I really needed a coffee. Unlike one of my fellow Yelpers I did get whip (and quite a bit) on mine. The drink was good, but very sweet. 

Then it's the debate between something savoury, like the eggs benedict or something sweet like the raspberries for lucie crepe. I went with sweet and got the crepe with banana and nutella and whipped cream on top. 

There's just one crepe but it's huge and very delicious. It's rather sweet and I also ordered a side of bacon which was pretty good. But it was so much food. I always forget that when I go to Cora's, you get a lot of food. 

The only bad thing was we got seated at a booth first, which I found very squished. If you like a bit of space make sure to request a table. Luckily our server came back and asked if we wanted to moved to a table, so we did.

Sherwood Park is a bit out of the way for me, so I can't say I'd come back to this location right away. However; if you're in Sherwood Park or on the east side of the city it's pretty easy  to get to and good spot for breakfast/brunch.
Had the hungry man's breakfast.     Everything was excellent.     Meal arrived in 15 minutes staff was awesome
As a sports addict, I Love Wings! But coming here on s like flipping a coin, the food was great months ago. What puzzles me is why do all the waitresses look scared to be there.
LOVE THIS PLACE! Staff is always extremely friendly and the store is always well stocked. If you have a cold, you HAVE to try their "Cold 911"

Terrible food. Terrible service. Random piece of soggy lettuce in nachos. Chicken has NO seasoning whatsoever. Cheese barely melted. Waitress spilled a tray of drinks down my husbands back and they took $7.50 off the bill. Barely touched the nachos and the waitress doesn't ask if there was a problem and doesn't notice the lettuce on top. While my husband was trying to be more understanding, he felt, shit happens, the waitress apologized and felt bad, but it still happened. It's a "service establishment" so I feel more should have been done. The nachos on the other-hand, after complaining the manager did take the nachos off the bill. But as far as I'm concerned, too little, too late.

I decided to try Golden 88 as it's close to my place. I ended up getting: 
- Pineapple chicken balls
- Beef and broccoli 
- Chicken fried rice

First off, the pineapple chicken balls weren't great. They tasted like they just microwaved them, and the pineapple sauce wasn't that good either. Maybe my standards are too high for Chinese food, but I don't think so. 

Other than that, the beef and broccoli and chicken fried rice was pretty good. Similar to what you would expect for normal Chinese food. 

Overall I'd probably go there again - just don't get the pineapple chicken balls. :)

I've been coming here for years. Typically we would come during lunch hours on fridays which was always kind of a logistical nightmare for the kitchen with such a large group. Recently I went with a friend since we enjoy their poutines. With Skip the Dishes their kitchen was SUPER backed up even though the restaurant itself was fairly quiet. It took a while for someone to come and explain what was taking our meal so long. Once they did come and apologize though it made much more sense. 
I've always found the service to be pretty standard at Brewhouse but their food never really disappoints.

I really appreciate the knowledge and advice I get when I go into this store. The one just off 23 ave in Edmonton is also great. Although their prices are a bit more than other pet food stores(for the same brand) the owners all have consistent answers for question I have. I can call any store and get an educated response, and they actually care about their customers (the pets!!)
Outside is not so fancy....but wow its good.  Definely going back....so tasty.  Loved the spices....even the rice was incredible.  Very reasonable prices also.  Staff was pleasant.

I visited Verve this week for a facial with Joana (yes one 'n'). In short, it was one of the best I have ever had. Joana was professional, with a gentle and soothing manner. As she worked through my treatment at a leisurely pace, she answered my questions about products and techniques. Her responses were knowledgeable and easily understood. She seemed to know the right time to speak, respond to comments and questions and then remain quiet and let the facial take its full effect. The duration of the facial was what I expected and her style and skill level were truly outstanding. I thoroughly enjoyed and will return without hesitation.

Terry

I really enjoy this place that being said I'm not a big chicken wing person but I love their salt and vinegar wings and their gar par fries are sooo good. Last time I went I ordered their buffalo burger and it was fantastic. I may have a new favorite. There's so much selection with wing flavors it's almost too much selection but that is their thing I guess. The service has always been great I'll definitely continue to come here.

I would love to leave a five star review but...

I would love to leave a five star review because the sales person was amazing. Estie got us a decent deal, he waited late hours and made arrangements so I could take the vehicle the same day. Other people we spoke there were also really nice. Ali was really helpful and corrected mistakes from another advisor.

I would love to leave a one star review because one of the guys in finance was sneaky, never gave me full price amounts, lied to me on total package costs, and was purposely deflecting and miscommunicating in order to sell more packages.

Be careful with some of the finance guys, more so  then with the vehicle salesperson.

I came in here with three of my great friends and with great expectations. And unfortunately only a few were met. I tried the super drums in mesquite and they were dry and just OK.  My friend ordered the donair pizza which I tried and it had a doughy thick crust, which I don't like. (One good thing about the pizza they were not to shy on the cheese)  My other friend had the donair poutine, which I tried and it was no where near a donair in taste, it had a very prominent flavor of sage, why would they put this in a donair poutine???   The cheese and a few strands of donair meat were placed on top of the donair poutine, probably just to make it look like a "donair poutine".  My other friend ordered the Honey and Garlic Riblets, they were really good, full of flavor and sticky sweet.  I wished I would have ordered this instead of the super drums. Our server was fast and kept bringing on the pints, which is always a plus when your at a Brewhouse.

Love this place.  We ordered the Mashawee platter for two. Lots for our dinner and a great lunch to look forward to!  The skewers were tasty and perfectly cooked.  The salad was so flavourful.  Please try this wonderful family owned restaurant. You won't be disappointed.

Just ordered 8 Canadian made dining room chairs and was very happy with the service from Steve and the other lady in the store. We weren't sure about the fabric colors or wood stain that would go with our dining table and sideboard so Steve suggested taking the complete fabric samples and wood stain samples home. We took Steve's suggestion and actually choose a fabric completely different than we originally thought would complement our dining set. Thanks to Home Envy for trusting consumers with their samples, not like other furniture retailers in Edmonton who guard samples as if it were gold. My wife and I try to support Canadian manufacturers and local businesses as much as possible and we've found both in Home Envy.

Only eaten here for takeout but really happy with the food. Excellent portion sizes. Not the most cheapest for a family to eat at, but the quality is pretty good. 
My kids love their pizzas and quesadillas. My husband says their hot philly cheese steak is awesome. Staff is always friendly and great  :)

We visited Sherlock Holmes for the first time last night. Immediately I liked the atmosphere of the place. It was cozy and very English pub reminiscent. 

We were sat fairly quickly. And our drinks ordered. The waitress was friendly. We placed our appetizer order while we were still deciding on our meal. While bringing the appetizer over the waitress accidentally bumped my glass of water right into my lap. She felt horrible, I wasn't upset - stuff happens. But also now I was soaking wet and cold. 

At this point I think the waitress panicked a little because after bringing paper towels and getting me a new water she more or less vanished - not even taking our dinner order until we were done our appetizer. 

In hindsight we probably just should have called it there since sitting in my soaking wet jeans was going to get old quick. But we hoped an amazing dinner could redeem this place for future trips. 

Our meals were decent. I had the Mushroom Swiss chicken sandwich which was tasty but I'm in no rush to try again.  Our appetizer was tasty too but also nothing too amazing. 

All in all I think what bothered me the most was how our waitress almost seemed like she was scared to come back to our table.  

Personally I'm not really in a rush to return here.

The staff was very polite and even brought additional cutlery and straws to the table. 

Ordered the bacon lovers poutine. poutine is good minus the three strips or bacon they laid across the top. Skip it. The Oreo milkshake is fantastic as always. 

Restaurant was running a little slow due to staff shortage. Food was very late. One family waited 25 minutes and finally just left.

My 78 yo mom was just tricked into getting a Walmart credit card by a cashier. She had no idea this was happening until it was done. Once she realized - she told them 10 times she did not want this. All the cashier said was it will be ok - you can cancel when it comes. She would not cancel it. I called the store - manager in a "meeting" and couldn't speak with me. The customer service person just kept saying "I understand". 

This practice is illegal.   Everyone- just be careful that this practice is currently happening at the wye Rd Walmart in Sherwood park.  The scam starts by the cashier saying you can only pay with cash or debit card.  They then asked for a driver's license and credit card for ID. No mention of signing up for credit card.   If this has happened to you. Please file a complaint with Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, RCMP, post to social media. They need to stop.

California Burger. Delicious!
Ultimate Backyard BBQ Bacon burger...great!
Nacho fries...very good!
Pricey as bugers go...but worth it. 
~$20 for a combo with fancy fries.
Happy to have one in Sherwood Park finally.
Looking forward to trying a few more offerings.
So many burger joints these days. 
So little time!

I took my Edge to Sherwood Ford because the rear-view mirror was shaking and while trying to remove it they took a big chunk out the windshield. They lied and told me it was hanging off when they got the vehicle, so I'm not sure how a giant chunk of glass came out when they took it off. They also tried to hide the fact that they damaged it by telling me they just didn't have adhesive strong enough to attach it back on, and would be sending it to a windshield shop to get it put back on. When I spoke to the service manager about the issue the first thing he said to me was "why do you look like you want to punch me in the face?" Gives you an idea of their level of professionalism & respect. This is one of several negative experiences I've had here. Do not trust your vehicle with these people - go elsewhere.

Disorganized confusion!!!!
This place has been the worst truck buying experience i have ever had. it starts with the internet sales team that when you inquire about a vehicle they don't get back to you for about 2-3 days. Then you have to deal with a sales person (Esky) that gives you the run around. i called before i left for the dealership to make sure that the truck was still there and he said yes. i told him to have the truck ready and that i would come down there right now and go for a test drive. After i drove all the way to Sherwood Park he says that his sidekick Adele would be dealing with me instead of him. We go out in the lot and the truck was gone and they told me that a lady already had a deposit on the vehicle and the file was not updated. No communication what so ever.
Later that night i get home and the salesman calls and says the truck is back and I'm first in line to purchase if i want. We work on a tentative deal and when i get there the sales manager says that he will not honor the price that was emailed to me by the salesman. After some discussions the price was settled and sent me off to financing. The first financing guy seemed to be new and didn't know all the details so another financing person came in to seal the deal.
Just when i thought the hassle was over, they told me my truck would be ready on Wednesday (bought the truck on Friday), because I purchased the undercoating and scotch guarding. On Wednesday after numerous phone calls and emails to find out the status of my truck they said it was not ready because the truck had mud underneath it and they couldn't spray the undercoating over the mud. Someone doesn't realize that they have to wash it first even on a new vehicle to get the dirt or dust off in order for the undercoating to be properly applied. More confusion !!!

After some more discussion the salesman (Esky) promised that it would be ready on Monday. I call Monday and truck still isn't ready because of the same excuse (mud) and was told not to sell my other truck until this one was ready. i do not do business this way , I had a sale and i keep my word when i do business, maybe they should do it this way as well.

i drove down to the dealership and got the runaround again from numerous people, they gave me a loaner vehicle and promised it would be ready on Tuesday. I get my truck on Tuesday and the idiots didn't wash the mud off , and undercoated on top of the mud. Hey here's an idea inspect your work before you give it to your customer.

By this time i have had enough and told them to give me the *&^%$ keys and i would never buy anything from them again. I should have sent this truck back to have them re-do it but i want it done properly so ill take it somewhere else and spend more money on something that should have been done right the first time.
Just when i think that the problems and disorganized confusion has stopped, no they screw me one last time. After realizing that the bank did not take my payment out of my account on the day that was discussed, I looked closer at my contract and realized that the financing department has 2 different monthly deductions dates on it and now i have to try to figure out who the hell to talk to (bank or dealership) to get this problem sorted out.
I hope this is the end of my saga with this dealership, but i guess we will find out.
***ONE STAR MAY BE TOO KIND OF A REVIEW*****
Great clothes and fun designs. Customer service is top notch.

This place is tucked into a strip mall behind the Joeys Sherwood restaurant.  They repair phones and sell phone accessories and gadgets such as off  brand fitbits.  I had a problem with my phone jack that was beyond the usual cleaning measures.  They repaired it very quickly.  Staff were very pleasant and professional.  They have a sign that says they guarantee most repairs within 60 minutes.  Well you can't beat that.  5 stars for me.

Big warehouse full of furniture in Sherwood Park.  Brand new.  Staff were pleasant.  Nice wall pictures and hangings.  Especially liked the bicycles hanging on the walls.  Definitely worth a look and may save U a drive to the city.
