We have been shopping at the Bone & Biscuit in Sherwood park since we got our dog a couple of years ago.  While the old owners were good the new owners are fantastic, always making you (and your furry friend) feel welcome.  They are knowledgeable and there is never a bad experience.

We will be continuing to shop here.

I can't atest to the 94% rating everyone else is complaining about. That certainly seems outlandish.
But really.
What do people expect.
It's a diner. In a trailer park. Attatched to a pub and a gas station.
I've eaten at Willy's dozens of times over the years (perhaps more...). Mostly when working in the industrial area to the north of the Yellowhead. I have tried almost every pizza on their menu, and all their burgers and sandwiches.
I admit...the entree's and pasta's have never really spoken to me.
For the most part...i've always left satisfied. Prices are reasonable. Food is pretty consistant, and still way better than any fast food burger joint. They also let you call in your order and they can have it ready and on or almost on the table when you arrive. Pretty convenient when one only has a 30min lunch break!
Pizza is pretty good and the individual sizes hit the spot.
It's not fine dining. It's not trying to be fine dining. But as a hole-in-the-wall lunch/dinner stop...it does just fine.
Keep it up Willy. I'll be back.
And then...
I'll be back again one day.

This Swiss Chalet in Sherwood Park is pretty decent. It has a nicer feel to it than many others in this chain. There are a few plants scattered throughout the restaurant and a warm cozy feel. Many Swiss Chalets I have been in tend to be stark and unfriendly.

Our food came amazingly fast and mine was so hot I had to wait a bit to eat it.

I had a bowl of the chicken chowder soup and it was delicious. Very generous serving size with lots of creamy chunks of potatoes, chicken and bacon. I also had the chicken spring rolls which were quite tasty, although a wee bit greasy.

Hubs had the old standby of 1/4 chicken and fries. He found it tasty, but left wishing he had ordered more.

The thing I was most impressed about with this chain is that when we explained there were some dietary issues, they brought us a nice pamphlet that named all their menu items and what the allergy issues might be.  If you can't have eggs, dairy, nuts, gluten, etc. it was all listed right there.

It was great to be able to look it over and not have to ask the waitress question after question. The added bonus was we were able to take the brochure with us so we can decide ahead of time if we need to.

Overall, a pleasant place to grab a quick bite of good food.

This was the worst experience I have ever had at a dealership. Before the sale, the staff was helpful and acted very professional. The car I was looking at fit what I needed and a deal was quickly made. The next morning, I did a search myself and found there was a lien against the car. It should have been no big deal as I was assured they had a lien release form from the manager. I live out of town and drove over an hour on a Saturday to come pick up the car. But when I got there I was told the form was locked up in an office. Regrettably I decided to purchase the car being told the issue would be dealt with promptly on Monday. 

After the money was in their hands they notified me that there was also only one key and another could be purchased for $300. In hindsight, that was a mistake on my end as I never should have assumed anything from this dealership. It then took two weeks for them to get the lien form using excuse after excuse and having them dodging calls while the car that I bought sat in my driveway. 

This is just a simple warning for anyone looking to buy from a "reputable" dealership. Make sure you have all your ducks in a row because once your money is in their hands you will be ignored and treated with no respect.
Once again they do not know their left hand from there right received a reminder that my 2013 ford F150 is due for service I have never owned one ? never mind I look forward to next years reminder

We love this office and Dr. Smith. We've been with them for senior care and the loss of a pet, and for introduction of a new kitten and all his care as well. All staff we've encountered are knowledgeable, caring, and attentive. Would highly recommend this clinic.

This is the best salon and spa in Sherwood Park. I like all of the services there: hair, nails, and massage. The lady there has the golden hands, every time I had a backache, she help me back to normal just in one hour
smelt so gross! walked in to hear mario kart music playing in the back & a lot of goofing off; so unprofessional. the food was meh, could be way better for how much we paid. over all won't go back.

My buddy had a coupon for a free 2 topping pizza from Papa Murphy's, so we decided to road trip it and give it a try.  I live in South Central Edmonton and unfortunately since the Riverbend location closed down the next closest one was in "The Wood."  So road trip to Sherwood Park, here we go.  

Wasn't worth the trip.  The toppings tasted fine, but it was the doughy bottom of the pizza that absolutely refused to cook no matter what we did.  We started by following the package directions, bottom of pizza is still under cooked.  We changed settings from broil to bake on the oven and kept it in for longer - still nothing.  We even switched to my pizza tray - which I have successfully cooked other frozen pizza on both top and bottom evenly - and again put it back in the oven for more time.  Still doughy.    

Almost 30 minutes in the oven.  Top of pizza is cooked fine, bottom must be coated with something for some ridiculous reason because it absolutely refused to cook.  

At this point I remain convinced you'll have to cook their pizza on top of the earth's core or on top of the sun because that seems to be the only temperature that will cook the bottom of this pizza.  Never seen anything like this before.

As a result of this doughy bottom, the pizza tasted horrible but as pizza goes, even bad pizza is still edible, and that's the most flattering thing I can say about this pizza.  It's edible, but mediocre.  

It also didn't agree with my digestive system considering what happened in the bathroom a few hours later.  

So, if you want pizza that is severely under cooked on the bottom no matter what you do and thus tastes like the smell of a diarrhea infused anus, then have at it.  Otherwise, I'd recommend going to literally anywhere else where the pizza can be properly cooked on both the top and bottom and not taste like butt.
Took my car in for detailing and I can't believe it!  It looks and smells brand new. They did an amazing job!!  The pricing is very reasonable and the service is top notch. Highly recommend!!!

**SCAM WARNING**  PLEASE AVOID AT ALL COSTS. 

A simple and strait forward $24 Oil Pressure switch and 'check the tire pressure' turned into a full on 3 day disgraceful, lie filled mess that ended with almost $900 in outrageous charge and problems still not fixed. Not so good at all.

On top of this they very heavily suggested, almost insisted, that I needed another almost $1200 to fix 'problems' that didn't even exist! Lol. I wonder how many people fall for this?

Is this really how Ford operates now?

Anyways, a guy really cant help but feel completely ripped off. It is a very organized and purposeful scam. Avoid at all costs.

To add insult to injury they disconnected my Command Start. Why?

Was told the service manager would be calling me. Nope. Not even once. Left a few messages and still nothing. This was almost 2 weeks ago now. Pathetic. Obviously this is something that AMVIC must look at.

Just a totally brutal experience. I cant say I wasn't warned. Their reputation is truly awful and deservedly so. Please go elsewhere. Anywhere. You are welcome.**

This was my first time at this store and I was blown away! I was expecting to walk into a bakery with mostly cookies and maybe some cupcakes. I didn't expect to see so many different products!

Confetti Sweets had a Confetti Collective Christmas Market during my visit. A wide variety of products from more than 40 local vendors and businesses were for sale. Most of these local products were displayed upstairs on the second floor. What a excellent way to support local, especially when small businesses have been struggling during the pandemic. This is a great place to buy some holiday gifts.

I spent a lot more time in the store than I had anticipated. Today, I bought a dozen Confetti Sweets cookies in the following flavours: Chocolate Candy Cane, Oatmeal Raisin, Peanut Butter Chocolate, Gingersnap and a Jam Thumbprint cookie. I also grabbed a couple bags of Eggnog flavoured Kick Ass Caramels and a bag of Maple Walnut Brittle. 

In the past, I bought Confetti Sweets cookies from our local Farmers Markets. I know their cookies are delicious. However, coming to this store was pleasant surprise! It was so much more than just a bakery! What a sweet way to support local!

We've been to the Edmonton area several times the last few years and the last 2 years we've eaten at Cora's.  We love, love, love this place for breakfast/brunch!  Good quality food, great service and massive portions - especially for the price!

Anytime we're up in the area from the States...we will always make time to enjoy breakfast at Cora's.  We'll see you again the next time we're up for a visit!

I haven't been here for a while but it looks like they've expanded into the other space which is cool! I love it when local businesses thrive. I've been to a couple of yelp events that they were at and they are always super generous and great with their customers! 

We tried the peanut butter chocolate, coconut, and chocolate coconut. We also got some hot chocolate. All very delicious. It's usually a big hit when we come here!

Came here to watch UFC 196 - called ahead and booked a table which I would recommend because the place was full.  
Attentive service for how busy it was.  I ordered nachos and my husband ordered wings - both were good.  Plenty of TVs to watch the fight. 
It was definitely full of guys in here (for obvious reasons)- our waitress was flirty with our guys, but not overtly so.  Made them feel 'special' but also paid attention to us girls. 
I'd come back.

I think I can easily define myself as a "regular" customer here. I have not once been disappointed from the food or (especially) the service! These waitresses and waiters make your time there so enjoyable! Coffee always being offered, check ups often, excellent knowledge and recommendations! Love the food and the staff and highly recommend this location!

My recommendation & tip however would be show up earlier on weekends, or be prepared to wait about 10-30mins average for a table as it is very popular and busy at that time. It is however definitely worth the wait!

I have to start off by saying how impressed I am! At first I was worried about it being similar to other over done sports bars but that is simply NOT the case. Shoeless Joe's has stepped it up compared to the competition... it's definitely worth checking out.

The inside is spacious, clean, and has a top notch layout. I appreciate the fact that they also don't charge for ANY live events... so come check out all your ppv's without cover!

Our server Cassie was AMAZING... so fast, nice but also knowledgeable about the menu... everything she suggested was delicious!

When it came to the food, my friends had the typical food which looked and tasted good, but I went with the blue freezie to drink and the pecan crusted chicken. All I can say is "nailed it!" Instead of the beans being soggy and overcooked they were absolutley delicious and crispy... and the chicken and mashed potatoes was awesome as well. And that was just for the main course!

You've got to order the caramel pretzel bites which are crispy on the outside and super soft on the inside... or the slam dunk donut bites... they are amazing mouthwatering bites of goodness! For someone who rarely eats deserts I'll be ordering it again!!!

Come down and check it out... you'll get more than you've bargained for. If you like girly drinks, they have the best menu that I've seen... and they taste like... M-O-R-E lol.  I'm looking forward to talks about hosting a fundraiser here as well as the layout is so much better than other places and ALL the staff was great! Although I don't come to the park often, I'll definitely be back here :)

Ordered wings and a chicken Greek salad.   Wings were full and good and the substitute house side salad that came with the wings was great (romaine and cheese, croutons, tomato, cucumber)! And a side of carrots and celery.  The chicken Greek salad was good and light but didn't come with bread so not filling enough for a guy.  The hostess was very friendly. They have one huge TV screen inside.  The hot wings aren't very hot so I would recommend the Xtra hot. They are busy at supper time so your order may take 20 minutes for takeout.
What a beautiful store!  I am amazed that I haven't ever been in this store right here in my home town!  Beautiful gluten free treats and a little market upstairs!  I've been missing out!

I went here for the first time, and a giant piece of my hair was missed when it was dyed. I paid $179 for a cut and and solid color ( with a junior stylist). It took over 3 hours and I have shoulder length hair. I called the next day to complain, and the assistant manager was extremely rude to me and said basically we can't do anything. No apology either. I then emailed the manager, and never received a word back. 
Will never be going to again. Expensive and rude. Do not waste your time!

Had a coupon here for a free pizza though it be a good time to use it as I'm not often in the area, as a total stranger to papa Murphy's I was delighted to see how knowledgeable and friendly the staff was. 

Ended up trying their Stuffed pizza option that's basically two pizzas sandwiching the toppings,  similar to a calzone. It was easy to cook and delicious which is perfect for the busy family to get a break. 

The food prep service here works similar to other DIY food joints ( with a couple premium options) although the twist is that the food isn't cooked so it's meant to go home with you and cooked whenever needed,  aka fill that freezer.  They seem to have pretty cool kids kits where they can build their own pizza and enjoy it.

Impressed! Never been to any location before. 

Food was really good. Fair service. Decent price. I'd go back for sure!

Ok so I contacted the Service Manager a couple months ago to complain about not getting my vehicle back in a timely manner. I was assured that the problem has been rectified. He lead me to believe that the service advisors were taking advantage of people using the key drop regardless if we made an appoinment b/c well if we could be ok with not being with a car so long before the appoinment then we could just be pushed back b/c we clearly didn't NEED our vehicles. The last 2 times I have taken my vehicle the both have been ready before noon instead of 545. Well done.

This is not a review of Ford vehicles in general but rather Sherwood Ford the dealership.  If you don't like Fords you probably aren't even reading this. 
I bought a slightly used Ford Explorer here in July. The process was very low stress and our salesman seemed to be more knowledgeable than those that I encountered at a number of other dealerships. Sherwood Ford is one of the decreasing number of locally owned dealers that is not controlled by a public entity such as those with the prefex "Go".  That appealed to me.   So today I brought our slightly used Explorer in for the first service since I bought it. The only thing it needed was the basic oil and filter change plus, strangely, this morning my key  fob for the keyless entry didn't work. I grabbed my wife's key fob and then mentioned this problem to the dealership. I was very pleased to be told that they replaced the batteries in both fobs and didn't even charge me for it.  That was unexpected and pretty nice.  They offered me a ride on their shuttle but since I didn't have to be anywhere I decided to wait for them to finish the service. The customer waiting area is okay. It's not better or worse than any other dealership I've been to in the past few years. There is hot  coffee and strong WiFi.  I considered giving Sherwood Ford four stars rather than five because of the billing situation. The charge for the oil change was as quoted which was $79.00 but then they added on $10 for an environmental fee and $10 for shop supplies. All dealers do this but they should have included that in the quote. Also $20 in extras seems high for $79.00 of work.  However I probably saved more than that on the two batteries. All in all I would certainly recommend Sherwood Ford to anyone who owns or plans to buy a Ford product. They have a long history in Edmonton (they used to be Healy Ford located in downtown Edmonton before the move to Sherwood Park).  This is a dealership that really seems to put the owner above short-term profits.

Best Chinese fast food place EVER!!! This place was in the Sherwood Park Mall when I attended High School just across the street....a lot of memories built over sharing a 3 or 4 item combo with my best friend on those ummmm "spares" during school when we found ourselves with a severe case of the munchies! 

I have yet to find better ginger beef anywhere else - seriously it's the BEST! The same lady that has worked there for ages is very friendly and recognizes me every time I go in there. After high school Golden 88 moved!! OMG I was panic stricken for months thinking it was gone forever...until I found out it moved into a strip mall just down the street!! Geeesh - what a relief!!!!!! Line ups can get a little long during peak hours but they are usually very quick! Prices are excellent and the food is really good and typically pretty fresh. When I have a craving for this place, I will drive from wherever whenever because, honestly, I have yet to find a place that is comparable to this one. Definitely recommend this place!

(PS - apparently, it's not open on Tuesdays)
Love the pizza.....but it has some weight to it.....very filling. So much cheese and so much meat....a big pizza.....i need to go back.

Went once within a few months of it's opening.
Was far from impressed. 
Pretty young girls in short skirts does not a great eatery make.
They were out of the first item I ordered, and what I wound up with was lackluster to say the least.
With so many other options, I highly doubt I will return.

Our purchase experience was great and we've been dealing with them for years!  Our MISTAKE was our loyalty in using the same dealership for service all the time - until we had an on-going problem that was just never resolved and had to go somewhere else for a solution. The findings were not pretty and the parts and hard evidence were provided to Sherwood Ford. When we finally got a meeting with the Fixed Operations Manager who appears to be responsible for service, our loyalty to this dealership was rewarded with rudeness, arrogance and a lack of preparation. He made his lack of interest abundantly clear by playing with his computer and phone during the meeting.  If you are thinking about having your service done by Sherwood Ford, PLEASE DO MEET WITH THE FIXED OPERATIONS MANAGER BEFORE YOU MAKE YOUR DECISION.  Ask him how he would respond to a service issue or problem - would he review the hard evidence, would he talk with the person who worked on the vehicle, would he investigate to ensure the quality and safety of the service provided by Sherwood Ford, would he meet with you in good faith to review the situation and work out a solution? If you care about your safety and the on-going maintenance of your vehicle, it might be useful to use a couple of different dealerships for alternating service so someone is always on top of what is being done - more importantly what is not being done or being done carelessly.

We had a really great brunch here today. Our food came quickly and was delicious. The staff was very friendly. We went around 1:30 and it wasn't very busy so it was nice and quiet. 

I had the French toast and it was superb.

Our server Maddy (I think) was awesome.  She joked with us and helped us pick a great breakfast.  She was on top of our coffee needs and water.  

I ordered my usual fab the crepe omelet which was delicious and served nice and hot.
I liked it :) the servings were HUGE! the service was awesome! What a fun place! Gotta try the kettle chips!
Went through drive thru to get me and hubby a treat.  Got to window chick opens up and says we are closed I'm like it is 6:55   Nope we are closed. Very disappointing.  Amateurs
dry wings the salad was ok but wings were terrible and overpriced not impressed.................

Terrible!  The job they did with snow clearing was so bad. I wanted to talk to them about what wasn't done well do it could be handled well for the rest of the the season. I called, emailed, texted and left a message on the website. No response. I wasn't rude, though I was getting pretty frustrated and it may have begun to show. Finally I decided I needed to fire Donewell and find someone else so I wrote to cancel the following month. Guess what!  Immediate response. Strange business model. In the meantime, my driveway is a mess with no attempt to clean it up.

Thank you for the reply, Kristi.

To clarify:

1) I was NEVER offered another pair/color of jeans when I was informed about the back order. I have documented all of the discussion that passed between myself and your administration and this never occurred.

2) I did mention that the doortag from Canada Post never got to my door. Yes the jeans sat at the post office - but I DIDN'T KNOW ABOUT THEM and was NEVER sent tracking information even though you had it in your possession. Therefore the fact that it sat at the post office was not necessarily my fault.

3) Once again, this is another fabrication. Yes, you did offer to deliver the jeans to my house but you never once offered to refund a portion of my payment and then do so. I declined delivery to my door because this had happened several months after my order and I no longer needed the jeans.

4) Yes, you offered me a 40% off coupon. I apologize for not mentioning this. For all of those reading this commentary - I was offered a 40% off coupon for a future purchase at Key-Lime.

5) At least own up to the fact that this was a huge error on your part instead of fabricating lies to paint me in a negative light. Thank you for demonstrating the poor customer service that I mentioned in my previous review. I am so disappointed, mortified and frustrated that you would even go out of your way to "apologize to me" while passive aggressively claiming that I didn't tell the whole story. Abhorrent.

Great experience. No pressure sales, vehicle was clean and ready when they said and got the price I wanted.

Take my truck there for service and I am always impressed. Great dealership to deal with.

Referred my in laws and they were equally impressed with the service. Two very satisfied customers

Great vet, dr. Smith goes above and beyond and is always there to help you out. They try to keep cost at a minimum without sacrificing on their service.
Truly thankful and happy with our experiences here.

There were wings. They tasted like they've been fried set aside to chill and then thrown back in the fryer but they were there. There's a wide selection of sauces to choose from but none of them will cover up the fact that the wings are over cooked. The lemon pepper was ok. The hot sauce was lame. The blue cheese dressing was sad. It made me sad. The whole place was sort of a shabby sad experience. There were three other tables but we still waited half an hour for our wings to be cooked to death. It's possible they were in the fryer the whole time! The server was nice. I just think if you have a food item in your name, you should take care to serve that item well. They didn't. Just go to Boston Pizza like you were originally thinking.

we ordered a bedroom suite in maple.we absolutely love it.service and delivery were excellant.arrived in 4 weeks.definately would shop their
again.james and matthew were very professional and very helpful.

This used to be a really great Salon but now a lot of people have left and there's a lot of new people in that are not quite as experienced and the customer service isn't as good anymore so I probably won't be returning nor recommending.

Well...I arrived with a little hope.
Upon realizing the "restaraunt" doubles as a convenience store...I almost turned around and left.
Bah.
One never knows.
Alas.
The Jumbo donair I payed ~$10 for was marginal at best. Quite bland. I think the onions had more flavour than the meat and "sweet" sauce.
My pics say a 1000 words. 
If i lived beside it....nah...I'd make the trip down the road and partake in any of the other donair shops I habe tried. To date...I have eaten at 4 donair shops in Sherwood Park. This was the worst of those four.
Perhaps their pizza is better...

I have tried wings all over the place and keep coming back to Wild Wing -so many flavours and unique combinations to try. Great specials as well -something new to try every day. Friendly staff and I've met the owners -super people that support the community in so many ways. Great people, great food, great place overall. Thumbs up!

First and foremost... as soon as you walk in , your nose is overloaded with the smell of freshly baked goodies.. OMG !!! It smells amazing in there. In a way, I could not work there because I would be eating a cookie every 20 minutes or so. 
This is not your typical cookie bakery. There is a great variety of food - from frozen pizzas to pastas, sauces and more goodies than you can possibly imagine. 

I walked around for about 5 minutes looking at the cookies and the layout of the store.. it has a great appeal . 

What amazes me is the story of how it all started. From baking cookies at home for the farmer's market to being featured at the Oscars - really !!!  In 2014 she supplied the Canadian Country Music Awards and a year later at the Oscars in Hollywood. 

I bought a dozen of my favorite - gingersnaps, shortbread and chocolate chip ( with crumpled up candy canes mixed in ).

The second floor features an assortment of christmas decorations and other products.

As soon as I left , I could not resist the urge. . My car was smelling like cookies. So I dipped in and ate a gingersnap....  HOLY CRAP !!!! 

These are amazing !!! 

I mean I love a good cookie just like the next person .. but these ones are simply heaven !  Soft and very chewy.. perfect !  Unfortunately ( or fortunately .. depending on how you look at it ) I could not eat just one.. three gone by the time I got home. ..

It may be a long way to go for cookies but I did get told they have a table at the farmers market by the Costco southside Edmonton ( the employee tried to sign me up for their loyalty card - which I declined ..then she told me about the farmers market.. I will have to think about it ) . 

Any way.. the store is laid out nicely and very clean everywhere ( I peaked into the baking area ) the staff and owner are amazing .. and best of all... those cookies are damned delicious.

Really good customer service today. I went in there looking for a pair of leggings that I saw online but unfortunately they did not have them. As I know the in-store stock is different than the online store. I got a wicked deal on the hoodie for $50 which was a steel and deal because it was very comfortable. The lady who was working there today helped me with finding a pair of leggings which I wasn't really expecting to find. They were very very very comfortable the ones she pick out. Which I had to buy because they felt so comfortable. She was very very friendly and very very good customer service I will definitely be back to see if there's any steel deals in store. Absolutely happy with my experience here today I found what I was looking for. Thank you!

Would not recommend, worse experience from start to finish. Where to begin? I asked 3 times when the job would start and was told each time "as soon as the nurseries open" which was May 1st.  The job did not "start" until May 31st after I threatened to cancel.  I was also told the job would take 3 days, it actually took 10 days with more than half of those days with no one showing up and things sitting idle and unfinished.  Everyday they said someone would come work and most days no one ever came. The "crew" (usually just one person) would arrive later and later -sometimes not until well into the afternoon and once they had people here until 9:30pm (way too late) and one person smoked weed while working and the smell came into our open windows (not professional). They installed a gate in our fence which I could not open less than 48 hours afterwards, they sent the crew to "fix" it and now after one month I can't open it again. They drove their truck onto my neighbor's lawn and even when the neighbor asked them to move it, they did not as they said it would be fine -and I ended up having to fix the lawn for my neighbor afterwards -Donewell offered to re-sod when their reseeding job failed but by then no one here wanted to have to work with them or wait around for them again. Yesterday, I added a new plant and was shocked to find that under the new rock and landscape fabric were the old rocks and clay that was there before the landscape. One of the main things I asked for was for the clay to be dug up and replaced with new soil- I was assured this would be done, but obviously they just covered up the area and left the old clay untouched.  How can a company be so awful and still be in business?

I looooove confetti sweets cookies! 

The sugar cookie with rainbow sprinkles is delish!  

The chocolate and skirt ones are also a winner winner chicken dinner!

And did you know they were featured at the Oscars last year?!?  Yay #YEG
Quick in response, felt Paul McLaughlin was really representing me. Would recommend for wills and estates. Treats you like your case is special.

I see there's lots of negative reviews from years ago. I ended up purchasing the groupon for highlights and I saw Kayla who is an intermediate hairstylist. I have gone to her twice now and I am very happy with my service. She did an amazing consultation and truly understood what I wanted. She was fast, efficient and my hair looked great. The service ended up being about half the price. Definitely important to give a decent tip!! I will for sure be back to see Kayla. 

They also have a full service spa as well. I used to go often for waxing many years ago. Their prices definitely increased quite a bit so I ended up having to find a new place for esthetics services which is why this is down a point. I recommend to check this place out for hair, especially Kayla!

One of the most disappointing "improvements " that I've seen. It's run by a bunch of kids who have no idea about Seafood. Everything is frozen except for a few selections of oysters and the odd fresh fish. They seem to cater to more of the wholesale Market which apparently likes frozen fish. Steak selection is limited but what they do have is good. I think they should have stuck to seafood and given us a better selection instead of Frozen. TNT and H Market on Calgary Trail have a huge selection at a much lesser price. Just saying. Too bad.

What kind of a business allows such distaste when a customer comes to them with a problem that is clearly due to their own sanitation practices. They should be reported to the health board. Disgusting. Also, perhaps some anger management classes for your managers would assist your business in paying the rest of your polite staff prior to bankruptcy.

Horrible all around. Bought a new car that was to be ready 5 days later, took 14 days for it to be ready, then the device team gouged the hood before pickup. That was supposed to be fixed within 3 days, and took over a month, with no apologies or compensation, and no offer of a loaner in the meantime. Since then, every time we try to book an oil change we are told it will be 3 months before an appt is available, despite other ppl getting spots the next day when they call. Every time we go in for the oil change they have lost or changed the appt and the shuttle that we have booked ahead of time is unavailable, and staff are always surly and rude and claim that we are wrong, despite having voicemail proof that they confirmed the times we have written down. Due to poor service we have given poor service feedback, so rather than improve their performance they have now informed us they won't help us anymore, despite it being part of the contract warranty. Absolutely ridiculous- wouldn't recommend this dealer to my worst enemy.

This is not so much a review of Cora's as it is for this location.  As a regular patron of the North and West locations, Cora has become my go to breakfast spot.  This week I was in Sherwood Park and decided that it would be a reliable choice for brunch. After the two of us had ordered, our food (4th of July and a Crepomelette) arrived quickly enough.  Unfortunately we immediately found that our crepes were tough and chewy.  I didn't mind it too much, but on the 4th of July it was simply unenjoyable.  Now I know that its rude to eat everything and then complain, so after a few bites she set it aside to wait for our server.  By time she showed up, I was completely done my meal (without any coffee refills) and we mdidn't have time to wait for a new meal.  She took it away only to return and say the manager had adjusted the bill for us.  He adjusted it by taking a whole $4 off of the $14 uneaten plate.  Now I don't normally complain or ask for free things, but I've worked enough in hospitality to know that it is courtesy to refund an uneaten and unacceptable meal. After many visits with great food and service I came to expect more from a great franchise, but this experience will probably keep me from this location.

I really love this vet. My dogs have had 3 successful surgeries here. I was concerned about it and they took me through the whole process. They are patient and answer all my questions thoroughly. Bonus: my dogs love their vets! Which tells you a lot!

Great new Vietnamese restaurant in Sherwood Park.  We tried the salad rolls, dumplings and some vermicelli dishes and they were all great.  This is a great family owned local restaurant.  We will be back.

My wife and I split the full Butter Lick 'n Chicken sandwich and The Cubano.

The Cubano was very good and the flavours were there but I was really wanting that crunch you get from the bread from an actual Cubano. 

The Butter Lick 'n Chicken was delicious. Tasted like butter chicken on a sandwich accept less creamy and saucy then actual butter chicken. Good his sandwich is a featured sandwich so not sure how long it's going to be on the menu. 

The soup was okay, I was craving a sandwich and not soup, so if I was craving soup I would go else where, but it was a nice add on to a delicious sandwich.

The service can really suffer when it gets late. This location gets very busy so the waitresses are constantly running, and sometimes it can be a good idea to order 2 drinks at a time because you may not see your server for a while.
Another thing that bothers me is the lighting. It is very dark, even for a nightclub.
Good food, reasonable prices (for a bar.)

Another new bistro sports bar with TV screens and the usual food fare.  No beer specials.  Which is unfortunate as every other bar just a block away  such as the Tilted Kilt, The Local, Joeys Sherwood, and the Canadian Brewhouse have them.  For that reason alone I won't be back.  As noted in the previous review food is not special.  And the piped in music is too loud, especially when there are only 6 patrons in the place. Atmosphere is nice and sort of upscale.  Not sure why they have 2 tiny TVs on each side of the bar; should be a little larger.  Ample free parking.  Open til 2:00am Thur to Sat at least for now...

Visited here on a Friday morning for breakfast. Not busy as expected. Decor needs help as it has no theme. Food was good.  The service was poor. Wait staff were more interested in chatting at the back than checking on their customers.

Andrew McLaughlin is an excellent lawyer who is devoted to his clients and super knowledgeable.  I would highly recommend him to anyone for Wills and Estates. His fees are fair and I'm so impressed with the quality of his customized work.

Love their cookies! Every once in a while my husband spoils me with some mini cupcakes and dozen assorted cookies.
The reason for the 4 stars is last visit, my husband just picked an assorted dozen cookies bag as usual and received what seems like the leftovers they had, 8 (!!!!) chocolate coconut cookies, 3 oatmeal chocolate chip and 1(?!) gingersnap. When my husband came home I was confused for the amount your paying you really do want assorted flavors and not whatever leftovers (or feels like it) the store wanted to get rid of before closing time.
Would deff come back cause their cookies are incredible! Would recommend maybe to choose your own flavors :)

Stafff are welcoming. Store well laid out. 

Added extra self check outs recently which is awesome.

Unfortunately the food is awful.  Any other restaurant would be better.  But as a truckstop for breakfast and a coffee and for comfort food it is good.  Nice bright windows and friendly staff. Fries were awful and cooked in some old oil.  I don't recommend anything that is deep fried. Natchos were spicy but had to look hard for the veggies and the beef was so fatty it was dripping and forming a pool on the bottom. Did not look like the photo.  Closes at 10pm daily.  Not 24 hour. Washroom is outside in the store.

Just completed the purchasing process.  I should probably wait until I visit the service department before I write my review, but I'll come back and update it if I need to!

I chose Sherwood Ford because a friend of mine had just purchased a new truck from here about 3 weeks prior and she referred me to her salesman, Shane Johnston.  I set up an appointment for after work one day and headed in.

Now I'll admit.  I was terrified.  You read awful things about just about every car dealer, so how on earth do you pick somewhere to go?   Plus, I had never done this before.  So, I brought my friend with me.

Shane greeted us as we walked towards the building and we started looking at vehicles right away.

It was a long process, but I have to say I never felt pressured.  I actually felt like I was being listened to, and I think I got a great deal.  They even threw in a few extras that I asked for.

We were there on Thursday evening and I picked up my brand new car on Saturday afternoon.  I couldn't be happier with my experience.

Staff that I dealt with during my visit were: Shane, Rahul, Sharbel, and Ali.  I wouldn't hesitate to go to any of them if I have issues in the future.

I don't have a passion for cooking but I LOVE this store. There are soooo many great gift ideas, yummy foods to try, and the staff are beyond knowledgeable. The in store kitchen is gorgeous and they offer cooking classes for all types of foodies. This is an awesome place to check out if you are looking for the perfect gift for any cook - you're sure to find something!

Not reviewing a purchase of vehicle, but rather for vehicle servicing. Advised to book in advance even though quick service doesn't require appointment. It's great that they are open on Saturdays. Just needed the basic quick service: oil change, tire rotation & fluid check. Was appalled that the price quote was roughly $500, however, that was not an issue since I had purchased a maintenance package when I bought the vehicle which covered that cost. 
I do like how the service centre is the same location as the quick service... that's a major improvement from trying to find parking in the back & then waiting in a tiny room with barely any amenities while service is done. 
The waiting lobby is large, has a massage chair, popcorn machine, beverage machine, TV and a little kids spot. 
Washrooms are baby friendly with change table space & seating for breastfeeding if you want to do that privately. 
I found the receptionist to be knowledgeable about the service I was receiving & also aware of what my warranty covers and doesn't as well as what services are considered more of a priority if I had to choose one over the other which is really helpful for my personal budgeting purposes. 
I'm glad I chose to get my service done at this location under the maintenance package I have for this vehicle. And to add, I don't even think I had to wait a full hour for the service to have been completed.

Took my vehicle here because after my first service at another dealership left me with a horrible wobble in the front end asked them to check and fix a slow leak in driver front tire, after 36.00 dollar charge for the slow leak and the wobble I left satisfied only to discover a crunching noise coming from my the tire that had the slow leak took it to another ford dealer only to have them tell Sherwood ford had not tightened the lug nuts on said tire thue generating the noise then charged me 90 dollars to tightened five lug nuts and take test drive at least they are all consistently horrible so beware
I've always loved their food though I'd recommend eating in house rather than ordering for take out.

Fatburgers everywhere serve the same food, so I'm just reviewing the service at this particular location and I must say the service was excellent.  I'm guessing the two staff were brother and sister and owners of the place.  You can always tell when you're dealing with an owner vs. the hired help.  They were both very friendly and accommodating.  I had to change my order three times because my wife stayed in the car for medical reasons so I had to keep going back to the car to get clarification and come back and change my order and at no point did they give me any indication that they were annoyed.  They were just so patient and accommodating and I really appreciate that.  Also I have a face mask phobia (true story) and they didn't give me a hard time about not wearing a face mask so I really appreciate that as well.

We brought our puppy in for a diagnosis and treatment of his symptoms. The staff and Dr. Mah were very knowledgeable, professional and caring to us and our puppy. An exact diagnosis was made based on the test ordered and a treatment plan is now in place for our puppy. The staff and Dr. Mah were excellent, as well as the overall service we received from this veterinary clinic.

I've had a couple of the vermicelli bowls and loved them. Best bowls in Sherwood Park I think. Today I ordered the large Wor Wonton bowl and it was LARGE and packed full of deliciousness. To start they don't scrimp on the veggies or the jumbo shrimp. But unlike other places it's also is FULL of meat including multiple sticks of crab meat. I am very picky about my Wontons most places are just ok. This place makes fantastic broth and the actual Wontons are flavorful and large. This has easily become my favorite place to eat in Sherwood Park. The staff are amazing and friendly. The food is out of this world and the price is really reasonable for the portion and flavour.  Cannot day enough good things about this place.

I get my brows done here by Joanna. She does an amazing job, and pays special attention to detail. She cares, and it shows through in her personality. All the other staff seem great too, it's a lovely place!

I had just finalized my divorce and was instructed by my lawyer to update my will.  A friend of mine recommended Turning Point Law in Sherwood Park.  I met with Andrew McLaughlin and he went through everything with me regarding my will.  He took his time with me to insure that I fully understood everything that we were discussing.  I was very pleased with the service that I received and have since returned to have them prepare a Travel Consent letter for an out of country holiday with my children.  I would recommend this firm to my friends.

Disorganized Dealership!

I purchased a vehicle from this dealership on Monday. Cash deal. Paid in full with a credit card and personal cheque. I was not offered the possibility of speeding up the process with certified cheque and told that as soon as the cheque clears I will receive the vehicle.

This morning, December 24th, my cheque has cleared, the money was transferred from my bank account to the dealership account. The dealership is open today from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, however there is no one at the dealership who can check/confirm if the cheque has cleared indeed. I was told that the finance person is not in today, therefore nothing can be done. Moreover, I was told that "my car" is not ready for delivery anyways and that it will be ready for delivery on Boxing Day!(?)

Why is this dealership open today at all if nothing can be done there?
I paid everything promptly but cannot pick up the car because of this organizational mess!

I contacted the owner of this dealership immediately, however nothing changed. Couldn't the owner himself check the account instead of relying on one person, who had this day off, therefore froze everything? It just doesn't make any sense.

I would never recommend this dealership to anyone.

I wash my car nearly every week - seriously. My friends joke that I wash my car more often than I take a shower.

I even have a toothbrush to clean my car with (even your car's grill needs its teeth brushed). 

So its no surprise that I like to wash my car myself and don't trust the "pros" to wash it. Cue in Self Service Car Wash. The place has everything I need to make my baby gleam like the pearl it is. Extra points for being cheap and easy (unlike my ex girlfriend's).

In a strip mall.  Phoned in an order for pickup.  Wings are very good.  Lots of meat on them. But just token one tiny sliver of celery and one half carrot stick .  Just change your menu to say no veggies.  Otherwise for us that are expecting veggies, this is a total fail.  Staff are East Indian and were friendly but difficult to understand.  There is a language barrier.  My other complaint was the boxes the wings come in for take out leaks so eating them in the car requires a plastic bag underneath.  Have not tried the burgers.  Beware the redneck tradrivers that pull up in their jacked up trucks as you are backing out. I suggest you park a lane back and walk, so that you don't have to back out.

Cora's has become my son's and my favorite place to sneak off to for breakfast before "the girls" wake up. That being said..if my daughter stirs early enough...she is always excited to tag along. Even before the kids started joining me, I must say one of my favorite ways to start the day was to be here at openning for a hearty breakfast. 
Because of the early nature of all our visits however...we never really experience the zoo that this place becomes later in the morning, and the sevice is always good.

Food is consistant. Ironically...I often find the obliguatory "pile of fruit" is occasionally not of the highest quality.

Of all the times I have eaten here (over 20 I'm sure), i have only had poor food once. I complained. It was replaced and I didn't pay for it. As it should be. 

Amazing...no.
Hearty breakfast. Yes.

But I'll be back.  
I just can't get enough of their eggs beni!

A couple months ago I was in Sherwood Park for work. One restaurant I've been wanting to try for a while is Toast. My parents told me that they have a traditional English/Irish breakfast, with white and black pudding (hint: the pudding in this case is not a dessert). I lived in Dublin for a bit, and while I didn't have a full Irish breakfast every day there it was something I enjoyed from time to time, and so I was excited to know there's a place somewhat close by (well closer than Ireland) that would have this. 

I went in on a Sunday morning around 9am. It was busy, but I was able to get a table right away. I was also alone, so if I'd been with more people I may have had to wait a bit. In any case I got a coffee and put in my order for the full English/Irish breakfast. It probably only took about 10 minutes to come out, and like a full breakfast this was massive. The breakfast even came with Irish soda bread (though you could get regular toast, but why?). The only thing missing was a side of Irish butter (which I know we can't get in Canada, but it's the most delicious butter ever - if you go to Ireland try the butter, Kerrygold was my favourite). This dish the pricier breakfast option at $18.25, but with the amount of food you get you probably won't need to eat lunch. Having this totally brought me back to being in Ireland. Of course they have lots of other breakfast options like pancakes, omlettetes, etc. and lunch options as well. Next time I'm in Sherwood Park I'll make sure to stop at Toast again.
Made a large order, ready on time delicious and they worked with their promos to get me the best price

Two locations. One in Sherwood Park , one in Riverbend. The one is Riverbend is within a bakery called Prairie Mills- see that review. Business within business - Confetti Sweets started as a small vendor at Market now becoming much larger business - famous for its cookies - and reported game at an appearance at the Oscars by request from none other than Oprah. No need to say more. Reasonable tastiness for reasonable price. Good as party treats or on its own.

I paid for two SVT vehicles from this dealership over 150000 dollars for them and they have consistently given me the worst service since that day.  I have an extended service package they have used against me since day one; not once has it helped me get anything done.  They promise to do things and never do.  They tell me they checked everything yet I am always returning for some reason.  Last time they didn't put the oil plug in tight it leaked all over I had to drive back and wait another few hours.  This time they never filled my fluids and I was out of washer fluid in two days.  The last 3 times I went my brakes were close to needing repair and in the "yellow zone."  This time 36000 km later they are in the green zone and fine; I now have more brakes then I had in the last 2 years and they gave me documentation show that!  WTF they think people are stupid; this place is ridiculous!  It took them 6 visits to fix a leak in my tire; all at my cost for missing work.  I took their shuttle and spent an hour driving other people around the city more then once.   Customer service means nothing to them once you buy a vehicle.

We used Go Coach charters to transport our group from Edmonton to Calgary. Our tour group was very fortunate to have a sweet person named Claude as our tour bus driver. He had a contagiously cheerful attitude. We were delighted with their service and their hospitality. The coaches were clean and comfortable, and the rates were very reasonable as well. Everyone got back and forth with ease. I will be using them again in the future for all my needs.

I purchased a groupon because $200 for a haircut and color isnt an option. The groupon was $109(plus $12 chemical fee?) Nicole was my stylist. She was nice but i feel that if you are advertising on groupon to bring in more clients you should not be putting these clients with less inexperienced stylists. For example, I showed nicole a couple of pictures of long black hair with some great pops of color. My hair is long and black, i wanted it to remain long and black with a trim and some vibrant colors throughout. No problem according to her. She chose to do a purple near the roots and fade out to hot pink! Great this sounds awesome! Im totally on board, i said to her that i was also prepared to spend a bit more than what the groupon was if need be. She said it probably would be necessary. Cool! Anyway as we are nearing the end,  she discovers that she missed a part of the bleached section at the top of my head so thats visible and not colored (its blonde/coppery) the color came out nice but hardly visible, their simply wasnt enough sections of color done (compared to the pictures i showed her) 
She attempted to curl my hair after me saying it will not curl unless youre using hairspray and pins to keep them in place until they cool. Didnt bother her, she did it anyway without product and after i left i had to go home and straighten it out again because it was full of kinks from the straight iron she used to curl with.  Just so happened to be on the day of husbands and his fathers birthday party! She burned the base of my neck on the first curl! Hurt for 2 days later!! The right side is also longer by at least half an inch. And now that its been 4-5 days since my apt all the "hot pink" is no longer visible and it's taken on the darkness of the black color she used. I suspect its probably something to do with her choice in using a demi-permanent black which bled into the vibrant color because now its coppery and looks nothing like what i showed her! 
In short, my hair looks just as bad as it did before the apt and im out $141 and my trust in hair stylists is no longer existent after this

Food was really good, about as close to getting a full Irish/English (only the fried bread missing, lol).  Food came out very fast but placing the order, paying was slow, and no one came around to top up coffee.  This was the difference between a 5 and 4 star rating.  But definitely worth a visit, we will be back!

Over the drawn out course of my car buying experience I have written many Yelp updates as my experience just kept getting worse and worse.  I think it's finally over - time for a final update from beginning to end!

I left Sherwood Ford after signing the paper work for my brand new Ford Focus thinking WOW - finally a large purchase that I felt good about.  I guess I got my first lesson about car salesman's pitches that day - cuz I was way wrong!  We talked everything out that day (Nov 26, 2011) and I left owning the exact car I wanted for exactly what I wanted to pay.  The one snag (and of course I was expecting something) was that the car I wanted either had to be factory made (8 to 10 weeks out) or they had one in BC but they would ship it over (I signed the paperwork on Sat - they were telling me at this point that I would have my car by THAT Friday).

For the next month and 4 days I WAITED while my salesman gave me the same run around song and dance about how the transport company this and the transport company that...(ironically I work for a trucking company - in sales - so I know how ridiculous it is to claim a 1 month delay in shipping.  I also know how ridiculous it is promise to call your customer back with an update numerous times and to never do so).  Coincidentally, after writing my second Yelp review (shedding a not so positive light on this company and my fruitless efforts to find out what was going on) the very next morning I received a phone call saying how sorry Ford is and how unheard of this is - that they will make my first car payment (umm - yeah since it came out before I even got my car) and make sure that I am compensated for being so patient and understanding.  So, first payment made YAY :) but by compensation they meant to say further run around and terrible customer service.  

I finally got my car on Dec 29, 2011.  I was shocked (well not really) to find my new car did not have winter tires on it as per the 'Winter Safety Program' I had qualified for.  Over 2 weeks later I got my winter tires.  Over two weeks after that I got my block heater installed (after being laughed at by the salesman when I asked about it at signing - and after they tried to tell me I would have to pay extra for it after I found out it wasn't there).  Neither time was I offered shuttle service or anything so I also had to be without car and find my own transportation for both these occasions!

My sales guy started out great but ended up being a complete flop!  He told me that we would fill out the customer satisfaction survey together so I thought great, here's my chance to work out the compensation with the dealership - that never happened so I just filled it out on my own - told them exactly how I felt - and haven't heard a word from anyone at Ford since I picked up my car from getting the block heater installed.  And honestly this is a much toned down version of all the crap they put me through - I really could go on and on......and on!

I went to my car buying experience knowing there would be some challenges along the way but I did not expect this - Sherwood Ford should be embarrassed of themselves!

This is the previous location of Thai Together who moved up the street. The menu has shifted to Vietnamese. 
So far, I have only tried takeout and tonight is Lemongrass Chicken on Vermicelli. Good value ($13) and a nice spice level.
Also very good service.
As a realtor, I always refer my clients to Andrew McLaughlin because I know he is one of the best Will and Estate lawyers in the city.  My clients always have positive feedback.

My husband and I were hesitant to try this place due to the Vietnamese restaurants in the Park. I would say this is the best Pho in the Park for sure. . It was very quite during the lunch hour which made us a bit concerned when we first went in . Service was good. Food was super fresh and hot. We had medium rare pho tai and spring rolls. Soup had great flavour, spring rolls were a bit over done. But all in all a good experience. 

Will definitely be back again.

Sales staff was friendly as well as finance department and sales manager. That goes a long way with me. The used  truck was in good shape and detailed after the deal was signed. Missing a floor-mat and they ordered me a full set free of charge to replace 1 mat. Overall I'm satisfied/happy with the experience thus far and have a feeling it will be a good dealership to deal with in the service department. My only small grievance was the classic negotiating line in regards to this used truck not having much margin as a colleague mis-valued it during it's trade in. I was relatively happy with the price (from a dealer) and decided to pull the trigger so my fervent vehicle search did not have to continue. If there were half stars on Yelp, Sherwood gets 4.5.

It is a modern sports bar of medium size in Sherwood Park on Baseline Road.  Older folks frequent during the day and young take over in the evenings.  Modern with booths and padded stools. Square central bar counter in the middle with large screens around it.   Tv's all along the walls but all on one station when we were there?.  If you miss happy hour beer is expensive.  16oz pints as they call them start at $6.5 and 22oz start at $9 and up. Definitely no value there.  Clubhouse sandwich was good.  Cheap Tuesday tacos.  Waitresses were quite pleasant and wear the requisite short skirt.  More for the younger crowd at night and those with big arms, tattoos and large chains.

I really want to like this store because it's my local one but I have so many issues here especially with customer service. I returned two unopened meal replacement supplements with a receipt today. 

The lady said "Just so you know this will be thrown away" I said ok it's unopened why do you have to throw it away? 

She said any food item must be thrown away. I said "that sounds like Walmart's problem not mine." She continued to go on about it.... so I said I don't care.... She said "I KNOW YOU DON'T!" WTH lady? How do you know that? Is that the best customer service technique you've got?

First off a multi-billion dollar company is tripping on people to return things? Which according to their company policy all you need is a receipt.  In this period with enormous economic pressure on everyone it's not cool. 

Second is it really getting thrown away? Or does Walmart return it to the manufacturer and get a refund?

Thirdly isn't bad enough that my charity contribution at the till is essentially a tax write off for Walmart but now returning things is an action to be shamed for???

By the other reviews I'm certain I'm not the only one feeling this way...

I was really impressed with how much different stuff is inside this shop! It's far more than just cookies - but don't get me wrong, the cookies are the stars here. The cookies are big and chewy and don't skimp on flavour! I tried the candy cane Christmas feature cookie, as well as their peanut butter choco-chunk. I also bought a package of frozen cookie dough to take home and bake up a delicious batch of gingersnaps. I was well aware of this company as they have products available through Uproot Food Collective, but their store location also sells a variety of the popular Uproot brands, which makes for convenient shopping. This is definitely a great place to stop in and pick up a delectable treat - or a great option if you are looking for a way to mark a special occasion with something other than cake.

Bar and restaurant for locals.  Upgraded inside.  Full menu.  Sports bar.  Booths.  Definitely a younger crowd.  Friendly staff.  Some daily specials.  Several
Levels inside.  The weird thing about this place is that it has no windows, it's like a casino or  Jehovah Witness place.  The apocalypse could hit and you wouldn't have a clue .  That said, they have a nice wrap around outdoor patio that is decent size.  And if you are into buying the house a round, just ring the large corded bell .  Gets busy after work and early evening, so off-hours are best.

Not very happy with the service at this location. The battered mushrooms I ordered came out under done. The batter was still raw inside. Like cold raw. Disgusting and inedible. 

They screwed up my order. Again. I'm getting sick and tired of this location not listening when I order. 

I always order my wings with flats only, since they take pride in offering this as an option. So for my third visit in a row I get mixed wings. I can't stand the drums because they're too fatty.

The waitress at least owned the mistake and told me she forgot. That's cool, thank you for being honest, so props to her for that. 

Insider tip. If they screw up your wing order, you still get to keep your wings and they bring you a new order. Yes Wild Wing I posted that. Get your stuff together and maybe you won't bleed money on wasted food. 

Sorry for the aggressive review but I'm pissed off. 

I'm not coming back to this location.

This is an awesome little store in Sherwood Park. I love that a really good portion of their clothes are made in Canada. The bamboo line is crazy comfortable, and super cute. I also REALLY appreciate that they have plus-sized clothes also available. It's so nice to be able to go into an active wear store and be able to buy clothes that FIT ME.
I highly recommend that people check this store out!

Love the concept, non profit with all proceeds going back to the community.  The cappuccino I had is on par with or better than the big chain coffee place based in Seattle, the sandwich was no way extravagant but tasty, and the homemade dill pickle soup was excellent. 
Run by volunteers, everything made in house, your money spent is going to a good cause.  Worth stopping in.

If I'm in the area and have to grab an item or two. Save-on Foods will do.
I remember "this lication" when it was accross the parking lot in what is now the Party City building.
Nice store.
Nifty little cafeteria where one can grab a meal and sit to eat.
Very large bulk section.
Fancy motion activated lighting in refrigerted isles to cut costs I guess.
I've bever been one to sit and really compare prices when it comes to grocery chains. I think in the end it's as combination of whichever is more convenient, and perhaps which one a person is accustomed to.
When I'm near this store...
It will do!

We're waiting for a replacement and we'll see how this one does. Employees and Manager was responsive and professional. The replacement pizza was better but quality of food has reduced considerably from most previous experiences. All side orders and pizza was low quality.

Trustworthy, knowledgeable and compassionate are just a few words to describe Dr. Tara Mah. She goes out of her way to care for our pets and took the time to understand all of their quirks and unique needs (and there's a lot of them!) 

If you want someone to care about your animals as much as you do, go see Tara and her team. I can't say enough good things!

Do you love cookies? Do you like treats of any sort? 
Most likely the answer to this question is yes, have I got a place for you to try!
Confetti Sweets has been around for a while and there is a good reason, because the cookies are made with love and their passion and it shows!
They also are big community supporters, when Covid hit they quickly pivoted and offered products online, but not just their own products, pretty much anything local people wanted them to offer so helped a lot of other small businesses stay afloat. 
I  personally can not enjoy the gluten filled goodness in most of the treats, but that is no problem as they have some great Gluten Free options also. 
If you can't make it into the store, you can usually find them in Save On Foods as you are grocery shopping. Hats off to these great folks!

My top compliment today was that Cora's package for take-out was ENTIRELY compostable - no plastic at all. I'm trying to find restaurants that use environmentally friendly packaging and support them. I was really pleased to see Cora making this choice. Thanks!

It's tough to find a breakfast place that is not too fatty and that gives a good fruit serving. This one is it. With take-out, it's a fruit salad. But if you eat in they make it look nice on the plate. 

I had the mushroom and brie eggs Benedict. My egg was perfect, the sauce was great, as usual. And I love their potatoes.

I used to get my hair cur here till my stylist left. I've also had a few pedicures done at the salon.  Overall I was generally happy. However, my happiness soon turned to tears, literally. In September I decided to get a pedicure and gel nails for my sisters wedding.  Christine was doing both my pedicure and gel nails.  My pedicure was rushed.  My toe nail polish was all over, not just on my toe nails where it belongs.  I didn't think too much about the rushed pedicure and didn't notice my toes till I got home (colour was very light).  My gel nails, well best word is disgusting! Amateurish.  I was in tears.. My fingers burned, they were so thick I couldn't pick up anything! They were uneven, crooked, and some corners were so sharp they would have cut my young child.  I asked Christine ton shorten them two times, even gave her an example of length.  She didn't care, suddenly said "ok we're done".  I had to return home bc of childcare issues and left on a flight early the next day for a wedding.  I spent over an hour filing them down and another 100bucks having them fixed in the city I was visiting.  I sent management an emails d just today, a month later received a response.  Their excuse for the delay " my complaint got lost on a messy desk".  WOW! Oh and they got my name wrong.  Free service, no thanks, not a place I want to give my business!

Apparently you can't give 0/5 starts but if I could I would.

The entire experience here was terrible. We brought in our 2012 Ford Edge for some repairs under warranty. We had issues with the sun roof and a few other things so we brought it in thinking this would be an easy fix...not the case. The vehicle sat there for 3 weeks, they kept saying we didn't have it scheduled, this went on for some time. Then they said they had some sort of mini explosion in one of their shops that delayed it for 2 more weeks.  Finally they called and said it was ready, again not the case. The issues was not resolved and to top it all off the doors were all scratched, the inside was atrocious and there was oil leaking through the headliner. Needless to say we took it back that day, and spoke to a manager who did nothing. We ended up leaving it there again, and came back to speak to the main service manager who said that the entire roof needed to be taken off as it was a factory defect, they gave us a loaner vehicle, ordered the part and off we went thinking oh great a guy who knows what he is doing it will finally get fixed...again not the case, this happened twice where they needed to give us a loaner vehicle, because they can't get their stuff together. 

Finally after almost 3 months of not having our own vehicle they called today to let us know it was done. When we picked it up the headliner was still stained with oil and dirtier than before, the roof was actually fixed, but out hood is scratched to he*l. When we commented on it, the manager said I don't see what your seeing, there is nothing there, and the hood we did not do that...to which we replied, here let me outline it for you, and those weren't there when we dropped it off so yes, yes it was you. 

To sum this up, never ever go to Sherwood Ford, terrible customer service, the customer is apparently never right and your vehicle will come back in worse shape than when you took it there. 

I am telling everyone I know to avoid this place like it has a contagious disease, that will turn you into a zombie.

New.  Has a pub feel.  Massive burgers.  Friendly staff.  Darts and slot machines.  Will have live music eventually.  TV screens throughout. Daily drink specials.  They even have a patio with heaters! I'll be back.
Thanks for your service and wonderful food ! Each time we have had lunch or coffee there we feel well looked after! We will recommend you to family and friends! Keep up the good work

I agree with Jenna M. about the terrible receptionists. They are extremely unfriendly, and looked at me like I was stupid when I tried to strike up conversation. 

The hairstylist (Kelsey) was super young, and I was a little nervous initially. She did an incredible job however. She was quite knowledgeable and made the experience very comfortable for me. I got light blond highlights and she recommended me to get some low lights to break up my bleach blond look. I will definitely be re-booking with her!

Oh and since she is a jr. stylist, it wasn't expensive at all. Paid 140 + tip for a full 2 color dye, cut and style.

Lots of TV's (one in every booth and almost every wall) and great food! Pesto shrimp flatbread is the perfect thin crust and the artichoke dip is amazing. It's a great place to be to watch games and hang out

Visited for the Oilers game opener and had a really nice evening.

Didn't have any food so no comment on that.

Did have a couple beer though. They have a really nice lineup of beer on tap and even more in bottles and cans.

The service was spectacular. Buddy and myself sat at the bar and every server/bartender would stop and chat with us a bit while watching the Oilers game.

The atmosphere is very cozy, and typical for a Sherlock Holmes.

Would definitely visit again.

Well I started my last review with "maybe I should wait...." and I should have trusted that instinct.  My interactions with the dealership were stressful and gave me anxiety.  

Claiming the Oil Changes that were worked into the sale was such a hassle, eventually I just stopped.

Trying to get a callback for something as simple as replacing my remote starter fob was impossible.  Twice they said "we'll get that information for you and call you back".  I ended up just going in to talk to them about it.

I decided to take my car back to them for an oil change in November 2021 cause I wanted them to check some other things out.  I'm not even kidding, when I walked in, I stood in the doorway while the dude walked around, no more than 5 feet away from me.  He didn't acknowledge me until my boyfriend walked in behind me.  Then he finally asked what he could do for us.

My car is out of warranty now, so as far as I'm concerned, I never have to go back there.
very friendly vets and nurses!! helped my cat and now he is healthy :)) super helpful and not long wait times

Food here is good. We've dined in and didn't love it. Had Skip the Dishes deliver a few years later and we were happier so within the month we ordered for pick up.  Consensus is we enjoy the variety of dishes but don't care to eat in the restaurant.  The cost climbs quickly. Two people is about $45 plus tip without beverages. Its not great value but enjoyable non the less.

My dealings with First Call have been excellent. From the receptionist to the employee ( Dan ) who diagnosed and fixed the problems with our air conditioning and heater, I found both employees to be courteous, knowledgable and helpful. I will definitely use First Call in the future.

Stopped in here while traveling - really nice place and didn't charge me to borrow a driver and iron so I could use the driving range. Not too busy and easy to get to off the freeway. $9 for large bucket

I'm a big fan of Branches. This is the kind of simplicity I enjoy when eating out. 

The menu is small, and many of the meals are fairly light. I love their quiches, and the selection of desserts! The pizzas made in their wood burning oven seem to be a pretty big hit.

The set up is like a cafe. You find a table, and when you're ready to order you go up to the counter to order. The decor in this cafe is pretty minimalistic, but it overlooks the grounds outside so depending on the time of year, it can be quite stunning.

This is a place that I drive out of my way to go have a nice light lunch by myself. Relaxing!
Great workout & nowhere near as scary as I thought! Quick drive from YEG.  Thanks for the great workout with Yelp Fit Club!

Ordered a dishwasher to be delivered and installed 6 WEEKS ago..  Yes 6 weeks!!!  ( she was told it would take  one week) My wife called today after 2 people had already come out to the house to fit it to install. Lows wanted to charge us for both fitting sessions? WHY? If they didn't get all the information the first time out that isn't our fault. She asked for our money back in full and the employee just agreed. Looks like we are going elsewhere to buy our appliance. Didn't even try and save the sale. Looks like we will go to an appliance store not a box store.

Worst size portions I have seen anywhere ! High prices low food quality had issues with food twice . Such a shame as I have been coming here for many years and since the new owner took over everything has gone to hell. Visit any other location but this one if your going to pay a good price then go somewhere were you get what you pay for because this location is sad and the eggs seemed to have a odd taste almost old like . Anyways don't believe me try this location for your self you will be disappointed ! As a customer of 8 years I see the quality gone down hill.

Two stars only because the food and service is usually okay....usually.
This evening the manager (I assume?) had a fit over the fact I didn't want a fountain pop in a coffee cup to go (I wanted a can to go) and he slammed it into the trash instead of compromising with me as the customer.
I had to bring back my food I ordered to go because the poutine had no cheese, and barely any gravy.??? Poutine!
I get home and was surprised to see no cheese!
Stop cutting corners and give customers what they paid for!!!
Not to mention the portion sizes for amount we pay is way off especially for the quality. 

Also I felt duped when I went to eat with my kids for the "kids eat free day".
Normally when you order a meal from the kids menu it includes their drink. On the kids eat free day they still order their meal from the kids menu but they charge $3 each for their drinks! Just another corner, right?

Via Cibo - Tasty Italian food, less pricey and always busy during lunch hours. 
Order food over the counter and get a table to sit. They will bring food over to you. Had a chat with their manager once. He said they make everything from the scratch.
I have tried their pasta's.Fresh and tasty. Portion was filling. Yet to try their pizza's. Service was fast and staffs were friendly. 
I will go back to try other items on their menu !

What an absolute rip off, $16 for this little crap pizza. Never again will you get my money or anyone else I talk to for that matter. What a disgrace of a pizza shop. Your quality and quantity are both lacking. Might as well just pack it in now, it's only a matter of time anyway with this garbage.

What an amazing place! Not only is the food way beyond any other pasta place in Sherwood Park, but the service is fast and friendly. Every time I've been the owners are there and take the time to check in with you & see how every thing is going. 
Big plus for me, even my kids (7 & 4) LOVE it!!

During the visit to Edmonton I got to join my young cousins on their birthday party trip to Kidz Quarterz. 

Immediate flashbacks to my childhood visits to Jungle Gyms or to the Discovery Zone and the blast we used to have. 

I assumed with the 'germaphobe' attitude the world has these days, that these kind of places would strike fear into the hearts of parents who "bubble-wrap" their poor kids these days and don't let them have fun.

Not so here. A kid's wonderland of stuff to climb on, ball pits to play in, or arcades to partake in.

There is a bit of a seating area for the parents to sit in and be serenaded by the screaming yelling of the tykes. 

The knocks being the over priced food and drink (of course who comes here for that?) and that a lot of the arcade games were broken down and or not even plugged in. 

That said, the little ones enjoyed every second, and it tired them right out, and in the end, that's all that matters, right?

This is a newly opened ultra deluxe wine and beverage store in the Emerald Centre in Sherwood Park (next to the new northside Walmart).  The place is huge and will cater to the well heeled individual looking for a special bottle of wine $$$$ as well as the regular folk, like me, who are just looking for something just a little different, but will not break the bank $$.  In addition to wines there is a large selection of beers and hard liquor.  They even have a booth set up for wine and draft beer tasting (which you can buy and take home).  I was even impressed by the selection of wine corkers.  They also have a gifts section, which adds another dimension to a liquor store.  The gifts include accessories, decorations and wrappings for gift bottles.  Yes you could spend a lot of time browsing in this store!  I'm just waiting for the valet parking to come next ;).
Great and delicious food. Nice ambience and comfy booths. Great service from a very friendly staff. A must eat!!!!

The workout was brutal but after the workout you feel like you achieved something great.  The staff members were awesome and motivated you every step of the way.  The workout definitely pushed you over and above your limits.

I had a furnace diagnosis done.  $250. 

PROS: neat, clean, polite, on time

CONS: expensive, pricing unclear, slow, charged labour rates to order parts and check on warranty, felt very sketchy.  

I hired this company based on reviews from homestars site but later discovered the site is not considered to be very reputable.
