I thought the cost was $109 for the diagnosis but that is the cost to show up.  Then they charge $129 per hour labour.  I wouldn't have hired then if I understood that. However, even though they were unclear, I thought the misunderstanding was reasonable (though disappointing).  The tech took the entire hour to "diagnose" the problem with 20 minutes of that hour spent in his vehicle.....checking on the warranty coverage.  I don't think that this is legitimate part of the labour fee.  Certainly the company I eventually hired didn't charge me labour for those things.   

The second thing about the length of the diagnosis (exactly one hour), is that I knew what the problem was, I knew the error codes and told the tech.  I needed the Hvac certified diagnosis to get the warranty.   It's very simple issue to diagnose....I could appreciate that there are some standard best practices and extras to check to see if there maybe additional problems but it really shouldn't have taken more than 30 minutes at the absolute most (with all the extras)! 

The third thing I was disappointed about was I told the company before coming was that it was a warranty job and I wanted the job under warranty.  I was VERY CLEAR about this.  I mentioned it twice on the phone and once by email.  They told me after they had completed the diagnosis and I had paid the bill that they would offset my bill by the warranty amount but wouldn't do the job for the amount provided under the warranty (100% parts and labour).  

To be fair, I dealt with three other companies and the warranty amount provided is less than market rates in Edmonton.  One company even denied there was a warranty.  It is not popular.   The warranty company warned me  about this and I warned First Call. If they had been up front and honest that they would charge me extra, I would not have hired them and I felt taken advantage of. It seemed dishonest to me to say you will accept warranty work but then charge the client extra. 

Fourth, I was rather aghast when the tech told me I should appreciate their willingness to offset the warranty because some companies will submit warranty claims without telling the homeowners and pocket it as profit.......whaaaaaaaattttt?   

I'm giving this place two stars rather than one because I think they may have been poorly represented by this employee.  Their pricing is still higher than average but they are readily available.  So if you need something done quickly, they can likely accommodate you without having to pay their overtime rate.  I would suggest that you stay with them while working to insure you are charged for genuine labour. I would also make sure you agree up front that "truck time" is not "labour".
I love this place for lunch. I go maybe once or twice a month. The bartender remembers me, my order and the house red wine. Friendly staff and pretty great food. Can't beat it !

Came for the first time and loved it. I've never been to Thailand but ever dish seemed authentic and unique. Sweet, sour and spicy. Hot and fresh. Very very good! Price was fair. I would recommend it to anyone! I'll be back!

Ugh... this place has gone downhill and now that better competitors like Hide n Seek and Treehouse have opened, I don't think we will ever be back.  

Between the 4 kids I brought today (9,8, and 2 5 year olds) not a single kiddo liked the pizza and not a single kiddo ate more than 1/2 a slice.

In years past we've been to birthday parties here and the pizza never tasted this gross.  The crust actually had an old or stale flavor to it (like flour gone bad) and was also slightly burnt.

Got the kiddo's slushes and the blue was some god awful bubblegum or something they didn't like. 

I'm actually sitting here debating on taking the kids to Costco to get $1.99 pizza slices and $2.99 sundaes before taking them home because it was so brutal here.

1/2 the games they tried are their tokens and the play equipment just couldn't keep their interest.  

Adios Kidz Quarterz.

Way too greasy and cheesy for us......
Also expensive for the quality we received.
Not as good as Olive Garden.....and I hate Olive Garden.
Go to pasta pantry instead....
Last week we tried this place. It is just like other burrito place with the exception of some Indian flavours and spices.

We've been coming to Kidz Quarterz for both birthday parties and drop-in play now for about 4 years.

They have a toddler area as well as a super big climbing strutter more suitable for an adventurous toddler up to school aged kiddos.  You can crawl through it as an adult as well but I usually only last a couple rounds on my hands and knees.

There is a large arcade area where you win tickets to trade in for prizes/candy but the trouble for about the past year is a good 25% of the games are broken/out of order at any one time and that's a pretty big bummer for my kiddos.  The tokens are pretty pricey when purchased alone so try to get them in a package price that includes admission and pizza, etc.

You are not allowed to bring in food (aside from birthday cakes) here but they do offer a pretty extensive menu for this sort of place - think pizza, nachos, kraft dinner in a cup, etc.  While it's not gourmet, you certainly won't starve.

The prices range depending on the age of your child and the day of the week (up to age 12) so check out their website for current prices and packages: http://www.kidzquarterz.ca

I really want to give KQ a 4 star but our last several visits found many machines out of service and the water fountain out of service as well.  Overall, the place could use a good scrub from head to toe.

The staff here are pretty awesome and always friendly though the buzzer swinging doors don't seem to actually require them to unlock/lock as my 3 year old was able to get out on his own on both of our last visits.

PS - Remember to bring socks :-)

Country-side is one of my fav golf courses near Edmonton for many reasons: 

- Easy to get too from highway 14, only a 15 min drive from Old Strathcona. 
- Lots of parking
- Trees everywhere - it smells amazing. 
- Beautiful new club house
- grass driving range
- 27 hole course
- Staff is extremely nice
- price is very reasonable (as golf goes) 

Down side they don't have a drink cart person.... it was 30 degrees... water or a beer would be nice. 

Over all Check out this course!

Not fast food but not slow either,  order at the counter they make it and bring it out. Very friendly staff. They have a couple italian beers and a small selection of wines. I had pizza, best in sherwood park. The meatballs in my wife's pasta pomodoro, amazing. Definitely  coming back again.

New restaurant on the east side of Sherwood Park.  The place has already been discovered as it is packed at supper time.  Dark wood throughout and dark interior.  More restaurant than bar but has a small bar counter and a couple TV screens.  Prices very reasonable and menu similar to Original Joes with the option of 2 sides.  Staff were surprisingly friendly.  Decent beer selection.  Beef dip was huge!  Pulled pork was filling.  They have some fish entrees and the flatbread pizzas which seem to be good if you add meat.  No complaints, but is busy so you may have to sit at the bar.

I have been going to UFC Gym Sherwood Park almost every day since it opened. 

Don't let the name fool you - this isn't a place to be punched in the face or slammed on the mats (unless you're into that kind of thing ;)  )  It's a huge clean facility, just five minutes down Baseline. We live in Terrace Heights and it's only a 10 minute drive from Wayne Gretzky. 

First coming in, you're greeted by their front end staff who are happy to explain the classes and facility. You might notice the coaches up at the counter in between classes socializing and having a good time. The staff there are clearly all very good friends and it's not unusual to hear them razzing each other and the regulars like one big family.

Speaking of the coaches, each one of them is qualified and specialized in their classes. 
Mike, the fitness director, is highly knowledgeable in his coaching for strength and conditioning. 
You can ask him anything about dieting and even how to work your workout around injuries and weaknesses. 

Cody and Shawn are actual professional Kickboxing and MMA fighters. They are excellent striking and MMA coaches and host boxing, kickboxing and MMA classes all throughout the week. You can book private classes with them for one on one or small groups-  they help out brand new beginners and it's even very common to see them working one-on-one with recognizable pro fighters. 

On Saturdays, Cody hosts a professional sparring open-mat where pro mma fighters and boxers from all over the city come and spar each other! It's the craziest thing to watch these guys get in the cage and go hard! If you want to see some actual blood, sweat and hard hard work - pop in on a Saturday. It's like a free fight card with some of the city's best. 

Paulo Azambruja is a third degree Brazilian Jiu Jitsu black belt and a great, friendly and traditional BJJ coach. He hosts gi and no gi jiu jitsu for all ages. Check out the kids' class and don't miss the adult classes for the best workout of your life! 

The place is a good size, painted red and black and has motivational quotes and pictures UFC legends all over the walls. 

In the middle of the gym is a huge octagon replica complete with locking fence and high quality mats. Some striking and jiu jitsu classes are often going on in here. 

To the left, a couple dozen full-size heavy bags hang for Fight Fit and kick boxing classes. 
A large mat space for open rolling and movement workouts. 
A length of turf for Daily Ultimate Training classes is home to a big sled for pushing, kettlebells, box jumps, and more! 

There is also a full gym workout area. Stationary bikes, stair climbers, treadmills, elliptical, a squat rack, free weights, and pretty much every kind of exercise equipment you would want to get a good work out in. 

Membership is month to month. You pay the first and last month up front and the fees are SO good at about $80/month for basic. This is GREAT if you decide it's not for you in a couple months and you're not stuck in some year long contract. 

Definitely check the place out. 
It's a fast paced, highly motivational place that you won't feel left alone or lost in.

Massage addict gives you the option of signing up for a 1 year membership to save money on each visit. I signed up in September and have loved my experience. I have been seeing the therapist named Natasha and she is really great.

The waiting room is really open and comfortable, the rooms are quiet and warm. You really can't ask for more out of a massage therapy clinic, it feels more like home than a clinic.

Ok run... ok mountain climbers. ... get those knees up p! Push it! You can do it! I love hearing this from the trainers at UFC Gym!  They WILL push you to your limits and beyond!  There is no slacking off here! 
You came for a workout you got it! Located in Sherwood Park it's very easy to get to and and other location opening up in July in Edmonton north you have options!  

Let me tell you that the equipment is amazing!  They even have an octagon for sparring. They offer various classes at all skill levels from core fitness to boxing to Brazilian Ju Jitsu and so many more classes, you can be sure that you can find anything to suit your interest and the trainers are very knowledgeable. And they encourage ALL skill levels!  So calling all beginners calling all experts call anyone who has ever wanted to step in the octagon check this place out! You will not be disappointed!

Had dinner at state and main for the first time tonight and it was pretty good.
When you come here with kids they do not have high chairs, only booster seats. It made me nervous having my 1 year old in a booster seat at a high booth, but at least it had straps, we just had to keep an eye on her.
Our server was awesome, I felt very taken care of. Thank goodness she mentioned they have a kids menu because they don't have it in writing, she had to tell us about it in person prior to ordering. 
We had the calamari which were probably the best calamari I have ever had. The highlight was the deep fried jalapeños.
The bang bang shrimp were very good but could have been spicier.
For my main I got the fish tacos. I don't know how they managed to do it but the fish tasted micro waved and was spongy and flavourless. I left most of them behind.  The salad that they came with was equally bland. Luckily for me I had filled up on appetizers.
My wife got the beef dip which was very good, so I'm sure we will go back to get the calamari again and try different main courses.

Most of the food was lukewarm or cold, server forgot creamer and never came back, and when she did she served us burnt coffee. At least the service is fairly quick so we could leave fast after having a mediocre meal. The pancakes are always pretty nice though.

Usually come for dinner past the rush. I don't find what other negative reviews too. The food is good. Not stellar but for the lower prices I find it's decent and worth while. Customer service is alright - mostly I find they are overworked and too tired seeming.

This UFC gym is friendly with helpful staff.  I enjoy my time spent training here - they give you a choice of whether you want to do circuit training or boxing (fitness or classes) so there's always a reason to go back.  Good job!

I used these guys for their moving services when me and my wife moved from West edmonton to the Southside.  These guys are awesome. They were punctual and very professional. They were very careful with the moving all of our furniture and made sure not to scuff or scratch any walls while hauling stuff in and out. They moved all of our stuff to our new house really quickly. I shopped around looking for the best price and these guys had very reasonable prices. I would definitely use these guys again in the future.

I had been out shopping for hours and if I was going to make it through to a few more stores I needed to fuel up. So I happened to see the SmashBurger sign across the parking lot. I pulled up peeked inside and decided to give it a try. I was warmly greeted upon entering. After reviewing the menu I decided on the Buffalo Burger with crispy chicken and a side of Smashed Fries. I was given my number and I took a seat. They told me to take a seat and they would bring my food to me as it is cooked upon order. I gazed through the menu a bit more as I waited and read some of the Yelp reviews. I determined next time I would get a milkshake as I saw many go by...and deep fried pickles would be a side to try.  My burger arrived promptly and I was pleased with my order on many levels. First impression on its arrival was to dig in. The chicken must be Smashed before it is battered. The results were a juicy crispy breast if chicken that was bigger then the bun. The burger had drizzles of Franks Red Hot and then crumbled blue cheese on top. The bun was so fresh and a perfect compliment to the burger along with lettuce and tomatoes. The Smash fries were also a hit. You get a generous portion of the shoestring fries. They are tossed in olive oil, rosemary, and garlic. So I already know what I want to try next time...the Truffle Mushroom Swiss with a side of haystack onions and deep fried pickles; and a classic vanilla shake. So yes I liked it so much I can't wait to go back. I asked my server about the restaurant chain itself as I hadn't heard of them. They are a US franchise that is new to Canada with the first stores being only in Alberta. Best place to start with since we are known for our beef. The are two locations in Calgary and one in St. Albert along with the one I ate at in Sherwood Park.

Not only the best Thai food I've ever had, but literally the best food I've had in months!! So flavourful and fresh. Must try the mango salad & coconut rice!! 
Service was also amazing. Attentive, knowledgeable and genuine. Sawaddee is a MUST if you come anywhere from Alberta (or just anywhere)!!!

The waiting room is FREEZING! The rooms were a little warmer but not by much. 

First massage was intro rate $50 and was a good experience with Petyr. He genuinely cared and addressed the shoulder issue and even texted to follow up a few days later. Second massage was with Sheyna, and was meh at best - really didn't address the issues, and cost $90 without joining their membership.  I just can't commit to one massage a month.

May go once in a while if I can book in with Petyr but if I can't get in with him, at that price I'll save a bit of money and go elsewhere.

The drive out to Sherwood Park is a bit of a long one, but if it's for Smashburger, I'm usually pretty pumped to get in the car and go. I've given them several tries just for consistency's sake and I have to admit - I've had the same burger several times now....because it's just SO good. I always get the mushroom truffle burger - yummy and juicy with a perfect truffle flavor (without it being overwhelming) on the most BEAUTIFUL egg bun. I love it!!!

The sides at Smashburger are pretty spectacular, too. My favorite are the SmashFries, which are just their thin matchstick fries in rosemary and garlic (and maybe parmesan, but I can't remember). They are just SO GOOD and simple, but flavorful and lovely. I've also given the Veggie Frites a shot too, and while they were a good idea, they were disappointingly soggy. Not sure if that's just the nature of things or if we just got a bad batch (but I will say that they still got eaten up!) My boyfriend has been curious about the poutine, but because they feature such thin, crispy (yummy) fries, I've always wondered if the fries would be overwhelmed by the gravy/cheese. Either way, I'm happy with the plain SmashFries...sooo good.

I have noticed each time at Smashburger that the customer service is exceptional - the staff are always polite, quick and very approachable and friendly. Someone always comes by our table (sometimes several times) just to check up on us and make sure we are happy with our meal (even though it is definitely a counter restaurant - so this kind of service isn't even truly necessary, but always appreciated). The restaurant has always been spic and span whenever we've come, and the wait is never too long.

The hype behind Smash Burger is that they "smash" their burgers on a buttered grill for a flavorful experience. I will say that the meat of the burger is never what truly jumps out at me, but maybe that's just because the truffle sauce is just that damn good :)

I just can't say enough about this place. Me and the fiance were looking into wine and we had nooo clue what we were looking for. Then we were asked if we were finding everything that we were looking for. We answered back no aren't too sure. We were looking to get into drinking exploring the world of wine. She told us that she is not an expert in wines but she is gunna go look for one the people that are. We were introduced to one of the employees (I can't remember his name.) he gave us a HUGE education trip. Which felt soo nice we walked out feeling a lot more confident and not so over whelmed with the amounts of wine that they had there. I am super excited to say the experience there is well worth going back for. I am excited to going back and getting a couple "Growlers" for Christmas presents that's a GREAT idea. They definitely take care of their customers.  

Side note: I can't put a price range on this one because the prices range from 10$ to $500. (I think that was the most expensive wine I saw in there)

It's interesting that there are no reviews here in over 2 years... very strange...

I love this place.  They have almost everything you can think of - thought I agree with Kaylee that they could use a better selection of mix to make this more of a one stop shop!

Aside from that though, this place is awesome.  I can easily get lost in here for way too long while I look at everything on the shelves.

Prices may not be the best in the area, but watch out for their sales.  You can get amazing stuff at a pretty big discount when they have too much of something!
Great food, great service, very quick and friendly! 2nd time being here, always forget about it as its kinda out of the way. Same quality as fat burger, but less coma. Great value for your money!

Our office has brought in Wow Factor cakes several times and everyone here agrees that it's the best cake they've ever tasted - no matter which one we order. 

It's moist, it's dense and it tastes so incredibly fresh.  So today I decided that I'm ordering all my family's future birthday cakes from these guys.  I phoned them up and they were super helpful.  They mostly sell their cakes commercially, however they have a retail outlet that is open from 9 - 5 pm for anyone to purchase from.

I'm not exaggerating when I say this WILL be the best cake you've ever tasted.

Need to bump it up a notch.   Nice urban feel with tv screens In the lounge.  But all tvs are all on the same channel cause staff are too lazy to put multiple feeds.   Friendly staff.  Nice place for drinks.  Booths.  Beverage specials.  But the lasagna was just a bunch of noodles and the fish tacos was just a bunch of shredded head lettuce.  Food is better at Browns Social House or Hudsons.  Still a good place to socialize.

Also stoked that this is so close to home. I don't use this place enough. It's not too busy during the day and when it is busy the noise level is still moderate. 

Great place to meet people or have a business meeting.

It's Denny's. I never really thought much of it. My friend's told me some horror stories since as he's employed here though and they're pretty disgusting which I'm here to tell you thankfully

#1: The cooks
Frequently go to the bathroom and don't wash their hands
Sneeze on/near the food and don't throw it away
Get orders wrong constantly
Use dirty plates intentionally if there aren't enough clean ones
Get hair into the food
They time the food wrong so half of it is cold and the other half is burnt in an attempt to get the customer their food as orderly and quick as possible
Don't know how to cook
Have no experience in general
Keep bacon in what they call a bacon drawer which is essentially a heating pad thing so the food stays warm when they cook the other half to reduce work load, but some genius decided to cook all the bacon at 6 in the morning and keep it in the dreaded bacon drawer; the head office guy came and said it was unsanitary to do this and they would need to change it if they wanted to stay open
Denny's agreed and all but quickly reverted as soon as he left

#2: Management
People leave every few months in massive droves leaving the remaining few strained and deliver poor quality food (not that it wouldn't suck if they were there anyways)
When this happened one time Denny's had 3 people working there that day and one of the waiters was forced to cook the food despite no cooking experience whatsoever
The bathroom is disgusting as they refuse to clean that pit of despair
The employees aren't allowed breaks unless they have literally 0 customers (which is illegal by the way)
They force the employees to pay for their work clothes (also illegal)
Pay their waitresses less than minimum wage if they wish to receive tips (another Grade A douchebag move)
The general manager sucks and takes tips that aren't theirs
The waiters and waitresses seem to not really give a shit about helping the customers which is understandable in their situation working with people half of whom want to work and the other half not
Have allowed minors to serve alcohol

#3: Cleanliness
The food that is dropped on the floor is put right back on the plate
They passed the health inspector at least but that says more about the quality of inspection rather than Denny's
Tables are usually clean or look clean at the very most
As well as all the previous mentions of sneezing and bacon drawer antics this business is very disgusting

#4: Food
The last time I went and last time I will go; I was graced by the most bland inedible mediocre disappointing food I've ever been delighted in eating
The chocolate chip pancakes didn't have chocolate no no, just black burnt specks I assure you
The bacon which I was aware of at the time being in the drawer was soggy and tough
They ran out of butter some how so we had to make do with no butter and unevenly cooked toast
The drinks were so watered down it tasted like drinking sugar water
A very bad experience overall

Conclusion: spend your money on something that tastes good and won't give you food poisoning and diabetes
Don't make the excuse of going here because your drunk or no other place is open ANOTHER PLACE IS ALWAYS OPEN

We had a good experience. Staff was friendly, our burgers were really good, and the shoestring fries were yummy too!  

Thanks

This is your typical Dennys. The only reason that I are here was because it is difficult to find a breakfast place in Edmonton that accepts AMEX cards.  I had an omelette with a side of sausage.  The omelette was their supreme omelette which is basically a sausage and bacon omelette with cheddar cheese.  

The bottom line is it was ok but not great.   I will eat here again because they accept AMEX.

Waitresses are pleasant.  Modern surroundings with a couple of TV screens.   Fish tacos were good and salmon burger was good.  Pasta hit the spot too.  But, the men's washroom is poorly designed.  The urinal is in front of the toilet so when you sit you are facing the urinal.  To make matters worse you have to step on the urine under the urinal in order to access the toilet.  Then the soap dispenser is so small and unfortunately for me it was empty.  So I go back to my table with dirty hands and sticky feet!  Fail! Fish tacos were good though.

I came here for lunch with my sisters and mom and having never heard of this restaurant was shocked at how jam packed it was. The only table left was on the patio which was totally ok with me because it was beautiful! What a genius idea to have a restaurant in a greenhouse! Everywhere you look there are flowers and greenery and it's just lovely. A perfect atmosphere for a lunch date. 
Our server was very friendly but you could tell she was a bit overwhelmed with the lunch rush. I ordered the falafel lettuce wraps and oh my goodness were those ever good! They came with these sweet pickled onions and a really tasty drizzle. I'd definitely get them again! My one sister had the Caesar salad with chicken and she very much enjoyed it and my other sister had the scallops. They were also good but very heavy in sauce/cream/cheese so if you're expecting them to be seafood light - you'll be surprised. My mom had a panini and salad and she said it hit the spot nicely. 
To drink we all enjoyed their freshly brewed coffee and lemon infused water. 
My ONLY complaint, and reason for only 4 stars, was that the food did take about 35-40 minutes to come out. It was like I said really busy so I wasn't expecting it to be super quick and I really only noticed it more because I only had an hour before I needed to leave. I've noticed in other reviews that too was the main complaint and I get that. Id suggest going when you're not in a rush or perhaps earlier or later in the afternoon. We were there at 12 and I'm pretty sure that's peak time. 
I definitely will return for lunch when I have a bit more time, it was so nice just enjoying the patio and scenery on a nice spring day.

A bunch of girlfriends were getting together and we wanted to try something new. 

We found this Resturant excellent. Not overly noisy as we wanted to be able to chat and not yell at each other. The booths were wide and could comfortably fit 6 people. 

The food was good. I personally had a Steak sandwich with jalapeño mash which was to die for. Which I eat my steak rare and was not over cooked at all!!! 

Service was fast and friendly. Always on top of our drinks and getting lemon water. The waitress didn't impose or ask millions of questions either. 

Great service and money spent well. Will definitely come back again

I've had nothing but amazing experiences here with my hedgehog. The vet was knowledgeable, I can get supplies there, so convenient. It's worth the drive!! I can even call and ask for advice, no problem. Will come here forever!

Not my idea but revisited this location! 
Happy to say the three of us were very happy. Food was hot and tasty and brought in a timely manner. Coffee pot quickly refilled without asking. Service very friendly and efficient even though restaurant was busy with Sunday lunch rush. 
Thank you for improving!!

This is now my second visit to park veterinary and the staff is so welcoming and pleasant . First visit was for my snake and turtle. The staff was so compassionate and knowledgeable, they were able to answer the million questions i had about my animals  and we're very patient with teaching me how to administer the needles.
With my second visit i was being a concerned mom about my turtle thinking his cracked shell had gotten worse, they did a full check up and confirmed that nothing was wrong and didn't even charge me for the check up.

Selection is pretty mind boggling what wasn't was being asked 8 times if I needed help. Also a few times they were extremely biased based on my look on different days (lazy or professional) I would be hounded for my I.d. . I get it I'm 2nd young looking but I don't need to be asked by all of your floor staff for my I.d. when they do it at the checkout. I do like the consistency at the checkout for an id though. Also they will order in any thing you don't fine but fat chance of that happening ahahaha.

Went to via cibo for their soft opening. The experience was well executed.  They were offering a limited menu of food and the staff were all in training so I hope to go back and get the full experience.  That being said, I really enjoyed the pasta bowl that I got and my wife's sandwich was amazing as well. The Italian soda my meal came with wasn't very good, but I am usually just a water person so it may have been amazing Italian soda that was lost on me.... so don't take my word for it.
The ordering process is done at the counter and then you sit down and wait for your food. This is a process that speeds things up a bit, but I prefer wait service.
Overall a good experience that will bring me back.

If you have tried one Starbucks it can definitely seem like you have tried them all but in reviewing this one I looked at the fact that of the three in the mall here in Sherwood Park (yes you are reading that right....there is infact three in this small mall) this location is the standout.

For one if you work in the mall or somewhere nearby it is very easy to get in and out of this one quickly. All three times that I went last week around 8:30 there was nobody ahead of me in line and the only thing I really had a wait for was for the barista to put out the containers of milk and cream as she had not finished setting up for the day yet.

Secondly if you need a pastry with your morning java fix they seem to have the best selection here. I had tried the Safeway Starbucks as well last week and by the time I got there at 8:30 about half of the pastry case had already been cleared out. I don't think alot of people associate Starbucks with Target yet in their mind like how many do with Safeway and Starbucks.

So to sum it all up while there was nothing stand out about this particular Starbucks location when it comes to the franchise as a whole when it comes to convenience and selection of product for those in the area it really can't be beat.

It is a beautiful location. The staff is very friendly and it is very clean.  The overall experience is like a famoso meets ikea but with much more underwhelming food. Based on the sandwich and pasta dishes we chose we would not come again.

Smashburger has one hell of a burger. Truffle-mushroom-swiss - the one everyone is raving about - lives up to the hype. From the incredibly soft and buttery bun, to the juicy burger & savory toppings, it truly jumped outside of my expectations for the very affordable price range. 

The other thing I like: the service is really good. It's a very "happy place".  I would not hesitate from bringing friends and family here... I don't know if I'll ever be able to try anything other than that burger. It's too good!!!

Good authentic Thai food. I had the chicken pad sew ew and enjoyed it. I did take away so I didn't experience the restaurant entirely but the woman who helped me with my order was extremely friendly. I would go back.

I have been here a few times and have been so impressed with the fresh, wonderful flavors.  Although it is a little on the pricey side, the ingredients are fresh and I find the entrees large enough to share.  The large soups are a smaller portion, but my hubby, father-in-law, and I were able to divy up the tom kha gai into 3 small bowls.  The restaurant is very clean and staff are always welcoming and polite.  We will definitely be back!  I highly recommend their deep fried prawns as an appetizer.  Soooo crispy and delicious!

Ah, the good 'ol Park. I never come out to this neck of the woods but figured I'd make the most of it and go for dinner while I was in the area. 

We came on a Friday night for an early 6:00pm dinner. People must eat early because it was a full house when we arrived but completely dead by the time we left. The inside is brightly fuschia and cheery with Thai music videos playing in the background.

Service was very friendly. The family that runs it were great and checked on us several times. It was also nice that they accommodate most of their dishes for our vegetarian eater.

- Thai iced tea ($3.50) - hit the spot and wasn't too sweet. Less ice would have been nice.
- 2x Coconut rice ($3.00) - it's not listed on the menu but we ordered two bowls.
- Paw pia sod ($5.00) - we got these vegetarian; a little too rabbit like for me but L enjoyed.
- Mango salad ($11.00) - I wish there was some fire to their mango salad but it was still satisfyingly light and refreshing.
- Tom yum goong ($12.00 large) - subbed in tofu for the prawns. We weren't sure if this was a large size or not but apparently it was. It's a small portion and again, lacked any real spice. 
- Pineapple fried rice ($16.00) - best dish of the night! Their pineapple fried rice was fantastic. Addictive, flavourful, I kept going back for more.
- Gaeng keow wan ($14.00) - the green curry was good but flavours tasted dumbed down.
- Pad kee mao ($15.00) - drunken noodles were solid.
- Maw kaeng ($6.00) - this was actually really good. Light, moist, just so small for $6.00.
- Bua loy ($6.00) - wasn't too sweet; basically, like a rice pudding. It didn't entice my taste buds but the other two enjoyed it.

I was a bit disappointed as I was told they cooked their dishes spicy. I guess if you want that, make sure you tell them because the default level is non-existent. Never less, the meal was still enjoyable but keep in mind portion sizes are small. 3.5 stars.

Service distant, tip requested before getting food,  and the food ranges between above-average and bland and terribly under seasoned and generic. Very hit and miss. They need to lower prices desperately.

Food was great, a little pricey and service was fantastic. Could not give them a higher rating as they don't take reservations, even for larger groups and expect larger groups to wait 30-60 min until enough tables are "cleared"

Went here for a Yelp event and got to try out their fitness based workout. It was a sweaty good time.
The biggest dissapointment was it didn't feel like a UFC workout, more like a normal boot camp.
I was told they have different technical classes, but this was not one of them.

A clean, well organized and not stinky gym also added to the pleasant atmosphere.

Worth checking out!

Every time we go to Sherwood Park, we always make a stop to Smashburger.

The ownership is a set of great people.

The prices are more than reasonable, the staff is all very knowledgeable, and most importantly, the food is out of this world!

There are about 7 or 8 burgers and some chicken options as well as great salads. I normally get the large sized bacon cheeseburger which is colossal in size and flavour! The smashfries are very unique and very tasty!

The egg bun, hand made patties and fresh ingredients just make this place so addicting! 

They also have milkshakes and make a great poutine.

The only thing that needs to be done is for them to open a location in the southwest ;). The St Albert location is equally as fabulous!

This is such a great restaurant to come for lunch or dinner. I stopped in for lunch one day and got the chicken pesto panini, the flavours were absolutely divine! I loved the takeout box too. The staff were super friendly, I really hope this restaurant does well in Sherwood Park.

Although the restaurant is a bit far for those living in downtown Edmonton, it's well worth the drive! Their burgers are juicy and flavorful, their condiments are made in house and their truffle mayo is especially tasty, and their fries are perfectly crispy and well seasoned. I thoroughly enjoyed the food and look forward to a return visit.

Update Feb 2, 2013

They did come by today and both men where very polite and professional. They did a great job and were in and out fairly quick because we have a small bungalow. Other then the problem with their fleet I have to say that is understandable and I would use them again. 

Previous Comment:
This company had a Groupon in the fall for duct cleaning. We bought it and booked for October. They left us a voice mail to cancel. We left a message to rebook and asked if they would honor the Groupon we didn't hear from them for a week. So we contacted Groupon for a refund and then First Call called us back and booked for December. Well two days before we were scheduled they called us to reschedule for February. I would not recommend them at all. I am not sure if they are trying to avoid us because of the Groupon or if they really are that bad to deal with either way it is no good. Maybe in the summer we'll get our ducts cleaned but for now we will have to wait.

We used the call in program to arrange for seating as we had a special request and we knew it would be busy for Mothers Day. The manager and waitress were accommodating and so helpful. The food was really good  I would recommend this IHOP to everyone! Don't let a few bad reviews spoil it. It was fantastic!

What a amazing gym! We went there for the fit club trial to get a taste of what the gym has to offer and I can guarantee that if u want a session that shows results, the is the place to go. 

We started with a bunch of cardio, then did core strengthening and circuit. There was a lot of variety and they made sure to change things up all the time which made the hour fly by. 

At the end of the hour session we were all exhausted, but felt amazing knowing how hard we had worked. I would go here again and definitely recommend to other. The gym is new, nice equipment and a variety of classes. Great experience!

Kinda disappointed this is the last remaining second cup in shpk. Love their coffee atmosphere and wifi connection. 

This place needs to be bigger though. Or they need to reopen a second location.

I stop by this Second Cup every Tuesday for Latte Tuesday.  Aside from the location inside Millenium Place, I believe this is the only Second Cup left in Sherwood Park.  Which makes me pretty sad. But it's close enough to work that it's not that bad.

The customer service here is interesting.  The men who work here seem to be over-the-top friendly and outgoing and the women all seem to be a little more reserved and almost a little grumpy sometimes.  Maybe it's just happened that way when I go in.  Either way though, it doesn't change the quality of the latte.  I'm addicted to the Matcha Green Tea latte.. so that's what I usually get.

What makes me sad is that even during lunch time on Latte Tuesday, it's really not that busy here.  It's not empty by any means... but not hopin'.... especially in comparaison to the 8 or so Starbucks in The Park.
The food is absolutely delcious. Alot of healthy choices. Great place to eat. I have also orfered take out many times from here and it was great.

Nasty doughy battered fish and chips. No one cares. Half cooked fries.
Tasteless chicken club.
Never going back

A brand new place. A really nice place for lunch - no dinner served here. Licensed - wine and beer. 

Salads, sandwiches, wood fired pizza are the mains. Excellent looking desserts. 

Best patio in Sherwood park.

Ordered take out for myself and some co-workers.  Called my order in and it was ready at the time requested for pickup.
The interior is really nice - modern and clean.  The staff was EXTREMELY friendly and helpful.
I do find it pricey for what you get.  We all ordered the Pollo Alla Griglia Panino.  For $13 all you get is the sandwich.  It was tasty, but a little dry.  Could have more filling - a lot of bread.

I'd love to give this place a 4 star just based on the interior and how awesome the staff was, but the sandwich was underwhelming.  

I would like to come back and try their pasta/pizza to see if I can up the rating to a 4.

I love Starbucks! Especially their Café Lattes, they are to die for. Back when I was in University a year and some months ago, I would buy it every morning before class and it perks me right up. And I'm no longer grumpy. Without coffee I'm cranky. Now that I don't have any part time job for awhile, I had to cut down my Starbucks purchases of coffee.

This is no longer our go to breakfast place. Every time we go here the service is slow, but there is plenty of standing around and talking loudly between the employees. I have had to repeat requests multiple times to a server, and it's annoying to have to flag them down each time because they don't come around to check on things.

This is a complaint more so for Denny's than this location, but it's frustrating to ask for a substitution for one of the items in the meal. They don't let you pay a few bucks more to substitute your home fries for bacon. Instead they make you stick with the meal including the home fries and the bacon. Well if my meal already includes toast and pancakes, do I really need the home fries too? I am willing to pay a little more it that is what it takes, but don't force me to waste food.

New in Sherwood Park.  Good food but weird ordering system.  The pastas were quite good and you could see the chicken and shrimp and spinach and their wraps and soup are tasty.  Prices around $14 to $18.  You enter and line up and look at a menu on the wall while people wait behind you, pressure.  You order then they give you a number.  Then you walk further and line up again to order your beverage and pay.  Then you sit down and they bring the food and beverage to you.  I guess you aren't supposed to tip... I don't know.  Staff were pleasant.  Ordering system is annoying but food is good.  So squeezes out 4 stars.

Found the prices I paid for two burgers with fries and a shake to be a bit expensive, came to over $20 
The sauce used on my burger, in my opinion, did not fit well with the overall taste/style of the burger. The way the onions on it were cooked did not taste as good as word of mouth had led me to believe.
Overall is a good place for customer service.
I love the fact that you can book online. I had 5 different therapist and don't have any complaints. They always accommodated my requests for more/less pressure.

We have ordered from here a couple of times now and have not been disappointed.
Red and green curries with your choice of protein, pad thai. ... delicious and very reasonably priced. 

Will definitely be going back, and soon.
Friendly service and quick delivery of plates. I tried the masaman with beef and coconut rice. Tasty and lots of flavor, but not spicy enough. I'll order it a little hotter next time.

After a long day of gardening I really needed some carbs. So we went to Via Cibo not knowing what to expect but the food looked good. The prices are reasonable. Dinner for two plus and appetizer, wine and an Italian soda for under $50. 

The carbonera was made well but not perfect. The Gorgonzola gnocchi was delicious. The food came with ciabatta bread as well. I asked for pepper flakes to liven up the carbonara and the whole thing *would* have been rounded off nicely with a few grinds of black pepper. 

The bruschetta had a good flavour but it was a mess. Three roasted crostinis and tomatoes but then so much cheese was dumped on top and balsamic reduction that it ruined the appetizer. 

The space was comfortable and the servers were friendly. 

The food was quick and reasonably priced so it's firmly in the "good" category.
Wow. Great food! Such an unexpected treat. The Chicken Portobello was AMAZING! And a coffee Toffee gelato was the perfect end to the meal. Highly recommended!

I've been to this restaurant twice in the last week and have left disappointed both times. The ordering system is confusing- as per some of the comments from a year ago.  They want you to order at the first counter but there was no one there to take our orders both times.  The food is mediocre at best. I had chicken with portobello and my husband had chicken parmigiana. Chicken was very over cooked. Husband wanted red wine and they only had chianti left... glasses were dirty. Kids meal is a good deal but flavour is lacking. Now that I have used up my groupon, I will definitely not be dining here.

Very friendly service, but when the food arrived, nothing was edible. I don't mean the hyperbole, but my gnocchi was oversauced and did not taste very good. The gnocchi was overcooked and mushy. The meatballs tasted like they were frozen, and they were very dry with a sauce that seem to come from a can. After not finishing my meal (hardly eating), The friendly waitstaff removed the plates and asked what was wrong with it.  I quietly mentioned that I didn't enjoy it, and the waiter told me that he was surprised, as it's one of his favorite dishes on the menu.  i've hidden gnocchi many times before, and I am an above average home cook, and I must say that I did not enjoy my meal at all. Will not be back.

Stopped in at 7:45 pm, we were the third occupied table. Pretty sure owner was our server, he was efficient but very quiet (tired?). Beverages and food came quickly.  We ordered two versions of eggs Bennie. Unfortunately our food was mediocre; lukewarm and cool! Ham and turkey under our eggs was not warmed/grilled, hash browns barely cooked. As the restaurant was literally empty I would expect piping hot, or at least warm food. We were very disappointed!

We just moved to Edmonton from Calgary a few months ago and still checking out the food scene here. Thank-goodness we found this Smashburger location in Sherwood Park. Like in Calgary, Smashburger menu items are yummy and reasonably priced... so much better than Soda Jerks. I always get the spicy baja burger with a few extra toppings. Their milkshakes are quite good, Saskatoon berry and the chocolate Oreos are my fave!

I used to love coming here back when the old owners worked there. But, sadly, I am not impressed. The food is pricey for a small portion. The lobby is so dirty, as are the washrooms. Don't get me started on the glasses. The new owners messed with everything that was once good at this restaurant. I wouldn't recommend going here, save your money!

The food selection is exactly what you'd expect from a chain breakfast diner, so I won't say anything more about the menu. We've found the eggs always warm and the potatoes piping hot. I order my toast dry because I find most people add too much margarine for my tastes, but it's never over-toasted. We frequently get undercooked pancake puppies, but the staff is great about making us a fresh batch. The coffee is great even with the recent change in beans.

Cleanliness is wanting at most restaurants and breakfast joints frequently have syrup from sticky child-sized finger all over the seats. Again, the staff here is always cheerful about wiping any problem areas or reseating us.

To be honest, the staff is why we return every week. Sandy is standout fantastic, but everyone is friendly and greets us with smiles. The coffee pours freely and the food arrives promptly and fresh off the grill.

Disgusted with our experience. There were two other people in the restaurant on a Thursday night at 1130pm. The server had finally sat us after a few minutes of standing. Once we finally ordered after waiting 10-15 minutes and got our food our server seemed to have disappeared or was too busying gossiping with another person (who turned out to be the manager! - Kat).

After another 10 minutes had gone by half way done our meals with no quality check and endless attempts to make eye contact I interrupted the pairs conversion to ask for refills for my table to which the server tried to claim she was just about to check in with us.. yah, ok! (The other table had just left)

Finished, we sat at our table another 5 minutes with no plates cleared while the server again continued to talk casualties to the manager. When the waiter finally made time to attend to clearing the plates, not asking if we were done, just grabbed and began to walk away, no offers of refills/desert (which were needed and wanted !) we asked for the manager. . surprised to find the woman who had listened to us have to call out for our own drinks walk towards our table. 

Once at our table while explaining how disappointing the experience was the manager couldn't have been less interested. Needless to say Kat was extremely disrespectful and wouldn't apologize for her poor excuse of a waiters down fall. She offered to "look at the bill" and didn't insist on the discount or even an apology for that matter! 

The waiter coming to give us our bills tried to say she had had a long day. . Taking to a table of servers!!!! We all know about long days and haven't neglected our customers with such distaste ever! Not to mention we were ignored because she was too busy talking about boys to the manager! 
Absolutely disgusted with this half assed excuse of a manager and the way she DIDN'T deal with our complaint and just over all made us feel like we were an inconvenience.

The food was absolutely amazing though. So be sure to tip at least 5.5% so it goes to the kitchen!! :)

Branches opened 3 weeks ago in Greenlands Garden centre, Sherwood Park, just off the Yellowhead.

It is a bright and airy restaurant with indoor and outdoor patios along with its main dining room. The setting is lovely! Surrounded by waterfalls and beautiful plants. A nice escape.

I was surprised by the modern menu with interesting fare.

They offer a variety of European-style sandwiches and panninis, lovely salads, wood-fired pizzas, etc. mostly light fare.

A nice choice of desserts: pies, squares, scones, Tiramisu, etc. 

The menu has vegan, vegetarian and gluten free options. All are marked.

Coffees, wide selection of loose-leaf teas, granitas, Italian sodas, wine and beer are also available.

I was beyond pleased with my choice of a beautifully presented Mediterranean Napoleon salad. It was a layered delight of zucchini, roasted peppers and light and cream Feta. Served with a delicate ring of phylo pastry. (See photo)

My companions shared a wood fired pizza. They asked for fresh tomatoes instead of tomato sauce. That was no problem at all, for extra charge. They enjoyed it very much.

For dessert I tried the brownie. It was very chewy and too rich for my taste. Two thin brownie layers sandwiching a thick chocolate icing and topped with a cream cheese icing.

The next visit, I tried their daily scone which that day was a strawberry rhubarb scone. Light and fluffy! Highly recommend it.

There are daily specials so be sure to ask.

You place your order at the counter and they bring your food to the table.

I really liked this place, will certainly return again and again.

The service was fast and friendly and the vegetables were very fresh but I expected a lot more from a place called "Smash Burger". 

The actual beef patties were thin and bland and the poutine was pretty much a spoonful of gravy with a few cheese curds. When we asked for more gravy for the poutine they wanted a dollar for a ketchup cup of it. I have an issue with paying a dollar for something I feel should have come with a meal already.

All in all the food and service were both decent but I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here again.

Pleasantly surprised!!

I have to admit, I had extremely low expectations going in here. I'm a huge Fatburger fan, so it's hard to find a burger joint that can compete. I made sure to order a burger that I would not typically order from Fatburger so I went with the Avocado Club burger. I loved the fact that it came on a multi-grain bun. The bun, as well as all the toppings were nice and fresh. The burger was full of flavor and I'm happy to say that I didn't once make a comparison to any other burger. I actually really enjoyed it.  

The variety of buns, toppings, sides and sauces is impressive. I have to say the star of the show for me was the smash fries! They're shoe string fries that are tossed in Italian olive oil, rosemary & garlic! ummmm... YES PLEASE! :D  I can't think of any other burger place that offers anything like it. But if you're not a fan of those, they also have french fries, sweet potato fries, haystack onions, spicy buffalo fries, fried pickles, veggie frites and garden salad. I know, right??? Options galore! 

I can't say this has replaced Fatburger for the #1 spot but I will say I look forward to trying out more Smashburger ;)

Gorgeous patio in the garden!! A must for summertime. The menu is small but varied. We chose to share a couple plates . The peaches wrapped in prosciutto were divine. Would definately go back just for another order of those. Caesar salad was grilled which gave a nice charred flavour and the dressing tasted house made. Finished off with the butter chicken pizza which again was flawless. Nothing bad to say here. The service was friendly and attentive. Will definately be back.

I'm revising my review and adding a star since we had to bring one of our hedgehogs here to be put to sleep.

Dr. Bousquet was attentive and very comforting to us as we dealt with a difficult decision, and we can't thank her and the rest of the staff enough for their compassion.

Suffice to say, I was already very impressed with Park Vet, and now really can't recommend it enough to small animal and exotic owners in the Edmonton area.
The things that are good are great. Portions are small. Worth getting two items if you are hungry or if you think you ll be disappointed with one of your choices. All sandwiches are good

Need to bump it up a notch.   Nice urban feel with tv screens In the lounge.  But all tvs are on the same channels.  Friendly staff.  Nice place for drinks.  Booths.  Daily Beverage specials are nice!.  But the lasagna was just a bunch of noodles and the fish tacos was just a bunch of shredded head lettuce.  Food is  better elsewhere.  Still a good place to socialize.

Went here for the first time today - I got a burrito bowl and it was SO good! I got it with mole chicken and it was really flavourful, didn't need to add extra dressing though the bowl. My go tos are usually chipotle (when somewhere with one) or burrito Libre but I think I have a new favorite. It's similar concept - subway style line where you pick which meat and if you want a burrito, bowl, salad, taco etc. My only criticism is I got queso to go with a side of chips and it tasted like melted cheese whiz. I was expecting some spice or seasoning. Either way I will definitely be returning!

This location unfortunately needs a manager to address the service issues at it's roots.  Three times now my order has come out improperly and they write the order down for pete sakes.  Now I do not like to complain too much but as a previous Restaurant owner operator service DOES mean something.

Food:  Eggs are consistently cooked and that is good but the red skin potatoes are almost 95% of the time soggy.  I am a brekkie person and enjoy a coffee with my meal as well.  However once I got my cup I was not asked once for a refill on my recent visit and actually went up and got it myself.  

Service:  No check on my food as originally the wrong hashbrowns came out with the meal.  Now if this was my first visit all would be somewhat forgiven as I could chalk it up to a poor server who has become complacent.  She was nice for the once time I saw her to take my order and get my coffee but never saw her again until time to get the bill.  Almost an identical experience my last visit here as well.

Three times poor service with no attention to how things were as if they were scared to ask lol.  

When the time to pay the bill came I went up to the front  to pay but the two hostesses felt it far more important to calculate their earnings and must have had to make me wait whilst they figured it out.  

Bottom line is we all like the fast Denny's fix which has a good price and while greasy and kinda low brow it fills the needed void for some reason at times.  I won't be back here but will still take in gateway and 36 ave on occasion.

I do hope they can address the little things that add up to a big thing and address loafing around by some servers not all of them that I saw.

I was lucky enough to receive one of these fruity bad boys. Well, not me, actually, my roommate, but how much fruit can one person eat, am I right? These things are huge! That means you either need to have a team working to devour it, or you really, really need to love fruit. (Don't worry, the chocolate strawberries were no problem for this girl.)

This "bouquet" was beautifully arranged, just like a typical flowers bouquet. The fruit is all attached on sticks to make it all stand upright. I was really impressed with the presentation and the freshness of the fruit. Next time I need to say "thank you," I think I'll order one of these!

Awesome lunch!  Very fresh ingredients.  Had the Mediterranean pizza cooked in big good fired pizza oven, egg salad sandwich on a amazing whole wheat croissant with to die for potato salad ( lots of dill), excellent sweet potato soup-can't wait to try the other menus items.  Part of Greenland Greenhouse-make sure you stop by!

I came during a weekday morning and was seated quickly which is almost where the good experience stopped. The waitress came quickly after I told the guy who was getting my drink I was ready to order. My food arrived lukewarm at best; the toast was cold, the bacon was cold and undercooked, and pancakes barely had enough heat to melt the butter. I had to flag the server down to get a refill and then waited an unreasonably long time for an almost empty restaurant. The server then proceeded to walk past my table several times and stared at my empty plate pushed away from myself and kept walking. I had to flag her down to get the bill. During my entire breakfast not once did she stop over to check how I was doing or how my food was. 
The pancakes were pretty decent (would've been better hot).

A month ago my 12 year old Bichon Shihtzu had a stroke at home. I had only been to this Vet clinic a few times and had felt they were very professional and took great care of my dog.On the day he had a stroke I quickly called the Clinic to tell them I was on my way with Molson as something was wrong with him. The Reception said that my Vet was busy but she would get someone to look at him. The moment I walked in the door my dog was seen by Dr. Michelle Meckelborg. She was very compassionate in giving us the bad news that there was nothing they could do for him. She told us they could maybe do some tests but in the end it would cost alot of money and we still may have to euthanized him because of the severity of the stroke.At that point I thought here is an honest person.She could have racked up a big bill for us. I also called her back a few days later just to talk about his condition again and she was so caring. Also Dr.Rodriguez who was our Vet was very caring and compassionate. We knew our Molson was in good care. The only thing that didn't happen as other people had told me and I also see on these reviews is I didn't received a letter from the clinic expressing their sympathys and compassion. But maybe that is something they don't do anymore. I did receive a card from my old Vet clinic which surprised me. All and all I would recommend this Vet Clinic to anyone looking for a good one.

Fairly new restaurant but looking a little  ragged. Men's Bathroom could use a good scrub, women's was spotless according to my companion.. 

Friendly server. The vegetable shrimp wraps were excellent . Goong Kratlam, shrimp with broccoli was also quite good. Pad Kee Kao Beef was bland and the beef tasted boiled and  tough. Considering the prices there  was not much beef or shrimp in the dishes. Total bill was 44 bucks  with no drinks.

Overall not bad  but unlikely to stop here again.

Nice little restaurant with friendly staff, all of them.
As a vegetarian I appreciate the way they keep the vegetables fresh and crispy in the entrees.
Love the pad Thai and also the pad see ew.  The spring rolls are plump and delicious.

A great place for quick Italian street food. Very quick service and the staff was extremely friendly. I have to eat gluten and dairy free and I was able to have the  Pomodoro Pasta with gluten free penne and no cheese. Most of the salads can be made gluten free as well and they have a dairy free sorbetto for dessert. I'm hoping they introduce more gluten free options because I was very impressed with the dish I could order.

Recently had my daughters 5th Birthday oarty here. Our families second birthday party here, and the 4th we've been to.
Wife also enjoyed stopping by with kids over summer holidays.
If nothing else...it's an indoor playpark at a reasonable price. Food's not really great, but it a goid spot for the little'uns to burn iff some steam.
As with any environment such as thus, ones experience is often dictated more by other patrons as it is by the employees and facilities.
It's certainly worth checking out. It's as pricey as your kids convince you to make it...

My girlfriend and I bought a Broil King BBQ on 27 April 18. We ordered it per-assembled and had it delivered. The igniter for the rotisserie did not work. Now, I know this seems like a small issue, but we paid over $1000 for this BBQ. When you are spending that kind of money, everything should work. We specifically spent that money so we would have a BBQ that worked and would last us years. We called several time, and were told they were waiting on parts.

The problem there is that there isn't parts, the system is quite simple. If it was complicated they could just replace the whole rotisserie system as it would probably be cheaper than ordering parts and paying people to repair it. We spoke to several people including the manager and they all told us that this would be dealt with. I am leaving for tour in 10 days and we are quite disappointed that Lowes has failed to repair something so simple.

The feeling we have is that the employees wanted our money and then could not be bothered with us afterwards.

I did some banking this afternoon at the nearby BMO and had not had lunch yet so I decided to wander in and check this place out. The staff are quite friendly and one met me right as I was coming in to see if this was my first time visiting and if I needed any explanation about the menu. She also seemed very well trained as she was able to offer extensive information about their dishes and the ingredients well beyond my expectations of service when eating out.

After paying at the till im not sure if I even had to wait a full ten minutes before my peach Italian soda and penne pomodoro were brought to me. For such a speedy delivery I was initially weary of the quality but the pasta was actually quite good. My only gripe was with the bread they brought. It was surprisingly small and a little dry. I would have much rather had a nice big piece of garlic bread but perhaps that is just me. I also have to make mention of the Italian soda here. I am usually a Second Cup girl but after having it here Second Cup will never taste the same again. I am not sure what the brand of syrup they use here is but it was A-MAZING and the best Italian soda I have ever tasted.

I think my biggest concern with this place and the reason im taking off stars was how I was treated as I finished my meal. It was 3 p.m when I was in there and nobody else was sitting yet the girl from the front appeared literally as I put my last bite into my mouth said something to the effect of "oh good" and then quickly whisked the plate away. I know this is a different service style then a traditional sit down restaurant so it's not like I was expecting her to pop in halfway through my meal and ask how it was or to offer me a dessert but it still felt kind of awkward and I rushed to finish my Italian soda as I felt like she just wanted me out so she could wipe the table and start getting ready for the dinner crowd.

I would come back again if I was with someone that was curious to try it but they are charging the kind of prices you expect at a place with wait service when they don't offer it here and while it was good it didn't really knock my socks off with the exception of my Italian soda.

Oh Denny's, good ol reliable Denny's. Always there when you decide you want a Belgian waffle at any hour of the day. - until the last time I went. When waffles were removed from the menu. WHAT. Yeah I was shook. My replacement meal was tasty but alas no waffle. I mean it's Denny's it is what it is. Reasonably priced diner fare. Service here is always kind of shotty but I can't imagine the clientele is always stellar so I give them props anyways.

I've been meaning to try the butcher block for quite some time, because I love the idea of having a good local butcher.  The biggest knock against the butcher block is that they are not open on Sundays.  I usually BBQ the most on sundays and like to buy my meat fresh, so that's why it took me so long to come here.
I went in after work this week and picked up a couple of new york steaks.  The owner was kind enough to cut them fresh for me at a custom thickness because there were none in the cooler.
The steaks themselves were really good, but could have used a little more marbling... I couldn't see them before ordering because they were custom cut, but if I could do it all over again I likely would have gotten the rib eyes because I like a little more fat in my steak.
All in all, I can't wait to go back and get brisket and ribs this summer, because those are my favourite cuts of meat and they are rarely present at grocery stores. It's great to have a local butcher who can provide the rarer cuts of meat on demand.

This is a great wine & more store. Not only do they have a great selection, but they offer free tastings, samples and more. The people who work there seem to be quite knowledgeable about their products, or willing to find someone who is. 

And not just wine! check out their "Growlers" it is a glass jug that you can fill and refill with their craft beers.
Tonight I tried the Chicken and Portobello. It was outstanding!!! My new favourite! FIVE STARS!!!

We have only tried 2 things on the  dinner menu because they are so good. My husband dreams of their ossobuco! I also have the chicken Marsala everytime. The Polenta it comes with too is amazing.They really do their sauces well! The atmosphere is nice for dates and the service is good.

I ordered take out from them. Order was ready and the staff seemed pleasant.

The food was gross though so that's why I give them two stars. They are quite similar to a famoso style of restaurant, main difference is quality of food. I had the portobello and goat cheese piadina and the pomodoro pasta. Both tasted weird and not appetizing. Portions were decent, but that doesn't really matter when it doesn't take good. 

Would not recommend. You'd get a better italian style food from pretty much anywhere.

Did a take out order and was disappointed with the portion size. The pad Thai with shrimp was average. The Massaman with chicken was very good but I would not order the green curry again. All of the dishes could have had more spice.

I heard great things about this restaurant from a friend and was excited to try it after we did some Christmas shopping at greenlands. 

We went on a holiday so we understood that it was busy. And the host was very good at explaining to ppl why the wait was so long and asked for their numbers so he could call when their table would be ready. 

Once we got to our table, we were hungry and eager to order and get our food. It was our first time there and we didn't know we had to order at the counter. We were outside of the restaurant where there are no signs to indicate such. Once we realized that, we quickly got in line. We waited 45min in line to ORDER our food. They have one till and it seemed everyone at Greenland that day was ordering at the same time. After we ordered, we waited about 20more min for the food. The food was good, nothing exceptional...definitely not worth waiting 60min for. 

So I give branches 3 stars for their poor poor system. Get more tills or perhaps make it a traditional restaurant where there are servers.
Excellent service, great coffee, smiling staff and cleanliness and condition is very good.. Kudos to the management.. Will definitely come back again.

Worst size portions I have seen anywhere ! High prices low food quality had issues with food twice . Such a shame as I have been coming here for many years and since the new owner took over everything has gone to hell. Visit any other location but this one if your going to pay a good price then go somewhere were you get what you pay for because this location is sad and the eggs seemed to have a odd taste almost old like . Anyways don't believe me try this location for your self you will be disappointed ! As a customer of 8 years I see the quality gone down hill.

Had lunch at Smashburger yesterday. The service was exceptional. Very friendly!  If you haven't been there, you order at the counter when you arrive and they bring your burgers to your table when ready. The food is fresh and reminds me of the homemade burgers my mom used to make. We have been there twice since it opened and have enjoyed the burgers, fries and shakes. Be prepared to pay more than the fast food chains but it's worth it.

I can't thank the wonderful staff here enough. I brought my senior cat in after a few days of not eating and showing signs of  being Very dehydrated . They gave Joshua fluids and ran some tests to find he was in the early stages of  hyper  thyroidism . Because of their caring and  concern I will now have Josh for many years to come ;) thank you from the bottom of my heart .

This was fast seating, slow to get beverages, slow to take order, other tables got their food before we did &  they arrived later than us. Waiter was distant, seemed unhappy. The person/runner that brought our food looked entirely miserable as she dropped our plates,turned on her heel and left. No clear gluten sensitive options. Our bill came promptly as we just finished eating....funny how when it comes to $$ there is service. Do not recommend, will NOT be returning....go to Cora's or even Dennys....or even A&W....just not here

I had been here once before and was pleased. It has the same menu as Original Joes but a different setting. This time My and I came back with our kids and it was a pleasant experience. It's nice to have more kid friendly restaurants in Sherwood Park. Something that is lacking in this town. 

All table settings are high top tables or booths so if you bring a child needing a high chair, you better not come. Booster seats only. They don't have a kids menu which is kinda weird but whatever. If you want your kids to be occupied before food arrives I suggest you bring your own time wasting toys. They don't give out coloring sheets or anything. 

The food is what I would expect from an OJs sister restaurant. Good portions and good eats. 

The service was good and the overall experience was good. I'll definitely head back here again.

My favourite library in the area 

I enjoy the convenient location being a 5 minute walk away, the free underground parking and street level parking, the large spacious area spread across 2 levels, the architectural accents, delightful artistic mosaic pieces. Let's not forget there's actually a cafe inside the library!  Who wouldn't enjoy curling up with a good book and a latte here? :)

The strathcona library also has a bunch of programs available ranging from kids to adults, a decent size rack of books & movies on sale outside the main doors in the lobby, and lovely staff. 

Bonus: it's inside the Community Centre, which hosts a variety of different events throughout the year, such as farmers markets during the evening of a particular weekday during the spring & summer (Wednesday's I think?).

Also!  New Years in the Park is great! Free hot chocolate and they still lit fireworks this past New Year's Day (the -freezing day)

Terrible service. Only got half of the food I ordered. My friend ordered a milkshake that never came.  No refills on any of our drinks and it wasn't even busy. By far the worst place I've ever been to.  If I could give it 0 stars I would.

Ive taken my family here and the food was decent. Although i will say that the server forgot how i wanted things cooked(eggs) and i asked for one substitution it was forgotten and over all service was on the slow side even though we were one of 3 tables in there. Polite and friendly service! 
The reason for my review is because i am a delivery driver also! I came to pick up food and drinks. The server helped me out getting the food in my bag, the manager(older, Italian maybe?) was quick to scold him on how i should put it in the bag myself because if "she spills it, it's her fault, you know!" I quickly told him their was no need for that and that we are in this together. He very rudely walked away. 
Like seriously? A tray with 2 child size drinks is what the server put in my bag, i put the rest in myself. He was nice enough to give me a hand. I can only imagine what the employees must have to tolerate from this guy!

I've eaten at Smashburger twice so far and really enjoy the modern space that makes it feel a little more upscale than your typical burger joint, and the burgers are pretty good quality.  I tried the Avocado Club burger (beef and grilled chicken versions) and enjoyed it both times.  They have a good selection and lots of options. The fries are unique and taste deliciously fresh.  I will say though that the burgers can be pretty messy and since their policy is to serve it open-faced, they don't wrap it and you end up needing 4 napkins to eat your sandwich!  I pretty much gave up trying to look dainty eating at Smashburger and just dive right in with a flurry of napkins on standby!  Definitely a must-try in Sherwood Park!

Branches you've done it again! They have changed their brunch menu since I was here last so new items to try! I had the vegetable breakfast bowl with green onion cakes. I love that you can shop and enjoy the greenhouse after a delicious meal or just grab a coffee and scone on the go! Just make sure to get there early on the weekends as this spot is in high demand.
Great food, descent price, neat selection and variety. Service was fast and very pleasant. For a fast food burger place is a great family establishment. Rosemary French fries are to die for!

The quality of product at edible arrangements is, is unique, cost effective, topped with excellent service. 
I get rave reviews when sending these arrangements, and don't mind if I get one either! 
Keep up the good work.
Jamie

This place is a total disappointment. First off there is way too much staff but they do nothing but talk to each other. There is only one person who actually serves while the army of young girls chit chat and ignore the customers. 

The food sucks - ordered one of the most basic items "All American Slam" and it tasted rubbery, old, and parts were cold. The customer sitting across from me never even got his eggs after waiting 15 minutes (and the place was pretty dead). The kitchen is rather loud in some language. 

Restaurant is dirty and sticky and again the one employee who works is the only that cleans as the rest just chat. 

Denny's of Canada might want to send its people to Denny's of USA for some hands on training as they are the most basic restaurant concept and it's hard to mess this stuff up.

I'm a regular user of this library.  For a community library it has everything you need. They have a great selection of business books that I often take out. My kids enjoy the atmosphere and social area in the kids section. Movies, music, everything else for a selection of books is great.  

The building itself is a gem in my mind. It's open, tons of natural light and plenty of places to work and study. 

My only complaints are the parents who bring their misbehaving kids. They lack any sort of common sense when it comes to noise. I often see parents turn a blind eye to their kids running around, yelling, screaming or not being polite to other kids.

Second complaint are the people who use the library to socialize.  Last time I checked libraries were designated as quiet places to think and work.

I wish the library staff would discipline these people.

Great spot otherwise.

I have been anxciously awaiting Cibo's openning.
Tonight...
The wait is over!
Very impressive (brand new...so it should be!) inside.
Fresh. Vibrant. Clean and modern.
1st offering...
PICCANTE Pizza.
Spicy Sausage, Tomato, Roasted Peppers, Shaved Grana Padano Cheese, Fior Di Latte Mozzarella
Delicious.
Just the right amount.
I also had to try s brownie. When you see them...you will understan why!
I am looking forward to going back and trying...well...everything!
Nothing else like it around.
It was worth the wait!

I like to deal local and that's what I did when I call First Call Heating when I had a problem with an air conditioner. Joel the technician that came out was courteous , phone prior to the set time and confirmed that he was on his way. The work was done professionally, the leak was found and all was fixed. I would highly recommend them for any repairs for a furnace or air conditioner
Great food and fast service. It was amazingly good food actually. Loved it. Had a salad with high quality ingredients delicious.

The food is really good, and the portions nice and big. But prices are really high. Not to mention that when you order a kids meal, but want to give your kids one of their amazing milkshakes, they charge you for the kids meal drink AND the milkshakes. They will NOT substitute milkshakes for a kids meal shake, but they don't tell you this when you order, they just charge you for both and then only give you the milkshake, basically keeping the drink that you've paid for with the kids meal. I really enjoyed their food, but haven't gone back since I found out they scam people like that.
