I have had some of the wonderful creations from Edible Arrangements in the past so I was really looking forward to an opportunity to purchase something from them.

I went in, in person, on Monday morning and placed my order. I told her I needed it for a 7 pm function on Wednesday. We made arrangements for me to come by and get it between 6 and 6:30 pm on Wednesday so I could drive directly to my destination with it.

When we arrived at 6:20 pm on Wednesday, they didn't have it ready. They said they had it down for a Friday pick up. The lady behind the counter said the best she could do is pull one together really quickly but that would take at least 15 minutes.

At that point I realized they don't have any process for giving their customers an order receipt. It was kind of  my word against the order takers.

So my husband took me to the function and then returned about 10 minutes later to Edible Arrangements thinking it would almost be ready. The lady working that night was in the back and poked her head out and saw he was there. She didn't say anything but returned to the back without saying a word.

He waited there 15 more minutes before she came out front and gave him our order.

The order was great and the product wonderful, but I think they need to look at their processes. This whole thing could have been averted by providing the customer with an order receipt.

I struggled with what star rating to give them because their actual product was great and I don't know if this was just a one-off issue. But in the end, I have to rate it based on my experience.

Unfortunately twice as terrible as the first time. Had a rude waitress and a manager who wouldn't do anything about it. Split our meal brought the soup with one bowl and two spoons. Nice. Then brought a second bowl and told us to split it. What a mess! The service twice has been deplorable. Won't make a third time.

What can I say? we have the most incredible library in the history of libraries. No, really, I think we have a book on how we are the most incredible!!

This lovely library opened in November of 2010 and I have been a regular ever since. There is something for everyone here. We have big tall windows to let lots of natural light pour in and cozy nooks to curl up in. There are plenty of plug ins for laptops and chargers as well as lots of comfy seating.

There is an area with desks where you can plug in your laptop or there is another section that has computers you can use. There is free Wifi - that doesn't require a library card or anything else convoluted to use.

The library is two stories and there is a coffee shop on the first floor, with the adult study area upstairs. The first floor houses the children's section with a great magical kingdom area. Speaking of kids (and adults who want to be kids) you can also check out a Wii and play it in one of the alcoves.

Of course, the library also has the usual vast selection of hard cover, soft cover and e-books. DVDs, CDs etc. to check out.

There are automated check out and return machines but if you have to go to the information desk, they are pleasant and helpful.

I honestly can't think of one way they could improve on this place!

Well I am a huge fan of burgers, at least I was until I found out about my Gluten Intolerance.  Now a new burger joint drops right into my neighbourhood and I feel obliged to try it out so I attend the grand opening. I know I probably can't have a burger as buns are where the gluten is found, but maybe fries or something.  I was the happiest man in the world when they told me they could prepare it gluten free for me...score! Then I found out the fries are done in a separate fryer so they too are a safe bet so slide me an order of those also....I think I am in love with this place already. I haven't had this treatment since I was at the Delux Burger Bar a while ago.

Then the food arrived, my giddy attitude turn very disappointed. I was delivered a piece of meat on lettuce leafs. Not cool. My fries arrived and they were for sure OK, but I think my outlook had been tainted with the burger scenario so when asked what I thought of them I said they were OK, I did not see anything special about them other than they were shoestring fries. I did eat my burger with a fork and a knife, not the way burgers were intended to be eaten. It was a tasty patty, nice flavor and all, I still wanted to like this place.

When it came down to looking at the experience as a whole I would say the service was good, but they had lots of staff on for the opening so I will try again later to see if it holds true. The noise was overwhelming, I had to go outside to change my mind...not good. Then I realized they were marketing it as an Edmonton location and realized the buzz in the room was how they though Sherwood Park was Edmonton. Signs, pictures and even the menu was all Edmonton biased, they even have an Edmonton burger on the menu. This may have been an advertising mistake on their part as Sherwood Park prides themselves in not being Edmontonian. They could lose the locals and never be able to fully reach the Edmontonians. 

I hope it does well because if the rest of the burger tasted as good as the patty I had they are on to something. It is worth a try if you are in the area.

A couple years ago I was asked to adopt a Red Eared Slider (Mr. Turtle) and as an animal lover to the MAX I was happy to oblige! With no prior experience with turtles I read everything I could find - and about $2000.00 later turtle has an amazing aquarium with ALL the bells and whistles. Well that takes care of habitat but what about Turtle health?? I called around to find a vet that could do a turtle check up and chose park vet cuz they could get me in that weekend and their price was surprisingly reasonable (I was prepared for some outrageous fees just cuz he's exotic). 

I walked in for my appointment into a new, comfortable, clean, well decorated lobby and checked in with a friendly, warm receptionist. Once we got into the examining room a few mins later a tech came in to assess Turtle and ask me a bunch of questions about his care and behaviour. She was AWESOME cuz she has sliders too so we chatted about them and she had a few tips for me - it was excellent!! Then we did have to wait about 45mins to an hour for the doc (but she did come in an explain she was dealing with a sensitive issue and would be in ASAP - she apologized for the delay). 

Now I have to agree wholeheartedly with the previous review and about Dr. Bousquet. She was knowledgeable and attentive and seemed to really check Turtle over carefully. She did a swim test as we had some concerns about him swimming in circles (which can indicate pneumonia - but turns out Turtle's just kooky!) and then we decided to do a blood sample (a little pricey but worth it just to be safe and to have a basis for comparison if anything happens in the future). She gave me some pointers on how to care for Turtle and how to keep his shell healthy (growing turtles shed their `scales` as they grow and can get all flaky and dry). She then printed her report, went over it with me, and sent me and Turtle on our way. About 2 hours later I received a phone call from Dr. Bousquet herself to go over the results of the blood test (which was completely OK). 

I just could not get over how good I felt after leaving the vets office - and honestly when does that ever happen - I usually feel like I just walked out of a used car dealership! 100% recommend this place for exotic animals and because of my previous experience I would not hesitate to take my cats in for a visit next time they need a check up!

Had dinner tonight at the newly reopened VIA CIBO,  and I gotta tell you it was absolutely Delicious!! I had the Chicken Parmigiana with Alfredo pasta, as good as what I've had in Rome, SERIOUSLY!! Check it out you will not be disappointed. If I could give them 6 STARS I would!!!!!  May 3, 2018

My kids love coming here to burn energy and play, but I can't stomach the price anymore. They jacked up admission prices by about 40%! Admission is now $12.50 on weekends. There are other similar indoor play places that are MUCH nicer and WAY bigger that charge less. I'll only be back if I have a coupon for admission.  I won't pay their price anymore. They've lost my business.

First time to this Cibo and I definitely be back!

Staff- probably the friendliest staff I've ever come across, super attentive and seemed genuinely interested in making my visit the best hey could make it.

Location- different style of order set up and I liked it, very logical and straight forward. very modern interior, very clean

Food- had the gnocchi, never had it before and it was amazing!!!! Will 100% be back for that 

Drinks- little over priced at 3$ for a Italian soda.

All in all s good place to grab a quick pasta dish

If you like eating at the same time as the rest of your table, this place is not for you. Been here many times, have also been here my last time. Honeymoon is over. When I go out to eat with my family, I want to eat with them, at the same time. Simple ask, difficult delivery at Via Cibo. Too many options out there to be as complacent as they are about the whole dining experience. Shame. Also, Italians make wine, they do not make drinkable beer.

Amazing food, amazing service- prices are a little high, but I don't mind paying for good quality.  Pad Thai and Pineapple fried rice are our favs.  Coconut rice is amazing!  Our go to Thai place in Sherwood Park!
The gym is beautiful. The price is right. Tons of classes for adults and kids alike.

Love Starbucks coffee and their service. Even more so as this one is in our back yard just about! Their staff is very friendly and are willing to help out if you are not sure what you want at that time. 

    My only issue with this one is that they are a bit slow at getting your coffee and getting you on their merry way. If they stepped it up this would be an easy 4-5 star place. Just be cautious if you're on a short time limit!

Utterly disappointing. First visit and definitely our last!!

My "salad' consisted of lettuce with oil and vinegar. No grape tomatoes, cucumber, onion, feta, olives or, really, *anything* other than lettuce that would have made this a salad: Greek, house, Caesar, chiffonade or otherwise.

Pollo parmigiana was beyond dry and terribly bland. Both pasta dishes ordered had disproportionate amounts of sauce. 

Staff were bringing orders to the wrong tables: that was really the *only* thing that was consistent! 

Very loud/noisy; hardly conducive whatsoever to conversation and no real ambience to speak of. 

A wait of over 20 minutes for our dessert is simply unacceptable.

Caveat emptor!!!

If you feel like arguing with a receptionist drop by. You'll be met with such cliche's as "I don't understand the purpose of our conversation" and "our system never has issues" waste of time coming here.
Food was good. Dessert was awesome. Service was horrible. Portions sizes were really small for price

I used Riteway for a move across Edmonton a couple of days ago. They arrived on time, were polite, professional and courteous. Moving was done at the expected time and with no surprise costs. Would recommend them and use them again.

I ordered the "Spicy Jalapeño Baja" burger with a poutine. The poutine was a little light on the gravy so I asked to get a side to add to it. I was informed that a container the size of a ketchup cup would cost $1.05-not worth it and as gravy isn't even on the menu as an add-on, I don't know where that price came from. 
The burger was well put together, the vegetables fresh and without defects, the sauces were flavorful, and the buns were soft. I was very disappointed with the burgers though! Very bland! I don't think there was any seasoning in/on it, BUT it was still moist and a good size. 
Overall, if you're searching for a mind blowing burger, Smashburger is not the place to go.

Better than your average fast food burger by far! 
Price point is similar to five guys. 
The smash fries are good but the haystack onion rings are amazing. Will be going back to try out the grilled chicken and the black bean options!! 
Definitely would recommend.
Service was great this visit!
Thai restaurant excellent service excellent food very friendly staff prompt we been there many many times

Maybe I'm just easy to please, but this was one of my best eating experiences in the city. What makes a good experience for me is good customer service (a nice and helpful waitress), good food, and more good service.

I don't know why everyone is complaining about the staff and wait times, when you go out to eat you should expect to wait, as simple as that. The wait was about a half hour if that for our large breakfasts and special pancakes, but we hardly noticed the wait as we were busy talking. Sandy took our order on Christmas morning with a smile on her face that put one of ours. We couldn't believe how great the service was, although only a Denny's, I wish we received even near the amount of friendliness and joy that Sandy had, from other waitresses elsewhere. 

Great food with tons of flavour, bacon was crisp and salty and the buttermilk pancakes which I normally leave untouched were delicious as well! 

Great experience and wonderful breakfast as well, a nice Christmas treat.

Thanks Sandy!!

Ok to start off I have to admit I hate UFC.. I can not handle watching it or boxing or any hand to hand combat type sport.. it freaks me out & bothers me. That being said.. I came here for the yelp fitclub & the circuit style workout we did with Mike was intense & definitely would hit all of your target areas.. without having to hit anyone!  
 I know there are several types of training offered here.. & knowing that I wouldn't have to partake in any actual contact training unless I wanted to made me completely change my pre-conceived notion about what all goes on in the gym.  Obviously if you are wanting to pursue that style of training it would be available.. but there are many options available including kids & ladies only classes.   
 The space itself was cool complete with the octagon caged ring as well as the usual gym treadmill, free weights etc. They have their desk to check in & cubies at the front for your shoes & as well change rooms available. It was clean & open so you can see what everyone else is upto. There is lots of free parking out front too. If you are looking for something new head here & as their motto goes "train differently" .

We've been here several times and have never been disappointed!  Food is great, always fresh and hot - lots of choices beef, grilled chicken, crispy chicken, salad, hot dogs.  And the fries!  The fries are fantastic!  Love, love, love the smash fries and the sweet potato fries!  Everything is always clean, tables wiped and the customer service is above reproach!

I wanted to give this 3.5 stars, but will give it 4. There's enough good things about Smashburger to give it that little boost. The thing I was waffling on is the burger. Their process surely makes a juicy burger, but my oh my is is salty. And why don't they use Alberta beef? Apparently due to 'consistency'. Not good enough in my opinion.

So on to my experiences. The burgers are good. As I mentioned before, the patties are a touch too salty for me, but otherwise I've never had a bad burger here. That's because each burger is made to order, which almost in itself justifies the price above the ubiquitous fast food joints. They do chicken as well and have a diverse selection of 'smashchickens'. On the burger side, my favorites are the avocado club, the spicy jalapeno baja, and the truffle mushroom swiss. They also have a black bean burger which was tasty, but a little dry.

Now, on to what I think makes this place shine. Their fries and sides are amazing. Their classic fries are decent, but you need that good base for the amazing rosemary and truffle oil fries. The sweet potato fries are wonderful and those veggie frites are to die for.

All in all Smashburger fits nicely between the big fast food joints and the gourmet burger joints. Their pricing is reasonable, they offer a good selection of drinks and food, and the service is fast and friendly.

I really enjoy this Starbucks. The main reason? They always spell my name right on the cup!!! It may not sound like much but when you've got a weird name it's pretty exciting to have someone actually spell it right. My beverage always is more satisfying when it actually says my name.

The seating area is always kept clean. Since it is inside of a Chapters there isn't a whole lot of room but it's a cozy little area with a nice bit of natural light. If this location gets outrageously busy and you don't feel like waiting in line, you can hop on over to Target since there's a Starbucks in there too (although it doesn't have a seating area). 

The baristas here are always nice and reasonably quick. I've never had a bad experience here. (Unlike other Starbucks... Cafe Vanilla frappes are NOT the same as Vanilla Bean, but I swear 87% of the baristas don't know that).

I've been going for monthly massages for about six months now and love it. I see Melissa who is very friendly and professional. She checks in with me before each session to see what our goals for the day are and if there has been any changes over the last month, afterwords she makes sure to verify that everything went well. The tables are heated and each room is temperature controlled which is very cozy. I've never had a problem with the front end staff, they are always comfortable handling any issues I've had. Twice I've rescheduled at the last minute with no problems. The paperwork is taken care of and insurance is billed by the time I'm done so I can check out quickly. My only complaint is that I have not yet won the monthly draw for a free massage!

Just yum. They literally "smash" their meat when they cook it, I think that's cool. Their "smash fries" are perfect and they give you so many of them - which means lots of bag-fries when you get take out! 
I've only ever got take-out, but you can dine in as well. Takes a little while for your meal to be ready (it's not "fast food") and it's a tad pricey, but well worth it and always fresh and filling!

My new favourite place to lunch with a friend! The setting is lovely- especially at Christmas we enjoy wandering around the lovely Christmas displays&gifts before or after meals. Excellent selection of soups/salads/ main dishes/ lattes and desserts TO DIE FOR! Couldn't ask for a more lovely ambience with our cafe table surrounded by plants, twinkle lights and bubbling fountains.

I went in wanting steak tacos, after ordering and seeing what the steak looked like I asked the girl working if the meat is normally this dry and she said yes, it's dry right now, would you like anything else? After looking at all my choices I noticed everything was dry and crusty looking for protein choices. I asked her if it was always like this or if it's like this right now. She said it's always like this. I don't think I would go back. Taco Bell if much fresher not to mention cheaper

I come here to let me kids run around when they need to blow off steam. The price for tokens is a little high, especially since 1/2 the machines are always down. The price for food is a little high as well, but the food is VERY good, so I don't mind paying it. They could use a little bit of a better house keeper, but it's not too bad.

The whisky tasting bar at wine and beyond is out of this world. For pennies on the dollar you get to sample some really rare or old scotch. My wife took me here for our anniversary and bought me a half oz of the auchentoshan 1957, 50 year old scotch. This review is not of the scotch but rather over the fact that I got to try a $4000 bottle of scotch for $50 bucks.  The value for your money is amazing.
The staff that hover around the tasting bar are extremely knowledgable about what they are pouring and are not afraid to engage you about products while making recommendations. So even if you never plan on buying expensive scotch. This is a great place to come and try it.

Bad service killed the review. Food is OK but our server abandoned us for about 30 minutes. It would have been longer but I hunted her down. 

Could have sold us desert, coffee and perhaps a digestive, hard to do when you are hiding.
The worst breakfast ever. .. three of us and all our meals were tasteless.  The sausage had the strangest smell and tasted horrible.  Service not very good either. Never again

I can't even begin to express how compassionate the staff here is.  A little over a month ago we had to have our hedgehog Frey put to sleep and I am glad I made the trip here from all the way on the west end of Edmonton.  I will never go anywhere else in the future as they helped us through the whole process and gave us as much time as we needed.  Even about a week later we got a letter in the mail signed by all the staff  with their condolences.

Again thank you to everyone at Park Veterinary Center if you are reading this.

Such a yummy place!  I craved their soup all week this week. It reminded me of the food that my former sister in law used to make. She was from Laos. I can't afford it all the time but I treated the family to some scrumptious Thai food tonight. Yum!

Very underwhelmed.

Would pick 5 Guys any day over this place.

I actually found the portion sizes (for fries) on the small side.

I"ve tried other State and Main's before so I had a pretty good idea what to expect and this Sherwood Park location did not let us down.

It was busy the night we decided to try it out - just a few days after they opened - but we were seated quickly and the service was great.

I had some issues with my order because I asked for the tomato and bacon soup, along with some gyoza instead of a full entree. They brought me the gyoza and a very, very small cup of soup. I looked at the menu again and it said the soup came with bread etc. and it is $8. I asked the waitress about it and her response was "I wondered about that! I think they gave you the appetizer size" She quickly had it replaced and all was good, but I couldn't help wonder why she didnt question it BEFORE she brought it to our table and I had to call her back to ask!

Overall, it is a very nice new addition to the Sherwood Park food scene!

First walked in to a very confusing, large menu. The lady at the front actually had to explain the menu to us, and then also gave as a paper menu as the kids menu was not actually on the very large board. I would hate to see what it would be like if it was busy and had to explain the menu to every single customer that came in. Food was good, but small serving for the price paid. Sandwiches didn't even come with a side, so it left me feeling very unsatisfied. No where to grab extra napkins and kids drinks are the same size as adult drinks. Gelato flavors are different and there are no "common flavors" for those less adventurous. All desserts feature Nutella, so not really an option for someone who doesn't like Nutella. Was nice as a change but probably won't be back

There were some mixed reviews in my group, but overall, lunch was tasty!  Although, considerably overpriced.

I enjoyed my beef dip sandwich and traded my fries for potato salad.  The beef dip was delicious.  The Au Jus was thick, more like a gravy, but that's ok.  The pretzel bun was soft and flavorful and the beef was juicy.  The carmelized onion mayo added something extra that was awesome.

The ordering process is a little confusing because it's not explained until you get to the counter.  But here's how it works.... You find your table.  Flip over the little card (one side of the card says "This table is free" the other side says "This table is occupied"), then go up to the counter to order and they deliver your food to the table.

Overall I was happy and I'll be back, but probably no more than once a year!

Love, love, LOVE this library!

Great for everyone - fantastic children's section that includes some toys, computer games and comfortable seating.  They have many programs for storytelling and songs for the little ones.

Free wifi as well as computer access.  Very comfortable seating areas.  Great selection of movies to rent.  

There is a small cafe in the library that serves food as well as drinks.  People can take drinks into the library areas - definitely not the library of our youth!!

Library card is $12 for the year and additional household members are $3 per person.

A solid 3 stars!
This is a delightful location inside a garden centre.  You can sit inside or outside.  Both are lovely.  Menu was small, well prepared, and tasty.  Our party had beef dip, pizza, and chicken sandwich. The beef dip was the stand out.  So was the beer!  Service was friendly, prompt and low key.  Would totally recommend to a friend and would happily go back.

I know for a fact that Sherwood Park is pretty starved for decent and new places to eat, especially places that are family-friendly. While I am typically not a big fan of visiting "chain" restaurants, I am always up for a new experience, and I have heard some pretty positive things about State & Main. 

State & Main is like a "brother" to Original Joe's - I believe it was dreamt up by the same people, their only difference being that they cater more towards a family-friendly atmosphere (but they do also have a "bar" adults-only side). The food is very similar and the menus are very similar. As you might know, food can vary from location to location - and I found the food here to be pretty good all though nothing mind blowing or super exceptional.

We visited sometime in December, so the place was still a little bit new, and I think staffing and service is still being sorted out. Our server was very friendly, but a little disorganized and it took quite a long time to have waters refilled, beverages offered and to generally be well, "served." 

In a city where, there aren't a lot of options, State & Main offers pretty good food at pretty good prices. Let's hope that other restaurants take note and we start seeing more development and options that provide a similar vibe and consistency.

Service took forever, and the food was average at best. Actually tasted exactly like Original Joes where you get better service and similar food that is again ok. Something about the bun of their sandwich that turn me off.
Not just that the food wasn't so great, or service slow, but the waitresses who helped me were complacent and didn't seem to want to be working.
A great addition to Sherwood Park!  I loved the crab and scallop cakes.  Great oven fired pizza too. Excellent specialty coffee and dessert place. There is a large patio as well as indoor space.

Smashburger is alright.  I don't think it's the be all and end all like some, but I can concede that it's alright.  If nothing else, the young staff members are extremely friendly and obliging.  

The owner of this particular location would do well to see that his or her staff keep the johns cleaner, though.  That's important and it was something that was lacking on the date of my visit.

Pros: 
Food is very fast, fresh, and good 
-Tiramisu French toast is AMAZING  
-Did not take long after I ordered for the food to come out 
-ingredients were fresh, and quality was obvious
-great selection, I do not eat pork which makes it difficult to eat at Italian restaurants however, they had a great selection
-Server even mentioned one of our menu selections had pork in it- saving my friend from ordering it 

Cons:
-Service process is very confusing and inefficient;
sit down, then order food at one counter, order for drinks and pay at another counter, and then sit down and wait for food to be brought to you. 
-due to the structure of the process, its uncertain who your server is, and who you would ask if you needed anything 
-We decided we wanted our Tiramisu French toast to go, their containers aren't big enough- resulting in us smushing it in. 

Overall; great choice for a casual lunch. If you're craving something different than the regular Chain restaurants, this is a good choice.

Phenomenal burgers, always fresh. The classic smash with smash fries has always been my go-to. Not overly pricey, which I appreciate, and I always leave feeling very full. They serve fantastic salads and shakes as well. Would recommend trying the place out if you've never experienced smashburger!

Always friend staff and on point food
Big potion sizes always great place
To share meals....nice and quick for
lunch meetings and atmosphere it
Great.

How neat is this place?  I've never seen anything like it! 

As far as I can tell, it's about as close to an "all in one" stop you can.  I know I missed some things, but here is what I noticed:

Pharmacy
Women's health centre (Halleluja! You don't need to become a regular patient there... you can just book appointments for those pesky 3 year tests if you're not comfortable having your regular family doctor do it)
Obstetrics & Gyno clinic
Medical clinic
Hair Salon
Spa
Coffee Shop
Chiropractor
X-Ray/DI
Dynalife Lab (book an appointment online when you need blood tests done and save yourself the wait!)

Like I said... I know there's more services, I just can't remember!

There is lots of parking.  It sucks that you have to pay, but it's only $2.00 no matter how long you have to be there.  It's very easy to access and decently easy to find your way around once inside.

Just sent an aarangement for a friend that had a baby and she was sooo satisfied with it. They even had baby ones to pick from.
It is kind of expensive considering it is fruit but it is very talented the way they put it together so I guess you pay for that more then the fruit! I would definetly order again for a babyshower,bridal shower,birthday party. Different then the average stuff at these events.
Pretty good Thai cuisine, but I found it pricey for what you get. I will probably go back, but will have to be mindful about what I order to keep my costs down.

I'm sure a number of McDonald's patrons will undoubtedly rave about this turd-barn.  However, the food here is very un-spectacular.

The person that took our order had a difficult time communicating.
(So of course our order showed up wrong.)

The food wasn't that great either.
The shoe-string fries were incredibly greasy.
The burger was a little too juicy and lacked seasoning.

The overall experience was poor.
5-guys makes a much better burger.

On our recent move, we hired these movers. Due to circumstances we had to reschedule and they were awesome and accommodating (no extra charges as well).
They were on time the day of the move and were careful of our items. Since we lived in a loft and moved to a new loft, at each location there were a lot of stairs. So far in unpacking nothing is broken, chipped or damaged. The 2 gentlemen that moved us were super polite and the whole move (we moved a lot of items including appliances) took the two of them about 6 and a half hours... we forced them to take a break and have some refreshments and we paid just over $500. Well worth the money! Will use them again if we ever have to do a big move.

The selection of burgers on the menu have been hand-selected.  The condiments in each burger come together nicely for a well-balanced flavour in almost every bite!  No obligatory large slice of tomato/onion on these burgers.  I don't like fried egg, but I tried the Alberta burger, and couldn't taste the egg as it blended nicely with the other toppings.  My favourite so far is the BBQ, Bacon & Cheddar burger.

They also have great shoestring fries!

While I have only used their driving range and putting/chipping areas, this course is absolutely beautiful! 

As someone who is currently a beginner golfer I love their driving range for its natural setting. Driving off of real grass is a lovely change to your typical AstroTurf. Priced at par (pun intended) with other driving ranges it's affordable for any golfer. 

I'm excited to get out and try their track, it looks beautiful kept.

Branches is the perfect place to end your day. The service was excellent. I truly enjoyed seeing the hands on touch of the owner. The atmosphere was relaxing and I loved all the extra touches of decorating for the Christmas season. Not to mention DELICIOUS food right down to the coffee.

I 1st had their Gluten Free Very Berry cheese cake when I stayed at the Sawridge in Edmonton  (see that review).  It was so good I went back to the lounge to have another peice when a friend joined me for drinks. Anyway it was so good that I asked the staff where it came from because it did NOT taste like other commercially produced GF crap. We had a surprise party for my mom's birthday yesterday and I purchased 2 cakes from them on Friday.  1 GF Very Berry Cheesecake and the Chocolate Caramel cake for the gluten eaters. They both came presliced with parchment paper between each slice so it made for super easy serving. The cake had 16 portions and the cheesecake had 14. They are in super sturdy cardboard boxes so I never felt once that these cakes would get squashed at anytime. They come frozen but I was told to let them thaw for 2 hours before serving for a whole cake 45 for a slice. I was told if left frozen the cakes would last 10 months in the freezer. Anyway all the guests devoured the cakes. Even though there were only 2 Celiacs the gluten eaters couldn't resist the beautiful cheesecake. I'm not sure if anyone but myself and my aunt knew the cheesecake was GF. I will DEFINITELY BE buying all my birthday/anniversary cakes from them from now on. I didn't feel like I was being left out of the gluten party.

As usual a big disappointment.  Food was mediocre. Service was sub par. There was only 4 other tables and one waitress. 2 of the tables were done with their food. The manager was dressed so sloppy and unprofessional. Food didn't take too long. Waitress didn't care about any of her tables. No follow up no refills. Once again a disappointing outing

This place is alright when you need a change of scenery in the long winters. But it also needs to be refreshed. A lot of the materials are getting worn out and dirt. I stopped going because it just felt dirty. It is a really great place to play but really clean it up.

My wife and I met here for lunch. It was freezing inside. We never took off our winter jackets the whole time. Although there was maybe 10 other people in there our food still took a half hour to arrive. I had the French dip and it was the worst au jus I've ever had. Pretty much just a bowl of grease. The coleslaw had a great lack of dressing. On a good note the jalapeño cheddar mashed potatoes were quite yummy as was my wife's flatbread. And the waitress was quite friendly.

It's no secret that I love State & Main.  My co-workers asked where I wanted to go for my birthday lunch and I had a real craving for the dill dip...... so off we went!

I was a little concerned because we didn't decide on our destination until noon, and our office is on the West end of Sherwood Park, so I was worried that we wouldn't have enough time.  But my worrying was for nothing... the service was on point and the timing was much better than I anticipated.

We were greeted as soon as we walked in and shown to a table.  The seating is incredibly comfortable and the atmosphere is very warm and inviting.

Here's the funny part... I usually get the steak sandwich at State & Main, and am never disappointed with my choice.  But today I decided I didn't want so much food and opted for the French Dip, assuming it would be a little smaller.  WRONG.  This was the biggest sandwich I've ever seen.  But also one of the tastiest.  The meat was still juicy and tender, the bun was not dried out and the au jus was FULL of flavour!!  yum.  Do I even need to go into how delicious the fries and dill dip were?  I think everyone has experienced them by now... if not, you should.  One of my colleagues had never tried it until today, and she admitted that it changed her life.

My other colleague who was with us is on a very specific meal plan while she prepares for a competition in May.  She's been to OJ's many times in the past and they can usually accommodate her there, so she hoped for the same at State & Main.  She asked if she could just get a chicken breast, some rice, and a side of veggies.  The waitress was very understanding and made some recommendations of ways she could be accommodated and the meal she ended up with was delicious and fully on plan.

This is definitely our new "go-to" lunch spot - we all left incredibly satisfied.

The only reason I took away a star was because the waitress took my plates away to pack up my leftovers, but did not pack up my dill dip.  okay.... so there was only like 10 French fries left on my plate... but I definitely still wanted to take at least the dip!

I love smashburgers so i try to have them everyrtime im in calgary. I recently discovered that we have one here as well.

Came here yesterday and ordered the BBQ bacon cheeseburger (reg size). It was very good, however i cant help notice that they dont give you as much fried onions with it as they do in calgary. It was a little disappointing since the fried onion was the best part. When i would get them in Calgary they would load it up with fried onions, like almost half it was that. Here you can literally count how many was there.
Also had the oreo milkshake, which was very good. Not as sweet as i thought it would be. It was perfect.

Anyways the burger was still tasty and the service was good. I just dont think i would be driving 30 mins to have it here.

I LOVE the burgers here - especially the buffalo blue cheese burger. I eat a lot of burgers but honestly this is one of my favourites anywhere at any price point. The buns are soft and delicious. The meat is very tender and juicy.

Unlike a lot of the reviewers I'm not a huge fan of the fries - but to each their own. If I could marry a Smashburger with Red Robin steak fries I'd probably never leave.

For the reviewers complaining about the Saskatoon shake - that's probably a fair point and the reason why Saskatoons aren't used in much - the texture doesn't blend well. I think the chocolate oreo shake is awesome though - give it a try.

I like to bring my family (4 kids) to Smashburger. The kids meals are HUGE (too big, in fact, but Dad gets the leftovers) for our little ones, but when they get bigger and older they'll appreciate it for sure.

If you're looking for a more refined menu than what you get at Five Guys then this is your best bet. Five Guys is great for what it is - simple, calorie loaded, and simple (yeah, I said that twice). Smashburger gives you way more variety, better quality (IMO), and a better family dining experience. I think the burgers are a better value overall.

Can't go wrong!

I was excited to try State & Main since I had heard great things from people. Sure enough they did not disappoint. The food was fantastic and the drinks were good. 
Our waitress was friendly but a little bit overwhelmed it seemed. 
It reminds me of a slightly fancier, child friendly version of Original Joes as I find the menus are quite similar.
I will definitely be back along with recommending it to friends.

How can coffee and pancakes take so long to serve? Because Skip The Dishes get first order over patrons in the restaurant? Give this place a pass. Long wait times, lack of service, disorganized. There are better options!

I went to Country Side Golf Course on a Saturday, we were a group of 20 so we booked the spots in advance. Every person in this facility was totally awesome, super friendly and helpful.
The parking lot is big enough for everyone, they have a nice welcoming area and they take good care of the facilities. Bathrooms were tidy and kitchen and bar area were in good care.
We played 18 holes, all of them in good shape and also we used the practice range for half and hour before our tee time.
We ordered dinner for everyone and it was delicious, brad, salad, main course, dessert, everything was taste really good.
We had a extremely great time in their facility, it is on the south east side of the city but is easy to get here.
If you don't have your equipment, don't worry they can rent all that you need.
I recommend you to bring some snacks if you don't want to go back frequently to the main house, depending how big is your party is you will spend few hours here.
I'm taking one star off as the drinks cart passed just twice around the area where we where, so if you didn't buy enough supplies the first time you have to wait a long time until the next cart pass. Other than that this place is great and I can't wait to the next summer to be back!

I showed up 15 minutes early for my 10:30 appt just like they asked me to do .... After a few minutes I was told that my therapist was stuck in traffic .... After another 15 minutes I was told that she was still stuck in traffic but I would need to return at 4:30 so as not to inconvenience her other clients ... There has been construction on the highway now for over a year ... So why was she suddenly unprepared for it.  If I need to arrive early perhaps the therapist might want to as well. My first and last trip in one!!  I'm only giving one star because it won't allow me to post with none.  This was at the sherwood park location .... I hope the other locations are better organized!!

Not that impressed.  Nothing special; Just another burger joint.  I didn't care for the thin burgers.  It was tasteless and a bit dry for me.  On the flip side the staff was very nice.  I'm willing to try it one more time at another location.

This is such a cool place!

If you want to find a unique for someone, this is it.

These guys make edible bouquets.  They shape fruit and put them all together to make amazing (and delicious) bouquets!

Some of the bouquets have chocolate covered bananas and strawberries with oranges and grapes, some have every kind of fruit you can think of!

You need to check these guys out if you haven't already.  They are so cool!  And they deliver!

Have been here a few times last time here wasn't great but wife convinced me that we should give another chance. Our server greeted us and that was good and got our drinks promptly. That's where it started to go downhill. 
Ordered our meal and waited and waited and waited , the restaurant was only about 1/2 full and yet we wait for an eternity. We flag down another server and ask when our food is coming and wait some more , by now it's been an hour and still nothing. We see our server is avoiding us and another person comes up to us and says oops your order was never entered. Now I'm upset say forget it we are leaving and would like settle our bill. 
We wait for another 15 mins and I get fed up and go to bartender and get our bill from him and he says don't worry it's been taken care off. 
My goodness people if this is how you run a business there won't be one there for long. Needless to say we will never come back and give this 10 thumbs down.

My co-worker and I have been anxiously waiting for this to open since the signs went up a couple of months ago.  It was well worth the wait!

I'm really happy to have so many amazing lunch options in Sherwood Park these days and Via Cibo is a welcome addition.

If you have been to D'Amore's Mercato in Edmonton on 99 street, it is somewhat similar, but without the market.  You order from the counter, pay, and then sit and wait for them to bring your order to you.

I went in on November 3, 2015.  It was their 3rd day being open and the staff were all incredibly friendly and knowledgeable on their offerings.  They were great at answering our questions, and making suggestions.

I went with the Prosciutto Piadina.  A Piadina is a flatbread that is then folded - so you end up with a sandwich type, but without the heavy bread aspect (although they do have paninis as well if that's more your style!).  At $12, I thought it might be a little steep, but once I saw how much prosciutto was on there, I quickly changed my mind.  The bread was soft, the meat was flavourful and the cheese was perfect.  I have no complaints with this dish.

My co-worker got the arugula salad and added steak.  I was really impressed with how much steak was on there!  She said it was tasty, but did wish that there were more roasted seasonal veggies included (we counted 3 or 4 pieces of roasted peppers).

I'm really excited to try out more things on the menu!  Honestly... I can't wait to get back.  The Tuscan fries are probably next on my list.

Will not be back.  Go to Home Depot.  Reasons:
1) Will not price match.  Will say they get it from a different supplier and deny price match (like a cheap electronics store).  I was making request where difference was less than a dollar ($1) on two separate items so thought it was no big deal...it was.  Furthermore, the manager refused to come talk to me to discuss it.

2) Terrible quality lumber.  Terrible.  I appreciate there is going to be twisted lumber on a pile, but there lumber is noticeably worse than anywhere else I go.  I actually had them bring down a pallet to try and find better quality, and then watched them (twice, on separate occasions) put all the terrible wood back (like boomerang terrible) on top so you have to keep digging deeper and deeper to get at anything even remotely decent.  And it's MORE expensive than Home Depot.

3) Store is actually quite small.  It is smaller than their standard store (like in South Common), meaning less available products and supply (& it seems higher prices).

Went to branches for lunch on a Sunday afternoon. My only serious critique that day would be the service. I think in total, we had about 5 different servers helping us. One took our drinks order, another came back to check if we had ordered, then another brought us our food, different one for our drinks.. it was so confusing. The table of guests next to us had issues too. I overheard one server say it was because of the shift change. 
In any case, I had the Asian salad which was delicious, but lacked actual lettuce. The pesto chicken flat bread was very good but I don't remember actually tasting chicken? I also had their basil lemonade which was awesome. Their Caesar cocktail was mentioned as very good but I felt it was pretty average.
Most of the experience was lovely as the location of this cafe cannot be beat. It's the perfect place to take friends and family for a unique experience.
I will be back to try different things on their menu and I hope I'm not there during the shift change!

Love this place! Been here three times now. Love love love the rose shrimp and pasta. Every bite is delicious. The decor here is simple but nice. All the pizzas I've tried have been flavorful. The picante pizza is the perfect amount of spicy. The Stella and Nutella dessert was something different and I loved it paired with a latte. A suggestion: maybe don't start sweeping and mopping while people are still eating

Smashburger is quite the Jekyl & Hyde burger joint. Do the pros out weight the cons? 3 stars is an accurate reflection of what they do.

So it's an American company that has both franchise/corporate locations. (The Sherwood Park location is a franchise) The reason I bring this up is because they use American Corn Finished Beef in their burger patties. I find that hard to accept even though they explained the reason is due to the consistency of flavour across all their locations. They also fly their buns in from Chicago, IL. I didn't hear why but I'm sure that there is a local bakery that would be able to make a similar, if not identical, product. 

Now they do a few things very well. Shoestring fries herbed with rosemary and truffle oil shows a level of finesse that you wouldn't expect from a burger joint. I would buy that and their Yam Fries again and again. Also their price point for the portion sizes are quite reasonable. 

Finally I would strongly urge anyone reading NOT to get the saskatoon berry milkshake. It has no berry flavour and the texture of the berry peels is not appealing. A few suggestions to improve this shake would be to blend it more so that there is no berry skin plugging up the straw and adding a saskatoon berry syrup or another berry.

I'd go back if I happened to find myself in Sherwood Park but I probably wouldn't drive there just for a burger.

I had been craving Smashburger's Jalapeno Baja burger & Haystack Onions for about 10 days. We ordered takeout a few days ago and it did not disappoint. Typically I can only consume one-half of a Smashburger burger but that evening ate every single bite. De.li.ci.ous!!!

First visit was for lunch. It was a little confusing understanding the layout but a simple salad and meatballs was ok. Decided to convince my husband (who is from Italy) and son to go for supper. Our overpriced meal cost $83. My son's food was undercooked. My husband's food was just disgusting. And mine was nothing they explained it would be. I had the chicken pesto sandwich. I asked if it could just be served over garlic toast and they said they don't have garlic toast. After some back and forth they convinced me to take it as it comes. None of our food came out at the same time. The staff behind the counter were incredibly rude and impatient when we asked questions about the food. Our waitress argued with us about my sons pasta being undercooked. She said its cooked al dente. This was not. It was still hard!! I told her that was not al dente and she insisted it was because "her parents have been to Italy" WOW!! I told her my husband was FROM Italy and asked for our bill. My husbands meal was served with garlic toast. I asked the waitress why they told me they don't have garlic toast. She said they don't have it for the chicken pesto. Beyond frustrated! All of our food remained on the plates uneaten. After being treated the way we were, having been served the horrible food and the staff not showing a care in the world it was hard handing over $83. But to never have to deal with these people again, maybe it's money well spent.

Its always exciting to find a hidden gem Patio and Branches in Sherwood Park is definitely a garden oasis worth checking out!

We stopped in for a late afternoon meal and throughly enjoyed our experience.  

The quiet music in the background pairs nicely with the flowing stream and waterfall that skirts the plant filled Patio.  From your Patio seat you can take in the lush greenery that the Greenland Greenhouse backdrop provides.  

Cristina had the Rhubarb mojito and loved it while I enjoyed some Alley Kat draft beer.

Food was great and the staff was attentive and friendly.  A great Patio for a intimate date night!


Ambiance: 9/10

Food and Drink: 8/10

Staff and Service: 9/10
Well prepared food, comfortable environment- I really like coming here but it's so crowded from 11:30 to 1:00 and often short waits. I usually end up going somewhere else.

I was really excited to eat here because I love Italian. And I was so excited when I saw they had gnocchi. I found the layout a bit confusing initially but quickly figured it out. Service was friendly. However I found my food rather flavorless and on the mushy side. Maybe there's better options to try but with some of the great other options on the area I'm in no hurry to return here.

Just had brunch at Branches and it was so good! Started with an egg nog latte which was super tasty. So happy the season is upon us! My friend had a regular latte and she loved it as well. They only have a few things to choose for food but they all looked scrumptious. I ended up going with their breakfast bowl that had potatoes, peppers, onions, chorizo, ham, eggs, green onion cakes and a hollandaise sauce! It was perfectly proportioned and tasted marvellous. My friend had these tortillas with fruit and yogurt. Everything was great. Couple with the fact that you're surrounded by the beauty of the greenhouse. They're currently decorated for the Christmas season which is something to see. As we were there on Remembrance Day, they also paused everyone at 11 for a moment of silence which I really appreciated. The service was good and the ambiance is just relaxing. I totally recommend checking out this cafe!

Neat little pasta/pizza place. Upon entering you select from starters, sandwiches, pizzas and pastas. You place your order at the first till and continue down the line past the open kitchen! Really neat to see you food prepared. At the second till you order your drinks and dessert ( even gelato!) and pay. 

Choose a table ( seating is tight!) and place the number you received on it. The order is brought to your table. 

Ordered the Lasagna and Pasta Al Ragu Ossobuco. Both had fantastic flavour, portion size was good and we really enjoyed it. Do NOT order the poutine - one slice of cheese is not enough.  Can't wait to head back and try the other dishes!

This place has some of the best service I have ever experienced. My wife and I were looking for a new 1/2 ton truck and were undecided on which make to go with. The sales rep, Anthony, got us to test drive 3 different trucks between his GMC dealership and the Chevrolet dealership down the road. He was so easygoing and genuine as well as knowledgeable. We really appreciated that Anthony and the rest of the staff helped to find the right vehicle for us!

Delicious, had the braided Beef and polenta. The beef was perfectly cooked and swimming in polenta.  The staff were exceptionally friendly and helped describe menu items. Neat self-serve soda fountain.  Gelato samples! All sauces made in house.
Had a massage here and did not like it. They were unprofessional and frankly a bit awkward as well. Will not be back, found a better place!

I ordered delivery order through skip dishes today because I was craving sweet stuff. When I first opened the take out which were red velvet and kids chocolate pancake, it looked plain and sad but taste matters more than presentation when it comes to take outs. But unfortunately, it didn't taste good either. The pancakes were dry and room temperature warm. This is my second time ever trying Ihop in my entire life and it sucks that they cannot make their signature pancakes delicious... i understand if I ordered their their burger set or something but this place is known for pancakes ....Anyhow it was edible so i ate most of it. I would not recommend this place at all.

I love Starbucks, yes I do!

What I don't love is that I cannot as of yet redeem my Starbucks rewards on my smart phone app inside a Starbucks Target :-(

Beautiful patio!

Keep in mind Happy Hour from 4-6, Monday to Wednesday!

Ordered the Ricotta Fritters. The tomato jam they are served with is fantastic. The fritter itself does not have any flavour and there is so little cheese in it. 

The spinach salad is very tasty, but for $12.00 the portion is very small. Added a chicken breast for an extra $4.00. 

Fish Tacos- DO NOT ORDER.  These tasted terrible. Very sour, like something was off. Was able to salvage some of the taco to eat. 

Tiramisu was average. Take it or leave it.

Had the shrimp pad thai,  pineapple fried rice, and beef pad prik khing. Flavors of all were OK. The pad thai only had 4 shrimp & the pineapple fried rice had 3 shrimp so I didn't feel they were worth the price ($17 & $16). The beef pad was good but was a very small portion.

I would not recommend Azia. I got eyelash extensions and by the next morning my eyes were infected. I went back and had the eyelashes removed within 36 hours my eyes were swollen shut. I asked for a credit back and all she gave me was $40. 
I asked if myself and my 2 daughters could get free gel nail polish instead. We went in and she still charged us and outrageous amount. I would never go back or recommend here.

A co-worker of mine was recently raving about the cakes and desserts he obtained from a place called Wow Factor Desserts in Sherwood Park.

I have a major sweet tooth, so I simply had to head down there and check it out myself.

Wow Factor Desserts, is in fact a large factory that produces dozens upon dozens of desserts for high end restaurants in the Edmonton area, desserts for special big-wig events and they also have a retail section at the factory where you can go and purchase individual desserts by themselves.

Just because it is a dessert factory doesn't mean the product is mediocre by any stretch.  On the contrary, the taste and quality here is leaps and bounds ahead of any desserts I've ever tried elsewhere.

Here's some mini reviews of some of the desserts I've tried:

Triple Chocolate Cake:  A rich, moist chocaholics dream come true.  Two layers of cake separated by delicious icing.  Sweet, but not over powering.  (They also have a chocolate cake here that is SEVEN layers thick and about SIX inches high!)

Apple Pie:  Can you believe an apple pie that is TWO inches thick?  And this monster is as tasty as it is big.

Carrot Cake:  Good gawd almighty!  This is the best cake of any kind I've ever had in my life.  A rich, moist and delicious cake covered in the most amazing icing.  At 600 calories a slice, you can kiss your diet goodbye.  Boy, oh, boy this dessert is straight from heaven.

All their desserts are sold in a frozen state in large boxes. Most are 12" across.

All the cakes and desserts are already pre-cut and the slices are separated with wax paper, which is super convenient and avoids messes.

They also have a large selection of cheese cakes if that's your thing.

Be warned though.  These desserts are not cheap.  Were talking $30-$40 a dessert here.  But you pay for what you get, and these are high-end desserts.  But hey, you only live once.  Why not treat yourself to something truly good every once in a while?

Wow Factor is an apt name for this place.  I can guarantee you'll be saying "Wow!" after you try their outstanding desserts.

If you have a sweet tooth and haven't tried Wow Factor Desserts yet, I suggest you get your ass down to Sherwood Park and check'em out pronto.

Yeah, okay, it's a bit of a drive, but it's worth it. Hear me out.

Park Veterinary Center is a nice, friendly veterinary clinic, situated on the edge of Sherwood Park. The front-desk staff is pleasant, and the doctors are both knowledgeable and skilled.

But the real thing of note here isn't a thing, it's a person: Dr. Theresa Bousquet.

Dr. Bousquet is a specialist in exotic pets. As a hedgehog owner, I can vouch for her knowledge, and her compassion for her little - and often strange - patients. She is also brought in as a consultant for the Edmonton Humane Society when exotics are in need of care. Dr. Bousquet comes HIGHLY RECOMMENDED to any other Edmonton-area hedgehog owners, and to the owners of other exotic animals.

My only criticism is longish wait-times - not unlike a regular medical clinic, here. The staff at Park Vet can get swamped during the day, so if your appointment was for, say, 3PM... don't expect to see your vet until closer to 4.

Very helpful!  Needed to have a Maintenance Plan transferred to myself after purchasing a vehicle privately.  When I went in to Capital GMC to have this done, they said they couldn't do it and gave me 1-800 number to call GMC directly.  Called the number and they told me I needed to have a dealer sign the transfer and then I would have to fax it in.  So went to a Sherwood Buick GMC to get the signature as it was closer to work.  They took the transfer paperwork and processed the transfer for me while I was there.  Should have come here initially...would have saved me an extra trip and a lunch hour.  Guess where I'll be going to have my service work done in the future.

This usually our stop point after a good gym workout on the weekends. In the past we've always had good service and I personally LOVE that I can have a gluten free egg Benedict. However, we went and we weren't served or even asked if we wanted water for 15 minutes. We ended up asking someone's else's party if this had been the service all night and they said yes. We ended up leaving the restaurant starving and wasn't even asked anything as we were leaving after being sat 15 mins earlier. We ended up driving down the road to the other Denny's in Sherwood park and had wonderful service.

The atmosphere of Branches is lovely as it's inside Greenland Garden Centre.  It is very busy on the weekends though during my recent visit at 1pm on a Saturday, there was no wait.  Presumably, as spring and summer approach, so will the usual wait for a table.

My reason for giving 2 stars is that the food is really overpriced and everything is pre-made in the morning so cannot really be customized to accommodate a dietary restriction.  In some cases the restriction can be accommodated, just depends on what the restriction is.

I recently had their version of a Ceasar salad, which they call the 'grilled romaine salad'.  It is priced at $14 and consists only of a bit of romaine lettuce, a few capers, a bit of grated parmesan cheese, and a drizzle of dressing.  That is a fairly bare bones salad for $14.  To add chicken was another $6 and it was maybe half a chicken breast, if that.  

Also, the wait for our food was really long, which struck me as odd as everything is premade in the morning so really shouldn't take that long to be served.

The food looked nice. Their fries were crispy and delicious. The chicken brioche burger was really weird. The beef dip was burnt. Root beer float cake was dry af. And the taramisu was wet? Idk for the price we paid for the meal I would have expected more.

Ice cold beer goes so great with a nice order of hot wings. I really liked their "buffalo style" wings -a different twist on what you normally think of when it comes to hot wings. And their bleu cheese dressing is to DIE for -great big chunks of cheese mixed in with a super creamy dip. Heaven. LOVE IT!

Tried this place out for a pedicure. 

First off the girls were were super polite and nice. Water temperature was good. However there was no buffing or callus removal done. No massage either. My feet are in the same rough, dry shape now as they were when I showed up for the pedicure. Now I'm out money and have to go elsewhere to get my feet re-done. Super disappointed and will not be returning.

The Crave It Restaurant Group that brought Burger's Priest to Edmonton in March has brought Via Cibo, an Italian fast-casual restaurant, to Sherwood Park. This is the third Via Cibo to open in Canada, with the other two locations being in Calgary and Toronto. The restaurant opened it's doors on November 1st, and I had the opportunity to check it out on opening day. 

Via Cibo occupies a fairly large space off of the busy Baseline Road in a great location that is easily seen while driving by. The space is clean, modern, and designed to be a quick dining option. As you walk in, you're greeted by the large menu boards behind the counters and a staff member at the register. After placing an order, you are given an order number and lead past the open kitchen to a beverage station before finding a seat in the restaurant. I love this self-lead form of service in casual restaurants, as each experience is tailored to your needs. Whether you're in to grab a quick bite to eat, or planning to spend time sitting down for a longer meal, the servers are available when you need them, and they're not rushing you with constant visits to the table either. 

To start off our meal we had an order of the Tuscan Fries ($5) which are tossed with a mixture of rosemary, sea salt and truffle oil before being topped with a light shaving of Grana Padano Cheese. The fries were golden and crisp and the spicy garlic aioli gave the fries a nice punch. Although the rosemary tended to overpower the delicate truffle flavour with most bites, the fries were a nice little snack I would order again. 

Next to arrive at our table was the Broccolini and Sausage Penne ($14) that was recommended to us. All pasta options on the menu (with exception of the gnocchi) can be served with your choice of penne or linguine, and gluten free options are available too. Pasta used at this location is brought in dry from Italy and cooked al dente. Our dish featured broccolini, house made Italian sausage and the pasta tossed in a chili garlic olive oil, tomato sauce and was topped with Grana Padano. The pasta had a good portion of toppings and was fairly portioned for the price. 

At Via Cibo all the sandwiches (there are 5 available) are constructed between housemade calabrese bread. We tried the Ossobuco Panino ($14), because who can resist fall of the bone braised veal? The meat is combined with caramelized onions, arugula, provolone cheese and roasted garlic aioli. The sandwich may not look like much, but the tender meat was well seasoned and gave the sandwich a punch of flavour to contrast the sweet onions. The bread was soft, but I would have preferred for it to be slightly toasted for some added crunch. 

Last but not least came the Prosciutto E Arugula Pizza ($15). Prosciutto and arugula are two of my favourite toppings on pizza, so I just had to order this one. Via Cibo uses prosciutto, arugula, Fior Di Latte, slow roasted tomatoes, Grana Padano and a fig-infused balsamic reduction on their version. While I didn't like that the prosciutto on the pizza was cooked (I prefer mine just cured), there was a fair portion on the pizza along with the other ingredients. The crust to the pizza was thin, but held itself together well structurally, meaning that it didn't fall apart or become mushy from the toppings. According to one of the operating partners, the staff are trained to place a majority of toppings towards the outside of the pizza so as not to put too much moisture or weight on the middle. So that's the trick! The crust was evenly cooked with some blistering, and I would be open to trying some of the other options. 

When it comes to sweets, Via Cibo has brought Calgary's Fiasco Gelato on board to offer 10 different gelato flavours to customers after their meals. Flavours will rotate from time to time, and it's great to see that Via Cibo is supporting a great Albertan gelato maker! 

Via Cibo is a great addition to the lineup of dining options out in Sherwood Park, and I'm sure people are welcoming it with open arms! The service was friendly, food came out quickly, and the food was both tasty and affordable. Catering options are available too, so it will be a nice option to change up the usual office lunches! A second location is set to open soon in South Edmonton Common, but in the meantime, stop by the Sherwood Park location for a traditional piadina and a little taste of Italian street food.

I was the only one there which made me a bit wary but man am I glad I went ahead and ordered. They have weekday specials so my pizza was only 8.00$ and it was delicious! The chairs were super comfortable and the music they had playing was relaxing; I could have lounged here all day. The decor was modern industrial with lots of metal accents. I was in a hurry as I was on my lunch hour and my pizza was out in under 10 minutes, great service. One of the better places to eat in Sherwood park.

A cafe in a garden centre!  My, times have changed.  Busy indoor outdoor cafe that is good for brunch.  Massive garden centre with a lot of parking.  The food is very good and bistro style with the fancy dishes.  Prices are reasonable.  Get there early or you won't get in. They are licensed and have cocktails too.  Patio overlooks the perennials and shrubs.  Nice.
Excellent food! Great service! Very happy with all of my experiences here. Definitely coming back. This state and main is way better than the one at Southgate Centre in Edmonton.

If it were up to my husband, this place would get 2 stars because you have to walk through a year-round Christmas store to get to this restaurant ;)  Located inside the Greenlands Garden Centre (aka Alberta's largest year-round Christmas store) just off Clover Bar road north of the Yellowhead, Branches is a higher-end cafeteria-style restaurant that is definitely worth a visit if you're passing by Sherwood Park.

The restaurant is at the back of the store, with 2 main seating areas adjacent to the kitchen/ordering counter, and a greenhouse-type patio with bright high ceilings.  The latter area is slightly more noisy as it directly opens into the rest of the store.  As you enter, it can be a bit confusing.  As you enter and pick a table, flip over a card saying your table is reserved, and then go up to the counter to order.  We stood in the ordering line for a bit without a table, but we eventually figured it out.  You give the cashier your table number as you order, and your meal is brought out to you

The food is fresh and tasty.  Maybe a few dollars overpriced (not somewhere you'd go every day for lunch), but worth it.  It was around $30 for lunch for the 2 of us, not including drinks.  I had the Apple White Cheddar Panini, which is a glorified but super tasty grilled cheese (it's on sliced multigrain bread) with apple, arugula, onion chutney, and dijon mayo.  Sandwiches come with a side of soup (I had the Butternut squash - pretty decent), salad (fruit, kale, pasta or greek), or fries.  My husband loved the Breakfast flatbread (he even called it 'exceptional'... which is a pretty big feat considering he was sitting in a Christmas store!)- a flatbread roasted in the wood oven with scrambled egg, cherry tomato, hollandaise, ham and green onion.  There are tons of other appies, sandwiches, pizza, quiche, a handful of main dishes, and desserts, of course!  Regarding drinks, they have wine and beer, lots of nonalcoholic options, and seasonal specialty drinks.

On weekday evenings 4-6pm, they have Happy Hour specials, and a "Date Night" special on Tuesdays 6-8pm with an appetizer, salads, wood fired pizza, desserts and wine for 2, for $50.  I will definitely pop by for a repeat visit next time I'm in the area - definitely my favourite place I've tried in Sherwood Park!

I cannot say enough good things about this wonderful clinic and the care all animals and their owners receive.  Dr. Kwantes saved our parrot and has looked after my guinea pigs for seven years through all the trials and tribulations they have gone through.  He has personally called me many times at home to check on my little critters and he is terrific, knowledgeable and so caring.  Being an exotic vet has to be a challenge and he is so good at what he does and he is the only one I trust to care for my animals.  Great vet, great place and they care!  No hesitation in recommending this clinic to anyone, you will love them all!

They arrived about 20 minutes late, which in the time-frame we had was a pretty big deal, but not the end of the world. They were polite, came and assessed our belongings, and immediately got to work. We had done all of our own packing, so it was just moving things. 

They were careful with our belongings (we haven't finished unpacking yet but we didn't witness anything to make us concerned) and took their time in the hallways of our condo building which I appreciated. 

They arrived at our new place about 20-30 minutes after we did (they had to finish packing up the truck and obviously drive slower than us), and immediately began bringing things up. They took a small lunch break partway through the day, which they included in our total time. I wasn't sure how I felt about paying for them to take a break (at $100 an hour) but they worked hard and I just factored that in when I tipped them. 

We have an awful lot of stuff, so the total of 6.5 hours didn't seem unreasonable. I was expecting it to be a couple hours faster, but they did work hard and I can't really find any fault with what they did. 

I would likely hire them again, movers can be really dodgy and these guys were pretty good. All of my things made it (I think!) and there were no last minute hidden fees or surprises.

If running on empty and need a serious meal to fill up. This is not a spot to sop at. Did that today and had to spend more then one would like to in order to find my fill.


  The burgers over hangs the bun all the way around making sure you get an all beef bite with no bun for a first bite. Is that a thing I am
Missing? someone please let me know 

  The taste is not bad. Falling apart burger patty is a little on the not so friendly side. 

   For the medicated, to much money spent. A second trip to the till for another burger is alarming. The fries may be good but they won't fill what's left after the burger.
Friendly service, great food with authentic flavours, a gem in Sherwood park! Their Penang curry is my favourite!

Usually this place runs smoothly.  I should know with 90 year old parents that see the doctor upstairs frequently. Today, with Samantha running the show, it was a different story. I show up with my folks, one using the other's wheelchair as a walker, i am told it will be an hour. I ask for mercy as its been a long day and we live way out of town, but i dont expect any.  Samantha firmly states that it will be about an hour and its up to us if we want to wait. Ok, we'll grab s coffee and be back in half an hour. We arrive back in less than half an hour and find our name on the bottom of the list. Apparently their names were just called. Great! That means we're next, right? NO. Samantha rudely informs us it was our decision to leave and now we stay on the bottom of the list. In the ensuing hour, she proceeds to jam up the label machine again (she did it earlier) and admits to losing a requisition she copied for another patient who came to the desk to ask why she isnt on the screen and has been waiting an hour. It's a good thing 90 year olds enjoy spending their waning uears in waiting rooms (attempted sarcasm).

Beaners is a haircut place for toddlers, they have chairs made out of plastic vehicles like pink Barbie keeps and police cars.the cars themselves look like they need a refresh as they are pretty beaten up. All the stickers are really worn out. I don't think the kids care, but when you're paying close to $20 for a toddlers hair cut, they should be amazing, not just good.
It's way too crowded for my liking because they are also having a birthday party here today.

Checked out  Via Cibo on Tuesday evening. Got there for 7 and was easily able to get a table. I ended up getting the bruschetta and their beet and goat cheese salad. Both were pretty good. One of the pieces of bruschetta had soooo much pepper on it but other than the one piece, it was quite tasty. My friends all got pasta which they enjoyed. They do have gluten free pasta as well which was awesome for my one friend! They have a limited drink menu. Saw that they had cappuccinos so I had assumed that they would have hot chocolate but they don't. For my meal (no drink) plus a tip, my bill was $25. I am sure I will be back again!

It's a meat shop hidden in a strip mall.  It is just east of the Liquor Store. Very personable staff and helpful.  Not that big inside but they have sausages and bison burgers and interesting things like haggis in the frozen section.  Beef ribs too!

It's been a long time since Pizza Hut meant a special sit down family dinner with ice cream afterwards, I have a lot of nostalgia when it comes to Pizza Hut but let's be honest their actual pizza can be really hit or miss. That being said I've ordered pizza from this location a few times now and so far I've been pleased every time. I enjoy their stuffed crust and they often have some worthwhile specials.

Ordered a common item for in-store pickup in the morning so that I can grab it while running errands at lunch (to save some time). Did not get the confirmation until a few hours later. Did not get the pick-up confirmation until the next day. 

Note the guidance for in-store pickup (from the Lowe's website):
"Your item(s) will be available for pick up within 2 hours of placing your order on Lowes.ca during normal store operating hours. "

Made a complaint - someone called me and avoided answering why it wasn't ready or if this was a service that could be relied on in the future. Have not have issues with in-store pickup with competitors like Canadian Tire or Home Depot. Why bother offering the service and quoting specific time-frames if neither work?

Would NOT recommend this company to anyone to move. They changed my move time to accommodate another customer. The two men were almost an hour late, moved a couple boxes then took their lunch break.
Mine was a small move, they called me saying GPS wouldn't help them find the place.
Very unprofessional, never again!
Long wait only to be put in a room with dirty needles and bloody gauze on both sides of the bed

I got the Yelp app just so I could post a review. I thought I would take my daughter to a special place to get her hair done. It was supposed to be special, but for the price of the package (approx $38), I expected professional service. I guess the biggest problem I have is that the woman combed my daughter's hair down, and using around 5 or 6 snips, cut her hair at the length we had agreed on. She did not pin it up and cut it in sections. I have NEVER seen that done in a hair salon before. I was in such shock that I didn't say anything. I think I just kept thinking, "This can't be it. It can't." But it was. I feel like I was treated like an idiot who doesn't know any better. But it is people like me that, if they don't say anything, keep these people in business.  Yes, she was friendly. Yes, the place was fun for kids. But for $38, heck, for $15, I expect a professionally done haircut. I will never go back.

WOW! This place is such a delightful hidden gem! They have been around for quite a few years, 20 some I think I was told, and cater for businesses mostly it sounds like but they do offer to walk in's as well. Sounds like their cakes should be ordered before you just stop in. Their cakes are made in house and I would love to check out and get a tour of their facility one day. And their front staff were super lovely and friendly. Plus a bonus is they have their own parking and lots of it! 
I stopped in for their open house and they had a delicious display and samples available. That sold me on purchasing some of their tasty morsels! Who could resist a festive rum & eggnog cheesecake? They have some super open house special deals so if you need a dessert hit this place up! 
I got the thrifty cakes, which are the imperfect ones knocked back in price- they taste amazing so I don't mind what they look like! Sampled the carrot cake, which I had heard some raving reviews about, and hot dang they got a good carrot cake! Shredded coconut, pineapple, cream cheese icing! Super drool! I picked up the festive candy cane mouse for my GF friend, which was super lovely to hear that some of their most popular items are gluten free. Not so much available options for the diary intolerant people so be wary of that! 
But skimming through their book they have some really neat cakes and presentation- like a baklava cake, or the Mayan pyramid cake! 
Enjoy a sweet treat from Wow! Factor Desserts I know I will definitely be back here again!
We got a pizza delivered to us last night by Noel! She was quick and friendly! We were really happy to get our pizza hot and quickly. Would for sure order again!

I went with a dear friend and her daughters for lunch today at branches. The food was delicious as usual and the service was excellent. They have an issue with flies.
