I spent my whole meal swatting them off my body, my table, and fanning my food to keep them away. All four of us noted the large number of flies. It really takes away from a dining experience. I've eaten there before and I will eat there again. But likely not until winter if they can't get the flies under control.

Always great service and always leaving your wallet on the floor of the service department. 

I have used this dealership for initial assessments numerous times($89.25 to diagnose) but I have only actually used them to repair my GM's three times. The price is just too outrageous to ignore. I was quoted $2200.00 to replace my air pump and one air bags on the bags of my air ride suspension Envoy. I found the parts online for a fraction of that price then I found a conversion kit to make it spring coils and got it done for $300.00(I asked them if they could do it and they said no, with a sneer smile) My oil pressure sensor went and the charged me $89.25 for diagnosis, 106.14 for the part(That I found online for $32) and $386.75 for the labor. When I googled it, all you have to do is disconnect two fuel hoses and remove a few parts. When I asked them they said that GM doesn't recommend not following their specs for replacement and labor. 

I would get a great backyard mechanic and use them for all things out of warranty. If it's in warranty, Petersen is a good choice... otherwise you better be of the Grey poupon mustard and caviar eating type...

Visited branches this week. I love that it is located inside Greenland Greenhouse! Unfortunately, this is likely the source of their significant fly problem. Multiple big juicy flies live in the restaurant. They kept dive bombing our food when we were trying to eat it. These flies are not shy and like to buzz around in your face and land on your fork mere inches from your mouth. They do not go away easily! Despite varying degrees of mad arm flapping and curse words these buggers stick around for the whole meal. This totally turned us off eating. For dessert we had the bread pudding and it was dry AF. Even with the caramel sauce and cream it was difficult to swallow. I don't think we will return. Shame though.

These guys were AWESOME.  Used them twice in a week to consolidate two places into one shared new place.  Once of the moves was local, the other from Calgary.  Their rates were very good, their guys showed up exactly on time and they treated all our belongings with lots of respect.  Not a single thing broke and not a single scratch on a wall.

They were fast, very friendly and we couldn't be happier.  Moving services certainly isn't something we need often, but if we ever need a move again or have people we know wanting a mover - we wouldn't hesitate to recommend these guys.

I've been here a couple times since discovering that Denny's took Waffles off the menu. Each time the service has been great, we've always had great servers. The food has always been yummy too. I mean it's a diner so if you go in with reasonable expectations I can't imagine you'll be disappointed. This is my new go to waffle place. Also the cheesecake pancakes are so yummy!

OH. MY. GOD! What a great work out I had tonight at UFC Gym! The staff were very friendly and helpful in getting me organized. I took part in a promotional cross fitness session. We immediately started a warm up running laps, walking squats, rotating our arms and finished off with a nice jog. We then worked on our abs doing a sequence of planks and sit ups for about 3 minutes. Once that was done, we were given a demonstration of the various exercises we would be doing utilizing their equipment switching every 30 seconds. They had us jumping, climbing rope, doing squats and pushups on a balancing ball, toe taps, high knees, throwing medicine balls, using the punching bag, more squats while holding 8 lb, 12 lb and then 16 lb weights. After that, we did short sprints to 4 different pilons and at each pilon you had to do 4 sit ups or 4 pushups. Oh and they threw in another ab workout in the middle of that just in case we were bored (major sarcasm there). :P

It was great though! I love being pushed and encouraged to go further than I think I can and that definitely happened. If I didn't know what I needed to do with the equipment, the staff were right there to help me. I would say we got a nice sampling of what the UFC Gym has to offer.  They also offer various classes like kick boxing, jiu-jitsu, and boxing-sparring and some of these classes are open for women or kids/youth only. I may take one of their kick boxing classes....once I recover from this workout.

Food is great and staff are friendly. Would have given them a 5 star if their menus was up to date. They have an eggplant stir fry on their lunch menu, but I've been told the numerous times I've been in that it's no longer available

Always a great experience when coming here. Been here several times (I don't even live in Sherwood Park). Quality of food is really good so I don't mind paying a bit more even though it has a casual dining experience. Their pasta is my all time favorite. Sauce is full of flavor. Pasta is cooked perfection and just the perfect amount. Tried their bruschetta also. Small portion but really good.  My family members tried the sandwiches which they said was tasty. Staff is friendly. Will be returning for sure.

So we finally decided to give this place another chance and it was awful! The shakes were watery and no flavour. The fries are no longer the thin, crisp but similar to McDonald's size. The burgers are very small. The kids meals we bough came out with unmelted cheese and when we asked to have it melted, they just threw the burgers back on the grill. We will not be visiting again

Our favourite Italian restaurant period. Fantastic value for money spent and the food is great. We've tried more than half the menu and every meal was perfect. The new owners/management should give themselves a pat on the back. Very well trained pleasant staff makes the experience perfect every time. Food comes quickly, even at peak times. 
For lunch: Prochiutto Piadina
For dinner: Mushroom fettuccine

Really love this place. First time I went here with my husband's family then my hubby and I went back again since everything was so delicious. I really love here. We only stayed in Edmonton for 5 nights otherwise we would have come back a lot.

I have gotten my nails done here on multiple occasions and they are awesome. I also get my eyelash extensions done here for the last year and a half and every girl is amazing at them. Their prices are awesome. I would recommend azia to anyone for eyelash extensions.

A beautiful facility that features health specialists of what seems like all types, a great little cafe, seating area, pharmacy and more! There seems to be ample parking ($2/day), it is a short walk from the Bethel Transit Station, and the public restrooms are clean and spacious to boot! Very easily navigated with a stroller, I was pleased with my visit here and will return.

I went to Branches on a lunch break last week and it was wonderful! They make almost everything in house and you can definitely tell. 

I had the shrimp with sweet Thai sauce, and the sauce was not that sweet orange sauce you usually get, it was spicy and flavorful and not too sweet. My friend tried the margarita pizza, and the tomato sauce was different than the usual bland sauce, it was so tasty.  We also tried the rhubarb mojito which again wasn't too sweet, just right and super refreshing. And we had to finish with one of the homemade desserts, so we tried the lemon tart and it was incredible!   

The setting is right in the garden area, so it's so nice to sit outside and enjoy a drink.   They host a few events each week, date night (2 drinks, an appetizer, a pizza and 2 dessert for $50), live music on Thursday and brunch on the weekend.  I'm excited to go back for one of these occasions.

My only complaint was that service took quite a while to first come to us and it's a little out of the way.

We went in on a Saturday afternoon. The place was very slow. When I got there I went straight to the restroom, both stalls were without TP but someone was servicing them so no big deal, I decided to wait for her to be finished by sitting at my table with my family. There were only 2 other tables in use. We sat there for over 10 minutes before I finally had to ask someone to help us and get us some water. She came over and took our order. The majority of our group ordered crepes and the rest ordered sandwiches. She came back and told us that they were out of crepe batter and couldn't help us. At this point I was annoyed and decided to leave. I told the manager about our experience and he didn't really have much feedback. I told him about everything and the fact that there was garbage all over the floor. As I was telling him this, another customer not in our party agreed that the service and restaurant was lacking. We went next door to Hops N Drops. Great service and food. Next time I'll ship IHop. So disappointing.
I just found out that I have a fungal nail infection courtesy of a set of gel nails I got from Azia. Won't be back.
The worst Pizza I've ever had.  And they found a way to make boneless wings gross.

I used to love this location a lot. The baristas in the morning were super friendly, the music was great, and I could get lots of writing done in the morning before work. Have even made some great acquaintances with all the regulars who are in every morning. 

But lately, it's been one thing after another. The music most of all. I don't know what they used to have, but they switched to the Sirius Coffeehouse Acoustic Mix, and I loathe it. If I have to hear Ed Sheeran doing the acoustic version of "I'm in Love With Your Body" one more time, I think I'll lose it. I usually have earphones, but somedays I forget. 

They've also brought in a Pinkberry stand, so that necessitated rearranging all the tables. That kind of annoyed me, since I'd sat at the same table for nearly a year. 

And then they took my favorite server off mornings. Small things, but they add up. Combined with the fact that I can't stand the "healthy" breakfast food options here, that means I'm eating way too many egg cheese and bacon wraps. I've had to start mixing it up with Starbucks again just to get some egg whites, turkey bacon, and fruit and yogurt parfaits, which are way better for me. I've already complained to HQ about that, but haven't seen much improvement. I'd really rather support a franchised Canadian company, so will continue to go in hoping things improve again.

I went here on a quick lunch break from work and had great service. They were fast at making the food and there wasn't a crazy line up. All the ingredients were fresh. I had the ground beef burrito with a side of fresh tortilla chips, queso and salsa. The only thing was the tomatoes that they put in the burrito had cilantro which is not my favourite!

This is the disneyland of Liquor stores. Huge selection! My fiancee likes a specific brand of vodka that he fell in love with in Ukraine. It's very hard to find, but they have it here! The selection is second to none. 

The only thing I was surprised at was the lack of mixes- I was making a christmas gift with a martini shaker, glasses, & vodka and wanted martini mix to go with it. No dice! However, the selection is so awesome that we will come back and make a trip elsewhere for the mix.

Stopped in for lunch on Sunday March 3rd at 1:30. We were cheerfully received, promptly seated, had a coffee within 1 minute and our orders taken. Great experience, delicious food, and fantastic service. We will be back.

I took myself into their emergency department after speaking with health link, I went in for respitory pain which was increased by deep breathing, coughing, or sneezing. When I arrived the nurse who took me in to do my blood pressure, heart rate and everything was beyond nice, honestly one of the nicest nurses I've ever met, after that I went to registration and the receptionist was also very nice. I thought it was a fluke and was expecting the rest of the staff on the Sunday night shift to be terrible, if you've ever been to the royal Alex you know exactly what I mean. But that wasn't so, the nurse who took me into the back was professional, epithetic, and all around very nice lady. Shortly after the doctor came in, she was very nice, explained everything to me step by step so I would understand... because I'm not in the medical field (aka a dummy lol) but she was not condisending at all, very friendly. After that I was given xrays and blood work and all the lab technicians and assistants were also very friendly. All in all every single person I dealt with was beyond nice, and to be completely honest if I ever need to go into emerg for anything ever again I will also choose this hospital..... or barrhead if I'm closer lol

On Friday January 25, 2019 my wife and I went to the Sherwood Park location.  The food we ordered was delicious.  This is the second time we been to Via Cibo since it's under new management and both times the food has been delicious and the service has been excellent.  The staff are very friendly.  The manager came to our table and asked us how the food was and the service.

I would highly recommend this restaurant for Italian food in Sherwood Park.

Super disappointed with the level of service. Have never been before and drove all the way from west Edmonton to take my toddler here for some indoor fun. Enjoyed the play area but could not believe the poor service. There were only 4 kids in the whole building, so it was not busy at all. When we first arrived, there was one blonde lady working and she quickly informed us that there were no hot meals. Which was not an issue at all since we didn't want to eat. About 30 minutes before they were closing, I asked for some change to get some tokens so I could play a game and my child could see the bright lights. This was a huge issue! She went on and on about how they were closing soon and that we are not allowed to bring our token last minute. They were closing in 30 minutes, etc. I wasn't even going to cash in my tokens. I could care of less about the prize. Unfortunately, she wouldn't stop. I own a business and if I had staff like this, I would fire them immediately. At the end of the day, a business is represented by its employees and she ruined my experience here and I will never come back nor recommend.

I took the Hubba Hubby here this summer as he was having some unexplained pain and we had a good experience from start to finish.

It's easy to get to as it's just off Yellowhead and Cloverbar so while it is on the North East side of Sherwood Park, it's accessible by major roads. And bonus, the parking is free here - which is awesome when you don't know how long you're going to be there for.

We found the hospital to be clean and bright and saw the cleaning staff often. It was quiet when we went - a Tuesday at 8am - so we got into a room fairly quickly to get looked at. 

The staff were all super friendly and the Doctor was really personable. After running multiple tests without being able to find anything, the Doctor came to chat with us about what he thought the pain could be, relating to his own personal experience with severe heartburn (which we think it was as it went away and it has never come back - knock on wood). We appreciated how empathetic he was and how relate-able the Doctor was. We truly felt like he tried everything he could and we were satisfied with the outcome.

As the "visitor", I appreciated how many plug ins I could find as my phone was quickly dying while I was working on it - and I wasn't about to unplug machines to plug in my phone (and my chargers were all dead). 

All in all, the Strathcona Community Hospital would likely be our hospital of choice as it is still so new, clean, and fairly quiet when we were there. Mostly though, we really appreciated the service we received and the empathy from all of those who looked after us at some point or another!

First Call came by our neighbourhood a knowing the age of the homes and that we were all 'due' to need replacement. I contacted them and they were very helpful - easily set up a convenient time to discuss and arrange the service at a very reasonable price. When the day came for the replacement they were neat, clean, and professional. They corrected some piping that had been done poorly by the water heater folks several years previously. The new furnace that was delivered had been damaged but they couldn't tell until it was in the basement and they started unpacking it. First Call immediately got the supplier to send out a new one. I had my new furnace and a cleaned up basement before 5:00 that day. I would recommend them to anyone asking. In fact, I just called them to service my AC and my gas fireplace.

This is an easy five star rating. We came for a Saturday brunch and to celebrate our twins turning 20. Three of us ordered breakfast bowls which are reasonable at $15.00. It was wonderful. There were delicious crispy green onion cakes in it so it was a combination fork and finger dish. The eggs were nice and runny like I prefer them and the flavours of the rest of the bowl worked so well together that all three of us were highly pleased.  I will probably order it again the next time we come here. You can choose between a meat version or vegetarian version. My son ordered the grilled cheese with lobster (he always picks the most expensive entree when I'm buying). At first It looked small for $17.00 but it was full of lobster and it filled him up.  My wife ordered the pizza  special and of course I tasted it. It was good but not as good as my breakfast bowl.  The coffee tasted very rich and we could have as many refills as we wanted.    Service was pretty good, not exceptional, but no serious complaints. Actually I think that they were training someone new and that's how you learn by doing. The washrooms were sparklingly clean and they cleverly route you past the desert display to reach them. As a result result, we ordered a Creme Brulee to share. I know that sharing one dessert for five people makes me look very cheap but honestly we all just wanted a couple of spoonfulls to taste it.   I should mention that Branches is inside a large greenhouse and gift shop.  Somehow I didn't realize this beforehand and drove right by it before being told emphatically to "turn around".   This is a wonderful place for Saturday brunch so I know we'll be back even though it's a bit of a drive from our Edmonton home. If you enjoy brunch as much as I do I highly suggest you make plans for Branches.

I have pay for maple syrup?! To add insult to injury, it's "American" maple syrup served in a small jar for .99 cents and NO Canadian available! My 1st time and last time. I will never support this American operation here. Hey Trudeau, time to impose import and tax/tariffs duties on IHOP for not using local but importing their own....fine....hit'em where it hurts Government of Canada!

I enjoy taking kids to this library, and they love the programs they run. However, some of the older staff are extremely rude and act like you are wasting their time when talking to them. My worst experience is that a malfunction in their system caused one of my books to become overdue. When I asked about it, I was told it wasn't their problem, and I should have returned my book earlier. They even refused to waive the $0.15 overdue fee! Seriously? Yes I can pay it, but why should I have to when the error was on their end.
I love the coffee selection. Service is okay.. very slow and sometimes grumpy. Unfortunate because second cup is great and it's the only location in Sherwood park!

Our favourite little taste of Thailand. We are excited to try everything on the menu since each item we've picked so far has been so satisfying. Every dish has all of the flavours you're looking for in Thai cuisine. We love ordering take out from here for nights when we don't feel like cooking but want some comfort food. The portions are large and the staff are so friendly! You won't be disappointed ordering from this family-owned local business.

This library is a good spot for young kids. There were enough activities to keep our two year old occupied. He enjoyed the Duplo table, and the metal bead mazes that were dotted around the Enchanted Forest, which is a section of the library on the main floor dedicated to young children. There's also a set of wodden bins with board books in them at just the right height for him, so he was able to pick out and read books himself.
There's also a small table that looks like a produce stand, where plastic and foam food items sit in buckets that the children can interact with.
There's also a set of 4 computers that I'm sure have child-friendly activities on them.
There is also a puppet theatre in a small but against the back wall which we didn't have time to play with but certainly looked interesting.

I was so happy to discover this place. I am so tired of going to places and telling them what I don't want on my chicken burger but end up paying for all of the unwanted toppings anyway.

Their grill chicken patties are huge and look like actual chicken. My favorite buns are the egg buns as they are so and not so bready. I also love the goat cheese topping.

I didn't care for their fries at first as I thought they were a little bland but the plain crispy flavour has started to win me over. When I am not sure what to eat I go there. The location isn't great but worth the drive.

Way back in the day when I lived in Sherwood Park, Greenland only had a little café for coffee and snacks. Now, there's a brand new full service restaurant, with lots of beautiful windows and live music.  We visited on a weeknight that had a discount on wine and it was packed.  We tried a taco pizza, which was surprisingly good and tasty, and we were able to sample some of the wine and beer they had available.  The night we visited, there was table service, and it was a little lacking. We watched as all the tables around us were served, and it was about 10 minutes before a server came to our table after we had been seated.  We wondered if we had been forgotten.  The rest of the evening was similarly slow, although I would definitely come back here for a causal bite.

Our server Sandy has worked here 22 years and honestly it's the best service at a restaurant, full stop, I have had in years. Extremely attentive, friendly and warm. It's rare these days to find someone who is great at their job, enjoys their job and takes pride in their work. Denny's, give this lady a raise!

Only complaint was the bathrooms, I know they must have just been cleaned because the floors were wet, but there was a very unpleasant smell. Otherwise they were clean and stocked.

The food was fantastic, we had almost 2 plates of food each for $13 a person. Such great food for the price. I'm going to keep this place in my back pocket, we will definitely be back!
Worst grooming ever!!!! My dog came home with a bruised bloodshot eye! They say they didn't do anything but he sure wasn't like that when I brought him in. Do not take your animals there!!!!!!

Used to always get takeout and it was really good. Just threw out pretty much my whole families order. My wife had chicken wings and they tasted horrible because their oil was old or something. I had the fish and chips and the same thing; not to mention it was actually overdone! Both my daughters did not want to eat their food either.  So I phone in and let them know what went on and the guy who I talked to just said thanks for letting me know.  Horrible business practice!! I am in a business that thrives on customer service; detonate fail!  You just lost my business and my free advertising!

I am a frequent customer and consistently pleased with the quality of meat (typically I get beef or bison).  It is far better than grocery store meat (& I would assume freshness has something to do with it, as despite giving the impression of cutting their own virtually all grocery stores do not any longer and have it shipped in which makes sense to keep their prices low).  

The store is clearly busy too, which is a good sign that product is turning over quickly which is also good for local farmers (& the local butcher).  On days when I arrive late and there is nothing left in the display, the butcher is always happy to cut more and there is something cool about getting a 'fresh cut' of meat the size I want.

Lastly, he has a number of local products (pierogis, burgers, and condiments (try them!!)).

Overall, great locally owned business that proudly supports other local small business and farmers.

Based on the staff bios I chose Kat for my first appointment. I am one of those clients who wants deep tissue massage and she delivers. Occasionally I need to let her know that the pressure is too much but overall she is excellent.  Kat is always prepared for our appointments by asking about previous areas of concern.  If I win the lotto one of my top wishes is a daily massage. Space is clean and organized. Hallway noise can be a bit distracting.  My rating is based mostly on the skill of my massage therapist and not necessarily the company.

I was introduced to this place after I interrogated my coworker about where she got this amazing cake while at a staff party. That was almost 10 years ago and based on how I was impacted by this sliced piece of perfection, I wanted a cake for my Birthday. 

My wife got this giant 4 layer chocolate cake that took me to a special place of pure bliss. I would give it a perfect score but there were a few notes to be aware:  
1. Hours of operation are really limited where they are closed on the weekends and outside work hours, making it hard to access.

2. Cakes come frozen, so you have to give at least 4 hours to thaw to be ready to serve.

3. Service was reasonable but not exceptional. It was like they didn't feel the need to entice our business and did bare minimum.

4. Cakes were enormous, one standard size, and intended for large gatherings so cakes are not customized for personal preference.

All that being said, the cake was amazing. One of the best cakes I've ever had and it was pre-made and frozen. The $50 cake seemed expensive but the cake was enormous, the taste was exceptional and we were able to re-freeze a large portion for future times when I need my chocolate cake fix.

Love this quiet, little authentic Thai restaurant. Service was fantastic, food was hot and bursting with flavours... We drive from Beaumont to experience fine Thai cuisine. One of our favourite restaurants.

This vet charges ridiculous fees and you can find the same services, with friendlier staff I might add, at other centres.

They tell you that your dogs medicine is 24 cents a mg (yes, 24 cents) and the cheapest thing on our bill was over $15.00.  The difference is the dispensing fee they charge for the 4 seconds it took someone to put 3 pills into a bottle with a label.  

Our dogs knee surgery was done at this center 18 months ago and the price was within reason.  But the fees for basic services have now gone through the roof.  And I couldn't believe they didn't ask us how the dogs knee is!  It was like they'd never seen my dogs before.  I felt like a stranger to them.  We had concerns 18 months ago when the dogs knee wouldn't fully heal.  The vet staff informed us we clearly didn't follow the post-op instructions and then they threatened "if you want to come back in to see a Doctor, you'll have to pay the exam fee."  There is no actual CARING about the dogs wellbeing and a desire to ensure my dog wasn't suffering needlessly.

Smash burger was a welcomed reminder of why I love me some united states.  I had a couple of burgers while visiting Edmonton this week.  My bbq bacon burger was the first that tasted like an American buger.

I went for Brunch this morning.  Shared the bread as Appetizer.  Excellent. Obviously freshly baked with a honey drizzle sauce. Delightful.  We had the breakfast bowl with peppers, onions, ham, Potatoes and sunny side up eggs and on the side onion cakes.  The Peppers and onions tasted like they came right from the greenhouse, to the pan, to my plate.  Delicious.  The potatoes perfectly cooked as were the Green onion cakes.  It was great. One of the best places I have had brunch in The Edmonton area.

First off, let me explain that Branches is a small bistro style restaurant inside the Sherwood Park Greenland Centre. Being inside a greenhouse provides quite the surreal ambiance for gardening enthusiasts. That is, if you like a little black fly with your soup. I'm not even joking with that.

How did I find myself in Branches you might ask? My bestie and I hadn't seen in each other in a long time. She suggested we spend the day shopping and find a new restaurant to try for brunch. She mentioned Branches, and I was keen to give the restaurant a try.

We got to the restaurant around 11:00 am on a Saturday morning. We were advised there would be a 30 minute wait and we gave our phone numbers to the friendly hostess.  We opted to go shopping while we waited for our phone call. 

It's worth it to note, that the restaurant is very small and the waiting area outside the restaurant is even smaller. I felt like I was in the way of shoppers. It is a good idea to make reservations ahead of time if you can. 

We wandered through the garden and had fun taking photos of flowers and checking out the latest arrangements. Prices for flowers & pots are far out of my range - I'm used to going to places like Home Depot for flower pots. Everything is super pretty and would make for great gifts for friends with green thumbs. But again, if you're watching your pennies and looking for budget friendly places - this greenhouse may not be for you.

At exactly 11:30 am, we were called to come back to the restaurant and opted for a table in the far side of the restaurant next to the patio. We soon realized our mistake - the area was swarming with large black flies. We made note for next time to sit outside. 

The food however, did not disappoint. We were disappointed that the shrimp appetizer we ordered was out of stock. Instead, we both tried the quiche and kale salad. The food was delicious, although, I felt prices were a little high for the portions received. I guess this is the new normal for "higher-end" restaurants.

All in all, our brunch at Branches, was a positive experience. But again, Branches isn't for everyone.

Branches isn't a place you'd want to go with a Friday night crowd or a first date. It's more the type of place you would take your mother for her birthday or your grandmother for a nice outing. Do give yourself plenty of time to wander through the "garden" and admire the beautiful array of flowers. And if you want to make the most out of the menu, arrive early so you have first pick of the day.

Went in asking them to look into a rear sensor issue. Was told by them it was going to be a minimum of $1300 to repair. I went home and in five minutes of watching a YouTube video I was able to repair the sensor issue myself with a $71 part from Napa. Be very careful out there.

Loved it. 

Allan G and I went to the Smashburger Yelp event, and were completely overwhelmed at the choices. First, I LOVE the Smash Fries, with olive oil, rosemary and sea salt. The sweet potato fries were good, but the thinly cut artsy fries were amazing. 

Out of all the burgers we sampled, I liked the BBQ ones and all, but the truffle mushroom one blew them all away for me. Savory, earthy, juicy, and seriously to die for flavor. I was less pleased with a chicken burger. It was good, but if I'm going to a place for a burger, give me the burger, not chicken. Seems like a cop out. 

The Saskatoon berry shake was meh, but I enjoyed the Oreo one. However, I still prefer the consistency of my blizzards at Dairy Queen. Thicker is better. 

Tom, the owner, was super friendly, and when he found out I was American too, joked with me a bit. Al had previously not enjoyed Alley Kat beer much, but actually found a variety he really liked. I'd gladly head out to Sherwood Park for more of the same.

I took my dog there after Mills Haven was being less than helpful. At Park, my dog saw a vet about a swollen eye. She told me it was a corneal ulcer and gave me some ointment. The ointment did nothing. She gave me drops. The drops helped with the redness and swelling a bit, but it did not fix the eye completely. She also performed some kind of swab on his third eyelid, without telling me about it. I also think it's pretty shady that they take your pet into the back where you can't see what they are doing. My dog came away from that vet with a clouded eye.
I took him to a new vet (Spruce Grove Vet Clinic) and the vet there was way more explanatory and actually interacted with my dog, instead of just walking in, grabbing his face and ruining his eye. The vet informed me that it was not a corneal ulcer, but entropion and he now has to go for surgery to correct this. The swabbing and lack of care from the vet at Park left my dog with untreated entropion that has clouded his eye permanently.
So regardless of what you hear in "good" reviews for this place, consider whether or not you're willing to risk having your pet permanently scarred due to their negligence. The only good reviews for this place seem to be for reptiles. So save your pet the pain and you the money, and find an vet that gives a shit. I recommend Spruce Grove Vet Clinic. It's a drive, but at least my dog isn't going completely blind under the care of the ignorant vets at Park.

I've purchased many different fruit "things" from here as gifts, and every single one of them has been beautiful and delicious. 

The BEST thing is the box of different chocolate covered fruit. SO Good.

Staff has always been very friendly and helpful. Service is quick, and theres always something ready in the cooler, in case you forgot to phone ahead and order. (I ALWAYS forget to phone in and order). 

I would give them 5 stars, but it's expensive.  :o)

Killing my insides and trying this pizza so you don't have to. 

Yesterday I saw the IG ad to try the Pizza Hut/KFC pizza colab. It's a Pizza Hut pizza with sweet corn, popcorn chicken with a KFC gravy base. If you are craving pizza... don't get this . It was okay tasting but definitely just tasted like you mashed a ton of stuff together on your fork and took a big bite, nothing about this pizza was pizza, accept the shape I guess. 

If you into trying new limited edition items restaurants launch then this is worth the try, otherwise save your money or order your favourite pizza combination.

I thought this was one of those run-of-the mill drive-thru basic burger places. 
Boy, I was wrong!
I got a couple of kids cheeseburgers which the little ones enjoyed.
We got the bacon brisket burger and the spicy Baja along with a side of smash fries.
The burgers were great, the fries were great as well! The fries had the right amount of saltiness, herbs and crispness. I would definitely like to try some more of their varieties.
The only downside was the 12 minute wait...but hey these were made to order and not waiting for me under a heating lamp; and moreover it was a Friday night, I guess I'll take the wait.

Tom the founder was explaining the concept of SmashBurger and it's quite the process. A man very passionate about burgers. 
Seven different recipes that are all on the menu, we are trying every one on the menu, this could be filling! 
They have feature beer and like to use local breweries. Alley Kat is the one of choice for this night, Aprikat is great with many. 
We are served samples of all of the burgers I think the Truffle Mushroom Swiss is the winner. I could be back for it from the portabella mushrooms  to the way they apply the Swiss cheese, this is a winner! Don't let me sway your opinions, there isn't a bad burger in the lot. They are all great and worth trying out. 
I am much happier with the way they treated this place after the feedback they received from the first grand opening. This is something many businesses overlook. My hat is off to them, now they just need to provide Gluten Free buns & I will be a regular!

DO NOT TAKE YOUR KIDS HERE!! 

My son broke his wrist three years ago. We waited over 3.5 hours in the waiting room, the nurses decided because he wasn't in a lot of pain, that there was no way it could be broken. They were quite embarrassed when the x-rays came back showing it fractured.

Then two days ago, I brought my daughter in after falling at school and developing a very large lump on her collar bone. Brought her in and again, they brushed her off because she didn't have a lot of pain. We waited for an hour and a half for x-rays (not a big deal) and then another half hour for the doctor to look at them (again, not a big deal), we were told it he THOUGHT it was a subluxation (partial dislocation), but he said for certain it was not broken and sent us on our way. No more information on how to treat it, what to expect etc.  I followed my gut and took her into the Stollery 2 days later, and the exact words of the Doctor was "I could have told you it was broken before even looking at the x-ray." I even had a chance to look at the x-ray and it's clearly broken. Yes, my daughter was misdiagnosed and brushed off because of her lack of pain. Even the nurses at the Stollery say they don't put a lot on the amount of pain a patient is having, only for pain relief if needed.  

I will not be using this hospital for me or my family ever again. Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on me.

I am just updating my review since it has been a few years. The atmosphere is amazing. It is so lovely to sit on the patio and enjoy lunch. Menu is diverse. Server was busy and seemed a little overwhelmed. We generally go twice a year. Once around Christmas and once in the summer to enjoy the patio. This time we chose pizzas. They are good, but a little high on the price point for what you got. However, you are not paying for the pizza exactly, you are paying for the atmosphere. We will continue to go. I would like to try the date night one time.

So Smashburger has been popping up on my feed quite a bit lately. I remember trying it when it first opened but I remember not liking it, but with everything popping up on my feed I thought we'd give it a try, again. 

I ordered their Double Classic Smash, Fries seasoned with rosemary and garlic and their Brussels sprouts. 

The burger, was very good but definitely not the best burger in the area. I found it a little over sauced and definitely to many red onions (pretty sure I got a whole onion). The bun didn't really hold up to the amount of sauce on the burger. 

The fries, seasoned with rosemary and garlic, two very strong seasonings and I found that the fries had no flavour. If they were advertised as just regular salted fries they would have been fine but they weren't. 

The reason I will go back, the Brussels sprouts. Such an interesting side for a fast food burger place and they were very good. I find that a lot of places over deep fry and over season their Brussels, Smashburger did not, they were perfect.

Well, we will not be back. Their menu states for the age of my daughter (3yrs) the package includes a shampoo, cut, braid with bead, curls and sparkles. What did we receive you ask? A few snips of her ends. No sectioning, just her hair combed out and snipped all the way around. 
No wash (nothing offered, just saturated with a spray bottle) and when asked if she wanted a braid or sparkles the "stylist" was so disengaged that my daughter just said no (she loves having her hair braided and is always asking to have this done). There was just no effort made to make her feel comfortable and no enthusiasm from the stylist. To top it off, when finished the "cut" my daughters hair was not dried in anyway. You're sending children out your doors in -10 with wet hair? 

My daughter was in the chair for less then five minutes, not an ounce of product used and it was $20.00. 

I have zero talent when it comes to cutting hair but could have done the exact same thing that was done to my daughters hair. 

See ya never!
Delicious burgers. Food quality a solid 4/5. Service was good, though more of a self serve situation as you order at the front. But that certainly doesn't distract from the great burgers

I usually don't do reviews but this wasn't a great first experience with this vet clinic.  My puppy had diarrhea and I couldn't get into my usual very.  Was so glad park vet fit me in.  Got meds and seemed to get better but it came back so dropped off a stool sample to find out he had a puppy stomach parasite.  The new meds were great but was recommended to drop off a stool sample to recheck it was gone. No vet visit.  $85 dollars later I sit and wait to hear back if its cleared up or not.  I called around to find out one clinic charges 25 and another one $40 for a recheck.  So not only are they over double the money they still haven't called to say he was clear.  I called 3 times just to be told they would remind her to call and give me results.  Not a great experience and I wont be back.
Batista added a $9 tip to my coffee order at drive through.  Careful if you are noticeably American.  Super lame.  Then manger tried to tell me that I added the tip.
Very good burgers with lots of options: beef, chicken or black bean patties.  The truffle Swiss burger is the highlight.

Ordered the Chicken Club last night...oh my goodness, it was one of the best club's I have had in years.  We all enjoyed our food, service was great, and the place was a clean cozy haven on a -20 evening.   We sat in the lounge and really enjoyed the choice of tunes as well:  Queen, Tom Petty, mixed with cool modern stuff.

Great value for fresh food-a $7.50 supper! First visit here,I had a super yummy pair of soft tacos, made to order with all my favourite fix-ins. Generous portions of meat- I had one beef and one chicken. The veggies&sauce I chose were loaded generously as well-so I had to ask for a fork! Bonus-they give you a side of crisp warm chips&salsa! All this for $7.50. What other fast food places feed you for that amount? Good friendly service by a server who was attentive to Covid guidelines for cleanliness. Bonus is they also have an attached outdoor patio. Will be definitely eating here again as I like fresh, healthy and good value. Thanks Bar Burrito!

I tried Smashburger in Sherwood Park on its opening day on July 3. I was impressed by the selection of burger toppings on the menu and the effort that the chain made to identify with Edmonton (although I am aware of the "complaints" about a restaurant in Sherwood Park naming an Edmonton burger, I am more inclined to say "good effort").

My burger was good with good quality meat that was better than the usual chain places. 

For a side, I tried both the haystack onions and the smash fries. The onions were too salty and the fries were fine, nothing special.

Overall the meal was good but not great. I will be back, but mostly because the location is close to home. Given the choice, I prefer the quality of the both the burgers and fries from Five Guys.

A lovley shope in the industrial neoghbourhood of Sherwood park. I have been following their social media sites and a free cheesecake offer poped up one day.  Who could resist! They have a nice clean little area and aell a variety of cheesecakes, cakes and all types of other desserts. They also have a good assortment of gluten free items as well.

They are a Canadian company and use home grown ingredients. The cheese cake I took home was really good. Rich and creamy exactly how a cheesecake should be. They have a delicious looking menu as well.
Great dealership! Always happy to help from their sales to service team. Have never had a bad experience there.

I realize that maybe my "emergency" was not as important as others' which was why I chose to come to this hospital instead of the other major ones in Edmonton. I suffered minor whiplash injury from a fall and had to make sure that it was nothing more than just that, so was confident that if I needed xrays or other tests, everything is there and can be done quickly. I observed the triage nurse to be very curt, not very welcoming and the least compassionate. Maybe she was tired, who knows. Asked every person to describe what made them come in "a couple of words", but asked rudely. But I felt that the moment I told her what my "emergency" was, she made sure that I knew I was completely wrong for coming. I get it, like I said I was not in any medical distress, but what she doesn't realize is that sometimes people go to emergency/hospitals because they lack complete trust in walk-in clinics. Yes I could have gone to a walk-in but I would not have the peace of mind. For me, I know I wouldn't even get the same quality of nursing care at a walk-in clinic. Even if I got seen by a crappy ER doc, at least I get access to great nursing care. I sat there for almost 2.5 hrs, patiently waiting until it was my turn accdg to triage, because I knew I was gonna get better care than at a walk-in clinic. Be mindful of all the "whys" each patient comes to emergency for, because if emergency nurses knew how important their role is to patients, they would feel really proud that patients come to them instead of going to a walk-in clinic, no matter how small the issue is. But this is why our health care system is so broken, yes you get free health care but for what? So you can get sub par care by primary practitioners who more often than not misdiagnose illnesses? But that's another review for another day.... until then.

I need to mention that we are from New Brunswick and just recently moved to the area and we are used to after hour clinics for things like a sinus infection(sometimes you can't get into see your physician for weeks).  We have yet to find out if they offer such clinics here.  After weeks of suffering and just returning to Alberta after Christmas vaca I took my husband to the out patient dept.  We were pleased with the wait only 2 hours, we got to see someone fairly quickly and received treatment by way of a prescription for antibiotics however what I noticed when we got to the out patient shocked me...Sick people have to wait in a line-up, no chairs to sit in until you get through triage....I have never experienced this before and it was upsetting to see people quite ill standing for sometimes up to 15 minutes...one such lady had to bend down crouching because she was so ill while another sat down and let her husband stand in line (what if he wasn't with her).  In this day and age I can't imagine this inhumanity, I am certain it must be an oversight on someone's part.  An easy solution is to add a number system and let sick people sit while they wait.  I understand that this is a fairly new hospital and certain there are kinks that have to be straightened out however why this hasn't been noticed before shocks me.  Our hospital back east even has a couple of televisions so the patient has something to do while waiting as some times the wait can be daunting if the out patient dept is busy.  This appears to be a great little hospital and I hope they change things to make it a little more accommodating for the sick after all it is a hospital...a little more compassion is always a good thing....I have learned over the years that we will all go thru some kind of sickness and we will also have the task of helping a sick relative or friend so lets keep this in mind and help the hospital improve by possibly a suggestion box....maybe they already have one.

This is a beautiful wellness centre. It's bright, modern, spacious and easy to navigate the different areas. The various medical clinics and health services are clearly labelled. On the main floor, they also have a pharmacy and a little cafe.

I was referred to a specialist in this building. I had no problem locating my clinic. There's easy access to an elevator and stairs. Covid precautions are being followed.

I can't speak for all the services provided here. I can say that I've had a good experience at the Synergy Women's Wellness Centre. I'd recommend this location to anyone in need of the services available.

I love this place. I've been getting my nails done for years but now that I've found Azia I refuse to go anywhere else. They take their time, they actually get to know you and remember you when you come in the next time. And most importantly they actually do a great job! I always ask for Lulu or Angie.

I'm waffling between 3 & 4 stars for my review - Please YELP - let us minions have the option of half stars :-)

I came to Smash Burger the other night when the CEO/Co-Owner, Tom Ryan, was in town.

I definitely give the layout, decor, and vibe of Smash Burger a big 2 thumbs up.  It was clean, bright, plenty of seating & family friendly.

Highlights for me included three flavored of iced tea with stevia as the sweetener!  When have you ever seen Stevia at the fountain here? 

I appreciated their choice of locally crafted beer - Alley Kat!  Optional bottled Dad's root beer & cream soda are also a winner winner chicken dinner with this Kat :-)

The beef did not disappoint and the price point is spot on at $6.99 for an artisan 4 1/2 oz. certified angus burger and $7.99 for a 6 oz.  The chicken was higher at about $8.49 and less filling - the chicken is pounded flat before searing on the grill to lock in the juices.

The multigrain buns (usually my fave) were far too dense and completely overwhelmed the chicken.  I much preferred the egg bun but like George, I do not understand why the bread is being shipped in from Chicago.  

The beef is certified 80/20 angus, grass fed, and corn finished for the last 30 days - said to give a more buttery flavor.  But then again they sear your burger on the flat top with unsalted clarified butter anyway.

They def got it right with toppings like a fried egg, haystack onions, sautéed baby portobellos, fresh jalapeños, Local whiskey BBQ sauce. Swiss cheese, cheddar cheese, truffle oil, and many more! 

The sides were a real show stopper for me! Shareable and priced from $2.49 to $4.99 ranging from yam fries, to veggie frites (wok inspired carrots & green beans), haystack onions (my fave), to poutine!  They def got the sides right :-)

For dessert time, they make old fashioned milkshakes countertop style.  The Oreo was great but the Saskatoon berry was probably the worst milkshake I have ever had.  I didn't taste anything resembling fruit and the texture was very displeasing - with large  chunks of Saskatoon berry flesh getting stick in the straw :-(

While I appreciate the effort to include local flavors and they got it right with Alley Kat & the BBQ sauce, it was a total miss with the Saskatoon shake.

Take a peek at a bunch of the pics I uploaded :-)

Thanks to Yelp Fit Club I got to try a workout at UFC gym. It was a challenging circuit training class. I was kind of disappointed that there wasn't any boxing or marshal arts teaching but it was still a great workout.

UFC Gym is conveniently located just off of Broadmoor  in Sherwood Park. The place is clean and looks like all of the equipment is fairly new. There is a big fighting cage at the back of the gym, which had a marshal arts class going on during our circuit training class, it looked pretty intense. I also noticed there is alot of both cardio and weight equipment at this gym.

The instructors seemed pretty knowledgeable and helped to keep you motivated during the workout. I think if your looking for a little something different to mix up your workout this place could help you with that .

The first time we went to Park Veterinary service we were impresses by how everyone was and the Vets knowledge.I even did their survey saying we were pleased.
However our second visit was  less than ideal. It was also our last visit there!
Due to covid, you have to call when you arrive and they come get your pet. You wait in your vehicle.
Anyway, we arrived early for our appointment because we were asked to muzzle our dog and she is not used to wearing one. 
We called and told the receptionist that we were there and that we were early because we needed a muzzle and wanted to give our girl some time to get used to it.
Someone brought out a muzzle and we sat waiting . No one called us and our appointment time came and went. I tried calling a few times but phone was busy. I finally got through and was told I didn't call to check in.. I said I did, I got a muzzle and was waiting.
Someone else came on the line and actually argued with me that I should have called again because the receptionist thought we left.
Ok, we really were going to drive over an hour into Edmonton, get a muzzle, drive home, turn around and drive back to Edmonton for the appointment and drive home again.???
We called, told her we were there for our appointment so it's on her.  The second person arguing with me was so unprofessional and rude. When we got home, we saw that they had called our home phone , but no one called my cell which is also on our file.
The vet did see our dog but was less than friendly on her call to talk about things.
We will not be back again! I'll spend my money at a vet where I am treated like a valued customer. We spent over a thousand $$ on tests and such  in those 2 appointments. 
No I do not recommend Park Vet!

We've ordered from here several times for large work events. The desserts are always fabulous and go over super well. 

The staff is friendly and can help with advice if you have a large crowd to feed. 

If you need one or twenty cakes I definitely recommend this place, just remember everything is frozen so make sure you give yourself time to let it thaw out. 

PS. the gluten free berry cheesecake is UNREAL.

This was our first time to Branches, but I think it will become a brunch tradition for my friend and I! It's so cute and tucked away inside the Greenland Garden Center. 

First of all, Greenland is amazing for just wandering around. We came for wine & brunch, and wandered the Garden Center after. Honestly couldn't have asked for a nicer Saturday girl-day. 

The service was very good- the waitress was so pleasant and didn't hurry us along. 

They substituted the pork on my flatbread for chicken, which was very nice. Everything tasted and looked excellent. Great presentation. 

The atmosphere is very cute. Cozy, and you kind of feel like you're not really home, if that makes sense. It definitely feels like something different.

Food was better than I expected for a greenhouse bistro. I will definitely be back. So fun!

After making a somewhat last minute decision to move, Riteway was one of the companies I contacted on a Tuesday morning for a Saturday move-in date.  Of the four companies I spoke to, Riteway had one of the most competitive rates, with a $100/hour charge for two men and a truck, plus a $100 travel fee and three hour minimum.  Moving the majority of items and furniture from our two bedroom condo to a house took six hours for $735, and we felt that it was definitely money well spent.

Booking on the phone was very easy, and the man I spoke to was able to answer all my questions.  The movers arrived at 9:55 am for a 10:00 am booking, and got to work immediately after assessing our unit.  The two guys worked efficiently the whole time we were with them, and no items were lost or damaged. Our walls, floors and stairs were protected, and they easily navigated our unpaved front walk.  Part of the contract specifies a five minute break for every hour of work, and a half hour break every four hours.  As a human, I understand that this is totally reasonable (and they were working hard) but sitting and waiting during their paid breaks was a little tough when I was totally stressed out over the whole day and just wanted to get everything done ASAP. I also would have appreciated if they had taken the shrink wrap off our furniture after it was delivered to our new house, it was kind of a pain to find our scissors or a knife and cut it all off ourselves.

Overall though I'm pretty pleased with Riteway, and I'm glad we hired them.  The value for cost was high and they did a great job moving our belongings safely.

Amazing food and for reasonable prices. The deserts are always so fresh and tasty and the service is awesome the girls are so friendly and look like they genuinely like each other. Love to sit on their patio when it's open. I would recommend the jerk tacos, and grilled cheese. However they could work on getting rid of the flies they are all over the place and the servers say that the owners don't do anything about it.

I can see from the other reviews, I am not alone. 

This 'hospital' is cleaner than the city hospitals but it's not worth it, no professionalism at all. Working at the University for years, raising a (now 19) child alone, I know what I'm talking about. 

Online it stated the wait time was 1 hour and 23 minutes, and my daughter has a wet cast that needs changing so we went there knowing that all we needed was a casting tech. 

We went into triage and then registration; registration said 'we will call you when a casting tech is available', as we waited, we watched and heard the 2 young registration clerks pointing and talking about patients waiting in the waiting room, they realized we caught them and stopped. the entire waiting room went in, were seen, and left happily as we sat in the waiting room. After 2 hours we were taken to a regular hospital room, went through medications, etc., then told they needed doctors orders to change the cast. Every other hospital just runs it by the doctor and then changes it. 2 more hours in that room, no ambulances came in, it was very quiet, the room across from us saw 4 patients in and out. I looked online to see what the wait time was then and it was 1 hour and 56 minutes at that point. The only doctors I saw were 2 in the hallway chatting about their weekend and laughing. 

She has a wet cast on because the cast glove I bought her for showering at Aspen Health care let in all the steam, you could see red, raw skin. We had to leave and go to another hospital. 

On my way out I said they should update their wait time online to 4 hours but they said they don't do that. Yes they do, I know they do. 

Very disorganized and unprofessional. Trust me, I know a heart attack, even stitches come before a cast change, this was not the issue. 

Don't waste your time with kids on a school night. We went to another hospital in city and they took it off within 30 minutes, no physician involvement other than giving the go ahead to the cast tech and then signing off to close the file.

I am kind of afraid to write this review. This place is never busy when I go but it's fast, fresh and most importantly, consistently delicious. My SO and I went in here for dinner after work, it was 4:30 PM and I had never been in for dinner so I asked the guy if we could have the lunch special and he said yes, which is awesome. The lunch special is amazing. You get a bunch of pastas or pizza or a panini,and it comes with a soup or salad or fries. Pro tip: the fries are OMfinG Amazing. Like the best fries I have ever tasted. They are flavoured with tears from Angels or something. Do yourself a favour, GET THE FRIES. Another pro tip: everything else is consistently amazing too. I highly recommend the pepperoni pizza. It's what Famoso Pizza is supposed to taste like (SO agrees and she loves Famoso). Look I could go on for a while. Go there, get the lunch special. The staff are friendly and accommodating. The food is fast and very fresh for a sit down and it's just plain delicious. At 12$ for an entree with amazing fries, it's a steal. Just look, don't fall in love with the place, because I love it, and I am only writing this review to show my appreciation for Via Cibo, not so it can be populated all the time by a bunch of other people who love great food. Also, definitely don't try the biscotti with gelato dessert; it definitely is not for you. Just for me. Just don't make this place busy okay. It's mine. I am serious. Stay away Peoples!

So I'm sure my review would be a bit different if it wasn't for the timing -- COVID-19 is impacting a lot right now and at the time I visited, the ball pit had been closed and they were doing additional cleaning because of the pandemic. That said I brought an infant to this location for a baby's first haircut and it went splendidly! This infant no longer has a mullet to get food stuck in! And the staff were really accommodating even though we showed up at the spur of the moment without an appointment (hard with an infant). They offered to give us a bit of hair but we just accepted a certificate commemorating baby's first haircut instead and that was great. I can't imagine that cutting kids' hair is very easy, especially kids as young as the one we brought in -- who cannot even sit up on their own. I'm quite thankful that this place exists and I'll likely return in the future.

My own vet was short a doctor so I took my friend's pup to Park Vet, trying to give a local vet my business. What a mistake! Never again! They put a total stranger's name on the medication, they would not let me change the file name to the owner, they said that they would give me something to 'stop the pup's diarrhea' and only gave antibiotics which may address the underlying problem but do nothing for diarrhea at the time. Then a repeat fecal exam cost $85.00!! Obscene! I phoned Park Vet and complained. I was told that the 'office manager' would call me. That was three days ago and no one has phoned.  What really struck me over the many phone calls is how the staff Does Not Listen.
Love this place!!! The place is clean, staffs are friendly, no lifting or yellow on the nails. Will come back again
never been here tbh but my best friend works here go best friend that's my best friend!! i've heard the food is really nasty tho and that they have a drawer where they keep the bacon all day.

Distanced Patio lunch today at Branches.

My first DINE OUT, in three months.

Patio was set up with distanced seating.

Plenty of indoor / outdoor seating options.

Patio overlooks Greenland Garden Centre.

Seafood Taco & Salmon Bites were fabulous ! 

A few Wood Stove Pizza's were delivered to other patrons. We didn't try them, but they looked delicious !! 

Prices are $14-$19 generous portions 

Wine $10 6oz, Beer, Prosecco and seasonal drinks available.

If you're looking to escape the city, Greenland's Garden Centre and Branches Bistro was a delightful afternoon out !!

If running an ungodly amount of hunger come
Here with cash. The portions are not meant for super giants (made the mistake of
Coming here many times with an ultra empty stomach the. Spend the money for the quality of food).

   The front staff is beyond friendly for my visit. Loved the interaction. It always helps to have friendly staff. In the pack the ladies cooked today. Prepares my food like legends. Excellent job I gotta say.

I am really impressed with the service I've been receiving at Lowe's for the past few months! On three occasions I've had wonderful associates help us with our big purchases and load up our vehicle and just today an associate helped me look up a lost receipt for an expensive item I had purchased and needed for warranty. Thanks again!!
We really enjoy bringing our son here, he burns tons of energy and has great fun! We also love that they play 105.9 Shine FM as background music, very family friendly place!

This was my first visit to the salon, and I was so pleased with my whole experience! The reception area and receptionists were friendly and inviting, and the new guest consent forms were succinct and paperless. This salon is much bigger than I initially thought; they have lots of spa and aesthetics services. I had my nails done by Sara, and I cannot say enough good things about her! I have simple taste, but I was very particular about the colour I wanted to wear. Sara was so professional, and so patient with me; she tried three different colours on me before we found the right one, but she didn't get annoyed at me, or make me feel badly about being so picky. I was so impressed with how expertly efficient Sara was at completing my nails, without skipping out on quality. I can't tell you how thrilled I am to have found an aesthetician who is so skilled in their craft, and so open to communicating with me about the look I'm going for. 10/10 recommend. Also, the fees for service are SUPER reasonable; I sincerely expected to pay more. I've found my new salon & spa - I'm going back next week for a full set of lashes! ‍

DO NOT go here. Save your life and health. Go to a reputable hospital. A friend spent 7 hours waiting for a needle to be removed from her foot and after a severely botched and unsuccessful attempt at removal she ended up being stitched back up and sent home with a promise of "someone" calling her in a "few" days to deal with its removal. After watching it swell badly and redden, thankfully she took it upon herself to go a day later to U of A hospital where they were clearly appalled at the state she had been sent home and told her this should never have been done. After an hour reopening the surgical sight the very competent doctor at the U of A was finally able to remove the object and resuture the sight.  We were warned of the probable negative consequences of infection from this obvious malpractice. This entire process would have been completely and positively remedied by initially going to a reputable hospital. This is the third person I know attempting to use this facility with appalling consequences.

We had a Hot Water tank fail on us 6 1/2 years after install (by another company). I spoke with Sandi and she was incredibly amazing to deal with. She got back to me during one of the busiest weeks of a crazy heatwave. She identified that it was still under warranty even though the original company claimed it was not. She went above and beyond and saved me over $1,000 in unnecessary costs. I highly recommend this sort of professional customer service and will make sure they are my first recommendation and go to for anything Heating or cooling related. Wish I heard of you sooner!

This was our first visit to this IHOP location and while a lot has changed during the pandemic time period (no multiple syrup flavours on the table, menus are printed on individual pages, have to provide information for your group for contact tracing purposes when you check in at the desk etc.) but our experience was good. The toddler really enjoyed having a high chair that allowed sitting directly at the table. The menu options, while more limited than on the full menu from pre-pandemic times, were good. I was quite pleased with my omelette and the kid loved the chicken. Service was slow-ish when the restaurant got busier but was on the whole a-ok. Drinks were refilled reasonably frequently as were the all-you-can-eat pancakes. The tv in our area was showing sports highlights which distracted the kid until seated in a direction facing away from it.

I booked Riteway and they were really courteous and friendly. After booking our appointment we were all set to move. However, life happens and very suddenly we were moving provinces to Ontario. In the rush of everything we forgot to contact Riteway and cancel our move. Barely 4 days before we called and explained our situation. He totally understood our reason and didnt mind not charging us for cancelling since the clause is they charge for 4 hours work if you cancel within 2 weeks. Amazing of them to do that for us it was really a life saver since our provincial move is really cash strapping! Thanks guys, we appreciate it!

Amazing place to work and be treated. 
I was walking down the hall to prep a room for a reflexology client and Andrew noticed my limp. He doesn't like to see people limp so he asked if he could have a look. I told him good luck I have tried every different therapy imaginable. Boy was I wrong, he new exactly what the problem was when I explained my problems and he watched me walk. Next thing I knew he had pinpointed the spot and improved it. He explained why he could not fully release it as that would strain the other side too much.
The guy is a genius when it comes to how muscles work. 
If you are broken whether it has been a short time or after  for 15 years, give Andrew a shot. I nicknamed him "the fixer" 
You won't be sorry!

I had an app at 530. I arrived late due to heavy traffic and I arrived at 542. Being late is totally on me. The girl said they could not take me anymore because they book for every 15mnt. But when I asked her if she had another all coming in she said no. She wanted to close. What I found upsetting is that she didn't have another app after us. She could have taken us in still.

Our waitress was very good and it was clear that she was experienced at doing this. However, it took more than 35 minutes for our food to arrive and the bacon was under cooked and we had both ordered extra crispy bacon. The portions were small and generic.  I expect it will get better after they find a way to speed up the kitchen, but the only real saving grace was our friendly and thoughtful server.

Not sure why this shows on baseline. They're at 14206 Stony Plain Rd now. 

I've only ordered twice, both times the Chicken Parm with alfredo pasta and Garlic bread and cheese.

The chicken parm was so amazingly good that I ate it all in one sitting. Same with the alfredo. The bread and cheese was OK - I've had better, but it's still very nice. I'm looking forward to trying something else on their menu in the future, but I feel pretty sure I'm ordering the chicken parm again... lol

Had a Bacon Burger was a very good burger. The fries were delicious, crisp and had rosemary on them (I think) I had to ask her 4 times what she was saying... pretty sure she said rosemary and olive oil.

The only thing that ruined this experience was the employee sleeping on the table next to me. VERY unprofessional. I walked by him going to the fountain and he had drool dripping on his arm. He didnt budge the entire time we were in the empty restaurant, several other employees just walked quietly by him as he napped away.

Last 3 times in less than 2 months huge delays trying to purchase goods at cashier. Today no cashiers at tills, customer service desk was dealing with customer and 2 others were on the phone. They would not even look at us until there were a few frowns. There were tons of staff on, staff need to be trained that a paying customer is not an inconvenience when customer service staff are bumping into each other. Yikes!
Lovely setting, clean, bright. The servers are so nice, food arrived quickly. Everything tasted homemade and truly fabulous. This is going to be a regular stop from now on.

Azia nail is the only nail salon I go to in Sherwood Park. It is very clean and they have excellent service. I usually get the gel nails and they last for a solid 3-4 weeks before I have to get them filled.

We went to smash burger with high hopes of tasty burgers and some interesting fries. What a disappointment.  My husband ordered the large jalapeño baja beef burger with smash fries and I ordered they goat cheese spinach cucumber  chicken burger and onion rings. 

The food came quickly but we were soon disappointed. My husband said his burger had zero flavour dispute the jalapeño peppers. The fries were okay - nothing to write home about. 

My burger was missing the cheese and cucumber. The girl was helpful and brought me some - unfortunately they were out of cucumber and suggested pickles instead (no thank you) the chicken burger was salty yet had no flavour. Bizarre. 

The onion rings were AWFUL! Nothing but salt coated onion. The texture was okay but the salt ruined it! 

I won't be going back. The 2 stars earned were only because the burgers came quick and the service was friendly.

Walking around in this place early on a Monday evening, I had an eerie feeling: it was quiet, too quiet. It was like I was in Home Depot after the zombie apocalypse. And then I realized that all the other patrons were clustered in a pack at the single functional self-serve till. The one other self-serve till was malfuctioning, and all the regular tills were closed. There were at least 5 people in line, not counting those at the customer service centre, and the one worker at the self-serve was obviously having problems.  The staff were trying their best but there were not enough people to do the work.

I haven't had great experiences with Lowe's generally, and I don't think I'd stop at this one again. Lowe's always seem understaffed.
I saw Jamie and was skeptical that he would be able to "get to" the problem.  Wow, was I wrong!  Deep tissue massage but still very comfortable.  I'm booked for another appt and I can't wait!

Kind of like a Humptys.  With emphasis on breakfast.  Booths inside. And some tAbles.  No TVs.  Wait to be seated. Omelettes are $16 to $18. Potatoes in omelettes are filler as far as I'm concerned. And hamburger in omelettes?  Weird.  I ordered a plain omelette with mushrooms ham and peppers.  Most of the stuffing was on the outside?  Weird.  Came with pancakes.  Overall not worth $17.00.  I've had much better elsewhere.  Staff were friendly.

The butcher has always been very helpful and able and willing to bring in unusual cuts when ordered ahead of time.  Product has been of good quality.  
I have been there and they not have the cuts I want, he has always given me a time I can come back, usually within an hour and he will have them ready for me.  
Store also carries a selection of other local goods such as jams and sauces.

Walked up to the "Please wait to be seated sign" with a Senior between two young chicks. Was advised that there would be a 30 minute wait.

There was two tables vacant in our left one with only one chair and the other with two.

They were not willing to allow us to move the one chair over not to move the tables side by side together to form as other seating formations two tables together. It was very evident that it was too much trouble. Our Senior was unable to walk around for 30 minutes

Not sure how you can be so unkind and unreasonable and still be in business.

Lovely brunch had elsewhere. Sad Testimate. Spend your money where you like but they obviously don't care about people.

I know this one is as good as it gets, because it's just about in my backyard! I was stoked when it finally opened and even happier to know that it had a great drive through.
 Although still in training the baristas  here know their stuff and are smiles all day long. they treat the customers like gold and that is huge in my books for any business!
 The interior of this place is a bit of an oddball with old wooden doors turned into a wall. Not what I would do with them but I do appreciate the attempt to recycle. Actually, it's a real conversation starter! 
 Stop by and enjoy, give me a ring so I can join you ;-)

Mid-Sunday afternoon, we were seated by a smug, underdressed girl with lots of extra skin hanging over her itty bitty clothes, which is so inappropriate for a place selling food. 
Then we ordered our beverages and watched our waitress socializing in the bar for 25 minutes, I timed her because I checked the time of the message I had texted as I was about to order my drink. One of us finally got up and went over to the bar to ask about our drinks, then the manager brought us 1 glass of water. Where were our drinks? 
The manager apologized and watched the waitress take our orders but our waitress was not meant to be a waitress, she mumbled very fast in a way that left us confused more than anything. We were not even rude. We were being friendly so this was not a nervous thing. 
Worst salad wraps I've ever had, the lettuce was old, the chicken was dry. I didn't even eat it, I had half of one and didn't take the rest home. The other items purchased were a dry cheeseburger and cold fish and chips. 
We still tipped but don't go to this location, it's very poorly run. The locations in Edmonton have always been excellent.

I love BarBurrito! It's my favourite burrito place that is fast food. I get a burrito or burrito bowl and love the pulled pork. The staff here provides great service, and are professional and friendly! Thank you

Nope, never again. I paid $18.00 for my 13 month old to spend 2 min in a chair, and have three snips of her hair. We spent more time in the waiting room, then in the actual chair. I now take her to my hair dresser, who only charges me $10.00, and spends about 10-20 min on her hair.

Servers a friendly but kitchen staff needs to get their ducks in a row. We waited approximately 30 minutes for our food only for it to be subpar. Server offered to ask the kitchen for fresh eggs but wasn't really in the mood to wait for another 30 minutes for a fresh plate. Manager was kind enough to pay for our meal. I would not go back to this location.
This dealership is a joke! If you want to get ripped off this is the dealership you wanna come to. Do yourselves a favor and take your business elsewhere!

I have tried to shop here twice... both times the staff were INCREDIBLY rude. On both visits I left without purchasing anything. The first time was because they barely had anything in the store, and wouldn't cut any new meat for me (isn't that the job of a butcher??). Horrible little store. I will never return.

We were very happy with this business when we used them this past winter to replace our broken water heater and replace our HVAC and water softener as well. The staff were incredibly good at communicating and were very professional. I was also happy with how good they were at cleaning up after themselves, with their willingness to come back and fix any thing (or remove anything) forgotten or left behind, and with their service when they returned to set up the air conditioning in the spring and when they cleaned our ducts. I am happy to become an ongoing customer with their good service.

Last week my rabbit Clover was behaving strangly. As it was early evening, my regular vet was closed. I tried calling an emergency clinic in Edmonton and they recommended that I contact Park as they were likely to have an "exotics" specialist in that night (yes, rabbits are considered "exotic"!) Lucky for me, they did.

After describing her symptoms, they recommended I come in right away and guaranteed us an appointment as soon as we were able to get there. When I arrived, they were ready to take her into the back for some oxygen to help her calm down.

I ended up sitting in a side room while they checked on Clover in the back. Throughout the night we ended up taking x-rays and doing bloodwork and the vet (Dr. Bousquet) was extremely helpful in explaining the results.

While we didn't come out with a diagnosis, they did have a treatment plan for her (she's doing much better now by the way!). Since my visit, they've followed up twice and I'm still expecting a third conversation in a few days.

I'm so impressed with my experience at this clinic. If it wasn't for the distance from Edmonton, I'd be more than happy to take my pets here regularly.
Eating out way through sherwood park one stop at a time. We ordered double bacon smash burgers with smash fries and oreo milkshakes. Will definitely be back. Burgers were awesome.
