First of all "BEANERS" is a racist term towards Mexicans. So f*ck you to whoever owns this place and you guys suck!

Awesome store and love the staff for sure! No problems with that. My problem is that there is one bloody body on checkouts and it's at the opposite end of the store. 

    Self checkouts all over but god forbid we put someone to work with the silly profits they make anyways!

  It's as if they are truly forcing you to use self checkout by making it so convenient in the center of the store and then a person on checkout way off in the corner. 

  I more so feel bad for the staff member who has to work in that corner. No staff members to hangout with or anything, checkout right at the entrance of the store in a secluded corner. I would not feel safe.

    This store probably won't be seeing me again. Sucks because the people kick ass! Just sick and tired of dealing with machines, or being forced to deal with machines it feels like

I have been here a number of times, particularly for lunch and I have always been impressed with the menu and the quality of the food. Lovely atmosphere. I feel my shoulders relax as soon as I enter there. It helps that it is in the middle of a garden center full of greenery, flowers, water, and all pretty things. I especially love coming here for Christmas...so many beautiful Christmas trees and decorative pieces. Also, it is nice to get a window seat so you can see their plants outside or if it is really nice, a patio spot. Lunch is a nice selection of soups, sandwiches, salads, and a few heavier dishes. I really love the beef dip on a pretzel bun, but today I went with the chicken and chickpea curry bowl. It was delicious. Flavourful without being too overwhelming (good for those with a sensitive palate), really well cooked with some lovely steamed broccolini and spaghetti squash. I also enjoyed a peach mimosa. If you aren't stuffed, they have a lovely baking and coffee section to enjoy. It gets busy so be prepared to wait...however you can browse and shop while your waiting and they will phone you when your table is ready. Servers are friendly but busy and I think they should have a few more on site especially during the Christmas season when it is swamped. Also, prices are high. I am always pleased with my menu selection, but don't expect cheap eats here..

Had my first round of the season today! Took my nephew for his first round ever. We were able to walk on at around 11 with another couple. Everyone was so supportive of my nephew. The marshal took him aside and gave him a bag of found balls which was super nice. Everyone we encountered on the course was very nice and supportive. The marshal and grounds crew checked in with us and cheered on my nephew. The course was in quite good condition, especially with all the rain we have had. There was one wet hole but luckily I hit it far enough to avoid it ‍. The course has different options for golfing. They have an 18 hole prairie course. I haven't folded that one in a while but it was always great (it is longer!). The Woodlands is 10 holes which is what we golfed (yay for 10 instead of 9!). They have an online booking system or you can call (or just show up sometimes). The clubhouse is beautiful. They sell food and drinks. There isn't a cart that goes around so make sure you buy before you start. They also have a driving range which is amazing as it's grass tees. I would totally recommend this course!

I should have read these reviews before wasting my time going to this horrible place. The waiting time online under Alberta health services said 30 minutes for this hospital but I waited two and half hours with a small baby until I decided to leave. No explanation or even an estimation of when you will be seen even though the waiting room was empty .Save yourself and go somewhere else. If I only knew!

Two strikes and we are done...
My husband and I tried this restaurant the first time for lunch a few weeks ago. When you walk in you order right away, it was very hard because people are trying to come into the restaurant and it causes a messy congestion at the door as you are reading the menu. Very strange idea after you order you walk over to another area where you order drinks and pay. I did not like that you pay prior to getting your food and sitting down, how do you tip if you have no idea what kind of service you are going to get? 
My husband's pasta was over cooked and under salted. He ordered the pasta with broccolini but had very few pieces of broccolini and it was all stems. My pizza was soggy and the toppings all slid off. The side fries were cold and bland. 
Today we thought we would give it one more chance and try brunch.  I ordered the Nutella and Banana French toast. When I asked what it came with I got a very odd look and was told a very large piece of french toast. I asked if I could order a side of bacon as I like the whole sweet / salty taste and she told me she did not think they could go that. After getting help I was able to order a side of bacon. My husband had the Italian eggs benedict and they were not bad, again nothing special and do not come with sides.  My french toast arrived and it was just that a single piece of french toast with chocolate around it.  I noticed my bacon did not come and when I tried to call the waiter over the person behind the counter yelled out "what do you need" I said my side of bacon. It arrived and it was literally a piece of bacon, yes just one piece.  The French toast was unimpressive with the Nutella being a big glob carelessly dumped in the middle of the bread, and it had not a single banana. After already being yelled at I did not want to ask for the bananas.  At the end of the meal a waitress asked how my meal was, I responded just okay, she smiled thanked me and walked away. 
This restaurant is way over priced ($14 for 1 slice of French toast) and the concept does not work at all. My advice is to avoid this restaurant unless you like okay overpriced food with bad service.

Went here for lunch as a double date with friends a few weeks ago. Nice enough on the inside, however in general I don't like restaurants where you have to go up to order. I am the main cook in my  house, and I spend a lot of time cooking preparing and serving meals. If I am paying to go out, I want to be served. This is me being a stay at home mom after 17 years. I also don't like feeling pressured on looking at a menu on the wall with people behind me. I would rather have a physical menu. Decent menu with a selection of salads, pizzas, and pastas. They had a lunch deal any pasta for 12 dollars which sounded good to me. I had the ravioli of the day which was filled with cheese and spinach and I opted to have grilled veggies put on top. My husband has the spicy sausage and broccolini. Our friends had the carbonara and the penne with rose sauce. We also ordered a caprice salad to share. Pasta came out really quickly. Food was really tasty and generous portions for the price. My ravioli was really flavourful and the pasta itself was really well made. The caprice salad was delicious and the tomatoes were a grade. Salad was really thought out. My only complaint is that we had to go up and ask for chili flakes etc.  All in all really good value for the money.
Great service great people I used them for my home guys were so clean and didn't break anything

Went in blind not knowing what I was getting into . Had no idea this was a contract massage setup . Receptionist had room for a massage I went in and had one . The therapist was good . When I came out I was ambushed and the intro massage price I was charged double I guess since I refused to sign the contract . Very pushy like a gym membership sales person that just won't budge . A few points I don't like about this system . I hate contracts. This place won't let you come in and just book a massage as they charge 2 times the price if your not in a contract Which is ridiculous .if I find a therapist I like it's impossible to book them online all you can do is select male or female and hope you get someone good . Next day I had a call asking if I was still interested . If you enjoy high pressure sales / contracts min 1 year . This is the place for you but not definitely me. Won't go to any of these locations .

I am not a golfer, first off. But I DO hit up golf courses for food/fuel for my road cycling rides, alone or with my cycling club. My sons who are golfers say it's a good course, and they have well-priced package deals for golfing.  Absolutely LOVE the setting, wonderful new and beautifully designed clubhouse and outdoor patio spaces. A real gem of a place to grab a coffee and light lunch while enjoying wonderful  outdoor spaces. Limited ready-made food during Covid ;choose from beverages, fresh great sandwiches, and pastries. During "normal" times grilled Franks, homemade soups etc are their specialty. LOADS of outdoor patio seating areas. Lovely well kept garden areas to look at, plus you may catch glimpse of one of their wandering PEACOCKS! The staff treat non-golfers well; we cyclists don't get frowned upon for our cycling gear. Very close to Southeast Edmonton , minutes from the Henday. I've  been told that this is a family owned business, on the property of a family heritage farm.  They've created a beautiful venue and are doing a great job managing it!

Beaners just cancelled my kids hair cut because we booked it for 2.15 and they wanted to close early. So we could either change it to noon or it would be cancelled. WOW! ENJOY YOUR TIME OFF!!! Terrible terrible terrible.

Just wanted to send a thanks to your Sherwood park baseline road location. I had messed up my online order and they were quick to remedy the issue, i had a phone call yesterday to double check the delivery time (that's what I had messed up) pizza arrived today with an awesome delivery guy, on time, and super fresh. I had a semi large order and they made the food part of the birthday we were hosting a lot less stressful.

You've gotta try their veggie fries! It's basically just carrots and beans, but they are awesome. Way better with your burger than regular fries.
My favorite burger is the truffle much room Swiss,  it's savoury and delicious. I always get the large size burger and then regret it because it's too big, so don't do what I do and just get yourself the regular size.
The smash fries are pretty good as well, cut up like shoe string fries you get a lot of surface area for the rosemary oil that they cover them in. I also like their buffalo fries that they hit with some cayenne seasoning.

After sampling various kids' play places, Kidz Quarterz doesn't rank very highly on my list.  From a plethora of broken games to a play structure that is definitely not adult friendly, Kidz Quarterz leaves a lot to be desired.  The overall idea behind it is nice but the execution of it is poor.

My wife put it well when she said, "It's just not awesome."

So I'd heard about this place for a long time when my friend suggested we try it for lunch. I've always heard rave reviews so I was excited to try it. We headed in for brunch on a Saturday morning. We were seated promptly, the staff was all friendly. Our order was taken pretty quickly but I will say it took a pretty long time to get our drinks / probably at least ten minutes which considering it wasn't absolutely bustling seemed like a long time. The coffee was good, I had a latte. And then I ordered the warm fruit churro shells which sounded and tasted delicious - that being said there is no graceful way to eat them at all. 

Overall I was pretty unimpressed with the handful of menu items (aside from the counter bakery portion) I guess as someone who is a Cora's brunch frequenter I'm more used to a bit longer of a menu. And I found it to be pretty pricey.  My entire meal came to around $20 which seemed like a lot for what I got. 

It's a fun location to visit especially if you're catching up with friends but I won't go out of my way to eat there.

We came here recently for a number of things. We were really pleased with all the great advice we received from the staff members who helped us attempt to find a good product to clean with, the correctly priced floor mat and made sure that the prices we paid matched the shelf pricing. This is more help than I normally need when shopping but we were quite pleased overall and we found what we needed during this trip.

The bathroom was well maintained as well. There was ample parking.

Like the previous reviewer I booked First Call in late 2012 - the first time they rescheduled, the second time their van broke down, the third time they rescheduled because they were too busy...  This went beyond the dates of their offer.

I'm too busy to chase these guys and finally when I got around to it now (it's October 2013) they say they'll only take cash value and no discount because it's too late.  No notice, no warning, no nothing.  Groupon says it's up to FirstCall on what to do so I'm screwed.

They want to clean the furnace AND the ducts and charge per duct so what was going to be an $50-70 spend is now going to be a $150+ spend.  Great way to run a business - reschedule a customer 3 times then don't warn them when you're running out of time to reschedule.

DO NOT GO HERE. I just walked out without seeing a doctor because of the terrible treatment I got. I got there at 12:30 to see a doctor for a packing/dressing change on an incision from Tuesday. The front end staff were great, very friendly and quick to get me registered. I only had to wait maybe 15 minutes to get into a room but that's when everything went downhill. They put me in the room and no one came to check on me or anything after. After about an hour and a half, I went and found someone to see if I had a few minutes before the doctor came so I could go outside, they didn't ask for my name or check to see how many people were ahead of me. Just said "I don't know how long it will be, you can risk it if you want but you'll probably be here longer." Then about half an hour later, they brought a new patient in to the room across from mine. He waited for about 10 minutes before the doctor came to see him. He was there because he had a cold for a week and was still sick. Hospitals are supposed to see more urgent patients first, I don't see how a cough is more urgent than a packing change from a surgery. I went to leave and the nurse asked me why so I explained that I had been waiting almost three hours and that the doctor went and saw a patient who got there two and a half hours after me who just had a cold before coming to see me, and that if the doctor wasn't coming to see me right now that I was leaving. Again she didn't ask for my name or check to see how many people were ahead of me, just simply responded with " ok have a nice day " I just had surgery, I should be at home resting. Not waiting three hours for the doctor to deal with a cough before my dressing change. I'm never going back there and I strongly recommend that no one else does. I'm placing a complaint and I'm going to make sure that everyone knows about the terrible care and attitude from them.

Excited to give Branches a try tonight.
Pretty good.
Not amazing.
~$30 for a chicken pesto pizza, brushetta, and overpriced bottle of iced tea.
Resonable I suppose for an above average meal.
Brushetta fresh and flavourfull. Pizza thin, criso, and satisfying. 
I thouroughly enjoyed the atmosphere and decor. Very modern, and clean.  Alas, I found the most distressing part of my visit to be the noisy employees behind the counter. They all too often brok the tranquil, greenhouse setting with their boisterous behavior.
I must say that their system of seating oneself, taking in the menu alone and then ordering at the counter (and paying before eating) make me less apt to be gracious when the debit machine spurs me for a tip. At this point, I have neither enjoyed the food, or experienced any customer service.
I may be back.
I may not.
But if you're in the neighbourhood...Branches is worthy of a shot.

Since my holiday favourite is no longer offered at my usual choice of coffee place I decided to try second cup. It's actually way closer to me then any other coffee shop. I grabbed a eggnog latte and it was amazing! The staff was super friendly. The only downfall is that since they have the eggnog latte they are super busy now. Which is AMAZING for them as they are locally owned. But it is quite the wait.
Stopped for a simple oil change and very happy good price great service actually greased my suv totally happy with this place I will be back and a free car wash too

Wow I'm surprised by the reviews here. I don't know what people expect from a hair cutting place for kids. Beaners is pretty good. The reason they are so fast is because they are dealing with small kids with a short attention span who are forced to stay still. I think it's amazing they get it done so fast and it looks as good as it does. I am happy with my kids cuts and we'll be back.

The Synergy Wellness Centre is a wonderful all-in-one location medical and health professional centre. 

In one centrally located building in Sherwood Park, you will find doctors medical practices, laboratory, x-ray & ultrasound services, a women's wellness practice, a dentist, denturist, ear clinic, respiratory clinic, sleep medicine, neurology clinic, massage therapist, pharmacy,...the whole spectrum! There is even a hair salon and spa, and a café!

Lots of parking and lots of handicapped parking as well.

The Bethel Transit Centre is also across the street. Very convenient for everyone.

Cute little restaurant tucked away in the Greenland Garden Centre in Sherwood Park! They have a beautiful patio right in the greenhouse. This is the perfect spot for brunch. We opted to try their wood fired pizza as we heard great things about it. The food definitely didn't disappoint. The pizza was about a medium, perfect for 1 person. 

Along with the great atmosphere, the service was exceptional. Our waitress and the hostess were lovely and attentive. I'll definitely be coming back here for more mother daughter dates.

Denny's, as far as I know, is the only all day, and all night sit -down restaurant in Edmonton. Meaning if you're craving pancakes at 4am after a night out, or perhaps before an early working shift Denny's is the place to go. 

My friend and I made our way to this location in Sherwood Park. It was busy, but not insanely so. The menu has a good variety of breakfast foods, plus lunch and dinner options. They also have a special bacon menu with a bacon ice cream sundae. As intriguing as that sounded (read: sarcasm) I couldn't justify buying it. 

Our server was nice enough, but didn't give us enough time to look at the menu. When we got in I went to use the washroom. As soon as I came back the waitress was asking for our order. We said we needed a few minutes, and she was back in about thirty seconds. Um, yeah that's not a minute. 

I got the banana foster french toast with eggs (over easy) and bacon. The french toast was good, very sweet. But I was dissapointed by the lack of bananas on the french toast, there were only five small slices on each piece (2 pieces total) - probably not even half of a banana. The eggs were ok, but a little runny (I forgot to specify i don't like them too runny, so that's partly my fault). The bacon was a bit too crispy, because it had become very dry. I ordered a cherry coke to drink, which was delicious. 

Denny's is always low price, my meal was filling, and with tip and tax came to under $15. However shortly after eating my meal I began to feel gross. I know Denny's isn't top notch food, it's greasy and cheap. It's the McDonald's of the sit-down restaurant world. Not great, you feel gross eating it, but still you crave it every now and then. Can't a girl enjoy french toast somewhere at midnight and not feel like wanting to crawl into a hole and die? No. Well I guess I'll have to stock up on breakfast ingredients and just make french toast at home.

Branches is located inside of Greenland Gardens and is a cozy little lunch spot after you are done shopping. I recommend going early as they don't take reservations and are usually full by 11 am. I had the mushroom soup and garlic knots, delicious! It is quite crowded so expect it to a little loud. There is free parking and they have a cute indoor patio setup.

Visited this little gem in Sherwood park on July 3/17. What a great place, easy to find. Beautiful open space, patio facing the nursery to really relax and enjoy the view. The place was quite busy with only a few spots open so thankfully we didn't have to wait to sit outside. The menu had a variety of dishes, we opted with the Margherita pizza and two sodas ($21 at the end of our meal, not bad!). I wouldn't say the place is child friendly, I feel it's more of place to go have some brunch or drinks with friends. The only thing I have to say is the service wasn't too good, it took a really long time for someone to even come take our order for drinks. After we were done our meal we grabbed a latte on the way while we walked around and checked out the garden. Defs will be back.

My first two times coming here were a disaster. Both the first two female therapists I got were a joke and I wasn't going to come back but I thought I would try it again and I'm happy I did. I had an appointment with Jamie and he was great! He listened to what I wanted and worked on exactly that and nothing else. His pressure is EXTREMELY DEEP so if you are uncomfortable with that, stay away. I'm glad I finally found a RMT that gives a good deep tissue and I will come back to see him.

This wellness centre located on Bethel road is amazing. Kind of one stop for all your needs. As you enter theres a very nice lounge on left and pharmacy on right. Next to it a coffee shop. On lower level you have dynalife, MIC etc and upper level you have womens wellness and medic clinic (abt 16 doctors) dentist, gyne etc. 

Clean. Lots of places in hallway to sit as well. 

Lots of parking outside actually for $2 parking fees. Also walking distance from Bethel bus station

Went looking for a better version of a
McChicken and both Wendy's and mcdonalds blows them away for this sad $7.99 crispy chicken burger.
It's smashed together on rotten wilted lettuce with hot and mushy tomatoes and the chicken paddy is about under a quarter inch thick. Had to take the toppings off and left with a bun and chicken for my $8

The picture says it all

I have used this company for the second time. This time moving within the city of Edmonton. 

The movers were on time and worked very efficiently. They were able to get everything done in a few hours since we didn't have much to move.  All of our items were moved without any damage. The movers were very friendly and made sure no walls were damaged in the old or new place. 

Dealing with the office was very easy.. they discussed the pricing and the time it would take.  I would use Riteway Moving again in the future. 

Highly recommend this company for all moving needs.

Went on a Monday night so it wasn't busy and the service was so slow.  Took forever for the waitress to take our order and when she finally came to our table she said 'What do ya want?'.  Had the calamari for an appetizer, and I wouldn't recommend it as it was so salty.  Staff were seen behind the bar making their own drinks and sitting at the bar drinking them.  Staff came out of the kitchen carrying their own meals and eating them at the bar. The noise from the kitchen at times was deafening! And it wasn't meal prep it was staff yelling and screaming.  A waitress wearing a sleeveless shirt was walking around with a pepper mill in her armpit!!  Disgusting.  It even took a long time to pay for our meal.   We finally had to get up and stand by the door to get staff's attention.  
This was our second visit to State and Main in the Park. We would have rated it a 4/5 on our first visit.  It sure has gone downhill.

I didn't know what to expect from a class at this UFC Gym but I liked it a lot!
We had a very good condition session including a circuit class with all type of exercises: cardio, push-ups, abs, weights, planks, etc.
I feel it was a very complete and fun workout. 
The instructors were very patient with us considering that many of us were new to this gym but kept us very motivated.

They have different classes for whatever you may need including boxing and kick boxing.
They gym is well equipped with treadmills, elliptical, stationary bikes, stair climbers, etc.; they also have a bag and free weight room.
This gym is located in Sherwood Park very close to Baseline. There is plenty of parking there so you won't have trouble finding where to park.
Check out their webpage at https://ufcgym.com/sherwoodpark

I needed to get my cat seen by a vet for an emergency, and my regular vet was short staffed and fully booked. I called around a few local places but apparently it was a very busy week and nobody could fit us in. A couple places recommended I try Park Veterinary Centre before trying an emergency clinic - since they're out in Sherwood Park they are sometimes less busy, and they're open late in the evenings. 

Happily, I was able to get a 6pm appointment and saw Dr. Emily Dorey, who was lovely and was able to examine my cat and prescribe some painkillers and antibiotics immediately. While I'll be going back to my normal vet for regular treatments, it's great to know this place is a good option for late nights and emergencies.

On a very cold snowy day, and a craving for good breakfast we stopped at Denny's. it is nice & warm inside. We were greeted with the friendliest smile. Being vegetarians there's not much options but you can get substitution for eggs & bacon. We ordered vege burger, toast & hash browns. Our server Sandy is very courteous, friendly and kept checking to see if we were doing ok & for coffee refills. Very good service. The only complain we had was very little hash brown with burger..should have ordered fries. 

There's lots of parking outside. Washrooms available . Nice & clean 

Would definitely eat here again

Today a friend and I decided to have lunch at Denny's in Sherwood Park. I arrived early, and the person at the door that seats you was very nice, I had a half an hour wait, and three times she came over and asked if I wanted to be seated or have a drink of water, I said no, thank you my friend should be coming soon..that was the best part of the lunch...it went down hill from there. At one point while waiting for my friend, one of the servers and the cook got into a loud argument that I overheard, and no doubt a few other people as well.
Our server arrived and asked us what we would like to drink..me diet pepsi no ice, my friend a coffee..they arrived, her coffee was cold, my diet pepsi had ice. I asked for no ice so sent it back..but my friend just drank her coffee.. We then ordered our meal, she had a small portion eggs bennedict, I had the new burger. We had a very long wait..it was not very busy, but we had a long wait. The food finally arrived and the waitress explained that the cook thought she was to have the potato, but found that was not the case so took it off..but left the messy potato stuff on the plate with her eggs. Since my friend's coffee was cold,she decided to switch to hot water. The waitress brought her a little teapot..but no cup..I asked for a new cup..and she took her coffee cup away..and she came back with a cup..we are not sure at this point if it was a fresh cup with coffee grounds in it..or her old cup that the waitress just dumped and brought back. Meanwhile..while we are eating, another waitress is vaccuming the floor next to  us. Yes the place needs to remain tidy..but there was hardly anyone else in the place at this time..she could  not have vaccumed another area? My burger however was good and my friend and I shared the fries. When we left, I had a talk with the girl who sat us at our table about the plates, and asked if we wanted to talk to a manager..I told her that I would ask my friend and see if she would like to talk to the manager..which I did..but she decided to have a talk with the waitress instead..who told us it was not her fault that the plate was not clean, it was the cooks fault..In my opinion..it's both, the cook should not have sent it out in that condition, and if it was..it was up to the waitress to ask for a clean plate.  Will we go back..likely not, there are other places we can go and get better service.

This is kind of a weird concept, but it seems to work.  A restaurant... inside a garden and plant shop?  The decor matches, but I honestly don't know who cooked up this pairing.
I arrived at 2pm on a Sunday.  My family didn't make reservations, so I put my name in and was quoted a 20 minute wait for a party of 6.  I checked in with the hostess after 25 minutes, and she said we were next.  After 40 minutes, my uncle and cousin decided they had to jet since they had other things to do.  So it was only after waiting twice our quoted time and dropping down to a party of 4 that we were actually seated.
Our server was great, although we seemed to sit too long between each step.  We should have been asked for our drink order right away since we had waited so long.  I also feel like we should have been asked if we were ready to order our meals when our drink order was taken (we were), but she rushed away (probably to put the order in before she forgot -- she didn't write anything down).
I tried to order the quiche special, but was told they were out.  Disappointing, since it was still on the chalkboard out front.  I assumed they would erase it (thinking they must have just run out), but the listing stayed on the board through our entire meal.  I ended up getting the chicken panini, which was really good, and everyone else enjoyed their meals as well.
Branches clearly has their food game down pat -- I'm hoping that they can get the front of the house up to the same level.

I'm in love with the caramel caretto (may be spelling that wrong).  It's a warm hug in a cup. So smooth and delicious.  Today I had decaf with oat milk.  Very yummy. 

Sat inside and did some work.  I find it cold inside but it's also -25 so it's just cold.  The place is super clean and lots of spots to sit.  

Lots of parking available and a drive through.

I took my adult son to this hospital--once by ambulance and again last night.  I was not pleased with the service my son received on both these occasions.  Last night we arrived at 10:30 p.m. we did not leave until 3:00 a.m. that was the wait time.  It was not busy and it did not appear that there were any urgent critical patients waiting.  My son was given an exam room about 30 minutes after we arrived,  but the doctor did not come to see him.  He was freezing cold, he was given a gown and left sitting in his wheel chair.  His caregiver put him on the bed (she is a nurse) and brought him warm sheets to cover himself. The doctor finally saw my son when I said I was leaving and taking the caregiver with me as she had been on overtime since 10:00 p.m. and it was costing the government extra money to pay for overtime for her.  I told them they could deal with my son and contact me.  After telling them I was leaving the doctor finally came in at 2:30 a.m.  All other patients had been seen even those who arrived much later than we did.   A very strong medication used for MS flare-ups was used.  My son did not have an MS flare-up he had severe itchy rashes over his body and a fever.  We had already been to a walk-in clinic to see about the rashes and because they were persisting for 3 weeks, I suggested blood work.  Nothing was done to see why the rashes were causing a fever nor would the staff/doctor order blood work.  The other time when my son was brought in by ambulance the diagnosis was pneumonia, they would not keep him until morning and sent me home in the middle of the night/3.00 a.m. (winter)  to get his winter clothing then drive back to the hospital with his clothing and wheelchair because they would not keep him until morning.  This does not happen at other hospitals, they have always kept him and given him IV treatments to deal with his infections.  They also told me he had a bladder infection but his GP said he didn't and the bacteria in his urine was his own body bacteria.  I will take my son to another hospital in future and I will not allow ambulance attendants to take him to this hospital.

I always wondered when a good bar would pop up in Sherwood Park. Let me explain good, cause my good can different from yours. By good I mean they don't have people so drunk they are puking all over the outside. By good I mean the atmosphere inside is so inviting and classy, we had seating right away and professional service the whole experience. By good I mean they had the best nachos, and at only $4. I thought these nachos would of been a smaller portion, cause of the price, but when they bring it out, your jaw drops. The portions of sour cream and salsa exceed what you need. Just these nachos are enough for a meal itself. ( By the way nachos are only $4 on Wednesday) still good. I will be back, because this place is so good.

I'm not going to lie, Michaels is my happy place. It's one of my go-to places for anything creative, only because they carry so many things. I love some of our more local shops like The Paint Spot, but when I'm looking for something that I'm not sure where the best place to start would be, Michaels is my jam.

I feel the prices can be a little high, but it seems like they always have deals on in store, plus there are always coupons on their app.

If you're ever looking to spark your creativity, a stroll through Michaels will always highlight new projects and opportunities for you.... or like a dozen projects if you're me!

This is by far the best Dairy Queen location. Why?

1.  They are a training centre 
2.  They are an inclusive employer
3.  They are strong community supporters

And of course, hot eats and cool treats!

Food is good but the kitchen staff  and front line staff are loud and obnoxious...speaking their own language with no manner.  Don't go there after 8pm as they close at 9 or you they will be sweeping the floors and bringing you  food at the same time without washing their hands. gross!! They don't deserve 15% for sure!

It's a solid 3 stars.  I'll be back, but probably won't crave it.

I work incredibly close to this location... so on Friday when I couldn't figure out what to eat, this is where I ended up.  Really what brought me in was the idea of poutine.  I love a good poutine.  

I walked in at about 11:55 and there was only 1 person in line ahead of me.  The ordering process was fairly painless... I had read Russell's review before going in so I was armed with responses to the questions I knew would be coming at me.  When I started to answer her first question, she stopped me and pointed to a sign with the available toppings. "Just tell me what you want on it".  hrm... okay.  Single cheese burger, carmelized mushrooms, pickles, chippotle mayo.

The burger was pretty good.  The pickles were sliced too thick though... I know that's a weird complaint, but it made it difficult to eat.  I'll come back for burgers.

The poutine was a let down though.  The fries LOOKED delicious, but there was no seasoning on them at all :(

It took almost 15 minutes after I ordered for my food to be ready for takeout, and by the time I left, the line up was out the door.  There was one person working the till and taking orders, and only two people in the kitchen.  I can't imagine how high the wait times can get during a busy lunch.

I've heard the milkshakes are really great, so I would give them a shot next time too.

I've only ever had 1 dish here, and I get it on a regular basis because it's so delicious!  It's #21a Satay Assorted Meats Rice Noodle Soup.  It never disappoints.   It's one of the tastiest soups I've ever had.
I always call ahead and order for pickup - I've only dined in once at lunch.  Service was good.

So I spend way more time and money than I should here. The staff are usually great and super helpful. download the app to keep tabs on the coupons. There's almost always a good coupon. 
Also specifically Quinn in the framing department is amazing. He's so helpful and really spends the time and knows exactly what questions to ask - wait for custom framing to go on sale though I've gotten up to 60% off my custom framing order before!!

Sigh. Another unoriginal, uninspiring, clone of all the others restaurant in Sherwood Park, with bland wait staff and blander food. 

My father-in-law wanted to try this place out for some reason, so there were four of us in our party. We sat outside on the enclosed patio. Before I even sat down I was unimpressed. There was green painting tape along one of the edges and corner of our table! I looked around and noticed it on another table as well. A) This restaurant isn't that old so their furniture shouldn't be falling apart. B) If their furniture IS falling apart, REPLACE IT. I've never seen anything so tacky anywhere, not even in a dive bar, a cheap noodle place or a fast food joint. The chairs were really low and had big cushions on them. I thought the cushions were sort of comfy, but the seat depth was so great that everyone felt like they were sitting really far apart, and the cushions weren't tied down at all so I kept sliding around and almost slipped off once. 

Throughout the evening we had three servers - two females and one male - for some unexplained reason. I could barely distinguish the two females from each other. Everything they said was very canned, very scripted, very insincere. The man started to come around more towards the end of our meal and he was so cheesy and just kept saying "For sure, for sure, for sure" over and over, it was irritating. 

We order the mushroom caps to start and they came out at lightning speed,  less than 5 minutes which I don't take as a good sign. Our meals took a long time to come out - at one point the server breezed by and said "It shouldn't be too much longer" but didn't offer an explanation as to what was taking so long in the first place. Three of us got our meals (pizza, nachos, salad - not things that require a lot of cooking time) at the same time. They didn't bring out my mother-in-laws meal for another 5 minutes, again with no explanation. She only had lettuce wraps, so not sure why they took so long, and she said the meat inside was cold. Nothing on the menu was appealing to me - I thought there would at least be a burger. Lots of steak sandwiches, though. I settled on nachos. 

The nachos were bizarre and disappointing. The chips that had toppings on them were soggy, but not in a way that just made them wet and fall apart. For some reason they were incredibly chewy, to the point where my jaw got so tired I had to stop eating even though I was still hungry. Half of the cheese wasn't melted, either. Brutal nachos. 

To top off my disappointing nacho experience, when the male server came to clear our plates he asked if I wanted the nachos packed up. I said "No thank you." He responded with "Ah come on! Pack em up! You know you want to! Come oonnn!" I didn't want to take them because I thought they were disgusting but I didn't feel like mentioning that. Don't press a point here, man. 

The top 40 music they were playing was way too loud for the dinner hour on a weeknight at a restaurant - all four of us were irritated by it. As soon as we paid the bill my mother-in-law said "Let's get the hell out of here, I can't stand this music any longer." I walked through the inside of the restaurant on the way to the washroom and noticed the decor - generic chair restaurant style, thinking it's classy but it seemed too run down for how new the restaurant is. 

There's really no reason for anyone to go here. If you want Canadian/American food, appies to share, and cocktails, at least go to Earl's and get something that you know is decent quality. It's no secret that I generally dislike these types of restaurants in Sherwood Park, but Square One really took it to a new low.

Zero lineup during the day on a Wednesday. Well, actually there were two customers being helped at the counter so a third employee came out from the back to help me immediately as soon as I walked in. Very courteous and helpful.

Really enjoyed our first experience here. The staff came around the counter and went through menu options/choices and spice/heat ratings. Food is made fresh daily, sauce made from scratch daily and they were more than happy to accommodate menu switches for my daughter. Food was excellent and fresh. Will definitely return!

Worst fries ever! Soggy as hell very oily and no one here when we arrived feels like just passing off old fries to customers. Burgers tasteless and greasy as hell we both won't return to this Restuarant  as it was horrible food for burgers! Lucky to get a 2 star rating for the food they serve! Fries should be cooked more and same with the burgers ! A complete disappointment but am sure it won't last long if the food is like this all the time I won't bring my worst enemy here to eat this  food. The owner should be ashamed of the quality of the food he serves I would be!

We heard this place was pretty good through a coworker so we drove in to try it out.  Right off the bat the people are friendly and the place seems pretty clean.  The prices are also really low too.  

We ordered different burgers among the group, a few sets of fries and I tried a poutine.  

The burgers are fresh but to me they seemed a little undercooked and they definitely had fillers. There was no searing to the meat which sort of made it a soggy bite.  The fries, while fresh, are fried in some kind of cheap oil which leaves a really bad after taste. They also did not spread the salt evenly so some of us got really salty fries while others got tasteless fries.  My poutine came out as a plate of fries covered in nacho cheese with a side of gravy.  I almost threw up eating it.  I highly recommend that if you do like poutine to not order it here.

For any parents out there, we have two kids in diapers with us.  They really didn't have many kiddie options which is not a bad thing once in a while.  However they also have no kid facilities beyond high chairs; yes...we had to change the diapers on the floor. Their sinks don't even have a counter top.

They do have pretty good milkshakes. Nothing extrordinary but tasty enough. Not many drink choices beyond that; pepsi brands at that.  

I might go back in a year (probably not) to see how this place evolves but right now it's a cheaply done five guys knock off that really does not hit the spot.  The odds of me returning are the same as me ever enjoying that poutine....slim to none.

Spent about an hr looking for this place as i got lost coming off all the construction between anthony henday and yellowhead .
Finally reached home plate and bought some Tom Yum soup to stay and some spicy peanut and kung pao to go which i'll eat later.
Staff is friendly and the layout of the store is very simple and informal.
There are utensils and sauces on the tables in case you need hot sauce.
They have a lot of water glasses on a side table with 2 types of water taps for plain and bubbly in case  your face starts on fire i guess from the heat. 
You pay up front and they bring it to you.
I doubt i'll drive this far from the west end enough times to get their spice system down pat so i ordered everything mild/medium as i read they understate everything.  
You can always make stuff hotter later but you can't un-spice things.
The soup turned out to be much like a spicy pho broth with small thick beef pieces,vegetables  and flat noodles .
It was pretty complex and very good.
It wasn't very spicy at all though so i ladled in a bunch of sambal olek  to crank it up.
I'll have to add more to this review after i eat the other dishes.
This is a great place to get a pedicure and nails, but be weary of waxing. Very aggressive and painful.
I give it two stars out of five and that's being generous I want to explain my reasons why visit the location for yourself and figure it out thank you

I did not care for Fulton Market, and these guys are worse.
The bun was a 10, the patty a 2.
Frozen and pressed, only flavor is from the flames!
Too much shredded cheddar was all I could taste. 
Fries were good, just potatoes and no salt.
Price was OK.
I give them points for Coke and Pepsi.
Lovely owner/waiter I feel bad for them as well but they are in tough company here in the park.
I wasted my weakly burger time!!!!

I hadn't been in a while and on my most recent visit I realized that there was new ownership. The previous owner made everything from scratch but now everything is boxed and frozen. I was quite disappointed. I probably won't be back. Too bad.

Bar was empty, kitchen closed at 9pm, not going to be the place I go very often. Had the $4 nachos and they were really good. 

Square One also has a massive beer list but nothing really on tap, most of their beers are canned or bottled. 

I have given this place 3 chances and have not been impressed once. Probably be the last time I go.

Nice theatre
I have gone there tons of times. Very friendly staff, nice sized seats and theatres, although the floors in the theatres could be cleaned a little better. The different selection of snacks is nice, and have multiple restaurants is quite convenient for parties or special occasions.  The only downside is that the popcorn often leaves a sick feeling in your stomach, but other options are available.  Overall, it's a good theatre if you're trying to catch a movie without going to Edmonton.

Just got home from seeing Fast and Furious 7. What an action-packed movie ... the excitement of the car and action scenes just never stopped. We enjoyed it at Galaxy Cinemas in their renovated theatre which is setup with a system called Ultra AVG" with has an absolutely "GINORMOUS" screen and a fabulous sound system. They charge an additional $3 but, wow, what an experience. If you go, be sure to sit toward the back of the theatre; we had to move from our seats in roughly the middle of the theatre to near the back as I found the gigantic screen hard on my eyes! I highly recommend viewing from their Theatre 1!

Restaurant looks trendy and clean. (+1 star)
Staff is cool. (+1 Star)
Food is very high quality (+1 stars)  Their "No Spice" level still burns my face off.  (-1 star)
Selection is lacking (-1 stars),  but the dishes they are good (+1 star) and they entertain substitutions. (+1 star)
20 minute wait time for a stir fry dish is a bit ridiculous (-1 stars)

For me - they get 3/5 stars

UPDATE:  15 minutes later my mouth is still on fire.. how is this "No Spice"?  Maybe he misheard me and thought I said "Mo Spice" .. Wow!

I was there September 23/15. Noisy lunch time environment. I was offered a table elbow to elbow with another guest but refused the table. No privacy. 

I came back an hour later around 1:30 pm. Much quieter. 

Clean restaurant. Prompt table service. Nice menu. Veggie choices. A little pricey. 

Lunch specials are ONLY on Tuesday and Thursday which is a bit disappointing. Wish they were every week day. 

Otherwise seems like a nice restaurant for Vietnamese food.
Prices are 40-50% more than they should be and the place could do with being a little cleaner.  To be fair to them, however, Canadian movie theatres are frequently far dirtier than they should be.

I had high hopes for this restaurant. I had read an article saying that the chef had trained under someone noteworthy, so was excited that Sherwood Park finally has a high end restaurant. Unfortunately, I was disappointed.

We went on a Sunday night so it was far from busy. But the service was still slow.

As for the food, we had the Pesto Chicken Pizza, the Carnivore Pizza, the Lettuce Wraps and the Steak Sandwich. 

The Pesto Chicken Pizza was hard to eat. All you could taste were onions. Almost no pesto flavouring at all.

The Carnivore Pizza tasted pretty good, my only complaint was the 2" of crust. So not a whole lot of topping per piece. 

Everything inside the Lettuce Wraps was cold. Decent flavour, but cold.

The Steak Sandwich was perfectly cooked, but it had some weird lemon flavour that didn't fit. 

Sadly, we were all in agreement that it was ok, but we won't be going back. Very disappointed.

Great food, kind of disappointed, I ordered a medium hot Spicy Peanut Noodle Box with chicken and prawns through skip the dishes, only to find one tiny piece of chicken and no prawns. I love their food so much so I was sad when I came upon it. My food still had a great taste, just wish that I got what I paid for.

Excellent! Ordered the Kung Pao Tofu at medium hot. My eyes are watering nicely. Really delicious. I'm looking forward to trying more selections in the future. Presentation was thoughtful and appealing. Nice atmosphere and decor. Owner is approachable and seems very proud of his establishment.

My partner ordered the Coconut Curry Noodles with chicken at medium. He enjoyed his meal very much.

Waited until our 3rd visit to post a solid review. And the third visit didn't disappoint. Great sauces, GREAT NOODLES, and we love the atmosphere. Sauces from scratch. Non-GMO. And if you like HOT food they can bring the heat. We recommend for lunch anytime or casual dinner date. Having Alley Kat on tap is also a plus for me!

We had 4 item from the menu. Pad thaï, coconut curry, kung pao and spicy peanuts. Every thing was great and the portion were very good and super filling even without any protein. Let's just say we're VERY far away from your local Thai express chain.

You know when you find money in your pocket that has been there for a long time, like a 50 dollar bill. That's how it felt finding this place. It's been open for two years now. This place is a Gem. From the staff,ingredient, the biodegradable ustensiles they use and the price. 
Chef Jeffrey was there to answer all of our questions we had about the very interesting menu and diverse item which includes very specific level of hotness. Interesting note, the spiciest was made with the ghost pepper.
We actually went with friends who travelled across Asia and they said that's the most authentic cuisine they had on our side of the pond. Chef Jeff told us that prior to opening their first location, the owners went to Asia and made sure they got all the right ingredients in the pursue of authenticity and taste.
Nachos are awesome!!!!! You have to come try them. Really attentive staff. Great house beer. A %100 recommend

The coolest place to buy glasses. You enter the store and literally have a seat at the bar. The staff are super attentive and knowledgable. Christianne was my "bartender" and brought me so many awesome styles it was hard to choose. She gave me great feedback and I am extremely pleased with my final choice. Next up was Luke who took my measurements and made sure my glasses were well adjusted when I picked them up. He was fantastic, my glasses fit and i have great vision! The prices are comparable to stores with lesser service and have great styles to choose from. I will definitely be a repeat customer.

Hubby had donair, loved the fresh shell and nicely seasoned meat. Fries were a over seasoned, poutine seemed very salty and not that much cheese. 

Very clean place, overall....would recommend. :)

It's right smack in the middle of the mall, great location, easy access for cars and buses. Tickets are at least $13/person, on Tuesdays it's $6.99! I usually go to the movies on Tuesday if something I like or love is in theatres. The staff there are friendly, nice, and helpful, when the mobile kiosk to pick up movie tickets is down, the box office staff help you. I can't wait for the newest Eye-catching wizarding world movie in November. And all of the newest Eye-catching marvel movies. 
Their food is delicious, their poutine is not overly salty, the cheese isn't too big like Costco's cheese, their nachos are fresh every time. I love their points system. It's great. But also difficult to reset passwords and stuff if gmail deletes the accounts. You can only access the points.

My visit today was prompted by Yelp reviews of Registry offices in the Edmonton area.  I required some searches specific to enforcing a court judgement.  A previous visit to the Registry office closest to my home in Stony Plain was an effort in futility.

The line was moderate when I arrived and I had to wait for a bit.  There was a sign posted explaining they were short staff due to summer holidays.  I'm glad I got there after the lunch rush and not near the end of the month.

When I got to the front of the line I realized I was dealing with the Manager.  Shanon was very friendly, she understood EXACTLY what I was looking for and was very eager to help.  It is indeed a pleasure to deal with a business that understand the needs of their customer.  (Possibly even better than I did.)

The only thing I would change is the number of people available to help customers.  But this is Alberta in the summer which makes this a difficult task.

The time Shanon spent with me along with her knowledge and patience pretty much ensures that my future Registry business will be done here.

I have been eating here often for the last couple years. When we first went I wasn't sure which was a decent go to but have now found it and that is all I seem to eat when I order take out. And most of the time I do just that: take out. The vermicelli noddle bowls are great!! I normally get 22, chicken, pork and spring rolls vermicelli noddle bowl. And my wife always gets the Lemongrass prawns vermicelli bowl. If we are really hungry I will also order the Satay soup, and you can choose beef, chicken or assorted meat. Sup to you. Be advised -  it is delicious!!! but if you don't like spicy watch it :)

All I can really say is I'll be back.......this was are first time here and it was outstanding! We had the 4$ notches OMG wow best I've had. Thinking of there is no way I could order more food but after talking with the chef I had to order the strsk (flat iron) sandwich and wow I'm not lieing but BEST I've had . can't wait till tomorrow

I went there for a group party and wasn't aware how much it cost. It is a little on the high side but the food and the decor are good. It looks much nicer than your typical buffet place. I just wish that the chinese food was labelled as I don't eat beef or pork and had to wait for someone to tell me what everything was.

Located right in the heart of Sherwood Park next to the mall, this is often a convenient choice.  However, the drive through is kind of a pain in the behind when it gets busy!  Its either lined up back onto the public road, or you have to block pretty much all of the parking stalls if the line exceeds 2 cars - this can be very frustrating to all involved!  But don't be discouraged; there is a way around it - go in through the south entrance (by the bike shop), park in the south facing stalls along the road, turn off your vehicle, and GO IN!  Trust me, it's for the best!   That being said, when it's not busy it's no big deal and I find this location to be the most accurate in terms of getting what I have ordered.  You don't know how many times I have ordered tea and been given coffee...this is a big deal...soooo not cool! I also find they always have chocolate glazed Timbits that always taste sooo fresh and delicious Mmmm :)

Guys this place is amazing!!! Right in Baseline Village in Sherwood Park, Noodlebox serves just that....noodle boxes. There are stir fry and curry options (so yes, some have rice) but the coolest thing is that everything is made fresh in the store daily. This means their sauces don't come in big plastic bags that are trucked in from around the world. All of the meat and produce is locally sourced! How amazing is that for a fast food place!? It's like an Asian version of what Tres Carnales does for Mexican food. Their spice levels have more kick that normal, so if you like mega heat you will definitely feel it with their Scorching Hot level. The staff is super friendly and we were given a full breakdown of the menu and how everything works upon entering.
Such a great little spot with a great vibe inside. They have some high top tables and then one super long one that seats 16!
Stop here next time you're in Sherwood Park! Do it!!

Great food, great specials everyday, new menu. Met the chef, he was very nice and didn't feel like he was rushed to get back to the kitchen. He trust his support staff. We sat at the bar, bartender was very friendly, even the wait staff took their time to say hi. Will be back for sure.

Great location for the locals of Sherwood Park. Movies and snacks are super expensive, but which movie theatre isn't these days. We usually go when we have a movie pass or scene points to use. The staff is mostly friendly. They lost stars for hours (not open until 3pm on weekdays; I have a smaller child that would love to go while her brother is in school) and when I have waited for the theatre to open at 3pm, they are always 10 - 30 min late opening.

I really should have read the reviews PRIOR to eating here.  Too bad the owners don't read the reviews so they can actually try to make things better.  I was going to tell the lady about the rancid ketchup on the table and that the coke ran out of syrup but I was waiting for her to come and ask how the food was considering I tipped hsr prior to receiving my food (you pay up front and there is a tip option).  I was never asked how the food was until I walked out the front door.  Mind you she had to interrupt her phone conversation to ask me the question.  I was going tell her before writing this review but the sad thing is I don't think she'd do anything about it.

Very friendly service food was good. Owner even came  and sat down and was very friendly and social. We ordered the Hawaiian burger and it was very good lots of flavour ! I would come back again and recommended everyone try it for your self and make your own decision . I like it  and my partner also loved the food and the gravy was awesome.
This is a great place to get nails or a pedicure! It is very clean and well maintained. The technicians are kind, patient and talented. I will continue going and would recommend you do too!

Ahhhhhmazing... And very good portion size for price  Also serves beer and very friendly atmosphere.  In and out pretty quick and compared to other restaurants of its kind, it's by far the best that I've come across.

My wife and I enjoyed this little place. Service wasn't great. Seemed like they were understaffed for how busy they were everytime we have been there. Food was acceptable. Not stellar...not bad. As with most asian food...the doggy bag makes for a great bag lunch the following day. Prices were fair.

Wonderful staff, very knowledgeable  doctor. They put time & effort into me finding just the right pair of glasses which you don't find everywhere so I'm very very happy and we would highly recommend!

You won't find a better donair here in the capital region. That, I assure you. Rob is also a fantastic host who is loved by the community and befriends anybody who comes his way. I highly encourage whoever's reading this to visit this man's business and see what I'm talking about!

I work in the Capilano area so I often get food to go from Taste of Vietnam.   Their vermicelli rice bowls are awesome.   Very flavourful meat and fresh veggies.  I have been there over a dozen times and have never been disappointed.   They are always packed during lunch hour.

Came by for an event. Service was friendly. The place is nice, clean and has a good layout. Trendy atmosphere and cool booths - both large and small.

I ordered the Pina Colada shrimp and although the size of the shrimp was very impressive, the coconut crust was bland...I found myself salting heavily and still unsatisfied with it. The pineapple sauce came with a cool injector thing of hot sauce but I wasn't a fan of the type of hot sauce used (I think it was Buffalo?) and it still wasn't enough to give sufficient flavor to the shrimp. I think this dish has much potential and I love the concept of the Coconut on the shrimp and a pineapple sauce accompanying it...I just think it needs some spices or cajun or chipotle or something to kick start it. 

The dessert was redemption in a dish. Nutella Mudpie...wow. Rich, oh so very rich and delicious. It also had what I think was marscapone or maybe cheesecake in there?--not sure, but definitely tasty. I liked the touch of it coming garnished with a fresh flower- an orchid I think.

Speaking of garnishes, I saw someone else order a Caesar and it was garnished with a chicken wing. Random and cool.

Prices were reasonable but we did order off of a Late Night Menu which had roughly 40% off. Not sure I would come back for full priced menu and yet I'm wondering if their best dishes are hidden in there. 

All in all, Square One seems like a good alternative to the usual sports bars if out just for a few drinks.

A little smaller than some of the theatres but still a nice theatre. Seems less busy than some of the larger theatres in the city and is only a short drive from the south or north east ends of Edmonton. Worth the trip for a comfortable movie experience.

Absolutely amazing food!!! It's a great change from traditional fast Asian food. Great service,  they recommended what I should order and the level of spiciness. I will be back lots. Please do yourself a favor and try it.

Was at square 1 for a private event and we got to try the late night menu. The items were so cheap that we just ordered a little bit of everything.
The nachos were huge for $4 and the sour cream was delicious, but i would have paid more for more cheese and less tomatoes since they made the chips a little soggy
The button Buffalo mushrooms were the highlight of the night, I think they were the only item we actually finished.
We also tried the chicken wings which were good and the shrimp which I do not recommend.
The service was good and the staff were friendly. I was shocked by their awesome craft beer bottle options! They had some really great unique beers available, I enjoyed the Yukon brewing ale which was awesome.
I will likely go back to try out the full menu.

Service was great - the late night eats menu (after 11pm) is awesome, $4.00 nachos which are HUGE - more than enough for two people.  Though, the coconut shrimp was dry and not that amazing.

The caesar came with a chicken wing!  That was pretty sweet, though it was overly peppery - too much pepper for my taste buds, and I'm not crazy picky.

It's a smallish location filled with mostly booths - and some really big ones which are nice. I was here for a special event so I didn't take much time to look at the regular menu or anything, but what I saw so far I liked! It's definitely worth trying out again that's for sure.

My sister has been raving about this place for ages as she's from Vancouver. 

Her peanut bowl was consistent and delicious but she said the spice level was a bit milder than van. 

My Singapore bowl was very filling and very bland.  Not like Singaporean food at all,  and certainly not like a curry.

The thing that was great was the amount of fillings and quality ingredients.  Chicken was plentiful as well as the veggies.  It isn't one of those bowls that are all noodle and no filling.  For that,  it felt healthy,  hearty and is worth trying.

Went here on Christmas Eve for lunch. It was a bit busy for lunch. Service wasn't great. Food was good when we first arrived. Lacking flavour but that is generally what happens at a buffet. WonTon soup was disgusting. Tasted like someone rung out the smelly old gym socks to make the broth. Roast beef was full of gristle and tough and ice cold. Told server she didn't seem to care as the same slab of meat continued to sit there.  Plates weren't taken away very quickly. For 2 people the edge of the table piled up quickly. Paying $3.25 for a beverage is a tad ridiculous. It should be included with the buffet. $40 for lunch is a bit extreme

This little burger joint isn't too bad. Burgers are decent and fires are somewhat soggy but I think thats due to the fact that they are chopped up in the restaurant from regular potatoes so they absorb a bit more oil than usual. Still good though. Never busy so that's why I keep coming back from time to time.

I never did get to try Fulton Burger but I did try Wally's today and was all around disappointed. The lady (owner?) at the till was on the phone/on hold while taking my order and then was having trouble completing the transaction because of her phone call. Her husband (cook) had to come out from the back to finish putting my debit card through. We got our food fairly quickly and it took about 3 bites to realize my Spicy Chicken Burger wasn't spicy at all. I put hot sauce on it myself. My friend said her burger was OK but was certainly of the frozen variety. Fries and coleslaw were "meh" and overall nothing really stood out. With places like Smash Burger and Red Robin in the park, there's really no reason to bother with a burger from Wally's.

Amazing staff, amazing product. Professional and personalised service. The team at eye bar will ensure you get a great pair of glasses that will fit, look great and last. Don't waste your time going to any other optical!

I was counting down the days for this location to open and I was not disappointed!
I've been eating at Victoria Noodle Box(s) since 2008 it's always been one of my favorites. The staff is welcoming and knowledgable and the food is incredible. I can finally have my noodle box more than semi-annually!
Love bringing my kids here. The pop corn is always hot and fresh and the seats pretty darn comfy, not vip theatre comfy but hey its the only movie plex in Sher wood park...

This place has some of the best and freshest Vietnamese food I have had in Edmonton/SP area.  I often go here for the vermicelli bowls and grilled platters (wrap your own with meat of your choosing) which are delicious and extremely well priced.  They also have amazing Kim Chi and onion cakes as well as lemonade soda.  The service isn't always the best, can be slow and a bit abrupt, and they always forget our Kim Chi.  However, the food itself stands out enough that it keeps me going back, and leaving full usually for about 12$.  Check it out if you are in the park!

I remember when this cinema first opened in Sherwood Park.  I was in Junior High and it was a BIG DEAL because the only other theatre was super outdated and stale smelling.  As a teeny bopper, the cinema in the park is like the club scene for the underage crowd - all the girls dress their best to impressed the hockey boys, and flutter around with awkward excitement.  

It hasn't changed a bit!  I come here when trying to avoid the massively overwhelming crowds of South Common, and when I am not in the mood to navigate through downtown to get to Empire.  If you pick the right movie on the right night, the theatre will be empty, and the only struggle you may have is wading through the crowds of oblivious tweens.

Attached to the Sherwood Park Mall, this place is a great alternative to busier cinemas in the city, and definitely worth considering.  Located in the heart of boring, uneventful Sherwood Park, parents with kids aged somewhere between play dates and house parties can perhaps feel a little better about leaving their young unattended here for an evening of healthy camaraderie.

Galaxy Cinema in Sherwood park is the Denny's of Cineplex Odeons. 
Nobody is "going there" but if you live in the area, just like Denny's at 3am it's the only thing around. 
Good service, the same prices as the nicer theaters in Edmonton, and worse Sound/Film .

When I stepped into Galaxy Cinemas even though I liked it's outdated decor, it felt like an older 90's style theater. I expected to see "BACK to the Future!" Posters.

They advertised an Ultra AVX but we were there for Cheap Tuesday so we went into one of the "normal " theaters.

The seats don't recline, there aren't cupholders and they are slightly stiff. When I was watching the trailers I kept wondering, is this movie in 3D? Why is it so fuzzy? Did they forget to give me the 3D glasses? Nope just fuzzy.

Sound? You know that super annoying Scotiabank commercial where that boyfriend goes to all those laces, because of his SCENE card? Well in a bigger theater, you can hear the popcorn really POP. In this theater it just sounds like loud TV.

All in all I'd recommend going here if you live in Sherwood park, don't care about effects, sound, film and are ok with paying the same price as one of the newer theaters.

Why didn't it get 1 star?
Lots of ample free parking!

What could you do to get More stars?
Seriously, either turn this theater into a cult / b list theater like the Metro/Princess or step up your game in EVERY way. I swear the home theater in my friends basement is better than this place.

Went to visions to compare their pricing on a new tv I saw advertised at futureshop. The tv is a samsung 60" 1080p 3D tv on sale for $899. I asked the sales rep if he had that tv in stock and he did! They also have a price beat guarantee, so he sold me the tv for $799!!!! $100 less than the price at futureshop.  It wasn't too busy in the store, they had Tonnes of tvs on display to see side by side comparisons of different models and great attentive sales staff. 5 stars hands down.

Michaels is indeed a "one stop shop" for all craftsy projects. I have found it usefull for projects that the kids and I can do for Mom's special days. 
Personally, it is my go-to store for picture frames. When on sale (which is often), they are reasonably priced and they have quite a selection. Be carefull with their custom frames. I have heard the prices can get out of hand quickly.

Awesome restaurant! I have severe allergies to wheat and dairy and am always leery of trying restaurants like this, but this place did not disappoint! Great customer service, the portions are huge...and exactly as advertised....lots of gluten free, dairy free options plus added bonus is they do not use MSG or GMO products! I will be looking for these guys in our travels.

Nice place and friendly staff. Had the Thai style chow mein which supposedly had a ginger soy sauce but it was extremely bland and couldn't taste any ginger at all. It basically tasted like plain noodles. To top it off there was hardly any meat for the price you pay.

Congrat to DQ Cranford Way, Sher.Pk, #1in fundraising for Children's Miricle Network in Canada. To start this years campaign, I stopped for a juicy Bacon Cheeseburger and a Choco-Cherry blizzard and donated my change, the cashier told me they plan to be númbro uno again in 2012.

(Just as a side note - this location has moved to Chippewa Road in the 'business district' of Sherwood Park, AB) 

I just recently started getting my nails done on a regular basis - for my last set of gel nails and subsequent fill I went to Nails by Donna but in an effort to try new places I decided to give Vo's a try as I had heard good things from a few people. I went in on a Thursday at about noon with no appointment hoping for a walk in. Although they were busy and had other bookings they were, thankfully, able to fit me in before my hair appointment 1.5 hours later. 

The staff were super nice and very personable and the shop appeared clean and welcoming. In comparison to the other nail salon I go to, the lady at Vo's was much faster but slightly less gentle - she cut my skin a few times (very minor) but was extremely apologetic about it (no biggie!). I love the coloured tips and they have a pretty good selection with some really neat designs. I also like the way the nails turned out here more than my other place as they are significantly thinner and less bulky. I also had her free hand a little flower design on my nail and she did an amazing job - I was blown away with her talent! 

All in all I had a great experience here and will definitely be back for a fill soon. Do caution though - they do try to up-sell their other services; however, I did appreciate that as I had never had my eyebrows waxed, so she offered to do them for me, which is something I have wanted to get done but I never really think about it at the time - with nothing to compare it to I think she did a good job :) .

Salad rolls disappointing very little flavor
I had the Philly steak sandwich it was nice and fresh 
My wife had the grilled cheese pulled pork,it was greasy and dry. If you don't like pepper ask for your fries  unseasoned. 
Maybe the chef has the day off 
Will cone back again, but will stick to sitting at the bar. 
Today was training day for the wait staff

I'm never going to go anywhere else for glasses again.

Before my afternoon at eyebar, I had never been to a shop that picks out frames for you. I had mostly done the Family Vision Care thing, where you wander aimlessly around the store and wait for a staff member to come over and unlock the case for you when you find something you like. Not the greatest experience, so it was time to switch it up.

The staff here are fantastic, and the guy who grabbed frames for me (I forget his name, eek! But he was wonderful and wore teal glasses) brought a range of styles and colours he thought might fit my face and my tastes. Most of the frames were great, a couple were just OK, and then there was that one pair - that pair I simply can't get out of my head. Sleek but retro, super cute, and the perfect colour. I've never tried on a pair of glasses that look so great on me.

eyebar actually makes shopping for glasses fun and super stylish! I'll be heading back soon to purchase that dream pair, and I can honestly say I've never been this excited about a pair of new glasses before. The best part? They're totally within my price range, too!

Worth the drive to Sherwood Park, for sure.

With so many restaurants/bars in Sherwood Park, give this a pass. Pretty lousy service, food that was bad, mediocre and just OK, and it was the most uncomfortable place I've ever sat in. 

First off, the food. I had a caesar salad. It was the dish that was OK. My mom had a wrap that tasted fine, but it was served way later than the rest of our food and was cold. It was the mediocre meal. The bad meal was the nachos that I shared with my wife. The worst part about them was the chips were chewy as if they had been microwaved a number of times. The cheese was only half melted. We ordered chorizo as a topping which was good but it was the only thing that was decent on them. The nachos themselves were so chewy they were nearly inedible. 

We also had the buffalo mushroom caps, which weren't actually mushroom caps as I know them (which are the caps of mushrooms hollowed out and stuffed with deliciousness) but rather just small mushrooms cooked in a buffalo sauce. 

When we first arrived our server was attentive. Our appetizer was out very quickly, but the rest of the food took a very long time to arrive and as I mentioned, one of them arrived late and cold.

When our server brought the food, she noticed my water was empty. She said she'd be right back with to top it up, but decided instead to fall of the face of the earth. The two servers who were serving the table beside us brought two orders of waters to that table by mistake so I had to ask if we could have them, as our server had vanished. 

So onto the seating. On the patio there are very low tables that have a large cement block underneath them. This meant no leg room. The equally low chairs mean tallish guys like me have to stick their lanky legs somewhere and there was no room to do that. To compound the problem, the chairs were more like loungers, with long seats and very short backs. I left feeling sore and tight. Whoever ordered that stuff wasn't thinking. It just didn't work. 

And I'm not being whiny here. I have never had a furniture related complaint at any other restaurant or bar before. My dad mentioned it to a server who said he had heard that many times.

I'm not a huge fast food fan but I must admit that I enjoy the Blizzard at Dairy Queen.  I recently went there to get some ice cream for my family and was  happy to see that they had a buy one blizzard get the second one for $0.99 deal on.  Only problem is that my wife likes the sundae's there not the blizzards.  When I ordered and asked if I could get the $.99 deal on the sundae I was pleasantly surprised that the lady at the till was more than accommodating.  She simply entered it as a special "hot fudge blizzard unmixed" put it in a blizzard cup and problem solved.  I love it when people are not nit picky about the rules and will continue to frequent this place because of this.

This little gem is tucked away in sherwood park. It's a great spot for lunch and you get a ton of food. Pro tip: order the kids box if you aren't super hungry. It's a lot of food. I haven't had a bad meal here yet. It always comes out fast and super fresh and tasty. Warning: I like spicy but even the medium here is not for the faint of heart so keep that in mind when you choose your spiciness. It's one of those places where you order at the front counter and then sit down and it gets delivered to you. I love that they have unlimited sparkling water for free and that you don't feel obligated to tip because you bus your own table. The food is kind of like a wok box or Thai express but way more fresh and delicious. It's a definite favourite of mine and  if you are in the mood for some delicious Asian cuisine you should definitely give this place a try. I am not sure why I can't give it 5 stars. Maybe it's the price. Its just a little steep for me.

The location is good, but everything else is lacking. We had such high expectations because of all the hype when they first opened, but we were disappointed. We were seated, and watched the waitresses attend to everyone but us for 10 minutes. We were in a high visibility spot, so there was really no excuse. As we were about to get up and leave, the waitress finally came to take our drink order. Another 15 minutes and we received them... but I am fairly certain my vodka diet coke had no vodka in it. We then ordered food and it was... not good. I'm no great cook myself, but I could have made a better dish. My food was burnt on the outside but cold on the inside. My husband's chicken was cold, like they had just brought it out of the fridge or something. We had to wait 20 minutes to get our plates cleared, and another 10 for the bill (the restaurant was NOT busy but the girls were sure chatting with each other a lot rather than serving customers). When we paid with the debit machine, you had to specifically select that you didn't want to leave an automatic 18% tip. Don't assume you will get an 18% tip and try to trick customers into giving it. I have never seen a debit machine set up that way, and was honestly shocked that they'd try to coerce people into it.

Home style burgers. Good fresh toppings. Heinz ketchup. Fries are as good as New York Fries. $8 for cheeseburger combo. Well worth it when compared to fast food places. 

And, quick service.

When I went with a coworker, she mentioned that, at previous job, her coworkers would drive over from Edmonton just to pick up lunch from this place -and I can see why.
