I've been here twice in the last month and both time, my food was delicious, flavourful and more unique than your average Vietnamese place. Yum!

The best Donairs in Sherwood Park! We've been eating Robbie's Donairs for 17 years. First at the old location that he sold a few years ago, and now thankfully at his new and improved spot. The shop is clean and bright, the food is always fantastic, and Robbie is an awesome host!

We had a good friend come to town and had a bit of a reunion, so we all went to Square One. The place was dead when we got there, so we thought figured, "Perfect! There are 12 of us so we will get faster service this way!" Boy were we wrong. The server didn't come over to us for 12 minutes. That's right I timed it. I tried going up to the bar to order our first round of drinks (we originally planned to have a ton of drinks and stay all night) and was told my server would be over shortly, and when I asked again if I could just order the first round from them and settle up while we wait, I was told NO! So we finally got our server, ordered our drinks, and then it took 16 minutes to get them!!! They waited on the bar for 9 of those minutes. When I went up to the bar to grab them myself I was told I was not allowed to take them to the table, and when I told them that no one else was doing it, I was given a dirty look and and the bartender walked away. And that was how Square One dealt with a complaint. Walk away. The server then brought the drinks over and walked away, even though we were ready to order, and we were saying, "We'd like to order please" and she acted like she couldn't hear us (we were 1 of 3 tables in the whole place and it was very quiet and my friend said it very loudly). The service never got better, we only got one more round of drinks as it took almost 20 MORE mins to order/get them. The menu was VERY lame, and sparse, and the food we got wasn't very good, not bad, but not good, and the portions were light. The drink menu was very light as well. By the time we got our food the place had started to fill up and we never saw our server again. Definitely no reason to go back as there are many many MANY more places within a 15 KM radius that offer all that they have and more, with GOOD service. Very strange place...

Chris:
It was very quiet on a Saturday afternoon.  They turned off most of the ceiling lights, resulting in a drab and depressing atmosphere.  I had the quintessential bowl of pho w/ rare beef.  The broth tasted diluted.  The beef was sliced a bit thicker than most other places;  I practically could've used a knife and fork.  

Near the end of our meals, most of the staff sat down in the dining room and had their lunch without even flinching to see how we were doing.  I stood in the middle of the room for a few seconds, flashing my hard-earned twenties, waiting for someone to accept my payment.

David:
I think it was inappropriate for the entire staff to be eating while customers are around.  Otherwise there was a healthy amount of meat in my bowl of pho. 

Verdict:
We hate to think that what we had was a "taste" of Vietnam, because surely, true Vietnamese cuisine should blow our minds. First impressions are important in many facets of life.  For "A Taste of Vietnam", our first impression of the place was disappointing.
Saw This Means War & LMFAO, it was a very good film,if you like comedy and action.

Two stars simply for the customer service. They come by every two bites to take away plates, refill drinks etc. They did ask how the food was, we couldn't reply. It was horrible. Cheapest cuts of meats, powdered potatoes and packaged rice etc. We have eaten here before and never thought it so terrible. We will never return. It was well below standards for any restaurant let alone one that charges $30/pp!!! I will send "corporate" a review, call or whatever as well so I don't need a personal apology attached to this. There is no excuse.

This location is poorly managed. I live right by it and keep giving it a try every month or so. The store is severely understaffed! If you see a line up in the drive through and you think you'll save time by going inside? Guess again. All the employees are scrambling trying to satisfy the drive through. Want a grilled cheese? Make sure you ask them to put the cheese in. I've received anything from no cheese in a grilled cheese, plastic wrap in a breakfast sandwich, frozen milk, the list goes on. This has been happening for years. I feel bad for the employees because I truly believe they are stretched too thin and having to cut corners to keep times short. Really has soured my taste on the company as a whole. I will be going to the "other guys" from now on.

The staff were very friendly and informed us how the menu worked and that some of the ingredients are locally sourced!

The teriyaki bowl was flavourful with lots of noodles. Never had pad Thai before so not sure if that is what it is supposed to taste like. Skip the root beer, it has no "bite". 

The bowls were really big and provided lunch the next day!

As far as Vietnamese food goes, this is pretty run of the mill. Reasonable Prices, good flavours, good selection. I would consider this more of a local joint as opposed to something one would drive half an hour for. 

I had the Special Pho, was pretty good I guess. Not bad for a meal out when you're too lazy to cook, but certainly not a culinary experience. 

Was a good time, I guess!

Below average burger. Lacks taste. Terrible service. I ordered a burger and fries to go. Waited almost half hour. Noticed people that came in well after in large groups getting served first. Only thing is, all the orders were wrong. Burgers are being cooked by what looked like an 8 year old kid. Won't go back.

Best noodle place ever. Walked in, the guy came out from behind the counter explained all the dishes and basically picked them for me. All fresh vegetables and almost everything is made in house, highly recommended. And the got some really really spicy noodles

Once the proud location of Fulton Market, this dive has retained the decor but not the ability to make edible food. Don't fooled by the untouched familiarly of the tables,chairs,logos and art which remain from the Fulton days, this is no burger joint. It's a disgusting greasy spoon.

The menu now has a handful of burgers surrounded by breakfast fair and other entrees. My wife ordered a Bacon cheeseburger and I a chili burger. With drinks and her side of rings it was just short of $20 so the prices haven't changed either.

As the food was delivered we were suddenly swarmed by clouds of fruit flies that came from nowhere. The burgers were thin wide patties cooked on a flat top, clearly frozen purchases from a wholesaler. Gone are the thick hand packed burgers of old. Neither of us finished and both of us were toilet bound within an hour.

Avoid at all costs.

This is probably my favourite "fast food" noodle take out place in Sherwood Park and Edmonton. I love their pad Thai - most fast pad thais are too saucy, and this one is just right. They don't have butter chicken often but when they do - get some! You won't regret it. Staff is friendly, decor is hip, and I love all their eco-conscious details.

This is the only place my 7 year old and I can agree on when we go out to eat. Despite there not being a specific kids menu she always enjoys the food she gets. Last time we were there she ordered a chocolate milk, and I can only assume they went out and got chocolate milk specifically for her because it took longer than the rest of the drinks and I saw them pouring it from a little 500ml carton. THAT's amazing service.
So delicious! Portion sizes are big and the food is absolutely amazing. They try to use local food which is also a big plus. Sooooo good!!

A friend suggested i try the burgers here.... YUMMY, best burger i have had.. WAY better than 5 guys, fatburger etc,, the burger had a flavour, the brioche bun was fresh, I had the single burger with cheese, bacon, carmelized onions and mushrooms..... i could barely stand afterwards... and of course i stole my husbands fries and they were also yummy.  Next time i am going to order the same burger and add a chocolate milkshake,,, they looked delicous.   Seriously best burger ......Not only was the food excellent ,, but the people running the place... very friendly........

Well, we thought we'd give this burger place a try, somewhere new to try in Sherwood park. My opinion is, it didn't really blow me away and it didn't really upset me. I had the Philly cheese steak, which want bad, little bland except the sauce, which was good. Overall, not bad, kids liked the poutine, and I found my onion rings way too greasy.

First of all, we've been quite a few times, so this isn't a first impression.  Instead, this review is based on the food quality and service over several years.

Upon walking in, the restaurant has nice presentation, appearing clean and understated.  Unfortunately, the tables are nearly always sticky and the chairs often contain bits leftover from the previous diner's meal.  An closer look reveals condiment containers with drips down the side and even mould growing around the lids.  I must add that the general griminess is a fairly new development.  When we first began coming here, everything was always well taken care of.  The bathrooms are clean and tidy.

We're always seated very quickly, though our order isn't always taken promptly.  The wait to order (or even get drinks) has been getting longer and longer each time we go.  Since there are only two or three servers even during busy times, I'm understanding and would forgive a wait for our food, but to be left at our table without even water to drink for twenty minutes is a little much.  

Once ordered, the food comes fairly quickly and is on par with most other Vietnamese restaurants we've been to across the Prairies.  They don't have a vegetarian menu section, but do offer a few vegetarian dishes that are clearly marked.  I'd like to see a little more variety here.  They happily supply me with peanut sauce instead of fish sauce at no extra charge and at their own suggestion.  I like the way they prepare the tofu for the vermicelli bowls - crispy and moist.  Very tasty.

Interestingly, the worst service comes when it's time to pay.  We've stood at the front with money in hand while our server seats other patrons, takes a few phone calls, and allows our transaction to time out on the machine while she accepts cash for a take out order.  Once, she let the transaction time out and didn't even look at the receipt, just tucked it into the drawer and then took another call.  We waited until she was free and pointed out that the transaction hadn't completed.  She laughed and apologized, always friendly, but still...  We're not the dine-and-dash types, but we have marvelled at how easy it would be.  

I do enjoy having good food close to home, but I dislike shoddy service and sticky tables.  I'm sad to say that we're not going back.

I came here today for a late lunch after reading such positive reviews. Needless to say, I was disappointed with both service and food.

When I walked in, there was just one other customer eating at a table. Being this was my first time eating here, I had to take a minute to stand at the front to review the menu board overhead. There was a gentleman (possibly the owner?) standing at the cashier waiting for my order. I told him it was going to be a minute or two as i had to review the menu. In the meantime, a couple walked in and strolled right up to the till to order. Fine. By the time they were done ordering, I was ready. I decided to try the Cambodian spring rolls & Thai green curry. The gentleman asked me what kind of protein I wanted and what spice level? So I asked for beef and mild. He immediately responded that I could expect the curry to be very spicy at least a 5 on the scale of heat. Alarmed, I second guessed myself. I told him I'd had green curry plenty of times before from authentic Thai restaurants throughout the city, to which he replied if it wasn't spicy then they didn't make it right - "Thai green curry uses green chilies so it's supposed to be spicy and if it isn't then it wasn't made right". He seemed very annoyed he had to explain and educate these things to me. So after he scared me how spicy the curry was I decided to change my mind and instead ordered the Pad Thai noodles. But before I finalized the order, I inquired about the Thai style Chow Mein and asked what exactly it was. He then proceeds to "educate" me that it's just like Chinese style so "If I've ever had Chinese style chow mein it's pretty much the same except with basil" (Um excuse me?  What's with the attitude? And you can clearly see that I'm of Asian descent - Chinese actually -so yes I have had Chow Mein many times since I was young, heck i've even made it so please don't speak to me like i'm an idiot). Anyways, I decided to stick with the Pad Thai with Chicken after that explanation. The gentleman felt he needed to warn me once again that the spice level of this dish was a 4 because of the red chili. Fine. I paid and sat down and waited. When the food finally arrived, I was surprised to see must how anemic my Pad Thai looked. The rice noodles were barely coated with sauce - they were sticky and needed a lot more sauce to make these taste good. The ratio of noodles to toppings was large - I basically ate biteful after biteful of noodles and every so often was lucky to get a piece of veggie, egg, or even chicken (I think I counted 8 small bite-size pieces of chicken throughout the whole bowl). Also, the spiciness level was surprisingly so little - what heat?! - that his forewarning made me laugh - I should've ordered the Green Curry after all.

It was disappointing. Also, the Cambodian spring rolls never arrived because the same gentleman thought I wavered on those and so didn't order them for me even though he apologized and said he should've asked - he didn't.

I didn't have enough time to finish eating my Pad Thai so I got a take out box to put the leftovers in.

I'm disappointed in the whole experience. I was wanting someone to welcome me warmly to this new & exciting establishment, to take the time to tell me what the values were for this business - it looks like they believe in sustainable products? But then again i'm not sure. I wanted to know the story behind this place and I got none of that. I feel like the owners think they have a great knowledge of Southeast Asian cuisine - probably because they've travelled there before, and I suspect many a time. 

The place itself was too cold with air conditioning and the music being played overhead was Oldies diner music. How strange and mis-matched to the food and surroundings.

The set-up of the establishment is nice with an open-style kitchen, a long wood communal table, some high top tables, and window seats and floor to ceiling windows on 2 sides of the place which brings in lots of natural light.

Overall, I would be very hesitant to return after this very disappointing experience in both service & food.

My daughters and I have been getting our nails and toes done by Thao and Yim, sisters, for years. It's a family business with a brother and sister in law also working there. 
We love the sisters! Their nails are professional, long wearing and beautiful. They do whatever style/design you imagine. 
I like white air brush ombré tips, a milder French manicure. The daughters are more flamboyant with colours, gems, and shape. 
Not until an extended visit away from home facilitating a nail fill did I realize how extraordinary the sisters were. The cleanliness, and fastidious work is awesome!! You always go satisfied, no inner panic to run home and file errors. 
Thank you Thao and Yim for spoiling me, I can't get my nails done anywhere else!

I don't know why it took me so long to try noodle box... possibly because there are so many restaurants in that part of sherwood park and the place is simply called noodle box, but once I did try it is was pleasantly surprised.
I like my food spicy, so I ordered my satay noodle box spicy..... the guy behind the counter launched into a questioning period of 'have you eaten here before' and 'are you sure you want it that hot '.... he recommended I only get it as medium hot. He was right, medium hot was perfect.... they chop Thai red chillies into your bowl, so the hotter you request, the more chillies they add. I wouldn't have wanted more than I got.
The bowl I got was delicious and I can't wait to go back and have it again.

I used to be an optician so I like to pick out my own glasses. I know what I like and what looks good on me. It felt weird for me to sit their and have some one lay frames in front of me. I have a smaller head and like funkier frames. It is hard to describe what you are looking for when you are not sure.

I did manage to find a pair and they were on clearance (yeah!). I asked if I could just have the frame as I still needed to get my eyes checked. They said that was fine but there would be no warranty. I was fine with that.

My mom got her last pair of glasses here (I don't really like them). I think it is good for people who are uncertain of frame shapes or sizes. It is something I prefer to do myself, I felt awkward.

It is an older theatre  but that is fine with me. The seats are comfortable enough and it isn't as busy as some of the other theaters. I think it should be reflected in the ticket price but that isn't likely to happen.

They have the regular concession and a fast food concession. There is also a games room. They do offer 3D movies but I can't comment on them as I have never been to one.

I live in Sherwood Park so this is the theater we usually go to unless the movie isn't playing
Great food, great service (Nick was AMAZING!!!!!! Super busy but made us feel right at home while we waited), great music, great atmosphere. I will be back for sure!

Update:  I went in a second time to speak to a manager, and he refunded me the difference, however it still didn't come with the extras for the same price that was offered elsewhere and my previous experience still is preventing me from going back or recommending it.  As a result upgrading from 1 star to 2 stars.

Just had our Vehicle Washed & detailed. Wasn't too happy with the sales man at the get go. Just wanted a simple cleaning inside & out. Then he started to go on about a whole bunch of other things. Long story short we now have a very clean & detailed vehicle. For a bit more than I wanted to pay for. Also they should give you a time est. As you can be stuck at that place for a few hours. Will I go again nope !

I love the food at this place.  It never disappoints.  It is always fresh, tastes delicious, and their variety is amazing!  The only thing that does disappoint me is the service as it isn't always friendly.

Awesome! Been here a dozen times and absolutely love it. My only complaint would be that the spice level isn't consistent. Also don't get the spring rolls because you only get 2 for $6.50. Everything else is Devine!

GREAT fresh and exciting food with a fusion of flavors not readily available.  Clean.  Emphasis on recycling and frowns on waste.  Efficient.  GREAT options and very desirable tastes and entrees.  Affordable.  Would help of front counter service was always helpful and energetic and pleasant and warm.  Sometimes it is and sometimes it isn't.  Would help if could eat outside - tables, umbrellas, etc.  Would also help if they advertised.  Great place to eat.  Sherwood Park is lucky to have it.

I was so excited when Wally's opened. There menu has plenty of options. I went back several times that first week or two as I was excited to try everythning (fish, chicken, beef, even their breakfast). The prices are fair. And actually I really enjoyed their breakfast sandwiches when compared to franchised competition.
 My kids also really took a liking to Wally's...but as all they like are hotdogs and cheeseburgrs with ketchup, the menu was somewhat lost on them! That being said...I certainly would rather bring them here than most of the chain fast food joints.
Service is great. Owners are very friendly and within weeks...they knew my kids by name.
...
The bad.
I must say that I did begin to feel that the hamburgers were lacking in the quality department. Toppings and combinations there of were good...but the meat was just mussing simething.

I have taken a break from Wally's for a few months. But I'll be back. So many (too many!) options out there. 

Give Wally's a shot. Bring the kids. Have an ice cream to top it all off.
The variety and prices deserve...a few chances...to find your favorite!

It's tough for me to write this as I do generally like the staff here and they do a great job of keeping the dining area clean but this location still leaves alot to be desired.

I find this Tim's to be very drive through focused and you almost can't blame them when you see how bad the line here gets wrapping around the building and making it difficult for those parked in stalls to get out but it still can be a pain for those standing inside. During off peak times I have been standing out front waiting for service while all the staff behind the counter work on completing 2-3 drive through orders before anybody will acknowledge me at the till. During busy times it's much worse and I have sometimes left with stale food or the wrong beverage in my cup.

Expanding a little bit more on the topic of food I must say the quality and consistency here is just all over the place. Sometimes I leave with everything tasting great and there have been other times where I have ordered the garden salad and it's missing some of the toppings or like I mentioned earlier I ask for a donut early in the day when you expect it to be fresh yet when I get to work I find myself with a dry brick.

I have worked out in Sherwood Park now for about a year and im quite certain the help wanted signs have been out consistently for the whole 12 months. If staffing issues are the concern here I would really encourage them to look at raising the wages to entice folks out in Edmonton to make the commute.

This theatre is older but it seems a little less busy then others which I do appreciate. Staff are friendly and helpful but I find the concession takes a lot longer then it should.  All and all a good experience and we will be back.

I love this place, the first thing you notice as you walk in the door is the super friendly staff and the nice decor. I love that you can order your food with different spice levels. The portions are great and the food is super tasty. I highly recommend the Spicy peanut noodle box. Also if you go here enough they WILL remember your name.

A man that works at this restaurant had given my mom's friend a gift card to give to me, because he wanted to date me. He left his number for me to call him if I wanted to get to know him too. (He met me once at my mom's party)
I wasn't interested in getting to know him, but since he gave me a gift card, I wanted to bring my friend here. The first time we decided to go, they were closed for summer vacation. The next time we were free, I called to make sure they were opened!
We went during the day on a week day.
The first thing I did when I was inside the restaurant was check how much was on the gift card. The lady checked for me said that there isn't any money on the card?! 
I asked if that man was working today and she told me he isn't in right now...
I told the lady to tell this man that he shouldn't be giving people a blank gift card.
Moments later, I realized he was probably using it as a business card?! 
Since we were already here, we decided to give it a try. We both ordered a beef noodle soup and a side of kim chi. 
The soup didn't have any real flavors and the meat was alright. I felt like I was eating food from the food court.
Also, Kim chi and onion cake didn't originate from Vietnam.
I couldn't find a "taste" of Vietnam in my food. 
There was a lack of lighting and openness to the restaurant. 
As we were leaving the parking lot, the waitress ran after me to give me back my money, because that man just came in, and he paid for our bill. =)

I feel really bad for this place. They were much better when they were Fulton Market, my partner and I went in for dinner tonight. We went in knowing that they had a different name but what we didn't know is they have new owners too. 

Back when they were Fulton Market the burgers were fresh and the every bite was a joy. Now they have gone to using hamburger patties that you would expect to get at a Hockey Rink when you're watching your 10 year old play hockey. I refused to even finish my burger (The Classic) because the burger patty tasted like cardboard.

The only reason I'm giving this a 2 star is because, unlike the burgers, the milkshakes haven't changed and the lady that served us was very polite and courteous.

Bring back real meat and the ability to build your own burger and this place will stand an actual chance of me coming back or recommending it to anyone.

I used to be a huge fan of this place, but little by little I've been disappointed and it's getting harder and harder to forgive the "little mistakes" and inconveniences.  It seems that the chef's just don't care anymore or they're like I was when I worked at Xtreme pita in high school and thought I was doing everyone a favor when I heaped on the cheese and sauces instead of following the proper recipe. I've been hoping it would go back to being good, but I think I'm done with Square One.

I was so disappointed in Wally's Burger & Bistro!

I was a huge fan of Fulton Burger and was very disappointed when they closed. Although this restaurant is in no way affiliated with them, I held out some hope that it might be a good place to get a burger that isn't a fast food chain.

We were sadly let down. We were served by people who appeared to be the owners - a couple. The woman was confused and not able to process our order properly. She ended up forgetting my drink when all was said and done.

The burgers were bland and basic. The ingredients did not taste fresh at all. The fries were nothing special and the whole meal left us feeling 'blah' for lack of a better descriptor.

It was a warm day and we ended up hurrying to finish our order because it was so hot inside. We were the only people there so it wasn't become it was a hopping place that was fighting to get their A/C to keep up!

Chinese dishes were good,best Chow Mien in SPark,no waitin for table.Friendly/attentive staff.price was a bit high, but not bad,lots of variety in the dishes.only disappointment was the grilled sausage did not have much taste. Would I go back?---you betcha. I suggest adding more Med type food.

Noodle bowl was ok. Nothing to spectacular but what I found more disturbing was the large mural on the wall talking about ethical food but when asked about it the response was disappointing. They buy local when possible but really only for 2 months out of the year. Then the staff member went on to tell me how they ensure all animals are slaughtered with the upmost care and only use Halal meat. Anyone familiar with Halal meat knows it is definitely NOT the most ethically humane way to kill an animal. In fact it is the opposite. I only purchased food from them once and will never go back.

Had such an excellent time here. Buffets are always considered low end and not the best but this place has a beautiful atmosphere and lots of great food options. The staff were extremely friendly and I got to eat my heart out. I would 100% recommend coming here if you're looking to sit comfortably for a while with a good friend and eat as much as you please!

I had referenced the struggles this location has with crowds a bit in my last review and I can say that nothing has changed since I wrote the initial review in November and infact it has actually gotten much worse. You would think being across from the mall management would understand they are going to be busy during the holiday season and staff their business accordingly but I have come in twice in the last month or so to long lines,backed up food orders,and extremely stressed out staff. I actually had a girl serving me once who was so stressed out that she was having troubles talking and her hands were shaking when I went to hand her my money. Mind you with management like they have here I can't blame the staff for being this way. I have been in twice now where there has been staff verbally abused by management in full view of the customers. The first time it was a shift supervisor and the second time it was a man in a Tim Horton's dress shirt which lead me to believe it might have been the main manager or even the owner of this location. Nothing ends my relationship with a business faster then watching people in positions of authority abuse their employees so I can honestly say im done patronizing this Tim's now. It sends the wrong message to staff about how much you appreciate their efforts and the wrong message to customers about how  to treat your staff when visiting the business. There is a much better Tim's a short drive away from here in Baseline Village and I highly recommend people take their business over to that location.
OK thrid time is the charm right not this 3rd. Ordered lunch and had sliders bun dry meat pushed fat over cooked and burnt don't think we will be back to bad first time was great
The spice scale is hotter than usual. Tried numerous items on different occasions.  Food is generally bland aside from being spicy. Everything is fresh and clean though

Upon first entering the Sherwood park Michaels, I must admit I was completely overwhelmed by the sheer volume and amount of supplies they had to offer! I never realized how many items there were in existence, or of all the possibilities and selection. But thanks to the staff and service, it was a happy ending. I had the pleasure of being served personally by Sharon, the stores manager. She was extremely knowledgeable and patient as she waited on me with her full attention throughout my lengthy constantly changing ideas. If the rest of the staff is half as helpful and kind as their leader......I swear that you'll have the greatest shopping experience possible, even for the most clueless craft seekers!
We have been there a bout 5  times an even with our friends. Friendly staff an great food, a bit pricey but you get what you pay for! We will fore sure, go back.

A surprise trip out to Sherwood Park the other day led us to A Taste of Vietnam. A large, clean, classy looking restaurant, it offers pretty much everything one would expect in a Vietnamese restaurant: pho noodle soup, vermicelli noodle dishes, rice dishes, stir frys, and the like. 

I, of course, had to try the pho (i am a real pho-natic!) and was impressed with the size of the portion and amount of sliced, medium-well beef. The broth could have used a bit more flavour, as it was very one-dimensional. Using some of the side garnishes helped with that a bit.

My companion had the Shanghai noodles with chicken, which he enjoyed. It had a good flavour and a good portion size. He also enjoyed the onion cakes we had to start. The onion cakes are very large, taste almost baked instead of fried, and have a bit of ground chicken in them. They are also not cut, which made them a bit awkward to eat.

The prices are in line with other VIetnamese restaurants, service was very fast (the fact we were there at an off hour probably helped), and again, it is a very nice place. If you are in Sherwood Park and looking for Vietnamese food, check out Taste of Vietnam.

I have dined here on many occasions now,.Nice place.
Trendy.
Fresh. Flavorfull. Filling.
I have sampled most of their noodle dishes, several sides, and some of the daily specials.
Food looked great.
Fresh. Flavourfull. Pretty damn good.
I am always surprised how full I get.
Doesn't happen this fast often. I feel they should have half order sizes...but they don't appear to.
Sadly, my biggest point of contention of late is their inconsistant application of their spice. I always stick with a mere 1 on their scale. Several time now I have gotten home woth my take-out only to find that the dishes are hot enough to set my tastebuds ablaze. Given the range of spice they offer...the really so need to be carefull. It gets damn hot. Had I been dining in on these occassions...they certainly would have beem remaking my meals.
Regardless...I'll be back. 
It is indeed quite good.

I like this theatre but they have to do something about the commercials. We want to wreck it Ralph today and there was about 45 minutes of commercials to get through, not even previews. It was brutal to sit through. The commercials started about 25 minutes before the start of the movie and continued another 20 minutes after the start time.

Well to my elation my night was salvaged by this amazing vibes and bestest music restaurant with food that takes you on a taste journey. Thank you noodlebox will return will spend my money willingly here!!! Worth every dollar!

First of all, I would just like to add that a review is just a review. An opinion from someone else. I suggest you check it out for yourself before judging then maybe make your own opinion of what you thought. But since you're already on here reading reviews let me tell you a bit of what I think. Now, everything here down to the honey garlic sauce for your wings and the clamato juice for your ceasars is made from scratch. I promise it will not taste like what you are used to, but it does taste like it should. No pocessed foods from a bottle on the shelf at Sobey's. Now, think about the last time you had made from scratch food other than your house? The first time I was here, my poutine came out with a bright yellow looking gravy on top. I was judging a book by it's cover and already labelled it as gross and then I gave it a chance. This was by far the best gravy I had ever had in my life. They have since changed their gravy, now I hope it's not because people complained about it not being exacly like everywhere else, but anyway. I have had the nachos, they are ok as far as nachos go. But let's be honest, the chefs are probably top chefs and red sealed. Let's not judge them by their hability of laying down some chips on a plank and then topping them with meat, veggies and cheese. If you want to be blown away, take something they actually make. The wings are amazing, the fries and that seasoning are the best fries you will ever have, the spinach and cheese dip is out of this world, and i could go on. You will probably notice that there are no burgers on their menu, ask them why, they have a pretty interesting story when it comes to the reason. They have pretty awesome specials every night, like one for example 10% off appetizers with every Oilers goal. If you made it to this point in my review, I sure hope I have convinced you to at least try it out. It has soon become my favorite place to go anytime we go out to eat, and I am sure with our upcoming move in that area, we will quickly become regulars in this great atmosphere pub. Will you?

I love Michael's, but this location disappointments me.The staff has told me that they are considered a smaller location, so they don't get the same stock that the other locations in the city get. I don't like driving into the city, so I just usually go without, or find what I'm looking for elsewhere in the park, or online.

Here's the deal.. I hate cilantro.. Remember this...

First time in, got what looked like an amazing dish! Asked to have it without cilantro.. no big deal!

Waited around a little while, clearly made fresh as much as possible! Took my first bite and decided, I'll be back frequently! Great grub!

Second bite.. Cilantro... Whole dish, ruined...
So I went and asked how much of a pain in the ass would it be to have it remade without cilantro.. He said it wouldn't be, but he'd have to recharge me for it... To which I replied, but I asked to have it made without cilantro... To my surprise.. He disagreed and said I never did..

So here's the deal... His attitude toward the whole situation sucked and I expected more.. Maybe I didn't ask, but I distinctly recall requesting my dish without cilantro.. BUT, the reason this establishment is getting 5 stars, he gave me the benefit of the doubt, remade my dish for free and have me a to go box for the tainted dish. 

Please eat here! Like I said, the attitude sucked in that interaction, but, by giving me the benefit of the doubt, I will certainly return. Also, the food is top notch, 100% amazing! Assuming you like a little spice in your dish!

The food is ok for a buffet and there is lots of variety. I did find that the price was excessive and it doesn't even include a drink. That's another outrageous cost added on. Our family of 4 ended up with a bill over 100.00 and none of us had more then one plate of food. I don't think I would return to this buffet just because of the poor value. You can go to Montanas, Applebees and a number of others to get great food at a much cheaper price and they even come around to refill your drinks.
I went here after reading the reviews and I hated it. My fries were soggy and the burger was soggy... not the bun but the patty it self was mushy. I ended up throwing it out .. I would not go back

Disappointed today the sliders had no meat, was so flat the cheese was thicker than the meat. My son had the Philly cheese steak wasn't nearly as good as the one that we had last week on Sunday. There was no dressing on it just a plain bun, The Caesar salad was made with very bland dressing. Husband order a steak sandwich instead of the sliders. Steak sandwich was very good once again. 
Had to continually ask for water. We were the fourth table here.  Two wait staff and a manager, She did not even come by after we sent good back to the kitchen. 
We were given spiced pumpkin seeds which were tastey.

The only reason I'm not giving this place one star is because I didn't get sick. I don't even know where to begin.

The meat. The roast beef and ham were so dry, and the beef was a cut of meat that should not be served as a roast. And the girl cutting it was cutting it about a half inch thick; major food waste.

Nothing even looked amazing, so I didn't try too many things. I was sure the $30 Saturday dinner was supposed to have dim sum and it didn't. We had 4 kids with us and even they didn't like their food. 

One thing that really didn't sit well with me was the girl carving the beef stepping away from the carving station to clear our plates and returning to the carving station. 

They also dropped off our bill for 7 adults and 4 kids without asking if we would like it split or together, so that took a while for them to correct. 

I definitely won't return to this location. Maybe the gigantic "hiring all positions" sign should've steered us away.
It is located upstairs.  Large inside.  They have a good selection of materials.  They offer courses.  Staff have been very helpful on the courses.  Large rooms to spread out things.  See photos.
Very friendly! Amazing customer service ! Thank you Shannon and Paul . Squeezed us in and make a great experience !

Unfortunately due to a lack of walk in traffic, they were forced to close.  Sad, sad day it is..... Original Review:  This place is awesome! Its our new favorite restaurant in Sherwood Park. Great food, well priced. Staff is friendly, and the atmosphere warm. Don't listen to the negative Nancy's... they wouldn't know good food if it... well you know.

By far the most EFFICIENT, FRIENDLY AMAZING registries office I have EVER witnessed in my entire life! Not only do they treat every person who walks in with respect and kindness, they actually know how to do their jobs as well!! Instead of working against u and hating the world like the rest of the registry offices out there....they actually try to make your day easier and allow you to accomplish what you came there for and leave with a smile!! A million thumbs up and high fives and pound its to the staff at WYE REGISTRIES you guys kick some serious @$$!! Thank you all for being so AWESOME!! ;)

While the food wasn't the worst I've ever had it sure wasn't worth the$28.99 for dinner. There was one small table with not the best Chinese food. One table with usual potatoes, veggies, etc. one exceptionally small salad bar. Dessert table & chocolate fountain & some meager choices for dim sum & a roast beef sitting there. But you can't have any unless you track down staff. The servers were top notch. Excellent service. Very friendly & quick to refill drinks & take away plates. They get 4.5 stars. Only reason I've given it 2 stars is cause of the staff the food really deserves 1. Definitely not worth the money. I almost lost a tooth on the rock hard onion ring. Gravy for the potato was "off" rendering them inedible. The deep fried meat at the Chinese table was tough & not much flavour. I would not go back. Definitely not worth the $$.
The worst service ever. Over priced. Rude staff. Go in for a wash and takes them 2 hours. Go to hands on car wash in the south end....better wash with a smile.
We love Noodle Box!!! My friend and I go here for lunch all the time, and they never disappoint. Food is fresh, always tasty and great portions. Highly recommend!!

Quite nice for a buffet place. The food was decent and there is a pretty broad selection. The cost is around 40 bucks for 2 at lunch. The drinks aren't included in the initial cost but it comes out to around 40.

It was relatively empty and quiet during our quick lunch and the wait staff is friendly, quick, and unobtrusive. 

Definitely a nice place to go to when you can't make up your mind on what you want.

The staff is friendly and helpful and their is a decent selection of coffee and food. The place is well maintained and I like the new renovations done. Unfortunately I am often left waiting in a line or for someone to be able to help me due to how busy it get and how understaffed they are. This is not the employees fault. Another issue is the lack of wifi. I have been here at least a couple dozen times and have only been able to log into wifi once or twice. This makes it hard for me to able to stay their and do some work for school as I can't use any internet. And it's a shame as the prices are much more fair than the Starbucks at the mall and I wouldn't mind hanging out here working on some essays for school.

The moment I walked in to the eye-bar, I was greeted by 2 amazing staff members. They made me feel very welcome.
Dr. Ross was very friendly as well. He provided the BEST eye exam I have ever had. I didn't feel rushed at all. He took time to explain everything. 
I highly recommend going here.

Extremely over priced. The food was okay, but I expect much better for the price we paid. They don't allow coupons on weekends or holidays and they are not very kid friendly. We hardly saw our waitress and had empty cups and dirty plates on our table often. Probably won't go back.

Sherwood Park Galaxy Cinemas has definitely seen better days. I hate to say it because I remember when it was "all that". I remember back when the Sword & Shield was the only game in town. Along came this mega theatre and everyone was wowed. 

These days, however, it is a different story. It is only a short drive to Edmonton and their truly mega theatres. Galaxy is starting to look worn out and a bit old in comparison. When the mall it is attached to did a major facelift, I think Galaxy should have taken the opportunity to do the same thing.

When you walk in to the main lobby, the walls are painted black and the roof is high and "celestial". It was cool when it first opened but now looks a bit lame.

There is a kids arcade centre that helps keep kids busy before a movie and manages to raise the noise level several decibels. I don't think they have changed the games in there for years.

The counter service is famous. Or should I say infamous? The average age of the employees is about 16 and they exude an attitude of "yeah, whatever man". When it is finally your turn to order, you are met with a blank stare and a slightly slack-jawed expression. You just know they are wondering how on earth they got there.

The theatres themselves are comfortable enough, although certainly not top of the line. It would be nice if they had one deluxe theatre that included the slightly reclining seats like some of the ones in Edmonton.

My biggest annoyance about this theatre is the washrooms. They are almost never clean. In the women's washroom, the first section of stalls almost always have 2-3 out of order. There are usually paper towels on the floor and a slight scent of 'ewww.' I know they get a lot of traffic on there, but I still think they could do a better job keeping it up.

Overall, I tend to leave feeling mildly cranky.

Have been going here for years. Lunch time can be busy but the service is fast and the food is always great. Dinner with the family is always satisfying. I know everyone has their favourite Vietnamese place - this is arguably the best Vietnamese restaurant in Alberta, let alone Edmonton. I've taken clients and friend here for lunch and it's never disappointing. The soups are pretty much LEGENDARY. If you like Vietnamese food and are in the neighbourhood, you have to give this place a shot.

Went to visions to purchase a gopro. 6 weeks later I tried to return it having not used it yet and they refused to refund it.  I bought it for $100 cheaper at Costco and mailed in their "price protection" application along with receipts which is obvious proof of the product, price and in stock status. Today I got the letter that price protection was declined.  VISIONS IS OVER PRICED AND HAS POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE.  This is the last transaction I will make with this company If I were you I would take my money almost anywhere else.

Good venue for relaxed movie-goers, maybe not quite satisfying for the hardcore fans seeking an Experience.  As a more casual viewer, this is my favourite Cineplex outlet in Edmonton & area, partially because it's smaller. It's usually not too busy, it's clean, the staff are courteous, the parking is ample, and it's fairly central and quick to get to from east Edmonton. It's also close to many other conveniences and shopping, versus out in some distant strip like South Common or Manning. I've never had a negative experience here.

Really good pizza but with Way too expensive.Great customer service and I love how it's very very close near my work. I wish the prices were less than they are but unfortunately with our economy they have to be skyhigh.

I had such a good experience here. I got a great massage, some sole of foot punches, hot towel treatment and lovely leg and calf massage. It's the best pedicure I've had at a Vo's yet. 

They were both very friendly and the salon is pristine. They have an amazing array of gel colors some I hadn't seen at other salons. Would absolutely go back. 

You do have to watch the parking though. It's one of the lots where you can only park in front of the business you're a patron of so watch out for that.

Delicious!  I was looking for the exact flavour I got here today. Spice was on point and the portions were huge. I can't wait to come back and try the next item on the menu. I ordered the peanut bowl and my son ordered the Tom yum soup. He ordered his hot and was warned at that time about the heat. He still wanted it hot and wasn't disappointed. My dish was a mild/medium and it was perfect. Fresh. Flavorful. If that's what you like. You should eat here.

A tiny store front that opens into a large room that seats many. We went for lunch and the place was packed. I had the dinner combo which included soup and a large portion of hot fresh food. Service was quick despite the restaurant being extremely busy. Highly recommend this restaurant, I will be returning here soon.

Let me start off saying the food is not bad by any means, however, this is not he place to go if you want a Halifax donair. Ordered jumbos one with sweet and one with tzatziki. Sauces are very watery and don't really stick to the meat. It mainly just pools and causes a very soggy pita. Sweet sauce flavour was uninspiring. Tzatziki has a strong complex flavour that I can't identify. Veggies were fresh but sparse and the pita was typical. The meat however, it has a very Mexican flavour. We really didn't know what to make of it. The Mexican flavour was even more pronounced with the tzatziki sauce. As we ate our donairs it seemed more and more like we were eating burritos. Sorry Rob, you may have a bit of a nostalgic following in Sherwood Park however we won't be back. Unless we're craving Mexican.
They have a great take out special $6.99 for medium. You can pick any pizza off menu. Love their crust.

A solid place to eat. I've been here a few times and enjoyed it every time. Tasty food, good price. I've never finished a full bowl of pho anywhere but here. Service has always been decent. Strange to me that they dont turn on all the lights all the time, makes it kind of dark/dull, and they take forever to come take your money at the end. Other than that, I'll be eating there again for sure.

Came here on a Wednesday night with the family around 7pm. Place was pretty empty save for a few patrons. The chain has a thank the customer promotion so adult price is a few dollars off. My 3 year old was free and my 9 year old was half the adult price. So good deal. A few places that I've been to include one drink - this did not.

There is a lot of variety. There is a chocolate fountain station with lots of fruit, cookies, marshmallows, and cake pops to dip. My daughter loved it. I liked the selection of fruit.

There was a roast beef, sausage, and pizza station although no one was manning it throughout the time I was there. Maybe if someone stood in front then someone would come. We didn't partake.

Next was a dim sum station with a selection of the more common items. The shrimp dumplings were great but the steamed pork dumplings tasted a bit old.

In the middle was standard chinese buffet fare with your sweet and sour pork, egg rolls, chicken balls, etc.. Kids liked the fried rice. Wife and I had the mussels - it was alright just a little dry.

Near this was the salad bar - good selection. I took some cole slaw and seafood salad (fake crab) and it was pretty good. Son loved the corn on the cob.

At the far end was some western fare - I only had onion rings; not bad.  Next was the nacho/taco station. Daughter loved the melted cheese; she kept coming back for more - with our without chips. I made myself a taco with the selection of beef and all the fixings.

For dessert, my wife made a banana split. I had some fruit and the kids had the chocolate station.

All in all it was pretty average. It's hard to keep buffet items fresh when you don't have the customer base. When it's more busy then they will probably replenish more. Instead, some of the items were under the heat lamps for awhile.

Service was good for a buffet. They cleared out our empty plates regularly and filled our waters.

For some reason I stopped going to Taste of Vietnam. Those are years I will never get back.

The salad rolls were fresh and tasty, dipped in either fish oil or peanut sauce, they are a great gluten free option off the menu.

We followed that up with #90a, the Seafood Curried Coconut Sauce. Mouthfuls of prawns, scallops and squid, sizzling in a creamy curry sauce... nom... nom... nom.....

The seafood at Taste of Vietnam is always fresh tasting and prepared just so - no rubbery squid for them! The menu says it is spicy, but I'm not a big spice fan (eating shouldn't hurt in my opinion) but this is more flavourful than spicy. Sweet spicy. 

Number 83 is prawns and peaches 'n cream. A perfect foil for the more savoury 90a, the creamy sauce is almost dessert like, with the prawns done to perfection. Although they said the prawns were not gluten-free, I don't think the batter was wheat flour, but rather a rice or tapioca flour.

This brings me to why I rate this a four out of five. It would have a fifth star if we had been more secure in the gluten free options. The waitress didn't seem to have a good handle on what we were talking about or what constitutes gluten.

The guy at the counter was on his phone as he was taking my order and when I went to order popcorn the girl at the front threw my cheese packet at me. Definitely one of the worse movie theatres I've ever been to and would not go back.

This place desperately needs renovations. Everything is gross, they also have a mouse problem which is pretty disgusting. While I go to this place because it's close, I'd rather drive farther to one of the other movie theatres. Time for a revamp cineplex!

That salmon bite was amazing along with my martini
OMG the food was spot on, they have redeemed themselves 
The steak was like cutting butter, better than The Keg by far. Keep up the great job. The Caesar salad was perfectly dressed potatoes amazing, both kinds

First off, let me say that one other review below is for another location.  My review is for the SHERWOOD PARK LOCATION ONLY.

I haven't been here for a decade!  

The price is pretty good for a detailed car wash. $95.00 for an inside out package with extra vinyl cleaning and outside shine coating. 

The waiting area is actually cool! Art work on the walls, a fireplace, two big screen tvs! There is also a work station where you can charge your phones, etc. and plug your computer in. 

Bringing kids along? No prob, there is a play area and lots of windows to watch your car too.

The furniture is leather and very comfortable. 

It looks like they are still renovating!

And the car wash itself? The armourall was well done but the outside was a bit streaked and had lots of water spots on windows etc. had to have them wipe it down a bit.

So, would I return? Not sure. Pretty fancy waiting area but so-so product/result.

We never visit this location anymore. Their food and staff have gone way down hill. Staff are rude and very unfriendly. Hot food comes out cold. Blizzards are never mixed properly, so by the time you get half way through, there's no more mix, just vanilla ice cream. Order a sundae or peanut buster parfait and get very, VERY little sauce/topping. They're very stingy with the topping.
Great food selection under Asian cuisine. Quantity and quality is fantastic! Even my 5 year old daughter loves their spring roll... definitely will recommend!

Just like all chain stores, these places are too massive and offer a lot of CRAP. I was looking for material to build my dad a birdhouse and I couldn't believe the cost of the material. I thought large chains had cheaper prices, ummmm nope. If I was to purchase everything the bill would come to about $250, whhhaat? Serious. I then went to the specialized shops, usually expensive, and was able to get everything for just under $30, big difference. This was a real eye opener to me and well I wont be back. Support your local craft shops instead.

I went here on Mother's Day with my family and the service was so terrible it was an awful experience. Our waitress didn't come to our table until about 15 minutes after we arrived and then she forgot about our drinks so we didn't get them for another 15 minutes. She barely removed any of our dirty plates and she gave us the wrong bill twice and refused to split it up. The food was decent but it was extremely over priced at $35 a person not including drinks. I'm a server so I know what it's like to be short staffed but our server wasn't apologetic at all. I won't be going back.
Good service. Clean. Priced good for all you can eat. Im not into seafood or pork so options are a bit limited. They could have more meat or chicken dishes. Overall good experience.

I haven't been yet. I have tried. Tell me, who closes on a Friday night at 5:30 PM?/


They do/ 

My stars * (only one ) is on times not on what is in the store .

Not a bad little theatre. It's outdated and the chairs and sound quality are poor compared to newer theatres. However, this is not reflected in the price. 

The games room is terrible. On more than one occasion had a little time to kill. The games are old almost always mostly broken. Don't waste your money. 

Rarely will you stand in line long here though.

My daughter went to her with her boyfriend and left just before they close. Her boyfriend had left his wallet. At the cash register when he  left There was a table with a woman and her two children and another table with two women when they left. He went back to get his wallet only to find that they had taken out all his cards and he had $140 missing out of his wallet. He handed him back his wallet and said they had no idea where his money was. This used to be one of our favorite restaurants but not anymore. Be wary when eating here. Obviously they don't hire honest people.

Awesome pizza ! Had this in Saskatoon when passing thru a few years ago . This place has some pretty cool unique pizzas you don't see any place else . I had the spiciest pizza and a rider pizza today . Walk in special . Good prices , think crust and tasty !
Best Donair in the city, make sure you have the Family Fries they are Grrrrrreat. I have been there 100 times and never had a bad experience

I had to put a star otherwise this car wash would have gotten none. My husband and I took our respective vehicles there. I paid $90 for an outside wash, inside wipe down. No carpet shampoo, just a vacuum in the cargo area (dog hair). A vacuum later at home with a shop vac did a great job in ten minutes. It must have been a really quick vacuum cause it looked the same. The outside had lots of missed spots (drip marks, dirt). My dashboard looked like it had been attacked by an armour all junky. Places that you simply don' t armour all ( think steering wheel, shiny trim, mats )were done. The first order of business after leaving there was cleaning up the armour all mess. My husband's experience was much worse. He paid over $200 for detailing that included carpet shampoo. The armour all was everywhere including the running boards. As my husband's truck is high, this creates a dangerous situation for anyone getting in. The tailgate paint was badly scratched . From the scratch pattern it was obvious that it had been wiped with something with grit on it. Probably dropped the cloth on the ground, picked it up and kept wiping.
The fact that one can do a better job themselves than they will get at bubbles begs the question: why go there? I have been to good detailing places that do an excellent job for the same money or less. They take a little longer, but it is worth it. Bubbles definitely isn't.

took my moms car in to get a clean, got the carpets shampooed and everything wiped down. Came to 262.45. got the car back and it looked the same as when we brought it on, the carpets have garbage all in the back didn't even wipe down the back seats and the cup holders were still dirty. will not come back here.

I'm usually not too big and too reviewing larger corporations food but I am a sucker for wanting to try new items on the menu or limited time menu items.

My wife and I decided to try the new Spicier Szechuan McChicken and we were actually surprised at how tasty it actually was, it was also very spicy. This sandwich is definitely worth the try especially for all the spicy food lovers.

Because of the pandemic we picked up through drive-thru so this review is 100% about the food and not about the actual location.

If you're craving Vietnamese and you're in Sherwood Park... this is your place!

I highly recommend the coconut seafood curry... served on a sizzling platter with coconut rice... YUM YUM YUMMY!  

The sweet and sour soups is delish and the platters with wrap your own salad rolls with grilled meats, vermicellii, and veggies is delish!

Light and Refreshing... 

Have probably been there a dozen times!

NOTE - they have private rooms with shogi screens (no idea how to spell that...) that you can request in advance to make it a private and special experience!

I have been there a few times already within the last two weeks since I moved to Edmonton, because it is really close to work.

I always love a hot bowl of Pho ( especially during winter time) and this place offers high quality Pho and other side dishes. Had the onion pancake the first time in my life ( I guess it has to be a western thing, as I have never seen it in any Vietnamese places in Toronto), and it tasted great!

Highly recommended for now and I will have to come back with more comments after trying other items later.

The reviews on here made me leery of trying this place out but the services I had (detailing the inside of my SUV) were performed with great attention to detail and in a timely manner   The customer loving to wait in is lovely and and with good amenities.

OMG I love Samson's comparison of this theatre to Dennys.  It's very fitting.

This place needs an upgrade and has for a very long time.  It's nice that the concession and arcade is before the ticket takers so you can entertain yourself if you're waiting for other people.

The box office only has one staffed position, the rest is kiosks.  Which I have no problem with.  I would imagine that during busy times, they would probably have roving staff there to help people who have any issues.

The seats are really basic and there's very little leg room.  Sound quality is fine, but nothing amazing.

If you're in Sherwood Park, it's fine.  But don't go out of your way to see something here.

Purchased a new TV from Nathan at this store.
Every time I've gone into most stores it's been a high pressure sales pitch from the salesmen. Not in this store as Nathan was a no pressure  very knowledgeable salesman who did everything right to insure we made the best choice for our needs.
Prices are great and the service and return policies are second to none.
We were very pleased with our experience in this store and will definitely be returning should we need any electronics in the future.
Goodbye Costco!
Keep up the good work!!

This place is nostalgia city, I even worked here way back in the day for my first job. 

Most of the theater hasn't changed since I worked there 16 years ago. Which is probably the biggest reason most people think of this theater as a bit dumpy. That being said I go to the theater a lot, so I do notice that they are slowly making renovations and improvements. 

The food is pretty consistently mediocre - but rarely is it bad. The frozen yogurt is reliably probably the best. 

The staff is usually pretty friendly and the theaters are serviceably clean. 

I go to this theater because it's the closest to me, definitely not because it's the nicest.
A friend of me brought me here that happens to be a police officer and it was quite good. I only say is as they eat out a lot.

Been here 3 times now since it opened. Marginal at best when stacked up against everything Edmonton has to offer, as Sherwood Park's options go...it's a cut above.
I really enjoyed my Smoked Salmon pizza the last time I went. Being close to my home, it's a convenient diversion from the run-of-the mill franchises surrounding it. Not high on my list to revist...but it is on the list.
Slackssss once you get trapped in line you will be there at least 45mins drive the extra mile it's worth it

It has a good number of theaters for the demographic and plenty of staff to get people through the lines at the concessions. 

The only thing was that Theater 10, which I was in, didn't seem to have surround sound. It was just ok sound, which is not what you want for Star Wars. 

It was still a great experience though!

An amazing improvement from my last review. The food was actually amazing. It didn't matter what you chose from the buffet, it was hot and fresh. Quite amazing actually. Lack of the 5th star this time goes to the staff. Just a bit under performing, but quite honestly they deserve 4 1/2 stars.

 I'm also nit picking after my last review. My only complaint about the staff is that there was no one at the till when I went up to pay the bill. Had to wait about 5 minutes. No big deal. I grabbed a few extra shrimp while waiting. Keep up the great work!!

Highly recommend this location to everyone.

Disappointing all around. First, the "good" -- when I got my take out home, the ginger beef container was still hot. I was concerned needlessly about the temperature of the rice dish. And the spice level was perfect. I picked the second-hottest and that was a great level of heat for me. 

The "bad" -- all around completely disappointing. I booked my order for 6pm pickup using the App. I showed up 5 min early because I didn't want my order sitting around getting soggy and cold. I was greeted and instructed to wait at a table for them to prepare it. "Perfect" (I thought) as I really wanted it still hot when I got home. 

The cashier took a phone call for about 3 minutes and when he was done, picked my two spring rolls that had been sitting in the basket of the fryer, put them in a bag, and handed me one of approximately 15 take out containers that were sitting on the counter the entire time. Not impressed. 

So I get home and try it and it is awful. I mean bad. There was a bitter, burned, acrid flavour throughout the entire dish. Very off-putting. As I mentioned, the level of heat was good, but ginger beef usually has a sweetness to accompany the heat. This did not. At all. 

To cover up the burned flavour and bring up the sweetness, I added some sweet chili Thai sauce from my refrigerator. It helped, a bit. And the whole thing was soggy. Usually there's a crispiness to ginger beef, this had none. The texture was just completely missing, I could barely tell the scant beef chunks I received from the rice --the whole thing was mush. 

I had way, way better Ginger Beef, albeit less spicy, from the deli counter at Save-On Foods in the same mall. 

All in all a terrible experience, not worth the time and fuel spent to go pick it up. Will not be returning. Do not recommend at all. I thought Ginger Beef was not a difficult dish to get right. But you've proved me wrong. Awful. 0 stars if I could give that.

At least if I was eating in-store, I could have sent it back. But with a 15 minute drive there and another 15 minutes back, plus whatever time trying to sort it out in the store and waiting for them to remake it... not worth it for $20. (Neither was the meal)

I've been here a few times over the years. Overall, they have a relatively limited menu compared to other places. Additionally, the food (Pho) is just above average in terms of quality. However, the price is quite reasonable and the service is really good
i really enjoyed the food and the atmosphere , a little high priced, but other then that fantastic the staff was extremely friendly!
This is the best McDonald's in all of Edmonton yummy go here yummy. So many brown people it's unbelievable. My favourite kind of people! So very yes McDonald. W o W.

One day my fam & I was really frickin hungry & decided to go get a tasty, juicy a$$ donair. Anywho, I went to robs donair & did not expect this dude to be so darn sassy. He told me "the more I order, the longer I wait, because my meat is not ready". He made it seem like I was not wanted there & didn't want to take my order. So I mic dropped & left. I would not recommend going to robs donair if you appreciate friendly, welcoming service. Amen

Just opened where the Tutti-Fruiti yogurt place used to be.  Clean, bright but, most importantly, the donairs are outstanding.  Would've given them 5 out of 5 stars but the counter lady could be more friendly.

0 stars from me too!!! Truck came out with a bunch of scratches!! Noticed them after I brought it home and had to clean areas they missed. Brought it back and they told me "it couldn't have been from them" Will never go here again even if it's free!!!!!!

I went to this cinema for the first time yesterday with a friend and our kids. This cinema is older and quite small but it didn't seem like it needed to be any bigger for the demand. It's right in the mall so you can do some shopping before or after without venturing into the cold.
They have a self serve kiosk for tickets which is very straight forward to use. We were early so played in the arcade corner which has 8 games to play so that was a fun way to pass the time. 
I ordered my popcorn etc but found out you can order Pizza 73 and pay for it here then collect it from the Pizza 73 stand at the other side of the room. That was cool.
All the tables and stools are really high and I found that most people there were little kids who cant reach. They should rethink the foyer area for that reason. I noticed they did have a kids party room which is fun and those kids were in the My Little Pony Movie with us. I'm sure most theaters have that but I thought it was cute to see!
Seats were comfy and the sound was good. It's a decent place to take the kids but not somewhere I would go for a super, amazing cinema experience.

Ended up ordering pickup lunch from here for myself and coworkers. When we got there they claimed we didn't order which was quite confusing as we had a pickup time directed by the restaurant. Within a few minutes they got it figured out and we were on our way. Ordered a variety of items such a lemongrass chicken, beef satay, spicy prawn soup, and spring rolls. Everything was 10/10. Can't wait to go back and try other items!
Great place to grab lunch or dinner. Staff is extremely kind. They even remember my name and order as I come here very often. Highly recommend!

Awesome Bubbles location !  Customer Service is second to none, the gals that work the tills are friendly and fast and the retailers and cleaners are sooooooo awesome.   My SUV is always perfect clean and if detailed, looking brand new.  I love taking my car to this Bubbles!
Staff are lazy, rude & not helpful. Would not recommend wasting your time going to this location.

Got the ginger beef. 
Didn't realize it was four small pieces of beef (which is the normal portion in the dish) and a box full of cold rice. Thanks guys ;(
Not impressed. $14.50 down the drain.
Phoned to tell them and the manager told me to come back and get a new one. How about I just spend my money somewhere else.

Went there today for supper. The 2 star rating is because the staff was friendly. The food..... sigh.... it was edible. The best tasting items were the snow crab legs, pulled pork and ginger beef. The rest was absolute garbage. Over cooked Chinese rice, over baked rice and mushrooms. Salt salt salt on everything. And I like salt but this was too much. The perogies were still half raw and under cooked. Chicken in black bean sauce was like rubber. I didn't even know you could cook rubber chicken. I mean dry chicken sure, even burnt chicken I've seen, but rubber???  Oven roasted potatoes tasted like metal. And the mashed potatoes had so much sour cream in them I thought I was literally eating straight sour cream. I would not recommend this place, especially not for the prices they charge. Nice looking restaurant, but food quality desperately needs improvement. First time in a long time that I've left a restaurant still hungry.

It isn't the most glamorous Cineplex in the Edmonton area, but you can count on getting in without a huge lineup. The staff are friendly at the ticket counter. It's usually clean, and there's a big parking lot but you're not going to fine the glamour and services around places like South Edmonton Common or Manning. It's not a mega theatre. 

But they have a good selection of the latest movies and it's attached to the mall so you can do some shopping there if you want.  

There's a little arcade where you can play some games to pass the time as well. The sound quality isn't as good as at the newer locations but the film quality seems the same.

The workers at this establishment are derogatory and rude. I went into the drive thru, and I requested water after going on a long hike, I was famished, I left my wallet at home, so I asked for a simple water. In response, They replied and I quote "I don't give a shit about your water, order you cunts." I felt personally targeted, and I was very upset. The customer service here is ridiculous. Some of my buddys  went later on and they told us, "we don't care if you want water, you must order." I feel personally distraught and this is a prime example of horrible human kindness. Is water a limited resource in Canada? Do I lack the requirements to drink some simple TAP WATER???? I would not recommend going to this establishment because you will be treated like a dog.

Found the food to be rather lacking in quality. I know it's a buffet but for the price of "admission" the quality could be better. 
The service was ok, but nothing special. Found the place rather empty and yet understaffed.

Absolutely horrifying. BEWARE! We ordered 2 appetizers and 2 entrees. 

Artichoke dip & calamari as appetizers. 

I figured the artichoke dip would be a fail safe choice. I couldn't be so wrong. The dip came out to the table cold as ice with some shrivelled brown chopped green onions. And by a few I mean 3 chopped chunks. Upon tasting the dip, we found the chip had more flavour than the dip. 

The calamari. Well, do you like lemon? Because that's all you get to taste. SSOOOOO much lemon pepper. Need. More. Water. No!!! You're not allowed more water unless you beg for it. Refills on water seemed to be the biggest pain. Let alone getting one fountain pop and asking for refills three times. Still no refill. 

For the entrees we chose the BLT with SQR1 fries & house salad. As well as the steak sandwich with SQR1 fries & seasonal veggies. The SQR1 fries were an understatement. It should have been written as special SQR1 salt with fry. There was enough special salt left over salt to cure a cow! 

House salad was a hearty green salad with slivered almonds, tomatoes and red peppers, swimming in Italian. Most restaurants overload with sauce so this one is my fault for not asking for sauce on the side as everyone should. 

The seasonal veggies? What seasonal veggies?? I received one of my two sides with my meal. Having to ask for my seasonal veggies, I'm sure they took an extra dip in the buttery goodness they call seasoning. Swimming in lard. If you're trying to eat healthy. The veggies are not your choice. The main part of the steak sandwich was requested to be done medium. No blood, but cooked until colour through out. I received 4 slices of red cow on top of a slice of butter drown white bread. The menu reads topped with portobello mushrooms. BUYER BEWARE. This means you get a slice of a cap on top of your sandwich. Upon asking if this was a mistake, I was told this was known as a "garnish". 

To sum up my adventure with this new found building which calls its self a food establishment, we were thoroughly disgusted. Salty, butter drenched food. Fish lovers saving water for the aquarium, not its customers. And unappetizing appetizers. Yum. 

On a plus note. They have one thing going for them. If you need to use the washroom, this is the place to come! Very beautifully decorated! I would suggest this bathroom arrangement for anyone's home. But stay away from the food.

This timmies has to be the worst in Canada... I go there because it's close  by to my house.  It has the slowest service ever, time and time again . I waited 10 minutes to get a breakfast melt even though it was relatively not that busy.
Absolutely atrocious service most days.
My wife and are addicted to red swan pizza unique flavours fast friendly service awesome delivery  I haven't yet picked my favourite pizza the prices are very good

Always have issues with my orders at Tim Horton's.  Was told they don't have a pumpkin spice chill when it's advertised everywhere.  

The language barrier is always extremely difficult to navigate and causes much confusion and frustration.

What in the sweet mother! Sherwood park does not need more pizza joints, or so I thought. They keep popping up and I didnt think we needed more. Tonight I decided to roll the dice on the new guy, Red Swan pizza. Well let me tell you, the old guard better watch out!
We got the philly steak pizza and it might have been one of the best 5 pizzas I've ever had. It was exactly like a philly cheese steak, the sauce was amazing, the meat was crispy, the veg was cooked perfectly and somehow the crust was fluffy and crispy. Perfectioned defined as a gourmet pizza for sure.
We also got the meat pizza which was really good, but paled in comparison to the philly.
We also tried the bacon cheese bread and it was awesome, my kids loved it.
I'm torn on the fact that they cut their pizza in squares, I'm more of a triangle guy. Not to.self, next time ask for triangles and see what happens

Will definitely.be getting from there again and you should too.

Well I used to love this place. Honestly in the later half of 2016 everything has gone downhill here. 

They increased the prices. 

The service has been horrible, ie wrong thing I ordered, taking too long to get or forgetting about my order all together... not sure how that happens. 

Quality has fallen considerably, it used to be that the spice level was inconsistent. Now everything about the place is. 

Noodle box iv been disappointed the last three visits. I think we're done.

I have been meaning to try sky high burgers for a while because it is relatively close to where I live and I love a good burger joint.
I read some reviews before going in and forced myself to keep an open mind because they were very mixed. I have to say that overall it was a good experience, it started off very strange though. 
When you order at sky high, they have 2 basic burgers, the single or the double and hen you select the toppings you want, like a high end Harvey's. I got totally thrown off because I wanted a double burger, but no sooner than I said I wanted a double the lady behind the counter hit me with "do you want cheese and bacon?'... No.... I want cheese yes, but not bacon... Then she followed up quickly with 'do you want lettuce tomato ketchup and mustard?'... No... I want lettuce tomato and chipotle mayo, no mustard and no ketchup.. Then another one like BAM 'do you want pickles, caramelization onions and caramelized mushrooms?'.... I had to stop her there.... Listen lady, stop offering me random groups of toppings and listen to what I want..... I couldn't believe how much it bothered me, but it did.
In the end my burger was quite good even though I felt very rushed and decided to get banana peppers on my burger. The fries were excellent and the onion rings left nothing to complain about.
Overall it was a weird experience because of the ordering process, but I will be back to try it again, fully prepared to order what I want even if I am being ambushed by random condiment suggestions.

This is one of the few registry offices that actually want to help you out. Although the office is in an older strip mall, you don't walk in to large lineups of less than pleasant people taking all of your personal information. I was dealt with pleasantly and helped out with the importing of a vehicle from the US. They gave me answers and advice and sent me on my way. I will be back there again soon to register the vehicle I purchased.
Worst wash ever... gas station drive though does a better job... not worth any money at all.
