Can't wait to come back! A lot of the menu can be made gluten free or vegan. I also have sensitivities to onion and garlic and he even made my pad Thai gf, df, no onion and no garlic! It was delicious!! My boyfriend had a normal ginger beef and he said it was also really good. I'm hoping a location will come to St. Albert or closer to home. Highly recommend!

Fantastic service, very little wait time and very consistent taste.  I'm impressed in almost every regard... Almost.

So what's the hang-up you ask?  Well, a wise Yelper once wrote that no business should ever receive all 5 stars.  They should continuously strive for a perfect score.  I agree as I believe that in search of the 5th star, the restaurant might do something truly taste-credible and I hope I'm there to enjoy it.

I have dined here on many occasions now,.Nice place.
Trendy.
Fresh. Flavorfull. Filling.
I have sampled most of their noodle dishes, several sides, and some of the daily specials.
Food looked great.
Fresh. Flavourfull. Pretty damn good.
I am always surprised how full I get.
Doesn't happen this fast often. I feel they should have half order sizes...but they don't appear to.
Sadly, my biggest point of contention of late is their inconsistant application of their spice. I always stick with a mere 1 on their scale. Several time now I have gotten home woth my take-out only to find that the dishes are hot enough to set my tastebuds ablaze. Given the range of spice they offer...the really so need to be carefull. It gets damn hot. Had I been dining in on these occassions...they certainly would have beem remaking my meals.
Regardless...I'll be back. 
It is indeed quite good.
After all the reviews I decided to try this pizza out.  It was lacking toppings and flavour and they forgot my dip I paid for.  I would never order again.  First time customer very dissatisfied.
Tried the perogy and a spicy chicken pizza. It was tasty! Thought the prices were a little high for what you get but flavour was good. Would try again!
I had the same experience. I don't even remember being greeted at the door. Got completely ignored and left. Not the usual experience I get at a quilt shop.

This place is below average in its class.  It was actually quite busy so it is popular.  Maybe because of its pricing?  The prices were very reasonable.  My husband really liked the milkshakes.  The burger patty is really thin.  Unless your looking for a snack get a double party.  The fries were good.  We won't be back. 5 guys and Fulton burger are both superior.

As with any McDonalds you will find the food almost exactly the same everywhere. 

This facilty is a bit odd in it's placement as it is attached to another store and the parking lot is for customers to Sobeys and banks among other things. Parking is not prime ever if you can find it. Fairly quick drive thru but tight turns, not recommended for large vehicles! The seating area in this one throws me also, there is next to none, I guess they realize it is just about a drive through only location.

That being said the service was on par with other Mickey D's and they have the full selection, nothing is left of the menu. It is in a convenient location for parents to grab a quick bite for their  whining kids (or well behaved if you have them) after they endure you grocery shopping next door at sobeys for half an hour.

this car wash deserves No stars from me. I took my car there and prepaid $335.00 to have my car detailed...What a joke!! Because you have to pay at the start there is no recourse. I went to pick up my car when they called and found that the car was a mess.The man left behind to deal with me kept apologizing for the bad workmanship. we BOTH took clothes to clean the outside of the car. He went and got the vacuum as the truck was not done. They also miss places on the leather seats to clean and they did not clean any of the vents...I returned the next day to talk to the manager and I waited for him who they said was coming but never showed up. Some customer service ???
So my suggestion to all of out there please do not go to this car wash as you will as sorry as I am

Stopped by this past weekend to check it out.  The store is beautiful, huge and very tidy & organized.  The work space in the classroom was impressive, as was the variety of items for sale.  The fabric choices are increadible and worth a look before you start your next project.

So why only a three star rating?  For me it boils down to customer service.  The service seemed to be friendly and helpful... but only to the customers they knew or recognized.  I was acknowledged when I first entered the store and then otherwise ignored.  They were busy and I didn't mind waiting - but it was particularly galling when after about 20 minutes when there was a pause in the rush that rather than help another customer (me) the two ladies felt it more important to gossip about something in hushed whispers for a while until another familiar fave came along.  After spending nearly half an hour in the store and not recieving any assistance, I left and spent my money elsewhere.  I would think with a retailer like Fabricland around the corner the service at this store would have been much better.

Will I give this store another chance - probably, the fabric selection is that good.  But it's definatly not worth an out of the way trip - I'd make sure you have time to stand around and wait if you haven't  been a customer before.

We ordered the sliders, they tasted like McDonald's hamburgers but were super dry.  My brother ordered the artichoke dip and it tasted like rotten hummus, no artichoke flavour at all, and was accompanied with cold naan and plain tortilla chips.  The food was edible, but not delicious at all, and certainly not worth the price, and it wasn't even expensive.  Service was quick but our server never smiled or showed any expression whatsoever.   Needless to say we won't be returning.

My coworkers brought me here for authentic food and to celebrate a work anniversary. All my coworker friends really enjoyed the food. The service was a little patchy but not bad. Overall the price is good but I didn't find the food very authentic or flavourful. But it definitely depends on the individual.

I hated Fulton Market, and these guys are worse.
The bun was a 10, the patty a 2.
Frozen and pressed, only flavor is from the flames!
Too much shredded cheddar was all I could taste. 
Price was OK.
Lovely owner/waiter I feel bad for them as well but they are in tough company here in the park.
Stopped last night coming home from vacation gave them a try, good pizza tasted fresh, decent prices!

I have a love /hate relationship with this place.  Love the food. The staff...not so much. Waited over 20 minutes for my bill while the waitresses showed each other their new designer bags.  Not friendly at all..But the place is very clean and by far the best food in Sherwood Park. Always hot, fresh and cooked just right. Cant always ask for protection I guess

My Quilting Passion started in 1992, and my first wall hanging was quilted at Lori's Country Cottage in 1994.  They still are favorite store and Happy Place. The staff is very knowledgeable from traditional methods to the current market of today.  Their fabric options and colors are unsurpassed.   Amount of notions, rulers and bag/purse hardware is surreal!  Store Sales are held so often, because there is always a reason to celebrate us the customer, our birthday, the store birthday, the temperature outside etc.
The staff support and help each other, a true team spirit!  I am glad to be part of this personal and on-line community.  Cheers!

This is a good buffet for the Edmonton area. I have taken the family here several times, and enjoy coming back.
The variety of food selections are varied enough to meet almost every craving you might have.
The service is good and the children are fed. We will definitely be coming again.

This is a very nice shop, the staff were busy so not so helpful. Lots to look at the samples were inspiring. What I found shocking was the cost of the fabric it was rather high. I understand the stuff comes from the US & the exchange on the Dollar but 25,00 plus - for a yard of fabric - Yikes - I saw the fabric I liked then went home purchased it on line from a very well know site for far less. Until Lori has more reasonable prices I won't buy there.

I find that Tim Hortons is hit or miss when dealing with them. They are a company that needs to get back to the basics of what made them one of Canada's great businesses. They are changing and launching things no one is asking for. If they listened to their customers and gave them what they wanted they could be great again.

I have to say that the staff was very pleasant and the waiting room is very nice.  But, I didn't pay $60.00 to sit in a nice waiting room.  All I can say is, what a rip off.  How do they think they can charge $60.00 and not properly clean anything?  And why did I have to wait almost 30 minutes for them to swipe at the dash and run it through the automatic washer.  There were streaks running down the back window when I drove out.  So mad, I didn't even consider going back.  Feel like a fool for paying that kind of money for nothing. I will never go to any Bubbles Car Wash again.  I don't care if you 
have bought up all the decent car washes in Edmonton.

Tonight the Noodle Box won out.
Time to give'em a go.
Nice place.
Trendy.
Fresh. Flavorfull. Filling.
Ordered Cambodian Spring Rolls, and Spicy Peanut Box with beef and medium spice. A bottle of root beer to wash it all down put the bill at ~$20.
Within 5 minutes. I was served.
Food looked great.
Fresh. Flavourfull. Pretty damn good.
I was surprised how full I got.
Doesn't happen this fast often. I feel they should have half order sizes...but they don't appear to.
Sadly, my biggest point of contention was with the rockus staff. They were certainly friendly, but they were also the loudest group in the place. Not very professional.
Hopefully...this is not the norm.
I'll be back. 
They are deffinitely worthy of a second...and hopefully a third taste...

This place is alright but for the price I've had better. Food is heavily weighted towards Chinese and the ginger beef was really dried out and just kind of terrible to be honest. I'm not certain I would go back anytime soon...

I love this DQ location, the staff is great and eager to learn as this is where they train employees for other locations.

The fact that they are always raising funds for greta causes and a huge part of the Sherwood Park community is a big possitive also.

I find it difficult to not stop in here daily as I do like it that much and those Blizzards are something special. The treat selection and the cakes they have is another big plus, now you see why they get all those stars! Custom cakes are always cool and they will work with you to make sure your cake is extra special for the occassion.

They are always busy here so don't expect a quick in and out often, but it's not the servers fault, it's the demand they face with the steady influx of customers. The Parking lot is more than adequate for most days and they even have a patio outside for the overflow of diners.

On a hot summer day plan to stop in, see if you like it as much as I do.

Car audio installers are very incompetent. There has been at least 3 different occasions where Visions on Emerald drive has bothced up the install on my audio system in my vehicle. First time I wanted 4 speakers and an amp installed. 12 hours later call to check up on them. "Ya it's done come grab the car!" They did not call me when it was done of course. Get the keys. hop in my car. Flick on the stereo.... sounded like the speakers were stock still. Fold the back seat down to check the amp and it wasn't installed. So 12 hours to install 4 speakers. 

      Had to take it back to get the amp installed now. Took the day to install as expected because they were busy. Get a call this time which was considerate of them. Get the keys. Hop in the car. Speakers sound good! Try to fold down the seat to check the amp! The seat doesn't go down because it was wired in a way where there was not enough slack in the wire to fold the seat down without pulling the wires out from the amplifier. Oh goody. Come back and was told Eric the guy that installed it moved to another location so I would have to go there. Nope. Argued for a bit to get it fixed at the location where it was installed. 

    3rd incident was last time I went in because my subwoofers weren't working. Paid 50.00 to diagnose the issue and asked for them to tighten the loose door speakers they installed. 10 hours through the day I gave them a ring to see if any progress was made. "Your subs are blown". So job was done and no phone call again. Now to figure out that my subs are blown takes 10 minutes tops with a meter not 10 hours. Pick up my car and cut my losses. Not to my suprise  the door speakers are still loose and weren't tightened. Every single time that I have ever taken my car to this place I have been dissapointed.  If considering anything car audio go to another place. I'll be giving Method Acoustics a try for installation in the near future. They can't do any worse than the Visions has haha.

We've come here to pick up a few times and have never been disappointed. Their Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pizza is one of my favourites. 

There is something for everyone as well so if your feeling something more traditional you can order Pepperoni or Canadian Classic, but if your feeling more adventurous there are 41 pizzas to choose from. If you're from Sherwood Park or even stopping through on the way home you should give Red Swan a try.

The food was less then impressive for the price with small portions of poorly prepared food.  The rice in my dish was under cooked,  they brought a replacement dish and the rice was still under cooked and crunchy. After watching the bartender mix drinks im sure they are watered down and not full shot amounts.  I don't think this place will make it til christmas at this pace. None of the 10 people in our group will be back.

Do not shop at this location. The manager doesn't know anything and won't listen to you as a customer. The only sales person there that has any customer sevice is Doug. Go anywhere else to buy your electronics!!

$35/per person for a buffet is high to start. Quality of food was terrible, didn't see fresh food brought out once. Honestly I use to love going to this chain, but now I will never ever go back. Ever! Save yourself a bunch of money and go eat somewhere good, which means you can go anywhere else and it would be better food for half the price!

My husband I have enjoyed coming to Buffet  royal at least every 3-4 months for a good meal. To be honest in the past the food wasn't always fresh and hot but it was affordable with the size of family we had. 
My husband and I decided to go for buffet this evening at 5:00 pm the food was fresh, hot and tasty but the PRICE has gone up to $32.99 a person with out a drink. The cost of two people with one glass of pop is over $70.00 not including a tip for the waitress.  In my opinion the food on the buffet nor the service or atmosphere was worth The cost of this meal which is a shame. A good prime rib dinner at the Sawmill Or the Keg costs  close to the same price But a much better meal always fresh and cooked the way you want it and it hasn't been keep warm on a steam table. In my opinion  Buffet Royal is no longer worth the price per person so sad. 
Buffet Royal Make the meals more affordable and more people can afford to eat at your restaurants which in essence your profit line will grow!

Just went through the drive thru getting a quick meal/treat for the kids as the day became late after doing yard work. After a short wait for food, I asked if everything including dips was included, I even double checked and saw all the correct labels but waited until we got home to unwrap the food. When my daughter opened her two plain cheeseburgers to find that they didn't contain cheese. Wouldn't this be a plain hamburger? If this wasn't the closest McDonald to my house I would not shop here as it seems there is always an error in our fairly simple order. in parking lot and had to wait

So exciting!
A fresh new donair shop in SherwoodPark!
The moment I discovered it existed...naturally...I had to partake!
And I am happy I did!
First things...first.
The donair!
I was hungry...and excited...so I went "all in" (for $10) on a Jumbo Donair with sweet sauce (of course). Side of garlic sauce.
Portion for price? Very fair.
Meat? Juicy with a nice bit of heat.
Veggies? Fresh!
Sweet sauce? ... decent...but not 
increadible. My main point of contention.
One other thing I will note as I must begin to "nit pic" as my base for comparison becomes larger... the packaging.
The "obligatory" bag (or frankly...the"condom" as I affectionately call it...) was way too big..and I had to struggle. Typically, the bag really just covers the bottom to catch the mess. The wrapper can be peeled away, and the goodness inside enjoyed. In this case, by the time I got through the bag, the loosely folded donair had spilled most of the veggies into the bottom. Again...nit picking...but it's a struggle I've never experienced in this manner. In hindsight...I should have removed the donair from the bag...and wrapper...and devoured it like giant soft taco!
Oh well. It was still quite good! Points only lost for uninspiring sweet sauce!

Other points of note...

I sure hope the owner has a big bright sign on order!
I almost drove away as there is really no obvious indication of the presence of this fine establishment.
Apparently...after a brief chat with the friendly owner, he has been open in this location for 5 weeks.
I got the impression from photos on the wall and his dealings with a few other customers that "this was not his first BBQ"...and I was correct.
He had owned another shop in Sherwood Park (Robbie's I believe) that he said he sold 3 years ago. This certainly explains why this shop is so well put together!
It is one of the brightest, most modern snd inviting dinair shops I have had the pleasure if dining at! In all reality...it is still essentially the Yogen Fruz inside that it was previous to it's new tenant....
...
But that's enough ramblings from me.
Try it for yourself!
Would I be happy if this were my local shop?
It is...and I am thrilled!
Welcome back!
Sherwood Park is happy to have you!

The most expensive snacks in this mall available here! But it is a theatre so thats not unexpected.

What I can say possitve is that they always have a great selection of the newest movies. We are regular attenders and we utilize our scene points to the max because it is the only way to justify the overpriced popcorn. But the staff does quite well and tollerates me which is something I only thought my wife was capable of. 

With multiple theatres and a couple being 3D  they can generally set times to work for young and old alike to watch your favorite movies. The sound system seems a bit weak in comparison to other places but it is still more than adequate.

I can give a small word of advice or two. If you have a chance to go to the first show of the day, do it...the theatre will be as clean as it gets for the day. Another point to remember, don't leave anything valuable on the floors (Purses Jackets ect.) we went last time and my wife lost her favorite purse to someones fruitopia....it wasn't pretty, they rarely mop floors between movies. Too bad, that was the most expensive movie I have seen yet.

Absolutely disgusting I am so sick. Whatever the heck was on my egg muffin Is so gross. It tasted really weird and gross. I don't know if you guys are actually cleaning this place or if your food is going mouldy and you haven't checked expiry dates put I'm absolutely just disgusted because of this.

The best pedicure on the planet!  The service is always first class and the staff knows how to pamper you to death!  I love the day package, but everyone must experience their pedicure.  The facilities are beautiful, classy, & inspiring with quotes throughout for your contemplation during your treatment.  Try it- you'll love it and your feet will thank you!

I promised this dealership I would write them a review because even though they didn't get my business, their service was awesome.
At the time, I was shopping for a small, sporty, fuel-efficient hatchback. My heart was set on the Lexus CT200h however, I wanted to make sure I did some shopping around and didn't make an impulse buy.
So in efforts to apply some due diligence, I visited Park Mazda. They happily showed me the Mazda 6 and offered to let me take it for an afternoon. I advised them that I wanted to take it for a weekend, and they made an exception for me. 
Sadly, after driving it for a few hours I was more than certain it was not the car for me.
When I returned the vehicle, the sales team was still gracious about my decision acknowledging that really I was comparing two very different cars and yet not being sour about the fact that despite their time invested I was going with a different make and obviously a different dealership. Solid salesmanship and good sports. Thanks guys.
Fish is fresh and dishes are traditional. Love the salmon and toro sashimi. Spicy Rainbow Chopchop is a delicious maki. Give it a try!
And they did it again!! LOVED my cute bridal shower cookies - all our guests were raving about how cute and delicious they were! Thank you!!

I came into the tailor to try and deal with a small rip in my parka before it worked it's way into a big rip. My first impression was mixed. Admittedly it looks a bit retro inside but the staff were fairly nice and they obscure part of the doorway so people walking past are less likely to stop and oggle you if your standing infront of the mirror getting measured for hemming. I am sure this is greatly appreciated by self conscious folks.

In terms of prices here I found what they charged me to a be a bit shocking. I was charged $21.00 for a rip about the length of my pinkie that probably took them all of five minutes to take care of. Part of this price however comes from the 25% markup they include if you ask for a rush job. Normally I would be understanding of such a policy but it rubbed me the wrong way here in two different ways. First off when I initially brought the coat in the lady came around the counter and stood infront of the sign they have on the wall that explains the markup and how much it is. Secondly I felt that things were phrased to me in a deceiving way. When I was asked about when I needed my coat back by I was asked "did you need this today or can you come back tomorrow?" Nowhere in there was it mentioned about the surcharge on rush work and as a first time customer of this business how was I too know?

Another weird thing worth mentioning is how the lady who rang me up didn't really want to take my debit card but when I told her I had no cash or credit she begrudgingly agreed to attempt to use it. I guess their machine has an issue with reading debit cards but why on earth would you not call and attempt to get someone in to look at it or swap out your terminal for a new one? 

Finally in terms of the actual job they did it was good. The stitch is strong and they color matched the forest green of my jacket exactly. Was it worth the $21.00? I don't know that I can say yes. They are conveniently located in the mall however and the people running it are very nice so if your like me where it's a rarely needed service it could be worth it to throw a few extra dollars towards nice folks running a small locally owned business.

The bacon wrapped scallops were excellent.  I had a pretty simply of the bacon cheeseburger and fries.  Fries were great, burger had a little "tang" to it.......maybe a little too much but it wasn't overpowering.  It was cooked very well.  The place was not very busy on a Wednesday night and the staff was nice.

I had a Groupon for a dozen mini cupcakes that I recently used.  When I picked them up they were so fresh I think they were still warm. They smelled amazing and was really hard not to try one right away. I got them for my husband's birthday but I think i may have eaten most of them....oops! Delicious and not too sweet!

This is my second visit to Yoshi. The first time was just for a quick hit of Sushi and since I agreed with my fellow Yelper's, I didn't provide my own review.

I'd recently read that ramen noodles were taking Edmonton by storm. I remembered from my first visit that Yoshi is now serving ramen noodles so I decided I'd avoid the Edmonton line ups and drop in for lunch.

I had the seafood bowl. Noodles have nice texture, seafood is delicately cooked and the opaque broth has a deep rich flavour with no oxo cube after taste.

Once again the service is friendly and attentive. The decor is cluttered, which actually adds some charm and is typical of many Tokyo noodle houses.

Overall, a great foodie experience.

Im giving this place 4 out of 5, only because it was a private event.
The staff were amazing, and very accommodating. The pasta that was provided was simple and delicious, the bruschetta was very good.
My only thing i dont like is that its in sherwood park, and i dont have a vehicle.
I do want to go back and create my own special pasta dish, which you can

How have I worked in Sherwood Park for 9 months and not been to Hey Cupcake yet?

My boss asked me to run out last minute to grab some cupcakes.  I was really impressed when I walked in the door!  The lady behind the counter was very friendly and made good recommendations for my purchase.

The service was excellent, and the product was even BETTER.  I picked up a dozen, which gave us a sample of almost everything on their shelf.  Personally, I had the salted caramel cupcake... I don't think I've ever had a more moist (moister?  Is that a word?) cake in my life.  Everyone was really happy with what we got... the only complaint was that they might have been a little too sweet (but that's why you only need one!).

I moved not far from this café and had visions of walking here in the mornings for coffee and breakfast. Unfortunately, I've been put off by a few factors:

They advertise as having gluten-free menu options, but for vegetarians, these options are naturally gluten-free such as vegetables and hummus and yoghurt. That makes breakfast somewhat limited since I am a bit of a traditionalist and enjoy baked goods in the morning. I did get excited about the Huevos Rancheros, but they aren't vegetarian.

The espresso is inconsistent. When it's good, it's fantastic. When it's bad, it's sour and undrinkable without adding milk. An espresso should be able to stand alone. 

The prices are more than I'm willing to pay for the lack of choices and that inconsistency. I paid about twelve dollars for my americano and my small plate of vegetables and hummus. Everything tasted very good, but I was disappointed to pay so much for so little. 

Because of the shape and layout of the café, it is very loud during busy times. A wall around the kitchen would help cut some of the noise. 

I give Café Haven three stars despite all this because I like the concept, the food is high quality and tasty, and I'm sure for omnivores without diet restrictions, the variety suits well--my omni husband loves the cinnamon buns and the wraps. For vegetarians who can't eat wheat and who enjoy a quality, consistent espresso, not so much. Also, the staff is great--friendly, competent. 

I'll keep trying every once in a while because businesses like this tend to learn and adapt, but so far Café Haven isn't my first choice café.

The food here is fantastic! Pasta is hands down my favourite food so I can't believe it took me so long to try this place. I've never eaten in so I can't really comment on that, but the staff were very friendly over the phone and when I went in to pick up. I am obsessed with the Gnocchi with the gorgonzola & spinach sauce. I can't wait to get back to try more from their menu!

I love this place! The sushi, the sashimi and the food.
The only down side of this place is that they take forever for the food to arrive! I don't mind though, the food makes up for it

So, I never give 5 stars, but 4.5 is definitely in order for Yoshi. I dont want to give this spot away but I feel it wont be fair to the owners if I don't. The quality of the food is second to none.  The tastes and textures are divine, and the food just seems to melt in your mouth. Plus the staff are very nice.

The place is very nice with good decor, the service is good and the people there are friendly. The food is just ok, if I wanted a good steak I would definitely go to the Keg, but that is my own personal taste. I have lots of friends whom prefer Rics, over other places. The prices are decent and affordable.

We had a great meal and experience here.  It was busy but the owner came over and apologized for the wait.  The food was fantastic, we had chicken tacos and a dynamite roll.  Try the gravy, seriously so good.  Great service, great food.
Best lattes ever! Our fav. place to go for coffee and London Fogs after the gym! Any breakfast item or salad is amazing too! Fresh and full of flavour.

One of my favorite places for sushi. Restsraunt is cozy and comfortable. The service is fast and friendly. The sushi is fresh. The price is reasonable.  They're is a lot on the menu even if you don't like sushi. I have tied many different items and all were great.

The food is flavourful and very tasty! I really love the Ragu De Agnello (lamb in tomato sauce). However not much can be said for the service. The only reason I would return is for the amazing food. So if you are able to put up with almost non-existent service, or feel comfortable watching your sever eat her meal while playing on her phone in close proximity, the food is definitely worth it!!

This review is based on the sate soup with chicken and nothing else.

I ordered the sate soup with chicken and I knew we were in trouble as soon as I saw the smiley lady bring it to the table. It had that very bright shiny appearance of yellow chicken soup base. You know what I mean....cheap ingredients. Yuck I thought as it was plunked down on my table. It also had that glazed thickened look from uncooked cornstarch that had been used. You know what??? I'm not going to write any more. Not worth my time. It was horrible and let's just end this here. They should be embarrassed and ashamed as they put no effort into their cuisine. Garbage.

I stopped into Hey Cupcake! thanks to a Groupon (wooo food deals!). The shop is fairly tiny and was well stocked with cupcakes when I stopped in around 4 on a weekday. They have a large selection of cupcakes (upwards of 13), featuring different flavour and icing combos. Since I had a Groupon, I got a mixed assortment of 12 cupcakes. I'll do a quick run through of the flavours I got, with my favourites starred.

Salted Caramel (brown sugar cake and caramel icing) - very, very salty tasting
Pretty in Pink (vanilla with strawberry icing) - the icing was overly sweet tasting, vaguely like the taste of strawberries that have started to turn to mush
Not so Plain Jane (vanilla and vanilla icing) - very good! Cake was moist and the icing wasn't too sweet.
**Lemony Snickett (lemon poundcake, lemon pie filling, lemon buttercream) - definitely one of my favourites! It was a lemony explosion in my mouth and I'm all about that. I would have preferred it to be a touch more sour, but it was good nonetheless.
Coo Coo for Cocoa (chocolate cake, chocolate buttercream) - super yummy chocolate! The icing is very thick, not light like the other icings.
Ghostbuster (chocolate cake, marshmallow filling, chocolate buttercream) - just alright. It ended up tasting way too sweet, and the marshmallow taste wasn't noticeable at all.
**Down the Rabbit Hole (carrot cake, cream cheese icing) - The cake was perfect, moist and very flavourful. The icing was also good, but it was gritty.
Chocolate covered Strawberries (chocolate cake, strawberry icing)  - same issue with icing flavour as the other strawberry kind
Salt n Peppa (vanilla oreo cake, cream cheese icing) - yummy!
Men Are From Mars (chocolate cake, mars bar baked in the centre, chocolate icing) - way too sweet, the mars bar in the centre was weird, and it was too much chocolate, which until now I didn't think could happen. 
**Love my Philly (cheesecake centre, chocolate cake, cream cheese icing) - I absolutely love cheesecake and cream cheese icing so this was right up my alley! It wasn't too heavy or sweet, and was delicious. If you're only going to get one, get this one!!

All in all, the cupcakes were very good - moist and flavourful. There were a couple that were flavour misses and also a few that were a little bit more dry tasting. They also didn't have flavour guides, which I was not happy about. When I asked the staff for one, the girl said, "well we don't have any, but they are really easy to tell apart...", so 0/10 for helpfulness there. So while I think the cupcakes are good, I don't necessarily think that they are worth the extra couple of dollars that this place charges.
The service was really slow and we both found the food to be pretty bland and disappointing. Should've gone to state & main instead. Definitely won't try it again.

Best Sushi in Sherwood Park for sure! Skip Sumo Sumo and support a local business that deserves it! I'm no Sushi aficionado however I was pleased with the sashimi, nigiri, and maki I had here. I'm from Vancouver so I've had a bit of everything and this stands up well to what you would get in BC. Everything tasted pretty fresh and service was quick and friendly! I'll definitely be coming back!

Bad all the way around. Booked for Sunday dinner on Mother's day. They neglected to mention it was a buffet dinner... They have never done a buffet for dinner before and as usual the Sawmill buffet was bad. Poor selection. Cold food. Service was good but the 35 bucks for service charge on a Buffet is a little steep.. We were 4 people on the bill but automatic service charged because as a total we were a party of 13. Was totally disappointed. Pretty sure they made use of the lunch buffet left overs

Be sure to ask questions to the service tech's and sales. I bought a used car 2 week's ago and I found out there is a problem with the wheel's, so far they have been more than helpful I will see what the end result is from this and report back later on the out come NOTE I love the new ride

As far as Chinese food goes, this does the trick just fine!

We got Ginger Beef, Vegetable Chow Mein and some Green Onion Cakes. Overall it was tasty. The ginger beef had some great flavour and wasn't too spicy, the chow mein was filled with vegetables, and the green onion cakes was just as good as most I've had. Those things never get old!

If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely go back!

Went here for the first time today with the fam. Had Jimmy as our server. Absolutely phenomenal service. Attentive and great sense of humour. We had the Dinner for four (Soup, appetizer, chicken fried rice, four entrees and dessert). Food was great and hot. Dessert is nothing special but we're leaving full and with leftovers. Atmosphere is great. Will certainly be back when craving Chinese food.

Found this place through an online deal (groupon or something similar) and decided to give it a try since I was going away to Cuba for my honeymoon. The place was nicely decorated with music playing in the background and beds set up for the customers to be comfortable while getting their lashes done. The staff were very friendly and accommodating. Overall I was very impressed with their service especially since I was missing a few of my original lashes (false eye lash incident) and was worried if they could even do the job or not. It was a bit of a challenge and the lady that did my lashes did check in with the supervisor to make sure she was doing it correctly which I appreciated. The eye lashes looked amazing and the best part was that they lasted almost 4 weeks even with being in the water constantly while I was in Cuba for a week. 

Overall I was very happy with the service and plan to go back again when I go on my next vacation :)

Was very pleased to find this nursery this was my first visit right beside it were some horses we got to pet. 

Overall the prices were great and a lady named Cindy was very informative and helpful. Out all the nurseries I been too I love this one by far and will be buying my plants/ flowers here all the time:)

Great place to get work done.  They're fair, honest and do the work for the quote.  Exaple - I took my RAV4 to the dealership for warranty work, and they wanted to do a bunch of additional work on the ball bearings.  I took my car to Robins and got the work done for 2/3 the cost.

I wouldn't take my RAV4 anywhere else.

Talk about changes!  This mall has changed a LOT over the years.  Most changes have been for the better.... some not.  but overall, this is a pretty decent mall.

The usual suspects are there - cell phone provides and accessory kiosks, Bentley (there's also a store very similar to Bentley, but I can't remember the name), Buck or Two, hair and nail salons, Bath & Body Works, travel agents, Claire's.... and as of September 10, 2015, it is home to the second DSW (Designer Shoe warehouse) in Edmonton.  (check out this ink to see the full list of stores: http://www.sherwoodparkmall.com/stores) 

For the most part, the layout is just one long corridor, which makes it easy to navigate through.  The food court is small, but serves it's purpose with places like A&W, Taco Time, A&W, OPA, Edo etc...  Albert's Family Restaurant I believe is the only sit-down place inside the mall, but there's a Montana's in the parking lot as well.

It never seems to be overcrowded and it's always nice and clean.  The big question right now is what will happen to the space formerly occupied by Target.  It's currently in use by Elections Canada, but we're still all waiting to hear what will move in once that's wrapped up.

Also attached to the mall are Chapters, Shoppers Drug Mart, and a movie theatre.

I wouldn't drive from the city to go to this mall, but it's a great place to walk around on a lunch break.

STAY AWAY FROM THE GLUTEN FREE!!!!!!!!

I cannot say anything about their regular cupcakes (being a Celiac and all) but the GF are pretty HORRIBLE! . My mom bought them for me for my birthday today and one bite I had to spit it out. it felt weird in my mouth and on my teeth. then the taste wow I gagged. tasted VERY chemically. 

I had chocolate, my mom and husband had vanilla (looked like banana).  We traded cakes same thing. 

They were also SUPER dense.

After reading the reviews I was expecting more. The place was empty at 6:00pm,  not a good sign.  The food was bland and plain. My soup had no broth even though it came with a spoon.  The steak dish with rice was not worth the $15. The salad rolls were good though.   Nice lady and she was very polite.  But not enough to bring us back..

My husband did a lot of research trying to find the best deal on a trade in and lease. He put on a lot of miles driving around and talking to sales people and managers. No matter who he talked to, the story was not great. It didn't look like we would be able to swing things.

As a last minute option, he swung by Park Mazda to see what they might be able to do for us. The salesman took the information and told my husband he would get back to him. My husband didn't think he would hear anything more from him.

Low and behold, we heard back from him about 24 hours later. Not only could he help us, but we would have a better deal than we had hoped for!

We filled out the paperwork in record time and had the keys in our hand before you cold say "great service".

I came hear with my boyfriend for lunch. We wanted to try someplace that was different than our usual lunch grounds. We both knew of the Ric's Grill that was here previously but had never stopped in since it changed. My boyfriend had the beef dip and my oh my did he ever enjoy it! Best beef dip ever, he said. He has sampled a few beef dips in his day. I had the Buffalo chicken strip with fries.  Nothing fancy, however I too enjoyed it. The patio is where we ate our lunch. It was sunny and enjoyable. The patio was actually quite nice. If you are looking for an enjoyable casual lunch you should try them out.

DO NOT buy flaunt hair extensions from Roxx. The quality is horrible. They guaranteed quality that they could not live up to. The hair does not last and it's cause me nothing but matted hair and trouble. When I called to see if there was anything they could do I was told no.

Newly renovated mall.  Has a food court.  Women's clothing stores.  A Safeway and a Pier 21.  Has a camera shop and a Chapters.  Shoppers drug mart.  A couple shoe stores and Ardenes for the girls.  Not bad.  Doesn't have a department store though one might be under construction .

We went for dinner last night to this Ric's Grill rebranded restaurant. Then menu is largely unchanged from the former restaurant.

We shared a warm goat cheese and chicken salad to start. Very flavorful.  We shared a full size salad so had a large portion for each of us.

I had a strip loin steak.  It was very well done. Medium rare right through with a lovely crisp exterior crust. My partner had a pasta dish that she enjoyed.

Too full so we skipped dessert.

Nor a cheap place but we were quite happy with our dinner.

I've been here a few times now while waiting for laundry and the laundromat. Perfect place to relax for a bit and enjoy a coffee or tea. The staff is welcoming and friendly. There seems to be always a few customers around but not over crowded. The smell is amazing, they make a lot of their own food here. Any cafe you can add baileys too is a winner to me!

I like the rustic gathered decor. It has a very unique artistic feel to the cafe. If you like the artwork on the wall, you can buy it and support a local artist. i love the concept of locally owned.
The coffee I would say is alright, but I will still stop buy to support this business. I always get a muffin along with my coffee. The muffins here are homemade fabulous!!! 
I've also learned that there breakfast items are amazing..mmm cinnamon buns and waffles! Oh so yummy!!
What I've also noticed is the girls that work here are dressed very trendy and I and i love the way they look. Friendly and adorable staff that always smile and deliver great service!
It's a unique and friendly cafe in Sherwood Park that I always choose to go to when I'm meeting my friend that lives in this area and on my way to work in the morning.
Locally awesomeness!

The London fog has orange shavings! 

Super cute cafe with amazing food. 

Everyone that works here is super friendly.  In this day and age when ustomer service is on a rapid decline, it's nice to get a genuine smile and hear "thank you".

I find it veeeery frustrating that this location will clearly advertise it being open 24/7, but will be closed from 10pm and onward. It would be fine if they don't have enough staff to keep up with those hours. False advertising is frankly dishonest and poor business practice. Other than that, the staff when they are here are decent and it's a typical McDonalds experience far as the food goes. Please just keep up with the other locations or be honest and advertise accordingly.

This was my first trip to Wallish's and I am very happy with my experience. It's a smaller family operation but a great alternative to the larger local greenhouses, and very competitive in terms of price and quality. There are fewer types and overall quantity of plants, but more diverse colours and varietals of the kinds of plants offered. I found the plants, especially the 6 packs of bedding plants, are healthier than at larger greenhouses and the megastore seasonal sections in my opinion. Reasonable prices, less expensive than other local greenhouses, and good customer service. I'll come back later in the season for sure, well worth the little extra drive from Edmonton.

I purchased my car at Park Mazda in May 2008.  The sales experience at that time (as far as I can remember) was pleasant.  What I really want to comment on is their service department though.  

There is a Mazda dealership much closer to my home that I have had poor experiences with, which have brought me back to Park Mazda for the last few years.  Even though it is a bit of a juggle to get out to Sherwood Park and then to work or back after work in time, their service department is prompt, courteous, and generally great to deal with.

I have brought my car in for regular oil changes (which are very reasonably priced), warranty work, recall work, and now for issues after my warranty has expired.  They've been honest and upfront about what items are worth the cost, explain the issues and work being done very well, answer questions without being patronizing, and don't add unnecessary work or services if they don't actually feel it will resolve the issue.

They even arranged for me to pick up a courtesy car after hours when it turned out I would be without my car over a weekend.

I'm typically skeptical with dealerships, based on past experiences, but Park Mazda has proven trustworthy.

We've found a hidden gem for Dim Sum. The food is fresh and hot and best of all is all made in house. None of this stuff is frozen packaged junk. We try to go here once a month or so and the wait staff are very friendly and so is the owner, Peter.

Check it out!
These girls are amazing, they saved my lashes and eyes from a horrid job done elsewhere.

My husband and I decided to go to Ric's Grill for New Year's Eve dinner. We went with another couple. It was $65 per person and included a choice of one of three soups or salads, one of four appetizers, one of six entrees and one of four desserts.

We were all very happy with our meal and the service we received. My husband has just recently learned he must go gluten-free and the waitress was very helpful in letting him know what would work for him. Their food is "whole" enough that it wasn't a problem and he was able to have the stuffed mushroom caps, a steak and lobster with stuffed potato for his entree.

For dessert they were very helpful suggesting desserts for him - in the end he decided on a liquer poured over ice cream. This was a suggestion of the waitress and it was not on the menu.

The only problem we had with the service was it started out too fast. Our soup and salads arrived before we had even had a chance to taste the complimentary bread (which is very soft, fresh and warm). But all it took was asking the waitress to slow things down a bit. We requested our entrees be served about 1/2 an hour later and it worked out great. Again, very accommodating.

Everyone seemed to thoroughly enjoy their meals. The lobster was done just right, the stuffed potatoes had just the right blend of whipped and chunks, including cheese and chives. The steaks were done exactly to our specifications.

The New Year's menu included a glass of champagne, which we enjoyed with our warm ginger cake and ice cream - nummy!

As usual, we will be back!

Yet another burger slash bistro slash bar.  It is a busy place so you have to be patient.  They have an indoor outdoor patio.  Decor is more upscale.  Burgers and sandwiches are around $17 to $18 dollars and come with fries, but if you want to substitute for a house salad that's an extra $3 and no more fries!  So $20 for a burger is a tad expensive.  The quesadilla was small and had very little fillings, definitely not worth the $20 we paid.  The Dragon rice bowl is the best deal.  The cowboy salad was very good.  The atmosphere is Cosy.  There are several tv screens. Staff were pleasant.  Craft beers are $6.5 and they are only 14oz pints.  But the place provides a different menu and atmosphere so we will return as we like variety.

Well, growing up on a farm and growing up on steak, I would have to say, this is quite possibly the best steak I have ever had!  
Had the Crab stuffed Mushrooms ....  bit fishy, but overall taste was good!  
Had the Bacon Wrapped 6 oz Filet. Potato Pie and Veggies. 
The potato pie was yummy, veggies were good!
Steak.....   prepared perfectly!  Absolutely melt in the mouth perfect!  
Our server was super and very knowledgeable. 
Thank you for finally getting a good Steak House in Sherwood Park!!!

We have eaten at a number of Sawmills Restaurants in the Edmonton Area and have generally enjoyed each meal.  Sadly, this was not the case last night for this restaurant.  There were four in our party.  When our meals came only one of the meals came as ordered.  The meal that did arrive as ordered as overcooked.  One meal was satisfactory while one of the other meals was undercooked.  Those in my party that had steak said it was below average or just average.  For the price of these meals, the quality ought not to be slightly below average or average.To top it all of, when the bill arrived it was incorrect.  We were charged for items that we did not order.  The issue with the bill was corrected directly.  Our server was polite, courteous, and professional.  She was perhaps the only bright spot to our visit

Was in Sherwood Park on business today and a colleague asked what I was in the mood for.  I said "healthy" and we ended up at Cafe Haven! Wow it was so good! I had the Chicken Waldorf Wrap and it was really good - they had a nice variety of sandwiches, salads, wraps and soups. After reading some of the reviews I'm bummed I didn't get a cinnamon bun  

The ambience is nice and cozy and I'm told that breakfasts there are to die for so next time I better go earlier!!

This morning I decided to stop into Ricky's for my 1st time.
Nice decor and atmosphere. Friendly, helpfull staff.
Food...well that's where alas, I have a story instead of a few words. My appologies in advance for the length of this, but I feel the place actually deserves the benefit of the doubt...and that said...I will certainly go back!

I ordered their "build your own Beni' eggs Benedict. I settled on Chorizo and avacado.
I recieved my meal and it looked good enough, so I dug in with zeal.
After a few mouthfulls, I began to wonder if it was normal that their english muffins were not toasted, and hence, very soft and somewhat mushy given the toppings and sauce.
The next time my server happened by, I made this enquirey. By this time, I had allready finished 1 of the 2 stacks.
She assured me that they should be toasted, and while I hesitated (given that I was now more than half done a hearty meal) she insisted on getting me "another one".
While I waited for what I expected to be at least another english muffin and at most another, properly constructed stack, I ate the topping off my original second muffin.
I began to wonder what was taking so long.
Now full from my meal, I am presented with 2,  more stacks. Obviously toasted, and with at least twice as much meat each asy original offering. Looked amazing, but alas, I am now too full to partake. I now quizrd the server..."Is this how it should be, or is the chef making reperations?". She says she feels that the original meals helping of meat was standard (which I had originally felt wasn't quite enough). I decide to take the beautiful new meal home to my wife, and primptly pay the bill. 
So I am left in limbo.
Would have been better ti discount the meal I had allready eaten half of than present me with more food I cannot enjoy. 
Which presentation is their standard fare?
Wife said the new batch was fantastic.
I felt the original batch was good (especially if ot had been properly toasted).

So...yeah...I think I'll go back.
But I think I'll try lunch!
Cafe haven is the best!!!! They have amazing london fogs. My family loves thr weekend brunch. The smoked salmon eggs benedict and the quiche are amazing and never disappoint.

Had a vehicle inspection here they did a great job with no strings attached. Told me there was a light out in my turn signal and they fixed it for 2$ and also added the time line on when i needed the ball joints done on it. Bonnie was an absolutely lovely lady to talk to on the phone i have never felt so comfortable and anxiety free when talking about my vehicle. Will be returning here for more work to be done for sure. Also my quote for a vehicle inspection was 120$ which was 80$ cheaper than what canadian tire quoted me. Also wasn't put on hold at all during a busy call time so they got me! :)

Sawmill I am SOOO sad at you right now!!  What used to be one of my favourite restaurants, is now a 2 star MEH...all because you went and changed your menu to NOT include my most favourite dish of all time.  That's it; it's over!

I love the atmosphere - classy but not overly trendy with a touch of Alberta's history and culture.  This location in particular may take a little to get accustomed to.  The lounge entrance is on the South side of the complex, whereas the entrance to the dinning room is on the North side.  You can get through one to the other inside but it's like navigating a maze (one time I actually ended up in the kitchen...).  The lounge is HUGE and it's rare that you won't be able to find a table.  

The customer service has always been ok to fairly good but it was the chicken Neptune dish that brought me back.  You can Neptune a steak, but I am not a huge red meat fan, so I typically go for the chicken or fish dishes.  Since the menu change I have tried a few other options but have been quite disappointed.  Salmon burger; processed salmon patty...really Sawmill, really????  Caesar salad; drenched in dressing (next time - if there is a next time - dressing on the side, please!).  There are quite a few new appetizers that look amazing, but since I can barely eat a restaurant size meal as it is they would be way too rich (fattening) to order as a meal.

I understand the need to change it up and keep things modern.  I guess you can't please everyone but who really needs another hoity toity steak place?!

Came here today for coffee with a friend and ordered the spinach and artichoke dip it was quite delicious. Coffee was super tasty! I ordered the iced mochaccino and my friend had the iced capuccino which she too said was very nice. I love the atmosphere here and that the staff were so polite. The menu had so many great choices it made hard to choose with how many tasty options you can get so take your time to read through the items  and arrive early to get them while they are available. Will return soon!

Yes and yes. My gf have very much enjoy sushi/sashimi on a regular basis and this is us the first time we visited yoshi. Needless to say, well be back.

The place looks like a run of the mill local joint but their food, is from a different place altogether.

We had a large serving of salmon and tuna sashimi, the slices were well sized and tasted fresh.

We also had a spicy tuna roll, lobster roll and a salmon roll. They were well proportioned rolls, about 6 thick pieces each. The taste was a surprise as each goy better with every slice.

Very on par with the other sushi place in sherwood park, worthwhile alternative and if the next visit is as good as our last, may end up being better.

Definitely would recommend this place and we'll be going back again.

Enjoy.

Can't give this place a good review. I was late for my appointment (my bad) but the way it was handled was completely unprofessional and a waste of my time, a loss of revenue for the salon as well as a future customer.

They did call but the cheerful receptionist encouraged me to come to the salon anyway (hint: next time, ask the hairdresser FIRST) and here's where my experience fell apart. The Factory can choose to review their procedure for late customers:

After rushing like a mad woman (believing I would be accommodated), I arrived 15 minutes past my appointed time.

I went through the ritual of removing my shoes and hanging up my coat; I was seated in the chair for my consult. It took less than two minutes to glance at my hair for the rookie stylist to know she wouldn't be able to do my colour. Instead, she earnestly offered to do 1/4 of my hair...??

I want to add that I've been to many types of salons around the globe--from holes in the wall to upscale celebrity shops--and on a rare occasion when I've been late or the stylist is running behind, I'm either worked around (with more experienced stylists top level performers can and often do two clients in tandem); or I'm conveniently rescheduled on the phone if they can't accommodate me. 

To her credit, the stylist earnestly offered to reschedule, but honestly, why would I bother? With the prices charged, I expect high end service. Making me drive to the salon and having me sit in the chair to offer a lame alternative is not high end service. It makes me question the competency of the stylist. And I'm sure she's fine! She wants to do a good job, she said.

Late customers and no-shows are a frustrating part of the industry. I get it! And sometimes it's the stylist who's late (or running behind) or hasn't arrived for their appointments. It happens. 

I should have been rescheduled on the phone with a firm but polite reference to a well thought out policy. The time of both client and hair stylist needs to be respected.

The extra star is for the earnestness of the receptionist and stylist. This is clearly a lack of good management directives.

Excellent customer service. Made my family and I feel very welcoming the moment we stepped into the dealership. 

Their sales rep and sales manager were very tentative and also extremely knowledgeable with their products, along with great sense of humor, which made the shopping experience exceptionally enjoyable. 

We test drove a couple vehicles and they delivered them with lightning turnaround time. Offered great pricing and very detailed when explaining the cost breakdown and going through the various options. which led us to walking out today with a brand new 2015 Accord Touring.  

Highly recommend if you're shopping for a vehicle. Might have to make another trip down here soon for a second purchase.

Having had such a bad experience at Sundance Mazda, I decided to check out Park Mazda based on recommendations from a couple friends.

My sales guy Kyle was SUPER awesome and very friendly.  He didn't pressure me at all and they totally catered to my every changing mind.

Got a fantastic price on my Mazda 3 sport and was able to take the car home that day.

When it got time to see the finance manager, she was VERY persistent almost offended that I wouldn't get all the extras that she was offering.  Just because I could afford it doesn't mean I want it.  

Unfortunately there was a ding on my passenger side and asked for that to be fixed, so I left the car with them when I left town.  Came back, picked up my car, and forgot to check.  They were very accommodating, however and Kyle even picked me up from my drop-off point from camp.

The ding is still there but I will be going back one of these days when I have a moment.  Hopefully that will get fixed eventually.

General impression is that Kyle is an amazing guy and I would recommend him to anyone.  And when he wasn't available or didn't know my questions, the manager (forgot his name) was more than happy to help me.

My family went to Blue Rare with some trepidation as we had a horrible experience when it was Ric's Grill. Well we now have a new favorite restaurant! The service was excellent. Our waitress was fun and thoughtful,  she even had us laughing. This was a very good sign. 

The menu was so appealing we didn't make it to page two. For starters the bacon wrapped scallops were cooked to perfection. They were large, tender, and seasoned just right. My mouth is actually watering thinking about them. Being from the east coast, it's rare that I find shellfish prepared so well.

My husband had the soup of the day which was a medley of vegetables and beef. The broth was delicious and the vegetables were not overdone as they can be in soup. 

We also had the spinach artichoke dip which was my daughter's favorite. This lacked some visual appeal but was also delicious!

After those appies my daughter had the bacon cheddar burger which she loved. Those crispy little onions on top were a bit too many, but she just put the extra on the side for snacking on with the perfectly crisp, seasoned fries.

My husband and I both chose the cajun chicken caesar. We heartily agree it is the best one we've ever had. The chicken was tender, moist, and so flavourful! The dressing on the salad was fresh and again so flavourful. It looked like there might be too much, but it was light and just right.

As it was my hubby's birthday, we had dessert. Oh boy they did not disappoint! My daughter had the warm chocolate brownie which came with ice cream and chocolate drizzle. It was enough for two! My husband had the ginger banana cake with caramel sauce that was decadent, and had just the right amount of ginger. Perfection! I had the vanilla creme brule. I can honestly say that I would eat it everyday if I could! The texture was so smooth and creamy. It was light and melted in my mouth. The caramelized sugar on top had that snap when you break it with your spoon, and was exactly the right amount of caramelization, no burnt flavour at all. 

If you haven't gathered it by now, I highly recommend a visit to this restaurant!

I've come here a number of times in the past and have yet to endure a bad experience. They are very accommodating for children and the staff is friendly. 

The only down side for this franchise is the complacent menu. There is never anything interesting to try. What you see is what you expect to get. Seasonal changes would be great or monthly specials would be nice to see. 

The food is great though. It's cooked and prepare well. I like their steaks and prime rib. Last night I had the ribs for the first time. It was fall off the bone good. Sauce was nicely balanced with the meat.

Clean, good food, courteous service, overall a real gem.  Dim sum is prepared fresh. Highly recommended is shrimp wor wonton soup, YUM!!! Loaded with shrimp dumplings, shrimp, veggies and the wor signature sliced pork.  Amazingly tasty broth a new favorite for us.  Dim sum was fresh, hot and very tasty.  Our server was very accommodating and did his utmost to make all of us feel welcome and well cared for. Was very helpful for spicy food eaters and kids alike. New favorite for Asian / Chinese food in the Park!

Need something hemmed or tailored? I usually go here when I need a dress altered or jeans hemmed. It's a local business that does well to get your order ready in a timely fashion. The service is fast and friendly. I've had good experiences here and will keep bringing my clothes back for future alterations. The shop it'self is a little out dated but that just means they've been in business for a long time!

Won't go back, we sat at the bar asked for water, waited for sometime. We were about to leave because it took so long . The waitress took our order than proceeded to complain about us to another server. The both were looking at us as they were talking. We left

The food was delicious and the staff were upbeat and friendly making it feel like you were invited into their home.  I had traditional eggs Benny and my husband had a vanilla waffle, both were delicious.

Bland, watery, flavourless take out.  I used to be a fan of this restaurant but I've been consistently disappointed as of late.   When they first opened they were above average but now they are below average.  I won't be bringing my business here anymore.

I wanted to like Cafe Haven, I really did but I was sadly disappointed with both the food and the service.  Ordered ham and eggs how hard is that to mess up?  Sadly the ham looked like it had been dragged out of a sandwich, the potatoes were cooked in some type of cumin slurry and only the coffee saved the meal.  Asked a staff member for hot sauce and they barked at me to look on other tables.  Very sad indeed.

Came here for dim sum a couple of Sundays ago and was very impressed by the cleanliness and atmosphere of the restaurant . 

We arrived about 10am and it was not at all busy so the 2 of us got a nice roomy booth table by a window.  The server was super friendly when we told him this was our first time coming in.  We quickly scanned the menu and was impressed by the variety of items they had from ginger beef to shrimp dumplings and deep fried squid.   We ordered way too much food as usual and it was all brought out to our table in a nice relaxed steady pace.   The food was fresh, nothing soggy or over coated in sauce and everything tasted delicious. The ginger beef was not at all dry, soggy, or difficult to chew.  The shrimp in little deep fried pouches was so good I had a hard time sharing them.  Throughout our excessive eating and tea drinking the service staff was continuously attentive to make sure our tea was never out and our waters were topped up when needed and this was all done with a smile. They made us feel welcome and yet not at all rushed in our enjoyment of our meal, and by this time the tables around us were starting to fill up.

As terrible as it is to say I have been to many Asian restaurants where the food was good but the service was so terrible (sometimes terrifying ) where I felt like I was intruding on the establishment and that i should have just gotten take out or delivery and then ran for my life...  At Good Buddy this was quite the opposite and for that itself I will be returning with family and friends.

On the way out we grabbed a take out/ deliver menu and ordered dinner from them the next night. The food was still good but some deep fried items where a little soggy as to be expected.  

I highly suggest coming here for dim sum rather then braving downtown Edmonton and fighting for parking and a seat.  The food is fresh from the kitchen and not pre frozen and reheated, the service is great and parking is plentiful.

Thank you Good buddy for the great experience and see you soon.
Got terrible service at a Alberta Honda and switched to Sherwood Honda. Brought my vehicle in for service... good customer service and washed my vehicle! Very happy.

Nice little Japanese restaurant on Brentwood, off Sherwood Drive in a small strip mall in Sherwood Park.

The food was good, nothing exceptional. Just your average, run of the mill Japanese fare.  I ordered the small Bento box snd was able to substitute the terriyake chicken for spring rolls.

The California rolls were not overly stuffed, the seaweed was tough to bite through and a tad chewy. This made it hard to just take a bite and eat like "a proper lady".  The cucumber rolls were quite plain, no zing to them. You will definitely need to use the wasabe sauce.  The terriyaki beef, on the other hand, was AMAZING! I would definitely recommend it. Nice shaved pieces of tender beef, perfectly cooked and drenched in the right amount of delectable sauce! Mmm...salivating at the tought of it. The spring rolls were small, yet tasty. Best thing about them? They were not greasy! Bonus points for this.

I would return just for the terriyaki beef!!

There is a small parking lot at the front of the restaurant hut more street parking can ne found around the corner.
Absolutely loved this place, can't wait to return! Delicious eggs benny and coffee :)

I finally found a place with great dim sum! I recently moved here and was on the hunt for a good Chinese restaurant. Coming across Good Buddy online, I decided to try it with my sister who also loves Chinese food. We decided to try a bunch of their dimsum, like their crystal shrimp dumplings, pork & shrimp dumplings, and deep fried shrimp dumplings to name a few! All the food we ordered was great! The ambience is awesome. And all the servers were nice and greeted us the minute we walked in the door. Will definitely be coming back and bringing friends.

Good selection of flowered plants etc but I struggled to find any of the edible, vegetable type. I went in looking for corn, peas and couldn't find any? I found the tomatoes but that was it? I was also looking for strawberries but again came up short? I came back another time looking for pond accessories, in fact the pond lining and again nothing? Maybe it was just my bad luck but it seemed that whatever I wanted they didn't really have? I wanted to ask around but again couldn't find help. I did come on the weekends and I understand that its probably busier time but ...... on the other hand like I mentioned the potted plants, and flowers were great and turned out awesome at my place.
Great Brunch and service! Going to definitely come back. Enjoyed the chocolate waffle topped with peanut butter cream sauce toasted walnuts whip cream:) yum.

To repeat another review, this is indeed a hidden gem of Sherwood park...

Fast, good service, excellent selection, expensive...but cheap compared to other sushi place in the park.

Once a week for us there....at least.

Yoshi is the best sushi in Sherwood park.  The other day my wife and I were going to a different restaurant for dinner but there was an hour wait, so we headed to yoshi. I am tempted to not write this review because Yoshi is like our own little secret... When we arrived the restaurant had 1 table full at 5:45pm. I need this place to get more customers so they keep serving fresh fish and don't go under, because they really are the best in the park.
My favorite roll is the avocado roll, followed by the sunrise maki. Both are very good.
I am also a big fan of their tempura and Kia karage (deep fried squid).
Yoshi isn't rewriting the book on sushi, as a lot of my favorite items from here are my favorites everywhere, this place just executes perfectly every time for less money than other places in Sherwood park

I was really excited for this location to open, as i have eaten at the different locations in Edmonton and always had a very good dining experience. My excitement was most likely the reason i gave this location two chances before deciding to never dine there again. 

Our first vist consisted of waiting for our food for over an hour and a half, resulting in completely over cooked steaks. When we complained the manager and our waitress were less then sympathetic and did not even offer to take anything off our bill.

Our second visit was not any better. Although there was less of a wait, two out four people at the table didnt recieve the right order. When we complained about getting food the waitress seemed annoyed that we asked her to fix the problem and actaully do her job properly.

However this location does have a rather nice lounge and fairly decent service. I would probably eat there again,l but never the resturant.

Always bad slow service.  Only ever one person working and they take forever to come from the back or if they are assisting someone else - good luck.  Cupcakes are dry and with very bland flavor.  Consistenly poor and have tried more than once or twice or three times.  I just wanted in again today and walked out because I got tired of waiting.  Unsure how they stay in business.  Cupcakes just don't taste good.  I make better ones at home with a cake mix without question.
Excellent customer service provided by Dean and his team. He explained everything without the hard sell that I always received from Mr.Lube.

I am not sure where the person got the dry and flavorless cupcake but it wasn't here. I have tried most cupcake places around and some only have vanilla and chocolate cake with different icings. They have many different cakes and delicious icings. My favorite was After Eight. Chocolate mint chip. A December specialty last year or the the year before. Large variety. A diet cheat that's worth it.

I take my daughter there often as a mother-daughter thing.

It was the first time visiting a Ricky's. There was five of us that went out for a business lunch. The place was busy but nowhere near full. We got seated by we presume the manager and then it went downhill from there. The waitress was grouchy and never smiled the whole time we were there. I know people have bad days but this is like we slapped her ourselves. She asked if we wanted drinks, one member asked for a latte, the waitress looked up an said 'no, we don't have them, this is Ricky's'. 
We didn't order food right away as we discussed business, this was not to the waitresses liking, whom seemed most disgusted with us. I didn't get a coffee top up for the longest time, basically until I started eating, then she came around too much!
Awful experience from the server, which was a shame because the food was half decent. I think the server could have been the owners wife, which sometimes can work out but definitely not with this place. 
I will try Ricky's again but not the Sherwood Park restaurant.

Don't like to write bad reviews but feel like I have to pass this on so hopefully they monitor Yelp and fix the problem.

A friend and myself went there for supper in the lounge and both ordered fettuccine alfredo, one with the shrimp and one without.   Food quality was terrible, will not eat there again.   Having said that I do want to say that the service was not bad and the décor was nice.   We did mention out issue with how the food tasted and received 25% off.

I just purchased a car from this dealership for the second time in under 2 years. 

My first experience in January 2015 was great, I was happy with the price I paid for the vehicle, and Robert worked hard to help me get good financing and find the right fit for me. 

After dropping my car off for service a couple of weeks ago, I noticed the 2016 civic had been redesigned, and I love the new style. After thinking about it for a couple of days, I decided to call Robert and see what kind of numbers I was looking at to upgrade. 

Within an hour he had preapproved me for financing and had some numbers. I asked him to do a little better. The next day he called me back with better numbers, and I decided to go for it. I'm content with what they gave me for my trade-in, I am happy with what I paid for the car, and Robert again worked hard to make it work for me. The fact that he didn't force me to argue with him to get a good deal was nice. There were no surprises when it came time to sign. He didn't try to upsell me on anything, in fact I had to ask him to add the extended warranty. He was very transparent and honest. 

I can't speak much about the service department, my experience with them has been limited but has all been good! The sales managers were nice. All in all, I'm really happy and would recommend them to anyone. Even my mom! Which says a lot. 

And I looooooooooove my new car.

We keep dining here hoping it will get better but I believe our efforts are finally over. We want so badly for this restaurant to do well but charging a fine dining price for something much less is not a recipe for success. Some examples that we experienced this weekend at dinner: (does not include other disappointing visits) fake crabmeat on the chicken neptune, grisly steak, only 4 pieces of vegetable on each plate and wilted spinach in the salad. So sad because the restaurant is beautiful and has lots of potential to be the best dining in Sherwood Park.

I have been going here for a couple of years. It is handy as Fabricland is in the same parking lot. I leave my keys and pick them up when I am done buying fabric I don't need.  

I get semi-synthetic as my vehicle is a little older. The staff has always been nice and friendly. I used to work in a place similar to this so I know they haven't tried to sell me anything I don't need. If I need an air filter changed then I do it myself. Sometimes they forget to reset the maintenance button and it is a pain to get it to change so I end up going back.

I will continue to go there.

This place is awesome! It is similar in prices to the Real Canadian Superstore Liquor Store but the selection of wine is not as good.

This place does have major price reductions to alcohol, wine and beer. If you are planning a party or a weekend away, this is the place to stop. It can get pretty busy on days before a long weekend, especially in the summer when people are going camping.

Tip: You DON'T need a costco card to buy from here.. pretty cool!

Excellent quality, freshness and for the quantity, the price is right at $4 - $6 per dish. The Siu Mai dumplings were the biggest I've ever seen! Check out my picture of the dim sum menu - there is also a full menu available. For two people whose eyes are way bigger than their stomachs, $50 for 9 items, tea and tip is a decent price for a very satisfying experience. Heads and tails above The Greasy Rice Bowl!

Wonderful place to get your lashes done!  Scheduling was easy and efficient. They will send you a text to confirm your appointment, which is handy as a reminder.  Technician was friendly, thorough and gentle.  Love the decor and the relaxed ambience. Lashes were great during the whole duration of my vacation, even withstood swimming.  Highly recommended!

A gem in Sherwood Park!

I went Friday for lunch to try it out and was impressed with their rolls!

I will be back for dinner soon!
Wow excellant fettuccini loved the backend chicken that came with it.  Deff early coming back for more !!  Love the atmosphere too !

Well, after visiting 3 locations in 2 different cities now.... I've come to accept the fact that Brown's will not be anything better than mediocre for me.

They had great happy hour deals when we were there.  If I remember correctly, there were a few drinks on for $4.00, including the house wine, and appetizers were all $4.00 off.  So, we each had a drink and shared a couple of appetizers.

The service started out okay, but then she disappeared for a while.  When she reappeared she apologized and explained that one of the staff members is moving, so they were all saying goodbye.  

We had the General Tao's chicken and Salt and Pepper dry rubs.  Both were okay, but I probably wouldn't order them again.  

Just meh overall.

Well, this was just a sad, disappointing mess of an evening.  Got to the Steakhouse (and I use that term loosely), and decided to go into the bar.   We sat and had a nice server come over and ask us for our drinks.  Once they were delivered, she came back around 3 times to get our food order, all within a 2 minute space.  Finally, we gave up having a relaxing drink and ordered the Steak and Lobster.  Pricey at 50.00, so we were looking forward to being treated to a nice meal.  NOT SO

Our meal finally arrived, with only one of us with a napkin and cutlery, we shared.  Even when we asked for one, we did not get anything.  Our plates were large and for the most part empty.  One steak filet wrapped in bacon (looked similar to the M&M meet shops filet) and a small lobster tail.  one quarter of a carrot slice, one slice of red pepper, one wilted, tasteless broccollini and two lumps of potato paste fresh from the microwave.

Meat was most definitely tough and tasteless and could have used some seasoning.  Lobster wasn't bad, if I didn't have to season it myself as well as the butter.  

Commented that there was no bread on the table...   thought that with the price of the food, you would at least get a bread basket.  Turns out, other tables received bread just not us.
