If we were tucked away in a corner, a small oversight could be understood.  But we were in the middle of the bar!  The servers and staff are all the same from before the owners changed the name to Blue Rare Steakhouse.  Technically, that and the dreary menu are the only things that changed.

DO NOT WASTE your money.  This one should be shut down in a month.  I

Came here for date night with my hunny. It was my first time at this location and wasn't disappointed.

We arrived for our 5:30 reservation to a quite restaurant. There was maybe 6 other diners in the dimly lit restaurant side. We had plans to go to a movie afterwards, so an early reservation seemed appropriate. 

Upon sitting we were politely greeted by our server Kris. He introduced himself as our "coach" for the evening. An interesting twist on what I'm used to. He offered us water and asked if he could get us some beverages. A little unfamiliar with the menu he guided us through it when my BF asked about spirits. Not a terrible move, but was expecting a bit more knowledge from a restaurant of this caliber. 

Upon returning with our drinks he proceeded to pour all 9oz of my wine into my glass... Another rookie move. Not a huge problem, but something worth noting. 

When it came time to order my BF ordered the Kobe burger... Seeing as it was a new menu our server wasn't quite familiar with the changes. So, he had to verify that it was available. I would think that training would be provided for the servers before a new menu launch... So I don't know what the issue was here. 

Food was typical for a steak house. My prime rib was juicy and very flavourful. The giant Yorkshire Pudding was fluffy and perfect! My BFs burger was juicy and cooked to perfection, with all the "groceries" crispy and fresh. Dessert was a lemon tart. Not too tangy and the perfect amount of sweetness. No complaints on the food. 

While the service was good it was missing that polished, fine details I was hoping for. 

All in all worthy of 4 stars! I would likely return for dinner or maybe a Sunday brunch.

I usually go to Regis Hair Salon when it's time for a cut or colour but I was going to a concert one night with a friend she told me she was going to go get her hair done at this Roxx place so I decided to phone and book an appointment and give it a try. I also wanted to get a trim and get my bangs cut. 

I walked in to a very trendy, clean looking salon. I didn't have to wait long and I really liked the stylist who did my hair as she was very friendly and fun/easy to chat with. She knew exactly what I was looking for and understood what I was talking about (surprisingly so as I am not the best at describing what I want done to my hair). She was quick and she did a really good job styling my hair the way I wanted it (and she was picky about it - like she actually cared about the way it turned out!?!?! I liked that cuz I am super picky about my hair when I get it styled and usually end up disappointed with it). 

So I get up to pay and I'm just bracing myself - this place looks really classy so I was expecting high prices. Not really at all - it was less than what I usually pay at Regis and I was waaaaay happier with the quality of service there! I definitely recommend this place and will for sure be back next time! Sorry Regis but you have been replaced!!!

An adorable little coffee house, with lunch items and dessert as well! I love the atmopshere of it! All different types of tables, lamps, chairs etc. Nothing matches but it makes it so cozy!  This is the place to relax and catch up with a friend, or do a business meeting, etc. Fabuolous place with great food and coffee!

Went to Ric's with my wife and 3 kids on Friday night. It's been a year since I've been there, and most things seemed the same, nice decor, darker, nice ambiance, a 'high-end' feel. The service was top notch. For the most part, the food was too, the filet was cooked perfectly, and tasted great, but my prime rib was not great. Ordered and received med-rare, as recommended, but it was difficult to cut through, and simply lacked taste. The last great prime rib I had was at the Keg. For me, I'll give the Keg another try before I go back here.

I went here for the first time and it will be my last. I had originally asked for a senior styles and given a name of who was to cut my hair. 

When I arrived i was greeted by 4 ladies not sure who it was I went with the first one that greeted me(silly me). 

As this girl was cutting my hair I began asking her how long she had cut hair and said a couple of years (2)  well right away I asked her if she was a senior stylus and said no. I asked for her name and it wasn't who I was referred too. i was very upset but gave her the chance to cut my hair as she had a great disposition. I then asked if she can do the style I showed her the picture and said yes. 

Well, the rest is history. 

I am so disappointed with this place and will not return. In fact I will give them the same service they gave me. I will promote their carelessness and unprofessionalism and hope that all future readers of this appt. don't get mislead by the flashy environment as that's not what u will show in public to others. 

I give then one star, as they are one poor facility that's not worst our money.

At this point, I'll be suggesting this place to others. The two times I've eaten here the food has been fresh and delicious. I've been here only twice and in both cases it was for lunchtime takeout so I didn't see much of the inside but the I did recieve was very welcoming and attentive (I believe the man I dealt with may have been the owner; he had that owner aura about him).

Café Haven changed owners about two years ago. Since then the quality of the food and service has greatly gone down.

No more delicious cupcakes! Dessert squares and pies, as well as the bread used are often dry.

Coffee quality is not top notch anymore.

Service is definitely not as attentive or as helpful as they used to be. I hear management is not present as often as they should be.

The last two times I was there, empty tables had dirty dishes left on them for much too long. They were ignored by staff that were just standing around.

I only return there when someone else wants to go. I choose elsewhere when asked.
Great food, Great Service, The Harvey's do it up right!  I love the fact that the walls constantly changing with Original "Local" Art.  This truly is a gem in Sherwood Park!

We had dinner there last night, I was disappointed to find there was no cart service but table service turned out to be way better. Hot, fresh and delicious. Our server was excellent. We will definitely eat there again.

I can't believe I didn't check out good buddy sooner! My family and I always drive into the city for dim sum on weekends, but now that we've found this place in the park I doubt we will drive to the city again.
The main difference between good buddy and more traditional dim sum places is that there are no carts at good buddy, everything is off the menu.
The menu has all of the standard offerings like su Mai and lotus leaf wrapped rice.  My personal favorite is deep fried squid and it was well represented. We didn't order a single thing that wasn't awesome.
The food all came fast and at a nice pace as opposed to all at once which was nice.
The servers were very attentive and consistently returned to clear plates, fill waters and check on us. 
My personal highlight of the meal was at the end when everyone takes turns guessing the amount of the bill. Our low guess was $89 and our high guess was $104. For dim sum for 6 people, it only came to $69!

The food was excellent as was the service however I have a big concern. I'm trying very hard to eat healthy and watch what I eat. I very seldom eat out because when someone else does the cooking you never know what's in it. I ordered the Ancient Grains and kale salad, sounds healthy doesn't it. Well it's not. I am on Weight Watchers and am allowed 23 smart points a day. This salad was 20 points! Why do they have to hide the fats like that. Why can't the chefs create a menu that is actually healthy instead of disguising and unhealthy food under a healthy name! Very disappointed and feel tricked or the restaurant. They should change the salad name to ancient fat salad.
Had a coffee and sandwich for lunch. Pretty pricy but tasted good. Nice atmosphere and not too busy. I'd go back.

The food was averagely good but served cold. The waitress was extremely inexperienced and it was frustrating to have these experiencing while paying $170 for the meal and drinks inc. tip. Very overpriced. Same management as Rics Grill but not near the same quality or cleanliness.

Food at this place is amazing. The only downside is how slow it can be.  Although you can't rush perfection, 30 minute meal times is a long time when there is only one other table occupied in the whole place.

I've been here a few times for business lunches and it's always been good. At lunch, it's never busy and the service is always friendly and attentive. I've had a few things on the menu and I've always enjoyed them. Most recently I had the Cajun Chicken Sandwich and it totally exceeded my expectations. It was juicy and flavourful and it was a big portion. The atmosphere is good and if you're into sports betting, there is a huge area in the back with many TVs so you can do just that.

The sushi here is fabulous! It's authentic and great quality. It also won't break the bank to eat here. My only complaint is that the egg should be a little sweeter, but that's just being picky. This is by far the best sushi in the Edmonton area that we have found so far. It's our new sushi spot

Excellent dim sum! Very clean and extremely well priced. We were with a group of people so we ordered almost one of everything on the menu and it was delicious! They make the dim sum from scratch, you can watch threw a glass window. Absolutely delicious it is one of our favourite restaurants. They also have non dim sum food for order

I approached Body and Soul Spa with high expectations. So when I entered the establishment, on time, I was directed to the waiting room with some displeasure as the receptionist informed me "Your esthetician will be five or ten minutes so just have a seat."  The waiting area was a small room, with an overabundance of armless chairs. The coffee table was strewn with spa brochures and literature, magazines, client forms and a vase of fake flowers. Music was piped in, while a wall mounted television with sound on advertised yet more esthetic services. The effect was inelegant, and less that soothing.

Upon entering the treatment room, I was instructed to disrobe and put all of my closes in a small wicker basket laying on the floor. No hangers, no closet, no hooks. A basket on the floor. I was coming from the office and wearing a suit. Thanks a lot. 

The young lady who would be my esthetician wanted me to pick my own facial. I said I would prefer if she, the professional, would recommend the one that best suited my skin. Without examining my skin or even a closer glance, she immediately directed me to one of  the most expensive on their menu, of course! The language in their brochure was generic and almost enigmatic. It was hard to tell why one which promised to "effectively improve the appearance of lines and wrinkles" was any different from another at the same price that would address "anti-aging and hydrating, skin tension and firmness".  Both were $139.95!

The facial was fine. And by fine, I mean, ok. Not extraordinary, not the best I've ever had. But it was certainly the most expensive. Cramped, messy reception area, a straightforward service and an eye-popping price in a Sherwood Park strip-mall day spa. Will I be back? Not likely.

I am giving this restaurant three stars because overall, it is A-ok. HOWEVER, I would love to be able to give their yummy peach shrimp dish  5+ stars!

I go to this restaurant specifically to order the peach shrimp dish because it is the only place I have ever had it where it tastes that good. I gave my friend a bite and she said "oh my! it is like a dessert!".

The shrimp is crispy and battered and it sits in a bed of peaches and a sweet cream type sauce. 

My husband always orders the gluten free combo meal and he is happy with it, although I don't think overly thrilled. Otherwise we would go more just because I want the shrimp!

The service right off the bat was excellent, and remained so even with a gigantic birthday party eventually consuming ¾ of the restaurant. Although the food is not mind-blowing in the world of Asian cuisine, it is still delicious and likely would be accepted by a wide variety of palates.

As far as breakfast goes it was pretty average it took quite a while to get our breakfast when it came it was hot it was good but I've had better I will pick Ihop over this place
 Anytime

2 stars because my glass of water was empty more of the time than it was full and for a steakhouse, my medium rare steak arrived dry and bland. It was disappointing because I've had much better experience with the Sawmill restaurants in Edmonton proper. At least the waiter was pleasant and the atmosphere was nice.

Although, I'm not a coffee-drinker (I know, I know, there's something wrong with me... two university degrees and you don't drink coffee???? FREAK!), I do enjoy my Saturday morning visits to Cafe Haven.

My girlfriend deserves credit for discovering this place after we moved to Sherwood Park.  Since we' discovered it, it has become a one of the places we visit most frequently.

Now, since I don't drink coffee, I wont' be commenting on that.  Rather I can speak, semi-authoritatively, on their pastries.  First and foremost is their cinnamon buns.  They are quite good, ranking 2nd on my list in the Edmonton area.  They are most and flavourful, with a good dough and a fair bit of gooeyness.  They are also a decent size, with one of them pretty much filling me up for a breakfast meal.

As for the other tasty treats, I've sampled their date squares (quite tasty) and a few other assorted squares (rhubarb squares jump out to me as being quite tasty).  I've also enjoyed a few of their sandwiches and some of their brunch items.  All have been very good and have the added bonus of using many local ingredients.

Even though I'm not a coffee guy, I still do enjoy warm beverages and Cafe Haven has much for those that are coffeephobic.  I'm quite fond of their Chai Lattes, although I prefer it half-sweet.  They also have a nice selection of loose teas.

A quick comment on the decor, if I may.  The shop is obviously a converted bank (as evidenced by the vault near the back), which has been decorated with a nice mix of furniture.  What stands out most (and is most appealing) is the range of artwork on display.  Cafe Haven appears to regularly change their artwork by featuring a new, local artist every so often.  It's a nice change and the artwork, thus far, has been fantastic!

In closing, this little Cafe deserves its 5-star rating, if not for some of the best cinnamon buns in Edmonton (or Sherwood Park for that matter), but for the ambiance and enjoyment so many get from this establishment!
Food is amazing and service is so friendly. Had a girls night out for my birthday and was so nice to have the private room. Food was amazing and everyone had a good time!

Been to this location 3x now. None have been during peak times. The service has been reasonable and the servers we've had have been great. The food is prepared well but also kinda basic chain fare in a Boston Pizza type of way. I guess if you want a more in-house chef derived menu you'd have to go to a more independent restaurant. Overall a good place to drop in for consistency, but no jaw droppers here.

When I walked in the door, it felt like I was visiting an old friend.  The décor has not changed much over the years, but the product and service seems to have changed a little.  After reading through the other reviews, I now see that it has changed ownership, so that would explain it.  

I was craving a Nanaimo bar, but was sad when they didn't have any.  I opted instead for a vanilla latte, and one of those multi colour marshmallow/butterscotch/peanut butter square things, that I've never actually known the name of.

When the barista was handing me my latte, he quickly pulled it back and explained that he forgot the vanilla, and fixed that mistake.  I was happy that he didn't let me walk out the door with the erroneous drink.

The latte was tasty, but a little too bitter for my taste buds.  The square was delicious though.  Soft and sweet, as it should be.

They had a really nice looking display of sandwiches and salads, although it was after lunch, so it was kind of slim pickins.

Went for take out here today... first time ever.... ordering was simple online.. was greeted at the door... food came out quick and hot.... (:)   had the meal for one and an order of shrimp dim sum.. food was amazing... hot tasted fresh and the portions ... holy cow... now i dont have to cook supper... Will definitely be a regular..
Today I took my BC friend to Saigon Cuisine for lunch and was gob smacked at how fabulous this little hole in the wall was. I will definitely be a return customer :)
Great coffee house with a very eclectic look and feel to it. They serve Transcend coffee and make a great Americano. Usually here a few times a month and I hear the weekend brunch is excellent.
Locally owned, everything made from scratch, customer service is excellent, prices and quality kills chain restaurants like Dennys. Lots of seating in the back.

This Sawmill location is struggling for an identity, experienced managers and staff you would expect behind a register at a fast food restaurant. We parked in front of what appeared to be the main entrance only to find out that was the lounge for the hotel. When we informed them that we had reservations, we were directed down a hotel corridor with kids in wet swimming suits dripping with water. When we arrived and asked where we could have drinks before our guests arrived, we were directed back to the separate lounge. We opted to go ahead and sit down at the table to have a drink. Three tables within sight were feasting on toothpicks after their glutenous all you can eat disease infested salad bar.  Flys were crawling all over the salad bar so I opted to switch to ordering alacarte. 

Unfortunately, the steak was cheap as the service. I ordered a New York Strip and was brought a Top Sirloin "baseball" steak. When I asked to have it corrected, the Manager (who looked 22 years old) stated that I was probably not familiar with meat cuts. I decided not to argue even though I've dined at some of the finest and most expensive steakhouses across North America. But for a $30 steal, I guess you get what you pay for. I'd rather pay $40-$50 and have a better steak and service.

The wine list consisted of a limited selection of lower end wines at fair prices but could be expanded. The decorations and atmosphere was nice and well appointed; one of a higher end restaurant. 

Our waitress was a metaphor for the evening; we saw our waitress three times during the evening. I later spotted in the parking lot with her friends sucking down on a cigarette. She muttered "thanks for coming" while exhaling. The manager and bus boy took care of our needs. While they were working hard they were clearly new to the restaurant industry.

The bottom line is that this is a good steakhouse for the bourgeoisie who have families who have minimal expectations. You can grab an average baseball steak in a nice atmosphere at a decent price point. For those seeking a better steak or someone who is celebrating a special occasion, spend a little more and go to Chop, Ruth Chris, or another. $200 for 3 people would go alot further in any of these versus the worn out tradition of Sawmill which has become too confident in their name and is showing in their service!
Fresh tasting sashimi.  Delicious.  Great friendly service. Must try the mushroom and spicy shrimp appetizers.

Food was okay, omelet was a little oily. Service is average. Haven't been asked for a refill. I have had their burgers here, they were good. For breakfast though I won't do again. Pancakes ok. 
The table next to us needed more cream, without hesitation the waitress reached over and grabbed some from our table. Breakfast was done and was finally asked if I wanted a refill of my coffee, than was asked twice within a minute. Now for the bill, we had our table cleared, no sign of the waitress with our check. I guess you need to be regular here as she spent a lot of time with another table, saying see you next week. I know I won't be a regular here. If I do come back and I end up with the same server I will leave or go sit in the lounge. I had better service there the last time I was here. 50$ for three of us to have a subpar breakfast and service.

Didn't review last time, so I thought I'd review based on the last two experiences at Roxx.  

My partner and I decided to check them out for a full spa day the first time based on a bunch of our friends saying how great the place was.  We went for a 120 minute couples massage, then both of us getting manicures, then myself getting a microdermabrasion and my partner a haircut and colour.  

We were greeted, taken to our beautiful lounge area, and we changed into our robes, had some wine and waited for our massages.  Our 2 massage therapists brought us to our room, which was lit with candles and smelled really good.  We both got an hour and a half massage, which was UNREAL.  Both massage therapists asked us what style of massage we preferred and if they should target certain areas - PERFECT.  I got a combo deep tissue/therapeutic massage emphasizing my shoulders and back, while my partner had a therapeutic massage focusing on his back.  We got whole body treatments, but they did spend more time in the areas we asked for.  We had a blast with them - we laughed and talked and had so much fun, on top of the massage.

The manicures following were great - I'd only had one before so I'm not a connoisseur but again we had fun with them while we had a really cool manicure, with hot wax and a hand massage with scented oil etc - awesome.

My partner went for a cut and colour after and it looked GREAT.  I had a microdermabrasion which felt amazing the next day.  My skin glowed and we both felt like a million bucks.  

We had such a great time that day we booked for another 120 minute couples massage 2 days ago.  PHENOMENAL.  We had a couple mimosas in the lounge before going into another fantastic massage.

This place is awesome.  Do yourself a favour and either book yourself in, or treat someone to it.  What a great experience.  We'll DEFINITELY be back.

Think Global, Act Local seems to be the motto of this hip cozy cafe! Be it their locally sourced theme, transcend coffees, artwork from local artists, Music nights on Thursdays... This place has all the elements of what your friendly neighborhood coffee shop should be all about!
Loved the ambience and service. Came here with a friend just before lunchtime and we were warmly greeted. Our order - latte,breakfast wrap and espresso was brought out to us. It was refreshing to see clean eating options - honey, raw sugar, cucumber infused water to mention a few. They are much appreciated! I love the artwork, the lil 'vault' room in the back.
Loved the latte, had to knock off one star because the espresso wasn't really my cup of tea ;) It was a bit too bitter for my taste but I will be back to try out more of their brews. They have transcend coffees for sale too.
I was excited to see the music nights in the local newspaper! Shout out to Lyndsey Burnett for making this cafe a lil haven, truly a gem in the neighborhood!

This place has obviously changed since the last reviewer was here. 

I had a pleasant and incredibly easy experience. Usually anytime you need to do 'something' to your car, it's never ideal. They were honest and upfront about everything (noting my air filter 'didn't need to be changed just yet - you can get more life out of it'). 

Although it was just an oil and filter change, the staff were incredibly nice and we're willing to answer any questions. To be honest the couple questions I asked I already knew the answers to, I just wanted to see what they would actually say. And sure enough, they were bang-on. 

These guys do oil changes right!

Wow, is all I can say and not in a good way. We have just had our Christmas get together at the sawmill Sherwood park, and I thought it was one of the worse meals I've had in a long time. 
Back 10 to 15 years ago I loved going to the sawmill, now I only occasionally get to go. I probably won't bother again as the food and service was awful. 
Admittedly we had 50 odd people there from our company, but the lack of service and also inexperience in servers has played a big part in my dissatisfaction in the place. They knew how many were coming but couldn't staff it appropriately.
Next comes the food, because it's a larger group we had a menu with just a few choices on it, that's fair. The Caesar salad was drenched in sauce and had a funny soapy taste to it. I couldn't pinpoint from what!
Next the main dish, I had ordered the prime rib, it came with a large Yorkshire pudding and I chose the garlic whipped mash with a side of gravy. The prime rib wasn't too bad, a little fatty than I would have liked. The yorkie tasted of oil. Being English I know my yorkies, this didn't pass the test. The gravy was lumpy and just plain dreadful. Then came the mash, I'm sure they used packet mash because it didn't taste fresh at all.
Dessert we had no choice. It was some kind of brownie in a toffee sauce with pecans. This wasn't much better but I'm sad to say was the better part of the meal. 
Really, what has happened to our restaurants here in Alberta, the mediocre establishments are now just plain crap. And you have to spent $150 to get yourself a decent meal otherwise it's just not worth it! Have we a lack of chefs in the area?

Basic food.nothing that good.Very Dissappointing.
Went for our anniversary dinner.The restaurant looks like its run by east indians same seasonings on everything.I would not come back

The service department here at Park Mazda is always fantastic. They keep you informed of the progress, as your waiting. Free coffee, newspapers and magazines. Could use a TV and free WiFi, but that's splitting hairs. The service is usually quick, and almost always within the estimated time frame they quote you at the start. Courtesy shuttle is available if you don't want to wait. Never had to use it, but I believe they have courtesy loaners as well. If you drive a Mazda, I recommend coming here for your service appointments.

Update: free WiFi available

Went in for lunch on a Sunday afternoon. Was greeted and seated promptly, took our drink order and didn't return for 15 mins. We both had a pizza as we were told they were good, and $12 on Sunday and Monday. Pizza was OK, and service was slow.

Amazing service! Very friendly waitress. Super kind and super sweet! The whole staff is very welcoming! My friend and I wanted to try sashimi for the first time so we came here. Although we did figure out that raw fish is just not our thing, the cook and the waitress made us feel very welcomed and gave us amazing service. My friend and I were very pleased! It felt like we were guests at someone's house. Thanks to the whole staff! Especially the waitress and the cook! :)
Went there for lunch today with both kids and my wife. Great food fast service friendly staff.

My first time in Sherwood Park in over a year, and I only had a half hour to get an impression of the city before a meeting. So naturally, I went for a burger and a cupcake.

It's a little shop, nothing remarkable, but the ladies are so sweet and friendly here. Some great flavours - so many that I almost picked up a 4 pack for myself, but I resisted. Eventually I settled on the pink lemonade cupcake, which was an excellent choice, if I do say so myself.

Next time you're in the park, Hey Cupcake! is definitely worth a visit for a sweet treat.
I like everything about Cafe Haven except their prices. If they could take a dollar or two off most items I'd be there every single day.

I bought a brand new Mazda in 2013 and had dealt with all of the Mazda dealerships in the Edmonton area to some extent during the purchase process. While they didn't manage to earn the sale, for service I will not bring my car to any other Mazda dealership but Park Mazda.  The guys at the counter have great senses of humour while at the same time being very professional.  They are knowledgeable and thorough, always taking the time to explain the work that's being done to my car and doing their best to make the experience as pleasant as possible. I have been bringing my car here for 2.5 years for service and have had a good experience each time.  No matter where you decide to buy your Mazda, I recommend you bring it to Park Mazda for service!

This little gem is one of the best sushi places that I have visited in the Edmonton/ Sherwood Park area. The service is friendly and efficient, we were seated instantly. There were quite a few tables available when we arrived, but by the time we had placed out order the restaurant was almost completely full. The staff are full of smiles and kept our dishes coming in constantly. The serving sizes are ample and well priced and the the flavours  are amazing! If you like sushi, you want to eat here! If you live in Edmonton, it is worth the drive.
Fantastic little coffee house in Sherwood Park.  Great coffee and a funky space.  I was very impressed with everything from the sandwich to the latte and it's my new spot close to home!

It pains me to do a negative review on such a nice restaurant. I know that seems like a contradiction but it is how I feel.

I agree with Amanda F. - it is classy but not overly trendy - a nice comfortable place to come for dinner for all ages. BUT I have not had much luck lately with their service.

I went with a group of women to eat dinner there. Luckily, we were all chatting and passing the time so the delay between when we arrived and when the server took our orders wasn't very noticeable - except to me because I was drinking the wine they served on an empty stomach!

We all ordered our meals on a separate bill. We ordered two bottles of wine. At no time did the waitress ask who the bottles should be billed to. I was one of the lucky ones she chose. Too awkward to pipe up after the meal and say "ummm, anyone want to chip in on a bottle of wine?" so I let it go.

The waitress seemed a bit out of it when we were ordering but we managed to get through that process ok. Whenever we asked questions though, we were met with a confused look. Like when we asked for a wine recommendation. Or if there was butter available for our corn on the cob.

After we all ate, the waitress came up to our table and said:

"Is anyone EXCEPT the one who had the steak special interested in dessert?"

It took us a while to figure out what she meant was that the steak special came with dessert. ONce we figured that out, two out of the eight of us decided to have a dessert. This seemed to confuse her further - she wanted to know if we realized it was not free with our meal, it was only free with the steak special.

Yes, we know that, we are ok with it. 

She brought out one extra dessert and proceeded to pass around coffee. I wondered if she had messed up so when she gave me my coffee I said "this will be good with my dessert".

She looked at me rather confused again and said "it doesn't come free with your meal you know, only the steak special". I'm not sure why, with a table full of women ordering steak, lamb and multiple bottles of wine that she was thinking we were going to quibble over the cost of a dessert.

I said I know, and I am fine with that. So I finally got my dessert.

All in all, it was an odd experience that left us all a bit bemused.
Gross. If you want good sushi in the park go to Sumo Sumo, you won't be disappointed!

Took a short road trip to Sherwood Park yesterday and went to Ricky's for lunch. This Ricky's was pretty much like all the others I have visited. Our waitress was nice, but vanished partway through our meal and we were helped out by others. At one point I signalled to our original waitress who saw me - and ignored me. My order was also royally screwed up, but that would have been the fault of the kitchen - the problems were fixed, but I was not impressed and may have been a reason for being ignored by the waitress. The food was as good as it always is at Ricky's - good, but not great. I would possibly come here again if I was in the area and wanted breakfast food, but this was not a very positive experience.

If you've seen one Party City, you've pretty much seen them all!  This one seems to be a little more cramped than the one I'm used to in South Common, but it is very well stocked and seems to carry all the same items as the other locations.

I really love Party City - I would shop here a LOT more if the prices weren't so high.  But they carry almost everything you can think of.  And they have a great supply of costumes even when it's not near Halloween - which is hard to find sometimes!

Along with costumes, they also have a great variety of themed dinnerware, serving bowls, Party Favours... oh!  And more balloons than you could ever need, along with Helium.  I've never seen so many different balloons... and they come up with some pretty great arrangements for them.

The thing that I purchase at Party City more than anything else - are little plastic Dixie cups with lids.  I make Jell-O shots for almost every party I go to, and so I usually stop by once every 2 - 3 months for these gems.  They're perfect for what I need them for.

We were looking for a good Chinese restaurant to order from. I looked on yelp and saw some good reviews so decided to try Good Buddy. I was not disappointed. The food arrived hot and tasty. I have an allergy to onions and so many times when I tell the hostess not to put onions in the dishes or sauces they think chives are OK.  It was so nice to finally have a restaurant that got it right the first time. We will definitely order from them again. The prices were reasonable for what we ordered. Thanks to everyone who recommended this restaurant.
Absolutely my favorite place to eat. Always consistent and fabulous.

The location was hard to find; the food was ok (but expensive for what you got) and the servive was HORRID.  Our waitress' name was Trina.  She did NOT introduce herself as such so I'm not sure how we were supposed to know that.  We were a table of 13 for a birthday and spent close to $1000 when done.  One guest polietly said to her "Excuse me miss" so he could get another drink and she said very rudely to him "For future drink orders, my name is Trina!".  I could see if he was rude to her to get her attention but he wasn't.  Another guest wanted a glass of ice and a pop - but because the birthday boy received a sealed bottle of whiskey, brought in as a present for him, she refused to bring the guest a glass of ice,, or water, or pop.  

The also automatically add on a 17% charge.  VERY innappropriate considering tipping is considered an OPTION.  Good service or not, I am not obligated to tip you a red cent!  

ALso when booking the reservations, the man who answered the phone was rude.  He made it sound like were were inconviencing him because we needed to reserve and weren't sure if we had 13 coming or 11.  

And last - we wanted to bring in our own cake for the birthday guest and were told there was a charge of $2 per person reserved, as a plating fee.  So it would have cost  us $26 to bring our own cake - - plus we would have had to buy the cake.  We did not bring it but the birthday boy did get a free piece of cake after having to ask.  He was just joking with her and she said "you get a free dessert, what do you want?".  Instead of offering him something and saying it nicely.  RUDE RUDE!  I've read lots of bad reviews on the service at this restaurant.  Time to believe it.  Because its true!

Worst dim sum around.  Dont waste your time or money. 

Waitress was really snotty when I returned my fatty spareribs and bean curd that was mushy. 

Any report of good service is beyond me.

Very cute place! Have had great service most of the time, some times when it is very busy the girls get a little flustered and short with you! 

Food is amazing and as far as I know all made in house! Have not had a bad meal ever! I am not a coffee drinker but have tried some of their specialty teas and have to say their Earl Grey Tea Latte is as beautiful as it is fantastic!!

Only two down falls to this place are the sucky hours it is open and the poor amount of parking! I can name 100 times off hand I have had to just drive by due to it being closed or no parking. 

Definitely give this little JEM a try!!!

Tonight's experience was pretty flawless. Table right away.  Courteous, knowledgeable and prompt service. Food arrived with perfect timing,  fresh and hot.  We left with full and satisfied stomachs. It's a great atmosphere to visit with friends or enjoy a meal with family.

I am never setting foot in that place again. They were extremely rude to me.

I pointed out that they had a stand filled with a local propaganda photocopied paper that is filled with lies and insults. They did not care. They said they never read it so it does not bother them. I asked if they had a paper filled with racism, would they display it. They said they did not care since they do not read it!!

Honestly, a local restaurant that does not care about displaying someone's personal vendetta & who prints lies about its residents in their establishment, and who then speaks down to a customer who brings it up to their attention, does not deserve my patronage.

I believe this reflects on management and staff. This is not about freedom of speech, it is about lies. People have a right to their opinions but not when they print them as fact with the intent of harming people's reputation. A restaurant that could not care less, is harmful to the community it is in.

Moist cake and rich, creamy frosting. They also have really fun types of cupcakes, as well as cookies & chocolate covered strawberries when I was there. The staff could be friendlier, but the cupcakes are really good.

One bad experience can really put a bad taste in your mouth. 
I have been to Roxx 3 times, 1 pedi and 2 shellac mani's. My pedicure was great which made me think to go back for a Shellac Mani. It was a good manicure and I was impressed until she was done the mani and started to exfoliate my hands and arms. 
It was painful! Putting on the exfoliation didn't hurt it was the technique used to take it off..which is normally a warm wet towel but at Roxx they take a dry towel and flick off the beads ....which then land everywhere...it was very odd and hurt, my skin was so red after I left!
My second mani at Roxx I had asked for an express mani as to avoid the exfoliating, and really the girl did do a great job with the nails.
However my second mani wasn't so great, I thought the nails looked good but realized when I got home and really looked at them it was not worth the money.
I had a nail that was a bit broken and the girl said she could glue it and put shellac over it and it would be fine. But when I got home I notice the shellac didn't adhere to the glue so there was a bubble and the a few hours later a crack where my nail was broken. Then I seen another bubble on my middle finger and chips on the tip of my thumb nail already. 
During the filing she also filed my skin a few times to the point of me saying ouch and there being blood and now I have a scab on my cuticle area. 

I think to sum this up...it's hit or miss when it comes to staff at Roxx.(nail techs anyway).

I can't give a review on the salon itself but I sure can on the customer service on the phone.  I was referred by a friend who has been going to this salon for a while. She told me to check out choose so I gave the salon a call at 10 am on September 17  whereupon I was told chloe was in later that day. The day passed and I never heard from her so I called back today September 18 and mentioned to the receptionist I hadn't heard anything and she was very unfriendly on the phone saying she was booked solid the previous day and made it seem I was inconveniencing her on the phone and said she would chloe to get back to me which she did about 20 minutes later. She wasn't apologetic about not calling and I was interested in the salon as I heard the prices were reasonable but she was wanting to charge $30 more then I thought..no thanks I'll stay where I am.
These girls really need an attitude check.

The food was definitely 4.5 stars.  Overall service sits at about 3.5 stars.

So why only 3?  Blue Rare Steak & Bar advertised on facebook that both their Sherwood Park and St. Albert locations had an amazing deal during the months of July and August.  A 3 course steak dinner, including a salad, 9 oz top sirloin, and a dessert for $25.95.  Based on the reputation, I knew it would be a quality meal, despite the low price tag.  But trying to get what was advertised, turned out to be a little tricky.

We arrived between 6:30 & 7 on a Friday evening.  I was surprised to see only a few other tables full at that time.  The hostess seated us and I asked her if the 3 course deal was still running.  She paused for a minute and then said "Oh yah!  I think so".

When our server came by, I asked him to explain the deal, as there were no signs or menu inserts for it (if it hadn't been advertised on facebook, I never would have known about it).  He explained that it was a 9 oz top sirloin and a dessert.  I asked - "no salad?".  He said, no.

So, I figured I must have read the ad incorrectly.  We ordered an appetizer instead to go along with our steak.

No, I take a break from talking about the deal, to tell you how amazing the food was.  Our steaks were cooked perfectly.  Absolutely beautiful.  I had the roasted baby potatoes, and my mother chose the potato pie (think: scalloped potatoes).  The baby potatoes were definitely the better choice.  As long as you like sage (or rosemary - sometimes I have trouble distinguishing between the two flavours, but I'm pretty sure this was sage).  We do not have a single complaint about the flavour or quality of the food, including the dessert (you have a choice of an espresso pie or a brownie.  We both went for the pie and were not disappointed).

While we were enjoying our entrees, I grabbed my phone to check the ad again.  It was kind of bugging me because I was sure I read it correctly the first time.  Sure enough, not only did it state the salad was included, but it even included a picture of it.  So, I showed the post to the server the next time he came around.  At this point, we were stuffed and couldn't imagine eating a salad, but had he offered, we would have taken them to go to enjoy later in the evening.  He had admitted earlier in the evening that he was fairly new, so I thought maybe he just didn't know about it (although he was new, he was very attentive and friendly, the only thing lacking was menu knowledge).  His response was "that's weird - somebody asked about the salad before, and I was told it wasn't included.  I'll definitely look into it".  

If he did in fact look into it, we never got to hear the outcome.  He brought us our check, took our payment, and never brought it up again.

I posed the question on the facebook post the next day - to clarify what was actually included.  The manager of the Sherwood Park location reached out to me personally to apologize and get more information so he could get the server the appropriate training.

Which is great... but it still doesn't get me a salad... or make up for the fact that we paid an extra $9.00 for an appetizer.

I'll be back... the food was incredible.  But, this experience did leave me scratching my head a little!


Side note.... I know August is almost over, but I should mention that they are CLOSED for lunch for all of August.

I hadn't been in a specialty cupcake shop in years and happened to be in Sherwood Park when the craving hit so I decided to check this place out. It's a tiny shop but they have many different flavors to choose from and also happened to be carrying holiday themed cake pops when I stopped in.

They have a couple tables for sitting at which is nice if you want to pop in with friends. The staff also seemed really nice. This place really gives the vibe of a friendly mom and pop bakery versus a fancy specialty store like some of the ones in Edmonton. That is a huge plus in my books.

I went with the salted caramel and I honestly think it was one of the best cupcakes I have ever had. I agree with Linda J. about the cakes being a little denser here than other places. They make up for it though with a nice flavor and they also don't pile it high with a mountain of cream cheese icing here like other places do which I find takes away from the flavor of the cake.

All in all a great visit and I can't wait to stop in again!

Well here is an update.....Any problems that I had was looked at and fixed no questions asked. The service manager was/is more than helpful. He personally called me and asked how things were with my car. I've booked my car in for an oil change. I'm fully confident that this will be a smooth and painless service.

Cafe Haven is another one of those cafes in Edmonton that believes in local sourced ingredients.  Although strangely located in a strip mall *and in Sherwood park, for those who don't have cars*, the menu they serve up is very inviting and tasty.  The ambience is sort-of library-ish/reading roomish.  It's really a random collection of furniture.  Not expensive or jazzy looking.  Just some combination that fits well.  But, having said that, it feels very comfortable in there.  Almost like visiting your aunt's place on the weekend.

The coffee is one of the big reasons they stand out.  They use Transcend coffee beans and serve masterful cups of espresso based drinks.  For the true coffee connoisseur, they also serve a french press coffee which is delightfully served with a timer by its side.  When the timer beeps, you've got to slowly push the plunger down, thereby extracting the holy nectar of coffee.

Their brunch menu (till 2 p.m. on weekends) changes every week and their weekly menus also change regularly thus giving the true feeling of locally sourced food.  I like this aspect of the café a lot because you never know what the menu is going to be.  Sure, at times it feels good to go to a familiar place where you know exactly what your favorite item on the menu is.  But once in a while, a place like Cafe Haven just feels great!

They have live shows on Thursday evenings (which I haven't been for, but have heard good things of).  Must try this local, little joint in Sherwood park.  Perfect stopover for those eastbound or simply going to the Elk park.

This place has definitly made huge improvements in the past couple of years!  By that I mean, the quality of the food service...everything we've ordered in recent months has been superb compared to early days! Delicious food! Already wanting a clubhouse!

I don't know what is going on at this location. Since they have opened as a sawmill, I have never had a decent experience there. Yesterday  (it being my birthday) my wife and I visited there. We were absolutely shocked by what was going on. The kitchen was under tents and tarps on the patio  (yes, you read that right).
Speaking as a certified Chef, I was stunned by what they were doing. It was irresponsible and reprehensible. 
Now you would think that if they were doing that, you would probably get some kind of deal. 
Nope. Not a penny. $20 for a crappy-ass 6 oz steak sandwich cooked on a basic backyard bbq. 
But that doesn't include the "floor show". The GM apparently seems to like to think that he is some kind of Al Pacino, somewhere between Scarface and what I would call the "embarrassing stage of old age".
There was one waitress who was dressed like she was in the territory of an aging Philipeno stripper who should have stopped 25 years ago. I really didn't need to see that much of her belly or her breasts. And I am definitely no prude.
Basically, I'm amazed that The Sawmill wants anything to do with these franchise yah-bo's. These schmucks couldn't find their asses with both hands and a map.

Returned to the spot where I purchased my 2007 Mazda 6 for a regular oil change. 

Friendly service staff and I was out the door in under 45 minutes. 
In my Mazda experience, I have found Park Mazda far better than Weber Mazda. More experienced and educated staff.

My wife, my parents and I traveled from Edmonton to Sherwood Park to eat a gluten-free meal of Chinese food. The restaurant is located off the main strip through town but is fairly easy to find. The decor was plain - tables and chairs in a fluorescent-lit room - a few pictures on the walls. The restaurant itself was clean but the washrooms leave a bit to be desired.

As near as I could tell, only the two owners worked there. Hubby cooked and his wife served. Service was great.

My wife ordered a beef pho, the rest of us ordered off the Chinese part of the menu. We had salad rolls, satay beef on rice noodles, pan fry shrimp, scallops in a black bean sauce and pan fried chicken with cashews.

The salad rolls were slightly unusual, they were about 3/4 the size of other salad rolls that I have had and they were served with fish sauce, not peanut sauce. The order comes with 6 rolls though so, despite the smaller size, there is plenty on the plate. My wife's pho was fine. It came with all the expected ingredients (although my wife expected vegetables and there were none other than bean sprouts). With one exception, the food was very well cooked. The vegetables were crisp, the chicken and shrimp were cooked perfectly - neither overdone nor underdone. I was particularly impressed with the onions, they still had a pungency to them. I suspect all the vegetables are cooked fresh with each order. You should not expect much from their sauces, the Cuisine's strength is in the basic ingredients that make up each dish. For instance, the black been sauce was more of hint than a sauce. The only flaw were the rice noodles that came with the satay beef. They were soggy and greasy, I didn't find them appetizing at all. At the end of the meal they were the only thing left over.

We had a $20 bottle of Kloster Liebfrauenberg with our meal. It was a good wine but only 10% alcohol. Probably why it was cheap.

If you are a celiac the great thing about this restaurant is that it has a gluten-free menu. It is numbered just like the menu for the non-celiacs but it does not contain any items that have gluten. Most of the dishes turned out to be gluten-free so there is a wide selection to choose from.

Saigon Cuisine is a wonderful family restaurant that does not aspire to be something it is not. And it's very celiac friendly.

This little cupcake shop is tucked away in a strip mall on Baseline Road in Sherwood Park. It has come a long way since changing owners a few years ago. I didn't like them when they first opened but ever since Dan bought the place, I've become a regular.

The staff is friendly and helpful. The owners are great community supporters and always ready to donate for a good cause.

The cupcakes? They range from not bad to excellent. It depends on your taste. 

The icing (I've tried almost all flavours) is very, very good. Not a fatty lard tasting one. I often will lick the icing off the cupcake just like an ice cream cone, that's how good it is! That's also a good proof that the cupcake part is good too since I end up eating it sans icing. :)

Some cupcakes taste like muffins (carrot cake) but I think it's because of the flavour.

The Red Velvet is quite good here.

My all-time favourite is the rare and elusive Chocolate Bacon Mini Cupcake! You have to keep an eye on their social media accounts to find out when they make some and then hurry over to get them before they sell out.

They vary flavours weekly. 

I highly recommend the mini cupcake variety pack. I often pick one up when decision making is too difficult. You can then eat several and it equals just one large cupcake (it's my story and I'm sticking to eat).

If you like cupcakes, Hey Cupcake will definitely have one you will like.

Great service and food!!! One top place in Sherwood park to try Asian food!!!

We love it :)

I used to work at a coffee shop here, many moons ago before it was Cafe Haven. I hadn't been back in several years as I don't live in Sherwood Park anymore but was in the area and curious enough to stop by. It's a very nice, cozy set up, fun decor with lots of art and vintage looking furniture. I only had a coffee which was pretty decent. The service was really fast and very friendly. The server even said good bye as I was leaving which was rather nice.  I'm not sure that I will make a special trip to come all the way back, but if I happen to be in the neighbourhood again, I will stop in again.

Im not a Japanese food lover but me and my partner started to try something new,. Eveything is good except for service, they need maybe one more server for a busy dinner and food was late a little bit.

Was just OK for me.  This is a trendy coffee shop.  Has a nice country ambience.  My eggs Benedict was just OK.  The ham was too salty.  The potatoes had a strong taste with some kind of spice or salt.  They have a patio and free parking.

Cafe Haven is hands down my favourite cafe in Sherwood park. It's cozy and intimate with friendly service, delicious food both meals and snacks and phenomenal coffee and lattes (both cold and hot). Great place all around!

Awesome is all I can say. First the service was good. The prices are average but the food is amazing! We had Calamari to start. It was bland but it was good. The drinks Ceasers were perfect! But the real kicker was the fish tacos! Maybe best I had, if not top 2 for sure!!! The burger was amazing too. Like this is a place to try fo sho! I will be back just wish we had one closer!

WORST DEALERSHIP EXPERIENCE EVER!

My experience at the dealership...to say it was a huge waste of my time is an understatement. It was unprofessional and honestly, it was disrespectful. My test drive consisted of 20 minutes at a gas station with someone who knew absolutely nothing about the vehicle in question (by her own admission). It was her first time in the vehicle, there was no gas in the vehicle when it came time to go on the test drive (which we set up days earlier), she called me by the wrong name while we were driving the vehicle, she didn't review any of previous emails because she asked me all the same questions we had previously discussed and that just shows lack of interest and preparation. She had to ask my boyfriend to get out and check the tires because she didn't know anything about the air levels and it took 10 minutes for her to try to open the gas hatch - again, my boyfriend was the one who eventually had to show her how to do it. She spent almost another 10 minutes trying to figure out the gas pump and by that time, I had made up my mind that I was done. The worst part is that I loved the vehicle and was very excited about it when I arrived at the dealership. But that was short lived because I was extremely disappointed in the quality of people representing Sherwood Honda and I can honestly say I will never go back, nor will I ever recommend it to anyone I know.
 
It blows my mind that someone who's business is selling cars, knows absolutely nothing about them.

To top that off, a Sherwood Customer Service Representative, had been emailing me about my initial inquiry and following up with me to see how things went. As soon as I mentioned that I'd had a terrible experience and asked her where I could make a formal complaint, the emails stopped and I haven't heard from her since.

The only saving grace here is that the Pre-Owned Sales Manager did get in touch with me after seeing one of my emails and seemed genuinely concerned about my horrible experience at the dealership.

Super unique place, I love the small cafe vibes that is has. The building used to be a bank, and they have kept the vault that was inside and converted it into a sitting area, which I find to be very original and gives the place lots of character. The patio is super cute and always clean. The staff are always friendly and helpful, and the food is fantastic. Little bit pricey, but as it is a cafe, this is to be expected. I have never had a bad experience with the food or beverages at this place, I would definitely recommend checking it out for yourself!
It is definitely the best restaurant in Sherwood Park.  I have never had a bad meal at Ric's.  It's great for a special occasion or even to stop by a drink and an appetizer on a Wednesday night.

Cafe Haven is really impressive. Most cafe's are just coffee and lack quality in every aspect but Cafe Haven does not let you down.

In addition to their great coffee, they have a good menu that offers sandwiches, salads and dessert. Some of the items don't even look like cafe food, they come across as restaurant caliber. 

It's a good meeting spot for friends and a good place to grab lunch. If you don't feel like coffee it's okay because they have beer as well.

I went here for a good friends birthday on a Wednesday night and besides a few other people in the bar this place was empty. It was funny to because we were recommended to make reservations. 

This place is a complete joke. The service was terrible, and I don't understand how since we were the only table the waitress was helping. The food was overpriced and under portioned and lacked any sort of taste or texture. I got the New York Strip I believe and ordered a side of crab legs because I love crab legs! I ordered my steak medium rare but even for me it was still to bloody and raw and that says a lot, my crab legs were disgusting! They were the pre-portioned frozen kind and when I bit into one it was still partially frozen, stringy, and just yuck. I got the waitress to take them back and for 5 tiny pieces of crab it was an extra $30 that got taken off my bill when I sent them back...Wow.

The only good thing about my meal was the mashed potatoes and that is because they are the same delicious garlic mashed potatoes that every other restaurant in the city serves and they come pre-packaged and frozen but are still really good.

I noticed other reviews mentioned how dark it was inside and I agree, but when they said it was "nice" I thought it made the place look dingy, but I guess that is OK when your trying to cover up all the stains on the seats...

I am glad other people had a better experience at this restaurant than I did, But that's OK because I will never go back. Why? When I can buy a steak 5 times bigger and 3 times as cheap and even more delicious than the tiny morsel of steak they gave.

Very dirty Restuarant I have ever been in the floors had a trail of pop or something from the Pop machine to the door to get into the back staff / work area! Food was cold one McDonald's I would not recommend the fellow who took our order got it wrong because he was speaking his language to another Indian person instead of taking care of customers. Tables were dirty and they should be using the recommended cleaner which is pink and recommended by McDonald's and not windex! Washrooms not clean and smelled horrible . And am offended that the manager and another fellow wearing a turban dressed in jeans thought it was alright to talk while taking my order? # 1 I am Canadian and speak another language as well but while I am working I speak our English language not this Punjabi crap ! That should be saved for after work or at home not in a work place while taking my order that was very rude to do. Shame on you McDonald's  allowing that rude behaviour

The problem with Roxx Salon is the prices, not because they're ludicrous, but because they often don't live up to the name. While I do enjoy their salon, their stylists are incredibly talented and have given me some of the best experiences, I've had some very bad experiences in the past, echoing past reviews of the front end staff and their failings, a few months ago I had an appointment during the poorer Alberta conditions; roads were covered in snow, barely able to get to Sherwood Park, typical Alberta weather. So of course, we call on our way over, trying to make sure we can indeed make out appointment.

We're told, no problem.

We get there, sign in, are told to sit down, given water. About ten minutes later, we're told our stylist can no longer do one of our appointments, because of time restraints, would we like to rebook? 

We were maybe ten minutes late.

I think not. 

So, unfortunately, while one wouldn't be disappointed by stylists, for the prices you will pay you expect some accommodation, which you will not receive from their staff. Disappointing for their price tag, I think.

Good , but not fantastic. My service provider (rochelle) was really great, got a pedicure and quite enjoyed it. The massage chairs are nice and the jet tub is a bonus. However the atmosphere and professionalism of the staff is lacking, the receptionist was very off putting and borderline rude. The waiting room was messy and we were not offered any drinks, or told that our providers were running behind (10-15 mins).  Good pedicure but lack luster front end service.

Great place to entertain clients...or...just go for a quiet 'n relaxing evening! Whether you're enjoying a glass of wine in the lounge or a delicious dinner in the dining room, it's a good choice for a mid-week outing!

We wanted to order sushi but were getting bored with our normal sushi place, so we called up Yoshi.

Super fast and friendly service on the phone, it took less than 15 min from order and pick up till we were eating delish sushi!

The sashimi was fresh and large pieces, and the rolls we ordered were delicious.  When I went to pick up our order there was only one table eating, so it's a prettty quiet little place.  They had a private room too which I assume you could reserve.

We will definitely be ordering from them again!

I hadn't heard of this restaurant before, but ended up here with a group of people for a get together.  We ordered off the regular menu, rather than the dim sum menu, and the food was awesome.  Spring rolls (my fave) were great and the lemon chicken - mmm mmm.  The whole meal was really good.  The service was quick and super friendly and the prices were great.  Trying the Dim Sum next time !

Great service as the staff are friendly and will go out of their way to satisfy the customer. I enjoy coming here for my favourite cup of coffee while I catch up with friends. The snacks are always fresh and in stock. I recommend that you try the flat white. It's a like a latte only much creamy. It costs a little more then the other drinks but I think it's worth it. 
The only downside to this location is that they don't have a drive through. However they are in a convenient location right on baseline Rd. I have not tried the patio but then again I haven't been in sherwood park that long. Maybe when the weather warms up :-)
Waiter was very attentive, didn't have to wait to be seated. Food came out promptly, very hot and very good. I have been here before enjoy their Dim Sum haven't tried their Chinese food

Their skill and experience shows in their work. I brought in flare jeans to be hemmed, capris with a broken zipper and a leather brief case bag with a broken zipper. They replaced both zippers seamlessly with replacements matching the old zippers and the hem on the jeans is perfect. They even finished the job a week early!

The prime rib that I tried was good.  The mechanically peeled/processed carrot that appeared along with it wasn't.  Service was solicitous, if a bit too informal at times for a restaurant in this price bracket.  All in all, what Blue Rare offers is alright, but I don't think that I'll be making a return trip anytime soon.
Clean, friendly. Food was very good. Only problem is everything is over priced. Prime rib is worth it any weekend though.

Untrustworthy. Very shady business. Would never buy or recommend to anyone. It is run poorly and the staff is not well trained. Management seems inexperienced as well. There is different mazda dealerships in the city that seem to have it a bit more together. They also offer incentives for good yelp reviews so buyer beware.
Wow the staff tonight were pretty grumpy. Not a smile, not a thank you. NOTHING. YIKES.

If i could give a review with more than 5 stars, I totally would.  These guys ROCK.

My check engine light appeared on my vehicle today and a slightly strange sound, and before taking it into a repair shop I figured I'd go get a quick once-over inspection and oil change while I wait as opposed to dropping it off at a mechanic and not having a car for a couple days.

I drove in immediately, got a synthetic change, transfer case fluid change, and included with that they checked a ton of fluids, mechanical stuff etc.  During that they found the culprit - a tension wheel in the fan belt assembly was essentially ready to fall off completely as it was so incredibly damaged.  Although the vehicle was running perfectly smooth other than a little sound, it had to be fixed immediately or I would have been stranded somewhere and likely facing a big repair.

I ran over to a parts distributor (literally - they were across the parking lot), I picked up the $30 part and these guys installed it for me on the spot, and I notice now on the bill they did not charge me for that service at all. 

On top of that, they gave me a $20 discount on the whole bill.  They're super friendly, definitely willing to go above and beyond for a customer (a first time one at that) and they know what they're doing.  What I also liked was when they found the problem, they showed it to me, showed me how to remove the bad part, and I watched as they put the brand new one in etc.  I learned something there today too.

6 stars.  I'll never get routine maintenance done anywhere else again.  Customer for life.

Stopped in for a little treat while driving around the Park. I asked the person working about the cupcakes and let her know that I didn't like things that are really sweet. It was a toss up between the Coo Coo for Cocoa and the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chip - she said the latter would be the less sweet of the two. The cake was moist, but overall it was quite heavy and the frosting was a little sweeter than most buttercreams I've had from cupcake shops. Next time, I think I will stick with chocolate!

I got Hey Cupcake to make some "Ugly Christmas Sweater cookies" for a party we were having. I was really nervous about how they would turn out, but when I got to the store to pick them up I was so ecstatic about how amazing they turned out!! The ladies there did SUCH a wonderful job!!! I also decided to try one of their "Holiday Spice" cupcakes, and it was delicious. The cake was very moist and the icing wasn't too sweet. I will definitely be returning and recommending them in the future.

It's very unfortunate that my second review is quite different then my first review. 

After I had a good experience with them I decided to go back to get a lash lift/lash perm and to use their apprentice tech to try out the services at a lower price. Unfortunately though I never got that far. I initially tried to book back in July/August but the availability was very limited (I was looking for evenings or weekends due to work schedule). I managed to make an appointment only to have it cancelled the day after I made it due to scheduling error. The receptionist then said she would call me back with an available time which never happened. I never ended up getting that phone call so I went somewhere else. 

I decided to give them another try and called them last week for the same appointment. The exact issue happened again....they couldn't find an available spot and said they would call me back. 5 days go by and no phone call but this time I decide to call them to follow up. The receptionist then begins to tell me that the staff that observes the apprentice has gone on maternity leave and can't get ahold of her to book the appointment. So after some back and forth finally I asked "does that mean that your no longer offering there services?" to which she says "yeah I guess." It was a struggle for me to get a straight answer from her. 

If they can't offer services they should inform the customer or at least not promise to call them and not follow through with it. 

The services they offer were good when I went but unfortunately I can't say the same thing for their customer services related to booking or follow through.

This place is like...my other office!  It's a great place to do some quiet reading.  A great place to bring a client.  An excellent place to enjoy some evening entertainment or a good old story slam.  And the coffee...well...it's hard to beat!  The staff are friendly and creative!  I absolutely love dropping in!!!

Sherwood Park's BEST cafe! A must drive out to from Edmonton. New owners who are very friendly and go around giving you samples.They also own the Mill Creek Cafe. You can still get the best cupcakes around. Try the Red Velvet. Mmm

My complaint with this Ricky's isn't with the food or the service.  Both were great and plentiful.
My friend is vegan and there was really nothing on the menu for her.  She ordered a salad that had chicken on it and asked them to hold the chicken -- they did.  However, when the bill came it did not have a reduction for no chicken even though most places do that.  I had nachos and guacamole, which is a $2.00 add.  This morning I got thinking about my bill and look at it a little more closely -- I was charged $3.99 for the guac.  This means that everyone pays double for it because it is programmed into the computer that way.  NOT one tiny bit impressed!
Had a groupon, when for lunch with the girls.  Food was fast and fresh, very friendly service. Great takeout option for dinners during the week

Such a shame that this great place with such potential is so badly managed. I have tried numerous times to give this place a chance but almost every time am disappointed. Althought the servers seem to be trying there is definitely something missing from a customer service, management perspective. Did not accomodate on several levels and occassions. Also wine choice is sadly lacking. Too bad.

It's no secret that I'm a huge fan of Costco!  I do wish that Costco had the extensive wine selection in Canada that they do in the states but I am oh so happy that we now have Costco liquor stores in Canada!

Sherwood Park was our first location to get a liquor store in the greater Edmonton area but now we also have them in St. Albert and Edmonton.

The selection isn't huge but it is varied from $8 bottles of wine up to a couple hundred dollars.  I love giving the GIANT and I mean giant bottles of Kirkland Signature alcohol as Christmas presents - who doesn't want a gallon of spiced rum or vodka?  I know, I sure do and this present won't go to waste!

They carry a great seasonal selection and don't miss out on the ever popular Christmas import beer advent calendar for that beer drinker in your life!

I'll be seeing you soon...

P.S.  You don't need a Costco membership to shop here.

If you are in the market for a car dealership that has great prices and friendly people, Sherwood Honda is definitely where you should go. As far as selection goes, they have a HUGE lot with tons of cars and SO many different options. The dealership itself looks brand new and is really one of the nicest I have ever seen. As for the people, I have never been greeted by a more friendly or helpful salesman. I had the best time shopping around, and felt as though I could really trust that he was being extremely genuine and trying to help me get the best price I could possibly get. In addition, he kept me smiling the entire way through the sales process, which is always a plus! Haven't been back for service yet, but I have heard great things about their service department as well. Really can't beat this place!

The best place for a decent steak in the Park-  sleek decor and casual style- healthy (as in moderate) portion sizes, and not a lot of gorpy sauces, nice presentation and good selection of wines as well. This is where we go for good eats. The service is up a notch here as well. Enjoy!

I took a car in for inspection and I was very impressed with how friendly the staff (Bonnie) was.  After they inspected it, they took the time to show me what was mechanically required (I asked what a hub was, and Bonnie ran to the back to grab the part to show me!) and they also pointed out flaws on the body.  If you want good and friendly service, they won't disappoint :)
I like this location. So nice and clean and staff members are very pleasant!Not usually busy inside or drive thru which is nice when you're in a hurry!
Such a beautiful interior! Perfect for a spa day or just a little "spoil me" time! The staff is fab! They have childcare too! This is a HUGE bonus.

Mmmmmm.... I love this place, and I love that they make their own vanilla for the lattes, which my fave drink here!  I have yet to try the food but from what I've heard it is delish!  My only wish is that Cafe Haven wasn't all the way in Sherwood Park as I definitely do not make it out very often to enjoy this sweet cafe spot!

The stylist that I have been seeing for the last 6 years or so moved to this salon about a year ago now.  I love my stylist, Kathleen, which is why I am willing to follow her to Roxx.  

The salon is impressive and very modern looking.  

I was really disappointed that they don't offer the hot towel after conditioning like my old salon did.

The front end staff leaves a lot to be desired.  I never enjoy dealing with them.  The worst thing is when they do not immediately greet people when you approach the counter.  This is when there are no other customers at the desk and 3 of them are standing around talking to each other.  As soon as someone approaches the desk they should be greeted with a simple, "Hello, I'll be with you in just a moment" at the very least.

I will keep going here because of my stylist, but if she ever moves to another salon I'll be moving right along with her again.

Gluten free friendlyish. 

The service was super slow from our waitress tonight. She was very friendly but slow. People sitting around us who ordered after us with different staff were received their items before we did. She also didn't offer us any fresh ground pepper, horseradish etc when out entrées we presented. 

The starter slads were TINY as well. 

They had a special Valentine's menu and under the dessert heading the 1st item was a gluten free cheesecake but when we sat down we were informed they had run out. Had to settle for the creme brulee. There was no caramel goodness on top just some soft whipped cream and a raspberry. 

The meal was tasty just not worth $150.

I came here for the first time at this Sherwood Park location, and its pretty good. This particular Sawmill we were told has been here about two years, it has a rustic feel to it, with one was covered to look like stacked logs of wood, ready for the fire.
There is also a glass type water fall on another section of the restaurant. The booths are nice and spacious and offer a good amount of privacy for those intimate dinners for two...
I don't have anything to complain about, and neither did my party  of six. We all ate a variety of different dishes and they were all good. Two of my friends ordered the prime rib and it came with the biggest Yorkshire pudding I've ever seen. (It was huge)
Two of my other friends had steak and they both said it was great. I and Hubby both had two different chicken dishes, I had the Chicken Neptune and it was really good. Hubby had the Chicken cordon blu, and her enjoyed it too.  They've got good beers on tap and a nice wine selection to go with the nice meat dishes. We were all too full for dessert but the service and hospitality were good. Would I come back......You Betcha Ya!!!
Love this spa, everyone is friendly and helpful, I am there for nails and eyebrows monthly....Nicole is amazing. Great attention to detail by all ladies :)
Picked up a couple pasta dishes to bring home for supper. They were both excellent. The meatballs were way bigger than I expected and everything was delicious.
Roast beef was the best EVER, cut it with a aplastic spoon. Rest of meal was only good.

I purchased a "Groupon" type deal for laser hair removal in August 2011.  I really like the decor, atmosphere of the salon and my esthetician is fantastic.  She has always been helpful and friendly from the beginning.  

The service staff at the counter is another story.  I continually find them very rude and disinterested, I'm lucky if I even get eye contact.  My last visit when I was asking about a specific eyeshadow I wanted to purchase, barely even a look and a half shrug. I do know that the "Groupon/Team Buys etc" do NOT make any money for the salon or the employees, its just a way of getting people in and building clientele. With that in mind, I purchase something from the salon EVERY single time I'm there, which is about once/month.  I give my esthetician a $20 tip everytime and I make sure to support the salon too.  The salon items are not cheap by any means, but I do my part out of respect for the business.  

I would appreciate a little less disdain from the snooty girls at the counter.  This basically means for me that as soon as my 1 year deal is up, I will never use this salon again.

I think the last time I was at Lube City was about 5 years ago when I first moved here.  Everytime I felt like they were pushing me into all these extra costs so I decided to never go back.  I have been going to Mr. Lube where I can get my oil changed for about $60.  Today I was in Sherwood park close to Lube City and I decided I would go again out of convienece and just turn down any extras they tried to sell.  My oil change was $115!!! That is crazy! They said that the only oil they carry for my car is their premium oil.  I would believe that if I drove a porshe maybe, but I have a Mitsubishi Lancer. Its a standard vehicle.
I love the top siroloin and french onion soup. Always has food service and food s very timely.

I love this place. I've been going here for almost a year and I have to say I've never been disappointed. My lashes always end up looking gorgeous and I get compliments all the time. The girls are all so amazing and I look forward to my monthly lash nap.

I can't even begin to explain my love for this place. From the comfortable trendy atmosphere to the friendly welcoming vibes from all the people in the building. There's also a candy station, so you can never go wrong with a little sugar while you wait for your hair to process! 

I get my hair done here every couple weeks so this review is based on the experience on how these lovely people have treated my hair! 

I do have a particular favorite stylist at The Factory Hair + Body, Mady Wright.
