She's been dealing with my hair for a long time now and has taken me from a VERY dark and damaged brown to a healthier blonde with a slow and steady process to maintain the integrity of my hair. (I'm naturally blonde, I just kept getting tired if how terrible it looked) Mady has truly made me love not only my blonde hair, but just my hair in general again after it was absolutely butchered by an uneducated and unprofessional stylist who truly didn't care about me, just the money I had to offer. I also appreciate she has made it very clear of what we needed to do from the start in order to achieve my goal, so I'm not in the dark wondering what is happening to my hair while it's being done. 

I didn't expect to be blonde in a day, but I also never expected for my hair to feel this good again. I am forever grateful for her and really all the people at The Factory for saving my distressed hair. 

So if you're looking for a warm and friendly environment with excellent service to match, check out any of the excellent stylists at The Factory Hair + Body!

Located in a sad, dated little strip mall in Brentwood, this place came with a decent reputation.  It did not deliver.  The bento box meals were quite expensive so we opted for ordering rolls and some shared plates.  The oyster ponzu was the best of those, with the gyosa the best deal.  The tofu kara age was too soft and the bowl too deep which meant it was swimming in sauce.

The barbequed eel was tightly wrapped and tasty.  The salmon skin roll was messy and tasted a bit off. Nigiri was OK.

There is better sushi to be had in the Park.

Usually go to Webber Mazda, but I came here for a part a month ago and I really liked the customer service. Decided to make an appointment for a Saturday to get my tires swapped. 

Not only was the service fast and every Saturday during the summer months they have complementary BBQ. I gotta say that was a plus as I didn't have lunch yet. 

The staff were very friendly and even though I was there to get my tires swapped none of the front end staff were trying to push car sales on me. I really enjoyed the BBQ the food was great. 

They take airmiles 1 mile for every 50 dollars you spend and their service prices are very reasonable. Definitely will be back. 

I also had chance to walk over to London drugs and back. There are a lot shops around to pass some time if you want.

Cafe Haven is one of Sherwood Parks only independent coffee places - other than Common Grounds Cafe. 

It was started by a young husband and wife who eventually sold it to a business owner from Edmonton. 

I'm afraid it just isn't quite the same under new ownership. Although it still has some
Funky furniture, mismatched dishes and an interesting menu, some of the attention to detail and the spirit of the business has been lost. 

My order was taken by a slightly uninterested teen who told me the flavours of their smoothies was "fruity stuff kinda". my grilled sandwich showed up with cold in the centre and my fruity kinda smoothie was forgotten and made once my sandwich was at my table. 

Whereas once the food and business were watched over by a diligent and passionate owner, it now seems to be running on auto pilot. 

Although my latest experience was not great, I'm giving it three stars because it is still one of the more original places to visit and when they are on their game, it is awesome.
All is can say is wow great food love to go here for sushi always so amazing great service and atmosphere can't get enough of this place

Thank you for your reply Heather, it is appreciated. 

One highlight I'd love to pass on is the outstanding service I received from Nicole (George?? I think)  I usually see Catherine (who is awesome too by the way) but she wasn't in that day.  Due to the private nature of the areas being treated I was thrown off a little!  There's only so many people you want to show your bits to hahaha.  Whether Nicole sensed my nervousness/shyness or if she is just always so amazing, I was absolutely thrilled.  She went out of her way (I felt) to reassure me and make me feel so comfortable and at ease.  She gave me some great tips to cope with the pain and really coached me through it and even took my mind off of it at some points.  

My experience with your service staff so far has been wonderful and they definitely deserve some praise. :)

A former Ric's Grill now converted to Blue Rare under the same ownership. The only thing I had noticed that was different was the sign on the outside. Overall it just seemed like a boring place without any identity. We had gift cards purchased at that specific Ric's Grill location, which is why we ended up going there. 

I had the Steakhouse Burger and it was decent. The patty was tasty and the boursin cheese was pretty good. It suffered from a poor burger-to-bun ratio though. The bun was too thin and kind of disintegrated when I started to eat the burger. 

My parents both felt parts of their dishes were cold and were not terribly excited about their meals.

Located where Ric's Grill used to be and still under the same ownership. The decor hasn't changed at all and if it has, barely. It's very generic, standard, uninspiring. Lighting a little too dim, brown tones, over-sized vases with those long curly sticks sticking out the top, and menus simply printed on a piece of white paper. The booths are really narrow in depth and I was surprised by how low down the seat was when I went to sit down. 

I went with my husband and my parents-in-law. MIL suggested appetizers but there was nothing, ahem, appetizing to me in that column of the menu. We had the crab stuffed mushrooms and could hardly find the mushrooms, they were so tiny. Her and my husband liked them, though. My husband and I ordered burgers - I the Bacon Bacon (why two bacon's?) Cheddar Burger and him the Steakhouse Burger which is topped with bruschetta and Boursin cheese, each $16. We both liked our burgers - mine was better than I expected, nothing to complain about. My in-laws each had the blackened salmon with veggies and the chef's potato. They liked the salmon but their veggies and potatoes were cold on arrival.

Our server was really nice and did her job well, nothing to complain about there either. The reason we ended up here was because we had old Ric's Grill gift certificates - there is a sign up right on the front entrance saying that they will NOT be accepted, but they did accept ours as they were purchased at that location. Best to call ahead if you're planning on doing this. If someone were to take me out and pay for my meal, I wouldn't have a problem returning, but I wouldn't go of my own devices. Overall a generic experience that I don't crave.

My family has purchased a few vehicles here. 2007 Toyota Yaris RS, 2003 Honda Accord Sedan LX, 2009 Honda Fit Sport, 2009 Honda Pilot, 2007 Acua MDX, 2018 Honda CR-V. I service my vehicle here as well. And I work here now too.

Yes it's busy so you have to be patient.  The Dragon  rice dish and quesadillas were excellent.  The cowboy salad was very good.  The atmosphere is Cosy.  There are several tv screens. Craft beers are $6.5.  What's not to like.  Two thumbs up.
My second favorite Starbucks location in Shpk. Good ample seating plenty of space to sprawl and good customer service. And there is enough parking here. Plus a good patio space.

No Costco membership? That's ok, you don't need one to shop at the Costco liquor store. 

The prices here are really good, but the selection is pretty meh. If you're looking for something other than the most popular brands, you're probably out of luck. 

Best value? The 1.75 L bottle of Kirkland brand vodka. It's actually not too bad.

Had a 90 minute couples massage which was fantastic! Nice atmosphere and lovely staff. The only negative was the hot towel that was placed under my head was extremely hot and my skin is slightly burnt from it. 
All in all good service, we will be back.

Today's Weekly Yelp was all about dim sum and through the eblast, I discovered that Good Buddy has all day every day dim sum. This is the best news since I've been craving dim sum like you wouldn't believe. 

So I convinced the Hubba Hubby that we needed to give dim sum another try (I love it but he's only had it one time at one other place and it wasn't his fav). 

To start, Good Buddy has the BEST ginger beef that we have ever had. And given that ginger beef is Hubby's favourite, that is a big statement. :)

We ordered all of our food off the dim sum menu including pork dumplings, crab cheddar wontons, sticky rice, the ginger beef, shrimp and peppers, another shrimp dish and pork buns. The seven dishes came out pretty quick and are were hot and tasty. We would have all seven again, plus we would love to mix it up and try more on the menu. 

Our server was great - there when you needed him, friendly and happy. 

It was a great experience and we will definitely be back. Good Buddy convinced Hubba Hubby that dim sum is good. And we found out that for a delivery charge, they will even deliver to parts of Edmonton. 

One more thing - it looks like it is fantastic for groups. There were three large parties in three separate party rooms. The main restaurant had a ton of seating as well. We thought it would be super busy given the amount of cars in the lot, but they mostly were in these party rooms.

My brother took me here for my birthday.  When I was living in Vancouver and traveling to Prince George on business, I used to look forward to having dinner at Rics in PG as it was near the Ramada hotel.

Wow, what a difference between these locations.   We dined late, 8:30pm reservation on a Saturday night.  We ordered a bottle of wine, a toasted coconut prawn appetizer to split and each had a steak.  I ordered the filet, my brother a rib eye.

The prawns came first.  They were small and a very poor value for the price.  Would not recommend this.  But hey, I had my steak to look forward to.

For a steakhouse charging the prices that they do, I was amazed at the steak I was served.  I have never had such a tasteless piece of meat in a steakhouse before in my life.  I am not sure where they source their meat from or how long it is aged but  it was totally lacking in flavour.  And I ordered it rare so it wasn't a case of it being overcooked.  I suspect they probably are importing their beef from somewhere as it was not up to the standards one usually encounters with Canadian beef.  Brother wasn't impressed with his steak either so they were 0 for 2 that night on what should be their core competency. 

For the money we spent, we both were very underwhelmed with our dining experience and will not come to this location again.   Having had good food at their Prince George location numerous times,, I'm willing to try another location but I will definitely not return to the Sherwood Park location.

When I think of cafes in Edmonton (and surrounding areas) I think of stale baked goods and sloppy menus. Cafe Haven is neither of these things.

In a strip mall (what isn't in this city?) located in the remains of an old bank, there are touches of comfort all over, in the chairs, lamps and other furniture. It just feels so cozy. 

Haven offers Transcend roasted coffee beans and latte art as well as carefully made tea lattes. And delicious sandwiches, soups, salads and even brunch. There are some baked goods, like pumpkin pie and cinnamon buns as well. 

They're so much more, though! Their menus change seasonally, and features local products and organic choices. There is a new brunch offering every weekend. They're even licensed and feature music and spoken word evenings. 

You're doing yourself a disservice if you don't spin by to check this place out next time you're in Sherwood Park. I don't find myself in in the Park that often, but if I lived there, this would be my go to lunch and meeting spot.

I've never purchased a car from Sherwood Honda and won't consider it until they get rid of that batch of "Lady Gaga - Pokerface" inspired commercials.  

They are so absolutely revolting, I cringe, convulse and vomit whenever it comes on.

The jingle wasn't cool or catchy 10 years ago, so why would it be relevant today?

#YOURMARKRTINGTEAMISLAME 

#STOPHIRINGYOUFRIENDSTODOYOURCOMMERCIALS

I was extremely disappointed with the lady I dealt with at the service desk. Rude is an understatement. The person who quoted the service obviously made an error however the lady helping me did not want to go out of her way to assist me. I left and cancelled my appointment. I will not be back.

My wife and I frequently go to Ricky's and it has become a staple of our cost effective date nights. We even went there for our rehearsal dinner. It has great service and you get a lot of food for your money. If you really want a lot of food for a good price get there lasagna. The music is all top 40s pop which I find amusing as it does not fit the clientele. However it is quiet enough to maintain a conversation, except in the bathroom the tunes are bumping and I will often have had a solo dance party too.
For the love of all things holy, please cook more corn.  Some of us neither want nor care for the other sides, most of which are both unhealthy and underwhelming.
Had the katsu-Don last visit and the rainbow roll today. Great little hole in the wall in Sherwood Park. Extensive menu, great environment and good prices.

Came here with the family for dinner on a Sunday night. Made reservations beforehand and were seated right away. The place was quite empty which suited us fine.

Waitress came over and took our drink orders and left to get them while we settled in with the menu. She came back with some fresh buns from the oven. Very warm and soft.

I ordered the prime rib sandwich with Caesar salad as a side. Prime rib was more medium and chewy than medium rare - no blood. 3 out of 5. Salad was one of the best I ever had. 5 out of 5.

Wife had the rack of lamb. She said it was excellent. 5 out of 5.

My daughter had the cheeseburger sliders. She said it was great. 5 out of 5. Fries were nice and crispy.

My son had the Fettuccine Alfredo. He devoured it quickly stopping only to breathe. 5 out of 5.

In my reservation I had put down we were celebrating our anniversary. Usually places don't do anything. The waitress came with a very decadent chocolate cake. 5 out of 5.

The service was excellent. Our waters were always filled. Bring the bread at the beginning was great. Kids meals also included ice cream. The waitress in a low voice asked my wife and I if it was ok to offer it in case it wasn't. Nice touch. Most places aren't that sensitive to children. We also had a bit of a mix up with the bill and they fixed it right away.

Great experience and will definitely be back. The only thing preventing a 5 out of 5 overall was just my prime rib. Everything else was excellent.

My wife and I decided on Friday night around 8:30 to try the new Browns to change the scenery up from Earls, Joeys and Cactus. We were greeted at the door by a nice hostess who informed us it would be about a 15 minute wait to get a table. We opted to sit at the bar instead as there were empty seats available. We sat and enjoyed the interior decor and enjoyed good conversation for about 10 minutes. There was no eye contact or interaction from the bar tenders during that time so we got up and left to Joeys where although they we also very busy we sat at the bar and were greeted and served drinks within 2 minutes.
It was a disappointing experience.

So this is definitely not the greatest McDonald's location ever but they have the absolute best crew working the drive through in the morning. They're quick and efficient and have yet to mess up my order. They're pleasant and really nice to deal with when you're maybe a bit cranky before your morning coffee. Definitely recommend hitting up the drive thru in the morning!

First time I never finished my favourite breakfast eggs Benedict, asked for soft got medium egg........egg shell in it, the sauce was so bland and tasteless and the hash browns were so soft the potatoes were raw. The waitress did ask if everything was ok but I had the egg shell in my mouth at the time and she never waited for my response. When she saw my plate still had 90% of the food still on it she never even asked if it was fine just took the plate away. Last time I will ever eat here!! I suggest you eat somewhere else.

The coating on the chicken is fantastic.  But the chicken itself is.... almost slimy?  It's strange, that's for sure, and nothing extraordinary.

The food was on the tray in front of me before I had even finished paying.  Which means it was just sitting back there waiting.  That would be okay if it was kept hot, but the chicken was only luke warm and the fries were cold.

The biscuit was also cold.

Basically, nothing was super exciting here.

Ok here it is.......I booked my car in for a 10:30am EXPRESS oil change. From past oil changes I've had in the past at other places it takes from 10-20 min max. But I hate to say it this took 1hr.... I was 15 min. early and they drove the car away and @ 11:15 I'm asking how much longer........They did kind of said sorry as I drove away @ 11:30 am. This should have been an easy way to convince me to come back for more service work. I'm now thinking if they can't get a booked oil change right what else can't they do.  I need to remind them when you are at work you're getting paid and when I'm there I'm there on my own dime.

The girls working at this location are very slow and spend too much time socializing with eachother. There will be a huge line and the girls are goofing around with the helium balloons. Very immature, and frustrating if your in a rush.

I never know what to do with my hair, so I tend to let the hairstylist take charge of my cut. Overall she did a good job, I really like the cut. I would definitely go back.

The atmosphere in the place was great. I really liked the modern style of the salon.

My wife and I stopped in here to pick up some wine last night, and noticed the sign says they are only open until 830. It's 820, so we are ok. We think. The moment we walk in the door a rather large bald young man walks in front of us, blocking our path, and says "Just to give you a heads up, we close in 5 or 6 minutes" I look at my phone, it's 822. How long did he think it would take us?
I turn to my wife and jokingly say that  maybe we should go? Doesn't sound like we should buy anything? He hears us, just goes back to what he was doing. We turn around and leave, he doesn't care in the least, and shows it by keeping his back to us as he cashes out his till early. We don't care either. We went to the Superstore liquor store for the first time, which is open until 11, and the two ladies working there was more helpful than we could believe, considering it's SUPERSTORE. 
PS the prices were amazing.

Easily one of the best sushi restaurants I've been to.  My wife used to eat at the fort McMurray location all the time and never stopped talking about it when she went up for work,. Luckily they opened this location,. The sushi is always fresh and you never leave unsatisfied.

I took my watch in to the Gem Gallerie to have the battery changed.  Very friendly and attentive service.  

Another client was in the store being attended while I waited my turn.  The staff seem to provide a very personalized service approach to their clients.

Upscale atmosphere in the lounge.  Numerous TV screens and some for betting on the races. Wings are huge and can come with veggies.   Happy hour specials.  Meals otherwise expensive.  Servers were pleasant.  Music not to loud.  Free parking.  Nicely padded seats and booth seats.  I would return.  At least for lunch!

Our experience with Sherwood Honda has been great. When we originally went to look at vehicles, our salesman Peter was fantastic. Very helpful, knowledgeable and no pressure to buy. We ended up purchasing a used Honda Odyssey Touring Edition. The woman in the finance department was also just as great and helpful. Service appts have mostly gone well. Our only request for improvement would be that the length of appt time can be an issue as they seem to either overbook or be understaffed at times.

RWhen we bought our Honda Odyssey in March of last year we bought at a dealership that was pretty awesome but has now changed to Go Auto. and their customer service have suffered for the change! We needed to find a new dealership to have all our service work done and were lucky enough to have found Sherwood Honda! My first call to this dealership was to the service department, as we had a recall on our electric sliding doors on our van. My call was answered by Carmen. I explained that I had problems with our original dealership getting this work done and could she help me! Well, let me tell you, customer service is what Carmen is all about! She was kind, she was understanding, and most of all, she made things happen! We live 2 hours away from the dealership and I am disabled. This service work was going to take several hours so I asked if a loaner could be made available. Carmen took my request to her service manager, Carolyn Lauinger who then rented us a car from Enterprise! We showed up for our appointment and our service advisor Darcy, was amazing! She was very professional and so kind! She took the time to come with us to the service desk to assure we were taken care of! Carmen heard my name and came over to the sign in desk to welcome us and say hi! I just couldn't believe the level of service that Sherwood Honda provided! I asked to speak to the service manager, Carolyn to thank her for the rental and her outstanding staff. After speaking to Carolyn, I understood why her staff was so awesome, she leads by example! Our Odyssey is all good now and Sherwood Honda has a loyal customer that will tell anyone that will listen, just how amazing they are!
My family and I have eaten here for years! The food is delicious and this small mom and pop restaurant is a gem. They are also accommodating of larger parties and the food is great for take out also.

I usually do not rate places like McDonald's, because the bar is set pretty low. It's McDonald's. 

I was there last weekend, I believe it was the evening of Saturday and the level of incompetence I witnessed is actually staggering. 

Uncooked, way oversalted food and bad service. We'll get there.

The lady taking the order seemed like she was either deaf or high. I would ask for simple mods to my burger and she would stare. Not a big issue, but strange. 

I asked for a larger water cup, they acted like they didn't know what to do. She stood there and tried to process it for almost 10 seconds before asking a manager what to do. I offered to pay for a larger cup. The manager grabbed the same small cup and rushed over to a tap before filling it up and handing it to me in a rude manner. It almost felt personal, I'm confused if they mistook me for someone else.

I asked for a lid for my water since I was taking it into the car, my request was ignored. They looked at me and just went "uhhhh". Nobody else was in line, just me. So this was very strange. Also I wasn't being rude in the slightest, but I was confused.

After being ignored I said "nevermind" and left. 
Here's where it gets bad.

My burger was oversalted to the point of being inedible. I order the same thing several times a week, and I've never had such a disgusting over seasoned burger. I choked on it and tried a smaller bite from the other side, which was better. 

Then I bit into the middle. RAW. 
Raw burger. Pink. Falling apart. I spat it out, took a picture and threw that garbage into the trash. 

I'm confused as to why I had such a horrible time, I've never been to this McDonald's before and I didn't know any of the staff. Unreal.

On July 30th, 2015, we came into Sherwood Honda to look at the brand new 2015 Honda Pilot. We met with Brandon White and he was friendly, not to lie to you, on that department of checking for cars, he was FRIENDLY. That same day, we met with the finance representative and our loan was approved. We asked to give us a night to think through it with payment and length. The next day, we came back and decided to go with it and signed the paper. The finance manager, Michael, sold us the undercoat and we had to wait 24 hours before we can pick up the Honda Pilot as it needs to cured and dried. Then they said that on Aug 1st, our brand new $50,000 worth of Honda Pilot will be ready for pick up. Aug 1st, we arrived at 11:45am and waiting was okay as we were early; at 12:10PM, Brandon approached us and apologized that it will be 15 more minutes as they only have one person in the service department cleaning the vehicle. After 15 minutes, Brandon came back and apologizing again stating it will be about 30-45 minutes more due to lack of staff in the service department. In the meantime, Brandon did his best to educate us with showing all that is in the Pilot, so that once our vehicle is ready, we could just drive away and everything will be done. The pilot was ready after 45 minutes. Again, Brandon came apologizing that he can only provide us ONE KEY and the valet key and he will contact us once they locate the other key. We had enough of this ridiculous experience for one day, plenty of disappointments; we are buying a brand new car worth so much--and not a JOKE--you'd think we'd have a better service, considering this is in their file that the car will be purchased, so proper preparations should have taken place. Next, Brandon introduced us to Doug Hennessey who came and told us that "we are not living in a perfect world" OF COURSE, yeah sure, who buys a car with just one functional key! (very disrespectful) Anyway, Doug made a resolution, an agreement that if the missing key is not located, a new key will be programmed, therefore the Pilot needs to be with the service department at NO COST--YOU THINK?! of course, we do not need to pay for that missing key--we're not the ones who lost it. As a complimentary for our missing key and disappointments, he said that cleaning the car and detailing is included at no charge. Aug 7th, 2015, our tentative appointment is quickly approaching, we called and asked if they have located the missing key, Brandon apologized that they did not and (okay fine), we said to pick up the pilot and bring the service loaner as we agreed upon our appointment set for Aug 9th. Brandon explained he can't do that day and it has to be monday--but what is the difference if you pick it up Friday and service it on Aug 9th--he again apologized and said it will be Monday, Aug 10th (fine cos it's a tentative appointment, anyways) but personally, we can't do Monday cos of our own personal affairs so we apologized to them for the inconvenience that we are bringing upon them. Tuesday, Aug 11 is our final set appointment. Today is Monday, we received an email from first, Jennifer Davis, stating confirmed appointment for tuesday Aug 11 at 3:00pm the pilot is to be DROPPED OFF; next, Natalie MacDonald. This raises a concern for us, should we drop off the Pilot against what was agreed in signed paper that it will be PICKED UP at my house and they will provide a loaner. We contacted Doug, he seems to have forgotten the agreement, luckily there is a SIGNED PAPER. He said he will call us back, we could not wait so we phoned and left a message. He finally contacted us back and informed us that he spoke with Brandon and Brandon has taken care of everything and we will follow according to our original plan. Hopefully, Aug 11, 2015 would be a better and smoother process. Also, we forgave that the headphones were ALSO MISSING--Brandon was nice enough to dropped it off--and there's a scuff on our brand new car. We should not be chasing people, we are the buyers, buyers of an expensive vehicle, it should not be taken lightly.

Food is quite tasty but decor is old & smells of stale cigarette smoke. Female owner is super friendly & extremely sweet. If you are looking for fine dining definitely not the place for you. But if you enjoy the quaintness of ratty dives with good food you won't be disappointed.

I've been there a couple times for hot chocolate and their peanut butter squares. the hot chocolate is okay, nothing special. but their marshmallow peanut butter squares are amazing.

their staff is kind and helpful and really make this cafe a place worth going too. I also love the fact that I can take a seat and they will bring me my order, it allows me to find a comfy place to relax. I also love the fact that when you choose to go there for a sit-down coffee, they give you a glass mug. its the environmentalist in me that likes that.

Great quiet place to study and relax.

I have dined here several times over the years with work colleagues, as it's close to work and their homes. And from an expense account point-of-view, it's an acceptable treat.  Ric's is a Canadian chain with several restaurants in Edmonton, one in Calgary and several in BC and apparently well-regarded.  The Sherwood Park restaurant is located in one of the many strip shopping areas along Baseline Road and you have to pay attention when looking for it.  And it's worth it.

I have eaten both in the main restaurant and the lounge (same menu) and have always enjoyed my meal, the service, and the ambiance. Most importantly, it's a comfortable place to catch up with old friends. The Alberta Beef is always excellent as is the seafood, the salads, and the wine selection.

My wife and I decided to go for a breakfast date at Rickeys, she ordered a BC Benedict and it was alright aside from the terribly small portion of chunky hash browns so we had to order a side just to have a little extra.. I ordered the meat lovers breakfast bowl and on the menu it said that there was maple bacon included in it but after the long wait for it to get to the table I noticed that there wasn't any bacon in it.. ask the server about it and they said they don't carry maple bacon.. then proceeded to go and bring back a single piece of regular bacon. I would never recommend anyone else to visit the Sherwood Park Rickeys. Poor service, poor staff. Mediocre food.

Big fan of Chai Lattes, and these guys did not disappoint! The Remedy Chai was very tasty, and warmed up my dreary afternoon. I also grabbed a chicken coconut wrap that was absolutely delightful. It had chicken of course, but also some roasted coconuts, bits of apple and celery, some grated carrots along with some other things. It was a very refreshing and satisfying lunch, and I was very pleased that it had no cheese as I can't do dairy. 

 As a side note, I've always been attracted to small cafes that feature local artwork on their walls, just a very cool feel to it. I will most definitely be back to sample more of the menu and soak up the ambiance.

After much consideration, I've decided to write a review on Roxx.  

I've rated Roxx 2-stars (though they are not far off from 3 stars) for a few reasons and it primarily has to do with my experiences with one stylist in particular.  There were three key situations and I will note two of them:  I typically try to arrive early to appointments, usually 10 minutes or so.  Hey, you never know if your stylist is running ahead of time, right?  When it was 15 minutes after my scheduled appointment time, I approached reception and asked if my stylist was running late.  I absolutely *hate* tardiness, but hate more when an establishment isn't professional enough to communicate with their customers (upon their arrival) that their stylist is running behind.  My concern was brushed off and I was told that the stylist should only be a few more minutes.  When my stylist finally came out to greet, there was no apology and her acknowledgement was 'I don't even know what time it is."  My time was not valued at all.

The following appointment my stylist was not late but she greeted me with one of the worst criticisms I have ever received.  It was in direct relation to how I looked.  I was completely shocked and truly at a loss for words.  To make matters worse, this was done in their front area with 3 or 4 other customers in earshot on the couch.  At the time I was going through complete and utter despair in my personal life and the stylist's words could not have come at a worse time.  Couple this with (me) an overly sensitive individual on a good day - well, hopefully you get the picture.  Following her comment, I think the stylist picked up on my demeanor once I sat in the chair and tried to make light of what had been said - but I was extremely quiet and didn't embrace the forced conversation that followed.  After the experience, I never booked with that stylist again.  

Part of me is regretful that I did not inform management of what took place with this stylist but at the same time, the comment made was hurtful and embarrassing.     

I flopped back and forth as to whether or not I would return to the salon.  I knew that I would see the stylist at some point and if I was sitting in another chair, it could be awkward.  I decided to continue to give Roxx my business.  I tried another stylist and unfortunately it didn't work out.  The stylist was timely, never any issue with tardiness, but I never loved the cuts.  I then tried someone else and although I was extremely happy with the cut, we had issues with the colour.  Not the stylist's fault at all, just a bad reaction to the brand used.

We have had a couple of questionable children's cuts, too - so I do have to sit back and evaluate the skill level of some of the stylists that Roxx has.  I now have three or four stylists that I would not use again.    

I have used the spa services and have had two great pedicures.  Great job, ladies!

Child care services are amazing - I don't use them anymore because I don't need to, but the caregivers really go above and beyond.  If I rated the child care alone it would be 5 stars for sure.

Had the blue rare tuna, it was okay. It doesn't compare to the tuna I have had. Boyfriend had a steak ordered it rare, came to him well done. The food was okay not the greatest. Definitely better steaks houses in Edmonton.

When your shop opened in sherwood park I was thrilled. Finally a cupcake shop close to home. I went in and got my favorite flavor, chocolate cake with mint icing and it was delicious. Great first impression.

I have been disappointed every time since. The 2nd time I went in I was excited to get my chocolate mint. I was sad to find out that it was a monthly flavour and your staff could not tell me when it would be back. I walked away with nothing. And I checked back every so often, usually walking away with nothing.

In december I decided to come in despite knowing you likely wouldn't have the flavour I wanted. There was a sign on the door stating there was renos and when you would re open. I came back a few days or a week later, AFTER the date on the sign and you were STILL closed during your usual business hours with NO explanation!

On valentines day february 14th, an occasion that you should have known would be busy I walk in around 4pm. There are 2... Count it TWO cupcakes left total!!!!. I tell the lady ahead of me in line that doesn't look promising, she says there must be more in the back. I didn't expect there would be since I've been disappointed by this company before. Sure enough the girl at the counter tells me that that's all the have. By the time I got in line there was ONE cupcake left! Are you kidding me? This is THE most poorly operated business I have ever encountered. you can bet I will be going to edmonton if I am looking for single cupcakes, or multiples for birthdays or wedding if I can help it.

Update: there is new management that did try to right the wrongs and I hope they can improve.
Amazing appetizers!! Good selection of cocktails and the staff were very friendly. I will absolutely be back for the bacon wrapped scallops!!

This is one of my top 5 favourite Japanese restaurants EVER! 

I was missing this place something bad when I moved away from Fort McMurray years ago (where it originated), but thankfully they opened a second one here in middle Alberta, and conveniently located a block away 

The main reason I've loved this place for years are the donburi (rice) bowls offered - it just has that flavour and certain ingredients I haven't really seen elsewhere, especially the glass noodles!! (Love that stuff)
As well as the deep fried pork (katsudon) or chicken (oyakudon) options, topped with a cooked egg, and a nice helping of vegetables and mound of rice. 

They also have a nice selection of sushi, sashimi, maki, tempura, and bento boxes. The miso soup here is also one of my favourite miso soups - once again very different from other places :)
The gyoza and agedashi tofu are also pretty tasty appetizers. 
And of course salmon maki - can't go wrong with salmon maki

I love this cute and cozy café! It's a great way to relax on a Saturday morning for breakfast or grab an awesome cup of joe . The food was delicious and the service was good too. If you  sit front of the window it's nice but it can get a little bit hot from the sun. However don't worry because they also have a nice little patio and more space inside!

Ric's grill was exactly what I was expecting it to be, which is why I haven't ever been there before. It is a very average steakhouse.
My wife took me here for our anniversary. The bread that came out was a mixture of white and marble rye bread. The white bread was good, but the marble rye was dry. We ordered escargot as our apply and it was really good. Full marks for the crispy cheese on the escargot serving dish. I had a spinach salad which was ok, but it seemed like the spinach was kind of limp and wilty, not the freshest I've had.
I ordered the 13oz New York strip loin cooked blue rare and my wife got the 10 oz medium rare of the same. My steak was served rare, but I elected to keep it... The problem though was that it WAS rare for about 1 minute, but it was on a hot plate and still hot, so by the time I was half done it was medium, not even close to blue rare like I ordered it. My wife's steak came out well done so we sent it back... It came back medium, so we kept it and they comped it... Kudos for that, but what's up with steak houses not knowing how to cook a steak? And how do you mess up blue rare?
The restaurant also sent out a free desert for our anniversary, it was quite good.
Overall it was a pretty typical steakhouse. We got good value for our money since the steak and desert was comped, but I doubt I will go back.

Our #1 restaurant in Sherwood Park.  Food is always great, prices are reasonable.  The restaurant interior is plain and no frills, once you have your food you won't notice.  Take out or dine in, experience and service has always been exceptional.

First time I have been at Ricky's and I'm pretty sure it won't be my last. I've never been in a Ricky's before so if what I experienced is any indication for other Ricky's, I will definitely request this place over a Denny's anyday of the week.

The decor and atmosphere was nice and warm. Even though the Sherwood Park location looks small, there is ample seating inside. But I could see a long wait time if you arrived at peak hours. 

The food was wonderful. And the service was great. I ordered the Classic Double Egger and the food came out 'perfection'. My sunny-side up eggs were huge and cooked perfectly. The toast was soft, the chorizo sausage was money. The shredded hashbrowns, perfectly cooked golden brown. Unlike other breakfast places in this category of restaurant, you often get a cook who is banging out breakfast meals at lighting speed and you end up getting a sloppy plate. This didn't happen at Ricky's. Whomever was the cook on Saturday morning, *slow clap* I can tell you enjoy cooking and take pride in your work. Thank you!

As for our server, she was really good, I didn't ask her name but my intuition thinks it was the manager/owner of the place. Either way she was awesome. Hope to see her again.

As for the 4 out 5. I need to visit again and try the Brekkie Bowl. I saw someone have one and I thought "WTF is that!? Do Want!!!" It looked awesome.

I ordered Yoshi through Door Dash as I was staying in a hotel near Sherwood Park.  Very fresh fish (toro, salmon). And their cut rolls were very good also!  What a pleasant surprise!  Will definitely eat from here again next time I am here.

Delicious food! Much better than Pasta Pantry, and they have a much better selection of pasta...and my kids will actually eat this food, something they
 refuse to do at Pasta Pantry.

I would like like to thank Sherwood Park Mall for inviting Valley Taekwondo club into the Mall were we do our annual break-a-thon. All money raised goes to the local women shelter(Strathcona women shelter with the help of the mall we have been able to raise $265,000 over the last 22 years.

Excellent fresh food.....
Restaurant itself is good to visit if you are interested in the food alone....they focus on the cuisine, not interior decoration.
But they sure do a great job on the food.
Quick on takeout orders as well....

I don't usually write a bad review unless I feel strongly about it. I booked an appointment for a hybrid full set of lashes. I'd been to Posh a few times prior and although I wasn't super happy, it was the only place I could get in with hardly any notice. The girl did take the time to ask questions about the look I was going for. 

One thing I stressed was that in my last appointment I had a volume set (and paid way too much for it) and that I didn't want that again. This time, I was looking for a more natural look - hence the hybrid. She asked if the length was ok in the past, I agreed it wasn't too bad. I stressed I felt like the volume set was just too thick and a little too "young" for my age. 

At the beginning she did mention some of girls have started their fall shed so I can expect the same. She was giving lengthy explanations of what she was doing and reiterated she prefers I tell her if something wasn't right rather than not saying anything. She began the work but at the end when I held the mirror up I was so very disappointed. It looked exactly like she took a fake set out of the package at the local drug store and glued the strip to my eyelids. Horrible! That's not natural. They were so curled it looked like the tips were attached to my eyelids as well. That's not natural. They looked like they were perfectly cut across the top with a pair of scissors. That's not natural either. There were zero lashes in the corners. That's not natural. They were so thick and dark and stiff and they almost looked blue in the sunlight. I immediately told her I didn't like them at all (remembering she'd prefer to hear that) 

Instead of listening to me, she got very defensive and kept holding up a piece of paper saying they did this length last time. Always something about last time. Again, I wanted a natural look therefore a hybrid because I didn't want it to look like last time. 

I kept giving very valid reasons why I didn't like them. She simply said do you want me to take them off for you? I had another appointment after and declined. It was very evident of my dissatisfaction but she didn't care. I paid the $183.75 and when paying she came over and offered to remove them and lucky me, she wasn't even going to charge me! I don't think I should have paid for them at all. If she's only going to refer to a piece of paper and negate everything I say, then why bother asking questions? 

After leaving, I sat in my vehicle and cancelled my next appointment. Called my old lash business I went to for years (quit going cause it was too far after I moved) and explained my situation and my lash expert I had been going to for 5 years made some arrangements to book me in the next day. 

I immediately went back into Posh - less than 5 minutes later and told the girl I wanted the lashes removed. I was embarrassed leaving with them. All of a sudden she wasn't available to remove them. Someone else did it and I couldn't get them off quick enough. 

Never again! Just because you give lengthy explanations doesn't make you an expert. And acting defensive when a customer isn't happy doesn't make you a professional.

This is normally a favourite place to come for a latte or their amazing eggs Benedict. However today my London fog comes with an old lipstick stain. I immediately notice it and point it out to the waitress and she's like oh and takes it back. Is that the new form of sorry? And another waitress comes back with another London fog and sets it down and walks away. Still waiting for that apology...
Like I said, the food here is always amazing but how can one enjoy it after bad service?

I went to this location with a few of my co-workers/friends for a pampering day as one co-worker was heading off on maternity leave.

As the location had moved, it is a tad hard to find since they only have a banner outside the doors.

Inside; the location is presentable and provides a friendly atmosphere. We were led to a room upstairs where we relaxed & awaiting our appointed time.

Once out appointed time arrived, we were led downstairs to the room where the "pampering magic" happens. 

During our pedicure, two of the ladies were very sociable and friendly, while the third was very quiet and a bit rough.  I did enjoy the relaxing massaging chairs & the pampering of feet.

What I did not enjoy was the fact that the nail polish only last 1 day before it started to slightly chip & smudge. I don't know if it was due to the specific kind of nail polish or the way it was applied, but I was pretty disappointed. I had gotten one done almost a month or so prior at a smaller, less expensive salon and it honestly turned out way better.

For the price, I was extremely disappointed and will probably never go out of my way to this place again.

Had my lashes lifted and tinted for the first time. Got a great price and very good service. Artist was gentle and knowledgeable about every step. The studio is clean and tastefully decorated and the staff are relaxed and kind. I'm going back for sure.

I have come here lots in the years that it has been open and I've always enjoyed the eclectic menu and delicious and fresh coffee.  It's a nice relaxed atmosphere, the couches are getting a bit worn, but still comfortable. The girl who took our order was friendly and knowledgable. 

I had the chicken wrap and my mate had the ham and cheese. He is addicted to the ham and cheese. The chicken wrap was mediocre. Very little chicken and overall bland. 

My major concern was what I was watching while I relaxed and ate my lunch. You can clearly see behind the counter and watch the staff prep food. Most staff were wearing aprons and had their hair tied back, but there was one (who was doing the majority of veggie cutting) that had her hair hanging in her face and no apron, I wasn't overly concerned until I watched her pull up her sleeves, scratch her face and brush her hair back, then go right back to cutting. And she did it repeatedly........ Not once did she wash her hands. Good thing I'm not squeamish on food safety and prep rules but it will make me think twice before ordering food again. I also saw a few different employees munching behind the counter, little bites here and there as I know people do in all kitchens, but again limited hand washing. But as said, some people were amazing and washed lots, maybe a bit more attention to be paid to some of the other staff.
Very impressed. Great service and fantastic food. Found this place via Transcend Coffee on Twitter. If you're a Transcend fan, then you'll love Cafe Haven.

I had hair extensions put in. Great job and so many compliments about how well the extensions blended in to my real hair. Super happy with them and would highly recommend going here if looking for hair extensions.
Good Chinese food if you want the standard Americanized Chinese food. Staff is always friendly and good is fast and fresh. Highly recommended.

I  went for a classic full set and what seemed like a third of the lashes fell off within 24hours. I called/messaged them the next day but they were closed. However, they responded shortly after outside of business hours! They promptly dealt with my issue and got me in at the most convenient time for me to fix them free of charge! I do believe the initial issue was just a one off. My lashes are now incredible! I definitely recommend this place!

Spotted a car at Sherwood Honda. Drove in yesterday (July 17), from Devon to see it, it wasn't there. It'll be back tomorrow (today, July 18). 
Test drove a like model, really nice! Called today, Thursday, July 18, to test drive the missing model ( cheque in hand, btw ) was told that the Manager won't have it back until Monday.
Add to that, only $7000 to upgrade to a brand new one... Oooh, the possibilities! Can you spell M.I.S.S.E.D. O.P.P.O.R.T.U.N.I.T.Y.

Did not expect a car dealership to be so complacent with customer service. Don't get me wrong, I got lots of apologies, but that hardly satisfied my need.

Too Bad

Tried a new greenhouse. I have to say I am impressed. It has a very large selection of flowers, veggies and herbs. The staff was super helpful and friendly. Also very knowledgable about plants. Which is something you want in a greenhouse. Very well kept and clean. Not sure what more to say, they have been around 100 years or something. So they must be doing something right! I feel it was a few $$$ more than normal but I hope thats for a quality product!

This is the place to go in Sherwood Park for an oil change. Today was my third visit to this location; and the first time I've actually had my oil changed.

The last oil change I had was at another oil change provider and they did not place a sticker on my window. I was unsure of how long it was until I needed a service, so I came to Lube City. They were completely honest to me the two times I came and told me that I wasn't due for a service. 

Today, I had my vehicle serviced. They were nothing but helpful and friendly, without pushing me to buy extras I didn't need. The crew provided excellent customer service, while telling me everything they were doing to my vehicle, step by step. 

I will definitely be stopping by again when I am due for a service. Thanks fellas!

We had the beef satay soup. I've never seen a beef satay soup like this before. The broth was thick and off coloured. Almost like they had used hot and sour soup and added rice noodles and added some Beef, green onion, bean sprouts 2 pieces of tomato.    The soup was warm not hot at all. I

Really great, consistent Vietnamese food. The owners are friendly and prompt. The food is a good selection of typical dishes. This time we ordered quite a few things - spring rolls (good and crispy), pan fried lemon grass shrimp, green pepper & onions (my favourite dish there), beef with mushroom, onion & green pepper in Satay Sauce (good),   chicken with onions, green pepper, carrot coconut milk and curry sauce (decent), pan fried mixed vegetables (excellent and fresh tasting),  Singapore vermicelli stir fried with eggs, pork, shrimps & vegetables (great consistency of the noodles and very flavourful), pork chops with salty sweet sauce in hot pot (excellent flavour), with some rice and vermicelli noodles. Super great price for the amount and the quality you are getting. The dining room is really dated. It would be nice to see a remodel of the place and especially of the bathrooms. However don't let the décor set you off, try it.

Ordered spicy chicken was asked if I would like to wait 14 minutes cuz it's made to order then after 16 minutes I was called up to tell me it was done but it wasn't and was told it would be another 8 minutes if I wanted spicy chicken and then it took another 12 mins for the spicy to be ready.
All this with no apologies.  

Not to mention bathrooms were gross

We started going to Browns not long after it opened here in the Park. We liked the feel of the place, the food was good and the best part for me, was  a decent gluten aware menu. I enjoyed the gf pizza there. I was very excited to see that a gluten aware fish and chips had been added to the menu. I had it in early May at lunch and loved it. So my hubby and I were there for dinner at the end of May  and I has the ga fish and chips again it was so yummy....and I was seriously glutened. It took me a few days to recover. I thought it was just a one off, so when my husband and I were there about two weeks ago I ordered their delicious gluten free pizza ( great thin crust). I have never had any issues with it before, ever...but guess what? Glutened again. It took me about five days to recover and now I am just staying away from Brown's. So if you have a gluten issue, be cautious. Maybe it is a change of kitchen staff..or just a relaxation on gluten aware prep...not sure., but I do not want to go through that again.
I did send them a note on their website. Just a heads up, as if this happened to me, it was probably bothering others as well. I have had no response.

Watied for quite some time at a deserted host desk before being greeted and shown to our seats by a young, seemingly indifferent, hostess. The all-you-can-eat salad bar has been removed. The service at the table was the highlight from Jan, our waitress.
Our food was OK for the price - I guess. But I also think it would take very little effort or expense to bring the caliber of the restaurant up a notch. Guest never want to hear the staff chatting amongst themselves as opposed to doing their jobs. Overall.... underwhelming and it will be quite a while before I go back.

I have to say how impressed I am with this location (especially with how disappointed I was with the south common location). The store has a huge diverse selection of decorations. In addition to having a few specific rows for Halloween Costumes, the rest of the store is filled with all different types of decorations.

I needed 80's decorations for my event and didn't want to order on line so I appreciated that the store shelves were stocked and I could walk out with everything that I needed. I also appreciated that when you buy balloons from them that you get them filled up for free in store.

It was super busy so if you just want to walk in and walk out with your balloons already done and not wait, then I would recommend making a pick up time for your balloons.

I went in about 3 different times for more options from this store and each time all of the staff was friendly and helpful (even when they were being treated disrespectful by a rather rude customer).

I will skip the frustration of the one in south common and make the trip here!

This is the world's worst dealership. They lied to get me to buy a car. Then when caught in the lie (after I bought the car based on their lie) they basically called me an idiot. Then the saleswoman admitted to lying. Then the management team did nothing but offer EXACTLY what I said (before I bought the car) that I did NOT want!!! They completely ignore AMVIC regulations and do not care about anything other than getting a sale and making customers feel terrible. DO NOT BUY ANYTHING FROM THESE CRIMINALS!!!

Brought some business associates from Italy here and our entire party loved their meals. The service was excellent and this place has done a complete 180 from when it was Rics. Best restaurant in Sherwood Park.

My husband and I have been here several times for rock chips and windshield replacements.  They consistently provide cheerful and helpful service.  Their work is great and they are very accomodating with scheduling and contacting third parties for warranty coverage.  It's always a pleasure dealing with them.

I ordered ginger beef (extra crispy and sauce), vegetable fried rice, egg roll and green union cakes.

The ginger beef was so mushy I feel like they let it soak in water for a day before packaging it up and sending it out. It has zero flavor, no extra sauce and was not even remotely crispy.  Mmmm mushy beef. Gross. 

The vegetable fried rice was cold and was packed full of mushrooms. 

What can I say about the egg roll. It was as terrible as the rest of the meal. It was literally dough for 7/8 of the entire roll. Mmm deep fried dough. 

The green onion cakes were wet and sweet. Disgusting. 

I have never had such a horrible experience at this restaurant, I called the manager and he gave me a $13 credit on my $40 bill. Thanks for nothing. I'll never be ordering from this company again, stay away!

If you want great deals on wine, beer and liquor, then look no further than any Costco Liquor Store. Sure their selection may not be on par compared to private stores, but their prices (cheap!) more than make up for the smaller selection sizes. They also carry their house brand of wines & spirits, which I am told are excellent for quality and price. 

Don't be afraid to stop here for your alcohol needs as you don't need to have a Costco membership to shop here!

Honestly I usually don't take time to review businesses but the service was so bad I'm making the time. 
The whole experience was far from adequate. The girl who provided my services (Bridgette) seemed catty and unprofessional to her colleagues. They were literally bickering over how to do my lashes. 
I asked for natural looking lashes to match my current lashes that I got at a high end lash bar in Calgary. Instead she made them long and too curled for my liking. The lashes immediately started falling off, my eyes had watered the whole appointment and I'm wondering if that's why. Instead of adjusting my eye pads so my eyes were not watering she just kept wiping it away. I've never had this issue and I'm a regular lash customer. (Not here, was visiting from out of town.) 
When I went to pay they tried to charge me more bcs I didn't have my previous set done there. I asked them why and they said well if the work is sloppy and we have to remove it then we charge more. I know it wasn't sloppy work, and I also know she didn't have to remove any, so I said so. They talked to the girl who did my lashes and she said they were fine so they were literally just trying to charge me extra. 
I've had the lashes for 5 days and I'm down to id day half of what she put on and they are poking in all directions and keep getting in my eyes. 
Biggest waste of money.

Front counter staff are the first and last point of contact at an establishment like a hair salon - which is exactly why it is CRUCIAL for these staff to be properly trained on how to handle unusual/difficult customer service situations.  I find all too often that front counter staff are pretty good at handling the day to day customer service interactions - throw a curve ball at them though, and, more often than not, they completely drop the ball!!!

I am currently growing out my hair and only require a trim and some touch ups every 2 months or so.  Since I absolutely love the more dramatic cuts and colourings I have received at Roxx, I didn't mind too much coughing up the $65 bucks for a trim to support a business who had been good to me thus far, so after procrastinating for way too long, I decided it was time for a trim.  On Friday morning I call them up to book an appointment for 4:45pm that day.

I work literally across the street from this place; so by the time I left work at 4:30 and got to Roxx it was 4:32.  I checked in (even mentioning that I knew I was a bit early) and then proceeded to take a seat (on the couch right in front of the front counter).  At about 4:45 or so, another lady walks in to check in for her appointment.  Immediately after she checked in, the stylist I ALWAYS am assigned to comes out, immediately recognizes the woman, and takes her to the back for her appointment.  Thinking nothing more of it than it being interesting that I wasn't getting the same stylist as normal, I continued to wait.

At 4:55pm (10 mins past my appointment time), I go up to the front counter staff to ask what the delay was - again keeping in mind I am sitting right in front of their faces so it's not like they didn't know I was STILL WAITING!  My question 
"soooo, is the stylist just running a little behind or.....?" took the young lady completely off guard as she immediately agrees with my assumption with a look of bewilderment on her face; "oh yes, just a bit late, shouldn't be more than another 5 mins."  I go back to sit, as the same lady walks past me saying "you know what, I am just going to check."

She comes back to tell me that it is going to be another 15 20 mins (keeping in mind it is already 15 minutes past my time).  At this point it was quite obvious that someone had screwed up somewhere along the line and the appointment scheduled for after me was taken before me.  This is not the problem - these things happen and I can understand that (being that I have worked in customer service my entire career so far).

The problem is that I am now completely frustrated that you had wasted my time when I would have loved to be anywhere but there on a sunny Friday afternoon.  An apology is nice, and she really did seem to feel bad.  But here's where it all went wrong:

Her: "Would you like to wait?"
Me: "No, I think I'm just going to cancel"
Her: Ok, would you like to re-book?"
Me: "No thank you"
Her: "Ok, well sorry about that."

Since I am not one to make a scene in these types of situations, I am quietly thinking 'Dammit, now I need to find a new hair salon."  Had the nice young lady come clean, told me that they had made mistake, and had she done something to make up for it (discount, no charge for the wash, anything......), I would have said, "yes, I'll wait" or "sure, I guess I'll just re-book for next week."  Instead, I will likely not be back.  

We have all heard the saying that actions speak louder than words; in this case, (im)proper customer service training speaks louder than a fancily decorated salon.
great place, friendly staff, kids love their haircuts
Does this look like light ice WTF      For the price of these drinks we don't need cups full of Ice

Recently just discovered that you did not have to have a costco membership to use the Costco Liquor Store. We are holding an engagement party for our friends this weekend and were told to go buy the liquor at Costco. Holy cow did we save money! Unfortunetly if you are not a big drinker it could take you a while to get a  bottle finished! I do not think many people would complain about that :)
Best barista ever award goes to.... BURK! This guy had my entire family laughing at the drive through. Great service.

By far the worst Chinese food I've ever eaten. Ordered dry ribs and they were extremely greasy and fatty. Chow mien had no flavour, it was extremely watery. Fried rice was mediocre at best,    it was very bland. Way over priced for the quality of food you get! I would never recommend them to a friend or order from them again.

Honestly the food was really good but it was only us, and another family in the restaurant and our food took forever to come, no one asked us how our food was and our server only came by to take our order and our payment. We didn't have water our whole meal, browns is usually great but this time it sucked

This is a review for the service department. The sales department I cannot speak to, and parts I cannot speak to. The service department has made this company categorically the worst business I have ever dealt with.  Their lack of accountability for their actions speaks volumes to their credibility and you should avoid them at all costs. 
In September 2015 I went in for routine service and an oil change. When I got my vehicle back, I noticed that the check oil light was on. Thinking it was just a sensor that they forgot to turn off, I continued to drive it. Wouldn't you know it, someone in their service department forgot to put oil back in! Do you know what happens to engines without oil? Yup, they seize! Considering the most material part of the oil change was missed, one would assume a very linear relationship of who is at fault. Sherwood Honda's service department was. You know who they tried to blame? My last oil change, because it wasn't 'dealer authorized'. They fought tooth and nail to keep from paying for the cost of a new engine. Only after I enlisted the help of my lawyer-dad did they finally agree to pay for a new engine. The total time spent without a vehicle in this instance was approximately a month. At that time, my vehicle was my only way to get to work and school, and the amount of apathy displayed by the team was staggering. 
Fast forward to May, 2018 - my car gets broken into and the front passenger window is smashed. Because Sherwood Honda's service department has scared me so badly about getting serviced at places that weren't "authorized", I genuinely feared  the repercussions of taking it elsewhere for this much-needed service.  I took the vehicle in to Sherwood Honda to get it replaced, which I was assured would be a breeze. I get it back at the end of the day, only to discover that they had broken the actuator in the door, making it so you can't unlock the door from the inside or outside. This was absolutely not the case prior to their service. As you might imagine, I did a real quick turn back into the office where I told them what I noticed. The service guy apologized profusely and said they'd be happy to get me in for another appointment sometime that week so they could fix what they fully acknowledged happened during the course of my service. I bring it back at 7:30 two days later, after they had indicated it would be a service I could just wait for. Yeah, definitely not the case! The line of communication with the service department went completely dead. Knowing how difficult they are to deal with, I had my dad follow up with them. He was told that because the service would be laborious, it would be at minimum another $450 to get these repairs done. Repairs that they had necessitated happen because of their negligent service. This is very akin to mob tactics. You want protection from us? It'll cost you! I am honestly astounded at the consistent level of inaction and dishonesty from the service department. My legal recourse is limited to civil courts, however in the event that a passenger is put in danger because of their negligence, let's hope that they don't get hurt, because hell hath no fury like a woman whose loved ones are endangered. 
In summary, if you purchase your vehicle from Sherwood Honda, beware the service department. Based on the amazing reviews of their sales team, it strikes me that all of the good customer service is limited to the sale. Once they have you as a customer (especially under warranty) they will treat you like subhuman filth.

Very good service the people working there is very friendly and nice, love this location, they always do excellent work on my windshield, so happy every time  I stop to get my windshield fix, will keep coming to this location!!!

My girlfriends and I went there for coffee and a cupcake to try a new place. The new owners (about a year) were very friendly and personable.The cupcakes we had were very good, I had the salted caramel,it was truly the best cupcake I've had. Coffee was good it was a Keurig I think, but I'm not sure. They also bake all kinds of cakes, birthday, shower, wedding made to order.  We sat at the little tables and had a very nice time. We'll be back.

I have gone here two times as my hairdresser had moved to this salon. I love the look and feel of this place. It creates a relaxed homey environment. I really love how all the hairdressers are friends with each other and they look like they are having so much fun at work. I also enjoy that all of the hairdressers will talk to me regardless if I'm their client or not. Jasmine and Mandy are both amazing hairstylists!

We come here regularly because the food is so good. If you want a drink and something to share, the loaded nachos are so tasty! The Thai chicken soup is incredible - I have gotten stuck on ordering the soup and salad because the flavour between the soup and the Cowboy salad is SO good. The owners/management at this location are great - the food and drinks are very consistent. The brunch is also a definite thumbs up - especially if you like eggs benedict.

Masks mandatory. 
Super clean, bright patio.  
Pleasant, efficient service. 
$5.00 pints and  deals on "bites" during the 3-6 happy hours.
I had a lovely, spicey tuna roll and a hoppy IPA.   Great pairing.
Nice attention to detail.   
I would recommend.

Great place if you want to deal with a huge headache.  Told Aladeen the used sale rep that I needed their CRV inspected third party. Aladeen said that he couldn't do it last minute no big deal.  I tell Aladeen that I booked SEVEN DAYS IN ADVANCE and that he can't get anyone here. The reason? "I'm sorry but we're to understaffed you have to understand blah blah blah".  This went on for two days. I call the manager, he says he can do it no problem THEN ALADEEN MESSAGES ME FIVE MINUTES LATER SAYING HE TALKED TO A MANAGER AND HE CAN GET IT IN... only if I can pick it up?  After all of this dealing over 5 days I pulled my deposit from them.  They are all full of miscommunication and are extremely lazy to make a sale.  I called five other dealerships and they had ZERO ISSUES AND ENCOURAGE THIS. I even called dealers in Red Deer and they had zero issues bringing it in.  Take your money else where as these guys are "to understaffed you have to understand" which was also told me by their manager.  Aladeen also offered me a job there as a passive agressive remark.

Best part was after Aladeen, talking to two managers asking why there is so much foot dragging financial calls me on Sunday asking me when I'm getting this car in for an inspection.  Sherwood honda has zero clue on how to communicate issues.  Don't give them your business. *finance was really quick to refund so at least that's a plus from these guys*

How come your service is never consistent some times you get bread to the table sometimes not. Calamari was very rubbery tonight and the order was only about 1/2 the  usual amount. And was charged 95 cents for extra horseradish.  Maybe next time it's the Keg!

My husband just had the "Bodyroxx Package" for a retirement gift (from me) - with the Bodyroxx scrub, 1 hour relaxation massage and the Roxx Signature Facial and he is "over the moon" with how good it was.  He is on "Cloud 9" and it looks like I picked a fantastic retirement gift for him.  It was about 4 hours in total and they treated him like gold and it was ultra professional and clean and wonderful he said.  HE LOVED IT!  Best he has ever had and he has been to some nice places.  A high end pamper gift.  Highly recommend this package and Roxx salon & spa!!!!!  Thank you Roxx and way to go!  Professional care and well conducted treatments and classy expertise is worth paying for!  THANK YOU!

I have to say I adore this little greenhouse even more after this weekend. Their pre-ordering site worked well, great phone chat with the greenhouse before explaining what to expect, amazingly quick response to curb side pick up once parked (I didn't even have mask on before she was at my window so the fast response almost spooked me!) and staff were super friendly and helpful to all I observed during my time there. 

I ordered 3 bags of a certain soil and 2 of another. By no means did I need to pick up on mother's day but it was the date that appeared first was available, so I had selected it. The lady who brought my order to my vehicle realized she grabbed the wrong combo before even loading and was off like a flash to correct it. The two plants were well selected (I couldn't have done a better job myself and I'm picky!). They also sweetly added an extra plant as a Mother's Day/thank you for supporting their business gift. 

For those that hadn't ordered ahead, they were standing good distances apart in line up outside the greenhouse (which the staff member mentioned is the first weekend they had their green house open but it's only half available). Carts were being wiped down before given to customers and staff seemed super on top of keeping the flow going. Kudos to the greenhouse and I hope you had a fantastic weekend!

Apparently they can't/won't do alignments on sports cars so don't bother asking (they told me to go to Kal-Tire....what in the ?!?!). Also, was told on the phone after asking if they could hookup a timing light and set the timing..... that Chris couldn't do it because my car had computer controlled timing and they can't help (which it does not..its over 30 years old. Called because they came highly recommended been around the Park almost as long as me and I happen to work nearby. The lady on the phone was not even close polite nor knowledgeable regarding the abilities and services of the shop. They can't do alignments and don't know much about basic timing on older vehicles. It appears to me they have no interest in new customers at this point and strictly rely on repeat customer base. All it takes is a "How can we help you? and a thank you or a can you please hold. Basic business phone etiquette. Also, all you need is a timing light (which aren't obsolete last time I checked).....an easy 10 minute job, charge an easy hour and gain a new customer.

I ordered sawmill on skip the dishes. I got there crab cakes and one of their pasta dishes. First the crab cakes were burnt all around, very bland, very mushy and had just a burnt taste to them. The pasta was okay but still lacked a lot of flavour and seasoning that could have helped it be better. I've heard bad things about sawmill and I now know why nobody really orders from there. I won't be purchasing again because the food was quite expensive and I wasn't able to enjoy eating it either.

This a small, cute little Ricky's. It's the smallest I've seen. From the start the staff was accommodating because we had a larger group - 5 and a baby. For this little location. That's a lot! 

We got a great table, they really made it work for us even though it was busy. The coffee then came quickly and we are looking forward to the food - which, come on, it's Rickys!! It's gonna be good :)

First time here with some family and nice!  Really liked the interior decor - creates a very homey, warm, inviting atmosphere with the lower color temperature lighting and woodwork throughout the space, nice comfy leather seating, a big glass (gas-powered?) fireplace in the back. 

The hostess was nice and waitress was great!  It was 'Destiny' (sorry for the pun lol)!

Our food was pretty delicious too - French onion soup, some virgin drinks, beef dip sandwiches & Korean BBQ chicken bowl 
Korean bowl a little on the saucy side but still inhaled it all haha  

I would like to come back again to try some moo-moo meat

The drive thru at this location is the worst. If you don't have minimum of 10-20 mins to wait for your order go to another Starbucks. Today 2 cars ahead of me. No idea what first in line got but one in front of me only ordered 1 hot beverage.  Took 9 mins from order until I drove off with my 1 refresher. 1 beverage 9 mins. Ridiculous. Worst Starbucks drive thru in Sherwood Park. Maybe it needs more employees I donno. The staff is always pleasant & order is always accurate so I'd like to give more stars. But the drive thru is sooooo slow.

I haven't been to lube City in years to get my oil changed. I have to say I was quite impressed after my most recent visit. The oil change was fast and efficient with good customer service. They even vacuumed out my front matts in my car while I waited in the lobby! I thought this was a really nice customer service perk especially when it's muddy and gross outside so my floors really needed it. They also send out coupons for $20 off of an oil change or $10 off new wipers. So if you watch your mail or your inbox they're bound to pop up and save you some cash! I'm not sure how typically busy this site is but I didn't have to wait at all to get my car in the garage. Good job guys!

My wife and I have been looking for a place that sells good pancit. A lady my wife works with who used to live in the Philippines recommended good buddy and said the flavours of the Special Cantonese Chow Mein were very close to the flavours of the pancit that her mother used to make.

The Special Cantonese Chow Mein, very good but not pancit (which is fine because Good Buddy was not selling it as pancit). It tasted no different than any other chow mein from any American Chinese chain restaurant. 

The green onion cakes again very good but not the best green onion cakes we've had in Edmonton, but if you are not heading to 118th Ave. for green onion cakes these will definitely curb the cravings.

They made an error in my formal quote, then Windshield offered to install at that price. I was booked when they emailed the day before the appointment and doubled the price. Which was even higher than OEM. I had another great offer which I lost in this process. Not happy at all with Windshield Surgeons. I will never deal with them again, I have done business with them in the past and won't use or recommend them to anyone.

I don't usually write a bad review unless I feel strongly about it. I booked an appointment for a hybrid full set of lashes. I'd been to Posh a few times prior and although I wasn't super happy, it was the only place I could get in with hardly any notice. The girl did take the time to ask questions about the look I was going for. 

One thing I stressed was that in my last appointment I had a volume set (and paid way too much for it) and that I didn't want that again. This time, I was looking for a more natural look - hence the hybrid. She asked if the length was ok in the past, I agreed it wasn't too bad. I stressed I felt like the volume set was just too thick and a little too "young" for my age. 

At the beginning she did mention some of girls have started their fall shed so I can expect the same. She was giving lengthy explanations of what she was doing and reiterated she prefers I tell her if something wasn't right rather than not saying anything. She began the work but at the end when I held the mirror up I was so very disappointed. It looked exactly like she took a fake set out of the package at the local drug store and glued the strip to my eyelids. Horrible! That's not natural. They were so curled it looked like the tips were attached to my eyelids as well. That's not natural. They looked like they were perfectly cut across the top with a pair of scissors. That's not natural either. There were zero lashes in the corners. That's not natThey were so thick and dark and stiff and they almost looked blue in the sunlight. I immediately told her I didn't like them at all (remembering she'd prefer to hear that) 

Instead of listening to me, she got very defensive and kept holding up a piece of paper saying they did this length last time. Always something about last time. Again, I wanted a natural look therefore a hybrid because I didn't want it to look like last time. 

I kept giving very valid reasons why I didn't like them. She simply said do you want me to take them off for you? I had another appointment after and declined. It was very evident of my dissatisfaction but she didn't care. I paid the $183.75 and when paying she came over and offered to remove them and lucky me, she wasn't even going to charge me!
