I don't think I should have paid for them at all. If she's only going to refer to a piece of paper and negate everything I say, then why bother asking questions? 

After leaving, I sat in my vehicle and cancelled my next appointment. Called my old lash business I went to for years (quit going cause it was too far after I moved) and explained my situation and my lash expert I had been going to for 5 years made some arrangements to book me in the next day. 

I immediately went back into Posh - less than 5 minutes later and told the girl I wanted the lashes removed. I was embarrassed leaving with them. All of a sudden she wasn't available to remove them. Someone else did it and I couldn't get them off quick enough. 

Never again! Just because you give lengthy explanations doesn't make you an expert. And acting defensive when a customer isn't happy doesn't make you a professional. 

UPDATE - I just read the owners review and am very disappointed to see it's full of inaccuracies and lies. I was NEVER told the lashes were going to be a repeat of what was done in the past. Not once. I was asked if I was pleased with the length, I recalled I probably was. There was absolutely ZERO discussion about curl, extra fullness or any of the the other claims made by the owner. Furthermore, there was NEVER an offer to have the fee waived. NOT ONCE. I would have have gladly taken them up on their offer if they had. They NEVER offered to redo them either. This reaffirms their lack of professionalism and the lengths they'll go, to take responsibility. It was only after I declined an appointment for a fill (in what they insisted had to be within a 2 week period) staring "I won't be back" that the technician came over with an attitude and said if I didn't like them she'd remove them. As I said in my review, I declined due to another commitment. Certainly no offers of any kind were made to me prior to paying. FALSE, FALSE, FALSE. After going to my vehicle and making alternate arrangements with my commitment, I did return to immediately have the lashes removed. In that span of a few minutes, the technician rescinded her offer. She was NOT with another client. She was actually folding towels at her station. I will GLADLY be contacting you to have my money refunded.
Terrible service. Spent 2.5 hours and saw a waitress once. Not impressed.  Hockey game on but no excuse. Place wasn't packed. Probably because of the poor service.

I am a lover of good Saigon style food and this place is definitely the best in Edmonton. 

They offer a massive selection of dishes, and many can be made gluten free (which makes the dish CHEAPER!) and the portion sizes are definitely edequate for what you pay. 

They offer delivery through skip the dishes, so you can be ultimately lazy and get it delivered to your door, which I love for these cold nights. 

Make sure you try their tofu curry, even if you don't like tofu it will rock your world.
Had to get a chip fixed. Called got in straight away. It took about 15 minutes and was $35.00. Great service and great job. Would highly recommend.

Service is horrible. Took them 20 mins to get a menu and to asked me what drinks I wanted. It's a family members birthday to day and I told the waitress, she said "k".... It's someone's birthday and they say "k"!!! Such disrespect I cannot believe the behaviour of the staff here. I really hope the manager sees this and makes some serious changes.

Needed a windshield for my 2008 Expedition Max. Andrew and his team were excellent! Took a bit to find the right windshield but the boys were excellent in problem solving. The service is efficient, fast and impressive.  Definitely THE place to go! All issues resolved appropriately and professionally. Received protective coating on new windsheild, best thing ever!!

Cute little cafe in Sherwood park! If you're going to go, get the London fog! Best one I've had anywhere! Other than that, they just have basic sandwiches for Starbucks prices. Still a cute place though!

Great salon!
Excellent stylists

Sales staff were friendly and informative at first... 

I found an excellent car that I wanted. Thought the deal was going well.

My biweekly payments were over $50 more than initially quoted. I said "no deal" and requested my deposit back. 

Instead, I was trapped in a finance associates office and berated for not knowing the deal before I came. Fair enough, but I was told "your payment may go up a little". Does $50 biweekly seem like a little? 

Anyway, I finally managed to escape with my deposit. They tried every slimy sales tactic to make me feel bad or that I was being unreasonable. 

Don't go here! I ended getting an excellent deal at Toyota Northwest!

Great tasting food at a cheap price. The decor is dated but the staff is friendly and attentive. I would highly recommend this restaurant as a dine in or take out option. A hidden gem in Sherwood Park!

Got my appointment within a few days. Replaced my windshield.  2 days later got a rock chip  but also heard and could feel a slight wind coming from the corner of the windshield.  Went back , they fit me in immediately. Fixed my windshield and fixed the rockchip for free. They were apologetic for the inconvenience.  Yes I would recommend this location and the prices were a little bit cheaper other places in the city.

Jus an update on Browns. The gluten free menu has been updated and the kitchen is doing a much better job of keeping gf gf. Though the gf menu choices are much fewer I have eaten here lately and not had any issues or repercussions. Grateful for this as this restaurant has a friendly atmosphere and is close to home.

Picked up a nasty rock chip on the Yellowhead and called Frasier at Windshield Surgeons right away. He booked me in and after I arrived, got my car right in. We both inspected the bullseye and he gave me the price. 20 mins later, job done. He even replaced the old piece of tape on my key fob!  And then asked me if I worked anywhere and gave me a Corp discount!  Less than $25 for the repair compared to my last chip fix by those guys with the tent in the parking lot, at $100. I will definitely go back!!

I have taken multiple Vehicles here over the years and I've always had a great customer experience. In person or on the phone I've always been treated well and had my questions answered. I find the mechanics do good work and are always upfront with me. The pricing is honest and has come in under what they quoted me for initially at times. It can be difficult to find a good mechanic place that you can put your trust in and I'm happy to recommend this shop to anyone!

They Wowed Me! 

So this was not my first time shopping for a car, as a matter of fact I have spent many years selling and on the inside of auto dealerships so I had a pretty good idea of what to expect. 

I stopped by Park Mazda to see how they played the game; I have been through the lot before but never with the thought of making a purchase. This time it was top of my mind as I had done all my homework and knew what I wanted and what I was willing to pay for a new Mazda 3. 

First thing when I pulled up was someone came out and greeted me, that is exactly what I was hoping for. It was Chris Anhill and I very much appreciated it. Many think it is too pushy when they come out, but to me this said professional, courteous with a welcome to Park Mazda greeting, made me feel comfortable. 

We started talking and I explained to him my goal for that day as I had figured it out before I went in and I was determined to get it set up that way. I was after a lease, but I wanted to trade a vehicle with negative equity off on the new car. He was unsure if it could be done but he asked someone else to look into it as we went for a ride in the new car. The Mazda 3 was everything I had read about in reviews, a nice solid little car that would get me around comfortably and with very little fuel expense. 

We returned to the dealership and I confirmed this was the car I would want, we sat down and wrote up the deal and I told him I was pre-shopping for my wife, as this would be done in her name and I just wanted to know if it was possible. He was unable to get the answer right away and said he would call me when he had knew.

Later that day he called, confirmed it and even gave me a good number.
I set up an appointment for my wife and I to return and make the deal. 

We arrived for the appointment we had set and she took the vehicle out for a short drive while his manager confirmed numbers on our trade. 

It got a bit dicey here but He was able to hold it together. The number they came up with on the trade was quite a bit shy of what we were told. I don't blame them for this as anyone would do the same, after all the car business is about making money. 

We came to an agreement and it wasn't much longer until we finalized the deal with the Finance Director, Pat Sawa. He was great and in the end we drove away happy, with a great car and a good feeling as though everybody won. It was all low pressure but constant forward motion. In the end the time spent at the dealership was minimal and while we were there all staff treated us great. I would recommend Park Mazda to anyone.

Good option for Dim Sum in Sherwood Park

Recently stopped by after a nearby eye doctor appointment.   We were well past the lunch rush, we didn't get there til almost 2:30pm and the restaurant was fairly empty except for two other tables.

We opted for dim sum, the dim sum menu has a good variety of selections with all the usual favourites. There were only two of us so we ordered 7 dishes. All were of good quality and fresh tasting. Service was very efficient, extremely polite and attentive. Food quality wise, I think this location is a bit better than their Northgate restaurant location. 

Based on this meal, we will probably check it out for dinner some evening.   Thank you folks for a great late dim sum lunch today

The coffee here is great there's no doubt about it, the food is pretty good too. It is quite pricey - and I've usually found the wait to be a little long too. It definitely caters to more of the "hipster - coffee elitist crowd" which there's nothing wrong with that - but as a person who will nurse the same cold cup of McDonald's coffee all day that's not how I would describe myself.  Even though I live close by this place just really isn't in my rotation unless someone else suggests it.

Went to bring my adult kids here today and it was a neat vibe. A Smaller low key place. Order meal at the entrance and they bring it to you. I wanted the yogurt bowl but they  didn't have yogurt and it was the first item on their menu!  However I had the french toast with banana and choc drizzle and whip cream. It felt better as they used grainy bread.  Also there was two egg Benedict's and a pulled pork bowl. Everyone enjoyed their meal. I won't say the meals are really big but just enough. Cost was $15 per meal more or less. 
Plus two nice looking hot chocolates. Check the pics. 

I liked it but didn't feel I got good value for my meal as I paid the $70 bill. I could tell the guys could have eaten a little more.

Most of the people that work here are unhelpful and rude even the manager is rude. My boyfriend and I have both been here multiple times and have never had a good experience. From being told that "we would only be saving two dollars more" when we were angry that they didn't suggest or tell us they had a sale on balloons to the manager coming up to me and giving me trouble for my son being loud . He's 3.

Overall: an enjoyable sit-down experience in the mid-range of price, clearly managed by a family.

Atmosphere: 4/5 Comfortable, and with a typical Japanese layout.

Staff: 5/5 Attentive and professional.

Food: 5/5 Fresh, flavourful, and well cooked.

My friend brought her car in for some  warranty work. She asked for the number to Honda Smart care and was given a number to a sex hotline!!!  When she brought forward this issue she was told by the manager that all they could do waa write he employee up who gave her the number..  she left in tears and feeling degraded ..  what an aweful way to be treated.  This behaviour is unacceptable and needs to be taken more seriously then just " writing the employee up"...

Great sushi and reasonably priced. Service was alittle slow but the food made up for that. Between two we shared:
Tuna and salmon sashimi (14 pc) was fresh, large pieces and great quality cuts of fish, we ate that up sooo fast! 
We also tried the new style, lobster king and oilers rolls and these where delicious! All of the rolls had 8 huge pieces. Each roll had such a wonderful pairing of flavours and did not disappoint at all. 
We rolled out of there stuffed and will be back!

I'll start by saying that my very first job over 30 years ago was being a busboy at the original sawmill on gateway blvd. Sawmill used to be a high end steak and prime rib house and it was a treat to dine there. Fast forward to now and the SHERWOOD park location which is a franchise location. It used to be decent a few years back but in the last few years it has gone down hill. My wife got a gift card for them so thought we'd give them another shot. We both ordered the prime rib dinner. The veggies were okay but the prime rib itself, although still slightly pink in colour, felt like a piece of leather when cutting it with my steak knife. It was dry and opposite of tender. When the waitress came around and asked how dinner was I told her it was meh. She did ask if there was something she could do but what can she do? No manager came around to apologize and nothing was done with my bill. I paid, tipped her my 15% as it wasn't her fault for the crappy food, and that will be the last time I step foot into that restaurant again. For them to call themselves a steak and prime rib house, they need to get their quality up a few notches. Now I know why Joeys is my go to as they are always so much more consistent.

Great service compared to the south side location. I live in the south side and my parents and I always take the extra drive to Sherwood Park because of the service here. So friendly and attentive, also free dessert!

They got our order wrong. We ordered a $29 dollar plate of special sushi for take out.  You can imagine our disappointment when we got home to find it was an entire order of sashimi!  We had a commitment so couldn't return it. Yes the receipt said sushi. Check your order before you leave.  So disappointed. And some of the sashimi fish was very chewy, couldn't bite through it.

I love Popeyes chicken so much. Ever since they came to Fort Saskatchewan, I haven't even thought about getting KFC. The chicken is always so fresh and deliciously crispy. The sides are really good too. There is sometimes a bit of a wait for the chicken, but I would rather wait for something that is deliciously fresh, than something that has been sitting under hot bulbs for hours. Sometimes I get a craving for Popeyes and almost nothing can stop me from getting some. I love the spicy chicken with hot sauce. The spicy chicken itself isn't too spicy at all. The only thing I haven't been too crazy about are the biscuits, but many people seem to like them too.

Called Frasier he booked me in the same day. I showed up late like a horrible person and he still took me in even though he was seconds from closing!  Super sweet fellow, easy to talk to, quick on the job. Not my first rock chip he fixed.. I had a honker the size of a marble when he was done his magic it was the size of pebble of sand! Reasonably priced I refuse to go anywhere else same with my family.

This is our favourite sushi place in Sherwood Park. The rolls are delicious and the service is fast and very friendly. The prices are reasonable. The only reason I didn't give 4 stars is because we like to go for lunch and none of the lunch deals are vegetarian, so I have to order off the regular menu.

This isn't so much a review for McDonalds because it's McDonalds, we all know what we're going to get for the most part. I have been enjoying ordering fast food through their apps or through third party apps like Skip, Uber Eats, etc. Sometimes there are ingredients I don't know they have and using the apps I can get my food made the exact way I want it made, GAME CHANGER!
This is the slowest fast food restaurant I've ever been to. The only bonus is that at least the food is hot when you finally get it. It's a 10 minute wait in the drive through every time.
Really nice mall with a Safeway, the hugest Indigo I have ever been in, and a variety of smaller stores as well as a food court. While not huge, there is a good variety of stores.

Such a beautiful location and ambiance, I'm shocked that the service didn't reflect that.
I went here as a escape before my wedding. It was a surprise for my future husband! we needed just a relaxing day just the two of us. What a better way than at one of the most beautiful spas in Sherwood park?..... I was wrong!

We had a service in the private couples room. I even upgraded so that me and my husband could get a Facial, Pedicure, and Massage

It started off with the girls taking us to the room, asking a few questions about our skin for the facial... and then they left. my husband and i where confused as to where to put our clothes or what they wanted us to wear during the facial. we discovered the lockers, Half of the locks didn't work. then got into the beds. I had explained to the girls that we were getting married in a few short days and not to use anything strong or with Camphor in it because I have skin allergies to it. Half way through it felt like my face was going to burn off! i couldn't even tell her because i had to keep my mouth closed from the massive amount of product she put on! it was even running into my ears! The facial "massage" was little to none and she barely touched my face .and after all this i asked my husband how his facial was, he told me that the girl he had was watching the other girl because she didn't know what she was doing. she would stop and start constantly. *sigh*

The pedicures were ok. Ive definitely had better ones. There's only 2 things I liked was the scrub, and when I asked my esthetician if it was available for purchase, she said that it's professional use only.... oh well, and the chocolate strawberries and champagne. I had gel toe nails on so i asked for a longer massage, then me and my husband would be done at the same time. still  i was done 10 - 15mins before him. *sigh* and unfortunately that was the better of the services 

I had faith for the massage! and it was crushed...
I said i wanted to relax because we are so busy with our wedding. oh my goodness did I learn a lesson. Do not talk to your massage therapist if you want a quiet massage. She talked the WHOLE TIME! the other massage therapist was so quiet and mine just wouldn't stop. I couldn't enjoy my service. and my husband complained as well.

I don't think I will go back. We were married in September and it took me this long to cool down and write this. But i want to warn other brides/ customers of the experience we had

I had discussed test driving a 2019 Mazda 3 with Jesse. I drove 30 minutes to this location just to be told by the salesperson that the vehicle was unavailable because it was up on the hoist. I am very disappointed with the lack of professionalism from this location as it's literally not at all hard to text or call your customer to let them know.
The salesperson seem to be apathetic at the fact that I was dissatisfied and he didn't care to apologize. 
Do not go here to buy a vehicle.

I recently came to Sherwood Honda from another dealer on the West end of Edmonton. The West end Go Honda was not honouring my Honda battery warranty.

I sat down with the service manager and shop foreman who were both very approachable. They honoured my Honda battery warranty and I had my rear brakes and rotors done last month. 

Looking forward to a lasting relationship.

You gotta book with Jasmine!! I've been going to the factory for years and jasmine has never disappoints!  She colours are always perfectly blended.  I also like that she lets me know if my hair goal will damage my hair or take a long time to achieve.  She really is a hair wizard.

Ric's grill is known for its ambiance, food, and price. I have to say it only gains its accolades in one out of those three areas. I have only been to this location, as opposed to others in the Edmonton area, but both times I have been here I have walked away disappointed. First of all, it is very dark. While I do enjoy sharing a meal with my significant other in a romantic setting, this restaurant was overkill. I could barely see my food, let alone the person I was with! As for the food, I cannot imagine how they justify the prices in comparison to the quality. I suggested my boyfriend celebrate his birthday here with a group of close friends, and almost every single person was disappointed with the quality of their meal. My steak was subpar to say the least. The vegetables were limp and the potatoes looked as if they came straight from a grocery store box. Definitely not what I was expecting when I saw the menu, nor the outrageous prices they were charging!

However, there was one highlight of my most recent visit. The lounge had some excellent selections, and I, as well as the others with me, enjoyed the cocktails. I tried one of the specialty martinis and it was delicious. I only wish I had spent more money at the lounge and less on the disappointing food.

Poor customer service and terrible work. I dropped off a bracelet to be fixed and was told it would be 2-3 days. A week later I called to inquire and no one knew what was going on or called me back. I called every few days and still nothing. Finally I'm told it'll be ready at noon. I drive in at 12:45 and still not ready, but it'll be ready that afternoon and they'll call me. Of course no call (they never once called to update me on the status of it). Finally I got fed up and picked it up almost a month later. They had scratched my bracelet and reversed the magnets so they were repelling each other. So I got my bracelet returned in worse shape. The owner didn't seem even slightly bothered when I told her the lack of communication and disrespect from their company. 

Go to faithful jewellers if you need jewelry fixed. They're knowledgeable, respectful to your items and care about their customers. They've been a breath of fresh air in comparison to the joke of Gem Gallerie.

I am a graduate this year, & because of covid-19 a normalized graduation was taken away from us. Browns created such an amazing experience for us who are graduating. The food was amazing as well as the staff. They decorated the place beautifully & we had tons professional pictures taken for us. Thank you so much to everyone who contributed.

I love the atmosphere in this restaurant, very high class without the snobby attitude you get at some higher end dining establishments. 
I like to bring clients here as it has a layout that is not overly noisy and some great options on the menu for any appetites.
The staff are second to none as far as how they take care of you, they are a great part of the whole ambiance of the place. 
After being introduced to this place a few years ago I try to come whenever I get the chance, entertaining clients almost feels like an excuse to come here, but I know for sure they won't be let down. A bad experience at a restaurant can make a big deal go sour quickly. This place you never have to worry about that, they are consistently far above average. 
I recommend the rack of lamb when you come, its a crowd pleaser! Enjoy!!!

Seems every other time I get service here they refuse to wash my car but other times they do...once my warrantee is up I'll be happy never to come here again. Terrible service, inconsistent, and inconvenient.

This is a great little shop with great cupcakes. Staff is friendly, cupcake flavours are delicious and fresh. 

Just recently discovered that they also offer Gluten-Free cupcakes, so I will definitely be buying these for my upcoming birthday.

We bought a brand new Accord in January.  The salesman was really nice, the finance guy was a complete idiot.  He wrote down my husband's income as being a tenth of what it is so the application was declined.  Instead of looking over the application and thinking something was odd, he told my husband he would need a co-signer to complete the application.  My husband told him there was no way that could be possible, we have amazing credit and he makes a lot of money, and the finance guy argued with him.  When the finance guy finally agreed to look over the application again, he realized his mistake and we were approved.  

The same idiot processed the contract with my husband's wrong birthday, wrong e-mail address and wrong mailing address.  I didn't realize the mistakes until we were driving home (we live 30 minutes away from the dealership) and when I called them to tell them about the mistakes they freaked out and said they needed it fixed asap.  We refused to go back because they had already wasted hours of our day to buy this vehicle so they couriered the documents to us to get signed.  They then called twice a day every day until they received the amended documents, because they had sent us the originals and couldn't process the sale until they got it back.

From that point on, our e-mail address and mailing address were incorrectly entered in their system.  It took FOUR separate requests to get them to change it.  Each of those times they told me they had made the change and when I called back to confirm it still hadn't been made.

Fast forward to now, four months later.  We had (stupidly) bought the oil change package, thinking it was a good deal so I brought the car in to get the oil changed for the first time.  They only have my husband's name listed on the account and I asked them to add mine since I'm the only one who will be bringing the car in for service.  The desk person assured me she'd make the change right away.  

When my car was done, my husband's name is called.  Of course they didn't change the information like they said they would!  It also turns out the tires need to be balanced and the air filter needs to be changed but they didn't even give me the option to have that done while the oil was being changed, they just told me after the fact!

I'm stuck going there for oil changes because we paid for five years of them, but if anything else needs to get done I'm taking it to a different Honda dealership.

Reviews!  
I've not done enough reviews to match the number of check-ins I've made during COVID season 
Nows a good time as any to break the chain and form new habits!

Lovely little jewellery store in a mini strip mall area just inside Sherwood Park.  Totally didn't notice the sign by the door about having to get buzzed inside the second door haha...  (probably to maintain max # of people in store for restrictions) 

I was immediately greeted upon entering, and although the space is quite compact the setup is still great!  Lots of shiny sparkly things to lay eyes upon 
Jacqueline was able to point me quickly to what I was searching for and hot darn I'm so glad I went!  The items I had in mind where from American online sellers, and there on the counter was exactly what I was thinking of buying, but now it's there, it's cheaper, AND it's local!
Super excited for the available selection, and also the costs of each type - colourful & fun or sleek & sexy 

Thankfully I was referred there by another company - Get It Laser Engraved - so now I can support 2 local places!  Buy blank jewelry from one and get it engraved at the other. Win-win for everyone 
(Thank you Stephen from GILE!)
We have bought two raspberry plants from here and have been amazed how much faster they have grown than any other raspberries. They were huge and fruit bearing the first year.

The nice lady behind the counter made me a roast beef sandwich. The roast beef was appropriate for sandwich eating purposes as it would pull apart when you bit into the sandwich rather than getting pulled out of the sandwich. 

The salad that accompanied my sandwich was delicious. 

This place has a neighbourhood cafe vibe and there were plenty of people meeting up with friends and family.

I love Popeyes! Sometimes there is a bit of a wait - but it is always worth the wait. Their chicken blows KFC out of the water. The breading is fantastic and I love their choices of dips! I usually get my meals with mashed potatoes (so good) and biscuits! And I always have to get an extra biscuit because they are so good!!

Going to Popeyes is always a special treat!

Nice restaurant. Atmosphere and decor were nice. Went later in evening and no issue finding table or being served quickly. 

We ordered Pad Thai and wonton soup which were both quite good. 

We had popped in for a beer and were disappointed by the standard mega corporate brew beer menu. Nothing brewed in Alberta. The "rotating tap" was Coors Banquet.  Usual attempts at promoting faux crafts beers that are owned by giant corporations. Uninspired and completely uninteresting beer list. 

Not bad by any stretch but come here if you enjoy your standard big box cookie cutter eateries.

I bought my used ridgeline here about 5 years ago. Salesman was nice and it was a relatively stress free transaction. I originally got all service work done here but then I started taking it to another dealership closer to me in 2017. After just servicing my truck, I brought it to sherwood to diagnose a check engine light. They tried to upsell me for about $3,700 of service when I just did a $900 service 500kms ago at the other Honda dealership (in which my truck passed the inspection with flying colors)The staff are friendly and they do complete the work well, but beware they will try to get you to pay for extra service work to be done that is not required. Also, don't expect to be able to wait, they are busy and it takes time for them to do the service.

This review is from New Year's Day. One of the first tables in the restaurant, quickly ordered brunch and coffee (there were two of us). We both had about 4 coffee refills each until we had to ask what was taking the food so long. The waitress appologized saying there was only two cooks in the kitchen and they were working on it. The food finally came an hour and a half after ordering. It tasted fine, we ate it. The manager came by apologizing and again said there were only two cooks in the kitchen along with another excuse about something not working well in the kitchen. Although it wasn't necessary (but would have been nice- since we had to wait so long) to be offered maybe free coffee, perhaps a mimosa while we waited, or even a promise that the next time we came back to let them know so they could "wow" us: but they did not offer anything- we payed and left. I contacted the store about this feeling a bit frustrated after thinking about spending almost two hours in the restaraunts for some eggs Benedict. The manager said all they could offer would be maybe a $5 gift card if I "wanted" to return, really an apology is all I wanted, but I didn't get one of those.

It's not the money.. it's the integrity. A gesture would have been nice. But instead all I got was excuses. It was a poor experience, and I will not be taking their $5, as I won't be back.

Have to shout out good service when you get it. 

They don't get a lot of love because it's McDonalds but I have to say, I get coffee every morning from the McDonalds on Kaska and I am guessing he is the General Manager (man usually working the first window of the drive thru in the morning), he is always, at least when I am there, in a great mood and wishing everyone a fantastic day. It's nice, usually we just get pushed through those lines like cattle and little to no emotion is shown. 

Anyway, I wanted to shout them out as I have a great experience every morning.

I think this place is over rated and over priced. I have been here a few times now and I honestly think that the food is just meh to ok. More than once now out silverware/dinnerware has had spots on it and particles of food stuck on it. The service was very slow and not that friendly too.  I'm never coming back here again.

I bought a used 2014 jeep grand Cherokee from here about 2 months ago or so, felt like they worked very hard to get me what I wanted as I was not living in Alberta at the time and my previous vehicle had broken down for good.

After completing the purchase .. few days of driving noticed that the horn wasn't working, back trunk latch wasn't fixed like I had requested and my coolant resovior was below the add line.

I went home and referred back to the mechanical assessment and like I had remember everything had a check mark beside it.

I called the dealership and let them know what was going on, brought the vehicle down the next day

The finance manager derian had told me they must of forgot to re connect the horn when they were hooking up the GPS to pass inspection. Which wasn't true later on told the end connecters were just corroded, so this was something that wasn't verified. 

They topped up the coolant resovior, now I'm about 4 weeks from that date my resovior is completely empty, vehicle has been leaking coolant tho whole time there is a part that is broken. But yet passed on inspection

Terrible experience with this dealership would not suggest this place to anyone.

 Posted this on google originally but was deleted almost immediately.

Sherwood Park Ricky's : Had lunch today with my wife. (Retirees) My wife's baked onion soup was sour like vinegar. I tasted it as well and we sent it back. Replaced with the tomato bisque which was OK. No real apology for serving something like that which could have made my wife sick. The teriyaki stir fry had broccoli that had see it's better days. My 1/2 lb burger was overcooked & dry. No I won' t be going back to that restaurant for what they charge. We expect delicious food. Service was so /so as well.
After having to cut my ring off my finger at home, I had Gem Galleries fix it. They did a beautiful job and it looks brand new. Very happy with the service as well, very friendly!

There website says full head highlights for $100. I called in to see if that was accurate, they said it would be about $100. I let them know that I was only willing to pay $110 max but could look at other salons if they weren't able to do. They assured me that would be the price. I walked out paying $185.00. I expressed my shock and frustration to the receptionist who kind of just laughed it off and said she would talk to the person who booked it (as if that would change the price or help me out in anyway?). What if I had just brought in $120 cash or something? Luckily I had my debit. I felt terrible because the girl who did my hair did a good job on the colour but struggled to give her a $20 tip on top of the $165. Of course it wasn't the stylists fault. I had another place I could have gone for $100. $165 isn't "about" $100, its almost $200. I have pretty average blond hair. It didn't take an extremely long time so there was no excuse that it cost almost double what it should have. I was so disappointed because I really needed to stick to that budget and they didn't apologize or offer any sort of reimbursement. I feel like they should have offered to let me pay what there website advertised and what they confirmed over the telephone twice. Definitely can't go there again if this is their common practice. The little laugh and muttering sorry of the reception was definitely not appreciated. I understand she was in the middle of her homework, but she was working and she could have done something and gotten a manager. There was secondary receptionist who did absolutely nothing and there was no one waiting so it's not like they were really busy and couldn't work on a solution.

The service department is horrible and seem to not care about your issues and will only try to suggest bandage solutions to get out of finding the underlying issue. Our new 2016 vehicle has been having issues with the battery being drained and dying after leaving the car for only 3 days max. It has had the battery replaced twice already and they insist that nothing is wrong. The advisors, specifically Carolynn and the service manager (Martin Brown) told us that we should just drive the car/go for joyrides or invest in a charger which is ridiculous because why should we have to waste more time in our already busy lives or spend more money than we have to. We told them that the car is driven for at least 30 mins one way to get to work, but their reply was it should be a longer trip which blows my mind because I am not taking a detour or leaving earlier for work, which makes me wonder if they actually know what they are talking about. I have never ever heard of having to do these ridiculous things especially on a new car and no one that I asked has either, yet only Honda insists that this is solution and won't do anything about it. Also, when we were sold this vehicle, we were promised many things such as car washes and to date they have only done this the first time we brought the vehicle in. I strongly recommend not purchasing a vehicle here or visiting this location because you will waste your time and get talked down to.

Probably the best customer service I have ever received at any Starbucks ever. I normally don't go to Starbucks for coffee as it's a little pricy but my wife and I really wanted to try the Irish Cream Americano which was very good. 

The person (wish I would have got her name) that was working drive thru gave us the best customer service I have ever received. It took awhile to make the coffees but because she was delightfully having a conversation with us it didn't feel like we waited long. 

For all Starbucks fans I would strongly recommend this location.

Cheap.
Bulk.
Liquor.
Need I say more?
Kirkland brand makes some quality spirits.
Many big labels in big bottles at good prices!

Depends on who you get.  The girls at the counter didn't seem to be informed.  Asked for a men's haircut. They said the rate depends on the girl.  They sent me to who was available who happened  to have a cheaper rate.  And she did a terrible job.  Two weeks later I noticed I kept playing with the hair along my ears.  I noticed she did not trim it.  It was driving me nuts so I booked with my regular stylist elsewhere and she said it was a bad haircut.  That was $30 down the drain.  I wonder if they don't screen staff? Have them do a men's and women's cut before hiring.

Something has gone wrong with what used to be a fine Japanese restaurant. The prices are up and the quality is way down. Service is slow and not friendly at all, until it's time to pay the bill and suddenly it's all smiles in a last-minute attempt to get a good tip. 

I gave this place one more chance than I should have, because it's close to where I live and I didn't want to give up on it. At my last visit, however, hoping things might have improved, I was greatly disappointed. The sushi made me sad. The sushi itself was sad. Overall experience ... just sad.

Hadn't been to Cafe Haven for a while. A friend and I checked it out on Sunday for their brunch/lunch. My friend ordered a latte and their fruit bowl which comes with toast. It looked really good. There was tons of fresh cut fruit topped with granola and seeds. It also comes with a side of toast. I ordered a sticky chai. They call it that as they use a special honey when they make it. It was magnificent. I also had a side Caesar salad and spinach dip. Just for mine it was over $30. Everything tasted great but I do find the prices are quite high. They do have a fair bit of seating but it definitely fills up fast. There's usually always a line ordering things. After you place your order, they give you a number tag and deliver your food/drinks to you. Our food ended up coming out before our drinks. It's definitely a cute place to check out. Nice to have something different than the "usual" coffee joints. Just know that being local, you will pay that price for it!

My colleague and I were in need of a washroom and a great iced coffee so what better place to stop at than Starbucks to order 2 coffee Frappuccinos.  They make the best! It was refreshing and needed in a Friday afternoon.  I get mine made with coconut milk and it's got just the perfect balance of sweetness.  

I'm always pleased to stop at a Starbucks to use their facilities.  They are typically very clean.  Today was no exception the washrooms were very clean and our order took no time at all.  

This location is pretty nice great big windows and a nice patio.

I ended up to this Party City because the one in the city didn't have what I needed.  But, boy it was worth the drive.  I phoned to make sure they had the helium tank I needed and not only did they have it, they put it at the front counter so I didn't have to hunt for it when I walked in.  This store was bigger than the one in South Common and the staff was nice.  They said hello when I came in and then when I said I drove in from the city from this ONE item and wouldn't it be nice to get a discount (half jokingly since it was already on sale) she said sure and gave me a percentage off.  So, despite the 20 minute drive I left happy and with money left in my pocket.  Who can ask for more than that?

As a kid growing up in Sherwood Park, my folks would always take us out to the original Sawmill on Calgary Trail whenever we had family in from out of town.
I used to love it.
Perhaps due to my tastes changing, and certainly due to my experiences increasing...none of the Sawmill's excite like they used to.
Backstory aside...
I was so excited to have a Sawmill come to Sherwood Park.
Reallity...it's "OK".
It no longer feels special.
It's just another franchised eatery which is no better or really worse than any other Sawmill..Keg, Earls, Red Robin or even BP's for that matter. It is now just another option in the revolving list of "where should we go tonight" when fast food is out, and price is of moderate concern.

Great and friendly staff but stopped in for an oil change and it took 1 1/2 hours!!! Thats ridiculous! Also got 3m tape put on and they didnt even do everything they told me they were going to and still charged me full price. When asked they just said they didnt know what happened and couldnt help us. Not impressed!!

Great when delivered...restaraunt itself leaves something to be desired.  Staff is very friendly.
Dim Sum all great so far (all be it a little pricey).
My family's Chinese of choice for delivery in Sherwood Park.

So I popped in to see Jacqueline the other day, I had not been in the store for years. I forgot what and amazing place it was, so many shiny things to look at. While I was there I watched as she helped a very nice lady with a damaged bracelet she brought in, she also took her rings and cleaned them while they were waiting, customer service done right. 
I was eyeballing some bling myself, and asked about the process to make things. She explained it all to me, not as easy as most people think, and they can do custom work so others don't have the same thing. I do love to be different! 
Looks like I found a sweet little local place to do business, and Jacqueline is such a bright shiny gem herself, a bundle of personality.

I arrived at popeyes chicken in fort cask and the place was not busy at all. So I ordered a Chicken burger, the bun was still frozen in the middle and the tomato on was dead as if it had been sitting int he fridge for a couple of days and as for the Chicken breast it was less than a quarter inch in thickness and about the size of a small fist.  Very poor and I took in back 2 times to complain about it and was told that there was nothing they could do....

We had such a great time here. Super friendly wait staff and excellent service. The food is very good. There were five of us and we each had a different appetizer and a different meal. All were excellent. Very tasty and great portion sizes. But the main thing here is the true ability to socialize with our group. The music is in the background but at a volume that allows the patrons to converse with each other and not yell. Overall a very pleasant atmosphere and good food.

Trendy little spot...
Finally got an opportunity to scratch this place off my list.
Stopped in with my kids for brunch on Sunday.
Not too shabby.
Kids had bagels and I had to give the Eggs Benedict a shot. Decided on the salmon incarnation. 
Flavor was great...but something in the dish seemed to chill the entie thing down. Perhaps this was by design. I am not entirely sure. Chilled salmon on warm english muffin with cooked eggs? Regardless I wasn't expecting it and gave the whole thing a feeling of egg/sushi-fusion. The accompanying hash browns were tastey.
We also indulged in a brownie and a huge chunk of my personal kryptonite..beanut butter-marshmallow square. Both were indeed good.
All in all...not bad. Not amazing.
The hipster feeling and missmatch of furniture including couches and armchairs is allright I suppose.
All told, my main, 2 bagels, a coffee, a hot chocolate and the 2 desserts came to ~$45. A little pricey, but not terrible.
I may just be back if my schedule and theirs align again. If only for a "healthy" dose of kryptonite...

I used to love coming here on my lunches or going out to dinner with my family and grabbing some food, but after our last few experiences I truly believe this place has gone downhill. 

I don't know if they went under new ownership or something happened but they don't seem to care nearly as much about the quality of food they're putting out. 

The rolls fall apart or they're just straight up getting our takeout orders wrong. 

I specified many times over the phone that I'm okay if my food comes into contact with other seafood but I can't eat it. I ordered the chicken kara-age for myself and confirmed many times that I was indeed getting the chicken one because in the past I had made the mistake and ordered the other option called ika kara-age which is made with calamari. Surprise surprise we ended up with the calamari one and I was unable to eat it leaving me disappointed and hungry. 

Truly disappointed with what this restaurant has become because it used to be a favorite!

My husband and I have date night every Friday night and always started off the date with a visit to Ric's grill.  Up to about a month ago the service, food and atmosphere have been awesome.  We always order the same meals;large Caesar salad and crab stuffed mushroom caps for my husband and a large salad with halibut for me.  Our last meal there was March 07/14. We sat in the lounge as is per our usual and were greeted right away.  We ordered our usual and waited for the bread to arrive.  After 10 minutes I had to ask the hostess for bread.  When our waitress saw the bread on our table she never said a word, just took the empty basket away.  My husbands items came first but he did not get crab stuffed mushroom caps, instead it looked like some sort of spread on crackers.  When he asked our waitress if the kitchen had run out of mushrooms she said they were "mixing it up" with a mushroom pate instead and left.  My husband was not impressed.  My salad and halibut came....my halibut was dry, tasteless and had a thick brown crust and my salad was bitter with almost no dressing.  The waitress came back about 15 minutes later to ask how our meals were.  I told her to take mine away as I wouldn't be eating it.  She said,  "oh I knew it wouldn't taste right when I noticed the Halibut was over cooked"  What???? Then why would you bring it to me???  They did not charge me for the meal but the damage was done none the less.  We will not be going back.  Shame

Stopped in at this restaurant for a quick lunch. 60 dollars later and I am wowed. Maybe it's cause I haven't had sushi for a while, but had amazing food brought to us. It was a quiet dining experience, lots of menu selection. I ended up ordering green tea, a beer, teriyaki beef lunch plate with tempura, and the chefs choice of sushi. A lot of food. But worth it.

We ate in the lounge part of the restaurant, as we were staying in the hotel and decided to grab a quick bite. Service was great.

I ordered the Garlic Whiskey Shrimp, and loved it. The shrimp came with artichoke hearts, a lovely salad with a fruity vinaigrette and some bread. I enjoyed the whole thing.

My husband, however, ordered the fish and chips. It arrived positively GLISTENING with grease. We tried blotting it with a napkin, we tried squishing it into the napkin, and he tried removing the batter from the fish. It just wasn't edible.

The waitress was very understanding (She looked pretty grossed out too.) and we weren't charged for it.

Go for the service. Not the food. Unless you order the Garlic Whiskey Shrimp. That's a nice lunch.

I took a friend out for their birthday. We both love Vietnamese food, but had never been to this place before. I trusted the good Yelp! reviews. 
Kinda dead at 1:30 on a cold, Thursday afternoon.  
We had our pick of clean booths. 
We both ordered the same thing. Small wonton soup and #26a Saigon special: vermicelli bowl with pork, shrimp, meatballs and spring rolls.
I drank jasmine tea. 
This food was great.  I would definitely  return.  
Especially for the price.
Really good food, wait time wasn't too crazy. Food wasn't outrageously expensive. Good in my books.

Super awesome coffee shop.  Ambience is perfect, the coffee is yummy, the food is fabulous, the bathrooms are gorgeous, and there is often live entertainment! Seriously doesn't get any better than this!

The other night I had a craving for some Wonton soup.  After experiencing several mediocre places I decided to give Hui's Wontons a try.  I ordered the medium Wor wonton Soup for pickup.  When I arrived I wasn't overly impressed with the outside but once inside saw that it was very clean and well presented.

The soup was excellent, not too salty or greasy and full of a generous helping of all the necessary ingredients.

I will be back again and will give some other dishes a try.

Besides this place being a convenient stop for groceries I am quit impressed with the layout and selection of goods they offer. Their shop local attitude is fabulous and I try to purchase locally grown produce when ever I can. Great selection and decent prices. 

What I love is their app. I no longer have to carry a save on card it's on my phone and easy to scan. Plus the app has some other cool features for grocery buying.

Great bakery staff but cashier #3 today was rude and had attitude. Not sure I want to return to this Save-On location. Manager said he would speak with her. I must say he was very apologetic for his employees rudeness. This in itself speaks volumes. 

I will be giving them a second chance at some point to see if things have changed. This is not my regular Save-On so not sure when that will be.
Fly in beer at supper tonight! manager reaction? Oh it's good for them - extra protein??!! We asked the waitress and she said the beer hadn't been poured in weeks! Never again! So grossed out!

Read this! It exceeds expectations on all levels.  We live in Sh Pk and take friends and family here whenever we get the chance and it has never disappointed.  

The food is deliciously made in house and the portion sizes are great; that said, if you are looking for a quick supper, don't go here.  Fresh, homemade food takes time to prepare (and this is what Vicky's is all about); so if you are in a rush, go to a chain and get your meal quick from a microwave.

The service constantly impresses.  It is a family run restaurant and whether family or not, everyone seems to genuinely care about your meal and experience.

All in all, it is by far the best destination in town for a classy, sit down meal.  I recommend reservations and if they are tough to get, that is probably saying something. 

Also! There is FREE (2h) underground heated parking, so you don't have to freeze in the winter.

Notes/My favorites:

Lemon rice soup (which we always get with their warm bread, you have to ask for it)
'The Rack', medium rare (lamb); my favorite 
Baked Alaskan; my wife's favorite

We are typically there for 1.5 hours.
Can be a bit chilly by the door in the winter (but only impacts a couple tables)
Patio is beautiful in summer
Wine options are great

Go there!
Really good pizza, lots of sauce and toppings. Great sandwiches too ! One of the best pizza's I've had in a while
Always good with friendly staff.. Iloveit.. I always recommend my friend everytime they want Mexican food..

A wonderful locally owned Italian trattoria. Cafeteria-style line-up. Pick your salad (2 to choose from), your entrée (meat or pasta), & your sauce (so many to choose from). The Pasticio is fab AND they have Gluten-Free pasta! 

All pasta is freshly made in the restaurant! The buns are nice crusty buns delivered daily from the Italian bakery. There are also two desserts to tantalize you, both also homemade: the perfectly fluffy and delicious Tiramisiu and the to die for Death by Chocolate! 

They also cater and you can pre-order trays of anything on the menu!

This Sherwood Park restaurant is a MUST  in visit!

A great place for my dogs' special dietary needs. I also buy my cat and rabbit food here. They have awesome hours which is great for those of us who forget to pick up food on the way home. If they use my phone number they can look up past brands we have tried which is very useful as the bags all kind of look the same after awhile. It is close to my house and offers a frequent buyer program.

I tried them at Taste of Edmonton and was really blown away. I had the chorizo taco which was of generous portion and great flavour. Loved the big wedge of lime that came with it. Not only was the food great, the owner was more than happy to listen to my feeble attempts to practice my Spanish and was super friendly. 

My only complaint - I wish they were more accessible. I've wanted to eat there many times after Taste of Edmonton but can't make it downtown or to Sherwood park. And so my cravings increase week after week, visions of chorizo haunting my hungry brain.

Where do you think you should go for the best steak in Sherwood park? Probably a steakhouse... But would you think it could happen at a wine bar???? No? Well it did.
I was at vickys for a Christmas party and the place was jumping. The wait staff were flying around. I got escargot as my appie and they were really good. I've only ever had them soaked in butter and stuff in mushrooms, at vickys they served them in a delicious tomato sauce.
For my main course I got the filet mignon. It was seasoned and cooked perfectly, plus it is aged 30 days before serving, so the meat was very flavourful. Hands down the best steak I have ever had in Sherwood park.
For desert, I had scotch because there was no room in my belly for more food after that amazing steak.
Go check out vickys because it was awesome, even when it was really busy.

Not sure how I've lived in Sherwood Park for 3 years and never tried this place!! 
Had the Mac and Cheese with 4 cheese sauce and all I can say is Wow!!! Most delicious dish I've had in a very long time!! Their portions are generous and very well priced. 
I will definitely be back!! :)

Best Mexican food I'm tasted in A while.  Finally a restaurant that has Nice size portions.  I've been on the west coast of Canada for 6 yrs and this is the first time I've didn't finish my dish.  The staff was super friendly.  Most importantly the Margarita drinks are HUGE!

Was there Saturday
Sorry i was not impressed had lunch with my husband.
We both left hungry

To put it simply, Boston Pizza is just a classic and easy place to go when you have 0 ideas to what you actually want to eat. 

I go with my grandparents here at least once every two weeks for lunch because they think they have the best pizza ever, their favourite, in particular, is the pepperoni but they recently tried the vegetarian one to be a little "healthier" and enjoyed it as well. 

We always get great service and get exactly what we want to from the kind and friendly staff who understand to speak up a bit when addressing my grandparents, which is huge for me in particular so I'm not constantly having to repeat to them what a mumbly, disinterested server had said. They are the complete opposite of that being attentive to all of my grandparent's needs. Even walked in a little late one time on one of the servers helping my grandpa take his coat off!

The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is the place always seems to have this cold uncomfortable draft, not awful enough to make you want to leave but one that gives you a little shiver occasionally. 

Our food always comes to us warm, and always seems to satisfy. There's not much more to ask for from a restaurant, so if you're ever unsure what to eat, just pop into a Boston Pizza and there's most likely something on the menu for everyone.
This was delicious. And the portions are great. We were new here. Got a great tutorial from the staff and other customers while ordering. Even though they were swamped. Great service too.

So this is the 3rd time we have been to this restaurant and it will be my last. First off upon arriving we wait at the door while some manager is giving his number to some random Asian woman,  I assume she was looking for work but he was clearly hitting on her. Normally not an issue to wait to sit bit this place is dead and nobody is waiting. So after she leaves he decides to go back to the back and find some other staff to seat us. Waitress comes over and I ask if they carry wisers. She says she has to ask,  takes the rest of our tables drink order and comes back to say they are out of Budweiser but that they have other beer on tap. I correct her that it's whisky and she goes to her till to search. Comes back and says they have it,  so I order a double with coke in a big glass. 4 minutes later comes back to say they actually don't carry it. What other rye whisky do you have? She has no idea,  has yo go check,  I say forget it. Just give me a southern and coke made the same way. Another 4 minutes and she brings the booze and pop in 2 separate containers. Again not an issue except when I pour them together it doesn't even fill the glass 3/4   so the manager comes over noticing the look on my face I'm sure and asks if there is an issue,  so I say when I poured these two together shouldn't it fill the glass? Now my double is a bit strong,  he is confussed and asks me what he should do about it. So 4 more minutes I decide to go to the bar and get it topped off. The bartender is another idiot. She is arguing that the waitress is one of their best ones and she has never even waitressed before. Anyways, food comes out cold and ribs are super fatty,  gross. The mashed are dry and cold. All in all I want the last 2 hours of my life back and a refund of 180$  Who ever owns this place clearly has never seen any of the undercover restaurant shows on TV these days.
I arrived at restaurant to have a full rack of ribs with a friend. To be told that the kitchen did not have enough for two people ! Really it is 6 pm and inner time and you are offering this to us .

Best Authentic Mexican street food in Canada! Their tacos and tortas remind me of my days kicking around the late night tacos stands in Mazatlan. 
Great variety of salsas and sauces all made from scratch. This truck is a must try!

Recently I had a chance to try out this Boston Pizza with my friends. Based on this visit, the place provided a great experience with only minor slips in quality. 

The inside and restrooms were clean; the staff was professional and polite. The male waiter suggested specials and gave us enough time to order, checking us out every now an then without being too intrusive. We did not have to ask for water because BP provided us with a pitcher (we didn't request it - they know what to do). The gentleman serving us also had good manners.

We ordered BP's Perogy pizza. The pizza was large and thin crust. Classy not trashy with just enough toppings on it. The slices were perfectly sized. It was as good as it gets. No chipped silverware.

Parking lot was clean; ample space for parking. The last thing I have note here is that I hit the ground with the bottom of my car when pulling out of the parking lot - the slope is way too steep. 

1 Star deducted for having appetizers served at the same time as the main course and the overly steep drive-in.

Went into this place this evening, not sure what to expect, but looking for a decent donair. I walked in to a smiling face, and two happy people, husband and wife team, looking to serve me the best donair I could have. I ordered two jumbo loaded and they did not disappoint, as they were packed full of veggies and delicious donair meat. We had ours with tzatziki sauce, that was very good, but we could have also had garlic or sweet sauce. We ordered the combos and the fries were hot and fresh and I believe fresh cut. Such a great experience, we'll be back for pizza. Highly recommend it.

It pains me to give this place 2 stars... I live right near by and want it to be so much better so we can go here all the time.... But alas it was not so.
I ordered beef ribs and they came out burned pretty badly. Not even loads of TRs bbq sauce could hide all the char. By the time were were checked on for me to let them know it was sadly too late to salvage the meal. They replaced them, but my family was long done their dinners before I got mine. My wife's burger was really dry and not very good, definitely not up to par for all the other $15 burgers in town.
I'm sure we will give this place another try at some point, but after reading all the other bad reviews I wonder, what's the point?

What is there to say about London Drugs? I love me my London Drugs. This location has a great selection, friendly staff and decent prices. The only problem is that whenever I go there, I end up buying way more than I expected. I end up perusing the aisles and seeing what interesting things they have.

A great selection of small kitchen appliances, including retro popcorn makers make me want to get back in the kitchen and create! but then I saunter over to the furniture aisle and the feeling thankfully passes.

Lots of small scale furniture like end tables, boxes and chairs that you don't see everywhere. We purchased two upholstered chairs for our office and love them!

I just wish there were more London Drugs in Sherwood Park!

Jepama's for dinner last night.
I must admit I had high hopes...
10" Donair pizza and  10"Hawaiian Feast with an order of Cheese Bread.
$33 including delivery before any tip.
Not bad...
Certainly not great.
Hawaiian was decent.
Cheese Bread...pretty good.
Donair...a genuine letdown.
Not too generous with the toppings on
Any.
I will stick to Nitza's.
Fare thee well Jepama.

What a wonderful discovery we were looking for something different besides Starbucks or second cup and we discovered social Grounds  this is the real deal people great coffee not just a bunch of syrup  up and sugar and their desserts were absolutely marvelous we shared a marshmallow Peanut Butter Square not quite sure what the name was but it was absolutely wonderful five stars with no hesitation

Awesome pasta. Great place to come and get your fill of pasta for a good price. Also very fast and convenient! This is the best and quickest pasts in its class. Recommended to everyone in Sherwood Park!
Best donair in Sherwood Park.  The Ingredients look fresh, the sauce is on point and there is a crunch in the meat that edges it above the rest

Amazing and a welcomed addition to the area.

Many of you may question the overly enthusiastic tone of this post, so I challenge you to try SGC for yourself. 

Firstly, I love my coffee but I refuse to pay the over-inflated prices of the chain stores. At SGC you get a rich, full-bodied, flavourful coffee that is fairly priced. Not to mention that the cups (12 or 16oz) keep the coffee warm, without burning your hands (like another well-known ex-Canadian chain)... and you get a coffee sleeve without having to ask for it.

Secondly, a red-seal baker on site!?  OMG freshly baked goods that aren't par-baked, defrosted, and then finished after going through x-number of machines and sets of hands? Who ever heard of such a crazy idea of freshly baked (daily) goods? WTH??  WTG!!   TRY THE CINNAMON KNOT. ...  not-too-sweet, light, airy, consistent flavour throughout.  Well worth the price, and big enough to share between 3 friends  (but you won't want to).  

Decor - clean, industrial, well-lit, and very inviting. Try the benches... very comfy!!

I'm so glad that the Social Grounds Coffeehouse (www.sgc.coffee)  opened in Sherwood Park, a welcomed and NEEDED addition with a great location, easy access, ample parking, and friendly service.  

Do yourself a favour, try them out, make the right choice for a great cup of coffee and freshly baked homemade style goods.

Support a local independent business and tell the big-chains that there's a new kid in town.
This is one of my favorite places for Mexican!  Seriously, the food is incredible and the staff is always polite and really friendly!  My boyfriend and I LOVE coming here!

"Can we please get Pasta Pantry tonight?" was a common question in our family when I was growing up in Sherwood Park. Unfortunately, the Park is notorious for the amount of crappy chain restaurants it has; this is not one of them. It was a sad, sad day when this place closed down to move to its new location. And an absolutely jubilant one when it reopened. The extra space is great for the place, and the look is totally modernized. The food however, has remained the same: high quality at a low price. The pasta is made fresh, the sauces are made fresh, the buns are fresh, fresh, fresh, fresh... you get the picture. I rarely stray from my favourite: Pasticcio, but simply because it is absolutely delicious. How can you go wrong with 5 types of pasta cooked in cheese and meat sauce? The pasta is always good, and I usually go for the Spicy Italian Sausage sauce because of the spicy kick. 

Not only is the food great, but the service has always been friendly. A lot of the same faces from when I was in Junior High are still behind the counter now as I toil away at University. The staff is always ready with a smile and a kind word. I'm probably a bit biased because I grew up on the place but I'm not wrong when I say the food will leave you feeling satisfied. Seriously, you can't go wrong here, try it... try it now.

I would give it a 5 but when they moved to the larger location they lost something of it's more distinguishing characteristics. 

That being said, The pasta is all made right there and it's amazing! The salad is crisp, the staff helpful and friendly and the environment is trendy, clean and Italian in nature. It's all served deli style and they are licensed for that special date. 

The spicy sauce has a real flavourful bite, the alfredo sauce is nicely done and the meat sauce has lots of meat. 

Don't leave without trying the huge helping of tiramisu.

One of the better restaurants in the Sherwood Park area. The interior of this restaurant is ok, a bit busy for my liking. Maybe choosing a lighter colour scheme would be better. The service on the other hand is hands down WAY better than the 124th Street location, kudos to the owner and staff. The Pho is very good. I think the Pho I've had in Pho Hoa St. Albert has more flavour but Delicious Pho's have bigger portion.
Bad Beauty Boutique Service- What a joke! Older lady working in Beauty Boutique has an attitude issue that should be left on the shelf for good

Best second hand store I've ever shopped at! Great items/clothing, etc. and great prices. It makes everything affordable there so not only is it good for lower income families/individuals but also those who just want to find a good deal.It is small and a little hard to see/find at first but it's perfect for this little store. 
On the other hand the hours they are open are horrible. Only during work hours when I cant get there, and on Saturday.
Also some of their staff are nice but some are deffiently not! Last year I had a situation where my father in law had either thrown out or donated some of my belongings including all my jewlery and jewlery box's. All the jewlery I had ever owned was gone but the one piece that devistated me was my baby braclet. In a frantic desperate search to try and do everything I could to possibly find it one place I went was to this store to ask the staff if they could help me out and try to remember if they had come across any jewlery that may have been mine, specifically the baby braclet. If they had it of course I was willing to pay whatever price to buy it back. When I got there they were "closed" for christmas break but I ran into one of the ladies who owned or worked their as she was just picking up some of the donations left outside. I asked her and she just told me "i dont know, but were closed right now.you can come back when were open again".
That was extremely rude, and upsetting,

Very clean and super friendly owners. There are quite a few machines including extra large washers which is great. They have all kinds of change so you can just go in with dollar bills. They help you pick out the right machine and are very knowledgable about their business. I'll definitely be coming back.
Awesome food !!! Decent size helpings also !!! Left way to full. Third time coming here and definitely on my must go list. Never disappointed

I honestly don't know how this location stays in business. Unfortunate I can not rate lower than one star. 
The location in Windermere is excellent. Good service, great food. However the Sherwood park location is lacking in both food quality and customer service. I ordered the pulled pork sandwich which is what I always order at the other location. Normally it's meaty saucy goodness. I was very disappointed to get a burnt dried up might have been meat at one time sandwich. 
The food was bad but the service was worse. We sat in the lounge area as there was immediate seating and was assured by the hostess the lounge offered the same menu. So we took a chance. There were five waitresses in the lounge area, was unsure if all five belonged there, but assumed service would be quick and efficient . Again, I expected too much. 
Our waitress forgot to put in our appetizer to the kitchen, so our meals came first. We asked the waitress about it, her response was, " do you still want it or what?! "
The meal took over two hours for us to get our order taken, drinks, missing appetizer, and finally our order served. Time enough for the waitress to bring us five glasses of fountain pop each. Which all the empty glasses were left on our table during the meal. All TEN. 
I did submit the online survey regarding my visit. That was four months ago.i never did hear from the manager or anyone else regarding my visit. 
I will continue to go to the Windermere location even though I live four blocks away from the Sherwood park one.

It has been about a year since we went to montanas and I was reminded why that was 
The young man that served us was very nice and tried hard but very under trained
 wife ordered a steak M.R and it came hockey puck well ( not a big deal it happens ) but when it takes 20 mins to replace it     damage is done 
This day and age money is more important than ever so the days of half &@($;&. service and food are over people are done waisting money at bad restaurants at least I am

Always excellent service.

The food menu needs more variety and prices are a bit on the high side.
I love their ribs but not impressed tonight. It was hard and not enough sauce in it that makes it dry...

So disappointed!  Used to be one of our favourites. 3 pastas in cardboard take out came to 70.00 with no add-ons. Got home and pasta was chewy and some pieces burnt. Shall not return which is unfortunate as this place was an icon in Sherwood Park at one time. Like to support local but this is ridiculous.

Excellent. I had the bistec tacos and got them to go. It was my first visit and I couldn't wait to get home once taking a peek. I pulled over and ate them on the side of the Henday. Wonderful meat. Fresh toppings. Beautiful servers. I'll be back

I have been 3 times now. Mexican street food. The first time the beef had a bit of gristle hiding in it resulting in the loss of the 5th star. 

However the flavours are fabulous. The people are friendly and the chef customizes the  food at your request. They added some seating this past week as colourful as their truck. Oh, and they have Mexican pop which seems to be lower in sugar than most of what we are used to, a more adult taste if you will.

 I am going again this week.

This has been my go to shoppers for a long time yet lately I have noticed that there has been a significant decrease in customer service. I went in today and there were four employees working in the beauty department. So engrossed in their conversation not one even said hello or welcomed me like normally happened. I was quite disappointed because service is usually much better than this. This shoppers also doesn't seem to have the same beauty selection as others.

Great pasta, fast service for take out or dining in. Pasticcio is my favourite by far! If you have a pasta craving this is the place to go. They also cater, their big trays of pasta have made feeding a large crowd way easier.

I'm not sure why I continue to go to this Boston Pizza.  Today was maybe the last time.  I ordered takeout through the call centre.  I was told on the phone it would be ready in 20 - 25 minutes.  I was at the restaurant at the 20 min mark - hoping it would be done early as it was before the lunch rush.

It wasn't ready - and it wasn't ready at the 25 minutes mark either (it was a salad and a kids meal).  

When I asked the manager Katie about it - she said that the call center gave her a time to have it ready and they were only over it by a few minutes and asked rudely if I still wanted the food.  

If it wasn't lunch for my son, who is now going to get his lunch late, I would have cancelled the order and walked away.

Very Poor Service.

I recently found out that they do have spaghetti! With their meat sauce, it's YUMMY. The salad is still way to garlicky so I skip it still and my kids are still not a fan of the place. I also wish that when you ask for extra cheese, the would give you extra cheese. I had to ask 3 times .

I usually try to avoid dining out in Sherwood Park like the plague. It's riddled with boring chain restaurants and I'm not usually willing to make the trek out there to eat when I could stay in Edmonton instead. 

My husband and I were meeting his parents (who live in ShPk) for dinner and he suggested this place as he'd been there once before. He was worried he had over hyped it to me but I was really impressed. 

We ordered the dinner for four ($65), which came with mini bowls of wonton soup, spring rolls (in place of shish kabobs) and four mains. We chose lemon chicken, beef with black bean sauce, salt and pepper shrimp, and seafood chow mein. We also had pork jaozi. Even though the menu items are mostly typical westernized Chinese food, the flavours were fantastic, portions were big, and food was fresh. The lemon chicken sauce was a bit much for me. The salt and pepper shrimp were a big hit. 

The real highlight of dining here was Hui (pronounced We) herself. She was waiting all of the tables and was so hilarious and outgoing, making jokes and recommendations, but not in that awkward, uncomfortable way. She is just a natural with people. The young girl (her daughter?) bringing out the plates was really pleasant, too. 

This is a definite gem in Sherwood Park and I highly suggest giving it a try next time you have the urge to head to EarlJoeMoxies. Decor is nice and the restaurant is clean. Only thing I didn't like: turn off the TVs!

Bonus! There was a 10% off check-in offer. Sweet!

This place is just down the street from where I live.  I enjoy the laid back atmosphere and it's not usually crazy busy to point where you feel like you are suffocating.  You can find a wide age range in the patrons here but you don't often see a lot of barely legals.  They always have a live band when I am here which can be neat - but they play a lot of oldies usually.  This is a really great place to catch up with a friend over a drink and I have often run into people I haven't seen in years which can be interesting sometimes.  I have had some good times here and I will certainly be back.  Their food (pretty standard bar type food) is decent...And what's this I hear about FREE APPIES on Friday afternoons - can someone please fill me in on this - is it for real???????

The food was excellent, the portions were plenty and the atmosphere was enjoyable.

The cafeteria-style ordering wasn't expected (nor well-documented when we came in), but it was quickly surmounted by the selection and quality.

We *will* be back!

Love this place, the fact that they had FRESH melt in your mouth pasta was so awesome! the death by chocolate is to die for! Fast friendly service, but in a really obscure area, they should really move into the city, and open one in Edmonton!

This place has come a long way since its early days. Years ago it was a bit of a dump. The menu was hokey and the food was average at best. But now this place is much better. The decor is cleaner, the layout is nice and the addition of the patio makes this place fantastic.

But what about the food you ask? It's a great place for pub eats. The menu has a wide selection of grub to whet any appetite. Their beer selection is huge and they have a TON of TVs. When the NHL, NFL, CFL, or MLB is in full swing, count on them showing a ton of games playing.

The staff here are also great, all the waitresses are friendly and quick. But be warned, when this place is packed it can get a bit slow.  If you are into the Oilers or Eskimos they offer a bus ride from their location just make sure to purchase tickets in advance. Depending on who is in town, they sell out quickly.

This is a much-needed sports bar for Sherwood Park, I'm super happy they don't stay complacent. The decor updates and menu changes are what will keep this place successful for years to come.

Pasta is amazing i always mix my meat sauce with a dash of spicy sausage and it leaves me drooling for more! Also i get irritable stomach and their food never bothers me! Staff is always friendly and quite nice looking for slaving away around hot food!

By far the best pasta in sherwood park. They make their pasta in house and their sauces too. I like going in and getting a large pasta with a mix of red and white sauces. It comes with a bun which is always welcome and delicious. The best part of the whole deal though is that you can refill your pasta bowl for free if you get a large, so if it's just not quite enough then you can go get more. The cafeteria style setting is good because it allows you to get in and out quickly if you need a fast lunch but you can also sit in and enjoy your meal in the dining room... all in all a great Italian pasta experience.
