I love their pastas. Especially when they have their coupons out. For like probably 50% off? It's been awhile that they had coupons. But the pastas are very delicious anyways.

Went on Sunday morning to have the Sunday brunch buffet and watch the Edmonton Eskimos play their playoff game. They had the Eskimos game on a few of the TVs but we had to listen to the audio from an NFL game playing on some of the other TVs. 
I figured surely they would change that once I brought it to their attention. But no, they said that they get way more NFL fans in there than Eskimo fans. It looked to be a fairly even split to me. I couldn't believe it! They chose a week 6 NFL game over an Eskimo playoff game!
Needless to say I walked out and won't be back anytime soon.

We came back here because of the great experience and food from our company meet and greet with clients. If I could give 6 stars I would. This was one of the best experiences all around.

First, the atmosphere was great. Setting is more centered around adults, but you could bring your family. Great place for a date night. Service was also exceptional, friendly and attended to regularly.

Ok, so the food was fantastic, there were five of us and we all agreed this was an amazing place, with amazing food. I had the risotto, one of my coworkers had the lamb chops, and another the salmon. All cooked very well. We had appetizers, the olives and little meatballs (can't remember what they were called). Both were very good as well.

Then we splurged and got 3 desserts to share. We had the souffle, the coconut cake, and tiramisu. All excellent desserts and would highly recommend.

Nothing about this was disappointing. I'll be back when in the area, as I'm sure my coworkers will be too!

My friend told me this was a hidden gem so we had to try it out. You pick your pasta and sauce. The small size is huge and it comes with buns at no additional cost. You can have an alcoholic beverage  with your meal. The Parmesan is fresh grated. I had Alfredo on pene noodles and it was very good. The noodles were cooked just right and fresh but I wished the sauce had more flavor but overall it was pretty good. The service was very friendly and asked us how our meal was and If they could get us anything after we had sat down and started eating which was nice! I would probably eat here again if I were in the area.

Great patio and service. I had the Thai Noodle Salad with Shrimp. Pretty darn tasty. As a personal preference I think the salad would taste amazing as a warm salad. The shrimp is served warm on the plate. Will be back for sure

We decided to try this place after finding out our favorite place wasn't open until 430.  It was very busy and the decor is nice so we were hopeful.  However, we quickly noticed the wheels were spinning and the bus wasn't moving.  Got seated with menus in about 7 minutes.  The young male server came by and took our order soon after.  We had lots to talk about so we weren't watching the clock but we had 4 different orders brought to our table.  Finally our appetizers came (green onion cake - very good and after the second try - salad rolls - large, bland and not much meat).  Shortly after came our Pho (two number 3s steak and meatball) and it didn't live up to the name.  The noodles were very spongy and very little meat, maybe two quarter meatballs.  Broth was OK a bit on the salty side.  We never got any drinks.  Both of us didn't finish our soup.  We left and had to wait about 5 minutes to be acknowledged to even pay our bill that didn't exist in their system.  It was $32 for two people with no drinks (not even water was brought to the table).  Expensive and not very good.  We won't be back.

Amazing!  I had the haurache and my husband had the Torta.  My husband doesn't even like Mexican food but I managed to convince him to try a food truck.  He couldn't stop talking about how tasty his Torta was, going on and on the entire time he ate.  My haurache was also VERY tasty and the staff are just so friendly. We will most definitely go back to this food truck. I've recommended this to friends who will be trying it tomorrow.  I highly recommend Casa12Doce!
Went for the hockey game last night, what a great atmosphere and service! The pizza is TO DIE FOR!!!! Great quality, I will be back for sure.

A newer coffeehouse for Sherwood Park woohoo!  

This quaint little cafe, conveniently located just off the major intersection of Broadmoor Blvd and Baseline Rd, is a nice addition to the Sherwood Park area for unique coffee places 

I quite enjoy the fact they had a couple boxes of Trivial Pursuit on some of the tables; a great way to break the ice for those conversation cliff hangers 
They also have an art wall that seems to get changed up every so often, which adds to the uniqueness of the space. It's a little smaller than most cafes, but that just adds to the quaint space as well :)

The menu is simple and delicious with a few twists on the side, as well as delicious sweet treats offered. I had a delightful cup of London fog courted by a big chunk of peanut-butter marshmallow square of deliciousness 

Boutique cafes for the win!

Located close to where I work, I often choose this Timmy's as a meeting spot for lunch dates with friends and family.  Although the drive through seems to be the normal chaotic gong show you will find at the majority of Tim's locations, the inside is usually reasonably tolerable.  I also find this location tends to have a wider variety of soups available (BONUS!) and always has a great selection of muffins, bagels, doughnuts, and all those other good things. All little out of the way other than when I am at work, but definitely one of my favourite Tim's.

Great selection but prices can't compare to G&E Pharmacy. Tonight I popped in to check out the herbal stress chews and saw cockroaches scrambling around the corner of the display. Freaked me out enough to leave. Not sure where they are coming from and would not want to risk buying food there.
Food tasted good and service was good. Food is high priced and very small portions tho! High priced snack in my opinion.

Delicious Pho is a new place that's just up the street from my place and across the road from the gym I train at so it's a perfect place to go for some grub post-training. 

I get the big bowl of pho with all the fixins. It's fresh, the noodles are always perfect. 

The spring rolls are tasty, but at only 3 per serving they're unusually pricey. 

The place is nice and clean with contemporary decor and quiet music.
I had the chilaquiles and really enjoyed them. The service was good and I loved the Mexican coffee they have there. I'm definitely coming back to sample some more of their menu.
I always get something before work if I have a night shift and I don't have anything prepped. It's always delicious and I've never been disappointed in the past. Sometimes the line is out the door!
Dropped in Saturday ,the mushroom and Swiss burger and the Ceasar salad that accompanied it were excellent. Service was top notch, quick ,courteous and friendly

Have been to this place four times. The first time we were so impressed.  The melted cheese and veggie starter was great.  We also shared the grilled meat dish which was a generous mix of various meats served in a stone chalice.  Very tasty. I would have given a five star review after that visit.

Our other visits have been less impressive. We treated family friends one night and were not impressed by how the vegetarian options are so limited and there was no willingness to adapt enchiladas or tacos with veggies.  Fajitas were a messy plate of grilled meats, no veggies or cheese. 

So I would go back but with much lower expectations.  Too bad.

Well Rosie's USED to be our favourite place to go on a Friday night.  $0.35 wings and $3.50 highballs ($4.50 pints)....THEN around a month ago it underwent new owners and while we were excited to see the place with a fresh outlook we were beyond disappointed to see the high turnover staff become even more-so. 

Three weeks ago the signs still posted the great deals on Friday nights yet the staff had no idea it was on and charged us full price for drinks and because we argued about false advertising they gave us our wings for free.

Two weeks ago was better - wings and drinks were back on sale and Rock n' Roll Bingo was back...YAY!! 

Last week - fantastic! Wings, drinks, bingo...and Lauren was working (the only staff member that actually knows what she is doing so we were thrilled and optimistic the owners' were going in the right direction.

TONIGHT, March 20/15....after a very long and stressful week...my husband and I decided to go for our Friday night routine and relax and enjoy some laughs, Bingo, cheap wings and drinks...only to find that the signs were all down; Karaoke was on (normally on Saturday's which we don't go to often as it is way too loud); NO wing special and NO drink specials! 

Thank you for ruining our tradition we have had for over a year.  We looked past the dirty and gloomy atmosphere in the past thanks to the friendly faces, but now we are looking for a new place that can maintain stability and if it means we have to drive further..then sobeit!

There's good food, the weekend breakfast deals have great prices ranging from $8-$10 each. I had the hangover poutine for $8.00 it was excellent. It's got easy over eggs, bacon bits, green onions, and loads of gravy. My dad and Grandpa had the steak and egg deal for $10 my aunty had the pizza thing. I forgot how much it was. But they were all very delicious. I would go there again for the weekend breakfast deals. Their staff were friendly, listened well to their patrons, the staff were proficient at what they do at their jobs. Although they would need a few more on the weekends so that the one waitress doesn't have to do all of the work. I haven't had their coffee yet, but my grandpa did. I think he liked it. I'm not sure. Give him coffee, and he's happy. That's that way he is. I would rate this restaurant establishment a 10 of 10. Excellent work guys. Keep up the great work.

My wife, son, and I went here for lunch. We had the guacamole (delicious!), and the enchiladas de mole, and the fish tacos. The food was wonderful and the service was excellent. The hot sauce is flavourful and I highly recommend this place.
I used to frequent this location, but recently the service has been terrible, including long waits for food, messed up orders, and inattentive staff. Never again.

Aradia Fitness a fun and exciting way to get fit.  I tried the a 30 min session through the Yelp Fitness Event. Through this I realized I need build more upper body and core strength. I definitely recommend this place if you are looking for a place other than the gym to get a great workout.  

It was really easy to follow the instructor especially if your a beginner and out of shape.

My only experience with I Dream of Pizza so far has been for delivery this past Friday night.  The weather may have been bad, but I had just driven from St. Albert to Sherwood Park myself, so I can attest to the fact that the roads were really not that bad at all.  Despite that, the pizza took well over an hour to get there (quoted 45 minutes).  We called to check in on it at the 55 minute mark and the lady said she would call the driver.  It was another 10 - 15 minutes after that.

So... needless to say, the pizza was cold by the time it got there.

So why 3 stars if my experience was bad?  Because the pizza was really good!  It was tasty but would have been so much better if there was any gooey-ness left to the cheese at all.

Also, the prices seemed pretty high for the size of pizza that you get.

But now I'm addicted to those darn stuffed peppers that were on my pizza so I know I have to go back hahaha
One of our salesmen found this place a few years ago and that's when I first tried it out. Great wor wonton and green onion cakes. It's our go to place for takeout once a month. Hui is the best!

Came here for wing night. Good price at 4 buck a pound, but that's the best part. They were a good size but dry. I ordered a hot and a salt and pepper, I got 2 hot. We ordered a poutine it was luke warm, which sucks fir the cheese curds. My friend had the Spanish dip, it came in a bread bowl which was a nice touch and the piece they cut out of the top was very nice, however the rest of the bowl was soggy grease. 

I know other reviews say they have decent food, but I didn't like it enough to try it again. Will not return :(

Not many options for those who don't love beef and pork. 
I got the apple pecan salad, it was mostly a pile of romaine lettuce with a sprinkling of goat cheese, 8 apple slices and I'm not sure I tasted the pecans that's how many there were. Adding chicken was an additional 5 dollars. For $15.95 I can get a much higher quality locally sourced salad at a much nicer restaurant... not worth it for me.

I'm a bit leery about writing a review on this Save On. You see, when it first opened, no one knew about it. I went in the day before Christmas and it was so quiet you could have heard a pin drop.

Now, I am all for businesses doing well and making money, but a grocery store where you don't have to jostle your way around, weaving in between screaming toddlers and sulky adolescents? Now THAT is something not to write a review about.

Although it has gotten quite a bit busier since it opened, I still find that it is not near as busy as some of the other stores in town. So back away and get your own grocery store.

I used to love coming to Montana's the food was always good and the servers were friendly and prompt. But recently every single trip has wound up in disappointment. The food is always very mediocre, and the wait staff seems like they would rather be anywhere else. Montanas used to be fun and kitschy but since they tried to "class it up" this location has lost most of its charm and merits. It's put me off of trying other montanas locations.

The Landscaping Services and knowledge is indisputable in what they offer for service. I have called with questions through-out this year as I will need landscaping next year and they have been more then helpful. I will be doing business with them , and their greenhouse (stopped by this last weekend) is so beautifully decorated for XMAS. If you want a gorgeous escape go visit Salisbury , it was serene and the staff was so pleasant.

Hubs and I went here on a whim on Thanksgiving Monday after our original turkey dinner plans fell through. But happy they did because this is the best Mexican restaurant in Sherwood Park and top 3 in Edmonton & surrounding areas for sure.

First off, the space is clean, spacious and filled with tons of natural light from all the windows. The decor is not overly kitschy. 

We had two female servers and they were both friendly and personable! Great service from them both.

What we ordered:
- Tacos al pastor: Fresh ingredients and tasty pork. We both felt the tacos needed a salsa of some sort so we asked for a side of it and they brought out two different flavours. Otherwise very good.

- Alambra - A stiry fry mixture of beef, chicken and pork with peppers and onions, served with warm tortillas. Great for meat lovers as there is lots of it. I didn't find much for pork on the platter but the meats in general were tender and well prepared.

- Sopa Azteca - Aztec soup was really nice,  and smoky. Top 3 in the city for sure.

- For drinks I ordered a classic lime margarita, blended. I found it too salty though - but my husband enjoyed it. We also ordered the Jarritos Locos which came in a cute clay mug - we both thought the drink could use more of a pronounced tequila flavour.

Bottom line, I would highly recommend this lovely family-run restaurant if you need a Mexican fix! This and Calle Mexico are my favourite two in the city.
Very good pho. Lots of selection, love the different types of rolls you can order. Large portions and friendly service.

Food is decent but their pricing is terrible. If you decide to stay in their restaurant you can have unlimited pasta but if you take a "to-go" order they charge you the same amount but will only give you one box of pasta. If they want to limit the amount of food they give to their take-out customers but want to keep charging the same price I won't be returning for take-out.

How much to I love Pole Fitness?! Oh man, if you're looking for an amazing full body work out, check out the team at Aradia Fitness. The classes are fun, and not embarrassing (like you think they will be). Half the class is spend on the pole, and half the class is spend working on core and flexibility on the floor, which is great because that is the stuff you can do at home when you don't have access to a pole! They break down the moves, teach you transitions, and give you what you need to complete the routines or create your own freestyle! You will feel stronger, more flexible and more confident after this empowering class! Just try it!

We were there on a Friday. New location.  It is located next to the new library. Wasn't too busy.  Not a big place.  The food and atmosphere is excellent, no question.  We sat on the lounge side which has similar atmosphere to the restaurant.  A notch above the Sawmill with red cherry paneling.  Quiet and good for a date.  Entrees average $25. Meals have good presentation.   On the downside there is only one washroom and the pints of beer are $9 and $10 dollars!  They invite you to watch sports in their lounge, but at $9 and $10 for a pint, you've got to be kidding.  Wine pricy too!.  Bottles of domestic beer thankfully are around $6.  Always ask the price!

Tried Average Joe's for brunch today. Arrived shortly after it opened. We sat ourselves in a roomy, elevated booth (the bench of which needed to be wiped down.) I had the breakfast sandwich and my partner had eggs benedict. The sandwich was nice but was advertised to come with maple syrup for dipping...it came with maple FLAVOURED CORN SYRUP...a BIG disappointment! (false advertising) The eggs benedict was nice and the eggs were soft, as requested. They have an online speed trivia game you can play; it lasts about 5 minutes. The waitress game during both of our games to ask us: first, if we wanted anything else, and then, if we'd like our bill. It was obvious we were playing, the place was dead, a considerate waitress would have come back when the game finished. It was a drive for us to go...we won't make that drive again.

This is my "truck stop" Tim Horton's as it's right off the Yellowhead and across the street from a big transportation oasis. When I'm in town, you'll see me around 5:30 AM after leaving the hotel.  Afterwards, with a good cup of Tim's Joe and doughnut (or bagel) for the road, I'll be on my way to work towards and beyond Fort Saskatchewan.  Sometimes I'll do the drive thru and other times I'll come inside.  And in any event, there's lots of great blue collar people watching.

I came to Aradia's newest location here in Sherwood park for an intro class. It was only 30 mins long so we only got a small taste of a full session. The sessions are done bare footed and make sure to not wear any jewellery and capris or pants if you're new. Started out with a warm up and stretches which I could see being very important for this type of work out. She went over the different pole types they have. Smaller ones for those with small hands, wider for more resistance and strength and even one that's a different metal and spins if you unlock it. We were shown 3 different types of spins which were the more popular ones. They were a lot of fun and harder than you would think with the proper technique.

The studio itself is a little off the main road behind the bottle depot so you gotta look for it. But its very easy to get to and there's lots of parking available. Inside there's a cute seating area with some couches right by the front desk. It's all open so you can watch classes going on. There's a small washroom where you can change in the stalls but no lockers or cubbies. It's a small space with about a dozen poles. The staff here were so wonderful. Our instructor was so full of energy and so excited to share her passion with us. It was very encouraging and you can tell they are very supportive of people from all walks of life. They have classes for the newbie and maybe less fit crowd to the professional exotic dancer in to practice in a safe space. At the end of the sessions they even had small gift cards for us all! It was such a sweet gesture! 

I would definitely recommend for your next bachelorette party or a new fun way to exercise without feeling like your working out! The vibe of this place was so awesome and welcoming making even the most modest person feel at ease.

I forgot how nice the food was here until tonight's visit :)

They seem to have pretty good daily deals throughout the week - tonight Thursday being fish and chip night!
(Haven't had that in ages!)

Nice little pub/lounge/restaurant, not too crazy busy or noisy (unless it's hockey game night), with a good selection of food and drinks.  The server was also good with bringing drinks, food, and checking up on customers. 

I'll have to come back to try the weekend breakfast deal though!  Steak and eggs Saturday brunch looks pretty appetizing
Pasta Pantry is awsome.  We love the home made pasta and sauces. Service is great and you get great food for a reasonable price.  :-)

Pretty "par for the course" Asian fare.
We've ordered from here a couple of times. Never disapointed...never amazed.
A little pricey. 
If you fancy Asian, and are looking for a different restaraunt...they are certainly worth a shot.

This place has gone down hill!!! What used to be a once or twice a month family night out for us is no more.  Our last few trips have been met with lackluster service and food that is just ok.  Even the portions have decreased, especially for kids...more 'Idaho' sized now. 

Like the tattered and worn out moose antlers they offer for your birthday...this location has seen better days.

Thought we would try Open Box/Jepama's out on a Sunday night.  This was a mistake. At first, their website order platform seemed to be pretty good until it sat and spun doing nothing for 5 to 10 minutes.  I picked up the phone and phoned the order in.  A second sign should have been that they were out of pepperoni.  The girl taking my order knew nothing of the special offer listed on the website. 

I arrived at the storefront to find I would have a much longer wait time than I was told. The lady in front of me was equally frustrated with the time it took to get her pizza and voiced her dissatisfaction a number of times.  When I finally did get my pizza, the price for one was different than their website.  When I pointed this out, the girl at the counter said she checked and said the price was correct.  I checked the website when I returned home and found I was correct about the price.

I would like to report after all this that it was worth it for the pizza. I can not.  The first couple of bites, while the pizza was piping hot were ok, but as the pizza cooled, so did the taste.  The BBQ Chicken that my wife so wanted, was a great disappointment.  I doubt that it will ever be finished as sits in the box in our fridge.

It turns out that Jepama's is transitioning to a new name - Pizza Box. Other than what appeared to be the delivery driver reading a paper in a corner, there was actually only one person working.  The girl at the counter took orders and made the pizza.

There are many other options in Sherwood Park for pizza and I would suggest that almost all of them will provide you with a better experience and pizza.

Being a past employee of Pookey's this place will always have a special place in my heart. While their prices can't compete with those of G&E and the big box stores their knowledge makes up for. For the most part if you have a question about something they can answer it, or they will do their best to find someone who can answer it. If you're looking for something special it can usually be ordered in. If your brand of pet food has a frequent buyer program they'll take care of that for you too. And to top it all off with each purchase on your "account" you earn Pookey's points which can later be used like cash which is great when your dog runs out of food and you're a bit short on cash that week.

It's probably worth 3.5 stars.... so, I'll give them the benefit of the doubt and go up to 4.

My group of 3 arrived at 6 pm on Saturday.  Early enough that there was lots of people in there, but we were still able to find a seat no problem.  We score one of the comfy booths.  We could tell that there was a group doing some fundraising later that night, as they were starting to set up their silent auction items in the "upper area".

I was surprised that the noise level in this sports bar was not overbearing.  We were able to hold a conversation without shouting, despite the fact that the bar filled up quickly for the hockey game.  

Service was decent but not spectacular.  The waitress was friendly, but didn't know what "cointreau" was and made no drink suggestions when I told her I was having a hard time making up my mind.  I settled on beer because a $12 cocktail in a sports bar was not overly appealing.

Prices overall seemed to be unusually high.  

My friend ordered nachos for herself.  She asked the waitress if they were really cheesy, or if she should order extra cheese, and she was assured there was plenty of cheese. wrong.  Cheese was sprinkled lightly on top of the nachos and was barely enough to even see.  subsequent layers contained no cheese whatsoever.  

The other 2 of use both ordered the soft taco.  I was really disappointed in it personally.  The only warm element was the meat (your choice of ground beef or chicken), and everything else cooled it down significantly.  The flavours were all really generic and bland and the tortilla used was far too large and we both ended up peeling off excess wrap.

I will say that the fries were DELICIOUS.  They're obviously a frozen product, but they were the highlight of my meal for sure.

We were there from 6 pm until just before 10 pm and the waitress was getting a little annoyed with us towards the end because we were just drinking water (we had each ordered dinner and 3 - 6 drinks prior to slowing down).  It wasn't a blatant annoyance, but I know she wanted to turn the table over to someone else.  Having worked in the service industry for years myself, I'm very aware that typically you don't make a lot of tips on tables like ours... and because of that, I over-tip to make up for it.  

TL:DR - Food and service was not spectacular, BUT, that atmosphere is fantastic and I was very comfortable here.  I would come back, but would probably stick to the appetizer menu.

Can not say enough good about this place!!! Your typical good ole comfort food at an excellent price like the crab melt sandwich and cheesy baked mac and cheese shells, as well as there wings and breakfast options. Their pies are all homemade and absolutely delicious! I've come during the day and on weekends at night the lounge is hopping, they do Kareoke! The service is always outstanding!!! Holly and Jenna are true gems here, always recommend to everyone!!!! Wouldn't change a thing!

Wait staff was excellent. We ordered the seafood lava bowl and it was more than enough food for two of us. Presentation is impressive as a sizzling lava bowl arrives at the table piled high with seafood and topped with crab legs and lobster.  It would be nice if they had a bun to enjoy all the flavours at the bottom.  Because the entire table ordered the lava bowls the chef sent over chocolate lava cake.  Although we were full a few spoonfuls was the perfect end.

Quaint little noodle shop, seats about 40, waitresses were very attentive and food was quick to arrive and very tasty. Recommend the salad rolls and the green onion cakes, and the kimchi if you like spicy cabbage.

Fantastic class! 

Mel is soooo peppy and you can't not feel fantastic leaving this place!! 

PLUS it's a fantastic work out! 

Thank you new friends! 

Will definitely be back!!!
Had the kapow shrimp and the chicken club waffle sandwich was so good the service was fabulous too will definitely come back here to dine again

what a great place to watch the NFL!
I came to average joes to watch the NFL on Sunday and it was a really great experience. There are televisions in every direction with every game on. Our server was unbelievably good. She was always buzzing around offering top ups, clearing plates, checking in and visiting. She was a pro.... So much so that i almost felt bad switching to water after the first game, she had nothing to do!
The appetizers were great. We had chicken wings, deep fried fire cracker shrimp, nachos, dry ribs, and mozzarella sticks which were all good.
The beer selection ranks in at about a dozen beers on draft which is nothing to write home about, but still pretty good for a sports bar.
They also keep people after the games by offering the chance to burn your bill by entering a draw during the game. Pretty cool promotion.
I will definitely go back if I can get my wife's permission.

I've ordered here a few times. But lately service has gone down hill. I ordered a bubble tea via SkipTheDishes only to have delicious Pho call me to let me know it wasn't available and I had three flavour options left to choose from. But that's not even my real complaint. Today we ordered two meals. Both arrived with hairs (not one but many) in the noodles. We are done eating here. Stay far away and order from a place that bothers to wear a hair net.

Lots of time waiting for appys. It was alright though,  lots of fruit flies to kill to help pass the time. The server did her best but the kitchen staff needs to graduate kindergarten first. Terrible food. Talked to the manager and worked out a deal. Dissapointment for supper on your birthday mom,  sorry.

Great service our waitress was really friendly, we sat in the bar. All the safe were having fun and cheerful 
My meal of pasta was good, what I expected

My last visit here was a truly great experience!
It was late at night, my friends and I were running late for a movie so we looked for the quickest place to get something to eat since the mall was closed, this happened to be montanas. 
We came in probably 10 minutes to closing but the waitress (unfortunately I don't remember her name, she had reddish hair) welcomed us in seemingly wholeheartedly. When we expressed that we were worried that it was close to closing, she instantaneously responded not to worry about it. The burgers she recommended were great! Since we were the only ones in the restaurant it, it appeared as if the kitchen had taken extra care into making our burgers that much juicier and fulfilling both food wise and aesthetically even with the speediness it came out ! 
After our food came, it was already past closing but the waitress patiently waited for us to finish eating keeping the restaurant open an additional 15 minutes for us.
Great customer service !

Visited this place for lunch today ... I always wanted to try pho and never had the chance to ... So I have nothing to compare it to but I know good food !! and this was very very good . 

I can eat a lot ( I usual eat my plate then my husbands left over lol ) so we ordered the green onion cake and I had the large pho with the flank steak, tendons, tripes and All.. And my husband got the vermicelli bowl with everything on it . First of all..the green onion cakeS ( comes with 2) are amazing ! Piping hot served with a sweet chilli sauce  and tons of green onions in it ... I ate most of it lol!! Then my GIGANTIC bowl of pho came out ! Holy shit lol  I have never seen a bowl of soup that big in my life !! I just started laughing and right away starting to regret getting the large one lol. I put some nice hot chilli oil all over that baby along with hoisin sauce and I was ready to start my eating workout lol. 
The tripes and tendons were awesome and the beef was still red when she served me my soup!! Loved it ... Loved every seconds of
It !!! 
I almost .... Almost finished it All... I was aching I was so freakin full!!  I tried my husband vermicelli bowl
And it was really tasty!! Came to about 30$ and I couldn't believe how cheap it was ... I had no problem with the service everything came very quickly !!! Will be back pho sure !!! Lolll

Wonderful food here if you're up for paying a little more. I would prefer that they had an option to purchase the entire pot of the lemon dill rice soup goodness they tease me with. I need more of that in my life. Great food, great wines, classy yet relaxed environment.

By far one of the best spray tan salons in the Edmonton area. Always clean, friendly and top quality spray tans. I've been going here for about a year now and never had a complaint. Super cheap promos and very affordable pricing on products and tanning!

I have been to Pasta Pantry more times than I can count and I have never been let down, now that they have moved into their larger location they have more options which is great. The staff are great at keeping the line moving at a good place so even though it's often lined up out the door it won't be a horrendous wait.

I've been to this Montana's many times over the years and had good service. Today wasn't one of them.

The waiter did a great job in answering our gluten free questions - he went and got a chart and was able to give us definitive answers. We informed him that one of the meals had to be gluten free.

It seemed to take forever for the meal to arrive and the waiter did not stop by once to give us an update, let us know how long it was going to be or refill our drinks.

When the meals finally arrived, the plate that had to be gluten free had coated onion rings. I'm thinking that wasn't in his chart.

The child that was with us asked for his kids cookie once he had finished his grilled cheese sandwich. Again, we waited and waited. After quite a while, the waiter brought a fist full of suckers for the table. We reminded him about the cookie and it finally appeared.

The food was ok, but not spectacular. I had the pulled pork sandwich and the meat was so tender that it was almost mush - not an overly pleasant taste sensation.

I'm hoping this was just a one-time bad-service experience.

This is Sherwood Park's newest coffee shop. Located in a bustling area. I came here for a coffee after hearing about this place. First impressions, nice little spot but it lacks something - atmosphere. 

It's quite small for a coffee shop with limited seating and its high ceilings launch noise and create a warehouse like echo. It's not a warm atmosphere that you would expect. Compared to Starbucks or second cup, this place is colder and stale. Plus there was no free wifi. 

I liked that they placed trivial pursuit boxes on the tables. Nice touch in creating conversation. The baked goods were awesome. The coffee, absolutely love their choice of a Kelowna roaster. Great flavour. 

But the atmosphere is lacking. It is not a place you can spend more than 20 minutes at. It's not a comfortable place to sit and chat. Not sure how they can change this and I worry they won't be around long enough to fix it. I hope they can. Sherwood Park loves coffee shops. And needs more!

This is one of my favorite breakfast places.  The food is always good - I usually go for the breakfast but I have a few friends who swear by the club sandwich.  The decor is SUPER outdated but it almost gives it a grandma/grandpa's house type feel.  I have never had to wait to get in and the services is typically very good.  All in all this place is nothing extraordinary but that may be what makes it so comfortable.
Fantastic place, Cozy Sports Bar, Big Tables, Dinning room is great for kids

This is a community-based thrift shop. It is a little treasure trove. I have bought many items that still have the tags on them. Everyday a different color tag is 50% off. At the end of the Winter and Summer they clear out almost everything.  My last purchase included a formal dress (5.00) a long sleeve black shirt for my husband (sale $0.20) and a new pair of awesome Michael Korres heels ($29).

At Halloween their costumes are at a great price. They also get some great vintage items at great prices.

The staff is friendly and the new location is nice and roomy

I'm really sad to say, since my last review on Caffrey's, the service has gone down, down, down.  I've been there at least three times and this was the last time I'll step foot in there until they get a new server!!!!!
Our server took our order and it was just a couple of pints, we ended up waiting at least 12-15 minutes, we were in a deep conversation, but I said wait a minute, where is our drinks??? I looked at the waitress and she was standing at the kitchen doorway drinking a beer herself.... What The...
So I got up and the bar tender asked if there was something she could do for me ?  Uh Ya, I would like to have our drinks if that's possible... She was totally surprised and quickly got them for us. Then our server brought them to us, like nothing ever happened. Later we saw her again downing another beer??? I don't know if this is normal practise for waitresses to get semi drunk and forget about your customers, but until, Caffreys shapes up, I'm definitely NOT GOING BACK!!

I am a gardening fanatic. I've been to every place that sells plants and garden supplies in Sherwood Park and this is my favorite. Why? Because they have great selection of plants that grow best in our area. When we bought our current home, I purchased all of our trees from Salisbury. They offer a one year warranty on trees and shrubs which you can extend by purchasing Myke root stimulators. I have not had one tree or shrub die on me yet. In the fall they offer an excellent Dutch auction style sale where you can purchase trees and shrubs at deep discounts the later in the season it gets. I take advantage of this every year and add a new plant to the yard each fall. There is always a least one knowledgeable staff member on hand that can answer your difficult gardening dilemmas. The seasonal staff might not be able to help you with such questions but, they will find someone who can.
This is by far the best Pho I've had since leaving Vancouver. I highly recommend this place!

If I won the lottery, I would spend a lot of it here. Kind of pricey, however the quality is there for sure. Sometimes I get phantom cravings for this place, seriously.. Wish it wasn't like playing "where in the world is Carmen San Diego?", but it's a food truck.. so beggars can't be choosers - seriously this place makes me beg for more!

One of the first brunch places we checked out in Sherwood park after moving from Vancouver. We were pleasantly surprised by the quality of all the food, and comfort of the chairs. The decor is not the draw, the home-cooked food is. Above-average quality (and size) breakfast sausages, rye toast looked light but was wholesome and substantial. I had the Ukrainian platter, with melt-in-your-mouth mini cabbage rolls, perogis and a farmer's sausage. Great value at $10 for the plate. Coffee was on the light side but endless refills did the trick. Attentive and professional staff. Will return!

Jepama's has some great pizza at excellent prices. It's the cheese-on-top type of pizza, and both pizzas we ordered came out with a perfect mix of crispy golden brown and gooey mozzarella. The cheesy bread with marinara was decent, but nothing to write home about. The only thing keeping this from a perfect 5-star is the crust, which (for regular pan crust) was more on the crispy side instead of thick and airy. I would eat there again.
This place is rather overpriced.  The food they offer is good, but the value proposition is poor.  Meh.
Yummy Mexican food and pops. Food is made to order, fresh and hot. It's really nice to have the food truck experience in Sherwood Park. Next time you're at Canadian tire give this place a try.

I visited this BP location in Sherwood Park for lunch with a group of 9. They had us seated within 5 minutes. 

The waitress was really friendly and attentive. They did forget about one of our dishes, however they were very apologetic and took it off our bill. I had the Spicy Chicken sandwich with fries and I do recommend it! It was the perfect split of "Hot and Flavorful". 

The waitress and hostess did a great job of checking in on our table and making sure we had constant refills on our drinks. If there were issues they took care of them as quickly as possible. 

I would definitely return to this location again!

Located in a strip-like mall. Easy to get to via Google maps :). Small business and busy. Not sure how it first works so ended up asking the first young worker. Very nice - gave a big explanation. Pre made options- lasagna and another pasta dish or you have the option of choosing from five different types of homemade pasta- and sauces. They have two additional sauces full of meat for extra cost. You can charge it with a salad and drink or not. There's so in and take out. Small and quaint family style. Not much decor but still clean. If pasta is your thing then this is the  place. White pasta was available I was not sure about gluten free or whole wheat- I did not ask.

What a disappointment tonight. There food is pretty solid, but when I ordered tonight Hui called me back to tell me that because I'm 3 km outside of her radius that she will have to charge me $5- after accepting my business! She also tried to accuse me of cancelling food in the past which is just ridiculous. 

Unfortunately she will just loose more business now.
Fantastic new restaurant in Sherwood park. Highly recommend, clean, friendly, family run authentic mexican food. Excellent value and very fresh.

I do not have a green thumb.  I tend to have a medium brown, often yellow, sometimes just dead black thumb.  Thankfully I live in a town with an amazing greenhouse that can save my garden half way through the summer after I kill almost everything!

Salisbury Greenhouse is an awesome addition to Sherwood Park.  They work hard to create a community with the publishing of a newsletter, emails, and a Farmers Market on Thursdays.  The greenhouse itself is MASSIVE and beautiful.  When I am having a particularly stressful day I am guilty of going for a walk among their beautiful flowers and dreaming of what my garden could be one day.  Thankfully they also have classes for people like me so one day my garden may be more than an barren wasteland next to my beautiful green front lawn which is thankfully maintained by my fiance or it would be dead too.

I bought three dealfind vouchers this past summer and couldn't have been more thrilled with what I managed to get with them.  I managed to fill my deck with pre-made pots of plants (which are still alive!), put lillies in the front of my house, and a couple other flowering plants in the front of house as well.  

The staff here are very helpful and knowledgeable.  They also have a great selection of home items, patio furniture, floral arrangements, and a small cafe.  

Be sure to check out the Farmers Market during the summer!  it is such a wonderful little market and a great addition to the area.  It is often busy so be sure to arrive early.

This  bar has excellent lunch specials. If you're tight for time, you can count on the service to get you back to work in a flash, with a full stomach to boot. On Fridays they have free finger food,  followed by entertainment. It can get busy in there; what do they say about a busy place?  That's right. Oh and they pour a wicked Guinness.

I have been going to an aerial hoop's class at Aradia and it's been amazing. Every class I feel like I'm learning so much and pushing my body to do things I never thought I'd be able to do. Our instructor Christina is awesome! It's been such a good work out but at the same time I barely feel like I'm working out because I'm having so much fun.

Wow yum!! This was a hella good taco truck! Unlike the same old lame old tacos from the big chains these guys have cilantro and lime! It is in my mind the best tacos I have had except for in East L.A and    Mexico. The only thing I would say is bring your wallet as you do pay for what you get! 4.5/5

I went here for yelp fit club. I was a bit intimidated as I walked in but our instructor was so welcoming (and patient) and I was with a fun group of ladies. This is great work out, especially for helping with upper body strength. I left feeling exhilarated and will be going back for more classes for sure.

Excellent authentic Mexican food. I have been twice already but would eventually like to try everything. Lots of choices for anyone and the option of getting something really spicy. The food comes in good portions, and the service is great. I haven't had the drinks yet but there is a wide variety of bulldogs, beer, wine, and signature cocktails. Would highly recommend this place for people who like authentic Mexican or are just a fan of good tacos.

Exceptional place to eat! Your family will enjoy wonderful sauces, pasta dishes, salads.  Prices are reasonable too! Eat in or take out. We prefer take out, kind of a cheat night  They also have a gluten free choice which is excellent. The baked macaroni with cheese sauce is a favourite.  Pasticchio is hit and miss but add some sauce and voila, delicious.  Don't forget to add meatballs!

My wife and I are right now waiting at Pizza Hut, which is 7 minutes away from this Boston Pizza location at Ordze Road. We got in there and headed to the front desk, where the attendant immediately told us to hold on. We asked him for a take-out flyer and stood there for a good 10 minutes with no one bothering to ask what we needed. 
A lady came in from the kitchen, looked our way and then headed back. Meanwhile the gentleman who had been at the front earlier was standing nearby doing i know no what, and the restaurant had 3 clients who had just left. We waited another 5 minutes, and then I checked on my phone for the nearest Pizza Hut, and have just spent $35 at the one at 270 Baseline Road. Nina at Pizza Hut welcomed us like old friends as soon as we stepped in. Guess who has a new client and who will never see our faces again.

I only recently became a faithful customer of pookey's its much closer to my house than petsmart or G&E and i love that they are open til 9 every night. I used to always go to G&E when i was looking for something specific, but i realized Pookey's has all the same stuff and WAY BETTER customer service and knowledgable staff at that.  I dont find the prices to be any different from other places, and they have more options.

Visited this place for lunch today ... I always wanted to try pho and never had the chance to ... So I have nothing to compare it to but I know good food !! and this was very very good . I can eat a lot ( I usual eat my plate then my husbands left over lol ) so we ordered the green onion cake and I had the large pho with the flank steak, tendons, tripes and All.. And my husband got the vermicelli bowl with everything on it . First of all..the green onion cakeS ( comes with 2) are amazing ! Piping hot served with a sweet chilli sauce  and tons of green onions in it ... I ate most of it lol!! Then my GIGANTIC bowl of pho came out ! Holy shit lol  I have never seen a bowl of soup that big in my life !! I just started laughing and right away starting to regret getting the large one lol. I put some nice hot chilli oil all over that baby along with hoisin sauce and I was ready to start my eating workout lol. The tripes and tendons were awesome and the beef saw still red when she served me my soup!! Loved it ... Loved every seconds of
It !!! I almost .... Almost finished it All... I was aching I was so freakin full!!  I tried my husband vermicelli bowl
And it was really tasty!! Came to about 30$ and I couldn't believe how cheap it was ... I had no problem with the service everything came very quickly !!! Will be back pho sure !!! 





Returned 2 weeks after and I had the #9 which is steak and tendons ( I love tendons ) and it was great !!  Nice broth just like last time ... Plenty of tendons and beef ... Had the green onion cake again but wasn't as nice and fluffy as last time . We were greeted by a younger looking Asian woman... Didn't seem nice at
All... No smile and actually very bitchy but I guess her shift was over because she left a few minutes after we sat down . Anyway the older woman is very nice and always attentive to our need .

Salisbury is a beautiful greenhouse to visit in the spring and summer for gardening. They have a great selection of seeds for harder to find items and their selection of tomato plants is awesome. They have a huge selection of gardening furniture aka fountains, pots, etc.. Their checkout could be better as I had to wait a while but was definitely friendly. I once needed to find a hanging pot container and got no problem with getting help. Their website is fantastic too and Rob Sproule seems to know what he's talking about! Definitely a go-to greenhouse in my books! Keep up the great gardening work!

Solid establishment in Sherwood Park. I had no problems with the service or quality at this Boston Pizza. The food was great, and they are now serving Starbucks as their coffee. 
Got a chance for $5 personal pizzas because of their birthday deal. 
Well worth it. 
If you want a child friend place to go, I'd recommend this BP. And don't forget Tuesday is cheap pasta day

Came in at 5:00 pm on a Sunday night (2015/01/25). There were piles of people at the door. We were told 30 minute wait - despite our hesitation we decided to wait.

It was a painful 40 minutes watching the hostesses (or anyone for that matter) do little to fix the wait while there was dirty empty tables everywhere. I watched the bus boy saunter over from table to table slowly cleaning. The most frustrating part was the table we ended up being seated at was empty and dirty from the moment we arrived. 40 minutes passed and finally we watched as they cleaned it eventually seating us there. (5:47 pm)

Alice was our server and she was a breath of fresh air after waiting for our table. She was polite, personable and helpful with our kids. 

Luckily, the food service was timely and the food was delicious. 

Two hours later (7:00 pm) and we were finally done. If it wasn't for the service provided by Alice this review would have been a 1 star.

My wife and I decided to eat at Tony's. My wife's order was perfect. I ordered ribs and chicken combo with the blue ridge smoky sauce, my chicken tasted like jerky and I was given the original sauce. Not impressed with the food, but our waitress Shaylynn rocked it! Thank Shaylynn, if it wasn't for you I probably would have dined and dashed.

Great place to go for wing night! Parking could be tricky to find some times. It's pretty busy on Wednesday so seating is somewhat tricky to find also. Service is good, and wings come in quick enough, food temp is mild. They claim to serve 20oz pints  glass looked like a 16oz(thick bottom) owner could have some mixed up in there to make more money on draft. No proof, can't judge, just a perception. Wings are really good and atmosphere is great! Can't resist going there on Wednesday's for $4.50 10 wings night. Although the site shows 45 cent wings on poster and under it says 35 cent wings.

We made a reservation for March 10th. There were ten of us.

First the bad:
- everyone's food came at a different time.  Some were done eating before others were served.  One even had that huge seafood dish (apparently takes 20-25 min to make) and that dish was the 2nd dish to come.   
- we had a hard time getting the waitress's attention for cutlery, drinks, plates, etc. she was just too busy.  She was taking drink orders, serving drink, serving food and cleaning plates.   There were no bus boys.  She was ran off her feet.  We felt bad for her.  
- when my bill came there were 2 extra margueritas and a beer on it. I asked her to fix it, the 2nd bill still had the beer on it. The third bill I paid
- this meal took 3 hours.  Never have I spent 3 hours in a restaurant.  

The good:
- the best marguerita I have ever had (strawberry).  So good
- meals were pretty darn good.  I had the fajitas, others had the shrimp  tacos, enchiladas and seafood dish.  
- the restaurant allowed us to bring in our own cake.  Thanks so much.  

This place has a good thing, they just need to focus on the service because it's just broken.  

There are not to many good Mexican restaurants, this one has potential with a bit of work and organization.

I am always searching for a delicious bowl of pho and this place definitely lives up to its name. Not only is the pho broth flavourful and hot, there is never a lack of noodles or ingredients. Service is awesome and if you happen to be there when the larger than life owner is working, it's an experience you never forget. The pho is my personal fav but they also make amazing vermicelli bowls and Vietnamese sub sandwiches. Oh and the Vietnamese coffee is one of the best. So happy to make this place one of my favourite go to restaurants.

I feel like this Montana's has really gone downhill, a lot of the food is greasy and just doesn't compare to the flavor you can get at other restaurants. If you're looking for "pub grub" this restaurant is very granola. At least the tables are fun to color on while you wait for your food

This is a great place for pasta. It is so fresh and yummy. I always get the Italian salad, if you love garlic you will love this salad too !! The service is fast and friendly, the place is clean and lots of parking.

Very Satisfied!

This morning, after a few hours of running around, I realized I had skipped breakfast.
As I am in the area, this seamed like a great opportunity to give this Sherwood Park staple a shot. Some reviews I have read had me a little concerned with what I would find...

Decor is pleasant and bright in low sun of a late November morning. Server was friendly and there when I needed her. 
Menu looks like it's full of choises.
I quicky decided on their Ukranian breakfast special. Eggs. Sausage. Toast...and pierogies! Just right for brunch!
Food came inside 10min. It was delicious and filling. 
I look forward to returning to this pleasant spot, and sampling more of their menu.

This is a new restaurant in Sherwood Park, and they are off to a great start. Delicious authentic Mexican food to rival Huma, my personal favourite.

It was busy, but we were still able to get a table quickly on a Saturday night. They brought chips and pico de gallo and took our drink orders quickly, however the bar was absolutely hopping and the drinks took a long while.

Our sopa Azteca came before the drinks, and was very tasty, with a nice gentle spiciness.

The long-awaited drinks were really good too, an excellent pina colada, and a michelada (dos equis on ice with fresh lime juice in a chamoy rimmed glass), this was a very unique combination of flavours, the rim lent a sweet and sour tartness that was really interesting.

Our mains were delicious, the enchiladas verdes and the alambre sabores de mexico were both plentiful and flavourful, very satisfying meals.

I finished with a lime Margarita on the rocks, and it was exactly as it should be.

Highly recommended!

Some of the best cheesy bread ever. The pizza is hot and teh ingredients are fresh. I really liked the crust. Its has just the right amount of bite to it. This pizza is way better than the commercial chains. If your looking for a new place or even if your not go pick up a pizza at Jepama's

Very good experience buying a new SUV and trading ours in. The salesman had all the information we needed, was not pushy and was very accommodating to our wishes. Felt like we got a good deal and they went the extra mile to make the deal happen. Our first Service was very good and detailed and a good price for the work provided.

Mexico Lindo is a great Mexican restaurant, they bring some salsa and tortilla chips following your menus, which were very tasty.  We ordered some guacamole to start and a delicious tequila cocktail that i cannot remember the name of, both excellent.  We enjoyed some delicious brisket tacos and some steak/pork/peppers/onions with tortillas, all of which were very good!  Finished the meal off with some corn cake dessert that i was not a fan of.  But all in all the wait staff was awesome, and very friendly, the food was great, and the atmosphere was very Mexican.
Great place for Friday Night! The winner wing are the best chicken wing that i ever had in my life! It's soooooooooooooooooooooooo goodddddddddddddd!

This was my second time there tonight. I had the special pork chop. It was delicious. Tonight I started with the lamb lollipops they were good. The balance of feta cheese. Tomato and lamb was ok, a bit to much feta for me. I am not a huge feta cheese guy. The lemon rice soup was tasty - I am not a huge fan of soup either. Bring on the NY steak- that's up my alley. The potatoes and veggies with the steak were fantastic. The steak was a tad bit over cooked. I like a solid med rare. Ended the meal with the carrot cake. Not the best cake I have ever had but it did the job. 

The atmosphere is fantastic. It was extremely busy but we were not rushed to eat and didn't wait to long for food. 

I will be back to try the many other dishes that intrigued me.

Mmmm ham & eggs for breakie @ Rosie's in Sherwood Park - this seems to be their breakfast special every weekend.  And the ham is a big slice of real ham.  I'm a carnivore-lite so this is pretty much enough meat for me for a day or 2.

I might be a food snob but I like a good diner. Although my dearest wish is that someone would start a diner with amazing lattes - probably should hold my breath on that unless I'm interested in getting into the breakie biz myself.

I first experienced casa12doce at a food truck event here in edmonton. I was really craving mexican food so I decided to give a try. I look at the menu and see its $5 for a taco! WHAT?! I'm sorry, but it doesn't matter how good your food might be , that is just ridiculous. Back at home (TX) I could get an order of 6 tacos for $6-7. I'm not saying it should be like that but at least 3 for $6 would be reasonable.  Anyway, I didn't get to try the tacos but saw other people walking away with them in disappointment. I figured that maybe this $5 taco would be served in a bigger tortilla but nope just a regular sized tortilla smaller than my hand. 

On the other hand, I did try their "quesadillas". I've been eating mexican food since I was born and never knew quesadillas had cheese on the outside not the inside. If you know mexican food, they looked more like empanadas to me. Anyway, these were pretty decent and were 3 for $8 (they're pretty small) 

Will I be back? ehh, if someone offers to pay for me.. sure, why not.

Wings at BP on Mar.17 not traditional Irish fare after FP folk music,joint jumpin but not as wild as Caffreys. Lots of large groups havin a great time. Try the Cactus Cuts they are pretty dang good. Over all I had a great St.Patrick day (even if I am an Orange Irish), Caffery's brunch, Festival Place for Irish Folk music and end they evening at BP.

Rosie's is usually a great place to go for breakfast. I have been there countless times. The food is great and the prices are cheap. It can definitely be hit and miss though. Sometimes you go and it's packed and they still get your food to you quickly, other times you go and there's 2 other tables and you wait 45 minutes and your food is cold because it was sitting on the counter for over 10 minutes waiting for the server to bring it to you. (Not an exaggeration, has happened more than once, the head server always gives the young one shit when they do this but still.) But usually it is super quick, and very satisfying! Decent portions, none of that "handful of hashbrowns" BS you get at most breakfast places. Highly recommend it!! Every server I've ever had there was very friendly, except the middle-aged red haired woman. Very strange encounters with that one...
Amazing service, I enjoyed the sauces and the pasta made by scratch! These ingredients that are used bring an aroma to the restaurant and I was satisfied with my visit!

I received a Living Social voucher in my e-mail, and it coincided at the time of me MumZ birthday, who is a true plant lover with a super green thumb, so it seemed like a sign to go for it. So happy I did, and my Mummy is beyond delighted. Watching her in that Greenhouse was a joy. She was quite thrilled with everything.

The staff were incredibly friendly , knowledgeable, and approachable. I was surprized to find so many other interesting products besides what you would expect at a Greenhouse, everything from purses and jewellery to cool looking rainboots to all kinds of cool things you can pretty up your garden with, like crazy frogs and gigantic bamboo chimes. The prices seemed a tad expensive to me, but having said that, I found there was still plenty that fit into my tight budget. 

The variety of everything is just outstanding, and again, what really stood out were the awesome staff. This place is so huge that I actually "lost" my Mum several times. lol

Oh, only negative thing is that my bf asked a staff member if they had any bamboo plants, and then disappeared off into the very spacious Greenhouse, and he returned empty handed. They didn't find any, and he was told they didn't have any at the moment. However, on the way out, we just happened to come across them. Yeah.He got FOUR at $4.95 each. Great price on those.

I would highly recommend this Greenhouse to any nature lover.

One thing though, be warned.... mosquitoes are just everywhere.
These people know how to cook real authentic Mexican  food right down to the hot sauces. I will continually eat here when I can and highly recommend them. Beware the 'loco' hot sauce .

Salad rolls really tasty, love the sauce. We both enjoyed our vermicelli bowls but nothing that we felt was any better then anywhere else. The bubble tea drink we both got were the grossest ever. The tapioca balls were all mushy and lumpy and they put way to much flavour powder in mine. Place was clean, lady at the front was friendly and efficient. However it just wasn't good enough for me to ever return.

This Shoppers is right by my work so I often pop in for everything from snacks to hair dye. In terms of selection they have everything you typically expect from a Shoppers and they keep their shelves fully stocked. The only real difference I noticed is they have a smaller beauty boutique then Shoppers larger free standing stores. So why the three stars you might be asking? Well my first issue is the fact they seem to struggle a little bit with crowds. Everytime I am in they usually only have one register open and they are always calling someone in the photo lab to help deal with the line. Also the sales floor here feels like a ghost town. I can't recall a time where I have come in and there has been staff on the floor stocking or tidying up. This leads me to think they do the majority of that work early in the morning or later in the evening which is fine most of the time but it can be a hassle when your walking up and down isles multiple times trying to find one thing and there is nobody around to help you. All in all though they get the job done and despite being understaffed in my opinion the staff they do have look after you to the best of their abilities and with the greatest of sincerity. I just don't recommend running in here if you need to grab one quick thing in a hurry and aren't familiar with the layout of the store.

This place will always hold a special place for me as it's where I met my better half. We do go back by choice!

I like the food here, especially the deep fried mini perogies. The atmosphere is fun, and it's easy to book for a large group. Half the time there's also an event going on for something or another- makes for an interesting visit!

I have tried this place a few times hoping its a hit or miss prospect and one of these times it will be good. It never is. Last Friday my husband and I went for dinner. The lemon rice soup was mealy and salty. My lamb chops were terribly undercooked. My husband ordered filet mignon and he got two thin pieces of grey meat. One was cooked well done and the other was raw in the middle. He asked for medium. We heard one of the older waitresses oh I think is Vicky's sister scold two of her co-workers separately in the time we were there. Not appropriate. And to top it off, this awful experience cost us $200 for the two of us. It's time for me to admit that this place isn't hit or miss, it's just miss.

I don't bother righting reviews, but I have to say that my family and I had a rotten experience here. It started with me making a reservation for 6 people at 6pm. But when we got to the restaurant we were told we had to wait? What's the point of making a reservation then?
Anyways we decided to tough it out. I was really looking forward to having Montana's hot wings. So after waiting for 30 minutes we got a table. Once we met our waitress she took our drink orders. I think it took another 15 minutes to get them.  But whatever we were trying to make the most of it, as it was my wife and my anniversary supper with my family. 
We placed our food orders. I ordered the aforementioned wings and ribs. Also we asked for an appetizer to share. So another 30 minutes and we got our appetizer. 
But when my meal came out, it was the ribs and shrimp. Now I like shrimp and I was going to eat it, but our waitress seemed eager to correct the order. So she said she would rush the hot wings out. 
So I was actually finished the rest of my meal when the wings arrived -honey garlic wings! So the waitress takes them back. And another 5 minutes, which seemed like a reasonable time for a "rush" order, and she pops down the hot wings. Now if you like wings as much as I do you know what to expect at each restaurant. Needless to say these were not the wings I was craving when we got there. 
By this time everyone, including my very slow eating mother, is done. Seconds after I ate the last disappointing wing, the waitress brings the bill-full price!!! No "I'm sorry for screwing up your anniversary supper" or nothing. 
I don't know if they have gone through some management changes or what. But I can assure you that my family will not be going back. With so many other choices in Sherwood Park now, there's literally no reason to go back to Montana's for crappy service!

Greenhouses are my favourite. I'm a greenhouse snob.

We actually went to another one first to get some garden supplies, felt the prices were a little ridiculous and wound up here. Picked up all of the seeds we needed and a few plants for under $60. I found a little mason bee home that's already getting some use - it was a bit pricey but super adorable and I'm never going to take the time to make a bug house, so totally worth it. 

The staff were friendly and helpful, helping folks haul things out to their cars and offering recommendations around plants and seeds. I bought the weirdest tomatoes I could possibly find (blueberry tomatoes and tie dye tomatoes) as well as some regular ones. All in all, a great weekend pit stop and will absolutely go back.

Horrible server named Jen. Never once asked us how our appie & food was. Mnger came by & we had to ask for our appie 30 mins later. She brought it out immediatly. Server brought our food out & it was cold even though she told us it was fresh & just put under the warmers. Spoke the manager before our dinner & explained our situation she understood but wanted to speak to the GM about it. Manager took care of our meals & our appie. Not sure if I would go back 3rd time having horrible service & food

Not worth even 1 star. .
Best pub food in town! Great service! So excited to see the new upcoming menu! Thanks for being a Sherwood Park staple!!!

I have not been to a Boston Pizza in over five years, since they were a regular destination on hockey road-trips. So, when my cousin suggested Boston Pizza as a location for our miniature family reunion, I was cautiously optimistic, hoping that a chain I always remembered as being extremely average had modernized their menu or improved in some way in the half decade since I last visited. Unfortunately, the opposite was true. 

The service was poor and sloppy, from the hostess giving our group the impression that we were intruding on her by entering the restaurant, to the waiter who was inconsistent, to the shattered plate my 81-year old grandmother had to step over on the way out of the restaurant. Sadly, the service was actually the best part of the experience. 

There is no way around it. The food was extremely poor. My spicy penne was served covering an extremely thick bed of shallots, which tasted like they were coated in barbecue sauce, amounting to a disgusting combination of flavors. The sausage was thin, and of poor quality. The sauce and pasta were equally bland and uninteresting. The nachos and yam fries were equally greasy and poor, and we were not even brought condiments such as ketchup with the fries. 

With all this being said, I was still willing to overlook this. After all, this is a Boston Pizza, and you don't go there expecting good food or competent service. You go there expecting a cheap, quick, and edible meal. Even this was not the case.

When I alluded to the fact that Boston Pizza hasn't changed their menu in a decade, I wasn't being entirely truthful. They have updated only one part of their menu: the prices. The average entree, even for a vegetarian pasta dish, ran between $15-19 before tax and top, and items such as fish or steak dishes were in the low to mid $20's. Perhaps most astonishing of all was the $19.99+3.00 (to add guac) plate of nachos, which was actually on the small side, had almost no meat, and was extremely underwhelming in taste and appearance. I have not infrequently ordered nachos for the regular price of a plate of nachos ($11-15) at other places that has been double the size and quality of these. Our bill for 6 diners, without drinks, came to an exorbitant $166.60. This meal wasn't worth half that.

Overall, this was a terrible experience. Boston Pizza as a company is clearly bleeding, on the way out and attempting to milk whatever suckers wander through their doors for every penny, without offering a quality product in return. Avoid this place like the plague, and let this company that is unwilling to adapt or treat its customers fairly go the way of the dinosaur. Do yourself a favor and open a can of Chef Boyardee. You'll be experiencing roughly the same result.

Sparknotes:
-Heavily overpriced (~200%)
-Microwaved Pasta sauce ready in 2 minutes. Tastes like it was manufactured in a lab.
-Horrible service
-Cramped seating atmosphere
-**Avoid this place!
*If I get food poisoning, I'm getting rid of this second star

Been here for bussiness lunches or suppers several  times.  It always seems good.    The lunch menu was a bit limited, but they are all good staple dishes.   I had the bistro burger.  It was tasty but had too much on it to be eaten properly.   It was pretty messy.   But tasty.   Almost everyone else had fish and chips which was the special.   Most of the dishes were served on a cutting board.   Plates would have been better, but that is a small quibble

I come to this Tim Horton's in the evenings. Sam and Ann 2 hard workers always persist in meeting my needs. The coffee is always fresh, outstanding service. I always like to come to this quite corner just a few seconds away from the Yellowhead. John Zapantis

MUST visit the patio! It's beautiful and has a misting bar! ( have not seen this anywhere in Edmonton, very big in Vegas)

The service was good! Ordered the beef dip. I suggest "poutine ing " your fries! Fries tasted great, they did not skimp on the gravy or the cheese curd!!! Awesome!!

Ordered the brownie for dessert. The brownie was warm and a bit crispy on the outside. Flavour was not there though. Skip it, as it will not satisfy your chocolate craving.

I usually really enjoy this place.  Its large open floor plan and numerous big screens make it one of my favorite places to go to watch a sporting event.  However, I believe that all of Sherwood Park agrees with me on that so sometimes finding seating for a major sporting event (or even just a regular season Oilers game) can be an all day event.

I think the quality of service here can depend on the day or the time of the day.  Usually when I go, the services is pretty good - during busy times they seem to staff themselves appropriately.  However, I have found that during 'slower' times they seem to really short staff themselves and the quality of service suffers.

The food - a bit of an expanded bar menu - is usually really good and there is lots to choose from.  Gotta say though - I would have given this place 4 (...maybe 5) stars if they didn't get rid of the HOUSE OF THE DEAD game!?!?!? :'(  (now what am I guna do when all my friends are watching some boring sporting event that I am not interested in - big buck hunter is just cruel and not nearly as fun hahaha?!?!?!).  But, in their defense, they do have pool (if u can get the table), virtual golf, various other video games, and VLTs if that's your thing.

Love going here with friends. The menu is the usual bar fare and is pretty good (nothing special though ) but they have great wings. What I love most is the restaurant itself (lots of screens, sports memorabilia everywhere) and the busy atmosphere. 

I'm pretty sure I've knocked down at least half the menu if not more and my favourites include the quesadilla, the burgers (chicken and beef) and the Havanna Sandwich.
This place has great lunch deals and good food. If you're feeling the need for some Canadian-Albertan-Chinese style of food. I'd recommend this place.

We are not all rig pigs!

This pub only caters to a male clientele.  They are constantly playing UFC (ugh!) or hockey games at full volume. My party, and others, consistently request that hockey commentary not be blaring throughout the entire bar. They need to mute the tvs by the booths so that some folks older than 20 can actually have a conversation!  We like to watch the hockey games too, but it's so loud and they leave it cranked up constantly so that commercials are blaring too.  

You can definitely not consider this bar if you'll be trending with anybody you want to chat with t all!  You wont be able to hear each other all night.

I had a very pleasant lunch here with a friend. We arrived early to beat the rush and between the waitress and the manager taking care of our every whim they did a fantastic job. As we entered the waitress noticed my friend was cold, suggested a table beside the fireplace and turned it on, talk about taking care of the customer.

The atmosphere always makes me feel cozy and the music they play is right on target. I ordered myself the Smokehouse Wrap and it was very tasty, not too much, and not too little, that's saying lots as I am slightly larger than the average eater. 

I will go here more often just because of the way I was treated, they earned my future business!

Excellent selection and helpful people. I never feel rushed. From the amazing wonderful humid green scent, to the fact that you can talk to real gardeners, makes this place a must. Pricing seems fair and reasonable. Give this business a shot and I think you will be impressed.

I am so sad to say we will not be ordering again.  We've been ordering regularly since they opened and it used to be fantastic.  Over the last few months it has gone downhill.  Our pizzas today came with almost no cheese, few toppings and just not very good.  Are they in financial trouble and are trying to cut costs?

Such a cute little coffee space. My husband had a Carmel macchiato and it was delicious. A tad on the sweet side but very good. I had buttered rum flavored coffee, it was very good. It could have been a bit hotter though. My daughter had a Carmel frappe she really enjoyed it. They have a good selection of desserts as well. We will return for sure.

Went here for the first time tonight with a group of 6.  Firstly, it is clear that this place is popular as it was packed.  However, the staff were efficient, polite and quick at getting you seated at taking care of you.  The atmosphere is comfortable and classy.  

My wife and I both had the NY Steak.  Both were a little over cooked but were very good.  The Greek potatoes the steak came with were awesome.  We also really likes the lemon rice soup.  Very interesting and tasty.

We also got the bread loaf with our meal and I could probably eat three of those alone.  It was awesome.

Overall a very good night out with good friends and good food.  We will definitely be back to try out the many other items on the menu.

Not impressed at all. They didn't carry one thing I was looking for (what kind of drug store doesn't carry non powdered latex gloves??) And their prices are very high. However I did need a few things that only they carry. When I got my items, I had to stand at the only open register for 10 MINUTES before someone came and rang me and the other customers through. The guy who did finally show up, said supervisor on his name tag, and he didn't even know how to work the till!! so glad I only need to visit here once in awhile!

I highly recommend this place. The prices are very affordable and it is a clean, well kept space with friendly staff. You will always find something and I regularly find gently used if not new with the tag still on brand name items. Excellent resource for anyone on a budget. However, it definitely has more clothing for women and children than men, but that is somewhat typical in the second hand world. 
During the change of seasons or when they have lots of stock, they will do a big sale where everything is a dollar. Those are sales you do not want to miss! In between those major sales, they regularly have deals of the day where certain tag colors or types of items are priced to sell. They have a Facebook page (County Clothes-Line Foundation Sherwood Park) and I would encourage you to like them on Facebook, because they use their page to advertise sales. 
Currently, the parking lot to access the store is being redone, so customers have to park on the street and walk in. The address listed on here must be the previous location. I have been shopping there for about two years and it is located at 201 Athabascan Ave, Sherwood Park, Alberta, T8A 4C8.

This was the worst meal i have ever had
My husband did a pick up last night spent over 45 dollers an 
I cold nt even eat it . It was cold an the taste
It was gross 
I will never go there again 
An to top it off what i did eat ended up in the toilet.  Later that night

I've started shopping at Pookey's due to its convenient proximity to my BFs house. Seeing as I'm almost always here it's no trouble to grab my sweet baby Belle and take a walk over. Belle is always welcome in the store and lives sniffing around. 

Pookey's carries my usual kibble brand and a great selection of treats and soft food for when I feel like spoiling my pooch.
