The staff here are friendly and helpful, I like that they don't follow you around asking a million questions. But if you need anything they anticipate your questions and are quick to find a solution. 

What I like most about Pookey's are their hours!! They are open from 9-9 every day of the week; that's unheard of in almost any retail store! Their shelves are always stocked and the shop is clean. Prices are comparable to most pet supply shops and they also offer a rewards program. 

Also, they carry frozen adult mice for your reptilian needs. My boy Noodles approves!

Last night after the Rush game, my bride & I detoured via Original Joe's on way home. Have not stopped there for about 18 months. Wine selection is limited, but managed to find something. Bar menu is pretty typical, the burgers are great, the wings so-so. If going for wings, go elsewhere, but okay if that is your watering hole. I would go out of my way for the burgers.  On busy nights could use more servers, we were in the upper section and only had one lady, she did work here butt off, tray was always full of drinks or empties, but wait was long. Lots of screens but really how many views do I need of Vegas poker. Lots of cabs waiting near door.

This place is ok, taking in mind that we don't have that many good mexican restaurants in Edmonton, I'm mexican and maybe that's why my expectations are high but off all of the other mexican retaurants I had try in Edmonton I will say this is the best one, so if u like mexican food this place is good to give it a try. The place inside is nice and clean and the staff is super nice.

Came here in the early evening for some beverages and snacks with my wife and friend. The place was full. Our server Justiss was at our table in quick fashion and took our drink orders and returned after only 5 minutes. Not bad considering how many people were there. Also reflects on how organized the bar staff was. Playoff hockey was on so lots of TV's and games to watch. I must say though that the volume was almost deafening levels and made it difficult to carry on a conversation without having to yell across the table. My wife ordered a burger and our friend and I ordered wings and ribs. Justiss checked on us regularly to take additional drink orders. The food arrived after about 20 minutes. The burger was tasty and the ribs and wings were ok.....I mean we're talking bar food right? Good evening and great service.

What a lovely coffeehouse! When we walked in we were greeted warmly by the barista. She asked us if it was our first time there, which it was, and she proceeded to tell us all about the menu. The coffee was delicious and the pastries were immaculate. I highly recommend SGC to anyone who is looking for a boutique cafe experience. Just lovely.

I use to get great service, but not anymore. I am sorry for being an inconvenience to your serving staff. Place was dead, there were at least 4 waitresses waited 20 minutes without getting so much as a hi. 

Use to be one of my favourite spots but the lack of service is quickly changing that.

We had wor won ton, seafood pho and green onion cakes.  The green onion cakes were excellent but the soups were both very disappointing.  The broth was good - but they were very skimpy on the seafood and won tons.   The won ton soup was mostly cabbage and the seafood soup was mostly both.   There were 4 won tons on the very large bowl.of wonton soup.  In my opinion the restaurant is being "penny wise and pound foolish"  I won't go back.

Often very quiet but service is slow. Last time we tried to visit we sat in the lounge which had one other table seated. Three staff and after 20 minutes we still had not been approached. We left. At which point we were acknowledged and wished a great evening?!

As far as pub food goes, Average Joe's is better than average.
I've been a couple of times, and everything around the table has been much better than expected.  The menu has a large selection that includes flat bread pizza and salads.  The everything we've tried was tasty and plentiful and the sandwiches and burgers come with a choice of fries or onion rings.
The staff is really friendly and helpful, and their nightly specials are actually worth stopping in for.

Caffrey's is my local pub.  It is a large place, with specials everyday and for every occasion.  Why is it my local?  For the following reasons:

NOT pretentious..    I can go in and have a beer after work with my husband and not worry about dress code!  (No he is not a rig pig, just a hard working blue collar boy who doesn't need a change of clothes to have a beer.)  Then get cleaned up for a nice night out with the whole gang!

On nights out, we can enjoy the hockey game, in fact, we go there for most Oilers games, as they play commentary and we like to hear the colour play by play.  

Friday nights are great time to catch up with friends and share an assortment of free appies that Caffrey's serves up to their customers.

Live music, good food..   an absolutely yummy weekend steak and eggs as well!

The best part about Caffrey's is their commitment and pride in local fund raising events!  

We will continue to enjoy the atmosphere and ease of Caffrey's!

This is my new home grocery store... It's really confusing because it has the exact same layout as my previous save on foods except opposite. 
The parking lot for this store seems like an afterthought. You enter heading west off Lakeland or behind the store on cloverbar. The parking lot is a mess, you have to drive through really awkward intersections or around terribly placed barriers in order to get in. It's not safe for cars or people.
This grocery store has energy saving lights in the coolers that shut off if no one is there, but sometimes they are a little slow to activate. I like my food lit up all the time. Especially with led light technology for energy savings, I could go without the motion sensor technology.
This store is less busy than most in the park thanks to emerald hills only a few blocks away and aspen trails being currently under construction... Enjoy it while it lasts.

Always Great food and has become the pregame meal of choice for my two minor hockey players.  Thanks for making game day so easy.  My little secret - you can also buy some caesar dressing to take home.

It's a modern neighbourhood bar sports lounge.   Many televisions for sports.  A long curved bar counter with attractive servers.  They have a patio.  The servers are pleasant.  The piped in hard rock music is too loud and it is hard to escape the speakers. The food is generally good.  But they really skimped on the toppings for our $18 3 topping pizza.  Had to look hard for any mushrooms and salami.  We were disappointed so won't order pizza here anymore.  Happy hour prices are almost the same as regular prices.  They have weekly specials. But it can be a busy place during sports events.
Food is always good. Portion sizes keep getting smaller every time. They need to fix that!

We hit Salisbury once, if not twice, per year for major plant investments, generally for bedding plants, tomatoes and herbs. It can be expensive but the plants are generally high quality and the staff is helpful. Just like anywhere else, certain things sell out quickly and all that's left are the leggy, sparse plants. I don't generally buy hanging baskets or regular planters because Costco and other store have competitive stock for a much more affordable price. But if you're looking for something different, Salisbury has a huge selection of gardening and 'lifestyle' items, and is the perfect place to find a unique present. They also get in some neat accessories, like purses, tops and jewelry. 

I recommend getting the annual membership for $27, which offers 10% off regular price. It soon pays for itself.

Someday I'll have a house large enough for a $150 tree-sized hibiscus, someday...

We went there last new years What a  disappointment.... The service was slow the selection was poor as it was mainly fish which I do not like and the dessert was a disaster . so when looking for a new years place to go foe 2013. Don,t pick this place poor food,poor service and high prices. I wish the Old place was back............

When I'm in the mood for some pasta, this is the place I go. It has great home made pasta and sauces. If you buy the large pasta bowl size, your entitled to free refills, but honestly getting through just one is tough (but very delicious).

Food was DELICIOUS, although a bit over priced. Staff was extremely helpful and even offered to make something off their menu for my kids. Whether or not they are even in the parking lot is hit or miss, because they also do private functions. A special treat, but would not visit regularly.

I went to pasta pantry this evening For dinner after reading the reviews on yelp. Service was very friendly. I placed an order for carry out I got pasta and then tried the meatballs and got a Caesar salad.  My salad was very good. It was crisp and fresh. I thought the meatballs were a little too lean, not like momma used to make. But they were still good. I also tried a chicken Parmesan, it was pretty good too. I got pasta with meat sauce. The pasta was done a little more the al dente but it was still enjoyable. 

In all I would go there again. 

Keep in mind they are closed on Sundays.

Decent pub in the Park.  But they need a liquor menu.   Modern decore.  More upscale feel for a pub.  Long bar seating area.  Large place with many tv screens.  Have happy hour every day til 7 and even 12 to 6 on Sundays.  They don't post their beer and highball prices so ask to avoid sticker shock.  Is a mixed crowd of all ages.  Freeloader Fridays is nice with free snacks from 6 to 7.  Have bands on weekends and karaoke Monday and Tuesday evenings.  Regularly show sports games and that is when it tends to get busy and loud and on Wednesday wing night.  Otherwise not too busy.  We found the food was good with salad choices.

I couldn't agree more with one of the prior reviews. Food is good, but the amount you pay for your serving is extremely high. I enjoyed 2 taco's, but they cost me $10. The lady said the taco's were 6 inch pita's. After seeing them, they definitely were not 6 inches, more like 4. (bring on the joke's - haha). 

Anyways, $10 for half a meal from a food-truck, no thanks.

I have eaten here once before and it was fantastic, albeit a little long for wait times for food. I wanted to go again so called to make a reservation and spoke directly to the owner. She said 9pm and 4 pm were the only available times. I told her I would call right back. 60 seconds later I called back and a young guy answered. I asked to book the 9pm slot and was told they weren't taking reservations. I explained I had just talked to the owner and he got very rude with me. Not going to argue, just means my buisness isn't needed there. Too bad.

Pasta Pantry has great pasta, made on site. You line up as you come in, choose your pasta, your sauce and any additions - like sausage, meatballs or chicken. You get a nice basket of fresh buns and you can have a decent glass of wine to top it off.

They have been getting live entertainment in lately that has been very nice - a guitar player for example which really suits the ambiance of the restaurant.

Is that all? of course NOT! Whatever you do, don't forget to try their Death by Chocolate. It is a very light, very moist chocolate cake with whipped creamy-pudding type filling topped with crumbled Skor bar. One of my all time favourite desserts. Just remember - one piece (for $4.95) is enough for two people - easily!

Food is great, and huge portions for the price! If you come you MUST have a piece of pie for dessert! They are amazing! Staff is usually pretty friendly, although when we come in, I usually have to grab the coloring pages(which are just pages pulled from coloring books)/crayons for the kids myself, but I don't mind as I can then pick exactly what I know my kids will enjoy coloring and keep them busy. Minus one star as the place is a little run down, and the floor doesn't seem to get swept/cleaned at all during the day.

I've only had this pizza takeout (my fiancé brought it home for us) and it was wonderful. 

I ordered the chicken wings which were unbreaded (thank goodness) and nicely flavoured. Plump and crispy! 
I also go a little cheese pizza that was so gooey and fresh tasting I ate the whole thing. 

He gets the meatlovers and suggests to add meatballs. 

The service is always fast and friendly!
Blue collar atmosphere - the food is good - service is competent.  Excellent value attracts seniors. A popular breakfast spot in the Park. Adjoining lounge next door for a more roadhouse feel.

Wow, what a great place to get great, fresh pasta and fast. The service is friendly, and helpful. There food is really really good. Great price especially if you purchase a large, you get a free refill!  They come around and offer to get your refills.

The appetizers were good and the beef and brisket pho soup was very good.

The service was not the greatest.  We were the only people in the restaurant so it wasn't busy at that time but the server was nowhere to be found when we needed them.

What a pleasant surprise! I went with a friend for a weekday lunch and we ate in the restaurant. They have four chairs, so it's definitely more of a takeout place. The pizza was hot and fresh. There are a few types of crust to choose from (including stuffed!) and lots of toppings. They have classic pizzas, specialty pizzas for a bit more, or you can build your own from scratch. It's not loaded with cheese, which is exactly how I like my pizza. And it's not dripping in grease either. I had their Hawaiian pizza with the stuffed sweet peppers and those peppers are addictive! I will be back for sure.
Not my favourite pasta place. My kids refuse to eat the macaroni and cheese, they don't have spaghetti and their Caesar salad is far too garlicky.

I love BP's...  grew up in the Sherwood Park's Wye road location and am loathe to write this review...  but it is time someone said something.   The word I am going to use is:

SAD!

After ordering Lasagna both eat in and take out for over a year (yes my family goes there a lot!)  we thought we had finally figured out how to have our baked lasagna with actual meat sauce.  

We always order extra sauce. 

 No matter what, we have had to ask for extra sauce otherwise the lasagna inevitably arrives at the table with dry brittle noodles and one slice of cheese bubbling on top.  After figuring out the extra sauce, we continue to go, until the last time, when we ordered it, didn't receive it and then to top it all off, got charged for it.  

We have also had issues with the delivery where we have been charged for items and then they aren't in the bag. 

The portions sizes are hit and a  miss, sometimes you can count the fries that are on the side of your plate with two hands...   or you order a full size cactus cut fries appetizer and there is 16 (yes we counted) slices.    Side salads are ghastly and not worth the money.   

The worst thing is the pizza sizes, when we ate at a Boston Pizza on Vancouver Island, the pizza's were huge, full toppings and delicious..    pizza at this location is lack luster, and lacking in toppings.   

Sad Sad Sad!

First time at this Keg.I have been a Keg customer for many years. This location is very nicely decorated and the lighting is awesome.The service and food were outstanding.I will be going back there again.

Extremely slow drive through, I would definitely recommend going to another Tims... I have been in line between 540 and it is just now 6am.... I am still behind two vehicles stuck in here. I have no idea how they could possibly get away with this garbage being near a truck stop

very authentic Mexican food! I had a great experience here. I ordered the chicken enchiladas which were amazing! And you can even choose your level of spiciness that you like. The service was wonderful very friendly and we didn't have to wait too long for food either. I love that there's a Mexican restaurant in my neighborhood. You definitely feel like you're transported to another place AKA Mexico!

We have not been to a Tony Roma's restaurant since Montana's opened in St. Albert.  We used to frequent Tony Roma's for a good meal, however, once Montana's opened, we were getting less and less food for our dollar at Tony's so we switched it up.  Yesterday, family decided to try out TR's in Sherwood Park and I have to say, it was VERY disappointing.  Coffee was old and burned so we had our waitress get us a new pot brewing.  No big deal there.... food was substandard in my opinion.  French fries were cool... ribs tips were way over cooked and dry and the prices are steep.  Then, on top of it, the tip is added to the bill before we even get it!  That is a no no for me... tips are just that, a tip for service. Its not automatic and I won't eat in a restaurant that makes me pay for services I haven't even received yet.  Thankfully, our waitress pointed this out to me before I added in my tip to the bill.  Unfortunately, one other guest at our table was not so lucky and added his tip to the tip! I will not come back to TR's again.

You know those days you have where you don't want to cook but you're tired of pizza and burgers? Go to this place it will not disappoint. 

If you are in the mood for a hearty, filling dinner of pasta you need to come here. Locals will know that this place has been a fixture of Sherwood Park for quite sometime. Their new location is quite spacious and inviting. The moment you walk through the doors you are blasted with the warmth of boiling pasta and the aroma of sauces. 

This is not a typical restaurant. Locals will drop in to order takeout. They don't do table service. You feast your eyes through the glass at the pastas and let your stomach decide what to chew on...pasticcio? Regular pasta with 4 cheese sauce? Spicy meat sauce? Meatballs? It doesn't matter what you choose because it's all good! 

They make ordering easy and the portions are more than enough for lunch the next day. Top off your pasta with a salad and buns, well you have yourself a feast. 

The pricing is great. The service is excellent. You know young kids might get a bad rap but for some reason this place is run by a great group of kids. They are pleasant, fast and do a great job. So kudos to management. 

You will not be disappointed by this place. I visit it at least once a month. My waist line seconds that.

We've been to this Keg several times and have never been disappointed.       The food has been great and the service very attentive every time.  A super place to go for a special occasion or just fine meal. When I want to go out for a good steak this is now my go-to place.

Wow ... and I mean wow in the worst way possible. We love Mexican food and were excited to try this restaurant. It was a disaster all the way through. It started with pop being flat but that was rectified. Then when our food came we asked for an extra plate since we were sharing. It never did show up and neither did our waitress. The torta we had ordered was so dried out that it was inedible. I would have sent it back right away but nobody ever did come to see if everything was ok. By the time the waitress did show up everything else was eaten. She asked if I wanted something else and I told her no just take the torta back and bring the bill. She then brought the bill and tried to charge me for the returned food. When I told her no she threw the debit machine on the table and stomped away. Never have I been treated like that by a server. A different girl came back with a fixed bill. I asked her if the waitresses usually threw stuff on the table. She said no the other girl was just rude. There was no attempt to get the manager or to make things right. That is the sign of a restaurant that doesn't care about return customers. Message received. We will not be back.

You never can go wrong at The Keg. I was so happy to see that there was one by my hotel. So we decided to come here for dinner on our last night in town. 
Just like every other time at The Keg, everything was excellent!
The food and the service were top notch. From cocktails, to starters to the main course, I throughly enjoyed it all!
I found the beef steak taco meat was a bit chewy. The restaurant was clean and well maintained.

Enjoy the environment but the food is consistently disappointing.  The latest disappointment is the poutine.   The fries were cooked to a nice soggy state in very dirty oil.  Judging by the amount of cheese curds,  the cook must buy them with his own money.

Checked out Mexico Lindo tonight. The staff are very welcoming. The service was great. The server was not afraid to make suggestions or answer questions which I appreciate. My husband had the beef tongue tacos which he said were good. I had the soup and cheese quesadillas. They bring two hot sauces and some salsa to your table to start so you can have some chips and/or season your food to taste. Things tasted good but we both felt that there could have been a bit more seasoning (salt). We were too full for dessert but one table had the churros... I want them haha. The prices were quite reasonable as well. We would definitely check it out again!

I was at this establishment last night with a group of 11.  We were firmly told they did not have the technology or willingness to breakdown group costs and provide separate 6 bills as this amount of people were too many.   However, we would still be expected to pay the 18% gratuity and a calculator would be provided for us to figure out our own costs.  The bill was over 600.00.  This experience was totally humiliating and I  felt bad for our waitress, who was left on the front lines to deal with this REDICULOUS and FRUSTRATING Disaster!!!  Do NOT expect a lovely evening for more than 4 people.
I found a bone in my pho.. luckily I got a refund, but it ruined the experience for me.

We ordered a dinner for 4 for take-out, planning to feed 5 hungry people. We felt like we could probably have fed two more with the amount of food received. I would describe the food as the prototypical Chinese take-out. Everything was saucy, and well fried. Happily, no one ran into any grisly bits on the chicken, beef, or pork. The delivery was prompt, and we all agreed we would happily order from them again

I have only ever been here for drinks, but its not the best time. Nice enough atmosphere, swanky and all that but a couple small issues bother me to no end. 1) there is only a single unisex bathroom in the middle of the dining room, seems awkward to me. 
2) there is only a wine list, no drink list. have to constantly ask the waitress what they have, then she goes to check and comes back. incredibly inconvenient. 
3) Vicky seems drunk all the time, always going to the bar for drinks.

First time being in this new location. It was great  service and food. I ordered the Sunday Sangria special and noticed later I was overcharged. Overall definitely a place to go back. I will just pay attention to the bill before I leave. 

Plenty of parking, the bar area is nice as its not so dark.

Still waiting for a response after 16 days.  One week ago on January 9 I got this response AFTER I asked on the 8th why I was still waiting for a call from the owner.

Shoppers Drug Mart
Hi Marlene, 
Thank you for messaging us. Please accept our sincerest apologies for the delay in responding. 
We have reached out to the Associate Owner and he has confirmed that he will be in touch with you shortly. 
Please do not hesitate to contact the Customer Call Centre at 1-800-SHOPPERs should you have any further questions or comments. Your Reference number is 540586.

John
Customer Service

On January 1st I got this message
Shoppers Drug Mart
Hello Marlene, 
Thank you for writing to us about your experience at the Shoppers Drug Mart located at 1020 Sherwood Dr. We apologize for the incident that you my have experienced in the cosmetics department of this location and for any inconvenience that this may have caused. 
At Shoppers Drug Mart, we promise to provide superior customer service that goes beyond your expectations every time. We were sorry to read that, this time, your experience did not reflect these standards and, again, we sincerely apologize.
Your comments and concerns are important to us and we have forwarded them to the Management Team at the store for further investigation and to follow up with you directly. 
Thank you again for bringing this matter to our attention and allowing us to improve our services to our customers. Please do not hesitate to contact the Customer Call Centre at 1-800-SHOPPERs should you have any further questions or comments.
Regards,
Kofi 
Shoppers Drug Mart Customer Service

I don't know why I keep hoping Montanas gets better but they just don't. Had to go ask for cutlery, beef is over salted and fatty. The pulled pork slider should read pork hockey puck. Ribs were good and I wanted butter for cornbread but the server reappeared about the time it was - to pay. As I am here now, I hope against hope she returns so i can fill up on cornbread as the rest was just not adequate. But I doubt somehow she will alas I will throw my Montanas gift certificate on the table and leave forever. (The card was from Montanas as they were deplorable in service at another location...but I won't be back no matter how many gift cards you throw at me!) Stop at grocery store on your way home instead....better food & no expectations of service! Stay away

Another fantastic meal at The Keg. This was our first time at the Sherwood Park location and we were very impressed with the food, the service, and the atmosphere here. I still think the keg is a bit overpriced, but it is consistantly delicious. Always go for the double baked potato side. It tastes like heaven.

Do not recommend.  Service is horrible.  We ordered and paid for 2 large pho takeout got home to find regular size and skimpy toppings.  Called to remedy the issue but when we showed up they wouldn't honour our replacement-  go next door to Miki sushi it's way better

we love the food here.... Especially the spicy speciality soup  (do not know its name), the lemongrass chicken rice or vermicelli bowl.

It all worth for the price you pay. Average per head would be between CAD 11.00-15.00

Must go for sure !!!

I'm anything but Average, but I came here on a recommendation that they serve Craft beer. Well, they did have ONE Alleykat on - the Aprikat, which we liked. Then the server mispronounced Shocktop when trying to clarify the one interesting European import on the menu, and although we ordered a pint we got a whole pitcher - a rip off at that, $25 a jug for mediocre American imitation craft beer. They also had no idea what their own rotating tap was. 

We got disgusting glasses with other people's mouth imprints on them. A couple of server-dudes walked by but did not ask what the empty glasses and full pitcher was about. 

The burger special on Thursday was a highlight, $8 for a base burger.  Decent but the atmosphere gives me the creeps. There are more TVs in here than any bar I've seen. I am a sport lover, but I need a couple of massive well-placed screens, not every place I look lined with one. Total waste of money if you ask me. Though it's probably awesome for hockey playoffs.

They have a hidden jewel at the bathrooms, if you ever have to suffer this place, one of those bowling lane games. Fun!

Stick with Original Joe's if you must - and forego the Average.

Very few people for a Saturday night. A couple of guys sitting two booths behind us continually dropping F bombs. Bits and pieces of paper like products on the floor giving an unkempt and untidy appearance. Dirty comes to mind. Why can't the workers pick them up? New manager is obviously required.
We ordered a prime rib and a rib-eye and we both ordered seasonal vegetables and baked potatoes. 
Both the prime rib and rib-eye were ordered medium/rare. They both came cooked medium/well. The "seasonal vegetables" were just broccoli and probably, in market value, were no more then ten cents worth in quantity.
Would rate it two and a half out of five.

I love the Shoppers at the Sherwood Park Mall.  I tend to be a cosmetics & skin care junkie even though these days when I am not working, I am usually found without make-up on.  This Shoppers carries the best selection of all the regular brands and the "department store" brands, and then some. I use Bare Minerals, a line previously only available in the U.S. or at Sephora and this is one of the Shoppers that carries it.  

The staff in the Beauty Boutique as well as the rest of the store have always been courteous and helpful.  In the Beauty Boutique they are always ready to help you try anything you are interested in, a new product, colour, scent, or makeover if there is time or they will set up a time for one for you.    I do not use the pharmacy so I cannot comment to their service.  The Beauty Boutique also has different "Galas" where they bring in the make-up artists from the different lines and you can make an appointment for a make-over with the artist of your choice, (on a first come basis...)

I can never go in and just buy that mascara I need.  I always fall in love with some new colour or some new product , or want to try something else.  Isn't that what marketing is all about?  I know all the gimmicks and still fall prey to them!!!  Hey, I did say I was a junkie!  So I signed up for the Shoppers Optimum program, signed up for the e-mails, and made the program work for me.  I only go in when they are offering 20X the points.  And WOW!  The points add up fast.  I make sure I buy 2 of my mascara, and what ever else we usually get from Shoppers.  I make my trip the the Beauty Boutique etc.  Well,  those Galas I mentioned?  Being the junkie I am, have gone to a few (did I say a few?) and my points have paid for my purchases.  A few times a year Shoppers also offers an additional reward when redeeming your points.  Instead of getting a certain dollar amount for redeeming you get an extra dollar amount.  That is the only other time I redeem.  I also ONLY redeem when I get to them MAXIMUM bonus amount.  They want you to redeem whenever you get the minimum.  That is what is best for them but worse for you.   I have redeemed for 2 good digital cameras, one an underwater one before a trip to Dominican Republic.

My wife and I enjoy dining out, and have been to most of the nicer restaurants in the Edmonton and Sherwood Park area. We hadn't been to Vicki's so we thought that it was time to try it. So we got there to the nicely central Sherwood Park location. The restaurant itself seemed nice, and almost newly renovated. Unfortunately that was the only positive thing that could be said about the experience. We walked in the door and waited for a hostess to greet us and ask us if we had a reservation or how many people were looking for a reservation. 9 minutes later finally someone stopped by and asked for how many people. We told them 2 people and they said they were just clearly a table and it would be 2 minutes. Another 10 minutes went by and we asked who I think was the manager (short, wearing a vest, early 40's, slight accent) how long it would be and he told us to be patient and they were busy and doing the best they good. We were a bit surprised by his attitude but chalked it up to the fact that he seemed to be dealing without another irate table that had been complaining about something prior to us asking him. So we finally sat down, and about 10 minutes later we still hadn't seen a waitress. So I stopped another lady who also seemed to be a manager (really short, 50's big blond hair) and asked her if there was a waitress around. She then proceeded to tell us that "its busy in here. A waitress will come when she has time. What do you want us to do". I was so shocked I didn't know how to respond. Things did not go much better after that, and given the extremely high price of this restaurant we will never go back. The service is so poor that I really am amazed that they are still in business. Guess we should have listened to the other reviews on this place.

My first order with IDOP (carry-out). Every time I had tried before to order online, their system wasn't working but it's fixed today. Located within a stone's throw of three other pizza shops, you know the competition's fierce. Parking's tight, wouldn't want to be there during rush hour. Very clean establishment, limited seating and tables (white plastic outdoor furniture), fella at the register was friendly and it all popped out of the oven right on time (I'm talking to the minute). Pizza was terrific: they've got a great sauce---the kind that's flavorful without simply being over-spiced. Crust was perfect. Pepperoni was just right. Baked to perfection: crisp but not overdone. The 'cheesy garlic pizza bread' was okay but could've had more cheese and garlic. Might be a tad greasy for some people (I thought it was just right myself, though; not eating pizza cuz I think it's healthy!). They have gluten-free menu items and a pretty broad range of appetizers and other choices beyond pizza that I'd like to try. I figure it's maybe 10 percent more expensive than Dominos but I'll be back for their more authentic pizzeria taste.

This is my favorite Shoppers location by far.  Staff are always friendly and helpful, it carries the full cosmetic line (some of the smaller locations don't always carry my particular make up brand "Cover FX"), and it is close to home.  There is always parking and it is never super busy.  The Shoppers loyalty club is not too bad either - although I don't really care about the points, the discounts and promos are pretty cool sometimes.  I signed up for the email notices cuz if I plan it right I can make my cosmetic purchases when they are offering the free $10 Tim Horton's card when you spend however much (my make up is ridiculously expensive so it works out!).  It's for sure the staff at this location that make it stand out though - a refreshing change to what seems to be the standard for customer service these days!

Bathrooms are absolutely dirty and smell terrible! And it's really sad that the automatic doors for people who need them haven't worked in months! Seems like they don't clean or keep up on the maintenance!

Gross, feel sorry for the people lining up for their slop here. I refuse to go to any Tim Hortons because of this location. 
I wonder if the people who work here realize people are eating what they are working on. Maybe someday I'll order something, pay for it and watch the person who made it eat it. That might bring some perspective to their eyes.

Stoped in to have lunch and a drink bartender was not interested in being there. was notified I can only use pub menu cause they won't serve off there dinner menu   So I order and then 10 min later I'm informed they have no cook at 2 pm so no food was 
So disappointed and a waste of my time

I buy my dog food from pookeys because they have a great selection of locally made dog food. They always have good stock and are open long hours. Why I only buy dog food at 8:30pm is a mystery to everyone.
The pricing here is as good as anywhere else and they also have a frequent buyers program that gives you discounts based on how much you purchase. I recently got $25 off a bag of food wahoo.

I wish I could leave no stars, my co worker and I ordered skip the dishes and 1/2 my salad was rotten. When I called to complain the manager argued with me and tried to make me feel like a fool! The jokes on him, I've managed kitchens most of my adult life, SHAME ON YOU MONTANA'S FOR SELLING ROTTEN FOOD AND THEN ARGUE WITH THE CUSTOMER OVER IT

Great ready homemade pasta that's
 Great with great service. 

Salads are fresh and whole wheat pasta.  

Even great Peroni beer for $6.50. 

Love the place.
Food is a cold and not good. At least it fills you up till the next day. I recommend the $5 Garlic Bread and the chicken parmesan. I would ask how to make it but I know that I would never do.

Love coming here to eat their fresh pasta and sauces! It's cafeteria style so nothing fancy but it's awesome for take out on a weekday evening when you're feeling lazy. Their salad dressings are really good!! And if you eat in and get large sizes it's free refills! What's not to love.

$3 for a side of salsa to go with your $2 Tuesday taco....brilliant!  It is a large popular bar in Sherwood Park.  TV screens everywhere and large!  New renovation has changed it from the eclectic sports to a modern urban bland bar.  Beer prices are now $7 and $9 a pint!  Although you can get sleeves for five and a half.  They shrunk the quesadilla to fit in a salad.  Burgers are OK.  Food prices did go up a little.  This place competes with the Brewhouse.  They turn up music on Thursday to the weekend which I find too loud.  Mixed age crowd.  A lot of sports groups come here.  Service is erratic.  It's an OK place and the bonus is that it's open late on week nights. Has a patio and patio bar in summer.  Taxis dangerously double parked out front  which impedes traffic and visibility.  They should assign the taxis two stalls just across the way from the front row parking.

I went to the County Clothesline to find a dress that my daughter needed for a photo shoot.  I had only yesterday to find as I needed to mail it to her in Vancouver so it would be there before Saturday.  One of the ladies there said there was a dress in the back that might be exactly what I needed.  She wnet to see but was told they couldn't take it out.  So I went to ask the manager Freda if I could see it.  I was told there was not way I could see it or buy it.  They could not bring out till graduation season.  It's March and many people start looking for grad dress way before this and since when do you refuse to sell something you have in stock.  So I will never return to County Clothesline nor recommend anyone go there.  The ladies on the sales floor were wonderful but as a manager Freda you are lacking.  So much for customer service.  Extremely Poor Service on the part of the Manager Freday.

Rita Barrett
The Sherwood Park Keg doesn't disappoint. You know what to expect on the menu and the food will be good. From the hostess' right through to the managers we were always taken care of.  Love the decor.

I like how some customers can complain about the stupidest things.To be honest with you I go into that store all the time and they always have what want. I also don't like how some of these customers on Yelp are saying that the staff that work  here are rude. Maybe you shouldn't make up a ridiculous lies about something that isn't true.

I really like this place! I have been quite a few times and have always enjoyed my food. You get to pick what type of pasta you'd like (they have some noodles or ones baked with cheese), as well as what pasta sauce you'd like and if you'd like any add-ons (meatballs, chicken). I always gets the penne with four cheese sauce. I have tried the meatballs before which are yummy. I also always get the Italian salad. This is sometimes hit and miss. Tonight it was done really well! Sometimes I find the dressing taste isn't consistent. They will also give you a bun with your order but I usually decline as I am too full. They have kids size all the way up to large. It's quick and efficient. You are able to eat in or take out. If you're looking for a fast, decent pasta meal, I would definitely recommend pasta pantry!

This place was so good! This was our first time here, we had the trio something. Our waitress recommended, the steak was my favourite. So much flavour. 
When you first come in you get fresh made tortilla chips, and a trio of dips. One is mild and the other two on the more spicy side. Our dish came as a make your own fajita type, it included chicken, pork, steak, and one other type of sausage, cactus, a cheese. Then you build your fajita! So good! We will definitely be going back again. Really filling and if you don't eat all of your food and need extra tortillas they send them home with you! 
I wish I would've taken pictures, but trust me, you need to try if you like Mexican food!

Nice find! Of course, they are very friendly and want to show you how welcoming they are. It seemed personal connection was important.

We did take out and it was not hot enough but the flavours were there. 
The smooth salsas are two different and refreshing 
Liked the rice pudding very much!

Went for an event but unfortunately there were "minors allowed" so our party of 3 which included our baby got seated in the restaurant section. Large. Space with booth and table seating and screens in every corner. Clean and extremely friendly staff ( thank you Ewen and Sarah). When they found our predicament of not being able to join the event at the bar - they were very attentive and provided us with great service. We tried out their tasting menu and I am a traditional of sorts so I had to get my mind wrapped around the fact that my turkey and stuffing were married with pizza. Turned out okay :). The Poutine was delicious and the drinks satisfying. I would give it a try during the festive season. I was not able to try anything else on the Christmas menu but definitely would want to hear other  reviews :)!

Oriental food is not my first choice ,  but I was very displeased with there service here . While communication skills were lacking by the telephone operator I found one of my 16$ plates severely under cooked as well as a slow delivery time .  Golden 88 on graham's food was better quality at 1/5 the price .

This Beauty Boutique has wonderful skin care selection such as Lancôme that I love. I would have rated it a 2 before because service is usually not that great at all at this location. I know good service when I get it and when I don't........and yesterday I did get it........ professional, wonderful and  educated service!. I felt like this person was more interested in helping me and educating me on skin care than in the actual sales.  She made me feel special.

Please go see Lindsey if you want true and honest help. I had my 2 girls with me at the time and they also loved Lindsey. A true beauty- inside and out! 
THANKS  LINDSEY!   

                              *****FIVE STARS FOR LINDSEY!*****

While the tacos here don't seem to be quite the same as they were several months ago, that could be my mind playing tricks on me.  What isn't the same and what needs to change is the complementary snack that they bring to you before your meal.  Previously, Mexico Lindo used to bring to you a small plate of totopos/nachos/tortilla chips at which one could pick until your main course(s) arrived.  No more.  Now some pretty gross wheel-shaped corn puff things are produced for you to try.  They aren't the best.  Six-year-old me might have liked them, though!

Sherwood park was in need of a unique coffee shop. It feels very comfy when you walk in, show casing an exposed brick wall and a built in booth. The counter is made of strips of wood and they have a photo collection hung on the wall. Each table has card games that you can play which I think is a great concept.

The cashier was really friendly and the barista was fast to finish my drink.

The menu is diverse and they use real chocolate in their hot mochas. I got an iced mocha which was delicious, I can't wait to go back and try other items.

One of my top greenhouses in Edmonton area. I love coming here so much that sometimes I just stop in to hang out and be surrounded by beautiful plants.

They have a large selection which varies seasonally. They do have staple plants always in stock, like succulents and tropicals. It's always very easy to find a plant thay looks happy and healthy and take that bad boy home. If you are a new plant parent, they have little complimentary handouts that talk about how to care for the type of plant you are getting. 

Now for the miscaleanouse plant stuff: Their pot section is kinda small, so you will likely need to buy a pot somewhere else. Salisbury hosts workshops and classes very frequently on things like terrariums, wrea, fairy gardens, and so on. You can get tickets on Eventbrite. I think the material cost can add up quickly but the end products look amazing!

One big perk to Salisbury is that they have a rewards system! As you buy your plants, you actually are earning money that you can apply to future purchases. So if you are a frequent shopper, you are getting rewards the entire time.
Terrible. I went for the first time and was left feeling gross and wet. My clothes got stained too!! Do not recommend!!
Nice little restaurant. Very authentic food. The salsa was very good. Everything was tasty, the waitress was helpful and the service was quick. Will try again for sure!

All of our friends kept recommending this restaurant to us and my husband and I love Latin food. It's hard to find authentic real tasting Latin restaurants in Edmonton. So I called in around noon to make a reservation for 7:30pm since it was Valentine's Day weekend I figured it might be busy. We got to the restaurant and they had no reservation for us and couldn't seem to find one in my name so they sat us on the bar side with no compensation whatsoever except for a simple sorry. Then after we ordered, it took an hour for our food to finally arrive. While we waited we had 2 margaritas each and they tasted watered down. I didn't even taste any amount of alcohol in them. We both ordered the skirt steak dinners and both of our steaks were over cooked. It had the tiniest serving of beans I've ever seen at a Latin restaurant - it was served in a sauce container so I thought it was some kind of sauce initially. Overall we will not be coming back. Worst service ever and food was not worth the price.

They over cooked my steak sandwich and they took forever, but they also comped (and re-cooked) my steak and comped my sons chocolate milk, so in my eyes they made it right. Montana's is one of the good chains that I feel genuinely cares about the customer experience.

We had 40 ppl out for our friends 50th and was served by Karissa who was AWESOME.  She knew all our names and was timely in getting our orders and just a pleasure overall.  Karissa made our night!!!

And AJ's is just becoming the place to go in Sherwood park.  Staff are almost always fantastic.

Good food - they have a fun spin on some old pub favourites; with their waffle fries and parm fries. Decent service (nothing bad nothing good) 

Honestly a great pub, that seems to always be decently busy- says a lot about a place! We've always been happy with our meal, and they have decent drink specials

BEWARE: This is the kind of message you will get if you don't give them a good review. 

"Let me introduce myself, I'm Carlos O'farrill chef and owner from Casa12doce, where are you from ? My food is from Mexico City and we do have quesadillas doradas that are stuffed with potatoes and different ingridieants. Unless you have giant hands our tortillas are bigger than mine.
I assume your Mexican and you know what your talking about. Or are you the kind of people that think that Taco Bell is authentic ? 
All my products are top quality but I'm sure you don't know about that. 
Thanks anyways and have a happy Taco Bell"

I was not going to post this message (sent to me by the owner of this food truck) but I figured I would since he is extremely unprofessional and does not care about what his customers have to say. NEWSFLASH: This is what Yelp is for

First of all, I AM MEXICAN and grew up in Mexico raised by Mexican parents so I do know what authentic is. What does my background have to do with anything? I never said your food was not authentic. If you look at me previous review, I said that the food at Casa12doce is pretty expensive ( just like other users said before) 


Happy Taco Bell? We all know Taco Bell is not real mexican food, but with that kind of attitude, I would pick Taco Bell over this food truck anytime.

Once again we are disappointed and refused to walk in the door. The only good thing left about Rosie's after the new owners, was Laurel and she quit for reasons unknown. (Likely not recognized for all the incredibly hard work she did)! Way to go Rosie's! Glad to see a bunch of familiar faces come over to Oscar's Pub where things are still consistent and bright and cheerful!

Great winter menu. Delicious drinks. Christmas themes dishes. Amazing servers.

I visited the lounge with my stepfather. We wanted to try some new items on the winter menu. All of the food was delicious and did not disappoint. I was able to try all the items, but the clear cut hands down favourites were....

1. Smoked gouda and poblanos pepper ravioli.

2. Bourbon bbq chicken pizza 

3. Aperol citrus spritz

These 3 items blew my mind and I hope they become regular items on the daily menu. The portions were very generous with lots of cheese to satisfy anyone's cravings. 

The aperol spritz was one of the best drinks I've had in a long time. For just  under $9 it was an unbelievable drink and will definetly be my go to drink whenever I go to BPs!

What was so great was the service. It was paced perfectly and the food came hot and dishes cleared quickly. I was surprised how quick she did her job in such an unobtrusive way. She was friendly and did her job well but most of all was very knowledgable about the menu. It was a awesome bc alot of the items i tried were all new items on the winter menu.

Very impressed. The place was cool as well. Lots of tvs that could be seen from every angle. A bunch of sports and u could choose which one to watch. It was amusing and great entertainment! Despite the place being jam packed, it didnt seem overly loud. I still could have a good conversation without screaming...I hate that about some lounges. The music was set at a perfect level for conversations!

Overall, this was a great visit. Food was superb, service outstanding and atmosphere hip, cool and fun! This might be one of my new hangouts whenever I'm in sherwood park!

Wow this place is a bit of a gem. It's a small independent thrift shop with some really great finds and super low prices. I snagged my self a dress and a great pair of pumps of $10. Yes that is for both items. They also have some great jewelry selection. I'll definitely be back when I have more time so I can explore the entire store.

This was bad  Kung po chicken no peanuts  peach shrimp with mayonnaise   Fried rice was  just steamed white rice crispy ginger beef had no ginger and sweet an sour  sauce 
This was lots of   Gross  food

Pretty expensive but worth it, at 5 bucks a taco. The best (and only?) taco truck in Edmonton.

I keep getting the Gringo ($10), which is just a giant grilled cheesy mess with al Pastor pork. 
The other options are pretty enticing as well, as are the variety of sauces, especially the peanut one. 

Parks between City Centre mall and Jasper Ave at lunchtime most weekdays.

Full descretion, I have yet to visit Mexico. However, when I entered into this restaurant I felt transported to another place. Beautiful bold colours we're all over. Orange, red, white, green and browns. Each booth had red, white and green runners. 

We ordered tacos al pastor de soya, tacos dorados, flautas de papa and tortas with beef. The waitress came out with chips and three types of salsa to start. The heat was from medium to hot and each was amazing in there own way. 

The Mexican coffee came with rotiboy, which is a soft and delicately sweet cookie commonly served with coffee. 

Next came our appitizer of flautas de papa. These were potatoes wrapped in a corn tortillas and deep fried. Thinly sliced lettuce with queso fresco drizzled on top. They were crisp with soft potatoes inside. I dipped mine in the salsa for more intense heat. 

My meal of soft warm tortillas, marinated soy, diced onions, cilantro and mango came out and I was in savoury heaven. The spicy rich flavours delighted my senses. I can only hope the food will be as amazing when I visit Mexico.

The staff were excellent. They were attentive, knew the menu and were very friendly. I will return especially on cold winter days.

I really liked that place till last visit the meal was good but for the price they really skimped out.We were rushed out cause we never had a reservation and the waitress avoided us so had to deal with the old bag running the show there she didn't like what I said about the meal that I was going to Mac Donald's to get full cause the salmon I had there was so small wasn't worth eating.wont be going back there

Good selection, a WONDERFUL sale on hanging baskets today, 2 for 1. It was worth the trip plus we also qualify for the seniors discount. Not going to say no to that. Helpful staff, some clever planting ideas (really liked the pallet planters), and healthy plants. We picked up 4 stunning hanging baskets and a monster tomato plant that's  already got some fruit ready to ripen in the vine. Nice additions to our garden and deck. Very pleased with this sale!

Fun new coffeehouse that just opened up in Sherwood Park.

The decor: Warm industrial (I don't know if that's a real thing) The lighting and the open ceiling are industrial but they have lots of natural wood (the bar counters are a really cool collection of wood blocks),flooring,cabinets are all in a warm grey tone. They have tables and chairs, a really comfy upolstered bench area in the corner and a bar with bar stools as well so lots of room. 

The Coffee: SO GOOD! Seriously tasty coffee from Cherry Hill roasters. The double espresso I got wasn't bitter or acidic. Just a nicely balenced coffee.

The Food: 1st things 1st - they have a baker onsite. No processed junk, what they sell they bake. They said they'll start making panini's and soups later this week. I got a cinnamon knot - So good. not too sweet, more like a cinnamon brioche. I really enjoyed it.

They have lots of parking, free wi-fi, a couple power outlets, friendly customer service. It's just a comfy, bright space. I'll be back!

Since it was opening day when I went in I said I'd help them out with lots of photos and they happily posed while I was very intrusive :)
We always eat in the lounge at lunch.  Katie is a wonderful server very friendly and always knows what I want.  Food is always good and hot when it arrives

This is as authentic to Mexico as it gets. Family run business, The owner came to our table to introduce himself. You are seated with tacos and 3 different homemade salsas. 
Make sure you order a michelada, you'll think you're in Mexico. The chamoy (pickled fruit) on the rim was even homemade and so delicious. 
Desserts are also homemade. 
Prices are very reasonable. 
Michelada picture attached.

Had a great time tonight at Salisbury! We went for the farmers market that they have every Thursday from 4-730. This was our first time going to this event. There were maybe around 20 booths that had everything from sweets to veggies to purses to jams and much more. It was awesome to get some fresh produce in the dead of winter and I was able to pick up my favourite tzaziki from a place I usually buy from Strathcona Farmers Market. They of course also have all their plants, art and clothing out from Salisbury. What was even nicer was we could bring our dog! He was able to walk around and not freeze his paws. It was a great evening and we will definitely be back. I did find some of their plants did seem higher priced than other places. Such a wonderful evening, go check it out!

Why why why do  restaurants change their way of doing business after customers have fallen in love with them and are loyal?  Like  changing the salsa and chips to save money reducing the guacamole pot size? ... No longer having an extra taco on the Taco Pastor... All these little things add up to just annoying loyal customers who have come to expect it to be one step above the rest... Anyways the food is usually very good, The service can be a bit slow but they are lovely staff, but the little things you have been knocked down a peg as Mexico Lindo does not stand out above the competition anymore.

If you are looking for decent pub fare with sports bar ambience, this is the place for you! Lots of tables and booths (usually all full!) and oodles of large screen tvs. 

I had the steak salad and it was perfect. The steak was done medium and still warm to the taste. Lots of great greens and cheese topped it off.

The waitress and kitchen were very accommodating to my husbands food sensitivities and he was able to get some food - not always possible in a pub!

The only thing that stopped this from being rated higher was the staff hanging around the outdoor patio on their smoke break. I would have enjoyed the patio, but not the added "smoky ambiance"
I don't know what pasticcio is, but damn was it good. Spicy sauce and a meatball to round out the main dish and a delicious bun for even more carbs. Carbs carbs carbs. I'm going to go take a nap now.

Wow! What a find! If youbare looking for authentic Mexican cuisine this is the place to go.  Celebrating Mexico's Independence, the atmosphere was incredible! Live music, with a beautiful singer who walked around the restaurant singing classic Mexican songs that everyone can sing along to.  The drinks were great! I had the drink Obsession and Andrea had the Piña Colada.  We shared a Molcajate.  This was the first time I have had one, stuffed with various meats, onion, cactus, cheese.  The bowl is heated to very high temperatures and it cooks the full dish together.  It is incredible.  I've been told this is the only restaurant in the greater Edmonton area that you can order a Molcajate.   I HIGHLY recommend Mexico Lindo and will gladly travel from downtown to Sherwood Park to enjoy their food.
Got a donair pizza from here. The meat had a nice flavour and the sweet sauce was good as well. I would imagine the donairs are good as well.

Hubby had prescriptions transferred over to London Drugs. Every time we went in they seemed to be out of stock of his stuff and also rude about it. I've bought a lot of chocolate there, and one day I had taken what was left in the box. Joking remarked "Cleaned you guys out!" and I got a cold stare from the cashier and told that if that was true that I should advise the staff so they can put more out. K. Do I work there? No. Do they have stock people - yes. So why make me feel bad for a purchase? Hubby ended up transferring back to old London Drugs in another city and will go all the way in for them, as they always have stock and the pharmacists are friendly!!

This place got 2 stars because they have some good choices in product and occasionally you get a good staff member, but other than that. Meh, don't get your prescriptions here!

The two things I don't like are that they don't sell tomatoes or flowers in multi packs any more and the tiny 2 inch pots are $4 each!  And they arrre tiny!  Ouch.  Greenlands is looking better now.  Otherwise this is a huge greenhouse and you can buy everything from clothing to nick knacks to annuals to perennials to trees to giant 5 foot fiberglass tortoises worth $2000 and gargoyles.  There is even a life sized Sasquatch for a tidy $3k.  For those on a limited budget you need to be selective.  For those with deep pockets it's paradise.  Lots of parking.  No restaurant.  Hotdogs at the front on weekends.
Service, quality/taste and cleanliness have completely gone down hill. Sad, because Montana's used to be do awesome. Two stars though because they still make a killer ceaser

The Pho was great. 

The Service was poor. 


...But the pho was great. I would definitely come back; after all, I'm there for the pho and not the service.

This home grown bar is pretty darn good.
It has some great specials (see my review) and it actually feels like a bar. Many bars I visit feel like upscale restaurants.
Loud, noisy, and dim. A great place to watch a game. Not the type of place you take your mom

Pros
Great Specials
Lots of parking

Cons
They don't have any specials before 4pm. So don't bother coming before then.
I asked if we could have the special at 3pm, nope. Not till 4pm
Prices are so so .

I asked my dentist for in office teeth whitening. They suggested I do in home teeth whitening due to my sensitivity. I have tried twice in the past to do it at home I have the custom trays and all. I usually only lasted a few days 2mwith at home as with each application my teeth became more and more sensitive. The dentist said that in office whitening is 10 time worse for pain in cases like mine. My theory is that I would prefer one day of intense  pain vs days and days of wearing trays and having pain. I googled teeth whitening and one of the options that came up was Glitz. I read all the info on the sight and decided to make an appointment. I had a cleaning in the 7th so I booked my whitening session for the 11th figured it was best to start with the cleanest teeth possible. Also when I booked my teeth whitening I decided I would try the Hydration Station and booked a combo package. When I arrived the studio was bright an spacious. If I didn't actually walk down stairs I wouldn't have guessed this was a basement of an low rise office building. I was given my waivers to read and sign and whisked into the lounge where I would complete my whitening. The procedure was explained to me and I was told it would be done in 2 15 min sessions so that if I did have any discomfort I could choose not to do session #2. During session one I felt no pain just a slight tingling on my gums which happens with Crest strips or gel in trays. At 15 min we evaluated my progress and I continued with the final session. The lounge chairs are very comfy. There is a TV in the room to watch shows/movies but it was hard to see with the protective eyewear so I just laid back an enjoyed the quiet. 

I was taken to the room with the Hydration Station and again everything was explained to me. I have NO idea why I wanted to try this as I don't like heat. I don't go into saunas or steam rooms but I was intrigued. I found this to be enjoyable. I think b/c my face was free from the heat and steam I was able to enjoy the benefits. That is generally why I avoid the steam rooms at spas etc as I like to breath freely. At home I don't even enjoy a steamy bathroom I leave the door WIDE open. Anyway my 30 min session was over before a knew it and I felt a lil sad. I even turned up the heat in the last 10 min as I was enjoying it!

I was told that depending on my eating and drinking habits my whitening could be redone in 3-6 months. I think I will come every 6 months after my dental cleanings just like I did this time. However I will be back for the Hydration Station before that!

Vicky's has the best Greek salad I have ever eaten in my life. The lady's always there working hard making sure standards are kept up and the food tasty!

Great staff great atmosphere when you're in Sherwood Park I'd be eating here.

The girlfriend and I went there to have a nice relaxing meal. Well we went on a Saturday night and was busy, and was 10 mixture wait for 7 pm at night which I thought was pretty good. So we sat down the waitress apologized for taking to long Which we felt wasn't that long at all. We ordered our
Food. We got our Caesar salads which we love at this place. Then 2 mins later we received our meals. 
Well we felt rushed so we eat our salads as quick at possible. The girlfriend didn't even have time to finish hers. So be the time we got to our meals they where both cold.  At the end of our meals we talked and both felt rushed and the food was cold. We asked to see the manager. It took awhile for him to come, we told him our complaint. And he did take off the salads off our meals and gave us coupons for free appetizers. I just think it's a sad excuse when the manager blames it on a busy night. They should be prepared for a busy night and run a tight ship. All
I Can say is that I wouldn't go back to this location, but I have no problem with the others.

I've eaten here on several occasions and they never fail.  Their won ton soup has their own home made wontons.  Not sure what the seasoning is, but its very nice.  I've also had a few of their other dishes and they too were very good.

I do not believe that I am being overly generous with my 5-star rating. Allow me the chance to explain why. I have dined at countless Vietnamese restaurants, both locally and abroad. I am no stranger to Vietnamese street food and the traditional recipes that come from different regions in Vietnam. I have a sense when establishments resort to shortcuts and flavor masking in the preparation of food items. Hence, I can confidently say that Delicious Pho stands tall amongst its competitors. 

The pho broths are fragrant and clean in appearance. My typical go-to item on the menu, BUN BO HUE, is a spicy beef soup that is remarkably well-balanced (in terms of flavor). The lemongrass notes are clearly present. I add a squeeze or two of lime juice to the broth for a further flavor experience. What I largely applaud is the lack of MSG and sodium in what I have ordered thus far. 

COM GA NUONG XA (lemongrass chicken over broken rice) introduces a dynamic marinade to thinly sliced chicken breast, which is then stir-fried with red and green bell peppers and onions until a caramel glaze begins to form. In a word ... delectable! I strongly suggest that you upgrade the accompanying plain rice to coconut rice for a pleasant twist. 

I have found that the service is sufficiently attentive, whilst not being too overwhelming or intrusive. On the busiest of days, one can usually expect to receive an order of pho in 10 minutes or less. With that said, if time is not on your side (for dining in), pho is definitely the way to go!

The one downside to my dining experiences here, albeit infrequent, is the darkened, spotty appearance to the basil that is served. I understand that keeping basil fresh can be difficult, so I do not necessarily feel it is fair to critique a place on points like this alone. What concerns me far more are the finer points such as quality ingredients, the relational proportions of those ingredients, the flavor that comes from patient cooking methods, the responsible practice of using little to no MSG and sodium in recipes, and a decent menu price. 

This Delicious Pho, and its sister property at 10418 124 Street in downtown Edmonton, will provide you a dining experience that exceeds that of its competitors. With that said, I look forward to my return. 

[To the staff, have those chopsticks and soup spoon on the ready!]

I am constantly looking for authentic Mexican food, I came across this place oddly after going to Costco. It is VERY personable, the servers are bilingual, they are not short to start up a conversation and inform you more about their food or drinks. Their flan is to die for, they have micheladas, al pastor, mocajetes too I believe  I will be back

Amazing variety in flavours, well presented, tasty and fresh food!

Clockwise from top left of photo:

The chips (totopos) were tasty and the green salsa just the right amount of spice -- my wife likes it rather bland and I like it spicy, but we both loved them.

Enchildas verdes were very nice and fresh, but we wouldn't choose them again. They were well made, juat not our style.

The nachos are to die for ... THE BEST NACHOS WE HAVE HAD ANYWHERE, ANYTIME.

Sopa Azteca was great, beautiful spiciness. They added a few small extras to give it some texture, and the sour cream and fresh cheese on the side made it easy to bring the spice back down.

Nachos de Lengua were nice and fresh (I hadn't had tongue in a long time). Great tortillas and plenty of onion with lime on the side.

Taking the time to write this review while still in the restaurant... because we are too full to get up right after :)

Highly recommended -- we drove here from west end of Edmonton and will definitely be back!

I just purchased a used vehicle from Sherwood Hyundai and honestly, it was a great experience. Everyone was so friendly, helpful and I felt no pressure to purchase (unlike most dealerships). I had my heart set on a certain model and they realized that quickly. They didn't try to convince me otherwise or encourage me to buy something out of my budget. Being a first time car buyer is a bit scary. I was fearful I would be taken advantage of; However, they guided me with honesty and took the time to explain things with patience. In addition, because I am a nurse, they gave me a great price. I am thankful they care about us healthcare professionals during these difficult times. The most important thing however, is that I would feel confident purchasing another vehicle from them in the future. They have been so good to me. If you're looking for a new vehicle, I would recommend at least stopping by.

We don't normally visit Boston Pizza, as we find it has become over priced for the quality of food. However we received 2 "Kids Cards" (one for each of our kids), giving us 5 free kids meals (each). So we have gone a few times. The last time we visited, we were told we were only allowed to use ONE card (we used both the time before, and they even suggest on their Facebook page to use one card per child). The waitress was accommodating, and did allow us to use both cards, but we were not  impressed to be told, at the beginning, that we could not use both cards. My kids didn' teat half the meals anyway, because they don't seem to like anything they serve on the  kids menu (and my kids are NOT picky eaters).

I came here for a fundraiser for the Stollery last night, and I was honesty expecting more of a dive bar, but it wasn't.

This is a Brewsters/Original Joes-esque bar with cute and friendly waitresses, a clean and laid back atmosphere, and above-average pub food (I had the sirloin salad, and my step dad had a pizza - both delicious), and unoffensively loud music.

Lived in The Park since 2005, never had a bad meal here yet, also pick up take out and it's always perfect.  Anyone complaining about the price should stick to fast food, this is fine dining.  The service is comparable to any high end restaurant in Edmonton.
Always worthy of a 20% tip, It's in our top 3.
It smells delicious as soon as you come in to the nice, bright restaurant and it's always been delicious food, pizzas burgers and donairs. It's all so good.

We go to the south common Montana's all the time. The Sherwood park location is horrible!!! We got the spinach dip so over cooked it couldn't be eaten. It wasn't busy an yet the server couldn't stop chatting with her friends. It took an hour for the food to arrive. Then we had to keep asking if we could have plates and cutlery for the table. This is horrible. Go to. Different location

If you like your nails do not go to this place! Technician removed nail polish with a dremel only, no acetone. Resulting in thin nails that have divots in them. Save yourself the money and months of nail growth to fix what was done

Used to be a great Saturday night spot , the guy and girl servers were great! Now they are gone the new bartender is a miserable old hag , unfriendly and very slow will not be going back here , oscars is a way better bar!!

Montana's has consistently good food, and has a decent atmosphere, but it's not going to blow anyones mind. You're probably in for a reliably good meal, but I've never heard anyone say "I had the best _____ I've ever had, at Montana's". Try the ribs or steak.

Vicky's is a bistro within walking distance of Festival Hall. They were able to squeeze my GF & I in prior to the show. We appreciated that they gave us a time we needed to be out to accommodate a reservation. Service was great. The waitress was awesome very informed about the menu & told us about parking for our next visit. Food was very good & pricing was on par. Great way to start the evening.Thank you.

Came here for a girls' night out and was really impressed with the size of the bar.  In fact, this may be my favourite BP bar to date!

So many seating options including raised booths in the middle of the room rather than against a wall.  Loved how many TV's there were and how they were laid out.  

Faves for us on this visit incmuded the new Rosè smash sangria, Boston Bellini, and chocolate almond lava cake!

If you've got Xmas on the brain and are up for a new take on Christmas dinner - try their Christmas dinner pizza or poutine!  The pizza was my preference of the two - loved dipping the crust into gravy and cranberry sauce! 

Well done BP's, well done!

This is my favorite greenhouse in the Edmonton area. I love the set up and could easily spend over an hour looking at the roses and peonies.  They have a large selection of both. Their perennials come with a 1 year warranty.  I had an odd situation with a peony tree and they offered to exchange it for me but I declined.

The staff are knowledgeable and if they are uncertain  they will find out for you. I buy most of my perennials here and have bought several trees since we bought our house 7 years ago.

I enjoyed the LANDSCAPING services. Their CUSTOMER SATISFACTION LADY was really awesome and helped me decided how to further my landscaping venture. My home is not quite ready but I will be calling back next year once its done being built to start the process. It was nice to talk with a contractor that had a process, organization and steps in place. I can tell their services are valuable even from the first person I talked to on the phone. She was a great help and bundle of knowledge.

A fixture in Sherwood park for fantastic pasta and other Italian treats.....
Consistently great...kids love it....and bottomless if you eat in.
Also does large trays for "take and bake" at home.
Caesar salad is fantastic.
Best news ....they are now open sundays!

Would get 5 stars if only they did something a little different...like chicken cacciatore or carbonara.

Roma is another great pizza place!  We order from the Sherwood Park location which isn't too far from us in SE Edmonton. 
Last time, ordered  Greek Salad, Margherita Pizza, Canadian Pizza and fries (always fries for the munchkin!).
Crust is nice and thick.  Sauce is yummy. Lots of CHEESE on their cheese pizzas.
We order from here every couple of months... pretty delicious!

Pretty sure that I'm going to be the only Vancouverite that reviews this place, but maybe it'll garner a following? :) I mean, I hadn't even heard of the expression "rig pig" until I started writing this review. 

This bar is huge,  American blue-collar style. Oh wait; I just described Edmonton. (That was not meant to be a dis.) Everyone is friendly, and the bathrooms are what I'd call clean for a "dive" bar. I'd never seen so many men in one bar in my  life. Maybe that's why the female bathrooms were empty? But CLEAN. I'd also never seen a guy wearing a t-shirt that made him look like he'd just been attacked by a dragon. I guess he must of been one of those-them $$$$ "rig pigs." 

We tried the mini-perogies, since, in my town I can only find these at Granville Island and even then, the shop is run by Asians. They were average, pub food and I do not believe that they were homemade, even if the server swore otherwise. I was slightly disappointed since this is almost perogy town. I might be blonde...but.

Also shared the mini-burgers. I was disappointed that they were served only with a dab of cheese. I was sorta hoping for more in the Meat capital. Oh well, they were still pretty good, but I can't say that they were any better than what I'd find at a "meh" place in BC. And no veggies on them either, since, they don't need those things here.

We were there for the happy hour food, but I was informed by some pretty down-to-earth patrons that the meatballs were "good for throwing at walls", so I took a pass.

My wine was fine, but I didn't like that the tax was included in the prices. Still, it didn't seem overpriced, and the service was good. I would probably return here again, because, quite frankly, I don't know where else to go here where I can feel comfortable and not look like Mom's night out around the teenage drinkers present.
Enjoyed a quick lunch here with the staff from sherwood dental.  Many pasta options and many sauces to choose from.  Carb load!  Plenty to take home as well

Service was AWESOME
Not so much the food. Our food was cold and undercooked. They were extremely busy at the time, but I probably won't go back for a little bit. The management were great they did take off 15 Percent of the bill. But just something's to be aware of with a new place.

On Sunday May 10 I ordered some food from Montana's using SkipTheDishes.  It took Montana's 2 hours and 20 minutes to deliver the using SkipTheDishes.  I was advised by SkipTheDishes that the restaurants was busy and there would be a slight delay.  When the food arrived at our doorstep,  the food was cold and the order was incomplete.  I have made several attempts to contact Montana's in Sherwood Park to discuss the problem and they refuse to answer their telephone.  

The manager of the restaurant returned my call and offered to compensate me for the missing items.

Amazing pasta, large portions, amazing Caesar salad (especially if you're a garlic lover), and all at a decent price. The staff is always warm and welcoming... Which is rare to find these days.  Always a go to when I am in the Park.

We had the best meal in a long time. Our waitress was so friendly and kind she was the bartender Dec 20 2019 at 2:30 pm shift and I think the chef or server was so kind. He came out ask how our food was. We said amazing and from out of town in for a funeral. He was so compassionate and bought us a round of drinks. That is true 100% service and caring. If you want kindness and good food it's a must to eat here. I wish I got there names. Thanks from the Kayters from Pilot butte sask.

VERY great service and food. I love their drink selection. Always busy, but service is still great. Portions could be a bit bigger for the price, but this wouldn't hinder us from returning. We love the keg :)

Tried Casa12doce today for the first time on Cinco de Mayo!

The fam jam and I gobbled up churros, suadero (beef brisket) tacos, and quesadillas dorados (vegetarian corn tortillas stuffed with smashed potatoes and feta cheese served on a bed of lettuce and tomatoes). 

EVERYTHING was delish!  And their sauces really hit the spot!  My fave is to mix the garlic & jalapeño with salsa verde.   Mmm... I'm drooling just remembering how good lunch was today! 

The churros were a big hit with the kiddos. 

Two thumbs up!

These guys have HANDS DOWN the best pizza I have eaten in the Edmonton Area! Not your average takeout. We make exceptional pizza at home and are always disappointed when we order out but never when its from IDOP. EAT HERE!

Caffrey's is a nice little option in Sherwood Park. There's pool and tvs and it's a fun little place to go for a drink. The first night we went there UFC was on, so it was pretty busy, but the service was still decent. 

I had mini perogies and they were tasty! 

We will likely come back next time we need a change from our usual haunts.

Can we say discrimination?! I was in a Beauty Boutique in Sherwood Park, AB buying Clinique. I picked my 3 items and decided to browse the rest of the store. I had already left the Boutique and had gone up and down MANY Isles.
