I was making my way back to the Boutique to pick up one more item of Clinique and pay when I was POUNCED on by an employee who very brusquely told me I wasn't allow to leave the Boutique area with my items, she said "Clinique MUST stay within the boutique area!" and took them from me. However I turned around and saw the men's Clinique NOT in the Boutique area. So if I were buying the men's products I could have walked around the store but b/c I was buying "women's" items they were confiscated. How does that make sense?

We order from here via Skip the Dishes quite often, but I called directly to place an order for pickup the other day, so now I feel like I can write a good review.

More often than not, we get pizza.  They have a very tasty veggie pizza with onions, olives, mushrooms, and tomatoes.  And the cheese pizza is delicious as well.  I've also had donairs here and they are MASSIVE.  Like... absolutely huge.  I'm not ashamed to say that I have had to use a knife and fork on them in the past because it was just too big to hold.  

The husband and wife team who run it are so friendly.  It makes me feel like they really enjoy being there.

The only thing we haven't loved is the greek salad.  Which was actually inedible and we threw it away.  The dressing on it seems to just be oil and oregano mixed together... but it maintains a very gritty texture and all I could feel and taste was oregano.  I'll skip that next time and probably stick to the onion rings when I need a side dish.  I suppose it's my own fault for trying to order vegetables from a donair shop! 

Overall, very pleased!
It's one of the best pizza place I've visited. We ordered couple pizza and we loved it. Recommend to visit

Authentic. My husband is from Texas (where Mexican restaurants are abundant) and felt like this was an amazing restaurant. We loved the service, restaurant decor, meal, price and the salsa options. It's our new go to restaurant when we're in the city.

The pizzas are awesome, different choices good flavours really like the stuffed red peppers. Have had the wings a few times with the dry rubs not too bad and not so messy. Always a good deal on take out for the large size great pricing. This will be my first choice for pizza in the park.
Found this Amazing place for coffee! Taste is out of this world! Knows everything about coffee. Of course had to try the macaroons. Will definitely be back!!

This place hops every night of the week. A well done Greek Canadian menu...very friendly staff and owners are on the premises and always out and about to say hello and make you feel welcome. Vicky makes her own desserts and George is in the kitchen. Great ribs and slovaki, and the greek lamb chops are my husband's favorite dish. Good idea to make reservation here on the weekends especially and special occasion events. Very good value for money...
and please please make sure you check out the bathrooms...they are the best!

I really love the idea of this place. We went in the last hour it was open and the pasta was kinda cold and overcooked which was disappointing. I think it would have been much better had it been warmer. I like that you get buns with it and we will be back to try it again earlier in the day when its hopefully fresher.

I come here about once a week to get my regular need for Pho because it's close to my work and there's always plenty of space for me to park! 

I consider myself a regular here because when I walk in they ask me "same order?" as I'm on my way to my favourite spot on the left side of the door that's kind of hidden away from everything. Every time it's a yes to the regular sized pho with sliced steak with extra steak just because why not treat myself to some more steak! 

It's always exactly what I need and they always seem to know it. 

The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is they seem to give fewer beans now and it sucks causes I LOVE the beans! 

I also had a poor skip the dishes experience with this restaurant getting lemongrass chicken. I find you get better quality everything when you actually take the time to sit down in the restaurant but you can only do so much with takeout food! 

But if you're ever craving a nice simple bowl of pho, here's a great place to stop in! They'll take great care of you. They recently got new chairs that are extremely comfortable as well.

Well, it's The Keg... so you know the food will be good.  Service was a little strange on the night we went though.

The manager was very accommodating when we asked if we could move our party to another table.  We were originally sat at a booth, which was extremely uncomfortable for everyone.  The table was far too large and pushed into the seating spaces.  So they moved us to a half booth and everyone was happy.

The men's room and the women's room entrances face each other and they do not have doors on them.  So if you miss your turn when you're leaving the restroom, you will walk directly into the other one.  For real... happened to one of us.

They have some signature drink, which is mentioned in the drink menu, but not actually explained.  So we asked the server what it was and her response was "I don't recommend it".  Maybe you should tell us what's in it and let us make up our minds?  Anyway... when we finally found out what was in it (some kind of jam, and ginger beer)... it didn't sound appetizing at all, but that's really not the point.  What if I love jam and ginger beer?

When we asked what the seasonal vegetables were, she said it was Asparagus and Red Peppers (we always ask, because my mom is allergic to Zucchini), but when our plates arrived, we all had green beans and red peppers.

And then at the end of the meal, we were discussing dessert and my aunt started to say "I think we need to try the Crème - - ", when the server cut her off and said "The Billy Miner Pie is delicious".  My aunt said again "I think we need to try the Crème Brulee".  

All of our steaks were cooked perfectly and the side dishes were delicious.  There was absolutely nothing wrong with the food.  But we had to make a conscious effort to not let the server irritate us.

My favorite!
In the summer this is a weekly family dinner for us, everyone is happy on Taco Mondays.

I have always wanted to try a pole dancing class. The unfortunate thing is my inner stripper is not nearly as proficient at swinging around a pole as I imagined her to be. 

But lucky for me the instructors at Aradia are awesome at encouraging and coaxing that inner sensual diva out. Even for  the  most clumsy and awkward of us. 

The class started out with some stretches. I have to say getting to hang off a pole really helps deepen stretches to a whole new level. Right after that we got to get right down to business and try out some various swing techniques around the pole. At first I could barely get out one full swing but it was amazing to see the improvements possible after several attempts.

This studio was easy enough to find but is somewhat hidden just off Wye Road. There is ample free parking out front. The studio has 13 poles which is a perfect size for a class like this. I was a little late for the class so didn't have much time to explore the rest of the studio. 

Thanks again Yelp for another amazing fit club event. Oh and thanks to Aradia for the amazing snack provided as well.

How amazing would a class l8ke this be for a birthday party or stagette with your besties and gal pals.

Ever since they left Wye road, they seem to think they are big shots and have the attitude to match. My very old Grandmother tripped there and fell hard and there were no apologies or anything done by the staff or owners (who were there), which was odd. Especially considering she tripped on a carpet that was flipped over and therefore was the restaurant's fault. They have also upped their prices but the food isn't much different. It's not really worth going there anymore.

Salisbury Greenhouses
52337 Range Road 232
Sherwood Park, AB T8B 1B5
(780) 467-5743
4 stars

This is one of the best greenhouses in the Edmonton area. They have a massive greenhouse that is stunningly beautiful and they sell everything you need to grow and plant, including annuals, perennials, plants, florals, tools, fertilizers, etc. They are an amazing place to go at Christmas. More varieties of poinsettias than I ever knew existed are sold here, in every shade from red to white. 

Salisbury also creates a dynamic community with newsletters, a cool website and the hosting of regular workshops on everything from spring cleaning and flower box composition to fertilizing, landscaping nursing plants back to health. Prices are reasonable, stock is lush, healthy and plentiful. It's great place to forget about winter for a while in the temperate climate of the greenhouse.
This rating is solely based on them playing almost 100% country music. Even after I complained. Never going back.

Every year I come here for fresh flowers, herbs, mini trees to plant.

I never leave empty handed,  I always come out with beautiful plants and they produce such wonderful products. 

I will always come back every year!

This may have been the worst Mexican food I have eaten. The restaurant was clean as was the men's washroom. I ordered a Coke. It was watered down and no refill was offered. My wife ordered a horchata; she said it was good. The carne asada tasted like steakum. Everything was under seasoned. Chips were not served while waiting to order. The chips served with the guacamole appetiser were deep fried, but served cold. When we walked in initially the music was extra paisa, but then they changed it , unbidden, to a Puerto Rican channel. My wife's dish ,which would traditionally served with queso fresco, was served with feta.

WE LOVE ROMA PIZZA!!!! Family owned business!!!!  We are so happy to have these guys in our neighbourhood! They are super friendly and have awesome food! Their Donair Pizza is our family go to ... love supporting a local business and really appreciate the friendly service.

Very friendly staff, quick service, and very accommodating. Food was fantastic to say the least. Only reason I don't score them a 5 stars is because they had quite a few items unavailable,even though they were on the menu. We went for lunch, so not sure why they would be missing so many dishes already. Nevertheless, the food we did order was delicious, so will return again, to hopefully try the unavailable items.

Tried this place for the first time. We arrived at 8pm and dinner rush was over. Place was very clean. Waiter was courteous and very friendly. Explained the different names on menu and also the ingredients used. Since we are vegetarian, he helped us choose menu and also willing to accommodate our choices. I ordered pad Thai and it was yummy. We got to try some new dishes . Great lil place. 

Ambience: very calming with soft music playing.

Washrooms available 

Lots of parking outside 

Would definitely eat here again

Sam, Sully and Robin were so amazing and helpful with our search for a new vehicle. They were not pushy, and when my husband and I wanted to go home to think about which model we wanted, they didn't try to force us into making the decision that moment, which is not what I expected from a car dealership! We came back later, and settled on a Hyundai Tucson, which we LOveWe would definitely do business with Sherwood Park Hyundai again, as it was a fabulous experience!

This used to be a great place but last couple years it's gone downhill. Staff have gotten really rude and I've know several people who got really sick after eating there. I really would not recommend.
Been here a few times, a true Mexican restaurant, not a fast food joint.  Food is decent, prices a little above average, wait time is average.

I've wanted to get a spray tan for a few years now, but I've always been afraid of turning orange! I did research, and found great reviews for Glitz Spray tanning online, so I gave it a shot. I read the website for details on how to prepare for the appointment. Lots of exfoliation, and no moisturizing the day of. 
Upon arriving, the owner is super friendly and made me feel comfortable. She took the time to explain the process to me, and figure out what shade I was looking for. I'm fairly pale, I feel like my legs can glow in the dark. 
With regards to what you wear or don't wear, it's totally up to you... swimsuit, underwear, nothing. For me I just wear underwear, no bra as I don't want tan lines when I wear different tops. And I feel completely comfortable.
After the spray tan, I was told not to shower for at least 12 hours, and I was also warned that tan would look 1 or 2 shades darker before you shower, and then once you shower it'll be the intended shade. This was true... I woke up and I was DARK (lol)... I hopped in the shower and the extra tan rinsed off and I was left with a gorgeous even brown tan. 
The tan lasted for a good 7 days before it started to show fading. And I didn't look after the way I was supposed to either, so I was quite impressed. I went back to get sprayed just before leaving on vacation, and I feel confident I won't look like someone who's never seen the sun :)
Highly recommend using this place. The drive from SW Edmonton is completely worth it.

NOT GOOD AT ALL!!!! This is the first time in my life that I ate pizza and it didn't taste good. Waste waste waste of money. Barely no cheese on the pizza, crust SUPER DRY. The driest food I've ever eaten in my life. WILL NEVER GO TO THIS LOCATION AGAIN.

I stopped here for lunch with a few friends one afternoon. I think my expectations from this place were a little high. The decor and atmosphere give it a feel that you are going to be treated with excellent food and service. 

Our waitress was average and served us periodically. The place wasn't busy so I was a bit surprised she was slow. I ordered the bistro burger which came with soup. I was surprised that their menu didn't give the option of fries. I didn't bother asking becuase I assumed it would have been an extra charge and also I thought the cream of potato soup sounded interesting. 

The soup was good but rated like something I would buy from a grocery store. When my burger arrived it was placed on a cutting board with a small side salad. The burger was large and had some great ingredients but after my first bite I realized that the beef patty was not homemade. It was a frozen pre made patty. So much disappoint. The bun, onions, Brie cheese were great but the beef patty was a total let down. 

For the price they charge here I was expecting a great homemade burger with fries. I've only been here once before and I will not go back. Nothing about this place makes me want to return.
We ordered the Easter special to take home and make ourselves during COVID-19 and it was so much food! It was tasty and went a long way to feed our family and make Easter special.

We were so excited when we found out a new Keg was opening in Sherwood Park, finally! but its been really disappointing from the get go.  We have been here about 6 times and each time its just not been up to par.  The steaks are completely tasteless without any seasoning and almost every time has been undercooked and not rested.

Last night was our last time.  We came in early for a bday dinner, about 4:45pm.  The rest of our party of 6 was already there, we were greeted by the server who was very friendly and ordered our drinks.  The whole place was virtually empty except for 2 small tables of 2 and our diet coke and paralyzer took over 15 minutes to get, how is this even possible unless the bartender or whoever wasn't doing their job.  This has also happened on every single occasion.

We ordered the prime rib (which was ok), 2 steaks, which were undercooked and bleeding all over the place, kids chicken strips and the oven roasted chicken.  Well first of all the chicken was so dry i had to drown it in the sauce so I could eat it.  I could swear it was cooked the day before. Also, for the price you charge and you're only going to give one tiny leg?  My nephew had more chicken in his kids meal!

It was my father in laws bday so he ordered just plain vanilla ice cream, which took a very long time to get and upon its arrival we noticed that it looked like they gave him 2 scoops from a melon baller! C'mon are you running out of vanilla ice cream or something?

Made a reservation for a family dinner tonight. 
It's a Friday so it's understandably busy. Parking is a bit hard to find but found one in decent time.

Our waiter was super friendly and she checked on us several times during our meal which was nice. I ordered the Oven Roasted Chicken, and it comes with gnocchi, brussel sprouts, vegetables, and small pots of demi glaze and gremolata.

The serving of gnocchi and vegetables was a bit small but I already expected that. The vegetables and gnocchi was a perfectly texture and wasn't too soft or too hard. 

The chicken was also very good. The gremolata was nice and bright and helped offset the heavy flavours of the gnocchi and chicken. Would go for this dish again!

I ordered take out and picked up the pizza on two occasions over Christmas 2017.

I got great discounts on both trips due to a special holiday promo. There is a small area to sit and eat once you enter. That area was bright, clean, and tidy. 

The food preparation area was spotless. Staff were friendly and prompt. I spoke with the owner who said he opened two years ago. Very respectful guy, courteous and down-to-earth. 

This pizzeria is off Broadmoor Bouelvard in a strip mall, so it is not noticeable from Broadmoor. During the first visit, I was a walk-in and got my order promptly. The second visit I ordered the pizza online and chose 5:05 pm as my pick up time. That pizza was ready when I arrived. 

When I got the food home -- on both trips -- the pizza was hot and fresh. I ordered veggie pizza both times. Great little spot.

Boston Pizza's new Winter Menu looks delicious but unfortunately I was not able to eat any of them because I am Vegan :(
However I still had a great time as I got to see all my Elite Yelper friends and this is always super fun! We took pictures, joked and laughed so even though I could not eat anything, I still had lots of fun!! The waitress was super friendly, helpful and patient. I told her that I was a vegan and she went above and beyond to accommodate my needs which was fantastic! At the end of the day the kitchen was not able to make a lot of changes on what was been offered so I had fries......which were delicious! The featured drinks were YUMMMYYYY so I would totally come back for these fruity, tall glasses, colorful drinks!!! Good job BP's and keep up with the great variety in drinks.
I would have loved to see more vegan options :)

Went to Average Joes for the first time since they expanded their patio.  A nice addition was a bar right there.  However, I couldn't believe the bartender.  He had a pitcher 1/2 filled with beer by the beer taps and when an order for a beer would come in he'd pour about a quarter of the beer from the pitcher and then fill the rest from the tap.  And then I saw where the beer in the pitcher was coming from - whenever a beer would have too much head he'd pour the excess into that pitcher.  So what ends up happening is that when you order a beer a quarter of the beer you order is a warm mix of previous beers.  And then the worst thing is that bartender is a manager there - bearded guy. Definitely not going there again.

My husband and I had a great experience here. We hadn't bought a new/newish car in 12 years and everyone there made it easy and we got a great deal!! Well done Chance, Brad and Bryan! Would highly recommend!

Came to average joes on Sunday morning for an 11:00 CFL gameSaskatchewan vs Montreal    I would say there were no less than 30 TVs  they WOULD NOT let ONE screen play the game instead having NFL on all screens. I must say for this I give them 1 star such poor Canadian pride

Have gone here for lunch and dinner. Decently busy with a lunch crowd. There's lots of seating here for dinner and it doesn't feel cramped. Got the Nachoes el Muneco and they were great. Also got the Sopa Azteca and it was very rich and flavourful. For my meal, I got the Tacos Dorados and they were well stuffed and delicious. The service was really good, and the ambiance is very much like you would expect at a traditional Mexican restaurant. Lots of parking outside for dinner since most of the neighbouring offices are closed. Bang for buck - for Mexican food in and around the city - you really can't go wrong here.

COMPLETE JOKE FROM ARRIVAL TO EXIT!
For decades The Keg has been known for excellent food typically Steak and Lobster. My gf and parents meet there for a nice dinner as we though and ended up paying for a very dissatisfied frustrated experience. Ordered Seafood Steak meal where 3out of 4 were cooked not as we ordered and were so chewy and later found out they were Sirloin Steaks which are the cheapest steak you can buy! At that price you would think it would of been Tenderloin or Eye of Round like the old days when The Keg was a great restaurant! One steak had to be remade because it was so chewy it couldn't be eaten and my order was discounted because their was No Seafood in the sauce!
My parents asked for Wine 3 times and were brought the Wrong kind Every Time!
We also couldn't hear each other because the music was so loud and Blasting like a Nightclub! We asked 3 times to please turn it down but they refused and gave bogus excuses like they were arguing with the bar employees to keep it loud! The service was terrible and the restaurant was busy but the staff were more interested in chatting their social life and dancing at the bar instead of taking care of customers!
The manager finally came out to apologize for all the problems and promised to adjust our bill and take things off but when the server brought it to us the tried to charge us an Extra 5th Meal and didn't remove Anything! Took another 10 minutes to straighten that out! This meal should of taken 1 hour to eat and enjoy our time but took almost 3 hours due to complete Incompetence!
WHAT AN ABSOLUTE JOKE OF A PLACE! NOT THE KEG WE GREW UP WITH AND NO, WE WILL NEVER RETURN AND HOPE YOU AND YOUR FAMILY CHOOSE SOMEWHERE ELSE TO EAT AS WELL.

Overall a great dine in experience. We ate here
for my friend's birthday lunch. COVID19 friendly, follow arrows, not every table was open. Great service from staff and servers. Washroom was clean. 

Delicious and very generous proportions  We ordered:
-The nachos el muneco was a winner with
my friends and I, we chose to pork meat and
it was the best!!! 
-The tacos el pastor and adored the pineapples in it. 
-Enchiladas verdes was delicious juicy and tart 
-Tostadadetinga, crunchy and a mountain of 
toppings.

We definitely had leftovers and they tasted just as good the day after.

My new favourite Mexican place to eat

This was an excellent pasta joint, kinda of build your own pasta dish with a variety if sauces and they  have chicken parmigiana which looked very tasty and i was told it was. The staff cared very deeply if you were happy with your choices and it was very busy which is a good sign.

Check in to get your free meatball!!!! 

I've been coming to pasta pantry consistently for about 18 years and it's very consistently awesome. My favorite thing to order is the large size pasta and get them to mix the meat sauce and cheese sauces together for me, they should give that mixture a name like dirty cheese sauce or something, because it's just that good. let's make that a thing. 
In my younger days I could get the large bowl filled twice but now I don't dare go back for refills because my scale would punish me.... but I do get a bun and my free meatball.
Follow my lead to pasta happiness.

Mexico Lindo was introduced to me when a client of mine suggested it for a meeting spot a few months ago. I had never heard of it before, but since then I've been telling everyone to go there. They brought us an adorable little plate of Mexican pin wheels with a few of their sauces on the house while we looked over the menu. My client insisted that I try their home made chips and guacamole as an appetizer and I was hooked! You can even purchase bags of their chips to take home with you. For my meal I ordered the shrimp tacos, which comes with 3 tacos and a side of their delicious refried beans and a side of a tasty chipotle dip. Everything tasted delicious! We got some churros to go which came with a chocolate dip and although the churros were a bit small, they were the best churros I've ever had. The service there was fantastic, and the atmosphere feels very authentic. They also have really good margaritas. I will definitely be back again.

No stars.

I dream of pizza, NOT!

The staff were friendly and the service was good but the pizza needs a lot of work.

It is the first time ever that pizza has been thrown away in my house.

Sorry for the negative review.  I hope you can turn it around, but i will not be wasting my money there again anytime soon.

I typically don't think of going to The Keg for happy hour or just a casual drink. I feel like this place definitely gets overlooked as they have some really awesome daily deals in their lounge! And I think I've discovered my favourite cocktail it's also on their Saturday happy hour menu. It's called the high tea and it's made with gin, green tea, honey, lemon and mint leaves served over ice. It's not too sweet and extremely refreshing. So happy I discovered this delicious drink! Also it can be really hard to find a restaurant that has happy hour deals on the weekend so it's nice to know I can put the keg on my go-to list!

Took a class on bonsai that included the instruction, specialty pot and my plant along with all the planting materials. It's been a few months now and my little juniper is still doing quite well. I trimmed and tweeked it so much the day of the workshop I haven't had to do much more than pinch little stray bits off some new growth. Really enjoyed this class. If I get  time I plan to take a few more, this one having been really informative, well organized and great fun.

Have to agree with other posters. The chips are weird & cheapy feeling. Portions do not substantiate the price. Portions are small not very favorable and way overpriced. I had the shrimp tacos for $28. It was not worth the price & it was bland. There was 3 soft tacos with next to no filling. The actual portion of shrimp was ok but they had no flavour and there wasn't anything else with them, except for a tiny cup holding appx 1 tablespoon of beans & same size cup of salsa. There are far far far better Mexican restaurants in Sherwood Park.

Tried this restaurant and it was very good good service good food, only negative would be beef cut was not the best.  But the rest was great.  
Try it.

This second hand store keeps nothing but the best stuff, so you can rest assured that you're not buying anything dirty or full of holes. For the things that don't quite make the 'perfect' category, they've got a 50 cent rack. They have clothing for every member of your family from kids to adults, plus-sizes and swimwear.

Theres a huge housewares section, along with toys and books.

I've been able to get some amazing deals, especially at season change times.

It's totally worth stopping by and checking them out.

My problem with Pasta Pantry is that it's totally hit and miss. 
If you somehow time your visit right, the pasta is fresh and very enjoyable. 
Unfortunately this last visit was not. I wanted to get seashells, but it was almost all gone. So I went with the penne. I've made better decisions in my life. It tasted like something you get out of a box, not the "made fresh daily" they advertise. 
On the positive side, the staff is friendly, especially the girl working in the seating area! But I can't help but wonder if they were smiling because they knew how old the penne was that I was going to eat? 
So if you are really looking forward to fresh pasta I would suggest Pazzo Pazzo in Edmonton downtown. But if you just want to eat some ok pasta, and you're willing to take your chances, then I guess Pasta Pantry is okay

Was in the store today and couldn't believe the attitude of the cashier she was lecturing customers about how they should treat the people who are hoarding and selling items for profit telling save on food customers that they should talk positive about these people and believe that if you are in need they will step up to help.  Seriously lady when all someone wants to know is when you will have meat in stock that's not an invite to reprimand someone.  People there today from what I saw were simply trying to shop for the week not for the end of the world... needless to say I will think twice about where I shop because after listening to you go off on customers doesn't leave me with a great impression of the store.

So we had a great time trying authentic Mexican food at this establishment. The service was friendly, prompt, and helpful. The food was delicious.  We ordered a super cabana drink and one Jarritos locos drink. For food we went with the nachos el mueco, I did the shrimp tacos while my husband ordered the dorados tacos. The food came out really fast and it was delicious. I really loved the nachos. The chips were home made and there was a very generous portion of toppings on top. We both enjoyed our alcoholic drinks. The were properly made and full of flavour. I loved my shrimp tacos and my husband enjoyed his tacos as well. The only thing I did not like was the décor and atmosphere was too fast foodish. It is not welcoming to sit and linger and socialize. Definitely would come back for the food though.

They switched the sides around for us at no extra cost. The Caesars were amazing. We stopped in on our way home from the gym and my partners never had Montana's before. We were not disappointed. The steak was cooked perfectly, the lettuce wraps were a little bland but there's so many bbq options on the table already I just added some to the wrap and it was perfect. The lettuce wraps were gluten free but the menu does have their gluten friendly options marked out. The server was super friendly and helpful.

Yummy yummy yummy yummy yummy so good in my tell me they give you a free meatball yay I applied there and they never call me back though but fellow yelpers I would do truly recommend check out this establishment for a good time you will not be disappointed!!! XOXO

We heard good things about Vicky's and wanted to support local. The waitress was welcoming and service was pretty good. We ordered 3 mains: the lamb rack, NY steak and pork chop. Lamb rack and Steak were well seasoned and not overdone, but the pork chop was dry and extremely salty. I ate the lamb chops without the mint glaze as it didn't complement the meat at all, we felt the same way about the sauce that came with the pork. 

The sides reminded us of steamed frozen veggies that you can buy at Costco (see our picture). Our child's fries were Kirkland cavendish which are unmistakeable (this one is forgivable). When we got home we looked it up and sure enough, their veggies were Costco Kirkland stir-fry veggie blend. For dishes around $30-40, serving Costco sides are unacceptable! This was our first restaurant we've been to as a family for two months and we left extremely disappointed. Not worth the almost $200 bill.

Worst Chinese delivery we have ever had especially since it cost us $70.  There was not one dish that we even finished out of 4 people. Called the restaurant and was told the owner would call me back. Two days later and nothing. Do not waste your money here. The mall has better Chinese food.

Large, open and clean dining area, lots of seating. Our waitress was very friendly. 
They have quite a large menu, I did find it more expensive in comparison to other Mexican places I've been.  
I ordered the beef brisket tacos. The waitress told me ahead of time that they were greasy, but I went ahead with them anyway. Because it was taco Tuesday, we got 4 tacos for the price of 3. When she brought them to me, I thought she had made a mistake and gave me pork. It wasn't the shredded beef brisket I was expecting. It was chunks with lots of fat. I would have said they were fatty as opposed to greasy. It was just beef and lots of red onion. No salsa or sauce. I asked for a side of sour cream. 
I didn't love them. They were missing salsa. I don't think the Tortilla was corn or authentic. It seemed store bought. 
My one friend got the steak tacos and said they were the best she's had. They did look better than mine. My other friend got the pork tacos and was put off by the amount of raw red onion on them, she said. 
We all got desserts. I got the chocolate flan and it was moist and delicious. One friend got the churros and the other got a strawberry shortcake of sorts - both raved and said they delicious. 

Things I would have preferred here and love about other Mexican places:
An array of salsas In squeeze bottles to add to the tacos like green salsa, habanero salsa, mild salsa etc. 
Being able to mix and match tacos. Instead of just choosing beef and having to eat 4, it would be better if I could have one chicken, one beef, one pork etc. 

I will come again and order something different. I'd like to try the enchiladas and few other items. I'm hoping to be able to raise my star rating on subsequent visits.
Best thai food in Edmonton & area. The food comes out so fast and fresh. Beautiful vibes and the owner is so kind.

My family and I were here for the Yelp Elite winter menu sampling. My husband and I couldn't find babysitters, so we hung out in the dining area and got well taken care of. My kids had fun colouring. Our favourite winter menu items were the ribs (slow cooked in cranberry sauce) and the turkey poutine! Who would have thought cranberry sauce in poutine is delicious. The turkey wasn't dry or salty; it is deliciously herbed. Must try! We ordered bugs and cheese & chicken fingers for the children. The kids' menu is always good for $7.99 each; probably cheaper if you got the kids' cards over the summer promotion. 

The Gouda ravioli was very rich. If you like cheesy and rose sauce with some smokiness to it, you would probably like the ravioli. The Christmas pizza was good; having stuffing on pizza was a bit of a pleasant surprise. My kids were content with their meals and only dug in to our meals when the lava cake with ice cream came. Service was very good. We were very well taken care of. I would come to this location again. (My second time at this location)

Pasta pantry is a good too go restaurant. The pasta here is quite good with a nice selection of sauces, meatballs, toppings, cheeses and chickens. Although some of the pasta you are getting is over cooked and or undercooked if they give you the corners of the pan. The dine in experience is nice with a soda machine with different soda selection (not the typical soda machine). The price isn't bad and more on the cheaper side for your meal with quite a lot of a portion!

Caffrey's is a run-of-the-mill sports pub located in Sherwood Park. It's solid but nothing outstanding or unique. The food is hit-and-miss, although the 6oz steak & eggs weekend brunch is pretty good. Avoid the poutine. Service can be slow, but is consistent and reliable. The beer selection is average, no real craft beer but they usually have one Granville Island offering on draught, as well as Guinness.  

I really like the space because it's quite open, the noise level is tolerable, the seating (mainly high table, limited booths) is comfortable and TVs are well visible from wherever you sit. Caffrey's shows the UFC matches and is the best cover-free venue for this in Edmonton area IMO, although you should come early or make a reservation. Prices are fairly typical, but brunch is a very good deal at $9-$11 on average versus $15 at an equivalent chain pub in Edmonton.

Good for weekend pub brunch and for sports night out with friends.

Had an interesting experience here on Saturday. Initially I want to say that it wasn't a bad experience - just a little lack luster I suppose. What I found a little odd was that the restaurant seemed to be significantly empty, but the waiting staff looked super busy... I think? There was a lot of staff and not a lot of people attending to tables so we didn't exactly get much of an experience with our waitress but who knows maybe there was a huge takeout order? Not sure, it was just very odd.
However our waitress did a decent job of attending to us - she started us off with some crispy fresh chips and a nice, light salsa. Their salsa is grounded very finely and on more of a liquidy side so it differs pretty greatly from say Tres Carnales. 
We also tried the guacamole which was delicious! It was very fresh and well seasoned - unfortunately we got about a huge chunk of an avocado that didn't get broken up but I'd rather have that than something sitting out for a few days! 
I had the tacos al pastor and the boyfriend had the tacos de suadero. Mine were really quite good, the pineapple was refreshing on it and the meat was so well seasoned. Unfortunately his seemed pretty tasteless in comparison but it had a nice texture and it was still good at that. 
Overall I was pleased but not so excited about it. Very good for the price and if I lived closer I would certainly come back!
NO THANKS. Ive been there a few times now just hoping for an improvement but well havent seen it. The staff was rude and the pasta bland, whats the hype?

Ordered from Roma on Saturday night using Skip the Dish.  
Roma has become my husband's favorite pizza!  If I was just reviewing the pizza, it would be a five star review.

Ordered a Deluxe and Margherita pizza and some chicken nuggets with onion rings.  
Asked for the Deluxe without onions and it was made to order.  
The sauce is a nice, thick pizza sauce and it's incredible.  Lots of cheese on both and cooked perfectly.
The reason this review is only four stars is because the nuggets weren't great.  I can't find a better word than "cheap" tasting (didn't even both with a picture!) Next time we will try the chicken fingers instead. The onion rings they came with were delicious though!!  
Roma will be our go to pizza delivery place from now on.

If you celebrate Chinese New Year. A Kumquat or Calamondin tree must have in your house for good luck. While other places sell poor quality with high end price, this place sells great selections with okay price.

Clean, friendly, and conveniently located. Very cozy "mom and pop" feel to it (Peter and Christine, I think). Equipment all seems to be in great condition except for a few machines down for repairs. I think I will try the drop off service next time as the cost seems pretty reasonable.

Ps. Nice little coffee shop in the same strip mall to have a coffee while your clothes wash.

Never having been to a pasta pantry but loving anything pasta, I decided to give it a try, it was my kind of restaurant, one where you can get your food and leave. Everything looked good and we got multiple different dishes. 

I felt like it was okay, the Cesar salad was a little bit garlicky, but it was good. The pasta itself was okay, but I felt like it was over priced and I could of went and sat down and had a full course pasta meal  somewhere for what I paid there. But the meat balls and the rolls were amazing. I was disappointed about the lack of garlic bread though, I felt like any restaurant that sells pasta should have garlic bread! 

But overall if you want a quick meal without any hassle here is the place to go.

Our staff drove over to the location they had advertised on their facebook page for today's location. It was about noon so they had only been open for a half hour and they had a good line up already. They let us know that they had a large order but it wouldn't be too long of a wait. As soon as they had the large order out they had food coming out within minutes. We ordered tacos (carnitas and beef), chicken gringa(?), and churros. When we arrived back at work we devoured our food. Not a single thing left. Can't wait to visit them again! Food was amazing.

Coming here to Edmonton from the US I was looking for a Mexican Restaurant that felt like home & this place was definitely it ! 10/10 would recommend ! Their food is amazing and the staff is so nice and welcoming!

I went last night for the first time and it was awesome, the live entertainment was great with an awesome crowd. Most food ranged from $13 and up minus the odd thing that was cheaper.Caffrey's is your spot for Sports and Entertainment, Featuring live entertainment every weekend, great daily specials, and diverse pub fare. Challenge your pals to a game of billiards or darts while you have a drink, for those billiards players you will be happy to know that the tables are near each other but give you enough space that your not constantly worrying about the other table or the constant flow of people. Definitely recommend checking it out.

I purchased a brand new vehicle through Sherwood Hyundai that was not operating up to factory spec. After 4 months of testing, they still to this day have not even solved one the issues that came up immediately. They constantly ignore my phone calls, my emails and give me the runaround. They ask me to do road tests, and when the results come back negative, they don't do anything about.

Extremely unprofessional. Avoid this place if you can.

Been awhile since I have been to Average Joes (Pandemic). 

Went for lunch and had the Korean BBQ Beef Bowl, shredded beef ribeye, bell pepper and onion in a Korean BBQ sauce, served over rice for $19, which was good for a bar. The flavour was excellent but the beef was a little tuff and chewy. It was nice to not have to eat wings or chicken fingers. 

They have an awesome beer selection and had my favourite Edmonton beer on tap, The Wolf from Sea Change Brewing. 

For the parents out there, Average Joes now allow kids until 8PM which is awesome. They have a kids menu which is nice but I don't think they were ready for kids to join them. The orange juice for my 2yo was in a pint glass which is fine and the kids pizza which was $9 (great price) was like a 10" cheese pizza. My boy had lunch for days. 

All in all I quite enjoyed the experience.

I would give a lower rating if i could - just ordered iced coffee and plain bagel with butter - as they had not peanut butter although the menu says they have it.  This bagel was the worst product - no butter on it - tasteless and just lousy product - so fail on merchandise - fail on staff - not first visit there either and if your expectations are the lowest of low you will not be disappointed

Went in last week to give them a try , my nails turned out horrible , thick , uneven and had a gap from the cuticle . I called and asked for them to be fixed , which they offered to do the next day , went in and waited 30 minutes . I felt like a burden so I left . Had to get Q nails to fix them . Which cost another $55, but my nails look fantastic ! I won't be recommending or will I return .

I was trying to think of something special for my 200th review... And Pasta Pantry fits the bill perfectly.

As I prepare to close another chapter of my life and say goodbye to my office in Sherwood Park, I made a list of restaurants and stores that I wanted to be sure to visit one more time.  Guess what was top on the list?  

I've been coming to Pasta Pantry for many years.  Before the major renovations a few years ago.  And I'm so happy that the quality has remained the same.  

For the last 5 years, my Go-To dish has been the Pasticcio topped with Alfredo sauce and a meatball on the side.  Everything is made in house and the meatballs are out of this world.  Pasticcio is basically a few different types of pasta, mixed together with a red/meat sauce, topped with cheese and baked.  Pasta Pantry goes the extra step to offer one of their delicious sauces on top.

This week though, I discovered that they've added Mac & Cheese to their offerings!  I had to give it a try.  I had it with the 4 cheese sauce, but I would probably try it with Alfredo sauce next time.  The pasta was cooked the way I like it, and the cheese was great.  I will definitely be back for this.

I usually get a small ceasar salad as well, but it's really not necessary - The pasta always fills me up.  I also find their dressing a little heavy on the garlic.

All the pastas are made fresh in house.  The impressive pasta makers are right behind the counter, so if you have any doubts, they will quickly be squashed.  Not just the pastas though.... everything is made fresh in house, and you can taste the difference that makes!

The staff are super friendly, even during a lunch rush.

There's lots of parking in the lot and the location is easy to find (right behind the mall!).  I really don't have anything negative to say.

If you are looking for something different with a country rustic feel, this might be it. I don't know how they got that pick up truck suspended in the lounge.  This place serves comfort food, such as beans and coleslaw and baked potato with your meals.  Wings are huge and battered.  Steaks look like good value.  Menu was extensive.  Servers in the lounge were very friendly.  Country music playing.  Cozy log cabin feel.  They have have daily food and beer specials.  TVs in the lounge.  I think they close around 10:00pm.

Cannot say enough good things about this place. If you want authentic Mexican you have to go here. I will go far out of my way to go here anytime I'm working in Edmonton. The green salsa/sauce they serve with the chips at the start is to die for. I buy it by the litre to go. The staff is so friendly and the food is 10/10 . Honestly can't say enough about this place. I'm getting hungry talking about it. 
Go here you will not be disappointed. 
The staff also went so far above and beyond and mailed me some of the sauce .

It's an authentic Mexican restaurant.  They even had a live musician which was a nice touch.  I found the portions on the small side especially the enchiladas which had very little meat and there could have been more beans and rice with it.  One drink was weak but hey replaced it.  The custard flan was heavy, almost like a cheese cake, unlike what we had in Guadalahara Mexico and little caramel topping.  Seemed that the spices were toned down too much.  But a pleasant visit nevertheless.  And there is a lounge side.  The place was busy.
Expensive.  The menu never changes.  Predictable.  Great salad dressing.  They should reduce the price for this mass quantity food they serve and should change up the menu every week a bit.
First time for us  and we thoroughly enjoyed our meal. I had the fish tacos and they were a different take but I loved them!

Saturday evening was very busy. The staff was cheery and attentive. We were a Table of 8, each ordering something different, the menu had a lot of options everything ordered was ok, not memorable. 

My dish pictured below was well portioned but over priced @$24.99. It photographed well but lacked something.... salsa, gauc.....some side would have fancied it up adding flavour if you decide to try it. 

I wish I would have thought of that prior to ordering or mid meal :) 

Having said this, $24.99 was the cap. There are many other menu items you'd be getting value. Some good flavours.

VERDICT: Mexico Lindo simply didn't stand out. Granted this is in Sherwood Park, living in Edmonton we have easy access to quite a few FAN FREAKING TASTIC Authentic Mexican restaurants.

Pubs. I really like pubs and pub foods. This place definitely fits that bill.

It is a seat yourself type of place like most pubs are. Enough servers to go around. The majority of the seating is high tables. But there are low tables, and bars, and also booths to have your food and beverages at.

I really enjoyed the steak and Guinness pot pie. It came out molten hot and I may have burned my tongue, but... it was too good that I didn't want to keep waiting. Great sized portion that I did not leave hungry!
Great place for plants. I tend to go to zgreelsnd and Zocalos, but Salisbury does carry unusual flowers.

Bad bad customer service. I ordered chicken and prawns. Got home and got pork and prawns.  I called to complain. Was told to come back. I had to ask for a full refund and the woman said that she needed to see the dish before making a decision. Anyway, don't go eat or order anything from here. Waste of your money.

Kim was our instructor for our succulent window frame. This is my second class with her and I keep coming back for more because of her fun banter. She is super knowledgeable and helpful in all things plants. During the class she went through all the types of succulents and how to water and care for the plants. She helps you to choose plants suitable to your lifestyle! The class was two hours and I booked it through Eventbrite for $10. The final price is dependent on the amount and types of plants you choose. Give the classes or greenhouse a try, you will love it and learn a ton about plants!

I got a Groupon purchased for $7.50 for $20 value of food to try based on a blogger's review. I was a bit disappointed because I had seen on Instagram they offered free delivery, but it was not the case anymore so I had to pick up which I probably wouldn't have gotten the Groupon if I knew that. The $50 molcajete di rancho was a lot of meat and definitely had leftovers with 3 people. Also had the side order of tacos which were alright. I'm not a huge meat eater so I probably wouldn't get again but was good to try once. I feel like I have enjoyed the food from local places in Edmonton such as 3 Amigos better but have not dined much in Sherwood Park.

Went here the other night with a couple of friends. We had been wanting to do a fondue and wanted to support local. The restaurant is bigger than we thought from the outside and has some nice aesthetic features -- fun light fixtures, comfortable seating and a nice ambience. We did the Couple's four course meal. We had the Welsh Rarebit cheese, the Bleu Feast, the wild mushroom soup and the Happy Ever After dessert course. We thoroughly enjoyed it all. At points, we wondered if there was enough food...but after all the courses, it was more than enough. We left absolutely stuffed! The wild mushroom soup was delicious and full of flavour. We used the house broth for fonduing and the couple we were with had the pan sear option, and shared one side of the pan with us. That was a nice option and we enjoyed the variety. We will definitely be back.

This is an amazing garden centre! There's a huge selection of plants to choose from. Everything was beautifully displayed. I literally felt like I was walking through a garden or park.

You'll want to give yourself some time to explore this place. I took a long time to decide what to buy. I was distracted by so many pretty colours and types of flowers.

They also have an fun little gift shop area near the front of the store. Here they sell a lot of different items other than things for the garden. I saw various household items and knickknacks for sale. 

If you're looking for a variety of options for your garden, I recommend checking this place out!

Bought from here 6 times now. Excellent pizza! Quick and professional. Definitely coming back! 

Restaurant was very clean and staff were very friendly. 

Pricing is on the higher side for pizza but definitely worth it!

Came here for lunch on a weekday and think it's a nice option for the area. Clean, bright space with lots of booths and a few tables (the booths are snug if you are in need of more space between the seat and the table). 

A pretty big menu with lots of options for both meat eaters and vegetarians alike. We ordered from the lunch combos and for $12.95 we each got a bowl of curry, some rice (extra $1 to make it coconut) and 2 small vegetarian spring rolls. *Side note - we actually ordered a full order of spring rolls in addition to our meals and notice that although it's the same filing, the appetizer rolls are much longer than than the ones you get in the lunches.

I had the panang curry with beef and it was delicious. Flavourful, creamy from the coconut milk and lots of vegetables and protein (I chose beef). Someone else got the exact same curry but with chicken and they had mostly broth, and hardly any chicken or vegetables. It's also described as mild in spice and while I had to add more hot sauce to it, my dining companion was sweating because they found it too spicy. So - not as consistent as I would have liked, and be aware that it may be spicy if you're super sensitive to heat.

Service was nice, and he was able to help us navigate the menu. It was just him serving though, so it was a little slow.

First of all, I need to stay the service was OUTSTANDING.  In fact, I can't remember when we had better service at any restaurant in North America at any price.  Erick the manager went out of his way to be sure that the ingredients didn't cause my wife any migraines (she has some specific food allergies which makes going out to eat difficult).  Lourdes the server was also excellent,  They were both simply terrific.  My wife had the Arrachera Steak.  It was excellent - tasty, tender and everything you could desire.  I had Shrimp Tacos.  They too were very good.  Very tasty.  All I can say, is if you are looking for good Mexican food this is the place to go in the Edmonton area.

Everyone is working so hard with the protocols and trying to keep as many staff working as possible. Things are tough. I try and support as many places I can wether that be takeout, ordering local products, and just being positive when I am out. It was my birthday this previous weekend and that means time to visit the keg. I'll be first to admit the take out services at most places I don't find worth the $. Seems like take out is a pain to the business in a sense. Sauces always missing, sides missing, and food is prepared like it couldn't be returned. We ordered for pick up from this location and I was already preparing to be disappointed. We got home and WOW.  Everything was prepared to a tee. Butter with the bread. Steaks cooked perfectly. Everything labelled. Would 100% order from them again. Staff was so friendly. Wish they had calamari on their takeout menu cause it is an absolute fav but will visit again soon when restrictions are lifted.

Went to Average Joes yesterday as I am new to the area and wanted to explore the bars. The food was excellent! I tried the Pretzel bites and then had the clubhouse with yam fries, everything was so tasty. And the service wow! I ordered quite a bit of drinks as I wanted to try different things and my server was always happy to help! Thank you for the great experience I will be returning!

As someone who has always been hesitant about Fondue meals, I was extremely pleased with my experience at Bleu Flames. Another couple joined my wife and I for the meal and all were pleased with the food, the service and the value for money. Give it a try if you are in Sherwood Park

My husband and I stopped in for lunch today. I had a craving for Thai and our usual place was closed today. It was just as good, or possibly even better, as our usual place. We both ordered off  the lunch menu. $13 for a lunch size portion and there was plenty of food. I had panang curry with chicken and jasmine rice. My husband had panang curry with pork and coconut rice. Both dishes came with two veggie spring rolls. Food was piping hot, fresh and delicious. Our server was friendly and efficient. He said if our dishes were too spicy he would have the kitchen fix them for us. They were the perfect spice level for us so we didn't need to, but it was nice to know we wouldn't have been stuck with a too spicy dish. The only thing I would change, and this seems to be true of all ethnic restauants, is the tepid tap water that is served. I'm okay with water, I just like it with ice. We will definitely be back!
Friendly folks work at Pasta Pantry & Trattoria.  The food they pump out is just a step above ordinary, though.  This isn't some kind of undiscovered gem.  Don't believe the hype.

We came in on a Wednesday and this place was packed. It was spread out so well, guides on which direction to walk, and staff was constantly cleaning. We ended up going with the wing special and a few other appetizer like items. The wings were awesome. The cactus cuts with parmesan are a new favourite of mine. The bruschetta was equally just as great. Service was quick and friendly! We would come back in a heartbeat.

We've attended a couple of fundraisers here, and for that...5 stars, if you're celiac, there's not a lot for you here that you could eat safely. If you are avoiding gluten by choice, there are options for you. 

Cider- the only offering is Strongbow, wine... it's limited.  Arnold Palmer for the non-alcoholic option, nope, no lemonade either. Full bar though!

The fundraisers definitely great for the community, hockey fans, UFC, fights are on the many TVs all over the place. Lighting at night is low, so if it's loud or you lip-read, it's a bit tough.

My fiancée had some service work done on her accent here. They then informed her that her brakes were completely worn out and would gladly replace her drums, pads and rotors for just under $1000. My brother is a ticketed mechanic so we bought the parts at part source to do it ourselves for a third of the price. Upon removing the tires we noticed there was still 50% left on the pads and the rotors were completely fine. Luckily we were able to return everything at part source. We decided not to replace anything as we are planning on selling the car in the spring. After all this I read the service report and they said there was only 4mm left on the brake pads. So my fiancée will definitely not be bringing her car to theses scam artists ever again and unless you want to get ripped off by these douchebags make sure you get a second opinion.

My husband and I are huge fans of Boston Pizza - it is, after all, a part of Edmonton history! This location did not disappoint. The staff in the lounge were friendly, attentive and made it a great experience. We also had the opportunity to try several items from the new holiday themed menu, which was very interesting. We tried: 

- The Christmas Pizza: This is essentially a pizza crust topped with the usual holiday favourites, such as turkey, stuffing, gravy and cranberry sauce. Kind of like the sandwich you might make on Boxing Day with leftovers from Christmas dinner. Filling and satisfying (though I maybe could not eat a whole pizza myself as I found it a bit rich).

- Smoked Gouda & Poblano Pepper Ravioli: This was the stand-out (in my opinion). It is really smoky from the inclusion of smoked gouda, poblano peppers and bacon. The sauce is creamy and cheesy. A hearty meal and delicious!

- Cranberry BBQ Ribs: I was nervous that this would have a super-strong cranberry flavour, but it was actually really well balanced and not too sweet. Comes with stuffing, mashed potatoes, vegetables and garlic toast for a well-sized portion.

- Chocolate Almond Lava Cake: Warm and sweet, this is a great dessert for sharing! The almonds add great crunch.

- Sparkling Cranberry Lemonade: Very refreshing! This would be a great drink any time of year, but is made festive with the inclusion of cranberry.

Boston Pizza is also giving out Toblerone bars when you order any of the main course options on the winter menu (which does include other items that I did not try, such as the Christmas Poutine and a Bourbon BBQ Chicken pizza).

Who knew SP was the place for Mexican eats! Stopped in on a Friday night on a whim and was lucky to snag a table for one. Very friendly and efficient service. The al pastor tacos were delicious. Can't wait to come back with hubby in tow so we can try multiple dishes. Reservations recommended on the weekend.

While I do love me a good bowl of pasta, I can't quite say I was fully invested in one I grabbed there recently. I ate there a few months ago only to have the same sort of experience. I figured it was an off day for them but sure enough: equal disappointment when I went back again.

The staff there were pleasant and efficient, but the product itself left a lot to be desired. It almost felt like a bland, chewy chore of eating after the first few bites to be quite honest. Can't say I'm in a rush to go back anytime soon

This is probably  my least favorite  London Drugs location.  I only like that it's  quick and easy to drive up and get away.   
It is sqeaky clean and bright.  Easy to shop in if they have the  stock available to buy.  
There were not cashiers open, so I got in line at customer service behind 2 other shoppers. 
I think I'll stick with the store on 51st ave. There really is a difference.

At first I rolled my eyes that another taco shop opened up. But then I ate their food and I was blown away. The fact that they have molcajete put them on the top of every taco place. The food is always abundant so the price point is not bad. They give you a complimentary crunchy wafer like chips with different salsas to dip in. Tacos are phenomenal!! The platters are big enough for two people to share if you're a small eater. I always say I'll make room for desserts but between the drinks and the food and fun atmosphere, I never have room. My friend's son who has a bottomless stomach tried the cheesecake and he said was good. Took home a churro once but i forgot about it and it cold so it was ok. Top of my taco food list!

Pretty typical McDonalds but I have yet to get an order that's right. Big Mac wasn't on sesame bun. Breakfast burrito had no salsa you apparently have to ask for it to be added. Today I ordered a Sausage & Egg McMuffin, Got ham & cheese and I was the ONLY person in the drive through so I didn't get someone else's order.

Soup: we had a Pho with steak and tendon.  Generous size overall with above average serving of steak and tendon.  A nice broth slightly floral broth. 
Vermicelli Bowl: Really, really disappointing.  The meat had the look and texture of boiled meat.  The meat is not marinaded, instead it is drowned in sauce after cooking.  So you don't get any good carmelization.  I used up 8 napkins trying to sop some of the sauce up.  It was pretty nasty.  It was really thick and tasted like oyster and garlic Chinese stir fry.  Definitely recommend passing in the Vermicelli bowls. If you like Chinese stir fry meat, consider asking them to lighten up on the sauce.  If you want a traditional, marinated and grilled, you'll find this fish really off-putting.  
Spring Rolls:  they weren't hot but the flavour was above average. Very good. 
Subs: saw one go by.  Looked good.  
Location: Same parking lot as Cora's so parking is a pain.  The restaurant itself is inviting. 
Menu: Lots of variety on menu.  Will go back for soup and other options. They have mango salad which I usually love.
for what we had, price was way too expensive. i used to love this place, too bad they got "money hungry" like where did the bread rolls go?!

It saddens me to have to write this review. Purchasing my car from Sherwood Park Hyundai was a dream. Ken, Robin and Doug were friendly, transparent, and made the sale as painless as possible. I went home and sung praises about Sherwood Park Hyundai to everyone who would listen.

Unfortunately,  the experience took a turn for the worse when I had to bring my brand new car in for small fixes. I needed a new bumper and fan system due to manufacturer defects and brought the car in July 22nd, less than a month after purchasing it.

To make a long story short, it is now November 4th, and I am still waiting for parts to come in that I had been told on numerous occasions were on their way. In the middle of October, I brought the car in for the scheduled appointment for these two fixes, and ended up having to leave my car there for a week because the parts weren't in and / or ready. (Despite being told it would be ready in 8 hours when dropping it off.)

When I picked my car up, there was a 170+ km discrepancy between the service paperwork and my odometer, damage to my windshield, and a further wait on the fan parts which had not yet arrived.

Up until I had dropped my car off, I was extremely patient, however, after being told so many conflicting stories for 3 months, the unexpected week wait to have a bumper put on, and the kms/windshield issues, I had reached my limit. 

I approached the general manager with questions as to whether something had happened with my car while it was in, hoping to explain the wait and other yet unanswered issues. I also asked for clarification regarding the misinformation I had consistently been receiving the past 3 months. (My new car only 4 months old.)

The responses were sarcastic, rude, and defensive with no attempt to address my inquiries. I have received no answer as to why there is damage to my windshield or why car was driven an undocumented 170 kms. (The first response from management said the kms were due to a "transmission change" that until that point I had heard nothing about. There was no transmission change done to my car.)

I've since filed a complaint with Hyundai Canada and am moving my service to another dealership.

To sum things up, a quote from one of the emails from General Manager Brian Hickey: "I am not really sure we are going to be able to live up to your expectations or make you feel confident in regards to your vehicle here."

He's got that right.
This laundromat is incredibly clean and well-managed. The employees were professional and kind. There are a lot of laundromats in the area, this place is by far the best! I highly recommend.

This place is always getting lots of hype on facebook, and I just don't get it :(

I've been there twice and really can't imagine going back a 3rd time.  The food is really mediocre.  Lots of deep fried options, but everything comes out tasting the same.  and oddly stale.

Service was horrible the last time we went.  It was a saturday around 8ish and the place was not busy at all.  I honestly almost asked our server if I smelled bad because she kept coming to our table with an awful attitude.  We waited for way too long for our bill so I finally went up to the bar to get it and pay.  The bartender was really friendly - we should have sat at the bar.  While she was processing my payment, our original server came over and took over the process.  But didn't say a single thing.

We used to love the Keg.  Its always been the 'go to' restaurant for good food and service.  Over the years, we probably been to a Keg literally a hundred times if not more.  The one on the Southside by Whyte was great.  Its been closed so we went to the Emerald Hills Keg for my birthday.  I order the prime rib.  It was over done, the rest of the meal wasn't very good either.  We were very disappointed after spending so much money.  We are never going there again.

We recently had guests in from out of town for an early Christmas gathering.  Although the weather didn't exactly cooperate as far as early winter driving was concerned, everyone made it safe and sound.  One of the many attractions for our out of town guests is checking out what's new and exciting at our local greenhouses.  They were thrilled and impressed with the many different kinds of shopping to be done at Salisbury Greenhouses.  Not only were there some cool indoor plant varieties, such as lemon tree's, fig trees... the array of water features still available to be viewed is astounding.  Also, the vintage reproduction furniture was a real surprise to come across.  Absolutelly beautiful pieces.

Oh and don't let me forget the Christmas shopping items, which is what we were really after in the first place.  Gorgeously decorated tree's with purchase-able items, stockings, stocking stuffer ideas, clothing, jewellery...  It was a great way to spend an hour escaping from the cold and rotten road conditions.  Thanks!

Great place for authentic Mexican food.   Nice decor inside. Cozy.  Spanish music.  Staff were all Mexican  and pleasant.  Staff seemed happy to work there.  Many of the customers were Mexican.  Food was a bit spicy but nice as it isn't watered down. Portions are average in size, however, the molcajetes are large enough for two people and priced accordingly.. They have authentic Mexican deserts.

I am in Sherwood Park often for business and use Broadmoor's wash and fold service. Friendly staff who never forget a face or a name. Highly recommend if you are on the go, visiting, or working in the area.

Sam and Robin were so amazing and helpful with our search for a new vehicle. They were not pushy, and when my husband and I wanted to go home to think about which model we wanted, they didn't try to force us into making the decision that moment, which is not what I expected from a car dealership! We came back later, and settled on a Hyundai Tucson, which we LOVE! 
We would definitely do business with Sherwood Park Hyundai again, as it was a fabulous experience!
Always like the pizza and is one of my kids favorite spot to eat!!!! Love the winter menu and the winter menu drinks!!!! Always an option to get a bite with the family or friends!!!!

What a difference two years makes since my last review. Mexico Lindo has grown to be one of my top choices for Mexican and both service and food have improved so much over time.

The molcajete is still my favourite thing to order and the chicken is still so good! The chorizo is delicious - not too greasy or salty but super flavourful. You still don't get enough tortillas - but for an extra $3 you can double them to 10. 

They still have Groupons available all the time making them an excellent value.
Great food and service the owner is almost always on site. My friends and I go at least once a week for their lunch specials.

Dirty location rude staff and half of the seating area is blocked off. Flies everywhere. The cooking area looks well below standards. Update my vanilla chai frap had a fruit fly squished in the lid and I had to get a refund. All I got was a sorry about that. No eye contact or sincere apology. Pure disgust I will not be back.

Unfortunately this place doesn't live up to the hype. I stopped by there today for lunch and was really disappointed. The pasta was mushy and the sauce was bland. I could have made a better dish at home in 10 minutes for $2.00.

Plants, workshops, outdoor decor, festive gizmo's and gadgets, and some of the largest planters I've ever seen! 
We adore Salisbury Greenhouses and check it out at least several times a year. 
We especially enjoyed their Whoville Grinch Tree-Making class. The team doing the workshops is awesome and really do a great job teaching you how to make something cool and providing you with all the tools to do it. The cost for the class gets incorporated into your purchase of the tree as well which is nice. I do recommend bringing your own ornaments and lights or planning to put your own on later because they are a little pricey here. 
We also love their customer nights, who doesn't love a little discount with your purchase. Pre-Covid they would have snacks and once there was cake, a lovely way to spend an evening with family and fellow gardeners. 
Of course their plant selection is incredible, definitely sign up for their electronic newsletter as they feature their incoming plants there and then you will truly see how much they offer. 
Some fun things you'll find there: sprouting seeds- a great addition to the other seeds they supply, we live growing our own sprouts to eat and finding some well priced sprouts is a perfect reason to hit Salisbury up; kids gardening supplies like shovels and gloves, who can resist the adorable little watering cans; planters and planting supplies- dirt, compost, pest control, planters of every size and color; little fairy garden ornaments and a huge variety of fun other figurines.

We had passed this place multiple times on our visits to Sherwood Park and this time decided to give it a try. Our first restaurant outing since self-isolation started in March, it turned out to be a fantastic choice and an excellent experience. There was an automatic hand sanitizer dispenser when you walked in the door, and arrows on the floor denoting one-way traffic. The decor is simple and it's nice and bright inside. The staff were very nice and efficient. We did have to wait a little while for our glasses to be refilled, but that's not a huge deal. The food, though. The food was amazing. So delicious. We started with the Papas Al Ajillo (garlic potatoes). Wow. These little nuggets were pure, creamy, potatoey heaven. Not super spicy, but definitely had a little kick! Hot and fresh and a nice suprise.

We ordered 2 entree's and shared them. One order was the Torta Cubana. Now, this sandwich, was massive! Great flavor. The bun was the perfect amount of bread and really fresh. The meat and veggie toppings were portioned out perfectly. And the fries are some of the best I've had in recent memory! Stellar dish.

The second entree were the Tacos Dorados with chicken filling. Deep fried tacos. You just can't go wrong. This was delicious. Reminded us of taquitos, but better. Crispy taco. Yummy shredded chicken. Topped with sour cream and cheese. We did feel the price on this was a smidge high for what you got- but just a smidge.

Definitely enjoyed our late lunch here and will be returning! So many other dishes that caught our eye on the menu, but very glad we chose the dishes that we did.

We went tonight with our family and were SO impressed with the food and service. Food was incredibly fresh and tasty. Portion sizes were huge and we left REALLY full. Our kids really enjoyed their Bubble Tea smoothies as well. We will most definitely be back with more friends and family. #48 on the menu was one of the best things I've ever eaten. This restaurant is an excellent addition to Sherwood Park.

My first time here today, the staff are so helpful with explaining how to use the machines. I brought in my king and twin comforters. The staff were also cleaning all the machines while i was here which was so comforting to see.
They take loonies only for washers and quarters for dryers but they do coin exchanges for you. It was 40 min for a wash and dry cycle
Amazing customer service and fantastic food. I started going here when I was desperately looking for authentic Mexican food in Sherwood park. No where else compares.

Terrible dealership! They bully people to an extreme and are abusive and threatening. Never buy here...don't even bother to visit! Had to give this 1 star just to save this info but I'd really like to give them a minus 5 review.

Enjoyed the patio here for what may be the last beautiful summer day in Alberta.  The place was pretty busy which is nice to see. We got a table on the patio. The last one on the end near the doors. Not the beat spot because everyone smokes right there and that's all you smell.....but it didn't ruin anything.  

Waitress came took my order as I waited for my friend to arrive, my beer took a very very long time to come. The waitress came over told me my bill got mixed up, I replied I don't need the bill I ordered a beer.  She explained that my beer "chit" got mixed up and apologized so kindly.  I appreciate when the staff met you know why something happened.  Mistakes happen so no big deal.  Our waitress was very delightful, kind and funny.  I love a waitress who likes her job. 

We ordered mozzarella sticks and each a steak sandwich.  They were delicious.  Steaks cooked perfectly. 

Tried a wild berry Sea Change Edmonton beer and their blonde beer.  Both were amazing.  I love that our waitress told us of the local beers. 

Overall a great evening and great place to enjoy an evening.

Paislii's favourite food after a walk at the wilderness park. We have been ordering quiet often from them during covid, and it's always on time for pickup. 

Thanks again
Paislii Rose and family

I have been here a few times in the past, and have been very disappointed on every occasion. The staff are pleasant enough, even though they seem to universally dislike working there  (I over heard two quietly complaining about the pay rate, and the "sexist" owner). 
What annoys me so much is that this place makes it's own pasta, yet always always always over cooks. It's called pasta, not paste! The sauces are kinda bland, and if those breaded chicken entrées are hand made in-house, then I'm the Pope. I know this because I am a fully qualified Chef, and I know exactly where they come from. It's called Lillydale's food processing factory. 
As a Chef, I am always outraged when restaurants buy products from suppliers and then claim that it's all made in-house! 
(PS - their buns come from the Portuguese Bakery on 118th Ave)

I am a little disappointed in the grocery pick up at this save on. They do not go over the substitutions like most other stores prior to pick up. I've received a few things that are not close to what I've ordered. They also do not let you know what was out of stock upon picking up. It's inconvenient to get home and realize half of what you ordered wasn't in stock and there's no substitutions. The produce picked however is good quality and the dairy has long expiration dates. Service is quick. Vehicle was hit once in parking lot though due to the location of the pickup area.

We stopped off here before heading to a Movie in the Park.  All we ordered were appetizers.  2 orders of wings 16 wings and 8 wings. The 8 pcs order had to go back because it wasn't the right order.  The 16 pcs came with 3 wafer thin carrot sticks and 2'pcs of celery.  Seriously.  The waitress Kay was average at best and the meals below.  There are many other restaurants in Sherwood Park much superior to this one.  They have steadily gone down hill over the years and most likely don't care.

I attended the Sherwood Park (Ordze) location for a Yelp event to try the new Winter menu. I was not disappointed! What stood out to me the most was the friendly staff. My server especially was very prompt and personable. The winter menu items I tried were the Christmas pizza and poutine, smoked Gouda and poblano pepper ravioli, cranberry glazed ribs and Moscow mule (not on winter menu). I enjoyed all of the items I tried. The Xmas pizza and poutine I liked more than I thought I would, the pizza especially. The crust was thin (but not too thin!) and had a nice chew to the edge, the sage cream sauce was the kicker that brought the pizza over the top. Delicious. It also had rotisserie turkey , stuffing, and mixed Italian cheese and cranberry and gravy to dip. The cranberry rubs were fall off the bone, they were mighty tasty but could use a bit more sauce for my liking! The ravioli was quite tasty as well, not as spicy as I expected. The centre was nice and creamy and was topped with a rose sauce and chicken and bacon (yay bacon!). The Moscow mule had a nice gingery bite to it, I would have this again. Also I had samples from Corkbeard wines, Situation Brewing, Rig Hand distillery ( great Double Double liqueur and horseradish Caesars!), Townesquare, and Analog Brewing. My favorite was the Earl Grey and blueberry Saison. It would be great for a holiday party. Overall I think that BP's did a great job of hosting and the food was great.
