I did a DIY kokedama class here with a good friend of mine. I loooooooved it! Salisbury is chalk full of plants, flowers, decor and more. Their staff is super friendly and helpful too! Walking in, you can smell the freshness of all the plants and your body and mind is definitely put at ease, being in such a inviting place in the dead of winter. I want to come back and check out the farmers market (Thursday evenings) and can't wait to do more classes! My plan is to fill my apartment with plants (and hope the kitties don't get them)

We went to this restaurant the other evening with another couple.  Overall the experience was somewhat underwhelming.

The service was very slow.  They had one server one bartender and apparently one cook working.  As this is a fondue restaurant and the server also sets up and preps the fondue pots, the poor girl working there was run off her feet.  Orders took a long time to reach the table and there was a substantial wait between courses.

The food was okay, although for what it was I considered it on the pricey side. The broth for the meat was bland, the cheese sauce was tasty though.

At the end of the meal, part of our order never arrived but we were charged for it anyway and the bills needed to be reconfigured.  I can't blame the server very much as she plain and simply had too many tables to deal with.  If the owner wants this place to succeed, he needs to have more staff working.

Roma used to be great and well ran, seems like there is new owners now and it has gone down. Wait times are insane you order and pickup it's never ready when it says it's going to be. Food is still great but when each time it's the same story we've now will stop going here.

Don't bother taking your car here for service. Made an appointment for recall service at 9 am. I arrived at 850 and didn't even see a staff member in service until 9:15. When I booked the appointment I was told it would be quick- less than an hour. When I dropped the car off they told me 1.5 hours because they had a walk in (which took priority I guess???) but they said they didn't have many appointments and it wouldn't be long. Arrived back at the dealership 1.5 hours later and it's still not done. Waited an additional 1.5 hours in the service area for them to finish all while hearing "another 20 min" repeatedly from the rude service receptionist. I get that things take time but don't lie to people and quote them 1/3 of the time. When they finally gave me back the keys I went to start the car and it wouldn't turn over and when the tech got it to start the check engine light was on and it was revving spontaneously they then had to let it run for 15 min and required taking it back to the shop. Then they couldn't get it to turn over and make me wait an additional 30 min and after I approach them to see what the hell is going on. Apparently they need to replace the whole throttle body for some reason and I'm without a car for a week and they don't offer me a loaner or rental or anything until I get quite upset and ask to speak to a manager they finally give me a loaner car.

If you are looking for something different with a country rustic feel, this might be it. I don't know how they got that pick up truck suspended in the lounge.  This place serves comfort food, such as beans and coleslaw and baked potato with your BBQ ribs.  Wings are huge and battered.  Menu was extensive.  Servers in the lounge were very friendly.  I found the BBQ sauce too sweet and the baked beans too sweet.  Country music playing.  Cozy log cabin feel.  They have a quiet outdoor patio.  They have daily front and beer specials.  TVs in the lounge.

The dishes are on point with respect to flavour and authenticity. I believe this is one of the reasons for the restaurant's appeal. I have always been treated to attentive forms of service, whether dining in or placing an order for pickup. Delicious Pho is certainly one of my local favourites.

Went with a group for the first time on recommendations from my niece. She told us it would be good and she definitely was correct. The meals were all great. The service was excellent. Will definitely be returning.

We had reservations, and arrived a little early. We signed in and waited outside, wearing masks, since others were also waiting for their table. I thought this was very organized. We were seated at a sunny table and requested a switch-no problem. The server graciously ushered us to our new table. I had  a small steak (done to perfection) with a wedge salad (my new fave) with cheese bread (which was to die for). What can I say? They were attentive to our table without being intrusive. We were never made to feel rushed. We enjoyed a wonderful family visit and a fabulous meal. And now I know what a Billy Miner is! But you have to try the cheese bread. That alone can make your day!
DoorDashed some Mexico Lindo tonight. Tacos are very good and very authentic tasting. Can't say much about customer service or atmosphere but the tacos did hold up being delivered through DoorDash.
Love their Mac N' Cheese! One of our go-to spots. Great service and you get your food fast thanks to the buffet- style layout.

The "east coast" donair (pizza), fingers and donair sauce, DON'T taste anything like the real stuff. I've been looking for a replacement since PIZZA HUT closed in Fort Saskatchewan (and I live in Edmonton! I use to drive there at least once a week ). So if you're feeling home sick and want the real stuff, or close to, this isn't the place for fellow east coasters. Donair sauce doesn't have that garlicky-sweet taste and the fingers also weren't that garlicky. That aside.... the fingers were still FANTASTIC! I got half with bacon, half without and favoured the half without best. Super cheesy and delicious! Dough was a bit on the floury side for both pizza and fingers. I liked them better the next day personally  I had one bite of the personal donair pizza and didn't like that much.. at all and ended up tossing it as the donair sauce wasn't my favourite. I do wish I could remember the cashiers name. I spoke to her on the phone and then again when I picked-up. She was a delight, happy, funny, very easy to speak with and informative. I was thinking about dessert and she actually had a brownie cooked and showed me what it looked like. Even wafted the smell toward me . I wasn't in the mood for sweet but it was still nice of her to take time to show me! I waited outside until my order was ready and she then walked it out to me! You'd think based on my experience and disappointment my rating would be much lower and if we're honest... if it wasn't for that one lady, it would absolutely be 1 star. I'll say I won't go out if my way to get food from here again but might drunkenly order those garlic fingers again  EXTREMELY LOVELY CASHIER !

I've heard a decent amount of things about pasta pantry from friends. When I was driving through sherwood park I decided to stop by and pick up some dinner. When I walked in I was super confused and overwhelmed with how to order and what they had. There was two young adults working behind the counter. A girl and a guy who instantly were showing and explaining how to order and what they liked. They ended up picking two pastas for me which one was like shells and long fettuccine like noodles with a mix of four cheese sauce and spicy italian. With a place that you can come in and dine out I feel like you expect decent food but I was shocked! This was some of the best sauces I've ever had with pasta. I will definitely return and not only because the food was good BUT the staff was unbelievable. You don't see a lot of friendly staff in a place like this which is a breath of fresh air!

Thanks to Adam for helping out our riding club, The Rig Riders and hosting our silent auction to raise money to go towards an injured oilfield worker. 

Shout out to Whiskey For The Pain... I you ever need an awesome band, then this is the one for you! They are dialed in :)

This is by far the best place i have been in a long time. I was waxed. Pedicure. And nail fill. The service was amazing. The daughter of the owner is great (i forgot her name - sorry)  she knows her stuff so well. I don't even pay attention. I have had false nails for over 10 years. I will definitely make the trek here again! !!

Muy bueno!! 

Authentic Mexican cuisine with an amazing Mexican atmosphere.  The staff was courteous, polite and very attentive. Lots of specialty drinks to choose from and there is something on the menu for everyone. 

The gentleman playing the guitar and serenading the tables was a pleasure to listen to and interact with. We came on a Saturday night, so I'm not sure if he plays only weekends though. 

I highly recommend this place.

After seeing the mouth drooling photos of the dripping with mascarpone cheese tiramisu Twitter, we finally made the trip to Sherwood Park. I had the Mac and cheese with 4 cheese sauce. The Mac and cheese by itself would have been too dry. I had a sausage which was tasty but barely warm. Hubs had their version of lasagna which was a mixture of different shapes of pasta. The sauce was tasty and perfect. The whole wheat buns were amazing. To finish our meal we went for the much anticipated tiramisu which was a disappointment. It was dry. The lovely attendant tried to explain why. The staff were warm and friendly, and there was a lot of them working. The place was very clean and welcoming. I'm not certain  we will be back. There is a similar concept in west Edmonton with amazing death by chocolate. I'm disappointed in Pasta Pantry. Maybe because I had such high expectations based on their advertising pics of tiramisu. And yes, I expect it to look like the picture.
Although it's a bit expensive (Groupon can help with that, though), Mexico Lindo is the most authentic Mexican restaurant that I've tried in the Edmonton area to date.  Recommended.

Decent Mexican food in Sherwood Park. We found the service to be lacking here - our server was hard to find (it wasn't that busy) and it took a while to take our order, get refills on drinks, etc. At one point we'd asked for salsa/hot sauce from 3 different people and nothing showed up until much later when it was dropped off with an, "I'm sorry, we forgot."

Food was good but not amazing. You get a small portion of chips and salsa when you sit down. We'd asked for more chips to finish the salsa, but it's $2 to get another round of both - you can't order just the chips or just the salsa. The queso was good with a choice of mushrooms or chorizo and comes with 3 small tortillas. Again, the ratio is off because there's way more cheese than 3 tiny tortillas would fill. Tacos Al Pastor had a decent flavour but the meat was very very dry. The best was the Molcajate which we were told feeds 2, but can easily feed more. Chicken, 2 kinds of steak, homemade chorizo and queso served with tortillas, guacamole and pico. I don't normally order chicken when I'm out, but it was my favourite component of this dish. Super moist and flavourful. We didn't love the chorizo because of the soft, crumbly texture and how salty it was. Churros to finish off and they were hot & crispy.

TL, DR: It's good and we found a Groupon for it - but it's a little pricy, service was meh and some of the items weren't great.

I've been a fan of Casa12doce for years now, before La Patrona was even open. If I drive by and see it open I will usually abandon whatever plans I had before to get a Gringa! The wait time is always usually at least 10-15 minutes but for the quality of the food. It's so worth it. 

I love the convenience of the food truck and being able to just grab and go.

I went at happy hour with my spouse, and the pints were still 6.25, not a fantastic happy hour price. We both had salads, his was steak salad, and his steak was cooked perfectly, but at $18, definitely overpriced. I ordered a Cobb salad, and probably the worst Cobb I have ever had. For $14 there was grated cheddar replacing the usual blue cheese. Sliced sandwich meat was substituted for the usual chunks of meat. 
Overall a very disappointing meal for the price. Service, however, was pleasant.

We will not be returning.

I'll start by saying, I did like acrylic nails that myself and my daughter got. Will I return, no. I had a gift card, it was 6 years old, there was no expiry date on it. 
The shop itself smelt terrible. We arrived and were informed that their debit machine wasn't working. My gift card was for $50, so I was going to need some extra cash. The lady there told me that because we had to go get cash, she would charge both my daughter and myself $40/acrylic fill plus she'd throw in a free nail design for us both so $80. I agreed and went and got cash. Came back, we got our fill, we got our nail design. I go to pay her, pull out my gift card and all of sudden she doesn't want to take it, tells me "to come back next time and she'll give me a free pedicure next time" First off, it's not free... It's a gift a card, you were given the cash when it was bought. and there is no expiry date on the gift card. I'll use it now to pay for the service I just received. She seemed annoyed, She started added extra charges, She charged me $50/fill and then charged for me and my daughters nail designs. so now my total is up to $110, more than i have EVER paid for two nail fills. What an absolute scam. They had no Covid protocols in place, no one was washing hands, cleaning the equipment between customers, the lady even kept taking her mask off every time she would talk. I would NOT recommend this scam of a business, head over to the mall and get your nails done, much better service, way cleaner and no hostility when you hand them a gift card.
This is probably my new favorite pizza place...the toppings are fresh and the crust is awesome

I went here last week before I had an appointment just to look at cars-not interested in buying. I hopped out of my vehicle, which was a mistake, to look into a Tuscan just for curiosity. I turned around to leave, and a salesman was there. The first thing he said to me after introducing himself, was insulting my current vehicle's condition. Once I repeatedly told him I didn't want to purchase, I am in school, and do not have time to talk, he would not leave me alone until I went into the dealership with him for "education talk".

I gave him 5 minutes, and after our conversation I informed him I didn't want a phone call, and definitely no texts from him. He said he had to call for a follow up, and I agreed, but didn't want anything after that because I wasn't buying. Fast forward to the next day, I received not just one phone call, but a voicemail, and a borderline creepy one liner text. Let's just say I blocked his number, and will not be purchasing from a company, and a salesman, that does not respect boundaries.

I stumbled upon Glitz Spray Tan by accident and I wanted to give them
a try...had a bad experience from a previous place where I turned orange and it was uneven. With Glitz, I loved my tan and there was no sight of orange. Everyone always asks me about my tan because it is so natural. The technicians were amazing, knowledgeable and explained every step of the way which put me at ease. I continue to use their services regularly (spray tan, teeth whitening,hydro-bed, and now red light therapy). Please check them out,you won't be disappointed. To all the brides out there or anyone going to a special event or vacation...you must give them a try!

It feels good to shop at a smaller box store than best buy and walmart in Boxing Day. Their pricing is fantastic and they will match the bigger guys when required. The best part if this experience was that the kitchen aid stand mixer attachment we bought rang in $60 less than we thought it was, score!

I'm always frustrated when I go to a "Pasta" restaurant and the menu hasn't progressed beyond the palette of a 12 year old.  This place has a very pedestrian menu,  your standard red or cream sauce with "exotic" add-ons like meatballs.  Sorry folks, this may have passed for pasta in the 90's but doesn't cut it today.  Large portions don't make up for an uninspired menu.  

There are plenty of pasta places in the Edmonton area that have matured beyond basic tomato and cream sauces, search one of them out if you want adult pasta.

Such an excellent restaurant. We had a few appetizers to start off our meal and they were all fabulous. Escargot were done to perfection. We ordered the Charcuterie Board and it was excellent. Our only qualm is that it could've had a little bit more meat, but the selection of cheeses and meats were delicious. All of our meals were excellent. Husband said his steak was the best he had ever had . Lobster was cooked perfectly. Overall atmosphere of the restaurant is good and servers were very friendly. Finished the wonderful meals off with coconut cake and tiramisu and they were both delicious. Fabulous experience and we will definitely be back! Can't wait to try more of the menu.
Ever since they bought Tim Horton's coffee they regained   My business  their food is still  questionable a ham  should not last three weeks without  going bad
Love going here anytime I'm in sherwood Park . Lots to look at and the weather is wonderful inside .

This restaurant has very tasty food,  but the prices continue to climb.  Very expensive.  My entree came with "a side of potatoes and vegetables. .. there was about 1/2 of a potato and 2 pieces of broccoli. The potato had no seasoning - just roasted. 

It was my birthday so we asked if they do anything for birthdays. We were told no, they don't do anything special for birthdays.  After spending $150+ on a meal for 4 people,  it would've been nice to get a bit extra for a special celebration dinner. 

We come here often,  usually with a large group,  and we all agreed it's gotten too pricey for what you get. 

That said, it's a beautiful restaurant.
Love this pizza! Love the unique flavors and attention to detail put into every pizza. The pizza sauce is to die for and the crust is light but still delicious. Highly recommend it!

give a zero if I could. You guys have done nothing but screw my sister around to fix her BRAND new car since July. Second time now she's been booked for the repairs and oh shock shock surprise surprise you can't fix it yet again. Oh but while popping out a dent you break her light and glue it back together for now because oh look you can't fix that properly now either.
Twice you people have left her stranded without a vehicle and her three freaking kids. Wasting her gas going back and forth. You guys are the biggest joke of a dealership I have ever seen. I'll be making sure not to refer you to anyone and everyone I know will know the bs you all pull. Such a bloody joke!

I've never been a huge fan of the Keg (I'm really just not a big steakhouse person) so it wasn't until I was invited out for dinner here that I ventured out. 

The staff was really pleasant and friendly. Immediately I have to admit that I was surprised that during the COVID-19 scare they had everyone sitting what seemed to be close together in adjacent tables. But it's also not like the tables are all adjacent. It just seemed worth mentioning. 

I really wish they'd add a pasta dish or two to their menu for those of us who don't like steak or the like but anyways. My meal was good and the staff was really attentive about my food sensitivities. One of the members of my party sent his plate back since his mashed potatoes were cold (but he's notoriously picky so I try not to dine out in public with him too much) but the rest of the food came out good. 

Overall I think it's a bit over priced for run of the mill fare but I'm a big fan of the staff.

Hi there. Well I'm an Italian so I thought why not try out the pasta pantry. I don't normally eat pasta at restaurants due to the fact that you cant beat mamma's cooking! The pasta was cooked good as well as the meatballs, but I thought the Italian sausages and red sauces were sub par! I just don't get what the big hype is about this place. As people were coming and going as I ate, I thought to myself if these people think this is authentic Italian food that Sherwood Park obviously needs an Italian restaurant that is really authentic! I guess it goes to show you that convenience comes before quality.

Came here on a last minute dinner date to celebrate a close friends birthday. She has celiac disease (wheat allergy) and this place has a surprising large number of items on the menu for her to choose from. That being said I think this place would also be great for anyone following a paleo diet.

I had already had a lighter supper earlier in the evening so I didn't think I could eat a full entrée. I went with an appetizer and the lemon rice soup. I have to say I was surprised by the quality of the food here. For the price I did find the survive size small, although the entrée plate my friend ordered was generous.

The lemon rice soup was spectacular. If you do come here its a must try. And my little pot of scallops was pretty darn good too.

Since it was a birthday I decided to try the Velvet V cocktail. This little concoction  was served cold in a martini glass. It was a little sweet side for my taste but went down easily enough.

Overall I think this place is worth a second try just be prepared to spend a bit more then usual.

I would give a zero if it was there. The sales and service department are both nightmares. 

Take your money and go somewhere else. Save yourself the headache of dealing with them. 

If you have a negative experience you can tell the workers and fill out reviews. No one will ever get back to you for a further inquiry. Big waste of time.

NOT A RESTURANT FOR PEOPLE WHO WANT A GOOD EXPERIENCE.

This was the absolute worst experience I've ever had at a restaurant. 
The customer service and food that my family and I received was so mediocre and bland. It took nearly 20 minutes just for our waitress to take our order and after an hour of us waiting for our order we received cold, dry food without flavour. While we were eating, we even found questionable hairs in our meals. 
The staff did not seem to care about customer experience for not just my family but for other families around us. I am extremely disappointed with the lack of care this restaurant has for their customers. 
DO NOT RECOMMEND.

We waited 30 minutes for our bread. I asked for Balsamic vinegar, no oil! I got served both mixed together . Runner brought me just vinegar. I ordered blackened chicken Oscar. Specifically said no asparagus, red pepper instead, server asked if I wanted Zucchini i said no thks. I got my food covered in asparagus. My bf orders a med well steak.. gets it, its rare. 
Our daughters steak was also supposed to be med well. hers was medium. 
I ordered french onion soup for appy. get told 20min later they are out of french onion but the kitchen would comp whatever appy we wanted in place of the soup ( good on the kitchen) 
they remade my bfs steak but didnt offer to remake our daughters or my food. 
my daughter waited at least 20 min for a refill. 
waitress finally surfaces after runners have done 90 % of her job
asks how food was.. i told her shes sure shit the bed on her job tonight, mistake after mistake.. theres zero excuse. 3 tables is all she had. 
management comes over, and basically threatens to kick me out of the restaurant for making her server upset. she doesnt offer to comp my meal that i ate anyways because i didn't want to wait for  new one.. 
and insists that i was the one in wrong for how i ordered my food. She then comes back and slaps a business card on the table. and goes out of her way to ask my bf how his food is and Specifically turns her back to me to adress our daughter's and says ladies.. how is your food... and walks away with her nose held high! 
we are avid keg customers and were looking forward to nice meal. what a disappointment.  Hire new staff !!

I went here to get a pedicure and gel nails for my graduation and it was awesome!! The pedicure was really relaxing and usually when I get pedicures the person doing them makes me think they are making jokes about my feet by talking in another language and giggleing to other staff but at cali it was different and for once in my life the lady doing my pedicure actually talked to me and made conversation with me instead of the other staff the whole time, which was relaxing! I then got to get my nails done! The guy doing my nails was so funny and easy to talk to once again making great conversation with me and not just speaking in another language to other staff. It felt like I was talking with a friend which I loved!! All the staff are so nice and willing to try to fit you in! They try and make you as happy as possible and don't make it seem like they are looking to make a quick buck! [rices are really affordable aswell and aren't ridiculously over priced!1 I will definatly be coming back!! :)

I've been coming to this place for a while and the food is definitely getting worse. Had a burnt burger, poutine that was overloaded with a pulled pork that was semi-worthwhile and beer that tasted flat....service was good and the server was empathetic and supportive.

This is the worst location I have ever been to, the food is cold 90% of the time. Orders are always messed up I know it's McDonald's but it should be easy to make hot food and get the orders right. Other locations do!!!! Definitely not going to hit this McDonald's anymore there is another location a few blocks away on Broadmoor way better. Also when I did have an issue with my order I called the store and the manager said sorry. He did not even offer to replace the meal. Come on!!!!!

We had been looking for a good Pad Thai ever since we moved to Sherwood Park and I finally think we have found the one. We ordered our staple chicken Pad Thai and chicken fried rice. However we were in the mood to experiment and so ended up adding the avocado cheese shrimp roll as well the Homok to our order. The Homok is a steamed fish in a banana roll.
The pad Thai was outstanding and the fried rice was so good! The rolls and homok were average, nothing to write on Yelp about. Did I mention the outstanding Pad Thai?
Anyway, while ordering we thought we might have some leftovers for lunch next day. Looks like I'll have to cook something for lunch now.

P.S. the banana leaves for Homok roll were held together using metal staples, the kind used to staple paper, which I personally think is big no-no for anything which comes into contact with food for obvious safety reasons.

Celebrating my moms birthday, we made a last minute reservation to this location. The one in South Common was fully booked, so thankfully they could get us in right away! 

The booths inside the restaurant are pretty tight. If you're on the bigger side, I suggest not requesting one. They are very limited on space and are the ones that you can't move. Tight space! 

The menu is simple, with various choices. The Keg is somewhere that we like going to for special occasions since it is on the pricier side, but we always enjoy the food here. My sister is REALLY picky and going out to eat is a hassle sometimes, as finding a place where she'd be able to find something she likes on the menu, is really rare. 

My younger brother is entering his teenage years so his appetite is blossoming along with his height. We ordered two appetizers, the calamari and the escargot. The calamari ($13) was delicious and came with two dipping sauces. It was really popular among my family, we even considered ordering more! My parents also enjoyed the escargot. ($11) I'm a bit too weary to venture into snails though ;) 

Unfortunately I completely forgot what everyone else at the table had ordered other than myself and my sister. I went into a deep food coma after dinner. Guilty!

I ordered the prime rib ($32), done medium. It came with some whipped mashed potatoes, and some crispy onions. I was a bit concerned once it had arrived at the table as it looked a bit over done, but once I bit into it, I was in love!! I'm very picky with my meats and how they're cooked, and I was really craving this prime rib the next day. Literally. So. Good. 

My sister ordered the bacon wrapped chicken ($27) and could not stop raving about the asparagus purée.That speaks volumes, as I mentioned before, she's a very picky eater!

All in all, the dinner left us full and happy which is what everyone really wants at the end of a meal. The servers are all very knowledgable about the menu, and the atmosphere is great. I suggest making the drive out to this location rather than the South Common location.

Came to Mexico Lindo for lunch and thanks to the reviews, we were not disappointed.  

There were a number of open tables when we came in, however it seemed like they were a bit short staffed based on the size of the place and the number of people there.  We were seated and then we had to wait for a fair amount of time before anyone came back to the table to take a drink or food order (note: going back to that short staffed comment to start).  

Once the server came over we put our food order in and within 5 minutes our food was being delivered to the table.  Hot and fresh !  I ordered the Mole enchiladas, and my wife ordered the shrimp tacos.  The mole was definitely good, but not the best I've had.  Definitely authentic.  The refried beans and the rice that was served with the Mole was ok, but nothing fabulous.  My wife's meal on the other had was delicious.  There was a healthy helping of guac on each of the tacos and the ingredients were fresh !  Very nice.  Luckily I was able to have one of her tacos.  

Once we were done our server was back to clear the table and get us our bill.  

Overall, very good food, and even though the servers were short staffed, they were definitely friendly and helpful.  I like their food and for Edmonton they are authentic and very tasty !  We were off to a bit of a slow start, but the food definitely made up for it.  Unfortunately the location is on the opposite side of the city for me.  But I will be making a trip back to try some of the other dishes.

Wow!!!
What a fancy store. The beauty section is gorgeous!!  It's a separate entity from the main store and pharmacy.  
There are way too many staff milling around to help you, but they are all wonderful and helpful. 
In the main store,  I wish there was more room for customers  to queue in front of the pharmacy.   
Hopefully I won't be so touchy about crowds in the near future.  
Excellent parking.

Wow!
That was really good!

Tonight I had the chance to Dream of Pizza. And it was a pleasant dream indeed.
Since it's not too far from home, I placed an order for pick-up. Much to my delight, they told me it would be ready in 15 minutes. I believd I made it there in about 14...and my order was ready!
To "cover all my basis", I decided to indulge in an order of garlic bread, swiss and black bacon chicken poppers, and a liitle 6" Extravaganza pizza.
At ~$17...it is reasonable to say the least.
Staff were very helpful and friendly. Store was very nice (entire building is brand new...so it should be!).
Upon arriving home with my goodie bag, I was extremely pleased with all the dishes. Despite there diminuative sizes, I was satisfied despite my wife "stealing" a piece of everything.
We both agree that the food was great, and look forward to exploring their menu further!

Stopped in with my wife for lunch. Wasn't planned, we stumbled upon this quaint spot after our original destination didn't happen as planned. I've been told this is a wonderful place from my cousin.
Well for a Saturday lunch it was quiet, which is not what I had expected. There were a few other parties of people in there. The decor is very modern and very inviting. Staff are very friendly, easy to tell that this is a family run business and they will be very successful.
The selections of dishes had no shortage. We had a few questions and the staff basically jumped at the idea of helping us. The portion sizes are fantastic for the prices the large size of pho for only $1 more than regular is definitely a great deal. The bowl was huge.
I had the pho with flank steak, brisket, tripe and tendons. Yes glorious tendons! The broth was amazing possibly the best I've ever tasted. The addition of copious amounts of cilantro add a wonderful tang to the taste buds. The steak and brisket were tender and perfect. The perfect amount of onions added for flavour, the tendons were plentiful never had a bowl of pho with that many tendons. The only issue I had with my pho was the pieces of tripe were too big, a knife would've been great to make smaller sizes. To top it all off the vermicelli was cooked to perfection. Fans of pho need to try this pho sho!
My wife had the grilled chicken and prawns vermicelli bowl minus the prawns. She wasn't feel the prawns today. The staff substituted the prawns for a spring roll. Which was delicious might I add! The vermicelli was the perfect texture, chicken cooked to perfection and seasoned just right paired with a tangy fish sauce. I enjoy vermicelli bowls but this is the top shelf of food quality.
For a first time this visit did not disappoint. With friendly staff, fast fresh food which is flavourful and delicious, healthy portion sizes and a total bill which shocked me of how cheap it was so surprised. The atmosphere is very inviting and I can't wait to go back. This place has definitely not seen the end of my family!

Big sports bar. Gets pretty packed and rockus  at times, but that's pretty much the idea.
Surprisingly decent food from a menu with something for everyone. 
Good local spot for a beer and a bite that is anything but a franchised experience.
I now understand why the parking lot is more often than not very full!

Got the opportunity of trying the new Christmas menu, Cranberry BBQ ribs, super tasty!! The Christmas poutine had some turkey, stuffing and cranberry sauce, I think I will stick with the original poutine tho. 
The pizza was my favorite, it had the right amount of turkey and cheese, the rosemary was a great touch.
Of the drinks menu, the blood orange quencher was by far the most delicious drink that I have tried at a BP before! 
Service was great, the server was soo friendly and helpful. The place atmosphere was really good, music, people, decorations.
This BP is located in a very accessible area of Sherwood Park so I'm sure I will visit them very soon!

Pookeys is a great local pet food store.  They aren't fancy, and they aren't huge, what they are is a community based store that focuses on what local residents want for their pets.

What I like about Pookeys:
1. great prices:  if you shop here regularly they will sign you up for a discount program which is 10% at time of purchase plus points that equal dollar for dollar value for future purchases.  I often use the points to by my doggy friends toys Christmas toys for their pets.
2.  Great hours:  they are open from 8am to 9pm many nights a week.  This is fantastic for anyone with a busy lifestyle where making even a 6pm closing is difficult.
3.  Quality products:  Pookeys stocks a range of dog and cat foods, but mostly the higher quality brands. 
4.  In stock:  barring a problem with the producer, which they have no control over, Pookeys generally maintains a good stock level of dog and cat foods.  The only times I have not been able to get a preferred brand was when the producer stopped shipping for some reason.  Event then Pookeys was able to get stock in pretty quickly once the producer got themselves back on line.
5.  Community hiring:  I am pretty sur Pookeys provides that valuable first job to many high school students.  It is good to see a community based business supporting local job seekers.

Suggestions for improvement
1.  More oversight of staff may be valuable.  Most times I find staff are chatting with each other at the front till.  Spending a bit more time cleaning, and keeping the place looking sharp might make for a better first impression.

Certainly a better option than the regular "fast food" fare. Great for the kids as they can choose their pasta and sauce combination. Sausage, chicken, and meatball add-ons are pretty good, but can quicky rack up the bill.
Given how much a "McMeal" can cost a family these days...this is considerably better. Also great for take-out!

Dinner at Boston Pizza tonight was part of a Yelp event to introduce holiday / Christmas specialty menu items.
We tasted the Christmas pizza, the cranberry BBQ ribs and the smoked Gouda and poblano pepper ravioli. BP's holiday menu features cranberry sauce, turkey and stuffing ingredients on most of their recipes, and we loved the food we tasted.
Also at the event, local breweries and distilleries were present to present diners with sample of their drinks, including the Situation Brewing.
Service was absolutely great, and the crowd seemed happy with the party going on.
During the meal we sat beside the live music singer, who sang famous songs with his acoustic guitar!!

Tried the pizza there for the first time tonight. FANTASTIC. Thinner crust than what you would usually get from a typical pizza shop. Very fresh toppings. Owner was very friendly and personable. I will be ordering from here again. Call them directly for pick up or delivery.

My husband went to this store to pick up some Halibut filets for dinner yesterday May 14, 2015. I am in my third Trimester of pregnancy and was craving them. He grabbed 3 packages that came to a total of just over $30. When we got home I opened the packages to discover the fish still had its skin on ( not a big deal) both my husband and I went to culinary school so this is an easy fix for us. While I was removing the skin on the fish filet I found a WORM in the meat under the skin. I phoned the store to let them know and to get a reimbursement for the $30. The lady took down our information and said the manager would call us back. It has been over 24hrs and we have not received a call back so I can only assume they do not care about WORMS in their fish. We had originally driven out of our way to go here as we live in Fort Saskatchewan but from now on we won't be going back.

Thought about putting some support behind this new establishment. Until I saw the owners wife take their child to put in the car. After getting the child sorted she cleaned her garbage out and threw it on the ground!  Literally right in front of their own business. I called and although the guy answering admitted he was the owner and that was his family the most he did was look at the garbage out his window.  We were in the area for another hour and nobody picked up her trash.  I find this a disgusting display of ignorance.

We have attended a couple events here. It's a pretty typical sports pub. Pool tables, lots of seating (mostly high tables) and it is a pretty big venue. The parking lot can be tight as it shares it with a lot of other businesses. There isn't a lot of choices for local or micro-brews but I guess what they offer pleases most of their customers.

Tons of TV's line the upper ceiling so no matter where you sit you will be able to watch whatever game or sporting event is going on.

Food is okay. Pretty typical sports pub fare. I've only eaten there twice I think. Nothing too special about the menu or the quality.  It's good pub food, not great or unique. They do have a big menu though so there is lots to choose from. They may not be able to accommodate all diets though. I think they have some vegan/vegetarian dishes. They offered a gluten-friendly pizza crust but they cannot guarantee no cross-contamination will occur. The fryer is shared also so anything is a no go for anyone that is Celiac.

I went to Vicky's to celebrate my wedding anniversary. It was my first visit at the new location beside the library and I enjoyed it very much! Service was efficient, professional and friendly, the food tasted great and the portions were just right. What I loved about the restaurant was its fantastic menu. There were many items on the menu I wanted to try and it all looked great. I think I'll be visiting Vicky's again soon.

A note about the other reviews: my water was replenished several times, my server was very attentive and knowledgeable about the menu + wine pairings and I left feeling completely satisfied with the dinner experience from start to finish. I would consider the menu to be more regional cuisine rather than exclusively Greek, although there is a bit of fusion within each dish, such as pita served with "Prawns a la Vicky" and Greek style potatoes served with my main. I had the Alaskan, which was prepared very well (chicken not dry) and my husband ordered the lobster and tenderloin, which was also prepared perfectly (not chewy). The atmosphere is more sophisticated than Joeys albeit more expensive.

If you live in Sherwood Park and are looking for alternatives to Joeys, Earls or Ric's, give Vicky's a try. It's a gem in Sherwood Park.

Went in last night ripped as hell. Found ourself a spot at one of the booth's and found it really
Hard to get up. The entertainment factor of multiple TV's going on is amazing! 

  I got to watch WWF summer slam with Brett the hitman heart (totally awesome for I have not herein WWF since a kid) well watching a plethora  of sports on other TV's same time. 


   I decided to get the Troy Oinkman burger and holy shit!!! Was  t ever good. Serious hit on so many levels. The amount of delicious flavor that comes out (if you can get a bite in, its so huge) is simply epic!! We ordered up
Mozzarella sticks as wel. They shipped us out 8 of them bad boys as well! 


 But back to the burger. So much bacon on it that it might as well have been a pork with beef burger lol. The condiments they put on it are proportioned wel to make it taste so damn good!!

My advice?? Next time you wanna get a burger. Fuck McDonald's or Wendy's. And try this bad boy it. Bet you struggle to finish!!

Stay lit

Calamari 5 yelps very tasty
Alaskan 3.5 yelps bit too salty.
Service 4.5 yelps
Busy make a reservation for the weekend.

Tried this place for the first time. We arrived at 8pm and dinner rush was over. Place was very clean. Waiter courteous and very friendly. Explained the different names on menu. Since we are vegetarian, he helped us choose menu and also willing to accommodate our choices. I ordered pad Thai and it was delicious . Great lil place. Would definitely eat here again

Smaller than most McDonalds.
Not open 24hours
Otherwise...
It's McDonalds.
Been here many times over the tears.
Seevice is as hit or miss as any other location.
It's always really a matter of convenience.
If this is the most convenient location for you...make it the one you stop at!
Good service. Expected my steak and veg to be hot as in freshly cooked as opposed to what felt like reheated.
Muchas Gracias a la gente de México Lindo. Muy amable y comida excepcional. Es un placer compartir un rato con Latinos. The place to be.

Went out to celebrate our anniversary tonight.  Thought we would try out the new fondue restaurant in Sherwood Park.  Big disappointment.  Service was great, efficient, friendly and helpful.  The food experience was not so great.  We each had the Bleu Flame Feast 4 course.  The cheese fondue was lack lustre.  We had the Welsh Rarebit.  You could have grated cheddar cheese added some liquid, heated and stirred on your stovetop to have experienced this course.  The House Salad was great.  Yummy arugula topped with thinly sliced watermelon, cucumber, feta cheese and pecans drizzled with balsamic vinaigrette.  The best course of the evening.  When our main arrived it was far short of what you'd expect from a main course.  There were six pieces of each protein to be shared.  The chicken was fatty, stringy thigh meat,  not breast meat that you'd expect.  The beef was fatty and tough and the shrimp were tiny.  It also came with 4 quarters of mushrooms, 4 pieces of broccoli, 2 pieces of cauliflower and a small bowl of baby potatoes quarters.  Not impressive.  They knew it was our anniversary so before the chocolate fondue arrived they brought out a plate with one scoop of ice cream with a chocolate chunk on top with two pieces of strawberries and two small pieces of brownie on the plate, same thing that comes with the chocolate fondue minus the ice cream. No big deal, would have preferred a complimentary glass of wine or a discount on the bottle we purchased.  When we were finished we had several pieces of our chocolate fondue dippers left, we asked if they could be packed up to take home, and were told that they couldn't as they had nothing to put them in.  Kind of crappy.  Will not be returning.  It was a unhappy anniversary dinner, great company, terrible food experience.

I have been wanting to try Mexico Lindo for some time, and yesterday I got my chance.
I went in for lunch with a friend, and have fallen in love with this restaurant.
We got in about 1pm, and were greeted by a charming young lady who would be our server.
We were seated and pointed to the QR code with which we could access the menu, though it did not work for my friend and our server brought us real menus, which were much easier to deal with.

I was very impressed with the selection, and ML seem to have a broader menu than most Mexican restaurants in town.

We ended up going for Chips and Salsa as a starter, Fish Tacos for my pal, and Lengua Tacos for myself.

We ordered a couple of beers, and the selection of Mexican beers, while not complete, is good.
Pacifico Clara for me, Modelo Negro por mi amigo.

The Chips and Salsa were excellent. The chips were freshly made in house, and that salsa, served in a stone bowl was delicious and fresh with just a hint of heat. (I could have gone for more chili, but we did not leave any behind.)

Our mains arrived in good time, and looked wonderful.
I was impressed with the portions, and with the amount of meat in my Lengua Tacos. (Beef tongue)
Mi Amigo's fish Tacos were also generous, and from what I was told, were superb.
The Lengua was juicy and tender, and perfectly seasoned in a very simple presentation that focused on the meat more than the condiments.
We also got a couple of ramkins of salsa to drizzle on the tacos. One was a Salsa Roja made with smoked Chipotle, the other was a Salsa Verde.
Both were excellent, but the Salsa Roja was a clear favourite, and we both considered licking the ramkin clean when we ran out of food on which to drizzle it, or dip in it.
Dignity prevailed and we wistfully watched it being carried away when the table was cleared.

The restaurant is welcoming and warmly decorated, belying the spartan concrete, strip mall exterior.
There are nice appointments throughout, and the music was perfect.
Our server was charming and efficient, and seemed to anticipate our every need, without hovering.
The place is modern and clean, and the washrooms are well maintained and decorated, as well.

I will definitely be back here again, as I saw many things on the menu that tickled my palate.

Food - 4.5  Excellent, and Muy authentico!
Service - 5 Charming, well versed, and efficient.
Restaurant - 4  Warm and welcoming with nice accents, but still a tad  utilitarian.

If you love Mexican food as much as I do, you have to eat here.

I went to Aradia Fitness at Sherwood Park for the first time.
We had a 30 mins session, which was broken into 10 mins warm up, 10 mins pole dancing and 10 mins cool down. We didn't have much time left for the pole class but since most of us were there for the first time, it still gave us the opportunity to get a taste of it. 
This can be indeed a great workout, my arm muscles were a little sore the day after even after such a short session. I'd say you can indeed build stronger muscles after several classes.
For beginners, they offer a 6 one-on-one sessions for $150.

I've always appreciated London Drugs. Canadian owned and operated, and offering some good deals.
With the apparent demise if small electronic stores like Radio Shack, this is now my go-to, nearby store for small electronics and cables.
They are also one of only a handfull of stores with a good camera department.
As an avid photographer, this is my shop of choice for developing pictures. Much more economical and higher quailty than my home inkjet. 
It is also one of my favorite places to shop for small appliances.
Pharmacy is solid.
All in all...I really lie this store and indeed this chain.
I'd rather support them than Walmart!

So I was curious about this place. I have to admit I took a class with some of my friends years ago and kind of forgot about it. What I remember is that the feeling you get out of a class never changes. Empowering and sexy. 
Aradia now has 3 locations very accessible for each location. Downtown- you may have to search around the Kingsway building so plan to arrive a bit early. The one I went to was Sherwood Park- Parking shared  with the bottle depot- so bring your bottles if you got some.2-1 stop ;)-. When you walk in open concept - change rooms with bathrooms located just beyond the front desk. No lockers so be prepared to keep your stuff in a bag. No runners required. We were given  a brief description of the class and the types of poles. Instructor Megan was incredibly nice and enthusiastic. Brought out the inner diva and sexiness for sure. It was an intro class so beginners would prob start off with simple moves but we jumped right into using the poles. It was extremely fun and empowering. My time there was through Yelp but we were told that class descriptions are online and easy sign up. They have workshops with different dance themes and it's a great work out for sure . Alternative to the gym to really tone your muscles you knew u never had- and get your sexy on!

I came here for brunch on a weekend. It was very busy and had to wait about 10 minutes to be seated, which was no problem but the super tiny waiting area was jam packed and the people had no where to go without being in someone's way. Staff were friendly and welcoming. We both had omelettes and my friend was extremely impressed with all the gluten free/paleo friendly options. Portions were exactly perfect for both of us, although I wouldn't go here if I was looking for a cheap breakfast. The food tasted really good, was filling but not heavy or greasy and I'd for sure go back. I really appreciated that each table is given a large cold glass bottle of water so we were able to refill our glasses conveniently without having to bother a server. The place became far less busy as we ate and my friend and I ended up staying for a couple hours catching up and they never pushed us out so that was good too. I'd recommend this place.
Some of the best sushi in the Edmonton area Ive ever had. Great BIG rolls.  Large portions of sashimi. Great selection of bubble tea too!!

Update: to one star. Very poor service, food is WAY worse than it used to be. We ordered our usual(almond chicken, ginger beef, stir fry veggies and egg fried rice without meat). The chickens sauce was cold, the rice was chocked full of meat and right as our order was coming out they told us they were sold out of ginger beef! Why couldn't they tell us sooner?! They told us we could order something else in place of the ginger beef, which we asked to see a menu and by the time the server came back we had finished the rest of our (horrible) food. Also took them 15mis to bring my son water he asked for and my husband also asked for water and never got it. 
We weren't once asked how the food was and when we went up to pay, we didn't tip(it's obvious why) the girl was VERY snobby because of our lack of tip! 
Very disappointed.
Boats and bridges are all very good. Really like the California pizza also. Restaurant is nice. Service is always really good. Overpriced but worth it.

I am a taco fanatic, and these in my opinion are the best most flavourful, fast food tacos in the Edmonton/Sherwood Park area. 

Staff is really nice, and if you go as much as my wife and I they tend to remember you. They will always know to put fresh shrimp on the stove when my wife walks in.

You need a reservation for this place as seating is limited. The food portions are large and have authentic flavours. The drinks were okay. The margarita tasted like it came from a drink mix though. The servers are friendly. Another Mexican option to try at least once.

I just stopped in here because I happened to be in the area. What a mistake, I should have taken my time and truly enjoyed myself. These chocolates are truly delicious and should be enjoyed lovingly. 

The staff here make you feel completely at ease and are really quite passionate about their chocolates. I am sure there are some bad ones here but I didn't have one.  I enjoyed what I sampled and grabbed a custom box to go.

The store is bright and extremely clean.

Decided to give this place a shot for dinner tonight.
Not bad.
Not great.
But a goid selection and pretty good value.
As they serve a mix of Western and Asian fare, I chose the Clark's burger, with fries, and an order of spring rolls to start.
Spring rolls seemd like they came a bag.
Fries...deffinitely from a bag.
Burger.
Fresh.
Thick.
Much like something one would do at home. 
For $20 total...
Infact that's how the entire meal sort of felt. Right down to thd iced tea that seemed like it was mixed in house.
Service wasn't bad...but it sort of seemed like they forgot all about me, and they weren't busy.
I made do with my one cup of iced tea, and one napkin.
The only time I saw the servers was when I received my food.
The place has NO character. White walls. Nothing on them.
Seem like they ae searching for a sense of themselves.
Despite all this.
I think I will return.
Perhaps for breakfast.
Because the price was right.
And the food was OK. And certainly better than a comparably priced fast food burger!

If you go here with a groupon don't let these guys charge you for "GST" they are lying. Groupons are legally treated as gift certificates.


Under the Excise Tax Act (ETA), the tax treatment of gift certificates is covered in s.181.2.  Essentially, the sale of gift certificates is not considered to be a taxable "supply" (sale), and when they are redeemed, they are considered to be like money.  Since the term "gift certificate" is not defined in the ETA, the CRA issued a Policy Statement (P-202) to clarify the types of certificates and coupons that are considered to be "gift certificates".


They are illegally charging you an extra charge at the end of the meal if you go through groupon.

The absolute best sushi I've had in the greater Edmonton area! So fresh with fantastic flavour combinations. Their sushi is not only incredibly tasty but is also a treat for the other senses as well. It's art on a plate!
I work for a large company- catered with Joe and he was excellent. Exactly on time, food was superb- easy to deal with, he brought everything we needed and more. Made the event super smooth.

The first time I went the service and food was great. We wanted to go a second time and we weren't able to get a table until late that evening. I learned my lesson and decided to call in for a reservation a week in advance for a larger party. When we showed up at our reservation time they had not written down our reservation and didn't try to fix the problem. They simply told us to come back next time. I am not impressed with their problem solving skills and was very upset that the hostess didn't try to create a solution. I understand that it's a busy place, and respected Thier time and business. I however didn't feel like my time was respected. It was disappointing to my first visit.

I'm very skeptical when it comes to Chinese food as it rare that it is done well. Huku is an example of why one should be wary. Unfortunately Sherwood Grill was closed on the night (closed forever actually) I decided to take my mom out for dinner so we drove by Huku and decided to give it a go. For appetizer we had the Egg Roll and Spring Rolls, since we couldn't decide on which to try. The spring rolls were actually decent, the menu stated that they used fresh Chinatown ingredients, and they tasted as though this was true. The egg roll however was a little over breaded for my tastes. I also wanted to try some Dim Sum, as I have never had it before, but they were out of pork dumpling so instead I tried the shrimp dumplings and was once again underwhelmed. The dumpling itself was okay, but the shrimp just didn't have good flavour.

For our mains we got Beef Chow Mein, Steamed Rice, and Shrimp Balls. The Shrimp balls were quite good actually, although the breading was once again heavy. The Chow Mein noodles had an odd flavour that I have never before experienced in a Chow Mein, my mom likened it to a fishy taste, and the beef was subpar at best. The rice tasted fine, but honestly if you can't do rice well you shouldn't open a Chinese restaurant.

We had 2 separate servers during the night, one that took our order and one that brought out the food. Our first server was friendly and accommodating, however the second didn't smile until we coaxed one out of her with a little conversation (my mom was not impressed). Anyways... overall the place was sort of what I'm used to with Chinese food, unimpressive. I'm really starting to wonder if anywhere in Edmonton does good Chinese.

Derks men's wear is a men's wear must in Edmonton. Their staff takes the time to go over their inventory and makes sure you leave never looking less than dapper. They have an enormous selection of suits and accessories from watches to cuff links. Plus all the Happy socks you can handle. I really like their online magazine as it has lots of great style and lifestyle tips. Derks is five star retail shopping.
That was the best Chinese food I've had in years!!  No Edmonton place compares. Was fast as well. Recommend you try it. You won't be disappointed.

I love sushi so I knew I had to try out this restaurant so a bridal shower was the perfect excuse to go! Despite our large group, the servers were very attentive and quick with service. We got our drinks fast and appetizers we're also quick out of the kitchen. The food itself was amazing - our crew sampling everything from the chicken karrange and avocado spring rolls to the sashimi platter, Maki boat, and more! The fish was incredibly fresh! The flying saki was on sale as was the cocktail called The Galaxy. The restaurant was cool, clean and had amazing ambience. Definitely recommend!

So you should know by now, my illustrious readers, that I like cheap. Not cheap quality mind you, but cheap price tags. I can appreciate quality in things and will happily pay for it. However, I can't help but get all giddy and flushed when I find quality AND a cheap price in once spot.

I've been to this little gem called Clarks twice now in the last two weeks. Once for breakfast to meet a super cool friend of mine who sells sex toys for a living, (told you she was cool), and another time for lunch with my Mom. ( My mom doesn't sell sex toys for a living, and while I thank God for that, she's still cool.)

So I'm only going to review the lunch with Mom for this post because I wasn't thinking to take photos of the breakfast I had with my cool friend, plus my Mom said "Hey, you should review this place".

Smartypants.

Easy to find, this little spot has maybe 10 tables in the whole place, I think. Surprisingly, it was about half full at 12:30 in the afternoon, (thought it might be busier), but our server greeted us immediately when we walked in the door and brought us to a table. Taking our drink order and giving us menu's she left us to decide.

The prices on this menu are amazing people! Mom ordered liver and onions (she could have ordered the senior's size for $6.50 - one scoop of mashed potatoes with gravy, two pieces of liver, and vegetables - but she's in denial about the senior thing I think - so she ordered the normal portion). She went on about how she hasn't eaten liver for almost a year, and I reminded her that it's been about 25 years since I've eaten it. I'd rather run naked through a cactus patch and bathe in a tub of vinegar than eat liver.

Ok, not quite, ..... but well, honestly?...... Maybe.

I ordered their house burger (can't remember the name of it dammit!), but it had cheese, bacon and mushrooms on it with all the other burger paraphernalia, and fries. The price for that burger rang in at $8.99.

When the dishes came to the table, my mom seemed super pleased with her decision. She tried her first bite of the liver and looked up to the ceiling and said " OH MY GOD" (all dramatic like),  with an added "this is the best liver I"ve had in a very long time!!". The waitress came along and Mom repeated what she expressed loud enough for all the other tables sitting around us to hear, and then the waitress went straight away into the kitchen and you could her yell... "JUAN!! Hey JUUAAAAN!!! -The liver and onions are excellent she said!".

Mom figured the liver was slightly coated in a panko type coating and fried slightly crispy, but not like "shoe leather". The gravy tasted home-style, the mash was smooth and creamy and she said the veggies were very good - fresh, not from frozen and  not overcooked. All this stupid excitement over the liver made me think I had to try it.

So I cut a very small piece and kinda dipped in some gravy.

It was crispy on the outside, tender, and still tasted disgustingly like liver to me. But I will admit, it was the very best of all the gross tasting liver I've ever had in my life.

For real - If you love liver,  you will love Clarks' liver.

(Somehow that sounded weird, but you get what I'm saying)

My burger was pretty good. The patty was house made and slightly dense, almost overworked, but very tasty. The cheese and bacon were nice but it could have used a few more mushrooms. All in all, the portion size was more than worth that price tag. Hell, you're gonna pay that same price pretty much at MacDonald's and the patties there are like shingles.

Our server was VERY attentive and incidentally, an older lady who's been with the company for 22 years. This lady worked her ass off, was super friendly and made sure we were looked after. She was worth the generous tip, without question!

On a side note, their breakfasts are super decent (EG: 2 eggs, 2 pancakes, 2 sausage, 2 bacon for $5.35.) and they have a huge variety of different Eggs Benedict if you're looking for something other than the original.

I will definitely be going back to Clarks for breakfast or lunch. Apparently for dinner, it becomes a chinese food place, which is great, but I can't comment right now because I've not tried it................................

Yet.

www.forkinfoodie.com

If you don't go into Sherwood Park often, I think this place is worth the drive! I've been to Sumo Sumo a couple of times now and haven't been disappointed. 

The look of the restaurant is very nice and the landscaping outside is also pretty appealing with water fountains and what seems to be a huge patio area (it was raining so we couldn't unfortunately take advantage of the patio) 

Their dinner bento boxes were on sale as their Tuesday special so we each had the seafood one (regular $27 for $19!)
It didn't come out as your standard bento boxes so we were surprised by the many plates of yummy food that kept coming out! 

This dinner box came with a miso soup, salad, chicken spring rolls, sushi (the California rolls were pretty tasty), gyoza and a large plate of seafood (inc. shrimp, crab, mussels and scallops) with rice. I would say that the teriyaki sauce that was on the dish just didn't go that well with the seafood though. 

But it was all in all very yummy and a great bang for your buck! I would definitely return to Sumo Sumo!!

I have loved GCB since I was a kid.... the owners are very nice here, but their bagel selection these days is horrible. I stopped in on a Saturday before noon, and they had almost no bagels available. I asked if they were making more and I was told to call ahead of time and they will try and put them aside for me. I don't think they get much business anymore, but it's very disappointing to go pick up your fav bagels on and there be nothing to chose from.I don't feel I should have to call a head at a bagel specialty shop to get 6 bagels!
IMPORTANT: be sure to tip the children working there or they will give u a 2 bite 2 scoop cone they have stuck up sherwood park kids working there

Popped in for a quick bite after a movie, started with an Alley Kat double IPA and a Pina colada, both delicious. I had the Hugo Taco with smoked sirloin and chorizo, and my wife had the tortilla soup and quesadilla, and the food was all very tasty and we'll portioned. The soup was maybe not as hot as it should have been, but a minor complaint. I also had a traditional margarita, and it was also very good. Efficient and friendly service, all in all a very good experience.

I have never had a bad experience at this restaurant! The buffet on Sundays is plentiful and delicious with variety and well worth the price. Their rolls are always delicious and sashimi always fresh and full portions. One of my favourite restaurants for their amazing food and drink. Service and prices are decent but I would come back for the food even if they weren't!

Best sushi in Edm so far. Nice decor, great atmosphere, and of course good food! Rolls are very well presented and very tasty. Exceptional customer service. I ordered some rolls, but they were too spicy for me, they asked which other ones i would like and replaced them immidiately with another tasty set! Pricey, but very worth it.

I love treating myself to great massage experiences here at namaste. They keep a professional and overwhelmingly calm atmosphere in their work environment and the addition of the steam before your massage is so enjoyable.  I even found a few gifts for girlfriends while waiting they have a store with all sorts of massage oils and creams. I have seen Chelsea signore i believe her name is and she really was great for communicating what i needed in a massage that day. I always recommend clients to go to Namaste as i am a hairdresser with a terrible back and neck and require a a firm hand and a relaxation here and there too. Had a pedicure here as well which was nice but the massage wasn't quite as good as my regular place will try again with another girl and see how the results are.

We came here the other night for dinner and the food was pretty good. I don't eat a lot of Indian food, so I don't know the actual names of the dishes. I really liked the curry lamb, butter chicken and saffron rice. For dessert I had the gulab jamun and a fruity custard. The gulab jamun tasted like pancakes balls drenched in syrup, so it is very sweet. My chai tea was great and rich in flavor (I dont put sweeteners in my tea). Overall it was a nice dinner and customer service was good. I can see myself coming back again.

This location is your average Safeway, nothing extraordinary about it

The parking for this location is a little sparse due to it also being apart of the mall, employees are friendly enough and the shelves are fairly well stocked.

If I'm in the area and in need of something here, I'd stop in again.

How does this Breakfast and Lunch compare ?

We went here for our Sunday brunch and I can only say, that it's a disappointing but not horrible experience.

A run of the mill restaurant worthy of only 2 stars.

For people who have gone to Cora's it'll easy to draw comparisons. Both serve similar menus laden with large amounts of fresh fruit per plate.

Unfortunately for Tutti Frutti, they get beaten like Paquio vs Mayfeather.

Worst Food.
Eggs came out cold (but they did replace them)
The fruit not as "creative or varied"

Service
No comparison. Cora's destroys this place. We had short wait times to get in, but we sat with no coffee (a must at breakfast) for far too long after ordering.

The table clearing and bussing were also sadly inadequate

Price
Similar to Cora's . Roughly $18 per person.

Menus
Confusing, and poorly written.

Decor
Loud. Filled with hipsters.

Overall? "I'd rather go to Denny's" according to one of my brunch companions.

Pros:
Lots of free parking
Not bad food

Cons:
Poor service
Worse than Cora's in every way
Amazing food very authentic very tasty. Maybe a bit expensive for what you get, but the flavor is definitely there. Very quick and friendly. Definitely recommend this place for a great Mexican meal

So, it has taken me some time to finally write this. I will never, ever return to this establishment.  Service was horrible, my companion and I were treated poorly from the moment we walked in the door. We did err on an order, and when they brought us the dish, we both asked if this was what came with the special, as it seemed too much. Waitress brushed it off, and then later proceeded to tell us we screwed up, and they would either remove the plate from our table, or have to charge us for it. With only 1 roll left, we laughed it off and told them to take it back. Guess what was immediately brought to our table afterwards? The same appetizer, but the appropriate size for their "Special of the day". The impression the server left us with was we were trying to scam them,  which resulted in us feeling horribly cheap. We (well....my date!) paid, tipped, and left. It is a bit of a shame, as the rolls actually tasted good. It really is a shame they decided to be....snobs? I would highly recommend ANY sushi place over Sumo. Check out Ichiban reviews!

One of the best Sushi places around Edmonton. It's worth the drive to Sherwood Park. Too bad they closed down the one by Calgary Trail. It was much closer to where I live but the food and the friendly staff won't stop us from visiting them even if it means 20-30 min drive. Their Sunday buffet is awesome!

Been here many times. My son just loves the butter chicken ("you can dip the Knan bread it it!" as he puts it) and is always on us to go again. That being said...there is little consistancy. I must admit I have never ordered off the menu...always simply indulging in the buffet. I can honestly say that it's never been bad....but it not always great. Biggest issue I had was them not having a booster available one time (as the couple they do have were in use). Prices are good for families and it offers the kids a chance to try something different without an unreasonable expenditure. When my 4 year old daughter isn't digging the Indian...we simply fill her up on the fresh fruit at the buffet.  I just wish they could get the food to be at it's best consistantly.
Best sushi in all Edmonton area. Family friendly and full of options.
The food was delicious, the service was awesome! It certainly will become one of our new restaurants.

As a foodie, I visit a lot of restaurants in and around Edmonton. I was at this restaurant for a birthday celebration with friends. Unfortunately, I have a severe allergy to sesame seeds (just the seeds, the sesame oil is fine) and indicated this to our server when she took my order. I specifically told her that it was a severe allergy and it seemed as though this was made note of. I ordered a teriyaki beef bento box and when the salad portion of my meal arrived, it was garnished with sesame seeds. I pointed this out and then then a new salad was brought to me with no sesame seeds but with the server making a comment about how they were "trying to kill me right off the bat". I realize that this was intended to be a joke but I do not think that was appropriate or funny. I don't think the server meant it in a harsh way, I just don't think she realized the severity of my allergy. After the meal I headed home but felt the outside of my neck was hot and itchy. Once I arrived home, I noticed that hives were forming all over my neck and onto my lower back. This was a clear indication of cross-contamination.  My allergic reaction lasted through the night and well into the next morning. I took a reactine as soon as I realized hives were starting to form and the inside of my throat and ear were itchy. This didn't take effect so I took an additional one. The next morning, my limbs were numb, my throat was still itchy but the hives were beginning to dissipate, and I was exhausted. It was well into the next day that I began to feel better. I am thankful that this allergic reaction did not have to prompt me to use my epipen. However, I feel that more precaution should have been taken to ensure cross-contamination did not occur. The server was nice but more communication with the kitchen staff would have been appreciated. I called the manager to alert her of the situation, she was nice and apologized for the mistake. I am thankful that this did not cost me my life and that nothing like this happened: http://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/canada/quebec-waiter-arrested-after-seafood-puts-allergic-customer-in-coma/ar-BBvg9jY?ocid=se. Allergies are serious and could be between life and death so if you have allergies, I'm not sure if going to this restaurant would be a good idea. I know that I will not be going back to this restaurant again. This is unfortunate since I've been to other Japanese restaurants (Mikado, Nomiya, Kyoto) and they have all accommodated my allergy to sesame seeds. I never had any issues at the mentioned restaurants. The staff are nice but when it comes to the food, I do not want to risk my life at a restaurant that did not take my allergy seriously.
Closed on Saturday at 11:45 am. Wow. I like Tutti at different locations but this is weird.
I'm a convert to Japanese food it's not my first choice but every time I've been here I've had good meals. And gone away satisfied. Had Cold Sapporo. Hot Japanese green tea etc.

This was my first time in a Tutti Frutti.. 

Honestly, the only downside for me was the price - it seemed a little steep.  Although, the portion size was so big that I couldn't finish it, so I guess that's the balance.

I ordered the club sandwich with soup, salad and home fries (I don't know what I was thinking... way too much food).

Today's soup was Tomato Basil.  It was absolutely delicious, with actual tomato slices in it.  I wouldn't hesitate to order it again.

The home fries and soup would have been enough to keep me happy.  The home fries are sliced potatoes... they don't own a deep fryer but they taste deep fried.  Not sure how they managed that.

The sandwich was good... but actual paled in comparison to the fries and soup.  The toast was perfect and the bacon was beautiful.

I would go back for sure... but only if I called ahead to make sure they had my soup :)

I have been here several times already since I moved to Edmonton. I've tried the tempora udon soup, which is really really good! Sushi tastes fresh as well. I heard their sunday brunch is good, but never had a chance to try it out.


One thing I'm not exactly happy about the place is the bunto box, which ia supposed to be in a " bunto box". I got a mixture of things in a big plate, the presentation of which is a bit disappointing... even at a cheap university cafeteria, they serve bunto box in the real box, I expect the more expensive sumo sumo would do at least the same... for this I give it a 4 star.

In addition, I quite enjoy the smell of deep fried fish when walking into the place. The paint in the washroom is hilarious...

Ok we went back 5 years later as relatives were visiting. Very glad we did. They had a fire and changed the decor for the better. Service was very improved although a little slow on drink refills, according to my sister in law.
The food was excellent, we ordered from the menu which didn't seem extensive but we ordered Indian food we like and got it. For instance I didn't see lamb  vindaloo  but ordered it and goat curry, no problem, and they were excellent. The sizzling seafood platter is worth going back for by itself. Lots of naan as well. Didn't try the buffet but a lot of people seem to come for just that. Very busy pick up as well. Give it a try if you've been avoiding it.
Overpriced and not fresh.   Every maki roll was covered in sauce.   Super disappointed in this place.   It is off my list.

First time here for my daughter and I. Friendly prompt service. Started with chips and salsa. Salsa (really a pico - not what I expected) had great flavour, but was a bit too heavy on the onion for me. I had Chile relleno. I'd never tried this dish anywhere before. I was pleased with the delicious taste of this one. Accompanied by guacamole and refried black beans. Also very good! Looking forward to going back.
Sumo sumo stands out as one of a few gems in the otherwise mediocre and over priced Edmonton Japanese food/sushi scene.

A very clean, very impressive Sushi bar in Sherwood park. This place is no dump , it's the equivalent of going to a KEG or Joey's but for Japanese food.

We had a sampling off of the menu and it was all really good. You can't really go wrong here.

The only thing I might quibble about is that it doesn't seem very much like an Authentic Japanese restaurant.

It's big , pricey, clean and well spoken.

Ideal clients, people who like going for Japanese but don't want a culture shock who are ok with paying a little bit more.

Great service, great atmosphere (the covered deck was awesome) and great food. Don't need to have sushi if you don't want to.... Plenty of other dishes to pick from. I did go with a few sushi lovers though, who gave the food a big thumbs up!

Clark's has just recently come under new ownership and they have already made some big improvements to the restaurant. The change is a a great thing and if they continue Clark's has the potential to really come around. Food for now is average and inexpensive. Although things are changing so this rating in the future has the potential to increase dramatically

The service is so fast, It doesn't matter what you order, within 10-15 minutes its ready to go (Or eat, I usually get takeout). The rice always tastes fresh and the sashimi and sushi never has a weird overpowering taste like some places I have had sushi. This is a great place for groups and also for a one on one date or a night out with the girls, they do sell alcohol! They also have specials almost every night of the week such as cheap California rolls or cheap kabobs. I like how they also give a decent portion of wasabi and ginger which is great because some places really cheap out on that and that is not cool.
They also have some tasty desserts and unique fruity drinks instead of plain old water or pop.

The decor is cute and simple and the ambiance is warm and inviting. The restaurant is clean and so are the bathrooms. The staff are quick and efficient and always refill my drink promptly. 

The location they are at right now is kind of small but they are moving to a bigger location in Spring of 2011 as mentioned by the staff that work there!
The buffet does not have enough options. The food is good, but the portions are a little small if you are by yourself. Definitely recommend their frozen drinks

I have visited this restaurant three times, now - and always find the same problem.  When you go for the butter chicken, vegetable korma, or other dishes with sauce, you are hard- pressed to find the chicken, vegetables, etc.  On Thursday evening all they should have called those dishes was butter sauce and korma sauce.  In talking to a friend, he said that seems to be true at the northeast location as well.
