On the next business day I asked to speak to the manager about the voucher not being used properly and he stated that the voucher was worded wrong and I needed to pay for 4 suit rentals to get one free. So they never honored their original voucher even though its from their own store. I asked since technically I paid for 4 do I get one free, but nope. Had to pay to get another suit, even though I should of got one for free. 

Another thing, the best man booked and appointment for a different day to get measured. He showed up and got told it would be an extra 50 min wait. So he ended up leaving because other commitments. 

DON'T GO TO DERKS.

You can't go wrong with the food here. Not only is it a local chain, the food they serve is fresh, tasty and quick - very similar to Mucho Burrito (which I am also a fan of). Service though is pretty shoddy, so don't expect much in that regard.  I've only tried their burritos which are loaded with your choice of fillers, beware, the guacamole is extra, and the serving attendant doesn't tell you that while she's listing off the choices for you to agree or disagree to. The roasted potatoes are a nice touch though.
This is my favourite Mexican cuisine. Amazing food with a great atmosphere and service.

Sumo Sumo is by far my FAVOURITE sushi place I have tried in Edmonton and Sherwood Park! The food is always fresh and delicious.

Last night was particularly spectacular on the taste buds. I tried the spicy cali rolls, dynamite rolls, spicy tuna tempura maki (YUM), tomago maki, and the avocado mango spring rolls. 

Perfection! Ingredients in the sushi rolls were supreme, and the spring rolls were warm and crispy with soft, flavourful insides. Still day dreaming about it all the next day!!

They also have a beautiful enclosed patio

I've been going to see Dr. Dustin at this clinic for about a year for various aches and pains. Dr. Dustin is the best chiropractor I have ever seen.  His demeanour is extremely friendly and professional. I always feel welcome in the clinic, from the warm feeling greeting room right down to the treatments it's all good.
Most recently I hurt my shoulder skiing, but it only hurt some of the time, so I put off going in.  I couldn't figure out what the problem was, sometimes it would hurt doing innocuous things, and other times I could lift weights and it was fine.  Dr. Dustin was able to diagnose the exact problem and do a treatment on my shoulder.  I gotta give the guy credit if he can diagnose a problem with my body that I couldn't even figure out.
I don't hesitate to recommend this location to my closest friends and family and trust Dr. Dustin and his team to take good care of my body, even when I don't.

A beautiful spot that has brought life to a quiet area . The best Mexican food I have had in Edmonton . Worth the drive to Sherwood park . The chef and owner are a great combo that make every visit as enjoyable as possible.  Highly recommend , they really have brought a flavour to Sherwood park .

I love this place!!!!! Sumo Sumo has some of the best sushi around, the employees are SUPER friendly and extremely quick. Try out the lychee juice - so good. Extremely good food, large portions, and some of the lowest prices in the Edmonton area. I will be back time and time again.

Not at all happy with this restaurant. I tend to trust that I'll be getting what is described on the menu. But no,, not at Sumo Fake'o . Order something on the menu that says is crab and you get imitation crab. What else is substituted.? What is really being served hidden in the roles or breading?  I should have paid with imitation money. Never going back.

Today i purchased the facial and a massage deal and i can say i walked in there a winter weathered scrub and walked out a brand new lady. So refreshing with the facial all the products smell wonderful! I have sensitive skin and nothing they used made me itch or burn. You also get free samples with your facial to try the products out. The product line is from Hungary and its all natural too. The massage i had blew my mind away i find my muscles are quite tense and hard to properly work all my stress away but today im all fixed up and ready to hit the ground running again. When getting a massage i find communication is key if there is a specific area of muscles more sore direct your therapist to focus or go deeper in your trouble areas to get the full benefit. These ladies are awesome the service and attitude all around is beyond your expectations! Shall be back soon to get back to feeling like myself again.

Walking in, the first thing I notice is the strong smoky grill smell and haze in the air. Not a good sign. Our hostess greeted me and then proceeded to take a phone call and ask the couple behind us if she could help them. I know I'm not invisible because she acknowledged my request for a table and even picked up menus. Anyhow, we are finally seated in their patio space which is actually a 4 season room. The space is quite nice with fountains, big windows and thankfully - away from the smoke. 

We ordered two chicken yakisoba bowls for the girls, miso soup, gyoza, Aloha,Joe's special and Samurai rolls. The noodles came quickly and they were huge portions for kids meals. My complaint with these were that they definitely looked like and tasted like the grill/hot plate had not been cleaned properly in between dishes. You know all those bits of thick black char everywhere? Yeah those. 

Miso soup was standard and so were the gyoza. The gyoza were served with a thick sauce, I think it's their teriyaki sauce. My husband liked it. The rolls are huge. Which makes up for a lot of the price. However, they did tend to be oversauced - for the rolls with sauce and the rice was poorly cooked, seasoned and even rolled. The rolls were packed much too tightly in some places and falling apart in others. It's just not what I expect when I go to a sushi joint that comes highly recommended. The flavour combinations themselves were good so points there. 

Service was spotty. Sometimes good, sometimes non- existent. Forgotten drinks. Only 1/4 waters refilled. I don't know .. Nothing special. 

Overall, I wouldn't make a special trip back especially since it's out of my way. I know there aren't many choices for dining in this part of town so I'd go out of convenience sake if I'm hungry.
This is my favourite place for Sushi!  Bright friendly and fresh.  I hope this carries on when they move to there new home. My mouth is watering as I write..  I guess it is sushi tonight

I was totally stuck with no other options for my gel fill and decided to try Q Nails despite all the negative reviews. So happy I did. Priscilla was so amazing and actually did my nails BETTER than my other nail tech. She fixed the shape perfectly and they have never looked this good! Can't thank her enough.

Don't even bother.
The owner and staff have absolutely no customer service skills. They bark orders, talk to each other (in another language) and you feel like it could be about you. There are no pleasantries exchanged between the staff and the customers.
And the owner always parks her SUV right in front of the door. Now those spots should be for customers not your laziness. If you had any customer service skills, you would realize this.
Will never go back. There is enough competition for nail places around that i can find one way better than yours without trying.

had too go back 3 times for final fittings. they lost the sizes for our ring bearer and did not order the clothes right. I'm here for my friends wedding. When I mentioned my shirt didn't fit the 1st he said Im not use to wearing dress clothes even though I wear a tie 5 days a week. When I get my clothes back I will not be going back here. BOO THE SERVICE.

I love going here for brunch and always take my friends. A delicious selection of eggs benedict is my favorite to order and also a bowl latte! Sometimes there's a bit of a line up to get in but definitely worth the wait. Friendly service and large portions awaiting you at this tutti fruity!

Went in to eat the buffet and wasn't impressed. The food we ordered from the buffet was cold and dry.. the only food that was fresh was the shrimp tempura and the sashimi. The dynamite rolls, along with the spider rolls were cold and weren't fresh. Some of the sushi rolls that were part of the buffet as well as the oysters were dry. The thing that triggered a red flag for me was the fruit flies that were flying around the bowl of fruit they had part of the buffet menu. I came here years ago when they first opened and the food was fantastic. However, coming back I didn't get that impression at all .

This establishment is now Texan Approved!

I came up from Texas for a few days to visit family and attend a funeral. I was fully prepared to hate this place since we have some world-class burrito joints and Tex-Mex where I come from (we are the "Tex" part after all). I was hungry though, and there were limited options near my hotel.

I drearily trudged at least 400 feet through a frozen hellscape to get here. Please note that what I call a frozen hellscape is what you refer to as normal February weather. On the other hand, what my Canadian family calls "Thermonuclear Spicy," I call normal food. Thus I was expecting bland mush.

I was delightfully surprised. The burrito I had was actually pretty good, if a little runny. The best part though was the guacamole. It was nice and fresh with enough salt and onions to make it flavorful but not overseasoned. I was surprised that the spiciness level was about equal to back home, and possibly even enough to induce "ring-sting" when I sit down and think for a bit tomorrow.

The burrito snob in me won't let me give this place five stars, since it just isn't on the same level as places like Cabo Bob's back home, but grading on a Canadian curve I would say it was great, and certainly better than expected!

A place my wife and I love to go to because it is absolutely AMAZING! The food is always delicious! We love this place and that is why we keep coming back. We get the love boat every time we eat here and it is always so fresh! 

If you love sushi, this is the place to go to!

The atmosphere is very nice and the service is top notch!!!

A pretty decent venue for events. Almost all the seats in the house provide a great view. I'm sure this is a great stage for many artists but as a former-ballerina I'm not a fan of the stage for dancing on. To me the dimensions seem funny and the stage is always a little slippery. The concession is over-priced in my opinion and the front desk is impossible to get a hold of when it comes to buying tickets. That being said, the dressing rooms are fairly large and the sound and lighting systems are great!

It's a fast food place.  Their regular burritos are $8 and they are filling.  You have a choice of white or whole wheat shell.  You can then pick your starch (rice, potatoes, beans)... I go with the black beans and some grilled veggies. Then you can pick your meat, chicken, shredded pork or ground beef.  Then you pick additional toppings such as corn, shredded cheese or hot peppers.  You can add sour  cream or salsa.  Guacamole  is extra.  Then you choose romaine lettuce or cabbage.  The meat portion is not that big but the beans make up for it.  Pretty filling and quite healthy and won't sit heavy in your gut like a hamburger meal.  Staff were pleasant and fast.  Their hot sauce is a sweet one which wasn't my favourite but they have a ranch hot sauce which I didn't try.  They have other food such as tacos.  Two thumbs up.

I go with the black beans and some grilled veggies. Then you can pick your meat, chicken, shredded pork or ground beef. The meat portion is not that big but the beans make up for it.  Pretty filling and quite healthy and won't sit heavy in your gut like a hamburger meal.  Staff were pleasant and fast.  Their hot sauce is a sweet one which wasn't my favourite but they have a ranch hot sauce which I didn't try.  They have other food such as tacos.  Two thumbs up.

The staff here are so friendly and the food is FAST!! It is so delicious! I always try to go just before the lunch or dinner rush as it gets busy fast! Makes a nice date night or lunch date with a friend!
We've been to all of the New Asian Village restaurants. This one is very similar to the one on Sask drive. Very comfy and clean. I recommend asking for a booth. We will definitely be going back
Shelves are always empty, and staff is just plain rude and unfriendly (except for one of their greeters,who is very nice). But what else do you want from a Walmart?
Good selection of options for made-to-order burritos.  The roasted potatoes were unexpected, but tasty. High marks for the fresh salsas.

Pretty darn good inexpensive sushi.
I ordered delivery from here using the nomme app. It was pretty fast and convenient. When it arrived it was missing the sashimi we ordered, so I contacted the nomme app who said it would be an hour to replace it or they would refund my money, I said replace it and they said they couldn't get hold of the restaurant so they were just going to refund me my money..... what!?!?! Wow. If they were on here the nomme app would get 1 star.
I contacted the restaurant myself and they delivered the sashimi to me within about 25 minutes plus a gift card to come in and use again at another time! Wow, talk about service!
The sushi is pretty good and their tempura is amazing. I highly recommend checking this place out, but pickup or go in, do not use the nomme app.

This restaurant is an exotic escape in winter or summer. Beautiful ambiance with rich satin & brass touches. Great for business meetings as they have a screen & other necessary items for meetings. 

Want to be romantic? Want privacy? Ask for one of their private booth.

And the food? DELICIOUS!!! 

Great buffet, lots of Gluten Free options. Don't want spicy? Order from the menu and they are more than happy to make any menu item to your liking!

My sister and I went super early (4:45 pm) for dinner. We were the only.ones in the restaurant on a Monday night for the buffet. We use the Groupon and had no issues. The butter chicken was probably the best I've ever had there. The only thing was we had to wait about 15 mins for naan bread.

Been here a couple of times. Never overly impresses as the service is really spotty. This last time convinced me to never go back. The waiter took a long time to acknowledge our party of six.  Brought some water and disappeared despite telling him we wanted to order from the menu. Finally came back and took drink order,only messed up one, 7up instead of soda water. Still no menus. After a few minutes flagged him down and asked for menus which arrived finally. Ordered appetizers and entrees and naan. After a while one appetizer showed up,no naan, then one more appetizer,still no naan. Then it showed up one dish at a time. The last dish came after we were finished everything.
Food: not bad but lots of sauce little food. Saffron rice at five dollars a small dish is outrageous.
Had to ask for the bill. You have to pay at the front desk and examine the bill there. Oh yes,they got the bill wrong and had to redo it. It.s very pricey for what you get. We've had takeout,you get more food and it's not as expensive .  If you just want nice decor and buffet this is your place, but not for a nice a la carte dinner. The 34th avenue location is infinitely better.
Clean, fast, friendly, innocuous American-style Chinese food. Nothing remarkable.

I booked a float with my friend to help ease my back pain from a car accident. This place has such a relaxing atmosphere and staff are lovely! The tanks are huuuge which was awesome because I am claustrophobic but there was so much room inside to float around and I'm 5'9"! I enjoyed my 90 minute float although I wish I'd checked to see if they do shorter floats as my attention span is super short and I ended up getting antsy and thinking about work...next time I'll definitely try to relax fully and really let myself be immersed in the experience!
Great food, really friendly staff. I always enjoy eating here!   I get the vegetarian burrito - it's nice to know there's an easy vegetarian choice in Sherwood Park.

First, I enjoy that this venue is within a 5 minute walk from my place!
Second, there's free parking there & an underground parkade at the library down the road!
Third, great venue space & seating for smaller functions 
The seats are pretty cushiony and the seating itself it good for the size & age the building is.  I never realized how many performances actually went on here or that services were mostly ran by volunteers 

The few times I've been here is all because of this awesome annual benefit concert called "Stand Up for Love"   
It's an amazing Kids Stollery fundraiser with a silent auction, family fair & kick butt dance/talent show!! 
I cannot WAIT for next year - it keeps getting better and more crazy every year! 
(Though it may outgrow Festival Place by then haha!)

Authentic Mexican food ! Best chorizo in the city . 
The service was also amazing , she knew the menu and suggested options for first timers . Try the house made sauces , delicious ! I cannot wait to go back .

I was really disappointed with the sushi that we ordered and also the tempura which was basically a plate of spaghetti batter. Definitely had much better tasting at many other restaurants. I was warned by other friends not to come here as we would be disappointed but wanted to see for myself. However the service was good I just would not recommend the sushi.

I used to go to the small Sumo Sumo all the time, and it was always great. Now that they have a new, nicer, larger restaurant they have more than just improved. They have a very large menu, with some very different style rolls I've never seen before. The presentation of the food is beautiful and the fish was really fresh. Service is efficient and fantastic. Their tempura also had red pepper which I have never seen before, so that was a pleasant surprise. I usually go to Maki Maki, but its all the way on the south side so this place is the best sushi place close to North Edmonton. I will definitely be going back there very soon.
Went to Sumo Sumo for New Year's Eve supper with family. Food was fresh tasting, restaurant decor was nice. Bit expensive, but most places in Sherwood Park are. Would return.

My boyfriend and myself are breakfast people for sure, we typically go out once a week. We have been trying to find a consistently decent breakfast place since moving to Edmonton. This place certainly tops anything else we have found!

The servers are friendly and flexible on the menu, which is really nice! Both times I have asked, they have no problem giving me only cantaloupe and grapefruit instead of the assorted fruit that came with the meal.

The prices are fairly even for what all of the other breakfast places are charging, and the price we pay is well worth it. The portions are huge and the food is delicious. Normally I am not a fan of home fries and will ask to substitute them for something else, but at Tutti Frutti's they are incredible.

We have found our breakfast place in Edmonton, no complaints whatsoever about this place :)

Great pizza, gluten option was delicious. Gluten tastier than daughters regular dough if you ask me. Fast service with many options for toppings. Whatever your taste a pizza you can create! Staff courteous, friendly and efficient. Love, love that calorie count is blatant! Thank you for a great meal.

Let me start by saying, it's lunchtime on Friday, so I can imagine it's not always this busy, but it's busy today! That being said, the two servers are done an outstanding job making sure everyone feels at home. The ambiance is very upbeat Mexican style music and it smells amazing on here. We both had tacos, cochnita so good, so fresh! And she had chicken that looked amazing as well. We stayed of with with tostados that were so good, and the sauce was memorable... Yum. We'll be back!! Thank you.

Have been to many sushi restaurants in Edmonton; Sumo Sumo is the best in the area. Tons of choices and always fresh and tasty. Spider Maki is highly recommended!

Service is wonderful too; very efficient and friendly staff.

Cute restaurant in Sherwood Park from the Casa12Doce food truck people. The restaurant itself is cozy, with a big window you can look into the kitchen (the day we went, we could see everyone laughing and dancing at one point - it's a really nice addition to the atmosphere).

The servers were very friendly though a bit slow - we weren't in a hurry though, so we didn't mind too much. 

As for the food, we loved it. We tried the Flautas (3 tortillas stuffed with chicken, then deep fried and topped with sour cream, feta & salsa on a bed of lettuce) - they were good; very crispy and flavourful with a good amount of meat in them. They're not big though, so be aware of that - think 3 small cigar sized treats. Next, the Quesadillas Doradas (3 tortillas stuffed with potato & feta then deep fried, served on a bed of lettuce and topped with sour cream, feta and salsa) - we looooved these. Think Mexican perogies-ish. The mashed potatoes inside were soft and fluffy and the tortillas were crispy and hot. In hindsight, if we had realized this dish was also deep fried, we would have probably traded the Flautas for something else. Both good, but really similar aside from filling. Finally, we shared the Hugo Taco which was a platter with steak, peppers & onion served with 6 tortillas and a cup of salsa verde and a wedge of lime. The flavours were great - the lime added the perfect amount of vibrancy to the dish. We filled the shells and took the lettuce & salsa from the other dishes to add some crunch and freshness to each taco. 

The salsa verde was ok, but the really awesome thing was the "bonus" sauces the server brought out to us last - a house made peanut sauce that was so so good, and a garlic aioli-ish sauce that basically tasted like pure garlic, but when mixed with the salsa verde and into the tacos, added such a great taste. There is also a bottle of crazy hot hot sauce on the table that is also house-made and was delicious - it didn't just taste like fire, it tasted like flavourful fire! (Pro tip: add a couple of drops of the crazy hot sauce to the peanut sauce and then wish you could bottle it all up so you can add that stuff on everything.)

Definitely a good find - and somewhere we'll definitely be hitting up when we're in Sherwood Park.

I love this place.

The owners are so nice and friendly and unassuming. They make me feel welcome whenever I come in and even remember me! My husband and I come here often for dinner and we are always pleased. Although usually way too full!

tThe restaurant seems to be busiest at lunch time as we have never had a big wait at dinner. I am not sure if that is just because people tend to think of Chinese as a lunch kind of meal. We like this restaurant for dinner because it doesn't blare loud music (no, I am not THAT old, really!!) and we can talk and relax easily.

Now, for the food...

The onion cakes are excellent - always very hot and fresh, soft and fragrant and full of flavour. 

I am also a big fan of the ginger beef - spicy, crunchy and fresh tasting. 

The rice is authentically Chinese - not minute maid mush like some places!

Make sure you ask about their selection of tea - if you request it, they have an incredible blooming tea that tastes like caramel.

My husband and I often have dinner for under $50 and leave with enough leftovers for lunch the next day.

I order take out today .. I got the volcano roll, the spicy scallop cone and the dragon roll. I have to say the food was absolutely delicious!!! The service was great and fast. Absolutely ecstatic that I tried out this place. Definitely recommend it.

I love sumo sumo's food.  However I have had poor service on two accounts now.  

  The first was on my birthday where they did not serve one of my friends for the entire meal (until most of us had finished eating).  We were in a party of 6 so I assumed it was due to the chaos of having a larger group. 

However, I went to dinner with my boyfriend the other night and he ordered a bento box and I ordered an appetizer with 2 types of rolls as an entre.  

He received his appetizer and meal and was half finished his entre (45 minutes) when I received my calamari (appetizer).  I then ate all of my calamari and still waited another half an hour to be told "you're rolls are on their way"

We paid for the bill and sat there for 10 minutes waiting for my food to show up in a to go container (I did not want to sit there while my boyfriend waited for me to finish eating).  I saw three other tables around me be seated and served before I received my food to go.

The waitress then dropped it off with a "have a nice day".  She nearly walked away when I asked her "can you please explain to me why I have waited well over an hour for my food when others have come and gone within that time?

Her excuse was that my rolls weren't made until after the calamari was fired and the calamari took a long time because the kitchen was backed up.  This is a complete lie considering I saw other orders go in and come out before mine, not to mention the fact that calamari takes no time to fry.  If the kitchen was backed up all the orders would be backed up.  

Then on top of the lie the waitress had a dismissive attitude and not a single apology or compensation for the meal.  I was quite furious at this point and left with my food to eat at home and regrettably paid the 90$ bill....

I will order only from take out there from now on because they seem to be quite consistent at making that in 10 minutes or less.

Sumo Sumo is outstanding, I used to visit Mikado for my sushi fix, but then I would have to drive into the city, Sumo Sumo is very good food, great cuts of fish, and at a very reasonable price! Highly recommended!

I always stay away from these kinds of places after many disappointing visits to much burrito,  but my friend convinced me this place is way better. 

He was so right! 

They had veggie options (tofu not just vegetables) for by BF and they cooked me fresh to order shrimp! And SO MANY SHRIMP! it was the first time eating at a fast food type place where I didn't feel that they were counting every gram of product that went into my food. 

Everything was insanely fresh, their salsas even taste like they are made in house! 

I will definitely be coming back!
I love the organic section here and just the overall look to the new and approved Safeway. I think staff are nice and helpful.
been few times for sunday branch.very tasty and good service. the best sushi and sashime place in edmonton.

Stay away if you have a food allergy I have a gluten allergy and that they were unsure how to handle it took a very long time to get my mail my friends are already finish before mine arrived I will not go back ever

This is a conflicted review -  somethings were great and others were just OK.  And we both felt queasy the rest of the night.

We are big sushi fans and were looking forward to S-S.  It is located in a strip mall near the Park Costco.  First impressions were good -- lovely entrance and we were seated pretty quickly. The menu is large and has very good photography.  

We started with kebobs as they were the Wednesday special - 2 for $4 instead of $5.  The chicken were a little bland, but the beef were great with a very gingery sauce.  The tofu kara age (deep fried with fish flakes) were fine, sauce was bland.  

Had a full order of Joe's Special maki (salmon, mango, avocado and tempura shrimp) and half of the Thai beef.  The first was amazing and second on par with Alberta rolls at Tokyo Express.

Also tried eel rice bowl.  It was really good - veggies and fried rice were very tasty.  It was served with wonderful miso soup and the best house salad I've ever had a Japanese restaurant. The sesame dressing was terrific.

Waiter was very attentive, but the place was almost empty when we arrive.  She did the hard sell on their gifts cards which was a little annoying.

Great food but smaller portions. 
Very authentic and great service. 
I really like the restaurant and the people. 
Just hoping that they'll make portions a bit bigger.
Best sushi around. The Salmon is a favourite. Both sashimi and cooked in a rice bowl. Love the atmosphere.

I made reservations here for a group/birthday dinner and the staff were friendly and very good at accommodating our large table. The food was amazing and well worth it. They always have something good on tap and as someone who likes spice, the option to have different dishes in a variety of levels of spice is something that shouldn't be overlooked. Amazing!
Stopped in for lunch. Co worker and myself both got the pastor which was super delicious! Their in house hot sauce was unreal as well. Service was quick and very nice.

Food is delicious and fresh ! I would recommend this place if your in the mood for some yummy mexi food and in Sherwood Park . The only thing that put me off was when I ordered my lunch the server said to choose the meat topping . Only later see I've been charged and extra $5 . This pisses me off he clearly was trying to up our tab for a bigger tip and when I told  him about this he said "my bad" really dude not cool .

I held off writting a review on this place for a few visits just to make sure it wasn't too good to be true.  So far, the food, the atmosphere, the service - it's all fantastic.  And only located about 3 minutes from where I work - it's perfect.

Try the soup - as a major soup snob, I can honestly say that I have had some of the best soup EVER here!  The food is AMAZING, and the portions are HUGE!  In fact, I meet my grandma for lunch here often, and we share an entree every time and leave more than satisfied!

As long as you can get here around 11:30, you can always find a seat, but it does fill up qiuckly at peak times.

Luckily I like the food here so much that I won't even take a star away for the ridiculous parking lot they have desigend for this place.  The desinger was obviously not from around here - with the random meridians and curbs everywhere; I can only imagine that winter in this parking lot is going to be a nightmare!!!

Sumo sumo does not disappoint! This time we had take-out for Christmas Eve. We got a platter and a few California rolls. The sashimi did taste a little off but I'm going to caulk that up to us not eating it straight away. I never had a problem with the fish being fresh when eating in the restaurant. This is my go to sushi place as the prices are good and they have a yummy Sunday buffet!

Sumo Sumo was recommended by a friend (thanks Graeme). The food was great. dinner portions were huge!   Hubby, Shane, had the teriyaki salmon dinner and I had the seafood rice bowl.  The salmon dinner was huge even without the 3 included sides!  Way too much food for me, glad I just ordered the rice bowl, although Shane managed to eat almost everything except the tempura veggies. And ice cream came with the meal,which he also ate. I couldn't finish mine but all that was left was rice ;) We had the Saketinis drinks which were on special and were good.

The restaurant was very busy for Saturday dinner but we were able to sit at the bar and were seated right away.

I rated it only a 4 star because the restaurant was a little difficult to find.  And the parking was a joke, lots of meridians everywhere and it was hard to tell how to get into the restaurant.

We would go again, maybe when its not so busy and ask for recommendations on different sushi's to try.

Went to Tutti Frutti on Sunday March 3rd at 1 p.m. for lunch. We were promptly seated, then after waiting 15-20 minutes with no service, no coffee, no order placed we finally gave up and left. Will not be going back, horrible service.

My boyfriend and I decided we wanted Mexican that night. And yes, that usually means eating Taco Time from the mall food court for me but this time we wanted authentic Mexican food.. No offence Taco Time. Or Taco Bell for that matter. 

We arrived at about 7-730 I believe, and there was no one in the waiting area thankfully. It's definitely not a bad idea to make a reservation there but on this night we hadn't. We were greeted kindly and told the restaurant was currently full but two tables had paid a while ago and it shouldn't be long. We ended up waiting about 30ish minutes which I was 100% okay with. We didn't have a reservation and if people want to sit around and chat for 30 minutes after paying their bill, hey that's their prerogative. 

A table frees up and our hostess who was also our waitress, takes us to our table. She was an absolute delight by the way. She had an excellent knowledge of the menu. She has tried everything on it so she could answer every single one of our questions. I ended up choosing the special which was a Gordita. It didn't look exactly like the one I get from Taco Bell but lord did it ever look and taste waay better. It was really good. It came with chorizo sausage and chorizo is probably my favourite sausage. 

My boyfriend, after quite the period of indecisiveness between the Chile Relleno and the Huarache; he chooses the huarache with chorizo. Since I only received two measly bites, I can only really say it was delicious. 

This meal we didn't have any of the churros as I was so incredibly full, I did not want to accidentally injure the family sitting near us with the button on my pants that would have likely shot off had I eaten them. Do try them. They're excellent and the sauce you dip them in is the kind you scrape off the inside of the container with your finger in shame because you need to eat it all. It should never be wasted.
Usually shy to give a 5* rating, Sumo Sumo has a great atmosphere, great food and always good service.  Can't see any reason for not warranting the 5*! Keep it up guys!!!

I went there for a play and felt it was a nice theatre. They even have a bar at the entrance with wine, beers, water, nachos... it is a small place but it's very clean, and look up to date. You have a balcony on the second floor and on the side with small tables. My seat was comfortable and the decorations outside was awesome. There was emple parking place. I recommend this place.

Went here for the Sunday brunch buffet. There was a good selection of sushi on the menu. Possible flaw is that only the buffet menu is available until 3. Other than that, overall atmosphere and service was good. Will come back the next time I am in the area.

Hands down, the best deep tissue massage I have ever had! They really work out all the knots, and you feel utterly relaxed when you leave. I'd travel to Sherwood park just to get worked on at this hidden gem!

We have been loyal customers to whichever New Asian Village we live closest to at the time.  We've been ordering from the Sherwood Park location for the last three years and we love it.  I'm not a huge fan of the buffet simply because I love my Indian food atomic hot, but ordering off the menu, whether it's eating in or taking out, has never disappointed.  We place an order there for take out at least every two weeks, sometimes more, and the very few times they've made a mistake with our order they have shown their great customer service the next time we place an order by giving us something free.  I will continue to eat here as long as we live in Sherwood Park!

Sunday brunch buffet is $35 plus 15% tips automatically added to the bill. It starts between 10:30am and 3pm. This is a good way to not pay too much tax.
The food is good! I am surprised with the grade of sashimi. The server is nice. Nice decorating. Friendly owner.
The reason I rated 3 stars because:
1. No soy sauce dish on the table.
2. Wasabi and ginger did not come with the food. I had to ask for it twice. I had to pause to eat the sashimi because of this.
3. Ebi shrimp sashimi is like a worm; so tiny.
4. Ordered 12 shrimp tempura (6 per adult; 2 adults); only 6 was brought out.
I may come back once more to give this place another try. If the service did not get any better, I'd stop going.
One of the best Japanese foods in YEG! Nice environment and excellent service! Will go back again

I had a lot of expections coming to Sumo Sumo. My friend gushes about this place and I was curious about "all you can eat" sushi.

Located in Sherwood Park, I was glad that it was situated in a different community that wasn't too crowded such as downtown or south common where parking is atrocious.

Upon entering Sumo Sumo, I was a little taken back by the smells and décor. There was an overwhelming waft of stir fry that was in the air and there were lots of Asian inspired decorations such as tiny monks and buddhas frolicking in a Zen garden.

I may be too picky or even overly sensitive but I associate Japanese food with the philosophy of "less is more". When I see this explosion of "Asian" decorations, I can't help but feel it cheapens the experience making this establishment more of a chain than an authentic Japanese experience.

Seating was quite open with tables being very close to each other. Based on how well sound travels, it would have been better if there was some privacy as you will be hearing other people's conversations.

The staff was exceptionally prompt as she came quite often. We began with a salmon tataki and the main dishes were a volcano roll, a spider roll, a sumo roll, an udon to be split betwen two people, and a sushi pizza.

The salmon tataki was flavored quite well with the meat itself being very tender with a great pepper after taste and texture. The presentation, however, was a little disappointing as it was swimming in ponzu sauce. If you want a reference point, I would recommend going to Cactus Club (of al places, I know) and order a tuna tataki and compare the two visually.

The volcano maki was my favorite dish as the sauces they used as "lava" was interesting and new. Very savory that left an after taste but it was not too salty.

The spider maki was average. It had an odd texture in the middle which I wasn't sure was part of the experience since I don't regularly order spider maki. 

The sumo maki was quite large with the ratio of rice more so than the filling which was disappointing. A little bit of fine tuning with ratio and it would be "good/great" than "ok".

I didn't taste the udon, but our waitress was kind enough to split the meal into two bowls which was very thoughtful.

The sushi pizza was the philly sushi pizza. We ordered this out of curiosity and we would have to give full points to creativity and thought. The base was a deep fried rice patty with salmon sashimi and cream cheese on top.It wonderfully looked like a pizza but after having a few bites, it simply came off as a large fried rice chunk with some salmon overpowered by a heavy cheese spread.

The dessert was very good. We all shared ice cream nestled in an asian roll that was deep fried. The green tea ice cream was flavorful that didn't have any excess of macha.

Overall, I feel Sumo is on par with Mikaido. If you are looking for creative and large rolls, look no further. If you want something that embodies the spirit of Japanese culture and sushi, I would suggest looking somewhere else.

I agree with a couple of other posts, when it's busy the two gals cope very well.  My partner and I have been there a few times .....  two occasions there were between 4 to 6 total in the restaurant - the same servers were not attentive.  Don't expect water refills without asking and don't expect anyone to check-in after the food is served.  It's too bad, because the food is incredible and well presented.

I wish I could give this business less than one star. 

The tattoo company (Studio Eight) is run through the same business as the hair salon. They do decent tattoos, but when you call to book over 5 (FIVE!!!!!!) times with no return call, tells me they don't give a crap about their customers. I've been waiting for 3 months now and every time I call, they promise me I'll get a return call same day, and I am still waiting. Ridiculous. I'm taking my tattoo money to a far better studio where they actually give a sh*t about the people who keep them in business. What makes me even more angry is I now have a $100 gift card that is essentially wasted. 
I won't go there for hair business either. My sister was a frequent customer and she had the same issue as a few of the other reviewers. They burned her scalp so bad she's scared to have her hair colored now. They are rude and don't care about customers, which I find ironic because without the customers, they really don't have jobs. Time to make some changes over there I think. Find a different place to go. These guys are only in it for themselves. Super disappointed in this place.

Came here on a Saturday night with the family. Super busy on this evening which I'm told was unusual. It appears they had a few very large groups. We were told it would be 25 minute wait. It turned out to be over an hour wait. It would have been nice to get updated on the time so as not to wonder.

When we were finally seated it took a while for the waitress to come by. This was another sign indicating how the evening will be. She definitely was overworked. We ordered drinks and food right away.

We had the sashimi platter - so tasty melt in your mouth. We regretted that we didn't get the larger one. We also ordered a rainbow roll. I liked it but my wife thought the panko crumbs were weird. The kids shared a teriyaki chicken dinner set which also comes with soup and salad. Soup and salad were great and the dinner set was pretty good - could use more sauce though. For drinks we had green tea and a virgin colada.

Food 5 out of 5
Ambience 3 out of 5, pretty loud
Service 2 out of 5, couldn't keep up with demand

Next time I'd skip the line and get takeout.

Fun story time: friend of mine was contacted by an employee who kept trying to set up dates with him from an online dating site (later looked like it was to cheat on her boyfriend). Because said friend kept getting strung-along, he expressed his grievances on Facebook while tagging her employer, which turned out to be this place. Said cheating employee spun it into a tale of a creepy stalker who had his advances denied (WTF? I saw the messages), and then the owner of this place (I think) "Lana Anderson" sent him threats about her connections to people who he wouldn't want to meet in "dark alleys". Like, really, threats? I wouldn't want a person who sends threats online to be doing my tattoo. Scary.

Sara at the deli ROCKS! Each time she helps me, I feel as though we are family. If the deli is out of something they cook, Sara will stop everything & cook it. I love this Safeway, but Sara always puts forth the extra effort

While I've been to this location once for a play and it was an enjoyable experience. The roadway leading to the venue was a bit confusing because of some construction and it being a one way street. There is ample free parking beside the building. My one critique would be the lack of a proper layed out lineup while waiting to enter the theatre. There was two entrances and the lines intermingled and was difficult to find the end of each line. The lobby is spacious with a licensed concession and numerous tables set up for seating. The building has a number of various sized conference type rooms available for meetings or seminars. The theatre is a reasonable size with comfortable main seating and box style seating for groups of 2-6 along the sides. There is also a balcony with limited seating. There is seating available for special needs visitors. The stage is a very good size allowing for larger cast plays and musicals. They even have small concerts which due to the acoustics would probably sound amazing. The prices, based on what I saw, seem to be quite reasonable. This is a great place to see a variety of shows

We got suits here for a wedding. They took measures during the fitting but then when we came to pick up the suit only a small portion of the adjustments were made. For example, the pants were not cut and the shirt was not adjusted. They said that they would readjust and that the adjustment would be ready the same day but they didn't. 

We had to come for a second time, this time again the adjustments did not fit (the shirt was so tight I could not wear it). On top of everything, they held our suit for ransom to pay for the second adjustments (this was never mentioned before, otherwise we would have gone to somewhere else). 
 
Terrible service, greedy and low quality. 

Amit
Cut the Sunday Buffet Menu in half and lowered the limits for Sashimi, Price Remains the same at $84.00 for two. Forced Gratuity for Buffet makes absolutely no sense.
What a great little coffee shop that roast Their own beans. WOW.  They definitely know what they are doing.   My new favourite coffee place.

I've been going to Twisted since October 2014, and I really like it so far! I see Molly every time, so ask for her if you decide to try a cut in the land of Sherwood Park. And Molly gives free clean ups and bang trims between haircuts! A LIFESAVER!!! 

I haven't really liked a haircut ever until I came here... so it basically was a miracle from the hair gods that I finally found a stylist that can cut straight lines, layer, dye hair, colour correct and make normal conversation. To be honest, it seems to be hard for some stylists to do all those things at once. I've had so many bad bang trims and colors at salons in Edmonton- Mud, Avanti, Mousy Browns, Celebrity, Rain, Pink Lime... I honestly cannot fathom why people become stylists if they cannot cut a straight line. ???

I suggest you try it if you are looking for something edgy or fresh... or some cool colors!

Breakfast was good. They don't own a deep fryer. Everything is baked. The breakfast wasn't heavy and just enough to fill you up. 

The place is big and very accommodating. The noise level can get a bit loud with a huge group of people but it's well laid out. 

Family friendly and could be a competitor of Cora.

Exceptionally well done! The food was amazing quality and the atmosphere was warm and inviting, everything about this visit just moved perfectly. The dishes were full of flavor and the deserts were excellent. Only suggestion would be a bit more attention from the staff to when to clear plates, but was satisfied anyway.

This is honestly the best sushi place I have been to since I moved to Alberta and I've tried a lot. 

Highly the joe special rolls  

Only reason for a 4 star and not a 5 is because it can be bit pricey but if you don't mind spending 15 dollars for a really good roll then I suggest you try it.

They make their own hot sauces.  All top notch.

I had the Pescado, a breaded and battered haddock taco, the jalapeno garlic hot sauce was a fantastic accompaniment.  I could eat these for every meal.

Then the Arrachera Steak.  Nice flavour and cook perfectly.  

My wife had the Tortilla Soup - was not hot(temp.) enough.

Then Enchiladas De Pollo - tasted great, but didn't like the texture of the ground chicken.

No strawberry margaritas available.  Just lime and grapefruit.  Really weird.

Overall, a do over, which will do soon.

A late lunch on a Monday... A hot day on a sunny patio where the flies moved as slow as the servers.

The best part about the lunch was probably the price. Usually lunch bento boxes in the capital region run in the $20 range which is highway robbery compared to Vancouver prices but alas this is where I've chosen to live. These bento's were only $15. They came with the standard miso soup and salad. You choose your main dish out of a few options: Seafood, Meat Lovers, Sumo Combo, etc... You also got the choice of sushi or tempura on the side. For this price it sounds like great value.

In reality the main dishes were basically sukiyaki style veggies with your requested meat on a heaping pile of rice. The miso was watery, the salad was fresh but under dressed, the sushi were 2 massive slices of a roll filled with imitation crab and 1 piece of salmon, and the tempura was badly battered and seriously lacking crispiness. 

The worst part was that in one of the deep fried pieces of meat on the meat lovers dish I found a hair fried in with the batter once I broke the piece apart. Unfortunately this was the last piece of pork and I realized I may have eaten more of these unwelcome visitors. 

My advice... don't eat sushi in Sherwood Park, especially at Sumo Sushi.

Sherwood Park is a little starved for some great restaurants. Sumo Sumo is a great option but they have room for improvements. Sushi is great and fresh, however the hot food items are sub-par at best and extremely overpriced. My favorite non-sushi item is the crab salad, however it's still quite expensive for what I suspect is definitely artificial crab. 

I usually order take-out as I work in the area and like to eat on the go. They have a separate area for take-out, which is nice, but it's quite loud and I always find it hard to hear the staff! I've eaten in the restaurant a few times and while the atmosphere is lovely, the staff seem to be extremely unsure of the food they're serving and in need of some training. On one occasion that I visited, there was a noticeable delay in the delivery of our food and it was hard to get our water glasses filled regularly, even though the restaurant was nearly empty.

For Sherwood Park standards, Sumo Sumo provides better food than some and worse service than others, which still makes them a viable option, but I'm in no hurry to go back. I live in Edmonton and feel that the city has dozens of Japanese restaurants that can provide a better experience for a better price. If you're going for just sushi in the park, it isn't so bad, but no promises.

the springrolls here are amazing!
they are a must get, even if they are expensive! 
the sauce goes perfectly with the taste of them and the service is pretty good as well! 
the take-out section was speedy for us

I love this sushi restaurant, however the Sunday brunch is unbelievably amazing!  There really isn't anything similar to what Sumo Sumo offers in the city and it's a bit of a tasting menu of both their regular sushi/sashimi offerings and traditional and fusion Japanese food.  One suggestion... take small samples of everything!  It's worth not getting full on maki the first go around!

I drove by the salon a few times and thought it looked absolutely adorable. Being new to the area I had to take a chance with somebody with my hair. I ended up making an appointment with Taneil, and I am nothing short of completely ecstatic with what she has done. It was a big job and she took a big chunk out of her day specifically to make sure it was done right. I will for sure be a client of hers from now on. Thanks a bunch!!!

Viva la Burrito! The closest thing to the burritos I fell in love with in San Francisco. These are burrito's the size of a baby's arm. Delicious.

You can choose all sorts of different options, although I always go plain old Beef burrito with the standard stuff.

They have 4 different types of salsa you can choose from, as well you can buy beer in bottles!

I had no problems with the service, and found it was exemplary!

Why did it get 4 stars?
Beer available at a fast food place
Lots of food for the money
Great service
Lots of free parking around.
No wait

What does it need to get 5 stars?
Make a better combo option. Seriously there combo is a handful of tortilla chips and a lemonade-type drink. Who thought that would be a good idea?
Love! Big meals worth your money.  Great looking establishment. Would recommend the dinner deals on Tuesdays.

I have no qualms with the chocolate, they are divine. I was displeased with the customer service over sampling chocolate. I made two purchases in one day. When i went to sample a second choice of chocolate that I presume is for customers, the employee questioned whether or not I had already had "one" then gave a disdainful look to the other employee, when I sampled the next one. Seriously?? and at Christmas time too, that experience soured my day, and I will not be returning to that location. 
I've supported their business from the get go, and I found that attitude to be "scrooge like".

The best steakhouse in Sherwood Park! The food was absolutely delicious, and the customer service was beyond my expectations. Definitely try the steak bites, they are unreal. Also check out both the dining room and the lounge as they offer different ambiences for your night. Happy hour in the lounge is my absolute fav time to visit!
Used to be good, but has gone downhill, in terms of food and decore.

A pretty decent Walmart by Walmart standards. The store has never been super busy when I go and there are almost enough cashiers working! (A real shocker, I know.) 

It's a decent sized store, which means it's got a better selection than the smaller chains. Which means more clearance deals! Woo hoo! 

The store has been a bit messy when I've gone in, but I honestly have very low standards when it comes to the good 'ol Mart. It is a super center so there's a grocery section. If you're too lazy to buy food for dinner while grocery shopping, there's a McDonald's in store!

Best Sushi Bar Ever. At least in my opinion. The food is always fresh and delicious. The wait time is so fast! And the staff are usually pretty nice and polite. The prices are awesome and I think a really good deal. If you go you have got to try the spicy tuna tempura maki, it's to die for.

This salon is very nice and all the staff there seemed very friendly, and welcoming.  They do sell the complete line of Davines hair products which is great.

My review is more for my stylist.  I have followed Adrianna (she prefers Anna, but the salon uses her full name) to several salons and now that she is here I just wanted to give her kudos for another awesome color. You always make me look like a million bucks.

If you live in Sherwood Park, or Edmonton, I would highly recommend you call Cherish, book an appointment and have yourself a wonderful hair experience.

I live right down the road from this place but for some reason I never checked it out until now. 
I walked my dog over since it's dog friendly! (You can get the most adorable little cone with a small scoop of vanilla and a dog bone on top... it disappeared before I was able to take a picture)
The girls working were super friendly, so don't believe the reviews that say the service is bad. 
The ice cream is your typical foothills creamery stuff you grew up with. Granted prices have increased greatly from your childhood. It's not exactly cheap but it's a fun special treat. 
I would definitely return here.

When this place opened I finally found a Chinese place in the park that was as good a Szechuan Stir fry in Richie (Edmonton). I have never eaten in but have taken out dozens of times. Sometimes it's not ready when they say it will be but it's always worth the wait. They have never disappointed me.

Wow!!  It's like walking into Mexico !  All the food I tied was amazing .  However, the fish taco was by far the best taco I have ever eaten!  My niece had the potato and feta Quesadillas .  I tried the Al Pastor and the fish tacos.  We will be back for sure !

Went here for dinner on a Friday evening. Modern-ish, well-decorated space with good lighting. Did feel a bit cramped and honestly - you can't fit that many people into the restaurant. Probably best to make reservations. The space that is there is maximized, though. 

Lots of gluten-free options on the menu - although the kitchen isn't gluten free certified. I got the Enchiladas De Pollo and it was fantastic. Also had a margarita which was pretty good - but abundant on ice. Overall - pricing seems to be on the mid to higher end for comparable food in-and-around Edmonton. That given - the portions seem to be reflective of the pricing.

Really nice venue. Great seating and reasonably priced shows because of the fact that you avoid all Ticketmaster fees here. I am fairly sure Ticketmaster is the spawn of Satan. I love booking the tickets here because you actually can speak to a person who can help you choose your seats when you phone. They have a variety of seating for the shows, including cabaret which is a little more but you have a table space. They have wine and beer and snacks that you can bring into the show. Although, you guys loose a star because your wine selection is terrible and for the price you charge you could afford to bring in decent wine.  And they have a great variety of shows to choose from, musicals, Celtic, rock, country, and classical. I will definitely look into this place more to try out music. Not only are you supporting local venue, but you can try out different music for a reasonable price. Just make sure you have a drink at home or at a local bar beforehand.

The Mrs. and I have been coming to Festival Place for nearly a decade now.

Free parking and concessions including beer/wine that you can take into the venue.  What more could a guy ask for?

The sound here is surprisingly good and it's a quick drive now that the Henday is completed.

The venue itself is intimate holding roughly 500 people without a bad seat in the house.

Anytime the Mrs. wants to see a performer here, I know we will in for a great show.

Ill be honest, I was hesitant coming here, there are so many mixed reviews and I wasn't sure what to expect. I arrived just before lunch rush hour and was seated kinda slow considering it wasn't busy (but that's me being picky). I did notice that there was only one server right before rush hour and it kinda had me shook for a second because rush hour was about to start and the second server just left. On to the actual review, the food was very heavy and filling. The pictures on the menu don't do it justice how much you get, that being said for a crêpe and eggs benny  the total came out to just under $40. Yes you got a lot of food but damn... My server was amazing and really nice it's too bad she didn't have help. Honestly I'm not sure I'll be back, strictly because of the price. But overall wasn't completely terrible.

I love this place!, my go to Indian restaurant ever!. The buffet is around 28$ (not including tax for one person). The staff are super nice making sure your drinks are filled and your table is full of baskets of naan bread!. The buffet is absolutely amazing with a selection of different Indian cuisines, I've been there around three times and they have a constant changing menu. The buffet also includes a salad bar, soup bar, and a dessert bar with traditional Indian deserts! My favourite part of the buffet is the ice cream machine! But the last time I went it was out of order ;(. OVERALL AMAZING! Totally recommend!

WHOA. This place, man...you've got to go. The first time we had takeout and were blown away. The second time we took our family of four plus my wife's sister. We made it clear we only had about 50 minutes to eat...no problem. Got in just before a huge rush. First, chips, salsa, guacamole to start. Those chips seemed hot and fresh from the fryer and were amazing as were the fresh salsa and guacamole. Mains: Cuban sandwich special for me...massive, messy, and easily THE GREATEST SANDWICH in the HISTORY of sandwiches. 2 flautas, fish tacos, and a cheese quesadilla for our 9 year old were also around the table and everyone loved their food. Got out on time, bellies full, not even sure what I paid...didn't care. This place has a very bright future. As word of mouth spreads you will need to reserve well in advance. A welcome addition to the sea of chain restaurants dotting the landscape here in the burbs. I really enjoyed the staff as well. With a packed restaurant you could tell they were really enjoying themselves.

Simply put, I love this shack! I always make a point of visiting it during the summer often to grab some of their awesome ice cream. The service is great, and I like that you can grab a punch card so you can grab a free one on occasion as well! It feels like a tradition to visit this place when it's open, and I encourage you to visit and take part yourself :)
Absolutely amazing! Best Sushi I've ever had, excellent service and friendly staff! So good my friend and I ended up ordering twice because we wanted more! Will definitely be returning!

My daughter has been coming here quite regularly. They are awesome at their work here!  My daughter doesn't want to go anywhere else as she gets undercuts and they do an excellent job!  All of the stylists and receptionist are very welcoming. It's great that on a Saturday morning they're open by 9 am!

Great loving people who care for so many unwanted or I'll birds. They are truly amazing for what they do. I adopted my bird from here and he is an excellent little bird. If I ever need help with my bird they're always readily available!  I highly recommend their adoption  program for anyone wanting a little feathered friend!

It's finally here! After a long-awaited night-out this location is finally open and you ready for business! We were really excited to try the happy hour menu off which we ordered chops famous steak bites and vegetable tempura. Both were delicious! Especially the steak bites with the creamy horseradish sauce, they are so tender and for 6 bucks on a happy hour menu how can you go wrong! They also had a lot of drink specials which were eloquently prepared! I was also watching what other people were ordering and their food looked awesome too! I can't wait to try out the dining room for the full dinner experience. The lounge is beautifully decorated, open with a high-end casual feel. The service was awesome and we always had someone checking on us to keep our drinks full which was great. Can't wait to go back and try more things on the menu. Welcome to Sherwood Park Chop!

I'm not sure if this place has undergone a change in management or employees, but my experiences here are far different than the others. 

I honestly don't think I've ever been in a more friendly SafeWay! I come here at least twice a week and have never been any less than impressed. 

The store is clean and stocked, carts and baskets are easy to find... If you can't find something staff are there to not just point but take you to where the item is. 

Not only are the staff helpful, friendly and genuine but they're also happy! Making small talk and commenting on the savings I've made are just some of the small things that keep me coming back.

So this review is a bit late but thought I should still write it as my Dad (who only ever really enjoys eating steak and potatoes or sometimes a pizza) thought this was a good enough restaurant to return to. So what made it that great that my dad would give it such a high review? 

First, if you've never seen an advertisement for this place, prepare yourself for ongoing talking and some well rehearsed comedy from the chefs. There literally is a live cooking show being done with your meals right in front of you. This combination of humour and meal prep was a big hit for my family (the 5 of us were constantly commenting on how things were being cooked, what was new to us and encouraging the ongoing trials of the fork toss plus the salt and pepper tossing trick by the chef). 

Second, it might be a Japanese place but they have steak! You may have guessed with my intro but that was an important decision factor in choosing a restaurant. We wanted a different place for the early Christmas family gathering but something everyone could enjoy. 

Third, they're very diligent about respecting allergies. My sister-in-law gets very ill with her allergies. So it's nice not having to worry. They set her food specifically on one area of the grill and no other food was ever placed there. Hers was never combined with the rest of ours either. They also had a different soup for her to enjoy and did a vinaigrette on her salad instead of the house dressing.

The food itself is a decent price for a fine dining experience and what you get with the dinner. There's soup, salad, grilled shrimp, grilled veggies and whatever you choose as your main. All with great flavour and you get two different dipping sauces - one being better for meat and other with vegetables. Obviously if you select the options of more seafood to accompany the main piece of the meal, the price is more expensive. We all kept it pretty simple. Two with shrimp dinners, two with New York steaks and one with teriyaki beef. We were all quite happy with our portions and if you feel you need extra rice, they will bring more out. If you have saved a bit of room, there's lots of dessert options too but that comes with an additional price. I really was quite happy with that large selection of mocktails to try but for those that want it, there's a large selection of mixed alcoholic drinks, wine, beer, etc. 

The place is accessible from the outside doors to the grill tables and even though my brother struggles to see in dim lighting, there's enough random lighting that we found a well lit spot at the table for him. I liked that I didn't have to watch for random levels or steps. There are a few booths throughout the restaurant for those that maybe want a more secluded meal but there's no grills for those spots.  

So after such a glowing review, why am I only giving it 4 stars? Well as I had booked ahead of time and specifically gave a number of 5 people for the reservation, it would have been nice to know we would not have anything started to be cooked, nor our meal order taken until they fill the rest of the table around the grill. If I had that information, I could have easily invited a couple of friends to join. However as this came to us as surprise, it meant even though we didn't know who was joining us, we were forced to awkwardly wait over 15 min to have them arrive and then start giving our order when they were ready. At least some of the drinks had made it out by then but the place was starting to fill up so the noise level was increasing. Luckily for us my mom randomly know the couple that was sat at our grill table but there were parts of the dinner you could tell they would have enjoyed having their own time as a couple (as I'm quite sure they weren't informed they'd be part of a bigger table being that they were surprised that my mom thanked them for arriving on time so we can now order when they are ready).

It would have also been a different experience for my family too without the combined table situation. I had to remind the chef who's steak was being prepared due to the over eager guy wanting a well done steak the same time as a medium rare... Things eventually got served to everyone but only because I spoke up, I was able to get near to what I had requested (glad that my dad at least got his medium rare) even though everyone had reconfirmed orders when the chef was placing the meat on the grill.

Lastly, the noise in the restaurant was so high at the end of our meal that not only did my dad stop trying to have a conversation but so did the rest of us. So instead of savouring dessert, I ate it quickly as all I wanted was to pay the bill fast and just leave the noise. I've gone once before on a week night back in April  and it was more manageable for noise level. This being due to not all grills were full nor was the restaurant as full.

Fantastic Mexican cuisine with friendly service!

The hype is real - food is authentic and tasty. This place was busy during lunch on a Thursday when we came. We ended up waiting about 20 minutes for a table but it was worth the wait.

What we tried:
Tortilla Soup: their version of the soup has a very distinct flavor - it wasn't my favourite but my husband seemed to enjoy it, especially with the added pico de gallo.
Totopos (Chips & Salsa/Guac): Deliciously fresh and perfectly salted with a generous portion or pico de gallo and fresh guacamole!
Tacos Al Pastor: Always a safe bet and these guys make theirs well. The pineapple gives the tacos a hint of sweetness
Shrimp Tacos (Daily special): Super messy and hard to eat - the shrimp kept on falling out. I found the price point a bit too high for just two tacos. If there were three I think it would add more value for money. Not sure I would order these again simply because of that.

Service was great, waters refilled and plates removed readily. I love it when the chef (and owner?) decide to come out and visit with patrons as well. Nice touch! 

We will definitely be back.

Great venue for more intimate productions. The seating is good and comfortable. And although for the events I have participated in I have only sat on the main floor, it looks like there isn't a bad spot in the venue. Seats are comfortable and well spaced out. I also like that there is free parking...a huge win after paying for parking at the Jube or at the Citadel. They have a diverse selection of events and a really good excuse to try things that you may not be so sure about. Nice and reasonable bar and snack selection

Bagels are good, but selection is awful. Go in to get a dozen bagels and can't get more than 1 or 2 of the flavors I wanted. Cream cheese is not very good and doesn't carry regular plain cream cheese, only light plain.

We had heard great things about this little Mexican restaurant hidden away in a Sherwood Park strip mall. I can vouch for those good reviews. La Patrona is amazing. The Chiles Rellano (sp?) is as good (maybe better) than what we've enjoyed in Mexico many times. It's a large, stuffed poblano chili that's baked and served with rice, frijole (beans) and some fantastic guacamole. The portions are generous and at $22, it's a pretty good deal. We had the nachos to start...also delicious. 
My only beef: the margaritas were a little sweet...too much mix, I think...not quite enough tequila! Overall, very authentic and very good. We will go back.
Not sure how I hadn't found this place sooner, probably some of the best coffee I've had, and I've drank a lot of coffee all over the world.... I will be a regular.

I have to warn you. Once you taste fine chocolate like Jacek's, you will never taste chocolate the same again. 

The owner, Jacqueline Jacek, began making chocolates in her basement and selling them at local farmers markets and coffee shops. She still sells them there, but she has opened up a small retail store front with a kitchen in the back. 

Her business is designed around fashion and she releases chocolate "lines" three times a year. Don't expect basic caramel or cherry chocolates here! You will be able to sample exquisite mixtures like violet vanilla, salted melon caramel, pineapple saffron and strawberry balsamic.

Just a warning though, if you want to get something for Christmas or a special event, make sure you call them ahead of time. Apparently it takes a week to make up a batch of chocolates and they only last 3 weeks because they don't use preservatives. That means they sometimes run out around Christmas, Mothers Day, Valentines  and other big chocolate days.

If i have to sum up my experience of this place, i will have only one word: WOW. This place has been on my list since long time so finally, i decided to check this off from my list on Friday by planning a dinner date with my husband. 

Suggestion: Please always reserve your table before by calling them because you might not get the table without reservation here.

Order:

Hugo Tacos: How can you miss tacos when you visit a mexican restaurant and i believe they are the heart of mexican food. We had Hugo Tacos and were really satisfied with the portion and your stomach doesn't  feel really heavy as it will feel after having cubana.  

Cubana: Tried one of their most ordered dish from Tortas and something different. I loved the combined flavour of garlic sausage, ham, avocado, refined beans and mozzarella served in a freshly baked bread paired with delicious pickles. It was quite of a heavy meal well. 

Churros: There is no chance to miss a dessert (especially when it is churros)  after a hearty and delicious meal. We ordered for 2 churros served with finger licking chocolate cream or sauce garnished with mint leaves and believe me, they were extremely luscious. 
 
Rating:
Ambience: 4/5
Taste: 4.5/5
Portion size: 4.5/5
Service:4/5
Value for money: 4/5

I visited the Sherwood park Core Wellness and Chiropractic office to see naturopathic doctor Baljit Khamba. I made the appointment on recommendation of a friend who is also a patient of hers. I booked an appointment for my son just because he has a bit of a weaker immune system.

The office is spacious  and clean, with a large seating area with comfy chairs and an awesome plush carpet. My son couldn't resist taking a role across it plush carpet. They offer several services including  chiropractic services message, acupuncture and physiotherapy. 

Despite the appointment being delayed a half hour I left her office feeling satisfied with the visit. Dr. Khamba really took the time to listen and asked the questions that needed to be asked. What she recommended were some simple vitamins and  probiotics. She also recommended a food sensitivity test called IgG. Which I will let you all know is not covered by my health insurance plan and is a wee bit pricey. (Although well worth it from what I can tell from my research) Above all I really got the sense that she cares about her clients and has a passion  for what she does.

If you're considering becoming more proactive about your health I would definitely recommend a visit with Dr. Khamba. Her approach is mainly diet based. No voodoo snake oil stuff here.

 My friend who has a gazillion allergies and suffers from eczema and frequent illnesses has seen huge improvements in her health since seeing Dr. Khamba. And what's crazy folks even her eye sight has improved. I'm talking needing a new prescription for her glasses better. I hope my son will have a similar experience.
This is the best Mexican cuisine in town, great menu choices and serving size. You won't be disappointed.

2 scoops is like 3 scoops:) lots of flavours definitely will come back and try a different one. Price was good for what u get and great service. Area was well kept and wet wipes were available on each table plus a washing station.

I live in Edmonton but drive to Sherwood Park to go to Cherish. I love the personal service, the friendliness as well as professionalism.  I have always been happy with my haircuts. Also they do not just rely on the training they recieved to get their licences, Crystal the owner continues to take courses and train....and does not charge more for having done so. As long as I can I will continue to go to Cherish. They make me feel like a cherished customer.
Dr. Headington is incredible.  Was 6 years in Vancouver moving from Chiro to Chiro as nobody had the talent that Dr H. does.

I would love to give this place a 5 but service needs a little work. The food was really good. We went for their brunch buffet. It's definitely a well rounded buffet. If you like Japanese food but don't like raw fish there are plenty to choose from. I was impressed with the selections. They had octopus salad, crab salad, seaweed salad. For the Makis there were a combination with raw fish and non-raw. Tempura they provided broccoli, salmon and yam. Some hot items - seafood yakisoba, yakitori, takoyaki, and a few more items. For service it needs a bit of work. We had 7 adults and one baby. We wanted baby at the head of the table so both parents can help feed but servers don't like people sitting head of the table --- fixable for us, not the worst. When you're spending $35/person I expect the server to clear the table not expecting us to put it on their trays for them. If you have guaranteed tips I expect the servers to be happy to be there. You're in the service industry if you can't smile to your customer I suggest a different profession. If you're serving sashimi I expect you to be able to tell table which is which.

Overall great food. Service needs work. The likelihood of recommending 25%. The likelihood of returning 10%.
Excellent place to eat. Very friendly staff and very delicious food. I highly recommend this place and I also have a feeling this restaurant will do very will.

i asked for ombré gel nails and i usually get shellac because i hate having long nails and for my job i can't have long nails either. she told me i could only go a certain length short after she put the fake nails on, she said they were really short even tho the overhang on my nails was a lot. after she finished i hated them, they were so thick and shaped so awfully. i came back the next day to get them filed down more hoping they could make them less thick, and they seemed really pissed off and annoyed even tho i was the only customer in the store. after they were filed they still looked awful and they were unable to file off any from the top because they said the "ombré nails are thicker because there's 2 colors" or some made up bullshit i'm so unhappy with my nails after paying 65$ and i'm going somewhere else to get them taken off and put shellac back on!!! don't go here ! just look at the photos of how awful my nails look :((
Amazing food & great atmosphere! My favorite is the rainbow roll but have taste a good majority and loved it all! The unagi is also something that is a must have.

We'd been to La Patrona a few times before. The service and food has gone down hill since we'd been there about a year ago. When making reservations, we were told to keep the visit to approximately 1-1/2 hours but because of the service we were there longer than they had requested.

Once seated, it took quite some time to get water and to get our orders taken. We'd ordered chips to start which were brought to us about 35-40 minutes later.  We were going to order a drink but because of the lengthy time for our orders to be taken and for the chips to come, we decided to stick with water. When the waiter came around to refill the glasses, all 4 were never filled even though they were all empty. First time, he filled 3 out of the 4, second time was 2 out of 4.... When clearing the appetizer plates, one plate was taken even though the chips were gone and all plates empty. We weren't asked if we needed anything or how the food was. The salsa was not as zippy and the food was more bland than it used to be. Not sure if there's been a change in ownership but definitely not what it once was.

My friend and I drove from West Edm to Sherwood Park (yesterday) Tuesday which happens to be Bento Box night for $19.75.  Each bento box comes with three sides.  We both chose Gyoza and tempura.  I chose sushi as my third option and he opted with spring rolls.  We also ordered a Joe Special roll to start.

Five minutes later, an employee came by and delivered a plate of 3 spring rolls.  We looked at it and thought, "Huh".  We asked her if that was part of the Bento Box to which she replied "Yes, I think so."  

We started eating it when our server came by and asked us if we ordered spring rolls.  We said no, we were advised by the other employee that it was part of the bento box we ordered.  She looked a little stressed and said it was an error and was for another table.  We asked her if she wanted to take it back.  She said, "No, that's okay." and walked away.  She came back two minutes and said that if we continued eating the spring rolls she would have to charge us for it. ?????  Really??
