An error made by another employee confirming that it was part of our order and your management wants us to pay for it?  By this time there is only one spring roll left.  My friend told her to take it away.  Now, we're both a little irked.

Then the sides started coming.  We confirmed with EVERY small side dish that it was part of our bento box meal.  Then his side spring rolls were placed down.  They threw away the other spring roll just so that they could deep fry TWO fresh spring rolls to accompany his bento box.  How utterly ridiculous.

My friend voiced his frustration with the chain of events and the server tried to explain that it was a misunderstanding and that sometimes customers order spring roll appetizers even when they order it as a bento box side.  WHO CARES????!!!  We didn't!!  And we even asked for confirmation that it was part of our meal when placed at our table.  

To make us feel guilty about eating it when it was their error, then try and charge us, and now turning it back to our fault was the last straw.  My appetite was ruined and I was done.  I told the server to pack our food, get the bill so that I could pay and get the hell out of there.

While she was in the back packing up our food, the hostess came by to clean up the rest of the table and voiced how sorry she was that we were unhappy and could she offer us free dessert.  "NO.  I don't WANT ANYTHING MORE from this place.  I want the food we ordered and I want to leave."

Seriously???  You tried to charge us for spring rolls we didn't order and you want to pacify me with free dessert??  Get real.  It's not about money.

I want to clarify that I paid for the food.  $61 and left $10 gratuity.  Management most likely forced the server to advise us of the charge for spring rolls if we continued to eat it and it is not her fault.  I am giving her the benefit of the doubt.  (I've been in the service industry; I personally would have taken the hit and paid it myself instead of aggravating my customers because it clearly was not the burden of the customer for internal errors.)

As much as I like the rolls at this place, I will NEVER come back here EVER.  EVER.  I refuse to spend any more of my hard earned money for lack of appreciation of my patronage. Food was good.  Customer service and appreciation sucks rocks.

A group of us decided to meet up for a lunch meeting and came here.  This is my third time here. I love the ambiance in this restaurant it's causal and relaxing yet upscale in a way.  The servers were all very pleasant we got our tea and waters right away and placed our orders.  The reason I like this place is because your food comes out looking beautiful.  Definitely a Food Porn restaurant.  And beautiful food tastes better.  I had the ginger beef yakisoba and I found my dish very plain and needed to add a lot of hot sauce.  But I wanted to try something new.  The shrimp on it was delicious and it was all cooked really well just bland.  The other dishes my friends had were phenomenal.  The vegetarian pizza (yes at a sushi place) looks amazing it's a work of art and she says it's the best.  I will continue to try different things in their menu as I know the flavours are there just today mine wasn't.

I've been here about 5 times and all 5 times I've had the same person serving me. An asian  lady with glasses. She is not pleasant and always tries to anticipate/manipulate what you should order. Instead of asking "What size would you like?" She instead asks "Do you want a large size?". Then, when preparing the burrito, she'll already have her hand ready to scoop the item she thinks you're going to get. I feel so rushed and unprepared (plus she doesn't explain all the options) that it's like you have to decide that right that second. This past time I went, she asked me if I wanted cheese, and before I could even answer, she had already scooped a spoonful onto my burrito. Turns out i did NOT want cheese, so she's feebly trying to pick out the tiny crumbs of cheese from my burrito (which is impossible), so she asks me if a little bit of cheese is ok. At this point I'm annoyed. I don't have time for her to recreate a new one  for me since I'm on a short lunch break. I say yes and she proceeds to cover up the cheese with more salsa and corn. What the heck? In any case, she needs to stop rushing people and herself and let people calmly make a decision about their topping without her pressurre tactics.

This place had pretty good Google reviews so I decided to check it out since my usual barber is kinda far away. I was very descript with what I wanted for my haircut and the end result was nothing like it. This seems to be common at salons vs. barbershops, but the end result here was disappointing regardless of what I asked for. There was also way too much swearing from the stylist..a big no-no. I realize society is getting pretty sleazy, but let's try and keep it professional when you're taking someone's money. Definitely not going back. I won't give it a 1 star since, at the least, the appointment was on time and prices are competitive with other salons.

I am currently growing out my pixie cut and when I told Jackie what I was aiming for she knew exactly how to cut my hair to help it grow out to the cut I eventually want. She was super friendly and very knowledgeable. I will recommend her to everyone that I know. Thanks again Jackie I love my hair :-)

They've killed their original page due to bad reviews and listed a new one.
This place isn't the greatest. They never return calls and majority of the staff is rude with a high and mighty attitude. 
The tattoo chick picks and chooses who she'll work on so kiss some serious booty to get an appointment....or save time and go to a salon with employees that enjoy their customers.

I used to come here for their Sunday brunch buffet (since 2017). Though they had a limit on sashimi, it was restaurant quality (unlike most AYCE Japanese places). Their other selections (other dishes and desserts) were also quite good. However, I stopped coming here for their buffet as they have increased their prices to pretty much the same as a dinner buffet. I've also been here for regular lunches. The overall experience have been decent (atmosphere, quantity, and price) but not impressive (service, food quality).
Best place to ever sushi and oysters in edmonton! Absoltely love sumo sumo. They have amazing bubble tea and service.

Took the 25 odd km drive from home to this place, only because there would be better parking compared to the one near the UofA campus. First timer to Burrito Libre. Craving for the tex-mex food, having tasted Baja Fresh, Chipotle on the south side of the border. Being a vegetarian - limited with single choice. Tried the burrito and Quessidila (sic). It was flavorful with the southwestern sauce. Would have prefered more healthier choices other than Gaucamolle. Not bad and definitely an option. But not in the same league as Baja fresh or the Chipotle.

We had a great evening here. We had made a reservation for a birthday celebration, upon entry the host had even wished my significant other a happy birthday which was nice. 
We were told about the 'chop experience' and had a very nice waitress. Made sure we had everything we needed. Unfortunately my steak came out wrong (undercooked). The manager happened to be walking by at that moment and I had asked if he could get our waitress for me, and he had said he was the manager and asked if he could help me with anything. I had advised that my steak came out not the way I had asked for it. He was very apologetic, and made the situation right. I was brought a salad to munch on while I waited for my steak. My date was pretty much done eating by the time I got my food. Once they finally brought that out, it was cooked properly, and it was delicious. 
Then they were even kind enough to cover the dessert for the birthday due to the mix up so we got the molten chocolate cake. Delicious! Thankfully they have gluten friendly options available as well. 
Overall they did make the night much better and we had a great time and we will be back. They even had all staff sign a birthday card. How sweet is that! Amazing customer service at this location. 
Thank you guys for making it a great evening, we had a a wonderful time.

Ordered from Skip the Dish for pick up. No unit # or phone # under the restaurant. Listed as Flavor which doesn't exist anywhere. Spent 25 mins driving around the parking lot until Skip provided the unit number. I've had bad food from Sumo Sumo before so had I knownn I would not have ordered from them.

Love it! Laara was super inviting, and I really liked the pods. I've heard Joe Rogan talk a lot about floating and was super excited to try it.

There's nothing like a good float to clear your mind!

Waaaaaaay to expensive for what you get. I've ordered from them twice. Both times ordered some of their specialty rolls for ridiculous money and twice I couldn't even eat them they were so large ended up having to cut them in half and eat with a spoon. Not how I like to enjoy my sushi. Would go to Tokyo Express for 1/4 the price over this place anytime

Great food and usually great staff. I take my kids there once a month and they are almost always friendly and accommodating to me and my kids. We had one instance where our waitress was rude and we saw very little of her, but that was a unusual occurrence.

Definitely need to make a reservation or you won't get in to this excellent Mexican restaurant!Atmosphere is wonderful filled with Mexican decor and music. The cozy room is open to the kitchen & you  can see the cooks preparing all the food. We've been there multiple times & everything we've had has tasted great! Good sized  portions for the dollar value and friendly staff. The owners also operate a successful food truck business, which is where I believe they started. La Patrons is definitely on our list of places to take our out of town guests!

Dr. Dustin Kalynchuk is the best chiropractor I've ever been to - period.

Dr. Kalynchuk's clinic is modern, bright, friendly and they offer a wide array of the most effective and innovate treatment methods available (Graston, ART, Shockwave). I've had some lingering sports related injuries bothering me, and the next step was surgery. Dr. Kalynchuk suggested I try their "shockwave treatment" as it helps with tendinosis (calcification) and ligament tears, and after 5 treatments my arm feels better than it has in over 6 years. I would highly recommend visiting him if you're considering surgery to discuss your available options.

Came for the buffet lunch, didn't expect something so surprisingly good! Gradually losing faith in East Indian after so many hit or miss inconsistent experiences. But OMG what magic is coming out of this kitchen!! What is the DEAL? The food was so fresh, the flavours both bold and subtle, every dish defined and individual, the aromas exquisite and tantalizing.  Every item brought me back to what superb East Indian food can be. And the surroundings so plush and cozy. Worth every hard earned penny.

Very few patrons this night. 
This is what we noticed. While perusing the selections in the buffet, and right in the heart of the buffet, were about five people having an extremely loud and never-ending discussion in their native language. 
The oldest man was obnoxiously loud (stick your fingers in your ears loud) and the ladies were close behind. Obviously these people were the owners, family members, ETC. 
There were two young children who appeared to be brother and sister and they were having a sibling spat and the maternal lady was giving them a scolding.
It was like we were in their own living room and they didn't care who was watching or listening. They probably have been doing this for so long, they think this behavior is normal.
What a place to avoid.

When you're beaten, broken, down on yourself, stop!! Come here to see Dr. Dustin Kalnychuk and he will crack you up!! 

I've had some back pains since a car accident in 2010 and Dr. Dustin really took the time to get to know more about me and my lifestyle and goals. He's an amazing person who didn't need to just jump on x-rays to see the issues, he talked to you.

I've been here twice now and even though the visits were far apart, the food has stayed constantly tasty. Today was a gathering of 3 for Christmas lunch. I called ahead to make a lunch reservation (they recommend it for lunch and I would too if you have more than 2 people) as I recall how busy I was last time I went for supper (we had made a reservation back then then too). It wasn't packed at lunch but the place was definitely busy for the first Saturday of the new year. There's raised booths along the wall and all the other seating is regular table height.

This is a smaller restaurant but has tasteful decor, fast service and very tasty food. We started with the totopos (chips, guac & salsa) while we waited for our meals. There's plenty of chips served with this and let's just say no guac was left behind! We did our very best to finish the salsa by adding it to our lunch options. 

My friends ordered enchiladas de pollo and tortilla soup. I went with the al pastor tacos (comes with 5 smaller tacos and some beans on the side). The hot sauce on the side was deliciously spicy & sweet. They also had additional hot sauce on the table which for even me that likes spice, was definitely on the hotter side of life. So apply with caution if you decide to raise the spiciness level. My friends kept on commenting on how fresh everything tasted. 

We were all very happy with our selections and very full. Yet somehow found a little room to share tres leches cake. So glad we did as it was the perfect way to end the meal! Light, fluffy cake that seemed to be soaked in milk and topped with a generous portion of real whipped cream and fruit. 

The food and portions were really good, but I do feel that this place is a treat and not a regular restaurant I'd select for lunch due to the price point.

Best coffee shop in Sherwood Park (ya I know, that isn't much of a complement).

Great coffee and a really nice vibe, there is even a book exchange.  The people who work here know how to properly roast coffee and take care making great coffee drinks.  For those of you too scared to eat real food, the baked goods appear to be vegan.

And to anyone that thinks Tim Horton's coffee is tasty, please stay there.

Let me start by saying Mexican food is hands-down one of my favourite types of cuisine, and I tend to be a harsh critic. It's so easy to unbalance a dish (too much/little cilantro/onion/salsa/endless). 

I think I would eat at Lapatrona for breakfast, lunch and dinner if I could! Met a gf for lunch : she tried the flautas (which are an appetizer, I think), and I had the Huaraches (a whole pile of YUM atop a handmade corn flatbread). I was excited to encounter a number of dishes that I've never heard of before (never having been to Mexico and not being Mexican myself). I can only speak to my dish (although my friend truly enjoyed hers): the fresh flavours were spot on -  the balance between tangy (salsa), creamy (feta and cilantro vinaigrette), savoury (cochinita: pork shoulder wrapped in banana leaf and braised. YES, OHMIGOD YES!) and salty (flatbread) is literally inexplicable... you'll have to try it for yourself! I adored every mouthful! While my friend's dish was definitely more appetizer-sized, mine was a fairly generous portion. I think if you add meat to the dish you choose, most people would be quite satisfied. 

One point to note: get there early or make reservations. We got there at opening time (11:30 AM), and it didn't take long before the entire place was full (maybe...30 min?). It doesn't seat many - my guess would be 50 diners or less. Service was wonderfully authentic and friendly, our server knew her menu inside out (and could explain the subtle differences between dishes). Prices are incredibly reasonable...I think the average price on the menu was $15 or less. 

Honestly, this restaurant really does deserve 5 stars, but we were there for lunch, and they seemed slightly understaffed. We waited quite some time to get our cheque and pay. We were in and out in 75 min total, and our food came out shortly after ordering... 4.75 stars for Lapatrona!

Service is always good . Had lunch there back in November and the food was great! I love their sonomono salad ! We had the toro and salmon sashimi! So fresh!!!! And a
Bunch of rolls . Also a bottle of hot sake. It was a great lunch. 



We returned for supper a few days after that... Appetizers were great!!! But the toro was so fishy! It turned me off really quick! How can the toro be so fresh at lunch time a few days back and then on supper time be so freakin fishy !??? Anyway .... I really like sumo sumo but this one time for the toro...
Incredible Mexican food served locally in Sherwood Park! Friendly service and I quite enjoy the Mexican beer served there as well.

Worth the journey: chanced upon Sumo Sumo looking for a sushi place near where we were. Don't let the out of the way location fool you. Sushi is hard to do with any originality and Sumo Sumo did a grand job. Had the combo appetizer, volcano roll, samurai roll, California roll and mixed sushimi. All very tasty and original. The only downside I would say is that their rolls are rather large and therefore difficult to eat with any dignity. But that's hardly something to complain about. The kids enjoyed it too

Very cosy. Lots of seat in front of the chef or the window, but the table is for 2 groups of 4 or one group of 6 to 10. I would recommend a reservation. The food was very good quality it was very fresh. We tried the tuna salad and the octopus bowl, I will definitely go back for those and to try the rest of the menu. The toro tuna nigiri was the highlight it basically melted as you bite it and was super fresh. We went wit our two young kids and they are very accommodating but avoid busy times if you are going with kids because the place is small. My kids had the fried chicken and they loved it

Maybe they had a bad night? I was not impressed by the service on my visit and the food was average.  We went there last Friday night at about 6pm.  My husband and I were meeting my brother and fiance.  We arrived first and had to wait almost ten minutes to be seated in a half empty section.  Didn't see our server for again almost ten minutes.  We ordered our drinks and when they arrived we ordered our food.  The appetizers all came our around the same time but when it came time for our mains they were all over the place.  It took almost 20 minutes for 4 dished to come out of the kitchen and that seems ridiculous.  

My husband works for a company that enjoys eating here and they don't usually have complaints about the service (he was back there again on Monday).  I am okay cutting a restaurant some slack for having an off night in terms of service, but overall I didn't feel like the food was exceptional enough for me to make a special trip to try them again.

Derks is one of my favourite stores to shop in, in Edmonton. Whenever I walk in I feel like a million bucks. Usually I stop by just to browse or say hi to some of the staff and I usually walk out with a great sport coat at a value price. I bought my first suit from Derks in 2008 and it still looks sharp and gets the frequent compliment. (I can't believe I can still fit in it now being a dad with 3 kids so that's always a good boost to the ego). Notwithstanding, the staff is always very helpful, knowledgable and genuinely care about their product and service. 

I enjoy my visits to Derks because typically I get a wardrobe upgrade and with it a confidence boost when meeting with new clients.

GREAT menu and very accommodating staff. My wife and I LOVE going to Sumo Sumo -even with her food sensitivities, we never struggle to find things for each of us to try. Even was able to get my kids to try octopus! Good times, great food. And my kids just love the "boats" their big combos come in. Okay, I love the boats too. I admit it.

First time visiting this salon and I was extremely happy with the service I received!! My hair stylist was Jakkie Williamson and she did an amazing job! I had a rather difficult request... My hair was dyed black (several times over the past year) and I wanted to go blonde... crazy, I know! 

Jakkie gave me her professional opinion on what my best options would be without damaging my hair too badly. Out of the couple choices she suggested, we settled on light brown with a few highlights. I'm thrilled with how it turned out!! See the before and after picture for reference. 

Jakkie is so friendly and welcoming and really knows her hair stuff. She also gave me some aftercare tips that I can do to keep my hair healthy. All the other staff were super nice too, and willing to help out and offer advice. Will definitely return!

My husband and I had our steaks delivered to our home and we weren't disappointed. First f all I have an allergy and the restaurant employee Ryan called me to make sure my meal was going to be safe for me to eat. He went over and above to make sure my allergy was taken care of. Now for the food. We had the 12oz New York Strip loin steak. That was by far the best steak I have ever eaten. Even though my steak was well done, it was still juicy and tender. My baked potato was big and delicious. Our food arrived hot and we are hoping next time to visit the restaurant in person. Thank you for a wonderful meal.

Love this restaurant. The decor is perfect, the staff are welcoming and warm and do a great job explaining the menu. The food  is delicious and well priced. The food and service levels are consistent, I have never hAd a bad visit and would  highly recommend tHis restaurant for authentic tasty food.

Walmart. What can I say? good ol' Walmart. Home of the low prices and low service.

We went through the express line with an item from clearance for The Spawn. The item rings through at $2 higher than it was supposed to. The Spawn is 8 years old and was spending his own money so we protested.

The clerk got on the intercom and asked someone from toys to call her station. Of course, no one did so the clerk had a great idea to remedy the situation.

"Why don'tcha jus' go to the toy aisle and take a picture and bring it back for me?"

Yeah, sure, I'll just do your work for you. But what can I say? it is Walmart, so I did. Oh, the shame.

Boy has this place gone downhill !! We use to look forward to eating here but after the take out we had on Saturday, we shall not be dining\ordering from Huku again! The War Wonton Soup was bland and had no BBQ pork which seems to be a standard in Wonton soup. The Wontons were small and falling apart and were drowned with ginger inside. The Ginger Beef was under cooked and the batter was raw. The Cantonese Chow Mein had only "1" shrimp in it, hardly any vegetables and barely any meat, "Special Chow Mein" my..... The noodles were burn't(black and dark brown)...explain that to me when it's suppose to be "soft noodles". The Beef and Chinese Greens were drowning in "water" with no flavor...which must have been in the water. The Chicken Fried Rice barely had any chicken or chopped green onion. The Lemon Chicken was not the usual sized portions that normally came when we ordered and there was only 8 pieces in the small order.

To think we ordered at 4pm and it was ready for pick up in 20 minutes, with only 1 table with people in the establishment. The young woman who runs the place did not look very happy and it was a bit loud in the kitchen area. 

At this rate I can't see Huku lasting much longer....sorry to say, it was good sometime ago! It was so bad, no one wanted to eat the left overs that were in the fridge and we just threw them out the next day.

I'm really really confused by this location.  Especially after my experience here today. 

Sometimes I come here at lunch time if there weather isn't great out but I want to go for a walk (super cool, I know).  I don't understand why new Wal Marts only have one entrance now.... maybe it's a smaller location, I don't know.  But when it's raining, like today, it sucks to have to hoof across the whole parking lot to get in.

No greeter today - seems odd for WalMart.

As I'm browsing, a cashier comes on the intercom and says "Till 4 needs change please, as soon as possible".  I giggled a little because you don't hear that very often.  A few minutes later, another employee goes on the intercom and calls for a CSM to somewhere or something and as soon as that announcement ended, the original cashier was back on the intercom "Till 4 is still waiting for change... I'm almost out!".  There was clear frustration in her voice.  Don't misunderstand - I am not mocking this cashier by any means.  But Wal Mart prides itself on Customer Service and training - and obviously missed something while training this cashier.  I was surprised when she was able to make the second announcement - I would have thought that somebody would have rushed over to her after the first one to explain that that is not how to use the intercom.

Anyway - I continued shopping.  I've always found there to be much less stock at this location than at others (primarily south common).  And it's hard to find things here that you've seen at another location.

After walking around for about 25 minutes, I remembered that I need some flour.  So I picked it up and headed towards the express lane with my one item.  There were only 2 people ahead of me.  But once I got in line, I realized that while two tills had their lights on, there was actually only one cashier.  The other till with it's light on but no cashier?  You guessed it... Till #4.  Did she get fed up and go to find her own change?  No idea.  It took 7 minutes for me to get to the till (with only 2 people in front of me).  I know it doesn't seem like much.  but 7 minutes is a bit much for the express line.

And then as I was leaving, there was a line of us walking towards the exit and the automatic door wouldn't open for us!!

Everyone kind of bumped into each other and looked confused.  I couldn't wait to get out of there and booked it over to the "in" door, which opened and I escaped.
Had the cochinitas .... amazing!!! And the churros for desert. Great little hidden gem in the Park that won't break your budget! Make a reservation though as it gets busy!!!

I travelled to my 12:45 appointment through horrible winter roads and arrived 12 minutes late.  No one was at the counter so I took a seat. A few minutes later a young lady asks who I'm waiting for so I let her know I'm with Alisa. She goes to the back then comes out to tell me they have a15 minute late policy, to which I let her know I was only 12 minutes late. She then asks me to reschedule! I drove from downtown Edmonton to Sherwood park for this appointment and this is how I'm treated! I would not recommend this salon at all!

It is so great to have a place in our city that is truly just devoted to the birds. It's hard to find anything not to love about Meika's Bird House.

The store is a little tricky to find, but you can't forget it once you find it. Impeccably clean and stocked full of all sorts of bird goodies, including premium brands of food, treats/seed mixes, toys, cages, accessories and much more. I love that they carry tons of supplies to make your own bird toys, a number of used cages for those on a budget and some specialty items (such as medical collars/feather protectors, etc).

The staff is quite honestly what makes this place the best bird store in the province. I've only ever met Ian, one of the owners, but he is incredibly approachable, down-to-earth, knowledgable and caring about all species of bird. It's clear that he's in this line of work because it's what he is passionate about, which is so great to see in a small local business.

Prices are competitive at Meika's and you are apt to find many products that you wouldn't find in a big box pet store. They don't "sell" birds there, but often there are a few adoptable feathered friends from their Safehouse in to visit with (which often is enough to warrant a visit from me!). They are also incredibly involved in their community, including the Alberta Parrot Association and other businesses thoughout Sherwood Park and Edmonton.

If I could give Meika's SIX stars, I would. Thank you guys so much for everything, and my cockatiel, Maru, thanks you too!!

I've been to 3 different Blaze Pizza's in Edmonton and area, and all 3 were exactly the same. 
You choose your crust, I choose thin, they make it in front of you, then you can choose from 5 or 6 sauces, 5 or 6 cheeses, 5 or 6 meats, and a huge assortment of veggies. I always get red sauce, ricotta cheese, artichoke hearts, mushrooms, and I always have leftovers. 
It's nice that they make it in front of you, the wood fire oven is even in front of you. 
When your pizza is done, you can choose from ~ 6 finishes (chipotle, ranch, arugula, etc). 
They have agua Fresca in juice fountains and those are refillable. 
It's pretty loud in there, and I took my mom once, and she was very overwhelmed by the menu and the process, it wasn't fun, so maybe keep seniors at home for pizza, just a tip. She's not even that old, I'm talking early 60's, not 80's. 
But, I promise you will be hooked on this pizza. I never would have imagined putting ricotta on a pizza, but it's the best thing ever. 
See you there!!

Every time I am in Sherwood Park I try to will whoever is with me to come to this restaurant. The sushi is always fresh and prepared well. The restaurant is clean and fairly well maintained. Some of their bench chairs need some new leather covers but the overall restaurant is very zen. They have fake plants and bamboo all over the restaurant. We happened to come during their lunch hour special so it was an extra bonus! Our server was also extra friendly and polite. This is by far my favourite sushi restaurant of all time!
The tattoo company is excellent, I've been to kaitlyn every time and she is always pleasant, patient and really nice. She does an amazing job and I always have the best experience when I go.

The sushi and sashimi was very fresh! The atmosphere and decor was lovely! We really love the cute cartoon chefs and the bathroom signs. We tried the appetizer for 2 and a combination of sushi, maki and sashimi. I must say its the freshest I've tasted. The price was also very good.

I would give this restaurant a 3.5 if I could! Met up with a few friends, two of which had been there before. It is a really tiny, cute restaurant. There aren't a lot of tables so I really recommend booking a reservation. When I was waiting for our table to be set up, they told a couple that I would be about an hour and fifteen wait at 7pm. Our server was very knowledgeable and answered all questions. The menu looked awesome. I ended up ordering a pīna colada. It took about 15 minutes to get my drink. We all got different dishes and everything tasted amazing. Hats off to the chef! I ended up getting this baked cheese with pico and tortillas. I added steak and guacamole. It was quite filling. For one drink and entree, my bill came to $41 (before tip). While it was tasty, i do feel that it is overpriced. It is definitely a nice break from hamburger and steak joints in Sherwood park but I don't know if it will be a place I frequent due to the price.

Blaze Pizza Sherwood Park
Generally my go to place as well as my family and every time I go I get 3-5 pizzas so it isn't cheap at all
Maybe the worst service I've gotten from Blaze Pizza 
The staff aren't friendly and they all seem as if they hate there job 
The staff at the Downtown location in Edmonton are always happy and outgoing but I live in Sherwood Park so it make more sense to go to the one that's local to Sherwood Park 
But after tonight I won't be back in a awhile 
Pizza was a bit burnt as well
They might've been new but they need to be trained 
It's customer based and people are spending a lot on pizza

I ordered volcano roll and that came after I finished everything. Also, the vegetable in seafood Udon is yellow and bitter. The server took 10 mins to give me the bill and another 15 mins to get the visa card. She didn't say thank you or anything after or before I paid. BAD SERVICE

Oh my gosh!  This is definitely my favourite restaurant in Sherwood Park now and I can't wait to go back!

We arrived shortly before 6 pm on a Tuesday and were asked if we had reservations... uh oh.  We asked if we needed them.  She said no, but gave us the head's up that they do get pretty busy and they don't have many tables, so a reservation is usually a good idea.  Good to know!

We were seated right away and the drink menu was pointed out.  We both started with the same drink... I think it was called the Vampiro or something like that.  It was tequila, sangrita, and grapefruit Jarritos.  It was pretty good.  Had a bit of a pepper flavor to it.  Our second round was basic margaritas.  Delicious!  But the lime juice was a little strong.

We started with chips, salsa, and guac.  The chips were obviously fresh, and very delicious.  The guac was the best I've had in a long time.

Now for the best part.  My friend got the Mahta Hambre tacos and she loved them.  I went with the Hugo Taco.  I was torn about it because it doesn't have cheese, but I am SO glad I went with it.  The Hugo includes both Sirloin steak and chorizo and it is SPICY.  I actually asked for a little sour cream to cool it down.  This was by far the best taco I've every had.  It's served like a fajita - everything comes on a hot skillet and you build it yourself.

The tortillas are made in house and you can tell.  I usually don't like corn tortillas because my teeth have a hard time biting through them, but these were so incredibly soft.  I ate about half of it and took the rest home for lunch the next day.  Everything was just as good the next day.

Here's the thing that really put this place over the top.  There was a larger group in the restaurant when we were there.  It was 6 adults and 2 young children.  The little boy (I'd say he was around 2) got really upset when the adults started eating.  I don't mind fussy kids by any means... but he was being really disruptive.  One of the amazing servers (I think he said his name was Coso, but I may have misheard that) went over to the table and started entertaining the kid.  To the point that he actually picked him up and started dancing around the restaurant with him.  That action changed everyone's mood in the restaurant immediately.  Big big kudos to that guy!

I can't wait to be back.  I have family visiting from the states soon, and they love Mexican food.  This is where we'll be coming!
Under new ownership! They have revamped the salon and have made huge changes! The best nail salon around. The only place I'll go!

Brand new restaurant attached to the Sandman Hotel I got the steak salad it was only $22 and a chicken salad was $20.
We took my grandmother and had fantastic service it was her birthday they gave her complementary crème brûlée and our wine by the glass was half off during happy hour from 3 to 6 so it was much more affordable than we were expecting.
I highly recommend this particular location. It's always nice to eat in a hotel. I'd like to try this place for brunch.

Well unlike other reviews. We stumbled across your store during an impromptu visit to Sherwood Park.  To say we were pleasantly surprised at how much NFL merchandise you carry.  Not many stores in the Edmonton core do.  We were greeting even though your store was busy. We were asked a couple of times if we needed assistance.   I love my purchase. and definitely will make the trip back to sherwood park for more Christmas shopping...  Thank you

Great selection, some items are cheaper than you can find online.  The item I wanted was $80 here versus $90 online (plus shipping), and was not available/in-stock at similar Edmonton sports apparel stores. Service was prompt and not pushy. Store is well-organized and items are clearly visible despite the small size and huge amount of stock. 
I'd come back here for sure.

My friend was celebrating her 50th birthday and her husband chose Japanese Village in Sherwood Park.  I didn't even know Sherwood Park has a Japanese Village and I hadn't been to one in about 15 years.

We had 14 in our group but this wasn't an issue as we were all able to all sit around two grills with two grill cooks. 
Our server did a great job of taking our drink orders, filling up our water glasses and making sure we were happy. 
I personally started with a pint of their house beer and the Tuna Sashimi.
Both were tasty.  For my main course I had Teppan - Yaki Dinner (Teriyaki Chicken) It came with soup, salad and green tea.
Our grill cook was a nice young man who brought a smile to our face and kept us chuckling.

For the value, I was happy with my meal, the price I payed and the fun interacting with our cook.  I would definitely go back with a group of friends.

Best sushi in the Edmonton area hands down!!! I don't mind making the trip from Edmonton to Sherwood Park for the best quality sushi around! My wife and I enjoy the Love Boat! I highly recommend Sumo Sumo if you want the best sushi!!!

Updating review based on last experience at the Emerald Hills Blaze pizza. Much like my first visit, the pizza was great. Blaze pizza is essentially a pizzeria version of sub restaurants as it offers a lot of customization options. With addition to several great pizza types, you can add or remove any other toppings you like as well as choose from multiple dough options to create your 'perfect' pizza. Overall, the food is great, but the service was not entirely professional. The first employee I interacted with walked us through the customization process and after explaining that we could choose two pizza types and split the pizza, she pointed to my face and said "...but you don't seem like the type who would want to share" and made the same remark after asking if I would like a salad. When going for lunch, I should not have to worry about my self-esteem dropping even further when I am just in search of a good meal. Very unprofessional. Rating updated.
Best food ever! I love coming here, my food is always amazing. Only thing is the service is kinda slow.

Sumo sumo is my Favorite sushi in the whole city! I don't care where I am if I'm craving sushi this is the only place I come. 

Amazing outdoor patio complete with water fountains, greenery, tv's, heaters & even sunscreens by remote control!

For all you vegetarians out there you MUST get #72 Vegetable Dragon. Literally the best sushi I have ever tasted! 

Prices are a little higher than other places for sushi, but the food, service & atmosphere make up for it hands down!

Great for groups they take reservations!

Nice modern decore.   Booths and wood trim.  Dance lounge music.  Staff all tall and slim, appear to be selectively hired.  Beef dip had the heavy bread which is hard to eat and dip.  They should put in more meat and use a lighter bun.  The house greens had head lettuce hidden in the bottom as filler.  Decent wine and beer selection.  Staff were friendly and accommodating.

Had a pretty bad experience; they managed to fry the hell out my hair, pretty mediocre haircut in general, not to mention she managed to actually burn my scalp pretty bad. I've never had this bad an experience with a salon, and to top it off? Incredibly overpriced for all that! Would not recommended at all.

Delicious authentic Mexican food. Atmosphere is great in this little gem. Seating is pretty tight & we arrived on a Friday with no reservations (our bad). Despite the no reservations they squeezed us in at the bar which was surprisingly spacious for a bar top. We had a cheese appetizer that was just to DIE for. As were the homemade tortillas that it came with. I had enchiladas and there was so much I had no hope of finishing. I got medium heat and it was more than spicy enough for me. My friend got the hot and even she had to admit it was hot. Both of us enjoyed our meals. Just heavenly. Definitely would return, with reservations.
Love this place. Best authentic Mexican food in Sherwood Park. Try the tortilla soup it's amazing

Came here in 2018 with a group. Overall,  it was a decent experience. They have a decent number of food selections (various rice, chicken, and vegetarian dishes) for their buffer. However, they have less items than some other Indian buffets at a similar price.

Friendly staff.  Large interior space, kind of modern.  They make ground coffee bean blends for businesses.  The inside smells like coffee beans.  Prices reasonable for a latte.  Coffee could be a bit hotter, but they don't have a Microwave . Their medium is equivalent to a normal dark roast. Their dark roast is for connoisseurs. I saw a few muffins. In a strip mall with free parking.  They sell t shirts and caps and mugs if you are groupie.

Absolutely phenomenal drinks, food, staff, and service all around!

We went to Chop for my husband's 40th birthday on October 30th, and we were blown away with how smoothly & perfectly everything was operating, even though they had just opened around a week prior.

Not only did they give my husband a complimentary piece of birthday cake with "happy birthday" written in chocolate sauce next to it, the staff also wished my husband a happy birthday by giving him a card signed by all the staff (with a GC for free steak bites next time we come to Chop). Such thoughtful gestures!

Oh, and their Pink Lemonade drink is officially my favourite alcoholic drink of all time now - SO GOOD!!

We'll definitely be back, sooner than later. Keep up the amazing work, Chop!

Now that my best friend and I live on opposite ends of the world, we needed to find a halfway point to meet for coffee. Randomly googled Sherwood park cafes and decided to try Roasti. Driving up, I was kind of like "oh man". It's in a run down looking strip mall, between a no-name pizza place and a liquor store... with a Fast Gas blocking its view of the street.

I went inside to wait for the bestie and just took in the feel of the place. Don't let the exterior fool you. Very trendy atmosphere. I waited about 15 mins and in that time the door didn't remain closed.... people constantly coming in. Listening to patrons, they were bringing others in to try the coffee here.... and raving about it.

When we ordered; staff was very friendly and made recommendations. The girl suggested I do honey in my latte with macadamia nut milk.  This was delicious and I ended up having two. 

I would say this coffee was delicious, and this will definitely be a return visit for us!

This is is my second complaint about your Emerald Hills location in Sherwood Park.  I don't live in Sherwood Park and have never had a problem at your locations here in Edmonton, I want to say that first and foremost I love Mary Browns and my local restaurant on Ellerslie road in Summerside is fantastic. Ok here it goes: It was decided with my husbands family to have a get together for Mother's Day (social distancing of course) outside on the yard. The 15 of us and decided on Mary Browns. I didn't want to order Mary Browns in Sherwood Park because we had a horrible experience two years ago for my mother in laws birthday. The kids won so we ordered.  We did a SkipTheDishes Order and picked the 30 piece feast party bucket which includes 2 large salads, 2 large fries or taters and 1 large gravy; also 2 chicken popins and an extra medium fries. So delivery came now problem from SkipTheDishes. Opened our bags and we were missing our 2 large salads, 1 popins chicken and 1 large gravy. I contacted Mary browns immediately as we needed this food especially the popcorn chicken for one of the kids, and the girl who answered the phone said oh yeah it must have went to another big order. I said well I need that food she said well u need to come and get it. I said no we want it delivered. She said that's your problem contact SkipTheDishes we don't do that. I got very upset because she was very rude on the phone she offered no compensation at all, nothing and when I said I will contact Mary browns head quarters she laughed and said go ahead and hung up on me. I didn't even get a chance to say that the chicken and fries we did get had way too much seasoning so much so I got sick and couldn't even finish what I had. I did contact SkipTheDishes and the will refund us for the missing items only of $26.46.  There customer service was great. But we will never ever order from the Emerald Hills location ever again. That's 4 families. I want you to be aware of the horrible service this location has. When I complained 2 years ago I told u the the same complaint about the chicken too much seasoning and the batter was falling off, well now the batter isn't falling off but they the seasoning was overkill. 
So another family event ruined by this location. Thank you so much. I just want you to know the type of people you have working at your locations

A new favourite for us! We ended up ordering the arrachera steak, enchiladas de pollo with spicy roja, el pastors tacos, and churros. Everything was sooo good. We usually wouldn't order a steak at a mexican recipe as we go for tacos, etc. We were fighting over the last piece of the steak it was so good. The enchiladas were wonderful and the spicy roja was delicious! We can't wait to try more of the menu. Love when they package everything perfectly to enjoy just like you would eating in. Sauces all packed wonderfully and cutlery in the bag.
Tried once again for date night! Fantastic AGAIN!!!!! Really good service too. 100% our go to sushi place!
This is the best sushi house. Great atmosphere, fresh food, service is always friendly.

This restaurant is beautiful and huge. Great parking and very accessible. The variety of choices is overwhelming but a bit pricey in some cases but the food  quality is excellent. The food is delicious, presented well and serving sizes are generous. Staff is friendly  and service is very good.

We went here last week. 

We waited about 20 minutes for a table (It was 2pm on a Sunday so we didn't think it would be full but it was). We felt they probably could have got us into a table a bit sooner as we saw lots of people leaving but it was still 10+ minutes after they left before we were seated. When we were seated, we were placed in the corner of a private room that seemed to have a family's party at all the other tables, so it was a bit loud and awkward.

Once seated, the food arrived quickly, and the buffet was readily available. We definitely filled up on both. The sushi was great - though the buffet kept running out of sushi rolls. I did try lots of things that I don't normally order at Japanese restaurants, so did appreciate the variety. There was no lack of creativity in the selection. 

The buffet was $35 each, including 2 nonalcoholic beverages. This was pretty pricey for lunch and I think we filled up before getting our moneys worth. I would probably only suggest this for people who love sashimi, because that is normally expensive. For maki rolls lovers like us, it wasn't really worth it. 

We were dissapointed when we paid to find out that they add a gratuity on automatically, so it came to over $80. I would have tipped anyways, but was insulted that it was done for me. I understand this on larger groups - but there were 2 of us. 

It was an interesting place to try once, and like I said, if you are looking for sashimi or interesting rolls it might be worth it, but we will stick to lower cost places in the future.
Had the tortilla soup and the fish tacos and they where both amazing !! Highly recommend! Great service as well.

Sports Closet is very similar in nature to Game on Sports or Jersey City. I think they hold a bit of a monopoly on the sports merchandise market in Sherwood Park as to the best of my knowledge there is neither a Game on Sports or Jersey City located nearby. This fact is very much reflected in the staff's attitude here because despite the fact there were two associates working and only one other customer in the store that was on their way out I got no greeting,no offer of assistance,and neither of them could even be bothered to look in my direction.

The selection here was good with the exception being that there wasn't much in the way of soccer merchandise that I noticed besides some shirts. I also give them credit for the fact that despite being a smaller store most of their prices seemed on par with bigger chain stores. The complete lack of not just customer service but willingness to even acknowledge my physical presence in their store however means that I will not be back and plan to buy the Sea hawks merchandise I had been looking at somewhere else that is actually interested in earning my business.

Wow! If you want some top notch Mexican you have to go here! What a hidden gem! Amazing amazing food! 
Our friends treated us here with a gift card- funny enough the gift card didn't have the name of the restaurant on it just their symbol. 
We had a selection of their tacos and they were all fantastic tasty morsels with great flavours and unique combinations. From the refreshing pineapple cilantro to pickled onion and pork.  
We started with the Totopos, the fresh tortilla chips were a great appetizer to start us off. 
We also had the Hugo Taco which has delightful flavour and was the groups favourite. We definitely recommend it. 
There is parking as this place is part of a complex. This place started as a food truck but I'm glad it has a set space. It was a little tight quarters inside the restaurant itself but we still managed to squeeze in with our stroller although I wouldn't recommend it for the next person. No baby change table here from what I saw either. 
All in all still a fabulous joint we will definitely go back!

Roasti is amazing! Recently I have become addicted to their iced oat milk latte. I'm a normal while fat milk girl generally, but this drink seals the deal. The vibe inside Roasti is fantastic, the team is friendly, and coffee is great.

Derk's are a bunch of jerks. The two guys working there followed us around the store which I don't mind help buy then whispered to each other to watch my boyfriend and I as we look like we were going to steal. Like wow we're paying customers like everyone else just looking for a suit. That's not how you run a place of business!! No wonder the reviews aren't good on here. That business owner really needs to get it together. I told the employees how rude they are and got 20 percent off so at least they did that. So all up the stars lol for 1 to 3. The youngest staff member was very kind today. The parking sucks though.

I've been to this restaurant twice, both for the lunch buffet on a Sunday. Each visit, the restaurant only had one other party eating.

Most recently, I arrived a little after 12pm, more than a half hour after the restaurant opened. At this time, most of the warmers had food, but two were still empty. There were various food options available, all hot and fresh.

I found the lamb and the vegetables deep fried in a lentil batter especially good. While flavourful, none of the dishes were overly spicy. The waiter brought fresh naan to our table shortly after we sat down with our food and also replenished our basket when we ran out.

Overall, service was quite good and the food was enjoyable. I would go again.
Good unreal , service was so slow to even get a drink ... overlooked because food was so good!!

Worst Tim Hortons in the Sherwood park. Long lines, everyone was squished not fun. Waited over half an hour for my grilled cheese and garden salad. To top it off, the cashier messed up our drink order. I got given an under cooked grilled cheese, the cheese wasn't even melted. To top it off even more the bread a hard wasn't even an Artisan bun, HARD/old white bun that they use for soup. While I was waiting in line the ladies behind me were obnoxious and shoving me. Very rude, the customers/worker and the experience was just bad. Do not appreciate being given UNDERCOOKED food. Thank you Tim Horton's for ruining my day and making me later for my doctors appointment even through I came to Timmies an hour before my appoinment

Great care and very knowledgeable staff. I would highly recommend this clinic. They promptly came out to my vehicle to collect my dog and call me while I waited to give updates. I really appreciated this as you are not able to come inside due to covid. The doctor was very kind and caring.
Delicious food! I always look forward to it and am never disappointed. We ordered pick up during COVID and was very pleased with the food, service and price.

If you're in the mood for authentic Mexican food this is the place to try! Fun decor and music will transport you to Mexico but it's the food that will really win you over. I had the traditional margarita which was one of the best I've had in awhile and chips with guacamole to start. The presentation was so nice you were looking at neighboring tables to see what they ordered. I ask so got the "gringa" el pastor pork with pineapple, cilantro served on two mozzarella grilled tortillas. I could not fault this place in any way and will definitely be back again. This place is worth the drive to Sherwood park!

I went here to have something done to my hair to allow the grey to come in gracefully( no obvious root line) . I have been colouring my hair a light auburn( close to my own colour). I told the stylist what I wanted. She removed the colour using foils ,applied toner and that was it . I left the salon a blonde, not at all what I wanted. The grey roots are already starting to show. She didn't tell me what she was doing . I had to ask.  Not impressed, I won't be back.

Nothing to complain on this store

There quick accurate and friendly. The remembered  my order and they always have it ready when they see me!

My first time enjoying "Burrito Libre" was ordering it from skip the dishes, I don't have much to say about the dining experience there. You are offered a minimal amount of ingredients that you can stuff into your burrito but they are quite unique with the flavours of there proteins! There salsas and sauces are also unique and flavourful. For the guacamole and chips I think they need a little bit more seasoning (more salt and pepper). The price is pretty decent and on the cheaper side for Sherwood park (10.00$ for a large burrito). I enjoy eating from the place but it needs to have more selection of toppings that are enjoyed in a burrito to compete with the other Mexican restaurants.
This is such an amazing hole in the wall! I love the enchiladas. The atmosphere is really fun and the staff are knowledgable. Super fun date night pick

I took my staff for dinner last week it was my second time. The first time great service food was great. Second time food still great but the service was so rushed! We ordered appetizers and literally 10 minutes after they were put on the table all the side dishes that come with the main course we're being brought out. At this point I said please hold off on our main course as we want to digest this and we are not in a hurry. 10 minutes later our waitress came to the table to see if she could clear plates as our main course was ready! At this point I was getting annoyed and embarrassed as I had raved about it and it was a special night out with my staff. I politely asked that they leave our meals under the heat to allow us to finish at least some of the appetizers on the table! The girl seemed uncomfortable and left then a few minutes later she came back again to ask if we were ready yet....I said no. Next few minutes our food is being delivered to the table by either the manager or the owner. We all wanted to talk , relax, and enjoy our dinner out and this was extremely rushed. Food was good but if you want to relax and enjoy tell them right from the start or better yet don't give the server your main course meal until you are done your appetizers! Disappointing night :(

This place by far has the best tacos in Sherwood Park and in my opinion second best tacos in all of Edmonton. 

Today they were advertising their empanada Thursday special so we decided to try for lunch, we were not disappointed. We ordered two empanadas each and got free churros for dessert, it was more than enough food for the two of us.

The service is always amazing, the people working are super friendly and super helpful.

Small and busy little restaurant.  Service a little slow but friendly.  Chicken enchiladas were good, hot sauce was excellent.  Will definitely go back and try more of their menu.  Make a reservation or you will be waiting awhile.

Had an amazing meal from New Asian Village last night. 

The chilli chicken is absolutely amazing as well as the cauliflower, the shrimp pakora and the mini veggie samosas.

The customer service is probably some of the best customer service you are going to get at any restaurant in the Sherwood Park area.

We got take out and when we got home the food was still hot and travelled very well.

Would strongly recommend checking out this place.

Lovely little boutique roaster. The coffee is quite good not burnt or acidic. 

The espresso could have more depth in flavour. 

The only thing I recommend asking for extra hot because normal is not hot. 

It would be nice to see a larger cup size too.

To me this is a place that tries to be a "higher end" Cora's. While they succeed in decor and ambiance I think they fall short when it comes to the food. Their menus are quite similar (I mean it's breakfast food but it's still eerily similar) 

Food wise it's okay. I've never been totally disappointed. But otherwise it's never at the top of my list. Although their late hours for a breakfast anytime definitely are great!

This was my second time to this restaurant. First time was amazing. We went on a holiday Monday. Quick service and the food was really good. Just went today. It's Sunday. And the experience was awful. We walked into the restaurant at 1:15.... Our server took our drink order by 1:20. By 1:45 we walked out because our orange juice still hadn't made it to the table and our menus were still sitting in front of us. The server had spilled water all over the table and never bothered to even bring over a napkin or cloth to clean it up. I am so unimpressed by my second experience here that I will probably never return.
Overpriced. Young guys working would only give credit instead of refund. Small business like this makes a guy want to stick with franchise stores.

I took my wife and toddlers here for Pizza night. They were very accommodating regarding dietary restrictions. They allowed us to split a pizza for the girls with different toppings, marked the sides, and cut the pieces extra thin. They gave us extra water glasses and were just so helpful it made our evening so much easier. The food was great and the price was reasonable. We'll be going back in the future.
Very excellent two lattes on a busy Saturday morning. Even excellenter cinnamon sugar croissant fast friendly good good good and they said our puppy was cute now 5.5

Nice patio!  Solid 4 stars.  Traditional Indian food.  Very friendly staff.  I was surprised at the extensive beer selection.  Indoor booths. Or outdoor patio with umbrellas with a nice skyline view. Be sure to check out the effigies in the patio fence. Buffet is $25 or order off the menu.

Top notch!
The perfect summer treats!
So many awesome flavors.
Lots of serving sizes.
Reasonable prices.
What more can I say.
The kids will ensure you go back!

Awesome new Japanese restaurant in Sherwood Park.  Their Teppanyaki food was excellent. My favorite however is their tempura udon.  I have to say they have the best tempura udon in Sherwood Park and I've had them all in this town.  I'll be going back there soon.  Can't wait.
Beautiful and delicious chocolate. I ordered curb side pick up and the staff was just as pleasant and helpful as usual. I go back and stock up again and again.
Wonderful food!!!! Sure a lot of take outs at this restaurant. We dined in and loved it. Clean....we recommend this restaurant.

I go to this Tim Hortons quite often for breakfast one day I decided to try one of the wraps and I asked the cashier what was in the farmers wrap she waited for a moment before punching in a bacon sausage wrap and asking me if I would like to make it a meal I said that's not what I ordered and she scoffed at me I decided it wasn't worth it and paid for it oh my god what is this a bad experience. Pure and utter shit.

I had originally ordered a tuxedo from the rental part of the store.  Later on I found a tuxedo that was more what I had in mind for my wedding so I called to cancel my order.  Doing this I knew I was going to forfeit my deposit but I had already paid in full.  I was told over the phone that they normally mail out refund cheques, I specifically asked to pick my cheque up at the store and it was noted when I called.  I went to the store to pick up my refund and to shop for shoes for my wedding.  I was told by the staff that my cheque was not there and even though it was clearly noted not to mail out the cheque I was told it had been sent to my address through the mail.  Nothing was offered to cancel the cheque and write a new one and the staff failed to see the inconvenience of this.  It has now been 16 days and still haven't received anything in the mail.  I've never actually been told by someone "the cheque is in the mail" before until now.  Needless to say my business for my shoes went elsewhere.  Also no response to an email that I had sent to the store, so if you're looking for customer service look elsewhere.

Not quite sure what happened maybe someone was just having a bad day when I called into the veterinarian clinic to explain what was going on with my dog she told me to hurry up and get to the point when I said excuse me what are you talking about she hung up.. so I called back and had some words when I realized it was a different person that was answering the phone so I explained what happened she quickly apologized and asked me to bring the dog in the next day as it could be some serious problems so the next day I took my dog in at 1:30 I asked how many people are ahead of me she said to you I said OK I waited outside and 34 above weather for 3 1/2 hours I finally called and asked how much longer she said well there's five dogs ahead of you I could not believe it I was absolutely thoroughly disgusted with any kind of service with their behaviour and the way they treat people if that's hard if that's how they treat us how do they treat our pets like I said maybe someone was just having a bad day but it totally was it an inconvenience waiting there for 6 1/2 hours finally drive away and I get a phone call to come in seems pretty convenient it was extremely rude I didn't bother answering the phone because they didn't deserve any kind of respect I would not recommend this place to anybody and I will make sure to put reviews on every social media I find and I would not definitely not recommend going thoroughly disgusted.

My first time here.  I love the ambiance of this place.  Great music and it smells delicious.  

Ordered a Paloma. It was the best one I've ever had.  Next time a spicy margarita.  

Had their chips, salsa and guacamole.  I tried the tortilla soup, I found it too spicy for my taste, with all that said I will definitely go back and try some of the other amazing food.  

Then to end our dinner we got their churros.  I love that they are served hot with a chocolate mousse.  Perfect way to end the meal.

Wonderful food! Service a bit slow and forgetful. They were very busy at the time though and I wasn't in the mood to be assertive. I survived! :) Overall we'd go back, the ambience is quite nice for a family setting and the food is second to none. Better than some of the premium resorts I've traveled in Cancun, Playa, etc. Nice people as well.

New favourite place!!!!!! It tastes like when my husband and i went on honeymoon in Japan. The rice was perfect and not compact and the sushi was perfect. Everything tasted fantastic and the slices of sashimi were perfectly sized. The fish tasted very fresh too! We will be making the 20 minute drive from Fort Saskatchewan for this place!

Sherwood Park is so lucky right now. They have the best Mexican food and now the best Japanese food of all time.  


Kobachi has been open for a couple months now and it's serving up top tier sushi. Aside from the sushi they are named after their small bowls "bachi" that are sure to impress. They have something for everyone in these bowls from curried cashew nuts to hotate butter scallops. If the small appetizer bowls ain't filling you up then there are "oobachi" the bigger bowls that include chirashi donburi and a wagyu steak donburi. I was picking some squid and octopus from my sister's chirashi bowl and i'd have to say it is the best tasting here at kobachi. This leads me to my favorite, the sushi. It's probably the closest thing to Japan you can get in the Edmonton area. Each piece comes with a little dab of wasabi underneath the fish and are glazed with some soy. It looks great and tastes even better. After trying most of the sushi the only one i'd avoid is the red tuna, idk what happened there but it's the only average thing I ate here. Regardless, the other tunas here are great, the aburri salmon, the scallops and also the uni if it's available. There are specials everyday so lookout for some of that exclusive fish yo. On my second visit here I ventured into some dessert, and it was also insanely good. That matcha white chocolate brownie is so good I want to share my last name with it. I also forgot to mention the rolls, try the real crab California rolls and see why every other sushi place doesn't compare.


Located near Festival Place in Sherwood Park, Kobachi is worth the drive. Service here was decent the first visit but clumsy on my second visit. Maybe it was training day but who knows.  Make a reso if your party is over 4 as there's only one large table and bar/window seating. There is also free parking underground for 2 hours.


Sal says: Just Eat It (4.5/5)

@ruejb says: Sushi so tasty, couldn't even take a photo. Perfect excample of the saying: Big things come in small packages.

Met with a friend at this restaurant this past Saturday night, first visit for me, my friend had been at this restaurant serveral times and highly recommended this restaurant.  She was absolutely right on, I found the service to be top draw and food was excellent.  The waitress explained the menu and told me which items were spicy and at what level.  
All the staff were attentive and courteous.  They were very busy for time that we were there but
all the staff stayed courteous and attentive to our needs.
I definitely will return to this restaurant and will recommend to friends.
Keep up the good work!!!
Harold N.

So authentic. Never had a bad meal. Cozy as heck, but a must for reservations as so popular. Sherwood Park had no Mexican Restaurants until them... now we have 3. Believe it's because they're so fantastic & popular.

A hole in the wall for authentic Mexican food! La patrona is a Mexican restaurant located in Sherwood park. I ordered the vegetarian tacos. They had refried beans, veggies and avocado. The dish has rice on the side. The tacos were very well seasoned and portions are great. 

As a dessert I ordered the churros which were delicious. 

Overall the restaurant is great. The only only thing would be to have more clear vegetarian options.
Best fast food chicken you can buy (better than KFC, Popeyes, etc). I come here every Monday for Big Mary Monday.

I often stop at Walmart on the road to grab drinks and snacks for my trip.  I bought $30 of drinks and snacks, and paid with $100 US bill.  Attendant tried to give me $35 and change in Candian dollars.  When trying to explain she told me that the transaction was closed and she could not help me.  I stood in line at customer service to do a refund to have the customer service try and give me $100 candian when the value was $133.  I had to demand my 100 us bill returned.  Shaddy.  Careful is you are US, I suspect that this happens often.  I would not expect this from Walmart, they usually run a tight ship.

Went here again today. Needed to pick up a new toy for my Jenday conure and wasn't disappointed. We also found out that we could get replacement shoes for a hanging toy. Whenever we go here we check out the birds up for adoption, and they always look so healthy. Staff are friendly and knowledgeable.

My family and I were on a last minute staycation and decided to visit the Ukrainian Heritage Museum. We stayed in Sherwood Park and Yelp said there was a Japanese Village nearby. 
If I'm correct Edmonton has two JV's to Calgary's one.
It's the same experience as the one in Calgary where they grill your food in front of you.
We had a female chef (rarity) only one other time have I had a female, and that was in Whistler.
Our chef was friendly and did a good job cooking our meals. O think she was a little new, as she was a little slow with the tricks. 
They have the familiar sauces, sesame and ginger.
The one noted exception is that this location doesn't include dessert with your meal. Ice cream or sherbet is offered at all other JV's I've been to.
Other than that if you're familiar with JV's nothing new here. Just Teppanyaki at it's best.

Cora's knock-off.
I have never checked the corporate timeline...but even if this place came first...it's a Cora's knock off.
Tried it once as a Cora's alternative.
Same "mountain io fruit" presentation.
Smaller place.
Food was ok.
Service was ok.
Me myself and I will just stick to Cora's.

Since it was our 10 year anniversary and we had had much bigger plans but had to cancel them due to COVID, we decided to try this lovely steakhouse. This was our first restaurant experience since COVID began (about 6 months), and all I can say is wow! What an absolutely wonderful and fantastic experience from start to finish. 

First, the food. Everything we had from apps to entrees and drinks was fabulous. We had the crab cakes to start, these were so good. And the basil cream sauce that came with them was lick-the-plate-worthy! I actually wiped the plate with our complementary bread to get every last ounce of that sauce. Yum! My steak & lobster with mashed potatoes was scrumptious. I definitely had a few bites  where I closed my eyes and sighed. My husband's shrimp linguini was also very good. And I chose a delicious Spanish red wine, which I had never had and am now searching for. And to top it all off we ordered the trio of desserts which came with a lovely "Happy Anniversary" written one chocolate. So thoughtful! And that creme brule was to die for! 

Second, the service. Everyone we encountered here was polite, friendly and accommodating. Our server Emily was sweet and upbeat and made me feel comfortable, as I was a little unsure as to the new etiquette around masks in a restaurant. I love that you can take them off while you are at your table, it really made the night feel just like it used to. And we even had the manager stop by our table and thank us for celebrating our anniversary with them. Included a card with a sweet message from our server and a coupon for a free app for next time. Again fantastic service. 

All together it made for a wonderful evening. Great job Chop staff, thank you for making our anniversary a night to remember. We will definitely be back!

A nearby vet recommended I bring my dog here over the other emergency vet in town since it was a "new facility with great staff". They operate on a triage system and I unfortunately had the luck of bringing my dog here on a busy night. He was sick,  but not sick enough to be seen quick.  We waited an hour to be triaged by the vet tech then another hour before he was seen by the veterinarian. I was then told it would be a few more hours before he could get any tests done,  so I opted to just make him comfortable, take him home and I would follow up with my regular vet tomorrow.  I was then hoping for a speedy discharge,  but it ended up taking over another hour.  I hope they bring on more staff to resolve the long wait times. 

Staff seem friendly although when I had called previously to inquire about whether they had a specific specialty on staff, the reception was not very helpful/ knowledgeable at all.  It felt like I had to do a lot of prompting to get answers about my pet though.  Pricing comparative to other emergency vet hospitals.

Absolutely loved this place. I am disappointed in myself for never going to this place even though I live minutes away. 

They roast their own coffee right in house which is awesome. 

The prices are right in line with Starbucks, Remedy etc. but love the fact they're local and will 100% support them.

I booked for a regular pedicure and shellac manicure, nothing extravagant.  During my pedicure, I was pampered. Leg massage with exfoliation, foot massage, more leg massage with lotion, more foot massage.  I thought that maybe I should have made my intentions clear when I called and was sure that I'd be paying more than I'd intended for what I thought was extra service.  My manicure was just basic with only a clear shellac (I have horrible, soft,finger nails and no polish has ever lasted more than a few hours). After more than 2 weeks polish on my toes and fingers are still holding up better than ever.  Oh - forgot to mention that I was shocked when I was only charged  $35 for such a relaxing pedicure.  I'm definitely going to go back!

This is a bit of a diamond in the rough. I don't necessarily love the area of the location, but the cafe is great. Staff is friendly and knowledgeable. I tried the Nitro coffee and it was great! Very flavourful. The atmosphere is super relaxed as well. Will be back to try more from the menu soon!

Once you have nachos here, nothing else compares.

It's quick to get food once you order regardless of how busy they are.

Great service from Camilo and looking forward to my next excuse to go there for lunch or dinner!
I keep trying to like this place because I always read great reviews. I have never had a good experience. The food is ok and the service is terrible.

Ive gone here a few times for a pedicure and it has always been good. This time I went for a gel polish. Ive gotten the gel polish before, and they usually last about 2-3 weeks. Not this one,  they started peeling 2 days later.  I wont go back there for the gel polish

So I have been here a handful of times in the last 4 years. The food is always excellent. Nothing i have had was not welcomed. It is generally a small place, so perhaps an expansion might be needed. I love everything but this last time I had the Huarache .House-made corn flatbread topped with refried beans, lettuce, salsa Mexicana, sour cream, feta, avocado and drizzled with cilantro vinaigrette. It is my new favourite. I also love the chicken enchiladas.  I do find the seating not comfortable. I wish they would do something different with the chairs. Otherwise it is pleasant inside. 
Save room for the tres leche cake. It is amazing.

it's funny since i used to work here, and nothing has changed other than the self-checkout expansion. lots of employees standing round chatting to each other, straight up saw someone walk out with a ton of groceries (stole them) & it took them a while to figure it out & he got away. got i stock but if you need help, you're on your own, the staff still suck, so glad i left when i did.

Not a great establishment staff are either nice or not nice at all. Every time or two I go there I always say never again in my head. Tim Hortons gave me Stockholm syndrome I am free to leave but always end up coming back I honestly don't know why at this point I am debating on boycotting them the only thing stopping me is the good service I get at other locations.

I've eaten JACEK chocolate many times before but finally visited their Sherwood Park location in person for the first time. It is magical. Right when you open the door, you are overwhelmed by the smell of delicious milky chocolate.

Their front counter is a showcase of all the beautifully decorated chocolates they create and the walls are all lined with preboxed and bagged creations. I had pre-ordered their annual advent calendar but I wasn't able to resist also picking up a couple more treats for the holidays.

As for the advent calendar? It isn't cheap but absolutely worth it. Getting to eat a surprise JACEK chocolate has been the highlight of my mornings this December and it's a good way to force you to stop after one!

Finally a serious coffee shop in Sherwood Park! Far and way the best coffee available in town. They know their stuff and even roast the beans in house. 

Beautiful spot to hang, delicious coffee, and friendly staff. Don't waste your time at Tim Horton's and support something local!

Friendly staff.  Large interior space, kind of modern.  They make ground coffee bean blends for businesses.  The inside smells like coffee beans.  Prices are reasonable for a latte. I saw a few muffins. In a strip mall with free parking.  They sell t shirts and caps and mugs if you are groupie.

I would recommend this place to every1. Very clean, warm and relaxing. I felt so relaxed and had this overall feeling of
