Excellent atmosphere. The coffee is just excellent. Strong, delicious and great selection. I love local shops that aren't your typical chain. Roasti is a local favourite!

Great little place run by Kimmy who is a doll.  Tran is also very nice and often there is a very nice 3rd lady there too.  Very clean and pleasant and a focus on customer service and satisfaction.  Kim is a very kind and gracious host.  I attend here regularly and highly recommend it.

My wife had mentioned to me how much I needed to find a way to shut my brain off for a bit and reboot. My reply was "that's what I do when I sleep" but then she pointed out how little I sleep and how even when I do it is quite often a broken sleep. "No worries" I said, "I have been doing this for 46 years why would I need to change it now"
She suggested something called floating, I told her "honey, you know drugs are not my thing' knowing full well that was not what she meant. 
This summer she had taken a month and dedicated it to try different things such as exercises, massages, therapies of all kinds in a search for what worked for her. One of the things she found was something called Float Therapy. It sounds odd doesn't it. 
They put you into a tank filled with water that is loaded with Epsom Salt and you close the lid on yourself for 90 minutes. This to me sounded insane, not that you would close yourself in a water filled coffin, but more that you would willingly give up 90 minutes of your life like that! 
Turns out there is actual science behind this, it's not all voodoo smoke and mirrors stuff. Regular flotation tank sessions can relieve chronic stress-related ailments. Conditions such as anxiety, stress, depression and fibromyalgia will find noticeable improvements. 
I know how stressful my wife's job can be and I figured if this is what she recommended to me after all the research she had done I would be a fool not to at least try it. So I went to this place in Sherwood Park we have called Float Wellness to try for myself and see what it's about. 
Well, as she is more often than not, she was right (don't tell her that). My experience at first was that of mass confusion not knowing how to relax was a huge deficit to me here. But time was on my side, about 10 minutes in I found myself actually tuning out, I had no place to be, I had no work to do, I did not even have a my iPhone to use, talk about torture. Turns out it wasn't torture at all but rather a feeling of calmness. I was not feeling the need to message or tweet or make a post on Facebook, it was just me alone with nothing to do. The lack of stimulation is exactly what the doctor ordered. 
I would recommend this for anyone out there who struggles with letting things go, take a float you won't regret it. The recharge will open your mind even clearer than it was before.

It checks all the boxes.  Nice cozy dining atmosphere.  Friendly staff.  Good food albeit a tad more expensive, and extra to get meat with the meal, but it is authentic. Worst Burrito I've ever had. Flavourless. Bland. Underwhelming. Huge disappointment for lunch.

fuck this place! the food was cold and old i could tell. i went through the drive thru ravenous for a turkey melt, when i ordered this delicious snack they just said no. on another occasion, i went to timmies at 4:30 pm on a sunday, waited 20 minutes in line only to find out that they were closing in 10 minutes and couldn't serve me. bruh moment. i'm boycotting and you should too.

Jenâs Nails is a little, non-descript esthetics shop in Sherwood Park I popped into on the weekend because I couldnât get into my usual place to get my eyebrows waxed. It was a particularly slow day when I walked into the shop. 

It was empty, but for me and Jenâs work associate, Cindy. She was friendly and agreed to do my eyebrows at once. The shop is very plain, much like the rest of drive-thru mani-pedi places. They have a couple of pedicure chairs with foot baths and a manicure station, plus a back room for other body waxing services. She just had me sit down on a stool right there in the shop and waxed my brows. 

She used a Popsicle stick and wax that mustâve been heated a hundred times. Iâm not even sure the Popsicle stick was new. I watched as she reached for the tweezers and the scissors, to trim, and neither had been disinfected. They just want back into a little container afterwards. The cream she put on my eyelids afterwards was greasy, and stung briefly.

 Afterwards, upon looking in the mirror, I wasnât really impressed with the shaping. I just wanted a clean-up, but she managed to kill the shape that used to be there. I was totally unimpressed with this place. The price was $10, which I think a brow wax should be. But the quality was low, and she should have at least had me lie down on a bed, like most other places do. I will not go back.

After running some errands in Sherwood Park, we decided to grab some takeout to eat at home. La Patrona showed up near that top on Yelp and when I saw they had one of my all-time favourite dishes on the menu, chile relleno, I knew I had to try it.

As soon as I got home and put my meal on a plate, I knew it was going to be good. I can only imagine how much better their food looks when you can dine in. First few bites were incredible. The batter covering the poblano melted in your mouth and the sauce was a great compliment. I devoured the whole thing pretty quickly and I regret nothing.

Right now they are offering some of their signature margaritas to go along with a variety of house made sauces and salsas. The restaurant is pretty tiny so I'd definitely recommend a reservation when things get back to normal. The food is absolutely worth the drive in from Edmonton but that being said, I'd hate to drive all the way to Sherwood Park only to find out I couldn't get a table.

To say I was impressed is an understatement. La Patrona is near the top of my list of places to visit once dining in is safe again.

Actually, if I could give it a 3.5 star rating I would. Few things that  I love about this restaurant...authentic ethnic food in Sherwood park, really cute inside, and the chef is definitely passionate about what he cooks.  A few things that  I didn't like so much... it took us a long time to be sat down at a table and to be served. I can't say that our server was super attentive, however it was very busy for a lunchtime on a Tuesday. It also took awhile for us to receive our bill.  Also, prices were a little high compared to other Latino restaurants that I frequent. My friend and I ordered a taco sampler platter and picked Pollo - Grilled chicken marinated in Guajillo sauce, Suadero Slow-braised brisket, and Cochinita  -Slowly braised pork wrapped in banana leaves with oranges, achiote and Mexican spices. Served with pickled purple onion and habanero peppers. They came all hot and nicely presented. Definitely the Cochinita was our favourite. Really great spices in that one. We also tried the sides of rice and beans. The beans were fantastic! I would really order this one again.  I think my biggest issue is that generally when you order tacos, tortas, etc. they typically come with a side of rice and beans to begin with. Since the prices were a little higher than what is typical, it is irritating to have to pay for the sides as an extra. Would I eat here again? Sure.  It was fresh and tasty and definitely authentic.  I would like to try the tortas as well as some of their specials. If I was craving Latino food would I seek out this place first...no. If you are in the park and craving some traditional food and don't mind waiting definitely check it out.

Newly opened in Sherwood Park in October, 2012. Mary Browns offers fried chicken and related items in a quality far better than KFC. At this location, the staff are friendly and quick. Seating is limited in the restaurant but it seems most people come in for take out so it's not a problem.

I wanted to try something different and local so we went here and it was so cool! Half of the place was where they roast coffee and the other part is where you can sit down and enjoy your cup. Cool decor and great tasting chai tea latte.
Best most authentic sushi in Edmonton hands down. Reminds me of Japan!

I have been going to Namaste for therapeutic massages for a few years now and I can't say enough great things about them!! They are extremely friendly, clean and professional. I usually go see Jai or Prenaka for my massages, and have recommended them to family and friends, all of whom have also had a good experience! Definitely give this place a try, you will not be disappointed!

Such a great place! I really love it here! Staff is always helpful, and willing to answer whatever weird questions we may have. I love that the city has a place just for birds. Staff has helped us pick out an appropriate size cage for our cockatiel and helped us pick out the best food for our new African Grey when we where unsure. I've recommended this place to some of my other friends and will continue to recommend!

We had the steak bites for appetizer which were wonderful, the sauces they come with pair so wonderful. Usually, when we come to a place like this we would order steak and wine but coming out with a newborn we need to be in and out. I ended up choosing the chop burger and onion rings and my husband did a full rack of ribs. Honestly, the food was really good but the service really struggled. I've been a waitress for 9 years so I understand but it definitely put a hindrance on dinner. She did mention it was only her second day. We ordered another round of drinks when dinner came and they never came. They cleared all our cutlery off at appetizers and when our dinner came out we had no cutlery for nearly 10 minutes so food was lukewarm. We tried to flag someone down but did not succeed. We asked if we could have sauce for the onion rings as nothing came with them and that never came either. Overall, we'd try again in the future because the food was good.
Great little neighbourhood coffee shop. REALLY good fresh coffee. Nice people.
Very delicious food! The shrimp are huge and amazing, steak was great and the service was awesome.

What started out as a popular food truck (Casa12Doce) became an actual restaurant in 2017, helmed by a chef who was born and raised in Mexico City. Sherwood Park's La Patrona is another great example of the vibrant Latin community that the Edmonton area is fortunate enough to boast. Voted #1 Worth the Trip: Sherwood Park 2018 in VUE Weekly, I was really looking forward to making the (short) trip myself. The restaurant is located in a particularly nice and rustic-looking shopping area where a lot of beautiful wood is used on the façade and as beams. The inside is alive with colours while also maintaining a very cool exposed-concrete-and-tin kind of industrial look. There are nods to Mexico everywhere, from the beautiful Día de Muertos skulls to the amazing music playing through the speakers. I loved the hanging string lights and the overall lively atmosphere. The staff was incredibly warm and friendly and made us feel right at home. The vibe of the restaurant demanded a Traditional Margarita (El Jimador, Triple Sec, fresh lime shaken over ice then strained - $9.00)! They have a bunch of great cocktails on the menu and of course plenty of cerveza, but it had to be the margarita for me. They offer it in four different flavours (classic lime being the original) and they also rotate a special flavour of the day. On my visit they were doing a spicy mango one and I had to give that a try. If you ever see a margarita made in one of those slush machines - just know that that isn't the way that a real margarita is made. At first sip this drink was like a punch to the face! It was both boozy and spicy and didn't shy away from being packed full of huge flavours. I loved the spicy rim and the actual pieces of jalapeno floating within the drink. The juicy mango flavour worked really well to create that coveted spicy/sweet combination. Not for the faint of heart, this margarita is the real deal. They also serve horchata, one of my favourite non-alcoholic drinks. I look forward to trying their version in the future.  The food menu was full of lots of things that I wanted to eat and I began with the Para Empezar section to get started. They've got a tortilla soup, which I always love (must try next time!), but I had to select the Queso Fundido (Melted cheese in a piping hot skillet served with wheat tortillas for dipping and fresh salsa Mexicana - $21.00) which literally translates to "melted cheese." You know that you want that. It comes in one of those sizzling cast iron skillets that will definitely burn you. But I can think of nothing better than a bubbling pan of hot melty cheese with golden brown crispy edges. I absolutely loved the ultra-fresh tortillas, which are very clearly housemade and have a beautiful light flavour. The molten, oozing cheese was surprisingly herbaceous and I was caught off guard by all of the delicious seasoning that goes into this dish. The bright salsa was a wonderful way to bring in a fresh component. Each bite was a delight. If you're a cheese lover (who isn't?!) this is most certainly the dish of your dreams.  La Patrona is well stocked with many types of tacos and tortas to choose from. They've got eleven different tacos and eight different tortas, each one sounding delicious in its own way. Most people probably select from this part of the menu and I'm sure that it's a solid choice every time. However, I was interested in the De Mi Casa section of the menu which seems to be where the true authentic offerings are found, straight from the chef's home and heritage. The chile relleno sounded absolutely incredible and it's what I will be ordering on my next visit. This time I went with the Enchiladas de Pollo (Corn tortillas stuffed with seasoned chicken topped with your choice of Salsa Tomate (mild), Salsa Verde (medium) or Roja (spicy) sauce. Baked with cheese and served with onion, tomato, avocado and cilantro - $24.00) since I loves me an enchilada. A classic Mexican dish, I always enjoy this saucy, cheesy, savoury mixture of hot and fresh flavours. I had mine with the medium salsa verde, which added a beautiful green hue to the entire plate. The corn tortillas had a nice bite to them, enveloping the shredded chicken within. I enjoyed the heat and freshness from the salsa verde very much and made sure to cover each bite with plenty of it. The melty, gooey cheese was one of the best parts and the tomato and avocado did a nice job of balancing out the dish. The portion is large and the flavours feel quite authentic.  The dessert menu at La Patrona is awesome because they've got all of the hits! Churros? Yup. Tres leches cake? My favourite! But the most unique item is their Chocolate Jalapeno Cake (House made chocolate cake layered with jalapeno jelly, chocolate ganache and a coffee crumble. Served with a tequila truffle ball - $11.00), something that I'd never tried before. This cake seemed pretty special. Deep and rich, it wasn't too sweet and really played into the robust flavours of dark

Sucks that the only place available on a Christmas night at 10 is the most expensive vet I've ever been too and there was nothing I can even do.

I needed to go here because my hair needed corrective color and this was the only place that could get e in asap. and now I see why they had so much availability. in my desperate state of needing my hair fixed I was taken advantage of.
The only reason I gave 2 stars is becaue my hair looked better then when I walked in (not a big improvement).

Cherish is a remarkable salon! Their staff is so welcoming along with the decor! Whenever I get my hair done here I feel like a million bucks walking out! There arent many salons in sherwood park or Edmonton that uses Davines products, which makes this place a very special place! They also are very environmentally friendly and recycle everything in the salon, even the hair!! All in all I would recommend this salon to anyone who needs their hair done, I promise you will love it!!

A fast food meal that tastes fresh and leaves you with a "little" less guilt for eating fast food :P

The burritos are very tasty and full of flavour. The only thing that sucks for me is all of their salsas have cilantro and I am one of those people where cilantro tastes like soap, I can't do it. 

My wife and I grabbed the Southwest buttermilk chicken for our kids and obviously tried one. They use dark meat so the chicken was juice and quite good, the breading lacked flavour. 

For dessert, we always grab one of these cookies each. They are unbelievably good and addictive. I am not much of a dessert after dinner type person unless I am eating at Burrito Libre.

It checks all the boxes.  Nice cozy dining atmosphere.  Friendly staff.  Good food albeit a tad more expensive, and to get meat with the meal, but it is authentic. Good for couples. Mexican
Music. Nice view into the stainless steel kitchen.  Chile relleno could use a bit of spice.  Enchiladas medium sauce has some kick to it. Cocktails and beers. Popular for lunch. Even a couple small TVs if you insist on not missing a game. Has a small patio.

If you want to get treated like you know nothing about your pet and pay stupidly high prices, go to Pulse. I took my dog in on Saturday as she became very ill very fast. We have been looking for good Mexican food in the Edmonton area since we moved back here about 4 years ago. After living in Phoenix for 15 years we enjoyed a lot of great Mexican food. My wife is a bit of a Mexican food junkie. We are glad we found this restaurant. Excellent service. Friendly staff. I had the Tacos Gringa and my wife had the Taco Al Pastor. They were both excellent. Quite tasty. Our only complaint was the miniscule size of the side of  refried beans.  While the food was excellent, and we'll likely come here again, we do think the prices are probably 10-15% higher than we think would make this a great value.

They have really poor customer service.  We went in their store looking for a suit for my fiance.  He was measured and everything.  The suit was supposed to be custom as we were looking for certain colors to match my dress.  We wasted a good hour and a half in that store, selecting the style of suit, dress shirt, tie etc.  The dude, a younger fella, told me I would receive a e-mail from them within 2 weeks after they have a chance to send us samples of ties. He was rude on the phone, told me that my e-mail probably ended up on junk and that he'll take a look at it, and reply back.  2 months down the road and STILL NO E-MAIL. I have been going to Jenn's since it opened.  CIndy and Kevin are always friendly and have provided great service. I get my nails done there and have received many compliments. I have had waxing and pedicures many times. The salon has had extensive renos  and looks great. They have expanded their services. If you are looking for a friendly place with great service and quality, this is it.

I went to this place tonight with my husband. It smelled good when we walked in, the place had only a few groups of people there so I expected a good service.  It took 20 minutes for the appetizer, about 30 minutes later the main course came.  The waiter never asked us if everything was OK until we were well into the meal.  For about 30 minutes we waited for the check.  The food was blah.  The chai tea was not like the usual aromatic, flavorful, authentic chai tea I was used to at other Indian restaurants.  The snotty waiter said, "Well we have to put some spice mam or the food has no flavor" when I asked him to give me a 0 on the 0-5 scale of spiciness.  I pointed out that spices are great, just not hot ones, he almost rolled his eyes at me.  Isn't that the point of the spiciness scale they put on their menus? I've actually made chicken tika masala myself and my own homemade garam masala spice combination so I know about Indian spices!  The jerk smiled when we went to pay and no, of course, my husband did not tip him.  What a lousy place.  I don't recommend anyone goes here unless McDonalds or something crappy is closed.

Hands down the best Me I am restaurant that I've ever been to.  My friend & I agree that it's our new favourite restaurant in the city. Staff are friendly & helpful. Must have an appetizers, you won't be sorry. I suggest making a reservation as the restaurant isn't big. The atmosphere is relaxing & quaint. Music was at the level that you can still have a conversation without yelling. It's worth every penny as the portions are quite large. Hope you go & enjoy!

Purest sashimi and sushi in the Edmonton area. I have not tasted such melt in your mouth sashimi since I was in Japan. Fresh and you can taste the ocean. Not much to look like like on the inside or outside but clean. I hope they do expand because three tables don't do well in January when you want to eat. There are three that fit two a piece and a bit of a bar. Not a huge menu but enough to please sushi and non sushi lovers alike. my non sushi friend ordered the beef bento box while i did the shashimi bento box. Everything was flavourful. Loved the fresh salad with dressing. We enjoyed the veggies that came with bento. My girlfriend enjoyed her beef, but the sashimi was amazing. I can't stress how fresh it was. I don't think i can eat anywhere else after I ate here. I would like to try some rolls for take out. For the quality of food, it is so worth the money.

The worst     Took fur baby in for a check    Waited in car for 4 hours as Covid had it curb side only.    Then they said I will get in only after all these EMERGENCIES are dealt with.   Just a bunch of BS.

Whether it's the chocolate bars or the little Easter chocolates, you feel like you're opening up something fancy (exactly what my friends said and I honestly think that too!). Super easy to order online and they're really good with email alerts, replying to questions and the pick up instructions. They're only operating out of the Sherwood Park location now but I promise you, Jacek chocolate definitely has curbside pick up down to a fine art. 

I pulled up, hadn't even called the number on the instructions and someone was already near the vehicle asking about my order. It came out in a lovely bag to be handed through my window. It included a printout of the order so I could do a quick check everything was there without having to go through my phone.  

I got an assortment of chocolate bars as I had a few people I wanted to leave an Easter surprise at their door and for some future thank you gifts. Well maybe one for me too! 

The Whisky bar was a big hit with my friends! I also ordered some standards (Frank, Audrey, Marguerite) and some new to me (Okalani & Whiskey). So it will be interesting to know what the general opinion is from everyone but for those that already received their Easter bunny (or I joked Jacek rabbit) surprise have already devoured them. 

No matter what, I think it's always good to have some chocolate on hand. So you might as well have very good chocolate if you're going to eat a sweet. Also, I should add that next year I'll have to think about ordering chocolate a month before. Then I can get an opportunity to try out those decadent eggs, mini eggs and other Easter items such as the rabbits (they were mostly sold out by the time I placed my order thinking about our yelp online event). The little Easter lambs (cookies & cream) I was able to order for the kids were placed in one long box and were reported to be super delicious!

Definitely will be ordering directly from the store again. Over all simple process and such a great way to still celebrate Easter in a very social distant way.

I was gifted a Jacek advent calendar this holiday season.  This was my introduction to the chocolates of Jacek.  Everyday I look forward to the chocolate, to see what it looks like, to taste the flavours, and to crack open the little gift that each day an advent calendar brings.  Early in the calendar there was a salted caramel that was so good I ordered 3 boxes for pickup. This is good chocolate and fairly priced.

Show you care!    the Charges are INSANE !    us little people try and care for our pets the best we can - I thought Vets and Vets teams main concern is for the pet!

Sushi

I love sushi and there are many amazing Japanese restaurants in Edmonton. Most of you know it already, but this place isn't in Edmonton, but is located in Sherwood Park, @kobachi_restaurant is hands down my favourite place for sushi!

They are a small mom and pop shop with very limited seatings that focus on a small menu to bring you the best and freshest sushi possible. Seats fill up fast, so call to make reservations, or call in advance, place an order, pick it up and get it to go like I did.

Something about their sushi that just looks so simple, so clean and taste so good and fresh. I typically order sushi for myself and always worry I will order too much, but as soon as I'm done eating and with regret, I wish I should have ordered more. Lol.

Our family has been going to Tutti Frutti for several years, and one of the best features was their gluten free options. However, recently they started up-charging for each gluten free item in the order... I paid an extra $5.85 for a meal couple weeks ago for a "gluten free Sausage, crepe and toast" on a menu item. Yesterday, I was charged an extra $3.90 for gluten free toast and waffle. At most establishments, you'd pay a single premium for a gluten free plate, but they have implemented this predatory pricing for those of us with dietary restrictions. For those of us with a Gluten sensitivity, we are well aware of the premium we pay not to have unnecessary wheat products added to meat or other products, and to be charged the price of a whole loaf of gluten free bread (and a low quality product at that), I have no sympathy for the owners. I am very disappointed at this predatory pricing model and will not be recommending this restaurant for anyone with food sensitivities or allergies.

Update time: I'm still a fan of Derks, but four stars seems more appropriate than five.  Our rental experience from Derks was overall quite positive, with only a few issues that bumped them down from five stars.  The tuxes we ordered were great.  All the men in our bridal party looked fantastic, and I loved that my husband got his rental free with four other rentals.  

Why the four stars?  A few reasons.  One of our groomsmen was extremely busy travelling for work, and wasn't able to get measured until four weeks before the wedding.  Derks started calling me weekly around mid-July, and I really appreciate that they care that we get our measurements done in time for the wedding, but the constant calling just kept adding to my anxiety - if he is not in town, I can't package him up and bring him down the store.  The final fitting process was also quite confusing.  The majority of our pieces were good, save for the members of our party who had experienced significant weight loss and needed different pant sizes.  After the final fitting was done, they walked away with the tuxes.  After 5-10 minutes a sales associate would come back and tell us they were ready to take the rest of the money for the tux and hand it over.  We weren't sure where they were going, and the one groomsmen that went on his own actually ended up leaving the store without his tux because they disappeared without telling him they would be back.  

Finally, I would caution people to keep their receipts.  Our best man paid in full for his rental at his first fitting, but the store didn't keep a record of it and insisted he only paid the deposit.  He didn't seem too concerned, but his receipt was at home in Toronto and he was unable to prove he had already paid the full rental and was forced to pay another $200 to leave with the tux.  I am glad no one else in our party pre-paid, one instance of this was troubling enough.  He plans to get a refund when he finds the receipt at home, but it is an unnecessary hassle.  I didn't find out about this until after the wedding, otherwise I probably would have argued the issue at the store.  

If I had to do it all over again, I'd still order from Derks, but I wouldn't be so trusting of their record-keeping.

This is definitely my favourite breakfast and lunch place. They have the best "homemade" bagels. There coffee is also surprisingly good too. 

It's a quiet place but it's perfect to bring family and friends. Would definitely recommend this place 10/10.

This was my first time at Sumo Sumo and it was decent. I have to say the decor and ambience was excellent and perhaps the cost of that went into the menu pricing. I was there for luncheon and wanted a quick and easy order - I went with the Sukiyaki Beef Bento box. 
The miso soup it came with was good. The salad looked ok, the California rolls were great - but I'm a sucker for those. The main dish though, was just ok. It was filling to a point, but it did lack in a fair amount of flavour. 
It could have been a busy lunch. The service was fine and the tea was just fine. 
I can't really say that it was an exceptional experience, but also not a bad one. 
It was...fine.

First things first, the food is amazing. We had the chips with guacamole and salsa and it was delicious. Next I had both the pescado and the asada tacos which were both excellent. My gf had the pollo enchilada which she also enjoyed, I tried some and the tomato sauce was incredible. Easily the best mexican food that I have had in Edmonton. The restaurant itself is smaller but very cozy and our server was very nice giving recommendations and answering any questions we had. Will definitely be eating here again

Without a doubt the best sushi you'll have in the Edmonton area. I'll keep coming back until they prove me wrong, and even should that happen... I'ma keep coming. 

Each bite was so perfect! So fresh! It felt like such a treat and delicacy to be eating takeout from here, not something I've felt while eating any other takeout sushi. My boyfriend and I each got a sushi combo (thumbs up for placing both orders in a container together! eco friendly vibes) and shared an order of the real crab California rolls, as well as the Fuji apple creme brûlée and the matcha white chocolate brownies, and washed it all down with their yuzu-nade. I recommend all of it! 

I wish I could post a more in-depth and descriptive review, but saying that everything was delicious and pretty much perfect will have to suffice!

YES!!!! Finally good sushi!!

First of all, the decor and ambiance of Sumo Sumo is fantastic, upon walking in I was already impressed. All together though, the feel of the place truly enhanced the dining experience. Not to mention the service was friendly and very hospitable. 

Onto the food... YUM! The rolls we ordered were absolutely delicious!! Especially Joe's Special Roll.... SO GOOD!! I would definitely recommend that one if you decide to go. I appreciated the creativity that encompassed their selection of rolls. They offered a lot of inventive rolls, that weren't too obscure. Of everything I tried so far, my favourite would have to be the Spicy Tempura Maki, words cannot describe how mouth watering delicious it was. 

So without question, you should add this place to your list of restaurants to try; in fact, you should move this place to the top of your list. I will definitely be a repeat customer, and once you try it, so will you!

We took our ailing cat here over the Canada Day weekend - to say the experience was unpleasant would be a gross understatement

The staff as a whole are cold, clinical & come across as money grabbers

Instead of listening to our needs they simply wanted to be paid & then called repeatedly in the wee hours of the morning to say that they had not saw our payment 

The only bright spot was the kind and caring Dr Thompson - she listened, provided her opinion on the care for our ailing cat

Best bagel I've ever had. It is only slightly pricier than the average grocery store, but the difference in quality for these extra few cents is unmeasurable. So fresh and soft. The service was excellent as well, the owners were very hospitable, kind, and informative. I would most definitely recommend stopping by and grabbing a few bagels, I know for a fact that I will be going back!

If you're not from the Sherwood Park area like me this store is still worth checking out. For starters they have a large selection and good stock. A year ago I called every store in Edmonton to finally and luckily call Sports Closet to find out they had what I needed in stock. 
But what I really want to do is shoutout to experience I had this week at Sport Closet. The store staff helped me have one of the best experience I've had in a long time! The staff are so helpful and friendly. And now I've got myself a nice new oilers jersey :)

We spotted their sign on a drive this afternoon and decided to taste-test this evening. 

The restaurant is quite small, very cosy and pleasant way. We were greeted immediately and seated. 

The menus are fairly straightforward with a good selection. I'd love a little more indication of whether things are vegetarian, but our server let me know that the kitchen is pretty flexible. 

I had the memelas, made specially vegetarian. Very tasty. Thoroughly enjoyed the homemade tortilla. My husband had the sirloin torta, which he says melted in his mouth. Our daughter had the veggie tacos and they were also delicious. I think I will order them next we go. 

For dessert, we had the churros and the flan to share between us. The flan was good, but the churros were fantastic. 

The service was great and the chef/owner himself came out to make sure we were happy. 

I highly recommend this place. We will definitely be back.

One of the best if not THE best chocolatier in Edmonton and dare say Canada?! I've been a fan of Jacqueline's chocolate creations for almost 10 years now. Today i ventured to their beautifully expanded original location in Sherwood Park. The space is beautiful and sophisticated, exactly like the star of the boutique - their chocolates. Service is always super pleasant and friendly! The drive from downtown Edmonton is definitely worth it now that the downtown location was closed (a casualty of COVID). Speaking of which, hand sanitizer is ready at the door and everyone in sight was masked. Signs outside indicate the option for curb side pickup as well! Great job adapting to these uncertain times

Went once before Covid and I really enjoyed it. They place is small, but it definitely leaves a large impact on your dining experience. All staff were so friendly and knowledgeable! I was able to have the opportunity to sit at the bar and watch the chefs create all the dishes right in front of me. Everything was delicate, very fresh, and unique! They had a special duck udon the day I went and the flavour of the soup was an umami bomb! I dream about it to this day. Fish was sooooo fresh and portions were really nice! All items adding up can get expensive, but it was definitely worth the experience! I can't wait to come back for dining again!

Tried there once for lunch. Decent mexican but far from what you get in USA. Tried to go there for dinner with family and fully booked for night. Not sure how this is good service or worth planning several days in advance if I'm going to eat overpriced mexican food.

My new favourite Mexican food restaurant which serves up fresh authentic food. Not too greasy like a lot of fake Mexican places serve up. Staff was super friendly and the chef had even said hi to us that evening.

Beautiful local coffee shop that recently expanded their shop to have more seating and still have room to roast beans. With social distancing the shop atmosphere and enjoyment is closed to public but deliveries can still happen. And they really do make them happen! 

When I called they weren't open yet. I got a text back from Andrew not even a couple hours later asking if I wanted to place an order. That just blew me away! Their voicemail made it sound like the coffee shop was closed for the day and I was going to wait for another day to place an order by the directions on the message. 

Andrew was super helpful, polite and just a generally thoughtful guy. He selected the beans with a few things I described I liked. I also ordered a mocha (as you guessed it, I've been craving some of my regular comforts and routines) but as the machines weren't on yet, he suggested delivering the beans first and coffee later. I'm not sure if it was because I was willing to wait for them to arrive together or because they really appreciate local returning customers but again happily surprised when another text came in (I honestly don't even think it was an hour difference) saying both were on their way to me. Holy customer service! I always enjoy going into the coffee shop and chatting with staff but this was something else. 

Great drop off procedures (ring and step back to make sure someone heard the bell) and seriously the coffee made my day! Now that I'm restocked on beans to keep this social distancing continued, I guess next time I will include those tasty, tasty donuts to make minimum delivery to get another tasty mocha (mine never taste the same). I believe it's $20 to have delivery in Sherwood Park but check on their Instagram page as that's where they do all the current updates.

Heard about La Patrona from a coworker of mine.  I can't believe I didn't find out about this place sooner because IT'S FREAKING AWESOME.  

The food is top notch - good portion sizes and it tastes amazing! The horchata? Made in house,  and you can totally taste the difference; no chalkiness to it whatsoever.  I'd buy it by the jug if I could.  They do, however, sell their sauces by the bottle. We were there on a Wednesday, which was tamales night,  available in house or you can take some frozen ones home.  (tamales got the two thumbs up from my husband)

Nice,  efficient service. The servers are Spanish speaking,  which I feel lends to the authenticity of the restaurant.  

I would most definitely come here again,  even just for the horchata. 

Ample free parking.  Free wifi available.

I was running late and needed something super quick, so opted to try Burrito Libre on skip... 
They were super quick- like 10-15 min quick, and that was the best part of it, unfortunately. Seems the Southwest Buttermilk fried chicken had been extremely overcooked , it was pretty brown and dry inside, while the coating was soggy- and I dont mean soggy like it gets a bit soft after being in warm container with steam, I mean soggy like he picked it up and it fell off in chunks. The burrito bowl we got was extremely soggy as well, looked/tasted as though the rice had not been drained when it was put into the bowl. There were also banana peppers added in when we didn't ask for any. We threw almost everything out because we couldn't eat it, so just kind of a waste of money for us this time.
I WILL say though, we got chips and guac with the inedible chicken, and they were delicious, so I'm really hoping this was a one-off for the restaurant? If not, maybe just stick to the chips and burrito wraps (I've heard they're alright).
This little restaurant is, hands down, the best Mexican food in the Edmonton area. It is authentic and so tasty!

A few weeks ago I wrote a review on Chop Steakhouse and Bar. Ryan the Senior Assistsnt Manager reached out to me on Yelp wanting to rectify the evening we had. It wasn't a bad night just had a few hiccups. We went back for our weekly date night and got a variety of things. Everything was wonderful. I would never expect for a business to reach out on this app but they did which was surprising. You can tell how much they care about top quality service. We will be back in a heartbeat for our next date night. Thanks Ryan!

To those who have spoken badly about the staff, I have to vehemently disagree! My little puppy was in shock and dying and they immediately took action and did all that they could to save her! Their diagnosis was spot on, while my regular vets was horribly wrong! My little puppy died while the doctor was helping us and every member of the staff comforted us. They gave us her little paw prints and never charged us a single penny! They are the kindest and sweetest vets that I have ever dealt with! You know someone by how they treat you when you are in pain, and Pulse treated me and my little puppy with all the love and care that they could!

These are art pieces in the form of chocolate. I took the chocolate tasting tour of the Sherwood park location and learned so much about the process of making chocolate from cacao bean to the artistry and designing the chocolate. Over all, great experience, great flavours, amazing packaging. 

Perfect little gifts.

Buyer Beware. Its only been in the area less than a year, and the pizza itself has always been great. However, today during a pickup for my online order, the cashier attempted to quickly add $5 just before I was to tap my debit card. I caught the number just as it was going through so I asked for a receipt. the register was showing the $5 extra dollars then what i remember the online order coming too. The cashier adjusted the order back the 5 dollars and issued my receipt hoping I wouldn't catch the change. I quickly opened my bank app and verified the additional $5 had been charged to my account. I spoke with the manager and it was quickly resolved, however if I had not been vigilant, I would of never caught it
Hands down one of the best mexican restaurants I've ever been to. (the tacos will not disappoint you.)

After coming back from my Japan trip last fall, I never expected to taste Japan level sushi here in Edmonton until now. Kobachi's quality and freshness of sushi is mind blowing good. In my opinion, it's probably serves the freshest sushi in Edmonton. However since Edmonton is landlocked, food here is unfortunately quite pricey as well.

The sushi here is simple nigiri or maki sushi so don't expect extravegent rolls. I was surprised at how big the portion size of the fish were on the nigiri because usually other Japanese restaurants in Edmonton provide a thinner portion. All the nigiri sushi I had that night were so juicy and fresh. I especially liked the scallop becuase it melted in my mouth as I took a bite. I also ordered salmon salmon sashimi and it was thick and delicious as well.

Kobachi also has a daily specials board that's not part of their main menu. My boyfriend and I shared the Wagyu Curry Udon off it. It was flavorful and the wagyu was cooked pleasing to the tastebuds. Since I shared the dish, the curry wasn't too heavy but I feel like one person can still finish the dish without it being too heavy. 

The restaurant is a bit small so there aren't many seats. I would recommend making a reservation if you're going with a big group. Service was friendly and welcoming. Between two people, we spent around $42 per person. We didn't leave hungry but we didn't leave super full either.  It's definitely worth a place to visit but prepare to spend a bit more for the fresh quality you get.

Chorizo Con Queso $19 w/ fried egg ($2) and habanero relish ($1)
La Patrona
2 Athabascan Avenue
Sherwood Park, Alberta

I had the most incredible sandwich last night at La Patrona.

You need this Chorizo Con Queso torta in your life. I got it with a fried egg and habanero relish, resulting in more agony for my long-suffering chittar-hole, but whatever. 

The standard edition comes with feta, mozzarella, avocado, tomatoes, refried beans, chipotle mayo, and Mexican-style pork sausage. I feel this thing was tailor-made for me because it's rare for a Mexican dish not to rely on cilantro and onions. Without these dreaded ingredients, I can enjoy Mexican cuisine's beauty and don't have to worry about the aftertaste of soap and brown-guy body odour.

Unfortunately, my taste receptors are unresponsive to avocado, but the nutrient-rich fruit is good for my bones, vision, and heart. And it reduces my chances of getting cancer and depression.

Other than the avocado, I savoured every element of the sandwich. Each bite resulted in these reddish juices, comprised of heavenly grease and salt, trickling down my fingers and wrists. 

Rather than cleaning my hands with a napkin, I excused myself, taking a trip to my car to lick the sticky fluids off my hirsute hands - it was delicious, and I'm not ashamed of my savagery. I then sanitized my hands before re-entering the restaurant for dessert.

You have to try this torta. It's mind-blowingly good. And it was soundtracked by Enrique Iglesias's Hero, giving me all the feels and taking my breath away.

My Rating: 4.99/5
The food here is amazing! Great authentic Mexican cuisine. Never had a bad experience. I always look forward to coming here!

$17 for a roll, you expect more than 90% rice, a poorly rolled roll and a sliver of unagi.... This isn't worth it. Their Mexican roll came topped with cheap mild salsa that ruined the flavour of the original roll and slices of avocado on top that should have been inside. Their miso soup is bland. The scallop in the chop chop is frozen, tastes stale and gross and not worth 3.12 per piece.

Not good enough...

Stopped in for dinner on-the-run last night around 630.
Store was empty.
Staff was friendly and helpfull enough.
Decide upon a Big Mary combo with Tater poutine and a bottle of water. Total was just shy of $14.
Sandwich was smaller than I expected and mediocre at best. Coleslaw side was pretty bland. Poutine...
Well let me tell you...
I enjoy a good poutine...
And this was FAR from good.
I ate a 1/4 of the dish at best. Couldn't be bothered to make a bigger dent...even after the smaller than expected sandwich.

I really doubt I will be back.
A-MAZING!!!!  The nachos are out-of-this-world!!  I have yet to try anything that isn't a 5, and I've been going here for a few hrs now.

After a few people telling us to try New Asian Village we finally tried it and we now have our new favourite Indian food place. 

The Butter Chicken was the best Butter Chicken I have ever had. 

Pakora was delicious but could have used a little less salt. 

The Tandoori Fried Chicken was awesome, you get 4 pieces with fries and a little butter chicken sauce to dip your fries and chicken in, sooooo good.

Once again this was an absolutely wonderful experience. Despite the COVID restrictions it was still a fantastic experience. We had made reservations online, which I find super convenient. We arrived a bit early, but they had a room set up in the adjoining hotel for people to wait in. This was a very nice gesture, as the other option was to go back and wait in your car. And when it's minus 30 out, most people don't want to go back to their cars. So hats off to them for this idea. 

The large banquet "waiting" room was set up with some tables spaced far apart. We were able to order drinks while we waited. But the staff were so fast we were seated at our table in the restaurant before those drinks arrived. Once we were at our table our drinks appeared. 

Both the staff and the food were excellent as usual. Once again the crab cakes were heavenly and that basil aoli... I seriously need to find out if they'll sell me a jar of it. Super yummy. And as it was Valentine's weekend there were some nice specials. I had a steak with bernaise sauce and veggies, and a creme brule for dessert. Both were wonderful. My husband had ribs and rum cake, again both very good. 

I've said it before and I'll say it again, if you want a really great place to eat with exceptional service and virtually flawless food, come to Chop. I am never disappointed, and usually pleasantly surprised.

Exceptional Staff, gorgeous ambiance and incredible services. Lacey is a student therapist who's cupping and fascia work with massage is game changing and Seeba does such a beautiful through therapeutic massage and explains what she is doing and how it helps which not alot of therapists ive seen do, and the girls are so sweet, everyone is so above and beyond i recommend at the highest level!

I had the pleasure of coming to this place August 21 for a birthday massage and I can't tell you how happy I am to have found this place. It's very cozy and welcoming inside and the staff were very polite and cheery which always helps when you're trying out a new place for the first time. My massage was with Kassidy and her hands worked magic. We did a 1hr relaxation massage and it flew by so fast. The room was nice and large, the lighting was perfect, so was the music. Not sure was massage oil she used on me but it smelled amazing and not like your typical peppermint oil most places use. They also accept benefits if you have them. 

It's very close to the Costco in Sherwood Park and has tons of parking. They follow the COVID protocols and are super clean. 

August 30- I had the pleasure of coming back to try out some float therapy for me and my partner and it was super cool, both a first for us. The staff did an amazing job of going over everything for us. You're placed in your own single room with your pod, no need for a bathing suit because you go in your birthday suit! You shower and rinse off before going into the pod, they have showers fully stocked with shampoo and body wash. The pod has the options of blue light, multi Color light or no light, it's filled with tons of salt so you float so be warned you will feel slippery and do not get the water on your face or in your eyes (if you do they have a fresh water bottle to spray your face off). 

TIPS: They will offer you Vaseline to put over any cuts so you aren't stung by the salt water but I HIGHLY recommend you apply that to armpits or any other area you may have just shaved or waxed if you know what I mean. I'd also suggest you put Vaseline on any cracks you have such as eczema. As cool as it was the salt water really irritated my eczema and made my skin itch, also suggest you get the firm ear plugs they'll offer you and not the soft ones as they fell out repeatedly. 

WISHES: I really wish that the water could have been a tad warm/hotter. Would also be cool if you could do 30 or 45 minute sessions- I know it's an hour so you can meditate and relax but even a 45 min session woulda sufficed. It would also be cool if you had the option to play spa music or a noise machine in your pod to wind down instead of going straight into silence (music will come on 3 minutes before you session is over to let you know you're about to finish).

Really impressed!

Stopped in for breakfast today. So much better that McFood or even the "allmighty. Tims"
Friendly staff.
I enjoyed a sausage and cheese sandwich on a sourdough bagel.
Very good!
Plenty of fresh, made in store, bagels to choose from. Cream cheese is also mixed in house! A little pricier...but well worth it!
I look forward to frequenting this place and trying many more items from their menu!

Wow...i have a nespresso at home that i love for the fresh coffee taste. BUT now that i just had an amazing latte from this place i have to say I might have to go back to fresh beans. Very smooth cup of coffee and I was glad I got a BIG size of it since I had a bit of ride home from the "park". You cant beat walking into a coffee shop and the smell of freshly roasted coffee beans hits you. Then you take a big whiff into the nose and taste it in your palate...woohooo. I was hypnotized by the delicious smell. Their pastries are also all vegan, which is a bonus. Tried their chocolate croissant and it was finger licking worthy good. Good job Roasti, keep up the fight to stay afloat in this pandemic!! You won my service
I use to come to this place everyday but they have just recently changed management and its run awefully. Rip

Thouroughly enjoyed it!

Stopped in early Saturday evening with the family to give this new spot a go!
Very happy!
Wonderful, clean, modern.
Entire staff greated us on entry.
Waiter was as "green" as the establishment, but it was ok. Super friendly. Manager extremely accommodating. 
We decided to try a number of the appatizers to get a good cross section of their offerings.
Everything was fresh, flavourfull, and pleasing to the eye to-boot.
Prices were reasonable.
We will no doubt be back!

I met up with a friend here for breakfast after her night shift. They open at 7am on Sunday, and so we were there pretty early. It was nice because it was quiet with only a few patrons. 

Our server was really nice and attentive. The food was ok. I had the banana crepe with Nutella. I got the combo which also came with two thick slices of toast, eggs, potatoes and bacon. It ended up being way too much food! Tutti Frutti reminded me a lot of Cora's, I'm not even sure what the difference is. You get a lot of food but it's generic and plain; and although most of it is good enough, there is just nothing special about it. 

I wouldn't not come back, but it wouldn't be first choice either.

This a "Jewel of a place"  to enjoy great music. It's a chance to get "close and Intimate" with the Artists....the seats are very comfortable and the view is fantastic from anywhere in the theater . They have great shows, all the time...from rock to jazz, folk, blues and others to satisfy any taste.... You should check out the line-up this year before it's all gone!!!........"Keep up the good work Festival Place"!......

I love this place...reminds me of a small town hole in the wall... Where the service is friendly and the food is amazing.  I love the clubhouse with the delicious crinkle fries and gravy, but the burgers are amazing too!! Giant handmade patty with all the fixings...all fresh.  Breakfast menu is great too...lots of selections...love the french toast and the different kinds of Eggs Benedict.  I would give this a 4.9 if I could.

A sunny gem in Sherwood Park! This awesome indoor Patio is perfect all year round. The walls slide, the roof retracts for those beautiful summer days. So many seating options: high tables, low tables, picnic tables. South west facing for maximum sunlight at your stare towards Edmonton. They even have a ping pong table on the Patio! Stayed for a couple beer and feel in love with this Patio!

Ambiance: 9/10
Staff and Service: 8/10
Food and Drink: Had a couple craft beers. Good selection.

This golf course needs some work. Their tee boxes are like concrete. Try stabbing a tee into one of these things requires a hammer. The greens are close to being back to great shape. 

For a course nestled in the heart of Sherwood Park it has a good layout. Plenty of mature trees and growth. It's a fairly easy layout if you are consistently playing straight and true golf. But if you do end up off the fairway finding your ball isn't that difficult. 

The clubhouse is nice and well laid out. They have a huge banquet room that can accommodate a large number of people. The food is here is decent and fairly priced. Nothing amazing just good cooking. If they focused on the food quality a bit this place could be a hot bed for those looking for a good meal. The scenery is exceptional for those sitting down for a beer or food.
Oscar's is a friendly British Pub where they remember your name, and the service is great.  I enjoy their food and recommend the Ruben.  Also, their fries are terrific.

Pros:
#1- The atmosphere was pretty cool, the games were entertaining. 
#2- The food was not terrible.

Cons:
#1- 30-45 min wait for any drink that we ordered. From the moment we sat down till the moment we left getting a drink was a struggle. My SO found out early that if he wanted to have a full glass in front of him he had to ordered two beers at once, this gave the waitress enough time to get the next order. Even waiting for a glass of water or a coffee took 45 minutes.

#2 - Somehow our waitress was able to put through half our order but lost the other half, she did not realize that half our meals were missing until one of the meals was served. 
This is an honest mistake and we would have been willing to over look it if it wouldn't have taken another full HOUR for the rest of the meals to arrive. Mean while my burger was served to me, which went cold as I was not about to eat my meal while the rest of my party waited.

#3- Around 9:30 PM I used the restroom to find that all but one stall was empty of toilet paper. Luckily there was a nice lady in the stall beside me who was able to provide me with toilet paper. Both soap dispensers were empty, the only option to wash my hands was a large bottle of soap tipped over on the floor underneath the sink. I have seen dive bars at 2:00 am in a better state than that bathroom.

#4- At 10:40 we ordered a cup of coffee (I confirmed with the waitress first that there was already a pot brewed) , a glass of water and our Bills. At 11:25 my coffee was finally served (water was forgotten), at that point a gentleman server asked how our night went, I explained to him the meal situation which he apologized for and stated that he would talk to our waitress. 

#5- 10 minutes later our waitress still had not come around with our bills so one of the party members went to hunt her down. She arrived with the bills, complaining that it is hard to find a working credit machine at that time of night.  No changes were made to our bills, we were charged full price for meals that came 1 hour too late. At this point we were concerned that if we made a complaint we would be left waiting for another 40 minutes, so we paid our bills. (One party member was overlooked, he had to chase her down to pay his.)

 
I really wanted to like this restaurant, but I just don't see myself going back.
 
P.S If the Local management reads this....the picnic table seats are terrible. There is no center brace on the bench seats, this causes the entire seat to bounce and bend in the middle. I was literally getting motion sickness.

Not as good as it was before. They frequently forget to stir the coffee and food taste is questionable. The staff is nice but get orders wrong every once in a while. The regular coffee tastes good but the new dark roast is gross. If you want dark coffee don't get sugar or cream. All in all a good experience.

Totally enjoyed it!  Sat in their outside area!  Friendly service!  Nice drink selection. Food selection was good.  Could not decide on burger or steak sandwich. Friend had the burger and I had the steak sandwich with side salad. No picture of the steak because I dived in too quick. My friend tried a few different beers and I order club soda with cucumber and mint. 

The burger apparently was good!  My steak sandwich was good. Sirloin but good, despite being a sirloin. Nice butter mixture on top.  Cooked perfectly. Nice garlic toast. Marinated tomato wedges. Salad was fresh!  

Service was spot on!  Parking lot is too full. Not easy. Parking spots are too narrow as well. Bathrooms were clean.

I'm extremely happy that this has opened in my neighborhood. The place is well laid out with a decent amount of sitting room. It has a community table that's perfect for bigger groups. There is an outdoor area to catch some rays as well

The staff here are great and are quick in getting drinks finished. Even thought the wifi can be a bit of a challenge sometimes, this is one of my regular hangouts.

Local has always been a favourite of mine in South Common. I was excited to try the Sherwood Park location as its closer to home. 
The food is consistent as the other location. The west coast chopped salad,  hamburgers, guacamole + chips and the tacos are all great choices! 
The beer is cold and the service is prompt and friendly. Keys to a great pub! 
I also enjoy the interactive pub games they have available.

What a disappointment. A few months back we had went to the Local in South Common had really good food & Service. So I was excited to try the one closer to home in SP. 

Tried to go there last weekend. After sitting for over  5 min we didn't even see a server. We left. Last night we were meeting friends and decided to give it another try since Craft Beer and a Patio was what we were looking for. 

Service was so so. No knowledge of the beer that was on tap. My husband had the steak sandwich, he left hungry. I had wings, they were, okay, nothing special. And an extra charge for veggies?!?!

But the big kicker is our food was stone cold!! Now our fault for not complaining, but we had already decided that we were never coming back anyway.

Great service. Always a welcome warming smile from the team, and they really know me now. Just what I want. The atmosphere is cozy (although it gets cold with the door opening and closing with nothing in between).
Has the gingerbread latte. Not a fan of it. Smells like an old wood shed, but tastes like a cinnamon dolce latte.

I went in for a massage last Thursday, Maya, the manager greeted me- very friendly and all the staff was so nice and pleasant!!! The masseuse's name was Lemlem, and did an amazing job, - worked my muscles so good- I needed that so badly on my shoulders, - it truly was a great massage. I have been to Vegas, Hawaii, and other 5 star spas- this by far was the best massage I've received!!! And to boot, the lady Masseuse was 6 months pregnant- she should have been the one receiving. I'd definitely would recommend this spa and especially that masseuse!!! Thank you for a relaxing,and pleasant experience!

This place is a comfortable environment to enjoy a bite to eat and hold a good conversation. 

There's nothing, in particular, that really makes this place stand out to me, but it has a welcoming environment which would most likely be best for families. 

I came here with a friend to have a quick bite late at night cause we were curious how they had managed to turn the old dark and dingy bar into a brunch place. Well, I can tell you they turned it around beautifully. You wouldn't even know that the space was a bar before. I do believe they have a bar attached with VLTs and what not still but they also now have the quaint restaurant with a private room for events. 

We just had a burger and they tasted like they were home cooked and made with love, not just another pull out of the freezer slap on the grill burger like I get from some restaurants. Also, the fries were delicious, I was full so my friend ended eating up all of his and my own because he enjoyed them so much. 

I would come here again, but there needs to be something more pulling me back next time. I would for sure suggest to people to give it a try because who knows, it could be your families next Sunday brunch spot!

One star, one simple reason:
If you want celery with your wings, it's $1 extra. GTFOWTS   Wonder if they charge extra for green beans in their caesars too.

Avoid this location at all cost.  There are too many more that you can go to.  I just made the mistake of breaking this rule today, and they did not fail to meet the expectation.  I ordered a grilled chicken wrap, and although it felt extremely light, I was heading to work and had no time to spare.  I should have checked.  Once I was at work, I opened it up and found a half filled wrap that did not contain one shred of chicken or any other protein.  One piece of lettuce and two tomato's with some sauce.  
Consider yourself warned!
Not much of a thin crust fan, but these pizza's are awesome!! Freshly made an different toppings to choose from!!  Only pizza plac we go to eat!! Very friendly service I might add!

One of the worst locations for Starbucks. Drive thru is almost always guaranteed a 20 minute wait. My order has been messed up many times. Even inside the location is slow,I've waited 10 minutes for my pike place grande before then finally had to ask for it again. I know these are first world problems but it can be very frustrating.

It's definitely a pub, the only cider on tap is Strongbow. Nah, thanks.

Food - looked good. If you are celiac or gluten free or sensitive, you probably want to find safe food before you head over. If you know you are going to be visiting, call the day before and they might be able to make something safe for you to eat.  Fryer is not safe. 

The wine... the Malbec was good and I would have had a 2nd glass were I not riding 2 wheels! I forgot to ask to see the bottle to get a look at it.  

Patio was fine, it was a nice evening to be outside. 

Unfortunately, there was only one poor server on a Tuesday night, and she was run off her feet.

This place is super shady. I took a younger friend there and she was very quiet the whole time. I was specific about the services she was to get and I was quoted a price. I was getting something else done so I wasn't with her during her appointment but I was in the same room. When it came time to pay the staff demanded I pay almost double the amount I was told in the beginning. The staff member insisted my friend had requested additional services I know she hadn't. Overall I left feeling ripped off. To make it worse my manicure was rushed and defiantly looked it.
This wasn't as good as I had hoped. Not awful, but not good. The som tum wasn't fresh and lacked flavor.  The sticky rice was mushy. Pretty disappointed.

I came to Spasation after purchasing a very well priced Groupon for a massage. I had driven past many times and never really noticed.  The outside is quite unremarkeable. I couldn't believe how lovely it was inside.  I was led to a very nice lounge (after removing my shoes and being given a new pair lf slippers) to fill out an information sheet about me and wait for my masseuse, Amanda.

I didn't have long to wait.  Amanda immediately led me to the room and the massage was very effective.  I thought I had been feeling pretty good and was without stiffness, but Amanda found every knot that I had and worked them out. I will be returning for regular massages with Amanda.  I felt comfortable with her and thought she was quite skilled.

The only hiccup was when I was checking out.  I had my Groupon on my cell and the blonde, older receptionist seemed quite put out that I hadn't brought a paper copy of it.  If it was necessary, make a note of it on the Groupon when you list.  So, the massage was super, customer service at the counter (with that one lady, anyway) not so much.

They have an excellent patio.   The wait staff are fun and friendly.     Decent beer selection including specials on tap.       Excellent salt and pepper wings except there is an extra charge for celery.   Which I disagree with.       Also no choice of ranch as a dip.         My friends had the burger and nachos.    The nachos seemed to be drowning in almost too much stuff.        Overall positive experience

I've only come to this store a few times and it's been hit or miss. I'm a huge Winners fan in general, always have been since they first opened a store in Edmonton. I'm that person that can spend hours looking for the right item and a good deal.

This store is large (not huge by any means), and has a variety of selection of standard Winners items. I find that the few times I've been here, the selection has been just okay as there are lots of empty spaces on racks. I know that the amount of inventory they have on any given day will depend on may factors but it's just disappointing when you walk into a store full of hope and see so many missed opportunities of items not there.

Service is okay here. I've never had a great fitting room attendant nor a great cashier. On my way out today, a lady walking by as I was walking out mumbled "bye" without making eye contact - I found that weird as I wasn't sure if she was talking to me but I was the only walking out so after an awkward delay, I said bye back. Lol
The food is always fresh and flavorful - the curries are amazing! We have been here a couple of times and plan to return in the future - highly recommend Thai Together!!

Just found my second favorite pizza place in Sherwood Park. Delicious cheese choices, dough is so fresh, and good amount of toppings. Delicious and pricing is competitive. We will be back. We also had fries and the breadsticks which were also very fresh and yummy. So so good.

I live in Millwood but avoid the 91 at Costco due to how busy it always is. I will drive to Sherrwood park instead. This is a less busy well maintained store with the added feature of a liquor store.  The prices are considerably less than a local liquor store, just less selection. Great place to go if stocking up for you Xmas party.
This location of Famoso offers good service.  The food is about 10-20% more expensive than it should be, but the swish surroundings have to be paid for somehow.  Recommended.

This location is always clean and quiet for a coffee shop, most staff are pleasant though I avoid this location weekdays between 7-11 PM, has one unpleasant and inappropriate staff member who doesn't respect your comments or queries appropriately. Otherwise love coming to this store.
Love the interesting items they get in, their premix planters are reasonable price. Meat prices are good
Been eating here since I was a little boy always a classic when leaving Edmonton tp grab some burgers and deep fried mushrooms with a couple milkshakes! Give this new location a try!

Seriously low quality ingredients. It's amazing that in a location that has proven to fail that the owners open up there and pair it with terrible food. 

Owners are lovely and the place is so clean I hope they have the flexibility to up their quality.  We tried it tonight out of nostalgia for the 80's SP memories. I regret this choice and it's 2 hours after the fact. Bloated with a yucky metal taste in my mouth. 

I would urge you to go anywhere else and I hate to do that to a small family run business.   If you are the owners I would suggest you taste the food from a customers perspective.

Food was not to bad large portions! A bit higher prices. But overall fun 80s barn interior and some nostalgia going on. Nice closed in patio let's you look at Edmonton from Sherwood Park. Would recommend! Beer list was nice and cool sign set up with the beers on tap. The kegs just sit in the hall by the bathrooms. Thought that was odd.
Waitress was great but the food, just because you put goat cheese on your food doesn't mean you can charge an extra $10.00

This locally owned business knows how to keep customers coming back.  Every time I walk in to the store, I am greeted by the friendly staff.  I get intimidated in some stores because my knowledge is limited, but the staff here makes me feel right at home every time.  Most recently, I was looking for a bottle of wine to take with us to a friend's house at Easter.  I wasn't exactly sure what I wanted to purchase, but after a helpful conversation with one of the staff I was confident in my pick.  The wine was a huge hit at Easter.

I had gone in because my husband was raving about the help he received a few weeks back from Ryan.  After asking around through a few friends, they have had the same great customer service.  We signed up for their e-newsletter and can't wait to attend one of their many functions.

If you value supporting local businesses with great customer service, then you should head to Baseline Wine & Spirits!

I can't believe I forgot to review this place!  I went here for dinner about a month ago, and it was so damn good.  Lots of juicy toppings, nice thin crust that wasn't swimming in grease, and wine.  Oh my, such lovely wine and pizza together.  Top it off with a little gelato for dessert, and I have a new favorite in the Park!
Big, fun, great food, relaxed and fairly cheap.....plus it's very kid friendly which is good for us.  I've since been back several times...doesn't disappoint.  My favourite casual dining in sh park.

They always do an amazing job when I come in and leave. 

I usually get a shellac pedicure and the type of pedicure I get is just the basic. 

You sit in a massage chair and soak your feet in a warm Epsom salt jetted foot rub. From there the esthetician starts her pedicure. When she is done she uses a scrub on your legs and feet and removes it with a hot wet towel. Personally that's the best part of the pedicure. 

I also got my nails done. I get gel nails. They clean up my nails and all hang nails as well. 
Nothing to fancy. 


They do a good wax job - eye brows. You sit in this oversized leather chair. Tilt your head back and they go to town. They take the time to complete the eye brow appointment with tweezers for any randoms the wax didn't pull out. 

Overall I am very satisfied. And continue to come back over and over again. 

Prices are 

Eye brow wax - approx $10
Shellac Pedicure - approx $60
Full gel set - approx $50

If you are looking for a great non-oily pizza this is the place to go. The crust is thin and very flavourful. The Gorgonzola salad is a good companion for the pizza and makes you fell better you are it just eating carbs.
The tomato soup is a good starter is light and just the right amount of bitterness and sweetness.

I would start by saying I would rate 6stars if I could, the price is cheap for the quality. And the quality is top notch. I have tried almost every dish and they are all outstanding. I hidden gem by far. Best ginger beef anywhere!  The mango salad is wicked too and don't forget the coconut shrimp and bulgogi beef!!
Food and service are good. I reserve one star because it isn't the best Thai food I have ever had, but is perfect for a yummy dinner in the neighbourhood.

China Kitchen is wildly overrated here on Yelp.  Yes, it might be better than the horrific Chinese places that one finds in mall food courts, but that's not setting the bar very high.  It's both overpriced and bad, even for the strip mall category.  I'd avoid it if I were you.
Amazingly delicious, casual environment with great service - perfect for lunch or takeout. Bring the kids - my favorite restaurant!
Havent had anything i didnt like. always consistent. Reasonably priced. Best asian cuisine in sherwood park.

I find Costco to be kind of a terrifying place... giant quantities of everything, long lineups, and so much spending. I sometimes go for cheaper gas, but the lineups at some times of day aren't always worth it. 

I ended up at this location while on the hunt for winter tires. Not every location in the city had rims, but they had some here. I got a really good price on my tires, relative to other places I checked, but I had to wait 3 weeks for them to come in (and then they installed one with a slow leak...)

I discovered that this particular Costco has two redeeming qualities that make it a little better than the others. One, it's less busy that other Costcos in Edmonton. I've never had trouble finding parking, even on the weekend. Two, it's got (as far as I know) the only Costco liquor store in the Edmonton area. Booze in bulk!

Just ordered a large with ground beef, mushrooms, onions, fresh tomato, green pepper.  Added cheddar as well.  The order took an hour via Skip The Dishes. 

Overall the pizza tasted ok but nothing special.  Gave the impression that the company is trying to save money. The toppings were diced into very small pieces.  Not much toppings overall as you can tell by the tomatoes. Crust was thick and kinda like cardboard which is ironic given what they put on their pizza box.  Won't order again.  Reminded me of store bought.
Very friendly and good portion size.. Always buy here every time i feel to eat chinese food. Bonus a woman always offer free drinks..

I love going to orange theory, it's only been open a month and I was a "founding member" - signed up in the pre opening sales . I go twice a week and I've notice results in my energy levels and strength. I enjoy the set up of the classes with the interval training . I would highly recommend trying a class !

If you are looking for great wine from 18-100+ bucks you must go here. They are very knowledgable and friendly. I've yet to go home with a bad recommended wine. They've surprised me with their picks every time I stop here.

Sadly I have to update to one star. This place is incredibly SNOBBY. They only have 7 table for guests with children. We came in with a family of 6 (2 were children) and because of this we waited a full hour for a table. Our children were pretty hungry and getting whiny,  unbearable and loud and starting to annoy other waiting guests. When we had arrived we walked in right behind a party of 4 without children. One of the booths that were designated for families with children had opened up and the hostess seated that family of 4 that waked in right ahead of us, in the booth designated for families WITH children!!  We continued to wait an entire hour to be seated, even though, if that family that came directly ahead of us were to be seated 2 minutes later they would have had a seat elsewhere and we wouldnt have had to wait that long! We counted more than 12 parties that were seated ahead of us. I pointed this out to the hostess and she was snobby and said "first come, first serve." Which, don't get me wrong, I completely understand BUT when you limit guests with children to only 7 tables in the entire place it's quite a disappointment!  An entire HOUR waiting with children!!! Unacceptable! 
So we were finally seated. I asked to speak to the manager about this and he was very unapologetic and lacked any sympathy for the kids whatsoever. Didn't offer any sort of compensation. Whatever. 
We order a few drinks and a couple of tasters and our food. They first bring out the wrong drinks for two guests and one of our guests was brought a dirty wine glass! We asked for a replacement and she got a second DIRTY GLASS! Had to ask for a third glass! Our kids drinks were empty and she asked me if she could get them some more soda. I said no because their glasses are quite large and my kids didn't need that much sugar. A few minutes later a giant glass of soda shows up. We send it back because we didn't order it. Our server comes BACK  again and sees the empty glasses and says again if she can bring them more soda! NO! My son asked for no pickles on his burger..guess what? Extra pickles! 
Several times a guy kept coming over and telling me to watch my head because he was reaching for chairs on the wall! Ugh! SO DONE BY THIS POINT.
Overall all of us were very UPSET and left feeling punished for bringing our children, to which they say are welcome?

The ambiance and decor was very tidy and trendy.  
We came for lunch which was a good thing because they had some good lunch specials.  We spent about $40 for an app and two rice and curry specials.  

The meal was hot and fresh but looking at the prices on the regular menu I do not think I would come back.  It's quite pricey. 

The service was good , the place was clean, the food was good. So if the price doesn't bother you then this is a good place to go for dinner :)

If you're a pubber, this is a place to be. I think it's authentic. It's off the beaten path so you might have to look for it if you're not familiar with the area.  Excellent service. Many good things to eat...fish and chips...Yorkshire puddings and for those of vintage British stock you'll recognize the peas...there's amazing live music pub - style every weekend. A lot of old-school long-time local entertainers that have huge repertoires.  Sing along, clap, tap or get up and dance.  It's casual, jeans, shorts, flip flops,  cowboys, or uptown it's all there.

I signed up for Orange Theory in January 2015, and just cancelled my membership September 2016. My experience at Orange Theory was really great for a lot of reasons.
