First and foremost, the staff and trainers are great. They're so friendly and helpful, and they really know how to make the classes fun. I really did like all the trainers, but I particularly enjoyed Sara's classes. The inside of the studio is pretty nice, and the equipment is well maintained. Every single class is always different and challenging. I rarely found the classes to be too busy, and the available class times are pretty good. I also had no issues cancelling my membership. You hear horror stories about hidden fees at the gym, but the staff were just as nice to me when I joined as they were when I cancelled. As far as the negative stuff, it is pretty pricey. I had an unlimited membership and paid $177 a month on top of the cost for the heart rate monitor. They also do optional in house events that you have to pay for. I personally feel that if you pay for an unlimited membership, the in house events should be free of charge. I felt like I was already paying a fortune to go to the gym and it seemed weird to be encouraged to spend even more money doing the same workout.  The only other issue I have is I didn't lose any weight! That's probably the biggest reason I cancelled my membership. I felt amazing and was in such great shape working out here, but I did not lose even 1 pound in all the time I went there. I found myself eating more because the workouts were so intense that it just cancelled out all the work I was putting in at the gym. All in all, I really did enjoy going to this location and I really enjoyed the workout. It was worth the money and I learned a lot in the 7 or so months I spent here.

My husband and I found this little gem by accident, WOW !!!, I can hardly wait to go back and try something else. I had Pad Kee Mao with chicken, it was sooo good. My husband loved his Tom Yum shrimp soup.

** DISCLAIMER: PIZZA SNOB ALERT **

I've been to southern Italy a few times and recently spent some time in Naples and fell in love with marinara pizzas. They are simple and delicious but require a few things - wood fired thin crust, flavourful sauce (since there is no cheese) and fresh basil. Famoso markets itself as the most traditional Neapolitan pizza around, so I thought I would try the most traditional Neapolitan pizza there was. 

Honestly, it was a let down. The crust was good, but slightly undercooked. The basil was sparse and didn't taste very fresh. But it's March in Canada so that's fair. For a marinara to be good, the sauce has to carry it and it just didn't. It was too bland. The worst part was the garlic. There was an overwhelming amount and it just dominated the whole pizza. It was like the cook used a garlic press and placed massive globs of mashed garlic all over it. So one bit was just sauce that was a bit too bland then the next was an explosion of garlic. I love garlic, but eating a whole clove in one bit is too much for me. 

Famoso really tries but when in Canada, I'll probably just stick to the greasy, cheesy pies that we do so well here.

I was bored one Sunday and decided to get my nails done, so I called a friend who works for a commercial property management company to ask if she knew of any salon's in the area. She mentioned Nails by Donna and I was actually driving by so I decided to give it a try. 

I walked in with no appointment and asked if they would have time to do gel nails for me - yep, no problem. Donna was the lady who did my nails and she was gentil and friendly. One of the other ladies offered to paint a rose on two of my nails and I was blown away by her talent - she did an amazing job! Even the atmosphere in there was nice, comfortable, and very friendly. The other patrons and the staff were happily chatting together like they had been friends for years, checking on what everyone was getting done to their nails. 

Never had an issue with my nails - I was worried cuz I tend to be rough on my nails and typically lose one or two within the first week. But it was all good - all nails lasted till I went in for my fill - where again I just walked in and they were able to help me pretty much right away - Donna again!! Same great service, warm atmosphere - Donna even remembered my name from the last time I was in. I don't have much to compare this too as I have not really been to any sort of spa in the past but I did spend a significant amount of money and walked out feeling good about it - not cheated :)! I think this will be my nail salon of choice for the time being - although they come and go so fast hopefully this one will be around for a while.
Challenging but with low impact options for those of us with injuries. The instructors are helpful and willing to answer any questions. Fellow classmates were friendly and helpful for Orange newbies.

Food is very expensive and the taste is mediocre. ( $18.00 for what is pictured) The Chicken Parmesan  was so tiny and very over cooked. Decor is nice. I would not return. Head down the road a little further and go to Forza Pasta Bar!

A little part of me dies every time I walk into Costco.  I prefer to shop local, organic if possible and definitely not in bulk.  I don't believe in consuming more than you need not only for your health but also for the health of the planet.  However, I do acknowledge that sometimes it is cheaper to buy in bulk and especially for those with a big family, the packaging saved on bulk purchases can be a big deal in the long run.  

I usually come to Costco for a couple of select things:  Almond milk, sustainably caught Tuna (although they rarely have it!), hand cream (Im a nurse I go through TONS of Glysomed), and chips if we are having a party.  I sometimes find the odd organics bag of almonds, quinoa or dried fruit which are all items I use on a regular basis.  

My issue with Costco is this:  they rarely keep the same stock, the line ups are horrendous (I often leave wondering if anyone works in this town cause everyone seems to be at Costco at ANY time of day!), and do you really ever need a bag of chips as big as you?!  I always feel like a dirty over-consumer, but Almond Milk that is MUCH less expensive will keep me coming back until my favorite organic store starts selling it in bulk at a decreased price too.
So far it has been great service and good food. Usually go to the one in south common.

Exactly what you want when you walk into a burger joint. Burger made to order. Amazing staff. Family
Vibe, good energy and good food!

Absolutely the most rude salespeople I've ever encountered!  Unbelievable.  I didn't even make it to the product. Sales lady asked if she could help, I replied I liked a certain style, to which she replied excuse me, walked passed me and began folding a pile of disorganized bras. I was stunned. I would have continued to look at products and helped myself except the odour in the store has the scent of a Value Village. I'll keep shopping at my regular boutique

I am so in love with this place, the pizza is amazing. I'm convinced people who say they don't like it just haven't found the "right" pizza for them. The staff are super friendly and helpful. Sometimes there can be a bit of a wait for your pizza if it's packed but if speed is a huge issue for you, you can always call ahead and pre-order which works well for lunches.
The pizza is true italian pizza and delicious.

I was passing by this place and needed a pedicure and wax.  They gave me a decent pedicure, nothing spectacular, certainly not the best pedicure I've had.  They lack attention to detail as some of my nails we cut unevenly but I didn't notice until I got home.  They forgot about me after I got the hot wax so I had to call someone to finish the work.  The brow wax was very shoddy.  She rushed, showed me her "work" in a dirty mirror and left stray hairs that I had to fix at home.  Not goi g back here anytime soon.

Worst Tim Hortons in Edmonton and area!  The owner needs to figure out their efficiency deficiency....counter service is painful and slow. Customer service is the whole package, quick, accurate and friendly.  They are seriously missing the quick and accurate component.

I went to this place for dinner. Pizza was good. Caprese salad was reasonable. Gelato was ok. Price was a little on the upper side on my point of view. Service was really bad. The lady taking orders was not willing to help. 
This region has so many options. So many restaurants. I'm not going there again.

I really love this location, especially when compared to the south Edmonton one.  The gas bar is really easy to get in and out of, and the parking lot never seems to be as congested as other locations.

Inside it's laid out like most others, but the inside also never seems as crowded as others.  Overall, it's my preferred location for sure.

Plus... Costco Liquor store on site!

Came here for a private function, and the service was great.
I also liked the fact that they were playing the game separately in a soundproof room, so you could sneak out and watch it for a bit.

I ordered the French fries $6 for a big order (think 2 large McFries) and the ketchup they gave me was off. I tried to dab the offending ketchup off.

They noticed, and just made me a new order of fries! Great stuff

One of the best Thai experiences outside of Asia that I've had. The ambiance is tasteful and the staff are friendly. The food really fills my curry kick, though I think that either the portion sizes could be more generous or it could be a little cheaper - one of the two adjustments would make me a more frequent visitor. 

I am a huge fan of the Curry Beef Brisket.

This is one of the best Thai restaurants I've tried and I've tried them all over this continent. The service is good,the food is amazing. The best part is it's a few blocks away from my current home!! I always reccommend eating there. The only thing I don't like is they aren't open on Mondays ...but it still gets 5 thumbs up
customer service is excellent as is most Edo's I go too. food is always delish.

First, this establishment is not for kids. Not sure why anyone would bring children to a pub...anyways.  

What this place is; a great new spot in Sherwood Park for adults to chillax at. The staff are friendly and the service was great. If you were a visitor to this establishment when it was another restaurant, your eyes are in for a world of hurt. Hurting with pleasure. They did a great job in renovating this building. The decor is great, layout is well designed and the new patio is something I can't wait to visit this summer. 

Our server Sarah was really nice and accommodating for my wife and I. They have a list of rotating taps of brews I have never heard of so I wanted to try them before I bought a pint. Sarah gave me a few taster glasses, unfortunately the ones I tried were way too hoppy for my liking. But where the beer lacked, the food made up for it. 

We ordered their loaded nachos and I was very pleased. Baked black beans, roasted shredded chicken, jalapeños, cheese, just what you would expect for a plate of comfort food. 

This new watering hole is just what we needed in the park.

I used to go there a lot. Food was good. Workers friendly. However prices got jacked up within the past 6 months and are a little too stiff for my budget. 

I tried ordering on line several weeks ago and found that it was quite confusing on the Internet with an old address. I just gave up. 

Otherwise a fairly nice place to get Chinese food if it is within your budget.

Love this place for its simple pub approach.  Food is well done pub fare, french fries are best in town. Try Tuesdays for hot dog night, a guilty pleasure. Minors welcome until something like 9 o'clock. Friendly, friendly, friendly staff.

Went here on the recommendation of a friend. The prices are much more reasonable compared to another location like Dawn's Bratique in Edmonton. However, I feel as if the sales people are in such a rush to force a purchase on you. I initially found 4 very cute bras and paid about $150 - great deal compared to some other specialty shops. I've been sized before and was placed in a different size - after wearing the bras for a few days, the band felt loose - and I truly feel as if the sales people sold me the wrong size just to make a buck. Regardless, there are two bras that I purchased that fit very well on the tightest clasp. Unfortunately, less than two months after purchase, one of the bra's underwires completely came out of the cup. When I called to see what could be done about this, it was explained to me that because one of my "boobies" is likely bigger than the other, this is why this is happening. I understand that wear and tear on a garment is expected, but come on. It tells me a lot when a company is not willing to stand by your product. The salesperson on the phone did mention to me that I could take it to a tailor to have it reinforced... 

Will not be returning. Save your money, spend a little more and go somewhere else..

While Edo is more of a quick takeout than a date night, I love this place: it is fast and delicious.  If you are looking to save on calories use noodles instead of rice (50 less calories) and only one scoop of sauce (another 50 less calories.)

My last visit here as a celebratory lunch for completing the last day of classes was a bit of a let down. Our waitress/server genuinely gave the feeling like she didn't want to work there and treated us as if she was trying to get as out as soon as possible even though we were nothing but courteous to her as we believed she was just having a long day/bad day.
That being said! 
I won't let just one waitress decide how I feel towards an entire establishment. 
The pizza is great here, it's a unique experience having to fold it. In my opinion it has one of the better sauces I've tasted in a while accompanied with the cheeses they use.
Albeit I am more on the sweeter side of taste when it comes to food. The pizza may not always be as filling as I want it to be, but it's never any less delicious as i expect it to be. When it comes to the gelato/floats they can be a bit expensive considering what you get.

Have fallen in love with weekend brunch at the Local. I'm a sucker for eggs Benny. Many happy return visits, many more to go I'm sure. Love the indoor bocce, the shuffle-board, ping pong on the patio.

Was there with a large group for a birthday. Food was great and so was the service. I was particularly impressed with the great service considering how large our group was. Servers came by often enough to check up on us and refilled our drinks without us needing to ask. Bills were also immediately separated at the beginning so there was no issue with people having to figure out what they owe for their share. People in our group ordered nachos, calamari, wings and fish and chips and every one was happy with the food quality. My first time here and I would definitely go back
Love the food and the atmosphere !! The beer on tap is always good and the brunch is also fabulous. Hands down the best chicken and fish tacos in town. Wish they had more booths!

Update on Sept 2017: I went back to this location, and the shop has closed down.
End update.

I remember the day I discovered boutique bra shops.  I went from frumpy ill-fitting box-store bras to colorful and sultry bras that actually supported the girls.  I have a soft place in my heart for these places, especially when run by knowledgeable staff.

I was delighted to discover this place a little less than a year ago, and have been remiss in not writing about them sooner.  

On the day I went in, it was afternoon on a holiday of some sort, and I was surprised they were open.  But open they were, and I went in without waiting.  I was shown to a room, and the matronly woman in charge asked if I minded if she brought the new girl along to learn.  I like being a demo bunny, so I was all for it.

The matron listened to what I wanted, fetched a good selection, and with a little refining (NOT pink, take that thing away) I got a more than ample selection.  The new girl was helpful and unobtrusive, and the matron knew her stuff.  I told her what brand I was used to fitting well, and she grabbed a different brand as well, that was on a significant sale.

Things here are expensive, but no more so than any boutique bra place I have been, and the sale they had running was phenominal.  I have never spent so little on good bras.  And here, a year later, all three I bought that day are still in great shape, despite constant wearing and less than recommended washing.  (after every wear?  Are you kidding me?)

The only negative was a slight air of "we want to go home" that I find quite understandable for the day I went in, and the cash register not working, so I was not able to get a receipt.  

Summer is coming, and I want to see what new colors are coming in for bras this season.  I will certainly be stopping in La Belle Femme.

Local is an awesome pub/restaurant with a great selection of beers and with really good food. Quick service and even on a really busy night we managed to get in within 5-10 minutes of waiting which isn't bad at all. Beer is super reasonably priced and it's a comfy spot.

I just finished a pedicure with my daughter and this Binh's customer service has really gone downhill.  My pedicure was not done well, the technician was in a hurry and they told me to paint my daughters fingernails and do a 'quick pedicure' would be $30.00.  Our pedicures took less than 45 minutes and the cost was ridiculous ($75+). Save your money, go somewhere else.

Oscar's is a nice little "authentic" British pub and the HQ of the Sherwood Park Chicken Wings Society, of which I am an occasional member.  It's a fun and comfortable place to hang out with friends for a pint, pub grub and some darts.  I've had many memorable (and reasonably sober) experiences here over the years.

I believe it was this location.  Had a work party 5 years back. Pretty decent pizza. I was never able to discern which pizza joint is the best. Its pretty hard to mess up pizza, right?

Anyways, great service and good times!

Although the location is quite convenient, this Tim's shares a parking lot with various other food establishments (both fast food and sit down style restaurants).  During busy times (lunch in particular) the drive through is a NIGHTMARE and the parking lot is a NIGHTMARE - you just can't win!  Unfortunately, there have been many a time when this Timmy's has failed me and not given me the correct order (often getting coffee instead of tea, or some watery, sludge-like concoction instead of a 1/2 coffee, 1/2 hot choc.).  Nonetheless, the staff are always friendly and efficient and I will be back for my Tim's fix the next time I am driving past (and not in a HUGE rush to get to work cuz I am running late like always...).
Love this place.  Great for take out or eat in, always my first choice for Thai in Sherwood Park.

Horrible is an understatement! Noodles were dried out & old. Sauce was mediocre at best and the minestrone soup was not anything close to what minestrone should be. Way over priced for the value. Cost $40 for my wife, 6 year old daughter & myself for a meal that we barely ate. We will never go back & recommend you don't make the same mistake we did.... TURN BACK NOW! (PS. I only gave it 1 star because the website forced me to).
Have been a few times. Beer and food have been great. Nachos might be the best I have ever had. Fish tacos also great.

The customer service I received at the optical center was outstanding! It was my first time getting glasses so I was a little nervous and had no idea what to look for. The service representative Charmaine was so helpful and made it a fun experience. She was also very personable and knowledgeable. The prices are great here as I quickly found out being a glasses newbie.

This place is not my cup of tea mainly for the food. My husband and I went to Famoso for dinner on a Friday night. It's kind of unique how you go up to the counter to order rather than have a server come to you. The service was great and fairly quick too. I ordered a smoked salmon pizza and my husband had a sandwich. I will stick with Americanized pizza that's for sure. The slightly charred thin crust pizza which is apparently how traditional pizza should be did not taste good. And there was no tomato sauce or cheese on it either. Just slices of smoked salmon, capers and some sort of white sauce drizzled on. Maybe I just need to try a different pizza but I'm in no hurry to back.
Nothing to complain about, always great food & service never disappointed!  My favourite location although never have had a bad experience at any of the other locations.

Figured we would grab a quick meal before heading to the movies....   looked nice from the outside-  the inside was not too bad-more like a highway truck stop restaurant. Staff was friendly and the service was great. The food however was less than desirable- 1 order of nachos and 1 order of calamari...   the calamari had zero flavour.. wasn't crispy.  It was more like the calamari you buy at the grocery store frozen food isle.  The nachos .. they must be rationing their cheese....

Sorry Headquarters..  can't recommend this place

The food is amazing and freshly cooked and they will make a dish for you if you request something they don't have. Both owners are very friendly and are the working force behind the kitchen as well. I would suggest if you like Chinese food give them a try my personal favourite is BEEF TOMATO FRIED RICE

Ahhh, this place is a gem in itself. The fries here are some of the best I've ever had in my life. Everything else you order is always hot and delicious. The staff are kind and good to everyone who walks in young and old. Plus the live music they bring in is always great and makes for a fun filled night you're glad you took part of. Best of all, you feel a real sense of community amongst the loyal customers you're bound to run into when you visit and it's great getting to feel like you're a part of it :) Go visit asap!

This is one of the best Thai restaurants I've tried and I've tried them all over this continent. The service is good,the food is amazing. The best part is it's a few blocks away from my current home!! I always reccommend eating there. The only thing I don't like is they aren't open on Mondays ...but it still gets 5 thumbs up

This Winners is big, clean and not too cluttered, which I really appreciate.

I am not a huge fan of these types of stores because I have a hard enough time finding clothes I like and that look decent on me, without having to add the necessity of clawing through racks after racks of clothing.

HOWEVER, I have had some luck at this store as they are large enough and have a high enough turnover that they offer a good selection.

I try this place out 2 weeks ago. The restaurant atmosphere was ok, the staff was pretty attentive and the food was pretty okay. I mean it's not memorable unless you go there to hang out with people. It's definitely not for ambiance or food.

Tire Center - They used to be a force to be reckoned with with regards to pricing but now they're no better than what most shops can offer. If you're willing to give the increasing number of Chinese tire a try then there's no comparison. I have gone from buying tires exclusively at Costco to only using their installation services. Now I'm struggling to defend that due to the excessively tight policies regarding servicing sizing. I agree with the policies for the most part but when I bring in a vehicle with wheels assembles by them and installed by myself and ask for them to change the TPMS sensors, they no longer assume liability for the tires that are on the vehicle. However, as a corporation, it's nearly impossible for them to get each employee to understand liability they way they do so they are forced to treat them like they're incapable of understanding..... and the employees are happy to play along. 
Unfortunately what they failed to recognize is that they have an obligation to ensure that my TPMS system is working and they refused, so therefore they assumed a higher level of liability.

This was my first visit at Costco in Sherwood Park. While I've never been a huge fan of Costco due to the crowds and long waits at the register, I get it... Busy place = waiting at the registers. However this location really took me by surprise! Extremely well organized and very little wait time! It did help that it was early afternoon and we were mostly organized. 

Like most locations this location is well planned out, it's like everything in every Costco is in the same place. So it eliminates having to search for anything. 

Unfortunately today I had a difficult time looking for burger buns, I had asked an associate where to find them and she replied with a "there over there" pointing in the direction of the bakery. I mentioned I was just there but couldn't see them. She replied with a "well we're out then" in a snarky tone. Maybe she was having an off day, but the lack of customer service and friendliness really left a sour taste in my mouth... Never the less the rest of my experience was great so I won't let this one time encounter affect my trip.

Was here for the first time for a girlfriends baby shower in one of the private rooms. They had a catered party in the private room. Food was outstanding & so was the service! I didn't golf bit the course looked pretty & well managed!!
A very clean place and the staff was nice however the food was just ok and very expensive. I was overall disappointed.

Famoso is one of the best pizza joints I've ever been to. The Quattro Formaggi is my go-to, but the Hawaiian is also a solid choice. 

Now onto one of the best items at Famoso: the Caesar salad. Hands down, one of the best things I've ever had. The dressing is flavoured so well and the prosciutto crisps and grana padano are such a great touch to make the salad even more authentic. I could eat that salad over and over. 

I'd be surprised if you haven't been to a Famoso, but if you haven't: what are you waiting for??

Over the years this has remained one of my favourite restaurants. It consistently has amazing staff, and amazing quality. Having now been to several different locations over the city I can safely say that this is hands down one of the best locations in the Edmonton Area... seriously there is a difference.

Old school pub feel, without sticking to the floor or nostrils being assailed by beard oil. Properly chilled beer, fantastic Scotch collection, and excellent pub grub. Easily the best place to enjoy a proper pint in Sherwood Park.

Service was alright tonight, but I enjoyed going to a Thai restaurant that doesn't have carpeted floors for a change and the food was awesome! I do wish their peanut sauce was more of a traditional Thai peanut sauce (it almost tasted powdered), but it was so good otherwise!! I tried a mixed vegetable dish with rice and the coconut soups and Thai salad rolls with peanut sauce. They accommodated my veganism well :)

This Costco is pretty darn good. Even when it's busy, the line up flows smoothly. I love how they get in new products to try out, especially organic. They usually have in everything out household needs. The only one recommendation I would make is tell some of the cashiers to be a bit more friendly. I would give this review a 5 star but some of the employees are just a tad unpleasant.

I was skeptical about takeout italian that isn't just heat warmed pizza, but was very impressed given what it is! I got a simply fantastic soup and salad. Came with bread, that was so fresh tasting. Their soup is generally bigger than most portions-- their small is the same size as most larges. Employees were so friendly. I will be going back. It's great! Now, it cost around 10 bucks for all of that but I was so full I could die. Oh man, so good.

I'm on the same page as everybody else: this is The place to get pizza here in Sherwood Park. They're always freshly made, the service is awesome and they may have better breadsticks than Olive Garden itself! And yes, I do mean that last detail sincerely. Grab one for yourself and you'll see what I'm talking about!

I'm getting some laser hair removal done, and I was originally going to the Whyte Ave location but I'm now going here as the technician I had left. 

My first experience was great. Jovi (my new technician) was awesome, explained her procedure thoroughly, and made sure all was going well throughout. Glad I found another good technician (and location) to use!

I've been going to this location for the last couple of years for massages, and recently started getting my hair done there too.  I go often enough that I decided to purchase a membership.  When using Groupons for massages, I never had any issues.  But last month, after dealing with migraines for months, I decided to splurge and purchased a 90 minute deep tissue massage at full price.  When booking, I advised that I would need to see an RMT so that I could claim it on my insurance.

the massage was pretty good.  Was definitely "deeper" than I was expecting, but with the pain I had been experiencing, I thought that I probably needed it.  When I went to pay, I was advised that the lady I saw was only registered in Croatia, not Canada and therefore I would not be able to claim the cost.  Now, I don't mind paying for a massage, but I never would have booked something so expensive if I'd have known there was no RMT available.

I was given the number to head office to call after the weekend to discuss it with somebody.  Immediately my stress level rose and wiped out the good that the massage had done.

The next day (Sunday), i was in so much pain across my shoulders that I couldn't get out of bed all day.  It was awful!

It took 2 or 3 days of me calling multiple times to actually get to speak with somebody about it.  And then almost another week went by before I got any confirmation of what they were actually going to do to compensate me..  What they ended up doing was given me another massage with an RMT that i would be able to claim the full price was.

So - I'm sitting in the waiting room and receptionist comes out and tells me that there was another mistake and the person i was booked with can't provide a receipt for my insurance company and asked if i would mind switching to a male masseuse.  It ended up being a really great massage, but the receipt I was given was for a 60 minute relaxation massage ($90) and not the 90 minute deep tissue ($150) that I had paid for.

I'm sure I'll return, but this whole thing has really irritated me and I doubt I'll be back soon.

Ok, I confess up front. I don't golf. I have never golfed this golf course. 

Now that we have that out of the way, I can tell you that this golf course is a gem in the middle of Sherwood Park. It is tucked so well into the hamlet that it is easy to even forget it is there - unless you live in one of the houses along its edge I suppose.

The Sherwood Park Chamber had their networking breakfast at Broadmoor the other day and I was reminded just how nice it is. Big, bright windows overlooking rolling green... links? or whatever it is there are called. Lots of green stuff. 

The food was simple but good and the service was efficient and discreet - nothing worse than having someone lumber around pouring coffee or clanking dishes when someone is talking.

If the atmosphere of the course and the professionalism of the staff are any indication, I am sure they have really good... greens? holes? The putt-putt-stuff.
This place is neglected and sad.  Poor draught selection and uninspiring menu.  If you like hanging out in an outdated basement environment with a bunch of sad looking men then yes, go to Oscars.

Awful service at the tire department , I came in and the manager book me an appointment to get my tires for December 17 , 2016 he never mention there was no guarantee for the tires not to come in , they call me on Friday telling me the tires are not in . When ask to speak to the same manager all he can said is sorry you feel about that , with no solution , awful service on their behave for the amount of customer they have they should have tires on stock.
Well How can you go wrong with Papa John?? The best chain pizza in the world! The only thing is that they switch to Pepsi and they used to have a partnership with Coke!!!!

There are basically 2 types of beer/wine stores in Edmonton.   Either they are staffed by people who are passionate and knowledgeable or they are staffed by people who know how to stock shelves and operate a register.

Luckily Baseline Wine leads the way in the first category.  Each week they send out an email with their POW (pick of the week), usually this is a limited edition wine that they sell on a first come first serve basis at a reduced price. I highly recommend getting on that mailing list.

When you enter the store it is new, clean, well lit and has a huge selection of wine and various types of liquor.  Ryan (I think) was more than willing to take the time to talk to me about their ever expanding rum selection and even directed me to some excellent well priced brands and some new brands that they had just added.


If you're a lover of wine, then absolutely you should check them out and use their knowledgeable staff to find that perfect wine for your occasion. 

Also, keep an eye open for the various events and tastings that they offer throughout the year.  I have yet to go, but It's certainly on my list of things to do.

This Winners location has improved its men's section but has reduced its women's section. It is no longer a higher end Winners. If you are looking for bigger designer names, you better go to the Winners on Calgary Trail. For food or household items, you should just go to the Sherwood Park Homesense. Similar items found here are also found there in greater quantities.

I still love shopping here. I enjoy searching and hunting for that unique piece. Give yourself at least an hour in this store as you do have to take the time to search. Treasures are to be found!

This place is pretty MEH if you ask me. Seems overly hyped up for what it is - I only ever have been in there to get my hair done/cut though so maybe their other Spa services are where it's at?? Nonetheless, I find this place quite overpriced and I have never felt 100% satisfied when leaving there (actually, now that I think about it there was one time I got an up-do for a wedding I was attending and I actually really liked what she did). 

Last time I was in was with my BFF and we just kind of decided on a whim to go get our hair cut on a holiday Monday (our usual spot - Roxx Salon & Spa was closed :( ). We walked in and asked if they would have an opening for the two of us to get our hair cut. Well, it almost seemed like this request bothered the receptionist lady. "I don't know if we can fit you both in at once." My friend and I looked at each other questioningly and then back towards the seemingly completely empty store and said yeah, that's OK - we can go one after the other. So, much to, what seemed to be, her dismay, she booked us in. The lady who cut our hair, although extremely nice, was not one for conversation (seemed English was a bit of a struggle for her - which is totally fine but there was very little effort on her part). I felt OK about my hair cut but my friend was not impressed at all - she had it cut from fairly long to fairly short with strict instructions to the stylist that she DID NOT want a bob...well it turned out quite bob-y! 

On top of it all it was very expensive. I don't think I would choose to go back here unless EVERYTHING else is closed again.

*** Posted this 3 months ago but not on the correct Yelp page ***

Was there last Thursday for a group dinner (8 people) and the Resturant cannot offer any tables other than the ones at the front door. So there we sat freezing cold as the drafts from the door would hit us on our backs. 

Our server didn't come and ask us for drink orders for at least 30 minutes, and got them wrong when they finally arrived. 

We all ordered our dinners which consisted of : 

1. 2 people got grilled chicken tacos - both with side of yam fries 
2. 2 people got steak sandwiches - 1 was supposed to have no tomato salad and was to be replaced with a garden salad instead and both with fries 
3. 2 people got tortilla soup 
4. 1 person got a burger with fries
5. 1 person got the jalapeño caesar salad - dressing was to be on the side 

Well at least they got something right - the burger and fries were 100% correct. 

Everything else was wrong and took over over an hour to rectify the problems. 

Haha plus no cutlery. 

1. Grilled Chicken Tacos & Yam Fries - both came breaded and the cilantro mix was supposed to be on the side but came with extra cilantro mix on top. 
The yam fries dip had 3 different dips - the best one supposedly was the plain mayo that came out.

2. Steak Sandwiches & Fries - the 1 meal
Came out good but they did forget the gravy. The second one was a disaster - no fries came , there was supposed to be no tomato salad but came with it. The tomato salad was supposed to be subbed out for a garden salad. So they gave the garden salad to replace the fries. 

3. Tortilla Soup - one came with no guacamole which was correct but it also came with no salsa or tortilla... So it had no flavour what so ever. 

4. Cheese Burger and Fries - well there was no problems so let's high five on that one !!! 

5. Jalapeño Caesar Salad - asked for dressing on the side as unsure how spicy if would be... Well it came on the salad and yup definitely has a kick to it. 

Well after the disaster of dinner all we wanted was out cutlery to eat. We waited probably another 20 mins as our food is now cold. 

Wouldn't complain about the food now after they finally straightened out everything even though it was cold. 



I recommend do not go in groups over 4 because the lack of seating and you may get a newbie server who should never have been on a bigger table. 

Management never did anything to help as we watched them have team meetings behind the kitchen and hear us complain and watch the server struggle.

I LOVE this gym.  I've been going twice a week for the last 4 weeks.  From day 1 when I came in for my free session and introduced myself everyone was so friendly and welcoming.  It's got such a personal feel to it, all the staff have known me by name since I first came in and they will go out of their way to make your day better.  There was no pressure to join after the free session.  The workouts are HARD which is good.  I push myself way harder with the motivation from the personal (group) trainer and their unique system than I ever could on my own at any other gym.  I'm a month in and I already feel leaner and can tell my stamina has improved significantly,  what was a struggle to maintain while running 4 weeks ago is a lot easier.  They email you your results of your workout and it's all on display for you while you workout too, you have to see it.  It's neat.  And again, the staff are amazing, head trainer Sara in particular (no im not her, we have the same name) is so kind and so upbeat and motivating.

And to address a couple things from other reviews:  yes the parking lot directly in front of the gym can be tight when it's busy, but there's a huge Safeway parking lot maybe 100 meters away.  If you can do circuit training you can walk a little bit ;). Not like you're downtown trying to scope out a parking meter or anything.

Also, there's two bathrooms, not one. 
And a shower.

I can't say enough good things about this gym!!  (If they wanted to stay open an extra couple hours on Saturday so I could workout after work I wouldn't complain ;)..hint hint)

IMO, they offer the best takeaway Chinese food in Sherwood Park. More extensive menu than most. Good portion sizes. Reasonable prices for dishes. Often also offer free pop and discount for pickup and orders over a certain amount. Also, the food is fresh tasting. Always friendly when you go there to pick up.

I can't believe I haven't done a review yet on Oscars! I love this place. It has an authentic English pub feel to it - unpretentious and down to earth. 

The food is fantastic - try the fries at least! The service is prompt and friendly. You almost expect at some point for someone to yell out "Norm!" :)

If you are a lover of Scotch, the owner is very knowledgable and helpful when making your selections.

Amazing pizza, the spring/summer features are incredible and are a welcome surprise to their standard if a little limited menu. The drinks/wine selection is perfect for a pizzeria, and the gelato is insane. If you're tired of the greasy gut bombs from other places, definitely give them a go!
Great food every time we've been. Family friendly in early evening. Good brunch too. Varied beer selection offers lots of interesting choices.

I like coming to this place when I need a filling, decent meal without leaving me feeling stuffed either. I agree with everyone else here when I say that the service at this location is awesome. They're always very friendly, attentive and make what you want just how you like it. This is definitely one of the best venues this food court has to offer. It's a must try the next time you can't decide which place to go with!

Heard good things but it's ridiculously just too loud and crowded to attempt to enjoy your time. Children are allowed but it's such a bar type atmosphere that I'd never want to bring my kids. Great selection of beer though. Maybe focus more on the customers and less on cramming people into tight corners. Will not return.

The food here is too good. The flavours are simple but jumps off the plate. The espresso is amazingly smooth. The service is fast and friendly. Over all it's a great experience for lunch or dinner. They do have a outside patio which is also really nice during the warm weather. Definitely check them out if you want some great Italian pizza.

This is my go-to Tim Horton's because it's on my way to work.  It's pretty standard and they always seem to get the orders right.

The low rating is based specifically on how they handled "Camp Day" this year (June 3, 2015).  I always make sure to stop by Tim's on Camp Day.  The Tim Horton's Summer camp is a great program that I am happy to support.  In the past, I've always been blown away by how many "pay it forwards" are going on on Camp Day in the drive thru.  it's usually really awesome.  Yesterday, I was excited to start one for the very first time, since the cars in front of me hadn't done so.  

When I got to the window, I told the lady there to use my change to pay for the next car or two.  She looked at me with a really puzzled look on her face.  I explained again, that I wanted to pay for the vehicles behind me.  her co-worker tried to explain it as well, but when I pulled away from the window, I still was not convinced that my money was being used for what it was intended for.

This morning, I went through the drive thru again.  And I was disgusted to see how many streamers and deflated balloons were littered around their store (leftover from yesterday's "festivities").  Clean up your property guys!



Aside from Camp Day - here is my review of this location.  This parking lot is incredibly cramped and has been this way for years.  In order to line up for the drive thru you have no choice but to block traffic trying to get to other businesses.  My *hope* is that they plan to tear down the vacant structure next door (formerly Wok Box and Taco Bell before that), to allow more room for vehicles, but that seems unlikely.  

However, the staff are competent and friendly for the most part.  

I'll continue to stop here once a week or so, because of it's convenience

Went here for dinner tonight because it was so close to all of the car dealerships, have never been to local before. Super nice inside lots of games and different things to do and lots of light and very open.

The service was mediocre at best, had to get our own menus, took over 15 minutes to take our drink order etc but the food was delish! My sister and husband loved the fish tacos and the burgers were great. Order the spicy edaname!

Will go back. Also great drink selection!

I love the atmosphere, which is why I'm giving it a 4 instead of a 3. The place just seems like a cool place to hang out! I mean, who has shuffleboard!? My great aunt had one and that's the only time I've ever seen one!

I loved the spicy Cesar salad, and the starter quesadilla was tiny but delicious. My SO got the Big Kahuna Burger, which he loved. He wasn't crazy about the gravy, but I thought it was perfect. 

They lose a star because of the servers. We had one girl seat us, another take our drink order, and another bring us our drinks after an incredibly long wait. The last and final server complained about how the bartender was being a dick, which was why our drinks took so long... so... um.... get your sh*t together, Local. For the record, it was not busy.

Our eventual server was totally inattentive. My SO, who was not DD, would have had more drinks, but we never got asked! One drink on a Saturday night? Thaaaaaaanks. 

That said, servers are a dime a dozen and I'm looking forward to getting a better one next time because the food was great, the ambience was great, and the drink was lovely (I had a taste of his pimms cocktail. YUM!).

The China Kitchen is a small restaurant that mainly caters to the take-out market. We ordered the Kung Pao Chicken and a large steamed rice and sat at one of the small tables.
We were impressed with the quantity compared to the small portions you receive from a lot of Edmonton and area restaurants these days.
Owners were very friendly and pleasant. Will definitely be back.
Amazing atmosphere, the only place in Edmonton and surrounding area I'll go to watch a soccer match.

Love Costco!  Customer service and return policy can't be beat, great products and great prices!  Love it even more now that they accept MasterCard instead of American Express. :)  And the money you save quickly pays off your membership fee, so don't fret about that.

Best Neapolitan pizza this side of Naples! Fabulous hand tossed brick oven baked thin crust pizza ever! 

Famoso imported their pizza brick oven straight from Naples. But that is not the only imported thing, they import most of their ingredients directly from Italia!  Flour, olive oil, sun-dried tomatoes... Mmmarvelous!  

Pizza isn't the only thing on their menu. They have wonderful salads and delicious baked sandwiches. 

If you like soup, their house speciality will impress you. A wonderful tomato bisque with cream and feta cheese. It is a little on the spicy side but you keep wanting more. A very filling choice.

You can also choose a pizetta with a side. The pizetta is a half-size pizza of your choice, which you can order individually or with soup, salad or sandwich.

Their desserts will also not disappoint you. Fabulous locally made gelato, panna cotta, dolce and banana, and affogatto.

I quite enjoy their Chai Latte. It is a nice surprise and can be ordered with skim milk.

The menu has regular features but also has seasonal ones that change. 

They have a wine club you can join and every time you purchase a glass of wine, it is recorded. These add up and you can earn FREE VINO! Can't beat that!

Be advised that at lunch and supper time, the lineups to this restaurant can be long, come a little earlier if you can.  Once seated, service is quick and friendly. 



Reservations only if a party of 6 or more.

Worst Starbucks Ever! The average wait in the drive through is 10 minutes, and then your lucky if they get your drink right! Going into the store is just as bad, you wait forever while the staff just stand around and chit chat. The only reason I keep coming is because it's the only Starbucks that is close to my house :-(

My hairdresser Marissa is awesome. She always listens to exactly what I want and then makes recommendations as to what will work for my hair and talking about the newest trends. She is also super friendly, down to earth and very professional. This was my 3rd haircut and colour with her and she always goes above and beyond.

Very good!  Pizzas are delicious and the prices are good.  Nutella pizza isn't as great as I thought it'd be. It would be better if it was made with more of a sweet dough instead of just pizza dough, but all in all, very good pizza :).

Seriously?! I ordered my usual medium regular dark roast and hubby double double. I am pissed off to see the cups this full. Not only that but he got triple triple, and mine had triple sugar. Unbelievable.......

Service was decent, and atmosphere was nice too.. but, let's talk about the food. Ordered nachos - wasn't a fan of how they're made, as they were not your traditional nachos (I was warned, but thought I'd give them a try). I would have been able to eat them, had they not been thickly coated in a layer of salt. My yam fries were also loaded in salt, and came with a not-so-palatable lemon aioli dip. My other half ordered a burger, which was also salted to an extreme degree. The food wasn't just a 'little salty', as the amount used made the food inedible. I'm not sure if they just had a poor chef on staff or what, but I haven't been willing to try Local again because I'm afraid for my blood vessels. Too bad, because their menu reads pretty good!

This is our go-to pizza spot for take-out in The Park! Sure there are lots of other places to choose from but staff are friendly and pizza is great. They also have a garlic butter dipping sauce that our kids love to use on their pizza crust -- it can be swapped out for another flavour though (ranch, etc.).

Be sure to order online for additional specials -- our fav is Web Wednesday with 25% off.
I went with a groupon voucher. I am pretty happy with my hair cut. The salon is nice and clean. Appointment was on time so I didn't wait at all.

Great service, best out of all locations I've visited! Clean and quiet atmosphere, large tables to accomodate families and large parties as well. 

Always get the quattro formagio....yum yum yum. The tiramisu is fab too. Try to save room.

In my second visit back to Spasation in the park, I had a different aesthetician for my signature facial. I can't remember her name now - but she's very friendly and had been giving out facials for 3 years. Aside from the great service, I would have liked for her to go over the brand & type of product used like the mask, the exfoliator etc. It's important for some clients to know the brand and line that will be applied. 

I had asked whether the chosen product was suited for my skin type, she assured me that it was. It just would be nice to know what to look for in future visits.

It's okay.  Service was good, but slow.  The menu was limited, not much selection.  The fish and chips was good, but not the best. The server was friendly and was helpful.  Personally, I think I will stick with either Joey's or Earls

First time at Famoso was awesome!

I actually liked the Sophia Lauren Sandwich rather then the pizza. (both vegetarian)

Very reasonable prices and always made to order. No problems with seating, ordering and getting what you pay for.

Try the gelato :)

The Edmonton Host Lions Club held a Wine and Cheese Event to raise money to support Lions efforts to combat diabetes.  Ryan Tycholas of Baseline Wines was a big part of making it a huge success.  Ryan selected some fantastic wines for the evening.  When he presented the wines, Ryan was extremely knowledgeable.  He was able to communicate his knowledge in a way everyone understood and could enjoy. In between wine courses, he took the time to talk to and mingle with people who attended the event.  In his quiet and understated manner, Ryan proved himself a joy to work with at all times.

I had a call from an attendee two days after the event.  He loved the event and was effusive in his praise for Ryan.  He said the event was the best wine and cheese tasting he had been to.  Ryan made him want to enjoy and know more about wine.

I end this review as I am off to Baseline Wine as I now have a new favorite wine I need to stock up on and want to beat others I know are doing the same.

An awesome Pub atmosphere right off of the Anthony henday. I've never been disappointed by the food here and the chicken tacos are top notch . There's a large indoor outdoor patio with a few team player games around the restaurant. They have a ping pong table and shuffle board among other team games if you are feeling fun. So get there early as the patio fills up fast!

I don't typically believe in doing multiple reviews on a business, especially in the same year, but i definitely needed to do an update on my last one.

It took me a full 8 months to go back... I was that irritated by my last visit.  But the massage that I ended up getting back then was really good so I knew I'd be back.

I booked a 60 minute relaxation massage with Milos.  The first time EVER that I have had the same massage therapist twice in a row.  He's that good.  

The only negative that I could say really is that his "bedside manner" (for lack of a better term) could use some improvement.  the scrub pants that he wears are just slightly too large so they "swoosh" as he moves around the room.  It can be very distracting.  And also, and this is going to sound absolutely ridiculous.... when he is getting more massage oil, he does it very loudly.  The squirting sound is quite unnerving.

But the massage is great.  He checks in a couple of times to see how you're doing.  


The main reason for the bump in stars is the AMAZING renovations that they've done here.  the place looks absolutely incredible.  It was cramped before but certainly not now.  They've opened up the reception area quite a bit and I just can't get over the changes.

Very yummy pizza! The caesar salad was done in a unique way and tasted very nice, as well.

I am not a huge fan of most thin crust pizzas (too crispy), so I was not sure what to expect. I was pleasantly surprised when I went here, though. The crust is very good. It's definitely not crispy (only on the edges). There is a nice balance between crust and toppings.

It's a bit odd how you get a table, then have to leave the table to order. At least they bring the food to you, I guess.

I will be back.

I attended the Orange theory but I didn't really like the workout or having to make appointments to work out so I decided to cancel my service. I went down to the location to cancel and was told my payment was already made for the month so I would have one more month to use the service. I asked if I would be charged again and I was told I wouldn't have another payment taken out of my account. Imagine my surprise when another payment came out of my account yesterday. I called and explained my situation and they said they were unwilling to do anything for me because I cancelled on the 22nd and my payment is set for the 20th. I was welcome to use the facility for another month. It's safe to say I will never use a Orange theory facility again and will never recommend it to anyone.

Got to watch out who's working as a manager there is nice ones but there's this one that won't let your kids play hockey or any games but he can go play ping pong and hit the ball all over and it's ok. What a d..k. If you go here look out for this one.

Love this place! Their Neapolitan style pizza is on point and service is fast! They even gave my toddler a little ball of dough to entertain her until the food came :) one time they messed up an order and they gave me $25 off my next visit! Our favourites are the Vesuvio and siciliana, style is very reminiscent of the pizza in Italy :)

YUM! 
Great portion sizes for average to below-average prices.
The customer service is just amazing. I love Edo!

Got to watch out who's working as a manager there is nice ones but there's this one that won't let your kids play hockey or any games but he can go play ping pong and hit the ball all over and it's ok. What a d..k. If you go here look out for this one.

So far it has been great service and good food. Usually go to the one in south common.
Enjoy the atmosphere

This Costco location is a bit of a headache finding parking. It seems to be pretty busy with lots of cars coming in and out. As other reviewers have pointed out, I find this location lacks the volume and diversity as other Costcos in the city.

That being said, I usually have no trouble finding what I need (the essentials). The line ups can be long depending on the time of day.

Can't beat the prices at Costco in general, especially when items also go on special.

This location has the added bonus of having a gas station as well as the liquor store!

The annual fee may be pricey to some however the prices of items more than make up for that fee. It's rare to find anyone these days who doesn't shop at Costco I find.

4/5 on the service. 
5/5 on ease in making appointment.
two thumbs down on the regular pricing for services. 

Thanks to Groupon, I paid Spasation in the Park a visit after paying $35 for $75 of service.
I couldn't resists their signature classic facial.
The service was excellent - from the receptionist who handed out refreshments to the the attendants at the till - they were very professional. The atmosphere is calming and adequately lit, music was soothing. The aesthetician (Fortunee) is experienced, but at times forceful. She took the time to ask about my preferences prior to the facial and whether or not I was happy with the results afterwards. However, at times I find her to be a tad too forceful in her techniques in delicate areas (like around the eyes).

Koodos to their online booking system, a few simple clicks on their website and they were able to get me in the NEXT day (a Saturday) at 10AM! They do this by email - so if you're looking for a quick appointment - stay tuned to your emails!
Super good food and great drinks but SOOOO EXPENSIVE! CRAZY small portion sizes. It's a shame because the place is so cool with a great atmosphere!

I recently returned to Local and had the cheddar press burger and shared nachos.
The burger was amazing, one of the best I've ever had, the nachos were wonderful, fresh and warm.  
Great decor, a very friendly and helpful waitress and not very crowded at all. 
Definitely a much better experience and really change my opinion of Local.  Would definitely recommend and return.

We went for dinner last night. .it was extremely busy and we had a 1 year old with us.  They give the little ones dough to play with which is great!  We ended up waiting quite some time and when our pizza came it was not cooked properly...we have eaten there before without a problem (it is GREAT) and the GF crust is amazing.  We ended up having to leave due to little one and the long wait but without expecting it the owner approached us to say sorry for the wait and he had taken the pizzas off our bill.  To conclude. ..we were satisfied with every thing...sometime things happen out of a restaurant s control. ..they solved the problem very well.

First off, This is REAL pizza. Not that gross, greasy, pie shaped stuff you get from Americanized pizza places, this is the real deal and holy pancakes batman..its good.

I started with the Caprese salad which was, dare I say, erotic. Thick slices of mozzarella with perfectly ripened tomatoes all swimming in balsamic vinaigrette on a bed of greens, so good my eyes literally rolled to the back of my head. My Pollo pizza, which was roasted chicken with artichoke hearts and peppers can only be described as what I think Zombies taste when they eat brains, just so good you can't stop until its all gone...They should definitely consider making that some sort of awesome slogan. 
For the longest time I thought that I would forever hate pizza but this is no more! Thank you Famoso for showing me what real pizza is, now I shall never look back! So long Pizza 73, Little Ceasars and other generic garbage! I think this has a huge thing to do with the fact that this is thin sliced which is healthier and easier to eat, and you get to roll it into cute little pizza rolls! How quaint!

The prices are pretty steep but in the end I think worth it because everything is made fresh and all the ingredients are of great quality and some even flown in all the way from Italy for more authenticity. The also have Nutella pizza and other desserts derived from Nutella which is bad for me...as I am addicted to Nutella..Argh! Go to Famoso and I promise you will never look at pizza the same way again!

OH and don't forget to sample some fine Italian wine! Like, how can you resist? I can't.

I stopped by the preview centre to find out what all these orange bikes around town are about. 

The guy who was there was very laid back and professional, at no point during my visit did I feel rushed or pressured. 

At the end of the "tour" I expected to be bombarded with sales pitches and packages. But I wasn't! He simply showed me the prices available and -get this- no contract.

I recently received an email from them saying they had complimentary boot camp classes every Wednesday in Sherwood Park until the gym opened. I haven't attended one yet but I plan to soon. 

Will update my review when the gym opens and the classes start. I really like the Orangetheory program at a glance and I look forward to starting it! :)

Four stars only because their website gives very little information on it.

I ordered the CAPRICCIOSA Pizza and it was simply exquisite. The high quality olive oil and fresh basil on this particular pizza that also comes with mushrooms, ham and artichoke hearts make for one amazingly delicious slice after another!
Service was also fantastic - shout-out to our server that night, Alexa Place, for being so helpful. 
p.s. I love the wine specials.
Such an improvement on the old Winners.  This one is bright and clean and one can actually move a carts around easily.
I've never had a bad pizza here. Favourites include BBQ chicken and Funghi pizzas. Tiramisu is a must try. Service is usually prompt here.

Baseline Wines&Spirits, is one of the best liquor stores in the Edmonton surrounding area. 
Not only is it privately owned and operated, the prices are fair, and the staff are very knowledgeable. They have a beautiful store with a really great tasting room. I've been to many of their tasting events, fundraisers ect and can say hands down that Ryan is one of the more entertaining tasters I've had the pleasure of listening to.

If you want a really great wine/boutique shopping experience. Visit Baseline Wines&Spirits.

I have loved shopping at Costco ever since it opened in Edmonton many years ago.

I really like the Sherwood Park location, though I find they do not get the volume of items the Southside store on 91 St does.  When they opened, I recognized many of the staff that had transferred from the South store so the service here has been as excellent as I was used to getting before. I am very happy with this location.

I find Costco's prices are still better than sale prices in the grocery chains. And I do like the benefits of buying in bulk, not only saving money, but less packaging on many items. 

I have also contacted suppliers of products to Costco and been very pleased with the reception I received when I requested information on their product.

I am also glad they have added a gas bar to this location.

I have been going here for quite awhile now and they do a good job. It is a good place to go for reasonable price,and a decent job. I have had pedicures and manicure. If you want a spa like atmosphere that is quiet and fancy, then this is not it. It is a place to go that is quick. They make their money on volume. I am busy in my life and want someplace I can trust, but that gets me going onto the next thing. Thank you ladies & gentleman for doing that.

Went there today to get my usual drink. I usually go to the baseline one but decided to switch it up.  For some reason it all of a sudden cost more so I asked the barista why via speaker to which she responded "see you at the window" ummm okay doesn't answer my question. Then I drive up to the window and ask her the same thing because it's always the same price and now it's more to which she literally responded "I don't know I just press the button and it gives me the price". When my coffee was finally made (a good 7 minutes later!) she hands me the cup that has melted ice and iced coffee dripping from it. When asked for a napkin she gave it to me with an attitude. She also looked like it's such an inconvenience for her to even be there and like we should be honoured by her presence. Here is a little tip honey. You're not meant for customer service go do something else and take a nap maybe.

A bunch of us came in here on Saturday night for karaoke..and the game. Alot of fun for sure. Great variety of beers and great bar fare.. We all had Nachos and Chicken wings, the usual snacks to go with beer. Service is great, and the guys all loved the big screen for sports, to watch the hockey game....Truly a great English Pub.
Great tasting authentic Thai food but was a little more expensive than we expected. We will absolutely go back when we are in Sherwood park

Worst customer service ever. I've never felt so disrespected before at a nail salon than the way I felt here with Donna. The fact that she is the owner is shocking. She truly doesn't care about customer service. She was rough and hurt my hands and nails. She didn't do what I asked for. She rushed the whole time and spoke in a different language to her staff right in front of me. So rude. I will never go back and I would never recommend this place to anyone!!!

I should have just listened to my gut. I went in for a cut and colour with a (so called) Master stylist. I showed her a picture of exactly what I wanted and she said she could do it. Well it ended up nothing like the picture and her version of layers are semi blended on one side and on the other just cut a straight line on the top layer of hair (see pic). Now I have to pin my hair up until it grow out enough to get it fixed/cut and wear it down. I will never go back again.

I find that if you catch them when they are not rushed you do okay.  You can relax and enjoy yourself.  But they are getting busier and so the service has gone way down.  You wait and wait for your appointment now and then they rush during the appointment.  It is very frustrating because the price doesn't go down if you wait or if they rush you!!!!!!!!!!!  Girls do not want to be rushed during a nail service.    I also find that Donna is always trying to get the girls to upsell to the clients and talks in Vietnamese to them when doing so and it is so obvious and tacky.  Can't stand that.  I think they are forgetting that serivce and experience is what people are going for and if they want to have a good reputation then they need to stop taking walk ins that cut into the times set up for their return clients who have called to make an actual appointment.  But because Donna is a lot about the money - she'll squeeze in walk ins in order to get more money at the sacrifice of their returning clients.  Again, not smart.  They have a bit of a turn over of girls so just when you bond to one - they are gone.  I like how clean they are, although the sinks for the pedicures should be cleaned with bleach and really sanitized.  But the big turn off now is knowing you will never be seen on time and you will be rushed during your visit to boot.  That really sucks and makes one think of going elsewhere and I have been going there since they opened.  They need to get back to what they were like when they were first open.  Service, service, service and cleanliness and care and attention to the client.  If they carry only like this - they are just another Vo's or Binh's or Q Nails..........

Meh. Just, Meh. The only highlight was our initial server, Kristin, who actually came and checked on us when we moved from the waiting lounge to our table on the patio-ish area. She was so sweet and earned the place an extra star all on her own. 

Other than that, the food was mediocre (we shared some poutine thing, the poke, some wings and edamame), and different than what they have at the Local in South Common. (other than Kristin) the service was slow, and took forever. The edamame was the highlight for me, honestly, and I enjoyed my radler once I had it, but it was an overall underwhelming experience. 

We were sat right beside the ping pong table, and were fortunate enough to be pelted by flying projectiles as the bros in the place played. The drunker they got, the more we got hit. Fan-tastic. At one point we were all squished on one side of the table to avoid errant paddles. 

Anyway, there are better options.

This is my favourite OT location.
I love that there's lots of space in both the cardio and floor areas, and have never been in a situation where there was insufficient stations or machines. The classes tend to be less busy here, there is always lots of parking, and it's quick to hit the freeway back to Edmonton.

It's also the home base for my favourite instructor Lisa, who is always positive and motivating, and really pays attention to peoples' form and offers feedback and modifications. She's absolutely the best! 
Becky is another great professional instructor. I like the staff in this location generally.

One complaint I have is that a few months back, I noticed the class time slots were cut over the weekend - I wish there were classes past 1330h. I also think the floors and walls could be washed more regularly. I hate stretching out on walls covered with sweaty dirt marks from previous patrons, and getting coated in flooring chunks when doing floor work/stretches. The shower areas could be more clean too.

Love the workout, been going for about 8 months now, and I have yet to be bored. I'm more of an outdoorsy sports person than a gym rat, so the fact I keep coming back is a real credit to the OT model.

I Love Orangetheory but I do not like this location. 

I decided to checkout this location because Riverbend was full for the class time I wanted. I called in and talked to a girl over the phone, in a minute she had me signed up for the class. 

The location was smacked in the middle of a Tim Hortons and another busy store which was fine except for the parking lot... Ugh I hate looking for parking when ppl are rushing in and out especially when there are trucks everywhere in tight small parking spaces made for small cars.
I found a parking spot at the other end and I am ok with walking (I actually prefer walking far). 

I got in and saw how small the fitness gym was, it's half the size of the regular I go to in Riverbend. Not only that but they only have one washroom! That is just insane because there were about 20 or more ppl in the class. The front end girl looked like she just rolled out of bed and I am just being truthful because that is just unprofessional.

Class started and I went to the treadmills I took one of the middle ones and this cranky lady made a fuss that "this was her treadmill". I did not get off because i had already started running. I could see her giving me the stink eye the entire time lol. When we got to the floor her and her 2 other old housewives com-padres were darting me evil eyes while doing weights. Seriously?! lol I'm not worried but the next round on the treadmills I let her have "her treadmill". 

The trainer was great and enthusiastic throughout the class but I just can't get over the entire facility.

O and to boot they had run out of WIPES at the middle of class (the trainer said it was ok we can share each others sweat???)... gross...

Yes I am NEVER coming back to this location ever.

They have just moved.  DO NOT GO TO THE OLD LOCATION.  The new location not far from their old spot, but has better parking and access.  The food is as good or better than before.  We just had their platter for 4 and their dinner for 4.  All the food was delicious and everyone at the table loved it. Portion sizes, especially the chicken pad thai and coconut rice were ample. Service was attentive but not obtrusive.

Few wine and liquor stores ever get my 5 stars. The passion, skill and genuine interest in learning what your tastes are and matching it to a mystery bottle you've never heard of/seen before give you an edge buying a bottle and knowing you'll like it or not before getting it home!

I'm not trained, I'm not a connoisseur, I do know what I like, and what I don't.  I hate blowing good $$ on a bottle to take to friends (or worse ...strangers!)  only to open it and no one likes it. 

Go in, tell them what you are looking for, what you like and what your budget is - they can accommodate ANY budget from low to high. 

Weekly wine email POW - Pick of the Week and there are some very very nice deals to be had! But be QUICK! They sell out of the deals fast.

Heck, I've ordered my wine once or twice by twitter... but I'd recommend you call. ;-)

Wine tastings are a great way to get to know some new bottles!  We had an after work tasting here with great success - and YES they do provide gluten free munchies! Be sure to let them know and they will look out for you.  I'm a sucker for good snacks, and they spread that accompanied our wine tasting was ideal! You're not there for a meal, but I'd like to know how the wine fares against chocolate, cheese, fruit or crackers.  

They also host themed tastings and the tickets make GREAT gifts! Ahem... I'm open to receiving gifts!

Baseline might be a short 15 minute jaunt from Edmonton,but there are few folks I would trust selecting for my daily drinker or stocking for any of your special occasions!

Been here twice already..great food for sure... But it's SO incredibly loud in there you're practically screaming at the people you go there with... Turn it down a notch or two guys!  Really enjoyed their chicken tacos and perogies. Their burgers are to die for! Very upbeat and modern rustic looking..looks great too! Love the beer selection the most!

Unbelievable rudeness! It's was amazing how unprofessional the "manager" was in talking to my elderly parents. Whoever is the owner of this restaurant needs to review their staffing compliment for professionalism. I will make sure to spread the word of how terrible the staff at this restaurant are.
The Alfredo was watery, the pasta was tough and The chicken was lukewarm and felt like I had been under a headlamp for too long. Was very disappointed since the place has a great feel and atmosphere.

I first came here because a friend goes and loves it, so I thought I'd try it out and it is such a great workout. When we were done they offered to talk about membership prices but didn't push anything, and said to come back for another class if I was unsure. I went again and they still didn't push the membership...but by then I just wanted one. It's month to month so they don't rope you into long term payments like the membership I have at World Health. I used to think that I was doing a good enough workout at World Health but I would recommend this to ANYONE because it whips you into shape in no time. I've lost 6 pounds since I've started 1 week ago (low calorie, high protein diet) but I know for a fact that I wouldn't have shed that at a regular gym where you just have to push yourself. Just give Orange Theory a chance and you'll be hooked! Its a free session, so why not and then decided if its for you or not. :)

I received a complimentary ticket to Baseline Wine's "Best Bang for Your Buck" wine tasting. For $25 we tried six different wines that the store felt were good value for the price. Ryan, our host, was quick to point out that doesn't mean cheap, it means good value.

The six wines we tried were priced from $19.99 - $29.99. After the tasting, if you decide to purchase one of the wines you sampled, you receive a 10% discount.

The tasting took about an hour to an hour and a half. How long it goes really depends on how many questions Ryan is asked and whether he goes on an entertaining rant or not!

You receive a brief history of the vineyard or winery as well as being treated to pictures on a big screen TV.

Overall, it was an enjoyable experience, the staff were very pleasant, knowledgable and helpful.

Pretty solid!
Tasty and reminds me of the Thailand that I know.

I like the fact that they ask you how spicy that you like your food . I got mine "White person " Spicy for the family and it was perfect for them.

Tips!
Get it take out and save 10% on orders over $45

Just thought I would stop by with a buddy and check it out for some food and a couple beers. 

Nice initial impression - atmosphere and ambiance were nice on the deck, but after we sat down some other patrons started playing ping pong on the table in the middle of the patio and they hit my friend in the head :(

Nachos were good, lots of variety and different flavours.  Burger was overcooked and I couldn't taste any cheese because it had all been burned off.

Server seemed cold and disinterested.  She would be looking around at the other tables when we were ordering and paying.

Overall we were unfortunately disappointed.  I'll give it a "Meh.  I've experienced better."

I find Local pretty confusing. It has the atmosphere of what should be a 18+ eatery. Like a adults only Joeys. Except kids are allowed which just seems odd and out of place. The games are kind of cool but also seem a bit unecessary. The service is okay. Everyone is always very friendly. The food is okay too nothing I find myself craving though.

I went there for a pedicure. the soak was nice. she took care of my slightly ingrown toe nail. Nice lady who done the pedicure. My only problem was that I have a lot of dead dry skin left on my feet. I was there a week ago for this pedi. I normally go to Vo's where they scrape all the dead skin off with a blade.. this girl used a pumice paddle. which explains why I still have a lot of dead skin left. I paid $62 including a $5 tip. NOT WORTH IT. Around $40 at Vo's and they do a way better job

Excellent homemade food and quality beer selection served at just the perfect temperature. The staff and owner are some of the friendliest people ive ever met. We come here often to relax or enjoy an listening to someone play some tunes on guitar (every friday and saturday i believe) quiz nights are thursday nights. Always in good company if you come here! Beautiful bar too!

Oscar's is a cool little pub in Sherwood Park - a town that really lacks cool pubs. 

If you're in the Park and want to venture out to a place that isn't a cookie cutter chain establishment and serves more than Canadian and Kokanee, this is your place. 

It's your standard British pub, with good beer, sports always on TV and a noise level that promotes conversation. It's a good place for the soccer crowd to hang out at.  I watched the World Cup Final with friends there and it was a good atmosphere. Of course its a great place for a pint and a hockey game too. 

I haven't had too much on the menu, but what is most memorable is their deep fried dill pickle spears. I thought they sounded gross, but they are actually really awesome. Just let them cool off before you take a bite - they are hot!

They have a trivia night on Thursdays, which I attended once and was pretty fun. They also have a selection of single-malt scotches, but I'm a beer drinker, so I haven't had any. 

The staff was always really friendly and the owners are always kicking around.
