Papa johns is hands down my favorite delivery pizza. And the staff at this location are so friendly and helpful I usually order online and sometimes when there's a glitch in the system I have to call them and they're always really helpful and happy to fix whatever problem I've encountered. The crust is sooo good and the garlic sauce is to die for. It's definitely not the cheapest around but it's worth it. I always order a large so I have leftovers.

Awesome food. Great service. Very quick and excellent for lunch!!

I highly recommend this location for lunch.

My husband bought me a spa package (massage, pedicure, manicure).  He requested an insurance receipt for the massage as I can get money back on my insurance. 
 When we went to pay, they told us they could not issue the receipt as our massage therapist did not have enough hours.  It seems to me if that is requested to begin with, it is dishonest not provide it.  
If you are hoping to be able to bill through insurance, be wary of this company as they do not provide what is promised and are not willing to fix their mistakes.

this is probably my least favourite place to eat because everything is expensive and you only get 4 perogies. the music is way too loud and you can't even hear yourself think. Other than that the service is good and the waitress is nice, Caycee, very kind. Cora's across the street is way better highly recommend. the perogies do taste good though

This looked like a good place to eat, until I stood at the door for almost 10 minutes. Do you seat yourself? I don't know. All the girls lol looked at me but no acknowledgement or anything. So I guess I'll go to average joe's, at least there  an employee will notice a paying hungry customer

Wow!  This place is the rudest lingerie shop I've ever been to.   They refused to believe what bra size I was and kept giving me too small of size.   They did not have any discreet robes to put on and left you standing in your underwear.   They were not helpful and judged me that I was a shoplifter based on my age.   I will never go back again.   Go somewhere where they treat you like a queen when buying two hundred dollar underwear.

Most the reviews here seem to be for the spa. I went for a cut, colour and style. I had purchased a coupon which was to cover all those costs except gst and tip. When I arrived at the salon it shows beautifully. I was taken to my chair and the hairstylist did not have much experience with colour. Another one had to help her give me suggestions. It turned out that because I wanted to lighten my hair to an extent I had to pay extra for that as it was not a "colour" Ok I agreed to this as it's what I wanted. Through the process my hair was being basically bleached to the point of no colour at all. It actually looked orange. I was not very happy so they decided to add another toner to it. I had been there now for 3 hours. The new toner took the orange out but I was still platinum blonde and at mid forties it  was not really the look I was going for. After a little quick snip of the scissors and asking me if I was ok that was it. I basically have medium blonde hair naturally and wanted to lighten it a couple of shades leaving dark blonde highlights with it. When they started I was under the impression that they would lighten and then add some darker tones back in which didn't make alot of sense to me but then I'm not a professional hairdresser and usually rely on Shoppers for my haircolour. Once finished I was not very happy with the whole outcome but Spasation then requested final payment for the lightening even though this color wasn't even close to what I asked for and they had to do it twice due to the fact it was horrible. So after four hours and well over 100.00  I left their salon, went to Shoppers and purchased a dark blonde haircolor and added lowlights to my own hair. It now looks wonderful except I'll need to go get the actual cut fixed up a bit as it a little lopsided as well. 
So I guess that unless you or someone you know actually know a hairdresser at this salon I wouldn't take my chances. I definitely won't be back and am still searching for a new hairdresser.

Went here for the first time on st patties weekend. Great little British style pub in Sherwood park. The place is showing it's age but it kind of works in a way to making you feel relaxed and has a casual atmosphere to go for a drink with friends. I hear they also have live music and pub quiz nights to entertain. I only tried the fried dill pickles off the menu as I wasn't too hungry but they were amazing just the right amount of tang and batter! Probably best fried pickles I've ever had and creamy dill dip to compliment. They also had a large beer selection and the other food we saw going out looked very appealing. I didn't even know this place existed so I'm excited to go back and yelp about this diamond in the rough to my friends.

The latest in Edo sit-ins to be opened in Edmonton (ok, the Greater Edmonton-area). Everything looks and still feels new. Walk in and you are greeted with very friendly service. The staff smile at you as they cook from behind the counter.

I like this location because of the outstanding customer service. Yes the food prices may not be the cheapest, but the portions are very generous. You get the feeling that the owners want you to leave fully satisfied. The sushi rolls are large (and not just overly riced out- they're full of stuff!), and the beef and chicken come in heaps and glazed over by teriyaki sauce and lined with vegetables. You simply have to try it yourself, they keep on making me come back!

We stopped by for a quick meal before our daughter's concert at Festival Place.  The menu was good and offered the standard diner fare of burgers, fish and chips, sandwiches, and breaded veal. The service was great (thanks Angela!) and the food good. The restaurant also boasts an outdoor patio. 

I'd happily come back again!

I have to update my review for this location... 

I like coming here not only because it's close to where I live but the trainers and staff are super friendly and motivating. I usually go to the Riverbend location but when I drive into the parking lot and there's no room on either sides of the building, I'm heading over here.

The trainers here have a different strategy on using the treadmills and rowers then incorporating the weights throughout so your heart rate is almost consistent (or I'm just out shape right now... lol). I build up a lot of sweat each time and expect a contrasting workout experience.

I think the best times to come in are during the daytime weekdays when it's not so busy. And I apologize there are 2 bathrooms lol. The last time I was in one bathroom was out of commission which had me frustrated.

I will definitely be back here.

I thought the service was slow to start. Menu is lean unless u like burgers. The French fries were awesome though and it was a gourmet burger. 

The atmosphere is good and it is a cool looking restaurant. Quite trendy.

As the name says, they serve Thai food. Delicious, authentic, fresh Thai food.  I can honestly say I have never had a meal there that was a disappointment.

To begin with, the decor and ambience is calming and understated. Often to get really good Thai food, you have to sacrifice atmosphere. Not here. Black leather seating, stylish lighting and simple, open air understated design contribute to this oasis type feeling. Even the washrooms at Thai Together are comfortable!

The other night was no exception. We started out with some piping hot onion cakes that were fresh and gave off a tantalizing smell. A perfect start to a wonderful meal.
 
I had the traditional Pad Thai with mild spice. I am not a huge fan of spicy food so I find this is just the right amount of zip - you can taste the spice, but it isn't painful to eat and your tastebuds aren't overpowered. You get a large serving size that you can either eat as a meal or share with your companion.
 
The Pad Thai had lots of fresh vegetables and just the right amount of tofu - I had mine with chicken and I don't like being overwhelmed with too much of the 'fake' protein. The tamarind sauce wasn't too heavy which allowed the noodles to carry the dish

 My husband's dish was the Thai Together Cashew Nut Shrimp with coconut rice. He was in his glory while eating and I have to say, after snagging a couple bites, I don't blame him.

Sweet crisp peppers pineapple, onions and baby corn cooked in a tangy sauce. A sauce that was described as "Sweet and Sassy" - he is so poetic! The coconut rice was sweet and just sticky enough to soak up the sauce.

As if this wasn't enough, we decided to try the mango and sticky rice. I don't usually try this dish at Thai restaurants in Canada because I have eaten in Bangkok so I know how it is supposed to taste. Although it is easier to replicate Pad Thai, I have found restaurants struggle with the mango and sticky rice.

I was not disappointed. The rice was absolutely delicious! It was so incredibly sweet and succulent, I could feel my blood sugar levels rising.  The mango was presented perfectly. Because we don't get the soft, fresh mango you find in Thailand, they sliced it into a fan shape and added a few drops of some type of mango dressing.  If they had used a lot of the dressing, it would have overpowered, but as it was, it was just enough to offset the rice. Definitely a must-have.

Bonus Tip: The Curry Grouper is to-die-for-good!

In total, the meal was under $50

Being gifted in the chest department, it is very difficult for me to find nice bras that fit properly. I can't shop in La Senza or even Victoria Secret as they only carry up to a certain size. I had previously always gone to "I am a woman" in south Edmonton but was devastated to learn they had closed. I looked on Yelp for an alternative and came across this shop. The store itself is a bit small but very clean and open. The staff were all extremely friendly and helpful and didn't make me feel awkward while fitting me. The sales lady and I spent about an hour together and we laughed a lot. I found the prices sooooo much better than any other specialty bra/lingerie store I have ever shopped in. I think I spent close to $350 on 3 bras at "I am a woman," and I spent that much on 5 bras and a corset at this store. If you're a busty lady and have never been sized by a professional, go to this store. They won't make you feel ignorant or awkward. I will definitely be back!

Great food, good prices and fantastic atmosphere. Really enjoyed everything I've ever ordered here. Never had a dish I didn't like. Staff are very friendly and always accommodating. Great place to eat and hang out, maybe even play a few games. Love the "board game corner". Very unique.

Costco SP always caters to their customers and is a great place to shop and make returns to if needed.  It is very busy and SP could use two Costco's but every Costco is nuts.  Just the way it goes.  They should serve Coke not Pepsi at the cantina or both.  Most people prefer Coke and they should offer some healthier options.

This is my local starbucks but I tend to go to Lakeland when I'm in a hurry or need consistency. This store was bad in the early morning for not following posted start times but lately they have been consistent.
I haven't waited the longest I have every waited in a drive-through in this stores drive-through (over 20min) If it's busy I don't bother stopping which is an inconvenient first world problem but if i have the time I still stop by.

OUTSTANDING service. Kudos to all wait staff and cooks. Mozzarella balls are delicious and definitely a new fav! Pizza is cooked to perfection and service is very quick and efficient. 

I will definitely be back!

Went through drive through and it was a little slow but staff were friendly enough. Got my Earl Grey double cream no sugar always fantastic only complaint wheres my second tea bag? This is a good location if you're heading into or out of Sherwood Park.

We have eaten Nandos chicken for the last 8 or 9 years, and have visited this location many, many times.  However, tonight I was served up a piece of black, charred chicken breast.  I refused it of course, and shortly afterwards was brought another piece.  Cutting into it, I and my husband both noticed the gooey and pink inside indicated it wasn't done enough. I again refused it and they took it back to the kitchen, to cook it more.  It was only 3 or 4 minutes later that they brought it out again, and I cut a piece off the outside of the breast.  It was still very under cooked, and I could not eat it.  We left the restaurant at that point, and I must point out that my husbands first half chicken was also burnt but he was too ravenous to wait.  We told the manager we wanted to be reimbursed for my meal and she argued that the oven is set to a certain temperature and so that meant it was fully cooked.  I told them we had been Nandos patrons for close to 10 years, and had never had chicken under cooked like that.  She refunded the money, but her attitude left much to be desired.  We were extremely disappointed in one of our favorite restaurants. Don't know if we'll be back, and we won't recommend it, as we always used to do.
Opening day, fresh food great service, had the roasted red pepper zuppa and the porketta sandwich.  If you're in Sherwood Park and want a great lunch, dine-in or to-go.

I went there for the first time ever today, I've heard so much about it I thought why the heck not. Service was good, and the bread was fresh and tasty, however my chicken parm was rubbery and the pasta was just ok. I felt that the $18 price tag was too much for the food I was given, it was just OK.

My co-workers and I dropped in at this location for a celebratory lunch as it is fairly nearby our new office.

We entered and were immediately greeted as with assisted in finding the seating to fit our  group of 6, We found the waitress to very much be on top of her game; quick, friendly & knowledgeable about their menu items.

Food came out in pretty good time & we all enjoyed our meals, with no complaints.

Good atmosphere, good service & good food; I'll be back! :)
Simply the most creative and delicious pizza I have ever had! Strongly recommend, you are not simply eating a pizza or a meal, you are enjoying an art!

Donna and her staff are very professional and efficient. This is a very clean location, an important thing for this type of business. Love the massage chairs. Just wish there were more nail polish colour options to choose from. They are always running out as they are a busy location. They do take walk-ins.
Atmosphere is ok rustic but the food is great Had the steak sandwich and it was the best service great The place is a little off for people over 50 but will still go for the food

My daughter suggested we go here when we visited her.  I tried my first Bloody Caesar which is a Bloody Mary made with Clamato.  It was good, but not any better than what I am used to.  The pizzas though were delicious!  We tried a couple of different varieties and we all shared.  The server was friendly and helpful.
Friendly staff, positive environment, great workout, flexible times, instructor are motivational, you will leave with a good sweat and an incredible feeling everytime

Staff have no problem taking money. Officially the laziest timmies I have gone to. Legit. Only blended my ice cap for 2 seconds  does it matter? To most not really. But when I pay for something I know I am suppose to get better service on it's a little frustrating/disappointing.


  Changed my review to a 1 Star for the ice cap tastes like fermented cream. They clearly don't clean the machine. I bet if you lifted the top where the liquid pours in there is a thick frothy film built up around the edges (i know because I use to have to clean these when I worked at a timmies).

    This was a disappointing stop. Best part was using the washroom.

The service was soooo bad, what happened Sherwood park? The other locations in Edmonton are so good, kinda sucks this is my local location... food was good tho cuz 2 stars cuz service, probably won't come to this one again after tonight.

Very smooth service, people very in and out because of how popular it is, so there is a very positive flow of people, they also serve free samples and have everything I need for packing lunches and cooking dinner, the only negative feedback I have for Costco is there is the rare grumpy soccer mom who thinks her life is more important, now I did say there's a post it I've flow but there is an occasional mean person. I gave it four stars though because of how busy and compacted it is, there's no space to breathe and you can never find a place to park, and the building itself isn't that busy.. just the parking lot!
Overall very good building that is very satisfying!

We live just down the road and this place is very good and super convenient. With our son having a good allergy, they are very understanding and make sure to not cross contaminate our food. I would recommend the shrimp curry it is sooo awesome!
Always fast friendly service.  Very honest about letting you know if you need a new air filter or not.  The shop is always super clean and orderly.

I think one star is giving this Sherwood Park location to much credit!
My stylist Jazz was horrific!!!!!   Beyond words she was bad.  She not only murdered my hair to the point that I need it re-cut asap she thought it was fine to wash my hair in COLD water and laughing at me when I asked for it to be warmer. I am only going back here to get my hair fixed by a senior stylist because they REFUSED to refund my money!!  MY nice long hair trim is now turning into a full cut because of the fix up job.  I am not happy and pissed!!   Avoid this place!

Famoso is definitely one of my favourite chains around.  I've been to almost all the locations around here, and I can always trust it to be consistent, no matter what location I choose to go to.

Last night, my mom and I visited the Sherwood Park location for the first time in a while.  We were kind of early for dinner - it was around 5 pm and there was only one other table in there when we arrived.  

Our server was Alexa and she was an absolute sweetheart.  She made great conversation with us and provided fantastic service.

They have a great Happy Hour Menu on from 3 pm - 6 pm and again from 8 - close and we definitely made good use of that menu.  I warned Alexa that although there were only 2 of us, we were going to order enough food for 6 people.  She laughed and told us to bring it on!

Let's see if I can remember everything we had.

The Famoso Salad is a must have, everytime we're here.  The flavours are delicious.  Alexa told us that she adds avocados to hers and I think I'll have to try that next time.

Cauliflower and artichoke dip: this was really tasty, though probably my least favour dish of the night.  The smoked mozza added a flavour that just didn't do it for me.

Meatballs: My favourite.  These are a mixture of beef, pork, and ricotta cheese.  Absolutely delicious.

Mediterranean flatbread: another staple on the menu.  Long strips of baked pizza dough with Tzatziki and Hummus to dip it into.  I'm not even a big fan of hummus, but this is great!

Bruschetta:  Always delicious.  The crustinis are not over toasted, so you can easily bite into them.  The balsamic reduction adds a nice sweetness.

This is a nice, inexpensive evening out, and awesome that you can bring the whole family!  They even bring little balls of pizza dough for the kids to play with :)

I have been going here for my manicure for over a year. They do a good consistent job each time. The value for what I pay is good. It is not a high end fluff spa, but a place you can go, get your manicure or pedicure done in a timely manner and get on with your day. If that is what you are looking, I would recommend going here.

Friendly service does not make up for embarrassingly bad food, which food is also strangely overpriced.  In particular, the nachos, the poutine, and the "snake bites" (a small order of chicken nuggets seasoned with chili flakes that costs more than $10) are terrible and they offer extremely poor value for money.  Oscar's is a favourite haunt of one of my friends, so I end up there a few times a year.  It isn't a favourite haunt of yours truly, however.  If you can avoid it, then I'd encourage you to do so.  There are better options in the Edmonton area.

We ordered take out today in celebration of my birthday. We ordered 4 dishes, one of which was fried rice and one order of spring rolls. For the $75 we were quoted, we were expecting something incredible but were sadly disappointed. Actually, disappointed was an understatement! 

While most of the food was tasty, it was not worth $18 a dish! The Shrimp Fried Rice with Basil was mostly rice and the Singapore Noodle dish had little to recommend it. The curry dishes are lovely however, the portion sizes for supper are more suited to lunch. 

The price of the food probably explained why at supper hour only a couple of tables were filled.

All in all, a sad ending to a great birthday!

We have many times ordered the meal deals they have. Pulled pork with Fresh Buns and Coleslaw. Ribs with Warm Potato Salad. An amazing deal and so much food. One order is enough to feed my family of 4! Super easy to place an order, we usually comment on their Facebook post that announces that days deal. 

We've also purchased meat and Pot Pies here as well. Everything is great, tasty and inexpensive. Very friendly staff and a nice local shop that we love supporting. Trust, try the ready made dinners you won't regret it!

The facial was quite nice. My sister-in-law had her hair color done here and it was horrible. I wouldn't have come based on her experience but I had a gift card from Christmas to use. I figured I wouldn't dare get my hair done but face and feet maybe!
Just discovered this place this year but I love it. Awesome meals, very reasonably priced and the nicest staff!

Very frustrating if you have a group on coupon for laser hair removal and try to use all the sessions before expiry. They frequently bump you and cancel appointments saying the machine needs coding and only the manager knows the code blah blah blah. They are not fair to group on customers. Also had to unnecessarily have a consultation first. Not permitted ANY laser anywhere if you're on your period (claimed it won't work). Not true according to normal aestheticians.  Also screwed up gift certificate redemptions. Used up the group on and will never go back.

Nice big open concept restaurant with a variety of seating options. My husband and I went on a Friday afternoon for some appy's and a beer. We were allowed to take our 2 month old baby in, which was nice - because we have been asked to leave a 'no minors' establishment (we weren't aware). 
It's a great atmosphere, they have some games like shuffle board and what looked like a bowling lane on the far side of the room. Our waitress was super friendly and explained their beer menu and how it changes. They have seasonal beers and a lot of B.C. brews, which we appreciated as we literally just moved from B.C. 
We eyed up the loaded nachos and asked our waitress if they were actually 'loaded' because we usually end up disappointed by blah nachos at most places. Anyway, she assured us they were indeed loaded so we went ahead. We also got the pierogis. The nachos were actually fabulous - lots of toppings the whole way thru, instead of just on top. Pulled chicken, jalapeños, lots of gooey cheese and beans - totally yumtastic. The pierogis were delicious as well. 
It was a successful first outing at Local. We will definitely be back, they have a big menu and we want to try some more goodies including the eggs benny on weekends!

My husband and I went to Spasation in Sherwood Park when I purchased a 1-hour couples massage for $89 off Groupon. Since I'm pregnant, I was able to get a prenatal massage and my husband went for the deep tissue massage. The guy I had did a very good job with just the right amount of pressure and he worked a lot on my upper back which I told him was the sorest. My husband said the lady he had really seemed to know what she was doing and she worked on his problem shoulder a lot. We were both very happy with the service, the atmosphere, and the price. I would definitely go back, pregnant or not.
Pizzas were burnt and there was nothing special about this place. I will stick with Blaze or Famosos

Always quick service. One of the most quick drive thru service in area. This is the place where I met my gf for the first time. We sat  next to the fire place which is  on the left side of the entrance. Very clean  and quiet always!

The service is fast and friendly. Up beat atmosphere. Food is always good. The truffle chips are dangerous... So good so addicting .. If you like Caesar's they are a favorite for us there. I think the staff are the friendliest in in Sherwood Park.

The food was absolutely amazing tonight! The best Thai food I have ever had. Thank you so much for the incredible service and food. You made our celebration very memorable. We will be back and highly recommend!!!

From the daily lunch choice to frozen meal items you will find everything delicious at Charlie's. had them custom cut and vacuum pack our Thanksgiving steak for Steak Diane. Every serving was top quality.  Going next week to reserve our Christmas meat. Don't forget to tune into their daily Facebook posts and get your name on the list for amazing hot and ready dinners too.  Highly recommend rib night.

Ordered the beef dip, tasted like tin, they gladly let us order another item. We ordered the Boar burger. It was okay the onion relish was very sweet not sure if it worth the 15.50
Won't order it again
Love the bacon tomato soup. My favorite cold day lunch pick

I love orange theory...well specifically this location. a lot of friends go to the other locations and love it too. i love that the coaches/instructors are so on top of the game. the music play lists are fantastic and i love that i don't have to think when i go there. it's a matter of go, and get ready to work hard. i also appreciate that there are plenty of options for us slower ones of the group. i really enjoyed the weightloss challenge and i thought it was super cute that i got a certificate after completing it. it made me smile. i genuinely love the vibe that the sherwood park coaches and staff give. by far the only location i would work out at.

Really good food but odd service! I got the Vietnamese sandwich and it was delicous, as were the sides.

But when we walked in, there was nobody to greet us. Well, there was, but she was standing at the other end of the restaurant staring at us. Had to walk over and ask where we could sit. After that, it was quick to order, but it took like 20 minutes to get our bill.

Delicious food but I think they need a few more staff, unless that was just an off-night for them.

Saturday lunch.. We went on our way to visit some family in Sherwood Park ànd decided to grab a bite on the way.   We went to Local in Sherwood Park. It is situated where Joey's used to be. The restaurant offers enough parking outside.  The venue is a very large, airy, sporty theme, and friendly area.  With warmer weather , their patio was out and it is a nice addition to it.   Service was very good. The server offered the specials, gave suggestions about the food. I have the fish tacos. .  My plate was amazing.. All positives for these restaurant and I hope they continue with their good service and food.
Very nice store unfortunately they need more stock.But sometimes the staff aren't really that friendly. I also noticed there's a lot of staff change is there a lot lately.

I've changed my tune about this place. While I'm
Still not a huge fan of all the games (shuffleboard is great but I'm tired of nearly getting a ping pong ball in my plate) the service is always friendly. And the chicken sandwich is SO AMAZING. it's super loud though so unless you want to scream above the loud music and noise - go somewhere else for a first date.
Restaurant service was very good and clean . The food was filling and tasty . The portion were very generous compared to the price . The soups were outstanding as well

No complaints!  Burgers are made to order, so they're not sitting around in a warmer for hours before they get to you.  I find that the flavours and quality is consistent at this location, but above all else, the customer service is great.  

I've walked in 20 minutes before they closed and been greeted with smiles. They're always friendly.  My order is always correct and always tasty!

My sister and I went to Original Joes about a week ago for the first time. It wasn't exactly what I expected, but we decided to stay anyways. My sister ordered the Kona burger with fries and a caesar salad and I ordered pulled pork sandwich with the same sides. It wasn't very busy that night (2 other tables) and we waited over half an hour for our food. Once we got our food, it was cold. The salad also looked like it came from a box and it had absolutely no taste. Don't think I'll be going back there for food even though it's 2 minutes away from my house.

Went for Brunch on Sunday with some friends, and The service was not good. Mistakes happen, but our server was not apologetic at all.  Someone I was with waited an extra 10 minutes for her meal, when it finally came out it had a blue dirty cloth sitting on top of the hash browns.  So then she waited an extra 15 minutes longer for another one.  Once the bills had arrived I was shocked that her bill had not been discounted and no manager came over to talk to her. I just think the situation could have been handled better!

i went to get my acrylic nails removed and shellac put on, and she took off my nails very poorly, made me bleed, and argued with me about the shellac so i ended up not even getting it on. i was left with uneven, brittle nails, and one that still hurts. it was so bad

Went for tues wing night.  Wings were old and way overdone  although they took 25min to arrive.  Felt manipulated to order more beer while waiting because there is no reason for them to take that long when my wings were already cooked when i walked in the door.  One crappy wing is not worth a half dollar.  Will try wednesday wing night at cafferys or average joes instead.  Food quality is way down from what it used to be and prices are up. They ended half price appitizers after 9pm in june btw.  Really disappointed.   There goes my favorite place....

First time visitor and I was greeted with the most amazing customer service. Very knowledgeable, and they have a really good selection of meat and cuts. I know where I will be getting all of my BBQ essentials now!

We had supper at the Sherwood Park firecrust Pizza. The salads are very good with fresh ingredients and interesting combinations. There veggie Meats, added to some of the salads, are delicious. The pizza is thin, tasty, with high-quality ingredients, and we liked the ability to customize our ingredients. Staff were friendly and accommodating, and the place is clean. Vegan, vegetarian, or carnivore, you'll find something that suits your palate.
Back to Firecrust again yesterday. I'm hooked on their salads - especially the vegan ones.

The last 2 months at this store been nothing but bullshit .My wife and I together and I give my card to cashier then cashier asked my wife for her card 2 times now  .im a white man and wife is from Guam is Asian I swear they ask from her card cause she is coloured.Another time cashier never got water under cart and we were treated like thieves let alone how embarrassing it was.This store might have good products but way they treat people I'm not impressed

Absolutely amazing food and staff :-) always satisfied. The crispy beef, red curry, pad kee Mao, cashew nut chicken are among my favorite dishes at this restaurant. But really, everything here is so good. It's worth the 30 minute drive to get here.
We love this place. Great selection, food, staff, and atmosphere. Great music. Their food is typical pub food but DELICIOUS.

Waaaaay better than the one on Cambie St. in Vancouver.

We split a poutine and wings were on special, got carribean jerk and bbq. BIG AND TASTEY. We were full. And it was cheap, my half with a pint was $13. 

GREAT SERVICE!! Didn't have to wait for anything around 4:30pm mid week.

ALSO THE RASPBERRY WILDROSE WAS DELCIOUS

Thanks for having a real local (ish) craft beer on tap! 

Great time with colleague, will return happily!

This is the place for EXCELLENT food, but not the place for great service. I've had the beef dip, the steak sandwich and the mushroom soup in my 3x there....worth the money! While service can be great and or has been at times, a server we had said the bare minimum, did the bare minimum...I would have actually preferred to go back in the kitchen myself rather than have her again. But lesson learned - never sit in her section. Easy enough. So returned her tip the same way, the bare minimum. It was crazy to see her surprise at how little we gave....but honey - you get what you give!! 

Expect sub par service but darn it - go for the food

Amazing product, lots of delicious flavours of smokies . Also they have awesome homemade buns.  They are always willing to customize orders and cuts of meat . Always have a good experience here and the prices and quality cannot be beat.  Maui ribs and steaks are very good !
The owner of this establishment is a terrible human being, saying that people on welfare or the mentally ill deserve to starve!

It's no secret that my heart belongs to Costco... As a former Seattleite, it's like having a little piece of home every time I go in!

The parking lot at this location can drive me crazy but check outs go quickly!  This location offers a liquor store (like the St. Albert one) and a gas bar!

Prescriptions are always less for me at Costo than anywhere else as their dispensary fees are low and their food court is a favourite treat for my munchkins before heading home.  Where else can you get a quality all beef hot dog and pop for $1.50?  Seriously, you can feed a family of 4 for under $10.  Of course, my kids love the poutine and that's a bit more.  I also appreciate the water bottle vending machine for 50 cents right next to the food court!  Who else does this?

Frequently, I thoroughly embarrass my husband by buying a rotisserie chicken back in the meat department and then a side of gravy from the food court to eat alongside my hot dog and poutine eating offspring.  But seriously, try it!  It's a MILLION BAZILLION times better than Swiss Chalet anyway and lighter on the wallet.  A trick we do is boiling the rotisserie carcass after making a meal or two out of it for soup stock - it's delish and full of so much flavour from their rotisserie process.

Another reason we love Costco, is their meat department.  You'd be hard pressed to find better meat quality at their prices.  They frequently run specials (like yesterday - $2.50 off a package of chicken breasts).  Their Prime Rib is to die for and makes the bestest Christmas dinner ever!

Great prices for organic cow's milk or organic almond milk, organic tofu, organic meat, organic produce... etc.  Basically, you can get a fair bit of organic here for much better prices than Planet Organic. The organic firm tofu is a favourite of ours and a great price!  You can find tofu in the refrigerated section as well as on the aisles vacuum sealed and not-refrigerated (firm, yay!).

And speaking of Christmas, if you aren't shopping here for hot Christmas items on your kids' wish list, you are paying too much!  From the latest video games to Doh Vinci to Star Wars Lego, their prices are the best!

I could go on and on about my love affair with Costco...  From customer service to quality and selection, I am forever yours.

See you soon!

I was unable to eat anymore as my stomach is on fire. This salad has over the years slowly progressed to an onion salad as the price of bell peppers went up. Poor way to save money. I miss the old Costco Greek salad. We have purchased many of hear salads over the years and it has progressively gotten worse. We will no longer be buying his product, too bad though. Was one of our favorite buys for many years.

I was at Original Joes last night and although it was lined up we weren't waiting long, and our food arrived quite promptly. I find that the service really depends on the size of the group. about 2 weeks ago I was there for lunch with about 20 other people and we were there about an hour and a half. That being said I find that to be quite standard for Pub fare at lunch with a group that size. Overall the food is delicious and decently priced (again standard pub fare prices) great for a night out with friends.

Attended a Yelp event here and had a chance to try their epic milk shakes and make my own pizza. It was super fun and the staff are so helpful. Those milkshakes are definitely epic and full of sugary goodness!

What a great place! When I moved to the area, I was very anxious about finding a new salon. The receptionist was excellent in making me feel comfortable about making an appointment and I was glad I did! Jeff is my stylist and he was beyond wonderful.  He consulted me every step of the way. He made me comfortable and did  better than excellent work on my cut amd colour! I've definitely found my new hair salon!
Really great place for Thai food!!

Stopped in for a quick salad on a holiday monday.  It was my first time here, so i wasn't sure what to expect.  I went for the Firecrust Chopped Salad, which was quite similar to the Famoso Salad at Famoso Pizza which is my favourite thing in the world.  This salad was quite comperable.  Ingredients tasted fresh - no wilted lettuce.

Service was friendly, though confusing.  I later realized that they were working on Skip the Dishes and Door Dash orders, and that's why it didn't seem like they were ready for me, even though there were no other customers waiting.

I would definitely return.  The milkshakes are intriguing... but a little ridiculous.

They have stickers on the table - promoting their items.  It really cheapened the place in my opinion.  Some of them were pealing a bit.  Kind of made me think of something that somewhere like Red Robin would do.  (that's not to say that I think Red Robin is "cheap".... they're just kitchy).

Bought a teambuy voucher, and loved it! The seating area was a little chilly but once I was in the massage it was wonderful, they let hubby and I go together even tho we hadn't scheduled it that way. Tipped big cuz the service was great.

Great made to order pizza. Great specials. Amazing salads. Generous toppings. Fast. Healthy. Enormous milkshakes. 

This place makes great pizza. I love how the food is always fresh and the toppings are so generous. The build your own pizzas are insanely delicious. First off, you get more than what you paid for here! I love the assortment of cheeses and the veggie toppings here are always super fresh and crisp!

I was super pleasantly surprised by the salads. The portion was huge and there was a large variety of toppings with a generous portion too! It was amazing and so delicious!

I've tried the birthday cake milkshake and it's literally insanely delicious. They give you a HUGE slice of cake on top of your finished milkshake! Best part is...if u download the app you get this for free on ur bday!!!

Another tip: when u download the app, you get a gift for a free margherita pizza to use within 4 months! I loved it! 

Third tip: lunch specials are such an amazing deal!!! $10.99 for any pizza with choice of soup or salad. For real, it was so filling and yummy!!!

Well I tried this place again. What a bad decision. I sat at a table by the kitchen and was totally disgusted by the cook who was making sure everything was done right. How dare him call a waitress a "stupid bitch" I will never come here again, if the staff is treated this way are they going to spit in my food? This is a hostile work environment for the waitresses. Don't spend your money here.

In a word: yum! I've been coming here with my family for years now and we always have a great meal. The service really helps this place shine: the servers chat with you like you're good friends which always helps us feel welcome there. This place is a must visit here in Sherwood Park in my opinion!

I came here for their wings night recently. Overall, this location has a nice atmosphere for hanging out with friends. In terms of food, it's good that they don't need you to order a drink to get their wings special. However, the wings were really dry and bland.
Always great food and great service.  We usually go a bit later at night on the weekend and have never had a bad experience.  A good go-to in Sherwood Park.
My son had started golf this year, so we put him in the golf school at Broadmoor.  His swing has improved already. Great clean well kept up coarse, and great food in the club house.

So, here is a disclaimer...I don't usually promote chain restaurants. However, they have their place. If you want consistency, and no surprises. Often chains are good for big family dinners where no one can decide on what to eat, or meeting new people for the first time and you are unsure on what to choose. They are the safe bet. I have been to Famosos 3 times in the last month to test this theory out and I was pleasantly surprised. I ordered two times the roasted cauliflower pizza- 
 Extra virgin olive oil, garlic, oregano, fior di-latte, roasted seasoned cauliflower, green olives, toasted almonds, gorgonzola and Grana Padano. Topped with honey, house made chili oil and a lemon wedge.  I really hope they keep this one on the menu. This pizza is a really lovely balance of spicy and sweet. I also was very impressed with the Antipasto platter - Marinated olives, fior-di-latte mozzarella topped with pistachio pesto, sliced Italian meats, arugula salad. Served with garlic flatbread. The platter was decent but the marinated olives were excellent. My husband ordered the SICILIANA - Oven-roasted Italian sausage, Italian ham, prosciutto twice and enjoyed it both times.  I also love the Fire-roasted Tomato Bisque. Rich, full of complex tomato and basil flavours, this is a warm hug. The thing that didn't work for me was the Cauliflower Artichoke Dip -Roasted seasoned cauliflower, artichokes, cream cheese, cheddar and smoked mozzarella. Oven baked & served with tortilla chips and garlic flatbread. It was fairly bland.  Our servers each time were attentive and quick with the food. This is a place that I would be willing to revisit.

I love Thai food and am faithful to a few common Thai dishes, no matter where I go. My basics are typically Tom Kha Gai (a coconut tomato soup with kafir lime leaves) and satay (typically chicken and beef), which are easy to find but not always easy to get right.

I've been lucky enough to try Thai Together via Skipthedishes (delivery) and also for lunch. I was thoroughly impressed with the flavor and the quality of the food. Value is very good and portions are quite large.

The Tom Kha Gai (small portion) had lovely rich flavorful broth, but was not very spicy. I was disappointed that they did not offer it with shrimp instead of chicken. Portion size was okay, a little bit tiny, but with a coconut broth, you don't need too much. Satay was delicious and the peanut sauce did not disappoint - chicken was moist and flavorful and cooked perfectly.

The restaurant itself is in a busy little area, very popular around lunch time, but the restaurant was very clean, polished and lovely. Service was attentive and efficient. Would definitely revisit again. Sherwood Park doesn't have a lot of options, especially in non-chain restaurants and especially in great quality food - so Thai Together is definitely to be appreciated.

I love Costco!

This location was no exception.  

I still believe that Costco has the best meat in the city (and surrounding areas, since this one is in Sherwood Park).

They also have pretty darn good produce which is surprising for a wholesale store.

But you don't have to buy produce in bulk if you don't want to.  They have small containers of berries and stuff so don't think that everything is bulk and you have to eat bananas 3 meals a day for a month straight.

Costco is great!  I love it and you will too!
Best Burger Baron I've been to the one in Leduc is Garbage but the one in Sherwood park is way better.

I went today based on the reviews I read about Baseline wines. I found the place neat and the staff courteous.  I found their listings on their website did not match the stock that they had in store, particularly the year of vintage and rating.  I also noticed that they had put up ratings for wines that were not even rated yet by Robert Parker, or they had ratings that was from another year which opposed what they had in stock (ie a rating for a cote du rhone from 2010 and they posted this rating for a wine that is 2012).  If you are a serious wine collector, pay close attention to year, vintages, ratings and etc, because I found them to be misleading.

Honestly, couldn't be better.  What a  (terrific) experience: great location (complete with outdoor patio), ample parking, a warm inviting atmosphere with equally fun and affable staff.  And the food was perfect; even your coffee made me want to linger.  I thought your Alberts restaurant was in a class of its own but this new venue tops it by far. Kudos to Rima and Joe!!  Will have to try one of their "Lebanese Nights" cultural immersion (including belly-dancing) someday, too.

This is the only lube place I go to! I moved downtown and still take the time to come to Sherwood Park when I need an oil change. All the guys there are so friendly and helpful!! They always do a great job and I don't feel like I'm emptying my wallet for the service.

Brought my grandkids (ages 5 & 7) here they had a great time picked out toppings for there pizza and watch while it was being made.  The gentleman there was really good with them both kids ate there whole meal.  I also enjoyed my lunch as well.

By far the worst service ive ever encountered. I sat at a table for at least 10 mins before I just went up to the bar and ordered drinks. I sat down and within 2 mins a group of other people sat beside my friend and I and the waitress came over right away. Then completely ignored us. So we decided maybe we should sit inside. We sat there for 10 mins waiting for someone to order our drinks and no one showed up. Insanely disrespectful. The waitress even walked by me, hit my arm, and just kept on like nothing happened. I've never been so ignored in a restaurant ever.

Terrible experience. The owner was rude and condescending. I had never gone there before and thought I would try something new. There is no discretion. The owner barged into the room without checking if I was ready. My bare breasts were exposed and she really didn't care who in the hallway saw me. When I told her the one bra she brought me didn't feel comfortable she told me I didn't know what I was talking about. She then proceeded to tell me she only knows how to fit the perfect bra and didn't think she could help. She had her assistant bring me a few more and when I was looking at myself in the mirror, she told me I was doing it all wrong. That I needed to put my shirt on and her customers would never just have their bra on when deciding on the perfect fit. Lady I was just seeing if I liked the style. I have lost 50 lbs so I have had to do a few fittings over the years. Usually I leave feeling beautiful and confident (which a proper fitting should do). The owner made me feel like a young child being scolded. Thank-you Princess Lingerie for saving the day today.

As a lover of Original Joes from way back, I've got to downgrade it from a 5 star to a 4 star.

I recently went to the Sherwood park location, and while it still had all the things that I loved

Great service
$4 Beers

It had several test kitchen items that I thought didn't have the same food quality that the old items had.

I find that this is a disturbing trend. Original Joes used to be one of the best gastropubs in the city, with huge portions, great food, and fantastic prices.

Now it seems to be trying to skimp on quality at the sacrifice of profit.

Here's 3 recent things I've been told at Original Joes,

1. They don't have half orders of Nachos, and they've never served them. Lies. Just plain lies. Although there full order now are about a 75% of their original size

2. They've never served sides with any entree that isn't burgers. I cannot confirm this 100% as I don't remember .

3. They've always served Sailor Jerry not Captain Morgan. Again. Nope.

So, hopefully this once beloved chain fixes their downward slide before they become the next Boston Pizza.

I recently went to have my eyebrows waxed with my two daughters the lady we had gave the impression that we were bothering her she was not talkative at all. The room was poorly lit it appeared like she couldnt see. My seventeen year old daughter said she will never go there again. I have experienced may Spas in Sherwood Park. Verves, Spa Zonar ,Body and Soul,and Roxx they are all great spas. I attended Spasations as my spouse bought us gift cards for there BUT I will use my cards up and then I wont be back.

This was my first time checking out Nandos new location in Sherwood Park. It is a Portuguese chicken restaurant with a modern twist. You have to try their famous peri-peri sause if you like it spicy and they have other flavoring if you don't enjoy spice. I shared one of their chicken platters with friends and it was deliciously flavorful! The garlic mashed potatoes and coleslaw paired well with the chicken dishes. Throughout our meal several staff members came to see we had everything we needed. It was buisy when were there a lot of people just came for takeout. I will be back again and I'm excited to have a Nandos so close to home!

I've been here a few times over the years, mostly with my parents, and my latest visit was so that they could renew their membership so that was a neat and quick experience for them. I was happy that while we had to wait in line, the process was pretty seamless.

In general, I like Costco and have been to locations in three countries. This location is pretty great in general and while I personally don't have a membership, I'm generally pretty happy that it exists and I'm rather glad that I can occasionally visit with friends and family.

It's good! It's good. We shared a Caesar salad which was very tasty. A bit average, but good. We also murdered a pepperoni and roasted mushroom pizza between us, and that was also good. Littlest kid had spaghetti and meatballs, which I ended up finishing because kids, and that was good. Also good; the oldest kid had a ham-and-pineapple pizza. It was good! Good stuff. Gelato for dessert. Good. Also good.

But the wine is Not Good. Don't have the wine. Not a fan. Probably should have had a coffee instead, or water. Not good. And I'm going to have to chop off a half a star for bringing the food for the adults well ahead of the food for the kids. Like five minutes ahead. Super not good, my friends. Parents hear me on this one.

I mean, overall, good. Good food, good service, that's what counts, but the little things around the edges were not ideal and the meal ended up being spectacularly expensive considering all the little annoyances that compounded. And nothing was capital-g Great.

So excited that Thai together is open again and ready for business! I had a pick up order for dinner with all my favorites including spicy pad thai, coconut rice, Ginger Beef and yellow curry with chicken. All awesome and still serving up consistently delicious Thai food. The service is very friendly and my order was ready for pickup in under 20 minutes. They have a great online menu as well as some weekly specials. I was more than happy to support one of my favourite Thai restaurants during this difficult time. We have to support our local favourites so they will be able to stick around for a long time to come!! A big thanks to all the staff here who are working hard to keep us happy and healthy.

Visited after hearing rave reviews from friends. It's a cross between fast food & restaurant in that they seat you & bring your food to you but you go up to place your order plus get your own napkins, sauces, condiments, & water.  The food was good but the chicken flavour is basically whichever sauce you choose. Garlic mashed potatoes were ok- more butter tasting than garlic. The corn was good (again, the flavour is based on the sauce you choose). The veggies were very good- onion, peppers & zucchini in a tomato basil sauce. We found the portions were slightly small for the price. I ordered only one side as I'm not a  big  eater and found I was still a bit hungry. My spouse ordered two sides and was also a bit hungry at the end.  Just a little more would have been perfect. 
 Service was okay, we felt when we said it was our first time that the one seating us could have explained about the foods rather than having us hold up the line to ask questions when we placed our order. (For example, what are macho peas?). All in all it was okay.

When I went I had a Pad Thai and I was pleased. The dish was not super big but fair. Its was tasty. I spent 10 weeks in Thailand so I can compare pretty well and it they always serve like this they will stay in business... Service was pleasant

Alex really wanted to play darts tonight so out to the park we came!! Double Caesar 8 bucks yummy!! Fries are homemade and yummy!! Friendly staff great neighborhood pub a secret gem of sherwood park. The boys loved it I loved it we will be back for sure!!

Dropped in for a quick bite and a beer on the way to the rodeo, service was prompt, quick and courteous. decided to go with the fish tacos, I was disappointed, not much fish in them, very small, definitely not worth the price !
I love this place so friendly and the food is sooo good and fresh. I can say that it's my new favourite place for breakfast.

Late on a Tuesday.  Open warehouse feel with a bar side and tv screens and a mini curling rink game.  Limited burger menu.  Our waitress with the long blondish hair and the large breast implants in the bar section shorted us in her favour.  The bill was X dollars and 8 cents.  She rounded it up to the next dollar. And shorted us almost a buck.  She is a thief.  Never short the customer.  If you don't have the change you suck it up.  Especially for a chain Restaurant trying to keep their reputation.   Music was too loud too, hard to talk and my ears were ringing later.

Absolutely as delightful as all the other Burger Barons.  Very happy they chose to open in Sherwood Park.  Fries are always tasty, burgers are always hot and fresh.  Prices are reasonable and you can't beat the smiling service you get!
Excellent little place!  Great prices, homemade food & Staff is always super friendly! Love how they have live music every weekend! Customer for life!

Big shout out to sherwood park nandos for providing health care workers with some famous peri peri chicken!! This is very generous and really speaks to the core values of this company. Any company willing to support others at a time where so many are struggling deserves five star review! Thanks a lot guys keep up the great work!!

My husband and I went for lunch today. It was our second time visiting Thai Together. We both ordered off of the lunch menu. I had Red Curry Chicken and he had Red Curry Beef. Each order was $12.50. Very reasonable. Mine came with jasmine rice and he upgraded to coconut rice for $1.25. Both orders came with a veggie spring roll. I just loved my dish. The rich flavours of Thai Curry came through with the perfect amount of spice. I chose the middle spice level of red as I didn't think I could handle the green! There was a nice mixture of veggies in the stir fry. The dish comes plated as a pyramid of sticky rice with the separate bowl of the curry to allow a person to mix as desired. It was a beautifully saucy dish that I will most definitely go back for. The spring roll was hot, fresh and crispy. The only reason I did not give 5 stars is the lack of fountain pop. A can of pop is $2.25. I just had water, but if fountain pop was available I would have had that. Overall, a great atmosphere, friendly staff and delicious food. I can't wait to try the Tom Yum Soup, my absolute favourite Thai dish.

Unbelievably good food.  If you like Thai food then you'll love it here.  My girl is gluten intolerant, they are VERY knowledgeable about the menu and adjusted dishes to suit her with ease.   
Our new favourite Thai restaurant.

Excellent locally sourced and made products. We have a favourite butcher/deli in Canmore and always pined for similar products back home in Sherwood Park. We have lived here for many years but only just discovered Charlie's - we're so happy! Everything we've tried so far, from the sausage to the pork chops to the steak, has been delicious.

I came here during the happy hour. The service was friendly, attentive and relatively fast for a Sunday afternoon. We ordered guacamole and chips, nachos, yam fries, local delicious beer. My friend ordered a burger with friends and I got the tuna poke which let me tell you was delicious. It had tons of flavor, filling and satisfying .

Thai Together has been a great place for my Bride and I to dine at. I have noticed over the 2 years of attending this restaurant the prices have risen substantially. It does not reflect any better service or extra menu items, not even extra portion sizes. I understand there is a cost of doing business, but I tend to think they are banking on more new people coming because it is great food. I hope it works out for them but it has managed to tone our frequent visits back a few notches.
The upside is, you will be well taken care of and the food is quite enjoyable. Try the Curry Grouper....it is spectacular!

Amazing pizza at a convenient location. Very friendly staff/owners. Had the Veggie pizza - added spices made it unique and delicious, also had "Fish Pakora" which was the owners own personal dish, Amazing - enough said. Added In house sauces with added spices made it unique and very tasty. Chain restaurant with its only unique vibe and taste, seriously go here for the Fish Pakora.

Haha, when you get one of their sandwiches they are pretty substantial and I am a big guy. Excellent service, loud with typical TV environment you might come to expect. Well worth it. Always tons of parking around.

Got to love the quality of the pizza here. This location also boasts great customer service. Super friendly and even when busy they are really quick. Need a good pizza? Come here. The specialty pizzas despite being more expensive then other places 'feature pizzas' are fantastic flavour. Worth the extra cost.

Even though it's chain, I love this place. The food is always awesome and they give you a more then generous portion. I've had almost everything on the menu and no complaints. Their house beer is great as well, I love OJs.

Best place ever. 
Great staff, the best brisket you will ever have, and the buns, mmmmm the buns .

Love, Love, Love this restaurant. I eat here all the time, and have never had any issues. Great atmosphere and beautifully designed space.

Service has always been great, food has always been awesome, and the food always arrives quickly.

I have a bunch of allergies and as soon as I mentioned that, they were quick to produce an allergen menu and helped me figure out what I could have. They also made sure to prepare my food seperately, and I've never had a reaction after eating there. (If you have allergies, you know how hard it is to eat out).

Perfect for a date night or a fun night our with friends.

I am updating the review because of the customer service. I left my purse there two weeks ago, but all my things that I use - license, ID, credit card, etc, I keep with my phone which I took with me. However, my house keys and Alberta Health Care card was in my purse. I rarely leave my house without my spouse so the other day when I was going out I realized I didn't have my purse. I felt sick. I phoned the places that I thought I left it at, but I forgot about LOCAL. LOCAL contacted me via Facebook just using my Alberta Health Care card. (all my other ID was in my cell phone holder). I was so impressed so I went back today to grab it and also have a delicious lunch. Thanks so much! Staff here are awesome.

So i have to say i love this little shop and how its a local business. The best part is that Charlie the owner  is a very kind man who would give you the coat off his back if you were out in the cold. Now on to the delectable selection of meat!! I bought a good 100$ worth of deboned hutterite chicken(one of the nice men deboned it right there for me took 10mins), two types of beef jerky (regular and teriyaki), fresh eggs12, two steak cuts( which colleen helped me pick out since i hate having lots of fat in my steak she chose a new York style of cut for me which apparently has less fat marbling in it), two types of perogies cottage cheese and cheddar, and a couple pounds of bison hamburger. Now i have to say that chicken in my lasagna made it that much better tasting with this quality of chicken. And the leftover chicken i used for sandwiches just is so much better from the grocery store. The beef jerky my own grandfather likes charlies style of jerky and he smokes his own on the farm! Not gonna lie though i did eat a lot of that teriyaki jerky myself. The fact that a lot of his meats are vaccum packed is a blessing cause i wont be spending as much on my own ziplocs. The difference between the quality of food you get at charlies compared to a chain store like m&ms or sobeys or Safeway is that there is way more selection and you can have your meat specified with the cut to what you'd like for preparing your meal. Also wont have to worry about gmos. They will also butcher any hunted meat (deer, etc) for you as bonus for many hunters. They have smoking chips if you need them with all different flavors for those of you whipping out your smoker soon!. Charlie seems interested in expanding as well and starting on some ready meals like pot pies and whatnot can't wait for summer to kick into high gear with bbqing Charlie's yummy selections!!

Went here for lunch with a friend and had a great burger, fries , and Gravy .  My friend had the fish Tacos which I also tried and they were SO good .  It was quite busy and the service was above par and the kitchen was on their game . I will absolutely be returning .

Over performer. 

Exceeded expectations for sure. Food was very good. Service also.  Chop Salad was great as was the Kona burger.

This place was phenominal. The regular prices are on par or better than boutique bra stores, but the sales are something I have never seen before for bra's of this quality. The ladies were professional and honest. Definetly check them out.

The pizza was decent, alright selection of toppings,fair priced and cooked well. Our server I forget his name
but he was pretty cool nice guy so shout out to him

I went to this restaurant previously and the food was decent. However on my last visit I ordered kung pao chicken and potstickers. Kung pao chicken had no flavour whatsoever and the pot stickers were undercooked and doughy. Paid over $20 for these two dishes and I will not be back. Don't know if the owners aren't paying attention as they cook this was a waste of my time and money.  I was the only customer in the whole place.

Owner was so wonderful to us. My friend I hadn't seen each other in forever and they let us stay and extra hour past closing and cleaned up around us before telling us they were closed. We felt so bad but they insisted it was fine. The food was wonderful. Some of the best fresh salad rolls and the Pad Thai was outstanding. My friend has the spicy curry vegetable dish and loved it. Great place and truly fabulous owners
Always good service, consistent food and great beverages. It is also a nice evening atmosphere for a date night.

Absolutely love coming to binhs. Vicky and her team do an amazing job every time. My nails leave looking amazing. The atmosphere she has created is excellent. Her salon is kept in excellent shape, clean and pristine. Highly recommended and will continue to go back!

My Wife loves it here! She from the fire roasted tomato bisque to the caprese salad.... Don't forget the pizza! Service has changed from what it originally was and we like it. There is a great atmosphere for the whole family at a very affordable price! Treat yourself to some gelato on the way out.

I love Famoso! This location is close to home and the staff are wonderful. Service is great for dine in and take out. I prefer dine in because I find the pizza gets soggy fast if we take out... but that's not their fault. Their cauliflower artichoke dip and tomato bisque are basically a good group in itself. :) my only dislike that I've ordered is the marinated olives (not the antipasto platter). Maybe it's the coriander and oil marinade. Not sure, but it's definitely not for me. Everything else though i love. Famoso is my happy place ;)

Sh*t hole, like I can't even bring a coffee in but yet you can buy a drink there and walk around which is bullsh*t, plus I put my mask down for 2 seconds as I'm leaving  to unlock my iPhone because that's how you mostly unlock iPhones and this one lady from all the down a aisle that works there started yelling "put your mask up over your nose" so I told her to get out of my sight and she walked away with the middle finger waving in the air so people go to a different Costco, the one by the airport is way better, there employees are not all up in your face over some dumb sh*t

I decided to go here because I read a lot of good reviews so I was expecting a really good job on my nails. However I was definitely disappointed. While the lady who was doing my nails was sweet and professional she just wasn't that good. She filed my nails so much that it actually burned while she was doing it. I was in legit pain. Once my nails were done I couldn't believe how poorly of a job was done. There was nail polish all over my fingers, my nails were so sharp and the paint job on them is sloppy. It's been 2 days and because she filed them down so much the gel nail has already broken. I definitely will not be going back here.

Good venue , good atmosphere. Did get a fry  that tasted like mold but the fries are frozen so they can't be moldy. Anyway good place can't judge on one French fry .  Manager could have adjusted the bill .. glad he didn't penicillin is more expensive than potatoes..

Top notch local pub!
Cozy and inviting.
Staff are increadiblbly easy going and friendly. They make you feel like you belong instantly.
Food is pretty typical pub fare. My "Yorkies" were not amazing...but they were simple and satisfying.
The culinary highlight of my visit...was my hotdog! 
My cordial waitress surprised me when I asked for a menu with her follow up question of "regular manu...or hotdog menu"
Well...when offered a hotdog menu...I simply must explore!
Am I glad I did! Tuesdays are hotdog night. Big. Juicey franks on soft buns with your choice of about 10 toppings for ~$4.
A second list of about 15 "premium" toppings are offered at 40¢ each! This...I have to try!
I wound up having a great do covered in chilli, fried onions, bacon, chedder & chives. Delicious!
Next time...I'm just going to indulge in two hot dogs!
Will I be back?
You bet!
Great little Sherwood Park pub with real people working there who are personable, welcoming, and friendly.
The world needs more Oscars!

If you get a chance to eat in at this location instead of driving thru I recommend it. You get a strong family vibe from the staff (pretty sure they are family) and everything is made to order. The dining room is nice and open. 

The location is probably the biggest problem, there's been a lot of restaurant turnover in that spot since it can be hard to access (if you don't come in off of Wye road you have to go THROUGH the Mazda dealership parking lot) 

The food is always great quality. My personal faves are the Pomo burger, deep fried mushrooms and a lime milkshake (sounds so weird but it's so good!)

I met up with a girlfriend here the other day and from the name I really didn't realize I would be walking into a log cabin type of pub. It wasn't quite my vibe and the food was ok. The buns were fresh but it makes the burger so much soggier than a usual hamburger bun as I could barely hold it all together. We shared the local burger and the hot chick sandwich, nothing to brag home about and nothing stood out for me to remember the meal by. Would probably not return again.

I drive in from out of town to get an oil change with them. That's how much I trust them. They are very open about any questions or concerns.
 
They only do oil changes and filters but do a good job of it. And they only use premium  quality oil and filters. 
Great and friendly service.

Friendly service and great food. The restaurant has an updated look. The curries on the menu are flavourful and adequately spiced. This restaurant is great for take out. I will often call and, by the time I get to the restaurant to pick up my food, it's already ready with no wait.

This is one of the best places for Thai food in Sherwood Park! It has a different location now as they just moved a few km down the road but same great taste. I love ordering their ginger beef and pad thai dishes they never disappoint as well as the curry here is awesome. They usually give you 10% off your order when picking up or some free spring rolls, but if you're dining in the new layout and decor allow for a very comfortable and stylish dining experience. The service is always friendly and I will continue to come back here for more dishes of delicious thai food!

Went for breakfast this morning. It was fabulous. We were the first to arrive and sat by an open gas fire pit on the enclosed patio area. It was bright and inviting, cozy by the fire. We ordered a spicy horseradish virgin Caesar and a non-alcoholic beer with a side of guava juice. Breakfast was the power bowl and braised beef & bacon hash. Really good savory flavour combination. I recommend breakfast/brunch here for sure. See pics, hopefully they do the food justice. 
Also .. we went for dinner one night and had the fried chicken ramen and ahi tuna poke bowl. Both were really delicious, and I'd order them again.

New staff.  Friendly.  Server Kaitlyn is a sweatheart.  Most meals come with 2 sides.  Cosy inside. Many TVs for sports.  Air conditioned.  Small patio. Free parking. Happy hour 2 to 5. Many booths and high tables.  Modern.  Windows to the outside.  Food is varied and good with salads.  Beef dip is huge!

ThIs is the armpit of Starbucks.  The worst location in the entire Edmonton area.  Terrible service.  They get your coffee wrong at least half the time. The wait in the drive through is a minimum of 5 minutes per car.  If there are 4 or 5 cars in front of you, it's a MINIMUM half hour wait.  And then the staff will probably get your coffee wrong and have to remake it.  

I have been here several times thinking it was new store problems.  But it's not.  The store is so inconsistent you just can't predict how it will go.  

My sister in law was a frequent customer here until yesterday when the Barista screamed at her (after she pointed out they got her coffee wrong AGAIN) and then THREW a large coffee against her car.  This is unacceptable behavior in an adult, let alone in someone working with customers.  

Neither of us will be back.  Ever.  She and I have both given them more than enough time to work out the new store kinks and hire some decent staff.  Apparently it's never going to happen.

This is a casual Breakfast and lunch restaurant and lounge.  More comfort style of food and country style of food.  As you can get liver and onions. Prices are very good.  They have a large patio and happy hour.  Renovated inside.  Friendly hard working staff.  Given the inexpensive prices I recommend tipping well.

I love Charlie's Place. The main draw for my family is their pastrami/Montreal smoked meat Saturdays which has fed many a large man on game night at our house over the years.  I've also picked up many tasty meat treats along the way, like smoked turkey legs, beautiful little pork cutlets, smokies, steak and kidney pie (great pastry!) and ground beef.  I find myself purchasing more things recently to support local, but also because the prices are competitive and the quality is high. The staff is also friendly, despite the somewhat snarky artwork on the building (ever think that growing up on a farm might be a privilege few get to experience these days?). Forget all that Albertan bluster and enjoy the product. Highly recommended!

Good pizza place. They cook their pizza differently by cooking there pizza by a fire oven for only 30 seconds. Authentic Italian pizza at its best. My only complaint is that the last two times  I went there the bottom of the pizza was black. This really ruined the experience for me. Has anyone else had this happen?

Had a very nice lunch at Oscars pub, ordered the two piece fish and chips and a Guinness. The fish and chips were very good and I love that it comes with a side of peas instead of coleslaw. 

Oscars pub is a very cool little pub, when we were there it was very quiet which was nice, they didn't have ridiculously loud music playing or a bunch of TVs with a bunch of sports playing, it was a very nice location to sit back have a great meal grab a pint and visit.

I definitely recommend this place and will 100% visit again.

It's Tims.
You get what you need..and that's about all I ever expect!
Been here many times. 
It us as consistant as any in the chain. I don't frequent any locations enough to be a regular anymore, but have never had any real problem here.
If you need a "Double Double" fix...this is as good a location as any.

A newer restaurant bar on Wye Road in Sherwood Park.  The food is a notch above the usual pub food.  We had the pulled chicken sandwich.  Was quite good with the vegetable fixings.  Wraps were good with good mix of meat and veggies.  Comes with 2 sides.  Coleslaw and sweet potato fries were good.  Also had the garlic mashed potatoes which were fantastic, really moist and tasty...how do they do it?  Beer is always reasonably priced with $5 specials it seems every evening.  They have modern decore and several TV screens.  It is not a big place but is open and does get noisy.  The place is always busy which is a good sign, but you do have to line up at suppertime on weekends.  Seems to be always open past midnight on weeknights for sports teams.

Absolutely hated my experience here. The service was rude and Donna's lack of attention and care left 3 of my  nails bleeding plus she burnt me on top of one finger. The shape was crooked, the color was uneven and she was so rushed that her husband had to chip in and help out on my nails as she was going back and forth between clients. This is all with an appt. booked a week in advance. None of this experience was relaxing or enjoyable. NEVER EVER going again and I would highly suggest that you think twice before spending your hard earned money here. First thing I did after I left was book an appt. at another salon to fix what Donna did.

I have been eating at Thai Together for years going back to their old location. The food is authentic and delicious. It is consistently prepared and there is a huge selection of items to choose from. I would say the larger the group of people you dine with the better the experience as you are able to try a variety of items. The curry dishes are amazing and comforting. The Pad Thai is delicious and the green beans to die for. The staff are friendly and accommodating. I have eaten in, picked up, used delivery service and I have been thrilled always with the attention to detail and how consistent the food and service are.

This might be the Costco location I visit the most frequently now that I have a membership. Costco is a warehouse store and they all have a certain amount in common: you need to have a membership, the wares are pretty similar, there are lots of free samples, the food court is pretty busy, and it is often very easy to spend more money than expected. This location is no exception. That said, I'm pretty fond of this location: the food court seems to have ample space and the aisle are familiar to me when I visit, unlike some of the other Costco locations I've visited.

I got yelled at 3 times in one trip. Once to get to the back of the line ( I was trying to get to the pharmacy, not cut in line), once a worker yelled that there was a limit of one paper towel per membership (I only had one) and once for wanting to go to the cashier (since there was only on person online instead of a massive self checkout line. I know there is a pandemic, but it doesn't give a right for anyone to yell at me. I won't be renewing my membership

Costco is wonderfull if you need...and storage space for all things bulk.
They have reasonably priced electronics, a full pharmacy, food, clothing, books, textiles, housewares, perscription eyewear...
They cover everything in some way shape or form.
I like this store as it is well maintained and...well...close to home.
It's a tough place to "dart into" for an item ir two. 
Inventory changes. Deals come and go...and just to make sure you have to go almost everywhere in the store...products migrate from one isle to the next in some areas.
All in all...I've been a member for years, and am really never disapointed. The imprtant part is actually usung ones membership to justify it's initial cost.

Absolutely awful. I got a full set of French  tips and even a fill a little while after, the service was decent and nails turned out not great but okay. I went back to get them removed, and ended up receiving the worst experience I've ever had in a nail salon. I wasn't getting any other services just the removal for today and it was extremely painful. They used a new nail tip and wedged it under the gels I had on to try and pop it off. When this didn't work they resorted to ripping the gels off with nail clipers, completely shredding my natural nails in the process. I was cut with the filer, my natural nails are ruined and it cost me $17 for the terrible service. I will not be back there and am very dissapointed in their lack of consideration,  professionalism and care.

It's Tims.
You get what you need..and that's about all I ever expect!
Been here many times. 
It us as consistant as any in the chain. I don't frequent any locations enough to be a regular anymore, but have never had any real problem here.
If you need a "Double Double" fix...this is as good a location as any.

The food is really good.  Plentiful vegetables and large portions in our order.  One plate is enough for 2 meals. Staff were very friendly.  Red chicken curry had medium heat.  Bulgogi beef stir fry had soy and some sweetness and low heat.  Complementary rice with each order. Spring rolls were the usual small size and came with a sweet and mild spice sauce.  Inside is nicely decorated with Asian feel.  No patio.  I would order again.
