Decided to take my parents here today (Jul 25,2020) since they've never been...my parents will probably never go anywhere I suggest again lol. 

Took about 5 minutes before the waitress even said hi to us. When she finally did come I asked for ours waters ASAP and we each ordered a beer on tap, going on 15 minutes later......no water or beers. She finally came to tell us that the keg was being changed out..... again, I asked for our waters and to my surprise....no water. Didn't ask if we wanted to order food either. 
She came back a third time after spending a good 5 minutes chatting up a table of guys. We then asked if we could have brunch menus since we still had 30 minutes until brunch was over. AGAIN.... I HAD TO ASK FOR WATER. Finally a waitress (not ours) brought our drinks to the wrong table and then brought them to ours. This has to be the WORST service I've ever had in a long time. Also, I found all the waitresses liked to gather at the bar talking instead of being out on the floor assisting clients. 

Also note the brunch menu which is also on their regular menu is only 0.25 cheaper. It's laughable. 

The food was meh. I'm confused as to why a table of 4 seated after us and had the same server had their food and drinks already. 

We had asked the girl who brought our food for ketchup, she politely said sure and proceeding to go stand by the bar and never came back, we had to wait for our server to stop by and ask her for ketchup. 

I have to agree with another review, confused about the crowd. We were seated by a loud obnoxious booth of 4 with a baby while they dropped F-bombs and got wasted. Charming. Will not be back.....Ever.

I always enjoy this place when we go.  Nice atmosphere, good service. 

The pinche beef tacos and the nachos are very good.  
For brunch the braised beef hash is also good.  LOCAL is a nice go-to with good food.

Without a doubt the worst nachos I've ever been served. There was nothing on them, they have made the order for two people now from being for 4 people, for 18.00 
Don't waste your money, was a total bust !

The only thing saucy here is the owner, sessile's? Attitude  
The owner tried to tell me he remember's every  single customer and every single order, he didn't remember me so he wouldn't give me a refund or remake my meal. Said their Edo doesn't even come in the bag I brought everything back in (which was a 7/11 bag) and fought me on every corner. Said I ate all the meat out of it... it was just mixed up. There was same amount of chicken there MINUS ONE BITE  Kay. Guess you're just stingy in the chicken then.

Great little golf course. My first time golfing this course and maybe it's because I golfed a great game but I quite enjoyed this course. Course was clean, greens were very nice.

The people working were following all of the covid rules, felt very comfortable in their clubhouse. They have an area to drop off golf cart, guessing so they can clean and sterilize them before the next golfer uses it. 

Very close to home and I will definitely golf this course again.

Nice local sports lounge.  Has an outdoor patio.  Food is quite good.  Booths and tables.  They have happy hour after work and evening.  Friendly staff.  Quesadilla was good but it comes with chipotle sauce which is just oily salad dressing.  Yuk. They should bring back sour cream!  Beef dip is amazing with fresh sautéed onions.  Salads are good.  Free parking.

I've been frequenting Charlie's since they opened whenever I'm in the market for some higher quality meats for entertaining...or just to treat myself and family to damn good food. 
The cuts of meat are far superior to what you can find in any grocery store. Aged to perfection and tender. 
So very good.
The staff are friendly and very helpful. Always willing to educate and offer their expertise when questioned.
They offer farm fresh eggs, pies, perogies to name a few.
Pleased with everything I have bought here. 
We will be back....and back again!

Excellent. Everything really. Good hard working family. The stuff has never let me down. I have 5 charcoal bbqs and I have had every damn kind of meat on each one. Look up 5 stars...every little chicken wing and sausage 5 stars. Go there now!

This Costco location is one where I feel safest when in-person shopping this pandemic. Our most recent trip here was very good as it wasn't busy at all (it was a Thursday evening) and the store was clean and bright. We picked up photos from the photo centre (easy to order online and the quality was marvelous!) and had a good checkout experience also. Yes they were short on paper products (what location isn't, these days?) but we weren't seeking them out. I was quite impressed with their selection of gift baskets and was happy with the adherence of other customers and staff to the physical distancing and mask wearing requirements. I rarely leave my home these days so the times when I am indeed out and about I am that much more aware of things with regards to the pandemic. We were also quite pleased that when they were out of stock of an item that we were seeking for the holidays, the staff were able to look up the availability in other warehouses and let us know the cost. It turns out this item was the same price when ordered on costco.ca so we eventually went that route but it was exceedingly helpful to know the local availability as well! I really look forward to the pandemic ending but having stress-free shopping experiences here (among others is really helpful!

Original Joe's has the best fish & chips with dill dip and amazing tarter sauce. We get it for take out and bring it home to reheat it in the air fryer. After just a couple minutes the fish and fries are just as crispy as when they came out of the deep fryer.

I purchased a pair of glasses in March of 2020 from the optical department at Costco Sherwood Park. I was very happy with the fit and the ease at which I was able to adjust to my new progressive prescription. Unfortunately, the arm broke completely off last month (Oct 2021). I went to the store and was told that the glasses were not able to be repaired and I was past the warranty. I was informed that the warranty was from one year from date of purchase. Basically, I was out of luck. I had made the initial purchase on my MasterCard, and I knew that MC would double the warranty, so I wanted to move forward with starting the claim. I required a copy of the store warranty policy, and a letter stating that the glasses were non repairable. I returned to the store to get the required documents, and was told by the optical manager (Scott) that they do not issue these documents. My initial reaction was pretty negative, as I feel that it was an issue with the glasses poor durability (the arm broke while I was cleaning them, not through any sort of accident), but Scott went ahead and allowed me to pick out a new pair at no cost to me. I know he did not have to do this, and I really appreciate the fact he went above and beyond the store policy to ensure my satisfaction. He really made my day, and I am more than happy with the service I received in the matter.
An accidental find while looking for a butcher shop in Sherwood Park... hot corn beef brisket and coleslaw and buns to die for!! We will be back!

I met Vicky the owner, and she does the most beautiful nails at such a great price! She believes in making sure her prices are reasonable and giving great service! This is mostly a family run business about empowering women! I've been getting specialty Balayage nail techniques at 50% of what other places offer! Spending time with Vicky is like coming to see a friend, she's the sweetest and I always look forward to seeing her!
Always great food and great service.  We usually go a bit later at night on the weekend and have never had a bad experience.  Definitely our go-to!

This is now the second time my husband and I have stopped in with our 4 month old baby for a bite after swimming and both times were spectacular enough to write home about, but I'll write it on Yelp instead.

Where to start...

The atmosphere of LOCAL reminds me of being on a trip somewhere cozy, like on a winter mountain ski trip after a long day of skiing and you're warming up by the fire and sipping a crisp porter while taking in the friendly surroundings. The first time we went was on a weekday evening after the dinner rush. We got to pick a seat on their patio which is completely closed off by glass, which gave us a spectacular view of an unexpected lightning show. The patio also features a cozy fire to keep warm by. 

The menu boasts a wide variety of dishes, offering a bit of something for everyone. Although there was a lot to choose from, I sheepishly ordered the same dish both times which was the fried chicken ramen. I swear if you are a ramen lover like me and you tried this dish, you would reorder it too, because daaaamn. The fried chicken ramen is loaded with delicious miso broth, charred corn, slurpable (is that even a word?) noodles and is served with a side of perfectly battered fried chicken. I'm almost drooling remembering it. My husband had the fried chicken sandwich with a side of yam fries and when I asked him if it was delicious, he mumbled "mhmm" through a mouthful of food, but I'm pretty sure that meant it was husband approved.

For the thirsty folks, the drink menu features a wide selection of beers on tap with a few rotating seasonal beer options, a great selection of wines, coolers, basic cocktails and a few signature cocktails. The first time we went I wanted something non-alcoholic and was pleased to see that they actually have a few non-alcoholic cocktail options. I found the pricing on the non-alcoholic drinks to be a bit expensive, but that's honestly my only complaint. I tried one anyway called "Spritzing Image", which I could have easily had ten of it it wasn't for the price tag. It tasted like a summer day, with notes of watermelon, cucumber and peach on a ginger staff. My husband being a bourbon guy, tried the Old Fashioned which he also enjoyed. The second time, I got another Spritzing Image, and my husband got the Sherwood Sour, which after I tasted it I wished I had also gotten. If you like whisky sours, you should definitely give that one a try.

 The service overall was great. Our server was friendly, prompt and the second one told me I had a cute baby, so she gets extra points. I apologetically did not get either of their names, but both servers were wonderful. I also need to rave about how quickly the food arrived. The first time I thought it was just because there weren't a lot of people there, but the second time was busy and the food arrived equally as quickly, which I was stoked about because I was hangry. 

*Arnold Schwarzenegger voice* "I'll be back"
Love Costco and this location is my favorite because is not as crazy busy as other ones!!!  And now they have self check out!!!!

There's no such thing as zipping in and zipping out of Costco. So many times I'd love to grab a quick thing on my lunch break, but I know I'll be standing in the checkout line for 25 minutes. Especially frustrating when 3 tills are open and another 5 or 6 are closed. There seems to be more than enough staff milling around to open another till, but no joy. Something must be sacrificed to obtain that cheap bulk bag of Hersey's Easter Eggs, and that is 1 hour of your valuable time.

This place is great. I've always been able to drive right in, wait times are minimal, helpful guys work here, they have always been honest and good to deal with. You just hang out in your car for a few minutes and BAM! Your oil is changed. Good prices, I would rather come here than a dealership.

Warning!  Cheese burger is made with processed cheese! Yuck!  Not stated on the menu.  Otherwise this is a nice open place with modern feel.  Numerous TVs for sports.  Booths and high tables. Portion sizes are good.  Most meals come with a choice of 2 sides. Beef dip is huge.  There is a small patio. Servers were pleasant.  Nice washrooms.  Ample parking. Air conditioned. I would return. Too bad about the burger tho .

I made a 11am appointment for polish change. When I arrived I signed in and sat down. All the technicians had clients.  After about 5 min one asks if they can help me. I said I had an 11am appointment. She asked if I could wait. I asked how long. She said an hour because they had people in the chairs already. I left. 

Binh's takes walks in and works on a first come first serve basis. They do not honour scheduled appointments.  There were two other ladies waiting as well who also had 11 am appointments. 

There are way too many nail choices in Sherwood Park to have to deal with their bad service. The good thing is I got an opportunity to try a different salon.

Seriously impressed with Firecrust as their pizzas taste sooo good!

I have now tried both the types of pizzas they offer (build your own vs chef created) and I enjoyed both experiences. I even liked the plain margherita pizza I tried here because their crust and high quality cheese are the best parts.

I think my favourite pizza that they offer on their menu is the prosciutto arugula because it has a super mild yet delectable overall flavour as it comes without tomato sauce. I also enjoyed the pizza I built with six toppings haha, I definitely overloaded it a bit though. You can never go wrong with their fior di latte cheese and prosciutto toppings 

One thing i am not a fan of is the milkshakes but I'm definitely not the right audience for those anyway. I think children will really enjoy their over-the-top milkshakes as a special treat! 

So thankful for yelp to introducing me to the place as I can't imagine going all the way to Sherwood park otherwise. But the pizzas are definitely worth the drive.

Love Charlie, love the food and love the philosophy.  That being said, the arrogance and rudeness of his daughter when you go in is unforgivable.  Reading past reviews shows that this is a pattern.  I reached out so I could speak to Charlie and got a response, from you guess it, his daughter.  Again, full of arrogance and attitude.  Such a shame.
Great place. Great prices. I love the bacon! Fresh and frozen food at good prices. I think this is a wonderful butcher shop. Ran well

I never write reviews on anything but I had to for this place. Do not go here!!!! I repeat do not. I went here as a walk in and with no appointment and maybe that was my mistake in the first place because she rushed through my nails in no time. The result as you would think was horrible. Super chunky and grossly shaped. My fingers were pulled and shaken every which way harshly. So disappointed and never going back.

I am writing this review just because every time we go the owner is so nice and always asks us how our meal was. I've only had their donairs with the garlic sauce and they are delicious. Prices are great. Thanks for the great customer service.

Really hate the experience at this Costco.  So many great staff but the few horrible ones and horrible managers are all you remember after a visit.  I feel bad for the great employees that try to make it a good experience.  Good thing there is several other Costco stores nearby for my Costco fix.

My husband and I had dinner here last night. We both had the lasagna. Portion size and presentation was good. We found the lasagna noodles to be overcooked to the point of being mushy. The ingredients in the lasagna all looked fresh but the overall flavor was lacking anything memorable. We weren't overly impressed with our first visit but will give them another try.

Honestly.... 90% of my rating is based on the atmosphere and decor.  I should have taken a picture because it looks nothing like the picture on here now.  it's so rustic and inviting.  I'll definitely go back, even though the food was not particularly outstanding.

i felt like i needed to try the perogy poutine.  it was a mistake.  Perogies were rock hard, and the whole thing was pretty dry.  it was better once i asked for some sour cream for it.  

My friend got pancakes and bacon and they were good.  The little man with us got a grilled cheese sandwhich and he gave it a good review.

The server treated us like we were her friends.  But... not in a good way.  i was getting really frustrated with her actually.

Third time going to Nando's and won't be back. 

1st time was ok... nothing spectacular but not terrible. 

2nd time I was going to get a family pack to bring home for dinner. The menu inside has different prices than the online menu- quite a bit higher ($12-$20). I didn't realize this until I went inside to order and was told they would only honor the higher prices for shareable meals.  I left and grilled my own chicken at home. 

3rd time I stopped by yesterday for lunch with my toddler. Ordered a kid's meal and 1/2 chicken with a salad for me.  Food was still ok... nothing great but not bad. Kid's meal chicken with the sweet sauce and vegetables was still too spicy for my 4 yr old to eat. 

The younger server was sweet, very kind. Older lady (possibly manager) came off rude when the credit card machine wasn't working with my card- made the comment "Don't you just have tap?" And seemed to think it was the fact that my US card was why the machine wasn't working. ( It wasn't, because the second reader they used worked just fine.) 
My daughter's glass hadn't been washed and still had lipstick prints on it... had to ask for a clean glass. My glass wasn't really clean, but I didn't want to continue to complain so I just used a straw. 
Flies were all over and kept landing on my food, which was an annoying turn off. 

In addition, food is overpriced for what you get- nothing special here. Won't be back.

I guess it was fine but nothing special. The room was quite small and clausterphobic. I absolutely hate getting short changed on my hour long massages. I make a point to be there 10 minutes early for my appt. but they didn't take me in until 5 after, the by the time I was only the table it was 12 after. She tried to end the massage at 2 minutes to the hour. I reminded her that we started late...she seemed really annoyed but did finish. This is a common occurrence at Spasation, I have visited two other locations and had the same experience. Don't advertise it as hour long if it is really only supposed to be 45-50 minutes.
Very impressed with the service , cleanliness and professionalism. This will be my stop for oil changes. These guys are good- real good!!
Still a great place with friendly waitresses and good food.  Regular beer specials.  But I don't like that they now charge $16.50 for nachos and that is without any meat!

Pizza Box...

The pizza is very average. You will see what I mean.

The donairs are not good. 

- Red onion - does not work in a donair especially when it is cut in 1" cubes. Burns your throat with onion.

- Romain lettuce - because it was cut small enough it actually worked ok in the donair.

- sweet sauce, might wanna check your recipe. It's more like Italian dressing.

- donair meat, has good flavour! Unfortunately the meat in my donair was cut in 1" or larger cubes and was not crispy. It was like eating a donair with a hamburger patty in it.

Overall I think I'm done with Pizza Box. If I want food with no care put in to it at all I can try a restaurant I havnt tried before. At least then there's a chance it could be good.

My first experience with Firecrust was at the Yelp event. However, I've been coming back ever since and seriously prefer it over Blaze. I love the authentic experience of seeing the food made in the oven imported from Naples. I don't think you see those ovens very often.

I usually make my own pizza when I'm there. I haven't had a chance to try any of their menu creations. I think I just enjoy picking the toppings myself. I like that the crust is nice and thin, so you don't feel too out of shape when you're eating there.

Every time I've come to this location I've experienced great service. Absolutely nothing to complain about and I will continue to come here when I'm in Sherwood Park!

This is a review of the tire center.
It's bad. Very very bad.
Think of it as a "non costco" thing.

If you are a regular lover and fanatic of all things Costco and Kirkland like I am, anything less than 5 stars is not acceptable.

The tire center has average prices, poor service, and really no reason to go in. As a huge Costco fan, I'd say it's even more disappointing. 

Go to Kal Tire instead. 

Hint. You can price match Costco tires at Kal tire...so you get the better prices (about $100 off) and the better service.e

Stopped in for supper had the local burger and regular fries they were great!!! Service was excellent food arrived quickly. Waitresses were cheery and attentive.  Large outdoor patio was the best on a hot summer night

I went here for lunch this past month. Loved the big open concept of seating. Soothing wood features makes this a place to stay and chat. They also have a patio. I haven't been here at a time that I could use it, but it seems like it would be a great place to have some drinks in the fresh air. Only thing was I thought the TV screens were distracting, I could have done without them. 
It was pretty busy for a Tuesday lunch, but our server was prompt and friendly. I liked the menu. It had many diverse items where a vegetarian and a meat eater could both find choices that they like. I chose the Malaysian Curry Rice Bowl - Grilled chicken, coconut curry, cilantro scallion slaw & crispy onions and  whatever the beer was on tap. While my friend chose the The LOCAL Burger - Two grilled patties, melted American cheese, caramelized onions, tomato, shredded lettuce & secret house sauce. The food came quickly and it was really tasty. I thought my bowl was done really well. I loved the mild curry flavour and the crunchiness of the slaw. The chicken was juicy and moist. It was a really great combination of textures and flavours. My friend really loved her burger. (And her fries were hot and tasty too, I might have snuck a couple). Definitely would come here again and try some things on the menu.

Cavoletti pizza is very good, might actually be my favourite pizza. It's the right right amount of sweet and salty. 

We also tried the cauliflower artichoke dip. It was also very good accept their portions are way out to lunch. You get a massive container of artichoke dip and four pieces of garlic flatbread? So if you order this pick up a bag of tortilla or pita chips to help eat most of the dip.

This company is racist. They wanted me to come in. They found I was white and female. the blocked my number so I called from another phone he answered and lied. They says we checked you out on face book and your not the right person for them. there no posts but pictures and basically calling me fat

Please go here. Last night got the brisket take out supper. A huge steaming pile of sliced brisket and I litre of yummy home style slaw. Plus the best biggest buns ever. Sooo fresh. 
For $15. Me and my meat loving wife had brisket sliced perfectly for supper AND lunch. 
This place also serves AMAZING steaks. Get them to cut 2 1/2 inch New York strip steaks for family reunion. So tender and juicy. 2 x better than the Keg 10 x better than Montana's. 
Plus don't forget the beef jerky. 
Barely made it the long 10 min drive home. Mmmmm
Please treat yourself. You gotta shop here. And no I don't work here, but I wish I did. Great staff, superb service. 
Ps
The other 1 star comment please disregard. All the staff treat you top notch.

This was literally the worst spa I have ever been to in my life.  I got a micro derm facial. The girl went in and out of the room about 10 times.  She didn't not explain anything.  The machine quite obviously was not working and nothing was mentioned.  The facial was suppose to be 60 mins.  All together it was probably 20 mins.  I am actually embarrassed for them. That was horrible I will never go back and will make sure that everyone I know never goes

One of the worst Costco locations. Regardless of where you go during the day or evening it seems like it is difficult to find parking. Driving in the parking lot of a pain too; there's a ton of short rows and lots of pedestrians. Once you get in the store things aren't much better. They never have enough lines open. It's no uncommon to see lines of 10 or so carts. The line at the cafeteria is generally long. And the staff that works there is inefficient too. The worst thing I have noticed about the cafeteria staff is they wear the food prep gloves inappropriately. Wearing gloves gives staff and patrons a false sense of cleanliness. I have witnessed multiple staff members wear a pair to make someones meal, go to the back touch a box, touch the cafeteria door and then go back and continue making food.

Poorly run place.  The younger heavy set server will not post hours on the door.  She locked the doors at 9:00pm tonight, no sign posted nothing.  She has done this before too.  local sports lounge.  Has an outdoor patio.  Food is quite good.  Booths and tables.  They have happy hour after work.  Friendly staff.  Quesadilla was good but it comes with chipotle sauce which is just oily salad dressing.  They should bring back sour cream!  Beef dip is amazing with fresh sautéed onions.  Salads are good.  Free parking.

After being treated poorly by Real Deal meats for the last time I figured I needed to find a new butcher shop. Best decision I've ever made! I love that you can see everything that is going on here. And I was able to make special requests for cuts and quantities. The pork chops! Best I've ever had. And their beef jerky is to die for. Wouldn't recommend anywhere else.
Gluten free options, quick and friendly service every time. Close to home and work :)

It is a pub for locals.  Older crowd. They have music on the weekends.  Darts.  Trivia night. Good beers. Kind of English style. Dated decor.  2 TVs for sports. Servers were quite pleasant.  No drink menu so you don't know cost til you get the bill.  The food was disappointing.  Our burgers were frozen supermarket patties.  And the cheese in the burgers was processed; including the mozzarella. Yuck.  If we had known we would not have ordered. The Caesar salad had too much dressing. My A&W Teen burger tasted much better with all beef, real cheddar and bacon. So only 3 stars for me.  A good place for a couple beers, but I am eating elsewhere till they find new cooks.

I had my nails done at Donnas last week. I gave the technician specific instructions on how I wanted my nails done, she didn't do one of the things I asked. In short, she completely ruined my nails. I phoned yesterday to ask them if they could remove the tips and shellac. I also indicated TWICE that because I had paid $102.50 just days before, that I shouldn't have to pay for the "fix". The girl on the other end of the phone said ok and booked me an appointment. Close to the end of the "fix", the technician indicated that there would be a charge. I was so distraught that I left and didn't take my coat. I walked back in to get my coat and they wouldn't give it to me. I stood outside for 30 minutes waiting for my ride, without a coat, while Donna, her very rude husband and the rest of the staff watched me freeze. I don't expect any thing for nothing but be it that we had discussed the terms of me coming back in for them to fix there botched manicure, that I had paid 102.50 just days before, I would not have gone back had I been told that they were going to charge me to fix my nails. To have me stand outside in the cold while they refused to give me my coat for 30 minutes, is border line criminal. There are many facts that I have left out of this review for the sake of time and space. I was yelled at by the technician and Donnas husband, this establishment is disgusting.

Fresh meats, sausages, bacon, and the aroma coming from this place was incredible. 

They have occasional deals which are posted on Facebook which sell out pretty fast. And for good reason. The meals are worth every penny, delicious, fresh and an incredible deal.

I ordered the bbq ribs and they were so tender and juicy. One slab was slightly overcooked but for the most part they were amazing. We liked our fingers with every bite. The meals are easily good for 3-4 people. For $24 we got 2 slabs of ribs,  hot potatoe salad loaded with bacon and a gigantic portion of coleslaw. At any restaurant it easily would of cost $60 plus dollars. On weekends they smoke some brisket or Montreal smoked meats and I definetly want to try them. 

I ordereda fresh garlic sausage and it was so delicious with a hint of spice which was perfect for breakfast and in pastas!!! Gotta try this place if you haven't. Its a hidden gem.
